edition.title: bod kyi tshig mdzod chen mo (tshig)
edition.author: Ngam ring blo bzang bstan dar

edition.title: [nges tshig sgra don]
edition.author: Ngam ring blo bzang bstan dar

f.d: bod yig gsal byed dang po 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mgrin pa dang, byed pa mgrin pa, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa nang phrad, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra med/ 1. 1) ming gzhi'i pho yig cig / 2) rtags mtshungs 'dren skabs ga da ba sa ste rjes 'jug phos drangs pa'i ming gi cha shas shig / ga da ba sa...thog ka/ dpyid ka/ rgyal kha thob ka snga mo/ skas ka/ 3) grangs kyi ming mthar bcug nas tshang ma'am thams cad ces pa'i don ston pa'i cha shas shig / snga phyi gnyis ka/ 2. rtsa ba dang, thog ma, gdod ma/ chos thams cad ka nas dag pa/ ka nas ma rdzogs pa'i bar/ ka nas rang chas su yod pa ma yin pa/
/ 1) skya ga'i ming dang de'i skad/ 2) lug gi aa cug gam the ge/ 3) (yul) byis chung gi gyon pa/ (legs) shing dug mo nyung ngam aardzu na/
aindra ni la dang ni ma la gnyis las cung zad nag pa'i rdo sman zhig yin pa 'dis nad ma lus sel/
(legs) shing dug mo nyung ngam aardzu na/

rgya gar nag dang lho mon nas thon pa'i rtswa ldum gyi 'bras bu de'i lo sdong ljang gu dang 'bru'i pags pa mthug cing sul can, dri ro ga bur dang phyogs mtshungs pa 'dis pho mtsher gyi grang nad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la zla ba'i bye ma dang, zla ba'i gzhon nu ma'o, ka tya'i bu dang 'dra,
ka ba'i 'gram nas skyor ba'i shing/ khang gog la ka skyor brgyab/
ka kha thog mar slob mkhan/

mdo khams kyi sa cha phal mo cher ka dang ga gnyis kyi sgra gdangs gcig tu klog pas de gnyis dbye ba 'byed ched mdo smad pas ka la ka kha phye zer la, ka kha dbye'ang zer, kha phye med pa'i ga la kha zum zer la, ga kha sdom yang zer/ ka...ka ga...ka...ka...ga...ga...

srong btsan sgam pos rang gi bka' chems le'u ka pa nas khol bton gyis lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi ka ba shing lo can gyi logs su gter du sbas pa phyis jo bo rje aa ti shas gter nas bton pa'i chos 'byung zhig yin zhing, ming gzhan lha sa'i dkar chag kyang zer/
chu 'khor gyi srog shing 'og gi shing rtsab cig /
gsal byed ka mad sum cu sogs kyis mtshon pa'i grangs rim/
(legs) rdo sman g.yu yi rigs sngo nag cig 'dis dug sel zhing mchin pa'i tsha ba la phan/
1) ka ba'i yar sne'i cha/ 2) chu 'khor gyi srog shing gi 'go la bskon pa'i lcags sgor/ ka rgyan, 'phan sogs ka ba'i logs kyi rgyan cha'i rigs/ ka rgyug sbra dang gur gyi tshugs shing/
nor rdzas spyi'i ming/ bkar bcug ka ca/ 'gro song tshad med btang bas ka ca zad pa/
(legs) ras dkar srab mo zhig / ka ci sgong shun ma/
mdo sbug med pa'i khang pa ka gcig ma/
khang pa ka gnyis ma'i ka ba gcig gi thad nas bar bcad brgyab pa'i khang pa/ sdod khang ka gcig lcam gang ma/
nang du ka ba gcig yod pa'i khang mig / nyal khang ka gcig ma gcig gi sa las med/
lho brag mar pa'i slob ma mchog gyur bzhi ste rngog chos sku rdo rje, mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje, mes ston tshon po, mi la ras pa ste bzhi'o/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dpal yul rdzong gi la zhig /
zangs rag sogs las bzos pa'i gzhong pa/
(legs) sh'akya mu ne'i dngos slob nyan thos mtha' 'khor 'dul ba'i mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pa de nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i gnas brtan pa'i sde'i srol gtod mkhan/
thabs zad pa/ khas mi len ka gtugs byung/
tshig rkang re re'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du ka sogs gsal byed rim par bsgrigs pa'i bstod pa/
aang ki'i tshab tu ka kha'i rim pa bsgrigs pa'i tho yig
1) stong pa nyid/ 2) ka nas dag pa ste thog ma nyid nas dri ma med pa/

gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gyi gnad, le lo can 'bad med du grol ba'i gdams pa ste, gzhi gnas rang byung gi ye shes de grol lugs chen po bzhi'i ngang du gnas pa nyid ngo rang thog tu 'phrod, thag chig thog tu chod, gding grol thog tu bca' ba bcas kyis chos nyid ka dag ma bcos gnyug ma'i don la ye bab sor bzhag gi ngang skyong ba'o/
(legs) 1) shing tshogs can/ 2) chu bya mthing ril lam chu skyar/

mtshan dngos shes rab seng ge'am, spobs pa mtha' yas kyang zer, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag la mdo khams su 'khrungs, rab byung gsum pa'i sa yos la khams dpal yul du ka: thog dgon pa btab, chu byi la 'das pa'i sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zhig / 'brel byed skabs ka ba la sgrog pa'i kha btags
1) bod yig gsal byed kyi sde pa dang po ste, ka kha ga nga/ ka kha ga nga...? 2) legs sbyar gsal byed kyi sde pa dang po ste, ka kha ga gha nga/ ka kha ga gha nga...?
(legs) mdung gi mar sner tha gu btags pa'i mdung zhags/

(legs) sngar rgya gar gyi rgyal po zhig ste, dus rabs dang po'i mjug tu drag shugs kyis rgyal phran gzhan rnams btul nas jan to la zhes pa'i rgyal khab btsugs, tshe mjug tu sangs rgyas skyabs su bsten nas dgon sde dang mchod rten mang po bzhengs, slob dpon rta dbyangs bshes gnyen du bsten nas bstan pa srung skyong byas, kha che'i yul du dgra bcom pa mang po gdan drangs te sde snod gsum las btus pa'i bye brag chen po zhes pa'i bstan bcos bsgrigs/
ka kha'i rim pa ltar bsgrigs pa'i dang po mtshon byed/ deb ka pa/ sde tshan ka pa/
(legs) 1) mi'i thod rus/ 2) bde ba skyong ste, mi'i thod pa las bzos pa'i snod cig /
ka kha'i dpe ste, yig gzugs 'bri klog gi thog mar mkho ba'i ma dpe/
phyogs gcig la rtsig pa med pa'i thog g.yab can gyi sdod gnas/
phyugs 'dogs byed kyi phur pa ring po/ mdzo ka phur la btags/ ka phor, chu 'khor gyi srog shing ka 'go'i 'og gi shing sgor/
1) gsal byed yi ge'i sde tshan/ 2) bod yig gsal byed ka nas aa bar gyi rim pa/
gos chen dang ras sogs las bzos pa'i ka ba'i rgyan zhig /
/ 1) khang pa'i gdung ma 'degs byed/ ka ba ring po/ ka ba sbom po/ 2) srog shing lta bu'i dpe/ 3) phyi'i dbyibs ka ba dang 'dra ba'i dpe/ ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba 'dra/
lha sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi ka ba zhig de'i 'og bod rgyal srong btsan gyis bstan pa dar ba'i smon tshig gi gter sbas yod zer/
lha sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi ka ba zhig de'i 'og bod rgyal srong btsan gyis mthu sngags kyi gter sbas yod zer/
(legs) dpe snod sho ka li'i ming/
lha sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi ka ba zhig de'i 'og bod rgyal srong btsan gyis nor gter sbas yod zer/
lha sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi ka ba zhig de'i 'og bod rgyal srong btsan gyis sgo phyugs dar ba'i smon tshig gi gter sbas yod zer/
kab kob ste mnyen po med pa/ ko ba bskams nas kab kob tu gyur/

1) stod nas byung ba'i shing tog bil ba mo 'di'i dbyibs bum pa dang 'dra bas chu snod byas chog pa zhig / 2) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, yan lag gi skrangs pa 'joms/
ka ba gnyis bar gyi stong cha
(legs) rdo sra zhing dkar ba zhig /
1) (sog) dus rabs bcu bzhi par byung ba'i yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po tha'i ting ye son the mur gyi mtshan/ 2) (legs) me tog pad ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa/

padma'i ngang tshul te dus rabs brgyad par rgya gar shar phyogs su byung ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i slob dpon zhig 'di khri srong lde'u btsan skabs bod du gdan drangs nas hwa shang ma ha ya na'i lta ba ston mun te cig car ba'i lta ba dang, bo dhi sa tva sogs kyi lta ba tsen min te rim gyis pa'i lta ba gnyis ma mthun par rtsod pa byas mthar ka ma la sh'i la rgyal zhing sgom rim rnam gsum yang mdzad/
ka ba mang po yod pa'i khang pa/
bod yig gsal byed ka la sogs pa/ ka mad sum cu/
bod lugs khang pa che chung brtsi stangs ka ba gcig gi sa'i rgya khyon/ khang pa ka mig gsum gyi sa yod/
thabs shes med pa/ mi byed ka med red/ snyan gtser phran bu mi zhu ka med byung/
tshig rkang re re'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du ka sogs gsal byed rim par bsgrigs pa'i rtsom tshig /
ka ba bzhi dang gdung ma brgyad yod pa'i khang mig /
rang 'thag la so 'don byed kyi gzong/

1) gur gyi ka rgyug / 2) (legs) ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas tsha ba sel, glo 'jags, dbang po gsal bar byed, lus stobs gso, tsha ba khrag mkhris la phan pa'i sman gyi nus pa rtsar 'khrid par byed/
bye ma ka ra sogs bzo byed bur shing/
rtsig ngos sogs la 'byug bya'i sa rtsi dkar po zhig /
kha dog dkar po/ bal ka ru/ g.yag ka ru/

1) drang min g.yo skor gyi gtam shod stangs/ skad cha ka re ko re kho na bshad pa/ 2) phar tshur 'then thogs kyis nar 'gyangs byed stangs/ lam bar la ka re ko re byas nas dus thog tu slebs ma thub pa red/
lcags zangs 'gyig sogs las bzos pa'i chu 'dren yo byad sbubs can/
(legs) rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas pa'i bya skad snyan po zhig /
(legs) 1) cha bsags pa/ 2) byang shambha la'i grong khyer zhig /
ka la bya ka ra na
(legs) cha bsags kyi brda sprod pa ste sgra rig par nye bar mkho ba'i cha shas bsags pa'i bstan bcos dang, de rtsom pa po ni slob dpon sapta warma'am, bod skad ltar na bdun pa'i go cha/
rdo'i rigs shig ste de'i phye mas aar 'dam gyi tshab byas chog /
mgo bo'i thod rus/ (legs) mchod rten gyi bang rim 'og tu phyogs bzhir 'gro sa'i sgo re yod pa zhig /
(legs) tsam pa ka'i 'bras bu, sman du spyad chog
(yul) au tshugs tsha po ste, dpral ko mthug po'ang zer/
1) sha mo'i bye brag cig / 2) (legs) gsal byed zer ba'i 'dam rtswa zhig /
(legs) gser spus legs nyes rtog byed rdo nag po zhig /
gos chen sogs las bzos pa'i ka ba'i shubs/
tshig rkang re re'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du ka sogs gsal byed rim par bkod pa'i rtsom yig /
si khron zhing chen gyi dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dpal yul rdzong khongs kyi dgon pa zhig ste dus rabs bcu gnyis par phag mo gru pa'i gcung po ka dam pa bde gshegs kyis btab pa/
(legs) mchod rten gyi bang rim 'og tu phyogs bzhir 'gro sa'i sgo re yod pa zhig /
/ 1) dus nges can gyi bar chad kyi don du go ba'i skag dang 'dra 2) (rnying) glo bur/ kag gis langs pa/ kag ste yong ba/
(legs) mgo nag la rgyab dkar ba'i dur bya zhig /
(legs) sha rngams mthug po'i gting du yod pa'i rus pa chag pa rnams 'don byed kyi skam pa zhig /

/ 1) (rgya) lag rtsa 'phar stangs lta skabs sman pa'i gung mdzub kyis nad pa'i mkhrig ma gnon sa'i rtsa ming/ 2) lag pa'i gung mo'am gung mdzub/ 3) (yul) pha rol ston pa'i spyi sgra zhig / ri 'go kan la dar dmar tshugs/
(rgya) rgya thug dang, bod thug man chi'i sogs sgril byed kyi rgyug hril/
(rgya) gzugs po gan bub bam mgo rting slog pa'i lus rtsal/ kan tur slog pa/
(rgya) sngo tshal skam po dang, mtsho nas thon pa'i sha tshal skam po'i spyi ming/
'og nad pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i kan rtsar don lnga'i nang gi mtsher pa snod drug nang gi pho ba'i rtsa yod/
'og nad pa'i lag pa g.yon pa'i kan rtsar don lnga'i mchin pa dang snod drug gi mkhris pa'i rtsa gnyis yod/

bod rigs rang skyong khul kan su'u zhing chen gyi lho phyogs su yod pa'i bod rigs rang skyong khul zhig ste, 1953 lor btsugs, de'i khongs su zha ho rdzong, rma chu rdzong, klu chu rdzong, co ni rdzong, the bo rdzong, 'brug chu rdzong, len than rdzong ste rdzong khag bdun yod cing, bod, rgya, hus, sa lar, sogs po sogs mi rigs kha shas yod, rang skyong khul gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas sa de zha ho'i gtsos yin/
(legs) tsher ma can te shing sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar la kha zhing tsha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rlung tshad dang bad kan skya bo, glo nad bcas la phan/
ka be ko be'i bsdus tshig
kam mi kum mi'i bsdus tshig
kam me kem me'i bsdus tshig
pags ras sogs gnyer ma 'khums tshul/ ko gyong kam mi kum mi 'di chu la sbongs shig / ko ba kam mi kum mi spus tshad zhan/
mig gdang btsum yang yang byed tshul/ mig nad can gyis kam me kem mer lta/
kar ma bka' brgyud pa'i nang gses kam tshang bka' brgyud kyi ma dgon chags yul/
gting nas dang shugs drag gi tshul/ nad zug kar gyis langs/ khong khro kar kar du langs/
ka re ko re'i bsdus tshig
kar ma bka' brgyud pa'i ming gzhan zhig /
ka ra'i ro myang lta bu'i rtsis te bal yul du dar ba'i char 'bras sogs brtag thabs/
kar ma bka' brgyud pa'i ming gzhan zhig /
nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis kyi khyim bzhi pa, khyim zhag nye ma kar ka ta'i khyim na gnas/
(legs) klu chen brgyad kyi grags shig /
(legs) btso bkru skabs dug 'don byed kyi rdzas cha skyes pa dar ma lo nyi shu rtsa grangs lon pa'i dri chu/
kar ni sgo bzhi'i mchod rten

lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi byang rgyud khrom lam du sngar yod mchod rten sgo bzhi ma'i ming, spyi lo 1368 gong la bod kyi grub chen thang stong rgyal po yun ring sku mtshams la bzhugs myong ba'i gnas shig yin par grags/
dwags po lha rje'i slob ma dus gsum mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud/
kar ma dus gsum mkhyen pa

rab byung gnyis pa'i ltags stag lor mdo khams tre shod gangs kyi ra bar 'khrungs, lo bcu dgu pa nas bzung dbus su dbu tshad dang bka' gdams pa'i lam rim sogs mang du gsan, rang lo sum cu par sgom po ba khu dbon las gdams pa du ma mnos, rab byung gsum pa'i me yos lor khams ri bo cher kar ma pa'i gdan sa btab pas kar ma pa zhes thogs shing, phyis su lha sa'i nye 'dabs stod lung du mtshur phu dgon pa btab pas kar ma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og gnyis zhes grags, rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang lo dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa la das/ kar ma de bzhin gshegs pa, kar ma bda' brgyud zhwa nag pa'i sku phreng lnga pa 'di rab byung drug pa'i shing byi lo la 'khrungs, mtshan dngos chos dpal bzang po yin, mtshur phu'i gdan sa bskyangs, rab byung bdun pa'i me khyi lor t'a ming rgyal po'i yab yum gyi 'das mchod la ris med kun sgrol gyi rim gro rgya cher bsgrubs pa'i yon du rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen chos rgyal zhes pa'i 'ja' sa shel tham bcas phul, shing lug lo la 'das/
(1384-1415)...kar ma pa (legs) 1) 'phrin las pa/ 2) kar ma bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan bla ma sogs/
kar ma pak shi chos kyi bla ma

rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi lor khams 'bri lung du sku 'khrungs pa 'di nyid kar ma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang srid du ngos bzung bas bod la bla ma'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed srol thog ma de nas 'go tshugs, dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang slob spom brag pa bla mar bsten, me lug lo nas mtshur phur phegs te lo drug bzhugs, se chen rgyal pos gdan drangs pa gzhin rong yul gser stod du rgyal po dang mjal, nang sog tu 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs, rab byung bzhi pa'i me 'brug lor mong gor rgyal pos gdan drangs te gu shri'i gsir tham dang zhwa nag gser mdongs can gnang bas kar ma pakshi zhes grags, pakshi zhes pa sog skad du slob dpon zer, lcags sprel lor mong gor rgyal po 'das, go be la gcen gcung nang ma 'chams pa dang 'brel tshul gyi dbang gis btson du bzung zhing rgyang 'bud btang, shing byi lor gu yangs byung ste dbus su phebs pa'i lam bar mdo khams su bstan pa lo brgyad spel, de nas mtshur phur byon, dgon pa rgya cher bskrun, rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug lor 'das/ (1204-1283)...1247...1253...1260...
kar ma mi bskyod rdo rje

kar ma zhwa nag pa'i sku phreng brgyad pa, rab byung dgu pa'i me yos lor 'khrungs, dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i slob dpon yin, rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pas legs bzhad gsung rtsom shin tu mang, shing stag lo la 'das/ (1507-1554)
kar ma rang byung rdo rje

kar ma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku phreng gsum pa'i mtshan te, rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel lo la 'khrungs, kar ma pakshi'i slob ma au rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi slob ma yin, khams dang dbus phyogs su gtsug lag khang du ma gsar bzhengs dang nyams gso, zam pa gsar 'dzugs sogs kyis 'gro don mdzad, rab byung drug pa'i lcags lug lor pe cin la phebs te rgyal po dang btsun mo la dus 'khor gyi dbang chen bskur, shing khyi lor ri bo rtse lnga brgyud nas dbus su byon te bsam yas gtsug lag khang du bzhugs, bka' bstan bod du 'gyur ro cog gsar du bzhengs, mdo sngag gnyis kyi bstan bcos dang rtsis gzhung kun btus sogs mang du brtsams, me byir rgyal po'i bka' ltar slar pe cin du phebs, sa yos lor 'das, de'i slob ma grags pa seng ge ni zhwa dmar pa'i sku phreng dang po yin/

bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma rim byon kar ma'i mtshan can brgyad de kar ma dus gsum mkhyen pa, kar ma pakshi, kar ma rang byung rdo rje, kar ma rol pa'i rdo rje, kar ma de bzhin gshegs pa, kar ma mthong ba don ldan, kar ma chos grags rgya mtsho, kar ma mi bskyod rdo rje rnams so/
(legs) sngar rgya gar du dngul gyi tshab tu sprod len byed pa'i mgron bu zhig ste, dngul zho'am tam gyi dod yin/

1. ming 'ga'i mthar sbyar rgyu'i cha shas shig / ya ki/ ma ki/ pha ki/ spyang ki/ aang ki/ 2. dpa' ngar skyed pa dang, 'bod skul gtong ba'i skad gsang mthon po zhig / ki brgyab nas g.yul sar mchongs so/ mi mang pos ki rgyag gi 'dug / ki brgyab ste 'bod brda gtong/ ki 'debs pa/
1) gza' r'a hu la'i bya rog mgo/ 2) sa bdag cig /
'bod skul gyi ngar skad cig / thag ring nas ki ki zhes pa'i sgra sgrog /
lha gsol skabs lha'i mgo 'phang bstod byed du sgrog pa'i sgra zhig /
(legs) gsang sngags kyi yi dam phur pa/
ki li ki li'i sgra can
dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
1) dpa' ngar skyed byed kyi skad gsang mthon po zhig / 2) snyad brko ba'i sgra zhig /
(legs) 'bras bu lta na sdug cing ro mngar la zos na 'chi ba'i dug rigs kyi shing zhig / yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs 'di, rgyal ba'i dbang pos kim pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/
gyim shing kong jo yi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
1. sgog pa chung rigs shig / 2. thag ring nas 'bod pa'i brda zhig /
don med pa'i ku co'i sgra/

1) 'ur skad dam don med du sgrog pa'i skad sgra chen po/ ku co sgrog / chu phran rtag tu ku co che/ khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na, rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug / 2) tshig rtsub bshad par zur za ston pa/ dmag 'khrug gi ku co sgrog /
mi mang pos bab col du sgrog pa'i skad sgra chen po/
don med pa'i skad sgra chen po 'don stangs/ don med kyi ku co di ri ri byed pa/
thabs zad pa/ ku dam, ku ba'i dam 'bi, chang rag gam snum sogs blug snod/
ku co ding nge ste don med pa'i skad sgra chen po 'don stangs shig /
mi mang po'i skad sgra 'don stangs shig /
rgyob sod ku dir bzhad sgra mtshang 'bru'i tshig /
(rgya) ka bed ming gi rnam grangs shig / rgya mtsho'i steng gi ku ba bzhin, skye bo ngan pa bskyod pa yang/
sgrung nang gsal ba kva kva zer ba'i 'bras bu bshags nas bzos pa'i gru gzings/
(legs) rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi gras shig /
(legs) dus rabs gnyis pa'am gsum pa tsam la rgya gar nub phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi mdo sde pa'i slob dpon zhig /

(legs) 'dam las skyes pa'i me tog cig mtshan mo zla ba shar tshe 'dab ma kha 'byed cing, nyin mo nyi ma shar tshe me tog kha zum pa zhig yin par grags/ ming gi rnam grangs la dgun zla tha chung skyes dang chu skyes, steng 'thung dkar po, 'dab ma'i mdzod, mtshan mo bzhad, zla ba dga', zla ba'i dri, sa dga', sa sgrog sa stobs, sa'i gdu bu, sa mos, si ta, autpala dkar po bcas so,
(mngon) nyi ma/ ku mud gnyen, (mngon) zla ba/

'di ku m'a ra dzi ba zhes pa'i zur chag ste sngar li yul las byung ba'i lo tsa ba chen po zhig 'di'i yab rgya gar ba yin yang li yul byang rgyud kyi rgyal po zhig gi mag par gyur pas lo chen 'di li yul du shing 'brug lor 'khrungs, chung dus su rab tu byung zhing, mtshan gzhon nu tshe ring zhes btags, kha che'i yul du legs sbyar skad dang theg dman gyi chos sbyangs, phyis su theg chen la zhugs te dbu ma'i lta ba la mkhas pa chen po byung, lyang cu sde bzhir yun ring bzhud te rgya bod kyi skad yig la'ang byang chub par mdzad, dgung lo nga bdun pa'i dus su ya'o chin rgyal po hung shi'i khri lo gsum par rgyal sa khrang aan du gdan drangs, der lo bcu gsum gyi ring la rdo rje gcod pa sogs sher mdo che chung dang, dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po, dri med grags pas bstan pa sogs mdo sde du ma dang, mgon po klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rtsa shes, dbu ma sgo bcu gnyis pa, aarya de ba'i dbu ma brgya pa le'u bcu, gzhan yang rgya nag tu klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i sher phyin chen mo bam po brgya pa bcas bka' bstan bam po sum brgya gya bzhi bsgyur, slob ma mang po bskyangs, dgung lo bdun cu la 'das/

nad can nad med gang gi dri chu'i nang du 'byung zhing chu'i rang mdog gis bsgyur mi gtub pa lbu ba'i dbyibs ltar che chung sro ma tsam sogs mdog shas cher skya zhib zhib tu chu yi steng 'og bar bcas la gnas pa de'i ming ste, nang gses su dbye na dbyibs ma nges pa spu dang, bal 'dab, sprin 'dra ba sogs dang, mdog kyang nad khams kyi dbang gis sna tshogs snang ngo/
1) snam bu'i rgyu sgrim byed lag cha 'phang, ..2) bong bu
(legs) rig byed ma ste, sa skya'i gser chos sogs las byung ba'i dbang gi lha mo zhig /
khram rtags te rtags ?'di la zer/

(legs) ngan sel lam rtswa mchog ste, rtswa gra ma can zhig ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas tshe ring du sring ba dang, lus zungs rgyas par byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrus rtswa dang, ngan sel, mchod sbyin rgyan, dag byed, bdud 'dul ldan, gtsang byed, rtswa mchog rtswa dbang, sa gnas bcas so,
(legs) 1) ngan sil bde skyong ste, rtswa ku sha'i 'bras bu smin pa las byung ba'i rin po che'i rigs shig nus pas rims nad sel bar byed/ 2) dung g.yas 'khyil gyi ming gzhan zhig /
rtswa ku sha gdan 'og tu bting nas gtsang sbra mtshon par byed tshul/
rgya gar gyi grong khyer zhig ste sngar sh'akya thub pa mya ngan las 'das sa'i yul de'o/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la skyur, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rgyu ma dang, long ga 'khrog cing 'khru ba sogs 'joms/
(legs) chos rgyal srong btsan skabs gdan zhus ltar bod du phebs pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig yin pa des rgyud sde khag mang bod yig tu bsgyur/
gsog gcod lugs kyi rang lus sbyin par btang nas tshogs gsog pa'i chos spyod
(yul) khu byug ste de'i skad la brten nas btags pa'i ming
(rgya) sbrag khang ngam sbrag tshugs te gzhung don mi sna dang sbrag yig skyel mkhan gyi gnas tshang /

1. thams cad dang, tshang ma, spyi yongs,/ don kun/ phyogs kun/ de dag kun/ gzhan kun/ dus dang rnam pa kun/ nyin mtshan kun/ mthun rkyen kun 'dzoms/ gzhung lugs kun chub/ kun mkhyen kun gzigs/ kun gyi mig la 'doms pa/ 2. yi ge 'di'i mthar tu'am nas gang rung zhig sbyar na tshig gi rgyan du 'gro ba'i rab tu dang shin tu sogs ha cang gi don yin zhing, de yang skad gsar bcad ma byas gong du kun la da drag thob pas tu sgra 'bri dgos par ma zad, da lta'ang tu sgra dngos su 'bri dgos/ tu/ nas/ kun/ da drag / tu/ kun tu skrag pa/ kun tu skyo ba/ kun tu bskor ba/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs pa/ kun tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu shes par bya ba/ kun nas dgod pa/ kun nas grags pa/ kun nas gnod par 'gyur ba/ kun nas mdzes pa/ kun nas yongs su grub pa/

zhi gnas dang, btang snyoms sgom skabs su sems yang yang dkri bar byed pa'i nyon mongs shig de la rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa dang, ngo tsha khrel med du spyod pa, dga' zhing mgu bar spyod pa, nyes dmigs su mi lta ba bcas yan lag bzhi tshang na chen po dang, nyes dmigs su mi lta zhing yan lag gzhan dag ma tshang na 'bring ba, yan lag gzhan dag tshang zhing nyes dmigs su bltas na chung ba bcas dbye ba gsum yod/
zhi gnas dang btang snyoms kyi dus su sems yang yang dkri bar byed pa'i nyon mongs pa brgyad de rmugs pa dang, gnyid, rgod pa, 'gyod pa, phrag dog ser sna, ngo tsha med pa, khrel med pa rnams so/
kun dkris brgyad kyi steng du khro ba dang 'chab pa gnyis bsnan pas bcu'o/
1) 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad kyi skyabs yul/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa

don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste bsgrub bya grags che ba'i dngos po'i gnas tshul khyad par ba zhig dam bcar bkod nas, de'i sgrub byed kyi rgyu mtshan du kun la khyab pa'i don gzhan zhig bkod pa'i rgyan
kun bzang 'khor lo'i bsdus tshig mi thams cad kyis gong du khur ba'am mtho sar bteg pa/
(bishwantra) sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pas skye ba snga mar sbyin pa'i phar phyin spyod skabs kyi mtshan/
mi thams cad kyis gong du khur ba'am mtho sar bteg pa/
mang pos bkur ba'i sde dang don gcig
1) don thams cad grub pa/ 2) (mngon ston dus/
1) thams cad yid dga' ba/ 2) (mngon) shing stag lo/
sa skya pandi ta'i mtshan dngos/

sa skya gong ma lnga'i gras, 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sras, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho sprel la sku 'khrungs shing, rang lo nyi shu pa nas drug cu re bdun gyi bar gdan sa sa skya dgon lo zhe brgyad bskyangs, rab byung gsum pa'i sa pho stag la 'das/

(aa'a nanda) sh'akya thub pa'i nyan thos nye 'khor bcu'i gras shig yin pa 'di nyid mang thos mchog tu gyur pa dang, bstan pa'i gtad rabs gnyis pa, bka' bsdu ba dang po'i skabs su mdo sde 'don pa po, gso rig gi rgyud bzhi gsung skabs kyi nang 'khor bcas so/
mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho sho bod rigs rang skyong khul kung ho rdzong khongs su yod pa'i mtsho zhig
1) sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs yul gtsug lag khang/ 2) chos khri dra mig can/ 3) dge 'dun gyi chos ra/ 4) shing thog gi ra ba'am skyed mos tshal/
me tog dang shing thog gi ra ba sogs srung mkhan/
(mngon) gos mchog gam, gos yag shos/
1) (mngon) 1, nam mkha'/ 2, sbrul/ 2) kun tu 'gro ba ste sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'gro ba'am rjes su 'gro ba/
sems thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sems byung lnga ste tshor ba dang, 'du shes, sems pa, reg pa, yid byed bcas so/
kun 'byung bden pa/ kun tu 'jug bral, thams cad du 'gro zhing rnam grol thob pa la gegs byed pa'i nyon mongs can gyi chos rnams skyed par byed pa phra rgyas kyi dngos po rnams so/ 'gog bden/
1) tshang ma 'gems par byed pa/ 2) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig / 3) (mngon) chu srin chen po/
kun nyon gyi dbang po lnga
so skyes rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i tshor ba lnga'o/
snyan ngag gi sgra rgyan yi ge'i sgra 'dra bas tshig rkang brtsegs pa'i tshid bcad sgor mo'am, gru bzhi'i dbyibs can gyi phyogs kun tu 'khor bar bkod pa'[i rgyan zhig /
kun tu rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu

sngar sh'akya mu ne zhal bzhugs skabs rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba drug gi nang gses rang 'byung ba'i ston pa 'dis sems can thams cad kyi bde sdug rnams rgyu rnams rgyu rkyen la brten nas byung ba min par ngang shugs kyis byung bar 'dod/
kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo
sho lo ka so bdun pa 'gyur byang med pa zhig / .
1) ga sa ga la 'gro ba/ 2) sdug bden/

gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i sgo nas nyes dmigs dang legs pa'i yon tan gang yin pa de dag gzhan gyi sems dang mthun par ston pa/ kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid, mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang gses, btags pa tsam du yod pa rang 'dzin rtog pas sgro btags pa ste, yid kyi rnam par shes pa kun tu rtog pa des gang zag dang chos phyin ci log tu sgro btags nas bdag dang bdag gi ba dang ming la sogs pa kun tu btags pa
nyon mongs pa ste de'i dbang gis khams gsum la yid mi 'byung bas dge ba mi spyod cing mi dge ba bsgrubs pas phyi ma la sdug bsngal dang kun tu sbyor bar byed pa/

1) cha thams cad nas dge ba'am legs pa'i rigs rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ 2) 1. ? chos dbyings dang, chos sku/ 2. ? sangs rgyas spyi/ 3. ? de bzhin gshegs pa bye brag cig / 4. ? byang chub sems dpa' bye brag cig / 5. ? bon lugs kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/
kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs
rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na sh'i la dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/
mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa gzungs mdo'i sde tshan 'gyur byang med pa zhig
sa bcu gcig pa ste mngon par sangs rgyas sa/
sa bcu bzhi yi gras shig /
kun brtags kyi 'bri tshal gzhan zhig
mtshan nyid chad pa'i kun btags dang, rnam grangs pa'i kun btags te gnyis/
yid kyi snang bar 'char ba'i gzugs te rmi lam du rta glang khang pa sogs yul lngar snang ba rnams dang, ting 'dzin du sa gzhi keng rus kyis khyab par snang ba lta bu/
1) kun las btus pa ste phyogs thams cad las bsgrugs pa/ 2) btu gzhi rtsom pa rnams las rtsom gsar pa bsdus pa/ chos mngon pa kun btus/ bslab pa kun btus/ tshad ma kun btus/ mdo kun btus/
1) kun tu rtog pa ste rtog dpyod byed pa/ 2) sems kyi rnam par rtog pa/ kun rtog skye gnas, 1) dran rtog 'char ba'i gnas/ 2) 'dod lha/
kun rtog skye gnas dang don gcig
kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bsdus ming,
kun brtags kyi nyon mongs pa
grub mtha' ngan pas blo bsgyur ba'i dbang gis yang dag pa'i don la phyin ci log gi rtog pas kun tu brtags pa'i sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i lta ba nyon mongs can la sogs pa'o/
kun brtags kyi ma rig pa
grub mtha' ngan pa'i lta ba nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pas dngos po'i tshul ji bzhin mi shes pa'i rmongs pa ste, lta ba log pa rnams so/
ting nge 'dzin dang 'grogs pa'i shes rab kyis phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa dang bdag med par mthong bas de la chags pa mi skye ba/
1) kun mud kyi zur chag 2) (mngon) khu ba/
kun bdag 'jig rten yongs kyi bdag po

/ kun bde gling, lha sa'i rtse po ta la'i lho nub phyogs su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing stag lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig ste, de'i bdag po rta tshag no mi han nam, rje drung ho thog thu zhes pa'i go ming 'dzin pa'i skye phreng snga phyi gnyis kyis gong ma chan lung dang, kvang zhu'i skabs su bod kyi srid skyong thengs gnyis byas yod/
kun bden gyi spang bya bdun
'dod pa'i khams 'dir kun bden mthong bas spang bar bya ba ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, khong khro, nga rgyal, the tshom, log lta, lta ba mchog 'dzin te bdun/
rtsa dbu ma ste, 'di la brten nas thig le dang, rtsa'i bde ba dang, rlung gi bde ba kun skye bas kun zhes bya la, de spyi la khyab pas 'dar ma zhes bya'o/

rin po che rgyal tsha'i gcung 'di phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po'i slob ma zhig ste, rab byung gsum pa'i sa pho 'brug la gtsang gi shab smad du 'khrungs phag gru la gdams pa zhus te bsgoms pas grub thob tu gyur, khro phur slob ma bskyangs pa'i gtso bo ni de'i dbon po khro phu lo tsa ba byams pa'i dpal yin, me mo glang la gshegs/
1) ming skad grags che ba/ 2) byang sems shig gi mtshan/
'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u bam po gcig pa, sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang , su rendra bo dhi dang, lo tsa ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/
pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, sh'i lendra bo dhi dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/

rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu ste rgyu dang kun slong ci rigs pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba sdug kun gnyis kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang, 'gog lam gnyis rnam byang gi phyogs so/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang ldang ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin snyoms 'jug sogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang don gcig
kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bden pa
kun 'byung gi bden pa la zer/
kun nas lta na sdug pa'i dpe byad
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste 'khor kun nas mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis spyod lam thams cad mthong na mi mthun pa med pas kun nas lta na sdug pa/
kun nas snang ba bkod pa'i dpal
kun nas snang ba bkod pa ste sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
1) kun nas spangs pa ste thams cad dor ba/ 2) snying rtsa lnga'i gtso bo/ 3) bya bral ba/ 4) (mngon) mya ngan las 'das pa/

rab byung bzhi pa'i chu yos lo la 'khrungs, rab byung lnga pa'i chu glang la 'das, yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje'i slob brgyud yin, des gtsang gi lha rtse rdzong khongs jo nang du dgon pa btab, de'i yang slob dol po bas grub mtha' de rgya cher spel bas jo nang pa grags chen po byung bas bla ma gong ma dag kyang ches bkur 'os su gyur/
kun tu spyod pa ste, lus ngag yid gsum mam de gsum gang rung gi bya spyod dam spyod lam/ rtogs pa lha dang mnyam yang, kun spyod mi dang mthun dgos/
bsam blo'i khyer so dang las ka byed stangs thad la tshul bzhin du 'chos par byed pa/
kun spyod spyi'i yon tan gsum
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, kun spyod gtsang ba dang, kun nas lta na sdug pa dang, phyag zhabs dpal be'u sogs kyis brgyan pa'i dpe byad bcas so/
kun spyod gtsang ba'i dpe byad
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig thugs gtsang ba nyid kyis sgo gsum gyi kun tu spyod pa la nyes pa'i dri ma med pas gtsang ba/
'dod don 'ga' zhig sgrub pa la nyer len gyi rgyu las kyang 'phral rkyen gyi grogs shig kun tu phan par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
kun nas nyon mongs pa dang, rnam par byang ba'i phyogs gnyis/

1) (mngon) 1, sems sam rnam shes/ 2, stong pa nyid/ 3, lha tshangs pa/ 2) rdzogs chen gyi brda chad cig 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po'am 'khrul grol kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i rang rig byang chub kyi sems te gzhi rgyud bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/ 3) gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud sde zhig gi bsdus ming ste, rgyas par byas na byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po lta ba nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shri sengha ka la dang, bee ro tsa nas bsgyur ba/
sems can las kyi bag chags bsags pa de dang de dag lha la sogs pa'i sems can gyi rigs drug po de dang de'i nang phan tshun cha byad dang rigs 'dra bar 'byung bas na kun 'byung ngo/
kun 'byung la chos shes pa'i bzod pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi gras 'dod khams kyi kun 'byung bden par dmigs nas bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/

kun 'byung la chos shes pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi gras kun 'byung chos bzod de ma thag tu 'dod khams kyi kun 'byung bden par dmigs nas bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/

kun 'byung la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi gras kun 'byung chos shes de ma thag tu khams gong ma'i kun 'byung bden par dmigs nas sngar bzhin bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/

kun 'byung la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa ste, mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi gras kun 'byung rjes bzod de ma thag tu khams gong ma'i kun 'byung bden par dmigs nas sngar bzhin bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/
'phen byed las dang, nyon mongs gnyis/

bden pa bzhi'i nang gses, rang 'bras nyer len gyi phung po ste ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad skyed byed kyi rgyur gyur pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa rnams te, de dag ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba nad kyi rgyu lta bu spang bar bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bslu bar snang bas kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/
kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi

bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, las dang nyon mongs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pas sa bon gyi tshul gyis rgyu dang, khams gsum rgyud lnga kun 'byung bas zhing pa las lo tog 'byung ba'i tshul gyis kun 'byung ba dang las nyon drag pos sdug bsngal phral la skye bas 'brel ba'i tshul gyis rab skye dang, las nyon las khams gsum gyi gnas su sdug bsngal gyi phung po mngon par 'grub phyir chu lud ltar 'bras bu skye ba'i grogs byed pas rkyen bcas bzhi'o/
shes pa bcu'i gras shig ste khams gong 'og gi kun 'byung bden pa rtogs par byed pa'i shes pa/
kun tu sbyor ba'i bsdus ming,
rjes su chags pa dang, khong khro ba, nga rgyal, ma rig pa, lta ba, mchog 'dzin, the tshom, phrag dog ser sna bcas kyi kun spyod dgu/
rten gyi dbye bas tha ma'i cha mthun gyi kun sbyor lnga dang, gong ma'i cha mthun gyi kun sbyor lnga yod do/

mthong lam gyis spang byar gyur pa'i kun tu sbyor ba gsum ste, 'jig lta kun btags kyis thar pa la skrag nas 'gro mi 'dod pa'i kun sbyor dang, tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyis lam ma yin pa la lam du 'dzin pas lam nor gyi kun sbyor, lam la the tshom byas nas thar pa'i gegs byed pas the tshom gyi kun sbyor bcas gsum mo/
1) thams cad zad pa/ 2) thams cad mthar phyin pa/
yang dag pa'i gnas lugs sgrib par byed pa'am 'gebs pa lta bur byed pa'i dngos po rdzun pa rnams/
kun rdzob gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, sgyu ma dang smig sgyu dang mig yor la sogs pa rang rang gis bya ba byed mi nus pa'i mtshan nyid can rnams/
kun rdzob rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa
byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs thabs kyi cha dang bsod nams kyi tshogs/
yang dag kun rdzob dang log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis/
kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab
rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab/
kun rdzob don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa
bam po gnyis pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po sh'akya pra bha dang, dzi na mi tra dang, lo tsa ba bande dharma t'a sh'i la sogs kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/

bden pa gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste, bye brag smra bas gang zhig bcom pa'am blos cha shas so sor bsal ba na rang 'dzin gyi blo 'dor rung ba'i chos su dmigs pa gzung 'dzin rags pa rnams dang, mdo sde pas rtog pas btags pa tsam du grub pa'i chos spyi mtshan rnams dang, sems tsam pas tha snyad dpyod pa'i rig shes kyis rnyed don kun btags dang gzhan dbang gi chos, dbu ma pas rang mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mngon sum tshad mas rang nyid gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul gyi rtogs par bya ba rten 'brel snang ba'i chos su 'dod pa bcas 'dod lugs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/
stong nyid kyi ldog zla ste snang phyogs kyi chos/
kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems
rags pa brda las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kun/
shes pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, bden pa ma mthong gong gi so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi shes pa/
sems bskyed dang go don gcig pa ste smon pa'i sems bskyed dang, 'jug pa'i sems bskyed gnyis kyi spyi'i ming/
kun rdzob kyi kun rdzob dang, yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rdzob dang, yang dag pa'i kun rdzob bcas gsum mo/
(a'al'aya:) ? 1) 'du ba'i gnas dang bzed snod/ 2) gshis rgyud dam sems rgyud/ kun gzhi dul ba/ 3) kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi bsdus tshig
rtsa rnams snying khar 'dus te gnas pa'i sa/

(a'alayabidznya'ni) ? rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi nang gses, ma bsgribs lung ma bstan pa'i gtso bo'i rnam shes gang zhig bag chags kyi bgo gzhir gyur pa rnam smin dang sa bon thams cad kyi rten du gyur cing don gyi ngo bo rig pa/
1) kun tu gzigs pa ste thams cad la lta ba'am bltas pa/ 2) (mngon) sangs rgyas/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
1) kun tu bzang po'i bsdus tshig 2) mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho byang bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rkang tsha erdzong gi ri bo zhig /
snyan ngag sgra rgyan gyi nang gses ming tshig yi ge re'u mig tu bkod nas yig phreng dkyus su mthar chags dang, phyogs mtshams nas dbus su bklag tshul sogs ston pa'i 'khor lo zhig /
byang sems kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa/
kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa
gsang sngags rnying lugs kyi rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa/
1) kun nas bzod pa ste dka' ba'i las sam, khur bzod pa'am, sran thub pa/ 2) (mngon) sa gzhi/
kun dga' ra ba'i bsdus tshig
1) thams cad mthong ba'am shes pa/ 2) kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi bsdus tshig
kun rig rnam par snang mdzad
1) gzhan thams cad las rgyal ba/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
(aa'adzny'ana:) ? yon tan thams cad khong du chub pa/ kun shes koondi na-ya ? sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor skor skabs 'khor lnga sde bzang po'i nang tshan gcig /
mang po shes kyang gnad gcig tu 'dril ba la mi mkhas pa'am thogs pa/ kun shes gcig rdugs mkhas pa'i skyon/
kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po
zag med kyi dbang po gsum gyi nang gses, mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi dbang po dgu po de dag nyid mthong sgom gyi nyon mongs ma lus par spangs te zad mi skye ba'i ye shes dang ldan pa'o/
zag med kyi dbang po gsum gyi ya gyal, sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi dbang po dgu de dag nyid kyis mi mthun pa dang gnyen po'i phyogs gsal bar bye brag phyed pa ste kun shes pa'o
kun shes byed pa'i dbang po
zag med kyi dbang po gsum gyi ya gyal, mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi dbang po dgu pos mthong spang gi nyon mongs spangs nas sngar mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'o/
1) bya ba gang zhig bsgrub 'dod pa'i sems kyi dmigs pa'am, bsam tshul/ 2) kun nas slong ba ste sems skyed pa/
rgyu'i kun slong dang, dus kyi kun slong gnyis/
(mngon) 1) nyi ma/ 2) nam mkha'/ 3) me long/
rkang lag 'khum tshul/ 'khyags nas kum kum du bsdad 'dug /
/ 1) drang min kyog por 'khums pa'i rnam pa/ lus kum por nyal ba/ 2) dpa' zhum pa'i tshul/ dngangs skrag gis kum por gnas pa/
sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig /
(legs) 1) sman du 'gro ba'i rdo'i nor bu kha dog ljang ser zhig / 2) tsha ba che ba'i sa khul du skye ba'i shing zhig /
zla chu'i yan lag bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'jo mda' rdzong dang chab mdo rdzong khongs su yod pa'i 'bab chu zhig
(legs) chu rnyog dwangs byed kyi dngos po zhig / rdo nor bu ke ta ka/ shing ke ta ka'i 'bras bu/
(legs) 1) rgyal mtshan/ 2) skar ma mjug ring/
(rgya) snum bzo byed sngo ldum zhig gi son/
sa dma' sar skye ba'i klung sgog cig /
dkar po/ lha khang ke ru bya ba bzhengs/
krang nge'am, krong nge/ gzugs po ke rer langs/ brag rdo ke rer langs pa/
(legs) gangs ri/ ke la sha yis bskor ba'i ljongs/
(legs) 'greng bu dang na ro nyis brtsegs yod pa'i yi ge/ 'greng bu ``ee''...na ro ``oo''...
(legs) 1) me tog gi ge sar ram, ze'u 'bru/ 2) (mngon) skra/
nges can gyi bar chad kyi don du go ba'i skag dang 'dra
tshe'i bar chad dam gegs kyi 'gag dog po/
sha med rus khog / khyi keng rus la chags pa/
mi sdug pa sgom skabs chags yul keng rus kyi rnam par 'du shes pa'am sems pa/
dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi gras shig /
rgya skyegs shing gi ming gi rnam grangs shig /

1) lhem lhem du 'gul tshul/ byi'u 'chi la khad pa'i brang khog kem kem du 'gul/ bung ba me tog gi steng du kem kem g.yo/ 2) mig gi nus pa shor nas zum zum du lta tshul/ nad can mig gnyis kem kem du lta/
/ 1) ri sgog / 2) sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig /
(rgya) g.yu byur sngo ne sogs brgyus pa'i bud med kyi brang rgyan phreng zhags shig /
lus sogs drang por gyen du 'greng tshul/ ker ker du langs nas phyogs su lta/ mdzub mo ker ker byas nas bsam blo gtong/
ker du bris pa'i drang thig /
(tha mi dad pa) gyen du lang ba'am, 'greng ba/ gzugs po gyen du ker ba/ mdzub mo gyen du ker ba/ ker langs/
ya yo med par langs pa'i tshul/ lus po ker re langs/ dar shing ker rer btsugs/
ker ker mi dang, leb leb sa, sgur sgur phyugs te spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs khral 'u lag 'gel sa'i yul gsum/ ker leb sgur gsum gyi khral rigs/
(rnying) dgar dang brnan pa'i ni sgra'i 'jug tshul dang 'dra ba'i phrad cig / ni...mda' mo 'phen par 'dod na ko phu thung dpung pa'i bar du rdzes/ 'di ko/ de ko/
1) pha g.yag dang ma mdzo mo las skyes pa'i pho phyugs shig / 2) mi rigs mi 'dra ba sgab mthun las byung ba'i bu phrug la mthong chung gis 'dogs pa'i ming ngan zhig /
1) lham gyi rdog pa'am krad pa/ 2) lham gyi rdog pa rnying hrul aa krad/
1) ko ba las dras pa'i rgyun bu/ 2) ko ba mnyed dus ko bar byug pa'i zhag dang klad zho sogs/
ko ba'i phyi shun gyi skyi'am, pags pa srab po/
ko ba'i khug ma chung ngu
ko rgyun las bzos pa'i khrol tshags/
1) ko ba'i ca lag bzo mkhan/ 2) ko gru gtong mkhan/
1) ko ba dang gru'i bsdus ming/ 2) ko bas bzos pa'i gru/ ko gru gtong ba/ ko gru'i sgrol 'don/
ko gru'i gla/ ko gla med pa'i 'grul pa min/
ko ba dras pa'i skud pa/
1) rgyun bu las bzos pa'i kha sgrog / 2) ko ba las bzos pa'i rta sgrog /
ko bas bzos pa'i snod cig /
(rnying) lhag bcas ste sogs kyi sgra'i 'jug tshul dang 'dra ba'i phrad cig / ste...
sngar 'gram par gzhu byed kyi khrims chas shig /
ko mog gi chu'am, sa kong dong du 'khyil ba'i chu/
klu bdud rdo rje rigs gnyis kyi nang tshan me tog dkar po 'char ba zhig /
'bru rigs tha ma'i tha ma bra bo lta bu/ zas mchog ko ta rgyan mchog mtshon la byed/
ko ba'i nang du bsgril ba/ mar ko btums rgyag pa/ ja do po ko btums byas pa/
sngo sman gyi rigs rtswa dres ma'i rtsa ba ste, ro mngar tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas sha dug dang, sbyar dug ma zhu dug thabs, smug po bcas la phan/
ko ba'i nang du btums pa'i thum bu/
ko ba las bzos pa'i gdan/
skra gri rdar byed kyi ko lheb/
sa dkar sogs g.yo sa ko ba'i snod sgrom ldan zhig
ko ba dang pags pa'i bsdus tshig /

'dul ba'i gos kyi gzhi gsum gyi ya gyal, dmigs bsal dang 'brel ba ko lpags kyi gzhi ste, yul dbus su gnas mal skyob pa'i phyir ko lpags kyi lham tsam dang gtsug lag khang las gzhan pa'i khyim du stan gzhan med na ko lpags kyi stan la 'dug pa tsam gnang gi nyal bar ma gnang la, mtha' 'khob tu ni grang ba skyob pa'i phyir lham dang mal stan gnyis kar brten par gnang zhing, shin tu grang ba che sar gos sogs ci dgar brten du rung bas dmigs bsal can/
ko bas bzos pa'i 'byar byed kyi spyin/
ko bas bzos pa'i mtshon cha 'gog byed/
sa la gding bya'i ko ba mnyes ma'i phyar ba/
(yul) ko lpags yod tshad sdud len gyi khral/

/ 1) rta g.yag sogs kyi pags pa mnyes ma dang ma mnyes pa spyi'i ming/ ko bubs bzhi/ ko ba sreg pa/ ko ba mnyes pa/ ko ba skyi bcad/ ko lham yu ring/ ko ba gcig nas dras pa'i rgyun bu/ 2) (yul) chu bo las sgrol byed kyi yo byad cig
sngar gzhung sar chu thog nas shing cha skyel 'dren byed pa'i khral

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag rlung stod 'tshang 'joms, glang thabs sel, dug tshad zhi bar byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngo leb spu can dang, ldum stag phur leb, bya 'phur leb bcas so,
ko ba la khung bu 'bigs byed kyi lag cha snyung bu/
ko ba 'bigs byed kyi snyung bu/
ko ba las bzos pa'i dkar brtsegs kyi khebs te dre'u dang, khal bong sogs kyi sga 'og tu brgyag bya zhig /
ko bas bzos pa'i khom 'bog gam gyon 'bog /
(yul) lham zom pa'i ko mthil brtsegs ma/
ko bas bzos pa'i tshags ma/
ko ba dum bu'am, ko hrug /
ko ba las bzos pa'i gzhong pa rtsi can/
rta'i sga stan gyi bar du 'jug rgyu'i ko gdan/
(rgya) nad yod sar sbyar rgyu'i sman ras shig /
dbyibs sgor mo/ zla ba ko re shar/ bzhin ras ko re/
1) ka ko la'i bsdus tshig 2) ko ba dang bal las skyes pa'i 'bu rigs shig /
(rnying) tshang ma/ ko ler gzer ba/
rkyen chung ngu tsam la'ang khong khro lang skyen pa/ ko long chen po/ ko long tsha po/ tshig mtho dman cung zad tsam la ko long chen po langs pa/
lus stobs skye ba dang, snying mkhal gyi nad gso bar byed pa'i sman zhig / bka' gdams pa spyan snga bas sham thabs la ko ba'i lhan pa mang po btab pas khong la mtshan de ltar btags/
bka' gdams pa spyan snga bas sham thabs la ko ba'i lhan pa mang po btab pas khong la mtshan de ltar btags/
phor pa sogs 'jam po bzo byed
ko ba mnyes ma'i skyi la rtsi gang rung btang yod pa'i rigs/
(legs) sngar rgya gar dbus phyogs su yod pa'i rgyal khab mdzod ldan/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses las bye ba'am las kyi rtsod pa'i gzhi ste, ko shambhi'i dge slong gis yangs pa can pa'i dge slong gnas dbyung byas pas rtsod pa chen por gyur te, las bye ba la yul gyi ming gis btags pa/
(legs) 1) mkhas pa/ 2) sman gu gul/ 3) brgya byin/
shun gyong po/ mar gyi grod kog / shun kog /
skra'i lcang lo gnyis mgo bor dkri ba kong po ba'i lugs srol/
(rgya) gong ma'am rgyal po'i sras mo/
kong yul nas dar ba'i rna rgyan/
rgya lu chas kyi rna rgyan g.yas kong rna dang g.yon pan tog /
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar ngos nyang chu'i stod rgyud du yod pa'i yul lung gi ming/

1) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kong yul nyang chu'i stod rgyud du yod, deng skabs rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de nga phod zam khar yod/ 2) grong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kong yul nyang chu dang spyi mda' phyogs nas 'bab pa'i chu gnyis 'dzoms sa'i lung pa sum mdor yod/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mal gro gung dkar rdzong dang kong po rgya mda'i bar du yod pa'i la zhig yin zhing, dbus dang kong po'i mtshams ri'ang yin/
lha khang zhig bod kyi sa gzhi srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba 'dra ba'i kha gnon du srong btsan skabs su bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang yang 'dul bzhi'i gras shig /
kong po'i yul srol zhig ste bod zla bcu pa'i nang kong yul du gtong ba'i lo gsar

zin tig kar ma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang mdzad pa'i nang sman sprad pa'i nyams yig cig ste de'i nang gtso che ba ni nad re re bzhin rtags dang bcos thabs sogs gnad du dril nas kha gsal zhing don tshang ba bstan yod pa dang, de bzhin sman dug 'don byed thabs sogs nyer mkho'i don rnams ma 'dres par bkod pa'i sman gzhung zhig /
kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho

mtshan gzhan gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas ni rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu byar mdo khams 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi pad ma lha rtse'i mdun rol rong rgyab sbas pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs, khong gis rin chen gter mdzod dang, gdams ngag mdzod, bka' brgyud sngags mdzod rnams bsgrigs par mdzad cing, shes bya mdzod dang, thun min gsang ba'i mdzod brtsams pa dang gter nas bton pa bcas mdzod chen lnga dang, de 'brel sman dang gtam tshogs sogs gsung thor bu sna tshogs bcas po ti brgya la nye ba zhig rtsom sgrig mdzad, rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa phag lor 'das/
kong po nas thon pa'i spre'u/
dpangs mtho zhing gting ring ba'i snod chung ngu zhig ste mar me 'bul snod/ mchod kong/ gser kong/
1. yul kong po'i bud med/ 2. phug zab pa/ mig kong mo/ sa kong mo/
bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi gras kong yul gyi gnas bdag cig / yul yar klung la bsdad na lha yar lha sham po dang, yul kong por bsdad na lha kong btsun de mo bsten dgos/
sngar lha ldan sa khul du lnga mchod dang, bzhi mchod skabs mchod me 'gengs rgyu dang, dgram rgyu, mchod kong bsdu rgyu sogs kyi las ka byed mkhan 'ul mi/
nyi skar bcu dang chu tshod drug spyi zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum skor nas 'ol pa log pa'i kong zhag bco lnga 'dren
kong po ba pho mo spyi'i lham/
kon pa gab skyes kyi bsdus tshig
sngo sman kon pa gab skyes skye gnas dbang gis rigs gnyis su dbye bas klung skyes te, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag shor gcod/
'brum bu dkar po'i nad rigs shig /
na-ya ? kun shes koondi ? na-ya'i ? 'bri tshul gzhan,

skor skor dang nye 'dabs kyi don la 'jug pa'i skor dang mtshungs te rtags 'jug las, pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drangs zhes pa'i rjes 'jug ga da ba'i rjes su sa mgo dor te kor zhes sbyar ba dang, de min gzhan la brjod bde'i sgo nas skor yig sbyar dgos/ skor...ga da ba...skor...sa , ?/ kor...skor 0 ?/ dper na, thig kor/ klad kor/ thab kor/ g.yas skor/ g.yon skor/ nye skor/ khrom skor/ mtha' skor/
zlum po'am, sgor sgor/ nyi zla'i mtha' la 'ja' 'od kor kor 'khyil/
ma ne'am, ma le ste, ma mchu'i 'og gi rus 'bur/
ma le'i rtse phra ba'am, rno ba/
rang tshugs mi thub pa'i rnam pa/ byis pa lam la kya re kyo rer 'gro/
1) rtsed mo'am dngos 'brel ma brjod par kyag kyag byas pa/ skad cha de dngos gnas ma red kyag kyag red/ 2) (yul) bsam ngan/ kyag kyag byas nas mgo rnyog bzos 'dug /
1) kyag ge kyog ge'i bsdus tshig 2) sngar rgya gar du dar ba'i grangs gnas chen po zhig /
drang min kyog kyog gi rnam pa/ lam kyag ge kyog ge/ shing kyag kyog ma gtogs drang po mi 'dug / las don kyag kyog kho na byed

ming mtha' ga da ba sa dang, da drag gi rjes su sbyor ba'i rgyan sdud kyi sgra zhig / ga da ba sa...da...dka' las khag kyang sems mi zhum/ mthun rkyen med kyang gsar du bskrun chog / rgyal kha thob kyang khengs sems med/ gzugs kyang mdzes la sems kyang bzang/ gros bsdur byas kyang thag ma chod/ gang yin kyang rung/ btsal kyang ma rnyed/ nyal kyang gnyid ma khug /
kyang nge kyong nge'i bsdus tshig
sa gzhi 'bur kong can gyi rnam pa/ sa gzhi kyang kyong la 'gro 'dug mi bde/ sa cha kyang nge kyong nge zhig gi nang du chu tog tsam 'khyil 'dug /
'od kyi rnam pa zhig / sgron me 'od kyam mer 'bar/ skar tshogs nam mkhar kyam mer shar/
kya re kyo re'i bsdus tshig
ku re'am, rtsed mo/ kyal ka bshad/
rtsa'i 'phar tshul zhig / gcong po'i lus kyi rtsa rnams kyal kyal du 'phar/
lus stobs nyams te gom stabs brtan po med pa'i rnam pa/ dud 'gro kyal kyol 'ga' ded nas 'ong gin 'dug /
sdong shun dmar zhing lo ma 'om bu dang mtshungs pa'i shing rigs shig /
don med dam rtsed mo'i gtam/
don med dam 'brel med kyi ngag / kyal pa'i gtam mi brjod/ don med kyi kyal pa spangs nas don ldan brjod par bya/

ming mtha' da ba sa dang, da drag gi rjes su sbyar bya'i 'brel sgra'i rkyen zhig / da ba sa...da...bod kyi sa bab/ ri rgyab kyi shing nags/ sa gnas kyi gnas tshul/ chu'i pha rold kyi ri rnams/ dag zhing kund kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ gzhan 'byord kyi yan lag /
rtswa sman zhig ste me tog gis phye ba'i dkar nag rigs gnyis yod/

(rgya) sngo sman gyi rigs kyi lce me tog dkar po 'char ba zhig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rgyu tshad dang, mkhris tshad, mchin tshad sogs la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la sku dkar gnod sbyin lce dang, khyi dkar dung gi thag pa can, pu dkar can, bong rna ba, la phram dkar po, sha lang pa, sha lang 'bangs, shel tang dkar po bcas so,

(rgya) sngo sman gyi rigs kyi lce me tog sngo nag 'char ba zhig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas skrangs pa 'joms, gag pa sel, chu ser skem/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyong byed dang, spyang dug nag po, shel tang nag po bcas so,
khandas ? tsha ba kun sel, snod lhung mkhris nad 'khru/
kyi lce dkar po'i me tog mer bsregs pa'i thal ba ste, nus pas rlung rims kyis 'bog pa dang, dran pa mi gsal ba, 'thibs pa sogs la phan/
rgyun mi 'chad par 'khyil lir skor stangs shig / nyi gdugs kyi li lir bskor ba/
(rnying) bsil rlung dang grang ngar che ba'i lhags pa/
sdug bsngal lam, mya ngan byed pa'i tshig / kyi hud sdug bsngal can gyi mi rnams la ltos/
(hahab:) ? dmyal ba'i sems can grang ngar gyis mnar nas skad shugs kyis 'o dod 'don pa ste grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad kyi gras shig /
mgyogs por rgyu ba'i bser bu/ rta mgyogs pa kying bser rlung la 'gran/

kyi zhes pa'i 'jug tshul dang mthun zhing bzhin zhes pa dang 'jug pa gcig pa'i dus da lta ba'i las ston byed phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / kyi...bzhin...mnyam du las ka byed kyin bsdad 'dug / skad cha shod kyin shod kyin gad mo shor/
sgra gdangs kyi khyad par/ byi'us skad kyur kyur dang kyir kyir sgrog pa/
sgor 'khyil le/ sbrul sgor kyil ler 'khyil nas sdod/
legs par nyon/ ma yengs rna ba kyil ler nyon/
'brel sgra kyi zhes pa'i sgra'i sbyor tshul dang mthun pa'i byed sgra'i rkyen zhig / kyi...khyod kyis yig thog tu 'khod dang ngas dpod chog / brjod kyis mi lang/ gser khab kyis rma kha brtol/
ming 'ga'i mthar sbyar na bzo dbyibs gug gug ston pa'i sgra/ lcags kyu/ nya kyu/ zhabs kyu/ au...
'bu dang byi'u sogs kyis skad 'byin tshul lam sgrog stangs shig /
'jam zhing 'od 'tsher ba/ skra nag kyug kyug byed/
'bu dang bya sogs kyis skad phra mo 'don tshul/
rang las mtho ba zhig la 'bod pa'i sgra/ kye rgyal po chen po/
'bod brda nyis brtsegs sam, nan tan gyis 'bod pa'i tshig
dgyes pa rdo rje ste sngags bla med kyi yi dam zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la dgyes pa rdo rje dang, rdo rje gri gug dpal ldan khrag 'thung, rol pa'i rdo rje, he badzra, he ru ka bcas so,
kye rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po

rgyud sde'i bye brag cig rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde brtag pa gnyis pa ste, dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag bdun yod pa las cung zad bsdus pa 'bum phrag lnga pa dang, de las kyang btus pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bcas rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang, 'brog mi'i 'gyur la slar yang lo tsa ba gzhon nu dpal gyis 'gyur chad bsabs pa/

thabs kyi yan lag drug gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag mchod pa don grub kyi yan lag rjes chags rdor sems kyi yan lag rnams so

smad pa dang, smon pa, zhum pa, ngo mtshar ba, mya ngan, nges pa sogs kyi don la 'jug pa'i 'bod tshig cig / kye ma 'di 'dra ma shod/ kye ma lo legs pa la/ kye ma phangs pa la/ kye ma mtshar/ kye ma yid sems skyo ba la/ kye ma khyod kyis ltos dang/
mya ngan gyi tshig gam, smre sngags 'don pa'i tshig /
1) ma ma la 'bod pa'i tshig / 2) mya ngan nam, ya nga ba'i tshig /
ha las pa'am, sems skyo ba'i tshig /
sems zhum pa'am, mya ngan gyi tshig /
ngo mtshar ba'i sgo nas 'bod pa'i tshig / kye ma ho de ring gtam de 'dra ba zhig go byung/
yid zhum pa'am, mya ngan gyi tshig /
snying rjes ma bzod pa, yid shin tu sdug pa, nyam thag pa sogs kyi tshig /
ngo mtshar ba'am, ha las pa'i don la 'jug pa'i 'bod tshig
dgyes pa rdo rje yum dang bcas pa ste sngags bla med kyi yi dam zhig /
'greng bu dang, na ro gnyis mtshon byed kyi rtags/
/ mgo bo kyog kyog / lam kyog kyog /
drang min 'khyog po'i rnam pa/ the tshom gyi blo kyog ge ba/ rgad po gzugs po kyog ge ba/
drang min 'khyog po'am yon po/ 'gro lam kyog po/ gtam kyog po/ rkang lag kyog po/ khug kyog /
gshong gshong/ sa cha kyong kyong nang du chu 'khyil 'dug /
kong kong yod sa/ kyong kha 'bur gsos/
mar rdib nas chags pa'i kong kong/ sa bab kyong po/ sa cha kyong por nyal nas yib/
1./ 1) gzhang 'brum la mar khu blug byed kyi yo byad cig / 2) zhing la yur ma yur byed kyi rko ma/ 2. kyong po dang 'dra,

bkra shis tshal te dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi gras shig /
dpal be'u dang, pad ma, gdugs, dung, 'khor lo, rgyal mtshan, bum pa, gser nya ste brgyad/
gsham nas gong du rim bzhin 'go 'dzugs pa/

dge legs phun sum tshogs pa/

bkra shis pa'i bya ba zin pa'i mjug tu bsangs dud dang 'brel ba'i rtsam phye gtor te lha rgyal 'bod pa/

gtsang phyogs kyi dge lugs dgon chen zhig ste, rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos lor t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub kyis phyag btab cing, rje blo bzang chos rgyan nas bzung pan chen sku phreng rim byon gyi gdan sa zhig /
/ lus stobs rgyas te gdong la bkrag thon pa/ yun ring na nas gdong gi bkrag shor ba/
mdangs kyi 'od/ bkrag mdangs 'tsher ba/ zhal gyi bkrag mdangs zla ba'i 'od ltar gsal/
1) 'od mdangs med pa/ 2) gzi mdangs nyams pa/
tshon gyi steng du 'od 'don byed kyi rtsi/
snum shog gam shel shog ste, chus 'jig dka' ba'i shog bu/

bkra shis sgor mo'i bsdus tshig
gzhi dang ri mo kha phral te bsgrigs pa'i gos chen zhig /
sngar bkra shis lhun po'i pan chen gyi zhabs 'bring che khag 'tshog sa'i las khungs/
bkra shis lhun po'i bsdus ming,

rlung nad la mi 'da' ba'i 'jam rtsi'i sbyor ba'i nang tshan rlung mkhris ldan par bsngags pa'i bkru 'jam gyi sbyor ba ste, chur gnas kyi sems can sbal lcong sogs kyi sha khu dang, ba'i 'o ma dang mar zhun bcas steng ru rta dang, de ba d'a ru, pi pi ling, rgyam tsha, aa ru ra, dur byid rnams kyi phye ma sbyar te bshang lam nas mas btang bya dgos pa'i sman zhig /
mna' bskyal te dag par byas pa

rlung nad la mi 'da' ba'i 'jam rtsi'i sbyor ba'i nang tshan bad rlung ldan par bsngad pa'i bkru ma slen gyi sbyor ba ste, skam na gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi sha khu dang, ra'i 'o ma dang zhun mar bcas kyi steng, ru rta dang, de ba d'a ru, pi pi ling, rgyam tsha, aa ru ra, po so cha rnams kyi phye ma sbyar te bshang lam nas mas btang bya dgos pa'i sman zhig /
dur byid dang thar nu lta bu sa chu'i nus pa shas cher las byung ba'i sman mkhris nad sogs rgyu long gi nad thur du bkru bar nus pa'i bshal sman spyi la zer/
bkrus nas gtsang bshal gtong ba/
sngar gyi yul srol du mna' skyel dag 'bud byas na khral 'bab chag pa
nor rdzas la 'dod pa che ba/
/ 1) nor med dbul phongs/ mi tshang bkren pa/ 'tsho ba bkren tsam 'ong bar 'dug / grwa pa bkren pa/ 2) ser sna chen po/ lag pa bkren pa/
pho ba ltogs shing skom pa/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal myangs pa/
1) nor med dbul po'am sprang po/ 2) rgyu nor la ha cang rngam pa'i mi/ dpon po bkres rngam can/
(tha mi dad pa) ltogs pa/ grod khog bkres pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la ltogs pa dang, bru ba tsha ba, za 'dod pa, zas 'dod pa bcas so,
don gnad la 'grel bshad gsal po byas pa/
(rnying) phan pa'i tshig gis gdams pa/
chu 'dren sa/ chu rka bzos nas zhing chu gtong/
chu 'dren sa'i yur ba'i mgo/ chu'i rka mgo gtsang po la thug yod/
yur ba'i nang du 'gro ba'i chu/
rka chu 'dren tho ste, chu rka bzo mkhan gyi mi gtong stangs dang, chu bgo bsha' rgyag stangs sogs 'khod pa'i tho/
sa ming zhig da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs thung te rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/
(rnying) skad cig tsam mam ska cig tsam/
chu rka dang ldan pa'i zhing/

/ 1) rus pa'i nang gi rkang mar/ 2) rtsa ba dang rang bzhin nam spus ka/ las 'gan gyi rkang 'khris pa/ go skabs rkang nas med/ mi rkang ngan pa/ ras rkang legs pa/ 3) cha shas/ tshong rkang/ skar rkang/ 4) sngar bod sa gnas su khral zhing rtsi stangs shig ste spyir btang rkang gnyis la 'don re brtsi rgyu/ 5) nyag ma/ shing rkang gcig / skra rkang gsum/ skud pa rkang gcig /
rkang pa la skyon shor ba/ mi rkang kyog /
1) thags mkhan gyi rkang pas rgyu'i snal ma'i bkad 'degs 'jog re mos byed pa'i thags chas shig / 2) tshem bu'i 'khor lo'i rkang shing/

'don grangs rkang la phab ste khral 'dra mnyam rgyug pa/
shing sdong gcig la ai khung mang po bton pa de dag gi nang du shing bu ring tsam re re btsugs nas bzos pa'i bod skas/
sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i rgyal po rkang bkra'am, sor mo'i phreng ba can zer ba des mi ji snyed cig bsad de mi de dag gi sor mo'i ske phreng can zhig /
1) 'bad brtson gang thub thub byed pa/ 2) lus kyis zug rngu ma bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur/ 3) sems dga' drags pa'i rnam 'gyur/
rkang pas 'khrab cing, lag pas g.yab g.yob byed pa ste, brel ba chen po'i dpe/ dus mnyam du las don khag mang bya dgos pas rkang 'khrab lag g.yob lta bu byung/
dmag dpung ru bsgrigs te 'gro skabs kyi rkang 'gros gcig mtshungs/

thun mong ba'i dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gses, bsgrubs pa'i rdzas rkang pa la byug pas 'dzam gling yud kyis bskor nus pa/
1) mi phyugs dngos su 'gro dgos pa'i khral gyi ming/ 2) yul kun tu 'gro ba po/ 3) (mngon) 1.dud 'gro/ 2.rkang dmag /
rkang 'gro'i khral ngo rgyug ma dgos par bogs mar sgyur ba/
rkang 'gro ni mi phyugs dngos su phyin nas sgrub dgos pa'i khral dang, lag 'don ni dngul dngos 'jal ba'i khral te sngar bod kyi khral khag gnyis kyi spyi ming/
rta khal mi gsum gyi khral ming/
rkang gdub sogs rkang pa'i rgyan cha/
'bu phra la ring ba rkang lag mang po yod pa zhig /
'bu phra la ring ba rkang lag mang po yod pa zhig /
rkang pa'i ngar gdong ste, pus mo nas long tshigs bar gyi mdun ngos kyi rus pa/
1) ma rkang gi dngul/ 2) rkang la 'khri ba'i dngul khral/

rkang longs re'u mig nang du rkang sdom chu tshod gang du yod pa'i bya ra de'i 'og na gnas pa'i sgyur byed kyi ri mo de ni khyim re'am skar ma re'i rkang pa'i nor dang bu lon gyi tshad yin, rkang sdom ma zin na bya ra dang po des 'dzin dgos/
1) rkang par rgyag pa'i khrims chas shig / 2) rta drel gyi rkang pa'i rmig par rgyag pa'i lcags/
khral rkang che ba ste, sa zhing mang bas khral 'bab lci ba'am mang ba rgyug dgos mkhan/
gzhan gyis mi tshor bar byas te 'jab stangs shig /
rkang pa la lham med pa/
1) rkang par lham ma gyon mkhan/ 2) rkang rjen dang don gcig

'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul du yod/
rkang pa 'jog sa'i stegs/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang khri dang, rkang rten, zhabs stegs bcas so,

1) rdog tho'am, rdog tshan/ 2) khral rkang gi tho/

sgo'i phyi la 'jog pa'i lham rdog 'byid byed/
rkang rgyan gdu bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang kor dang, rkang pa'i rgyan, rkang pa'i rin chen, zhabs gdub bcas so,
nyes can gyi rkang par rgyag pa'i lcags sgrog /
sngar khral 'khri'i sa rten brtsi stangs rkang zhes pa dang 'don zhes pa gnyis kyi ming, ..
rkang pa 'byid pa/ rkang 'dred shor te sar 'gyel/
zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan te rang phyogs kyi la rgyar gnod pa'i ming shas bzo mkhan/ bu ngan pha ma bzang po'i rkang 'dren pa/ mi ngan rang yul gyi rkang 'dren pa/
long tshigs man gyi rkang mgo chad pa'i mi/
gzas rkang longs longs spyad zin pa dang ma zin pa gang rung sdom pa'i chu tshod/
rkang pa sar brdab pa/ khong khro langs te rkang brdab lag brdab byed pa/
rkang pa gcig gi steng du gcig 'jog pa/

/ 1) 'gro byed/ mi'i rkang pa/ rkang bol/ rta drel gyi rkang pa dang lag pa/ rgad po rkang 'khyog pa/ yi ge rkang pa can/ ka kha ga ta da na zha sha ha...ming gi rnam grangs la bgrod byed dang, rgyu byed, zhabs bcas so, 2) 'degs byed/ zam pa'i rkang pa/ rkub stegs kyi rkang pa/ 3) tshigs bcad kyi bar mtshams/ tshid bcad kyi rkang pa dang po/ 4) (mngon) khrums kyi zla ba/ 5) bzhi cha'i don nam rkang pa bgrod pa'i gom pa lta bu/ 1/4: rkang pa'i 'phel 'grib/ snga rkang phyi rkang/ rgyu skar gyi rkang pa/
rkang pa kha skong gi yi ge

tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa'i tsheg khyim kha skong ba'i tshig phrad cig ste, ru dang, yi, yang dang, gzhan yang 'o dang, 'u, 'am bcas kyi gong du tsheg yod pa rna ms/ ra.. .ru...'i.. .yi...'ang / yang...'o...'am...'u...
gar yang 'gro thub mkhan gyi rkang pa/ mi 'gro dgu 'gro'i rkang pa rgod pa don med ngal dub kyi rgyu red/

1) sa rtsub mo'i steng du rkang rjen mar phyin te rkang pa tsha ba/ 2) rkang pa tsha ba'i rlung nad de, rkang pa gnyis ka drod che ba 'ur 'ur po dang bcas 'gro ba'i tshe lhag par du tsha ba'i rlung nad cig /
nyi ma la mtshon na rkang sdom 'dzin byed kyi khyim grangs, rkang longs dang, nyi rkang, zla rkang sogs kyi thad la'ang ltos/
rkang pa 'khyog po'am, brkyang bskum mi thub pa/
rkang pa'i rtsa rgyus 'khums te zha ba/
phar tshur 'gro bzhud hur po dang myur po/ kho rang rkang pa yang po yin pas de ring tshur 'khor thub/
rta drel sogs kyis rkang pa gzhu stangs/ rta rgod kyis rkang 'phra brgyab byung/
rkang stabs sgyur ba'i gar zhig / lag gdang sbrel nas rkang bro 'khrab/
rkang stabs sgyur ba'i gar dang, gzhas sam rnam thar gtong ba'i glu dbyangs/ chas gos sna tshogs spras nas rkang bro glu gar la rol/
sngar lha sa'i smon lam chen mo tshugs skabs mi dmangs tshos tshogs chen zhal ngor zhabs bro rgyag chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/

lhan skyes rma rigs brgyad kyi ya gyal, ngan khrag chu ser rgyas pa'i stod nad rkang par bab pa'i nad de, nad rtags su rkang pa'i sgyid chu 'khum zhing sha mdog sngo nag tu 'gyur ba dang, lus skrangs shing na zug ldang la rma 'byung ba zhig /
(mngon) sdig srin nam, rkang pa mang ba'i 'bu rigs/
sems can gyi brla rkang dang, dpung rkang rnams las byung ba'i rkang sbubs kyi mar/ ming gi rnam grangs la khu ba byed dang, mdangs so,

sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i ston pa zhig ste, sngon gyi gtam rgyud du sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pa 'jig rten du ma byon gong rgya gar gyi drang srong mdzes pa zhes bya ba zhig lha dbang phyug gis lha mo au ma'i srung mar bzhag pa na au ma drang srong la chags pas sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du bstan kyang, khong gis rkang par mig phab ste brtul zhugs bsrungs pas lha dbang phyug mnyes te bstan bcos rtsom pa'i mchog sbyin nas drang srong rkang mig pa zhes phyi rol pa'i ston par gyur nas phyogs chos kyi tshigs dgu sogs gtan tshigs rig pa'i srol btod ces grags/
rkang thang gi dmag mi/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang pas rgyu, rkang shar ba, dpung bu chung, mtshon chas 'tsho ba, rang stobs kyis bgrod, rang thang, lus kyis rgol, lus kyis 'thab bcas so,
1) gzhi rtsa btsugs pa/ 2) ched du/ da res nga tsho rkang btsugs nas khyed rang gi drung du bka' lan zhu bar yong ba yin/

rkang pa'i mdun gyi sne mo/

rkang thang du 'gro ba'i dka' ngal/ grong yul 'grim rgyu rkang tshegs che/

1) rkang thang bgrod pa'i zam pa/ 2) bang mi/

rkang pa skyon can nam, rkang 'khyog /

rkang pa dang lag pa'i bsdus ming / rkang lag bzhi/ rkang lag bkyigs pa/ lus rtsa tshang ma hrengs te rkang lag brkyang bskum mi thub/
rkang lag gi 'gul skyod byed stangs/ khong khro langs te rkang lag krab krab byed/ dbugs chad khar rkang lag krab krab byed/

(prash'akh'a:) mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'i lnga pa'am, mi lus mngal du chags pa'i bdun phrag lnga pa ste khu khrag gnyis yongs su smin pa las lus kyi yan lag lnga so sor grub pa'i dus skabs 'di nas bzung bdun phrag so brgyad pa'i bar smin pas sas 'dzin pa dang, chus sdud pa, mes ma rul par smin pa, rlung gis rgyas par byed pa bcas kyi sgo nas lus po yongs su tshang bar 'gyur/

1) rkang pa dang lag pa'i bsdus ming / 2) rkang pas gzhan la btang ba'i brda/ kha nas lab mi bde stabs rkang sug cig brgyab byung/

kha nang gi rkan/ ya rkan/

rkan mtha'i rnyil te, so rnyil/
1) lce rkan gnyis 'thab pa/ 2) so med rkan gyis rmur ba/
ya rkan gyi dbus sam dkyil,..
rkan la skyes pa'i thor pa/
byis pa dang rte'u sogs btsas ma thag tu khas 'jib rgyu gom ched rkan la sbyor ba'i mar 'jam po/
rkan la skyes pa'i thor pa/

ma byin par len pa'i spyod ngan/
brkus pa'i rdzas kyi cha shas/
tshul dang mi mthun pa la tshul dang mi mthun pas rgyab rtsa byas pa/
khyim nang gi ca dngos rkun mas brkus rjes khrims khang du phul ba'i dngos tho/
rkun pos brkus nor sbed yul gyi dong khung/
rkun po'i nor rdzas/ ming gi rnam grangs la brku dngos dang, rkun rdzas so,

/ 1) rku mkhan/ rkun po pha mar 'dzin pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkun ma dang, chom rkun, chom po, 'jab rkun 'jab bu ba, 'jab len, mtshams kyi byed po, gzhan 'tshe, 'og tu rgyu, yan lag ngan, g.yas ma, rang gnas pa, aar pa bcas so, 2) (mngon) byi ba/

/ 1) rkun chung ngam mtheb dras pa/ 2) rkang pa grang ba dang, ro stod gzer zhing mig zum mi thub pa sogs kyi mchin nad cig / 3) (mngon) byi ba/

/ 1) gzhan nor rku mkhan/ rta rkun/ nor rkun/ rkun mas rkun rjes gcod khul gyis ram 'degs byed/ rkun ma nang la bzhag nas sgo lcags phyi la brgyab pa/ 2) (yul) rku byed kyi bya spyod/ rkun ma rku ba/
jag gnyis ka byed pa'i mi ngan

/ 1) 'phongs/ 2) bshang lam/ rkub tshums/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'phongs dang, 'og sgo'o, 3) mthil lam zhabs/ snod kyi rkub rdol ba/
