1) dku skabs phyed pa/ 2) go skabs thob pa dang, shar ba/ phan tshun gros bsdur byed pa'i skabs phyin pa/ brel ba lang ba'i skabs phyin pa/
1) dus skabs yong bar byas pa/ 2) dku skabs phyed pa ste rked pa phra ba/

1) lam seng dang, dus thog / phar 'gyangs med par skabs 'phral du shog / nad gzhi byung ste skabs 'phral du sman bcos byas/ 2) re zhig dang, gnas skabs/ da res skabs 'phral gyi 'char gzhi zhig bting yod/
1) dus de nyid la 'khel ba/ skabs bab kyi dgos mkho/ skabs bab kyi las 'gan/ 2) dus su slebs pa/ dgra 'gog skabs bab go cha bgos, son 'debs skabs bab rmon slog rgyob/
1) snga phyi'i dus mtshams kyi skabs 'byed pa/ 2) las 'go rtsom pa/ las don byed pa'i skabs phye nas zla gsum song/

1) bab la gzhigs pa/ bka' mngag gnang rgyu gang yod skabs sbyar gyis gnang skyong yod pa zhu/ skabs sbyar gyi gtam brjod/ skabs sbyar gyi rogs ram/ skabs sbyar gyi bkod pa/ 2) sgo dang sge'u khung gi me long dang ru gnyis sbyor byed kyi lcags/
don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, yul gang la bstod pa gtong ba'i skabs su ma bab kyang, 'phral rkyen la brten nas yul de la glo bur du bstod pa'i rgyan zhig
1) bar mtshams med pa/ ngal gso byed pa'i skabs med/ 2) dus tshod med pa/ bsam blo gtong skabs med pa/

1) go rim gyi mtshams/ las ka snga phyi skabs mtshams so sor bkod sgrig byed pa/ 2) dus la bab pa'i mtshams/ skabs mtshams bab bstun gyis 'dzugs skrun byed/ tshogs 'du 'tshog pa'i skabs mtshams su gros bsdur nan po byed pa/
dus skabs 'tshol ba/ skabs 'tshol mgo bde byed pa/ skabs 'tshol tshong rgyag /
bar skabs bar skabs su bris pa'i ri mo/
tshe snga phyi da lta gsum/

(mngon) lha spyi'i ming ste, skye ba dang gnas pa, 'jig pa bcas kyi skabs gsum las med pa dang, yang na sngon gyi gnas skabs dang, da lta'i gnas skabs, phyi ma'i gnas skabs gsum shes pas ming de ltar btags pa/
/ 1) sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig ste, de'i gnas yul skyed chu'i byang rgyud deng sang gi mal gro gong dkar rdzong khongs yin/ 2) bzhon ma min pa'i mo phyugs/
rab tu skam pa/ khyed kyi gzugs po skam krog ge bar lus 'dug / sems rgyud gyong po skam grog ger lus/
tsha ba'i dus su mchu skam pa dang, kha skom pa'i bsdus tshig / tsha bas gdungs te kha skam skom gyi dus su chu zhig byung na ci ma rung/
sa skam sar skyes pa/ skam skyes byin tshal, chu ser dang tsha ba sel zhing skrangs pa 'jags par byed/

(yul) 1) than pas bsregs te skam por gyur pa/ 2) btung ba ma rnyed par kha skam por lus pa/ 3) sngar bod sa gnas su dus ston gtong skabs ser skya dpon rigs la sprod pa'i snum rtsi med pa'i bag leb kyi rigs shig /
cham tshad kyis na tshul zhig /
skam po dang gyong po/ sa skam gyong/ shing cha skam gyong/
1) char med par glog 'khyug pa 2) bzha' med pa'i glog rdzas
lam rgyags za chas skam po/
'phrul chas sogs la tshod lta'i sgo nas lhu chas sgrig sbyor byed pa
sngar bod sa gnas kyi gzhung 'bru bkar 'jug skabs bcu zur gcig skam dpyar bcag ste rtsis sprod len byed pa'i brtsi stangs shig /
'dzin chas sam, khyim nang gi dngos chas/
mgar ba'i skam pa chung ba/
bzha' thag phal cher chod nas skam la nye ba/ lo ma skam rnyid/ nyung ma skam rnyid/ me tog skam rnyid/
bzha' thag rbad de chod pa/ gyon chas bkrus rjes skam thag thag byas nas gyon na legs/
zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'jo mda' rdzong khongs 'bri chu'i nub 'gram gyi sde zhig yin
slob phrug gis dper blta ba'i ched du dge rgan gyis sbyang shing ngos su snag tsha med par bris pa'i yi ge / skam dras brgyab pa/
bod mda'i skam pa 'then byed lcags mda'/

1. 1) dngos po 'dzin spyad/ lag pa tsha dus kyi skam pa dang, tsher ma zug dus kyi rdog pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'dzin byed dang, lag grogs so, 2) rdza snod bzo byed kyi sa dmar zhig / 3) me mda'i skam pa/ 2. 1) chu med pa ste gsher ba'am, rlan pa las ldog pa/ me shing skam pa/ sman gyi yon tan skam pa/ 2) mo phyugs 'o thag chod pa/ 'bri skam pa/ mdzo mo skam pa/ ma mo skam pa/
sngar lha ldan smon lam gyi dus su lha sa'i mi dmangs so so'i khang thog tu dngos po nyi mar skam 'grems byas 'thus tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus 'khrol gyi ngos sbyor 'dzin tham/
/ 1) rlan gsher med pa/ lo ma skam po/ sa zhing skam po/ 2) sha shed nyams pa dang rid pa/ lus po skam po/ sgo phyugs kyi sha shed skam po/ bsod bde skam po/

sngar bod sa gnas su 'bru bun gtong skabs ngo bo khal bcu re la skyed khal gcig re len pa'i brtsi stangs shig / skam phogs, sngar gla pa dang bran g.yog la 'bru rigs ma gtogs ja chang sogs btung bya med pa'i gla phogs kyi srol zhig
sol pir sogs kyis bris pa'i ri mo rags pa/ skam bris ri mo/
dngos gzhi'i gong du byed pa'i nang sbyong/
skam sar dmag 'thab byed mkhan dmag dpung
1) lus kyi sha zhan pa/ 2) mig nad kyi bye brag mig skam zhing mi bde ba dang rtsub cing bser bus gnod pa zhig
bza' btung med par tshogs 'tshogs pa/
chu gtong sa med pa'i zhing kha/
tshad nad sogs kyi sngon bsu'i zug rngu
nad kyis rkyen pas rna ba 'on pa'i nad cig /
lus shin tu skam la stobs zhan pa/
1) skam po dang rlon pa'i bsdus tshig / 2) chu mang nyung gi rlon tshad/
chu thog min pa'i skam sa'i 'gro lam/
skam pa'i tshad dam, cha shas/ sa skam shas che na son la bzha' mi khug /
kha yod lag med kyi tshig stong pa bshad pa/
mtsho dang mtshe'u gtsang po sogs min pa'i sa cha/ nya mo skam sar thon pa ji bzhin gyur/
1) rlan gsher med pa'i sa cha/ 2) gling chen thog gi skam sa/ skam sangs, skam po skam rkyang/
1) 'bru la chu ma brgyab par brngos te btags pa'i rtsam pa spus zhan/ 2) skam la sob pa/ bag leb skam sob
lha rten la bsang btang nas smon lam 'debs pa/
rgyu skar rnams so so'i go lar skor thengs re byed pa'i 'gro lam de cha sum brgya drug cu re lngar bgos pa'i cha shas gcig /
zla srang skar skyed kyi bsdus tshig
sngar bod dngul skar gang sprod dgos pa'i khab ring thung 'bring ba zhig gi ming/
sge'u khung/ ming gi rnam grangs la dra mig dang, ba lang mig rlung sgo bcas so,
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis khyim bcu gnyis so sor 'dzin pa'i bar thag /
rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi sa khyon yongs rdzogs, dper na skar khyon phyed ni skar gnas bcu gsum dang chu tshod sum cu'o/
skar ma'i 'bor grangs de srang la bsgril ba ste, dper na skar brgya tham pa srang la bsgril na srang gang yin zhing, skar drug cu re lnga ni srang med zho drug skar lnga yin/
1) rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nang gses shig / 2) (tishya) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
1) skar ma lnga/ skar lnga'i dar dmar/ 2) sngar bod dngul zho gang gi phyed ka/

1) chu tshod skar ma gcig gi drug cu'i cha/ 2) ngal rtsol byas pa'i yong 'bab thob cha 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi/ skar chu, tho rengs skar ma ma yal gong du blangs pa'i chu bsil te, nus pas khong du btang na tsha ba khrag mkhris kyi nad sel, dugs byas na rlung nad ce spyang gi skrangs pa sogs la phan/
tho rengs 'char ba'i skar ma chen po zhig /
skar ma'i rtags mtshan te, skar 'od dang skar mdog sogs la bltas te legs nyes kyi mtshan ma ston pa'i bshad srol/
skar ltas la brten nas legs nyes gang yong ma 'ongs lung bstan byed mkhan/
nam mkhar mda' ltar rgyug pa'i skar ma/ skar mda' lhung ba/ nam mkha'i skar mda' lta bu'i myur ba/
gza' skar brtag dpyad byed lugs,
dus skar bzang ngan sogs rtsi mkhan/
snga dus bod dngul zho gang gi bzhi cha gsum ste bod tam gyi phyed ka/
snga dus bod dngul gyi zho gang gi bzhi cha gcig ste bod tam gyi drug cha gcig /

/ 1) nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'od khra lam lam du 'byin zhing 'phro ba'i skar ma/ sprang khyi thog kar bzhag na gnam gyi skar mar rmugs yong/ nyi zla skar gsum dus mnyam mthong/ 2) rgya thur gyi srang mdar bkod pa'i ljid tshad kyi rtags/ 3) ljid tshad zho'i bcu cha gcig / 4) dus yun chu tshod gcig gi drug cu'i cha gcig / 5) (mngon) gro bzhin dang byi bzhin gnyis gcig tu byas na rgyu skar la nyer bdun yod pas grangs nyer bdun mtshon/
skar ma sum tshom bzhi tshom sogs yod pa/ skya rengs tha mar skar ma tshom tshom du shar/
skar ma gang la bltas nas zho gang brlag pa ste bya ba chung chung la mgo 'khor nas chen po brlag 'gro ba'i dpe
'od chen po yod pa'i skar ma/

skar ma ri 'dor te, rtsis gzhung las, zla drug nyin 'char dang, zla drug mtshan 'char zhes gsal zhing, bod zla bdun pa'i gnam gang nas brgyad pa'i tshes pa gnyis kyi bar 'char rgyu'i rgyu skar zhig yin pa 'di'i 'od zer phog tshad kyi chu tshang ma sman chur gyur pas bod kyi chab zhugs dus chen zer ba'i srol rgyun 'di las byung/
myur ba dang, dal bu, 'khyog po, thad kar sogs rgyu skar 'pho stangs/
rkub skyog 'byor med 'byor yod du rlom pa'i che 'gying gi 'gro tshul
rig gnas chung ba lnga'i nang gses shig ste gza' skar dus tshigs sogs brtsi tshul/

rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i gzhung gi gras la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang dus 'khor bsdus rgyud, bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud, dpal ldan sva rod ? yi rgyud dam dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud, mig bcu gnyis pa'i mdo, stag rna'i rtogs brjod, nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo sogs mdo rgyud mang po dang stod 'grel, bod gzhung la mtshon na, rje rang byung zhabs kyi rtsis gzhung kun las btus pa, bu ston gyi mkhas pa dga' byed, mkhas grub rje'i tik chen de nyid snang ba, mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dri med 'od rgyan, phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho'i pad dkar zhal lung ma bu, lo chen dharma shr'i'i nyin byed snang ba, sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i beed'urya dkar po ma bu, sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyi dge ldan rtsis gsar ma bu, thu'u bkvan chos kyi nyi ma'i mkhas pa'i snying nor, phyag mdzod gsung rab kyi rigs ldan snying thig brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas kyi rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang sogs skar rtsis kyi khungs shin tu mang ngo/
gza' skar lta mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la skar mkhan dang, ltas rtog pa, ltas shes, dus mkhyen, dus shes, rtsis pa, ye mkhyen, lo shes bcas so,

sngar srol ltar bya ba gang zhig sgrub rgyu'i tshes grangs sngon du gtan 'khel ba'i nyin mo de'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyar mi legs pa zhig yin tshe de'i gong gi tshes grangs gza' skar bzang ba zhig la sgrub 'go tshugs tsam byed pa'i rten 'brel/
1) skar ma'i 'od/ ston dus kyi mtshan mor skar 'od chem chem 'tsher/ 2) (mngon) srin bu me khyer/ skar gsal, skar khung/
1) rang la bgo skal ma byung ba/ 2) lam 'gro med pa/

1) rigs gcig pa'am, rigs mtshungs/ skal mnyam gzhan la phan phyir gzhung 'di brtsams/ 2) sems can so so'i ris su skyes te 'dra ba'i chos de la skal mnyam mam ris mthun pa zer, ldan min 'du byed kyi gras shig /
rgyu drug gi nang gses shig ste rang 'bras rang dang rigs 'dra skyed par byed pa, nas las nas dang, dge ba las dge ba skye ba dang 'phel ba lta bu/
bsod nams can/ skal ldan gyi nya ma/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya/ legs par nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/

/ 1) bgo bsha' byas nas thob pa'i cha shas/ nor skal/ zas skal/ 'bru skal/ rang skal/ skal lhag / sprang skal/ 2) las skal dang bsod nams/ tshe grogs kyi skal ba/ chos skal/ 3) rtsis gzhung khag las dod dang yang na tshab kyi don du bshad/ ma thob nor skal thig le byin/
skal ba mi mnyam pa'i sems
sems can gyi gnas ris tha dad pa'i rgyud kyi bsam pa/
mna' ma dang mag par skal ba bskur ba'i dngos po/
1) bsod nams chen po dang go skabs yag po/ 2) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig /
skal bzang bgrod pa'i myur lam
tsha rong ba tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig /
ston dus su 'char ba'i me tog ser po zhig
thog kar yar 'dzeg mar 'bab byed pa'i skas ka/ skas ka ma 'dzegs par thog kar mi slebs/ shing skas/ rdo skas/ 'dre skas/ glog skas/ ming gi rnam grangs la them skas dang, 'dzeg rten, ya gad bcas so,
skas kyi 'gram pa gnyis kyi shing ste skas ru yang zer/
rdo skas dang shing skas kyi gdang bu'am bang rim/
rim 'dzeg ste rim gyis yar rgyas su gtong ba'am bgrod pa'i dpe/
1) khang pa'i skas sam 'dzeg skas/ 2) skas la 'dzeg pa/
1) skas 'dzeg gi bang rim mam gdang bu/ 2) skas 'dzeg khag mang gi steng shod rim pa/
skas kyi gdang bu'i g.yas g.yon gyi rten sa'i ru/
skas hril min par gdang bu shing leb btsugs pa'i skas/
bag ma gtong yul gyi khyim sgor slebs nas skas la 'dzeg skabs rgyag rgyu'i bshad pa/
lha khang dang pho brang sogs la yod pa'i skas gsum gshibs/
'dre skas sam byi'u skas te shing gdung ma hril por nyag ka bzos pa'i skas/

1. 1) lus kyi zhe sa/ sku tshad/ sku srung/ sku 'khrungs pa/ sku gshegs pa/ sku bsil ba/ sku mnyel ba/ 2) 'dra brnyan gyi zhe sa/ cu gang gi 'dra sku/ 'jim sku/ rdo sku/ lha sku/ bris sku/ 2. ming gi sngon du sbyar ba'i zhe sa'i tshig grogs shig / sku mgron/ sku mdun/ sku phung/ sku tshab/ sku zhabs/ sku yon/ sku gzugs/
1) khang pa la dkar rtsi gtong ba/ 2) ngo bstod byed pa/ rab btags zol bstod kyi sgo nas che brjod mang po'i sku dkar gsol ba/
gsal dwangs gzugs po bde thang/ bar lam snyun gzhi'i bar chad med par sku dkyil gsal dwangs byung ba dga' spro che/
gcig pu/ khong sku rkyang bzhugs 'dug /
dngos po'i bskur mo'am, lag rtags/
lus kyi 'du ba'am khams/ sku khams bzang po/
1) khrus brgyab pa/ 2) lha'i gzugs brnyan la khrus gsol ba'i chos spyod cig /

bod rgyal nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su spyugs pas spu hreng du brtsigs pa'i mkhar/ khar ma ru lha sa'i byang phyogs se ra'i nye 'dabs dben gnas pha bong kha la yod pa'i pho brang zhig ste, de na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po lo bzhi'i ring sku mtshams su bzhugs nas thu mi sam bho tas srol btod pa'i bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs dang sbyor ba rnams la mthar phyin pa sbyong tshul mdzad pa'i gnas te, sngar thog so dgu brtsegs su yod/
thugs rjes gzigs zhes gzhan la zhu gsol 'debs pa'i tshig /
gtso bo dang mnyam du 'gro mkhan/ sku 'khor stos bcas/ sku 'khor gtos che/
bag chags pa'i dpe byad sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste yon tan yang dag par brjod par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku 'khril bag chags pa ste, mnyen zhing 'gying legs pa/
lus khams ma snyoms pa ste mi bde ba/
lus kyi nye 'gram/ sang gnangs las mi 'gyangs par sku gam du ngo bcar zhus chog /
bar chad/ lo na phra mo nas sku gegs byung ste gshegs pa/
mi gtsang ba'i grib kyi zhe sa/ yab chen khyed la sku grib phog 'dug /
sku gzugs thang sha dod pa/
1) na tshod cher son pa'am yol ba/ 2) rgan gzhon gnyis kyi rgan pa/ kru'u zhi sku bgres pa/ phyag mdzod sku bgres pa/
dga' ston la bos pa'i blo nye'i mi/ sku mgron sne len khang/ sku mgron bzhugs gral/
dge 'dun mang tshogs la bgo bsha' byas nas phul ba'i dngul dngos/ tshogs la sku 'gyed phul/
1) lus kyi rgyan cha/ 2) rtsed mo'i skugs sam rgyan/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par 'phags pa'i phyir sku sha rgyas pa/
1) rgyu nor/ 2) lha'i sku brnyan bzo byed kyi rgyu/
rigs rgyud dam, gdung rgyud/ rgyal po'i sku rgyud/
dka' ngal/ sku ngal gso rogs gnang/
1) bdag po dngos/ 2) mi drag la 'bod pa'i zhe sa/
mi de nyid dam mi de rang/
chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo bal bza' khri btsun bod du phebs skabs rten skal du bsnams phebs pa'i sku ste, jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje, byams pa chos 'khor ma, tsan dan gyi sgrol ma gsum/

1) sangs rgyas kyi chos sku dang, longs sku, sprul sku, ngo bo nyid sku, mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ste lnga/ 2) rnying lugs su 'bras chos nyer lnga'i dbye gzhir gyur pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las te lnga/ 3) rnying ma'i rgyud sde rnams su gsal ba'i 'bras chos nyer lnga'i nang gses chos sku dang, longs sku, sprul sku, mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku, mngon par byang chub pa'i sku ste sku lnga/
t'a la'i bla ma'i drung ngam mdun du sdod mkhan dpon rigs/
t'a la'i bla ma'i drung du rtag tu sdod mkhan spyi khyab mkhan po sogs/
zhing drang ba'i mtshan bzang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste srog gcod pa spangs pa nyid kyis sku che zhing drang ba/
1) lha sku che ba/ 2) mi chen/
1) dge tshul slong gi gyon rgyu'i chos gos kyi zhe sa/ 2) chos kyi zhe sa/
pha ma gcig pa'am pha ma gang rung gi rigs rgyud du gtogs pa'i spun/
1) pha ma gcig pa'i spun mched gsum/ 2) rgyal sras sku mched gsum ste 'brom ston pa'i thugs sras po to ba dang, spyan snga ba, phu chung ba rnams so/
bla sprul che khag dgongs rdzogs rjes dran gyi mchod 'bul/
bya gzhag gi gzhi chus/ las drang po'i 'dun ma ma bzung na, dus tha ma sku jus shor na 'gyod/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, thugs rje can gyi phyir sku la rtsub bag med pas 'jam pa/
sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku dang, chos sku/
dkon gnyer ram lha gnyer/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkon gnyer dang, lha gnyer, lha yis 'tsho ba bcas so,
ngal ba'am thang chad pa/ phebs lam la sku mnyel ma song ngam/
lha'i khog rten nam, chos rje/
1) bstod bsngags/ 2) sangs rgyas kyi sku'i yon tan la bstod pa/
shi ba'i zhe sa/ sku thim khar zhal chems gsungs pa/
mi tshe'i ring ngam mi rabs/ sku thog sngon ma/ sku thog rjes ma/ sku thog mang po/ srong btsan sgam po'i sku thog /
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, thugs rnam par dag pa'i phyir sku rnam par dag pa/
phan pa'am drin/ sku drin shes pa/ sku drin gzo ba/
1) phung po'am ro/ sku gdung mjal/ sku gdung zhud 'bul byas/ 2) ring bsrel/ 3) ring bsrel lam gdung bcug pa'i mchod rten/ sku gdung mchod rten/
ston pa'i ring bsrel cha brgyad du bgos te bzhengs pa'i mchod rten/
1) drung ngam lus kyi 'khris sam mdun/ 2) sku ngo ma rang/
sha mdog / sku mdog ser po/ sku mdog rab dkar/

gser zangs dang 'jim pa sogs las bzos pa'i 'dra brnyan/ ming gi rnam grangs la nges snang dang, sku mtshungs pa, sku yi gzhi 'dzin, 'dra bar bzhengs, 'dra 'bag lder bzo, pra phab bzhin, dpe dang mnyam pa, dpe dang mtshungs pa, gzugs brnyan, rab tu 'dra, legs par bzhengs, slar bris ma, slar gzugs, slar byas 'dra, so sor mtshungs bcas so,
rdo rje gsum gyi nang gses, gzugs rnam par dag pa snang stong gnyis su med pa'i sku rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi rang bzhin tshang ba/
lo tshod/ sku na bgres kyang thugs rig ha cang gsal/ yab yum gnyis gshegs pa dang sku na phra bas phyag rdzas rnams mi'i lag tu bcol/

gro ta ltar chu zheng gab pa'i mtshan bzang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste nags tshal dang kun dga' ra ba la sogs pa byed pa yang dag par len du bcug pas shing na-ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab pa/
shi ba'i ro/ sku pur zhugs 'bul byas/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, sku mnyen zhing 'gying legs pas 'khril bag chags pa dang, ring thung sbom phra sogs ma 'chol bas rim par 'tshams pa dang, mtshan rnams kyi cha shas mtha' dag gsal zhing rdzogs pa dang, sku khyon che bas kho lag yangs shing bzang ba dang, sku shin tu gzhon sha can du gyur pa dang, sku la rtsub bag med pas 'jam pa dang, sku rid pa sogs kyi skyon med pas zhum pa med pa dang, sku sha rgyas pa dang, sku mi lhod par shin tu grim pa dang, sor mo dang yan lag sbom phra sogs kyi cha phyed pas shin tu rnam par 'byes pa bcas bcu'o/
skye ba'i rabs sam, tshe snga phyi'i brgyud rim ste sangs rgyas chos lugs las mi shi rjes slar yang skye ba len rgyu yod pa de'i skye ba rim brgyud la zer/
sngar bod rgyal gyi 'khris su bsdad nas 'don pa 'don mkhan bon po/
sku byi dor byas 'dra'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste sdig pa'i chos dang ma 'bags pa nyid kyis khrus sogs ma byas kyang sku byi dor byas pa lta bur gtsang zhing dag pa/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, sku la sogs pa kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba'i phyir sku la nag dreg sogs rnam par dag pa/
rtsed mo'i zhe sa/ ae he bdag gis sku rtsed zhus/ sku rtsed ma gnang/
1) lus che chung gi tshad/ 2) lus kyi tsha ba/

ma'i gcen po dang gcung po/
1) ming bye brag pa la sbyor rgyu'i zhe sa/ sku zhabs rgya mtsho/ mda' dpon sku zhabs/ 2) sku'i drung/ sku zhabs su bcar ba yin/

sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid sku, ye shes chos sku, longs sku, sprul sku ste bzhi/ zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par mdzod/

1) lus/ bar der sku gzugs bde po yod shag / sku gzugs dpangs mtho zhing rngams pa/ sku gzugs brjid bag ldan la mdzes pa/ 2) snang brnyan/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzud/
1) yon tan/ sku yon chen po/ 2) gla rngan te zhabs brtan byed mkhan sogs la phul ba'i gla cha/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku rim par 'tshams pa ste ring thung sbom phra ma 'chol ba/ ..
1) lus kyi rus pa/ 2) pha ma'i rus rgyud/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, dus ma yin pa'i chos 'dul ba dang bral ba nyid kyis sku la sme ba dang nag bag med pa/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, yang srid zad pa nyid kyis sku shin tu grims pa/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, chos go sla bar ston pa'i phyir sku shin tu gzhon sha can/

/ sku srog skyel ba'i mdzad pa gnang mi 'tshal

sangs rgyas la bstod pa'i bstan bcos shig sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan la bstod pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po krishna pandi ta dang, lo tsa ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/
ngal gso khams gseng/ sku gseng du phebs song/

sku brjid nyams gsal bar shar tshul/ sku ri rab ltar lham mer bzhugs pa/ tshod 'du'i thog la sku lham mer phebs pa/
(tha dad pa) bskugs pa, bskug pa, skugs,, rgyan 'gyed pa ste rgyu dngos sogs rgyal btsugs nas rgyal pham 'gran bsdur byed pa/ rgyal skug pa/ rgyan chen po bskugs pa/
1. skug pa'i skul tshig 2. rgyal lam rgyan/ lus srog skugs su btsugs/ skugs su 'jug pa/
jag rkun gyis sgug rgyag sa'i 'phrang dog po/
(tha dad pa) bskungs pa, bskung ba, skungs,, sbed pa dang gsang ba/ dngos yod gnas lugs skung ba/ mi ngan bskungs pa/ khrims 'gal dngos rigs skung ba/ skyon cha nam yang mi skung/
gna' bo'i gos chen zhig gi ming/

1. (tha dad pa) bskus pa, bsku ba, skus, , 'byug pa/ sman bskus pa/ bkrag rtsi skud pa/ skra la skra snum bsku ba/ 2. srad bu/ dngul skud/ lcags skud/ dar skud/ bal gyi skud pa snyod pa/ bal skud 'khal/ ras skud sgrim/ so ma ra tsa'i skud pa bsdogs te gru gu bzos/ khab kyi rjes su skud pa 'gro/ ming gi rnam grangs la snal skud dang, snal ma, srad bu bcas so,

/ 1) rang gi bud med kyi ming po/ ming gi rnam grangs la chung ma'i spun zla dang, chung ma'i mched do, 2) sring mo'i zla bo/
rang gi bud med kyi spun mo/

/ 1) kong bu sogs snod chung spyi'i ming/ 2) gzhong pa/
(tha dad pa) bskums pa, bskum pa, skums,, 1) nang du'am tshur 'then pa/ rkang lag tshur bskums/ brkyang bskum bde po 'dug / 2) sba ba/ skad cha skum pa/ bsam 'char bskums nas mi shod pa/
sku'i skyon med pa'i dpe byad bzhi

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, sku la sme ba dang gnag bag med pa dang, sku mi mdzes pa'i skyon gyis rnam par dag pa dang, mig rnag po dreg sogs dri mas gtsang ba dang, khrus sod ma byas kyang rang bzhin gyis dag pas byi dor byas pa 'dra ba bcas bzhi'o/
sku'i kho lag yangs shing bzang ba'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, yangs shing mdzes pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir sku'i kho lag yangs shing bzang ba ste sku khyon che ba/
kyi kha dog / sku'i mdog dkar po/ sku'i mdog nag po/
sku'i gnas bdun mtho ba'i mtshan bzang
bza' btung rgya chen po byin pas phyag zhabs kyi rgyab bzhi dang, phyag gong gnyis dang, ltag pa ste bdun rnams shas khengs pa/
lus kyi rnam pa/ gsung skad gsang zhing sku'i rnam 'gyur spam po zhig 'dug /
sku'i mdzad phrin nam spyod pa/
lus kyi dbyibs/ sku'i tshugs mdzes shing 'tshams pa/ sku'i rus tshugs dpangs mtho/ sku'i sha tshugs/

skur ba 'debs pa ste gzhan la yon tan yod pa rnams med pa dang, bzang po rnams ngan par bcos pa'i smod tshig / las 'bras la skur 'debs/ dkon mchog la skur 'debs/ bden bzhi la skur ba 'debs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la brgyad bkag dang phyin ci log brjod pa, 'phya tshig mtshang rgod, log sgrub, log 'dren tshig log smra bcas so,
tha snyad du yod pa'i chos rnams yod pa min pa'am med par 'dzin pa/
yon tan yod pa la med par smra ba dang, skyon cha med pa la yod par smra ba/

1. (tha dad pa) bskur ba, bskur ba, skur,, 1) gzhan la 'khyer rgyu 'chol ba/ ngag lan skur ba/ yig 'phrin bskur ba/ mkha' lam nas skur ba/ dngul bskur ba/ 2) sprod pa'am 'god pa/ dbang bskur ba/ las 'gan bskur ba/ 2. yod bzhin du med par bshad pa dang, yon tan yin bzhin du skyon char brtsis pa'i smod tshig / bden don la skur ba ma 'debs/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, mthong thos dogs gsum med pa'i dge slong la bsam bzhin du lhag ma bcu gsum gang rung gi skur ba 'debs pa/
1) skul byed kyi lcag tshan/ rta la skul lcag bzhus pa/ 2) skul ma dang lcag 'debs te, dngos su lag len byed du 'jug pa'i tshig gam thabs shes/ las don 'di'i skor la skul lcag thengs mang btang ba/
las don skul sla ba/ rta bzang zhon bde, mi bzang skul bde/
skul ma 'debs pa ste lag len bstar bar skul zhing 'ded pa/ khral 'ul skul 'ded/ btsan shed kyis skul 'ded byas pa/ dpe cha 'di bzhin brtsam dgos zhes pa'i skul 'ded yang yang byas pa/
skul lcag byed pa/ las 'gan 'phral 'phral bsgrub rgyur skul 'debs byed/
byed du 'jug pa'i go byed kyi brda/ skul brda dang len/
yar rgyas dang khyab gdal gtong ba/

(tha dad pa) bskul ba, bskul ba, skul,, 1) byed du 'jug pa dang, gsal 'debs pa/ lag len byed par skul ba/ khur sems skul ba/ nan gyis skul ba/ khral 'ul skul pa/ 2) skyod pa dang rlom pa/ zing 'khrug bskul ba/ rgyu nor gyis sems bskul ba/ lha 'dres rgyud bskul ba
1) (tsunda) byang chub sems dpa' zhig / 2) (mngon) lcag tshan nam, rta lcag /
blo sems skyed thabs dang, bya spyod dngos su byed du 'jug pa'i ming/ phan tshun skul ma gtong res byed/ yig thog nas skul ma 'debs/ mos mthun dgos lugs kyi skul ma yang yang btang ba yin/

mi gzhan la bya ba byed par skul ba'i tshig ste spyir bya byed tha dad pa'i byed tshig la 'jug pa dang, skabs 'gar bya byed tha dad pa la mi 'jug pa dang, tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'ang yod, skul tshig gi rjes su tshig grogs cig dang, zhig shig dang sgra sogs sbyar ba sdod cig gyis shig lta bu skul tshig tshig grogs dang ldan pa yin zhing, dang sgra la ni ltos dang mthong gi red lta bu skul tshig gi mthar gdams ngag ston pa'i dang sgra'i phrad sbyar ba yin/ cig zhig shig dang...mar sdod/ mar sdod cig / mar sdod dang khos 'khyer yong/ mig gis ltos/ mig gis ltos shig / mig gis stos dang mthong gi red/
sngar dus khral 'u lag sogs skul ba'i gzhung khra/
skul ma byas nas brtson sems dang ngar sems sogs slong ba/
skus byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'
ston pas skus byin gyis brlabs te byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i mdo, dper na, sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu/

mjing pa'am mgo'i rten/ ske 'chus 'dug / ske 'tshir btang nas bsad/ ske gcod pa/ ske gtub pa/ ske bregs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mgur dang, mgul, mgo rten, mgo stegs, mgo 'dzin, mgrin pa, aog kong bcas so,
ske yar bsgrengs pa'i dbyibs/ ske krong krong byas nas lta/
ske la dkri bya'i snam ras sogs/
phan du re'ang don du rang gis rang la gnod skyel ba/
1) ske'i rgyan/ 2) gos kyi mjing sgor/ ske 'gag myur du 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi ske nad cig /
1) rta drel sogs kyi mjing par g.yog byed dam skyob byed/ 2) ske rgyan/
snum gtig ske gcod dgos sam snum gtig gi yin zhes btsan shed byed pa dpe 'di phru gu tshos 'bu cha ga pa bzung ste btsir nas kha'i mchil ma skyug tu bcug pa'i rtsed mo nas byung/
sngar gyi go cha zhig gi ming/
ske mgrin gyen nam thad kar rkyong 'gul gyi rnam pa/ sge khung nang nas ske snyeng snyeng byas nas lta gi 'dug /
dud 'gro'i ske la 'dogs pa'i thag pa/ sgo khyi la ske thag brgyab nas btags 'dug /
khyi dang phyugs sogs kyi ske la mdzes rgyun du 'dogs rgyu zhig /
1) ske thag pas 'dogs pa/ 2) ske nas 'dogs byed/ 3) ske la 'dogs pa'i rgyan cha/
thag pa gang rung gis ske bcings nas srog gcod pa/
phor pa sogs dkrug byed kyi 'khor lo'i ske 'dzin byed kyi pang leb/
mgul du gdags rgyu'i rgyan cha/
1) sha khog ske 'byar/ 2) ske thung thung/
gsar nyos sgo phyugs de sngar yod pa zhig gi ske la 'dogs pa'i ming/ dud 'gro ske sbrel gyis rtswa sar btang/
mgo dang brang khog bar gyi cha de la ske zhes zer bas der mtshon sogs phog pa las byung ba'i rma/
1) ske krong krong/ 2) lus po rid pa'am rjud pa/
ske'i rus tshigs/ ske tshigs 'chus pa/

ske tshe nag po yang zer, sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, lo sdong sogs yungs nag dang 'dra ba, ro tsha, nus pas gnyan skrangs dang lhog pa la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngon skyes dang, nag mo, yungs kar rgyal po, lha min mo bcas so,
mi dang dud 'gro gsod thabs kyi ske sdom byed cig /
skye kyog kyog / grib phog nas skye yon por gyur song/

sgro mdog kham ser dang, rkang pa dang mchu shin tu ring ba, sder mo'i bar sbrel skyi mo med pa, dus rgyun na thang gi 'bu dang chu'i nang gi nya phrug rnams za ba'i bya zhig /

1) sked pa 'khyog po/ 2) rgyu skar zhig /

1) sked pa na ba'i nad/ 2) bud med kyi zla mtshan/

/ 1) lus kyi sked pa/ dar gyi ska rags sked par 'ching/ 'khur rgyu'i rdog khres lci drags pas sked pa 'chus 'dug / sgal tshigs 'chus nas sked pa gug gug byas 'dug / ming gi rnam grangs la ska rags yul lo, 2) bar mtshams/ ri sked la lam phran zhig 'dug /
sked pa'i thad kyi rus tshigs/ stag mchong sar wa mchongs na wa'i sked tshigs bud yong/
dpyi mgo la lag pa rten pa/ lag gnyis sked gzer byas nas sgo khar langs
btags nas bzos pa'i sked chings/
sked pa'i lung thag gam aa long/
(mngon) 1) bud med mdzes ma/ 2) lha'i bu mo/
sked pa'i thad/ mdel rtse sked sor phog pa/ thag pa sked sor btags pa/
bud med dar ma zla mtshan yun ring mi 'bab pas gzugs po rid pa dang, gdong la sha khebs 'byung ba sogs kyi nad gzhi zhig /

1. (tha dad pa) bskams pa, bskam pa, skoms,, rlan pa'am gsher cha med par bzo ba/ grib mar skem pa/ myi mar skem pa/ gzha' tshan skem pa/ 2. rid po/ gzugs po skem pa/ skem po, rid po'am lus sha shor ba/ rta rgan skem po/ gzud po skem po/
lha dga' rab dbang phyug gi mda' lnga'i gras shig /
skem pa'i skul tshig gi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
bod kyi bud med tsho'i gzab spros mgul rgyan gyi ga'u 'di ni gser dngul gyis bzos shing, ngos la g.yu sogs kyi phra btab pa, mu tig dang gzi sogs bstar la brgyus nas lung thag byas pa zhig /

(tha dad pa) bskos pa, bsko ba, bskos,, 1) go gnas su 'jog pa'am, go gnas sprod pa/ las 'dzin du bskos pa/ rgyal sras rgyal sar bsko ba/ zhang nye'i sras mo btsun mor bskos pa/ las 'gan bsko bar mi 'os pa/ 2) las dbang gis gta 'khel ba/ las kyis bskos pa'i skal ba/ gnam gyis bskos pa/
(rgya) ja spus ka zhan pa zhig /
/ 1) shun pa/ sgo nga'i skogs pa/ shing gi skogs pa/ star skogs/ 2) sbun pa/ 3) shubs/ yig skogs/ mar skogs/
phyi'i pags pa/ rus sbal gyi skogs shun/ ka ped kyi skogs shun/
phyogs gcig tu sdud pa dang khag so sor bkod sgrig byed pa/ las 'dzin skong sgrig / dmag dpung skong sgrig byas pa/

(tha dad pa) 1. bskangs pa, bskang ba, skongs,, 1) yid tshim par byed pa/ thugs dam skong bar byed/ re ba bskangs/ 2) grangs 'bor chad pa rnams tshang bar byed pa/ mi grangs kha bskang rgyu/ dpe cha'i mjug kha skong ba/ 2. bskongs pa, bskong ba, skongs,, 'gugs pa dang, sdud pa/ tshogs 'du bskongs/ nus shugs ji yod bskong ba/

1. (tha dad pa) bskon pa, bskon pa, skon,, gyon du 'jug pa dang, g.yogs pa/ phru gur gos gsar bskon/ rtsam pa rang gis brkus nas rtsam khug gzhan mgor bskon/ 2...1) ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rgya'am rnyi/ 2) gzhong pa/
/ 1) mchod kong sogs snod chas chung ngu spyi'i ming/ 2) bya dang ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rgya dang dra ba/ 3) lcug mas bslas pa'i snod chung gras/
(rnying) lcug ma las bzos pa'i lhung bzed sogs 'jog sa'i snod/
/ 1) bya dka' ba'i gnas/ las ka'i skobs su tshud pa/ 2) sa'i 'obs dong/ me skobs/
kha skom pa sang byed kyi skyur khu/

skom pa sel byed kyi chang/ skom dad, 1) 'thung 'dod che ba'am ji tsam btungs kyang ngoms rgyu med pa/ skom dad che ba/ 2) gyen rgyu'i rlung dang mkhris pa 'khrugs pa sod las byung ba'i kha skom 'thung 'dod che ba'i nad rigs lnga ste, rlung las gyur pa dang, mkhris pa las gyur pa, bad kan las gyur pa, 'dus pa las gyur pa, bcud zad pa las gyur pa bcas lnga'o/
btung ba blud pa'am, 'thung du 'jug pa/ tsha ba'i nad kyis mnar ba la skom yang yang ldud dgos/

1. (tha mi dad pa) skoms pa, skom pa,, kha'i nang gi rlan skam pa'i gdung ba/ kha skom pa/ skoms na btung ba 'thung, ltogs na lto chas za/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ kha yag bshad na go mi chod, tshwa chu 'thung na skom mi sos/ 2. 1) btung ba'i rigs/ zas skom/ skom pa grang mo/ skom 'dod pa/ 2) btung ba 'thung 'dod mkhan/ skom pa rnams skom pa dang bral/
shin tu 'dod pa'i dpe/ thar 'dod kyi bsam pa skom pa chu 'dod ltar yod/
lus rngul, rma gsher, rnag chu mang po rdol pa'i rma nad kyi ming/

1. skor ba'i skul tshig 2. 1) rigs dang sde tshan/ zhing las skor/ 'brog las skor/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor yar rgyas su gtong ba'i byed phyogs skor/ 2) yul sde dang sa khul/ byang shar skor/ skam sa chen po'i skor/ mnga' ris skor gsum/ 3) nye 'dabs/ khang skor/ grong khyer gyi nye skor/ 4) ldab grangs/ 'bru rigs sum cu skor thon pa/ ma bu skor thang/ zhing kha'i thon skor/
thad ka ma yin pa'am kha thug min pa/ lam skor kyog / bsam slo skor kyog / skad cha skor kyog /
sngar lha ldan smon lam skabs lha sa'i bar skor mtshan 'khyongs bskor te chos sgra sgrog pa po/
sa gnas ga sa ga la bskor te 'gro ba/ ga sa gar skor skyod byas nas ltad mo ston/ skor skyod sman bcos ru khag / skor skyod tshong pa/
ma ni skor sa'i khang pa/
rtsis kyi skor 'go ste grangs brtsi sa'i thog ma'am gzhi/
phar skor tshur skor byas te 'gro ba/ yul grong nges med la skor rgyug byas/
sngar bod lha sa'i grong nang gi khrims khang snang rtse shag gi skor zhib byed mi'i gras/
1) mtha' skor gyi bar thag / 2)thad kar ma yin pa bskor nas 'gro dgos pa'i lam thag / skor thag ring thag chod/ mtsho'i skor thag la rta lam nyin gsum yod/

1) brje tshong skabs kyi rin thang brtsi stangs/ 'bru dang mar gyi skor thang/ tshwa dang nas kyi skor thang/ 2) sa bon dang thon 'bab gnyis bar gyi ldab grangs/ lo legs skabs 'bru rigs la sum cu bzhi bcu skor thang thon yong/
ri mo sgor sgor 'bri byed kyi lag cha zhig /
sa zhing la thon skor rtsi ba'i deb yig /

1. (tha dad pa) bskor ba, bskor ba, skor,, 1) 'khor du 'jug pa/ 'phrul 'khor skor ba/ rta kha skor ba/ yang skor bskyar skor/ mgo skor ba/ kha phyod bskor ba/ bskor bshad gros bsdur/ 2) phyogs mtshams yongs nas bkag sdom byed pa/ mtha' nas rim gyis bskor ba/ gangs ris bskor ba/ lcags ris bskor ba/ 3) rim gyis 'khyam pa dang, phar tshur 'gro ba/ kha bskor ba/ gnas skor ba/ khrom 'khor ba/ 2.thog mtha' med pa'i dbyibs sgor sgor/ skor ba gcig brgyab pa/ ring thung skor ba gnyis 'khor ba zhig 'dug / skor lam/ chos skor/ bon skor/ nang skor/ phyi skor/ bar skor/

1) las ka'i rjes zin pa'am, lcogs pa/ las ka mang po de 'dra skor ba 'khor thub bam mi thub/ dus tshod da dung skor ba 'khor ma song/ 2) nyo tshong byed skabs ma rtsa sprod len la lag thogs med pa/ ma dngul skor ba 'khor mi thub pas tshong ha log pa/
dus tshod nges can zhig gi ring la skor ba 'khor ba'i thengs grangs/ skor dbye, 1) 'bru dang rdo dbye ba 'byed byed kyi yo byad cig / 2) skor zhib kyis dbye ba 'byed pa/
phyogs mtshams kun nas bskor te rgol ba'i dpung sde/ skor dmag rgyag pa/
(rnying) gnas skabs sam re zhig / skor tsher skyed cing, skor tsher sdug /
phyogs tshang mar phyin nas lta zhib byed pa/
rtsid skud 'khal byed kyi shing ru bzhi yu ba can/
rim bzhin skor ba'i re mos/ las ka skor res byed/
skor ba rgyag sa'am skor g.yeng 'gro ba'i lam ga /
skor ba phyin ci log pa/ mdun du skyod pa'i shing rta 'khor lo skor log tu skor mi thub/
(tha dad pa) bskol ba, bskol ba, skol,, 'khor bar byed pa/ sman bskol/ chu skol gyin 'dug / ja skol 'bras 'tshod/
/ 1) khang pa'i rtsig pa/ khang pa'i phyi skya rdo rtsig yin/ khang pa'i bar skya/ 2) lo tog dang bza' btung/ lo legs skya rgyal ba/
mdog dkar shas che ba zhig / dgun dus ri thams cad skya skyar 'gyur ba/
phug ron dang ri bong sogs bsad de za ba'i bya khra'i rigs che ba zhig /
dkar lam me ba/ grod mar gyi bcad kha skya khrig ger bsdad 'dug / khang pa'i sgo gsar pa skya khrig ge bar 'dug /
gangs kyi kha dog lta bu/ kha ba skya khrom khrom/ ba mo skya khrom khrom chags pa/
bkrag mdangs dang snum zhag nyams pa'i mdog / bkrag mdangs nyams nas skya 'khogs su song 'dug /
mdog nag cing glo dkar po can gyi bya zhig ste bya khra'ang zer/
lo ltar char 'go tshugs skabs khang steng du sa bkram ste thigs pa 'gog pa'i dus tshod nges can zhig /
mdog skya la gang yin mi gsal ba'am dreg pa 'thug pos g.yogs pa zhig ste bad kan nad kyis zin pa'i lce'i mdog lta bu/
1) 'bru sogs bza' btung gi rigs dkon po min pa/ 2) blon pos rgyal po la rgol ba la skya rgyal zhes mdo sde stag rna'i brda tshig yin par bshad/
skya rgyal ba ste ston thog legs shing mtsho ba'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa/
phyi thum dang tshon rtsi med pa'i shing sgam/
dkar ba'i rnam pa/ kha ba skya chil chil du 'bab/ rba rlabs skya chil chil du g.yo/
dkar mdangs 'phro tshul zhig / gnam la skar ma skya chem chem shar ba/ gangs ri nas 'od skya chem chem zhig 'phro gin 'dug /
'od dkar po 'phro tshul/ shing se ba'i me tog skya chem me bar shar 'dug /
shog bu dkar por snag tshas bris pa'am snag tshas spar btab pa'i chos dpe
skya nyil le ba ste dkar po'i snang tshul zhig / gangs skya nyil le bar 'bab/ skra skya nyil le bar zhing/
dkar pos gang tshul zhig / dkar yol 'o mas skya ltem mer gang 'dug /
dkar shas che ba'i thal ba langs tshul/ thal 'tshub skya tha la la langs zin 'dug /
rtswa chu med pa'i thang gi mdog /
dkar shig shig / mi phyin pa'i rkang rjes skya thal le ba gzigs pas rkang rjes ded de ri khrod du 'byor/
khang pa sogs kyi 'char 'god kyi dpe ris rags rim
mar mang po med pa'i thud/
dkar snang gsal la mi gsal ba/ smugs pa chen po'i nang nas mig gis skya thum me ba zhig las gsal po mi mthong/
skye dngos sogs gang yang med pa'i sa mdog skya po/ sa skya ther ther/
mig lcibs kyi nang du thor pa 'byung ba'i mig nad cig /
1) skud pa'i skya zhig pa/ 2) ston thog smin pa/
skya rengs/ nam la langs gong la skya mda' gtong ba,
lung pa'i nang zas gos phun sum tshogs po yod pa/
rtswa zhig gi ming/ skya pham, rgyal pos blon por rgol ba la skya pham zhes mdo sde stag rna'i brda tshig yin par bshad/
phyur khu'am sngo khu yun ring bskol te bskams nas bton pa'i phyur ba ro bcud zhan pa,..
dkar po'i rnam 'gyur/ 'o ma skya phyur phyur/
spu mdog dkar nag cha 'dres/ dbu skra skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur 'dug / sma ra skya phyed sngo phyed/
dkar 'od 'phro tshul/ rtswa rtser zil pa skya phrom phrom chags pa/
'tsho ba'i cha rkyen bza' btung zhan po/

1. (tha dad pa) bskyas pa, bskya ba, skyos,, 1) sdod gnas gzhan du spo ba/ ru ba bskya ba/ 'brog pa zhig bskyas pa'i shul na khyi gu gsum lus nas 'dug / 2) (rnying) skyel ba/ 2. 1) gru gzings skul byed dam skyod byed kyi yo byad cig / gru skya/ skya ba rgyag pa/ skya ba skyod pa/ 2) ja thug sogs srub byed kyi shing rgyug / 3) skya bo dang 'dra,
thal 'tshub phyur ba lta bu'i snang ba/

1. rab byung ma yin pa'i khyim pa/ ser mo ba dang skya bo tshang ma/ ser skya dpon rigs/ btsun pa skya sar bab pa/ skya min ser min/ 2. 1) thal ba dang 'dra ba'i mdog dkar shas che ba zhig / sa skya bo/ gos skya bo gyon pa/ 2) tshon mdog gam snum rtsi med pa/ zas skya bo/ spags skya/ rtsam skya/ skya bzas skya 'thung/ skya sgam/ chu lud gang yang ma sbyar bar sa zhing skya 'debs byed pa/
mdog skya bo snbum zhag med cing rid pa/
kha dog dkar po yin pa'i bra bo ste, 'bru rigs shig

lus kyi me drod nyams pa sogs las byung ba'i pags mdog skya zhing skrangs pa rbab rbab tu 'byung ba'i chu nad cig ste, nang gses dbye na glo ba skya rbab dang, mchin pa skya rbab, mcher ba skya rbab, chu ser skya rbab, rlung skya rbab bcas lnga mchis so/
skud pa skya mang gi ya gcig gam rkang gcig / skya ma 'dzings pa/ thag pa skya gnyis ma/
rta pa/ skya mi'i nyin lam bco brgyad yod/
rab tu ma byung gong ngam grwa ba ma byas gong gi ming/
dkar po'i rigs phyur bur gang tshul/ 'o zom skya mer rer gang 'dug /
mdog dkar zhing 'dzar 'dzar ram nar nar gyi tshul du 'bab pa/ kha chu skya tsa rer 'dzag pa/ 'o ma skya tsa rer 'dzag pa/

1) khyim gyi bu rgan pas mi skya byed rgyu'i rigs/ 2) rtsa ba'i mi khongs/ skya rtsa phyir slog grwa pa log rjes rtsa ba'i mi bdag gi khyim gongs su rang slog byas pa/ skya rtsa rang bdag grwa pa log kyang mi bdag dgon pa de rang gis byed pa/
nor phyugs kyi glo nad 'gog nus pa'i sman sbyor zhig /
mtshan mo rgya mtsho'i rgyang ring nas mthong ba'i thal 'tshub 'dra ba zhig /
rtswa rnying pa dkar po'i rigs zad nas rtswa gsar sngon po yang zla gtud pa/ skya zad sngo gtugs kyi gnas tshul rtsa ba nas med par gyur zin/
sha mar sogs zhag tshi med pa'i zas rigs/
khang sgrom lta bu'i bzo dbyibs rags pa/
skud pa'i skya gnyis kyi ya gcig / snam bu skya ya ma/
dpangs mtho la mdog dkar ba'i gzugs snang zhig / gangs ri skya yo re ba/ mchod rten skya yo re ba/
mdog dkar zhing gsal la ma gsal ba'i tshul/ snang ba skya yor yor/
1) 'od snang mi gsal ba/ 2) mig gi rgyal mo'i steng 'grib byed dkar pos g.yogs nas mig lam gyi gzud rnams rab rib tu gyur te gsal bar mi mthong ba'i don/
rims nad ma smin pa'i skabs/
ha lam tsam bris pa'i ri mo'am zhwa smyug dang sol pir lta bus bris pa'i ri mo/ ras gzhi'i steng du thog ma'i skya ris bris zin/

nam langs khar shar phyogs kyi nam mkhar shar ba'i nyi 'od/ khri gdugs 'od kyis ma ded na, skya rengs shar ba ga la srid/ skya rengs kyi mdun nas mun pa rang dbang med par bros pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyung sngon skyes dang, nyi ma'i kha lo, 'od srungs, brla med bcas so, skya rengs skar ma, tho rengs skar chen te zhogs pa snga por shar phyogs nas 'char ba'i skar chen zhig /
nam langs kha'i skya mda' ste nam mkha' dmar skyar snang ba'i mdog 'char skabs/
tho rengs shar dus sam, nam mkha' sngo skyar snang ba'i mdog 'char skabs/ skya rengs dang po'i snang bas tha grur khyab/
nam ma langs gong shar phyod kyi nam mkhar ser skya'i mdangs phog pa'i dus/
nam langs khar shar phyogs kyi nam mkhar skya mda' phog pa/
skya rengs dang po dang, bar ma, tha ma'am, skya rengs, sngo rengs, dmar rengs te gsum/

1) mi ngan dang 'grogs 'dris byed pa/ ma rabs kyi midang skya la sngo 'byar gyi ngan sbrel ma byed/ 2) 'khris nas sdod pa'am, gzhan la rten pa/ rang mgo rang 'don ma gtogs skya la sngo 'byar byed mi dgos/
1) srog chags rtsangs pa sgal ral/ 2) gru'i mjug tu btsugs pa'i gru kha lo sgyur byed shing leb mo/
(yul) tshos mdog dkar min sngo min/ gyon pa skya log sngo log cig gyon 'dug /
sprin dang thal ba sogs gyen du 'phyur tshul/ me sgyod phog pa'i sa nas thal ba skya long long du 'phyur/
'brum bu dkar po'i nad kyi ming/
dkar po'i 'od mdangs/ zla ba'i 'od mdangs skya shar shar 'phro
dkar rkyang gi snang tshul zhig / dri nog chu la bkrus nas skya sang nger dag song/ nas skya sang nger langs pa/
mdog dkar zhing gtsang ba'i mngon tshul zhig / zla 'od skya sang nger shar ba/ dbyar gos skya sang nge ba zhig gyon 'dug /
1) mdog dkar shas che zhing gtsang ba'i snang tshul/ 2) (rnying) gzi mdangs nyams pa/
1) ser skya ste mi skya dang grwa pa/ 2) mdog dkar ser/
ngo bo sob la mdog skya ba/ skra mdog skya sob sob/
'tsho ba'i cha rkyen 'tshol khungs dkon po/ rang gis thon skyed ma byas na 'tsho ba skya srab po yong/
1) mdog skya bo bkrag mdangs med pa/ 2) skya sob sob dang don gcig
mdog dkar po bkrag med pa/ ngo skya lhag ge ba de nad gcong yod pa'i rtags red/
1) tshos med pa'i lham/ 2) mi skya'i lham/
mdog dkar zhing lheb lheb kyis dal por 'gul tshul/ nags tshal mtshams na dar lcog cig skya lheb ber yod pa gzigs/
1) tshos gzhi dang rgyan ris med pa'i zhwa mo/ 2) khyim pa'i zhwa mo/
gzhan pa skam po/ skya tshar, rgyab sha med pa'i pags tshar/
skyag pa mang po yod pa'i sa dong/

bshang lam nas dor ba'i zas snyigs/ mi skyag / khyi skyag / sbrang skyag / skyag pa shor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyab ldan dang, rtug pa, lto snyigs, dri chen, 'dor bya, phyi sa, mi gtsang ba, bshang ba bcas so,
dngos 'brel min pa'i skad cha/ skyag rdzun ma shod/
goms gshis ngan pa/ khyod mi rgod skyag lang song le red/ skyag lang la shor ba/
chags sman gyi rigs shig ste ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas phru gu skye rgyun 'gog /

(tha dad pa) bskyungs pa, bskyung ba, skyungs,, 1) ring du 'dor ba dang, spong ba/ sger sems bskyung ba/ nga rgyal rtsa bskyung/ khengs pa skyung ba/ 2) nyung du'am chung du gtong ba/ mi 'bor bskyung ba/ bar thag bskyungs pa/
snyung bu ste bu ga 'bigs byed kyi yo byad cig /

nyi skar nyer bzhi dang chu tshod zhe bzhi la slebs pa dang spyi zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer lnga yas mas tsam nas skyung zhag dgu brtsis te sos than yod med brtag pa ste de'i ring la kha char bab nas gnam gshis grang na skyung mo'i khong khrag bton pa zhes sos than yong bar bshad/

/ 1) srung ba po dang re ba bya yul/ mgon skyabs/ gtan gyi skyabs/ gnas skabs kyi skyabs/ 'jig rten skyabs mgon/ skyabs 'gro/ skyabs 'jug / skyabs gnas/ skyabs su bsten pa/ 2) khur dkar gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang don gcig
1) skyabs su 'gro sa'i mgon te skyob mkhan nam re ba bya yul gyi mgon po/ 'jig rten gyi skyabs mgon/ 2) bla sprul khag la 'bod pa'i che ming/ skyabs mgon sbug t'a la'i bla ma la 'bod pa'i zhe tshig /
bod srol ltar t'a la'i bla ma dang rgyal tshab gnyis la 'bod pa'i zhe tshig /
gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'jigs dang sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i ched du bla ma dkon mchog la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas brten cing gsol ba 'debs pa'o/
dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ston pa'i gzhung slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa zhig /
bla ma dang, sangs rgyas, chos, dge 'dun bzhi la skyabs su mchi ba/
dkon mchog gsum skyabs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen/
sdom pa thams cad kyi gzhi rten du gyur pa sangs rgyas dang, chos dang, dge 'dun bcas la skyabs 'gro zhing, de'i dgag bsgrub kyi bslab bya rnams tshul bzhin bsrung bar khas blangs pa/
dgag pa'i bslab bya dang, bsgrub pa'i bslab bya, dgag bsgrub thun mong gi bslab bya bcas gsum/
skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i yi ge sgril byed kyi kha btags/
gzhan la skyabs kyi re ba 'chol ba/
gzigs skyong ngam, mgon grogs/ skyabs 'jug yun ring gnang ba/ dgongs 'gal med pa'i bar chad mi yong ba'i skyabs 'jug yod pa zhu
srung skyong byed mkhan gtso bo ste so so'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'bod pa'i che ming/
rtag tu dkon mchog dran pa/
mgo 'dren byed rogs zhu ba'i 'bul rten/
skyabs 'jug zhu don bris pa'i yi ge /
sngar pan chen gyi mdzod pa dza sag bla mar zer/
lag g.yas kyi gru mo phab cing lag rtse nu ma'i thad du sgreng ba'o/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad/
dbul phongs la 'tsho ba ster ba/
rim pa gong mar skyabs 'jug gam re don zhu ba/
1) skyabs su bsten 'os pa/ 2) skyob 'os pa'i nyam thag /
skyabs su 'gro ba ste yul gang la blo gtod pa/
skyabs 'gro dang, sems skyed gnyis so/
dkon mchog gsum ste, sangs rgyas dang, chos, dge 'dun bcas so/
dge bsnyen gyi nang gses, ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su khas blangs nas de'i bslab bya la slob pa'i dge bsnyen/

1) skya re skyo re ste, lus tsho mi zin par gzhan gyis lag pas bskyor te 'gro tshul/ nad pa skya re skyo re byas te sman khang du phyin song/ 2) tshig yang yang bskyar du brjod tshul/ sger don tsag tsig skyar skyor ma byed/
nya za ba'i chu bya'i rigs shig / nya khra skyar mo/ mthing ril skyar mo/
chu skyar gyis nya 'dzin pa lta bu/
'brog pa'i sdod gnas/ 'brog dud mang po mnyam du skyas spos pa/
ru ba spo ba/ 'brog dud tshang ma skyas bteg pas sa phyogs de dag mi med lung stong du lus 'dug /
ko ba'i phyi rtsi'am sha mtshams sam ko ba'i ngos kyi shun pa srab mo/ skyi dkar bcad pa/
ko lpags srab mo las bzos pa'i gos/
1) gri'i so khar spu nyag phus btab pa gcod nus pa'i gri rnon po/ 2) ko lpags kyi skyi shun bzhar byed cig /
skyi mo'i sgam mam, ko lpags kyis btum pa'i sgam/
pags pa'i phyi shun mdog nag po

1. (tha dad pa) bskyis pa, bskyi ba, skyis,, dngul sogs g.yar ba/ dngul skyi ba/ 'bru skyi ba/ rang la med dus gzhan nas skyis/ 2.shing sman gyi rigs te, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas snod mkhris rgyas te mkhris khu pho bar bab pa gyen du drangs nas skyug par byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngang pa chig rgyug dang, ngang pa chig thub, ngang pa gser sgong, gtso du, gtso 'brum, gtsos sla bcas so,
ko lpags sogs kyi skyi dkar nag rang bzhin gyis bud pa/
(rnying) 'jigs skrag byung skabs lus kyi sha lpags sbrid pa ltar 'gyur ba/
shing skyi ba'i 'bras bu, 'di'i ro kha zhing, dri ma zhim po, mkhris pa gyen du 'dren/
pags pa'i phyir chags pa'i shun pa srab mo/ nad gzhi sha skyi'i bar du gnas pa/
lus kyi pags shun la byung ba'i rma/
sen rtsa gas nas langs pa'i skyi lpags/
'jigs skrag skabs lus kyi spu ldang sha lpags sbrid pa ltar 'gyur ba/ go na skyi g.ya' ba'i gtam/ yid mi bde zhing shin tu 'jigs pa dang skyi g.ya' ba byung/ mnar gcod skyi g.ya' ba/
1) skyi mo dang sha/ 2) khog pa'i nang gi sha zhig
sar btsugs te ko ba'i sha dang skyi gcod sa'i shing/
rlung ngam, lhags pa/ byang skyi ser gyi rlung po ma brgyab na, lho tsan dan gyi shing nags 'gul mi yong/
pags pa srab mo las bzos pa'i zhwa mo/
rlung 'khrugs pa dang gyen rgyu'i bu ga 'gags pa sogs las byung ba'i gre ba'i lam nas aig ces pa'i sgra thon pa zhig /
mig har zhing tshig mi thon pa shugs drag chen pos skyigs bu byed pa zhig /
lte ba'i 'og nas gcig gi rjes su gcig bstud de 'byung ba'i skyigs bu'i nad kyi nang tshan zhig /
kha zas rings stabs su zos pa'i rjes su byung ba'i skyigs bu'i nad kyi nang tshan zhig /
zas zhu ba'i rjes su skyigs bu gnyis gnyis bstud nas 'byung ba zhig /
dar skud la gser skud dam dngul skud bsres nas btags pa'i gos shig /
brod rgyags langs pa/ 'tsho ba skyid kyis rgyags pa/
dga' dga' 'am, spro spro/ dga' dga' skyid skyid byas nas las ka byed/
'phags pa mched bzhi'i nang gses skyid rong spyan ras gzigs lha khang du bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa wa ti/
sems dga' ba'i glu/ skyid glu len zhing dga' ba'i bro gar 'khrab/
skyid pa'i thog ma/ dus de nyid nas skyid 'go tshugs pa/

mi tshe hril por 'tsho ba skyid pos skyel mkhan/ skyid chu, lha sa grong khyer gyi 'gram du yod pa'i gtsang po ste, chu 'go gnyan chen thang lha'i ri rgyud kyi lho ngos nas byung zhing, mal gro gung dkar dang stag rtse, 'phan po, stod lung sogs chu bo 'di'i ma lag gi rgyud na chags yod, mthar chu shur rdzong du yar klungs gtsang po'i nang du 'bab/
spyi lo 1955 lor lha sa'i skyid chu'i steng du gsar btsugs rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub pa'i zam chen/
skyid drags pa/ 'tsho ba skyid ches pa/
yun ring du skyid pa ste rgya bod mjal dum mdzad pa'i gtan tshigs rdo ring las gsal ba ltar sngar bod rgyal khri gtsug lde btsan gyi srid lo'i ming
lha sa'i gtsang chu stod rgyud kyi yul spyi/
skyid na mi dga' ba/ bdag la yul mi khyim mtshes skyid du phangs pa 'ga' bdog /

1) skyid po dang sdug po gnyis kyi tshig sdud/ dmangs kyi skyed sdug gsal por rtogs/ mi tshe gcig la skyid sdug sna tshogs myong/ dbul po'i skyid sdug dbul pos lta/ skyid sdug dbye ba 'byed mi shes/ 2) 'tsho rten nam, 'tsho thabs/ skyid sdug gcig pa/ skyid sdug 'bring ba/ skyid sdug skyo po/ skyid sdug dman pa/ skyid sdug zla sgril ba/ skyid sdug snye ma phon gcig byas/ 3) las rigs kyi sgrig 'dzugs dang tshogs pa/ shing bzo'i skyid sdug la 'dzul/ par pa'i skyid sdug nas phud/ rdo bzo'i skyid sdug nas 'then,..
bde sdug mnyam myong/ rang re tshang ma skyid sdug mnyam 'khur byed dgos/
skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum
rgyal po lha tho tho ri nas mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi bar yin, phyed kyi don ni mu ne btsan pos rgyal srid lo gcig dang zla ba dgu las ma bskyangs pas so/
lus sems bde po/ sdod gnas skyid po/ snang ba skyid po/ sems skyid po/ tshor ba skyid po/ skyid na lha yang 'du la, sdug na bu yang 'bros/
skyid la lhod pa/ 'tsho ba skyid 'bol le ba/
skye med sdug zad kyang zer, khe nyen mi rtsi bar gang byung mang byung byed pa/ skyid med sdug zad kyi bu spyod ma byed/ skad cha skyid med sdug zad sna tshogs bshad pa/
lha sa'i gtsang chu smad rgyud kyi yul spyi/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho nub ngos su yod cing, rdzong 'di'i lho ngos bal yul dang sa 'brel yin, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de rdzong dga' ru yod/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi skyid rong rdzong nas byung ste lho phyogs bal yul du 'bab pa'i chu bo zhig /
lha sa'i gtsang chu'i smad rgyud kyi yul spyi/
gzugs dbyibs ra dang 'dra ba'i ri dwags shig /
gzhan nor brkus pa'i skyin pa, 'khri 'jal, dngos tshab ste sngar rkun po'i khrims 'jal gsum/
gangs sbal te gzugs dbyibs da byid dang cha 'dra ba'i srog chags shig de'i sha sman la 'gro/
ser ba dang, de 'bab skabs kyi ha cang grang ba'i rlung drag po/
ser ba bab rjes su zhu ba'i chu log /
gzhan nas g.yar ba'i rgyu dngos rnams kyi tshab/ 'bru skyin/ dngul skyin/ rin skyin tshab gsum mi dgos pa/ skyin pa chu yin yang sla ru ma gtong/
1) bu lon sprod pa/ 2) tshab sgrig pa/
g.yar ba'i tshab/ dngul gyi skyin tshab la dngos po ma sprod/ rin 'bab ji gnas ltar skyin tshab sgrig dgos/ skyin tshab mi dgos par zhing son ster ba/
'jal rgyur bsdad pa'i skyin pa lhag ma/
g.yabs/ char skyibs/ bya skyibs/ brag skyibs/

dkyil krung ngam skyil mo krung ste, rkang pa gnyis nang du bskums nas sdod pa'i 'dug stangs te rnam snang chos bdun gyi ya gyal zhig / zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ skyil krung bcas nas yun ring bsdad de mi gzhig pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung/ skyil mo krung du 'khod pa/
rkang g.yas bskums shing, g.yon cung zad brkyangs pa ste sems dpa'i skyil krung yang zer/
rdo rje skyil krung gsum dang, bde stong gi skyil krung ste bzhi/
rtsa rlung thig le'i rdo rje skyil krung gsum/
rdza mkhan gyi chu blug sa'i yo byad cig

(tha dad pa) bskyil ba, bskyil ba, skyil,, 1) chu rgyug sa med par bkag pa/ phu chu rdzing bur bskyil/ shwa 'od ji yod chu mdzod nang du bskyil thub yod/ bskyil chu/ 2) nyar ba/ mi ngan bsten skyil/ skong skyil/ bkag skyil/
mtheb tshigs dkyil ma nas mtheb rtse bar tshon gang gi tshad/
1) mthe bong gis kong kong bzos pa'i spags kyi mtheb skyu/ 2) gdong la byug rdzas/ 3) mtheb tshigs dkyil ma nas mtheb rtse bar tshon gang gi tshad/
zan gyi mtheb skyu/ mar khu'i skyu tshe bzo ba/

(aamalak'i) skyu ru ra ste tshad pa che ba'i yul du skye ba'i shing sdong lo ma che tsam yod pa'i 'bras bu zhig 'dis khrag mkhris kyi tsha ba sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyal 'bras dang, bcud gnas, na tshod gnas, zhi byed, lang tsho brtan byed bcas so,

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur la mngar kha bska ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas bad mkhris dang khrag nad sel, mig nad dang bcud len la bzang/ ming gi rnam grangs la skom sel dang, khrag 'byed, gya nom, smin 'gas, am ? bhi bcas so,
skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu gsar pa 'di ha cang dwangs pas phyi nang thams cad gsal po mthong/ shes bya'i chos rnams skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar gsal sgrib med par mthong
(rnying) 1) btung ba'i bye brag thug pa/ 2) btsos nas skyur mor gyur pa'i sngo tshod/
bad kan gyi khams kyis kha zas pho bar mi chags par gyen du skyug pa
skyug log log byed pa/ skyug ldang, zhe mer rgyag pa/
mdzo g.yag sogs sgo phyugs sems can gyis gzan pa rags tsam 'chos nas grod par mid de slar yang kha'i nang du bskyugs pa de nyid zhib mor 'cha' ba/
ma zhu ba sogs kyi rkyen te zas sman pho bar mi 'jug nas yar gyen du skyug pa'i nad/

1. (tha dad pa) bskyugs pa, bskyug pa, skyugs,, zhe mer langs te zas sogs kha nas 'byin pa/ lto ma zhu bar bskyugs/ khrag bskyugs/ 2. 1) zas sogs ma zhu bar kha nas phyir phyung ba'i khu snyigs/ skyug pa bskyugs pa/ 2) sbyong byed kyi nang tshan skyug gtong ba ni bad kan lcags dreg sogs pho ba'i nad gyen du 'dren par byed pa'i thabs shig /
btsog pa'am mthong mi 'dod pa/ btsog pa skyug bro po/ spyod pa skyug bro po/ spyod pa skyug bro po/ skad cha skyug bro po/ gdong ris skyug bro po/
zhe mer/ zhag tshi mthong ba dang skyug mer lang ba/
ma zhu ba sogs lte ba yan gyi nad gyen du skyug par byed pa'i sman/
bya spu mdog nag la mchu rkang dmar po zhig / skyung kas skyung kar zer res ma byed, mchu to dmar po cha red/ ming gi rnam grangs la grang rig pho nya dang, byu ru'i mchu can, yul ngan 'bod bcas so,
tshag rgyag byed kyi yo byad bya skyung ka'i mchu dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig /
tshag rgyag byed kyi yo byad bya skyung ka'i mchu dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig /
(tha mi dad pa) bskyud pa, bskyud pa, ,mi dran par brjed pa/ ro ldan gyi zas skyud pa/ gzhon nu'i skabs kyi bya spyod phal cher bskyud pa/ sngar myong sdug bsngal ma skyud aang/
(yul) phu thung dang lham yu sogs kyi tshem mtshams su mthud pa'i rgyu cha zhig /
1) skyur mo'i khu ba/ 2) dar ba las phyur ba bton zin pa'i khu ba/
ra bzi nas spyod pa gang byung mang byung byed pa'i ming/ skyur 'gong shod mkhan chang la mi dga', spyang gi ltod pa lug la mi dga' zer ba rdzun red/ skyur chus myos nas skyur 'gong shod/
zho chang sogs skyur rigs snyol ba/
gro'i glum la nye'u byas te sman sbyar nas btsos pa'i rlung nad lus la zhen pa phyir 'don pa'i thabs kyi sman rta zhig /
star bu sogs kyi skyur khu'i nang du bsnyal ba'i phyur ba rdog rdog gi rigs shig /
skyur mo'i dri ma kha ba'am snom pa/
lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, mdog dkar zhing ro lan tsha la skyur ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas drod skyed, sbos pa 'joms, bad rlung la phan/
chang slong mkhan la dma' 'bebs byed pa'i tshig /

1. (tha dad pa) bskyur ba, bskyur ba, skyur,, 1) 'dor ba dang, spong ba/ khas len dam bca' rgyab tu bskyur/ logs su bskyur/ rtsis med du bskyur ba/ mun bskyur snang 'gro/ tha mag 'then rgyu skyur cig / 2) phar dbyug pa'am g.yug pa/ g.yang skyur thongs shig / chur skyur ba/ kha lud bskyur ba/ 2. (yul) tshos log pa/ gos kyi tshos mdog skyur 'dug / 3. skyur mo dang 'dra,
'bras bu gsum ste, aa ru ba ru skyu ru gsum/
ro drug gi nang gses myangs na so brtse zhing bzhin gnyer shor ba'i rang bzhin can/ kha zas skyur mo/ shing tog skyur mo/ kham bu skyur mo/ skyur tshal/ sman ro skyur mo/
1) chang gi phabs rtsi/ 2) zho'i ru rtsi/
1) chang gi phabs/ 2) zho'i ru ma/
ro skyur bar byed pa'i ru ma'am rtsi/
1) phyur ba skyur khu'i nang du bsnyal ba'i rdog chen po/ 2) chang bsnyal ba lam du ma rgyugs par bro ba skyur mo chags pa/
rabs dang, rgyun/ mi rabs skyus gcig pa/ skyus thog gcig la don dag mang po byas pa/ dbyangs gsal skyus su klog pa/
mi thog gcig pa'am, tsho thog gcig pa/

'gro ba sems can thams cad de, 'dod pa'i khams las tshe 'phos te khams gsum du skye ba gsum, gzugs khams las tshe 'phos te khams gsum du skye ba gsum, gzugs med khams las tshe 'phos te khams gsum du skye ba gsum la bya'o/
(mngon) 1) skar ma snar ma/ 2) rgyal po dang rgyal rigs/ 3) lha tshangs pa/
'byung ba dang 'jig pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming ste mi rtag pa'i dngos po
'dus ma byas sam, rtag pa'i chos/
sems can spyi/ skye 'gro rnams bde legs su byed pa/
tshe gang gi thog mtha'i bar gyi gnas skabs kyi khyad par bzhi/ skye rga na 'chi bzhi bo de, gcig la mi tshad kun la yod/
srid par 'khor ba'i sems can rnams kyis ldog med du myong ba'i rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal bzhi/

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi lho ngos dang 'bri chu'i stod rgyud kyi lho 'gram du yod pa'i grong rdal de da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul dang yus hru'u rdzong gnyis kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/
1) mngal du phru gu mi 'khor ba'i thabs shes byed pa/ 2) bskyar du skye ba mi len pa/
skye ba ngan pa ste ngan 'gro/
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa lho 'brug spa gro sa khul du yod pa ru gnon gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
(aayatanam) sems dang sems byung rnams skye zhing 'phel ba'i sgor gyur pa'am, gzung 'dzin gyi sgo nas rnam shes yul la skye ba dang mched par gyur pa'i gnas/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses ming gzugs kyi gnas skabs 'phel ba la brten nas nang gi skye mched drug 'byung ba ste lus yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/
mig gi skye mched sogs kyi lha/

mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa drug 'byung zhing skye ba'i rgyu'am sgo lta bur gyur pa'i mig dang, rna ba, sna, lce, lus, yid bcas nang gi skye mched dbang po drug dang gzugs dang, sgra, dri, ro, reg chos bcas phyi'i skye mched yul drug bcas bcu gnyis so/
nang gi skye mched drug ste rten 'brel bcu gnyis nang gi skye mched do
(mngon) nyi mas glang khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla bzhi pa/
skye ba dang 'chi ba'i bsdus ming/ skye 'chi'i 'khor lo nyi zla 'char nub 'dra/
'bras bu zas su rung ba'i chu shing gi rigs shig
mo rtsis kyi brtag 'bras las ji ltar thon pa bzhin tshe 'das ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las grol thabs su bzhengs pa'i dkon mchog gi sku bris 'bur gang rung
1) rtswa sdum/ 2) sngon sman tig ta ser po/

1) skad dang yig klog gi sgra gdangs 'don pa'i nga ro 'thon gnas gtso phal gnyis su phye ba'i gtso bo ste bod yig dbyangs gsal nang ka kha ga nga 'a ha aa rnams kyi skye gnas mgrin pa dang, ca cha ja nya tsa tsha dza zha ya sha ai ae rnams kyi skye gnas rkan, ta tha da na za la sa rnams kyi skye gnas so, pa pha ba ma wa au ao rnams kyi skye gnas mchu, ra ni spyi bo ste lce rtse'i nye 'dabs sam, lce rtse'i steng phyogs bcas so so nas 'byin pa dang, nga nya na ma bzhi po ni gong gsal tsam du ma zad sna nas kyang 'byin rgyu dang, nga ro skul byed kyi rlung rgyun khog pa'am aol ba'i nang du 'gro rgyu yin pas dbyangs gsal tshang ma dang 'brel ba yod, des na skye gnas nang gses la mgrin pa dang, sna, spyi bo ste lce rtse dang ya so'i nang, khog pa ste aol ba'i nang, rkan, lce, so, mchu bcas bsdoms pas gnas brgyad yod/ ka kha ga nga 'a ha aa...ca cha ja nya tsa tsha dza zha ya sha ai ae...ta tha da na za la sa...pa pha ba ma wa au ao...ra...nga nya na ma...2) (mngon) mngal gnas dang mo mtshan/ 3) 'gro ba sems can gyi bu tsha gsar du chags lugs sam 'byung stangs/
sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gnas rigs gcig pa ste skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba rnams rang gi skye gnas mthun pa/
(mngon) ma gcig pa'i spun nam ming sring/

lus can rnams kyi skye gnas mi 'dra ba bzhi la mngal skyes dang, sgong skyes, rdzus skyes, drod gsher las skyes pa ste, mi dang phyugs sogs mngal skyes dang, mtho ris lha rnams brdzus te skyes, bya dang sbrul sogs sgo nga ? las skyes, 'bu sbrang la sogs drod gsher las skyes pa'o/
phyugs rigs kyi rgyud gsar 'phel rgyas/ gnag phyugs skye 'phel yag po byung/ skye 'phel che ru gtong ba/
phru gu skye mtshams chad pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) skyes pa, skye ba,, 1) sngar med gsar du 'byung ba/ phru gu skyes pa/ lo tog gsar du skyes pa/ kha las so skye ba/ dga' ba skyes pa/ rva mgo la skye, shing sa la skye/ pho rog la skra dkar mi skye/ ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur/ 2) sngar yod gong du 'phel ba ste chen por 'gyur ba dang ring du 'gro ba sogs/ lug bal ring por skyes pa/ 2. mi tshe/ skye ba hril po/ skye ba snga phyi/

nyid med pa nyid ngo bo nyid med pa nyid gsum gyi nang gses, chos rnams rgyu rkyen gzhan gyi dbang las skye ba nyid kyi phyir thag khra la sbrul med par ma zad, thag khra rang nyid skud pa nyag ma du ma tshogs pa las rang ngo nas ma grub pa'o/
mi dang sems can rnams kyi tshe 'di'i gong gi skye ba/
'tshang rgya ba la skye ba gcig 'gor ba'i byang sems/
skye ba gcod pa'i ltung byed

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, sa bon 'joms pa dang skye ba gcod pa'i ltung byed ces pa rtswa sngon ljon shing gcod pa dang, nas rngo ba sogs mes rung bar ma byas pa'i sa bon gyi rigs nyams par byas pa/
skye ba rjes su dran pa
sngon gyi skye ba dran pa ste dran pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig /
sems can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du brgya byin dang, ri dwags, bse ru, bya, chu, zam pa, ljon shing sogs skye gnas sna tshogs su skye bar ston pa/
'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor skye srid sprul skur shar ba'i sgom rim/
shi rjes bskyar du blangs pa'i skye ba gzhan dag /
1) 'bu chung chung ngam, srog chad phra mo/ 2) myu gu'am, ljang bu/ 3) bar do'i lus/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du skye ba kun tu ston pa/

sdug bsngal brgyad kyi gras shig ste skye ba sdug bsngal dang ldan pas sdug bsngal ba ste, mngal skyes dang sgo nga las skyes pa de dag skye ba na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mang po dang bcas skyes pa'o/
(mngon) nyi mas sdig khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla bcu pa/

rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses srid pa'i mthus nam zhig rkyen tshogs pa na, yang srid kyi skye gnas der dngos su dang por skye ba dang, lus rdzogs pa dang, ris mthun par gnas pa ste, sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'grub par byed pa'o/
skye ba'i dbang gis rang shugs su byung ba/
mi spyi/ skye bo'i tshogs/ skye bos dben pa'i lung pa khug kyog / so so skye bo/ skye bo kun la rang bzhin gyis snying nye ba/
mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dmangs rigs la gdams pa ste 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos shig /
skye gzugs te lus po/ bu mo skye 'bras legs pa/
sngar 'brog pa la gnag phyugs she la gtong skabs lo re 'phel shi gang byung ma brtsis par thog mar rtsis sprad pa'i kha grangs de rang la she mar bsdu ba'i lam lugs shig /
gsung lnga'i ya gyal zhig chos nyid smra brjod dang bral ba nyid brjod bya kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i cha nas chos sku skye med don gyi gsung zhes sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa/
thar pa'am mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba chen po/
thar pa'am, myang 'das/ skye med btsan sa zin pa/
so so'i skye bo rmongs pa/
phru gu skye skabs kyi na tsha
phru gu skye tshod la slebs dus kyi zla ba/
lus dang gdong gi rnam pa'am dbyibs/ skye gzugs mdzes pa lha dang 'dra/
mgo'i skra byi ba'am bud pa/
thog mar skye sa'i sa cha/

sngar 'brog pa la gnag phyugs she la gtong skabs lo re 'phel shi gang byung zhib rtsis brgyab ste she mar bsdu ba'i lam lugs shig go ma gsum bu gnyis dang, ma lnga bu gnyis sogs grangs ka brtsis pa'i 'bab la gzhigs te she mar bsdu ba'i lugs shig dang lo re gnag phyugs kyi rtsa 'bor nas bcu zur shi bar cha 'jog byed srol yang yod/
1) phru gu skye skabs ma'i g.yog rgyug mkhan 2) phru gu skye skabs g.yog byed pa/
skye ba'i shing spyi'i ming/ skye shing 'dzugs pa/
srid pa bzhi'i gras shig ste mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i rnam shes lta bu/
phru gu skye skabs ma bu bde grol yong ba'i bya ba/
(rnying) bar chad/ lo skyeg / lo tog la skyeg chen byung ba/
1) rgya skyegs kyi bsdus ming, 2) skegs dang 'dra,
kha skyengs shing ngo tsha ba'i tshul/
(tha mi dad pa) ngo tsha ba/ kha mi skyengs pa/ kha skyengs gdong dmar/ spyang ki kha ma skyengs tsam dang, lu gu tshe ma zad tsam/ skyengs bzhin du cang mi smra bar yul yul por gyur/
skyed ka mtshams bcad pa/ dus sgo gtsang mtshams skyed bkag gis ma rtsa phyir bslog /

'phel thabs dang je cher bzo thabs/ grub 'bras skyed skrun yong thabs byed/ sdod khang skyed skrun/ skyed kha/ 1) ma rtsar 'khri ba'i 'phel cha'am 'phar ma/ dngul skyed/ 'bru skyed/ lo skyed/ zla skyed/ lnga skyed/ bcu skyed/ skyed lci'i bu lon/ skyed yang bu lon/ skyed med dngul bun/ skyed kha gcog pa/ skyed la skyed rgyag / 2) je mang dang je bzang du song ba'i cha/ yon tan la skyed kha 'phel ba/ blo skyed/ sems la skyed kha gsar pa byung ba/
bu lon gyi ma rtsar ma zad skyed kha la'ang skyed kha brtsis pa/
khe bogs sam yar skyed byung ba/ khe las nas skyed thon chen po byung/
khe bzang 'don pa'am, dgos don 'phel thabs byed pa/ las gra tshugs lo de rang la skyed 'don thub pa/

(tha dad pa) bskyed pa, bskyed pa, skyed,, 1) skye bar byed pa dang, 'byung bar byed pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa/ hur sems skyed pa/ stobs skyed sman mar/ lus skyed pha ma/ bu phrug skyed pa/ 2) spel ba dang, rgya che ru gtong ba/ spobs pa bskyed pa/ khang pa rgya bskyed/ snying rus cher bskyed/ yid ches skyed pa/ dga'spro dpag med bskyed pa/
1) (mngon) 1. pha/ 2. sa gzhi/ 3. me dang me lha/ 4. gsar du sgrub pa po/ 2) rang 'bras skyed par byed pa'am smin par byed pa'i rgyu'o/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba skyed par byed pa'i rgyu'i byed las kyi yon tan ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
sngar bod du zhing pa rnams la 'bru 'bo gang re'i rin dngul bkram nas lo ltar skyed kha 'bru bre bzhi bzhi len pa'i skyed 'bru/
mis bzos pa'i nags tshal lam gling ga / ming gi rnam grangs la khyim gyi kun dga' ra ba dang, khyim gyi tshal, bcos pa'i nags, ljon shing ldum ra, nye ba'i tshal, rtse ba'i sa bcas so,
skyed ka ji thob kyi rtsis/
skyed mos tshal gyi bsdus tshig
skyed mos tshal gyi ra ba/
'tshar longs yong thabs sam yar rgyas yong thabs byed pa/ phru gu skyed sring byed pa/ slob ma skyed sring/ lug rgyud bzang po skyed sring byas/ lo tog led po skyed sring yong thabs byed/
/ 1) myur ba dang, mgyogs po/ dar skyen pa/ nub skyen pa/ 2) las sla po/ khong khro langs skyen pa/ yon tan lobs skyen pa/ 3) sgrin pa dang mkhas pa/ 'phong rtsal skyen pa/
yar langs myur ba'am, rtsal che ba/ rta rtsal skyen yang ba/ 'phong rtsal skyen yang ba/ 'gro 'dug gi skyen yang ba/
btung ba'i zhe sa/ zhal skyems/ gser skyems/ gshegs skyems/ zhal dkar bkyag nas bsu skyems 'dren/
sa ming zhig ste dwags po'i yul zhig deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs kyi snang rdzong gi shar rgyud du yod/
dwags po skyems stong nas thon pa'i shog bu legs pa zhig gi 'dra/
btung snod kyi bye brag cig /
(rnying) chang blug sa'i rdza snod chung ngu/
sngar bod kyi shog dngul par skrun gyi rgyu cha skyems stong nas thon pa'i shog bu spus legs shig /
1) kha dog dkar ser/ 2) sngo sman zhig rma 'drub cing khams bde bar byed pa'i nus pa yod/
shing skyer pa'i shun pa'i khu ba bton pa'i chu ser po/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, me tog dang 'bras bu ro skyur la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, pags pa'i bar shun ro kha, nus pas dug nad sdud, chu ser skem, mkhris nad sel/
skyer pa'i bar shun las byas pa'i khanda ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mig nad kyi rigs kun la phan/
skyer pa nag po'i 'bras bu'i kha dog dmar la ro skyur ba, 'khru ba gcod pa/
skyer pa dkar nag gnyis yod dkar po'i me tog gis khrag shor la phan/
dres ma yang zer, lo ma mang po skyes pa'i rtswa ldum thag pa'i rgyu cha zhig /
rtsi shing tsher ma can zhig / skyer tsher rkang la zug pas rnag kyang gsog /
shing skyer pa'i bar shun te grang ba tsha 'dzag dang gnyan tshad la phan/
seng ldeng rigs gsum gyi nang tshan mdog skyer pa ltar ser ba zhig /
phar tshur skyel 'dren byed pa'i gla/
skyel rogs zhes bcol gtam byas pa/
phebs skyel zhu skabs 'bul ba'i chang/
thag thung thung zhig bar skyel ba/
skyel ma byed skabs ske la g.yog rgyu'i kha btags/
dmigs yul gyi gnas su skyel ba'i mdos kyi dngos rdzas/
dngos zog rnams sa cha gcig nas gcig tu 'dren gtong byed pa/ lcags lam thog gi skyel 'dren/

(tha dad pa) bskyal ba, bskyal ba, skyol,, 1) sa gnas gzhan du gtong ba/ sku mgron skyel ba/ phebs skyel/ gshegs skyel/ 2) dbor ba'am, 'dren pa/ 'gro chas bskyal/ tshong zog skyel ba/ nang gtam phyir skyel/ lan skyel/ thung skyel/ ri rdo klungs skyel/ 3) byed pa'am lag len bstar ba/ kha skyel/ mna' bskyal/ gnod bskyal/ gnod pa spu tsam yang mi skyel/ 4) yol bar byed pa/ don med dus bskyal/ mi tshe don dang ldan par bskyal/ za ma rgyags tshad bzas nas nyi ma skyel/
srung skyob kyi lam grogs sam, skyel mkhan/

yig rten dang, lag rtags sogs bsam pa dkar ba mtshon byed du sprod pa'i dngos rigs/ phebs skyes/ 'byon skyes/ gnang skyes/ thag ring nas dngos rigs phran tsam zhig skyes su bskur/ snying nye bas dus dang dus su bza' btung gi skyes phul/
skyes ni rdzong ba ste rang gi grod bshes lta bu thag ring du 'gro ba'am, tshur 'ong ba'i tshe phan tshun yid dga' ba'i mtshon byed du ster ba'i rgyu dngos/
1) byis pa skyes dus kyi tshes grangs gang yin pa der 'khel ba'i skar ma/ 2) skyes khyim dang don gcig

shar gling dbus ma'i tshangs thig steng du karda'i thog mar nyi ma skyes ma thag tu rang 'gros g.yon 'khor gyis gza' so so'i skyes skar steng du slebs te rlung 'gros kyis ma'i tshangs thig thad du slebs pa dang lhan cig tu gza' rnams skyes pa'i rgyu skar de la skyes skar yang zer, nyi ma nabs so'i chu tshod 45, zla ba tha skar chu tshod 0, mig dmar mchu'i chu tshod 30, lhag pa lha mtshams chu tshod 30, phur bu me bzhi'i chu tshod 30, pa sangs nabs so'i chu tshod 0, spen pa snrubs kyi chu tshod 0, skar 18, sgra gcan nag pa'i chu tshod 0, mjug ring chu smad chu tshod 0 steng du skyes pa'o/ 45...0...30...30... 0...0...0...0...0...

bskal pa chung ba ste, chos mngon pa'i bshad srol ltar na mi'i tshe lo bcu pa nas bzung lo brgya rer lo re 'phel te mi'i tshe lo brgyad khri bzhi stong bar yar 'phel ba'i dus yun la bskal pa chung ba gcig dang, de nas lo brgya rer lo re 'grib ste mi'i tshe lo bcu pa'i bar mar 'grib pa'i dus yun la yang bskal pa chung ba gcig zer, de la mi lo khri brgyad brgya so dgu dang dgu stong tham pa yod/

bskal pa chen po ste chos mngon pa'i bshad srol ltar na bskal pa chung ba brgyad cu tham pa rer bskal pa chen po gcig zer, de la mi lo dung phyur drug dang bye ba bdun sa ya gcig 'bum dgu khri gnyis yod, de min mi lo mi 'khrug phrag bdun re yod pa'i bshad srol yang 'dug /
yul dus rang bzhin gang rung rang dang bskal ? pa ste bar du chod pa'am rgyang ring ba'i rkyen gyis mthong mi nus pa'o/

dus kyi bskal don te dus yun ring ba'i dbang gis rtogs dka' ba dang, yul gyi bskal don te yul thag ring ba'i dbang gis rtogs dka' ba, rang bzhin nam ngo bo'i bskal don te dngos po phra ba'i dbang gis rtogs dka' ba bcas gsum/

/ 1) yul dus ngo bo gsum gyis ring du song ba'am rtogs dka' ba'i don/ 2) (kalpa:) dus skabs chen po ste dus yun ha cang ring ba 'jal byed kyi tshad cig / bskal pa khri stong mang po/ sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa/ bskal pa ji srid bar/ zas zhim po nyi ma gcig red, tshig ngan pa bskal pa stong red/ skyid pa'i bskal pa shar byung/ ming gi rnam grangs la spyad zin pa dang, yongs gyur, lo'i phung po bcas so,

'brog dgon pa na gnas pa po/ kha lud, 1) kha'i nang gi mchil ma gar po/ 2) snod nang du ma shong bar kha nas phyir 'phyur ba'am lud pa/ 3) ljang pa skyes rjes zhing khar kha snon brgyab pa'i sa lud/ yur ma brgyab nas kha lud rgyag pa/
snying nad rigs bdun gyi nang tshan, spro thung zhing mig 'bur tshugs su lta la, kha yo bar 'gyur ba zhig ste, kha le zhes kha yo ba'i don dang, nag po zhes snying nad gdug pa can gyi don no/
1) sne len/ mgron por kha len pa/ 2) gri rnon po ko ba dang ras sogs la brdar ba/ gri kha len pa/ 3) nang du phyir 'ded pa/ rtswa sa nas nor phyugs kha len pa/ 4) nor phyugs sogs kyi kha nas 'ju ba/
phyogs 'grul gyi gnyer kha len 'dzin/ 'grul rigs nam 'byor la kha len ngo len 'phral 'phral byed pa/
gtam dang gdong gi sne len/
kha phyogs kyi sgyur kha/ kha lor 'gro ba/ rta 'di kha lo bde po mi 'dug / kha lo med pa rkyang dang 'dra, sna lo med pa 'brong dang 'dra/
1) dbang sgyur ba/ 2) kha phyogs sgyur ba/ chibs pa'i kha lo sgyur ba/ rlangs 'khor kha lo sgyur ba/ 3) sangs rgyas shig /
shing rta sogs kyi kha lo sgyur mkhan, ..ming gi rnam grangs la kha lo sgyur ba dang mgo 'dren, sgyur byed, mngag byed, sna khrid, g.yas sdod, g.yon sdod bcas so,
ngo log rgol ba'i gtam dang bya spyod
1) phar byas pa'i lan tshur ldog pa/ rang gi bya spyod nor bas mang tshogs kha log pa red/ khyi gyang khug la bkar na kha log mi rgyag ka med red/ 2) mtshon gyi rno log pa/
log yi ma rangs pa'i tshig lan/ sems bzang gi kha ta la kha log tshig log rgyag mi rung/
1) ri dwags bye brag cig / 2) ko ba mnyes ma'i skyi dkar/

kyal ka'i sgo nas shags 'gyed pa/ phyogs gnyis phan tshun kha shags rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyed pa/ gzu dpang gi mdun du su bden su rdzun gyi kha shags 'gyed pa/ mi tsho khag gnyis kyis gzhas tshig gis kha shags rgyag pa/
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro lan tsha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo ba sogs byang khog tu rnag khrag chu ser rgyas pa skem, dug tshad sel/
'ga' zhig gam la la/ mi kha shas/ nyin kha shas/
1) lham gyi kha rgyong byed kyi shing/ 2) kha ru/ 3) sgo thod mdzes rgyan gyi bang rim zhig /
gtam shod pa'i nus stobs/ dkar nag bden rdzun gyi dbye ba 'byed pa la kha shugs chen po mi dgos/
par rko'i yo byad lugs snod/
gzong gi bye brag gzong kha rta sga 'dra ba zhig / kha shed, gtam smra ba'i nus shugs/
1) rdzun tshig / kha shob bshad nas gzhan mgo bskor ba/ 2) 'ud gtam stong pa/ mi kha shob tsha ba/
'ud shob kyi skad cha/ kha shom bshad de gzhan zil gyis gnon rtsis byed pa/ khas blangs thebs gcog gi kha shom che ba/
1) gtam kha nas shor ba/ gang byung du kha shor ba/ 2) thal drags pa'am tshad las 'das pa/ me mda' kha shor ba/ snod kyi kha shor ba/

1) tshem bu gcig brgyab nas g.yas g.yon du bslogs pa'i tshem srub kyi ming / 2) dkyil gshag ste, khag gnyis su snyoms por gshag pa/ gdung ma sbom po kha gshag btang ba/ ca lag gang yod tshang ma phyogs gnyis la bgo bsha' star ga kha gshag btang ba/
dal dal lhing lhing gi gros mol/ do bdag phan tshun tshang 'dzoms thog nas kha gshib gros sdur brtan lhing byed pa/ kha gshib gshib, kha spu rub rub byas nas gros sdur gyis thag gcod pa/
1) kha'i gtam/ 2) kha stong pa/ kha bshad kho nas don mi 'grub/
1) gtam gshags 'gyed pa/ phan tshun tshig nad ma bzod par kha bshad rgyag pa/ 2) shis brjod kyi gtam shod pa/ dga' spro chen pos dus ston rten 'brel gyi kha bshad rgyag pa/
kha nas bshad pa ltar lag len byed pa/
1) chus kha bshal ba/ kha bshal bshal gtong ba/ 2) chus bshal ba/ gyon pa der dreg pa mang bas kha bshal tsam gyis dag mi yong/

1) de ring gi nyin sngon ma/ 2) legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed 'khrugs bsdebs nang kha nas sa bar gyi bsdus ming, de'i zhib cha ha sa la ltos, kha sa...kha...sa...kha pha tsha tha tha tsa ta ta ka pa sha sha sa...ha sa

nye sngon nam nye char dus/

1) gtam mang po mi shod pa/ blo sbug dog pa'i rkyen gyis mi kha sra bo zhig tu gyur pa/ 2) rta drel sogs kha lo sgyur dka' ba/ bzhon pa kha sra bo de gang 'dod kyi phyogs su gtong 'then byed rgyu khag po yong/
nyung du gtong ba/ 'gro song gi grangs 'bor kha sri rgyag pa/
1) gtam gang byung shod pa/ 2) zas gang byung za ba/
1) tshur zug pa/ bdag por kha slog rgyag pa'i sgo khyi ni, dbyug pas bsnun te rgyang ring bskrad na legs/ 2) (rnying) gyen log /
1) ma tshang ba'am nyams pa'i kha gso ba/ 2) snod kyi kha gyen du ston pa/
1) kha gcang ngam tshig 'jam/ kha gsag gi tshig / 2) log 'tsho lnga'i nang gses shig ste, rnyed bkur gyi ched du gzhan 'drid cing, gzhan ngo dang mthun pa'i tshig smra ba'o/
kha yangs po'am 'khrol po/ skad cha kha gsang po bshad/
skad cha 'dzem bag med par bshad pa/ zhib gsal kha gsangs/ kha gsangs na go bde, nam langs na 'gro bde/
snon ma/ kha gsab snon pa/ kha gsab rod dngul/
gsar pa/ gyon pa kha gsar/

kha snon/ chu mar 'bab rgya mtsho'i kha gsos red/
1) bsod btags te, kha btags spus zhan zhig / 2) zas bzang po rnyed pa'i skal ba'am bsod nams/
mi gnyis gsum gyis bza' btung gi snod spyad gcig pa byed pa/ 'gos nad yod pa'i mi dang kha bsre mi nyan/
1) rdzun gyis mgo skor btang ste rgyu nor khyer ba'am phrogs pa dang, log pa'i lam du khrid pa/ 2) mgo skor gyis rgyu nor 'phrog mkhan dang, log pa'i lam du 'khrid mkhan/
kha shed mkhrang ba'am kha shob tsha ba/
kha dbang btsan pa/ kha hrag po shod mkhan de'i kha dbang du ma shor ba/
byung song gi rtsis kha 'thab pa'i lhag ma'am nor zas bed spyad pa'i lhag ma/ tshong rtsis brgyab pa'i kha lhag / 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen du bed gcod byas pa'i kha lhag /
rtsis mgo gtugs pa'i lhag ma'am, bed spyad pa'i lhag 'phro/
/ 1) sde tshan/ dgon sde khag / yul khag / lung pa khag / las khungs khag / 2) 'gan/ lag bstar gyi khag 'khur ba/ 'thus tshang yong ba'i khag 'gan len pa/ 3) nyes 'gan/ khyed rang la khag med/
nyes 'gan g.yog pa/ phar tshur nga min kho yin gyi khag dkri byas/ gcig gis gcig la khag dkri bzhag pa/
byas nyes gzhan la g.yogs pa dang ham pa shod pa/ mi la khag dkri bsnyon 'dzugs kyis rang nyes sel thabs byed/
1) ma byas kyang byas song zhes pa'i nyes skyon 'dogs pa/ 2) las ka'i 'gan dkri ba/
rang rang gcig pu/ las ka gcig pa ma red khag khag red/ sha rdza ma la btsos kyang sha khu khag khag
phan tshun 'brel ba med pa/ bzo zhing tshong gsum khag khag so so min par phan tshun 'brel ba dam zab yod/
sde tshan so sor bgo ba/ dpung sde khag bgos te btang ba/ las 'gan rnams sde tshan so sor khag bgos kyis sprad pa/
1) las ka'i khur 'gan/ 2) nyes skyon gyi 'gan/
nyes pa ma byas par byas tshul gyi khag ngan g.yogs pa/
nag nyes sam lan rtsa/ sha zhim po aa pho spyang kis bzas, khag ngan pa aa lce wa mor bzhag /
nyes can yin pa'i skad grad/ gzugs med grib bzo byas nas khag ngan sbir sgra ci che sgrog pa/
sde mtshan gcig / mi khag gcig / lung pa khag gcig
skyon 'gel ba'am snyad 'dogs pa/ rang nongs ngos len mi byed par gzhan la khag 'jog thabs byas/
1) khag 'phangs pa/ kham bu za 'dod med pas skyur mo'i ro la khag btags/ 2) nyes khag g.yogs pa'am snyad btags pa/ kho la ma byas byas tshul gyi khag btags pa red/
1) 'gan len pa po/ 2) 'gan len thub pa'am, phod pa/
las sla po min pa/ dka' las khag po/ bsam blo 'khor tshad lam la 'gro rgyu khag po 'dug /
sdug sbyong/ khag sbyong gi dus tshod yol nas slar ldang ba'i go skabs med par gyur song/
'gan med pa ste bden zhes pa'i don/ bu chung ltogs te ngu na khag med/
rang skyon gzhan g.yogs/ rang gis nor ba'i bya ba gzhan la khag g.yogs pa/
khag mang phyogs gcig tu sgril ba/ mi mang phyogs gcig tu khag rub kyis gros sdur byed pa/
khang pa'i 'dzin bdag su yin gyi khungs/ gzhung gi khang khungs/ sger gyi khang khungs/
su yang rung ba zhig la bdag dbang thob pa'i khang pa'i gras/ gzhung la bdag pa'i khang khongs le lag khor yug / sger la dbang ba'i khang khongs steng shod khe gtsang/
sngar khang pa glas nas sdod mkhan tshos
