sdod khang g.yar ba'i gla/ khang mig stong pa gzhan la khang glar gtong ba/ khang gla sprod pa/ khang gla bsdu ba/
1) khang pa chen po/ khang chen thog brtsegs can/ 2) gtsug lag khang/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, yo byad la chags pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma gnyis kyi ya gyal, gzhi dang dngos po ma dag pas dge slong bzhi yan chad kyi don du khang pa chen po brtsigs pa'o/
khang chen bsod nams rgyal po

mtshan gzhan d'a ching pa thur yang zer, gtsang rnam gling rdzong gi mi yin zhing, lha bzang h'an gyis bod la dbang sgyur ba'i dus su mnga' ris spyi khyab mdzad, pho lha lags dang lhan cig tu jun gar gyi dmag sde 'gog thabs byas pas manydzu gong mas khong la pe tses zhes pa'i go gnas gnang, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang lor manydzu gong ma'i bka' ltar bod kyi dbu bzhugs bka' blon mdzad, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug long nga lum sbyar gsum sogs kyis khong bkrongs/
khang pa bdag gnyer byed po/
don med rnam rtog gi dpe/ rnam rtog dgra ru langs na, khang stong rkun mas khengs/
1) khang pa'i steng ngam rtse thog / 2) khang pa'i thog 'gebs sam thog khebs/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu skyob dang, ya phub, yang thog bcas so,
khang steng gi chu 'gro'i wa kha/

dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, yo byad la chags pa las gyur pa gnyis kyi ya gyal, gzhi srog chags mang zhing rtsod pa can 'jig rkyen yod pas mi rung ba gsum dang ldan pa'i sar rang don du dge 'dun las gnang ba ma thob bzhin srid du khru bco brgyad dang, zheng du khru phyed dang bcu gcig gi tshad las lhag pa'i khang pa brtsigs pa'o/

bcad brgyab pa'i khang chung / khang pa 'di'i nang khang mig ga tshod 'dug /

1) khang pa'i rmang gzhi'am rtsig rmang/ 2) khang pa'i 'khris sam 'gram/ khang par me skyon shor na, khang rtsa'i rdzing chu skam yong/
khang pa'i rtsig pa/ khang rtseg khang pa brtsegs pa'am thog brtsegs can/
1) khang pa bkod legs sam khang pa yag po/ 2) gzhal yas khang/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shan rtsa rdzong khongs su yod/
khang khyim 'thor shul gyi sa stong/

1. bar thag / rgyal kha 'thob dus dang khad nyer slebs pa/ pha yul dang khad ring gis chod pa/ dbyar dus shar ba la khad nye ba/ 2. 1) dal bu'am ga le/ 'gro lam khad kyis kyog por gyur pa/ 'tsho ba khad kyis khad kyis yar rgyas su 'gro ba/ 2) de ma thag pa/ mi de 'gro ma khad/ nyi ma shar ma khad/
phan tshun bar thag 'gyangs shing kha tshang mnyam rub tu med pa/

mtho dma' cha mnyam pa/ zhing kha rmo log brgyab nas khad snyoms por bzo ba/

/ 1) gun gsab kyi bsnan bya'am 'thol pa/ dngos po legs nyes brje skabs khan pa sprod len byed/ rta tshong brgyab nas khan slog pa/ 2) snon rtsis/

/ 1) 'tshem spyad cig / khab sbom/ khab phra/ rgya khab/ bod khab/ mi dmangs kyi khab skud pa tsam yang gang byung gis mi len/ khab bsags nas 'bugs brdung, 'bugs bsags nas gri brdung/ 2) pho brang dang khyim gyi zhe sa/ rgyal po'i khab/ btsun mo khab na yod kyang sras gcig kyang med/ 3) bag ma'am chung ma/ bu'i khab tu 'os pa/ de'i bu mo khab tu blangs pa/
khab be khob be'i bsdus tshig

khab mgo'i ai khung / khab mig tu skud pa brgyus pa/
khab kyi rtse mo/ blo rtse gnyis kyis 'dod don 'grub pa min, khab rtse gnyis kyis 'tshem bu yong sa med/

rdo sman rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes cung bsil, nus pas mde'u 'byin, lcags g.ya' 'gog rus chag gso, klad pa'i nad dang rtsa nad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la skud 'dren len po'o,

kham gang bzas pa/ bza' bca' sos kham gcod kyin za ba/ 2) (rgya) spar kha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / khams phyogs kyi byis pa'i rtsed mo zhig ste, 'khyil chu'i nang du rdo leb kyi steng du rdo ril chung ngu zhig bzhag nas mig btsums te mgo chu nang du bcug nas rdo ril de kha yis sgrug pa/

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud na yod pa'i 'bab chu zhig de'i chu 'go blon po rgyal gdong nas byung zhing, gro mo brgyud nas 'brug yul du 'bab/

kham tshig nang du yod pa'i son dkar po/

/ 1) yul lam lung pa/ rgyal khams/ bod khams/ 2) ris/ 'dod khams/ 'jig rten gyi khams/ 3) 'byung ba'am rang bzhin/ lo khams/ me khams 'gyur ba/ khams snyoms pa/ khams log pa/ 4) lus po/ sku khams/ khams dub pa bsang ba/ lus kyi 'byung khams cha ma snyoms pa/ 5) rgyu dang sa bon/ 6) bod yul dbus gtsang khams gsum du zlas dbye byas pa'i ya gyal zhig gi ming/ mdo khams/ dbus gtsang khams gsum/ 7) (mngon) rnam shes kyi khams drug dang, dbang po'i khams drug yul gyi khams drug ste khams la bco brgyad yod pas grangs bco brgyad mtshon/

'jig rten gyi khams la 'dod khams dang, gzugs khams, gzugs med khams bcas gsum du dbye bas, gzugs med khams la ltos te, gzugs khams dang 'dod khams gnyis la khams 'og ma zer ba lta bur mtshon na 'dod khams pas gzugs khams pa'i don mi shes pa lta bu'o/

1) mo nad kyi bye brag cig / 2) skyes pa'i khu ba'am thig le lhung ba/
gzugs dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi/
khams gsum gyi nang gses, gzugs khams dang, gzugs med kyi khams gnyis so/
gzugs dang gzugs med kyis bsdus pa'i sred pa ste, gzhal yas khang la'ang chags pa yod kyang phal cher snyoms 'jug la chags pa'i kha nang du bltas par mtshungs pa'o/
dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i skabs su mkho ba'i khams brgyad de, pha wang long bu dang, gser rdo, dngul rdo, khab len, chu skyur rdo, ba bla, ldong ros, lhang tsher dmar po bcas brgyad do/

bon lugs spyod pa'i skor gyi gzhung zhig /

1) ngo mtshar rtsa bdun dang, don snod kyi skabs su khams lnga sbyar skabs shing dang, me, sa, lcags, chu bcas khams lnga'o/ 2) lus dang, nad, sman bcas kyi skabs su khams lnga sbyar skabs sa dang, chu, me, rlung, nam mkha' bcas lnga'o/

sa'i khams sgra reg ro gzugs dri'i yon tan lnga ldan, chu khams sgra reg ro gzugs kyi yon tan bzhi ldan, me khams sgra reg ro'i yon tan gsum ldan, rlung gi khams sgra reg yon tan gnyis ldan, nam mkha'i khams sgra'i yon tan gcig ldan/
phyi'i khams drug gam dmigs pa'i khams drug dang, nang gi khams drug gam rten gyi khams drug rnam par shes pa'i khams drug gam brten pa'i khams drug ste bco brgyad/
1) lus sems mi bde ba/ 2) rang bzhin dwangs po med pa/
lus sems mi dwangs pa'am mi bde ba/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rong pa tsha nas rta'u bar gyi spyi ming/
khams yul gyi chu bo mang che ba byang nas lho phyogs su 'bab pas sngar bod kyi deb ther nang du mtsho sngon zhing chen dang sa 'brel byang rgyud la khams stod zer/
khams stod rgyal mo'i dngul chu
khyung bo dkar nag ser gsum gyi chu, byang gi sog chu, nag chu, rgya ston dang lcags ra dpal 'bar gyi chu sogs 'dres te 'bar ma phyogs su 'gro ba'i chu chen/
1) gshis sam rang bzhin ngan shos/ 2) 'dod khams/
khams gsum dang de'i sas bsdus pa/

gcig pu'am chig rkyang/ mi kher rkyang 'gro ba/ khang pa kher rkyang/ grogs med kher rkyang du lus pa/
rang nyid gcig pur dag mo dgod pa/
gcig pur rgyu ba/ pho rgod pos dpung gdang ma bsgrigs par,
skyel ba'i rgyu/ rta rgod kher rgyug mi rgod kher 'gro/
gcig pu/ rkyen med pa'i rgyu kher ma la 'bras bu ga nas yong/ mda' rgod kher 'phen, dpung rgod kher ngom/
gzhan skyon gyi rnam grangs ra sprod pa/ sngar gyi byas nyes la khrel 'debs pa dang bcas phyin chad led bcos dgos pa'i bslab bya gtong ba/
nga dang khyod min pa'i mi de/ kho tsho tshang ma slebs 'dug /
kho rang tsho/ kho cag dang nged cag mnyam du las don byed myong/
rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dga' bde rdzong du yod/
rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dga' bde rdzong du yod/
re thag chod pa'am, re ba zad pa/ gtor ma chur g.yugs na bya khyi kho thag chod yong/
ko ba las bzos pa'i me mda'i rdzas blug snod/

'ba' zhig / 'jig rten khams na skyon kho na dang, yon tan kho na yod mkhan gyi mi med/ kha bshad kho nas las don mi 'grub/ snying po med pa'i tshig skam ldab skyor kho na bshad pa/ mi tshe don med kho nar zad pa/
'ba' zhig gam gcig pu rang nyid/
mi de/ kho pa tshos gang bshad tshang ma bden par ma 'dzin/
skyes pa bdag gam rang nyid/ kho bo dus rnam pa kun tu bde po yin/ de ni kho bo'i blo dang yongs su mthun/ las don 'di'i skor kho bo cag gis g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs byas nas bsgrub dgos/
skye dman bdag gam rang nyid/
(yul) zas rlangs 'tshod byed kyi yo byad cig /
mtha' skor gyi ra ba/ kho ra khor zug kho ra khor yug dang don gcig
1) mtha' bskor ba'i mu khyud dam lcags ri/ 2) mtha'i rgya khyon 'khor mo/
skyes pa la 'bod pa'i sgra/ kho re nyon dang 'phrin 'di skyol cig / kho re khyod dal bar ma 'dug las ka gyis/
1) lus po'am lus po'i yan lag / 2) (rnying) chu zheng ngam rgya khyon
'phel stobs yongs su rdzogs pa/ lus kyi kho lag rdzogs pa'i dar ma zhig /
1) rgya khyon che ba/ 2) lus kyi stobs shugs che/
kho na re'am, khos 'di skad zer bya ba/
bsam ngan gyis gzhan sems bskul nas zing 'khrug slong ba/
1) g.yag lug sogs kyi sha phyi sgrom cha tshang gcig / lug sha khog gcig / 2) nang don gcig pa'i dpe/ skad cha shod stangs mi 'dra yang, nang don khog gcig red/
ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas pa'i khong nad rnying pa ste, nang gses su dbye na gcong sde bzhi dang gcong sde drug gcong sde bcu drug bcas mchis/
khog pa chung ngu'i bsdus tshig
rdza sogs las bzos pa'i ja snod chang snod/
nang stong pa/ gzi brjid khog stong/
snying thag pa'i mna' 'am, dam bca'/

/ 1) lto ba'am, nang dang sbug / khog pa chen po/ khog pa drang po/ zas ngan gcig gis khog pa'i stod smad dkrug / 2) sems/ kha 'o ma khog tsher ma/ pho khyo ga'i khog par mda' shong mdung shong/ khog par dran tshad kha nas shod pa/ gnas tshul khog par tshud pa/
khog pa 'khru ba ste bshal ba/ sbyong sman btung bas khog pa 'grim gyin 'dug /
1) dkrug 'dod kyis gzhan la ngan slob pa/ 2) nang nas rgyong ba/
1) mi sems rgyud ngang ring ba/ 2) (mngon) rus sbal/
1) khog pa chen po'i ldog phyogs te grod khog chung chung/ 2) bzod sems med pa/
stong thun gyi chings chings lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste, dpe cha'i gzhung don khog sgrig gi sa bcad/

1) gur sogs 'bubs pa/ nyi gdugs rtsibs mas khog 'bubs pa/ 2) khog sgrig ste go rim sgrig pa/ dpe cha'i gzhung don spyi khog 'bubs pa/ khang pa'i phyi sgrom spyi khog 'bubs pa/ khog 'bubs drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar rab byung bcu pa'i nang zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rig gnas spyi dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa rgya gar du dar tshul dang, rim bzhin bod du dar tshul, g.yu thog pa sogs gso rig gi bstan 'dzin rnams byon tshul sogs 'khod pa'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig / khog 'bubs 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i nyi ma rab byung brgyad pa'i nang byang pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'phags yul dang bod du gso ba rig pa dar tshul dang, gso ba rig pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams byon tshul sogs 'khod pa'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig / khog 'bubs legs bshad beed'urya'i me long drang srong dgyes pa'i dga' ston rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu mo lug gi lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'phags yul dang bod du gso ba rig pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang g.yu thog yon tan mgon po sogs gso ba rig pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams byon tshul sogs gsal bar 'khod pa'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig khog 'bubs legs bshad gser gyi snye ma rab byung brgyad pa'i nang byar po pan chen gyis mdzad pa'i gso ba rig pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul bshad pa'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig / khog 'bubs shes bya rab gsal rab byung bzhi pa'i nang brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed kyis mdzad pa'i gso ba rig pa dar tshul gyi chos 'byung zhig /
khog pa'i nang gi stong cha/
rdza ma'i khog ma/ rdza khog...rdo khog...
btung bya'am bza' bya'i sman/ ..lto ba'i nad la khog sman 'thung
1) blo thog gi grangs rtsis/ 2) bsam blo'i 'char gzhi/
khog pa'i nang gi tshi lu/
nyams tshod/ rang rgyus rang gis mi shes par gzhan gyi khog tshod len pa mtshar/
1) mi'i khog tu lha 'dre zhugs zer ba/ 2) mi zhig gi blo mi gzhan zhig gis bskyod pa'am bsgyur pa/
1) blo rgya che ba/ brtan brling khog yangs/ 2) rgya'am khad/ lung pa khog yangs/ khog rul, 1) nang ngam snying rul/ khog rul zhing 'byon thang med pa/ 2) bsam pa ngan pa/
khog pa mkhregs po min pa/

1. 'gengs pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) sems/ gad mo khong nas rgod pa la rgyu mtshan yod 'gro/ kha tsam ma yin khong nas phyung ba'i snying gtam yin pas sems la zhog...aa tsi 'jigs skul yin nam, khong nas sdang ba yin pa mi shes/ 2) khog pa dang nang/ khong nang zug rngu sman gyis 'byin pa/ 3. kho'i zhe sa/ khong khrag khog pa'i nang gi khrag / kha nas khong khrag bskyugs pa

zhe sdang ste, dgra la sogs pa sems can pha rol po rnams la brdeg cing gsad pa la sogs pa gnod pa sna tshogs bya bar sems pa/ khong khro za ba/ khong khro tsha po/ khong khro zhi ba/ khong khro spong ba/ khong khro slong mkhan med na bzod pa su la sgom/
sems can dang, sdug bsngal, sdug bsngal gyi gzhi bcas la kun nas mnar ba'i sems kyi bag la nyal ba/
dgra sogs sems can dang, sdug bsngal dang, sdug bsngal gang las 'byung ba'i gnas rnams so/
1) sems ma zhi bar gyur pa/ khyod rang ci'i phyir khong 'khrugs pa yin/ 2) khros pa/
sems kyi gting nas shor ba'i gad mo/
sems ngan lag rdeg...khong ngan lag yang byas nas 'thus tshang shor ba/
(rnying) 1) sems khral yod pa/ 2) khong nad yod pa/
1) khong du chud pa ste legs par rtogs pa/ gang zhig khong du chud pa lag tu longs/ 2) (mngon) sdug bsngal/
1) khog pa'i snying/ 2) shing gi khong snying/
khong du chud pa'i le'u gsum
ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad lo lnga brgya phrag bcu'i dang po nas gsum pa'i bar rim bzhin dgra bcom pa'i le'u dang, phyir mi 'ong ba'i le'u, rgyun du zhugs pa'i le'u ste gsum/
zhe nag po'am sems ngan po
khong pa'i nang gi don snod la 'byung ba'i 'bras nad phyir mi mngon pa zhig...
lug aa ma'i khog pa'i nang du yod skabs kyi lug phrug gi pags pa/
khon 'dzin/ khong 'dzum, 1) sems kyi gting nas shor ba'i gad mo/ ma rabs kyi spyod pa la khrel nas khong 'dzum shor byung/ 2) gre ba bsang tshul/ gre 'gags bsang phyir khong 'dzum lan gsum byas/
1) sems gu yangs pa/ khong yangs dkyel che/ khong yangs pa'i mi de snang ba skyid/ 2) rgya che ba/ sa cha kha yangs khong yangs red/
1) snying rul te bsam shes med pa/ 2) nang rul/
khog pa'i nang du lag pa 'jug pa ..lung pa 'ga' zhig tu phyugs lug sogs la khong lag btang nas gsod srol yod
srog shing ngam, gtso bo'i don snying/ khrims kyi khong shing yo 'khyog mi bzo ba/
1) khog pa'i nang du song ba ste byis pas rde'u sogs mid nor byung lta bu/ 2) phyugs la bya bcos byed skabs 'bras bu khong du shor te lus pa/
khog pa mkhregs po min pa'am sob sob/
pho ba dang, long ga, rgyu ma, gzhang, mtshan ma bcas su gnas pa'i lhan skyes kyi srin bu/
bar srub/ shing gi khong gseb tu sbas pa/ brag gi khong gseb/ rtsig pa'i khong gseb/
rigs dang phyogs/ mnga' khongs/ spyi pa'i khongs/ sger gyi khongs/ khongs su tshud pa/ ri dwags dang 'bu srin tshang ma dud 'gro'i khongs yin/ phyugs las kyang zhing las kyi khongs su gtogs pa/
phyogs gtogs/ khongs gtogs sa cha/
1. 'god pa'i skul tshig 2. ngos sam gzhi/
mtho dma' cha mnyam pa/ sa gzhi khod snyoms pa la khang pa mang po brgyab yod/
chu 'khor nang rtsam pa 'bab yul gyi skyor ra/
1) (rgya) spar kha brgyad kyi bye brag cig...2) 'khon dang 'dra,
(rgya) spar kha brgyad kyi bye brag cig...
shing bkog pa dang, rna lpags 'dril ba'i sgra/
(yul) las ka 'phral 'phral la byed mi thub mkhan/
1. (tha mi dad pa) lcogs pa'am dal ba/ de ring khom gyi mi 'dug...sdod mi khom/ 2. dal ba/ 'gro khom med pa/
ko bas bzos pa'i ca lag 'jug snod
lcogs pa'am long skabs/ sang nyin khom long byung na khyed rang phebs bsur bcar chog...
1. bar mtshams med pa'am, rgyun mi 'chad pa/ mi rbas mang po'i bar du sdug bsngal khor mor myong ba/ grong khyer gyi mtha' 'khor du lcags ri khor mor bskor ba/ 2. khor mo yug gi bsdus tshig
1) mtha' skor/ phyi rol nas lcags ri khor mo yug tu bskor ba/ 2) rgyun bar ma chad pa/ nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu las grwa btsugs pa/ lo khor mo yug tu las ka byas/
khor mo yug gi bsdus tshig
khor yug ri dang don gcig
mngon pa las gsal ba ltar, gling bzhi'i phyi rol na lcags las grub pa'i ri ste, de'i phyi'i mtha' skor du dpag tshad sa ya phrag gsum dang drug 'bum nyis stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yod zer/
lha'i gzhal yas khang gi bar khyams sam, skor lam lta bu/ khor sa nang ma/ khor sa phyi ma/ khor sa bar ma/

1. bkol ba dang 'gel ba dang 'khol ba'i skul tshig 2. zur dang logs/ gzhung chen po'i nang nas le'u gcig khol du 'don pa/ gces nor rnams mdzod khang nas khol du phyung ste bzhag pa/ gsung 'bum gyi nang nas khol bkar gyis par du bskrun pa/
zing zing ngam, long long du g.yo ba/
g.yog po/ khol po tshang ma bcings bkrol thob/
tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'khol ba'i 'das pa,
/ 1) g.yog po chung ba/ 2) sbud pa/ 3) cha shas dang, yan lag dang, thor bu/
/ 1) mthong khung ngam skar khung/ 2) bskol tshar ba'i chu sogs/ khro chu khol ma/ dug mtsho khol ma/ chu khol ma/ 'o ma khol ma/ 3) (yul) rdza khog... pa
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'gas pa'i skul tshig
bya rog chung ba/ khwa gdong/
khwa skad shes pa'i rig pa
bya nag khwa ta'i sgra skad las bzang ngan dpyod shes kyi rig pa/
bya khwa ta 'ded thub pa'i bu chung ste, spyir btang lo lnga nas bdun bar du slebs na rab tu byung chog pa/
bya pho rog las chung ba'i bya nag cig...khwa ta thams cad mdog nag yin/
drang po med pa'am kyog kyog...ri mo khya ge khyo ge/ shing khyag khyog gis ka gdung bzo mi nyan/ tshig khya ge khyo ge la yid brtan med/
lus gom tshugs mi thub pa'i rnam 'gyur/ nad pa cung drag ste khya re khyo rer 'gro ba/ phru gu khyar khyor du phyin pa/
khya ge khyo ge'i bsdus tshig
1. (tha dad pa) bzod pa'am yar 'degs thub pa/ bu lon de'i khag khyag pa ngas byed/ bong bus rnga mo'i khal mi khyag...2. theg pa/ snying stobs chen po yod la khyag pa chen po'ang yod/
1) khyad par ci ste, dbye ba med/ de ring sang nyin gnyis la khyad ci yod/ 2) khyad par med/ lto gos gnyis la khyad ci/

khyad par gyi chos te gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'am gzhan las lhag pa'i yon tan/ khyad chos ston pa/ rdo khab len gyi khyad chos ni lcags len pa yin/ de ni khyad gzhi gang la yod pa'i khyad chos ston byed kyi tshig cig yin/
gzhan las lhag pa'i shugs nus byung ba/
khyad par du 'phags pa dang don gcig
mi rtsi ba dang, brnyas bcos byed pa'am, 'dzem bag med pa/ dka' ngal khyad du gsod pa/ nga rgyal dbang gis gzhan khyad du gsod pa/ sger gyi phan gnod khyad du bsad pa/
khyad du gsod pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses gso sbyong gi mdo sogs 'don pa la 'di 'dra'i don yod par da gdod shes so zhes zer zhing 'dul bar gtogs pa'i bslab pa khyad du gsod pa'o/
dmigs bsal can gyi bya las/
gzhan las lhag pa'i nor ram rtsa ba che ba'i nor/

1) mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba dang, bye brag...mtho dma'i khyad par/ dbul phyug gi khyad par/ yangs dog gi khyad par/ khyad par dmigs par mi 'gyur ba/ kho la 'gro dgos min gyi khyad 'dug pas de'i skor gyi lan gsal 'phral du yod pa zhu/ 'bras dang gro zhib gang rung zhig za dgos byung yang nga la khyad par med/ 2) khyad par gyi mtha' ru du zhes sbyar na dmigs bsal du'am lhag pa'i don bstan pa/ khyad par...du...spyir ma gzhi rnam kun...spyir me tog dang, khyad par du me tog dmar po la dga' ba/ ma gzhi khong gi sku gzugs thang po med pa dang, khyad par du deng sang mgul cham phog nas snyung gzhi drag po zhig bzhes 'dug...rnam kun dbul phongs rnams dang, khyad par du dbul phongs rgan rgon rnams kyi 'tsho thabs la do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa/
1) mi 'dra ba'i tshul bshad pa'am, bris pa/ 2) khang pa sogs bzo bkod dam rnam pa khyad par can/

rnam rtog 'bring po chod pa ste, zhu bde'i nyams cher rgyas nas rtog pa phal cher 'gags kyang, sems dang sems byung 'brel ma chod pa'i cha nas myong ba la thob shor cung zad 'char ba'i dus na lta ba goms pa zhes bya/
khyad par gyi dus chen bzhi

sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus chen rnam pa bzhi ste, mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen dang, chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen, lha las bab pa'i dus chen, cho 'phrul chen po'i dus chen rnams so/
khyad par gyi spyod pa lnga

'dul ba las bshad pa'i spo mgu spyod skabs khyad par gyi spyod pa lnga spang dgos pa ste, spo mgu spyod pa'i gang zag gis dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa'i bsnyen bkur byed pa dang du len pa'i spyod pa dang, des dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa dang gnas khang gcig tu gnas mal 'cha' ba sogs mnyam 'grogs kyi spyod pa dang dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa la ltung ba gleng ba dang, dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa la chad las bcad pa dang, dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa dang lhan cig tu 'gro ba ste lnga po spang pa'o/
1) khyad par yod pa/ 2) ngo mtshar can/ lam khyad par can/ khyad par can gyi thabs shes la brten nas grub 'bras khyad par can sgrub pa/
khyad par can gyi gzugs can

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, dpe can don gyi dngos po dma' ba zhig dpe'i dngos po mtho ba zhig gi gzugs can du bkod pa des khyad du thon pa'i bya ba lhag par 'grub par ston pa'i rgyan zhig...
khyad par can rab tu grags pa ma yin pa

chos can ma grub pa dang don gcig tshad ma'i rig pa'i bsgrub bya ltar snang gi nang tshan zhig ste, grangs can pas sangs rgyas pa la bdag ni sems pa can yin no, zhes sgrub par cha mtshon na, bsgrub bya'i chos can bdag ces pa de sangs rgyas pas khas ma blang pas khyad par can rab tu grags pa ma yin pa'i skyon du gyur nas bsgrub bya ltar snang du gyur to/
chos dbyings skye med kyi mandala thog snang bzhi rtog tshogs kyi tshom bu bkod nas, bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba/

don rgyan gyi gras shig ste, brjod bya yon tan dang, rigs, bya ba, rdzas, rgyu rnams la rang rang gi mtshan nyid ma tshang yang, tshang ba dang khyad med dngos po'i nus pa phul du byung ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig...
khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan lnga

khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses rnam grangs lnga ni, yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa, rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa, bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa, rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa, rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa bcas so/
bzang ngan dang che chung sogs kyi dbye ba shes pa/ legs nyes kyi khyad par rtod pa'i blo gros med thabs med/
khyad par ltos pa ba'i rtags

rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag gi bye brag cig ste, rang rjod byed kyi sgras sgrub byed rang gi khyad par ram khyad chos dngos shugs gang rung gis rjod par byed pa dung sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu rang nyid rtsol ba la ltos dgos pa'i khyad par gyi rtags kyis bsgrub pa'o/
khyad par dag pa ba'i rtags

rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag gi nang gses, rang rjod byed kyi sgras sgrub byed kyi dngos po rang gi rang bzhin brjod pa las, rgyu rkyen gyi khyad par brjod pa la ma ltos pa, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu rgyu rkyen gyis byas ma byas dang gang gis byas pa sod kyi dpyad pa dag pa'am mi ltos pa'o/
ming ngam tha snyad dmigs bsal du gdags pa/
gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa bla na med pa/
gzhan las lhag par nus shugs 'don pa/
ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa rgya gar gyi slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/
khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra

rjod byed kyi sgra gang zhig rang gis zin par brjod pa'i sgras brjod bya'i khyad chos gzhan rnams rang gi brjod byar spangs pa'i sgo nas ston pa ste, khyad chos ston pa'i sgra, dper na sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes pa lta bu sgra'i khyad par du byas nas khyad par gzhan rnams rang gi brjod byar spong ba'o/

spong ba'i sgra: rjod byed kyi sgra gang zhig rang gis zin par brjod pa'i sgras brjod bya'i khyad chos gzhan rnams rang gi brjod byar ma spangs pa'i sgo nas ston pa ste khyad gzhi ston pa'i sgra, dper na sgra mi rtag pa zhes pa lta bu sgra rang nyid mi rtag pa yin par ston pa las khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'o/

grags pa ma yin pa: tshad ma'i rig pa'i bsgrub bya ltar snang gi nang tshan zhig ste, dper na sangs rgyas pas grangs can pa la sgra 'jig ces pa lta bur mtshon na, bsgrub bya 'di'i tshig stod cha sgra zhes pa der rgol phyi rgol gnyis kas khas lbangs kyang tshig smad cha 'jig pa de grangs can pas khas ma blangs stabs khyad par rab tu grags pa ma yin pa'i skyon gyur to

pa'i don gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, bsgrub bya brjod 'dod kyi dngos po byed las khyad par can zhig de'i sgrub byed du gang dang chos mtshungs pa'i byed las khyad par dang ldan pa zhig bkod pa'i rgyan/
khyad par du 'phags pa'i bsdus tshig
phul byung gi rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, mtshon byed yon tan shin tu lhag pa de las kyang mtshon bya don gyi yon tan khyad par 'phags par brjod pa'i rgyan zhig...
gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dbang cha,
dbye ba med pa'am mi 'dra ba med pa/ mi de tsho'i yon tan che chung la khyad med/ 'gro sdod gang byed kyang nga la khyad med/
khyad chos gang dang ldan pa'i gzhi/

la khyad chos mtshungs dang mi mtshungs gnyis: kha'i bsdus brjod bsdus brjod kyi rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, dpe'i khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi rang bzhin ji 'dra ba brjod pa des, dpe don gnyis kyi khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs pa dang mi mthungs pa'i gnas tshul gang yin shugs kyis bsdus te brjod pa'i rgyan zhig...
khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod bsdus

brjod kyi rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, dpe'i khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kyi gnas lugs brjod pa des, dpe don gnyis kyi khyad gzhi ngo bo tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs pa shugs kyis bsdus te brjod pa'i rgyan zhig...
khyad du gsod pa'i bsdus tshig
gang zhig gi khyab pa'i sa khongs sam khyab yul/ stobs shugs khyab khongs/
mi mang po'i mthong thos go yul du bkram pa'am bstan pa/ khyab bsgrags yi ge,..
yongs la khyab pa'i cha dang, khebs pa'i yul/ khyab cha'i khyad par/
khyab cha chung ba/ dgag bya khyab chung ba/
khyab cha che ba/ bsgrub bya khyab che drags pa/

(bishnu:) 1) bram ze rnams kyis 'jig rten byed por 'dzin pa'i lha zhig ste snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas khyab dang 'jug pa bcu'i sgo nas bya ba la 'jug pas 'jug zer/ ming gi rnam grangs la skra can gsod dang, go pin da, dga' ba'i dbang po, 'gro ba'i tog 'jig pa bcu pa, nye dbang, tha gu'i lto can, thig le drug pa, nabs so skyes, pad ma'i lte ba, dpa' bo'i rgyud, dpal gyi bdag po, dpal gyi be'us mtshan, dpal gyi lag pa, dbyig gi lte ba, sbyor ba brgya ba, mi yi theg pa, mi'u thung, 'og dbang skyes, g.yung drung can, g.yo med glang rdzi, sred med bu bcas so, 2) gza' r'a hu la/

bram ze rnams kyi bshad srol ltar lha khyab 'jug gis 'jig rten gyi bya ba la sprul pa bcu'i sgo nas 'jug pa ste, nya dang, rus sbal, phag rgod, mi'i seng ge, mi'u thung, shing rta bcu pa'i bu r'a ma na, dzam'ada aagni'i bu r'a ma na, nag po, sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pa, rigs ldan bram ze'i bu karki tse bcas bcu'o/
1) (mngon) sman chen/ 2) gza' r'a hu la'i khro zhal dgu/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig yin pa des khyab 'jug ston par 'dzin cing, 'khor ba zad mtha' can du 'dod/
(r'a hu le ne) khyab 'jug gi nad/
chos gnyis phan tshun yin na yin mnyam dang, min na min mnyam ste, 'dus byas dang mi rtag pa lta bu'o/

rtags gsal dang mtshan mtshon sogs phan tshun khyab pa yod med kyi gnas la mtha' dpyad bkod pa ste yod med dang, yin min gyi mtha' gcod pa, dper na, byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin pas khyab, du ba yod na me yod pas khyab ces pa lta bu'o/
1) rgya khyab tu dar ba/ khyab gdal gting phyin/ 2) sems can rnams kyi rgyud la thog ma nas gnas pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/

(tha dad pa) khebs pa dang tshang ba/ nyi ma'i 'od zer phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab pa/ mi yin na sems can yin pas khyab/ sems can yin na mi yin pas ma khyab/ me tog sil ma sa la khyab par bkram pa/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de kun la khyab par 'gro ba/

ma grub pa: thal 'gyur la bkod tshod kyi sgo nas rtags kyis gsal ba la khyab pa kho na ma grub pa, dper na, sangs rgyas pa'i ngor, sgra chos can, rtag pa yin par thal, gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bur mtshon na gzhal bya yin na rtag pa yin pas ma khyab ste mi rtag pa la'ang khyab pa'i phyir/
khyab pa mgo mtshungs kyi lan
mtshungs pa mgo snyoms kyi lan no/

thal 'gyur ltar snang bzhi'i nang gses, rtags dang bsgrub bya mi mthun pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtag pa yin par thal, byas pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed dang khyab pa 'gal bas thal lan khyab pa 'gal zhes brjod pa'o/
1) mtshan mtshon gyi khyab pa sgo brgyad/ 2) rtags gsal gyi khyab pa sgo brgyad/

rtags 'dzin sems: rtags 'dzin sems gnyis kyi ya gyal, rjes dpag gi rgyu khyab pa 'gro ldog gi tshul 'dzin pa'i mngon rjes yid dpyod gang rung gi shes pa, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub na, byas na mi rtag pas khyab par 'jal ba'am nges pa'i blo lta bu'o/

kyi sdug bsngal: zag bcas kyi tshor ba btang snyoms yul dang cas pa ste gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel bas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab pa dang sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'o/
rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad kyi nang gses, rjes khyab rnal ma dang, ldog khyab rnal ma dang, thur khyab rnal ma dang, 'gal khyab rnal ma ste bzhi'o/
log pa bzhi: rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad kyi nang gses, rjes khyab phyin ci log dang, ldog khyab phyin ci log dang, thur khyab phyin ci log dang, 'gal khyab phyin ci log ste bzhi'o/
gzugs yin phyin kha dog yin mi dgos pa'i khyab pa med pa ste, nges pa med pa'i tshig ste, mtshan nyid kyi khyab mtha'i tshig / gzugs yin na kha dog yin pas khyab pa ma grub/

thal 'gyur ltar snang bzhi'i nang gses, rtags de bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gnyis kar 'jug pas mthun phyogs kho nar khyab pa ma nges pa, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag par thal, shes bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu shes bya yin na mtha' gcig tu mi rtag pa yin pas ma khyab cing, thal lan ma khyab ces sam khyab pa ma nges zhes brjod pa'o/

grub cing rtags khas blangs kyis grub pa: sgra rtag par khas len pa'i gang zag gi ngor, sgra chos can, ma byas pa yin par thal, rtag pa yin pa'i phyir, zhes bkod pa lta bur mtshon na, rtag na ma byas pas khyab pa tshad mas grub la rtags rtag pa khas len pa'o/

de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad la khyab pa'i dmigs pa ste, zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa bzhi'i nang tshan zhig. khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi: zhi gnas kyi khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi ste, rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan, rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan, dngos po'i mtha', dgos pa yongs su 'grub pa bcas kyi dmigs pa bzhi'o/

khyab byed kyis khyab bya'i gnas kun la khyab par 'jug pa ste, dper na tsan dan yin na shing yin pas khyab pa'am, me yin na tsha zhing bsreg pa yin pas khyab pa lta bu, shing ni tsan dan dang tsha bsreg ni me khyab par 'jug yod pa'o/

thal 'gyur 'god skabs kyi khyab pa bsgrub pa'i ngag ste, du ba yod na me yod pas khyab par thal, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed de yod pa'am yin pa'i rtags kyis bsgrub bya de yod pa'am yin nges pa'i khyab pa bsgrub pa'i rtags sbyor gyi ngag go/
phyogs tshang ma nas gong 'phel du gtong ba/ phyogs thams cad du khyab spel byed pa/
bye brag gi don, dper na, gser bum de bum pa'i khyab bya dang, byas pa ni mi rtag pa'i khyab bya dang, ma byas pa ni rtag pa'i khyab bya/
kyi 'gal ba: phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi brgyud 'gal te, khyab bya byas pa dang, khyab byed rtag pa gnyis lta bu khyab bya dang khyab byed mi mthun par gnas pa'o/

du ma 'gebs par byed pa'i spyi ste, dper na, bum pa de gser bum dang rdza bum sogs rang gi bye brag thams cad la khyab byed dang, rtag pa ni ma byas pa'i khyab byed dang, mi rtag pa ni byas pa'i khyab byed yin pa lta bu'o/

snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, bsgrub chos dang 'gal ba'i khyab byed dam spyi rtags su bkod nas, dgag chos khyab bya'am bye brag pa 'gog pa, dper na, me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, kha ba'i reg pa rgyun chags su 'byung ba med de, me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu, kha ba'i reg pa grang reg gi bye brag gam khyab bya yin pa de ma dmigs pa'i rtags su khyab byed me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i dngos po dang 'gal ba'o/
khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa

'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnod byed kyi khyab bya rtags su bkod nas, gnod bya'i khyab bya 'gog pa ste, dper na, tsandan gyi mes khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, kha ba'i reg pa med de, tsandan gyi mes khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu tsandan gyi mes grang ba'i khyab bya med par sgrub pa'o/
khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur

rang rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, 'gal ba'i khyab bya rtags su bkod nas thal 'gyur 'phangs pa gang zhig bzlog na khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, tsan dan gyi me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i shar gzhir chos can, tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa ma yin par thal, kha ba'i reg pa yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, kha ba'i reg pa med de, tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa rang gi rigs gcig pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa'o/
khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum gyi nang gses, 'gal ba'i rgyu rtags su bkod pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog na 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, tsan dan gyi me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i shar gzhir chos can, tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa ma yin par thal, grang reg gi dngos rgyu yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, grang reg gi dngos rgyu med de, tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal gyur ro/
khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa

'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnod byed kyi 'bras bu rtags su bkod nas, gnod bya'i khyab bya 'gog pa ste, dper na, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, kha ba'i reg pa med de, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu me 'bras kyis grang ba'i khyab bya med par sgrub pa'o/
khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum gyi nang gses, 'gal ba'i 'bras bu rtad su bkod pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog na rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, tsan dan gyi me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i shar gzhir chos can tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa ma yin par thal, grang 'bras spu long byed yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed med de, tsan me tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur ro/ pa: rtags kyis gsal ba la khyab pa ste, rtags de bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mthun phyogs sam, mi mthun phyogs gang rung dang gnyis ka la khyab par yod pa'o/
rtags kyis gsal ba la khyab pa ste, rtags de bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mthun phyogs sam, mi mthun phyogs gang rung dang gnyis ka la khyab par yod pa'o/
khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i rtags

snang rung gi 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, bdag gcig gi 'brel ba la brten nas 'gog byed khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis dgag bya khyab bya bkag pa, dper na, brag rdzong pha gi na chos can, shing sha pa med de, shing med pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur

gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bcu bzhi'i nang gses, khyab byed ma dmigs pa rtags su bkod pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog na rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs 'phen pa ste dper na, sha pa ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can, sha pa med par thal, shing med pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, shing yod de sha pa yod pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur ro/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, snying la gnas shing, khrag sogs dwangs ma lus kun la khyab par byed pa dang, rkang lag 'degs 'jog sogs lus kyi sgul skyod byed pa'i rlung/
khyam me khyom me'i bsdus tshig
snod bcud 'gul stangs/ sa 'gul rkyen gyis snod bcud khyam khyom du g.yo/
khyams ra'am khang pa'i tshoms kyi mdo'i phyogs/
ra bas bskor ba'i khang pa'i khyams/
khya re khyo re'i bsdus tshig

/ 1) nor srung/ sgo khyi/ 'dogs khyi/ sha khyi/ mi ngan ltag shed ngom, khyi ngan bdag shed ngom/ khyi'i 'ur kha/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba'i cha can dang, grong gi gcan gzan, 'dod dbang, rdo rje'i mjug ma can, nor srung, rdzi gsang ba, sha khyi, seng ge'i rigs, gso byed bcas so, 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / lcags khyi lo/
1) rku byed pa'i khyi/ 2) khyi la smod pa'i tshig
las don gang zhig yin rung de la kha gtad 'jal mkhan re dgos pa'i dpe/
gtsigs cher brtsis te blos gtong mi bra ba/
khyi 'khyams te, bdag po med pa'i khyi/
khyis 'cha' ba'am rmug tu mi 'jug pa/ mi gcig gis khyi 'gog rgyu dang, shing gcig gis me 'bar rgyu khag /
1) khyi lo lon pa/ khyi rgan sha la rgyugs na, khyi phrug rang dgar rgyug / 2) gzhan la gshe ba'i ngan tshig
khyi rgan 'gram pa'i spu mdog rgya bo/
(yul) ri la skyes pa'i sgog pa zhig /
1) khyi thu po/ 2) khyi khong khro langs pa/
mdzo mo shing gi ming gi rnam grangs shig
za phrug langs nas spu byi ba'i khyi nad cig /
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi tsho'i khyim du khyi nyar chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
don med gzhan la snyad rko'i gtam dpe/ bdag la bka' bkyon khyi nyal rgyug slong gi tshul du gnang byung/
rgyu ba'i dug gi nang tshan khyi smyon gyi sos rmugs pa'i dug nad lus la zhen pa
khyi spyang tsha zhes khyi'i rigs shig ste, spyang ki dang 'dra zhing, rang gshis drag po, rdzi rno ba zhig /
khyi spyang kha mthun yang zer, mi ngan kha 'gril gyi dpe/
mi ngan kha mthun gyi dpe/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig gi brtul zhugs/
(mngon) srog chags gzugs mo'am byi thur can/
gzhan 'dzin pa'am rmug pa'i phyir khyi skul ba/ cho cho byas nas khyi rbad pa/ ri dwags rngon la khyi rbad bzhin, khyed kyis bskul der lan de bslogs/
mig gnyis kyi thod du spu mdog ser po'i thig le gnyis yod pa'i khyi/ khyi me tog sngo zhig /
khyi mo sbrum ldan dang phru gu 'khrid rgyu yod pa'i khyi mo/ khyi mo tshang ma'i sgo 'gram nas, seng dkar mo yin yang dogs zon dgos/
sems smyo nad kyis zin pa'i khyi/ khyi smyon yin yang bdag po ngo shes/
khyis skad rgyag pa/ 'grul pa slebs na khyi zug yong/
rngon/ mi tshe gcig la khyi ra brgyab nas 'tsho ba skyel ba/ ri 'go lon nas khyi ra/
1) khyi'i ro/ 2) (yul) khyi la gshe ba'i tshig /
khyi las ngan pa ste, ha cang tha shal gyi dpe/
lo skor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / khyi lo pa/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo nad sel, lud pa gyen du 'dren/
khyi lo chung/ lung chung sbug na khyi gsar btsan/

/ 1) grong khang ste, mi tshang gtan du chags pa'i gnas/ rang khyim nas thon te phyogs la phyin pa/ khyim gyis stongs pa/ grwa pa yin yang khyim na gnas pa'i 'khor yod/ 2) chung ma/ 3) (griha)...gza' skar rnams la 'dzin par byed pa'i las kyis phan 'dogs pas khyim zer/ nyi khyim/ 4) nyi ma la khyim bcu gnyis yod pas grangs bcu gnyis mtshon/
1) khyim tshang skyong ba po/ 2) khyim skyong bar byed pa/
1) khyim nang gi bran g.yog / 2) (mngon) skyes pa 'bras bu phyung ba'i khyo ga /
khyim gyi kun dga' ra ba
khyim gyi 'khor lo zlum po'i tshul gyis 'khor ba'i nyi ma'i 'gro lam/
khang pa'i mdun gyi ra ba/
khyim gyi bdag po bcu gnyis
nyi ma bcu gnyis dang don gcig
1) khyim tshang mang nyung/ 2) khyim bcu gnyis mtshon byed kyi aang grangs te thig shar na lug khyim dang, gcig shar na glang khyim, gzhan rnams rigs 'gre/
mnyam du chags pa'i them dud/
nyi ma sogs ni skar khyim longs su spyod pa po yin pas na khyim can zhes brjod/

bum pa, nya, lug 'khrig pa, glang, karka ta, seng ge, bu mo, srang, sdig pa, gzhu, chu srin bcas so, ming de ltar btags pa'i rgyui mtshan ni, ri yi rgyal po re rab la gzhu dang, chu srin dang, bum pa dang, nya dang, lug dang, glang la sogs pa'i gdong pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i thad ka na nyi ma gnas tshe de ltar ming 'dogs lugs gcig dang, yang 'dzam bu'i gling na, gzhu sra ba'i,dus dang, chu srin gyi kha nyi ma la bstan nas 'dug pa'i dus dang, bum pa'i chang gi chang ro nus dang ldan pa'i dus dang, nya rnams chu la rgyu ba'i dus dang, lu gu skye ba'i dus dang, glang rnams kyis zhing rmo ba'i dus dang, dud 'gro rnams 'dod chags langs pa'i dus dang, karka ta ni sbal pa yin pas sbal pas skad 'byin pa'i dus dang, seng ges chags pa spyod pa'i dus dang, bu mo rnams mdangs bzang ba'i dus dang, srang ngam nya ga la ja mar 'degs pa'i dus dang, sdig pa rnams khung du 'gro ba'i dus dang, kha cig 'di dud 'gro gsod pa'i sdig pa'i dus kyang zer ro, khyim gcig gi sa khyon ni rgyu skar gyi rkang pa dgu ste yul gyi chu tshod brgya dang so lnga yod/
mi nor med pa'i khang khyim/
khyim tshang gi sa dbyibs bzang ngan brtag dpyad byed thabs/
bza' tsho'am, bza' mi khyo shug / pho mo de gnyis khyim thab sgrig pa/ khyim thab blangs te rang gi pha mes kyi gzhis 'dzin pa/
1) khyim gyi 'tsho thabs sam 'tsho tshis/ 2) khyim thab dang 'dra,
1) mi tshang gi bdag po/ 2) sbyin bdag / longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa'i khyim bdag /
1) mi tshang gi nang/ 2) khyim pa'i sdod gnas/
1) khyim tshang/ 2) khyim du yod pa/ 3) (mngon) mna' ma/
mi skya bo/ khyim pa pho mo/ khyim par 'bebs pa/
khyim pa'i mtshan nyid brtag dpyad byed pa'i thabs/
1) khyim pa bud med/ 2) (mngon) mna' ma/
'jig rten pa rnams zhe khrel bar byed pa/
mi skya bo'i chas gos gyon stangs/
khyim pa'i spyod tshul/ nam yang khyim pa'i chos kyis ma bcings pa/
1) rgyal po'am blon chen gyi phyag mdzod lta bu/ 2) bza' dpon nam khyim bdag /
khyim gzhis gsar du brgyab pa'am khyim bzung ba/ kho bos khyim phub nas lo mang po phyin song
lag rtsar brten nas gnyen tshan dang bcas pa'i legs nyes sogs brtag dpyad byed pa'i mo phywa ste, ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
nyi zla khyim nas khyim du 'pho ba, lag len byed skabs su don gyi khyim 'pho dang byed sla'i khyim 'pho gnyis yod/

1) khyim nang du gso ba'i bya de sogs/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang pa'i mtshon bya can dang, dga' byed, snga bar sgra sgrog tho rengs skad sgrog bde legs can, nor bu'i mgrin can, pags pa'i gtsug phud can, 'phel byed, mya ngan med, mtshan mo skad sgrog mtshan mo rig zngas kyi gtsug phud can, zangs ze can, zung gi sgra sgrog 'od kyi sde, yongs zlum mig gso byed bcas so, 2) byi'u zhig gi ming/
1) rkun ma sogs kyis khang khyim gyi rtsig par bug pa rtol ba/ 2) (mngon) rkun ma dang tsi tsi sogs rtsig par bug pa rtol mkhan/
khyim 'dzin gyi gtso bo bud med/
mi tshang ngam nang tshang/ khyim tshang gtor ba/ khyim tshang 'thor ba/
mi tshang gi 'tsho thabs/ khyim tshis zhor las/
mi tshang gi 'tsho rten nam rang tshugs thub pa'i nus pa/ mi tshang khyim tsho zin pa/
grong rogs/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab/ thag ring gi gnyen las mdza' mthun khyim mtshes dga'/ khyim mtshes du ba mdangs 'brel/
1) khyim tshang la 'tsho skyong byed pa/ 2) khyim dang 'tsho ba'i bsdus ming/
nyi ma khyim rer 'pho ba'i yun tshad sum cur bgos pa'i cha shas gcig /
khyim lo gcig gam khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu tham pa/
khyim zhag dus kyi rtag longs

khyim zhag gcig gi dus longs te yul longs dus tshod bzhi dang chu srang sum cu'am nyin zhag gi chu tshod drug cu dang, chu srang nga gnyis, dbugs bzhi, dbud gcig dus mda' mkha' ri yid kyi char byas pa'i cha shas sum khri lnga stong brgya phrag gcig dang bzhi yin/ 4.. .30...(... 1...)...1. ..60...1...60...52...4...35104/ 1470156...1...01464...
gtan du gnas sa'i gzhis/ khyim gzhis chags pa/

gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas te nyes pa la 'dzem pa med par 'jug pa spyod ngan la gzhan gyis khrel dogs mi byed pa, nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig /
khrel ngo tsha med pa dang, lugs srol la med pa/ khrel med lugs med kyi spyod ngan/
gzhan nam 'jig rten rgyu mtshan du byas nas nyes pa la 'dzem pa'i las can te, spyod ngan la gzhan gyis khrel dogs byed pa, dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi gras shig / ngo tsha khrel yod kyi mi/
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses, gzhan ngor ltos te kha na ma tho ba 'dzem pa lte, dge ba'i chos rnams srung zhing nyes pa'i tshogs bzlog par byed pas blon po rin che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
gzhan gyis khrel yong snyam du bsam shes pa/ rtag tu bag yod khrel shes kyi sgo nas rang gi spyod lam la zhib dpyad byed pa/
1. rtswa las byas pa'i stan/ 2. (rnying) cha tshang ngam kun/
khur po'am, khur tsa, rdog khres/
zug rngus brgyal ba bzhin du na ba/
khur po/ sgal par khres po khyer ba/ thag pas khres po 'drag pa/
khur po 'khur ba po/ ming gi rnam grangs la khur 'dren pa dang, khur ba, khur rtsal ba, rgyab kyis theg pa bcas so,
/ 1) zhun bdar ma bcad pa'i lcags rigs/ 2) khro las bzos pa'i snod/ tshod khro/ ja khro/ thug khro/ dkyil khro/
khro las bzos pa'i rkyan bu'am, khog ltir/
si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khro chu rdzong gi ming rnying/
dkyil 'khor gyi sgo srung khro bo bzhugs khang/
rgya lu chas spros skabs gyon rgyu'i zhwa mo'i bye brag cig /
khong khro langs te sems 'khrugs pa/ khro 'khrugs me ltar 'bar/
khro bo'i rgyal po ste lha drag po'i gtso bo/
mdo chen byams pa bon lugs bskyed rdzogs kyi 'bras bu'i skor bshad pa'i gzhung zhig /
khros te gsod sdigs la rings pa/ gnod byed mi bsrun pa'i phyogs la ha cang khro rngams byed pa/
1) zhun bdar ma bcad pa'i lcags/ 2) khro lcags las lugs brgyab pa'i dngos po/

1) gzhus nas chu ltar 'khol ba'i khu ba/ lugs kong khro chus gang ba/ 2) zung chu'i chu rgyud kyi yan lag cig ste, de dmu dge'i chu dang gcig tu 'dres nas mthar rmin cang gtsang por 'bab/ 3) rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus khul dang khro chu'i lho 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de rdo kha ru yod/
khong khro gcog pa/ bzod pa bsgoms te khro 'joms pa/ rig pa bsgrims nas khro 'joms pa/
rngam brjid dam, tshig pa za ba'i rnam 'gyur/
khro ba'i gnyer ma ste khros pa'i gdong gi gnyer ma/ snying nas mi dga' ba yin yang gdong du khro gnyer mi 'don pa/ khro gnyer bsdus te tshig rtsub mos bsdigs shing smod par byed/
yi dam sgrol ma'i bye brag cig /
1) khong khro drag po/ zhe sdang gi khro gtum mi bzod pa 'bar ba/ 2) si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rit rang skyong khul gyi khro chu rdzong gi la zhig /
khro las bzos pa'i me thab/ rdo sol 'bud sa'i khro thab/
khong khro langs nas lus 'dar ba/
'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rin po che rgyal tsha dang de'i slob ma khro phu lo tsa ba byams pa dpal bcas nas brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud/
phag gru'i yang slob byams pa dpal gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa gtsang shab gzhung gi shar rgyud du yod/

ba byams pa dpal: rin po che rgyal tsha dang kun ldan ras pa sku mched kyi dbon po 'di rab byung gsum pa'i chu sprul lor 'khrungs, dgung lo nyi shu pa nas zhang dge ba las sgra rig pa mthar phyin sbyangs te lo tsa ba grags can du gyur, nyer bzhi pa la bal yul du byon, kha che pan chen buddhashri las mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mang du gsan, snga rting du mi tra dzo ge dang, sh'akyashribhadra, buddhashri sogs pandita du ma khro phur spyan drangs, yul 'khor rnams su 'chad nyan mdzad, khro phu dgon par byams chen khru brgyad cu pa bzhengs, sras sems pa chen po byung, de'i yang slob tu bu ston rin po che byon, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya la 'das, de'i slob ma dag las rim par brgyud pa rnams la khro phu bka' brgyud ces grags/

1. (tha mi dad pa) khros pa, khro ba,, sdang ba/ dgra la khros pa/ shin tu khros pa'i tshul/ khros kyang slar mi khro ba/ 2.khong khro 'phel te rdeg pa sogs gnod pa dngos su gshom par byed pa nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig / khro ba ston pa/ don med kyi khro ba spangs te rang sems bde bar gnas/ ming gi rnam grangs la khong khro dang, khros pa, 'khrugs pa, mngon 'joms, sdang sems, mi bzod pa, tshig pa za bcas so,
khong khro'i sems rgod dam tshig pa za ba'i rkyen gyis sems g.yeng ba/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po byung zin pa zhig 'gog byed ko long gi khro tshig brjod pa'i sgo nas 'gog par byed pa'i rgyan zhig /

/ 1) drag po/ 2) khro ba po/ 3) drag po'i rnam 'gyur can gyi lha spyi/ 4) (mngon) 1. shing glang lo/ 2. nang gi srung 'khor gyi phyogs bcur bzhugs nas sgrub pa po la srung ba'i khro bo bcu yod pas grangs bcu mtshon/
gnod mdzes dang gshin rje gshed, gzhan gyis mi thub pa, rta mgrin, bdud rtsi 'khyil ba, 'dod rgyal, dbyug sngon can, stobs po che, mi g.yo ba, gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur, rdo rje sa 'og rnams so/

rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud: rgyud kyi bye brag cig khyon le'u bcu yod cing, bod yig gi sgyur yig yod kyang, sgyur pa po'i mtshan bkod med, slar rgya yig gzhir bzung nas bsgyur bcos byas pa zhig /
sdigs pa'i gad mo, ha ha, dgyes pa'i gad mo, he he, sgeg pa'i gad mo, hi hi, zil gyis gnon pa'i gad mo, ho ho ste brgyad/
zhabs gcig brkyangs gcig bskums kyi bzhugs stangs/
khong khro ba'i mig / me ltar 'bar ba'i khro mig gis dgra la lta ba
/ 1) bud med khong khro can/ 2) (mngon) shing 'brug lo/ 3) lha mo khro mo/
khong khro'i rnam 'gyur rlung tshub lta bu'i gzugs su bkod pa/ khro tshub langs pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston/
1)khro dang zangs mnyam bsres kyis lugs brgyab pa'i snod spyad/ 2)lcags rigs khro'i nang gses shig /

1)si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sde dge rdzong gi ri zhig / 2) la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kong po nyang phu dang aar rtsa mtsho'i bar du yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5494 yod/
sgra'i khyad par zhig / d'a ma ru dkrol nas sgra khro lo lo grag /
nang nas grangs pa'i sgra grag stangs shig / lto ba spos pas khog na sgra khrog khrog tu grag /
1) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rtsa tshad sel, rma gso, khrag shor gcod/ 2) mes cher ma tshig pa'am tshos tsam pa/
/ 1) mes tshig po'am tshos po/ bag leb khrog po/ 2) rna ba de tsam mi gsal ba/ aam cog khrog po/
1) sa 'og nas bton rjes dngos po gzhan dang ma 'dres shing, phye mar ma btags pa'i sman hrob/ 2) sngo sman min pa'i sman rigs/
krong nge'am srong nge ba/ gzugs po khrong nger langs 'dug /
dbus sam dkyil dang, gseb/ mi mang po'i khrod/ ri khrod/ nags khrod/ mun khrod/ dur khrod/
khron pa'i nang nas chu 'chu byed/

chu'i ched du brus pa'i sa dong/ khron pa bshang ba/ khron thag / khron chu/ zhing kha'i gseb tu khron pa brkos te zhing chu gtong thabs byed pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun brkos dang, chu nyal, chu yi ka ba, brus chu bcas so,
/ 1) khron pa chung chung/ 2) thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas dug tshad dang, snod tshad, bad kan gyi nad sogs thur du sbyong bar byed/
khron pa'i nang gi sbal pa ste, mthong rgya chung ba'i dpe/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i sgo ra so so'i nang du yod pa'i khron pa'i chu bed spyod sngar bzhin byas chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor gnang ba zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
/ 1) mi mang po dang, tshong zog mang po 'du sa/ rta khrom/ dpe khrom/ sha khrom/ tshal khrom/ 2) dmag las/
1) mi mang gral star bsgrigs nas khrom lam du bskor te gzi rngam ston pa/ 2) khrom la 'gro ba/
dom dom/ bzhon rta la khrom khrom nyis brtsegs brgyab pa/
khrom gyi dngos zog gi gong thang/
mi mang po'i dbus su byed pa'i khyab bsgrags/ gsang rgya khrom bsgrags/ gsang ba khrom bsgrags/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa skya rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig /
1) tshong khrom chen po/ 2) mi khrom chen po/
(rnying) 1) dmag brgyab pa/ 2) dmag sgar btab pa/
mang po 'dus sar bshams pa'am bkram nas 'tshong ba/ tshong zog khrom bton byas nas btsongs/
mang po'i nang du skad grags thon pa/ de ring rta rgyug 'gran bsdur skabs rta 'dis khrom thog chod song/
'od 'phro tshul zhig...rtswa rtser zil pa khrom me bar chags pa/
mi zog mang po 'dzoms sa/ khrom tshogs kyi nyi mar gtam dgos, dgrar 'thab pa'i nyi mar dpa' dgos/

sangs rgyas pa tsho'i phyag mchod gsol 'debs kyi rten tshogs shing sgom tshul zhig ste, gtso bo'i mtha' skor bang rim steng 'og tu mi khrom 'tshogs pa ltar sgor sgor 'khyil 'khyil du bzhugs pa'i rnam pa/
khrom gyi dkyil lam lte gnas/
tshong zog bkram pa'i ra ba'am sa cha/
d'a ma ru sogs kyi sgra khrol stangs shig /
zhing kha thengs gnyis pa'i rmon pa rgyag pa
/ 1) 'tshag byed kyi yo byad khrol ma chung chung/ 2) dngos rdzas rdog po chung ngu'i rnam pa/ sman rdzas rnams khrol bur brdungs nas gdus/
tshags ma, spyir btang rgyun bus bzos pa'i tshags ma der zer/
d'a ma ru sogs kyi sgra grag tshul zhig /
khros pa'i tshig rtsub bam tshig gnag po
byed po/ shing mkhan/ lam mkhan/ 'gro mkhan/ yong mkhan/ shes mkhan/
1) rab byung gi sdom brgyud/ 2) dgon pa'i mkhan po rim byung/
1) sngar bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag ser mo ba'i go sa'i ming zhig / 2) mkhan pa'i rigs me tog ser po 'char ba zhig ste, nus pas glo nad sel, lums byas na yan lag zha rengs 'dul/
mkhan pa rigs bzhi'i nang tshan mkhan aa krong ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag shor gcod, yan lag gi skrangs pa 'joms/
1) grwa sa khag gi khri 'dzin che gras/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ser mo ba'i go sa mkhan sde che gras/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs, yig tshang las khungs kyi las 'gan 'khur ba'i drung yig chen mo/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs, yig tshang las khungs kyi las 'gan 'khur ba'i drung yig chen mo rgan pa'i go gnas can/
mkhan drung mnyam sbrel te sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi yig tshang las khungs su mkhan drung zhes ser mo ba rim bzhi bzhi yod pa de dag mnyam sbrel la zer/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag ser mo ba'i go sa'i rim pa zhig /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sa mtshams srung 'dzin du btang ba'i rtse drung la mkhan po dang, shod drung la nang so zer/
ldum bu'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag gcod, lums byas na yan lag gi skrangs pa 'joms/
rkang re rer skyes pa'i rtswa mkhan pa/
/ 1) las kyi 'go byed dam byed pa po/ snyan ngag mkhan po/ 2) (aupadhuya:) rab byung dang, bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'bogs mkhan/ grwa sa'i mkhan po/

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, spyir brtan mkhas kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs shing, khyad par bsgrub bya'i ngos nas mthong thos dogs gsum gyi skyon med pa'i mkhan por 'os pa'i dge slong la mkhan por gsol ba btab cing khas blangs pa dang ldan pa'o/
mkhan po bo dhi sa tva
bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du phebs pa'i rgya gar gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/
so thar sdom pa ster ba'i dge slong ma'am dge slong ma'i gtso bo/
t'a la'i bla ma'i mdzod pa spyi khyab mkhan po dngos su ma bskos pa'i bar la de'i las 'gan 'khur mkhan de la mkhan tshab zer/
dgon pa so so'i mkhan po 'phos nas zur du sdod mkhan/
1) mkhan po snga phyir byung ba'i rim brgyud/ 2)sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs mkhan chung dang rim bzhi'i bsdus ming/

1) bla ma dang slob ma/ 2)mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi bsdus ming ste, 'dul ba ltar na, gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa, 'dul ba'i sde snod nas bshad pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa, nad pa sogs mgon med pa'i sems can la snying rje khyad par can ldan pa ste khyad chos gsum ldan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/
mkhan po bo dhi sa tva dang, slob dpon pad ma sam lha ba, chos rgyal khri srong lde mtsan gsum/
1) gnam/ 2) (mngon) grangs kyi thig gi ming/
nam mkhar khyab pa'am nam mkha' khebs pa ste rgya che ba'i dpe/ mkha' khyab slob ma/
phyogs kyi ris med par yongs su khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
gnam gru nam mkhar 'phur 'gro bar zer/
slob dpon pad ma dngos kyis mkha' 'gro ye: shes mtsho rgyal la bstan pa dang pad ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas bton pa'i rnying ma'i gdams ngag cig /

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dngos slob 'phyongs rgyas ngag dbang dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i man ngag rgyud kyi lhan thabs kyi gsang sman rnams lhug par bkrol ba'i lde mig lta bu'i le tshan zhig /
shar rdo rje mkha' 'gro, lho rin chen mkha' 'gro, nub pad ma mkha' 'gro, byang las kyi mkha' 'gro, dbus sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bcas so/
(d'akini:) 1) thun min dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ 2) dag pa'i zhing khams sogs su skyes pa'i lha mo/
slob dpon pad ma'i gsang yum zhig
sngo sman gyi nang tshan chu ma rtsi'i rigs: shig ste ro skyur la bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas chu 'gags 'bigs, skyug pa gcod, chu ser dang dmu chu sbyong/
rnying ma'i gter yig la mkha' 'gro'i brda: yig zer
1) sgrol ma'i gtso mo/ 2) (mngon) 1. bde mchog / 2. bya khyung/
1) nam mkha' mtha' yas pa dang mnyam pa ste, rgya che ba'i dpe/ 2) (mngon) sangs rgyas spyi,..
(mngon) gza' bkra shis te mig dmar/
srin bu me khyer te, lus nas me 'od 'phro ba'i srin 'bu chung ngu/
thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gses, 'jig rten pa'i dbang phyug brgyad thob pa'am, 'dod lha rigs drug sogs lha yul gyi mkha' spyod rnams su bgrod nus pa'o/
sa skya pa'i mkha' spyod skor gsum ste, n'a ro mkha' spyod, aintra mkha' spyod, mee tri mkha' spyod bcas so/
gzugs khams bcu bdun, 'dod lha rigs drug mi yul gyi nam mkhar spyod pa sogs phyogs gcig tu nges pa med pa rnams so/

yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i mkha' spyod de, rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo nyid dang, lus yang ba nyid dang, 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag khyab par byed pa nyid dang, sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'thob pa dang, ye shes kyi snang ba gsal ba dang, brtan pa dang, skye bo thams cad bdag nyid kyi dbang du gyur pa dang 'dod dgur sgyur ba bcas so/
(mngon) gro bzhin zla ba ste hor zla bdun pa/
mkha' klong ngam nam mkha'i mthongs/
bar snang nas 'bab pa'i mi rgyu kha char sogs/
dmag 'thab byed pa'i dmag dpung ste: spyir mkha' 'grul dpung sde dang, sa ngos nas mkha' dmag rogs skyor byed pa'i dpung sde sna tshogs yod/
gnam nas sa la mi rgyu sogs g.yugs pa/
bar snang du yod pa'i rlan gyi rlangs pa/
nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i rlung/
mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags
mi yul gyi 'byung po dang the'u rang la sogs pa/
1) nam mkha'/ 2) bar snang du 'gro lam/
mkhar rdzong ste sngar dpon po sdod khang/ mkhar gru gsum/ mkhar gru bzhi/ rdo mkhar/ rgyal mkhar/
ri sgang sogs la brtsigs pa'i khang pa btshan po/
rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, dkar gong srin can dang srin med gnyis mchis nus pas srin 'don, dug brtag thub/
mkhar ru'i rgya ma ste mkhar rgya'i 'degs khal gcig la rgya ma brgyad tsam yod/
mkhar 'degs sam mkhar khal gcig gi brgyad cu'i cha gcig /
sa ming zhig nang sog la yod, deng sang ming la hu'u ho ha'o the zer/
1) rdzong gi sde pa ste rdzong dpon/ 2) bsod nams/
nya ga ste mkhar rgya'i khal gcig gi nyi: shu tham pa'i cha gcig yin zhing nya ga gang rer ha lam rgya ma'i srang bzhi re tsam zhig yin/
mkhar ru'i 'degs khal ste, mkhar 'degs kyi khal gcig la ha lam rgya ma brgyad tsam zhig yin/
1) lcags ri'i phyogs mtshams su mtho tsam du brtsigs pa'i khang pa ste lcog kyang zer/ 2) (rnying) shing gi sdong bu/
(rnying) 1) btsan rdzong chung ba/ 2) mkhar chung ba/
mkhar ru'i bre ste, 'bo gang gi nyi shu tham pa'i cha gcig yin zhing, bre gang la ha lam nas rgya ma gang dang srang bzhi'i ljid yod/
mkhar ru ste nas mkhar 'bo'i khal gcig rer ljid tshad ha lam rgya ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad re yod/
(rnying) 1) mkhar srung dmag sde/ 2) mkhar nang sdod dmangs/
ri sgang sogs la brtsigs pa'i khang pa btsan po/ gtor dka' ba'i mkhar rdzong lcags ri can/ mkhar rdzong gog po/
1) mkhar gyi rtsa ba'am gsham/ 2) mkhar dang khad nye ba'i sa cha/
dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i 'go tshud skabs karma bstan skyong gis 'degs gshor gyi dngos po'i tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs bzos pa'i 'bo la gtan tshigs mkhar ru dang nya ga la mkhar rgya zhes grags/
khang pa nyams gso byed pa/
mkhal ma'i drod nyams pa'i mkhal nad cig ste, nad rtags su lus smad drod dang bral zhing mkhal rked na ba dang, dri chu sri'am snyi ba zhig /
grum bu'i nad mkhal mar 'bab pa zhig ste, nad rtags su sked pa man chad na zhing mjing pa phan tshun bsgyur dka' ba zhig /
mkhal nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi aa mdo rdzong khongs su yod/
lus smad grang zhing rked pa kha 'khor nas rgyun ring du na ba'i mkhal nad cig /
mkhal ma'i mdog ste dmar smug /

lus brdabs 'grams shor ba dang rlan grang gi gnas su las mang byas pa sogs las byung ba'i mkhal nad brgyad de, mkhal rlung dang, mkhal gcong, mkhal nad 'or lhung, mkhal tshad, mkhal nad chu shor, mkhal 'grams, mkhal grum, mkhal nad da rgan bcas so/
mkhal nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig ste, mkhal rtsa mi bde zhing zag chu khrag tu 'byung ba'i nad cig /
mkhal nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig ste, mkhal ma'i thad kyi sgal tshigs phyir 'bur por gyur te rgur por 'gyur ba'i nad cig /
mkhal rked na zhing lus la za 'phrug 'byung ba dang, 'gro 'dug byas tshe pus mo dang bol gong skrangs pa'i mkhal nad cig /
dri chu sri zhing rked pa kha 'khor nas na ba sogs 'byung ba'i 'bras nad mkhal mar babs pa zhig /

mi lus kyi byang khog smad kyi char sta zur g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi gong thad du gnas shing don lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni lus kyi chu khams kyi dwangs ma rnams lus la skyel zhing snyigs ma rnams rgyu grog rtsa'i brgyud lgang par skyel ba yin no/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, 'bras bu mkhal dbyibs dang 'dra ba, ro mngar la tsha ba zhu rjes cung bsil, nus pas mkhal gcong dang, mkhal tshad sel/
sgal tshigs bcu bzhi pa'i thad nas g.yas: g.yon du tshon gang re dang phun gang re gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i mkhal rtsa/
mo nad rlung tshabs rigs drug gi nang tshan tshabs nad mkhal mar byer ba zhig ste, nad rtags su rked tshigs kha 'khor nas na zhing lhag par du grang na sdug tu 'gro ba zhig /
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bcu bzhi pa mkhal ma dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang ste, der me btsa' bzhag na mkhal ma'i grang ba la phan/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi aa mdo rdzong khongs su yod/
mkhal ma dang 'brel ba'i gtar rtsa byin gzhug dang, long rtsa lta bu'o/
mkhal nad brgyad kyi nang tshan mkhal mar tsha ba zhugs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su dri chu sri zhing rked pa kha 'khor nas na ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
1) mkhal ma'i tshil bu/ 2) lus kyi gsang gnad kyi bye brag cig /
mkhal ma zho sha'i bsdus ming,
mkhal nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan mkhal mar rlung zhugs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su rked pa 'phyangs nas na zhing rna ba 'on par 'gyur ba zhig /
tshig la mkhas shing don la byang chub/

rab byung dang po'i me yos gong gi lo grangs zhe dgu pa sa stag la snye mo ra mang du 'khrungs, dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu tsam bzhugs par grags, gdung rus khyung po, gzhon nu'i dus su bon lugs sogs bslabs pa de la blo ma 'khel bar bal po dang rgya gar du chos la don gnyer mdzad, lo lnga bcu tsam gyi ring rgya bal bod gsum du 'byon bzhud mdzad, g.yas ru shangs su zhang zhang gi dgon pas gtsos pa'i dgon pa mang du btab, de nas shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi srol phye, grwa pa khri tsho du ma 'dus par grags, chos rgyud lo grangs bzhi brgya tsam dar nas rim gyis bag la zha bar gyur/
mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang
pan chen aer te ni'i sku phreng brgyud rim du 'dren pa dang po 'di rje tsong kha pa'i zhal slob dang yab sras gsum gyi ya gyal, dga' ldan khri rabs gsum pa/

t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa 'di rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa khyi lor khams mgar thar du 'khrungs, chu stag lor gser bum dkrugs te t'a la'i bla ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gyis gser khri'i thog tu gdan 'dren zhus, shing yos lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma zhan phung gi bka' 'brel rgyal srid chos srid bzhes, lo de nyid du 'das/
mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dang don gcig
mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho
rtsis rig mkhas pa zhig des rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi lor rtsis gzhung dri med 'od rgyan mdzad, rtse thang bsam gtan gling du thur grib brtags/
mkhas tshul thal ches pa/ mkhas thal shor bas mthar khungs ma 'khyol ba/
min na'ang yin khul:/ mkhas min mkhas mdog ston pa sngo lo 'phyar ba'i rgyu red/
yon tan la mkhas par byed 'dod pa/ yon tan la mkhas 'dod kha sbyang tsam gyis blo skyed mi thon/

1. (tha mi dad pa) rab tu shes pa'am legs par rtogs pa/ bod yig la mkhas pa/ lag rtsal la mkhas shing las ka byed rgyur yid gzhungs pa/ thabs la mkhas shing sgrub phod pa/ 2./ 1) shes rab can/ mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun rig dang, kun shes, go ba can, grangs can, grags pa thob, nyes pa shes, snyan ngag mkhan, brtan po, thos ldan, dam pa, dus yig can, dran pa'i dbang, rnam par dwangs, rnam gsal, pandi ta, spyod ldan, blo gros can, blo ldan, blo bzang, mig can, mdzangs pa, rig ldan, rig pa can, rig pa'i dpa' bo, ring du mthong, shes ldan, shes rab can, sems shes, gsal sgo bcas so, 2) (mngon) gza' lhag pa/ 3. grims po'am grung po/ thabs shes mkhas pa/ lag pa mkhas pa, ..shing bzo ba mkhas pa/ 4. legs par lobs pa dang, byang chub pa'am thub pa/ 'tsho ba skyel mkhas pa/ 'gro gron gtong mkhas pa/ ri mo 'bri mkhas pa/ za mkhas spyod mkhas/
lho brag chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bsdus ming,

si tu'i sum rtags te yul gangs can pa'i brda yang dag par sbyor ba'i bstan bcos kyi bye brag sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i gzhung gi rnam par bshad pa mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan mu tig phreng mdzes zhes pa, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing byi la karma si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sam gtsug lag chos kyi snang bas mdzad pa/
nga ni mkhas pa yin no bsam pa'i khengs pa/

mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i rna rgyan zhes pa, sde pa rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pas rab byung bcu pa'i lcags mo sbrul gyi lo la mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos shig /
'chad pa dang, rtsod pa, rtsom pa gsum mo, yang na, rigs lam la byang ba'i blo, gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len, tshig sbyor la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal te gsum mo/
zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, phung po dang, khams dang, skye mched dang, rten 'brel dang, gnas dang gnas ma yin pa rnams la mkhas pa'o/
byang po'am goms po/ thabs shes mkhas po/ legs par sbyangs na mkhas po yong/ kha mkhas mi mkhas la blta rgyu med, lag pa mkhas mi mkhas la blta dgos/
shes rig can dang, rmongs pa/
yon tan can gyi bud med/

mtshan dngos nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan yin, gu shri bdag nyid chen po'i sras su rab byung lnga pa'i shing sbrul lo la 'khrungs, shing glang lo nas bzung sa skya'i gdan sa lo bcu dgu mdzad, rab byung drug pa'i chu lug lor 'das/
shes bya rig pa'i gnas la ma rmongs pa dang sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims gtsang ba dang, gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa ste gsum/
mkhas shing dpa' ba'am, bzang spyod dang ldan pa/
mkhas pa min bzhin du yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal/
mi mkhas kyang mkhas pa yin snyam pa'i stong bshad/
yon tan la mkhas shing shes rig gsal ba/
/ 1) gdong 'gram g.yas g.yon steng gi mkhur tshos/ 2) 'gram khug /
zas 'gram khug g.yas g.yon phar tshur mi spo ba zhes 'dul ba'i nang du bshad/
'gram pa'i mkhur 'bur/ rab dmar mkhur tshos nyi gzhon 'char kha'i 'od/ ming gi rnam grangs la ko pa dang, mkhur ba'o,
gad mo dgod skabs kyi mkhur tshos kyi rnam 'gyur zhig / mkhur 'dzum byas te skad cha bshad pa/
mkho ba yod tshad/ mkho dgu'i spyad dngos/
mkho chas nyo sgrub/ mkho sgrub las khungs/
nyer mkho'i dngos chas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas mkho chas sgrub pa/
lho brag sa khul du srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa'i yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
1. (tha mi dad pa) dgos pa/ nye bar mkho ba/ shing bzo bar mkho ba'i lag cha/ 2. dgos pa'i don/ mkho che ba/ dgos mkho chung ba/ mkho med rgyu cha/

rab byung gi gos kyi gzhi'i nang gses, yo byad gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, 'tsho ba'i yo byad gang rung gi dbyibs su ma drubs pa'i gos khru gang yan chad tshad ma nges pa mdog dbyibs ma nges pa, rang dang grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa gzhan gnyis ka'i ming gis byin gyis brlabs pa, dar gos snam bu lta bu nor gyi 'du shes dang, zhwa dang ska rags sogs gos kyi 'du shes skye ba'i yo byad dag /
1) mkho ba yod dgu tshang ma/ 2) mkho rgyu'i 'bor tshad/
sems bde bar gnas pa'am lhod phab pa/ mi yul la mkhos phab kyis gzhi chags pa/
blo bag phebs pa/ mkhos phebs kyis gnas pa/ bde sdug 'dra dang mi 'dra ba'i yul de'i skye rgu mkhos mi phebs/
(rnying) don med dam dgos pa chung ba/
blo la 'gro ba'am blo bag phebs pa/ yul lung skyid cing mkhos su 'bab pa zhig tu phyin nas gnas skabs ngal gso ba/
lag pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo srin lag mthe'u chung rnams brtsegs mar byas pa'i steng mthe bong gi ne'u le'i ri mo mngon tsam sbyar ba'i tshad la zer te, de dang sor lnga gzhal ba gnyis don gcig /
(tha dad pa) gsang ba'am sbed pa/ gsang ba'i man ngag mkhyud pa/ dpe mkhyud byed pa/
shin tu zab pa'i man ngag lag len gyi skor rnams gud du sbas pa'i gzhung/
1) sman pa/ 2) rten 'brel gyi bcos ka sna tshogs byed mkhan/
(rnying) gzhan la man ngag bshad dus sbas nas mi shod pa'i cha shas shig /
mkhyen par mdzod dam thugs rjes gzigs zhes re ba zhu ba'i tshig / khyed kyis mkhyen mkhyen/ bdag la rogs ram yod pa mkhyen mkhyen/
shes rgya'am shes tshad/ mkhyen rgya can/
1) shes rab can/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/

1. (tha mi dad pa) shes pa'am rtogs pa'i zhe sa/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa/ gnas lugs zhib cha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pham ji yong gi gnad 'gag mkhyen par gsol/ 2. shes rab/ mkhyen pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ mkhyen pa dang gzigs pa mtha' yas pa/ mkhyen pa yongs su dag pa/ mkhyen pa'i klong du chub pa
ye shes lnga dang don gcig
ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang, ji snyed pa mkhyen pa gnyis so/
khams mkhyen pa dang, rang bzhin mkhyen pa, bsam pa mkhyen pa, bag la nyal mkhyen pa bcas bzhi'o/
sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi nang gses, shes par bya ba'i yul mkhyen pa gsum ste, gzhi shes dang, lam shes dang, rnam mkhyen rnams so/
chos sum cu: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang tshan, mkhyen pa gsum mtshon byed kyi chos sum cu ste, rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu dang, lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig dang, gzhi shes kyi chos dgu bcas sum cu'o/
shes pa'am rtogs pa'i nus pa/
shes rab kyi zhe sa/ shes bya'i gnas kun 'jal ba'i mkhyen dpyod zab cing yangs pa/
blo gros mig gi gzugs su bkod pa/ mkhyen spyan mchog tu yangs pa/
thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang brtse ba'i thugs rje/
shes bya'i gnas rtogs shing khong du chud pa/

rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu lug lor, dwags lha sgam po'i ri zhol du sku 'khrungs, chung dus nas rtse thang lnga mchod grwa tshang du chos zhugs gnang, de nas lha sa lcags po rir gso rig dang dkar rtsis slob sbyong du phebs, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas sman rtsis khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i skabs spyi khyab tu bsko gzhag mdzad pa nas bzung bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang, lhag par sman rtsis gnyis 'phel rgyas gtong phyir sku tshe ril por 'bad brtson gnang ste mkhas pa du ma gso skyong dang 'brel rtsa rgyud sdong 'grems gso rig rgya mtsho'i snying po dang, rtsis gzhung rig ldan snying thig sogs gsung rtsom mang po brtsams, spyi lo 1959 lor bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa'i rjes su mu mthud kyis sman rtsis khang gi yon krang gnang, dgung lo brgyad cur dgongs pa rdzogs/
mkhyen pa gsum dang don gcig
((ghan)) ? mngal lus mkhregs 'gyur te mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga las bzhi pa'i ming/
gyong po'am mkhregs po/ gzugs po mkhrang thang/
/ 1) gyong po'am mi gug pa/ mjing pa mkhrang po/ 2) grims pa/ blo mkhrang po/
1. sra la mkhregs pa/ 2. mkhrang po dang 'dra,
rta dre'u sogs rkang lag gi mkhrig ma man chad spu mdog dkar po can/
lag mgo dang lag ngar gnyis kyi bar du 'brel ba'i tshigs/ lag rtsar lta dus sman pa'i mdzub mos nad pa'i mkhrig ma gnon pa/
snod kyi mkhris thum nang chags pa'i skran nad cig
mi'i mkhris pa dang, dom gyi mkhris pa, bya rgod kyi mkhris pa, nya'i mkhris pa bcas te bzhi'o/
mkhris pa'i nad kyi bsdus tshig
/ 1) nyes pa'i mkhris pa ste lus kyi drod khams kyi cha shas yongs/ 2) snod kyi mkhris pa ste mchin 'dabs kyi mkhris thum/
snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud nas mkhris khu rtsa mig tu byer ba zhig /
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga ste, mkhris pa 'ju byed dang, mdangs bsgyur, sgrub byed, mthong byed, mdog gsal bcas so/
mkhris pa thang las lhag pa
me drod mkhris pa rang gi ldang tshad, skyes pa'i gsang sgro gang dang, bud med la dngos bstan ma gsungs na'ang shud bstan de ltar go dgos pas de las lhag par gyur pa'i don/
snod mkhris kha lud de rtsa mig tu byer nas mig sprin ser por 'gyur ba zhig /
rims nad mkhris par babs pa dang: zas spyod sogs rkyen gzhan gyis snod mkhris rtsar brgyugs nas bzhin mig pags pa rnams ser por 'gyur ba'i nad cig /
snod mkhris kha lud de rtsa mig tu byer nas sha mdog ser por 'gyur ba zhig /
ru thung zur nas mar lag ngar rgyab ngos nas thur du 'gro ba'i rtsa dang po snod mkhris dang 'brel ba'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na mkhris nad yun lon dang, mkhris rims mgo nad sogs la phan/
lus kyi drod khams rgyas pa'i tsha ba'i nad la nyes pa'i mkhris pa dang, mchin 'dabs mkhris thum skyon du gyur pa'i mkhris pa gnyis/
mkhris pa shas che ba'i smyo byed de, nad rtags su sems khro zhing brdeg snying 'dod pa dang, mig dang chu mdog ser zhing mig sngar me dang skar ma mthong snang shar ba zhig /
mkhris pa'i ldang tshad gsang sgro gang yin pas de'i cha shas zad par gyur nas, lus drod nyams shing, pags mdog nag por 'gyur ba'i nad cig /
rims nad mkhris pa la babs pa'i nad de, mgo na ba dang, tsha ba rgyas pa, gshang gci pags mig rnams ser por 'gyur ba zhig /
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs gnyis pa dang bcu pa mkhris pa dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang ste, de la me btsa' bzhag na mkhris pa grang mkhris la phan/
gyong po dang thug na 'jigs nas g.yol: mnyen po dang phrad na brnyas bcos byed pa'i dpe/ gang ltar btsan rgyal ring lugs pa mkhregs 'dred 'bol zug gi spyod ngan byed mkhan zhig red/
gyong po dang, sra ba'am mi zhig pa/ mkhred tshad/ mkhregs shing/ mkhar mkhregs po/ klad rnying mkhregs po/
khros pa dang, sdang ba'i skad cha/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khangs pa, 'khang ba, ,mi dga' ba dang, sdang ba dang, khros pa/ rang gis ma byung bar gzhan la 'khang ba/ rang nyid mun khang du bsdad nas nyi ma'i 'od la 'khang ba/ re 'khang byed pa/
ma rangs pa'am ma mgu ba'i tshig /
khros pa'i nyams dang, ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur
(tha mi dad pa) dran med du brgyal ba/ glo bur 'jigs nas 'khams pa/
'khar ba las bzos pa'i rol mo'i bye brag cig / rnga dang 'khar rnga rdung ba/
'khar ba las bzos pa'i sder ma/ shing tog 'khar sder gang bshams/
li las bzos pa'i phor pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) thogs pa/ gyon pa lcags gzer la 'khar ba/ zas mid par 'khar ba/ 2./ 1) dbyug pa/ sba 'khar/ phyag 'khar/ lag na 'khar ba thogs pa/ lus 'khar ba la brten nas langs dgos pa/ 2) li ste, zangs gtso bor byas pa'i lcags rid 'dres ma zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la zangs skyes dang bsil skyes so,
li las bzos pa'i me long/
li las bzos pa'i gzhong pa/
1) li las bzos pa'i chu blug snod/ 2) 'khar ba dang zangs/

(«khakkhir:») ? rab byung la gnod 'tshe bsrung ba'i phyir du ston pas gnang ba'i sil snyan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'khar ba ste, rgyu lcags dang shing gnyis las grub pa ste, rim pa gsum breng chags su yod pa'i stod smad gnyis lcags dang bar ma shing yin la, stod smad kyi lcags brgyad bzhog byas shing, 'og ma la rgya mdud yod pa, dum bu steng ma la 'khor lo dang lcags kyu yod cing, rwa bzhi'am, gnyis su nges pa, de la sil snyan bcu gnyis, steng dang nang la mchod rten yod pa, rwa'i bar stong pa, rwa'i dpang mtho gang sor bzhi dang rwa man chad lus tshad dang mnyam pa'o/
dge slong gi yo byad 'khar gsil dkrol ba/
rgyu spun 'khal zhing ras snam sod 'thag pa
(tha dad pa) bkal ba, bkal ba, 'khol,, skud pa sgrim pa'am bzo ba/ skud pa bkal te thad btags pa/ bal 'khal ba/
sems rab tu dga' ba'am bya ba zhig byed 'dod nas tshugs dka' ba lta bu'i rnam pa/ khyed mjal 'dod nas nga'i sems 'khal le 'khol le byed kyi 'dug /
mi dga' ba'am phrag dog / the'u rang lhar bsten na 'khu ldog cho 'phrul je cher 'gro
dogs pa'am rnam rtog / bshan pa 'khris su slebs pa mthong yang bshas lug la rang nyid da lta gsod do snyam pa'i 'khu 'phrig gi 'du shes med/
1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) sdang ba dang 'tshe ba dang, snying ring ba dang rgol ba/ dgra la 'khu ba/ mes rgyal la 'khu ba/ 2) (rnying) ldog pa/ 2. ser sna/
1) sdang ba'i bsam pa/ 2) log lta/
khug pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
dbugs 'khun pa'i sgra/ nad med 'khun sgra sgrog pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) nad sogs mi bzod pa'i dbugs sgra 'thon pa/ skad chen sgrog pa g.yag ltar 'khun/ na ste 'khun gyin 'dug / 2) dbugs 'tshang ba/ khur po lci bas dbugs 'khun nas gtam yang 'thon pa dka'/ 3) gre ba nas phug ron gyi skad ltar 'don pa/ 'khun bu, 'khun sgra chung ngu/ 'khun tshig nad dang dka' las ma bzod pa'i gcong skad/ 'khum 'khum, 'jigs pa dang 'khyags pa'i rnam 'gyur/ 'khyags nas gzugs po 'khum 'khum byed pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khums pa, 'khum pa,, 1) tshur 'dus pa'am zhum pa/ lus 'khum pa/ ngag 'khum pa/ yid 'khum pa/ dpa' 'khums pa/ 'gran bsdur byed skabs 'khum tshul rtsa ba nas ma ston/ ko ba ma brgyangs par 'khum pa/ 2) shes pa'am rtogs pa/ sems kyis 'khums pa/ bshad tshul de nga'i sems la 'khums kyang yid brtan mi byed/
'bru rigs kyi phye brdzis nas bsred pa dang btsos pa'i zas dbyibs sgor mo zhig aa mdo'i skad du go re zer/
'khyer byed dam sdom byed kyi thag pa
1. (tha dad pa) khur ba, 'khur ba, khur,, 'khyer ba/ las 'gan khur ba/ khres po rgyab tu khur ba/ 2. bag zan zhig ste yul 'gar go re zer/
theg shugs/ bong bu las g.yag 'khur shed che/
(tha mi dad pa) thul ba/ bong bus g.yag mi 'khul/ g.yog tu mi 'khul ba/ yid 'khul ba/
(rnying) sbas pa/ 'kheng ba, (tha mi dad pa) 'khengs pa, 'kheng ba,, grang ngad kyis 'khyag par 'gyur ba/ mar khu 'khengs pa/
(tha mi dad pa) khel ba, 'khel ba, , 1) thag chod pa/ gtan 'khel ba/ 2) thug pa/ rnag thog gtsag 'khel/ brel ba tsha po'i dus dang stabs khel ba/ 3) yid ches pa/ blo 'khel ba/ gdeng 'khel ba/
rgas pa'am gog pa/ rgas 'khogs/ lus 'khogs te thag ring du 'gro mi thub pa/
dus brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, mi lo bdun cu yan chod du son pa/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) gnas pa/ khri la 'khod pa/ 2) bris nas gsal ba dang, bkod de gsal ba/ gsar 'gyur thog tu 'khod pa/ yig rigs kyi nang du 'khod pa/ 'char gzhir 'khod pa/

sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi rus ming ste, gnam lha'i rgyud pa g.ya' spang skyes kyis srin po skya rengs khrag med btul nas de'i chung ma g.ya' 'brug si le ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras shig 'khrungs pa srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas 'khon zhes grags, de nas bzung gi gdung brgyud la 'khon rigs zer/
sngar bod kyi lo tsa ba skad grags can zhig ste, chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus bod mis rab byung gi bslab sdom srung nus mi nus tshod blta byed mkhan sad mi mi bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /

rab byung dang po'i shing khyi lo la 'khrungs, sku na phra dus yab gcen gnyis las gsang sngags rnying ma'i gdams pa sbyangs shing, phyis 'brog mi lo tsa ba sh'akya ye shes sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams las lam 'bras gtsos pa'i gsang sngags phyi 'gyur rnams la sbyangs, dgung lo bzhi bcu pa rab byung dang po'i chu glang lo la dbon po ri'i sa dkar gyi lod su dgon pa btab pas, de nas bzung sa skya pa zhes grags, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu rta lor 'das/ (gra bo lung)...
'khon 'gras la brten nas byung ba'i grib skyon/
phan tshun 'khon zhing 'gras pa'am, mi dga' bar gyur pa/
bde bar ma thon pa'am ma thar ba dang 'gag pa/ lam bar 'khon thogs byung nas dus su ma slebs/ da res kyi las don nang du 'khon 'khon thogs thogs mang po byung song/
phan tshun 'gras nas zhe sdang ba'i gnod sems/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) 'gras pa/ zhe 'khon pa/ sems rab tu 'khon pa/ don med nga la 'khon mi dgos/ dgra la 'khon pa tsam gyis ci zhig phan/ 2) 'gag pa'am thogs pa/ yas 'khon mas thogs/

mthun pa'i gso sbyong las dus ma nges pa'i gso sbyong gi gras shig ste, dge 'dun dbye ba bsdum pa zhes rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong byed pa'o, de la rtsod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong zhes kyang zer/
'khon nad cher langs pa/ 'gal zla phan tshun 'khon 'bar gyi 'khrug gzhi ha cang che ba/
phan tshun zhe 'gras pa dang, dam sel gang yang med pa/ grong pa khyim mtshes 'khon med dbyen med dam gtsang bkra shis lugs legs sha stag red/

1) 'khon du 'dzin pa ste, sngar byung gnod 'tshe rnams sems kyi gting du 'jog pa/ 2) nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig ste, khong khro ba'i char gtod pa gnod pa'i bsam pa rgyun mi gtong zhing mi bzod par byed pa zhig /
gzhan gnod dam por 'dzin pa'i gting nad/
khro ba'am sdang sems bzod thub pa/
zhe 'gras pa'i lan po/ 'khon lan log thabs byas kyang glan ma thub/
dgra sha/ sdang dgra ma rung ba rnams kyi 'khon sha mthar phyin par glan to/
khon pa'i bsam pa ste, zhe sdang gi bsam blo/ 'khon lha, rang la 'khon du 'dzin pa'i mi min/
1. mtha' dang 'dabs/ yul mtha' 'khob/ 2. (rnying) ngan pa/
(tha mi dad pa) rangs pa/ grang bas lag pa 'khob pa/ lo rgas nas 'khob pa/
lug gi brang 'og sogs las skyes pa'i bal rgyu zhal pa/
1. zheng tshad/ sa 'khobs che ba/ khang pa 'khobs yangs pa/ 2. (rnying) kun la khyab pa/ snyan grags phyogs kun tu 'khobs pa/
/ 1) bran nam, phyi 'brang ngam, ltos bcas gnyen grogs sogs zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan/ g.yog 'khor/ nye 'khor/ bza' tshang 'khor bcas/ gtso 'khor/ dpon 'khor/ 2) 'gram dang 'dabs/ nye 'khor/
rgyu skar gyi mtha' nas 'khor ba'i skar ma yin zhing, spyir rgyu skar las chung la, rang nyid las 'od 'phro rgyu med pa dper na zla ba sa'i go la'i 'khor skar yin pa lta bu/ mis bzos 'khor skar/
1) rgya tshad dam zheng/ 2) rang gnas su slebs kha/
khang pa'i nye skor gyi phyi khyams/
lo'i khyad chos drug myur du 'gro ba dang: gzhan du 'gro ba, ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byed pa, rgyal ba rnal du 'god pa, mtho ba la 'phar ba, dma' ba la 'bab pa/
ba'i rin chen bdun: ral gri rin po che dang, pags pa rin po che po che mal cha rin po che ste bdun/
'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga ste, nga las nu dang, mdzes pa, nye mdzes, mdzes ldan, nye mdzes ldan te lnga/

ston pa sh'akya thub pas gnas wa ra na sir dus chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi nas brtsams te, chos bden pa bzhi'i 'khor lo bskor ba na, thog mar ye shes khong chud kyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom thob pa'i 'khor lnga ste, kun shes koondi na-ya dang, rta thul, rlangs pa, ming chen, bzang ldan rnams so/
'khor dang bcas pa ste, ngo ma rjes 'brang dang bcas pa/
klong 'khor te, chu chen por rlabs sgor mor 'khor ba'i kong dong/
glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun gyi nang tshan zhig
