sgo phyi nang gnyis ka nas dbye ba'i thabs su sgo glegs kyi dkyil du gtan bu btags te 'khor lo bzhin du skor ba'i shing/
1) 'khor lo'i mu khyud/ 2) 'khor ba'i ya mtha' dang ma mtha'/
1) 'jal gsab dka' ba'i byas drin chen po/ 2) 'khor ba rdzogs mtha' med pa/
mgo yu 'khor nas shes pa 'thoms pa/
nye 'dabs/ gangs re chen po'i 'khor 'dabs su mtsho mang po yod/
srid pa 'khor ba dang, zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'o/
'khor ba dang myang 'das gnyis chos nyid bden par med pa'i ngang du dbyer med pa'am mnyam nyid du 'dzin pa/
ston pa'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi ste, khyim pa pho mo gnyis dang, rab tu byung ba pho mo gnyis te, dge slong dang, dge slong ma, dge bsnyen, dge bsnyen ma bcas so/
phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i nang gses shig ste, 'khor sa thob kyi sems dpa' dang rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis bskor ba/

rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi phyed ni skar bcu gsum dang chu tshod sum cu, nyi ma la mtshon na karka ta, sengge, bu mo gsum du rim pa'i snga rkang la ci tsam spyad pa de srang sdig gzhu gsum du rim pa'i phyi rkang la spyad pa des kha bsabs pas nor bu lon kha 'grig ste, rtag pa'i longs spyod la bri gang med par gnas pas, de yan gyi rkang rtsis byed mi dgos pas so/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) bskor nas rgyu ba/ glog 'khor 'di thengs gcig btang nas rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor bzhin 'dug / 'tshub skor 'khor ba/ phar tshur nyo 'tshong gi skor ba 'khor thub pa/ kho rang phyogs la phyin nas phyir 'khor ma byung/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe gang bskyal tshang ma rang gi thog la 'khor 'dug / 2) yeng ba/ ltad mor mgo 'khor nas bsdad pa/ 3) sems nang du dran pa dang 'char ba/ kho mthong ba dang nga'i sems la bsam tshul 'di 'dra zhig 'khor byung/ 4) 'du ba dang chags pa/ lte ba'i mtha' skor du 'khor ba/ ri la ri dwags 'khor dang, chu la nya mo 'khor/ lag par sha yod na nam mkhar bya 'khor yong/ rtswa rtser zil pa 'khor ba/ 2. 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas sam zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngon chad dang, 'jig rten, thun mong chos, sdug bsngal 'byung gnas, ma rig khams, gtsug lag dang po, zhi 'dzin pa, yang srid, srid pa bcas so,
(krakutstshanda:) sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi gras shig /
'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod pa'am dang du len pa/
'khor ba'i skye rgyun chod dus kyi mtha' la slebs pa'i gang zag /

1) dong nang gi nyal nyil thams cad sprugs pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun sel ba'am, yang na sems can thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa 'khor ba las bsgral ba/ 2) spyan ras gzigs kyi bye brag cig /
1) (yul) khyim gsar du 'dzin pa'am 'dzin pa po/ 2) byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'gro ba sgrol slad bsam bzhin du srid par bzung ba/
skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi sdug bsngal/
1) 'jig rten pa'i khyim grong/ 2) (mngon) btsun mo'i pho brang/
cha lnga pa: gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'phyor du bris pa'i dpe ris ltar gyi srid pa 'khor lo/
1) bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ 2) thar pa/
thog mtha' mi mngon pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho/
sngon gyi mtha' mi mngon pa'i nyer len gyi phung bo'i rgyun/
'khor bar 'ching bar byed pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa rnams/
skye rga na 'chi sogs dang tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/
las dang nyon mongs kyi kun 'byung/
'khor ba ni mya ngam gyi thang 'brog dgon pa'i gzugs su bkod pa/
'khor ba btson ra'i gzugs su bkod pa/
srid pa'i rtsa ba drug ste, 'dod chags dang, khong khro, nga rgyal, ma rig pa, lta ba nyon mongs can, the tshom rnams so/
1) ma rig sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ 2) skor bar 'khor ba'i lam ka/ 3) mi dge ba'i bya ba/

nyon mongs pa'i lam dang, las kyi lam, sdug bsngal gyi lam gsum ste nyon mongs par brten nas las byed pa dang, las byas par brten nas sdug bsngal 'byung ba, sdug bsngal la brten nas nyon mongs pa skye zhing rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor ba'i rim pa'o/
thar pa ma thob pa'i skye 'gro rnams/
snye ma rdung byed shing lcug bstar ba 'khor mig can/
kyi dgongs zhu:/ kho las khungs nas 'khor zhag zhus te phyin song/
dge slong pha ma gnyis dang, dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis te bzhi/
gnyen 'khor 'khor pa rnams mthun thabs byed pa/
skor ba thengs gcig 'khor ba'i dus yun/
sgo sge'u khung gi 'khor gtan g.yag shing
khang pa'i mdun phyogs 'khor mor bskor ba'i g.yab/
sgor 'khyil 'khyil/ mi mang po 'khor ro ror 'khrab kyin 'dug /
gnag phyugs mo rigs kyi chags sems langs pa/

/ 1) skor ba 'khor thub pa'i 'phrul chas sgor dbyibs can/ gser gyi 'khor lo/ chu 'khor/ me 'khor/ 2) 'phrul 'khor/ tshem bu'i 'khor lo/ chu tshod 'khor lo/ 3) shing rta/ 'khor lo bkag pa/ lam byang la bzhag nas 'khor lo lho la gtong ba/ 4) gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i yi dam lha'i phyag mtshan zhig ste, dbyibs 'khor lo lta bu, rtsib rim gyi kha phyir gdangs shing mu khyud med pa, rtse mo mchog tu rno zhing rdo rje'i yu ba can zhig / 5) gza' skar sogs so so'i sde'am khongs kyi grangs 'bor te, gza' dang byed pa'i 'khor lo bdun, skar sbyor gnyis ni nyer bdun te, chu tshod chu srang drug cu la, dbugs drug cha shas mang nyung dang, gnas la nges pa med pa yin, rang rang 'khor lo gang longs pa, phud pa'i nor de gong mar bsre, zhes pa ltar ro/ 6) (mngon) rgyu skar gyi go la'i 'khor lo la nyer bdun yod pas grangs nyer bdun mtshon/
1) 'phrul 'khor gtong mkhan/ 2) rlangs 'khor sogs kyi kha sgyur ba
mthun par gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang, skyes bu dam pa la brten pa, smon lam btab pa, bsod nams bsags pa bcas bzhi'o/
rdzogs rim byin rlabs bzhi: lus byin rlabs dang, ngag byin rlabs, yid byin rlabs, de kho na nyid kyi byin rlabs bcas bzhi'o/
1) klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo dang, spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo, bya ba las kyi 'khor lo bcas gsum mo/ 2) chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang don gcig
gza' rnams kyi nyi bar las skyes skar sbyangs tshe ma 'dang na 'khor lo 27 snon dgos, 'dang na snon mi dgos/
rtsibs stong phrag yod pa'i 'khor lo/
rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gras shig /
chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang don gcig
'khor lo rnam gsum dang don gcig
: shing gi phor pa sogs dkrug byed 'khor lo'i rting lcags 'dzugs sa'i shing gru bzhi/
shing gi phor pa sod dkrug byed kyi 'khor lo'i rting pa'i lcags/
dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen dang don gcig
'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses, rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum gyi ya gyal, dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen byung ba phyir bcos ni mchog zung gcig gis 'dum par mdzad pa'o/
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, bla ma rnams la skyel ba dang bsu ba la sogs pas phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa/
(legs) 1) 'khor lo'i ri mo/ 2)'khor lo'i mtha' skor/

mi rnams kyi tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar kho nar 'byung ba ste, gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los gling bzhi'i skye bo la dbang bsgyur ba'i ngang tshul can/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun dbang dang, gnam bskos, ma lus rgyal po, mi yi lha, yang dag rgyal po, lhag pa'i dbang phyug bcas so,
1) gcar sa'am gnas sa/ phru gu 'khor sa pha ma yin, ri dwags 'khor sa dben sa yin/ 2) kha gtad yul/ kha 'khor sa nyi ma, rgyab 'khor sa lhags pa/
rang 'khor du 'gro yul gyi gtso sems yod pa ste, sems byung rnams so/
gtso sems las byung zhing sems kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'am rjes su 'gro ba'i yid shes/

1) mtshon cha mda' gri mdung gsum/ sked par 'khor gsum btags nas g.yul sar chas/ 2) 'khor lo gsum/ 'khor gsum rkang 'khor/ 3) byed pa po dang, bya ba'i las, bya ba'i yul te gsum/ sbyin pa gtong skabs kyi 'khor gsum ni sbyin pa po dang, sbyin rdzas, sbyin yul te gsum/ 4) mtshan nyid rtsod skabs kyi 'khor gsum ste rtags bsal khyab gsum/ 5) lus ngag yid kyi las gsum/
'dul ba'i brda chad cig ste, gos kyi rgyu lte ba'i 'khor lo dang pus mo gnyis kyi 'khor lo khebs thub pa'i tshad du longs pa'o/
sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong skabs las su bya ba dang: byed pa po, bya ba'i rang bzhin te 'khor gsum la mi dmigs pa'i rgyas btab pa/

mi rtog pa: chos kun la dngos po dang byed po bya yul gsum la 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba ste, dper na sbyin pa gtong ba po dang, gtang rgyu'i rgyu nor, gtong yul slong ba po bcas phyogs gsum ga rang bzhin du ma grub par shes pa'i shes rab bo/
'bab chu zhig chu 'go bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gam pa rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod, smad rgyud la g.yas ru gtsang po zer, mthar bum chu dang 'dres te bal yul du 'bab/

1. (tha dad pa) bkol ba, bkol ba, khol, ,skul ba dang bed spyod pa/ bran du bkol ba/ las su 'khol ba/ rta drel bkol spyod kyis skyel 'dren byed pa/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) khol ba, 'khol ba,, 1) chu sogs bskol te gdus pa/ ja bskol nas khol ba/ sman khol ba/ chu 'khol la khad pa/ 2) dul ba dang, thul ba'am 'khul ba/ ji ltar bkol ba ltar 'khol ba/ btsan shugs kyis las su bskul kyang ma 'khol/
'byor pa dang 'jon stangs/ mi so so'i 'khos ka drag zhan sna tshogs yong/ las ka byed skabs rang la 'khos ka nges can zhig dgos/ 'khos kas shig mi zin rung, byang 'brong gshor ba'i gros byed/
'khos kas lcogs tshod/ phyi nang gang sar 'khos lcogs kyi las kar 'bad 'bungs zhu mus red/
nus stobs dang bstun pa/ kho rang 'khos bstun gyi las ka gang shes gang lcogs lag len byed sgang red/
la gzhigs pa:/ so so'i 'khos dpag gi las 'gan 'khur rgyu/
stobs nus kyi rang bzhin nam tshul/ rang gi 'khos bab dang mtshungs pa'i las khur len bzhin du yod/
(rnying) rang gnas su 'jog pa'am logs su 'jog pa/
kyag kyog / 'khyag 'khyog gi lam 'dzeg rgyur ma skrag na yang rtser slebs thub
shwa lam zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spo mes rdzong khongs su yod/
1) grang ba'i skabs/ 2) (mngon) dgun kha'i ming/
grang ngad ma bzod par 'dar ba/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyags pa, 'khyag pa,, grang bar 'gyur ba/ lus 'khyags nas 'dar ba/ 'khyags ltogs gnyis mnar/
/ 1) grang mo'am bsil po/ da nang gnam gshis 'khyag po zhig byung/ 2) sran bzod pa'am khur theg po/ ha cang sdug rus 'khyag po/
'khyag tshul lam grang bar 'gyur tshul/ gzugs po 'khyag lhang lhang byas byung/
ha cang grang bas ser ga gas pa/
chu sogs grang ngad kyis gong bur gyur pa/
grang ngar ma bzod par shi ba/ 'khyags grir thebs pa/
'khyag yong bsam pa'i dogs pa/ dgun lhags pa langs dus 'khyags dogs byas/
drod kyis gnod mi tshugs pa'i sa dong/
'khyags pa gong bur 'dril ba'i sdong po lta bu/

1. 'khyag pa'i 'das pa, 2.chab rom/ 'khyags sob/ gtsang por 'khyags pa brgyab pa'i steng du mi phyugs phar tshur 'gro thub/ 'khyags pa zhu nas dpyid dpal rgyas/ 'khyags pa sil sil chags pa'i chu 'bogs pa/
'o ma bskol ba sogs grang nas chags pa'i kha spris/ 'o ma'i 'khyags spris/ sha khu'i 'khyags spris
chu sogs la chags pa'i 'khyags pa'am dar
grang ngad kyis thon pa'i thor pa sib sib cig
'khyags te skyes pa'i 'brum bu lta bu/
grang drags nas gzugs dang rma sogs la byung ba'i skrang sbos/
ha cang grang mor gyur nas lus tshor nyams pa/ dgun dus phyugs ra med na phyugs rnams 'khyags sbrebs su 'chor nyen yod/
lus 'khyags pa dang grod pa ltogs pa/
lus 'khyags nas yan lag sogs brkyang bskum mi thub pa/
'khyags bag gam dar/ 'khyags rom cung tsam zhu ba/
'khyags nas rengs pa/ rkang lag la 'khyags hrengs thebs nas brkyang bskum mi thub/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyams pa, 'khyam pa, 'khyoms,, yul phyogs gang zhig tu dgos don med par nyul 'gro ba/ mun nag gi nang du 'khyam dus srin 'bu me khyer zhig mthong yang dga' snang skye ba/
/ 1) gnas nges med du 'khyam mkhan/ 2) gnyan nad rigs bco brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig ste, nad rtags su ske dang, lkog ma, mjing pa'i ldebs sogs la sgo nga 'dra ba'i skrangs 'bur 'byung ba zhig /
yang nas yang du 'khyams 'gro ba/ mi 'ga' zhig khyim la sdod mi tshugs par phyi rol du nyin ltar 'khyams 'khyams pa/
gnas nges med du 'gro skyod/ yul gzhan la 'khyams nyul du song/
lus tshugs mi brtan pa'i gom 'gros/ gom stabs 'khyar 'khyor du 'gro ba/
yan po'am khungs dang rten gzhi med pa/ khyi 'khyar/ mi 'khyar/ yi ge 'khyar po/ skad cha 'khyar po/
(tha mi dad pa) kha 'thor ba'am ya gyar ba/ yul gzhan du 'khyar ba/ phyogs kun tu 'khyar ba/
thog mar kha che dang, bru sha, zhang zhung sogs su dar zhing, de nas gri gum btsan po'i rjes su bod phyogs la mched pa'i bon zhig /
don med pa dang, 'brel ba med pa/ ngag 'khyal/ don med gtam 'khyal/
(tha mi dad pa) 'chal ba'am yan pa/ spyod tshul ngan par 'khyal ba/ dran shes yan por 'khyal ba/
don med ngag kyal gyi tshig /
(tha dad pa) bkyigs pa, bkyig pa, khyigs,, 'ching ba/ rkang lag bkyigs pa/
'od skor te nyi 'od dam zla 'od sprin rim la phog tshe tshur ldog nas 'phros pa'i 'od skor/ nyi 'khyims/ zla 'khyims/ 'ja'i 'od 'khyims/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khor ba/ gdugs 'khyir ba/ klad pa gzi yom 'khyir ba/ 'khyil chu, 1) rdzing chu dang, ko mog gi chu/ 'khyil chu yur bar 'dren/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'bri ru rdzong gi lho rgyud kyi 'bab chu zhig yin zhing, de'i chu 'go gnyan chen thang lha'i ri rgyud kyi byang ngos nas byung ste dpal 'bar rdzong khongs sa steng gi nye 'dabs su rgyal mo rngul chu'i nang du 'bab/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) 'du ba/ 'od du 'khyil ba/ rdzing bu'i nang du chu 'khyil 'dug / 2) 'khyil ler 'khor ba/ sgor mor 'khyil nas nyal ba/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ sbrul 'khyil ba/ 2. lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig
mgyogs po'i rnam 'gyur/ chu la nya mo bde 'khyug 'khyug tu 'gro/
lus mnyen pa'am lus rtsal che ba/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyugs pa, 'khyug pa,, myur ba'am skyen pa/ 'brug sgra ldir zhing glog 'od 'khyug pa/ nya mo chu'i nang du 'khyug cing 'gro/
/ 1) myur po'am skyen po/ phru gu bde cag 'khyug po/ las don la 'khyug cing blo rig grim po/ 2) spyan bsal lam 'gro khungs zab po/ mig lam du 'khyug po 'dug / 'khyug byed, (mngon) me lce/
bod yig dbu med tshugs thung chung ba/
zhabs bro shin tu mgyogs la gzhas kyang shin tu mgyogs pa'i glu gar gnyis kyi rnam pa zhig /
dbu med 'bri tshul mgyogs shos kyi yig: gzugs
myur du 'khyug pa:/ mun pa'i smag rum khrod du glog dmar 'khyugs se 'khyug /
1) mdza' bshes dga' sdug ches pa'i rnam 'gyur/ 2) 'khrig spyod/
(mngon) skyes ma thag pa dang nu zho 'thung mkhan phru gu/
ma ning gi byed brag cig /
(tha dad pa) 1) 'thams pa'am 'khril ba/ bu phrug dga' nas aa ma la 'khyud pa/ 2) 'khrig pa'am sbyor ba/ 3) sol du 'khyud gsum gyi 'khyud ni da lta ba, dper na tshes 'khyud zla skar/
chung ma min pa'i mdza' mo/
(tha mi dad pa) 'pho ba/ las 'gan 'khyur ba/
(tha mi dad pa) 'bros pa/ zhed nas 'khyus pa/ ri bong ltar 'khyug por 'khyus pa/
'jon stangs sam rgyu nor gyi 'khos ka/ 'khyer 'khos la gzhigs nas 'tsho ba skyel ba/ mi tshang gi 'khyer 'khos/

(tha dad pa) khyer ba, 'khyer ba, khyer,/ khyed kyis lag tu 'khyer ba de ci yin,/ dpe cha khyer shog / 'khyer rgyu grib nag dang, gzhag rgyu rkang rjes/ ston thog sad kyis khyer song/ sa zhing dang khang pa bcas tshang ma chu smyon gyis khyer ba/
'khos zhan te dpal 'byor gyis dbul ba'i mi/ dpal 'byor 'khyer dman/ mi ser 'khyer dman/
1) sems kyi bsam stangs sam dran stangs/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so rnam par dag pa/ sems kyi 'khyer so ngan pa/ 2) rnam 'gyur/ lus kyi 'khyer so mdzes pa/
kyog kyog / zam shing 'khyog 'khyog btang na zam sked ldem ldem zhig las mi yong
kyog ge ba'am drang po min pa/ thig shing 'khyog ge bas thig btab na drang po mi yong/
(mngon) 1) 'bab chu/ 2) sbrul/ 3) me/ 4) gza' spen pa/
1) gza' lnga'i 'gro lugs/ 2) sbrul gyi 'gro tshul/
gza' rnams rim min snga rkang dang po'i sa nas dal ba'i rjes zin nas kha nub tu phyogs te dal ba las phyir 'khyog por nub tu rgyu ba/
1) snyan ngag gi rgyan rang bzhin brjod pa ma yin pa'i rgyan rnams/ 2) gtam kyog kyog bshad pa'am drang po min pa'i skad cha bshad pa/
'khyog po ldem ldem/ 'khyog ldem yal ga'i lcug phran rlung gis g.yo/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khyogs pa, 'khyog pa,, yo ba/ lus 'khyogs nas sdod pa/ 'khyog tsam/ 'gro stangs phar tshur 'khyogs nas song ba/ g.yas mda' la ma 'khyogs pa dang, g.yon gzhu la ma 'khyogs pa byed dgos/
drang po min pa'am kyog po/ shing sdong 'khyog po/ lam 'khyog po/ ka ba 'khyog por btsugs na gdung ma 'degs thub mi yong/
gtam drang po min pa'am kyog kyog /
gtam kyog por bshad pa/ 'phros gtam 'khyog bshad byas nas gzhan la mgo skor btang ba/ dngos yod gnas lugs la 'khyog bshad ched du byed pa/ 'khyog bshad ched byed kyis mi kha 'gog thabs byed pa/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyongs pa, 'khyong ba,, mu mthud pa'am 'khyol ba/ chu tshod gcig kyang rgyun 'khyong thub pa mi 'dug / nyin 'khyong thub tsam byung/ las ka mthar 'khyongs song/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khyoms pa, 'khyom pa,, 1) 'khrugs pa/ klad pa 'khyoms pa/ 2) g.yo ba/ ri 'gul mtsho 'khyoms/ chu'i kha 'khyoms pa/ shing sdong gi yal ga rlung gis g.yo zhing 'khyoms/ me sgyogs ldir sgras sa chen 'khyoms/
rang sor ma gnas pa'i 'dres lhad/ bsgyur yig rnams la rang bzo'i tshig gi 'khyor mang po zhugs 'dug pas yid ches rgyu mi 'dug /
mi 'os pa'i khral rigs btsan 'gel/ dpya khral sna tshogs 'khyor 'gel gyi brdab gsig gtong ba/
g.yas g.yon du yo nas 'gro ba/
/ 1) 'gro po/ dpe cha skyor dus ngag la 'khyor po rang byung ma song/ 2) yo ba/ long ba ra bzi'i 'gro stangs 'khyor po yin/
(tha mi dad pa) brtan por tshugs mi thub pa/ lus 'khar rgyug la brten te 'khyor bzhin du 'gro ba/
lus rang tshugs mi thub par 'khyor ba'i nyams/ nga gzugs khams zhan rung de ring 'khyor ro ro la yong ba yin/
(tha mi dad pa) mthar phyin pa/ nyams len mthar 'khyol ba/ las ka khungs 'khyol ba/ rang gnas su 'khyol ba/ las mtha' 'khyol ba/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khras pa, 'khra ba,, 1) chags pa dang, au tshugs kyis bsdad nas gzhan du mi 'gro ba/ 'khras bsdad/ bya rigs nags la 'khra ba/ 'phyi ba tshang khung du 'khras pa/ 'khras nas kha gyes mi nus pa/ 2) yib pa'am gab pa/ dben sar 'khras pa/
(tha dad pa) 'khrabs pa, 'khrab pa, 'khrobs,, bro rdung ba/ zhabs bro 'khrabs te gzhas gtong ba/ khrang zhi 'khrab pa/ zlos gar 'khrab pa/ dga' spro chen pos rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed pa/
'khrab bya'i zlos gar gyi nang don dpe cha/
'khrab sa'i ra ba/ 'khrab ra'i sdings cha/
khral dang las 'gan 'khri ba de sgrub pa/
las 'gan/ rang rang gi mjing thog tu bab pa'i 'khri cha gang yin yar rlangs mar thigs ma shor bar sgrub dgos/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'khris pa, 'khri ba,, rang gi mgo thog tu 'bab pa/ 'khri khungs/ las 'gan 'khris pa/ khral rigs 'khri ba/ jus khag 'khri ba/ 2. zhen chags sam chags pa/ rang don gyi 'khri ba/ zhen 'khri/
bud med kyi mngal du phru gu chags pa'i dus su 'byung ba'i nad/
khral rigs gang bab pa'i 'bor grangs/ rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi 'khri 'bab che ba/

1) shing rang nyid kyi sdong po gcig pur drang por tshugs ma zin pa gzhan la 'khril nas skye ba dbyi mong dang, ba le ka lta bu la zer ro/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun nas 'khyud, gu ge, lcug phran, lcug ma, yal ga'i ral ba bcas so, 2) 'om bu/
brten sa'i yul/ phru gu'i 'khri sa pha ma red/ zhing pa'i 'khri sa zhing red/
khyim bcu gnyis kyi khyim gsum pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar bzhi dang chu tshod sum cu shar ba'i tshe nyi ma 'khrig khyim la slebs pas lho gling shar ma'i dbus dbyar nyi ldog 'char/
'khrig spyod 'dod pa'i sems, ..mo phyugs rnams 'khrig chags 'dod pa
/ 1) pho mo bar gyi chags spyod dam mi tshangs pa'i spyod pa/ 2) (mngon) 'khrig pa spyod pa la pho mo gnyis dgos pas grangs gnyis mtshon/ 2.
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, sems can la chags pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma lnga'i nang gses, chags sems kyis kun nas bslangs te bud med la 'khrig tshig sogs btsog gtam sna tshogs rjen par smra ba'o/
(tha mi dad pa) 'thibs pa/ nam mkhar sprin pa 'khrigs 'dug / du ba khang pa'i nang la 'khrigs bzhin 'dug
rta drel sogs khrid sar de tsam mi 'ong ba/

(tha dad pa) khrid pa, 'khrid pa, khrid,, 1) sna 'dren pa/ yur chu 'khrid pa/ rta tshur khrid shog / las sar 'khrid pa/ phru gu khrid nas phyin song/ char sne rlung 'khrid/ mgo skor btang nas khrid pa/ bu khrid/ 2) slob ston pa/ dpe cha 'khrid pa/ sman rig 'khrid pa/ slob phrug 'khrid pa/ lam bzang gi thog tu khrid/ 'go khrid pa/ 'khrims pa, byer ba dang, zhed pa, skrag pa/
mchor sgeg dang ldan pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur zhig / sgeg mo 'khril ldem can/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyud pa/ shing tsan dan la sbrul 'khril ba/ gos mtha' rkang par 'khril ba/
mnyen zhing bab chags pa/ rgyan gos gang bzhes sku gzugs la 'khril bag chags pa/
gzhan la 'khril te skye ba'i shing/
mar bshal ba dang yar skyug pa
pho ba'i me drod zhan pas kha zas ma zhu ba dang, mkhris pa snod lhung sogs kyis thur du bshal ba'i nad/ khog pa 'khru nad 'khrus pa
1. (tha mi dad pa) 'khrus pa, 'khru ba,, bshal ba/ grod khog 'khru ba/ 2. bshal ba'i nad/ sman btungs te 'khru ba gcod thabs byed pa/ 'khru ba 'byams pa/
grod khog bshal thabs byed pa/
grod khog bshal ba'i nad gzhi/
zing 'khrug gi rgyu rkyen/ sngar yod mi mthun pa'i khar 'khrug rkyen gsar du slong ba/
sngar dmag 'khrug rgyag dus gyon rgyu'i go khrab sogs/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'khrugs pa, 'khrug pa,, 1) go rim 'tshol ba'am nor ba/ dpe cha'i shog grangs snga phyi 'khrugs pa/ 2) sems mi bde bar gyur pa/ sems 'khrugs pa/ 3) 'thab pa/ phyogs gnyis 'khrugs pa/ dmag 'khrug pa/ 2. 'thab rtsod/ kha rtsod lag rdeg gi 'khrug pa shor ba/
zang nge zing ngi'am mi dga' ba'i sems/
'khrug slong gi bya ba/ mthun sgril bshig rkyen gyi 'khrug sbyor ched bzos byed pa/
zang ngi zing ngir 'gyur ba'i tshul/ dmag gi 'khrug zing/ rtsod gleng gi 'khrug zing/
legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed go rim rnying pa de 'khrugs nas gsar du bsgrigs pa'i yig star/
sde snod khag tu kha thor ba'i gzhung don rnams btus nas gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rtsom yig ste mdo sde rgyan nam bslab btus lta bu'o/
tsha ba sogs kyis gzugs po'i khams 'khrugs pa'i rims tshad/
go rim 'dzings pa/ bya rim 'khrugs 'dzings byung na las ka yag po 'grub mi thub/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khrungs pa, 'khrung ba,, skye ba'i zhe sa/ sku 'khrungs nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu tsam song/ thugs la rnam rtog 'khrungs pa/
skye dus kyi tshes grangs gang yin la 'khel ba'i skar ma/
skyes rabs rnam thar kyi zhe sa ste skyes rabs kyi lo rgyus/
mi su zhig thog mar skye skabs tshes grangs la 'khel ba'i skar lha dang, skye yul gyi gzhi bdag la zer/
(tha dad pa) bkrus pa, bkru ba, khrus,, chus dag par byed pa/ ras chur bkrus nas dreg pa dag song/
dbye ba'am thag / bden rdzun gang yin 'khrun gtsang mar 'byed pa/
dbye ba'am thag chod pa/ phyogs gnyis kyi rtsod pa 'khrun chod byung ba/
sogs kyi mtshams:/ lo rgyus thog gi 'khrun thag ma bcad pa rnams gcod par byed pa/ bzang ngan dbye ba'i 'khrun thag bcad pa/

'khrul shes skyed byed kyi rgyu'am rkyen te, bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs chos kyi tshul ci bzhin mi shes pa'i rmongs pa phugs kyi 'khrul rgyu dang, dbang po bslad pa sogs 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu rnams so/

'khrul shes skye ba'i rgyu rnam pa bzhi ste, gnas la yod pa, grur zhugs pa'i dbang gis ljon shing 'gro snang gi shes pa lta bu dang, rten la yod pa, mig dbang la rab rib nad byung ba'i dbang gis skra shad 'dzag par snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu, yul la yod pa, mgal me myur du bskor ba'i dbang gis 'khro lor snang ba'i shes pa lta bu, de ma thag rkyen la yod pa, zhe sdang drag pos yid shes 'khrul ba'i blo lta bu'o/
don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i nyams snang/ ma yin yin par 'char ba'i 'khrul snang / 'khrul snang bden 'dzin/ 'khrul snang zang zing/

1. (tha mi dad pa) nor ba'am 'dzol ba/ sems 'khrul te skad cha gang byung bshad pa/ don ma 'khrul bar gyis shig / snang ba 'khrul ba/ blo 'khrul nas mi dran pa/ 2. rang gi snang yul la 'khrul ba'i rig pa, dper na, dung ser snang dang, rtog pa'i snang yul lta bu med pa la yod pa dang min pa la yin par snang ba'o/ rig pa bsgrims nas 'khrul ba zlog pa/ 'khrul ba rim gyis nyung du phyin pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la nor ba dang, 'phyugs pa, 'dzol ba, log shes bcas so,

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, nyan thos la sogs pa ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas las su byed pa la 'khrul ba 'byung gi, sangs rgyas la de lta bu mi mnga' bas so/
skyon bton lo 'pho dang don gcig
'khrul snang ma lus zhig pa'am yal ba ste stong nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag /
'du shes 'khrul ba'i sems te, don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i mthong tshul dang bsam tshul/
1) 'khrul sa'am 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen/ 2) ltar snang 'khrul ba/
lha srung sogs kyis sems 'phreng ba'i 'khu ldog byed pa'i mtshan ma/
(rnying) zhen pa'am chags pa/ chags pa'i yul la 'khren pa/ pha ma la sems 'khren pa/ zas la 'khren pa/
sems rengs po ste sems bcos dka' ba/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khrebs pa, 'khreb pa,, sems rgyud rengs pa/ rta rgod ma btul bas 'khreb pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 'khrogs pa, 'khrog pa,, 1) tshigs 'chus pa/ rgan mo pus tshigs 'khrogs kyang 'gro snying 'dod/ 2) khog nang nas skad sgrog pa/ grang bas khog pa 'khrog pa/ grod pa sbos te 'khrogs pa/ 3) 'on pa/ aa mchog 'khrog tsam zhig 'dug /
1) dngos po'i lhag lus/ 2) dgongs pa ster ba'am gnang ba khrol ba/ rang yul gnyen 'phrad du phyin chog pa'i 'khrol cha gnang ba/
kha gsang po'am rnam 'gyur 'jam po ste sgam po min pa/ gleng gtam 'khrol po 'dug / kha gshis 'khrol po/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) grol ba/ dgongs pa 'khrol song/ 2) rol mo rang bzhin gyis 'khrol ba/

bod yig gsal byed gsum pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mgrin pa dang, byed pa mgrin pa, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa nang phrad dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1. 1) ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2) sngon 'jug gi ma ning yi ge zhig / 3) rjes 'jug gi pho yig cig / 4) rtags mtshungs 'dren skabs rjes 'jug mo yig gis drangs pa'i ming gi cha shas shig / thang ga/ gsum ga / 2. gang/ des ga la 'grig / khyed ga nas yong ba yin/ ga ru 'gro/ mi ga tshod yod/ kho rang gis ga la shes/
mdo khams kyi yul gru 'gar ka dang ga gnyis kyi sgra gdangs gcig tu 'bod pas ga yig gsal bar ston byed kyi tshig cig / ga/ ka ga/ ka... ga/
sngar zhing 'brog gi sgo phyugs che chung gang yod sa nas lo nges can re'i mtshams dngul khral bsdu srol zhig /
g.ya' sgog pa ste dbus skad du ai tsi lu gu zer/
(yul) gang zhig gam ga re zer ba'i dri tshig / 'di min na ga gi red khyod kyis ston rogs/
yul ma nges pa'am ming ma gsal ba zhig ste gang zhig dang don gcig / yul ga ge mo/ las khungs ga ge mo/ las don ga ge mo/
1) nyung ma'am yung ma/ 2) zha nye/
1) lhu 'grig pa/ lhug lag che chung tshang ma ga 'grig pa/ 2) mgo thug pa'am ra 'phrod pa/ bshad lugs ga 'grig pa/
phan tshun 'grig pa dang, mgo thug pa'am ra 'phrod pa/ kha bshad lag len ga rgyag pa/ byung song gi rtsis grangs ga rgyag pa/
phar tshur go brjes 'gebs sbyor/ zog rin 'bru 'bab sprod dgos rnams dngul rkyang sprod rgyu'i ga bsgyur btang ba/ 'bru dngul phar tshur go brjes ga bsgyur btang nas gtsang dag sprad zin/
yi thang chad pa'am 'u thug pa,..bye ma'i khang bu rdib gyur na, byis pa rnams ni ga chad ngu/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo nad dang, rims tshad, cham tshad kyi gre ba 'gag pa bcas la phan/
srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan, sha ba dang, kha sha, bse ru gsum gyi rwa'o/
gang 'dra'am, ci 'dra/ thon rdzas spus ka ga 'dra 'dug /
ga kha bsum dang don gcig
sngar dngos su bgrangs pa de las lhag pa da dung bgrang rgyu yod pa/ da dung de yis ga na tshad/
(yul) 1) khengs skyung gi tshig / ga nas ga nas dpe srid pas/ 2) yong bzo med pa'i tshig / de 'dra ga nas ga nas, khos shes kyi ma red/
(yul) gnas sam, yul ma nges pa'i gnas tshul dri tshig / khyod kyis slob gnyer byed par ga pa ga par phyin pa yin/
phyin ci log pa:/ skad cha bden rdzun ga phyi ga log shod pa/ las ka dkar nag ga phyi ga log byed pa/
pha ba dgo dgo'i ming gi rnam grangs

(legs) lus rgyas sam rab bsil te rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ro bska la tsha, zhu rjes shin tu bsil, nus pas rgyas tshad gsod, rnying tshad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha ba'i phye ma dang, kha ba'i ming can, rdul gyi snying po, nus ldan, sprin gyi snying po, zla ba seng ge'i 'o ma, zla ba'i thal ba, zla ba'i ming can, 'od dkar can, ro'i ge sar, shing gi snying po bcas so,

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo tshad dang, rims tshad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyi dug pa dang, khyi dug spyang brgyal, sngon mo cham 'dren, cham pa lam ldog seng ge sbar rgyab bcas so,

ri phag gi brun rdza ma'i bum pa lta bur blugs la kha 'dag pas bkag nas du ba ma shor ba mer bsregs pa'i thal ba ste, nus pas mkhris pa grang mkhris dang, mkhris skran, gnyan rims, rims nad pho bar bab pa sogs la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la gar nag dang, phag thal, phag brun bcas so,
kanda ka ri dkar smug gnyis kyi nang tshan, smug po'i ming gzhan zhig /
ci tsam/ dus yun ga tsam 'gor yong ngam/ 'bor grangs ga tsam longs yod dam/ 'gro lam ring thung ga tsam yod/
(yul) gang 'dra'am ji ltar/ da ga tsug byed dgos sam/
ji tsam dang, mang nyung dri ba'i tshig / khyed rang dgung lo ga tshod yin/ tshogs 'dur 'gro mkhan mi ga tshod yod/
(legs) glang po'i so ste glang po che'i mche ba, nus pas gdon nad dang, 'go ba'i rims nad srung/
mgo ma thug pa/ phar sprod tshur len gyi rtsis grangs ga 'dzol ba/
'phya lad kyi gad mo/ drang gtam bshad par gzhan gyis ga zha byas kyang skyon ci yod/ mi rnams kyis ga zha byed par mi 'dzem pa/ mi mang po'i dbus su sma 'bebs kyi ga zha sgrog pa/
ga khral bsdu rgyu'i g.yag lug dkar nag gi grangs tho/
sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos shig /

1) gang dang ci'i don/ las don ga re byed kyi yod/ khos las don ga re bsgrubs 'dug / 2) kun slong 'dren pa'am bsam blo gtong ba'am the tshom za ba'i tshig grogs shig / ga re ngas glo bur du yod la mi dran/ ga re de ring las gal che ba zhig byed dgos/ ga re mi de'i ming la ci zer/ 3) (rnying) 1, byin cig / 2, gar song ba dang, gang du yod pa/

1) gang du/ khyod ga la 'gro/ 2) ci la/ lcags dngul du ga la 'gyur/ nor 'khrul ma byung ba tsam las byas rjes ga la yin/ rang gi 'os 'gan bsgrub rgyu hur brtson mi byed ga la rung/ ngan pa'i bsam don 'grub pa ga la srid/ de lta'i yul ring po ga la thogs/ chu mig rang nyid ma skam na, sa yis mnan kyang ga la thub/ dka' ba'i las shig ma brgyud na, zhim po'i zas shig ga la rag /
gnas sam, yul ma nges pa'i gnas tshul dri tshig / yul ga la ga lar thon khungs 'bol ba 'dug gam/
yul phyogs gang zhig gam, gang du yod pa zhig / 'gro sa'i phyogs ga la ba der su 'gro/ khyod sdod sa ga la ba der nga 'ong ngo/
lhod lhod dam, dal bu/ ga le phebs/ ga le bzhugs/
dal po dal po/ ga le ga ler phyin na rgan mos rgya nag 'khor yong/
shugs med pa'i dal mo/ ga le gu le'i ngang nas nam zla 'phro brlag gtong ba/
/ mi la ga log byed pa/
phrag pa nas mchan khung phan tshun du bsnol mar 'ching ba'i thag pa/ 'dogs khyi la ga sha g.yogs pa/
phrag pa nas mchan 'og tu 'ching ba'i me tog sogs kyi rgyan cha/ me tog gi ga shal/ rin chen ga shal/ rin po che'i ga shal gyis mdzes pa/
yul nges med/ da lta nga yul ga shed cig la 'gro dgos/ dpe cha de ngas ga shed cig la bzhag yod/ kho ga shed du song ba mi shes/ sdug bsngal bsal ba'i rgyu ga shed na myur du tshol cig /
(rnying) kha rdung btang ba'am, kha zer ba/
sa phyogs nges med kun/ sa phyogs ga sa ga la dril bsgrags byed du phyin/ ga slog phyin ci slog pa/ las ka byed stangs ga slog tu gyur na don mi 'grub/
rnying) 1) 'bod pa'i sgra zhig / 2) spyi sgra gang
1) las su mi rung ba'am, lus zor lci ba/ gag ge gog ge'i lus de 'gro mi bde/ 2) gog ste 'gro ba byis pa'i 'gro tshul/ byis pa chung chung de gag ge gog ge byas nas thag ring du phyin song/
gag ge gog ge'i bsdus tshig

/ 1) gnyan nad lce'i steng du babs nas lce skrangs shing skad 'gag pa zhig ste, nang gses su dbye na pho gag dang, mo gag bu gag gnyan gag bcas rigs bzhi mchis/ 2) bya gag pa ste, mchu leb la rkang pa thung ba, sder mo skyi mos sbrel cing chur rkyal mkhas pa'i bya'i rigs shig yin pa 'di la khyim bya dang ri bya gnyis yod/
gag tshil sgog pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, skyi g.ya' bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas dge slong la g.ya sgog pa/
gag pas lce steng thor pa thon pa dang, lce 'og skrangs pa gshag byed kyi yo byad cig /
lce la babs te gre ba 'gag pa gag pa'i nad: dang sha la babs te thor pa 'byung ba lhog pa'i nad dang gnyis kyi bsdus ming/

1./ 1) spyi sgra dngos la 'jug pa'i spyi sgra gang/ yon tan gang goms pa rnams bed spyod byas pa/ sems la gang dran bshad pa/ 'bras bu gang 'dod byung ba/ dngos po che chung gang na ci yod/ thabs shes gang nas kyang dmigs yul legs sgrub byed pa/ rang 'dod gang bsam zol med du zhu ba/ gang dga' gang skyid/ bsam 'char gang dran dran bshad pa yin/ dus yun gang thung thung du btang ba/ sang zhogs

nas 'gro dgos:/ 'brel lam gang 'grig 'grig byed pa/ rogs ram gang thub thub byas pa/ 2) bye brag la 'jug pa'i spyi sgra gang/ gang la snying stobs mchog mnga' ba/ byas rjes 'jog mkhan gang zhig / bum pa gang zhig / gang nyid kyi bka' slob/ 3) dri ba'i don du 'jug pa'i spyi sgra gang/ las don gang yin/ mi gang dang su yin pa/ dpe cha gang du gsal ba/ khyed rang sa phyogs gang nas phebs pa yin/ 2. grangs gcig / rgya ma gang/ dkar yol gang/ gom pa gang/
thams cad dam tshang ma/ khong tsho gang ga phebs bzhag / (mngon) 1) gzhon nu gdong drug / 2) gser/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug tshad dang, rma tshad, tsha 'khru, tsha bas skrangs pa sogs 'joms par byed/
(mngon) 1) rgya mtsho/ 2) lha dbang phyug chen po/
gang ga'i klung gi bye ma'ang zer, chu bo gang ga zhes par yod pa'i bye ma ji snyed kyi grangs 'bor te sngar rgya gar lugs kyi grangs gnas chen po zhig ste ha cang mang ba'i dpe/
mgyogs gang thub/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba khag gang mgyogs ci mgyogs kyis byed pa/
spyi sgra zhig ste gang dang don gcig
snga ma su yin gyi dri tshig / bya ba rnams gang snga bsgrub dgos/
gang mgyogs mgyogs/ sang nyin gang snga snga phebs rogs gnang/
yongs rdzogs sam tshang ma/ las don gang ci/ gang ci'i lag 'dzangs/ gang ci 'dor med/ gang ci'i thad nas yar rgyas byung 'dug / gnas tshul gang cir lta rtog byas nas 'char gzhi 'ding ba/
khyed rang/ gang nyid sku khams bde thang yin shag /
gang yin yang ngam ga re yin na'ang/ gang ltar de 'dra byas na 'grig gi ma red/
'phel 'grib/ dbyar gyi gtsang po gang stong 'phel 'grib mang/ zla ba zla rer gang stong thengs re byed/
ci nus ci lcogs sam, gang thub thub/
ji ltar nus nus/ nus shugs yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis las don gang thub ci thub byed pa/
gang byung byung/ skad cha gng thon thon bshad na mi 'grog /
/ 'di rnams gang dag khyed rang tsho'i red/
spyi sgra gnyis brtsegs/ yul gang dang gang du skad cha gang dang gang bshad pa/
de'i don te spyi sgra bye brag la 'jug pa/ nga'i dpe cha gang de'i rgyab sha dmar po yin/ mi gang de'i bsam blo 'khor stangs yag po red/
1) ci legs legs dang gang bzang bzang/ mi dmangs la phan 'dogs gang drag ci drag byed pa/ 2) 'u thug pa'i gdung tshig / khyod rang la dka' tshegs de 'dra byung ba da gang drag ci drag /
snang bar ci shar thams cad lag len bstar ba/
ji 'dra'am, ga 'dra/ tshig 'di'i don gang 'dra red/
1) gang du yod pa/ khyed rang bzhugs yul gang na ba der ngas bcar yong/ 2) ga re na ba/

dang rtsol bstun thob sprod: spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang mi so so'i 'tsho ba'i rgyu chas bgo bsha' rgyag stangs kyi rtsa don zhig rtsa don des ngal rtsol pa rnams kyis rang nus gang yod kyis spyi tshogs kyi ched du ngal rtsol byed dgos pa'i blang bya dang spyi tshogs kyis ngal rtsol pa so sos bton pa'i ngal rtsol gyi grangs tshad dang spus tshad ltar 'tsho ba'i rgyu chas sprod dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod pa red/
1) ril po'am cha tshang/ mi tshe gang po/ lo gang po/ 2) (poorna:) nyan thos nye 'khor bcu'i nang gses, chos ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'o/
slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma gang spel gyis brtsams pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa/
(tha mi dad pa) khengs pa ste, cha tshang bar 'gyur ba'am tshad long bar 'gyur ba/ khang pa'i nang mis gang 'dug / bum pa chus gang ba/ zla ba nya gang ba/ lung pa gang ba/
gnod sbyin zhig ste, rnam thos kyi bu zhig
tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang ba/
/ 1) me tog kha ma bye ba'i the'u/ me tog la gang bu thon pa/ 2) 'brus khengs pa'i shun lpags sbubs mo/ sran mar gang bu thon pa/ til gyi gang bu/ gang bu can gyi 'bru/
1) gang ltar/ skad cha mang po 'dug kyang, gang byas ngas ni shod rgyu ma byung/ 2) byas pa tshang ma/
1) thob tshad tshang ma/ go skabs gang byung ba tshang ma bed spyod byas pa/ 2) ci'ang rung ba/ lto gos gang bung na yang 'grig /
1) byung tshad dam tshang ma/ 2) gang rung rung/ 3) lag tu gang thebs thebs/
ma brtags gang dran gyi bya ba/ las don gang byung mang byung byas pa/ skad cha gang byung mang byung bshad/

1) kha nas gang thon shod pa/ 2) byung lugs ji bzhin drang por smra ba/ gang mang gis zhi ba 'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gyi gras, mngon sum brgyad kyi sgo nas rtsod pa zhi bar ma nus na, tshul shing brims te gang mang ba'i phyogs la dag pa byin te zhi bar byed pa'o
ha las pa/ las ka gang min tshad yag po byas 'dug / gang min tshad tshabs chen red/ de 'dra yin na gang min tshad yag po red/
thal cha med pa'i 'tshams po'am, gnyis mthar ma lhung ba'i 'tshams po/
spyi sgra zhig / bya ba gang zhig / las don che chung gang zhig sgrub kyang do do brtan brtan byas nas sgrub dgos/ .gang zhig yid la byed pa/

ci red zer na/ de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ mig gi rnam par shes pa gang zhe na/ gang zag (pungala:) gdags gzhi phung po lnga po gang rung la brten nas btags pa'i mi'am, skyes bu'am, sems can gang de'i rgyud la skyon yon gnyis ka re zhig gang ba dang, re zhig zag pa ste 'jig par 'gyur ba'i ming/ gang zag gis gang zag la tshod 'dzin ma byed/ gang zag ma brtags par gtam bcol ma byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba dang, skyes bu, mthong ba po, bdag byed du 'jug pa po, byed pa po, tshor ba po, za ba po, shed bdag shed las skyes, shes pa po, sems can, srog slong ba po, gso ba bcas so,
phung po lnga ste, gzugs dang, tshor ba, 'du shes, 'du byed, rnam shes bcas so/
gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du grub pa/
bdag med gnyis kyi ya gyal, rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung po bden par ma grub pa'o/
bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi ya gyal, gdags gzhi rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung po la brten nas nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'o/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses, dus dang dus ma yin pa bsdus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi ste, gang zag gis ltung ba bcabs ma bcabs kyi rnam dbye ston pa la gang zag gi ming gis btags pa'o/ zag kha cig la bsngags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ga' zhig des chog par 'dzin pa'i gang zag kha cig gi ngor smad pa lta bu'o

sngar dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang, pan chen bi ma yi tra gnyis kyis slob ma rnams la nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi man ngag dngos su gsungs te rim gyis byung ba'i brgyud pa de'o/

dbyar gnas kyi sbyor ba'i cho ga zhig ste, thog mar gnas mal stobs pa'i ched du, khyad chos bcu ldan gyi dge slong gcig gam gnyis gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis gnas mal stoms pa'i gang zag tu bskos te, sbyor ba tshul shing nye bar bzhag pa dang, khrims kyi bya ba brjod pa gsol ba'i las byang, tshul shing 'grim pa sogs byas te, dngos gzhi'i gnas gtsug lag khang dang, shing drung sogs su khri dang stan dang gos la sogs pa'i gnas mal rnams rgan rim bzhin du bstabs, mjug tu gnas mal la gding ba rnam par dag pas bskyabs nas longs spyod pa'i tshul brjod pa bcas so/
mun pa nas mun par 'gro ba, mun pa nas snang bar 'gro ba, snang ba nas mun par 'gro ba, snang ba nas snang bar 'gro ba ste, bzhi/
mi rton pa bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa can yin na rigs rus snyan grangs mnga' thang sogs ji star che na'ang nye bar mi brten pa'o/
lo tsam/ ca lag 'di gang yag yag 'dug / las ka byed stangs gang yag yag 'dug /

ci yang ngam, gcig kyang/ mthun rkyen gang yang tshang ba/ nad rims na tsha gang yang med pa/ mi gang yang rung ba zhig / rgyu rkyen gang yang rung ba gcig ma tshang na 'bras bu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba/
1) gang 'dra'am ci 'dra yin/ 2) yin pa thams cad/

1) tshad 'dzin rgyu med pa/ skad cha gang yin 'di yin med pa ma shod/ 2) ha las pa/ rta 'di'i 'gros yag pa la gang yin 'di yin mi 'dug / 3) cho med pa/ las ka 'di cho med gang yin 'di yin med pa zhig byas 'dug /
1) yod tshad tshang ma'am ji snyed/ nus shugs gang yod/ bsam 'char gang yod bshad zin/ 2) ci zhig yod dam ga re yod/ las don gang yod na'ang byed dgos/
ci rigs/ bzhon pa rta drel gang rung yod na 'grig / rtags gang rung gcig la ma grub pa/
1) gang byung byung/ lag cha gang rung rung zhig 'khyer yong na mi 'grig / 2) gang 'os 'os/ da res kyi dngul lhag 'di gang rung rung du spyad chog /
gang la gang 'os sam gang la ci 'os kyang zer, yul gang la dngos po'am bya ba gang ran pa/
yul gang la de dang rigs mtshungs pa/ mi so lo'i gnas tshul gang la de 'tshams kyis go sgrig byed pa/
sems ldan sems med bye brag par sbyor rgyu'i spyi ming/ yul gang la la zhig tu 'gro dgos/ mi gang la la/
gang bzang pa/ skad cha gang legs pa zhig bshad 'dug / gang legs gang bzab/
phan thogs pa ci yin/ dngos po de tsho'i nang nas khyod rang gang lo ba zhig 'doms/
cha thams cad dang, phyogs tshang ma dang, sgo kun/ yul lung gang sa gang la skor g.yeng du phyin pa, sa phyogs gang sa gang la 'gro myong/
phyogs thams cad/ mthun rkyen gang sa ci thad nas 'dzoms 'dug /
kha ba/ gangs nyil ba/ gangs bshangs pa/ gangs sim sim bab pa/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khang thog dang, nye skor du bab pa'i gangs rnams 'phyag skyel chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
1) gangs ri/ gangs dkar seng ge'i g.yu ral la, khyi nag dom bu'i rnga mas 'gran/ 2) gangs ri zhig si khron zhing chen khong dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dar mdo rdzong na yod/
1) srid pa'i gangs ri/ 2) nyin grangs mang por bab tshan che ba'i kha ba/
1) kha ba yod pa'i yul lung/ gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan/ yul gangs can gyi skad/ gangs can ljongs/
pa mi gsum: tshig la mkhas pa sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan don la mkhas pa bu ston rin chen grub, tshig don gnyis kar mkhas pa rje btsun blo bzang grags pa bcas gsum mo/
1) gangs dang char pa'i bsdus ming/ 2) gangs ma char/ dgun dpyid la gangs char bu yug 'tshubs pa yong,..
gangs zhu nas byung ba'i chu/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khang thog 'khyil ba'i gangs chu phyi logs su gsho 'don chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/

bod kyi ri rgyud chen po zhig ste, de'i gtso bo'i ri rtse mtho shos gnas re khyad 'phags can gangs rin po che zhes grags par rnam kun nas rang rgyal dang, phyi rgyal khongs chos dad can gyi mi tshos phyag skor mjal mchod sogs byed par ma zad, lhag par rta lo nam shar la mjal mi mang du 'dus nas phyag mchod dus ston shin tu tshan che ba byed yul zhig / ming gi rnams grangs la ke la sha'i rgyal po dang, gang ga'i yab, gangs ri'i bu, dbyig gi lte ba bcas so, gangs ltongs, gangs ri'i la nyag gi ltongs ka/
rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil nus pas rus chag gso, mchin tshad sel/
kha ba chen po bab pa/ 'brog khul du gangs thibs brgyab na nor phyugs la god nyen che/
kha ba sib sib/ da nang lnga dro ri mgor gangs thul skya chags pa zhig bab 'dug / sbrang bu lding ba bzhin du gangs thul si li si li 'bab kyin 'dug /
jo mo glang ma ri'i ming gzhan zhig
gangs ri'i mdog gam mdog dkar po
1) gangs ri nas gangs nyil ba/ 2) gangs chen po bab pa/
(mngon) 1) gangs ri/ 2) bod yul/ 3) shu dag dkar po/

srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la chung zad skyur, zhu rjes drod, nus pas ro tsa bar byed, khu stobs 'phel, mkhal ma'i drod skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la gangs da byid dang, stobs skyed, stobs ldan mu tig gos can, sha'i rgyal po rnams so,
kha ba dang char pa 'dres ma/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khong mtsho nub sog rigs bod rigs ha sag rigs rang skyong khul gyi then chun rdzong gi gangs ri zhig / gangs zhod, gangs 'bab pa/
1) gangs lhags 'tshub pa/ 2) gangs nyil ba/
kha ba'i ri/ gangs ri lhun chags can/ mtha' bzhir gangs ri chen pos bskor/ ming gi rnam grangs la kee la sha dang, kha ba'i rdul brtsegs, kha ba'i ri, sa 'dzin dkar po bcas so,
ri rgyud cig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spo yul dang me tog rjong bar du yod/
gangs ri la gnas pa'i sde
phal chen sde pa lnga'i nang gses shig /

gangs te se'i ri rgyud kyi rtse gtso bo de yin zhing, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spu hreng rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod, mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 6656 yod, lha dbang phyug chen po'i gnas ri yin yang zer/
1) gangs kyi ri gseb/ 2) bod yul/
kha ba'i ri rgyud/ gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i zhing khams/
gangs ri nas gangs nyil ba/
gangs kyi dkyil du shur rer rgyug pa/
gangs ri'i gseng ngam, bar gseb/
kha rlung ste bu yug gi 'tshub ma/ gangs lhags 'tshub pa'i mtshan mo/ lam bar du gangs lhags drag po ldang byung/
byi dor/ sdod khang gi phyi nang tshang mar gad brgyab zin/
g.yangs sa/ g.yas phyogs gad ka dang, g.yon phyogs g.yang/
gad 'og g.yab phub pa ltar yod sa/
gad pa'i phug gting ring can/
gad mo'i skad kyi nga ro/
gad mo bgad pa'i skad sgra/
gad bdar ma byas gong nas gtor ba'i chu/
gad brgyab pa'i thal rdul nyal nyil/ gad snyigs spungs pa rnams/ gad snyigs 'phyags nas bor ba/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khyim nang gad snyigs phyi logs su 'don skyel chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
byi dor/ khang par nyin ltar gad bdar rgyag dgos pa bzhin du rang gi bsam pa la'ang rtag par brtag dpyad byed bdgos/ gad bdar ma byas par gtsang sbra gang nas yong/
/ 1) gad bdar byed mkhan nam gad rgyag mkhan/ 2) gad ka/
gad pa'i khug gam gad khung

bzhad gad/ gad mo bro ba/ gad mo slong ba/ gad mo 'byin du 'jug pa/ gad mo khra khra shor ba/ gad mo dbang med du shor ba/ kha ther ther byas nas gad mo dgod pa/ gzhan gyis gad mo rta gad ltar dgod pa mthong dus rang yang gad mo 'chor grabs byed pa
'bru rigs la sa rdo gzha' phu sogs med pa'i spus gtsang/ nas sran gad gtsang byas te mdzod du bcug /
gad brgyab pa'i thal rdul nyal nyil/
rang dbang med par rgyun mthud kyis 'chor ba'i gad mo/ kha shob tsha pos dgod bro'i btam bshad pas mi tshang ma gad srin langs nas grod pa na dgos pa byung/
nye ba'am drung/ nga'i gan du shog / gsang rgya/
lus kyi mdun nam, kha gnam la bstan pa/ lus gan rkyal du nyal ba/ thal mo gan rkyal du bstan pa/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba/ bu chung thang la gan rkyal log pa yar bslangs/
kha dan gyi yi ge/ gan rgya 'jog pa/ gan rgya 'dra gnyis/
gnydzira'i zur chag ste, gtsug lag khang sogs kyi thog steng du 'dzugs rgyu'i rgyan cha'i rigs shig /
gan de rdung byed kyi shing dbyug /
gan rgya len pa'am gan rgya blangs nas thag gcod byed pa/
(yul) gal lde ste snod phad mgo sbrel zhig /
(rnying) gan rkyal dang kha sbub gnyis/
gan rkyal dang kha sbub kyi bsdus tshig /
1) rtags thel bzhag pa'i kha dan yi ge bsdus pa/ 2) gan rgya dang 'dzin yig /
gan rgya dang 'dzin thung yi ge gcig gis 'thus pa/
1) gan rgya'i yi ge/ 2) gan rgya dang yig rigs gzhan dag /

gan di rdung byed kyi shing zhig ste rgyu tsan dan dang, bil ba sogs gandir rdung ba'i shing de nyid las byas pa, tshad gandi la 'phog pa'i tshad la sor bcu gnyis, lag pas gzung bar bya ba'i 'chang gzung la yang tshad de nyid dang ldan pa, rtse mo gnyis ne'u le'i mgo bzhin du yod pa'o/
1) gan rgya/ 2) gan rgya 'bri sa'i shog bu/
(legs) dri bzang ste, sngo sman gyi rigs shig ro kha la mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas skran nad dang, dreg nad, cham pa, dug nad, bad kan skya bo bcas la phan/

dge 'dun bsdu ba'i brda sprod byed kyi yo byad cig ste, 'dul ba las bshad pa'i tshad ldan gyi gandi ni, rgyu tsan dan dang, bil ba dang, pa l'a sha dang, tsan dan dmar po dang, star bu dang, 'o se la sogs pas, tshad dbyibs srid du sor brgyad cu 'rtsa bzhi, zheng du sor drug dpangs su sor gnyis, zur bzhir brgyad bzhogs sor gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa, rtse mo gnyis sbal ba'i mgo 'dra ba'o/
1. (tha mi dad pa) gab pa, gab pa, gob,, yib pa/ gab dmag / gab 'dzul/ gab yib/ byi'u shing lo'i 'og tu gab pa/ 'phyi ba tshang du gab pa/ 2. cha mnyam pa/ chu zheng gab pa/
srong btsan sgam pos rang gi tsha bo mang srong mang btsan la gnang ba'i zhal gdams kyi ming/
dgongs pa bkrol ba'am, sbas don gsal bar bshad pa/
1) za ma tog gam, snod/ 2) 'byung rtsis kyi khram kha/
bad rlung gnyis kyi 'og tu gab pa'i tsha ba'i ming/

rtsed mo sogs kyi mdun sar bzhad gad slong ba'i ched dang gab tshig shes pa rnams nang phan tshun gsang gtam tshig tu smra ba dang, rang dang mi mthun pa'i pha rol po rnams mgo bo rmongs par byed pa'i phyir du gab bya sna tshogs la gab byed sna tshogs sbyar te ston pa'i rgyan zhig
gsang ba'i yi ge:/ gab yig rgya dam yod pa zhig bskur/
gab res yib res kyang zer, byis pa'i rtsed mo'i gras shig ste, gcig gab nas gzhan dag gis 'tshol ba/

1. nye 'gram mam drung/ sku'i gam du su ci'ang med/ 2. 1) ming mtha' ga'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / ga/ sang nyin dgong dag gam, gnangs nyin zhogs par 'phebs pa khyad med/ 2) ming mtha' ga'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / ga/ chu khol ma 'dug gam, mi 'dug / sku gzugs bde po 'dug gam.
gam car mkhan sde che chung
sku'i drung du sdod pa'i mkhan chen dang mkhan chung ste, t'a la'i bla ma'i gsol dpon dang, gzim dpon, mchod dpon sogs/
sku gam mam nye 'gram du sdod mi/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi steng chen rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud na yod cing, 'di'i lho ngos 'bras ljongs dang sa 'brel yin, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de gam pa zhol du yod/
bod rang skyong ljong gong dkar rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
gyi nye logs rtswa kha legs po yod pa'i: 'brog sa
tshag rgyag skabs lcags sogs kyi ngos su gug thig 'bri byed kyi lag cha zhig /
bod ljongs gam pa sa khul nas thon pa'i gdan rum/
/ 1) lha sku 'jog sa'i ze'u lha khang/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha sbyar dang za ma tog go ,2) pho mo'i rgyan zhig / skra'i ga'u, ..ske'i ga'u
steng 'og gam, rgyab mdun kha sbyar gyi snod sgrom mam par bu/

las ka'i go rim gyi sgrig stangs 'dra ba/

sngar bod kyi lha lcam gyi gzab spros ske rgyan bye brag cig gser gyis bzos pa'i ga'u che ba gcig dang chung ba gnyis kyi bar la g.yu dang mu tig sogs skud par brgyus nas brang khar 'dogs shing, gong gi chung ba gnyis nu ma'i steng dang, 'og gi che ba de sked par slebs pa zhig yod/
lus dang rkang lag rol sgeg gi rnam 'gyur/ zlos gar/ glu gar/ gar gyi ltad mo/
1) gar 'khrab mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la gar pa dang, zlos gar mkhan, rol sgeg ma, rol rtsed ma bcas so, 2) (mngon) rma bya/
1) gar 'khrab mkhan bud med/ 2) (mngon) ldong ros/

sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, gar 'khrab skabs kyi rnam 'gyur la sgeg pa dang, dpa' ba, mi sdug pa ni lus kyi nyams gsum, drag shul dang, bzhad gad, 'jigs rung ni ngag gi nyams gsum, snying rje dang, rngam pa, zhi ba ni yid kyi nyams gsum/
gar gyi cha byad dgu dang don gcig
t'a la'i bla ma'i gar pas gtong ba'i glu/
dge tshul gyi spang bya blangs 'das so gsum gyi nang gses, rtsed mo'i rigs byed glu dang, gar dang, rol mo ste gsum mo/
sngar dgos gal gar byung la skul 'ded byed: rgyu'i dmigs su bkar ba'i khral pa tsho chung zhig /
1) gar rtsed kyi 'gro stangs/ 2) bang rtsal myur 'gros/
1) zlos gar gyi yo spyad rgyan cha/ 2) (mngon) ba bla/
1) lus sgeg 'gying gi nyams ldan pa'i gar/ 2) gar dang 'cham gnyis/
gar gyi stangs stabs sam gar 'khrab stangs/ gar stabs ling ling bsgyur/
gar ni 'bag dang 'cham gos gyon nas 'cham rgyag pa dang, thig ni dkyil 'khor 'bri ba, dbyangs ni ngag nas gyer ba'i gdangs rnams so/
gang byung byung/ khe nyen bsam blo ma btang bar las ka gar thod thod ma byed/
phag pa'i skyag pa me la bsregs pa'i thal ba

/ 1) sla po min pa/ chang gar po/ ja gar po/ thug pa gar po/ gar tshad/ gar sla 'tshams po/ 2) gyong po/ glags mi rnyed pa'i mi gar po zhig / 3) gzhi chen po/ rtsod pa gar po/ kha mchu gar po/

sa gnas srid gzhung gi gar 'khrab mkhan phru: gu
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs gar phrug bsdu ba'i khral/
'gro gnas sdod gnas nges med gang du 'khel 'khel/
/ 1) gong bu'am gcig tu 'gril ba'i rdog po/ lcags kyi gar bu/ 2) (mngon) lcags/ 3) (rnying) lce/

gar 'khrab mkhan dang rol cha gtong mkhan/
che yul gyi mi rigs tu ru ka'i nang gses yan: lag cig yin zhing dus rabs bcu gcig par de'i rgyal po zhig gis lha bla ma ye shes 'od bkrongs pa
mthe bong dang mdzub mo'i bar gyi sha/
gar phyin mi shes pa/ phru gu gar song cha med du gyur pa/
gar ba dang sla ba'i bsdus ming/ rtsam thug gar sla 'tshams po zhig 'thung ba/ thang sman gar sla ran po sbyor dgos/

/ 1) rgya'am, rnyi/ 2) gnad 'gag gam rtsa ba/ gal chen du 'dzin pa/ las don gyi gal che chung la gzhigs nas snga rting gi go rim sgrig pa/ rtsag rtsig gal chung ba'i gras la ha cang lta dgos don mi 'dug / da res gal che la thug stabs mi zhu ka med byung/

gam snying po:/ rtag tu slob sbyong bya rgyu ni gal 'gag che ba zhig red/
rtsa 'gangs/ don gnad gal 'gangs che rigs tsam du ma zad, gal 'gangs chung ba'i skor la'ang gzab nan byed dgos/

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor gnyis pa'i skabs su thob pa'i sa gsum pa ste, sbyor lam du mthong lam don gyi 'od gsal la sgrib pa'i mngon rgyu'i bag chags thams cad sbyong bas gal chen sbyong ba'i sa zhes bya'o/
re lde las bzos pa'i rgyags chas blug snod cig /
re lde las bzos pa'i rgyags phye blug snod mgo sbrel/ dpe re bshad na don re yod, dpe don gal ta mgo sbrel yin/

brtag pa mtha' bzung gi sgra'am ma nges pa brtag pa'i tshig phrad cig / tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs byed dgos pa las, gal te mi gcig gis de ltar ma byas na las don la 'thus shor yong/ khyod kyis gal te byed ma thub na ngas rogs zhu chog /
1) sun 'byin pa/ 2) khas len pa/ 3) don dam por 'dzin pa/
gnad 'gag gam snying po/ rgyal pham dbye 'byed kyi gal mdo/ tsha grang nad kyi gal mdo/
don gyi snying po bsdus pa/ gnad don gal bsdoms smras na tshig tshogs nyung/
rtsa 'gangs chen po/ gal po che la nan tan dang dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar/
1) rngon pa/ 2) (rnying) dgag pa rgyag pa/ gal 'dzin pa las rgyal ba/

the tshom gyi tshig gam brtag pa'i tshig / drang bden gyi bya gzhag la gal srid 'phral du rgyal kha ma thob kyang, mthar de ltar 'thob rgyu nges can yin/ khang pa'i nang du gal srid sdod mkhan gzhan med na'ang, khang pa srung mkhan gcig yod pa thag chod/ gal srid brgya tham pa med kyang, dgu bcu tham pa tan tan yod/
ser ka'i gas srubs/ sgo'i gas kha nas yar bltas pa/
dang chag grum:/ dkar yol gas chag can/
tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'gas pa'i 'das pa,
ser ga,/ dkar yol de tsho'i nang nas gas srubs med pa zhig 'doms shog / rtsig pa der gas srubs chen po byung 'dug /
ming mtha' ga dang, nga gnyis kyi rjes su sbyor ba'i 'brel sgra'i rkyen zhig / ga nga...ri 'og gi klung thang/ khang steng gi dar cha/
bod yig gi dbyangs dang po mtshon byed/

1) mi dang, glang chen, sgo phyugs che gras sogs kyi nang khrol du nad gzhi'i rkyen gyis chags pa'i rdo lta bu dang, gzhan yang sa dang rdo las gyur pa'i sman nus ldan zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la glang chen mkhris pa, glang chen rtsi, dud 'gro'i me, sa gas, sing ka la bcas so, 2) ba lang gi bcud de rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ro kha la bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad dang, rims tshad, mchin tshad, snod tshad sogs sel/ ..
lha'i 'khor ram pho nya ste gar 'cham 'khrab skabs lag par rnge'u bzung nas mchong bzhin du 'khrab pa'i keng rus gzugs can zhig / ging pho/ ging mo/

1) (rgya) spar kha brgyad kyi gras shig / gin ri bo/ 2) ga nga'i mthar sbyar rgyu bzhin zhes pa dang gcig pa'i da lta ba'i las ston byed kyi phrad cig / ga nga...bzhin...zhing khar chu gtong gin yod/ mi de tsho da lta yong gin 'dug /
'brel sgra gi zhes pa'i sgra'i sbyor tshul dang mthun pa'i byed sgra'i rkyen zhig...gi/ bdag gis bsam blo ma btang ba min/ khong gis zhib 'jug gnang song/ dar dmar rlung gis bskyod/

1) nang ngam, yul/ bsam ngan de 'dra yid kyi gu la'ang dran ma myong/ 2) rgya khyon/ sa cha gu yangs po la khang pa gu dog po 'dug / 3) chung ngu mtshon byed kyi ming grogs shig / khyi gu/ tha gu/ thi gu/ gri gu/ 4) smon tshig gi kha skong/ bsam don 'grub par gyur cig gu/
rdo rtsi btang ba'i lcags kyi yo byad rigs/

(legs) gdon 'joms te shing gi tshi ba'i rigs shig ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas klu gdon dang, lhog pa, gnyan gzer, rma nad bcas 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la ljon pa'i bcud dang, 'dre 'jigs thang chu, 'dre bdud klu dug 'dre gsod bgegs skrod, rdzas kyi phyag rdor, gza' gsod gza' dug gsod byed spyang nag bcas so,
'dre 'jigs shing gi thang chu nag po/

1) bod rang skyong ljongs khongs rtsa mda' rdzong gi sa cha zhig ming rnying par zhang zhung zer, glang dar ma'i rabs bzhi pa lde gtsug mgon gyis yul 'di skyong myong bas gu ge rgyal rabs zer zhing, ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su'ang bsdad yod, de'i rjes shul rtsa mda' rdzong du yod/ 2) shing lcug chung ba/
dbus gtsang chos sde chen po rnams su stod mnga' ris gu ge nas yong ba'i grwa rgyun 'du sa'i khams tshan zhig / ..
rgya khyon cher med pa'am, bar stong chung chung/ lam ga gu dog po/
slob dpon padma drag po'i skur bzhengs pa'i rnam pa
bzang po bskyangs te, bod du phebs myong ba'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon pa la rnam gsum zhes pa'i gras shig /
bag yangs dang, rgya khyon chen po'am bar stong chen po/ sems gu yangs po/ sa cha gu yangs po/
(legs) 1) bla ma'am dge rgan/ 2) ljid pa/
rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprel la 'khrungs, rab byung lnga pa'i chu bya lor 'das, rnying ma'i gter ston grags can zhig / (1212-1273)...
gu ru sh'akya sengge, gu ru padma sambha, gu ru nyi ma 'od zer, gu ru sengge sgra sgrog gu ru rdo rje gro lod, gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje, gu ru padma rgyal po, gu ru blo ldan mchog sred de brgyad/
(sog) mkhas pa dang, lo tsa ba..
(sog) 1) mkhas pa'i dbang po ste, sngar sog po'i go thob cig / 2) gu shr'i bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi ming/
1) (rgya) go thob kyi ming zhig / 2) (legs) yon tan dpal/

sngar aa mdo sog rigs tsho ba ho shod kyi 'go dpon zhig yin pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug lo dpung tshogs dang bcas pa bod du 'byor, chu rta lo pan chen sku phreng bzhi pa dang, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa rnam gnyis dang lhan cig tu da lta'i grong khyer hren dbyang zhes par man ju'i rgyal po tshang dang 'brel lam 'debs ched du sku tshab btang, chu lug lo t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga par bkur bzos kyis chos srid gnyis ldan dga' ldan pho brang gsar du btsugs te gong ma'i bka' 'brel bod kyi rgyal po mdzad, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing rta lo lha sar 'das/ (1582-1654)/ (1640)...(1642)... ..(1643)...
gu shri bsod nams grags pa

phag gru sde srid khri rabs bzhi pa 'di rab byung drug pa'i sa phag lo la 'khrungs, rab byung drug pa'i lcags bya lo nas shing glang lo'i bar lo bzhi srid bskyangs, rtse thang gi tshogs pa lo bcu gsum bskyangs, gdan sa mthil gyi spyan snga lo bcu dgu mdzad, t'a ming hung 'u rgyal pos kva din gu shr'i'i go sa gnang, rab byung bdun pa'i sa byi lo la 'das/ (1359-1408)...1381-1385...
zhabs kyu gnyis kyi ming:/ gi gu/ zhabs kyu
gug ni gi gu zhabs kyu gnyis dang, kyed ni 'greng bu na ro gnyis/ gi gu zhabs kyu...'greng bu na ro
du gug tshul:/ sked pa gug gug / stod gug gug /
gug gug / rnga mong ske gug ge bar 'gro/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyogs pa'am thur du dud pa/ shing gi yal ga gug pa/ rgad po'i gzugs gug pa/ dud 'gro'i lus gug pa/ ne tso'i mchu gug pa/
gug gug / dbyug pa gug po/ gri gug /
dngul mgar gyis bu ga 'bigs byed kyi lag cha zhig
sngar gu ge lung par dar ba'i nya ga zhig / gser gug srang sum brgya/

/ 1) (rgya) sngar rgya nag gong ma'i skabs kyi go sa zhig / 2) dkyil te, dgung yang snang/ nyin gung/ mtshan gung/ 3) srog chags kyi rigs stag dang dbyibs cha tsam 'dra zhing, spu ris nar mo dang sgor mo gnyis 'dres pa'i gcan gzan zhig ste, de'i sha yis smyo byed kyi nad dang, 'byung gdon gyi nad la phan/ gung lpags/ dpa' bo'i rkyen du gung dang stag / 4) snga phyi'i rim pa/ bshad tshul mi 'dra ba rnams gung bsgrigs pa/

'byor med gral rim gyi srid tang zhig dang, 'byor med gral rim gyi gdong len ru khag cig 'byor med gral rim gyi gral rim rtsa 'dzugs kyi rnam pa mtho shos shig bcas yin zhing, tang de'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni mar khe si le nyin ring lugs yin, de'i dmigs yul ni 'byor med gral rim dang de min gnya' gnon myong mkhan ngal rtsol mi dmangs mtha' dag gi 'go khrid byas te gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod la brten nas srid dbang len pa dang 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin gyis 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi tshab byed pa'i sgo nas spyi tshogs ring lugs dang gung khran ring lugs mngon du 'gyur ba byed rgyu de yin/

mi'i rigs kyi phugs bsam dang mthun shos kyi spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs shig yin, de 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dus rim gnyis su phye ste, dus rim dma' ba ni spyi tshod ring lugs dang, dus rim mtho ba ni gung khran ring lugs yin, dus rgyun du bshad pa'i gung khran ring lugs ni gung khran ring lugs kyi dus rim mtho ba der zer, dus rim de'i ring la thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba dang, spyi tshogs kyi thon rdzas ches phun sum tshod pa byung ba, mi rnams la bsam pa'i go rtogs mthon po dang ldan pa, ngal rtsol bya rgyu de 'tsho ba'i nang la med du mi rung bar gyur pa, khyad par chen po gsum rtsa med du gyur pa, gung khran ring lugs kyi spyi la dbang ba'i lam lugs lag tu len pa, bgo bsha'i rtsa don ni gang nus de sgrub dang mkho bstun thob sprod bya rgyu de yin/
gral lam go rim 'grig par byas pa/
nyin mo thun bzhir dbye ba'i thun gsum pa'o/
mthe bong dang gung mo brkyangs te tshad pa'i mtho/
1) blon po gtso bo'am nang blon/ 2) gung dang bka' blon gyi bsdus tshig /
/ 1) dkyil mdzub/ 2) gzig 'dra ba'i gcan gzan rigs shig /
1) nyin gung dus mtshams/ 2) nyin gung skabs kyi bza' btung/
nyin gung ngam nam gung yol ba'i dus/

sngar bod rgyal zhig ste, srong btsan sgam po'i sras su ming gzhan gung srong gung rtsan nam, gung srong gung btsan yang zer rgyal po 'di dgung lo bcu gsum gyi dus su srong btsan sgam pos rgyal sar bskos kyang dgung lo bco brgyad la gshegs rjes srong btsan sgam pos slar yang srid skyong mdzad, rgyal po 'di'i skabs ja dang rol mo rgya nag nas bod du dar, rang gi yum mong bza' khri lcam dang lhan cig tu dpal gyi yer pa'i lha khang bzhengs/
bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i g.yo ru'i ming gsar/
thi sho legs dang btsan mo gur sman gyi sras, sngar bod rgyal bcu gsum pa ste sa'i legs drug gi ya gyal zhig
(rgya) la phug gi bye brag cig /
lus sems ngal dub byung ba gso zhing sel ba'i thabs/ gung seng nyi ma/ las yun gang 'tshams shig song mtshams gung seng gtong ba/
(rnying) zur ram logs/ gud du bor ba/ gud na yod pa/ gud du med pa/ gud du bya'o/ gud du 'dzin pa/
1. (tha mi dad pa) nyams pa/ dar gud/ lus stobs gud pa/ bzang po gud pa dar las 'jam, ngan pa rgyags na shing las rtsub/ 2. rtsa 'phar stangs mi gsal ba/
gyong/ gzhan la gun mi gtong/ rang gis gun 'khyer/ nga la gun phog byung snyam du ma sems/
gyong gsab/ 'gro gron 'phar song gi gun mthud mtshon byed shog sgor lnga brgya tham pa sprad/
(legs) yon tan bskyangs te dus rabs bcu gcig par bod du phebs myong ba'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon pa la rnam gsum gyi gras shig /

ras dang re lde phying pa bcas las bzos pa'i sdod gnas/ phying gur, ..dbu gur/ bzhugs gur/ dmag gur/ sog gur/ thab gur/ gur rgyug / gur thag / gur phub nas sdod pa/ sdod gur 'degs pa/ nyi ma shar nas gur phab ste thon pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la gur khang dang, gos khyim, sbra, sbra gur bcas so,
1) dbyibs gur dang 'dra ba'i gnas/ shing gi gur khang/ rtswa'i gur khang/ 2) 'od gur ram 'ja' 'od kyis grub pa'i pho brang/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur khang/ sprin gyi gur khang/
sdod gur/ gur khyim rnam par bkra ba gangs ri'i dum bu 'thor ba lta bus phyod dang mtshams gang ba/

(legs) kung ku ma zur chags pa ste, bya rkang ma dang, kha che gur gum, le brgan ma, bal po gur gum, bod gur gum mam ldum ra gur gum bcas lnga mchis, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mchin nad sel, rtsa kha sdom, zungs khrag gso/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun nas 'khums dang, kha cher skyes, mchin sman gtso bo, mchog ldan, 'jam dbyangs mdog can, nyi ma gung rnyed, 'thung byed, dri zhim, dri bzang, bde byed, dpa' bo brtan pa, phra ma can, me tog nyi ma, me tog don can, me'i rtse mo, rtsa ba brgya pa, tshim byed dmar, rdzing drung skyes, li khri'i mdangs can, lus dmar le brgan rtsi bcas so,
kha che gur gum dang, bal po gur gum, bod gur gum mam pri yang ku bcas te gsum mo/
ye shes pa'i srung ma zhig /

gur thog gi mthar btang ba'i rgyan/ gur gyi sham bu rlung gi yam yom du sgul ba/
ye shes pa'i srung ma gur mgon yab yum gnyis/

/ 1) dbyibs gru bzhi/ 2) gur chung chung/

gur gyi gsham du yod pa'i chu len ras/

1. (tha mi dad pa) yid dang bas 'dud pa/ dpa' bo la gus pa/ 2. 1) rang nyid dma' sar 'jog pa'i tshig / gus pa rnam rgyal nas ched du zhu snying/ 2) gus 'dud/ khengs dregs spangs nas gus pa zhu ba/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa/
dang ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems dga' po'am mos po/ zhal bkod gang gnang gus por nyan pa/ phru gu 'di pha ma la gus po zhig red/
gus pa'i sgo nas 'tshal ba'i phyag /

1) me tog gi ze'u 'bru/ 2) sngo sman zhig nus pas tsha ba sel/ 3) gling ge sar gyi bsdus tshig

gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung zhes spyi tshogs thog grags che ba yin zhing, de ni sngar sgrung mkhan zhes pa'i mi yi ge tsam yang mi shes kyang ge sar gyi sgrung cha tshang blo thog nas shod thub mkhan mang po byung zhing da lta'ang yod pa de dag gis bshad pa rnams phyogs bsgrigs byas pas brjod tshul 'dra min sna tshogs rdzong chen bco brgyad dang, rdzong 'bring bdun, rdzong phran bzhi, lha gling, dmyal gling bcas le tshan rgyas bsdus khyon bsdoms sum cu lhag tsam yod zer
n'a ga ge sar dang, pushape ge sar, padma ge sar te gsum/
gnyan nad du go ba'i gag pa dang 'dra,
rkyen ngan bar chad/ las don gyi gegs su gyur pa/ rkyen god mang po'i gegs chags pa rnams bsal ba/ gra sgrig legs par byas yod stabs las don tshang ma gegs med du grub song/
gegs dang bar chad/ sku la gegs bar med par bya ba lam lhongs yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu/
1) bar chad byed mkhan/ 2) bar gcod byed pa/
bar chad gtong ba'i mi ma yin/
'dre gdon gyi rkyen las byung ba'i glo bur gyi nyer 'tshe'am, god ka/
bar chad med par bde por slebs pa/
1) gdon 'dre'i bar chad du gyur pa/ 2) (rnying) rag las pa/
lcug phran dang, shing gi yal ga/
sha khrag rgyas pa/ khye'u gel po/ mi'u thung gel po/

1. skabs dang, mtshams dang, gnas/ snga phyi go ldog / go mtshams med pa/ 2. grangs 'bor dgu bcu dang, de'i gcig gnas rnams kyi bar du sbyor ba'i phrad cig / dgu bcu go gcig / go dgu/ 3. ga mthar 'jug pa'i slar bsdu'i phrad cig / ga/ 'di ni lug go / rdo tshang ma bcag go/

1) dus tshod dam dus skabs/ lta skor du 'gro rgyu'i go skabs rnyed pa/ slob gnyer byed pa'i go skabs 'byed pa/ 2) bar mtshams/ hur brtson ma byas par go skabs bzang po don med du shor ba/ skor ba 'khor ba'i go skabs ma bzhag pa/
gnad don gsal por bshad pa/ khyim tshang tshang mar go bskon gsed 'grol byas pa/
1) thab 'og gi go thal 'don sa/ 2) khyim gyi lto gral/ las phyi ru byed, lto go khar za/
lus skyob lcags gos/ g.yul sar ma phyin gong nas go khrab gyon pa/
1) go sa'i gral/ 2) go kha'i gral/
go cha gyon pa/ mes rgyal srung skyob byed ched du go bgo mtshon 'khyer byed pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la go bgos dang, ya lad bgos, g.yul gyi chas zhugs pa bcas so,
pha ma'i khyim rang du na tshod rgas pa'i bud med/
1) thos rgya/ go rgya chung ba/ 2) don go stobs kyi blo rgya/
1) tshig don rgya cher go thub mkhan/ 2) thos pa rgya che yod pa'i mi/

1) don dag dang, snying po/ ca co mang po bshad kyang, go rgyu gang yang mi 'dug / 2) tshig zur gyis bstan pa'i brda/ kho'i skad cha la go rgyu chen po zhig 'dug / de ltar byas na mi 'grig pa'i go rgyu yang yang btang ba yin/ dngos su lab med kyang tshig shugs la brten nas go rgyu mang po yod/
gra sgrig / tshogs 'du'i go sgrig legs par zin pa/ slob sbyong gi go sgrig byed rgyu ma byung/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, theg chen la 'jug pa'i phyir go bgos pa go cha'i sgrub pa ste, theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya ba gang zhig phar phyin drug re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas nyams su len pa'o/
(yul) mna' mar phyin ma zin par rang gi nang du lus pa'i bsam shes med pa'i bud med/
ga yig gi mthar 'jug pa'i thams cad:/ ga/
1) 'dod don bsgrubs pa/ las don khag mang mi gcig gis go bcad pa/ 2) tshab bam dod thub par byas pa/ lcags skyogs med sar shing skyogs kyis go bcad pa/

/ 1) go lag cha/ go gyon mtshon thogs/ go bkrag mtshon brjid/ dpa' bor go cha spras pa/ 2) go khrab/ dmag mi thams cad go cha cha lag tshang ba zhig bgo ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyob byed dang, khrab, 'khrug gos, go khrab, lcags kyi bgo ba, lcags gos, dra ba can, brang g.yogs, mtshon skyob, mtshon sgrib, zhub can, lus skyob, lus srung bcas so, 3) lha dang sngags kyi srung thabs shig /
go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa
mdo sde zhig 'gos chos 'grub kyis rgya yig gzhir bzung nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba/
snying stobs mi zhum pa'i rtsol ba/
drug rdo rje sems dpa' dang: rnam snang, padma gar dbang, he ru ka nag po, rdo rje nyi ma, rta mchog ste drug
drug rdo rje phag mo dang: gshin rje ma, rmongs byed ma, skyong byed ma, skrag byed ma, tsanti ka ste drug /
1) las don 'pher ba/ gar btang go chod/ 2) dod thub mkhan/ 3) dod thub pa/
dgos don sgrub thub pa'am phan thogs po/ ca lag 'di go chod po zhig byung/ las don de'i skor la mi 'di go chod po yod dam/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud dang 'bri chu'i nub 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de aa dkar du yod/
go sa'am, gnas spos pa/ 'dod mos kyis las gnas go brjes brgyab pa/ rta dang g.yag lug go brjes brgyab pa/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas dug dang, rlung tshad, mig nad bcas la phan/
go don rtogs pa/ bsam blo'i go rtogs chu tshad mtho ru gtong ba/ bzang ngan dbye 'byed thub pa'i go rtogs ldan pa/
blo gros kyi stobs/ mi de lus stobs che ba tsam ma zad, go stobs kyang chen po yod/
bed spyod 'pher ba/ rta shed bzang, mi go thang/
1) thab kyi nang gi thal ba/ 2) bya go bo'i skyag pa/
rna bar go ba'am thos pa/ gnas tshul tshang ma go thos byung/ nang gi gnas lugs zhib gsal go thos ma byung/
(rnying) 1) gang mos/ 2) sna tshogs/ 3) tshogs shing 'du ba/
go rgyu'i don dag snying po/ go don 'phigs pa/ dpe cha'i nang gsal go don khrid pa/
(rnying) 1) gang mos/ 2) sna tshogs/ 3) 'dag rdzas/ 4) tshogs pa'am, 'du ba/
1) gnas 'gyur ba/ 2) go don phyin ci log pa/ dkar nag go ldog pa/

don snying rtogs rgyu yod pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang, ngag gi skad cha, de min pa'i sgra dang yi ge sogs/ lus ngag rnam 'gyur ci rigs kyi sgo nas nang don gyi go brda sprod pa/ phan tshun go brda 'dzol nas don dag phyin ci log tu go ba/ mnga' khul tshang mar go brda 'phrod nges kyi bkod khyab mthar nan bgyis pa/ skad yig gi 'bru don go brda 'phrod min byung mtshams dogs sel byed pa/
gros mol lam phan tshun gros bsdur byas pa/ rtag tu go bsdur byas na don gnad gsal po rtogs rgyur phan thogs pa yong/
1) go don nor 'khrul byung ba/ go nor thebs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la go bsnor dang, go zlog go log go ba 'gyur ba, go ba 'khrul ba bcas so, 2) rim pa go ldog tu gyur pa/
go bab kyi thob thang/ go gnas bsko 'then/ go gnas gcig lcogs/ go gnas rjes 'brel/ go gnas spor gcog / go gnas phab pa/ go gnas tsha len/ go gnas rim pa/ go gnas 'khyur ba
thos tshul lam, thos snang/ khyed rang gis de ltar gsungs kyang, nga'i go snang la 'di 'dra zhig go byung/
thob thang ngam go sa'i dpangs/ go 'phang mthon po/ go 'phang dma' ba/ mkhas pa'i go 'phang/ spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i go 'phang/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang/
phan thogs po'am 'jon po/ las byed go 'pher/ dar ma go 'pher/ las gnas gang la btang yang go 'pher ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) shes pa dang rtogs pa/ don gyis go ba/ ha go/ smra shes don go/ go ba lhang tsam byung ba/ go ba log pa/ kha sangs na go bde, nam langs na 'gro bde/ gzhung don go dka' ba/ 2) thos pa/ go ba brgya las mthong ba gcig lhag / skad cha de 'dra gtan nas go ma myong/ tshang ma gsal por go byung/ 2. blo rtsal lam blo yi rtogs pa'i nus pa/ mi de'i go ba zab po 'dug / go ba med pa'i glang rgan la, rgyal po'i bka' las dbyug pa btsan/
mkhas pa dang go stobs chen po yod pa/ mi go ba can la tshig gcig gis chog rta gom pa can la lcag gcig gis chog / mi go ba can la shod bde, shing yal ga can la 'dzeg bde/
go ba phyin ci log tu rgyag pa/
go sa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i bab/ so so'i go bab la gzhigs te gzigs skyong gnang ba/ khong bzhugs sa'i gral gnas go bab mtho ba zhig red/
(sog) sngar 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa dang sku thog gcig pa'i yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po zhig ste se chen rgyal po yang zer/
mgo ser mgo nag gnyis su phye ba'i bya chen zhig / go bo glag gag pho drod che ba'i bya chen zhig /

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas srin nad gsod, pho ba'i rims sel, rma sogs rul ba gcod, chu ser skem/ ming gi rnam grangs la dpal 'bras dang, ma nu khrag can, ma nu bse shing, bse 'bras bse ma nu bcas so,
dge slong gi yo byad 'khar gsil/
1) bar mtshams sam, dbye ba 'byed pa/ 2) go skabs 'byed pa/

1) sra rtsi'i rgyu bse shing gi khu ba/ 2)mgron bu mer bsregs pa'i thal ba/ 3) (legs) legs sbyar gyi skad du gu ru lci ba dang, la gha ma yang ba'i don bsdus pa'i gu la, au'i yon tan 'phel ba'i go la ste, go ni mtho ris sogs dang, la ni yang ba sogs don du mar 'jug pas mtho bar gnas pa'i gza' skar gyi ris rnams mi ltung bar 'dzin pas mtho ris 'dzin dang, steng phyogs su khyim dang sa la dus bzhi 'khor bar byed pa'i las can yin pas phyogs 'khor dang, ri gling rnams kyi steng du gdugs kyi rnam pas gnas pas zlum po dang, lhun po'i steng du mtho la me dkyil thad kar dma' bas sgang gshong dang, 'degs byed rlung stobs ljid che zhing 'phul byed rlung stobs kyi nus pa yang bas lci yang zhes kyang bya'o, de la nam mkha'i go la dang, skar khyim du rgyu ba'i nyi zla'i go la, sa'i go la sogs yod do/ gu ru...la gha ma...gu la au...go la...go/ la... brnyings nas skyon can du gyur pa/ lo rgas pa'i gog skyon can/ khang pa rnying hrul gog skyon can/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) yan lag bzhi'am sug bzhi sa la btsugs te 'gro ba/ phru gu gog nas 'gro ba/ 2) lhung ba'i don du 'jug pa'i 'gog pa'i 'das pa,

ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rnyi dang rgya/

/ 'bru gong/ zog gong 'phar chag / yul gong chag pa/ khrom gong spar ba/ 2) ltag ma dang, bla dang, steng/ rim pa gong 'og / dbang cha gong na med pa/ stobs shugs gong nas gong du 'phel ba/ sa steng gi gong du sa bla yin/ 3) thog ma dang sngon/ gong smos ltar/ gong mtshungs/ gong zhus ltar/ gong bzhin/ nga'i bsam 'char gong du brjod pa de ga rang las med/ dgun dus ma shar gong/ bcings 'grol ma btang gong/

1) bya gong mo las che zhing, rdza ri mtho sar gnas pa'i bya zhig / 2) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi yar klungs gtsang po'i rked rgyud dang, yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i byang ngos su yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de rwa smad du yod/
gong du bkur ba ste, mthong cher brtsis pa dang, thod du 'khur ba/ rang gi pha mar gong bkur byed pa/
lha sa'i jo bo dbu skra'i rdo ring du gsal ba'i skabs de'i the'u cu'i phyogs kyi yul zhig gi ming/
1) rin tshad shod pa/ gong yang tig rgyag pa/ har gong brgyab pa/ 2) rtsi mthong 'jog pa/ sha shi sha la mi lta yang, sder ma gser sder la gong brgyab/
gos kyi gong ba'i phyi rgyan/

gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba gsum gyi nang gses, gzugs khams su dang por skyes pa'i rten la myang 'das mi 'thob par gong du 'phos te 'da' ba'o, de la'ang 'og min gyi mthar thug par 'gro ba dang, srid rtse'i mthar thug par 'gro ba ste gnyis yod do/
gong du spel ba ste yar rgyas gtong ba/ bzo zhing gi thon skyed gong spel gtong ba/ spus tshad gong du spel ba/
gong du phud pa ste, dmigs bsal btang ba/ mi de gong du phud pa/ ra bzi smyon pa gong du phud/ dkon mchog gong phud/
gong du bka' ji ltar phebs pa'i don snying/ gong phebs bzhin, phran bsod nams dpal 'byor nas zhal 'debs srang chig stong tham pa phul/
yar rgyas/ nyin bzhin gong 'phel du 'gro ba/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba rim bzhin gong 'phel du phyin pa/
gos kyi gong ba/ gong gor/ wa gong/ stod thung gi gong ba'i mtha' lcags la me tog gis brgyan pa/ gos gong ba med na bzo 'phro red/

/ 1)gcig tu 'dril ba'i rdog po ril mo/ sa'i gong bu/ lcags kyi gong bu/ mthun sgril gong bu gcig gyur/ ming gi rnam grangs la gor mdang, gor gzugs, rdog po bcas so, 2)'dod khams kyi rdzas sa chu me rlung la brten nas thog mar gzugs dri ro reg shin tu phra rab byung ba rnams ye shes kho na'i spyod yul yin pa de la gong bu zer, gong bu 'dus te rdul phran phra rab byung zhing de nas bdun ldab bdun ldab tu 'gyur bas rdul phran dang, lcags rdul, chu rdul, ri bong rdul, lug rdul, glang rdul bcas rim gyis byung ba'i tha mar nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi rdul byung ba de nyid gzhi nas sha mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ 3)(mngon) lcags/
yan lag med cing lto bas 'gro mkhan/
1. 1)rgyal po chen po/ rgya nag gong ma/ gong ma'i pho brang/ gong ma chen po/
/ 2)snga rabs kyi bla ma dam pa/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ bon gyi gong ma che drug / 2.sngon ma dang, steng ma/ mi rabs gong ma/ rim pa gong ma/ gong ma'i gong ma/ khams gong ma/ sa gong ma/

rab byung brgyad pa'i nang gtsang sa skyar sku 'khrungs, brang ti chos rgyal bkra shis sogs slob dpon mang po bsten pa dang, gangs ri'i ljongs na grags pa'i gso ba rig pa'i yig cha phal mo che la zhib tu gzigs te, rgya bod kyi mkhas pa du ma'i snyan brgyud gab pa rnams khol du bton nas khrigs su bsdebs pa'i man ngag po ti dmar po dang, pod nag pod khra, phyi ma rgyud kyi dka' 'grel gnas thams cad gsal ba'i sgron me, brgyud pa'i rnam thar, sman ming brda sprod, rgyud kyi dka' 'phrang 'grol ba'i shog ser bcas pod bdun, rtsa chu'i gnad 'grol zhal gyi gdams pa dmar 'byin, sngo'i 'khrungs dpe don bsdus, khyad par du dpal ldan rgyud bzhi la mchan 'grel shin tu rgyas par 'debs pa'i rgyud chen khra mo be bum seng lding mar grags pa slob dpon bsten mi dgos par bltas pa tsam gyis grol bar bzhed pa rnams mdzad de gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa dgung du btegs/
gong sman dkon cog phan dar

rab byung dgu pa'i nang gtsang sa skyar sku 'khrungs, dgung lo dgu'i thog rang gi mes po dkon cog bde legs sogs bsten nas gso ba rig pa dpyis phyin par sbyangs, gso ba rig pa'i man ngag spyi dang khyad par du dpal ldan byang pa'i bzhed pa gtso bor bstan nas 'gro don bskyangs, gsung rtsom yang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa me long mthong gsal, man ngag gi skor la gso rig dgos 'dod 'byung ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba, nyams yig brgya rtsar grags pa rnams mdzad, brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma mnga' ris pa bde chen dang, mang mkhar bde gling pa nyi ma grags sogs byung/

1) gcer bu'am dmar hreng/ 2)sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/

chas gos gyon stangs/ phru gu rnams kyi gos tshags legs po bcos nas skyed tshal du gtong ba/
tshos mdog gang rung brgyab pa'i gos/
1)gyon pa dang gos chen gyi sne 'dzar/ 2)gos lhug ste 'dzar ba/
gos chen gyis bzos pa'i pho mo'i gzan
yi ge'i ri mo yod pa'i gos chen/

bya rgyud kyi spyod pa ste, phyi'i gos gsar pa gyon pa, nang gi gos sdom pa srung ba, gsang ba'i gos lha sgom pa'o/
