brje res bya rgyu'i gos/ gos bsum, (rnying) gos g.yogs/
gos smad kha bral ba'am gos kyi zur 'bral/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, chos gos kyi rgyur ma bsngos pa khru tshad du longs pa yan chad kyi gos lhag por rang la dbang ba byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag bcu ma rdzogs kyi bar du 'jog pa'o/
grangs brgyad cu gya gcig nas brgyad cu gya dgu'i bar du sbyor rgyu'i tshig grogs shig / brgyad cu gya lnga/ gya bdun/

1)g.yo sgyu'am g.yon can/ slu ba'i gya gyu/ mi gya gyu can gyis skad cha drang po bshad mi yong/ las don gya gyu byas na nam zhig sngo lo 'phyar yong/ 2)drang po min pa'am kyog kyog / lam phran gya gyu/ chu klung gya gyur 'bab/ shing gya gyu can mda' mo mi nyan, blo gya gyu can grogs po mi nyan/
si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi btsan lha rdzong gi la zhig /
1)ri mo kyog kyog / 2)(mngon) smig rgyu'i ming/

1)legs pa/ 2) bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris drug pa ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha ni lus sems nyer zhi'i bde ba chos kyi mchog snang bas gya nom snang ba zhes bya ste gtsang ma'i gnas lnga'i nang gses shig / 3) (rnying) yod pa/

1)phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyu nor gya nom pa/ 'bul ba gya nom pa/ bza' btung gya nom pa/ legs skyes gya nom pa/ 2)nyon mongs pa dang bral bas gtsang ba dang, sdug bsngal dang bral bas bde ba'i dngos po yin pa'i mtshan nyid can te, bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug gi nang gses shig /
(rnying) nyams pa/ bar du gya ba sor chud/ 'gro ba gya zhing mgon med pa/
kyog po dang 'khyog po/ chu bo gya ma gyur 'bab/ sems gya ma gyu/ m gya tsom, gya tshom dang 'dra,
ma brtags pa/ kha nas gang byung mang byung gis gya tshom du smra ba/ bshes gnyen gya tshom du bsten na 'dun ma nyes/ gya tshom du kha tshon ma gcod, gya tshom du chu rkyal ma rgyag /
(rgya) sa shing sgrom nang du brdungs pa'i rtsig pa/ gyang rdung ba/ gyang hrul/ gyang gog / gyang 'gyel ba yog shing gis mi bteg /
gyang ldebs su bris pa'i sku brnyan/
khang pa dang grong pa sogs kyi mthar bskor ba'i gyang gi ra ba/
1) gyang ngi gying ngi'i bsdus tshig 2) (rnying) khengs dregs kyi lus kyi rnam 'gyur/
gyang nge gyong nge'i bsdus tshig
gyang sa rdung byed rgyug pa
khengs dregs kyi rnam pa/ gyang ngi gying ngi'i mi la tshang mas dga' po mi byed/
ma thul ba'i gyong tshul/ sa gyang nge gyong nge chu lud kyis 'dul dgos/ mi gyang nge gyong nge der skad cha shod khag po 'dug /
lha ri gyang tho'i bsdus tshig
rtsig pa'i gyang gnyis bar gyi mthud mtshams/
phyogs gnyis phan tshun dbyen sbyor dkrug shing gis rgyab 'gal du gtong ba'i dpe/
gyang gi dpangs rim/ lcags ri'i dpangs la gyang phreng sum cu so drug /
1) gyang dang rtsig pa'i bsdus tshig / 2) sa las bzos pa'i rtsig pa'am skya
1) gyang gnyis mthud mtshams sam gyang gnyis kyi bar mtshams/ 2) gyang gi 'khris sam nye 'gram/
gyang ldebs kyi ri mo/ gtsug lag khang gi rtsig par gyang ris yongs khyab tu yod/
gyang rtsig bzo byed kyi shing sgrom/
/ 1) rtsal stobs dang lus shugs/ 2) ngag rgyun du grags pa'i mi'u thung shed che ba zhig /
gyad mi'i stobs shugs/ dga' ston 'tshogs nas gyad stobs sdur ba/
shugs rtsal sbyong byed yar 'gyogs rgyu'i rdo/
gyad mi'i lus rtsal longs pa/
lus shugs ches che ba'i mi/
1) lus shugs che chung 'gran sdur byed thabs/ 2) lus shugs kyi rtsal/
lus rtsal shugs che 'gran sdur byed pa/
ku re/ gsung che la drang ba gyabs kyis mi mdzad pa/
brag ri'i g.yab bam, brag phug rgya che la gting sbug thung ba zhig / brag gyam/ gad gyam/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) 'gyur ba/ ci bya med pa'i gnas su gyar ba/ 'khrug zing gi gnas su gyar ba/ grogs med kher rkyang gi gnas su gyar ba/ 2) 'khyam pa/ gzhan yul du gyar ba/ yul gyar srid gzhung/ 3) kha 'thor ba'am brlag pa/ kha gyar ba/ lhu gyar ba/ dpe cha'i shog lhe gcig gyar 'dug /
skad gdangs kyi 'gyur khug 'degs 'jog gi rnam: pa zhig /

1. ming mtha' na ma ra la bcas kyi rjes su sbyor ba'i 'brel sgra'i rkyen zhig / na ma ra la...'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag / lam gyi zur/ gsol mar gyi ljags gong/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyi zhwa mo/ 2. (rnying) gri/
tsong kha zhes pa'i ming gi rnam grangs te da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho sngon po'i shar phyogs kyi rma chu'i rgyud spyi'i ming/
nga'am bdag khengs skyung byed pa'i tshig /
1) rang ga'am tha mal/ 'gro ba gyi nar 'khyams pa ma lus pa bde la 'khod pa/ 2) dman pa/ gyi nas 'tsho ba/ lto gyi na ba dang gos lhags skyob tsam gyis chog shes pa/ 3) le lo can/
rta mchog gam phul du byung ba'i rta/ rta mchog gyi ling bzhon te mgyogs por 'gro/ rta gyi ling mgo 'phang shin tu mtho, lag mtshon cha'i rno dpal rab tu che/
na ma ra la'i mthar sbyar rgyu bzhin zhes pa dang gcig pa'i da lta ba'i las ston byed phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / na ma ra la...bzhin...'khor lo 'khor gyin 'dug /
(rnying) 1) tha mal ba dang, dman pa/ 2) rang ga ba dang rang bzhin pa/ 3) don dag med pa dang, le lo can/

rgya bza' rjes ma ste, rgya'i deb ther las, bod kyi rgyal mo khu dan gyis bu mo slong du byung ba la, rgya rje thang krung tsung gi nu bo yung dbang gi bu mo kims shing kong jo byin, keng lung gi lo bzhi pa lcags khyi ste spyi lo 710 lor bod kyi zhang btsan to ri lhas byin gyis bsus, krung tsang sku dngos kyis mgar chen po zhing pheng hyen gyi bar du skyel thung rgya cher mdzad de, mkhar de'i nyes pa can rnams thar du bcug dmangs la khral 'ul lo gcig mi dgos par byas, mkhar de'i ming yang brjes te kong jo'i ming gyim shing zhes btags, gzhan yang bstan bcos dang, gos dar khri tsho du ma, bzo rigs dang sgyu rtsal sna tshogs pa, rol mo khyad par ba cha tshang la sogs pa rdzongs skal gya nom pa bstsal, phyis su slar yang rma chu nub rgyud khug dgu zhes pa ste, mi nyag gi yul khams thams cad kong jo la byin, zhes deb dmar du zhib par drangs pa ltar ro, kong jo bod du byon nas khri lde gtsug brtan dang 'dus pa la sras khri srong lde btsan byung bas bod rgya gnyis dbon zhang du gyur/
(rgya) bkra shis pa dang bkra mi shis pa'am, bzang ngan nam zhi tshub po/
gyim shung rin chen spungs pa
nag rtsis skor gyi bod 'gyur rnying pa zhig yin zhing 'di'i dpe rgyun bar skabs thor nas mi snang bar gyur/

1. bgyid pa'i skul tshig 2. 'brel sgra gyi zhes pa'i sgra'i sbyor tshul dang mthun pa'i byed sgra'i rkyen zhig / sprin gyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bkab/ rdzun gtam gyis khungs skyel mi thub pa/ g.yang dkar gyis 'ba' sgra sgrog pa/ tshur rgol thol gyis byung ba/
(rnying) 1) gong du bkur ba/ 2) zos pa/ 3) bkru ba/ 4) nga rgyal can/
gyu ru lugs su shod pa
smon tshig cig / sku tshe ring zhing nad med par gyur cig / 'dzam gling yongs kyi ngal rtsol mi dmangs tshang ma bcings bkrol 'thob par gyur cig /
yong bar shog ces yid shin tu bskyod pas ci ma rung snyam du smon pa'i tshig /
gyur dug gyur pa'i dug ste
kha zas sogs kyi ngo bo thog ma nas dug ma yin yang dus dang rkyen gyi dbang gis rang bzhin 'gyur nas dug tu gyur pa'i don/
so ma brgyab par hril bur mid pa/ gzhan gyi mnga' khongs sa cha gyur mid gtong ba/ lto chas sos ma blad par gyur mid byas na 'ju dka'/
gyen thur gyi gyen nam dkan/ gyen lam/ gyen gzar po/ lag mthil gyen du bkan pa/ mig gyen du lta ba/ dbu skra gyen du gzengs pa/ nyi ma nub nas 'char ba dang chu bo gyen du 'gro ba mi srid/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, byed las tshig 'byin pa dang, dbugs gyen du rgyu ba sogs byed pa'i rlung/
yar 'dzeg mar 'bab kyi sa/ ri lam gyi gyen thur gzar po 'dug /
lus kyi stod nad sel zhing gyen du skyugs par byed pa me rlung gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i sman, dper na, ri sho dang spyang tsher lta bu la'o/
1) ngo log / 2) bka' khyad du gsod pa/ 3) yar log pa/ rlung gyen ldog / gru gzings gyen ldog tu gtong ba/ ri gzar rbab rdo gyen ldog dka'/
1) yar lud pa/ rba rlabs gyen 'phyur/ chu mig gi chu gyen du 'phyur ba/ 2) (mngon) ri/
dbugs 'tshang ba'i nad kyi rigs shig /
gseg gyen gzar po ma yin pa
(mngon) sha ra bha ste, seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa/
ngo log / btsan dbang gi gnya' gnon 'khur mi thub pas gyen zlog byed pa
1) ngo log / 'bangs gyen log gi lo rgyus/ 2) kan tur slog pa/
yar sgreng ba/ dar cha gyen slong/
gyer sgom tshul khrims seng ge

rab byung gnyis pa'i shing byi lor yar klungs su khra 'brug pa'i rje rgyud du 'khrungs, phag gru rdo rje rgyal po'i slob ma yin, rab byung gsum pa'i lcags glang lor snye phur shug gseb dgon pa btab pas shug gseb bka' brgyud ces pa byung, de nas rim par brgyud pa dag gis zhi byed pa'i rjes su 'brangs pas deb sngon du 'di nyid zhi byed par 'jog shing byi lo la 'das/
bon lugs phrin las skor gyi gzhung zhig /
(tha dad pa) gdangs 'then pa/ snyan tshig dbyangs rta mthon por gyer ba/ glu dbyangs gyer ba/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ngam ring rdzong gi lho nub ngos su yod/
lam ga dang shing gi yal ga sogs gyes mtshams sam kha dbrag /
so btang ba'i sa phag chag dum/
/ 1) so btang ba'i sa phag / 2) rdza las bzos pa'i snod spyad/ 3) sa phag gam rdza snod chag pa'i dum bu/
pham kha'm gun/ gyong rag pa/ sta res rdo la gzhus na sku gyong lcags la phog yong/
thob skal brlags pa'am ma byung ba'i cha shas/
gyong chags pa'am thob skal gyi 'bor tshad chag pa/
khe'i ldog phyogs gyong ngam gun/ gyong gun gtong ba/ re zhig gyong gun rag pa de, dge ba'i grogs su 'gyur yang srid/
(rnying) 1) bskal pa ya thog skabs mi rnams kyi zas su rung ba'i sa zhag / 2) sa'i tshi zhag /
gnyis ka btsan po'am, ngar ba, mkhregs pa 'dra 'dra/ mi gyong mnyam thug na bar 'dum byed dka'/
mi ngar po dang ngar po dngos su 'thab pa/
mkhregs po/ kha gyong po/ sems gyong po/ tshig gyong po/ dgra bo gyong po/ mi gyong po/ gshis rgyud gyong po/ mi bsrun dgon par gnas kyang gyong/
1) rgyud gyong po can/ 2) rlan med skam gyong song ba/
(rnying) 1) sa zhag ste bskal pa ya thog skabs sa steng nas rang bzhin gyis thon pa'i zhag rtsi mi'i zas su rung ba/ 2) sa rdul sogs rdzing chu'i khar chags nas byung ba'i spris ma lta bu zhig /
gyong shas che tsam gyi tshul/ mi de'i lus po gyong sil sil zhig red/
shas che ba'i tshul:/ skad cha gyong hrag hrag cig bshad yong/ gyon pa gyong hrag hrag cig gyon pa/
rtsod pa/ phan tshun nang gros byas kyang ma 'grig par gyod kha gtugs pa/ nga khyod kha rtsod kyi lab gleng gyod kha langs pa/ lab rnyog mang po'i gyod kha rtsod pa/
gyod kyi phyogs gtogs sam, gyod kyi nang du tshud mkhan/
gyod thag / lo mang po song yang, da dung gyod 'khrun chod ma song/
1) kha mchu gcig thog nyis brtsegs byung ba/ 2) nag nyes thog la nag nyes brtsegs pa/
khag 'phang gi bsnyon btsugs pa'am ya la dkris pa/
rtsod gleng ched du 'tshol ba/ sngar 'khon zhe la bzhag nas ched du gyod 'tshol byas pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sger chos sogs che khag bar gyi kha mchu thag gcod byed pa'i las khungs shig /
khrims gtug byas pa'i rgyu rkyen nam kha mchu'i rtsa ba/ gyod gzhi slong ba
khrims gtug byed mkhan phyogs gcig /
kha mchu ma 'dums shing: dpyad khra khrims sar phyir log pa/
gos spyi'i ming/ gyon chas sgyur ba/ pho mo'i gyon chas khag khag so so red/
gyon pa gcig gi rgyu long tshad/
1. (tha dad pa) klub pa/ gos gyon pa/ bong bus gzig lpags gyon pa/ 2. gos/ gyon pa'i gsar ngad/
rkang pa 'theng po/ rta gyol po/ 'gros stabs gyol po/
dang sgyug mo ste rang gi bza' zla'i pha: ma/ chung ma'i pha ma khyo ga'i gyos sgyug red, khyo ga'i pha ma'ang chung mar de dang mtshungs/
khyo ga dang chung ma'i pha/
khyo ga dang chung ma'i ma/

/ 1) dud 'gro'i rigs kyi spu'i rtse mo/ spu'i gra/ gra 'dzum/ 2) srog chags kyi pags pa'i spu la gra dang khul gnyis yod pa'i gra ste spu byings las rtsub cing ring ba zhig / wa lpags gra khul gnyis 'dzoms/ wa shi yang spu gra nyams dogs med/ dgun dus nor phyugs kyi spu gra chad nas spu mdog nyams yong/ rta drel gyi sha shed nyams nas gra yang chag 'dug / 3) cha shas sam yan lag gam dum bu/ rtse gra/ tshig gra ma nyams pa/ gna' dus kyi ca lag gra ma chag pa/ 4) sngar bod yul gyi rigs rus drug gi ya gyal zhig /
rta drel gyi sgal par g.yog byed/

/ sngon 'gro gra 'grig pa dang dngos gzhi 'dzugs thub pa/ las don tshang ma gra 'grig phun sum tshogs pa byung song/ bsam gros mthun po byung na las ka gra 'grig po yong/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms med pa'i las ka gra ma 'grig tsha ba la
las don bgegs med gnad du song ba/ las don mtha' dag gra 'grig 'thus tshang byung song/
stobs 'byor dar che ba/ khyim tshang gra rgyas pa/ rgyal khab gra rgyas pa/
gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa
'dod yon yongs su tshang ba/ gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs su 'gro ba'i gzhung lam bzang po/
bya ba ste: sta gon/ las 'go dngos su 'dzugs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa/ gra sgrig byas na bya ba 'grub, gra sgrig med na 'grub mi thub/
gzan pa'i gra ma phyugs kyi lce 'og tu zug nas rma bzos pa/
dngos por skyon shor ba/ g.yar zhus dngos po tshang ma gra chag gru nyams med par rtsis 'bul zhus yod/
1) pags pa'i spu gra snyoms sgrig / 2) tshogs pa gcig tu bsdebs pa'am ngan 'brel/ mi ngan gra sdeb byas nas yul lung dkrugs/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud dang yar klungs gtsang po'i sked rgyud na yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de gra thang du yod/
'bru'i snye ma'i gra ma dang phub ma'i bsdus ming/
rol cha skad bzang ba'i byed brag cig /
/ 1) spu dang, 'bru rigs kyi snye ma'i gra ma/ mig nang gi gra ma, snying nang gi tsher ma/ 2) bod nas thon pa'i sle tres/ 3) (rnying) tsher ma can gyi shing rigs/
1) gra ma yod pa'i rigs/ 'bru gra ma can gyis rtsam pa 'thag mi nyan/ gro zhib gra ma can/ 2) mtshan ma'i nang du gra mas khengs snyam pa'i na zug ldang ba'i pho mtshan gyi nad cig /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig ste, las 'gan ni dngul dang zangs shog bcas la dngul par brgyab nas 'grems rgyu dang, dngul gsar rnying brje rgyu, bu lon gtong rgyu sogs yin/
spu gra me la bsregs pa/ snam bu'i spu gra me la bzhur ba/
grang ngar che skabs rta'i spu rtse 'khums pa/
phor pa sogs dkrug byed kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon gyi ru shing/
gsum gyi grag ste mi 'dod pa dang: ma rangs pa'i tshig shugs ston pa'i phrad cig / bum pa bden grub tu grag / mthun rkyen yod med la rag las par grag /
rna shes kyi gzung yul bden gnyis/ khyed kyis grag stong bsgrags pa yis, kho bo'i blo gros rgyas par byas/
rna ba'i yul du grag pa'i sgra rnams stong nyid dang dbyer ma mchis pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) sgra skad thon pa/ glog 'khyugs pa dang chabs cig 'brug sgra grag pa/ khos nga la kha grag ma byung/ 2) thos pa dang shes pa/ nga la skad cha khyad mtshar po zhig grag byung/ de ring gsar 'gyur 'di lta bu zhig grag pa/
snying po med pa'i snyan grags/
1) skad grags che ba/ 2) byang sems spyi/
ming snyan grags bzang po/ byas rjes bzang ba'i grags snyan dkar pos phyogs kun khyab 'dug /

1. (tha mi dad pa) khyab pa/ khyab pa/ 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa/ rna lam du grags par mi 'gyur ba/ 2. ming grags/ grangs pa phul byung/ grags pa ngan pa/ mkhas pa'i grags pa rgya cher spel ba/ gzi brjid kyi grags pa mi nyams par srung ba/
sa chen kun dga' snying po'i sras sa skya gong ma gsum pa, rab byung gsum pa'i me mo yos la 'khrungs, dgung lo nyer drug pa la gdan sar bzhugs, dgung lo bdun cu pa me pho byi ba la gshegs/
rgyu drug rgyan 'gyed pa dang: 'dus pa la blta ba, le lo, chang 'thung ba, sdig grogs bsten pa, mtshan mo grong du 'gro ba bcas drug go /
phag gru sde srid khri rabs gsum pa, 'dis rab byung drug pa'i shing stag lo nas lcags bya lo'i bar lo bdun srid bskyangs/

rjes dpag gsum gyi nang gses: rang gi rten grags rtags yang dag la brten nas brda'm 'dod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'i yul la mi bslu ba'i shes pa, dper na, rtog yul na yod pa'i rtags kyis ri bong can la zla sgras brjod rung du rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu'o/

rtags yang dag gsum gyi nang gses, 'jig rten na ji ltar grags pa de nyid rgyu mtshan du byas nas bsgrub gzhi de bsgrub chos de yin par 'jog byed kyi rtags, dper na, ri bong chos can, zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du rung ste, rtog yul na yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgra rtog gis bzhag cing 'jig rten du grags pa nyid las rang ngos nas rgyu mtshan gzhan med pa/
grags pa don mthun yin pa mi tshang mas khas len dgos pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma/
ma pham g.yu mtsho, byang gnam mtsho phyug mo, yar 'brog g.yu mtsho, mtsho sngon po khri shor rgyal mo bcas so/
bsal ba bzhi'i nang gses, dam bca' dang 'jig rten grags pa dang 'gal ba, mi'i thod pa gtsang bar bsgrub pa dang, bum pa la zla ba zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/
(rnying) dri ba'am the tshom ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / bya ba de ltar byas na nor 'khrul du mi 'gyur grang snyam/
grang ba'i nad dang khrag nad 'dres pa'i nad
mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi byed las nyams pa'i grang ba shas che ba'i mkhris nad cig ste, nad rtags su mig sprin dang sha mdog ser por 'gyur ba dang, zas mi 'ju ba, bshang ba, dkar por 'gyur ba sogs so/
bad kan grang ba shas che ba'i lbu ba be snabs can 'khru ba zhig /
grang ba shas che ba'i grum bu'i nad de gzhan du trem dkar zhes kyang zer
ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas pa'i grang ba'i glang 'thab cig /
1) grang ba'i ngar shugs/ lung pa grang ngad che sar 'gro/ rtswa shing grang ngad mi thub pa/ 2) rlung grang mo/

grang ba'i ngar shugs/ grang ngar chen po/ grang ngar mi bzod pa/ dgun zla dang por grang ngar slebs pa/ dpyid zla dang por grang ngar gyi rtser son pa/ gangs ri mtho ba dang, grang ngar chen por mi 'dzem pa/
zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dbugs la grang ngar chung zhes pa'i dus tshigs zer/
zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i sgang la grang ngar che ba'i dus tshigs zer/
'khyags tshul lam 'khyags stangs shig / lhags bsil lus la phog pas grang cang cang byas byung/
1) grang nad can gyi gcin pa/ 2) nad cig /
dpyad kyi lag cha mer ma bsregs par zug rngu'i steng du dbug par bya ba'i thur ma spyi'i ming/
'thab nas glang thabs su gyur pa'i rta nad: cig /
1) tsha grang/ 2) grang ba dang dro ba'i bsdus ming/
lus grang ba dang 'dar ba'i rlung gi nad rtags shig
'khyags nas byung ba'i nad rigs shig /
gnam gshis grang ba'i sa gnas/

/ 1) tsha ba'i ldog phyogs/ dgun dus gos lham ma gyon pas grang bas mnar ba/ char rlung 'thab pa'i grang bas mgo lus gzir ba/ 'khyag rom gyi nang du phyin nas grang bas mi tshugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khyags pa dang, grang ngad, grang mo, grang reg bser bu, lhags ngar bcas so, 2) bad kan sogs 'khyags nas byung ba'i nad rigs shig / 3) sman gyi zhu rjes sam yon tan/

nad grang ba bcos pa'i dus las 'das te lus zungs yongs su zhan par gyur nas sman pa'i dbugs phyi nang gi rgyu ba gcig la 'phar rtsa lan gnyis sam gcig las 'phar mi nus pa gso dka' ba srog gcod nad dgu'i ya gyal zhig /
bad kan smug po dus gsum gyi nang tshan tsha ba'i grogs dang bral te grang ba gcig pur gyur pa'i don/
lus kyi sa chu'i khams 'phel ba las byung ba'i grang ba'i nad kyis zin pa'i rtags su dri chu kha dog dkar ram sngo la sla ba, rlangs pa dang dri ma chung ba, lbu ba che bar 'byung ba zhig /
lus kyi sa chu'i khams 'phel ba las byung ba'i nad cig ste, nad rtags su kha zas mi 'ju ba dang, dpyi sked na ba, lus kyi drod nyams pa, dri chu sri'am snyi ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
'dzam gling 'di'i sa 'og nas dpag tshad lnga brgya song mtshams su 'phred nyal du gnas pa'i sems can dmyal ba/
lus kyi sa chu'i khams 'phel ba las byung ba'i grang ba'i nad kyis zin pa'i rtags su 'phar rtsa zhan pa dang, bying ba, rgud pa, bul ba, lhod pa, stong ba bcas 'phar tshul drug mchis so/
grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba
grang ba'i dmyal ba dang don gcig/
grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba brgyad
grang dmyal brgyad dang don gcig
bsil che ba'am, tsha ba las ldog pa/ gnam grang mo/ chu khol grang mo/ lto chas grang mo/ btung ba grang mo/
grang ba'i dmyal ba'i bsdus ming,
chu bur can dang, chu bur rdol, so tham tham pa, kyi hud zer, aa chu zer, autapala ltar gas pa, pad ma ltar gas pa, pad ma chen po ltar gas pa ste brgyad/
dngos chas mer ma bsregs par tsha la gtong ba'i thabs/
rngo sreg sogs ma byas pa'i bza' bya'i tshal grang mo/
rma kha gzha' ba rigs shig ste, rma kha drod dang bral zhing reg bya tshor ba med pa zhig /
1) grang ngad dam grang ngar/ 2) zil pa grang mo/
grang zug bsil ba'i nus shugs
/ sa cha de grang zug chen po 'dug /

kha zas ma zhu ba dwangs snyigs 'dres pa, dwangs ma'i lam du shor ba des khrag ngan rgyas te sha lpags la byer bas chu ser 'phel ba dang, chu ser de nyid thur du lhung zhing lus g.yo bar gyur pa la 'or zhes zer bas 'dir bad rlung grang ba dang bsdong ba'i 'or nad kyi ming/
1) grang ngad che ba'i rlung/ ston dus grang rlung ldang/ 2) pho ba'i me drod nyams pa'i grang ba dang rlung gnyis 'doms te zas mi 'ju zhing lto ba sbos pa dang, dpyi sked sogs na ba'i nad kyi ming/

phyi rol gyi bser bu'i rlung gis bus pa sogs ma yin par don med du lus grang shum byed pa'i rlung gi nad rtags shig / cham pa'i 'phrul gyis lus la grang shum rgyag pa/ gzugs por grang shum rgyag gi mi 'dug gam/
rlung bsil bu ldang tshul/ la khar slebs dus lhags pa grang si ri ri rgyag pa/
bsil ba'i tshor ba/ tsha ba che skabs shing sdong gi 'og tu bsdad na grang si le ba zhig yong gin 'dug /
bde sdug la nges pa med pa'i dpe/ dpyid nyi ring po la grang gsum dro gsum, mi tshe ring po la skyid gsum sdug gsum/
phye mar btul ba'i gser 'byug dus me la brten mi dgos pa zhig / lha skur grang gser byugs pa/
rlung grang mo/ lam bar du grang lhags chen po zhig thug pa/
'khyag lhang lhang/ lhags pa'i dkyil du phyin na grang lhang lhang byas yong/

brtsi bya'i grangs/ lan grangs/ thengs grangs/ 'bor grangs/ mdzub mo lnga la grangs ka mi thebs pa med/ mkho nges kyi dngos po'i grangs ka ma tshang ba/ nor phyugs gang yod kyi kha grangs zhib tu bsgrangs pa/ star gral du 'gro mi grangs bsgrigs pa/ sde tshan so so'i mi 'bor grangs bcad pa/ phar 'gro tshur yong gi 'bru dngul tshang ma'i rtsis grangs 'dren pa/ sa rdul ma gtogs de byings rtsis grangs su byar nus pa
'jal byed tshad gzhi'i ming gcig las med pa'i grangs ka, dper na, khal gcig gam rgya ma gsum lta bu/
'jal byed tshad gzhi'i ming yod pa'i grangs ka, dper na, le dbar gsum mam, smi lnga lta bu/
'jal byed tshad gzhi'i ming gnyis sam, mang po yod pa'i grangs ka, dper na, srang gsum zho do skar lnga dang, khal bdun bre lnga phul do lta bu/
'jal byed tshad gzhi'i ming med pa'i grangs ka, dper na, gcig gnyis gsum lta bu/

sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' zhig yin pa 'di'i ston pa ni ser skya'am dbang phyug nag po zer zhing, de nyid nyer lnga'i grangs kyi mtshan nyid shes pa las grol bar 'dod pas grangs can pa zhes brjod pa'i shes bya nyer lnga'i rnam bzhag bshad par bya ste, gtso bo dang, chen po dang, nga rgyal dang, gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste de tsam lnga dang, sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste 'byung ba lnga dang, ngag lag pa, rkang pa, rkub, 'doms kyi dbang po ste las kyi dbang po lnga dang, mig rna ba, sna, lce, pags pa'am lus kyi dbang po ste blo'i dbang po lnga dang, gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can yid kyi dbang po ste dbang po bcu gcig dang, bdag shes rig gi skyes bu ste nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/
mi rigs mang po yod pa'i rgyal khab nang gi mi grangs mang shos kyi mi rigs phud pa'i mi rigs gzhan rnams, rang rgyal du rgya rigs phud pa'i spun zla mi rigs gzhan la zer/
sngar las rtsol byed mkhan mi ser tsho'i skyel 'dren 'u lag 'gro thengs mang nyung rtsi byed du ngo la brgyab pa'i thel tse/
rnam dbye lnga pa'i nang gses/ gcig nas brgya'i bar/
grangs ka'i ming brda'am, tha snyad/
grangs 'bor che chung mtshon byed aang yig bkod sa gong 'og gi gnas/

sngar rgya gar gyi rtsis lud la grangs gnas kyi ming drug cu yod de, 1) gcig 2) bcu, 3) brgya, 4) stong, 5) khri, 6) 'bum, 7) sa ya, 8) bye ba, 9) dung phyur te dgu bo re re nas brtsis pas rkyang ba'i grangs gnas dgu dang 10) ther 'bum, 12) khrag khrig 14) rab bkram, 16) gtams, 18) dkrigs, 20) mi 'khrugs, 22) khyad 'byin, 24) spang rten, 26) ded 'dren, 28) mtha' snang, 30) rgyu rig 32) 'od mdzes, 34) dbang po, 36) legs 'byin, 38) rtogs 'gro, 40) 'bying rdul, 42) rgya rtags, 44) stobs 'khor, 46) bda shes, 48) rnam byung, 50) stobs mig 52) byams pa, 54) snying rje, 56) dga' ba, 58) btang snyoms te nyer lnga po chen po dang bcas gnyis re brtsis pas lnga bcu dang de'i steng du, 60) grangs med tha ma ste gcig bsnan pas drug cu'o/
grangs ka'i tshad dam khyon/ slob grwa ba'i grangs 'bor lon pa/
grangs gnas drug cu pa btang snyoms chen po bcu la, grangs med tha ma ste rang gi gong na drug cu'i gnas gzhan med pas na grangs med ces brjod pa ma gtogs grangs gtan nas med par byas pa ma yin no/
(aasamkhya) 1) chos mngon pa sod las byung ba'i grangs gnas che ba zhig / bskal pa grangs med pa gsum/ 2) grangs 'bor bgrang du med pa/
chad lus med pa gtsang dag 'bul ba/
snyan ngag don rgyan nang gi rim pa can gyi rgyan/
grangs rim pa can gyi rgyan
snyan ngag don rgyan nang gi rim pa can gyi rgyan/
grangs ka zhib rtsis byed pa/ grangs bsher gyis rtsis sprod/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brong pa rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
1. nye ba'i don/ 'gro grabs yod/ shor grabs/ 'chi grabs yod pa/ 2. sngon 'gro'i don/ gsol tshigs bsham rgyu'i grabs sgrig pa/ zhing pa tshos so nam gyi grabs byed pa/
lam bar du bza' rgyur bsdogs pa'i zas rigs/
mu ge sil ched du bsags pa'i za 'bru/
rgyab gnon dang rogs byed kyi dpung sde
gra sgrig gam sngon 'gro/ 'grul pa tshang mas phyogs 'gro'i grabs gshom byed kyin 'dug / lkog g.yo ngan jus kyi grabs gshom byed pa/
yul ming las btags pa'i snga dus bod kyi lha mo'i tshogs pa zhig yul de gtsang rnam gling rdzong na yod/
chu'i gram pa'i kha/ chu'i gram khar gos nyi mar bskams pa/
rdo hrug gis khengs pa'i thang/
rdo gram pa yod sa'i thang/

1. (tha mi dad pa) khyab pa'am 'thor ba/ gnag phyugs tshang ma ri la gram 'dug / nad gzhi pags par gram pa/ 2./ 1) chu nang gi rdo hrug gor ma/ chu 'gram gyi gram pa/ 2) chu chen bab pa'i shul/ chu phyin kyang gram pa sdod dgos/
chu song shul gyi rdo hrug /

star ram sbreng/ gral 'go/ gral sked/ gral mjug / bzhugs gral/ g.yas gral/ g.yon gral/ mi gral/ gral 'grig po/ sdod gral bsgrigs te sdod pa/ gral 'go nas gtam bshad na gral mjug tu nyan mkhan yod dgos/
rigs mtshungs sam khyu tsho 'dra ba/
sdod sa'i gral gnas mnyam gshib tu yod pa/
(rnying) bab la gzhigs pa'am lta ba/ gtam bshad na gral 'tshos/

1) star gcig gi snga phyi'i go rim/ rgan gzhon gral rim bzhin du bsgrigs pa/ gral rim ma 'khrugs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrigs chags su bkod pa dang, gral star, gral du sgrig pa, gral du bstar ba, phreng bkod pa, phreng ba, tshar du dngar, tshar ba, lu gu rgyud bcas so, 2) spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed brgyud rim nges can zhig gi nang la mi rnams kyis gnas bab mi 'dra ba re 'dzin gyi yod pa dang, thon skyed rgyu chas skor gyi 'brel ba mi 'dra ba re 'dzin gyi yod pa las phye ba'i tshogs khag la zer, gral rim ni thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs nas byung ba zhig yin, bran g.yog spyi tshogs nang gi bran bdag dang bran g.yog phyogs gnyis dang, bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nang gi zhing bdag dang zhing pa phyogs gnyis, ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang gi ma rtsa can dang bzo pa phyogs gnyis tshang ma phan tshun 'gran rgol du langs pa'i gral rim red, spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs la bshu gzhog gral rim de gral rim zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na de rtsa med du btang rjes gral rim 'thab rtsod de 'gal ba gtso bo ma yin pa zhig tu gyur, gung khran ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs la slebs na ma gtogs gral rim rtsa med du bzo mi thub/
gral gyi bar gseng chung du gtong ba/
gral du sdod pa'i bar gseng/
rigs sam sde tshan/ mtho gras/ bzo las kyi gras/
(rnying) 1) thog steng gi lan kan nam sgrom skyor/ 2) skas 'dzeg gi lag 'ju/

/ 1) gcod byed dam gtub byed kyi lag cha zhig / gri kha/ gri thung/ gri ring/ gri rtse/ gri shubs/ spu gri/ skra gri/ gri 'don rgya 'dre rgyag pa/ gri rno rdugs pa/ gri bsnun pa/ gri rtsed/ gri rub byed pa/ gri btsugs te bsad pa/ sha btsos btsos pa dang gri brdar brdar ba red/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgrol byed dang, rjes su gcod, dpal gyi snying po, mtshon cha'i gzhi bcas so, 2) nad med glo bur du shi ba'i rkyen la gri'i brdar 'dogs pa/ rta grir shi ba/ skom grir shi ba/ mtshon grir 'chi ba/ 'khyags grir shi ba/ ltogs grir shi ba
mchod rdzas shig ste mi 'thab grir shi ba'i klad pa/
yun nan zhing chen gyi 'ba' lung rdzong khongs su zla chu'i thog la btsugs pa'i lcags zam zhig /
gri khrag mchos rdzas shig ste
mtshon 'og tu shi ba'i mi'i khrag /
1) gri chung ngu/ 2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong gi ming rnying yin/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong khongs su yod/
1) gri kyog po zhig / 2) sngar gyi mtshon cha zhig

srib khri btsan po'i sras sngar bod rgyal stod kyi steng gnyis kyi gras shig yin pa 'di la sras sha khri dang, bya khri, nya khri dang sras mo gcig bcas yod cing, phyis blon po lo ngam rta rdzis bkrongs, bod du sku phung sa 'og tu sbas pa'i srol gyi 'go tshugs, rgyal po de'i ring la rgya nag gi go khrab smar khams brgyud bod la drangs/
gri'i yu ba/ snyob sar lag pa su ring dang, gcod sar gri mgo su ring ma byed/
gri'i leb bam ltag / gsad bya'i sems can gri lcag gis brdungs pa
sngar mi bsad pa'i gri la 'khri ba'i nyes chad/
gri so gnyis kyis sha 'dra gtub byed pa'i ming / gri gnyis kyis gri 'thag byas nas sha btsabs pa/
1) phan tshun gri kha bkye ba'am gri khyer nas 'dzing ba/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis gri 'thab ja yun tsam byas/ 2) (yul) jem rtse/
mi mang pos mi gcig la gri sdeb g.yug gam sdeb 'dzugs byed pa/
mchod rdzas shig ste, mi gri khar shi ba'i rus pa/
gri la khu tshur rdeg pa
nyen kha yod sar 'dzem mi shes pa'i dpe
mi dar ma nad med glo bur du grir shi ba'i sha ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas gnyan nad dang, srog rlung, rgyal gdon bcas la phan/
gris bzhogs pa'i ri mo shur can/

/ 1) dme btsog la brten nas 'byung ba'i nad cig / tsa lam hrengs nas grib phog pa/ 2) mi gtsang ba'i dme btsog / zas grib/ gos grib/ bag grib/ yugs grib/ dam grib/ nal grib/ mna' grib/ dmar grib/ 'khon grib/ ro grib/ 3) rsrib/
rlan can grib nag tu skam bcug pa/
gza' bdud r'a hu la yi grib ma phog par grags pa'i klad pa'i steng du khrag rtsa rdol nas glo bur du brgyal ba'i nad cig /
grib nad sel thabs byab khrus kyi ming/
grib ma'am grib nag gi gzugs brnyan/
grib nad sel thabs kyi mdos yas/
dogs pa skye mi dgos sar dogs pa skyes pa/
lag pa snying gar bzhag ste gnyid khug na 'jigs skrag skye ba'i 'khrul snang gi rmi lam/
lag pa snying gar bzhag ste gnyid khug na lus sems mnan nas byung ba'i 'khrul snang ste sngar gyi bshad srol ltar gnod pa skyel ba'i gdon rigs shig gis byas pa red ces zer/
ri'i byang ngos nyi 'od phog dka' ba'i sa cha/

yan lag gi kha dog brgyad kyi gras nang gi gzugs mthong ba la mi sgrib pa'i kha dog nag po, gzugs kyi grib ma lta bu nang na yod pa'i gzugs mig la snang thub pa'o/ shing gi grib ma/ nyi ma nub mtshams ri rtse'i grib ma slebs pa/ la 'go yi nyi ma, la rting gi grib ma/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa/ grags pa ngan pa grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par 'gyur ba/
grib ma bsil zhing shin tu bag phebs pa'i don/ ljon shing bzang po'i grib ma snum por ngal gso ba/
1) nyi grib las dus tshod lta byed...2) grib gzugs kyi ring thung gi tshad/
thur grib kyi nyi ma'i grib ma/ nyi ldog gi grib gzugs 'gyur ba/
1) gnam gyi dgu tshigs/ 2) ri'i srib kyi 'gro lam/
grib las byung ba'i mig gi ling tog /
grib skyon gyis mig 'grib pa'i long skyon/
gtsang mar btsog grib kyi skyon shor ba/
grib ma...nyi ma phar phar 'gro dus grib so tshur tshur slebs byung/ khang pa btsigs thog mang yang, grib so sa la 'bab dogs/ ri bo chen po'i grib so dang, rkyal gog chen po'i zhabs ra/
grib btsog sel thabs byas pa/
(tha mi dad pa) dam por 'gyur ba'i don/ thag pa bsgril nas grim par 'gyur/ tsid skud grim dka' ba/ bal skud grim sla ba/
/ 1) thang po dang, gsal po'am spyang po/ sku grim po/ rig pa grim po/ lag pa grim po/ 2) lhod po'i ldog phyogs sam ldog zla/ thag pa grim po/ lag rtsa 'phar stangs grim po/
dam lhug / rig pa grim lhod 'tsham po/
bsgril nas ril por gyur pa'i dbyibs/ shog gril/ ras gril/ gyon pa rnams gril kha rgyag pa/

/ 1) chu las sgrol byed gzings/ shing gru/ ko gru/ gru gla/ gru thag / gru thogs pa/ gru thog rim can/ skya ba brgyab ste gru skul ba/ dngos chas mang pos gru brgyangs pa/ skya bas gru 'phul kyang 'gro mi thub pa/ gtsang chu'i gzhung du gru btang/ chu'i 'bab rgyun dal sar thag pas gru rtod pa/ dbyar chu rgyas nas gru tshugs pa/ 2) zur/ khang pa'i gru/ lcog tse gru bzhi ma/
khang pa'i zur du 'dzugs rgyu'i skas/
gru skyod byed skya ba ste shing leb yu ba can zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la skya ba dang, skyod byed, gru skul, gru yi gshog pa, gru'i yan lag g.yob byed bcas so,
1) lag pa bskums pa'i gru mo'i khug / 2) zur khug
gru gtong mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la skya ba 'dzin dang, mnyan pa, gdos pa, rna ba 'dzin bcas so,
1) skud pa'i gong bu/ 2) sngar bod byang rgyud dang, shin cang, mtsho sngon bcas kyi sa 'brel khul du chags pa'i rgyal phran zhig /
1) lag pa'i gru mo'i mgo'am sne/ 2) gru'i mgo/

'phyugs par 'dod pa'i lugs nang gses gling bzhi dus bzhi 'khor bar 'dod pa'i lugs de la'ang mkha' la khyim dang sar dus bzhi gnyis ka g.yon skor du 'dod pa dang, dus g.yon khyim g.yas dang, gnyis ka g.yas skor du 'dod pa bcas gsum yod/
char 'jam po/ yul gru kun la gru char bab/
sde tshan sde tshan du bcad pa'i re'u mig /
sems gcig mi tshang ma bsam blo gcig pa
ko gru rgyong byed kyi shing/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi smar khams rdzong khongs 'bri chu'i gru kha zhig yin/
lag ngar dang dpung pa'i bar gyi tshigs 'bur/ gru mo'i chu ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la nye ba'i dpung pa'o,
gru mo'i rus pa'i lhu mtshams/
1) gru pa sdod sa/ 2) ko gru gtong sa/
(potalaka) spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas mchog cig /
gru'i nang du 'jug rgyu'i dngos po/
1) ngos bzhi che chung snyom pa'i dngos po/ 2) rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas klad skyon gso, chu ser skem/
mtha' bzhi'i ring thung cha snyoms pa'i bzo dbyibs shig /
khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi ma/
zur bzhi yod pa'i dbyibs nar mo/
bka' gdams pa'i bshad tshul zhig ste, sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad cha tshang bar gdams ngag tu go ba lon pa/
mtho dma' zheng dkyus tshang ma gcig pa yin pa sho lta bu'i dbyibs/
1) gru dang zam pa'i bsdus ming/ 2) gru mang po gshibs sgrig gis bzos pa'i zam pa/ 3) gru dang skam sa'i bar gtsugs pa'i rkang zam/
chu bo las sgrol byed shing gi gru/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgrol byed, chu yi shing rta, rta mgo can, rtags gsum pa, pha mthar sgrol, gzings, seng ge can bcas so,
gru shan gtong sa'i chu kha'am chu 'gram/
gru sa la 'byar skabs 'phul rgyag gtong byed kyi rgyug pa ring po/
rta bong sogs kyi 'phongs mgo/ rta la grug shur thon pa/

(tha mi dad pa) grugs pa, grug pa, ,1) chag grum du 'gyur ba/ dkar yol kyi kha grugs song/ rdo grug yong / 'bras grugs pa/ 'bru grugs pa/ 2) lus kyi skyi spags la grang ngad phog nas rtsub por 'gyur ba/ lag pa grug pa/ gdong ngo grug pa/
chag por gyur pa'i snod spyad/
/ 1) spyang po/ mi de spyang grung gnyis 'dzoms shig 'dug / grung zon gnyis ldan/ khyo phyug chung ma grung, bal 'jam snam bu legs/ 2) nus pa dang ldan pa/ sa bon grung po/ me grung po/

mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ grub chen au rgyan pa mtshan dngos rin chen dpal zhes grags, rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags stag lo la 'khrungs shing rab byung lnga pa'i sa byi lo karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rje karma pa pakisha'i skye srid du ngos 'dzin pa po yin/
grub thob kyi mchog ste mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i skyes bu chen po
grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ma/
grub pa thob pa ste sngags lugs kyi grub pa'i dngos grub brgyad gang rung sogs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa/
grub pa thob pa'i rtags mtshan/
lam rtogs khyad par can mngon du brnyes te mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i gang zag /
mkhas grub khyung po ste shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi srol 'byed pa po/
(siddhanta:) phyi nang gi chos lugs so so'i lta ba 'dzin tshul te rang gi blo ngor gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum sogs gzhung dang, rigs pas bsgrubs nas grub par thag bcad pa'i lta tshul lam, gzhung lugs/
dbu ma pa dang sems tsam pa gnyis so/

grub mtha'i rnam bshad rang gzhan grub mtha' kun dang zab don mchog tu gsal ba kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma lung rigs rgya mtsho skye dgu'i re ba kun skong zhes bya ba dus rabs bcu bdun par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'o
rang gi blo ngor lung dang rigs pas don gyi gnas tshul yang dag par grub pa'i tshul de rigs pa'i lam nas smra ba las gzhan du 'da' bar mi byed pa/
sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba dang, sangs rgyas pa ma yin pa'i grub mtha' smra ba gnyis so/
theg pa che chung gi grub mtha' smra ba bzhi ste bye brag smra ba, mdo sde pa, sems tsam pa, dbu ma pa bcas so/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste thog mar ston pa byon tshul rags rim gyis khog dbub, phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' brgal te dgag gzhir bzhag ston pa'i bstan pa thun mong dang thun min theg pa'i bye brag 'phags chos du ma'i sgo nas bsgrubs te dpyad bzod par 'grel ba rim khang brgyad yod pa 'di ni dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/
bye brag smra ba dang mdo sde pa gnyis so/
grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa
rigs pas sbyar ba'i gzhung lugs la ma brten par rang dgar tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba'o/
tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin par rang gi blo ngor 'thad pas sbyar ba'i gzhung lugs la brten nas dngos po'i gnas tshul la dpyad nas blang dor byed pa/
grub rtsis kyi tshes kyi longs spyod/

kyi rdzas gcig chos gnyis po mnyam skye: mnyam gnas kyi skye gnas 'jig gsum dus mnyam zhing chos de gnyis kyi rdzas yin khyab mnyam yang yin de gnyis phan tshun gcig snang ba'i mngon sum la gcig shos kyang snang dgos pa'o/
gzhi gcig gi steng gi ldog pa rigs mi: mtshungs pa rnams mnyam skye mnyam gnas kyi skye gnas 'jig gsum dus mnyam zhing rdzas gcig pa yin pa
1. 'grub pa'i 'das pa, 2. (siddhi) dngos grub/ 3. (yul) dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig grogs shig / zhal lag mchod grub pa yin nam

rgyud kyi lam gyi mngon rtogs spyod pa'i sgo bzhi'i nang gses te, lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i rig 'dzin nam mkha' spyod grub nas, de'i rten la sngags kyi phyin drug gi spyod pa spyad de mthar thug gi 'bras bu lha'i sku gsung thugs dang mnyam par sbyor bas rigs gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'o/
mdo sngags gang rung gi rtogs pa mchog: brnyes pa'i gang zag /
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan, skye ba'i yan lag dang, rga shi'i yan lag ni 'gro ba tha dad pa'i skye ba sogs mngon par grub pas grub pa'i yan lag gnyis so/
las ka byas nas byung ba'i 'bras bu/ dka' las brgyab nas grub 'bras thob pa/ grub 'bras 'od stong 'bar ba zhig thob 'dug /
dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las dngos su bstan pa'i skar rtsis la grub mtha'i rtsis zhes bya'o, grub rtsis 'di la lugs mang ste phug lugs dang, mtshur phu lugs, dga' ldan rtsis gsar sogs yod/
1) mang po gcig tu bsdus nas grub pa'i gzugs/ 2) brtsis tshar nas bab pa'i grangs kyi ri mo/
blo ngor tshad mas grub zin pa dang, don la tshad ma'i bsal ba zhugs pa'o/

1. (tha mi dad pa) grums pa, grum pa, ,1) chag pa'am, zhig pa/ rdza khog grums nas chu 'dzags/ rkang chag lag grums/ 2) nyams pa'am brtsed pa/ rta 'di thag ring du btang nas chad de grums 'dug / 2. srog chags kyi rigs shig /
srong brtsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa gtsang lha rtse khul du yod pa mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /

'bab chu zhig chu 'go hi ma la ya'i rgyud kyi byang ngos nas byung, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khang dmar rdzong gi dbus rgyud nas byang ngos rgyal rtse rdzong du 'bab cing, myang chu'i yan lag cig yin/
srog chags grum pa'i pags pa/

rlan can gyi yul du rgyun ring sdod pa sogs kyis rkyen byas nas tshigs mig gi chu ser 'phel nas bad kan 'byor byed kyi byed las nyams pas tshigs kun chag grum shor ba ltar na ba la grum bu zhes zer te, nang gses su dbye na sha trem dang, rus trem, rtsa trem, chu trem, trem dkar, trem nag bcas rigs drug mchis so/
bad kan rigs drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, nad rtags pho mchin mi bde zhing, kha zas 'khru skyugs byed pa, nywa bzhi mig rus sogs na nas mjug tu grum bur 'gyur ba'i nad cig
gdan gyi bye brag dre'u rngog /
thag gru 'then byed kyi thag pa
cog gru gzings thog tu 'dzugs rgyu'i dar cog /
1) gru'i rlung g.yab 'gel sa'i shing/ 2) gru'i dar lcog bsgar sa'i shing/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur zhugs te chu'i rgyun phyogs sam ldog phyogs gang rung la rgyang grags kyi sar phyin pa'o/
(rnying) blo 'khel ba'i phan thogs pa'am gdeng thub pa/

(kumbhanda:) gnod sbyin gyi rigs shig ste rgya mtsho'i nang du gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gzugs mi'i dbyibs dang 'dra la, mgo bo srog chags sna tshogs kyi mgo can, rkang lag gi gru mo dang rna ba'i steng du sha'i ral ba yod pa zhig /
grul bum zhes pas btang ba'i gdon te, nad rtags su ngo nag la dal bar 'gro zhing rlig pa skrang ba zhig /
gnod sbyin gyi bdag po zhig /
gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po zhig /
gnag phyugs kyi lo na rgan gzhon lta ba'i rwa co'i ris 'khor/
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la skyes pa dang, rta chung, 'tsho ba bcas so,
skad dam ngag gi nyams/ yid 'ong snyan pa'i gre 'gyur des, khu byug skad snyan zil gyis mnan/
gre ba tsha zhing skad 'dzer ba sogs 'byung ba zhig
aol grong dang mid pa'i mgor gnas pa'i skad kyi gdangs dang, dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug 'byung ba'i rten byed pa zhig / gre ba bde po/ gre ba 'gags pa/
pho gdon gyi bye brag cig /
mo gdon gyi bye brag cig /
glo gsang rgyag pa ste, mid pa bde po bzo ba/
'grem pa'i skul tshig 'bri srol gzhan zhig
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nub ngos su yod/
mon gyi sran ma'i bye brag cig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su rigs gsum mchis, ro tsha, nus pa 'bras bus srin gsod, me tog gis mig gsal, glang thabs 'joms/
'bru rigs shig / dgun gro/ gro snye/ gro lpags/ gro rkyal/ ming gi rnam grangs la yid bzang dang yid legs so,
rta drel gang rung spu mdog sngo la dkar shas che tsam yod pa/
lam rgyags/ gro kha'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms na thag ring du 'gro mi thub/
rta drel sogs kyis bskor te gro zhib 'thag sa'i khang pa/
shing stag pa'am shing ltag pa'i shun pa/
rta dkar po sngo shas che ba/
brdungs te leb mo bzos pa'i gro
gro chag las bzos pa'i thug pa/
(yul) gro btags pa'i phye ma'am gro zhib/
phyogs 'grul skabs lam rgyags kyi dmigs rten dngul dang dngos rdzas/
lo tog gro nas kyi snye mar chags nas 'bru rdog thal ba nag por 'gyur ba'i nad cig /
ngo la nag thig chung chung mang po yod pa
1) lam du tsha phogs rgyag pa/ 2) gro'i zhing khar son 'debs pa/
gro zhib btags nas thon pa'i shun lpags/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs gro mo'i spyi khyab/
gro'i snye ma'i shun lpags phub ma/
spu kha dkar nag 'dres pa'i rta/
lho brag gro bo lung ste, bod rang skyong ljongs lho brag rdzong khongs kyi sa cha mar pa lo rtsa 'khrungs yul/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas tsha 'khru gcod/ gro ma gting la med na gro lo kha la mi thon/
phyogs 'grul gyi lam rgyags bza' mar/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud na yod, 'di'i shar ngos 'brug yul dang nub ngos 'bras ljongs dang sa 'brel yin, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de shar gsing mar yod/
rta drel spu mdog sngon po dmar shas phran bu yod pa/
1) gro brngos te btags pa'i rtsam pa/ 2) (yul) phyogs 'grul gyi lam rgyad rtsam pa/
mtsho sngon zhing chen lu'o tu'u rdzong du yod pa'i dgon pa dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus 'go la t'a ming gong mas btab pa zhig /
gro zhib zhib btags pa'i phye ma/ gro zhib bsnyal nas chil man mog mog bzo ba/
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nang gses shig / ming gi rnam grangs la 'phrog byed dang bon po'o,
1) hor zla bdun pa/ 2) 'dul ba las hor zla drug pa'i bcu drug nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i bar du gro bzhin zla ba zer
1) gro zhib btsos ma dang, mar, phyur ba, bu ram sogs mnyam du brdzis pa'i bza' bya/ 2) gro zhib brdzis te bzos pa'i zas/
1) gro kha'am lam rgyags/ 2) gro'i rigs kyi zas/

mtshan dngos blo gros 'byung gnas, gzhon nu'i dus jo bo rje dang 'brom ston las bka' gdams kyi chos gsan, rngog lo'i slob ma'i gras las gsung rab kun la mkhas par grags, jo bo'i gzhung chung rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa la don khog 'ching ba'i tika ? dang, bstan rim che chung gnyis mdzad, bstan rim chen mo ni lam sgron gyi dgongs 'grel zla med yin pas rje tsong kha pa'i lam rim chen mo yang phal cher 'di dang mthun par mdzad/

bod du lo gsar sogs rten 'brel gyi byed sgo'i skabs su sgrig gshom byed pa'i gro yos dang phye mar 'bo nang du blugs nas de'i thog tu gro snye dang me tog sogs btsugs shing, mgron po phebs dus de phul nas dga' bsu sne len zhu/
/ 1) gad 'obs/ ngam grog / chu grog / 2) glo bur du byung ba'i bza' btung ngam longs spyod/ kha grog / grog byung ba/ grog che thag chod byung/
zas nor sogs yong ba'i ltas su pho rog dang bya khra'i skad/
1) srog chags grog ma'i sked pa/ 2) ngam grog gi sked pa/
1) 'bu grog ma'i tshang/ 2) grog ma'i brun/
sngar rgya gar gyi drang srong zhig grog ma'i mkhar du dka' thub grub pas ming de btags/
grog mo'i nang nas 'bab pa'i chu/
stes dbang gis thob pa'i nor rdzas che ba/
skyes bu'i 'phar rtsa la brtags nas rnyed pa dang, nor 'tshol gyi lam 'gro yod med brtag thabs shig /
grog mkhar yod sar rtsam pa dang mar mnyam du bsres pa'i phye mar grog mar sbyin pa'i srol/
grog ma dang sbrang bu'i bsdus ming/
'bu srin gyi rigs shig / ming gi rnam grangs la rgyu rgyu ra dang, gshin rje'i bu, srin phra ma bcas so,
shing rigs za mkhan gyi grog ma gnod can/
chus bshal ba'i g.yang rong ngam, ri sul/ grog mo skam por nya rgya btsugs/
'bu grog ma'i tshang/ ltad mo ba grog tshang rdol ba ltar 'dus/ ming gi rnam grangs la grog mkhar dang, grog ma'i khyim, brgya byin spyi bo, nor ldan brtsegs bcas so,
grog rong g.yang sa gzar po/
sa cha grog rong g.yang gzar can/

mchod rten dang, gyang rnying sogs kyi ldebs su char pa phog nas spang gi rnam pa ltar gyur pa de la zer te, des dugs byas na rma rnying pa dang, tshigs steng skrangs pa, chu ser gyi za 'phrug lang ba sogs la phan/
chu log gis sa gshong rong shar shur du bzos pa'i ming/
ra mda'am rogs ram/ gdong grogs/ nad pa skyor grogs byed pa/ ye ge 'bri grogs zhu/ grogs su sbron pa/ khengs skyung zhes pa yar rgyas kyi grogs su 'gro ba zhig yin/ bsam pa bzang pos grogs byed pa/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed rogs ram gyi phan tshig brjod pa'i zol gyis shugs la 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
bza' zla gtan grogs kyi skal ba/
spun ltar brtse ba'i grogs po/
rogs ram/ las don byed skabs phan tshun grogs dan byed dgos,
'byung rtsis nang dgra la brten nas grogs rtsi ba/ shing grogs sa/ sa grogs chu/ chu grogs me/ me grogs lcags/ lcags grogs shing/
yid mthun pa'am mdza' ba'i mi/ grogs po rnying pa/ grogs po blo thub/ grogs po mdza' ba/ grogs gsar/ stongs grogs/ sdongs grogs/ grogs su 'thams pa/
spun ltar mdza' ba'i mi/ kho tsho dang nga tsho grogs po grogs mched yin/
rogs med pa'i kher rkyang/ ma rabs spyod ngan kho na byas te grogs med gcig pur lus pa/
sdug bsngal drug gi nang gses shig
grogs po bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun spyod mtshungs dang, na mnyam ma, pho nya mo, blo dkar ma, zla ma bcas so,
dmag rgyag skabs phan tshun rogs ram byed pa'i dmag
ma bu dgra grogs 'byung ba brtsis nas rtsa brtag skabs shing grogs sa lta bu grogs dang 'phrad pa de la grogs rtsa zhes zer/
blo bkal chog pa'i grogs po/

/ 1) them dud dam mi tshang/ 2) mi tshang gang 'tshams shig mnyam du chags pa'i sde/ brgya grong/ stong grong/ grong khang/ grong stod/ grong smad/ grong dkyil/ ming gi rnam grangs la grong sde dang, rgyal lam, sde tsho, yul sde bcas so,
grong khyer nang yod pa'i sdod gnas khang pa/
grong khyer nang gi khyim tshang/

las rigs mang po 'dzoms pa'i sde ste sngar gyi bshad srol du lcags bzo sogs bzo ba'i rigs bco brgyad tshang ba'i yul/ grong khyer ba/ grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs/ grong khyer che chung/ grong khyer lte ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyong byed dang, 'jigs med gnas, pho brang 'khor mi bskyod gnas, mi grong, srung byed bcas so,
rgyal phran nam yul gyi bdag po/

sdug ri rab kyi rtse mo de'i dbus na grong: khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba ngos re re la dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgya pa mtha' skor na dpag tshad khris 'khor ba yod cing de'i 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis gyen du 'phags pa gser gyi rang bzhin dbyibs legs shing lta na sdug pa rin po che'i ka ba drug khri yod pa, rin po che sna bzhi'i zam pa brgyud ma bzhi dang, nang gi sa gzhi tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bkra bar byas pa mnan na nem zhing btegs na 'phar ba me tog man da ra bas pus nub tsam du khebs pa zhig yod do/
dud tshang gcig las med pa'i grong/
khyim pa'i nang la tshugs pa'i zhabs brtan cho ga
chos bton pa'i yon la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan/
'khrig spyod/ bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa/
grong la rnam shes 'jug pa:/ rgyal bu'i gdung la grong 'jug byas nas rang gi phung po chu bor bskyur ba/
(mngon) 1) khyab 'jug / 2) brgya byin/ 3) ngang pa spyi/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtsa mda' rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod, mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5611 yod/
grong khyim du mtshams bcad de bsnyen sgrub byed pa/
mi nor med pa'i grong khang stong pa/
grong thag nye ba'i dgon pa/
grong du rgyu ba'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, rang grong gzhan du rgyu ba la brten nas, dge 'dun spyi'i gdugs tshod las yol ba'o
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim du gung yol nas sang gi skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du gnas pa'o/
bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sngar nas 'khri srol yod med la ma ltos par khyim tshang drag rigs tshang mar dmigs bsal 'phar ma'i dmag mi skong 'dems byas pa'i dmag sgar zhig /
sngar gyi bshad srol ltar na grong chung chung min pa grong khyer las chung ba, bzo tshong mang tsam 'dzoms yod pa'i grong sde/
mi tshang mang po yod pa'i grong/
/ 1) phan tshun 'dabs 'brel du chags pa'i mi tshang/ grong pa stongs pa/ 2) khyim mtshes/ grong pa khyim mtshes/ thag ring gi gnyen las grong pa'i dgra dga'/ 3) grong la gtan du sdod pa'i mi/
grong khyim khag gam sde tshan/
grong pa khyim mtshes pa/ grong gzhis, grong gseb nang du chags pa'i khyim tshang/
sngar dus rtag tu gzhung las la 'gro mi dgos pa'i tshem bu ba'i tshogs pa/
grong khyer nas lam thag ring tsam yod pa'i zhing las sa khul gyi grong tsho/
grong gseb la gtan sdod byed mkhan/
gsus pa/ grod khog che ba/ grod khog chung ba/ grod khog ltogs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dku, dgang bya, lto ba, pho ba, brang zhol, gsus pa bcas so,
grod pa lug pa'am 'phyang ba/ ba lang grod khog lhug ge ba/
lus kyi sha rgyags pa las byung ba'i lto ba lhug lhug tu 'phyang ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la rked sbom dang, lto ldir, lto 'phyang ba, gsus po che, gsus rdzing can bcas so,
ldad rgyag mkhan gnag phyugs sogs kyi nang khrol zhig / blo phyi gtad, grod pa nang gtad/
nor phyugs kyi grod pa'i nang du btums pa'i mar ril sogs/
'gro song chung ba/ gron chung khu sdud/ gron chung las brtson/
/ 1) zad pa'am chud zos/ 'gro gron/ 2) don med kyi 'gro sgo/ re gron/ zas gron/
rten 'brel byed skabs bzhugs khri dang gdan gyi thog la gro'i 'bru rnams star du 'then pa'i g.yung drung gi ri mo/
las grwa grol ba'am, zin pa'i nyin mo/
las don gang rung grub mtshams kyi dga' ston/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) zhig pa/ sbrul mdud rang grol/ tshogs 'du grol ba/ las grwa grol ba/ las khungs grol ba/ slob grwa grol ba/ gcig shes kun grol/ 2) thar ba/ nad gzhi las grol ba/ sdug bsngal las grol ba/ srog gi nyen kha las grol ba/ 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba/ 2. 1) tshigs bcad rtsom tshul zhig ste, sho lo ka gcig gis brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de rdzogs par ston nus pa/ 2) 'das sam thar pa/ grol ba thob pa/
(mngon)1) sman na le sham/ 2) mu tig /
grol ba yongs su rdzogs pa
phyogs thams cad las rnam par grol ba ste nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis kyi cha las legs par thar ba/
'bu dmar dang 'dra ba rgyu ma'i zhar skyes 'bu zhig
ka dag khregs chod kyi gdams pa rig pa chos skur grol ba'i tshul chen po bzhi ste, ye grol, rang grol, gcer grol, mtha' grol rnams so/

phan tshun bsam 'char bsdur ba'i gtam/ thon skyed byed rgyu'i gros gleng ba/ tshong zog khyon 'bor che tsam sgrub rgyu'i gros gcom pa/ phan tshun rogs ram byed rgyu'i gros 'chams pa/ gros thag bcad pa/ yul lugs cha ston gyi gros 'debs pa/ gang dga' ci legs kyi gros 'dri ba/
gros sdur bya rgyu'i don rtsa'i gzhi ma/ gros 'go rtsom/
gcig gyur byung ba'i gros don/
gros kha mthun pa/ gros dan chod yig /
thun mong nas gros sdur bya rgyu'i nang don/ gros don go rim/
las don gyi skad cha go sdur/ las don byed stangs skor la phan tshun gros sdur byed pa/
gros ma byas na'ang bsam pa gcig tu mthun pa/
gros sdur byed sa'i rogs pa/

/ 1) bya ba gang yang rung ba zhig byed sa'i gnas sam sde tshan/ slob grwa/ 'dzin grwa/ chos grwa/ rtsod grwa/ las grwa/ bzo grwa/ sman grwa/ rtsis grwa/ klog grwa/ 'don grwa/ sgom grwa/ sngags grwa/ 'dul grwa/ 2) zur/ khang pa'i grwa/ gos kyi grwa/
rtsod grwa khag tu bskyod nas dogs gcod bgro gleng byed mkhan/
sngar grwa khongs su 'jug pa'i btsun khral/
1) grwa pa rang lo rgan pa/ 2) sgrigs zhugs snga ba/
gzungs chen grwa lnga'i bsdus ming,
grwa tshang nas gtong ba'i ja/
snam sbyar gyi grwa rtags te dung dang, padma, shing lo, nor bu sogs/
grwa pa'i mi rabs rgan gzhon
rab byung brgyad pa'i chu 'brug lo la thu mi lhun grub bkra shis kyis btab pa'i dgon pa lho kha'i yar klungs gtsang po'i lho'i ri ldebs su yod pa zhig /
skya sar bab pa ste rab byung gi tshul khrims nyams pa'am yar phul nas khyim du log pa/
chags rten med cing 'gro bde sdod bde'i rab byung/

mtshan gzhan shes rab rgyal ba'am dbang phyug 'bar te, rab byung dang po ma shar ba'i sngon gyi chu pho byi ba'i lo la g.yo ru la sku 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas bsam yas kyi chos grwar byon, klu mes kyi mkhan bu yam shud rgyal ba 'od las rab tu byung, mtshan dbang phyug 'bar zhes btags, rang gi khu bo zhang ston chos 'bar las mdo sngags kyi chos skor dang gso ba rig pa, pha dam pa sangs rgyas las zhi byed skor, kha che pan chen zla ba mgon po las sbyor drug gi gdams pa sogs gsan, yul grwa la 'khrungs pas grwa pa dang, chos mngon pa la mkhyen rgya rgyas pas mngon shes zhes grags par gyur, khyad par du bsam yas dbu rtse'i bar khang gi ka ba bum pa can gyi 'og nas gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ma dpe sa pho stag lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nam phyed chu tshod gsum par gter nas gdan drangs shing dpe las bshus te phyi mo rang gnas su bzhugs, bu dpe lo gcig gsang ste phyis su yar lung gi dge bshes khu ston dbus pa dar ma grags pa la gnang, gra nang gi mdar dpal gra thang gi chos grwa chen po phyag btab gsung rtsom du rgyud kyi bsdus don sogs bstan bcos sna tshogs brtsams, dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu'i thog dgongs pa gshegs/
grwa pa rdab be rdob be
1) grwa pa lo tshod che min chung min/ 2) dpe cha mi lta ba'i yang yeng can/
grwa pa mtshan nyid slob gnyer ba/
grwa shag so sor ja 'thung ba'i shing phor/
rab tu byung ran pa'i mi tshang ma grwa pa byed du 'jug pa'i khral/
ste dmag 'gro mtshon cha 'khyer ba'i grwa: pa
dge 'dun sde tshogs kyi tshan khag cung zad che ba/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang/ sngags pa grwa tshang/ dus 'khor grwa tshang/ shar rtse grwa tshang/ byang rtse grwa tshang/ ser byes grwa tshang/
grwa tshang la gtong sgo btang nas dmigs bsal dbang cha blangs pa'i grwa pa/
1) grwa pa 'dus pa'i tshogs pa/ 2) grwa pa mang nyung gi tshad/ de'i skabs su grwa tshang nang la grwa tshogs rgyas po 'dug /
lo na gzhon pa'i grwa pa'am, sgrigs zhugs phyi ba/
hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer gsum nyin, smon lam gtor rgyab rta dmag lnga brgya dang, gzims pa sogs tshang min grangs bsher gtong ba'i brtsi gzhag gi byed sgo zhig
grwa pa'i gzugs brnyan nam cha byad/
grwa chas gyon pa'i skya bo/
sngar dgon pa khag gi grwa tshang ngam, grwa pa'i ru ba/
ban log gam skya babs pa'i grwa pa
phyogs mang nas dge 'dun pa 'dus te chos lugs kyi gzhung dang rig gnas sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum byed yul gyi dgon pa/
las ka byas par sprod rgyu'i thob skal/ 'tshem gla/ las gla blangs pa/
gla lpags mnyes ma'i rgyun bu/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas skad 'gags pa dang, glo ba'i tshad pa, rgyu tshad sogs la phan/
las ka byas pa'i gla dang lto gnyis dngul sogs la sgril ba/
las ka'i gla dang rngan pa/
las ka byas pa'i gla thob/ ming gi rnam grangs la khur gla dang, khur rngan, khur ba'i rin, gla yon, dge sgrub gla, rngan pa, rnyed pa, bya dga', mtshar dga', gzengs bstod, yon, rin, las gla bcas so,
mdo smad chab mdo brgyud nas 'bab pa'i chu bo zla chu'i ming gi zur chag / zla...gla...
gla chas dang lto chas/ gla lto'i mthun rkyen/ gla lto yog pa gzan sgril gyis sprad pa/
las gla'i tshad dam thang gzhi/
las ka byas pa'i gla'i thob cha/
gla pa byed mkhan te rang gi lus stobs btsongs nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan/
las gla dngul dang bza' rten 'bru sogs/
ri dwags gla ba'i phru gu

1.(tha dad pa) glas pa, gla ba, glos, ,dngul sogs sprad nas bed spyad chog pa'i dbang cha nyo ba/ rta drel gla ba/ sdod khang gla ba/ 2. 1) dri zhim rtsi ldan gyi ri dwags shig / gla lpags/ gla mche/ ming gi rnam grangs la
dri bzang dbang po, rlung bsregs, sa lus bcas so, 2) shing zhig /
(rnying) gleng mo/ gla bo drin du gcags pa ste, gleng mo gang byung ba rnams thugs la btags pa/
gla spu'i nang tshangs can gyi 'bol gdan/
gla pa byed mkhan/ gla mi glo bur ba/
(rnying) gla dang btsas gnyis gla cha'i don gcig / gla btsas kyis 'grul pa gtser ba/

rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad dang, mchin nad, mkhal ma'i gnyan tshad, srin nad, gnyan rims bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la lte ba'i dri dang, dri chen lte ba, dri'i rtsi, dri yi gos can, dri yi thod, 'doms kyi ngad rtsi, sbrul skrag byed, sbrul dug myos pa'i mtshan ma, ri dwags 'chang, ri dwags lte ba, ri dwags rtsi bcas so,
si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi zung chu rdzong gi la zhig /
1) las ka'i gla za mkhan/ 2) gla mi'i zas/
gla dang rin pa'i bsdus ming/
mo lcags kyu ltar gug cing rno la spu mdog: dud kha can gyi bya zhig / lu gu bya glag gis khyer na skad rgyag sa nam mkha'i mthongs las med

/ 1) dus tshod dang skabs mtshams/ khom glags med pa/ lta glags med pa/ khyim du sdod glags med pa/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la glags rnyed dka' bar gyur/ 2) thabs/ sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa/ zhe 'khon bzod glags med pa/
1) pha rol po nyams nyes thub pa'i dus skabs 'tshol ba/ 2) khag 'dogs sa'i gnad 'tshol ba/
1) 'gran zla byed thub pa, ..2) pha rol pham par byas pa
1) go skabs byung ba/ 2) 'gran zla byed thub pa/
/ 1) ba lang pho/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyu mchog dang, 'gro byed, stobs ldan bzang po, 'dren byed, bzang po bcas so, 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / chu glang/
khrus rdzas te, rgya skad du y'i rtsi/
che chung ngam, bzang ngan mnyam sbrel gyi dpe/ mi tsho'i lus stobs bzang ngan glang sker bel btags bzhin mnyam sbrel sgrigs 'dzugs byas pa/
khyim bcu gnyis kyi gnyis pa, khyim zhag nyi bar smin drug steng du slebs nas chu tshod bco lnga 'das nas glang khyim la slebs/
glang chen ma thul ba'am, dul ma min pa/
1) glang gog gi sgal pa/ 2) glang gis khyer ba'i do rgyab/ 3) dkyil 'khor rta babs kyi bang rim zhig /
skam sar gnas pa'i sems can che shos rna ba che la sna ha cang ring ba zhig / glang chen gyis ma theg pa'i khur de bong bus ga nas 'khur thub/ glang chen la tsher ma zug pa ltar gyur/
bod rang skyong ljongs mnga' ris sa khul khongs rtsa mda' rdzong gi chu zhig ste rgya gar chu bo gang ga zhes pa'i chu 'go /
glang po che las byung ba'i gi wam ste, gi wam rigs thams cad kyi nang nas nus pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig
si khron zhing chen ao me rdzong gi lho nub na yod cing, rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad smi 3099 yod pa dang, krung go'i nang pa'i chos lugs kyi gnas mchog cig /
sngo sman dpa' bo chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
glang chen mchog mche ba drug ldan/
1) glang po che smyon pa/ 2) dug shas che ba'i sngo rigs shig /
lha yul gyi glang chen lus dkar la yan lag bdun legs par gnas pa mgo dmar ba mche ba drug ldan dbang po dang nye dbang rnams kyi bzhon par gyur pa zhig /
sa ming zhig deng skabs bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lhun grub rdzong na yod/
rab byung gnyis pa'i chu bya lo la dge bshes glang ri thang pas btab pa'i dgon pa lha sa'i byang shar phyogs lhun grub rdzong na yod pa/
tsha grang 'thab pa dang, pho long rgyu ma'i srin bu 'khrugs pa sogs kyis nad rtags glang bu'i rwas bsnun pa ltar gyi zug rngu drag po 'phral 'phral du 'byung ba zhig /
sngar bod rgyal khri dar ma au dum btsan gyi ming 'dogs/
sngar rgya gar gyi rtsis gzhi'i gnas shig ste, lug gi rdul bdun bsgril ba'o/

glang chen/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khor lo'i rkang dang, mche ba stobs ldan, gnyis 'thung, stobs ldan, thig le can, nags tshal dga', sna zhags can, dbyug pa'i rna can, mang po 'thung, myos rdul can, myos bum can, lag ldan, sa lud nyal, so can, so gnyis pa, so ldan bcas so,
sems can chen po glang chen gyi ming gzhan/ gom pa spo stangs glang po che ltar 'gying zhing bzhud pa/
legs nyes kyi ltas sod shes pa'i glang chen/
gzhan la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i glang chen/
la rab brtan: glang chen sa srung dang don gcig
su gshegs pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, klu zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis glang po che'i stabs su gshegs pa/
po'i rgyal po:/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyu yi mgon po dang khyu yi bdag mche ba drug ldan, gnyis 'thung dbang po, thal dkar, spos kyi glang bcas so,
1) ma btul ba'i glang po/ 2) glang chen smyon pa/
rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gras shig /
jo mo glang ma ri'i bsdus tshig glang mo, glang po che mo/ ming gi rnam grangs la gnyis 'thung ma dang, lag ldan ma, so gnyis ma bcas so,
lo tho'i rtsis rtsi stangs nang gses shig /

rab byung dang po'i shing rta lor 'khrungs, mtshan rdo rje seng ge, po to ba'i dngos slob, bka' gdams blo sbyong gi man ngag dmigs pa'i sa bcad brgyad du mdzad pa la blo sbyong tshigs brgyad mar grags pa de tshogs chos su mdzad, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu bya lor glang thang dgon pa btab, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos la 'das/
glang gog spu mdog nag po
lo skor bcu gnyis kyi gras shig /
skyes pa glang lo pa/ glang lo pa'i chag sgo yos lo par 'khel/
pags mdog skya bo 'brum chung skya gsob yod pa za 'phrug ldang ba'i pags nad cig dang, sha ro glang gi gnya' ba ltar mthug cing ser ga 'byung ba'i mdze nad rigs nang nas gcig dang gnyis la 'jug /
spyang po min pa/ glan rgyag pa, 1) lhan glan pa/ 2) lan 'debs pa/
glon pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) kha g.yal ba/ thang chad nas gnyid bro bas glal ba/ 2) sgying ba'am rmyang shad dang rkyang shad byed pa/ seng ge glal ba/ 2. aal stong dang rmyang shad/ glal ba rgyag pa/ glal ba glal ba/ glal ba g.yal ba/
1) gla ba'i 'das pa, 2) (rnying) sdod sa spos pa/
gla pa bsgrigs pa'i dmag sde
las ka'i gla char brten nas 'tsho thabs byed pa/

/ 1) gtsang po'am rgya mtsho'i chus mtha' nas bskor ba'i skam sa che chung/ 'dzam bu gling/ mtsho dbus gling/ gser gling/ rin chen gling/ gling chen lnga/ 2) dum bu dang, cha shas/ zog sha bzhi gling gcig / lug sha bzhi gling gsum/ 3) dgon sde che khag la btags pa'i ming/ theg chen gling/ byams pa gling/ rin chen spungs pa'i gling/ 4) (mngon) ri rab kyi khor yug tu zla ba dang, 'od dkar, ku sha, mi'am ci, khrung khrung, drag po'i gling, 'dzam gling chen po bcas gling bdun yod pas grangs bdun mtshon/
lcags ri'am rwa bas bskor ba'i skyed tshal khang pa dang bcas pa/ gcan gzan gling ga / nor bu gling ga / kham bu gling ga/ mi dmangs gling ga /
sgrung nas byung ba'i dmag gi rgyal po/
rgya mtshos bskor ba'i skam sa chen po/
gling drug longs spyod kyi sa dang don gcig
gling drug longs spyod kyi sa

bsil ri'i nang gi ri mtsho gling gsum la nyi zla'i 'od zer mi 'phog kyang, mi rnams rang 'od kyis 'tsho ba sogs lha dang longs spyod mnyam pas na, gling drug longs spyod kyi sa ste zla ba dang, 'od dkar, ku sha, mi'am ci, khrung khrung, drag po'i gling bcas so/
dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i ri rab kyi khor yug tu 'khod pa'i gling bdun te zla ba dang, 'od dkar, ku sha, mi'am ci, khrung khrung, drag po'i gling, 'dzam gling chen po bcas so/
rgya mtsho chen po'i dkyil du chags pa'i skam sa/
ri rab kyi mtshams bzhir chad pa'i lus dang lus 'phags, rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan, g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro, sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla ste brgyad/
bstar phreng du chags pa'i gling tshom/
sbubs ma can gyi rol cha spyi/ 'phred gling/ rgya gling/ rkang gling/ dung rgya gling 'bud pa/
'das mchod skabs mtshan mor thog khar spar ba'i mchod me/
rgya mtsho'i nang la phan tshun thag nye bar gnas pa'i gling phran khag gcig /
ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi rgya mtshor chad pa'i gling chen bzhi ste, shar lus 'phags po dang, lho 'dzam bu gling, nub ba lang spyod, byang sgra mi snyan bcas so/

padma rdo rje rab byung gnyis pa'i sa pho sprel gyi lor gtsang myang stod du 'khrungs, rang lo so brgyad par phag mo grub pa'i slob mar gyur, rab byung gsum pa'i sa sprel lo sna phu dgon par gshegs, de'i brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo gtsang pa rgya ras kyis skyid smad gnam gyi phur 'brug dgon pa btab pas 'brug pa bka' brgyud ces pa'i grub mtha'i ming chags/

1) gling kha'i le lag chung ngu/ 2) dgon pa'i 'du khang gi nye 'dabs su yod pa'i lha khang dang, dgon pa chen po'i nye 'dabs su yod pa'i ri khrod lta bu/ 3) rgyug chu kha grams pa'i bar gyi skam sa dang, gling chen gyi nye 'gram du yod pa'i gling chung/

sngon gsang phu ne'u thog gi dgon par gling stod smad gnyis bzang 'gran gyi tshul du phan tshun bsres nas chos kyi rtsod pa mdzad pa la gling bsre zhes grags pa phyis su 'bras spungs sod grwa sa gzhan du'ang de'i srol dar/
gdan sa 'ga' re'i tshogs chen du gling yongs kyi dge 'dun bsres te bza' btung gi chos ston bzang po gshom bzhin du mtshan nyid dam bca' 'jog pa'i dge bshes/

gar mi 'khrab pa'i gzhas/ skyo glu/ hor glu/ sgrung glu/ glu len zhing mdun du shar shar skyod/ glu len gar 'khrab/ pho re re'i kha nas gtam re bshad, mo re re'i kha nas glu re blangs/ rta sga'i glo 'ching thag pa/
gzhas dang zhabs bro/ glu gar 'bud dkrol/ sa bzhi glu gar rol mo'i rtsed mjos bkang/
skad gdangs dma' pos gtong ba'i glu dbyangs/

rta dbyangs nges can la brten nas gtong ba'i snyan tshig rol mo dang bcas pa/ glu dbyangs snyan pa/ dga' ba'i mes rgyal la glu dbyangs 'bul ba/ bkra shis bde legs kyi glu dbyangs 'bul ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khas brjod dang, glu, mgrin skyes bcas so,
dbyangs mtho dma' sogs kyi rim pa/
glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun

sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi'i nang gses rigs shig ste, drug skyes dang, drang srong, sa 'dzin, bar ma, lnga ldan, blo gsal, 'khor nyan dang bdun, drug skyes rma bya'i skad ltar sgrog drang srong ba lang skad kyis rtsom, sa 'dzin skyes ni ra yi skad, bar ma khrung khrung sgra sgrog bzhin, lnga ldan me tog ldan dus su, khu byug skad snyan sgrog lta bu, blo gsal rta skad lta bur 'tsher, 'khor nyan glang po'i sgra lta bu'o, rtsed mo rlom par blang ba ni, bar ma dang ni lnga ldan dbyangs, dpa' bo drag po ngo mtshar du, drug skyes drang srong de bzhin no, sa 'dzin pa dang 'khor nyan dbyangs, snying rje'i ro la blang bar bya, 'thab mo 'jigs dang bcas pa la, blo gsal dbyangs ni blang ba'o/
glu dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed
sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses sa bcu pa ba'i rgyud kyi ye shes kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni gdul bya yid 'dun par byed pa'i chos ston pas na dri za'i glu dbyangs lta bu'o/
/ 1) glu dbyangs gtong mkhan gyi bud med/ 2) snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i glu dbyangs kyis lha tshogs mchod pa'i lha mo'i ming/
nyams mgur ram mgur ma/ yid skyo ba'i glu ma dbyangs blangs/
pa'i tshig ste: dbyangs su gyer chog pa'i tshig sbyor/
glu dang, gzhas/ glu gzhas mnyam gtong/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khyim du glu gzhas btang chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
glu gar mnyam byed/ dga' spro'i ngang nas glu len bro 'khrab byed pa/
dbyangs kyi sgo nas tshig shags rgyag res/ dga' spror 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams glu shags rgyag res byed pa/ phan tshun gtam nad ma theg par glu shags rgyag pa/
skad gsang mthon pos gtong ba'i glu/
lus tshab/ gzugs kyi glud/ rta glud/ phyugs glud/ srog gi glud/ mi glud/ 'dre shar sgor bzhag nas glud nub sgor gtong ba/ sngar lung pa der nad pa'i don du 'dre la glud gtong ba'i srol 'dug /
lha sa'i tshogs mchod gtor rgyag skabs rdzong ba'i glud 'gong/
glud gtong skabs sprod pa'i rdzongs skal dngos chas/
nad pa sogs kyi don du 'dre gdon la gtong ba'i gtor ma/
gtor glud dang mnyam du gtong ba'i rdzas sna tshogs/
chang rtsi brgyab nas bsnyal ba'i 'bru btsos ma/ glum la chu btab nas chang gsing ba
chu gnyis bar gyi gram thang/
(rnying) mthug po dang, mi gsal ba/ glegs, shing leb/ sgo glegs/
chos thag gi sne mor sbyar ba'i chab tse'am chab mgo /
glegs bam 'ching byed kyi thag pa
glegs shing gi bar du bcug pa'i dpe cha po ti/
1) chos gos kyi gling gru bzhir bcad pa'i grwa/ 2) glegs bam sogs kyi ming dang, ang grangs rnams rags tsam bkod nas mthong gsal sar btags pa'i dzar bu/ 3) yig cha/ bka'i glegs bu/
zangs lcags shing sogs las bzos pa'i leb mo pang leb lta bu/
dpe cha 'jog sa'i shing leb/ po ti re la glegs shing gnyis dgos/
1) smra brjod/ 2) klan ka dang, kha mchu'am, kha smras gleng rtsod/ don med gleng brjod 'tshol ba/
(tha dad pa) glengs pa, gleng ba, glengs,, 'chad pa/ gtam gyi gzhi ni kho bos glengs pa yin/ gcig gleng gnyis gleng/ chos kyi don gleng ba/ gros gleng ba/
shod ma dgos pa'am rtsod gleng ma dgos pa/ don gnad 'di'i skor gleng med 'thus tshang thag chod dgos rgyu/ de dag tshang ma rang rgyal mnga' khongs sa cha gleng med red/
skad cha/ kho tshos sger gyi don du gleng mo byas pa/
skad cha phar shod tshur shod/ gtam bzang mang po gleng mol byed kyin 'dug /

1) gros mol gyi don gtso bo'am skad cha'i gzhi/ sgrung gi gleng gzhi/ tshul khrims bcas pa'i gleng gzhi/ 2) rtsod gleng yong rkyen/ kha mchu'i gleng gzhi drang ba/ 3) bstan bcos kyi dngos gzhi'i sngon du brjod pa'i don rnams/ 4) sa bcad dang, dkar chag

(nidnam) gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi drug pa gang zag 'ga' zhig gi ched du gsungs pa, dper na rdza mkhan gyi bu nor can la brten nas ma byin len gyi bcas pa mdzad pa'i mdo lta bu 'dul ba'i sde snod du gtogs pa zhig go /
rtsod gleng sel byed tsam/ nyes chad gleng sel tsam zhig gtong ba/ gleng sel nyes pa/ skad cha gleng sel tsam bshad pa/ lag rtags gleng sel zhig phul/
gros bsdur gyi gtam/ gleng slong mang po byas/ 'tsho ba'i skor gyi gleng slong zhib gsal byed pa/
gtam gyi 'go slong ba'am skad cha'i rkyen slong ba/
blo rmongs pa dang ngag lkugs pa'i bsdus ming/
gang yang mi shes pa/ dud 'gro las kyang glen gog che/
mi shes pa'i rtags mtshan/ bya dka' byed gtad kyis glen rtags bstan pa/
shes rmongs/ bong bu lta bu'i glen pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la glan glen dang, lto 'gongs, tha shal, blun po, mi gsal ba, le lo ba bcas so,
gzhan gyis bshad pa la mi nyan par rang 'dod kyi skad cha dang las ka mthar skyel byed tshul/
blun po'am rmongs pa/ mi glen po/
(tha dad pa) glebs pa, gleb pa, glebs, ,leb tu gnon pa/ lci ba rkang pas glebs te leb mo bzos/ 'jim pa gleb pa/ sa gzhi glebs na nem byed pa dang, bteg na spar byed pa/
rta'i rnga rngog sogs kyis bzos pa'i dbyar kha lci ba rlon pa leb mo bzo byed/
ri dwags gla ba'i phru gu/

/ 1) lus kyi gzhogs/ khang pa'i zur du glo phab nas nyal ba/ sa la glo g.yas phab ste nyal ba/ 2) lud pa lu ba'i glo/ glo lu ba/ cham pa phog nas glo langs pa/ 3) rta dang phyugs kyi sga brtan por gnas pa'i sdom thag leb mo/ sga glo/ 4) lod dang, nye 'khor/ rtsig pa'i glo na yod pa/ khang pa'i glo gnyis su ljon shing mang po btsugs pa/
rtsig ldebs g.yas g.yon gyi sge khung/
gzhang 'brum gcod byed kyi yo byed ldebs sam logs su bug pa yod pa zhig /
pho'i gzhang 'brum gang na yod shes nas 'brum pa gcod byed kyi yo byad cig /
mo'i gzhang 'brum gang na yod shes nas 'brum pa gcod byed kyi yod byad cig /
glor 'dogs pa'i gri chung shubs ldan/
glo brgyab ste lud pa 'gog pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khogs pa dang, glo rgyag pa, lu ba, lud 'bod pa bcas so,
lug dang be'u sogs glo drag tu lu ba'i phyugs nad cig
1) glo lu ba'am langs pa/ 2) glo bur/
glo nad brgyad kyi nang tshan te, nad rtad su skad 'dzer zhing, stod rgyong ba, dbugs rngam rgod byed pa, lud pa khrag 'byung ba zhig /
khang pa'i logs zur du yod pa'i sgo/
glo nad brgyad kyi nang tshan glo rgyun du lu ba dang, lus kyi sha skem la shed chung ba, mgrin pa nas sor sgra 'byung ba, lus rngul zhing 'gul skyod dka' bar gyur pa bcas so/
cham pa glo bar bab pa zhig ste, nad rtags su glo rgyag cing lud pa mang po 'byung ba dang, dbugs hal ba, brang dang stod rgyab gzer ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /

glo ba'i sgang rtsa dang mchin rtsa ru thung gnyis 'doms pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs 'bur rgyab ngos kyi gtar rtsa ste, de gtar na mchin pa na ba dang, mig sprin dmar ser chags pa, glo lu ba bcas la phan/
1) nang khrol glo ba dang snying/ dngangs skrag skyes nas glo snying ldeg ldeg tu 'gul ba/ 2) sems sam yid/ glo snying gtad pa/

glo ba'i sgang rtsa dang snying rtsa snod kha gnyis 'doms pa'i 'khrig ma'i yar zur gyi rus 'bur nas gyen du song bzhi gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa ste, de gtar na glo snying la tsha ba zhugs pa dang, brang rgyab gzer ba, khrag ngan rgyas pa, glo langs nas lud pa, 'gog dka' ba sogs la phan/
glo snying brang gsum gtod pa
yid gnyis med par rtse gcig tu blo gtad 'chol ba/
lus kyi glo g.yas g.yon la 'dogs pa'i gri dang khab shubs sogs/
/ glo rdeg tu mi mang po 'dzoms pa/

1) mi phyugs kyi glo bar byung ba'i nad cig / 2) nor phyugs la glo nad thog mar phog skabs nyal dus lus stod mthon por byas te nyal ba dang, nang du glo ba rnag gis bzas te 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi 'gos nad che gras shig /
glo nad theng po dang, glo ba skya rbab, glo tshad, chu shor, thes po, glo gcong, glo rgyas, glo ba bung tshang bcas brgyad mchis so/
glo nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan rlung dang 'doms pa'i glo nad de, nad rtad glo 'gog dka' zhing dgong dang tho rengs kyi dus su wu sob can lu ba zhig /
glo nad brgyad kyi nang tshan lus stod lci zhing khengs la dbugs 'tshang ba dang, lud pa lngo ljang du lu ba zhig
tsha ba zhugs nas glo ba'i rtsa sbubs kyi khrag: dang chu ser rnams rul nas rnag tu gyur pa zhig /
1) rtsig ldebs su brus pa'i ca lag 'jog sa/ 2) rtsa lam gyi glo'am logs ngos nas gtar kha brgyab ste khrag 'don pa'i sman bcos byed thabs shig /

/ 1) mi lus kyi byang khog stod du gnas shing, don lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni dbugs kyi rten byed cing nang gi dbugs rnying pa phyir 'dor zhing, phyi yi dbugs gsar pa nang du rngubs pa sogs byed pa yin no/ glo bar mi phan mchin pa'i dug / 2) sems sam yid/ drang gtam gnas lugs tshang ma glo bar chud pa/
glo nad brgyad kyi nang tshan skya rbab glo ba la babs pa ste, nad rtags su glo lu ba dang, gdong dang mig lcibs skrang ba, dbugs hal ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
glo nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan ngan chu glo la shor ba zhig ste, nad rtags stod brgyang ba dang, mgo na ba, mig sprin ser por 'gyur ba zhig /
glo ba'i mdun ngos kyi cha shas lnga ste, mdzo sna dang, bya sgab, thugs khab, rte mig dgra lce bcas so/
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs lnga pa glo ba bu lnga dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang mig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na glo la rlung dang bad kan zhugs pa la phan/
glo nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan bung bas tshang bsags pa ltar glo ba'i rtsa sbubs la rnag bsags pa zhig
glo ba'i rgyab ngos kyi cha shas lnga ste stag mgo dang, sgang, rtsibs, gsham, zags sna bcas so/
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bzhi pa glo ba ma lnga dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang ste, der me btsa' bzhag na glo bar rlung dang bad kan zhugs pa la phan/
rgyab gtod byas pa'am, snying thag ring ba/
gru mo'i phyi zur nas mas su sor bzhi gzhal mtshams kyi sgang zur du yod pa'i glo ba dang 'brel ba'i gtar rtsa ste, de gtar na glo tshad dang, skad 'gag pa sogs la phan/
glo ba'i mdun phyogs kyi cha shas chung ba/
la rma khung thon pa:/ rta rgan rgyab chad glo bug /

/ 1) ma bsams ma dran par 'phral du byung ba/ glo bur chags rkyen/ glo bur gyi nad/ 'grul pa glo bur du 'byor ba/ glo bur drag tu khros pa/ glo bur stag gis mi tshugs, ..nam mkhar sprin nag glo bur du 'khrigs pa/ 2) gnyug ma min pa'am sngar med gsar du byung ba/ dri ma glo bur/
glo bur gegs dbang gdon skyod
glo bur 'dre yis rgyud brlams pa ste, nges med thog rgyag tu bar chad byung ba'i dpe/
nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis ni sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhud par sems dang 'bral rung du yod pas na glo bur gyi dri ma zhes bya'o/
ma bsams ma dran pa'i ngang la gsar du byung: ba'i rigs/ glo bur thog rgyag la lhags pa chen po langs pa/
glo bur thog rgyag dang don gcig
gyi myang 'das: glo bur gyi dri ma nyon sgrib spangs pa'i myang 'das/
glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i 'gog: bden
thol gyis byung ba'am 'phral du byung ba'i gras/ bsam blo glo bur ba/ 'grul pa glo bur ba/
phyi rol nas mda' rdo gri mtshon sod phog pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i rma ste, nang gses su dbye na bshus pa'i rma dang, gshags pa'i rma sogs rigs brgyad mchis so/
nor lug gi glo bar 'bu zhugs pa'i nad cig /
rtsig pa dang gyang nas zur du 'bur ba'i khang pa'am rtsig pa/
mid pa dang aol krong gi mgor babs pa zhig ste, nad rtags mid pa na zhing, skad 'gags pa, glo lu zhing zas mid dka' ba zhig /
glo ba'i rgyab phyogs kyi cha shas che ba/
1) sog pa'i me long 'og gi sngon bu dang gru mo'i sgang rtsa lta bu glo ba dang 'brel ba'i rtsa/ 2) sems shugs dang bsam tshul/ don med gtam 'chal mang pos grogs po'i glo rtsa dkrugs/
glo nad rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan glo bar tsha ba zhugs pa'i nad de, nad rtags su lus stod mdun rgyab gzer zhing, glo drag tu lu ba, lud pa'i nang nas khrag 'byung ba zhig /
khams phyogs kyi pho mo gnyis kas gzhogs la 'dogs rgyu'i rgyan cha zhig /
glo yu'i lam nas sor sor zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ba'i glo nad cig /
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bzhi pa dang lnga pa glo ma dang glo bu 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang ste, der me btsa' bzhag na glo bar rlung dang bad kan zhugs pa sogs la phan/
glo rgyun mi 'chad par rgyag stangs shig / phru gu chung ngu de glo gsud rgyun mi 'chad par rgyag pa/

skad cig 'od:/ 'phrul 'khor nas glog 'don pa/ chu shugs glog 'don/ me shugs glog 'don/ rta yi bang rtsal glog 'khyug pa ltar rgyug pa/ mtshams rer yod cing, mtshams rer med par 'gro ba de dag nam mkhar glog 'gyu ba ltar 'gyur skyen po 'dug / mun nag tu glog rgyag pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skad cig 'od dang, skad cig gsal ba, skyod byed, sgra 'gyed, chu skyes can, chun mdzes can, 'jug pa brgya pa, bde 'thung, sprin gyi lcug ma, gzhi sngon skyes, lus phra, rnam gsal bcas so,
glog rgyu sa'i lcags rigs kyi skud pa/
kha par ram glog 'phrin nam, skud med glog 'phrin gyi sgrig chas gang rung zhig gi thog nas skyel ba'i gtam mam gsar 'gyur/
glog gi kha dog / 'brug sgra ma bsgrags gong du glog dmar 'khyug / drag char 'bab pa'i rtags su glog dmar chem chem g.yo/
glog 'od zhags pa'i gzugs su bkod pa/ char sprin nang du glog zhags yang yang 'khyug /
glog gi nus par brten nas 'od 'byin pa'i sgron me/
glong thang sgrol ma lha khang
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa khams 'dan ma sa khul du yod pa ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig
glod pa/ btson pa glod bkrol btang ba/
