(tha dad pa) glan pa, glan pa, glon, ,1) lhan pa rgyag pa/ gos la lhan pa glan te gyon pa/ 2) lag pod dam lan slog pa/ bzang lan glan pa/ ngan lan glan pa/ dgra la 'khon lan glan/ 3) (rnying) chags pa/

don gang yang rung ba med pa'am, ma yin par dgag pa'i tshig phrad ma mi min med bzhi, de'i sbyor tshul ni ma mi gnyis ming gi sngon dang min med gnyis mtha' la 'jug / ma 'gro/ mi lta/ nga min/ nad med/
las tshig da lta ba'i thog mar 'jug pa'i: ma yig / bsam blo ma gtong / mig gis ma lta/
min pa dgag cing yin pa sgrub pa/
ske nas 'dzin byed kyi zhags rnyi/
dgag pa btang nas skyon brjod pa'am skyon bton pa/
de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig de sgrub kyi dngos kyi bsgrub bya'i chos yin na dgag pa yin pa, ma dmigs pa'i rtags lta bu/
dgag rtags phyin ci log pa

gtan tshigs ltar snang 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs gnyis kyi nang gses te, 'gog byed kyi rtags dang dgag bya'i chos gnyis rgyab 'gal du gyur pa, dper na, me stobs chen pos khyab pa'i gzhir chos can, grang reg rgyun chags su 'byung ba yod de, me stobs chen pos khyab pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa ltar ma dmigs pa'i rtags rnams phyin ci log tu bkod pa/
dgag bya 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i: rtags te ma dmigs pa'i rtags so

ldog pa rigs gcig pa'i nang gses, dgag par gyur pa'i ldog pa rigs gcig pa ni, dgag bya bkag tsam gyi cha med dgag rigs gcig pa ste, gang zag gi bdag med dang, chos kyi bdag med lta bu bdag dgag pa'i ldog pa rigs mtshungs pa'o/

1. gcod pa dang rgol ba'i don du go ba'i 'gog pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blo'am rang brjod pa'i sgras rang gi dgag bya dngos su bcad nas rtogs par bya ba'i chos, bdag med lta bu, rang gi don spyi 'char ba rang gi dgag bya'i don spyi 'char ba la ltos pa'o/ yang dag min pa'i log bshad la dgag pa gtong ba/ skyon brjod kyi dgag pa dang 'brel ba'i lugs bzang rnam dag / rigs lam la brten nas dgag pa byed nus pa/ spyod lam gyi thad nas dgag pa med/
dgag pa phyin ci log pa
(yul) 1) lcam mgo'i bar gyi pang leb gru bzhi/ 2) lham mthil 'tshem spyad/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya dpe la skyon brjod kyi sgo nas don du dpe can la 'gran pa'i nus pa yod pa ston pa'i 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
blos dngos su bcad nas rtogs par bya ba'i chos/ don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i dgag bya rnams 'gog byed kyi rigs pa tshad mas bkag pa/
1) rigs pa dang, lam gyi dgag bya gnyis/ 2) ma yin dgag dang, med dgag gnyis/
yod pa'i mtha' dang, med pa'i mtha', gnyis ka'i mtha', gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mtha'/
chos rnams kyi ngo bo yul can tha snyad kyi rtog pa gzhan la rag ma las pa ste de'i dbang gis bzhag pa min pa'i rang bzhin de nyid dgag bya'i bdag ces bya ba'o/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las bslab pa yongs sbyong gi gzhi gsum gyi nang gses te, ltung ba gleng dran dang, chad las, rnyed pa bgo ba, mtshams kyi phyi rol tu mtshan mo 'da' ba ste de dag dbyar gnas kyi skabs dgag bya yin la skabs 'dir dbye bar byed pas dgag dbye zhes bya, de la nang gses su dus kyi dgag dbye dang, dus min gyi dgag dbye dang, tshod kyi dgag dbye bcas gsum yod do/
'dul ba'i phyag len zhig ste, ltung ba gleng skabs mi 'byed pa'i gang zag la, dge 'dun dang lhan cig par dgag dbye byed du mi 'jug pa'o/

: dbyar khas blangs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis sbyor ba la ring sbyor zhag bdun la sogs pa'i snga rol nas spyod yul gyi grong la go bar bya zhing, gtsug lag khang brgyan, dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa la gsol ba btab nas tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan thog tu chos bshad nyan gyis dus 'da' bar byed, nye sbyor bco lnga'i nyin phan tshun bzod gsol sogs kyis mthar bskos pa'i byed pa pos gsol ba'i las kyis thud bstun, dngos gzhi rtswa dur ba bzung la ltung ba'i dgag dbye dang, rdzas kyi dgag dbye bya, rjes tshes bcu drug gi nyin gnas la zhen pa spang phyir ljongs rgyu bcas bya ba rnams so/
lung rigs dang 'gal ba'i gzhan lugs dgag pa'i tshig
rigs lam sbyong skabs gzhan lugs dgag pa dang, rang lugs gzhag pa dang, rtsod pa spang ba ste gsum/
phan tshun gyi 'dod pa dgag pa'i lan/
sbyin sreg gi mdzad sgo'i skabs bed spyod pa'i yo byad dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
1) sbyin sreg gi gzar bu mgo gru bzhi ma/ 2) du ba 'then par mkho ba'i dbyu gu khog stong zhig /
sems spro ba/ lus sems bag phebs kyi dga' skyid yag po thob byung/ dga' skyid dang ldan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel ba/
spro ba chen pos zhus pa'i phebs skyel/ tshogs 'du chen mo zhig 'tshogs te dga' skyel zhus pa/
dga' snang dang skyo snang 'dres pa

yid kyi dga' ba dang, lus kyi gus 'dud/
dga' bzhin spro bzhin/ tshang mas dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang nas las don byed pa/

1) bde skyid la rol ba/ 2) 'khrig pa spyod pa/

mdza' brtse ldan pa'i blo nye/

1) lus sems kyi tshor snang bde ba/ 2) rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus rgyud dang rma chu'i byang 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de bag chen du yod/

dge lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' bab kyi brgyud pa/

rje tsong kha pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab, se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa pa'i nang nas lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs dge bshes kyi go ming thob rjes rgyud grwa stod smad gang rung zhig la zhugs nas de'i dge bskos dang, dbu mdzad, mkhan po, mkhan zur bcas rim bzhin byas shing, de nas dga' ldan shar rtse'am byang rtse gang rung gi chos rje byas mtshams dga' ldan khri pa sngon ma 'pho 'das byung na de'i go sa thob/

lha sa'i shar phyogs stag rtse rdzong khongs gtsang chu'i lho rgyud dbang bskur ri'i ldebs su yod pa'i dge lugs dgon chen gyi gtso bo zhig ste, rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lor tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas phyag btab cing, rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen nas bzung dga' ldan khri pa gdan rabs rim byon gyis 'chad nyan byed yul gyi gdan sa zhig / 1409...
bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga nyin rje tsong kha pa'i gshegs mchod/

bod rang skyong ljongs gzhis ka rtse kron chus khongs lha rtse rdzong gi dgon pa t'a ra na thas btab pa zhig yin, ming rnying par rtag brtan phun tshogs gling zer, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bsgyur te ming 'di btags/

rab byung dgu pa'i sa stag lor sne gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon mo t'a la'i bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtshor phul ba'i ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur ba las byung zhing rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta lor t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas gu shri han gyi rgyab skyor 'og pho brang de'i nang du dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa'i srid dbang btsugs stabs sngar gyi bod sa gnas srid gzhung la ming de btags pa'o/ 1518...1642...

ba'i sdug bsngal: snying la sdug pa'am, yid la 'thad pa dang kha gyes pa'i sdug bsngal/

dga' ba dang, mchog dga', khyad dga', lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ste bzhi/
byang chub kyi yan lag byang chub yan lag bdun: gyi nang tshan phan yon gyi yan lag ste sa dang po mthong ba'i dga' ba des lus dang sems la phan 'dogs shing tshim par byed pa/
dga' bar smon pa/ de dang mjal na dga' ba la/ de 'dra gcig byung na dga' ba la/
snyan ngag gi khyad 'phags kyi nyams ldan sgo nas yid 'ong gi dga' ba skyed par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
dga' ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses rnam grangs gnyis ni, dngos thob kyi dga' ba dang, gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba'o/
1) gling ga'am, skyed mos tshal/ 2) grong khyer lta na sdug pa'i byang phyogs su rdzing bu dang shing sogs yid dga' ba'i tshal du lha'i bu dang bu mo dag 'dod pa'i yon tan la dga' zhing rtse ba/
spro zhing zhi ba'i gdong/ dga' ba'i bzhin gyis byams sems ston pa/

mi dga' ba sems la bzung nas 'khon 'dzin dam: po byed pa
/ 1) sems dga' po/ 2) (yul) legs po dang yag po/ las ka 'di dga' mo byung song/
dga' ba'i nyams tsam/ kho thug pa dang sems dga' tshad pa byas byung/
dga' bde'i nyams/ 'phrin bzang thos 'phral du mi tshang mas dga' tshor chen po byed pa/ gang gsungs pa mtha' dag nyan mkhan gyi blo la bab pas dga' tshor chen pos thal mo rgyun mi 'chad par rdeb pa/
dga' bas sha zhen byed pa/ mes rgyal la dga' zhen tshad med byed pa/ ngal rtsol la dga' zhen chen po byed pa/
lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi ming gi bye brag cig ste, gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengs skabs lha dang, klu, mi, gnod sbyin bcas dga' bas ming de ltar du btags par grags/
dga' nas nyams 'ur ba/ thang chen du ltad mo bstan ma thag tu mi tshang ma dga' 'ur gyis 'dus song/
sems spro ba'i nyams/ bslab bya bzang po byung nas sems dga' ya le bar gyur song/
sems kyi dga' bde/ gtam snyan thos pas blo sems dga' yal yal byas byung/

1) bzang po'i char gtogs pa'am yag tsam/ mi 'di la lag rtsal dga' rab 'dug / rma dga' rab sos pa/ rlung gi nus pa yang dga' rab yin snyam pa'i rang mthong byung/ 2) mang tsam gyi phyogs/ khang pa 'di'i nang du dngos po dga' rab cig 'dug /

1) blo nye'i grogs/ 2) khyo shug / dga' rogs sgrig pa/

dga' spro'i ngang nas phebs bsu zhu ba/

dgu tshan/ phyag 'tshal dgu phrugs/ rlung dgu phrugs su bsal ba/
(tha mi dad pa) sgur ba'am thur du gug pa/ lus mdun du dgu nas sdod pa/ mgo dgu ba/ shing 'bras mang bas yal ga dgu ba/
tsheg khyim dgu yod pa'i tshig rkang
gnam gyi ska rags/ ming gi rnam grangs la nam mkha'i ska rad dang gnod sbyin kha rlangs so,
gyi dgu tshigs log pa ste ngan ltas la: zer
bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i dgong mo skol ba'i thug pa'i rgyu cha sna 'dzoms/
rde'u dkar nag dgu re dgu re bzhag nas brtse rgyu zhig /
bod rtsis kyi sgyur thabs man ngag cig /
gdon 'dre sogs dgug pa'i shing byang/
ye shes pa spyan drangs te dam tshig par bstim pa
/ 1) dkyil/ nyin dgung/ mtshan dgung/ nam mkha'i dgung/ 2) gnam/ dgung sngon po/ dgung du gshegs/ gangs ri mthon po dgung la reg / 3) dus dang lo'i zhe sa/ dgung lo/
lo'i bar chad kyi zhe sa
lo grangs kyi zhe sa/ dgung grangs brgyad cur phebs pa'i bgres song/
gnam sngon po/ dgung sngon g.ya' dag / mtho ba dgung sngon nyi zla bkrag che yang, las ngan sgra gcan gnod pas 'tshe ba yod/
nyin mtshan so sor thun gsum gsum phye ba'i thun bar ma'am thun gnyis pa/
nyin gung gi nyi ma tsha po/
mi shi nas zhag po bzhi bcu zhe dgu song ba'i nyin mo/
1) nam mkha'i zla ba/ dgung zla'i 'od dkar phyogs brgyar 'phros/ 2) skyes lo gcig pa'i zhe sa/
na tshod lo grangs kyi zhe sa/ gzhon nyams dod kyang dgung lo mthon po/ bgres tshul bzhes kyang dgung lo phra ba/
snyan sgron nam snyan gsang zhu ba/ rim pa gong mar dgung seng ba ma gtogs thag gcod mi thub/
sngar rtse slob grwa bas bod zla bcu gcig pa'i nang dgun kha'i spro skyid gtong ba la zer/
nam dus bzhi'i dgun dus/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha ba'i dus dang, grang reg can, bsil ldan ma bcas so,
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ru thog rdzong gi nub byang ngos su yod/
me tog dus bzhi'i me tog gi ri mo zhig
ston khar 'debs shing, phyi lo'i dbyar khar bsdu ba'i gro la zer/
me tog dgun dus chu 'gram du skye ba'i me tog cig
dom dang, sbrul dang, 'phyi ba sogs dgun dus sa dong dang, sa 'og tu nyal ba/
zla bcu gcig pa'i sgang la lho bgrod mthar: thug nyi ma lho nas byang du ldog dgu 'dren
dgun zla gsum gyi stod cha/
hor zla bcu gcig pa'i sgang sleb pa'i dus tshigs shig /
hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dbugs thob pa'i dus tshigs shig /
dgun dus so nam pa las med dal sdod/
tshad gdung chu med pa'i grog po dang sa phyogs/

nam zla dus bzhi'i nang nas grang ngad che ba'i dus/ yon tan dgos na gzhon dus slob, 'o ma dgos na dgun dus gso/ tshig gis rgol ba pham ste dgun dus kyi 'brug dang mtshungs par smra ba med par bsdad 'dug /
dgun dus las ka mang po yod pa'i ming/
dgun zla gsum gyi smad cha/
bcu pa'i dbugs la dgun zla gsum gyi mgo tshugs: pas grang ngar rgyas
hor zla bcu pa bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa'o/
dgun zla ra ba, 'bring, tha chung ste gsum, hor zla bcu pa, bcu gcig pa, bcu gnyis pa dang, hor zla brgyad pa, dgu pa, bcu pa la ngos 'dzin tshul gnyis yod/
sgur po/ mgo dgur ba/ sgal tshigs dgur ba/ dbyibs dgur ba/ lag dgur ba/ lus dgur/
chos khrims pa ste dge 'dun gyi sgrid khrims gnon mkhan/
1) phan pa dang gnod pa/ 2) skyon dang yon tan/
bzang goms te, dge ba'i las la yang yang 'dris par byas nas thob pa'i bag chags
(yul) dkrog dkrog / rang gis mi shes par gzhan la dge dge ma byed/
'byung 'gyur dge rgan gsar bsko'i 'os babs yod pa'i mi/
bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas ris kyi gong ma ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha rnams ni 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba ma lus par rdzogs pa'am rgyas pas dge rgyas zhes bya'o/
1) dkar po'i las sgrub par brtson pa/ 2) chos byed pa/
dge ba'i bya ba sgrub cing mi dge ba'i bya ba spong ba/

yul lung gi dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa bcu ste, gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge, khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge, 'thung chu yur chu chu yi dge, khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge, khang shing bud shing shing gi dge zhes bcu'o/
shi ba'i mi la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa'i yo chas/
bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas ris kyi 'og ma ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha'i bsam gtan bde ba la dge ba zhes bya ba la, rang sa gong ma gnyis las bde ba chung bas dge chung zhes bya'o/
bsam sbyor bzang po'am, rnam par dkar ba'i las/
(aupasaka:) so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses, bslab pa gzhi lnga bsrung bar khas len pa'i khyim na gnas pa'i skyes bu/

rang dge bsnyen gyi sdom par 'grub byed kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas thob cing, dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i spang bya ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spong bar khas blangs pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims/
dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang don gcig
thar lugs kyi dge bsnyen drug ste: skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen, sna gcig dge bsnyen, sna 'ga'i dge bsnyen, phal cher dge bsnyen, yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen, tshangs spyod dge bsnyen te drug /
(aupas'ik'a:) dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rgyud ldan gyi bud med
sngar gyi khrims srol du mi bsad na gsod mkhan des 'das po'i shul mir mi stong dang dge dod sprod dgos der zer/
dge sdig gnyis ka'i ngo bo don dam du bden par ma grub pas stong pa'o/
(samgha:) nyon mongs pa spong ba la zhugs pa'i slob pa lam gyi gang zag dge slong gsum mam bzhi sde yan chad/
dge 'dun gyi chos rwa dang tshogs khang/
theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i gang zag re re: ba dang so skye'i btsun pa khrims ldan bzhi sde yan chad/

dge 'dun phan tshun 'byed par byed pa'i mtshams med kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i phra ma dang dbyen byed pa ste, dus ni ston pa zhal bzhugs shing bstan pa la skyon ma byung ba dang, mchog zung gcig bskos pa'i dus dang mtshams gcig tu byas pa'i nang du, gang zag grub mtha' shes pa'i gang zag gis yul so so skye bo'i dge 'dun rnams la, tshul ston pa sangs rgyas las gzhan lhas byin lta bu la ston pa dang, bslab pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa las gzhan lhas byin gyi bslab tshig lnga khas len pa'i tshul gyis dbyen byed pa'o/
bzhi sde yan chad khrims ldan btsun pa'i tshogs pa/
btsun pa nang phan tshun sgrigs su bcas pa'i bslab khrims/
'khor lo'i dbyen dang, las kyi dbyen, 'khrugs long gi dbyen bcas gsum/

rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug lo la 'khrungs shing, tsong kha pa'i zhal slob bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa phyag 'debs mkhan t'a la'i bla ma'i sku phreng dang po, rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta lo la 'das/ (1391-1474)...(1447...)...
sdom pa len dus snga ba'i grwa pa/

rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel lor gtsang rta nag ste deng skabs bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su sku 'khrungs shing sbrul lor gdan sa bkra shis lhun por phebs, rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul lor dwags stod rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtsho'i nye 'gram du chos 'khor rgyal legs bshad sgrog pa'i dga' tshal gyi dgon pa phyag btab, sa stag lor sne gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon mo rje 'di la phul rjes ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur, snga phyir bkras lhun dang, 'bras spungs, se ra so so'i mkhan po mdzad, phyis t'a la'i bla ma'i sku phreng gnyis par 'dren, rab byung dgu pa'i chu stag lor ' das/ (14 76-1542)...1485...1509...1518...

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal, tshogs su langs pa ste mkhan po ma gtogs pa'i bzhi tshang ba, kha skong gi chos bcu gsum tshang ba, mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba ste, mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'o, de la ston pa mngon gyur zhes kyang grags/
rjes dran drug gi nang gses, dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rig pa dang grol ba'i yon tan rnams rjes su dran pa'o/
dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig rig grol gnyis ldan gyi yon tan rnams don dam par ma dmigs shing kun rdzob tu dge 'dun la grogs kyi 'du shes rim ldan du dran pa'o/
dge 'dun dkon mchog mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun nyi shu ste, rgyun zhugs lnga dang, phyir 'ong gsum, phyir mi 'ong bcu, dgra bcom zhugs pa, bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas bcas nyi shu tham pa'o/
lta spyod cha lugs sod sde ris mi mthun pa'i dge 'dun/
bzhi sde yan chad kyi btsun pa lta spyod mtshungs pa/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde ba bzhi'i nang gses, phal chen pa zhes pa ni gyes pa'i tshe dge 'dun phal che ba phyogs gcig tu gnas pas de ltar grags la mdo 'don pa'i tshe pra kri ta'i skad du 'don, mkhan po bram ze'i rigs 'od srung las brgyud, snam sbyar bdun nas nyer gsum man chad la rtags dpal be'u, dge slong gi ming ye shes dang sbas pa'i mtha' can, grub mtha' bdag phung tha dad pa dang bden pa cig char mthong ba dang, chos mchog las kyang nyams srid pa dang, dbang pos yul mi 'dzin pa sogs 'dod pa'o/

bod rje mnga' bdag khri ral gyis dbu skra tshan pa gnyis su byas pa'i sne la dar yug btags par gcig la rab byung dge 'dun dang cig shos la gos dkar lcang lo can gyi dge 'dun bzhugs su bcug nas gtsug tu 'khur bas dge 'dun dbu sde gnyis zhes grags/
khrims ldan gyi dge 'dun nam de'i zhe sa/
lam du zhugs pa'am, gsol bzhis bsnyen rdzogs kyi so skye'i dge slong bzhi yod pa'i tshogs pa'o/

so so'i skye bo'i dge 'dun dang, slob pa'i dge 'dun, mi slob pa'i dge 'dun bcas gsum ste, gsol bzhis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i so skye'i gang zag bzhi yan chad la so skye'i dge 'dun dang, rgyun du zhugs pa nas dgra bcom pa la zhugs pa'i bar gyi gang zag gcig la slob pa'i dge 'dun, dgra bcom pa gcig la mi slob pa'i dge 'dun bcas zer/

(samghawashesha:) so thar gyi ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses shig ste, dge slong gang zhig la ltung ba 'di rigs byung na gso ba dge 'dun la rag las shing, sdom pa'i lhag ma tsam lus pas na de ltar brjod pa'o/

dge slong gi spang bya lhag ma'i sde'i nang gses kyi dbye ba ste, sems can la chags pa'i lhag ma lnga dang, yo byad la chags pa'i lhag ma gnyis, gnod pa'i lhag ma gnyis, bsgo gyur gyi lhag ma bzhi bcas bcu gsum/
ri bo dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'/
dge ldan rtsis gsar ma bu
sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos lor brtsams pa'i rtsis gzhung/ 1747...
sngar gyi khrims srol du mi bsad na gsod mkhan des 'das po'i shul mir dge dod 'bru sprod dgos pa der zer

1. 1) sdig pa'i ldog phyogs legs spyad dam, spyod pa bzang po ste, rang 'bras yid 'ong 'byin byed yin pa'i cha nas rnam smin lung du bstan par bzhag pa'i chos/ mi tshe hril por dge ba spyod pa/ sdig 'chab dge spyom/ sdig pa spangs shing dge ba dang du len pa/ 2) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig / 3) byed pa bcu gcig nang gi 'pho byed cig / 4) (mngon) dge ba bcu yod pas grangs bcu mtshon/ 2. legs pa dang bkra shis pa/ spyod pa mi dge ba/
dge ba skyes pa spel ba
rang rgyud la skyes zin pa'i dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa ste, yang dag spong ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /

srog mi gcod pa, ma byin par mi len pa, log gyem spong ba, bden par smra ba, phra ma mi byed pa, tshig 'jam por smra ba, ngag mi 'chal ba, gzhan gyi nor la chags sred mi byed pa, gzhan la gnod sems mi skyed pa, 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba ste bcu/
dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig dang don gcig

kyi tshul khrims: rang nyid tshul khrims la gnas te dam pa'i chos nyan zhing sems pa nas pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa byang chub kyi chos rnams sgrub pa la zer zhing tshul khrims rnam gsum gyi nang gses shig /
pa bskyed pa: sngar rang rgyud la ma skyes pa'i dge ba'i chos bskyed pa ste, yang dag spong ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
rnam par dkar ba'i chos dge ba bcu lta bu'o/
chub kyi phyogs: thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba'i chos/
dge rtsa mang du bsags pa'am, dge ba'i dngos po du ma 'dus pa/
1) rnam dkar gyi bdag nyid/ 2) rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing rtsom mkhan rgya gar gyi snyan ngag mkhan zhig /
rnam par dkar ba'i las sam rnam dkar gyi bya ba'am chos/
dge ba'i lam ston pa'i slob dpon/
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste rtag tu byung res kyis dge sems thams cad kyi 'khor kho nar 'byung ba/
dad pa dang, bag yod, shin sbyangs, btang snyoms, ngo tsha shes pa, khrel yod pa, 'dod chags med pa, zhe sdang med pa, mi 'tshe ba, brtson 'grus bcas bcu'o/
bcu gcig dad pa dang: bag yod, shin sbyangs, btang snyoms, ngo tsha shes, khrel yod, ma chags pa, zhe sdang med pa, gti mug med pa, rnam par mi 'tshe ba, brtson 'grus rnams te bcu gcig go /
legs pa dang bed spyod kyi bsdus ming/ dngos po yod kyang dge bed spyod ma shes na phan thogs med/
(shramna:) nyon mongs 'joms pa dang, 'khor ba'i ngal ba zhi bar byed pa'i dge chos so thar gyi sdom khrims lhur len gyis sbyong bar byed mkhan thar 'dod rab byung dge tshul slong pho mo spyi'i ming/
dge slong dge tshul gyi sdom khrims/
gshe yang slar mi gshe ba dang, khros kyang slar mi khro ba, brdegs kyang slar mi rdeg pa, mtshang brus kyang slar mtshang mi 'bru ba bcas bzhi/
dge slong dge tshul gyi 'phral phugs kyi phan bde/
rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang, phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu, phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu, dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu ste bzhi/
dri med lam ste, zag med kyi bar chad med lam mo/
rab tu byung nas skra bcad pa
dge tshul slong min yang yin pa ltar byas pa/
dge slong dge tshul ma yin bzhin du yin par sgrog pa/
'dus byas rnam grol lam dang, 'dus ma byas 'gog bden no/
mgo skra dkar phyed sngo phyed dam, sha mdog can gyi dge slong dge tshul/
/ 1) btsun ma/ 2) (mngon) rgan mo/ 3) sgrol ma'i mtshan zhig /
'das po'i dge ba sgrub byed mar, sngar gyi khrims srol du mi bsad na gsod mkhan des 'das po'i shul mir dge dod mar sprod dgos pa der zer/
dge ba'i rtsa ba ste, rnam par dkar ba'i las sam, bde ba 'phen par byed pa'i rgyu mchod sbyin bsnyen bkur sogs/
(shramanera:) so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses, bslab pa'i gzhi bcu dang, char gtogs blangs 'das sa gsum bsrung bar khas len pa'i rab tu byung ba'i skyes bu/
dge tshul gyi bca' khrims dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa'o/

rang dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas thob cing, dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i mi mthun phyod su gyur pa'i spang bya bcu ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spong bar khas blangs pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims/
'dul ba las bshad pa'i slob dpon lnga'i nang gses, bsgrub bya la dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bog par byed pa'i dge slong/
dge tshul gyi bslab bya'i rtsa ba/
dge tshul sgrub pa'i cho ga

dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga ste, sbyor ba bar ma rab byung sgrub pa'i cho ga sngon du song nas, dngos gzhi 'gal rkyen bzhi dang bral, mthun rkyen lnga dang ldan pa'i sgo nas, dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba rtsom byed du byas pas skyabs brjod dang, bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge tshul du sgrub pa zhes bdag brjod dang, btsun pas bzung du gsol zhes pa gzhan brjod de brjod pa gsum gyi mthar dus go brjod pa dang, bslab pa brjod pa sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi rim pa rnams so
sdig lta can gyi dge tshul la ltung ba gleng dran bzhams bsgo sogs zlog byed kyi rkyen gyis bzlog kyang mtha' mi gtong ba gnas nas dbyung ba'o/
dge tshul bsnyil ba sdud pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, sdig lta mi gtong ba dge 'dun gyis bsnyil ba ste gnas nas phab pa'i dge tshul dang lhan cig tu spyod lam mthun pa'o/
(shramanirik'a) so thar ris bdun gyi ya gyal, dge tshul gyi sdom pa rgyud ldan gyi bud med/

pa'i cho ga: dge bsnyen ma dang dge tshul ma sgrub pa'i cho ga spyir btang pha chog bzhin las, yul mkhan mo'i sta gon du gnas pa'i dge slong ma des dang por dge bsnyen ma dang bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs nas slob dpon ma des dge tshul mar sgrub par byed pa'o/
dge ba'i tshogs te bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs/

1) bkra shis pa'i ltas dang legs pa'i rtags mtshan/ 2) phan yon dang, phan thogs pa'i 'bras bu/ slob sbyong gi dge mtshan/ dge mtshan med pa/ mi re re la dge mtshan re 'dug / pha yul gyi dge mtshan gyis thugs phrogs pa/
'byung 'gyur dge rgan gyi dmigs sgor 'gro mkhan rnams kyi slob sbyong byed yul slob grwa/
dkar ba'i las te bde ba'i rgyu sgrub pa/

rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyis srol btod dar rgyas mdzad pa'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa, dge lugs pa'i grwa pa rnams kyi chos gos dang zhwa mo tshang ma ser po yin pas zhwa ser pa'ang zer/
phun sum tshogs pa'am bkra shis/
dge legs phun sum tshogs pa
khe nyen gsal por bshad de bslab bya byed pa/

blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen te, yon tshad kyi go ming zhig yin, lha sa'i gdan sa gsum gyi lam lugs la cha bzhag na, lha rams pa'i dge bshes dang, tshogs rams pa'i dge bshes, rdo rams pa'i dge bshes, gling bsre'i dge bshes bcas rim pa bzhi yod/
jo bo rje'i dngos slob 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi ming/
legs lam la mos pa'i yid/ dge sems skye ba/

(bhikshu:) so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses, 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum srung bar khas len cing de'i sdom pa cho ga bzhin len pa'i gang zag / ming gi rnam grangs la nags gnas dang tshangs spyod do,
dge slong bzhi sde yan chad kyi tshogs pa/
sdom pa gsor rung yan chad ldan pa dang, lus tha mal ba, shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa, gnas nas ma dbyung ba, dman pa'i gang zag min pa bcas lnga'o/
ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa thams cad spong bar khas blangs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa/
dge slong gis bsrung bar bya ba'i khrims so/
dge slong rnams la tshul khrims su bcas par mdzad pa'i ltung ba sde lnga, nang gses dbye ba nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mo/
nyon mongs spangs pa'i dge slong/
dge slong sgrub pa'i cho ga

gsol bzhi'i las kyi cho ga tshang la ma nor ma 'khrugs pa dang, bye brag sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bya ba ste, sbyor ba mngon gyur dang po nas dgu pa'i bar gyi chos rnams sngon song nas, dngos gzhi las mngon gyur gyis gsol ba'i las byas shing chags pa'i sgo nas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs, rjes su sdom pa thob mtshams kyi dus go brjod pa dang gdams ngag bcu gcig gis bslab pa brjod pa bcas grub pa'o/
sngar rgya gar gyi nyan thos sde pa'i dge slong zhig yin pa des rig pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i gzhung 'bum phrag bcu gnyis pa zhig brtsams te theg chen sun 'byin byas pa/
slong ba'i dge slong dang, ming gi dge slong, khas 'ches pa'i dge slong, bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong, nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i dge slong bcas lnga'o/
sgrub pa nyams len byed mkhan gyi dge slong/
rgya gar na lendrara klu sgrub bsnyen par rdzogs nas thob pa'i mtshan/
(bhikshuni:) so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses, bslab khrims sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i sdom ldan gyi bud med/

pa'i cho ga: rten dge slob ma'i sdom pa blangs nas lo gnyis lon pa'i gang zag ste, khyim so bzung na lo bcu gnyis, ma bzung na nyi shu lon pa la, dge slong ma'i dge 'dun bcu gnyis sam drug tshogs las mkhan mos chos gos rnam gsum gyi steng du rngul gzan dang shing nga dpung bcad gnyis bsnan pa'i chos gos lnga dang bcas pa'i rtags sbyin, bar chad dris te tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa sbyin, de nas dge 'dun pha'i tshogs bsnan te gnyis ka'i dge 'dun dang bcas pas gsol bzhi'i las chog gis bsnyen par rdzogs shing, rjes gdams ngag brjod pa la'ang pham pa brgyad dang lci chos brgyad sogs 'phri bsnan byed dgos kyang bod yul 'dir dge slob ma dang dge slong ma sgrub pa'i srol thog ma nas ma byung ngo/
par rdzogs pa'i las: btsun ma la dge slong ma'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i bya ba/
chos ston pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge slong ma'i ston par ma bskos bzhin du dge slong ma la chos ston pa'o/
pham pa brgyad dang, lhag ma nyi shu, spang ltung so gsum, ltung byed brgya dang brgyad cu, sor bshags bcu gcig nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis bcas sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/
bsnyen par rdzogs nas ring po ma lon pa/
sgras brjod kyi dge slong gsum ste, rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dge slong, ming gi dge slong, yang dag pa'i dge slong bcas so/

(shiksham'ana:) so thar ris bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, dge tshul ma rnams kyis dge slong ma'i sdom pa ma zhus gong lo gnyis su rtsa ba'i chos drug dang, rjes mthun gyi chos drug bcas bsrung ba'i sdom pa rgyud ldan gyi bud med/

pa'i cho ga: bsnyen par rdzod pa la lo gnyis su ma tshang ba'i dge tshul ma la sbyin par bya ba yin zhing, de yang khyim so ma bzung na lo bco brgyad dang bzung na lo bcu lon pa de nyid, yul dbus su dge slong ma bcu gnyis dang, mtha' 'khob tu drug tshogs kyis gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis dge slob ma'i sdom pa sbyin, de'i rjes su rtsa ba'i chos drug dang rjes mthun gyi chos drug gi bslab bya brjod pa rnams so/

rang dge slob ma'i sdom pa 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas thob cing, rtsa ba'i chos drug dang rjes mthun gyi chos drug gis bsdus pa'i spang bya rnams lo gnyis kyi bar du spong bar khas blangs pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims/
dge tshul ma'i sdom pa'i steng, rtsa ba'i chos drug dang, rjes mthun gyi chos drug bsrung ba/
shis brjod kyi rjes su byed pa'i sgra ste yag go yag go zhes pa'i don/ legs pa'i bya ba byas pa la dge'o dge'o zhes bstod par byed do/
pha ba dgo dgo ste sha mo'i rigs shig /
ri dwags shig / ri dwags dgo ba la mtshon 'phangs te phal mo che ni byer song/
ri dwags dgo ba'i rwa co/
dgo ba'i pags pas bzos pa'i gos
(rnying) 1) lo rga bar gyur pa/ 2) lkog tu phyin pa dang, phug tu phyin pa/
'don pa'i don du go ba'i 'gog pa'i ma 'ong pa
nyin mor cha gsum du phye ba'i mtha' ma/
nyin gung yol mtshams nas sang nyin snga dro bar kha zas spong ba/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste sprel gyi dus/
(yul) nub mo dang, phyi dro'i za chas/
dgong mo dang dgong dror 'thung ba'i ja/
phyi dror ri dwags gsod du 'gro ba'i ming
chos spyod kyi phyi dro'i thun/
zhag sa byed pa/ do nub lha sar dgong 'debs pa/ rtswa kha bzang sar dgong btab/
zhag por sdod sa/ nyi ma ma nub gong nas dgong mal phab/
nyin mor cha gsum du phye ba'i mtha' ma'am bya nyal ba'i dus/ ming gi rnam grangs la nyin mo'i mtha' dang, thun mtshams, pha skyes, srod bcas so,
phyi dro'am dgong mor bza' bya'i zas/
ham spobs/ rang don khog tu bcug nas gzhung gi rgyu nor la 'dod rngam gyi gdong shed chen po byed/
bya byed gang byed dgos bka' 'dri gros sdur zhu ba/
sems 'khrugs pa'am tshig pa za ba/ da res bka' bzhin du sgrub ma thub par dgongs 'gal ma bzhes rogs gnang/
rtsom pa po'i dgongs don la 'grel pa rgyag pa'i ming/
dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod pa ste, sku gshegs pa'i dus tshigs kyi mchod pa/
dgongs par rang shar du byung ba'i gter chos/
dgongs 'gal med pa'am bden pa/ rang gi nyes par 'gyod sems kyis dgongs dag zhu/
khyed bden dgongs 'gal med pa zhu/ las nyes 'di dag nga rang gis lan 'dug pas dgongs dag thugs bden/
khong khro zhi ba'i zhe sa/

1. (tha dad pa) bsam blo gtong ba'am sems pa'i zhe sa/ thugs la de ltar dgongs te gsungs pa red/ zhu don 'di dag thugs la dgongs su gsol ba/ 'di snyam du dgongs pa/ 2./ 1) sems kyi zhe sa/ dgongs pa chen po/ dgongs pa dkrugs pa/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i dgongs pa zab po/ rtag tu mi dmangs kyi khe phan la dgongs pa bzhes pa/ gang 'dra byed dgos khyed kyis dgongs pa zab bzhes kyis brtag dpyad gnang rogs/ 2) bsam don snying po/ rtogs dka' ba'i gzhung don gyi dgongs pa 'grel ba/ 3) gnang ba/ nad dgongs zhu ba/ dgongs pa khrol ba/ dgongs pa rtsa yang/ dgongs pa rang zhu/ de ring las khungs su yong mi dgos pa'i dgongs pa zhu ba/
1) yid log pa/ 2) tshig pa za ba/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, rjod byed kyi tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa dang, don ldan kho na yin pa, bstod smad sogs kyi skabs su bab pa, brjod bya rnams gsal bar ston thub pa ste khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi sbyor ba gang zhig dgongs pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/
sangs rgyas kyis dgongs pa gzhan la dmigs nas chos gsung tshul bzhi ste mnyam nyid la dgongs pa dang, dus gzhan la dgongs pa, don gzhan la dgongs pa, gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa bcas bzhi'o/
gsung lnga'i ya gyal zhig sku'i brdas 'khor gyi blo la don 'jal bar ston pa ni longs sku dgongs pa brda'i gsung zhes sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa'o/

srog sdom gzer bzhi'i ya gyal, chos nyid dag mnyam stong pa chen po rtogs pa'i lta ba ste, des mar 'khor ba'i dus su sems kyi bag chags dag par byed, yar sangs rgyas kyi tshe thugs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs bar lam dus su bde gsal mi rtog pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba'o/
khong khro za ba/ dus thog tu bcar ma thub pas dgongs pa ma 'tshoms/

nges par 'grel pa'i mdo rgya cher 'grel pa: mdo 'grel zhig thang rgyal rabs skabs yon tshes brtsams shing, 'gos chos 'grub kyis bod yig tu bsgyur, bar skabs rgya yig cha lag mi tshang bar gyur kyang, bod yig po ti cha tshang yod par brten nye char rgya lo tsa ba byams pa kun mkhyen gyis ma tshang ba rnams bod yig nas rgya yig tu bsgyur/
dgongs pa rdzogs pa ste shi pa'i zhe sa/ dgongs rdzogs rjes dran gshegs pa'i dran gso zhu ba/
gshegs pa'i dus tshigs kyi mchod pa/
dgongs pa zhu ba ste gnang ba zhu ba'i ming/
bsam blo gtong sa'i gzhi'am bsam don/
dgongs pa'i bzhed pa ste blo'i 'dod pa/
bsam blo rgya che ba/ nyes can rnams la dgongs yangs gnang ba/
dgongs su gsol ba'am gsan rogs gnang/ bsam 'char zhu rgyu'i sngon du lhan rgyas la dgongs gsol zhu ba/
(tha dad pa) 1) bgad pa, bgad pa, dgod,, gad mo 'chor ba/ dga' nas gad mo dgod pa/ 2) 'god pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
theg pa la dgod pa dang, bde ba la dgod pa, rigs pa la dgod pa, chos la dgod pa/
dga' ldan dgon pa'i ming gzhan zhig
1) dge 'dun mang po'i 'du gnas/ 2) grong las rgyang grags gcig gis chod pa'i dben gnas/

(aarnyam) grong las rgyang grags gcig gis chod pa'i dben gnas sam, dge 'dun gnas sa/ ming gi rnam grangs la klog grwa'i gnas dang, mkhas gnas, chos kyi grong rdal, chos kyi 'dun sa, bdud rtsi'i khang, dben pa'i gnas, zhi ba'i grong, bsam gtan khang bcas so,
1) dben sar sdod mkhan/ 2) bka' gdams kyi bla ma zhig /
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, dge slong dgon pa bas chos gos dang bral nas zhag bdun phan chad 'das pa'o/
dben sar gnas pa'i ri dwags/
1) dben pa'i gnas/ 2) dgon pa'i grwa khang dang nor rdzas/
dgon pa che ba'i khongs gtogs dgon chung rigs

mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs hu'u kru'u hor rigs rang skyong rdzong khul du rab byung bcu pa'i shing 'brug lor rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos btab pa dang, phyis thu'u bkvan ho thog thu'i bsti gnas dgon pa zhig /
dgon pa stongs pa'i sa cha/

gang dgos pa la nye bar mkho ba'am phan pa/ dgos gal, don snying/ dmangs kyi khe phan dang dngos su 'brel ba yod pas dgos gal chen po yod/ gra sgrig legs par byas na dgos gal nam byung de 'phral du btang chog chog yong/
dgos pa yod thag chod/ 'gro dgos nges byung na nga 'phral 'phral phyin chog /
'gro song gtong byed kyi dngul/ rgyal khab nas dgos dngul bton te sman khang gsar rgyag byed pa/
phan gnod gang rung du 'gyur ba'i don

dgos pa dang, bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing, bya ba des bya yul nyid dam, bya yul dang 'brel ba'i las gang gi ched du phan gnod byed pa nye bar ston pa'i rkyen la don rnam bdun yin pa 'di la rnam dbye bzhi pa'ang zer, dper na, yon tan du slob gnyer byed, gnod byed 'bu srin gsod par dug sman sbyor, rma la sman byugs, zhing la chu gtong zhes pa lta bu/
thon 'bor che drags nas brin mi thub pa/
dmigs yul lam, bsam pa'i don/ 'di ru yong ba'i dgos don gang yin nam/

1) bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa/ 2) nor bu mchog gyur zhig gi ming/ 3) rab byung bcu pa'i nang byang pa lhun sdings bdud rtsi 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i byang pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa gtso bor ston pa'i man ngag rgyud kyi lhan thabs tshul du bkod pa'i sman gyi lag len gyi skor zhig

1. (tha mi dad pa) mkho ba/ nad gzhi bcos par sman dgos/ nga la dpe cha gcig dgos/ mang po mi dgos/ mi la dgos pa'i rin chen yon tan red/ 2. don snying ngam dmigs yul/ dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa ci zhig yod/ brtsam par bya ba'i dgos pa bstan pa/ dgos sar chad, mi dgos sar lhag / snying po med pa'i gtam 'chal bshad na dgos pa chung/ ring nas 'bad rtsol byas te dgos pa yongs su grub/ 3. las tshig gi mthar sbyar nas skul ma gtong ba'i tshig grogs shig / spyi pa'i rgyu nor la gces spras byed dgos/ ltad mo lta bar 'gro dgos/ zhing la chu gtong dgos/ lag pa bkru dgos/ sa cha der nyin zhag gnyis gsum tsam 'gor dgos/

khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi'i gras 'bras bu'i sgo nas bzhag pa ste, zhi lhag gis dmigs pa yid la byed pa de kun tu bsten, goms par byas, lan mang du byas pa'i mthus rang rang gi gnas ngan len dang bral nas gnas 'gyur ba'o/
rang 'dod khog bcug gis gzhan la don med khyad gsod byed pa'am mthong chung byed pa/ dgos dbang sbug 'dren, rang nyid kyi dgos pa la bsams nas gnad 'gag zur tsam las gsal po rang mi ston pa/

bstan bcos rtsom pa'i 'gor dgos pa dang 'brel ba ste, de'ang skabs bab bstan par bya ba'i don gang yin pa de ni brjod bya dang, de nyid 'dzin cing byang chub nas gtsug lag gi dgongs don la 'jug pa'i lam yangs por 'gyur ba ni dgos pa dang, de ltar spro bas 'jug cing mthar gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mngon du byed pa ni nying dgos te dgos pa'i yang dgos pa dang, nying dgos dgos par 'brel, dgos pa brjod byar 'brel zhing, brjod bya'ang yan lag phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga mar 'brel ba ni 'brel ba'o/
thon 'bor gyis dgos mkho mi ldang ba/
dgos don med pa'i 'dra chags kyi mdzes chos/
phan thogs med pa'i dngos lhag /
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chen rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig /
'gul skyod kyi nyams 'gyur/ mi der khe nyen ga tshod bshad kyang dgye dgu mi byed pa/
gyen nam rgyab tu dgye tshul/ sprang phrug thang rkyal khengs nas sbo dgye dgye/ mgo dbye dgye byas nas nam mkhar lta/
gzugs po rgyab phyogs su gzengs bstod pa'i rnam pa/ g.yul sar dgye por langs/
(tha mi dad pa) lus gyen du g.yo ba'am rgyab tu phyogs pa/ gzugs po rgyab phyogs su dbye ba'i tshul gyis sdod pa/
1. stod sgur can gyi mi/ 2. dgye po dang 'dra,
rgyab phyogs su dgyed pa dang, mdun phyogs su dgur ba/
(tha mi dad pa) rgyab phyogs su 'tshor ba/ lus rgyab tu dgyed nas gad mo dgod/
(rnying) 1) thog med pa'i khang pa/ 2) gyang skor/
dga' dga'/ las 'gan grub nas tshang ma dgyes dgyes gnang song/
gang dgar spyod pa'am dga' bde yod do cog longs su spyod pa/
yid dga' ba'i ston mo'i zhe sa/ nyin mtshan kun tu dgyes ston spyod pa/ nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gi bar dgyes ston gyis dus 'da' bar byas/
(tha mi dad pa) dga' ba'i zhe sa/ thugs dgyes pa/
kye rdo rje ste bla med rgyud kyi yi dam zhig
dga' ba'i ngo gdong/ myur bar dgyes zhal dngos mjal zhus chog pa/
1) so pa sdod khang/ 2) dgra bo'i khang pa/
1) dgra bo dang mthun grogs/ 2) 'byung rtsis las 'byung ba'i khams mthun min rtsi tshul zhig /
gnyen sdug dgra bo spro zhing rang phyogs skyo ba
dgra bo gtso che ba'am dgra bo'i mgo gtso/ dgra mgo thul ba/
1) dmag rgyag pa/ pha rol gyi stobs shugs kyi tshod ma lon par dgra rgyag pa/ 2) 'phrog bcom byed pa/ grong khyer la dgra rgyag pa/
sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i mngon pa sde bdun sdud mkhan slob dpon mi bdun te, katya'i bu dang, dbyig bshes, bram ze lha skyid, sh'a ri'i bu, mo'u gal gyi bu, gsus po che, gang po bcas bdun no/
(aarhanta) bdud bzhi'i dgra thams cad btul ba'am, thul bar byas pa'o/
ma gung pa: dgra bcom pa zhig gi mtshan/

1) spang bya spangs pa'i sgo nas dbye na, shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba dang, gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba ste gnyis/ 2) rten gyi sgo nas dbye na, nyan thos dgra bcom dang, rang rgyal dgra bcom ste gnyis so/

yongs su nyams pa'i chos can dang 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can, rjes su srung ba'i chos can, gnas pa la mi bskyod pa'i chos can, rtogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i chos can, mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can bcas nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa rigs drug /
nyan thos dgra bcom dang, rang rgyal dgra bcom, sangs rgyas dgra bcom rnams so/
po mtha' ma: rang rgyud pa man chad kyis lhag bcas myang 'das rgyud ldan gyi phung po lta bur 'dod do/
dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi'i nang gses, khams gsum gyi sgom spang thams cad spangs pas bdud bzhi'i dgra thams cad yongs su bcom pa'o/
nyon sgrib las grol ba'i sems/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, gang srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu pa ma lus par spangs pa'i theg dman pa'o/
nyon sgrib spangs pa'i btsun ma/

bod rgyal glang dar ma'i skabs bstan pa nyams rjes grwa pa tshos sham thabs gong ba can gyon, sgra gzhan bzhar, gtsug phud bzhag dbyar zla gsum dgon par dbyar gnas bcas, ston dgun dpyid gsum khyim thab dang grong pa'i mchod gnas byed pa'i grwa gzugs rnams kyi bla dwags kyi ming/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse'i bar gyi nyon mongs mtha' dag spong ba'i sbyor ba can, dge 'dun nyi shu'i gras shig /
dgra 'thab byed kyi yo chas sam mtshon cha sogs/
dgra bo mnan gtad byed pa'i cho ga /
dgra phyogs dang, rang phyogs/ dgra gnyen go ldog / dgra gnyen gyi dbye 'byed gsal por 'byed pa/ dgra snying na ba, shin tu sdang ba'i dgra bo/
dngos su gnod pa'i dgra dang, mi mngon pa'i gdon 'dre/
1) dgra bo 'dul ba dang, gnyen nye skyong ba/ 2) phyogs lhung/
dgra 'dul ba'i ched du dmag dpung 'dren: pa
1) dgra bo mthar skrod pa/ 2) 'byung rtsis nang grogs la brten nas dgra rtsi ba/ shing dgra lcad/ lcags dgra me/ me dgra chu/ chu dgra sa/ sa dgra shing/
dgra bo'i dwangs ma'am dgra gtso bo
bla med rgyud kyi yi dam dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi nang gi gshin rje gshed dgra nag ces bya ba/
dgra bo'i phyogs khag / dmag ma brgyab gong nas rang phyogs kyi gnas tshul gsal por shes dgos par ma zad, dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul yang gsal por shes dgos/
dmag dpon gyi lag rtsar brten nas kho rang dmag sar phyin na rgyal pham ji yong sogs brtag dpyad byed pa'i mo phywa zhig ste, ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi nang gses shig /

gnod byed dam phas rgol/ snga dgra/ da dgra/ phyi dgra/ nang dgra/ sdang dgra/ 'chi dgra/ dgra 'dul ba/ dgra nyams pa/ dgra bo stobs ldan/ don med glags 'tshol gyi sdang dgra 'joms pa/ dmag jus legs pas pha rol gyi dgra las rgyal ba/ thabs kyis bskyangs na dgra yang gnyen du 'gyur/ rnam rtog dgra ru bzung na, khang stong rkun por 'chor yong/
shin tu sdang ba'i dpe la sbyor ba'i dgra sha chags pa'i mi/ dgra mi sha bo zin pa/
ma bu dgra grogs 'byung ba brtsis nas rtsa brtag skabs me dgra chu lta bu dgra dang 'phrad pa de la dgra rtsa zhes zer/
1) dgra ya'am kha gtad/ 2) mtshungs pa gsal bshad kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba

dgra zla/ dgra ya la dgra lan sprad pa/ nag phyogs dgra ya nyung na dga', dkar phyogs gnyen nye mang na dga'/ ming gi rnam grangs la dgra bo dang, 'gal byed, 'gal zla, rgol ba, rgol byed, mngon gnod, mngon par 'tshe ba, sdang dgra, sdang byed, gnod byed, pha rol po, phas rgol, phyir rgol, 'phen byed, mi dga' ba, mi mthun phyogs, mi phan pa, mi mdza' ba, zhe 'gras bcas so,
tshur rgol gyi 'thab lan/ thabs shes sna tshogs kyi sgo nas dgra lan 'jal ba/ dmag dpung bshams nas dgra lan sprad pa/ drag shugs chen pos dgra lan slog pa/
phan tshun bsad rmas kyi 'khon lan/ pha yi dgra sha len pa/
pha bsad kyi dgra bo lta bu/
sngar dgra byung ba'i lo zla'i dus mtshams su slar yang dgra 'byung ba der dgra sri zer/
dgra bo'i dwangs ma dang don gcig
(tha mi dad pa) bkrongs pa, dgrong pa, dgrongs,, gsod pa'i zhe sa/ rgyal po dug gis bkrongs pa/
(tha dad pa) bgags pa, bgag pa, bgogs,, 'gor rkyen bzo ba/ 'grul pa'i lam bgags pa/
dgod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
(tha dad pa) bgam pa, bgam pa, bgom,, nyams sad pa'am tshod lta ba/ mi de gang 'dra zhig 'dug tshod bgam dgos/
mi min gdon 'dre las byung ba'i bar chad/
gdon 'dre'i gnod pa las byung ba'i skyon cha/

dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang dbang skur ba sogs kyi thog mar lha'i nga rgyal gyis khro bo'i tshogs rnams spros te gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams la gtor ma byin nas phyir bskrad pa'o
'dre gdon la ster ba'i gtor ma/
'dre gdon gyi rkyen las byung ba'i glo bur gyi nyer 'tshe'am, god ka/
gdon 'dre'i rkyen las byung ba'i bar chad kyi 'tshub cha/
dgra bgegs gzugs kyi ling ga/ bgegs ling sreg pa'i mngon spyod/
thob skal lam thob cha/ las kyi bgo skal/ gzhan gyi bgo skal rang la mi thob/
gzhi gcig las dum bu dum bu'am, tshan pa tshan par phral te khungs so sor sprod pa/ ngal rtsol nus shugs bgo 'grems byed pa/ bgo 'grems bya rgyu mi 'dang ba/
bgo bsha' rgyag stangs nor ba/ dngos po bgo nyes ma shor ba/
1) rgyu dngos sogs bgo bsha' rgyag stangs/ 2) rtsis rgyag stangs shig /

1. (tha dad pa) bgos pa, bgo ba, bgos, ,1) gyon pa/ lus la go bgos, rta la sga bstad/ gos bgos/ 2) bsha' ba/ thob skal bgo ba/ dum bur bgo ba/ gsum gyis dgu bgos na gsum/ ja aa mas bskol na yag btsog med, sha aa phas bgos na che chung med/ 3) bgod pa'i ma 'ongs pa,2. gos dang gyon chas/ bgo ba ngan pa/ bza' btung dang bgo ba 'dzoms po/
bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i brtsi stangs/
1) bgo bsha' bya rgyu'i dngos po/ 2) rtsis thabs kyi bgo bya'i grangs 'bor/
thur grib skabs su khyim so so'i bgo gzhi rags pa de thur ma'i rang grib bdun po dang btsugs pa'i grib ma bsdoms pas bgo ba la brten nas ngo thog gi dus tshod brtag pa/
khag so sor 'byed pa'i ming/ ngal rtsol byas pa'i grub 'bras
/ las 'gan bgo bsha' byas nas sgrub dgos/
1. (tha dad pa) bgos pa, bgo ba, bgos,, bgo bsha' byed pa/ sgor nyi shu mi bzhir bgos na mi rer sgor lnga re thob/ 2. (rnying) zad pa/
(tha dad pa) dus sgo nges can zhig las 'da' ru 'jug pa'am 'gor du 'jug pa/ lam bgags nas mi gtong bar bgor ba/ zhing la son 'debs kyi dus tshod bgor na mi 'grig /
bgo ba dang bgod pa'i skul tshig
bgo ba dang bgod pa'i 'das pa,
