1) dpe cha'i shog ldeb dang po/ 2) yi ge'i thod du bzhag pa'i shog stong/
nu mar thug tsam thug tsam byed pa:/ be'us ma la mgo sug rgyag gin 'o ma 'thung bzhin 'dug /
mgo skra dkar nag 'dres pa'i ming/
gzhan gyis slu brid byed sla ba/
skyabs gnas/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen/

/ 1) mgo 'dren pa po'i bsdus yig ste 'jigs pa kun las yongs su skyob mkhan/ skyabs mgon/ 'gro mgon/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa mgon po/ 'jam mgon bla ma/ 2) chos skyong gi rigs shig / mgon po bing chen/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ mgon po dkar po/ mgon po gur/ mgon po nag po/ mgon po gri gug dpa' gcig /
bskang gso ba ste chos skyong srung mar gsol mchod byed mkhan/
sku'i mgon po dang, gsung gi mgon po, thugs kyi mgon po, yon tan gyi mgon po, phrin las kyi mgon po ste lnga/
chos skyong khang gi gsol mchod byed pa po/
mgo 'dren nam srung skyob byed mkhan med pa/ skyabs med mgon med kyi nyam thag la 'tsho skyong byed pa/

sngar rgya gar mnyan yod kyi grong khyer rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du kun dga' ra ba 'dzugs mkhan mgon med zas sbyin zhes pa'i sbyin bdag gi ming/ gyi kun dga' ra ba: sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pa'i bzhugs gnas shig /

1./ 1) lag rtsa'i 'phar grangs myur ba/ 2) rgyu dang 'bras bu myur bar 'byung ba ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig / 2. myur ba/ nga gnyis su mgyogs blta dgos/ rta mchog rlung ltar mgyogs/ mgyogs mgyogs byas na 'gor 'gor/
myur ba'i don du go ba'i mgyogs pa dang don gcig
myur stabs su bris pa'i yi ge dang ri mo/
myur po myur po/ gnas tshul mgyogs myur du 'gyur bzhin yod pa/ 'dzugs skrun mgyogs myur du byed pa/ ri bong mi la skrag nas mgyogs myur gyis bros pa/
lcags rigs la gtong ba'i grang tsha/
myur mi myur gyi tshad/ mdun du skyod pa'i mgyogs tshad je cher gtong ba/ dpung 'jug gi mgyod tshad chung du btang ba/
1) myur du skyel dgos pa'i yig 'phrin/ 2) myur por bris pa'i 'khyug yig /
bod kyi me mdar mgyogs thabs su rdzas mdel blug byed/
'gro yun nam bar thag thung ba'i lam/
mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod

dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i 'gor rje stag phu pa blo bzang rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i snga rabs rgyal po lha snang stobs ldan gyi sras chos kyi dga' ba khu byug mgrin sngon zla bar 'phos pas bya dang ri dwags mang por phan thogs byas pa'i sgrung zhig /
mgrin gcig skad cha gcig pa
/ mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa/ mgrin gcig tu dga' 'bod sgrog pa/ mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tshang mas kha gcig grag /

/ 1) ske dang gre ba/ lto chas za nyes kyis mgrin pa 'gag pa/ glu dbyangs mthon po yun ring du btang yang mgrin pa mi 'dzer ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la lkog ma dang, ske, mgur, mgul pa, mgo rten, mgo 'dzin, aog ma bcas so, 2) skad cha/ mgrin gcig gis gong bkur zhu/
(mngon) 1) dbang phyug chen po/ 2) rma bya/
1) skad gzengs bstod pa/ 2) ske bkyag pa/
mgrin pa phye ba'i rtsol ba
yi ge klog 'don byed skabs mgrin pa gdangs nas brjod pa'i rtsol ba/
mgrin pa btsums pa'i rtsol ba
yi ge klog 'don byed skabs mgrin pa btsums nas brjod pa'i rtsol ba/
kyi 'khor lo: mgrin pa'i thad kyi rtsa dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar kha yar phyod nas yod pa/
mgrin dbyangs gcig pa'ang zer, skad cha gcig mthun/ tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis mos mthun byas pa/
(mngon) 1) khrung khrung/ 2) 'dab chags bzhad/ 3) 'dabs chags shing rta ma/
sgor ming yig gam: aang grangs sbyar ba'i 'grul pa gal che sdod sa'i khang mig /
phyi nang gi las ka'i sne len byed mkhan/
snga dus t'a la'i bla ma dang, pan chen aer te ni'i mjal kha gtong tshod dang, bkod pa dril bsgrags byed mkhan 'go gtso
sku mgron gyi gras sam tshul lud/ grogs bshes rnams mgron thabs su spyan drangs pa/
mgron po 'bod mkhan gyi bdag po

gdan zhus ltar gsar du phebs mkhan nam phyi rol nas yong ba'i mi/ sku mgron/ byes mgron/ gzhis mgron/ ja mgron/ chang mgron/ mgron du 'bod pa/ mi sdod mgron po song na dga', mi sos nad pa shi na dga'/ khyi bdag pos bkag rgyu mgron pos bkag gtam aa phas gtong rgyu aa mas btang/
ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, mgron phyogs kyi gzhis sdod mi'i 'phar rtsa la brtags nas mgron po'i don gnyer 'grub min sogs brtag thabs shig /
mtsho las skyes pa'i srog chags shig /
mgron mang rkun sogs sde tshan

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bcu tshan brgyad pa la, rkun po dang lhan cig tu 'gro ba'i ltung byed dang, nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ltung byed dang, sa rko ba'i ltung byed dang, ring du 'dug pa'i ltung byed dang, bslab pa spong ba'i ltung byed dang, nyan rna byed pa'i ltung byed dang, mi smra bar 'gro ba'i ltung byed dang, ma gus pa'i ltung byed dang, chang 'thung ba'i ltung byed dang, phyi dro grong du 'jug pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/
mgron phal pa ste, mgron gtso bo'i zhor la skad btang ba'i mgron po/
sku mgron gdan zhu'i brda tho shog lhe
1) bos pa'i mgron po bsu mkhan/ 2) lam 'grul la bsu ba byed pa/

/ gnad 'gag / zam pa'i 'gag / ri 'gag / klung 'gag / sgo 'gag / gzims chung gi 'gag / phyugs la thog mar 'gag nad phog skabs kha sna nas chu thon pa dang, de rjes ske skrangs nas dbugs 'gags te nyin gcig tsam nas 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi 'gos nad che gras shig /
1) sa mtshams kyi tshong khral bsdu ba sogs kyi 'gag sgo/ 2) rtsa ba la thug pa'i don gnad/
'phrang lam/ thang bde po byung na glu aa li la mo 'gag dog po byung na bla ma ao rgyan padma/
phyugs la thog mar 'gag nad phog skabs kha sna nas chu thon pa dang, de rjes ske skrangs nas dbugs 'gags te nyin gcig tsam nas 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi 'gos nad che gras shig /
1. (tha mi dad pa) 'gag pa, 'gag pa,, thar mi thub par 'gyur ba/ 'gro lam de 'gags tshar 'dug / tshig 'gags/ gcin 'gag / yi gi ? 'gag pa/ sa 'og chu 'gro 'gags pa rnams bshangs pa/ 2. sgo srung/
grwa chas stod 'gag ring ba ste, snam bu sogs kyis bzos pa'i phu dung med pa'i gos ring ba zhig /
gnad dam gal/ gal 'gangs/ rtsa 'gangs/ las don tshang ma rtsa 'gangs che chung la ma ltos par rang nyid kyis dngos su thag gcod byed dgos dogs med/
(tha dad pa) bkad pa, dgad pa, khod,, 'gad gtor byed pa/ 'bar rdzas kyis rdo pha bong bkad pa/ grang ngar che bas sa 'gad rdo 'gad/

las don gyi khur/ las don mang po'i 'gan khur ba/ kho rang mi gcig la las 'gan de bskur ba/ mi zhig la mi gzhan zhig gi las 'gan dkri ba/ rang mos dang len gyis spyi phan las don bsgrub rgyu'i 'gan len pa/ 'gan mi theg pa/ skabs bab kyi las ka'i 'gan 'khris pa/
1) khe nyen gyi las khur/ 2) khag theg /
las ka'i khur po/ mi zhig la yig skyel gyi 'gan khur gnang ba/ las don 'di skor bsgrub rgyur blo bkal chog pa'i mi zhig la 'gan khur dkri ba/
1) las 'gan khas len byed pa/ 2) 'gan len pa po/
'gan len las dus re mos su 'khor ba/
(gnyidzar) mdzod ldan te, khang bzang gi thog steng mdzes rgyan gser zangs las bzos pa zhig /
1) khur chen po/ 2) nyen kha chen po/ khos don med 'gan ljid po shod kyin 'dug /
las 'gan dang dbang cha/ 'gan dbang tshab 'dzin/ gzhan gyi 'gan dbang la the gtogs byed pa/
1) sog chas kyi stod gos phu med cig / 2) bla sprul gyi gzab spros na bza' zhig /
'gan khur ji bzhin ma byung ba'i skyon shor/
khur len pa/ 'gan len dngul gte/ 'gan len gan rgya/
/ 1) smad cha'am gsham/ gos kyi 'gab gsham/ lus 'gab/ mthon po gnya' nas mnan, dma' bo 'gab nas skyor/ 2) gyon pa'i mar sne/ 'gab brdzes te chu brgal ba/ 3) nywa khug
'tsham po'am 'os pa/ las don de ji 'dra byas na 'gab pa 'dug gam/ 'os 'gab yod med/ las don 'di 'dra brtsams na 'gab mi 'gab mi dmangs dang go sdur byed dgos/ 'gro sdod gang 'gab lan gsal yod pa zhu/
(tha dad pa) 'gams pa, 'gam pa, 'goms,, rtsam pa sogs za phye skam po kha'i nang du blugs te mid pa/ rtsam pa 'gam rgyu dang, gling bu gtong rgyu gnyis dus gcig tu mi yong/
1. ras mthug po zhig ste, 'thum byed dang, gur, ras phad, gru g.yor sogs bzo byed ras cha/ 2. kha shas dang, kha cig / mi 'ga'/ re 'ga'/ skabs 'gar mthong rgyu gtan nas mi 'dug /
la la'am kha cig / yul lung 'ga' zhig la thon khungs ha cang yag po yod/ gnas tshul 'ga' zhig khyed rang gis mkhyen mdog kha po yod/
'ga' zhig gam kha shas kyang/ rang dbang la mi dga' mkhan mi 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin/ sha tsha'i bslab bya brgyab pa de la gnod skyon 'ga' yang med/
la la'am kha cig / mi 'ga' re/ ca lag 'ga' re/ dgra bo 'ga' re wa mo bzhin du bros/
la la'am kha cig / grong khyer der lo 'ga' shas shig bsdad pa/ lag rtsal cha tshang 'ga' shas shig lobs pa/
rkyen ngan pa'am mi mthun pa'i rkyen te, gegs byed pa'i bar chad/ nas myug skye ba'i 'gal rkyen sad ser than pa dang, srog 'tsho ba'i 'gal rkyen nad dang mu ge/
rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las rnal ma bzhi'i nang gses, rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pas khyab pa, dper na, byas pa yin na rtag pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/

log rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las: khyab pa phyin ci log pa bzhi'i nang gses rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pa ma yin pas khyab pa, dper na, byas pa yin na mi rtag pa ma yin pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/
'gal ba'i cha shas sam mi mthun pa'i cha
gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste gsal bya'i las gang yang rung ba zhig gsal byed gcig gis bya ba mi mthun pa'i sgo nas gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhig /

1. (tha mi dad pa) mi mthun pa/ khrims dang 'gal ba/ tshig snga phyi 'gal ba/ bya spyod phan tshun 'gal ba/ 2./ 1) tha dad cing gzhi mthun mi sred pa ste, ka bum gnyis dang, rtag dngos gnyis dang, me chu gnyis lta bu phan tshun so sor gnas shing gcig tu mi mthun pa'o/ phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba rnams sel/ kha bshad lag len 'gal ba med pa/ gzhan gyi tshig la 'gal ba brjod pa/ 2) (mngon) sa glang lo/

don gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses te, ngo bo dang byed las mi mthun pa'i dngos po zhig bsgrub byar bkod nas, de dang 'dra ba'i 'gal ba can gyi don gzhan zhig sgrub byed du bkod pa'i rgyan/

sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dpe can gyi dngos po gcig la sbyar gzhi dpe'i dngos po tha dad pa mang po bkod pa'i sbyar chos sgra sbyar rnams sbyar gzhi dpe can la yod cing mi 'gal ba dang, sbyar gzhi dpe la med cing 'gal bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
1) 'gal ba la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na, phan tshun spangs 'gal dang, lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gnyis/ 2) 'gal ba'i tshul gyis dbye na, dngos 'gal dang, brgyud 'gal gnyis/
dngos po rang dang mi 'gal ba'i don, dper na, bum pa dang 'gal ba dang 'gal ba ni bum pa dang mi 'gal ba yin pa lta bu'o/
dngos po rang dang 'gal ba'am, 'gal ba'i dngos po de nyid yin te, dper na, bum pa dang 'gal ba dang mi 'gal ba ni bum pa dang 'gal ba yin pa lta bu'o
mi mthun pa sel bar byed pa/
mi mthun par gnas pa gsum ste, lhan cig mi gnas 'gal dang, phan tshun spangs 'gal, tshad ma'i gnod 'gal dang gsum/

dmigs pa bzhi: lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags sbyor bcu gnyis kyi gras, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa dang, 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa dang, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/
'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur

rang rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, phan tshun spangs 'gal la brten pa'i tshad ma'i gnod 'gal can gyi 'gal ba'i khyab bya rtags su bkod nas thal ba 'phangs pa gang zhig bzlog na 'gal khyab dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, bum pa chos can, 'jig nges ma yin par thal, rang gi 'jig pa rang rgyu las phyi 'byung ba'i 'jig rgyu gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, rang gi 'jig pa rang rgyu las phyi 'byung ba'i 'jig rgyu gzhan la ltos pa min te, 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa rang gi rigs gcig pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa'o/
'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dgu'i gras, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur te gsum mo/
brjod 'dod kyi dngos po'i khyad par dang, rdzas, bya ba sogs 'gal chos rnams phan tshun mi mthun pa bsgrub pa'i ched du lhan cig 'grogs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig

'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses rnam: grangs drug ni gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba, gzhi gcig gi yon tan 'gal ba, gzhi gcig gi rdzas chos du ma 'gal ba, gzhi gcig gi rdzas dang las 'gal ba, gzhi gcig gi las 'gal ba, sbyar ba'i 'gal ba bcas so,
gtan tshigs ltar snang gi nang gses, rtags phyogs la grub cing bsgrub bya dang 'gal ba ste khyab pa phyin ci log tu nges pa, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra rtag par sgrub pa lta bu'o/

1) 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs la bsgrub bya'i chos kyis dbye na, dgag rtags phyin ci log dang, sgrub rtags phyin ci log pa ste gnyis/ 2) phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu'i gras kyi 'gal rtags gnyis te, mthun phyogs la gtan med mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa dang, mthun phyogs la gtan med dang mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis 'jug pa'i rtags bcas so/

brjod 'dod kyis dbye na bzhi ste, 'gal ba dngos su brjod pa, dper na, mi rtag pa'i sgra chos can, rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir zhes dang, 'gal ba shugs kyis brjod pa, dper na, nam mkha' chos can, byed pa po yin te, don byed nus pas stong pa'i phyir zhes dang, chos kyi khyad par gyi sgo nas 'gal ba brjod pa, dper na, mig la sogs pa chos can, gzhan don byed de, 'dus bsags yin pa'i phyir, zhes dang, chos can gyi khyad par gyi sgo nas 'gal ba brjod pa, dper na, gzhan gyi don byed pa'i mig la sogs pa chos can, yod de, 'dus bsags yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa ste bzhi'o/
dngos po'i sgo nas dbye na, rang bzhin 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs dang, 'bras bu 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs dang, ma dmigs pa'i 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs te gsum mo/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang, don gnyis phan tshun mtshungs chos 'dra ba la khyad par med kyang, gnas sa'i rten sogs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

dmigs pa bzhi: lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags sbyor bcu gnyis kyi gras, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa dang, 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa dang, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/
'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dgu'i gras rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur te gsum mo/

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi dngos po gang rung zhig dpe'i dngos po 'os pa'i bya ba mi byed cing, 'os min gyi bya ba 'gal ba byed mkhan gyi gzugs can du bkod pa'i rgyan zhig /

dmigs pa bzhi: lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags sbyor bcu gnyis kyi gras, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa dang, 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa dang, khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/
'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dgu'i gras, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur te gsum mo/
gyi sbyar ba: sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dngos po gnyis kyi sbyar chos bya ba phan tshun mi mthun pa 'gal ba can du ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i rtags gang zhig gang la rtags su song ba'i rgol bas mi mthun phyogs la mthong, mthun phyogs la ma mthong yang med par ma nges pa, dper na, skyes bu 'di chos can, kun mkhyen yin te, ngag smra ba'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu 'gal ba'i lhag ma dang ldan pa'i rtags so/

snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, bsgrub chos dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu rtags su bkod nas, dgag bya 'gog pa'am med nges su sgrub pa ste, dper na, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, grang reg rgyun chags su gnas pa med de, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed me 'bras du ba rtags su bkod nas dgag chos rang rgyu me dang 'gal ba'i grang reg 'gog pa'am med nges su sgrub pa'o
mi mthun pa'i 'brel ba chu dang me lta bu/

sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dpe can gyi dngos po gcig la sbyar gzhi dpe'i dngos po tha dad pa mang po bkod pa'i sbyar chos sgra sbyar thams cad sbyar gzhi dpe don gnyis ka la yod cing, mi 'gal bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
'gal dmigs kyi rtags drug snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i

rtags yang dag las lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags la dbye na rang bzhin 'gal dmigs kyi rtags dang, 'gal 'bras dmigs pa'i rtags dang, khyab byed 'gal dmigs kyi rtags dang, rgyu 'gal dmigs kyi rtags dang, rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i rtags dang, 'bras bu 'gal dmigs kyi rtags te drug /
lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags sbyor/
'gal cha'am 'gal ba'i tshad/ 'gal tshabs che chung la gzhigs nas nyes chad gtong ba/
1) mi mthun pa'i ya'am kha gtad/ 'gal zla de dag gis ji skad smra ba'i don la legs par brtags shing dpyad pa/ 2) 'gal ba/ 'gal zla gcig gyur/

snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, rtsod gzhi'i steng du dgag bya'i chos med nges su sgrub nus pa'i sgrub pa rtags su sbyor ba ste, dper na, me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can, grang reg rgyun chags su gnas pa med de me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed kyi rtags la dgag sgra gang yang sbyar med pa'i tshul gyis dgag bya bkag pa'o/
mi mthun pa'i gshags/ phan tshun rgol gleng gi 'gal gshags mang po rgyag res byed pa/

1. (tha dad pa) bkas pa, dgas pa, khos,, gshog pa/ rdo bkas pa/ me shing dum bur bkas pa/ shing leb bkas bzhag / shing bzo bas shing 'gas pa dang, rdo bzo bas rdo 'gas/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) gas pa, 'gas pa,,rang bzhin du 'gas pa/ gyang la ser kha gas 'dug / ri log pa thag pas mi 'dus, thang gas par lcags shan gyis mi phan/
tshos mdangs 'don pa/ snam bur spang 'gugs rgyag pa/ ther mar 'dam 'gugs rgyag pa/
drag las kyi skabs dgra bgegs 'gugs byed kyi sngags/
'dir shog cig zer ba'i brda lan/ lag pas 'gugs brda gtong ba/

(tha dad pa) bkug pa, dgug pa, khug ,1) sgur ba'am gug tu 'jug pa/ mdzub mo bkug nas grangs ka brtsis/ shing gi yal ga bkug ste bcad pa/ btang na mda' dang bkug na gzhu/ 2) tshur 'dren pa/ dmag mi 'gugs pa/ mgron 'gugs pa/ da lta nyid du khug cig / bu phrug rnams rang gi mdun du bkug pa/
rang gnas su skad gtong ba'am tshur skong ba/
tshos rgyag dus dgos pa'i tshwa rigs shig /
(tha mi dad pa) gum pa, 'gum pa,, 'chi ba/ nad pa 'gum pa las sos pa/
(rnying) shi mi rung ba dang shi mi 'os pa/
(tha dad pa) bkums pa, dgum pa, khums,, gsod pa/ dgra bo 'gums pa/
g.yo ba/ sman khab rgyag dus 'gul skyod ma byed/
khyug 'gul stangs kyi rnam pa zhig / nya chung mang po chu nang du 'gul khyug khyug byed
'gul skyod/ bya de da lta shi mi 'dug 'gul

(tha mi dad pa) g.yo ba/ lus 'gul/ sems 'gul/ sa 'gul/ lag pa 'gul ba/ ma bsgul rang 'gul/ me sgyogs chen po rgyag dus khang pa'ang 'gul tsam byas song/ ri rab 'gul ba'i sgul shing, rgya mtsho dkrug pa'i thur ma/
'gul stangs shig / sa yom brgyab pas khang pa thams cad 'gul mer mer byed/
stangs kyi rnam pa:/ 'bu srin mang po 'gul shig shig byed/
'gog pa'i da lta ba 'bri tshul gzhan zhig

(tha dad pa) bkang ba, dgang ba, khong,,1) rgyong ba'am gang bar byed pa/ bang mdzod 'brus bkang ba/ bum pa chus bkang ba/ sa gzhi chus 'gengs pa/ 2) gzhu'i rgyud 'then pa/ gzhu bkang nas mda' 'phen pa/

(tha dad pa) bkab pa, dgab pa, khob,, sbed skung byed pa'am g.yogs nas sgrib pa/ khang pa'i thog bkab pa/ khebs dang gos kyis dgab dgos/ skyon 'gebs pa/ je bkab je gsal/ yas bsu mas 'gebs/ zhwa dpe lham la ma 'gebs, ra mgo lug la ma sbyor/
1) g.yog byed kyi dngos po/ 2) (mngon) 'dab chags spyi'i gshog sgro/
(yul) ya kha ma kha ring thung ches mi snyoms pa ste, yas 'gem dang, mas 'gem spyi'i ming/
(tha dad pa) 'joms pa/ seng ges glang chen gyi mgo 'gems te bsad pa/

(tha dad pa) bkal ba, dgal ba, khol,,1) skul ba/ nyes chad 'gel ba/ dngul khral 'gel ba/ nag med nyes bkal/ sngar gyi khral 'ul 'gel lugs rtsa med bzos pa/ 2) rta drel sogs kyi rgyab tu khur skur ba/ rta drel lag gcig la tshong zog 'gel ba/ do po ma bkal gong du glo thag dam por sdoms shig / 3) bskon nas 'jog pa/ shing gi yal gar gos bkal ba/ 4) re ba byed pa'am 'chol ba/ blo bkal nas bzhag pa/ grogs la yid 'gel ba/
gyang ngos su gzar ba'i ri mo/

thog ma dang rtsa ba/ gral 'go/ las 'go / tshogs 'du chen mo'i 'go tshugs pa/ las don tshang ma'i 'go nas mjug bar 'thus shor med pa byung/ skad cha'i 'go smos pas ha go ba/ chos 'go sangs rgyas la thug pa dang, chu 'go gangs ri la thug pa/
snyan zhu'i 'gor gong rim nas gnang ba'i bka' lan/ zhu tho 'go mchan/

dang rtsa ba'am thog ma dang mtha': ma/ rgyug pa'i 'go mjug / las don gal 'gangs che chung snga phyi 'go mjug ma nor ba byed dgos/ shing gi 'go mjug gnyis la phra sbom gyi khyad par yod/ skad cha 'go mjug bslogs nas bshad na go bde po mi yong/
1) las don gyi 'go 'dzugs pa/ 2) las don gyi 'go 'dzin pa/ tshogs 'du'i 'go 'ju mkhan su red/
1) rtsom yig gi thog ma'i shis brjod dam tshig rgyan/ 2) gtam gyi gleng gzhi/ gros bsdur gyi dang po'i 'go brjod gleng stangs la gzhigs na rnyog gra che tsam yong bzo 'dug /
dpe deb rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gnas lugs bkod pa/
rtse mo phying pa lta bur gyur pa'i bal: ril
/ gtong yong 'go thug pa/ skad cha 'go thug pa/
1) skyabs rogs byed mkhan/ 2) (mngon) shing rta'i kha lo ba/
bal gyis btags pa'i snam bu'i rigs shig /
las ka'i 'go byed mkhan/ tsho ba'i 'go pa/ las rigs kyi 'go pa/
(tha mi dad pa) gos pa, 'go ba,, shan zhugs pa dang, sbags pa'am 'byar ba/ 'go ba'i na tsha 'gos pa/ skyon 'gos pa/ gos pa'i nyes pa/
gzhan la 'go ba'i rims nad de nang gses su dbye na bal nad dang, 'brum pa, rgyu gzer, gag pa, lhog pa, cham rims bcas drug 'chis/
mi so sor lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas skyob pa'i lha'am mi min gras/
yul lha, pho lha, mo lha, dgra lha, srog lha bcas lnga'o/
1) sne khrid byed pa/ 2) sne 'khrid byed mkhan/
las don gang rung gi 'go 'khrid pa po/
bya ba thog mar 'go tshugs pa/ 'go rtsom skul yig / thon skyed gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i thabs jus lag bstar byed pa'i 'go rtsom pa/ srol 'go rtsom pa/
bya ba thog mar byed pa/ 'go 'dzugs le'u/ las grwa gsar pa'i 'go 'dzugs pa/
1) thog ma tshugs pa/ 2) sne zin pa/ las gra snga phyi'i 'go zin pa byed pa/
1) nas kyi bye brag cig / 2) bying ma spu rug gi 'go ma'i snam bu/
ljon shing gi rtse mo'i yal 'dab rgyas pa/
tshor 'du rags pa 'gog par byed pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sems so/
'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang don gcig
'dod pa'i khams 'dir 'gog bden mthong bas spang bar bya ba ma rig pa dang 'dod chags, khong khro, nga rgyal, the tshom, log lta, lta ba mchog 'dzin bcas bdun/

brda'i 'gog bden dang, don dam pa'i 'gog bden gnyis te 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis sa bon nyams smad pas 'gog pa gang yin pa dang, 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis sa bon kun tu bcom pas 'gog pa gang yin pa'o, so skye la spang pa tsam yod kyang sa bon drungs ma phyung bas 'gog bden btags pa ba las med/

1. (tha dad pa) 1 bkag pa, dgag pa, khog ,1) rgyun gcod pa/ dgra 'gog pa/ 'go nad sngon 'gog / kha bkag pa/ rgyug chu de bkag zin pa yin/ lam 'gog pa/ 2) rgol ba/ phas rgol bkag pa/ 2 bkog pa, dgog pa, khog ,1) 'don pa/ rtswa ngan 'gog pa/ so bkog pa/ rtsa ba bkog pa/ 2) sbyar sa nas mar len pa/ ldebs ris 'gog pa/ shing shun gyi pags pa 'gog par byed/ 2. bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang, srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rnams spangs te mi 'byung ba/ 3. mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, 'dod pa'i 'gog bden la dmigs pa'i chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes 'gog bden gyi chos rang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes shing sngar goms pa mngon du gyur pa'i zag med shes rab kyis spang bya spang ba mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes shig /
nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, 'gog pa chos bzod kyi mjug thog tu spang bya las rnam par grol ba thob pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes shig /

nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, khams gong ma la dmigs pa'i 'gog bden gyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes nas spang bya spong ba ni 'gog pa la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa thob pa mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes shig /
nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, 'gog pa rjes bzod kyi mjug thog tu khams gong ma la dmigs pa'i spang bya spangs pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/
so sor brtags 'gog dang, so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa/
gdan sa dga' ldan gyi gnas ri, stag rtse rdzong na yod/
shes pa bcu'i gras shig ste khams gong 'og gi 'gog bden rtogs par byed pa'i shes pa/
bsgrub bya'i yul gang yang rung ba zhig dgag byar byas nas de sgrub tu mi 'jug par 'gog thabs brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses rnam grangs nyer gsum ni, byung ba 'gog pa, mngon gyur 'gog pa, 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa, chos 'gog pa, chos can 'gog pa, rgyu 'gog pa, 'bras bu 'gog pa, rjes gnang gis 'gog pa, shis brjod kyis 'gog pa, rtsub mos 'gog pa, grogs kyis 'gog pa, 'bad pas 'gog pa, gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa, thabs kyi 'gog pa, khro bas 'gog pa, mya ngan gyis 'gog pa, 'gyod pas 'gog pa, the tshom gyis 'gog pa, sbyar bas 'gog pa, don gzhan 'gog pa, rgyu yis 'gog pa bcas so/

tshor ba dang 'du shes rags pa 'gog par: byed pa'i snyoms 'jug ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba srid pa'i rtse mo las gyen du bskyod pa zhi bar gnas pa'i 'du shes sngon du btang ba'i yid la byed pas sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos brtan pa ma yin pa rnams dang brtan pa rnams las kyang kha cig 'gog pa ste, rnam par shes pa bdun 'gog pa, snyoms 'jug dgu'i mthar gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin no/

bden pa bzhi'i nang gses, rang rgyu lam la brten nas spang bya kun 'byung las nyon gtan du mi skye bar byas te spangs pa ste, 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras rgyun chad pa'i 'gog pa ni nad med pa'i bde ba lta bu thob par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bslu bas 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/

rnam pa bzhi: bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi nang tshan zhig ste nyon mongs pa dang sdig pa'i las rnams spangs te mi 'byung bas 'gog pa dang, sdug bsngal ci yang mi 'byung bas zhi ba dang, phyis kyang khams gsum du skye zhing sdug bsngal myong bar mi 'gyur bas gya nom pa, 'khor ba las thar te myang 'das kyi gnas bde bar phyin pas nges 'byung bcas bzhi'o/

ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang don gnyis khyad chos 'ga' zhig gis mtshungs kyang, dpe skyon gcig gis dpe can dang mtshungs las 'gog pa'i tshul gyis so sor 'byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
rnam thar brgyad kyi nang gses, sems sems byung nye bar zhi bar gnas pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin la 'du shes dang tshor ba rags pa 'gog pa'i rnam thar ro/

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa'i dpe can des, 'gog byed rang gi bya ba mi mthun pa byed pas gzugs su byas pa'i chos de dngos gnas min par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
dgra bo 'gog pa dang rang phyogs srung ba/
bye ma dang rlung 'tshub sogs kyi gnod pa 'gog ched du btsugs pa'i shing nags/

(rnying) 1) zhum pa dang, zhed pa, skrag pa, zil gyis non pa/ sems mi 'gong ba/ tsha zer gyi nus par mi 'gong ba/ 2) 'gal ba/ btsan po'i khrims las 'gong bar su yis nus/ 3) 'gran pa/ nyi zla'i 'od dang 'gong bar nus pa/ 4) smad pa/ 5) 'da' ba'am thal che ba/ grangs tshad las 'gong ba/ 6) thar ba/ rgya rnyi las 'gong ba/

(tha dad pa) bkod pa, dgod pa, khod,, 1) 'jog pa/ 'gro sa'i gzhung lam du bkod pa/ rgan rgon rnams bde skyid kyi sar 'god pa/ rtsig pa'i ldebs la 'brug sgor rgyan du bkod pa/ ..bkod 'chun/ 2) 'bri ba/ chings yig la ming rtags 'god pa/ don gnad tshang ma yig thog tu bkod pa/ yar rgyas gtong ba'i 'char gzhi 'god pa/ gsar 'gyur rnams tshags par gyi nang du bkod yod pa/
theg pa la 'god pa dang, bde ba la 'god pa dang, rig pa la 'god pa dang, chos la 'god pa bcas bzhi'o/
(tha dad pa) bgoms pa, bgom pa, bgoms,, steng nas gom pa brgyab ste rgal ba'am 'gro ba/ rkub bkyag gi steng nas bgoms te phyin pa/ yig rigs bkram sar phar 'gom tshur 'gom ma byed/
steng nas 'gom zhing 'og tu gnon pa/ zhing kha'i nang gi ljang pa rnams 'gom rdzi btang nas ma 'gro/
tshur 'gom gyi rkang 'gros:/ lam khar yod pa'i rdo pha bong la 'gom yug btang ste phyin pa/ gzhan gyi mgo lus steng du 'gom yug ma gtong/
dus tshod dang las ka sogs phyi 'gyangs/
'gor ba/ lam kyog skor skor mang na mdun du bskyod rgyur 'gor thogs yong/
(tha mi dad pa) yun ring thogs pa/ kha sang mngags pa'i mi de yun ring 'gor song/ lam du 'gor nas dus thog tu slebs ma thub pa/
'gor ba'i rkyen rtsa/ lam thag nye po zhig la de tsam 'gor gzhi ga re byung ngam/
dben pa'i sa'am dal ba'i sa/
dal po/ brel zing med pa'i dus 'gol po zhig la skad cha lhod lhod byed/
/ 1) dben pa/ sa cha 'di las 'gol ba zhig 'dug / 'gol bar sba ba/ 2) lhod pa'am khom pa/ nga sngon nas khyed rang gi gam du bcar 'dod yod kyang 'gol ba zhig ma byung bas da bar 'gyangs song/
dal po'am lhod pa'i bar mtshams/ 'gol gseng 'di 'dra'i skabs su 'bad brtson byed

lho kha sa khul khongs 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi sa khul 'ching nga zer bar byung ba'i sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig de las 'gos chos 'grub dang 'gos gzhon nu dpal zhes pa'i lo tsa ba chen po rnams byon/

lhag khri srong lde btsan skabs kyi blon po: zhig yin pa 'dis bsad pa stong gi zhal lce dang rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce sogs byang bu cha dgur grags pa'i don tshan bco brgyad thog mar gtan la phab pas, 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi ya gyal/
gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de mched pa'i nad/

bod rgyal khri ral pa can gyi sku dus su byon pa'i bod rigs lo tsa ba chen po zhig yin pa 'dis mdo dkon mchog brtsegs pa las 'phags pa go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa zhes pa dang, lang kar gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po zhes pa, mdzangs blun zhes bya ba'i mdo sogs mdo sde khag mang rgya yig nas bod yig tu bsgyur cing, bod yig gi mdo sde khag mang rgya yig tu bsgyur par ma zad, rgya bod kyi sa mtshams su phebs nas lo nyi shu lhag tsam gyi ring la dam chos 'chad rtsom gyi 'phrin las rgya chen zhig kyang gnang yod/
'gos lo tsa ba gzhon nu dpal

rab byung bdun pa'i chu sprel lo la 'khrungs pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i lo tsa ba grags can zhig rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel lo la deb ther sngon po brtsams, rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags glang lo la 'das/ (1392-1481)...1476... 1478...

(tha mi dad pa) 'gyangs pa, 'gyang ba,, phyi nur byed pa dang dus las 'da' ba/ chu tshod gcig las mi 'gyang bar 'grub pa'i las de nyin gcig gi bar du 'gyangs song/ dus yun ring po mi 'gyang bar legs par sgrub thub yong/
khral bun dus tshod las 'gyangs pa'i nyes chad, spyir btang du nyin bzhin je lcir gtong ba red/
(yul) 'gram/ brag 'gyam/ gad 'gyam/ phong 'gyam/ pha bong 'gyam/ ri'i 'gyam/ chu'i 'gyam/
brtan po med pa'i rnam pa/ sems brtan 'gyar 'gyur med pa/
rtswa rigs kyi nang nas byung ba'i 'byar: bag can gyi spyin zhig / 'gyig lham/ 'gyig mdong/ 'gyig 'khor/
mngar char 'gyig rgyu bsres pa'i byi ril/
nyams chen po'i gom pa spo stangs/
1) mdzes pa dang, dpa' ba'i rnam 'gyur/ 2) nyams chen po'i rnam 'gyur/ glang rgan ltar 'gying nyams che la byi ba ltar blo khog chung ba/
1) lus kyis 'gying stabs byed pa/ 2) sems kyis khengs nyams bstan pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'gyings pa, 'gying ba, 'gyings,, che nyams byed pa/ 'gying bzhin du 'gro ba/ stag mo nags nas 'gying, khyi mo tshang nas 'gying/ gzhan gyi yon tan la dang ba mi ston par ches cher 'gyings na rjes lus thebs rgyur thag chod/ gdan khri mthon po'i steng du bsdad nas 'gyings na mang tshogs dang 'brel lam chad yong/ 2. sgeg nyams/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur 'gying ba'i tshul gyis zlos gar 'khrab pa/ seng ge rnam par 'gyings pa/
1) lus kyi che nyams/ 2) sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur/
(tha mi dad pa) 'gyus pa, 'gyu ba,, 'phro ba'am gzhan du g.yo ba/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu/ dran pa brtan po med pas rnam rtog 'gyus pa/ nam mkha'i sprin nag nang nas glog 'gyu ba/
/ glu dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug bde po'i skad snyan zhig rgyang ring nas thos byung/
yig rigs shig yig rigs gzhan la bsgyur zin pa la slar bzo bcos byed pa/
'gyur bar nges/ hur brtson ma byas na las don nyams par 'gyur ta re:/ las don ngan pa byas na 'bras bu mi 'dod pa 'byung bar 'gyur ta re/

(yul) tshong thag chod de rin ma byung bar du gzhan la mi 'tshong ba'i kha chad du bzhag pa'i dngos po/ zog rin grangs tshang sprod len byas mtshams sngar bzhag 'gyur rten dngul 'bor de dag rin 'bab thog nas gcog dgos/

/ dbyar dus kyi gnam gshis la 'gyur ldog chen po 'dug / lo gcig nang gi gnas tshul la'ang 'gyur ldog mang po yong/ brtan brtan tig tig byas na 'gyur ldog byung yang nor mi yong/ las ka tshang ma 'gyur ldog gnas lugs nges can zhig yod pa sha stag yin/
bstan bcos kyi gzhung bod du bsgyur ba'i: tshe thog mar lo tsa ba rang nyid gus pa'i lha la phyag byas pa'o

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1, snga rgyun mi gnas par gsar pa zhig tu 'pho 'gro ba/ ngo bo 'gyur ba/ cha rkyen 'gyur song/ go sa 'gyur kyang rung ma 'gyur kyang rung/ rtag brtan mi 'gyur/ nad kyi gzhi bab 'gyur ba/ gtsang chu'i 'gro lam 'gyur yong/ 2, gyur pa, 'gyur ba,, sngar dang mi 'dra bar 'byung ba'am 'grub pa/ lcong mo sbal par gyur song/ shing lo ser por 'gyur yong/ rlangs pa gcig yin yang dma' sar smug pa dang, mtho sar sprin par 'gyur ba/ sku khams bde bar gyur cig / dge legs su gyur cig / 2. 1) gsar rnying dang, dar rgud sogs 'byung ba'i bya rim/ dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba/ bsam blo'i 'gyur ba/ gnas tshul la 'gyur ba med pa/ 2) skad yig rigs mi 'dra ba gcig nas gcig tu bsgyur ba'i gzhung rnams/ bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur/ snga 'gyur/ phyis 'gyur/ rnying 'gyur/ gsar 'gyur/ 3. ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshig grogs shig / chu rgyun 'chad par 'gyur/ shing gcod par 'gyur/ 'byung 'gyur/
sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor dang po'i skabs su thob pa'i sa dang po ste, tshogs lam du zag ldog gnyis ka yod pas 'gyur ba ma nges pa'i sa zhes bya'o/

1) mi pho mo gang rung zhig gi mtshan ma brtan por mi gnas par zla stod zla smad la ltos nas pho yin na mo dang, mo yin na phor rang bzhin gyis 'gyur 'gro mkhan/ 2) rjes 'jug gi ma ning yi ge na ra la gsum ming gzhi pho yig gi mthar yang 'jug yod med gang rung ste, bstand pa, bskor ba, btsal ba zhes sogs lta bu drag par 'gyur ba dang, ming gzhi mo yig gi rjes su yang 'jug med pa ste, 'gran pa, 'gor ba, 'gul ba zhes sogs lta bu zhan par 'gyur ba rnams/ na ra la...da drag / bstand pa bskor ba btsal ba...da drag / 'gran pa 'gor ba 'gul ba...
gtan du mi gnas pa'i gnad 'gag /

zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba ste 'di ni nam zhig na yang sdug bsngal bskyed par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya la, de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung gzhan rnams dang gang la dmigs nas skye ba'i yul zag bcas rnams kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal lo, sdug bsngal gsum gyi ya gyal zhig
skad cig re re nas gzhan du 'gyur zhing mi rtag pa/
sngar gyi ming min pa'i ming gzhan/
brtan po'i ming/ rtsa ba brtan por tshugs na 'gyur med sra thang yong/

pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi bu gnyis pa 'dis pha'i go sa shul 'dzin byas nas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung, jun gar dang lkog g.yo ngan 'brel byas nas khos shin tu mi 'os pa'i bya ba ngan pa ci rigs byas rkyen bod bzhugs aam ban gyis kho pa bsad/ (?-1750)...1747...1750...
'pho 'gyur med pa'i 'tsho ba'i rten sa khang pa sogs/
yongs grub kyi nang gses 'khrul gzhi gzhan dbang dang 'khrul ba kun btags gnyis kas stong pa'i med dgag de bzhin nyid 'dus ma byas pa ste bdag med dang stong nyid do/
skad yig lo tsas bsgyur ba'i rjod byed
dge 'dun sogs tshogs pa la 'bul rgyu'i dngul dang rgyu dngos gang rung/ ris med kun 'gyed/ sku 'gyed btang ba/
gcod lugs las bshad pa'i dkar 'gyed dang, dmar 'gyed, khra 'gyed, nag 'gyed bcas bzhi/
1) dge 'dun pa sogs la dngul dngos 'bul ba/ 2) 'gyed gtong sbyin bdag gis bos pa'i mgron po'am, 'gyed gtong rogs byed mkhan/

(tha dad pa) bkyes pa, bkye ba, khyes,, 1) gtong ba/ bang chen 'gyed pa/ 2) spro ba/ 'od zer bkyes pa/ 3) sprul ba/ sprul pa bkye ba/ 4) rtsod pa/ g.yul 'gyed pa/ kha mchu 'gyed pa/ 5) gtong ba dang sbyin pa/ gsol ston 'gyed pa/ mi rer skal ba re 'gyed pa/
grwa pa sogs la 'grems sprod byed pa'i rgyu chas/
skyo thog la brnyas bcos byed pa/
(tha mi dad pa) mar ril ba/ mi shi rta 'gyel/ shing sdong bcad nas sa la 'gyel 'dug / rkang pa rdo la thogs te 'gyel ba/ 'gyel ba'i steng la rdog brdzis, mu ge'i steng la zla lhag /

1) rta phyugs sa la nyal nas 'gre log rgyag pa'i ming / rta drel sa la nyal nas phar tshur 'gyel log rgyag pa/ 2) khang pa'i rtsig pa sogs nyil ba/ khang rnying gog po'i gyang rtsig 'gyel log song ba/
(tha mi dad pa) gyes pa, 'gyes pa,, 'bral ba/ bza' tshang tha dad du gyes pa/ zhal 'gyes pa/ rnam pa gnyis su 'gyes pa/ grogs po phan tshun so sor gyes pa/
(tha dad pa) bkyags pa, bkyag pa, khyog , 'degs pa/ rdo de khyed kyis yar 'gyog thub bam/ gnam yar la 'gyog par shed dgos sa mar la gnon par ljid dgos/
/ 1) dngos po lci ba'i rigs yar 'degs pa'i thabs shes shig / ka ba 'di la 'gyogs shig brgyab ste gsar pa 'dzugs dgos/ 2) 'degs rgya'am rgya ma/ rgya 'gyogs/ 3) byams sam khyogs/ phebs 'gyogs chen po/
khang pa'i ka ba thang po med rigs la 'degs rogs kyi ka ba 'dzugs pa/
'gyogs rgyag skabs 'gyogs mda'i 'og tu 'jug rgyu'i rdo shing sogs/
skabs 'gyogs gnon sar btags nas mar: 'then rgyu'i thag pa
'gyogs rgyag skabs yar bkan byed kyi mda' shing/
'gyogs mda' gnon byed ljid che'i dngos rigs sogs/
ka ba gsar rnying brje skabs rnying pa'i g.yas g.yon du btsugs pa'i ka tshab/
'gyod pa skyes te gzhi nas don rtogs pa/
'gyod pa skyes te sems sdug byung ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) las ka nyes nas sems khral 'byung ba/ sngar 'gyod phyis sdom/ rta pho gzhis su ma gsos byes su 'gyod/ sngar byas nor 'khrul yin par shes te gzhi nas 'gyod/ rang 'gan legs par sgrub thub na shi'ang mi 'gyod/ ming gi rnam grangs la rjes su 'gyod pa dang, rjes su bcags pa, rjes gdung ba, rnam par snyil ba bcas so, 2./ 1) sngar byas nor bar yid mi dga' ba'i sems/ dpyad pa sngon la btang na mkhas pa yin, 'gyod pa mjug la skyes na blun po yin/ 2) gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, sngar byas la yid mi dga' ba'i shes pa sems gnas pa'i bar du gcod pa'i byed las can no/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bsnyen rdzogs kyi yon tan la smod pa'am khyod la sdom pa ma skyes zhes sogs kyi sgo nas dge slong gzhan yid mi bde bar 'jug pa'o/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste dgag bya bsgrub 'os kyi bya ba gang rung zhig 'gog byed rnam g.yeng gi gzhan dbang du gyur nas de dag sgrub ma thub par don med du dus yol bas 'gyod gdung gtso bor ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
sngar byas kyi nyes par gnong zhing, bshags pas sems rgyud dag gtsang du gyur pa/
sngar byas nyes par 'gyod sems kyis bshags pa byed pa/
sngar byas nyes par sun snang skyes pa'i sems/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'grangs pa, 'grang ba,, zas kyis tshim pa/ zas kyis grod pa 'grangs drags nas na song/ spyang ki rta zos lug ros ma 'grangs/ gung tshigs zhim po grod khog 'grangs par zos pa/ 2. grod pa rgyags pa'i ming/ 'grangs pa gnyid khug kyang, ltod pa gnyid mi khug /
kha gtad du langs nas rgol ba/
gshibs te su bzang lta ba/ 'gran sdur skul yig

1. (tha dad pa) sdur ba/ rig pa 'gran pa/ ngas khong dang stobs shugs 'gran par bya dgos, khyed kyis kyang 'gran cig / sger sems che ba'i mi des gzhan gyi ming grags dang go gnas kho nar 'gran 'dod byed pa/ shing sdong la yar 'dzeg pa'i lus rtsal de spra dang spre'u la 'gran thub pa/ las don hur brtson byed mkhan la mig ltos yar 'gran byed dgos/ srin bu me khyer gyis nyi ma la 'gran pa/ 2. mtshungs pa dang mnyam pa/ rta mgyogs pa kying bser rlung la 'gran/
kha gtad/ rnam dpyod 'gran zla dang bral ba/ mi mang po'i nang nas dpa' ngar 'gran zla bral ba kho rang yin/ las ka la khur sems 'gran zla med pa/
kha gtad/ dpa' bo 'gran ya med pa/
'gran zla byed pa'i bsam blo/ rgyal pham gyi 'gran sems shar ba/

/ 1) 'khris sam gam/ rtsig pa'i 'gram/ chu 'gram/ sgo 'gram/ grong pa'i nye 'gram/ lam gyi 'gram/ 2) rtsig rmang/ 'gram 'ding ba/ 3) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnya' nang rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod pa'i bal bod bar gyi 'gag sgo zhig /
1) 'gram nas skyor byed dam srung byed kyi rwa ba/ 2) 'gram pa lag pas skyor ba/
ldan pa la gzhu byed kyi lag lcag / 'gram lcag gzhu ba
kha'i 'gram pa'i nang du 'khor ba'i chu/ shing tog skyur mo za 'dod kyis rang dbang med par 'gram chu ldang ba/
1) za 'dod langs pa/ 2) ha las te yid smon skye ba/ de la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos/ gzhan gyi rgyu nor la 'gram chu khol mi dgos/
'gram pa kong kong ngam, 'gram kyong/ spo bo 'gram stong/
byad kyi ldan pa/ yas kyi 'gram pa/ mas kyi 'gram pa/ 'gram pa lag pa la gtad pa/ 'gram pa sgul cig /
rlung nad rigs shig ste 'gram pa yas mas las byed kyi rtsa nyams nas so 'thams shing, kha 'byed 'dzum byed dka' ba zhig /
snyoms chung lugs mthun gyi spyod pa/ 'gram pa sa phab kyi gus 'dud sgo nas gnas lugs drang por gsol/
'dra ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, tshig kyal ba spangs pas 'gram pa seng ge'i 'gram pa 'dra ba/
thong gshol pus gug gi 'gram pa g.yas g.yon gyi 'gram lhan shing gnyis/
rmang gzhi/ dran gso khang gi 'gram gzhi 'ding ba/
gyi zur gdong:/ sga'i 'gram gshog / rtsig pa'i 'gram gshog / sna'i 'gram gshog /
(tha mi dad pa) khyab pa'am mched pa/ nad rims 'grams pa/ rmas 'grams pa/
rtas brdab pa dang g.yang du lhung ba sogs lus 'grams pa las byung ba'i tshad pa ste, nang gses su phyi yi yul gzhi 'grams pa dang, nang gi don snod 'grams pa gnyis mchis so/
(rnying) gya gyu can nam g.yon can/
(tha mi dad pa) zhe ldog pa'am mi dga' bar gyur pa/ zhe 'gras khon 'gras/ spyod ngan mthong nas zhe 'gras pa/ kha 'gras lag 'gras/

'grig po mthun po/ 'grig pa, (tha mi dad pa) 'grigs pa, 'grig pa,, 1) 'os shing 'tshams pa/ ma bsgrigs rang 'grig / gzugs po'i che chung la dpags pa'i gyon chas cha 'dzabs 'grig pa/ shing gi 'byar kha 'grig pa/ 2) mthun pa/ rtsod gleng 'grigs na bzang/ 'grig pa'i tsha la ma gtogs, mi 'grig pa'i dkrug shing ma byed/ de ring zhu rgyu de tsam gyis 'grig pa/ gtan nas mi 'grig pa/
ran po dang, mthun po dang, 'tshams po/ nam rgyun kho gnyis 'grig po yod/ da res kyi las ka gra 'grig po byung song/
1) ma 'grigs pa/ 2) 'grig dang mi 'grig / rtsom yig 'grig min slob ston gnang 'tshal/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) zad pa'am nyung ngur phyin pa/ gtsang po'i chu rgyun 'phel 'grib sna tshogs yong/ mtsho chu mi 'grib mi lud pa/ mar ngo'i dus su zla ba'i cha rim gyis mar 'grib pa/ 2) brgal ba/ nyi ma 'grib song/
phyogs phan tshun du 'gro ba/ 'grim 'grul mkho chas/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren/ 'grim 'grul bde po/ sa chu gnam gsum gyi 'grim 'grul las don yar rgyas btang ba/

(tha mi dad pa) 'grims pa, 'grim pa, 'grims,, myul ba dang 'gro ba/ phyogs su 'grim pa/ la lung 'grim pa/ chos ra 'grim pa/ yul lung so sor 'grims nas phyin pa/ yig rigs lag 'grim byas nas lta ba/ sa phag rnams lag 'grims kyis khang pa'i thog khar gtong ba/ slob grwa rim gyis 'grims nas shes yon sbyang ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) 'du ba/ nang don rdog 'gril ba/ shog ril bshig nas brkyangs pa rang shugs kyis ril bor 'gril song/ bsam blo mthun po byung na stobs shud gcig tu 'gril rgyur thag chod/ rgyug chu khag mang dma' sa gcig tu 'gril ba/ 2) 'khor bzhin pa'i ngang nas lhung ba/ kha ba ri ldebs nas nyil dus gong bu je cher 'gril ba/ rdo de gyen gzar po zhig nas yar 'dren ma thub pas thur du 'gril 'dug / 2. nad pa'i lag rtsa 'phar stangs shig /
(rnying) gos la tshos rgyag dus byung ba'i khra thig /

(tha mi dad pa) grub pa, 'grub pa,, 1) legs par tshar ba dang, chags pa/ yun ring bar du dka' las chen po byas te gzhi nas re 'dod ltar 'grub thub pa/ las don 'grub dgos na 'bad brtson byed dgos/ skud pa gcig gis ras mi 'grub, sdong po gcig gis nags mi 'grub/ sdong po mang na rlung 'gog mi mgo mang na las 'grub/ 2) yod pa dang, gnas pa'am 'byung ba/ rtags ma grub/ gzhi ma grub pa/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan, sred pa'i yan lag dang, len pa'i yan lag dang, srid pa'i yan lag bcas ni skye ba mngon par 'grub par byed pas 'grub pa'i yan lag gsum mo/

gza' skar bzang po'i 'phrod sbyor te res gza' bdun la 'grub sbyor bdun yod de, nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor dang, zla ba gro bzhin 'grub sbyor, mig dmar dbyu gu'i 'grub sbyor, lhag pa lha mtshams 'grub sbyor, rgyal phur 'grub sbyor pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor, spen pa snar ma'i 'grub sbyor te bdun no/
'grul pa gsar pa slebs pa'i gnod pa/
phyogs 'gro'i 'grul pa rnams kyi gnas tshang/
'grul pa mang po gur phub ste mnyam du sdod pa'i gnas/
phyogs su 'gro skabs 'khyer ba'i mgo chas/
phyogs la 'gro mkhan/ de ring nga tsho'i khyim mtshes pa'i nang la 'grul pa 'byor 'dug /
(tha mi dad pa) lam du skyod pa'am 'gro ba/ rgya lam du 'grul pa 'grul ba/ khrom srang yangs por rlangs 'khor 'grul ba/ nags gseb tu gcan gzan 'grul ba/

'grul la mgyogs po phyin pa'i don/ lam bar 'gyang 'gor chung ched nyin mtshan ltos med 'grul tsha po brgyab pa/ g.yul sa'i mdun phyogs su dmag 'khrug drag po byed bzhin yod pas 'grul tsha po brgyab nas dpung sde 'jug dgos/
phar tshur 'gro ba'i don/ 'grul bzhud bde po 'dug / 'grul bzhud bcad pa/
phyogs su 'gro rogs sam lam rogs/
1. (tha dad pa) brtson pa'am 'bad pa/ 'grus na mi 'grub gang yang med/ 2. 'bad pa'i ming/ las don gang la yang 'grus pa gal che/
gzugs po phar slog tshur slog byed pa'i ming / rta drel bong bu rnams bye thang 'jam po la nyal nas 'gre ldog rgyag pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 'gres pa, 'gre ba,, 1) rigs mtshungs su 'gyur ba'am 'pho ba/ snga phyi tshang ma rigs 'gres song/ de byings tshang ma 'de'i rigs 'gre btang chog / rigs pa 'gres nas shes pa/ 2) 'gyel log byed pa/ sa la phar 'gre tshur 'gre byed pa/ 3) (rnying) g.yo ba
'gre ldog / na zug skyes nas phar tshur 'gre log rgyag pa
(tha mi dad pa) 'grengs pa, 'greng ba, 'grengs,, lang ba/ dma' sa nas yar 'greng ba/ glo bur 'greng ba/ dmag mi rnams ru bsgrigs su 'grengs nas bsdad 'dug /
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dben par nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lhan cig 'greng ba'i spyod lam gyis gnas pa'o/
bod yig gi dbyangs gsum pa mtshon byed/
gom tshugs ma brtan par rkang pa shor stangs/ 'dzeg skas la 'gred bdar shor nas lhung ba/ 'khyags steng du rkang pa 'gred bdar shor nas 'gyel ba/
rkang 'gred lus brdab/ gyen thur gzar po la gzab gzab ma byas na 'gred brdab shor nas rkang chag lag bsnad yong nyen yod/ rgas 'khogs thur lam la gom pa 'khyor nas 'gred brdab shor song/
rkang pa 'gred bdar shor ba/ rdo skas la rkang pa 'gred 'byid kyis rbab ril thebs song/
dgram bya kha bkram nas mig lam du ston pa/ 'grems ston khang/

(tha dad pa) bkram pa, dgram pa, khroms,, khod snyoms por 'ding ba/ bye ma dgram pa/ tshong zog rnams phyi rol tu bkram pa/ lug khyu ri la 'grems/ tshong zog bkram nas mang tshogs la stabs bde byung ba/
kha bkram nas khyab thabs byed pa/
rtsa don zhib tshags su bkral ba'i rnam bshad/
sems 'grel skor gsum nang tshan, dus 'khor rgyud kyi 'grel bshad, rigs ldan pad dkar gyis brtsams/
tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i 'grel ba mchan bur btags pa/
rtsa don go sla ba'am gsal du gtong ba'i tshig /
dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang sum ston ye shes gzungs kyis mdzad pa'i bshad rgyud kyi dgongs don rnams gsal bar 'grel ba'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
kha che pan chen zla ba mngon pa dga' bas mdzad pa'i slob dpon dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa shin tu chen po zhig /
'grel pa nyung ngu'i don rgyas par 'grol ba'i gzhung/
(tha dad pa) bkral ba, dgrol ba, khrol,, rtsa don go sla ba'am gsal bar byed pa/ dka' 'grel/ don 'grel/ tshig 'grel/ go dka' ba'i tshig mdud so sor 'grel ba/
pa li ta: slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos shig /
don zhib tu bkral ba'i bshad pa/
tshig don 'grel bshad kyi yig 'bru kha snon/
tshigs bcad dum bu re'i mtshams su gzud rgyu'i rigs 'gres gtong rung ba'i tshig rkang/
phung po dang, skye mched, khams, rten 'brel, zas, bden pa, byang phyogs kyi chos te bdun/

'gre ba'i 'das pa, 'gro, yod las che'am yin las che/ skad cha shod mkhan kho rang yin 'gro/ khyed rang la'ang 'gan 'khris yod 'gro/ nyal sa'i 'khris su sman zhog dang, khos 'thung 'gro/ ched du skad gtong dgos mi 'dug kho rang yong gi yod 'gro/
'gro la nye ba'i dus/ 'gro khar ma dang ma 'gras/ sang nyin 'gro kha la mor nga skad gtong rogs/
1) mgo 'dren nam zhu brgyud/ 2) tshong zog brin yul/ 3) dngos po bed spyod 'gro yul/
rgyu nor zad sgo/ 'gro gron mkhas gtong/
(aashwa) sh'akya thub pa'i nyan thos drug sde'i nang tshan zhig /
rtag tu 'gro ba'am yang yang 'gro mus su yod pa/ phyogs nas phyogs su rtag par 'gro 'gro ba/
sngon du thon pa'i mi phyugs/ dngos po rnams de nas 'di gar 'gro snga ba su yod gdong dam don gyis bskur rogs gnang/
phyogs 'gro'i lam rgyags dang, yo byad/ phyogs thon nam byed la 'gro chas gang dgos sngon tshud nas gra sgrig byed dgos/
1) brin rgyug che ba/ tshong zong 'gro che ba/ 2) 'gro sgo che ba/ zas nor 'gro che ba/ 3) lam du lhong che ba/ bya ba lam du 'gro che ba/
phal cher 'gro la nye ba'am phal cher 'gro rgyur nges pa/
1) gom pas bgrod stangs/ 2) spyi'i lam srol lam byed lugs byed stangs/ 3) 'tsho thabs skyel stangs/
'gro stangs sdod stangs dang don gcig
1) bya ba byed lugs/ 'gro stangs sdod stangs mi shes pa'i gnas su gyar ba/ 2) 'gro stangs dang sdod stangs kyi rnam pa/

1) zhi zhing dul ba'i 'gro tshul/ zhum bus byi'u 'dzin pa ltar rdig sgra med pa'i 'gro stangs bzo ba zhig dgos/ 2) bza' tshang ngam 'tsho thabs sgrig pa/ sngar bu dang bu mo la pha mas phugs kyi 'gro stangs bzo srol yod/
1) sems can nam gzhan gyi khe phan/ 2) 'gro dgos pa'i don/
phyir 'gro nang sdod sod kyi bya ba byed stangs/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'gro 'dug kun spyod tshul dang mthun pa byed dgos/
'gro ba rnams ngan song las 'dren pa po/
spong len gnyis ka byed mi bde ba/
/ 1) brin che ba/ tshong zog 'di 'gro po 'dug / 2) thag ring bgrod thub po/ rta 'di ha cang 'gro po 'dug / 3) ngag thog tu skyor thub po/ dpe cha ngag thog tu 'gro po 'dug /
sems can la phan pa'i las/
rjes su thon pa'i mi phyugs/ 'gro phyogs, 1) 'gro sa'i kha phyogs sam lam phyogs/ 2) mgo 'dren/ 'gro phyogs zab po/ nges par du 'gro phyogs 'tshol dgos/

1. (tha mi dad pa) phyin pa, 'gro ba, song,, 1) mchi ba/ thon chas bsgrigs te phyogs la 'gro chog chog byas/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro/ yar 'gro mar 'gro/ phan tshun du 'gro ba/ khye'u 'gro mi thub pa zhig / rjes su 'gro ba/ yul byol du 'gro ba/ rtag par 'gro dgos/ gzhan yul du phyin song/ phar song/ 2) 'bab pa dang lhung ba/ rna bar 'gro ba'i skad cha/ mig la mi 'gro ba/ lam du mi 'gro ba/ blo la mi 'gro ba/ mgo bo'i rtse la phog nas, sna'i gzhung la 'gro ba/ 3) shong ba/ snod chas 'dir 'bru khal brgyad cu 'gro ba/ son khal lnga 'gro ba'i zhing kha/ 4) 'gyur ba/ nus stobs che ru 'gro ba/ sdug bsngal du 'gro ba/ dug tu 'gro ba/ 5) 'jug pa/ sman du 'gro ba/ 'gro rgyun/ shog dngul de bzhin gang sa gang du 'gro ba/ 2./ 1) sems can/ ngan 'gro/ bde 'gro/ bcud kyi 'jig rten 'gro ba rigs drug / 2) (mngon) 'gro ba rigs drug yod pas grangs drug mtshon/
dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ste ngan 'gro gsum dang, mi dang lha ste bde 'gro gnyis bcas lnga'o/
thugs lnga'i ya gyal zhig bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni sprul sku 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs zhes rnying gzhung du gsal/
dud 'gro dang, yi dwags, dmyal ba ste ngan 'gro gsum gyi spyi ming/
lha ma yin lha'i khongs su gtogs dang klu'i khongs su gtogs gnyis yod pas so so'i khungs su bsdus pas, lha ma yin ma gtod pa'i lha mi dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ste lnga'o/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i gsang ston slob dpon gyis bsgrub bya la bar chad 'dri bar 'gro ba bzhi dang bral ba zhig dgos pa ste, 'dun pas 'gro ba zhes pa bsgrub bya dang gsang ston mdza' ba zhig yin na bar chad yod kyang gsang nas mi smra ba dang, 'jigs pas 'gro ba zhes pa gsang ston bsgrub bya la skrag nas smra mi phod pa dang, zhe sdang gis 'gro ba zhes pa gsang ston dang bsgrub bya mi mthun na log par smra ba dang, rmongs pas 'gro ba zhes pa bsgrub bya la bar chad yod med mi shes pa bcas bzhi'o/
lha dang, lha ma yin, mi ste mtho ris gsum gyi spyi ming/

sngar mon yul rta dbang khul gyi mandala sgang la bram ze bgres song zhig gi bu mo 'gro ba bzang mo zhes pa de mi 'dod bzhin du rgyal po'i btsun mor phyin rjes mi ngan gyis gnod 'tshe drag po bskyal ba bzod ma thub par brten rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i yul du gshegs pa dang, rang gi bu dang, bu mo mi'i yul du lus pa de gnyis mi ngan gyis gsod thabs sna tshogs byas kyang ma shi ba'i mthar bu des rang lo longs nas mi ngan bsad de dgra sha blangs pa'i sgrung gi lo rgyus rnams gzhir bzhag gis bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi zlos gar lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung zhig
lha lhar rigs mthun pa, mi mir rigs mthun pa sogs/
lha ma yin, mi, dud 'gro, yi dwags, dmyal ba ste drug /
(mngon) sems can rnams la thar lam ston pa po ste sangs rgyas/

nyes byas kyi sde tshan gnyis pa spyod yul du 'gro ba'i sde tshan la, lus ngag ma bsdams pa dang, gos tshags led par ma bgo ba dang, ca co dang bcas pa dang, mig g.yas g.yon du lta ba dang, gnya' shing gang las ring du lta ba dang, mgo gos kyis btum pa dang, sham thabs 'doms snang bar brdze ba dang, bla gos phrag pa gnyis kar gzar ba dang, lag pa gnyis mdun nas gnya' bar bsnol ba dang, rgyab nas lhag par bsnol ba dang, mchong ba dang, gom chen spos pa dang, rting pa btsugs te tsog pur 'gro ba dang, rting pa btegs nas rkang pa'i brang gis 'gro ba dang, gru rgyangs bcas pa dang, lus kyog por bsgyur ba dang, lag pa g.yob pa dang, mgo bo gcog cing bsgyur ba dang, gzhan dang phrag pa sprad pa dang, gzhan dang lag pa sbrel ba bcas kyis 'gro ba na nyes byas su 'gyur ba ste nyi shu'o/
'gro ba'i skabs mtshams/ gzhan gyi khe dbang 'phrog 'dod kyi bsam pas 'gro tshod lta ba/
'gro ba'i skabs mtshams/ gnod 'tshe'i bsam pas gzhan la 'gro mtshams lta ba/
gzhan du 'gro ba la mtsher snang/ rkang pa mi bde ba'i skabs phar tshur 'gro mtsher yong gi 'dug /
phyogs su 'gro mkhan la sprod rgyu'i lag rtags/
khrims mthun byed pa'i tshul lugs/
1) phar 'gro tshur 'ong/ grong khyer gyi nang du mi mang po rgyun du 'gro 'ong byed pa/ 2) (mngon) lo/
'gro ba'i res mo/ de ring nga rang 'gro res yin/
(yul) khur sems med pa'i las ka thabs chag

1) 'grul bzhud byed sa'i lam/ 'gro lam sgyur ba/ rlangs 'khor gyi 'gro lam bde po/ phan tshun 'gro lam bzur ba/ phyi nang gi 'gro lam bsubs pa/ chu log rgyugs pas gyen thur gyi 'gro lam zhig pa/ 2) lugs srol dang byed thabs/ snga dus gyi 'gro lam bzang po ma nyams pa byed/ 'tsho ba'i 'gro lam bzang po zhig byung yod pa/
'gro shas che'am 'gro nyen che/ phad gog de'i nang la 'bru khal bcu tsam 'gro las che/ de ltar byas na 'tsho ba yar rgyas su 'gro las che/
phal cher 'gro/ kho rang 'gro shas che/ dmag gi gdong len du 'gro shas che/
1) lam/ 2) gzhan du phyin pa'i bar gseng/ kho 'gro shul du 'tshol mkhan mi gcig slebs byung/
'gro ba'i grabs/ khyed ma 'dug la mo 'gro shom gyis/
1) lam ga / 2) 'gro sa'i gnas yul/ khra chung mig la rngul dang, dam pa'i chos la rdzun 'gro sa med/ nags mthug po chen po'i gseb tu mgo 'thoms nas 'gro sa mam rnyed pa/
'gro sgo/ 'gro song rtsag rtsig / 'gro song rtsis zhu/ 'gro song gtong deb/ dgos med gzan rgyag che ba'i 'gro song nyung du gtong ba/ gang byung gis nyo cha brgyab na 'gro song che ba yong/

bsam spyod mthun po/ 'grogs pa, (tha dad pa) sdeb pa/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa/ grogs dang 'grogs nas gzhan du phyin/ phan tshun 'bral med rtag tu 'grogs pa/ khyo shug gnyis 'grogs nas sdod pa/ gshis ka ngan pa'i mi dang mnyam du 'grogs dka' zhing, bsam bzang go shes can dang lhan cig 'grogs bde ba/
dga' ba'i sems sam mthun pa'i sems/
(rnying) pho mo'i mtshan ma'am 'doms/ 'grong gis 'grong la sbyar ba/
(tha mi dad pa) grongs pa, 'grongs pa,, 'chi ba/ na tsha yun ring na nas grongs song/ grongs nas nyi ma gsum song/
'gron bu bsregs pa'i thal ba ste, ro tsha la kha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas skran bshig khrag gcod rnag dang chu ser skem/
(tha dad pa) bkrol ba, dgrol ba, khrol,, 1) bshig pa'am gtong ba/ mdud pa 'grol ba/ sgrog gu bkrol ba/ bcings pa dgrol ba/ btson pa 'grol ba/ 2) 'grel ba rgyag pa/ dgongs pa 'grol ba/

/ 1) 'gro stangs/ chang gis bzi drags pas lam bde por yang gom 'gros 'tshol ba/ rgas 'khogs 'khar ba 'dzugs bzhin du 'gro yang gom 'gros 'khyor ba/ lung pa phu thag ring thung de, gtsang chab sngon mo'i 'gros la ltos/ 2) rta yi gom stabs bye brag cig / chibs pa 'di'i gom 'gros snyoms la myur ba yin pas rtsa ba nas sku gzugs dkrug mi yong/ lung pa der skyes pa'i phru gu lo drug bdun lon pa gzhig gis kyang rta 'gros gtong thub pa/ 3) smyu gus ri mo 'bri stangs dang glu dbyangs kyi len tshul, dpe cha'i rtsom stangs sogs la'ang 'jug / ri mo'i 'gros/ dbyangs 'gros/ tsom 'gros/
'gros 'phel 'grib med pa/ sgra gcan dang dus me gnyis rtag tu 'gros mnyam g.yas skor rgyu/
rta gom 'gros bzang po yod pa/
rkang longs dbang gis gza' rnams la myur 'gros dang, dal 'gros, 'khyog 'gros, 'byung 'gros bcas 'gros bzhi yod/

(tha mi dad pa) rgas pa, rga ba,, lo na son pa dang na tshod yol ba ste, shing tog smin nas rnying pa dang 'dra bar lus kyi phung po lnga po de dag rgyun gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur nas tha ma skra dkar dang gnyer ma can la sogs pa'i bar du 'gyur ba'o/ lus rgas pa/ lo rgas kyang snying stobs che/ yun ring na nas gdong ris ha cang rgas 'dug / khyi rgas rim bzhin zhe sdang che/ gos chen rgas kyang ri mo'i gzhung/
sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, gzugs dang lang tsho yongs su rgud de 'dod pa'i yon tan la ji bzhin longs su spyod pa'i mthu dang bral bas sdug bsngal ba'o/
(yul) pha glang dang ma 'bri las skyes pa'i be'u pho mo/
1) rga ba dang shi ba/ 2) rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig /
nyi mas gzhu khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla bcu gcig pa/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses: skye ba de las phung rgyun 'gyur ba'i rga ba dang, rgyun 'gags pa'i shi ba ste, na tshod dang srog 'gyur bar byed pa'o/

lo na che ba'i mi/ gzhon pa'i shed las rgad po'i jus bzang/ mi tshos rgad po skyor zhing phru gu khrid de phyin pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khogs pa dang, rgan po, rgas pa, na tshod song ba, gnas brtan, smin pa bzhi pa'i gnas skabs, lang tsho yol, lo mang khur ldan, lo'i theg pa bcas so,
lo na mtho ba'i bud med/
mi rgan rgon la bkur sti byed pa/
na tshod mtho ba'i rgad po dang rgad mo/ rgan 'khogs rnams la gzigs skyong byed pa/
mtho zhing lus stobs nyams pa'i mi:/ rgan gog la brnyas bcos dang mthong chung ma byed/
1) las lam du zhugs snga ba'i mi rnams/ 2) lo na rgan gras/
1) rgan po'am 'go byed/ 2) phru gu'i dkyil nas rgan shos/
rgan pho rgan mo'i bsdus ming/
sngar gtso rgan byed pa'i khral chag /
na tshod rgas nas chos sgor zhugs te kha 'don dge sbyor byed pa/
rgan po'i blo byis pa ltar 'chal ba/ rgas 'khogs rgan 'chal langs nas phru gu'i spyod pa byed/
na tshod song ba'i rgas tshugs/ lo chung rgan nyams can/
sngar slob phrug gi gras nas mi gcig bskos te 'dzin grwa de'i 'gan 'khur mkhan
mi ser gyi rgan po dang, dmag mi'i lding dpon gyi bsdus ming yin zhing, sa gnas kha shas la rgan po'i las 'gan 'khur mkhan la yang lding dpon zer/

/ 1) sngon du skyes pa/ jo lags rgan pa/ pha rgan/ ma rgan/ bu rgan pa/ bu mo rgan pa,..mi rgan pa/ sdong rgan/ rdo rgan/ 2) las lam du 'dzul snga ba/ kru'u zhi rgan pa/ dge rgan rgan pa/ gnyer ba rgan pa/ slob phrug rgan pa/ 'dzin grwa rgan pa/ skyes pa'i lo grangs rgan na rgan rgyu med, rnam rig shes pa rgan na rgan pa yin/

/ 1) lo na smin pa/ rgan po skra dkar/ rgan po'i so dkar gting nas thon, mgo skyes gnag pa dkar por gyur/ 2) khral 'go 'tsho mkhan, sngar khral 'ul gyi brda gtong mkhan nam thad kar cha gsed byed mkhan yin zhing, 'gan de mi rgyud kyi 'dzin mkhan yod la res mos byed mkhan yang yod/ rgan po las thog
rgad po dang phru gu'i ming/
lo na mtho ba'i bud med/ rku 'phrog gi nyen kha med pas rgan mos gser khur lam bgrod kyi dus bzang shar/ ming gi rnam grangs la skra dkar ma dang, mgo skya ma, rgan 'khogs ma, na rgas ma bcas so,
rgan po dang mi ser dmangs kyi bsdus ming/
lo na rgas nas chos la zhugs pa/
1) las lam du 'dzul dus snga phyi/ 2) lo na che chung/
lo gzhon yin kyang rgan 'khogs kyi bzo lta dod po yod pa/
mi rabs rgan pa/ pha ma rgan rabs la gus pa/
lo rgan pa'i rigs/ bkur bsti 'os pa'i rgan rigs/

(tha dad pa) brgal ba, brgal ba, rgol,, sgrol ba dang 'da' ba/ la mthon po brgal te klung la babs/ chu chen po brgal te pha rol phyin/ tshad las rgal ba/ bzhon pa rta bzang po chig stong drug brgya brgal ba/ rkang lag yod kyang snying rtsal med na la lung dang chu chen rgal dka' ba/
chu bo chen po brgal sa/ rma chu'i brgal rabs/
rgas kha/ lang tsho ma yol gong nas hur brtson byas na rgas ka la slebs dus 'gyod pa med/ blo bag phebs shing, sems gu yangs na rgas ka sra ba yong/
lo na shin tu mtho la lus stobs nyams shing gog pa/ mi de sngar thang bzo dod cing, bde cag 'khyug kyang da ni rgas 'khogs de 'dra zhig chags 'dug /
rgas te rig pa mi gsal ba/
rgas 'khogs chags nas sgo gsum mi brtan par 'chol ba'i don/
rgas pa'i bzo lta/ lo bdun cu don grangs kyi rgas nyams dod pa rang mi 'dug / gzugs po bde po med pas rang lo chung yang rgas nyams gsal po thon 'dug /
1. rga ba'i 'das pa, 2. rgud pa'am rnying pa/ na tshod rgas pa/ nyi ma rgas pa/ mi rgas pa dang 'bras bu smin pa 'dra/ na tshod gzhon dus nas rgas rgas su ma slebs bar slob sbyong byed dgos/
lang tsho nyams dka' ba/ lus nad sems gcong med pa'i mi rnams rgas pa sra ba yong/
dus brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste lo lnga bcu nas bdun cu man chad/
lus stobs gud pa'am, nyams pa'i mi phyugs/ rgas po mgo bo dung ltar dkar ba/
blo gros dang ldan pa'i rgas 'khogs/ rgas rab chag chen gyi mi la blo 'dri ba/
mang ba'i don te dgu'ang snang/ mi byed rgu byed/ yod rgu tsal sprug /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma 'drub, rtsa chad pa mthud, rgyu gzer dang rims tshad 'joms/
dbul phongs kyi dka' sdug sel bar mdzad pa
(tha mi dad pa) nus shugs sogs chag pa'am nyams pa/ dar rgud/ srid dbang rgud pa/ sdug bsngal gyis lus sems rgud pa/ stobs 'byor rgud pa/
nyams pa'am rgud pa mun pa'i gzugs su bkod pa/
(rnying) gad pa dang sa'i grog phug /

shing tog gi rigs shig dang shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, glo gcong dang glo tshad sel, dbugs mi bde ba dang, skad 'gag pa, byis pa'i glo 'khun sogs la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la ba yi nu ma dang, sbrang gi ro, ro ldan, ro zhim bcas so, rgun 'brum mdog tshos gzhi rgya smug cig / rgun 'brum aa rag rgun 'brum bsnyal ba las bzos pa'i aa rag /
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi nying khri rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
byas za ba'i dngos rdzas sam bya gso byed kyi zan chas/ rgum bu 'thu ba'i mchu ring ma/
ri dwags rgo ba'i phru gu/ spang ljongs yangs por rge'u rtse zhing 'phyo/
ri dwags rgo ba'i pags pa/
(yul) dgo ba'i spu dang 'dra ba'i bal/
ri dwags rgo ba'i pags gos
/ 1) bya rgod/ 2) bod bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi thog mar 'bangs la rgod g.yung gnyis su phye zhing, rgod ces pa 'bangs rab kyi sde tshan yin pas dmag las kyi gras su bzhag /

srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi yul gru so sor btsugs pa'i dmag sde, de la dbus gtsang ru bzhi re rer stong sde bcu bcu, logs su zhang zhung du stong sde bcu, sum par bcu gcig bcas khyon bsdoms rgod kyi stong sde drug cu re gcig byung yod/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas zas 'ju, pho ba'i drod skyed par byed/
bya rgod kyi brang khog g.yas g.yon gyi spu: med par gyur pa'i dmar thig gnyis
rgod bkag la yang zer zhing, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi stag rtse rjong gi bde chen dang gra nang rjong gi bsam yas bar du yod/
rte'u ma 'khor ba'i rta rgod ma/
bzhad gad rnam g.yeng gi gtam/
chags kyi ro zan bya rgod:/ rgod thang smug gi sgro gur phub pa 'dra/
po grung po yod khul:/ ngo tsha khrel med kyis mi mang gi khrod du 'ud gtam bshad nas rgod mdog mdog byed pa/
rgod kyi ldem 'phru ste, zhwa mo sogs kyi tog tu 'dzugs rgyu'i bya rgod kyi sgro/

1. dgod pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig 2. nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses chags sdang gi yul la 'phro zhing sems nang du gnas par mi byed pa'i shes pa zhig / sems rgod par dogs nas rig pa nang du bsgrims pa/ bying rgod kyi skyon dang bral ba/ 3. mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig /

/ 1) blo sna tshogs dran nus pa'am grung po dang skyen po/ dran rgyu rgod po/ 2) ma thul ba/ tshal rgod po/ mi rgod/ rta rgod po khrid na mthur mda' thung dgos, shing sdong rgan gcad na star yu ring dgos/ 3) hur po dang 'pher po/ mi rgod rta rgod/ mi de las ka rgod po zhig 'dug / mi de gar btang go chod rgod po zhig red/
dpa' bo phyogs sgrig / rgod po dpung sgrig byas te g.yul du chas
1) yon tan med cing sems dpangs mtho ba/ 2) sems rnam par ma zhi ba/
mda' lnga'i gras kyi skem byed mda'i ming gzhan zhig /
srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan bya rgod kyi brun te, nus pas pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang, skran nad bshig par byed/
pha ma gnyis ka rta las skyes pa'i mo/ rta gseb chags pa langs nas rgod ma 'ded pa/ rta rgod ma de la rte'u gcig skyes/ ming gi rnam grangs la cang shes ma dang, rab skyed ma'o,
(mngon) 1) rta gdong gi me/ 2) bram ze/ 3) lha'i sman pa/
mtha'i rgya mtsho'i lho phyogs kyi rta gdong ri/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya mtsho 'thung dang, chu mkhris, nyal ldan me ri, rta gdong me, brang skyes, brla skyes bcas so,
lho phyogs rta gdong ri'i me/
rgod ma can gyi zla ba
(mngon) tha skar gyi zla ba'am hor zla dgu pa/
1) gyong po dang dul po/ 2) sman gyi nus pa drag zhan/
rnam par ma zhi ba'i sems/
gad mo mi 'chor ba'i sdug rus/ har chen gyis har gtam bshad pas mi thams cad rgod sran mi tshugs par shor song/ gad srin langs nas rgod sran byas kyang mi tshugs pa/
rgal ba dang rgol ba'i skul tshig
rtsod pa po dang lan 'debs po/

1. (tha dad pa) brgal ba, brgal ba, rgol,, rtsod pa'am 'thab pa/ tshig gis rgol ba/ dpung stobs kyis rgol ba/ phar rgol ba/ tshur rgol ba/ dgra bos rgol bar rngo ma thogs par bros/ 2. rtsod pa'i ming/ snga rgol/ phyi rgol/ rgol ba bdag nyid la ma grub pa/ rgol bar ltos te ma grub pa ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs gsum gyi nang gses, rtags su bkod kyang snga rgol lam phyi rgol gang rung la mthun snang du ma grub pa dger na, grangs can pa'i ngor blo dang bde ba sems med yin te, skyes 'jig can yin pa'i phyir zhes bskod pa lta bu/
ma grub pa gsum: snga rgol la ltos te ma grub pa dang, phyi rgol la ltos te ma grub pa dang, snga rgol phyi rgol gnyis ka la ltos te ma grub pa ste gsum
1) rtsod lan 'debs pa/ 2) dmag lan rgyag pa/
rgol lan sprod pa dang don gcig

/ 1) the'u tshe dang rtags/ dam rgya 'debs pa/ gsang rgya/ dngos po rga can gyi rigs/ thag ring du gtong rgyu'i yi ger rgya btab pa/ 2) ri dwags sogs 'dzin byed kyi rnyi/ bya rgya/ nya rgya/ ri rgya klung rgya sdom pa/ ltad mo grol mtshams thag rgya glod pa/ nyes pa'i rgyar tshud pa/ the tshom gyi rgyar tshud pa/ rgya bcas nas ri dwags glod pa/ nya rigs 'dzin pa'i ched du rgya btsugs pa/ rngon pa rnams kyis ri dwags rgyas gshor ba/ ri dwags sbyang po 'ga' zhig rngon pa'i rgya las 'chor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang, 'ching byed, dra ba can, ri dwags rgya, ri dwags dra ba, ri dwags 'dzin bcas so, 3) khyon/ shes rgya chen po/ sa zhing rgya chen po/ 'khor rgya chen po/ las khungs rnams kyi rgya bskums pa/ 4) 'gram pa'i spu/ mi rgya po/ 5) yul gyi ming zhig / rgya nag / rgya gar/ rgya ser/ 6) shing rigs shig gi ming/ 7) ri dwags shig gi ming/ 8) phyi thum mam skogs/ yig rgya/ gsang rgya/
1) dkar rag li khri skyer kha snag tsha bcas bsres pa'i mdog / 2) rgya gar gyi brda zur chag /
1) rgya nag gi skad/ 2) rgya gar gi skad/
rgya mthongs sam skar khung lta bu lus kyi don snod gang dang ma 'brel ba'i stong pa'i gsang zhig ste, lus stod kyi phug ron gsang lta bu'o/

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo tshad dang, mkhal tshad, 'grams tshad bcas la phan, shing 'dir brten pa'i 'bu srin rigs shig nas byung ba'i chu'i dwangs mas tshos dmar dang snyigs mas la cha byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ldan dang khyab mjug ril ma, rgya skags, pho tshos, tshos, srin po'i khrag lha mo'i zla mtshan bcas so,
rgya skyegs shing las byung ba'i tshos dmar/
rgya tshos sam rgya skyegs tshos gsog mkhan 'bu srin zhig gi rten sa shing zhig /
rgya che ru gtong ba/ rang gi stobs shugs rgya skyed gtong thabs kho na byed pa/ mgron khang gi rgya je cher skyed pa/
mes rgyal nang khul nas yong ba'i lha sdod kha che/
sked par 'dogs rgyu'i khug ma chung ngu zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas pho ba'i tshad pa dang, bad kan smug po, glo bur dug thabs kyi tsha grang 'thab pa, tshad pa rnying pa bcas la phan/

yul gru spyi'am yongs rdzogs/ sman khug khyer nas rgya khyab grong gseb khag la phyin pa/ rgyal khab kyi srid jus rgya khyab mi dmangs rnams la dril bsgrags byed pa/ nyams myong bzang po rnams rgya khyab kun tu spel ba/ 'bru rigs kyi son bzang yul gru rgya khyab tu spel ba/
gzugs chung, spu ring, rkang lag thung ba'i khyi rigs shig /
tha gru'am rgya tshad/ bzo grwa khang gi rgya khyon/ mnga' khongs kyi rgya khyon/ yul gru rgya khyon che la mi grangs mang ba/
kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste: ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas zla mtshan 'gags pa dang, mngal du khrag skran 'dril ba, bu dang sha ma ma thon pa, skye rgyun gcod pa sogs la phan/
hin rdu/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'phags pa'i yul gnas dang, dbus 'gyur 'chang, sa'i snying po bcas so,
khyer chen po drug sngon rabs su mnyan yod: gnas bcas, tsam pa ka, wa ra n'a si, yangs pa can, rgyal po'i khab bcas so/
rgya gar gyi chu chen bzhi
gangga, sindhu, si t'a, pakshu bcas so/
sngar rgya gar nub phyogs nas lugs brgyab pa'i sku 'dra/
sngar rgya gar shar phyogs nas lugs brgyab pa'i sku 'dra/
rdo rje sogs bsnol ma'i ming ngam, rtags ku ru kha/ rgya gram dmar po/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i gri/
sngar bod kyi sku drag tsho'i rked rgyab tu 'dogs rgyu'i rgya gri dang, khol tse, rgya khug phor shubs bcas kyi spyi ming/
gra ma med pa'i gro dkar mdangs can zhig /
dbus khul du zhog khog zer/
1) kha bye ba/ me tog rgya grol ba/ 2) bcings pa lhod pa/ mdud pa rgya grol ba/
snod kyi kha dbyibs ther ther ram g.yel g.yel/
mtheb rgyag gi bug mig 'khod sa'i gzhung ngam rgyud/
rgya gzhung gi rtsa ba khag la rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa tshos brtsams pa'i 'grel bshad/
1) thel tshe 'gog pa'am bshig pa/ 2) gsang rgya 'grol ba/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i rta sga/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i sgog pa
rgya nag nas thon pa'i dngul rta rmig ma lta bu'o/
(rnying) khug ma'i go chod pa'i ska rags sbubs stong zhig gi ming/
1) mtshal dang, li khri ser po, li skya, rna ros dmar skya sogs la rgya tshos kyis bcad rgyag pa/ 2) gtong yig skogs nang du bcug ste thel tshe rgyag pa/

rgya nag lcags ri'i ri mo'i bsdus ming/ rgya lcang, 1) sngar gyi bshad srol du rgya za kong jo bod du phebs skabs shing son bsnams pa btsugs skyes kyi shing zhig / 2) yal ga thur du dud pa'i lcang ma'i rigs shig /
cha ma snyoms pa'am phyogs lhung can/
1) gu dog pa dang, tshad gzhal sla ba/ 2) khyab chung ba dang, grangs 'bor nyung ba/

1) tha gru yangs pa dang, tshad gzhi gzhal dka' ba/ rgya che mu med/ mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs sa cha'i khor yug rgya che ba/ sa dang gnam yangs shing shin tu rgya che ba/ 2) khyab che ba dang, 'bor grangs mang ba/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs rgya che ba/ srid jus gsar pa rgya cher spel ba/ 3) rgyas pa dang zhib gsal/ gsung rab la mkhas par sbyangs te dgongs don rgya cher 'grel ba/ dpe cha'i nang gi don snying rgya cher 'chad pa/
gzhan gyi blo yul du mi shong ba'i bsam blo rgya che ba dang, dpal 'byor phun tshogs rgya che ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
rgya che ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses rnam grangs gnyis ni, bsam pa rgya che ba dang, 'byor pa rgya che ba'o/
khyon 'bor che la rnam grangs mang ba/ tshogs 'du rgya che gzab rgyas 'tshogs te bkra shis bde legs zhu ba/
tshad mtha' yangs pa/ sa cha rgya chen po/ sems rgya chen po/
1) gzhi khyon che la mtho ba'i khang chen/ 2) khyon che zhing 'bor mang ba/ gsol ston rgya chen dpangs mtho zhig bshams te gal che'i sku mgron rnams la sne len gzab rgyas zhu/
rje btsun byams pa nas thogs med sku mched sogs brgyud nas byung ba'i lam rim gyi brgyud pa'o/
rtsa ba lus dang 'phros pa yan lag dang bcas pa rnams cha tshang ba rgyas par bkral ba'i gzhung/

'phags pa rgya cher rol pa bam po bco brgyad dang le'u nyer bdun pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra sogs dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos pa'i 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dkon brtsegs kyi glegs bam kha pa'o/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i ja/
bya dang ri dwags sogs 'dzin byed kyi lag cha/
1) rgya gar nas byung ba'i tig ta'i rigs shig / 2) sa ming zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs hu'u kru'u hor rigs rang skyong rdzong gi rgya tig bod rigs rang skyong zhang gi gnas yul
1) yig skogs kyi khar 'bri ba'i thel tshab kyi yi ge / 2) grangs gnas shig /
ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang thog mar 'debs dus lha khang gi rgya phub stag ltar bkra bas ming de ltar btags pa/
thig ma ste: snam bu gang rung gi/ thog tshos gzhi gzhan zhig gi thig ris yod pa/
kyi zan 'jim dril nas bzos pa'i thug pa phra: la ring ba zhig /
gser dngul sogs yang lci 'degs byed kyi srang/
rgya gar ram rgya nag nas thon pa'i ther ma/
shu ba'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
1) khang pa'i dbus kyi gseng yangs/ 2) khang pa rtseg thog can rim pa gnyis pa yan gyi bar khyams/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i dar gos/
rgya nag nas thon pa'i rnying lugs me mda'/
bzhog bod mda' bye brag pa zhig gi ming
mdud pa lhas ma can zhig /
ching rgyal rabs skabs su gsar dar rgya sbyong dmag 'khri'i sa rten/

'khrug rtsod/ yin min bden rdzun gyi dbye ba 'byed rgyur rgya 'dre brgyab na mi phan/ kha phog sna phog gi tshig rtsub go 'phral du rgya 'dre rgyag snying bro ba/ mi la mi dgos rgya 'dre dang, shing la mi dgos 'dzer pa/
1) rdo dkrugs ma zur can ring po/ 2) 'jal byed rgya ma'i rdo/
rgya che zhing chas gos nag po gtso bo byed pa: ste rang ri'i rgyal khab nang gtso cher rgya rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa khul rnams la zer/ ming gi rnam grangs la stong khun dang ma ha tsi na'o,
rgya nag nas dar ba'i lo zla zhag dus kyi: skag ngan bar chad phyir zlog gi cho ga zhig /
sngar gyi krung go'i gong ma rim byung/
1) rgya nag gong ma/ 2) nywa lhog ske skrangs sogs gnyan nad la phan pa'i sman sbyor zhig /

1) shar hran ha'e kon 'gag sgo nas nub ca yus kon 'gag sgo'i bar ring tshad spyi le drug stong bdun brgya tsam yod pa'i lcags ri ring po/ 2) dkar yol dang gos chen sogs la lcags ri ring po'i ri mo yod pa zhig /

rgyu skar nyer bdun nang gi gro bzhin zhes pa'i mthar byi bzhin zhes pa sbyar nas nyer brgyad 'byung, 'on kyang gro bzhin dang byi bzhin gnyis la skar khyon gcig las med pas nyer bdun nyid du brtsi/

kyi 'bras rtags: 'bras bu'i rtags lnga'i nang gses, rkyen gzhan la ltos pa'i rtags kyis rang rgyu khyad par ba gzhan yod par sgrub pa ste dper na, dbang po'i mngon sum chos can, dbang yid las gzhan pa'i rang rgyu yod de, rang gi dmigs rkyen med na mi skye ba'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu dbang shes skye ba la dbang yid de ma thag rkyen yod dgos par ma zad, phyi rol gyi yul med na mi skye bas rgyu khyad par ba'am bye brag pa dmigs rkyen yod par sgrub byed kyi 'bras rtags yin no/
rgyu legs po'am rgyu yag po/ dus bzhi'i so nam la hur brtson byed pa ni lo tog bzang po 'byung ba'i rgyu khyad par can zhig yin/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la cung kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas tsha ba dang dug sel/
rgyu gzer nad kyi nang tshan zhig ste, nad rtags su bungs chen 'khru zhing 'khru ba'i skabs su na zug drag po ldang ba dang, 'khru ba'i rjes su cung bde ba zhig /
rgyu ma'i nad cig rgyu ma rlung gis gcus nas 'og rlung mi thon pa dang, ldang dub byas nas gzer ba zhig /
rgyu ma'i nad cig rgyu mar rlung zhugs nas blug blug ces pa'i sgra dang bcas chu ltar 'khru ba zhig /
rgyu ma'i nad cig khrag dang mkhris pas rkyen byas te rgyu ma 'gags nas dri chen mi 'byung ba zhig /

snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, rang rgyu dang 'gal ba'i dngos po rtags su bkod nas, dgag chos rang 'bras 'byung ba 'gog pa'am med nges su sgrub pa ste, dper na, me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags su gnas pa med de, me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu rgyu grang reg dang 'gal ba'i dngos po me rtags su bkod nas, grang 'bras ba spu ldang ba 'gog pa'o/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya phyi nang gi dngos po gang yang rung ba'i 'bras bu skyed byed kyi rgyu phal pa dag 'gog byed rang 'bras skyed byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo med lugs brjod pas 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig / ..

rgyu mar grang ba zhugs nas be snabs rgyas pas dri chen dus thog tu mi 'bab pa 'gyings pa'i nad cig ste, nad rtags rgyu ma na zhing dri chen mi 'bab par 'gag pa dang, skabs su be snabs can 'khru ba zhig /
phyogs la 'gro ba'i 'grul bzhud/ yul lung der bde 'jags med pas mtshan mor rgyu 'grul bcad nas zla ba gnyis tsam song 'dug /
'gro cha rang nyid kyis gra sgrig byed pa/ lam rgyags rgyu 'gro rang gshoms kyi sgo nas slob sbyong du 'gro ba/
tsha ba rgyu mar babs pa'am ma zhu ba sogs kyis bskyed pa'i rgyu nad rnying pa zhig ste, sdong zla'i dbang gis dbye ba bdun mchis so/
phar tshur ram yar mar yang yang 'gro 'gro ba/ don med du rgyu rgyu ba/ dbugs rgyu rgyu ba/ phyogs nas phyogs su rtag par rgyu rgyu ba/
gshis ka dang spyod pa gnyis ka ngan pa'i dpe/
rgyu chen po yod pa'i nyams ston pa/
longs spyod nor rdzas/ mi dang, rgyu dngos kyi nus shugs gnyis 'dzoms pa/

'bras bu'i rtags lnga'i nang gses, 'bras bu rang nyid rtags su bkod nas, des rang gi rgyu dngos su dpog pa, dper na, du ldan gyi la la chos can, me yod de, du ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu du ba'i rgyu me dngos su sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags kyi sbyor ba'o/
nor rdzas kyi rngan pa/ bka' khrims kyi zhal lce gcod dus rgyu rngan sprod len gyi rjes 'brangs mi chog / lkog tu rgyu rngan ster sbyin byed pa/
'byung ba chen po bzhir brten nas gzugs su 'gyur ba'i rgyu lnga ste 'byung ba'i rgyu, 'dug pa'i rgyu, rjes su 'gyur ba'i rgyu, gnas par byed pa'i rgyu, 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu bcas so/

kyi 'bras rtags: 'bras bu'i rtags lnga'i nang gses, sgrub byed 'bras bu mthong ba'i rtags kyis bsgrub chos rgyu sngon du song bar sgrub pa ste, dper na, bar snang gi du ba sngo long po chos can, rang rgyu me sngon song can yin te, du ba yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
1) rgyu nor dang ldan pa'i mi/ 2) rgyu phyug po yod pa/

gi 'bras rtags: 'bras bu rtags lnga'i nang gses, sgrub byed ro yod pa'i rtags kyis bsgrub chos gzugs yod par sgrub pa ste, dper na, kha nang gi bu ram gong bu'i steng na chos can, bur gzugs da lta ba yod de, bur ro da lta ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
