1) nges pa lnga dang don gcig 2) (mngon) rdo rje 'chang/

dge tshul slong sogs gtan khrims kyi sdom pa len par 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral dge slong la dngos dang, dge tshul la cha 'dra zhig dgos pa ste, mthun rkyen tshang ba'i yul 'dir bsrung gi gzhan du bsrung mi nus snyam pa lta bu yul nges pa, lo zla sogs 'di tsam du bsrung gi de phan bsrung mi nus snyam pa lta bu dus nges pa, 'thab rtsod kyi skabs ma gtogs pa gzhan du bsrung snyam pa lta bu tshe nges pa, dgra ma gtogs pa gzhan gyi srog mi gcod snyam pa lta bu sems can nges pa, bslab bya rags pa 'ga' zhig las phra ba rnams bsrung mi nus snyam pa lta bu yan lag nges pa ste de rnams dang bral na sor sdom thob pa'o/
nges pa can gyi sbyar ba

sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gi sbyar chos rnams kyi nang nas sbyar gzhi dang mi mthun pa'i sgra'i 'jug don rnams bkag ste de dang mthun pa'i sgra don gcig nyid du nges pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa'i mdo: bam po gcig pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po, pradzny'a warma dang su rentra bo dhi dang lo tsa ba bnde ye shes sdes bsgyur pa'o/
rang yul la yod med yin min gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas ji bzhin legs par shes pa'o/
phul byung gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'jig rten grags tshod las brgal ba'i gtan tshigs kyi nges pa phul byung ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
nges brtan med pa'am ma nges pa/ nga rang ga dus yong min nges pa med pa/
nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal
sdug bsngal drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, sdug bsngal gyi che chung dang, gnas dang, tshad la nges pa med pa/
nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde
nges don gyi mdo sde dang don gcig
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi gnas lugs dang chos mtshungs pa'i dpe gcig kho nar nges pa rnyed pa'i rgyan zhig /
grub ming gi tshig 'grel:/ sgra don legs par shes pas nges pa'i tshig la mkhas pa/

so yang dag par rig pa: so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i gras shig ste, sems can sna tshogs kyi skad dang brda dang sgra shes shing tshig gcig gis kyang don rnam pa du mar go ba dang, tshig 'khrul ba dang, tshab tshub dang, zlos pa med par, 'phags pas bsngags pa'i skye bo dga' bar 'gyur ba'i tshig /
theg pa gsum gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'am, mthong lam 'phags pa'i sa/
tshig don nges can du 'grol ba/

lam ston pa la mi 'jigs pa: mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i gras shig byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyis rnam par grol ba thob cing gzhan gyis nam yang ma yin par mngon sum du gzigs pa'i phyir, de ltar ston pa la sus kyang rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/
nges 'byed kyi cha dang don gcig

'gog pa'i rtags: phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi nang gses, nges pa rtags su bkod nas dgag chos ltos pa dang bcas pa yin pa 'gog pa ste dper na, bum pa chos can, 'jig rgyu don gzhan la ltos pa dang bcas pa ma yin te, 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
/ 1) blo la 'jags po/ gnas tshul tshang ma sems la nges po byung/ 2) brtan po/ chings don mtha' dag tshig thog don 'khel gyi nges po byung ba/
nges par 'byin pa ste 'khor ba'i nyes pa dang gtan bral zhing mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas su phyin par byed pa, bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi nang gses shig /

khams gsum btson ra dang 'dra ba nas thar cing mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas bde bar phyin pa ste, 'khor ba'i gnas mtha' dag las thar bar 'dod pa'i sems, bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi nang gses shig /

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, theg chen la zhugs pa mthar phyin pa ste, theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas bla med byang chub kyi ched du don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya ba gang zhig 'byung ba mthar thug tu gdon mi za bar 'byin byed sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam gyis bsdus pa'o/
'phral 'phral skyes pa'i nges 'byung mi brtan pa zhig ste phu btab na bser bus khyer 'gro ba'i spu lta bu zhig /
nges par 'byed pa ste, mthong lam/
mthong lam gyi zag pa med pa'i ye shes 'di nyid zag med ye shes yongs rdzogs kyi cha shas gcig tsam yin pas na cha zer/
so so skye bo las nges par 'byed pa 'phags pa'i lam gyi cha mthong lam skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'o/
sbyor lam drod dang, rtse mo dang, bzod pa dang, chos mchog ste bzhi'o/

sher phyin don bdun cu pa'i nang gses: gdams pa'i don nyams su blangs pa las, sbyor lam rgyud la skye ba ste, theg chen thar pa cha mthun gyi rjes su skyes pa'i mngon rtogs gang zhig mos spyod kyi sas bsdus pa'o/
nges pa med pa dang don gcig
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi gnas lugs dang chos mtshungs pa'i dpe gcig kho nar ma nges par gzhan yang yod par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gtan la phab zin pa'i rtsis/
nges pa'i tshig gi bsdus tshig
dam bcas pa'i tshig gi sgra don 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra zhig /
1) yul gcig la dmigs su bkar ba/ 2) nges pa brtan por bzung ba/
ni sgra'i 'jug tshul zhig / khong ni phul du gyur pa'o/
gtan du bde ba ste, thar pa dang, thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang/
shes rab ste gtso bo bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/
yid ches sam nges pa/ las 'gan legs 'grub thub rgyu yin par nges shes skyes byung/
1) yid ches skyes pa/ 2) don gsal por rtogs pa/
ngo ma'i don gsal brtan/ nges gsal brtan po/
nges par du bskur ba/ gong gsal gnas tshul rnams nges bsring yod pa zhu/

1. gdong/ ngo dkar nag / ngo 'gyur ba/ ngo ldog pa/ ngo dman pa/ ngo 'tshal ba/ bza' btung ster sbyin gyi ngor mi lta ba/ ra sha za dus ngo dkar, ra rin sdud dus ngo nag / phar bltas zhum bu'i ngo, tshur bltas 'ug pa'i ngo/ 2. nga mthar 'jug pa'i slar bsdu'i phrad cig / nga/
1) ngo 'dzum pa/ 2) dngos chas nang nas cung drag pa/ nga'i ca lag gi nang du 'di las ngo dkar ba med/
ngo lkog mdun dang rgyab ste
dngos dang lkog / ngo lkog gi bya ba/ ngo lkog can/ gtam ngo lkog med pa bshad dgos/
rgyab mdun mthun pa/ las don ngo lkog mtshungs pa zhig ma byas na mthar rdzun rkub brdol rgyu nges can yin/
rgab mdun mi mtshungs pa dang g.yo sgyu'i bya ba
ngo ma'i skal ba/ ngo skal thob thang gang yod dus thog tu sprod pa/
ngo tsha/ ngo skyengs nas mgo bo smad/
bu lon gyi ngo bo dang skyed ka/ bu lon sprod dus su slebs nas ngo skyed tshang ma sprod pa/
pags mdog dkyus dang mi 'dra ba skya ther sna tshogs shar ba'i pags nad rigs shig /
gdong pa 'gebs byed kyi sang ras sogs/
gdong lpags nag khra'i steng du thon pa'i: thig le chung ngu
1) thob skal du 'khri ba'i khral, sngar bod kyi sger pa'i khyim du zhabs sdod zhu mi med mkhan gyis srid gzhung la 'jal dgos pa'i khral zhig / 2) ngo gcog mi nus par byed dgos pa'i las/
mi ngo gtso bo dang de'i rjes 'brang pa/
gzhan la ngom 'phyar gyi ngo sor 'khyer ba/ ngan byas ngo 'khyer/
ngo'am rdog po'i grangs ka/ dpe deb kyi ngo grangs/ khyim nang du sdod mi ngo grangs/ lo zla'i ngo grangs/ po ti'i ngo grangs brgya dang brgyad yod/
mdun gyi bstod bsngags/ gong la ngo dga' dang 'og la thub tshod mi byed/ ngo dga' med cing gsar 'grogs med/
ngo bsrungs nas bstod bsngags byed pa/
ngo la bltas nas phyogs ris byed pa/
mngon sum 'dzems med kyi 'thab 'dzing/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog la ngo rgol byed pa/
pas rta khal mi gsum gyi khral rgyug: skabs tshab dang dod ma yin par dngos su rgyug dgos pa
re 'dod rtsis med du gtong ba:/ grogs po'i ngo gcog ma phod pa/
sngar bod du zhabs sdod dngos su zhus rjes chag pa'i
'go 'dren nam, rogs ram/ gyod ya su la ngo chen zab pa yod med mi lta ba/ rang la bden pa med pas gzhan ngo chen 'tshol ba/
1) ngo chen zhu mi gtong ba/ 2) ngo la bltas te don smin gtong ba/
mgo 'dren zhu brgyud/ khrims sar ngo chen zhu brgyud kyis bka' nyes chag yang zhus kyang ma phan/
ngo shes pa'am ngos 'dzin thub pa/ ngas kho'i ngo chod thub/ sa ngo mi chod pa/ mig yod kyang yag nyes ngo mi chod/
(rnying) 1) ngo ma'am, dngos gnas/ 2) ngo bo/
phan tshun ngo thug byas pa
gnyen sgrig skabs nang mi ngo ma phyin nas mna' ma bsu len byed pa/
1) gzhan gyi ngo srung/ 2) me long/
ngo 'khor te, gtso bo dang de'i 'khor/
gdong brtan po/ mi de dga' sdug gi 'gyur ba skyen po med par ngo brtan po zhig yong/
kha gsag gi tshig gam, mdun du che brjod byed pa/ rgyal po rnams ni ngo bstod dga', drang po'i gtam la mnyan pa dkon/ ngo bstod dang, zol tshig nor gyis bslu ba bcas la dogs zon gzab/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can las dpe yon tan lhag kyang, dpe can la ngo srung sprel lad ston phyir dpe la gzengs bstod med par phan tshun 'dra mnyam mtshungs mnyam du sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig /
mthong che chung ngam, brtsi 'jog che chung/ kun la ngo thang chung/
phan tshun ngo phrad kyis gtam phar dri tshur dri/
gdong dang gdong thug pa, dngos su phrad pa/
ngo thog ngo ma'am dngos gnas
brtsi'i skabs de'i ngo thog zhag 'das pa'i: khyim zhag steng gzugs bsnan pas grub

1) snyan grags byung ba dang, go gnas 'phel ba, gzengs su thon pa/ grub 'bras ngo thon pa zhig thob song/ 2) mngon sum dang, gzhan gyis mthong bzhin pa/ rang nyid ngo thon gyis spyod ngan byed pa/ ngo thon gyis mi'i rgyu nor 'phrog pa/ 3) (rnying) nan gyis/
1) mang po'i nang nas bzang ba/ 2) ngo so che ba/
sngar zhabs rten pha gzhis yod kyang, zhabs sdod dngos su ma zhus pa'i ring sprod dgos pa'i dngul khral/
1) lus kyi gdong pa/ ngo gdong nag log ge ba/ khong khro langs te ngo gdong dmar por gyur/ 2) thad ka'am gdong thug / skad cha ngo gdong du shod/
1) yi ge sogs ngo ma dang 'dra bshus/ 2) gdong pa dang 'dra ba/
bzang ngan brje 'phrul dang lkog nyar/ rtsis 'khri dngos rigs rnams ngo nor sbas bskungs med par rtsis sprod zhu dgos/
bzhin ras la khro ba'i rnam pa can/
ngo tsha'i don/ phar bslogs na mi 'grig tshur blangs na ngo gnong/
brda sprod pa'am, phan tshun ngo shes par byed pa/ bar skabs kyi gnas tshul byung lugs ngo sprod gsal por byed/ gsar du yong mkhan de gnyis mi tshor ngo sprod zhus/
ma rtsa la phan pa ste, bu lon 'jal mkhan gyis bun bdag la skyed kha sprad pa'i lhag ma ngo bo'am ma rtsa nas gcog rgyur sprad pa der ngo bo la phan pa zer ba'i tshig sdud la ngo phan zer/
ngo ma phebs pa/ khong tshogs 'du 'tshog sar ngo phebs gnang ba/
phan tshun gdong thug pa/ mi ring bar ngo phrad yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu/
ngo so'i dpangs/ byas rjes cung zad las med kyang, gzid bzos kyi ngo 'phang mtho ba zhig byung song/ byas rjes bzang ngan gyi ngo 'phang mtho dma'i khyad par gnam sa'i bar thag lta bu yod/

1) gnas lugs ngo sprad nas 'phrod pa/ yun ring kha bral ba'i spun zla da lam ngo 'phrod nas dga' spro chen po byung/ 2) bcos ma ma yin par lag par 'byor ba/ phyag bris ngo 'phrod byung bas 'dir yang blo sems bde/
rang bzhin dang gnas lugs/ don gyi ngo bo/ rang gi ngo bo min/ sman la ngo bo'i sgo nas bsil drod gnyis, nad la ngo bo'i sgo nas tsha grang gnyis/
rig pa'i ngo bo chos nyid stong pa'i cha
rang bzhin tha mi dad pa, dper na bum pa dang mi rtag pa lta bu'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la rang bzhin gcig pa dang, bdag nyid gcig pa'o,
ldog pa tha dad pa: rang bzhin so so ba ma yin zhing rang gi ldog pa tha dad du gnas pa ste, bum pa dang shes bya gnyis dang, mi rtag pa dang ngos po, mi dang mi'i nyer len gyi phung po lta bu'o/

1) rang bzhin nyid dam, ngo bo de rang/ sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ don gyi ngo bo nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyis 'phel 'grib tu gyur pa/ nam mkha'i khams ni rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa zhig go/ mi'i rtsol bas bzos pa yin gyi ngo bo nyid kyis byung ba ma yin/ 2) dngos po'i gnas lugs dang, rang gzud sam, mtshan nyid/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/
ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba
dad sogs dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig ngo bo nyid kyi dran pa nyer bzhag: lus tshor sems chos bzhi'i ngo bo la shes rab kyis ji ltar 'byed pa bzhin dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/
ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba
rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nye nyon rnams nyes spyod kun nas slong ba'i phyir thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba'o/
ngo bo nyid kyi tshig bla dwags
dngos po rnams kyi khyad gzhi tsam ston pa'i 'dod rgyal gyi tshig /
ngo bo nyid kyi lung ma bstan
khams dang skye mched gzugs can brgyad dang, de dang mtshungs ldan gyi yid dang, srog dang, ris mthun pa dang, ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams so/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bye brag dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar thug pa'i sku/
rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku dang, glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i sku gnyis/
mtshan nyid lnga: 'dus ma byas pa dang, dbyer med pa, mtha' gnyis spangs pa, sgrib pa gsum las grol ba, rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba bcas lnga/
ngo bo nyid sku'i yon tan lnga
gzhal du med pa dang, grangs med pa, bsam du med pa, mnyam pa med pa, dri mas dag pa bcas lnga/
ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid
gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i chos nyid de la dngos po med pa/
ngo bo nyid med pa nyid
yongs grub kyi ming ste, bdag gi ngo bo nyid du ma grub pa/
ngo bo nyid med pa gsum
mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang, skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa nyid, don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa nyid de gsum/
ngo bo nyid med par smra ba
nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i bye brag cig ste, chos thams cad bden med du khas len pa'i dbu ma pa rnams so/
kun tu brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid dang, gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid, yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid de gsum/

khyad gzhi don gyi ngo bo tsam ston zhing, de'i khyad chos gang yang gsal bar mi byed pa'i ming rkyang yin pa 'di dag la rnam dbye dang po zhes pa'i ming thob kyang, lod su rnam dbye'i rkyen ster rgyu med pa dper na, lcags, za ba, dmar po zhes pa lta bu/
ngo bo so so ba'am rang bzhin tha dad pa, dper na, rtag dngos gnyis lta bu'o/

gi 'brel ba: 1) rnam dbye drug pa'i nang gses, bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba ston byed kyi sgra, dper na lcags kyi skud pa dang, rdo'i khang pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi skud pa'i bdag nyid dam rgyu cha lcags dang, khang pa'i bdag nyid dam rgyu cha rdo yin pas 'brel sgra 'dis bdag gcig pa yin par shes thub/ 2) bdag gcig 'brel dang don gcig
stong pa nyid: stong nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid/
ngo bo phra ba'i dbang gis ma mthong ba'i bskal don te, rang gi mdun la yod pa'i sa rdul phra rab lta bu'o/

rdzun ma ma yin pa'i do bdag dngos/ kho rang do bdag ngo ma dang mngon sum mjal phrad byung/ sku ngo ma rang/ 'dra gzugs 'di ni kho rang zhal bzhugs skabs kyi sku ngo ma nang bzhin 'dug / gser ngo ma/ gnas tshul ngo ma/ bdag gis bshad pa'i gtam rnams dngos 'brel ngo ma rang yin/
(yul) gzhan ngo zlog ma nus pa/ ngo ma chog par khas len byed dgos byung/
ngos 'dzin ma thub pa/ dpon dmag su yin ngo ma chod pa/
ngo ston stangs dkar nag 'gyur ldog mang ba/
1) ngo mi shes pa/ 2) ngo srung mi byed pa/
ngo so dang don gnyis ka med pa/ dka' las ji tsam brgyab kyang ngo med don med red/
ngo tsha ba'i snang tshul zhig / ngo tsha kha skyengs kyis khong khro langs/
ngo tsha khrel med kyang zer, ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa/
rang skyengs pa dang gzhan khrel dogs la 'dzem pa/
rang skyengs gzhan khrel gyi bsam pa/
rkun po bzung nas rang yul du slog skabs 'dzin mkhan gyis rkun por sprod rgyu'i lam rgyags/

rang nyid kyis nongs pa ngos zin pas gdong tsha phyur phyur byed pa/ ngo tsha ba'i gnas/ nyes spyod la ngo mi tsha ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyengs pa dang, khrel ldan, khrel yod, ngo dman, ngo tsha shes pa, bag yod, bag ldan, mig dman, 'tsher ba, 'dzem mdog zhum med bcas so,
bdag rgyu mtshan du byas te sdig pa la mi 'dzem pa dug gsum gyi char gtogs pa nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig
dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi gras shig ste bdag gam chos rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i rten byed pa'i las can zhig /
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses rang ngor ltos pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'dzem pa ste, nyon mongs pa bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sbubs su sba bas rta mchog rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
blo stobs sam ham spobs/ ngo tshan chung ba/ ngo tshan che ba/

khyad mtshar ram ya mtshan/ ltad mo ngo mtshar can/ byas rjes ngo mtshar can/ ngo mtshar gyis lta ba/ mdzad pa ngo mtshar can/ yul ljongs kyi snang ba ngo mtshar che zhing mdzes sdug brjid chags dang ldan pa/

'dzam gling gi nor 'dzin: 'dzam bu gling 'dir khyad du 'phags pa'i yul gru chen po lnga yod pa ni, dbus su rgya gar rdo rje gdan sh'akya thub pa'i zhing, shar du rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhing, lho na ri bo po ta la spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing, nub na ao rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling pad ma 'byung gnas kyi zhing, byang na sham bha la chos rgyal rigs ldan gyi zhing bcas lnga yod zer/
1) gdong mdzes po/ 2) ya mtshan chen po/
phul byung gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'jig rten grags tshod las brgal ba'i ngo mtshar can gyi khyad chos phul byung ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
ya mtshan pa/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba/

mi nad med kyi rtsa'i 'phar tshul la brten nas lkog gyur gyi don rnams gsal bar lung ston nus pa'i rtsa brtag thabs bdun te, khyim phywa dang, mgron phywa, dgra phywa, grogs phywa, gdon phywa, me chu go ldog bu rtsa bcas so/
ngo srung byed pa/ rtsa don bzung nas ngo mi 'tsho ba/
gzhan gyi ngo srung ngam, sems srung/
nyes can la ngo srung zol yangs su 'jog: pa
dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur/ khong ni rgyun du ngo 'dzum ste bzhugs pa las cang mi gsung/
dga' sdug gi ngo gdong dkar nag /
gdong 'dzoms sam, ngo phrad/ phan tshun ngo 'dzoms byung ba/
bden pa khungs thub rigs la bzo bcos kyis lhad 'jug pa'am rdzun ma dang brje po rgyag pa/
ngo'i gzi mdangs/ mi ngo zil che ba'i dpa' bo/
gdong nag po bstan pa/ kha sbos ngo zum/
pa ste re ba byas pa khas mi len pa:/ khas len rgyab bskyur gyis ngo zlog byed/ snang ba gdong 'ded kyis ngo zlog byed pa/ yang yang nan skul byas pa'i ngo ldog dka'/ ngo ma zlog /
1) gdong thug gis rgol ba'i gtam/ 2) re ba khas mi len pa'i tshig /
kha ya'am kha gtad/ kha mchu'i ngo ya/ rtsod pa'i ngo ya/ dpa' bo'i ngo ya lon par dka'/
sku no'am dpon dang 'khor g.yog / dpon ngo g.yog tshang ma lhan du phebs pa
ka dag khregs chod kyi sgom rim nyams su len tshul zhig ste, rig pa'i ngo bo ka dag gi gnas lugs ji lta ba de da lta rang thog tu ngo shes pa'o/
ngo thug gi gtam dang rgyab logs kyi gtam/
'grul pa sogs sne len byed pa/
1) blo log rgyab gtod byed pa/ ngo log rgyab gtod/ ngo log zing 'khrug / rgyal khab la ngo log pa/ 2) ngo log byed pa po/
sme ba lta bu srab mos khyab pa'i pags nad: kyi rigs shig /
1) su yin dang gang yin ha go ba/ ngo shes 'dris pa/ ngo shes grogs po/ mi tshe ri la bsdad, ri dwags ngo mi shes/ 2) ngo shes pa'i mi/
'dra bshus te ma dper brten nas bshus pa'i yig cha dang ri mo sogs/ dpe cha par ma la brten nas ngo bshus byed pa/
1) yus sam brtsi mthong/ gzhan gyi ngo sor lta ba/ spyod ngan ngo sor khyer ba/ ra'i ril ma la lug gis ngo so gtong ba/ 2) byas rjes,
/ sman 'di rtsa chen min yang nad thog tu zug par brten ngo so thon po byung song/
(yul) bsngags brjod byed pa/ mi de 'dra ni ngo so bstod 'os pa zhig red/
gzhan gyi sems srung ba/ rang tshod mi 'dzin par ngo srung zer dbang la cha 'jog byed pa/ gzhan gyi ngo srung thal drags pa/ lkog rngan ster sbyin byed mkhan gyi ngo srung gzhan dbang du gyur pa/
/ 1) 'gram/ chu'i ngogs/ rgya mtsho'i ngogs la gnas pa/ 2) gzhung/ 'jug ngogs/
ngom yus kyi khyer so/ phan 'dogs phran bu las med kyang byas yus kyi ngom khyer tsha ba la/
phyir ngom pa'am gzhan la 'phyar 'phyar/ khri gdugs nyi ma 'grim lam na, 'bu me khyer rang 'od ngom ngom byed/
'bab chu zhig chu 'go gdang la'i ri rgyud nas byung zhing mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi nang chen rdzong dang bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ri bo che rdzong brgyud de chab mdor zla chu'i nang du 'bab/
(tha dad pa) ngoms pa, ngom pa, ngoms, ,gzhan la 'phyar 'phyar byed pa/ yon tan ngom pa/ mtshon ngoms mda' 'gran/ spre'u'i ngom rgyu rkub/
gzhan gyi mdun du ngom so 'phyar ba/
ngom po'am ngom 'phyar/ gzhan dag la ngom so rgyag pa/
1. ngom pa'i 'das pa, 2. (tha mi dad pa) tshim pa/ lta bas mi ngoms/ ham sems che ba'i mi de ngoms mi shes/ 3. ngoms pa'i ming/
ngoms pa med pa'i sdug bsngal
'dod yon gyis ngoms mi shes pa'i sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal drug gi ya gyal zhig /

stag ri gnyan gzigs skabs kyi blon po zhig ste, khong gis bre phul srang bcos nas 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal, dga' gnyis tshong byas mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs, de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med, de phyir mdzangs mi bdun gyi nang gses su grags/
dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin mkhan ngor chen kun dga' bzang po dang rdzong pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gnyis/
sa skya'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan, ngor chen kun dga' bzang po, sems dpa' dkon mchog rgyal mtshan, dkon mchog lhun grub sogs nas brgyud pa'i lugs/

1./ 1) phyogs/ shar ngos/ 2) logs/ ri ngos/ gyang ngos/ me long gi ngos/ ngos 'jam po/ ngos mnyam pa/ ngos snyoms pa/ ngos gzar po/ ngos yangs pa/ 3) mdun/ ngos zas dang lkog zas/ gtam ngos su shod/ 2. bdag / ngos rang blo gros dman po yin/
ngo shes pa/ rag gser gang yin ngos chod/ mtshan mor mi zhig thug kyang ngos mi chod/
mi ngo ma dang ngo ma mjal ba'am ngo phrad/ ngos mjal zhus nas bka' mol gnang ba/

gdong phrad pa:/ lan 'phrin gtong res tsam min par phan tshun ngos thug gi thog nas mol bsdur byas pa/ do bdag phan tshun ngos thug sar rgyu dngos tshang ma zhib bsher byas pa/ gyod ya phan tshun ngos thug gi thog nas bden rdzun zhib bsher byas pa/
1) sngar ngo mi shes pa ngo sprod byed pa/ 2) gnas lugs mi shes pa ngo sprod pa/
ngo ma'am, dngos su 'phrad pa/ phan tshun ngos 'phrad byung/
ngo sprod kyi yi ge tham 'byar/
yin min nam yag nyes ha go bar byed pa/ legs nyes mnyam bsres kyi nang nas ngos 'dzin ma nor ba byed dgos/ dgra gnyen ngos 'dzin byed pa/
1) ngo shes pa/ 2) gnad don rtogs pa/
'di yin snyam par nges pa bzung ba/ dngos po 'di dang 'di'o zhes ngos bzung med pa/
ngos/ rgya mtsho'i ngos rol/ gtsang po'i ngos rol/ ri'i ngos rol tu ra lug mang po 'tsho ba/
ngos sbyor dang lam yig ces pa'i bsdus bris te, sngar khral 'u lag skul byed kyi lag 'khyer/
khas len pa/ rang nongs ngos len/ rang skyon rang gis ngos len byed pa
gdong bsher/ khrims sar ngos bsher brgyab nas rgyal kha thob pa/
'jigs skrag / dngangs skrag skyes pa/ dngangs skrag tshab tshub/ dngangs skrag ma skul/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) dbugs glo bur du 'tshangs pa/ chur thim nas dbugs dngangs song/ 2) skrag pa/ sa g.yo chen po rgyag dus yid dngangs pa/
dngangs par byed pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang ses, dge slong la tho 'tsham pa'i bsam pas yid du mi 'ong ba'i 'jigs pa sna tshogs ston pa'o/
(rnying) g.yar nor phyir mi sprod pa/
gral star/ mdun gyi dngar kha/ dngar kha byas pa/
(tha dad pa) gral sgrig pa/ tshar du dngar ba/
me tog nang gi sbrang rtsi'i rgyu'i ro mngar mo/ zil dngar/ bung bas zil dngar len/
ngud mo ste shub bur ngu skad sgrog pa/ sdug bsngal gyi bsam pa bzod du med par dngud mo'i sgra dang bcas 'di skad ces zhus so/

/ 1) rin chen gnyis pa/ dngul mdog / dngul sder/ ming gi rnam grangs la gdung byed dang, mdog dkar, mdog ngan, rin chen gnyis pa bcas so, 2) nyo byed kyi rdzas/ dngul khug / dngul sgam/ 'bru bun dngul la phab pa/
dngul las bzos pa'i mchod kong/
1) sprod len bya rgyu'i dngos zog gzhan min pa'i lag dngul/ 2) rgyu cha gzhan bsres med pa'i dngul spus gtsang/
chang 'dren byed dngul las bzos pa'i rkyan bu tshag ris ma/
1) dngul gyis bzos pa'i skud pa/ 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo mchin gyi tshad rpa dang, rtsa tshad dug tshad sogs la phan/
1) dngul gyi gter kha/ 2) dngul gyi kha shan/
dngul gyi kha shan byas pa'i phor pa/
dngul gsog pa dang, bu lon gtong ba, dngul brjes gtong len sogs kyi byed sgo gnyer mkhan las khungs shig /
dngul phar sprod tshur len gyi bdag khungs sgyur ba/

dngul gyi zho srang bar khyad rtsi tshul zhig / zho brgyad skar ma phyed brgyad byung ba na, srang gi brgyad cha bdun du 'gro ba yin, 8...+7.5...=7/8... ? zho drug skar ma phyed bdun drug cha gcig byung na, srang gi gsum cha gnyis su 'gro, 6...+6.5...+1/6...=2/3... ?
dngul gyi sku 'gyed/ dge 'dun pa tshor srang gsum gsum byas nas dngul 'gyed gtong ba/
dngul gyis bzos pa'i sgor mo/
lhad 'dres pa'i dngul spus zhan po/

1) rin po che'i sman gyi rigs shig ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas bcud len, gnyan nad 'joms, rnag dang chu ser skem, gdon nad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la khams chen po dang, khu ba'i dbang po, dngul byed, chu sman ral gri reg gcod, chu'i sman pa dkar po, thig le dar ya kan, dag pa'i khams, bdud rtsi bcud rgyal, 'ded byed, gnam gyi bya khyung dkar po, 'phrog byed, dbang phyug thig le, 'bigs byed rgyal po, mes 'ching, mtshal skyes, mtshal gyi bu, mtshal chu, rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam, zla ba'i gzugs bcas so, 2) gangs ri dkar po'i chu'ang zer, chu 'go gangs ri dkar po nas byung zhing, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul khul du slebs dus rdza chu la bab/

dngul chu dang, gsha' dkar, zha nye, mar nag mar khu rnams lhan du lcags snod nang bskol nas khol ba'i tshe rdo gzhong grang mo'i steng du bsnur zhing ba chu'am star bu'i chus lan gsum bkrus pa la zer te, nus pas sbyar dug dang, mchin nad, bad kan smug po sogs la phan/
dngul chu la dug 'don dang, las snon sogs ma byas pa rnag bzhin rkyang pa'i ming
dngul chu tsha 'dul dang, grang 'dul lta bu dug 'don dang las snon tshar ba'i ming/

mu zi ser po lcags snod du bzhus pa'i steng dngul chu blugs nas lcags thur gyis dkrugs shing sngon por song ba'i tshe rdo gzhong tshan mor bsnur nas dbyer med du 'dres pa'i phye ma sngo nag la zer te, nus pas gag lhog dang, gnyan gzer, 'brum nag mdze 'bras sogs la phan/
mthing shog gi ngos su dngul btul mas bris pa'i chos, dngul bris kyang zer/
(yul) sa gnas shig gis dngul khang ngam sbrags khang du dngul sprad nas sa gnas gzhan zhig gi dngul khang nas tshur len rgyu/ dngul brjes gtong gla/ dngul brjes 'byor byung/
dngul bdag bzung gtong len byed mkhan/
rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan me tog dkar po 'char: ba zhig ste ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mkhris tshad dang sman nad sel/
dngul las bzos pa'i yon chab 'bul snod ting phor/
(yul) dngul las bzos pa'i ja chang gi snod/
dngul las bcos pa'i nad dmigs sreg byed kyi tel pa ste, nus pas 'bras nad dang, rtsa dkar sogs kyi nad la phan/
dngul sgor mo'i bye brag cig /
rta'i rmig pa 'dra ba'i dngul lugs ma/
dngul las bzos pa'i khog ltir/
dngul gyis bzos pa'i lung thag /
dngul sbrang bshog ltar brdungs nas bsregs pa'i thal ba la zer, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas sha ro dang, rmen bu, 'bras nad rnams 'joms, dmu chu skem, dngul chu'i nus pa srung/
rten 'brel dang dga' ston gyi skyes su sprod pa'i dngul ras dkar sogs kyis gtums pa'i thum bu/
1) dngul gyi thur ma/ 2) dngul gyis bzos pa'i khyem bu
1) dngul gyi dam be/ 2) dngul las bzos pa'i dam ga /
dngul gyis bzos pa'i dung chen/
dngul bzhus pa'am, brdungs pa'i sbyangs ma/
dngul gyis gtums pa'i gdung rten/

smin dbrag gi dkyil nas g.yon ngos su tshon gang re gzhal ba dang, de nas gyen du tshon do gzhal ba'i skra mtshams su yod pa'i khrag rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na mig nad dang, mig gi rdzi ma byi ba sogs la phan/
dngul shan brgyab pa'i snod spyad mdong mo/
rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag gso, chu ser skem/
dngul lugs ma sa phag gi dbyibs can
1)dngul gyi thog nas sprad pa'i phogs/ 2)sngar dgon sde rnams nas dngul bun btang ba'i skyed thog nas grwa pa rnams la sprod pa'i dngul phogs/
1) dngul las bzos pa'i 'thung snod tshags ris ma/ 2) dngul shan brgyab pa'i shing phor/
dngul rkyang 'jal sprod byed pa'i bogs ma/
dngul bed spyod mi nus par lag pas dam por 'dzin pa'am, srung ba lta bu'i bran g.yog ste, ser sna can la smod pa'i tshig /
dngul btul mas bris pa'i chos dpe, dngul chos kyang zer/ dpe cha dngul bris ma/
1) dngul las bzos pa'i mchod rten/ 2) dngul phye las bris pa'i sher phyin 'bum/
lhad skyon med pa'i dngul rkyang ngam btso sbyangs byas pa'i dngul/
dngul bzhus nas byung ba'i khu ba/
rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus pa gas chag shor ba dang, rdo dug sogs la phan/
dngul mdog gi bye brag cig /
dngul gyi tshab tu sprod len byed pa'i shog dngul/
nang rgya kha zhabs bcas la dngul shan g.yogs pa'i phor pa/
shog bu bzhin du bzos pa'i dngul
dngul 'degs tshad dam, grangs tshad 'jal byed/ dngul hrob hrob, zhib zhib dang yo byad bzos ma tshar ba'i dngul/
/ 1) ngogs sam 'gram/ chu'i dngo/ 2) gri'i kha/ gri dngo rnon po/ 3) rta lcag gi 'breng thag / rta lcag gi dngo/
rtsa chen nam, rin thang chen po/

/ 1) lkog gyur min pa'i mngon sum/ dngos 'thab 'jabs 'dzings byed/ dngos nas mdung phen pa dang lkog nas mda' 'phen pa/ rnam 'gyur dngos su ston pa/ mang tshogs kyi mdun du dngos su khas blangs pa/ 2) brgyud pa min pa'i thad kar dang rang nyid/ dngos brgyud gang gzab kyis yong thabs byed pa/ rna bas dngos thos dang, mig gis dngos mthong/ zhal ras dngos su mjal/ 3) sbyor mjug gnyis min gyi dngos gzhi'am gzhung/ tshogs 'du dngos su 'tshogs pa/ las khungs gsar pa dngos su btsugs pa/ gzhung don dngos/ dngos kyi don/ 4) bcos ma'am rdzun ma yin pa'i bden pa dang ngo ma/ dngos dang sgyur ma gang yin mi shes pa/ dngos rdzun dbye ba 'byed dka' ba/ bya spyod dngos la blta/

rang gi rdzas rgyun du rdzas su gtso bor dngos su skyed byed de, rang gis nye bar len bya'i 'bras bu de nyid dngos su skyed par byed pa, dper na, bud shing gi skad cig tha ma sol ba'i dngos kyi nyer len yin pa lta bu'o/
dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags
thun mong gi ma nges pa'i rtags gang zhig gang la rtags su song ba'i rgol bas rtags mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gnyis ka la yod cing yod pa ltar blos kyang mthung ba'o/
dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi

thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i rtags las dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi ste, mthun phyogs la khyab byed mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa dang, mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa dang, mthun mi mthun phyogs gnyis ka la rnam pa gnyis gnyis su 'jug pa bcas so/
dngos rigs kyi 'bul ba'am, lag rtags/
1) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig / 2) (siddhi:) man ngag bsgrubs nas grub pa'i dgos 'dod kyi legs 'bras/
ral gri dang, ril bu, mig sman, rkang mgyogs, bcud len, mkha' spyod, mi snang ba, sa 'og bcas kyi dngos grub ste thun mong ba'i dngos grub brgyad/
mchod rten gyi bye brag cig /
mchog gi dngos grub dang, thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis/
'gal ba gang zhig phan tshun dngos su mi mthun par gnas pa, rtag mi rtag dang, snang ba dang mun pa lta bu'o/

dngos 'gal la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na, phan tshun rnam bcad dang yongs gcod kyi sgo nas mi mthun par gnas pa yod dang med, yin dang min lta bu phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi dngos 'gal dang, dngos su gnod bya gnod byed du gyur pa snang mun dang, tsha grang lta bu lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi dngos 'gal te gnyis so/
skyed byed kyi rgyu'i nang gses, rang 'bras dngos su skyed par byed pa ste, rang gi bskyed bya'i 'bras bu de dang bar du chos gzhan brgyud mi dgos pa, du ba'i rgyu me yin pa lta bu'o
1) mdog dbyibs mi sdug pa/ 2) sha rid pa'am skam pa/
gsal gsal bden bden/ gnas lugs yong rkyen tshang ma dngos dngos rjen rjen bshad nas gnad don gsal por rtogs pa/
dngos po'i yo byad/ dngos chas brlag stor bor gsum med par bsdad 'dug /
dngos gnas sgrib med/ drang bden gyi gnas lugs dngos rjen la 'phya smod byed don med/
mthong thos dngos, tshor ba'i nyams snang, gnyid kyi rmi lam/
ngo ma dang rdzun ma/ dngos ming dang btags ming/

1) dngos rtogs rtag rtogs gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dngos por rtogs pa'i tshad ma ste, 'dus byas rang mtshan pa rnams dngos po la dngos por nges pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/ 2) dngos rtogs shugs rtogs gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dngos su rtogs pa ste, yul rang nyid kyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas rtogs pa, dper na, bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyis bum pa rtogs pa dang, sgra mi rtag rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra mi rtag pa rtogs pa lta bu yul rang mtshan pa'am don spyi'i rnam pa blo la shar nas rtogs pa'o/
dngos gnas min pa zhig dngos gnas ltar du mthong ba/
dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags kyi bsdus ming,
bsal ba bzhi'i nang gses, dam bca' dang dngos po'i stobs zhugs kyi rtags dang 'gal ba, dper na, sgra rtag par 'dod pa lta bu dngos stobs rjes dpag gis gnod pa'o/

rjes dpag gsum gyi nang gses: rang gi rten dngos po'i stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag la brten nas gzhal bya cung zad lkog gyur la mi bslu ba'i shes pa ste, 'bras rang ma dmigs pa'i rtags la brten nas rang gi gzhal bya gsar du rtogs pa'o/
ngag lam mam, yig lam gang rung gis dngos su gsal por zin pa'i tshig don/
ca lag ji yod kyi tho/
dga' ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, gzugs brnyan tsam min par dga' ba skye ba'i rgyu khyad 'phags kyi gzugs dngos su mthong ba las 'bras bu dga' ba thob par ston pa'i rgyun zhig /
dngos gnas gsal mthong/ ma shi dngos mthong/
mngon sum mthong nas bden par shes pa/ gnas tshul tshang ma dngos mthong bden rtogs kyis yid ches brtan po thob byung/
mig gis mngon sum mthong zhing, blta bya'i gzugs can du yang grub pa/ de'i legs nyes rnam pa'i khyad par dngos mthong gzugs grub yin/
nas dngos po rang nyid kyi ngo bo dug yin pa: btsan dug dang mthang phrom lta bu'o/
don gnad ngo ma/ dngos don ngo ma/
dngos gnas drang bden/ don de ni dngos bden zhig las bcos ma zhig min/
(rnying) rang gis byas pa'i sdig pa
don dngos yin pa/ skad cha dngos gnas/ dngos gnas khungs dag /
bden pa bden rkyang/ bsam 'char gang yod dngos gnas drang gnas bshad dgos/ las don gang ci g.yo zol med pa dngos gnas drang gnas byas na grub 'bras bzang po thon yong/

1. 1)nor rdzas dang, ca lag gam, yo byad/ sems dang dngos po khag khag so so min/ sger gyi dngos po/ yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po/ rung ba'i dngos po/ rung khang dngos po/ nyer mkho'i dngos po tsag tsig / 'tsho ba'i dngos po/ ming gi rnam grangs la dbyig dang, zang zing, dkor bcas so, 2)las don dang bya ba/ gsar byung dngos po/ gzung bya'i dngos po/ 'dzin byed kyi dngos po/ 3)don byed nus pa ste, rang 'dzin shes pa dang, rang gi rgyun phyi ma la sogs pa'i rang 'bras skyed pa'i don byed nus pa'i gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed rnams so/ dnggos po yod pa/ dngos po med pa/ 4) (mngon) shing khyi lo/ 2.ngo ma dang rang nyid/ mi dngos po phrad pa/
dngos po nye bar dgod pa
1)dngos po'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ 2)ca lag nye sar 'jog pa/
dngos po ste phung po lnga'i steng gi chos nyid/
dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags

rtags de yod na bsgrub bya de yod pa dang, rtags de yin na bsgrub bya de yin dgos pa ming gis bzhag pa tsam min par rtags dang bsgrub bya gnyis kyi dngos po rang gi chos nyid dang gshis la grub pa'i rtags kyi sbyor ba'o/

'jug skabs bdag gzhan gnyis su phye ba'i: bdag ste las gang rung gi byed pa po'i gang zag dang, byed pa'i yo byad, byed pa'i las rtsol bcas la zer, dper na, khos smyu gus yi ge 'bri ba zhes brjod pa'i tshe, kho ni byed pa po dang, smyu gu ni byed pa, 'bri ba ni byed las te, de rnams dngos po bdag yin/
rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa'am, don byed mi nus pa/
dngos po med pa stong pa nyid
'dus ma byas nam mkha' la sogs pa dang myang 'das rnams stong gzhir byas pa'i chos nyid de, stong nyid bco brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid: dngos po dang dngos med rang bzhin nam bden pas stong pa ste stong nyid bcu drug gi nang tshan zhig /
dngos po yod par smra ba ste, bden grub kyi dngos po yod par khas len pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/

rtags 'jug skabs bdag gzhan gnyis su phye ba'i gzhan te, las gang rung gi bsgrub bya'i yul lam las kyi dngos po dang, bya ba'i las kyi dngos po la zer, dper na, ngas sta res shing gcad par bya zhes brjod pa'i tshe, shing ni yul lam las, gcad par bya ni bya ba'i las te, de gnyis dngos po gzhan yin/

btsun pa chos skyob kyi lugs yin te, des myu gu lta bu ma 'ongs pa nas da lta ba dang, da lta ba nas 'das par 'jug pa'i tshe rdzas gzhan du mi 'gyur yang dngos po gzhan du 'gyur bar khas len pa dang gser snod bcom nas rgyan byas tshe kha dog mi 'gyur yang dbyibs gzhan du 'gyur ba dang, 'o ma zhor gyur tshe ro nus 'gyur yang kha dog gzhan du mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/
dngos po rang yin pa'i cha: dper na, bum pa rang yin gyi cha bum pa'i rang ldog yin pa lta bu ste, dngos po'i ldog pa dang, dngos po dang gcig bcas don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/
rang bzhin gyi bskal don no/
bya dga' sogs la ster ba'i rdzas/
dngos po'i stobs zhugs kyi rtags

rtags yang dag gsum gyi nang gses, sa bon las myu gu dang, me las du ba 'byung ba ni dngos po rang gi rang bzhin nam chos nyid yin pa dang, byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin pa'ang dngos po rang nyid kyi rang bzhin chos nyid kyi stobs su zhugs pa'i rtags so/
dngos po'i mtha' la dmigs pa

khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi'i gras shig ste 'di tsam du zad kyi 'di las gzhan med do zhes pa'i ji snyed pa'i dngos po'i mtha' dang, 'di kho na ltar gnas kyi gzhan du mi gnas so zhes pa'i ji lta ba'i dngos po'i mtha' gnyis so, dper na bden bzhir shes bya'i dngos po thams cad 'dus kyi, de phan chad du gzhan med pa'o zhes dang, chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o de min tshe gzhan min no zhes pa lta bu'o/
dngos po dang tha dad las log pa'i chos, dper na, bum pa'i ldog pa lta bu'o/
sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi brgyad pa don gyi dngos gzhi rtogs par byed pa ste, dper na brda sprod pa'i gzhung sum cu pa lta bu/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang don gnyis kyi khyad chos 'dra ba dngos su mi ston zhing, de'i ngo bo 'dra ba dngos su bstan nas mtshungs gsal gyi sgra tshig gi mtha' mar 'jog pa'i rgyan zhig /
lag thog tu phan pa'am go chod po/

rgyu des dngos su bskyed pa'i 'bras bu ste, rgyu des rang dang rang gi 'bras bu'i bar du rgyu'i rgyun gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dngos su bskyed par bya ba'i chos, dper na dngos po skad cig gnyis pa de skad cig dang po'i dngos 'bras yin pa lta bu'o/

snang rung gi 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, de byung gi 'brel ba la brten nas sgrub byed dngos 'bras med pa'i tags kyis, gzhi der dngos rgyu yod pa bkag pa, dper na, du bas dben pa'i rtsig skor na chos can, du ba'i dngos rgyu med de, dngos 'bras du ba med pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
dngos gnas/ khrims mthun dngos 'brel yin/ kha nas mi 'gro zer yang dngos 'brel byas na sems la 'gro 'dod chen po 'dug /
dngos gnas drang gnas/ skad cha dngos 'brel drang 'brel bshad na mi'i khyur 'dres yong/
dngos su lag bstar gyis sbyong ba/ dngos sbyong byed sa/

ming 'dogs tshul gyi bye brag cig ste, 'dra 'brel gang rung gi rgyu mtshan la ma brten par 'dod rgyal gyis thog mar brda sbyar ba'i ming gang zhig don de thun mong ma yin par go bar byed nus pa, nog dang lkog shal can la ba lang zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/
don byed nus stong ste don byed mi nus pa, nam mkha' lta bu 'dus ma byas pa'i chos so/
nyid du shes pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas rim gyis sgom pa'o/
dngos su thob pa'i nyams myong/
spus dag gam rnam par dag pa/ bsam pa dngos gtsang, kha btags dngos gtsang/ rgyan gos dngos gtsang/ gzhan phan gyi las don dngos gtsang/
1) ma rig pa/ 2) dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'am bden par 'dzin pa,
las don ngo ma/ tshogs 'du dngos gzhi/ mdzad sgo dngos gzhi/ gzhung gi dngos gzhi/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos gzhir snyoms par zhugs pa/
sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi ya gyal zhig / gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas nas dngos gzhi'i gnas skabs su slebs pa/
ca lag / dngos zog skyel 'dren/ dngos zog mngag gtam/ dngos zog 'jug 'don/ dngos zog dom len/
blo la dngos su snang nas rig par bya ba, dper na, bum 'dzin mngon sum dang, bum 'dzin rtog pa'i dngos yul bum pa yin pa lta bu'o/
mngon sum du yod pa/ dngos yod gnas tshul/ kha bshad tsam ma yin par lag thog dngos yod kyi steng nas bgo 'grems byas pa/
mngon sum ra 'phrod/ gdong bsher byas nas dngos ra gsal 'phrod byung ba/ lag len thengs gcig bstar na, dngos ra gsal 'phrod thob yong/
ngo lkog gam ngo ma dang zhor/ dngos shugs kyi sgo nas bslab bya byas pa/
thad ka dang, zhar byung, gzhan dag brgyud pa bcas gsum/ de la dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyi thog nas zhabs 'degs zhus pa/
slob bu ngo ma'am, thad ka'i slob bu/
sgrib med mngon sum du gyur pa/ byas rjes dngos gsal/ gnas tshul dngos gsal/ mig lam la dngos gsal dod po byung 'dug / bya ba dngos gsal bsgrubs 'dug /
bcol gtam/ nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bsgrub rgyu'i mngag cha byas pa/
las don bcol ba'i gtam/ khong la byed sgo mang po mngag gtam zhus pa yin/
ched mngags gtong ba/ bang chen blo 'khel ba zhig mngag gtong byed pa/

(tha dad pa) mngags pa, mngag pa, mngogs,, 1) 'tshol ba'am sgo ba/ bya 'os tshang ma kho la mngags pa/ skad cha zhib gsal mngags pa/ khab 'tshem mngags dang, sbud pa dbugs mngags/ 2) gtong ba/ tshur lan skyel mkhan mi gcig mngags pa/ sku tshab mngags pa/
lan 'phrin dang pho nya gtong ba/
gong nas bkas mngags pa'i las 'gan/
las don sgrub rgyu mngags pa/ dngos nor rtsa 'gangs che rigs grogs po la mngags bcol do nan byas pa/
mngag gtam byas nas nyo ba/ mkho chas mngags nyo/ dpe deb dang gsar 'gyur mngags nyo/
gzhan la 'tshong rogs bya rgyur mngags pa/
(rnying) skyon/ mngan bgrang ba, (rnying) skyon re re bzhin brjod pa/
dbang cha/ rgyal khab kyi chab srid bya ba mtha' dag la mnga' sgyur ba/ rgya che'i sa mi thams cad la mnga' mdzad pa/
dbang thob pa'am, byang chub pa/ 'phrul las la mnga' brnyes pa/ thogs rdugs med pa'i mnga' brnyes pa/

1) dbang thang/ mnga' thang lhun stug gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ mnga' thang longs spyod dpyid kyi dpal la 'gran/ 2) dge tshogs bsod nams/ sku bsod mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla gsar bzhin du 'phel/ ming gi rnam grangs la skal ldan dang, bgo skal, sngon gyi las, sngon byas, sngon bsags, gnam bskos, las bskos, bsags rgyab, lhas bskos, lhas bstan pa bcas so,
bod rang skyong ljongs lho kha sa khul mnga' ris grwa tshang, dwags po grwa tshang, chos 'khor rgyal grwa tshang ste gsum/
1) dbang po ste dbang sgyur mkhan/ 2) gtso bo'am, rgyal po ste, sa dang mi nor sogs la bdag dbang byed mkhan/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can khri ral pa can no/

1) sngar rgyal rtse'i sa khul la yod pa'i mnga' bdag cig gi ming/ 2) mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi sprul ba nyang gi rus las 'khrungs pa'i gter chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bka' bab nyi ma 'od zer ro
yod pa dang ldan pa'am, gsal ba dang dbang ba'i zhe sa/ thugs la mnga' gsal ltar/ sras gsum mnga' ba/ sku la bsnyung gzhi mi mnga' 'am/ dgongs pa'i dbus su mnga' ba zhu/
dbang cha/ 'dems sgrug byas nas mnga' dbang bskur ba/
bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin bdag po'i tshab byed mi/
mi ser/ yul byol du yong mkhan tsho sdod sa de'i mnga' zhabs su 'dzul ba/
/ mnga' 'og mi ser/ mnga' 'og las khungs/ rang gi mnga' 'og tu 'jug / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi sa yul rnams mnga' 'og tu sdud/

1) chab 'bangs sam, mi ser/ 2) mnga' khongs yul gru spyi/ 3) sa khul zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi nub rgyud na yod, khul de hi ma la ya ri bo dang khu nu ri bo'i dbar du chags shing, de'i khongs su sgar dang, ru thog rtsa mda', spu hreng, dge rgyas, sger rtse, mtsho chen bcas rdzong khag bdun yod/

stod mnga' ris skor gsum ste bod yul stod smad bar gsum du phye ba'i stod phyogs kyi spu hreng dang, mang yul, zangs dkar gsum skor gcig zhang zhung dang, khri te stod smad gsum skor gcig 'chim mam li dang, bru sha, sbal ti gsum skor gcig ste skor gsum/

gngas g.ya' mtsho gsum gyis bskor ba'i yul lung khag gsum ste, chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon te chab srid bzung zhing, sras gsum byung ba'i che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon gyis bzung ba'i mnga' ris mnga yul te, zangs dkar mtsho yis bskor ba dang, bkra shis lde mgon gyis bzung ba'i mnga' ris stag mo ste, spu hreng gangs kyis bskor ba, lde gtsug mgon gyis bzung ba'i mnga' ris zhang zhung ste, gu ge g.ya' yis bskor ba bcas gsum/
mtshan dngos pad ma dbang rgyal, rab byung brgyad pa'i me lug la 'khrungs, rab byung dgu pa'i chu yos la 'das, 'di ni sdom gsum rnam nges rtsom pa po yin/
gus pa'i sgo nas go sar bskos pa/ rgyal por mnga' gsol ba/ btsun mor mnga' gsol ba/ blon por mnga' gsol ba/
phyur ba ro mngar mo zhig /
bu ram lta bu'i ro/ ro mngar/ ja mngar mo/ chang mngar mo/
shel ka ra, bu ram, sbrang rtsi ste gsum/
bu snod/ mngal 'khor ba/ mngal du phru gu chags/ zla grangs tshang nas mngal grol ba/ aa ma'i mngal du zhugs nas zla grangs tshang/

'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes rnams: ma'i mngal du tshang bar ldan pa'i khams drug ste pha las thob pa'i rus pa dang rkang, khu ba bcas gsum dang, ma las thob pa'i sha dang, pags pa, khrag bcas drug /
bu snod skyon du gyur pa'i nad de, nang gses su dbye na rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan khrag 'dus pa bcas lnga mchis so/
bud med kyi zla mtshan dang chu ser gnyis rlung gis bsgril nas skran du gyur pa/
phru gu ma'i mngal du yod pa'i skabs/

mngal du mi lus chags pa'i gnas skabs lnga po 'di bod 'gyur snga phyi mi 'dra ba yod pa'i nang nas, gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos zhus pa'i mdo ltar na, nur nur po dang, mer mer po, nar nar po, 'phrang gyur, rkang lag 'gyus pa bcas lnga dang, yang mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo ltar na, nur nur po dang, mer mer po, nar nar po, gor gor po, rkang lag 'gyus pa bcas lnga'o/
mngal gyi btsog grib ste, mngal du yod pa'i btsog ngad/
aa ma'i gzugs por chags pa'i phru gu zla grangs tshang nas skyes pa/
aa ma'i gzugs por phru gu chags pa/
sbrum ma'am phru gu skye rgyu yod pa'i bud med/
1) rnam shes mngal du 'jug pa/ 2) dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo/
mngal du chags zin pa'i phru gu med pa bzo ba/
bu ro 'don byed kyi yo byad cig /
thag pa'i phru gur thon pa'i shu thor la zer: zhing gzhan du btsa' thor yang zer/
sbrum ma'am phru gu skye rgyu yod pa'i bud med/
dus brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, nur nur po dang, mer mer po dang, nar nar po dang, 'phrang 'gyur dang, rkang lag 'gyus pa bcas mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga la zer/
bud med kyi bu snod kyi nad de, rtsa ba'i mngal nad lnga dang, gzhan rtsa nad sogs rigs sum cu rtsa lnga 'dren pa'ng mchis/

nyal po mang du spyad pa dang, bu btsas rjes su zas spyod log pa sogs las byung ba'i bu snod kyi nad lnga ste, rlung las gyur pa dang, mkhris pa las gyur pa, bad kan las gyur pa, khrag las gyur pa, 'dus pa las gyur pa bcas so/
mngal chags pa'am phru gu 'khor ba/
ma'i mngal nas bu phrug skyes pa/
bud med la phru gu 'khor ba/
mngal du phru gu chags mi thub pa bzo ba'i thabs shes/
thabs shes la brten nas phru gu shor du 'jug pa
phru gu zla dus ma tshang bar skye shor thebs pa/
mngal du zla zhag 'phar ma bsdad pa/

bud med kyi mngal nang gi srin bu ma ra ka dang, aa so ka zhes khros pa'i nad de, nad rtags su mtshan ma za zhing nu ma rgyas la sems 'phyo ba dang skyes pa dang 'phrad 'dod pa sogs 'byung ba'i mo nad cig /

1.gsal cha'am mtshon pa/ phyi la mngon chung ba/ spyod pa mngon che ba/ gcig pu mngon chung byas nas phyin pa/ mngon chen po'i sgo nas dril bsgrags byed pa/ mngon 'dzing lkog 'thab/ 2.mdun nam thad ka/ dka' tshegs la mngon du phyogs pa/ 'chi bar mngon du phyogs pa/ gzhan la tshig rtsub kyis mngon du gshe ba/
dang lkog gyur ram: ngo lkog...gang byas mngon lkog mi mthun pa med pa/ mngon lkog gi skad cha shod stangs mi 'dra ba/
mngon sum du mkhyen pa'am mngon par shes pa/

1) mngon sum du gyur pa ste, dngos su byung ba dang, mthong chos su gyur pa/ 2) mngon par gyur pa'am, mngon du gyur pa ste, rang dbang thob pa dang, khong du chud pa/ 3) gzhal bya'i gnas gsum gyi nang gses, mngon sum tshad ma'i gzhal bya'am myong stobs kyis rtogs nus pa, gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lta bu'o/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, da lta byed bzhin pa bcos ma'i las kyi dgag bya de, 'gog byed bcos min gyi las khyad par ba zhig gis 'gog par byed pa'i rgyan zhig

bsnyen rdzogs sgrub par mngon gyur bcu tshang dgos pa ste, sangs rgyas mngon gyur, chos mngon gyur, dge 'dun mngon gyur, mkhan po mngon gyur, slob dpon mngon gyur, bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mngon gyur, yo byad mngon gyur, yang dag mngon gyur, gsol ba mngon gyur, las mngon gyur bcas bcu'o/
1) yid kyi dga' spro chen po/ 2) shar gyi sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing khams/
yongs grags min pa'am gzhan gyi mig sngar gsal por mi mngon pa/ sgo'i ser srubs nas mngon chung gis gzigs pa/
rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal te, ming du 'dogs tshul dang, 'jug tshul, ming gi rnam grangs sogs kyi rnam gzhag rnams gsal bar ston pa'i rig pa'o/
sngon 'dzin mig shes la sngon po rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snang ba la dbang par byed pa'i bag chags lta bu
mngon sum du shar ba'i rtags mtshan/
1) mkhyen pa dang ye shes te, mngon sum du shes pa/ 2) gsang sngags kyi bskyed rim sgrub thabs shig /

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba, rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang, lam shes pa nyid dang, thams cad shes pa nyid dang, rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa, rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa, mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa, skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa, chos sku ste sher phyin dngos po skabs brgyad kyi bdag nyid can, rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i byams chos sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig

'grel ba don gsal: slob dpon seng ge bzang pos brtsams pa zhig rgya gar gyi mkhan po bity'a ka ra pra bha dang, zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab cing, slad kyi pandi ta spal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang, lo tsa ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis legs par gtan la phab pa/
mngon par bstod pa ste, yid dga' nas mngon sum dr bsngags pa'i che brjod/
1) mngon par mtho ba ste, shin tu mtho ba/ 2) lha dang bcas pa'i bde 'gro'i phun tshogs dge legs/

'jig rten pa'i theg pa ste, ngan song gi sdug bsngal las 'phral du thar ba lha mi'i bde ba rnam smin rgyu mthun gyis bsdus pa'o, de la nang gses su lha mi'i theg pa dang, tshangs pa'i theg pa gnyis yod do/

sa drug pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas rten 'brel lugs 'byung du bsgoms pas 'khor ba las ldog pa mngon du gyur pa dang, rten 'brel lugs ldog tu bsgoms pas myang 'das la mngon du phyogs pa ste mngon du gyur pas na de ltar brjod do/
mngon du gyur pa'i sa dang don gcig
lag len bstar ba dang, sa lam thob pa/
mngon mtshan nam, gzengs thon gyi gsal cha/ byas rjes
zhig bzhag pa:/ gyon pa'i tshos gzhi mngon dod chung ba/
1) re 'dun chen po/ 2) (mngon) 1. 'dod chags/ 2. aa mra'i shing/
dad pa gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, dad yul gyi yon tan de nyid rang rgyud la thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) gsal ba dang, mthong ba'am rig pa/ mu mtha' mi mngon pa/ rang rtags dmar rjen du mngon pa/ gsal la mi gsal ba zhig mngon pa/ gang ci'i sgo nas mi mngon pa'i nus shugs 'don thabs byed/ 2.(aabhi) mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i bden pa la sogs pa dang, chos re re la'ang gzugs can yin min sogs zhib mor phye nas yang yang ston pa dang, phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa dang, 'dis mdo sde'i don rtogs par 'gyur ba bcas rgyu mtshan bzhis mngon pa zhes bya/ 3.mngon pa la ra yig sbyar na rab tu'am mchog tu zhes pa'i don yin, mngon pa...mngon par dga' ba/ mngon par rtogs pa/ mngon par zhen pa/ byas rjes mngon par 'phags pa/ mngon par spro ba/ mngon par bsdus pa/ mngon par mkhyen pa/ mngon par 'dud pa/ mngon par bsgrubs pa/ mngon par gsal ba/ mngon par lci ba/ rgyal khab kyi zhabs 'degs la mngon par brtson pa/
chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i bsdus tshig mngon pa gong ma, mngon pa kun btus so/
mngon pa kun btus dang: mngon pa mdzod/
las btus pa'i rnam par bshad pa: bstan bcos shig rgya gar gyi slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo tsa ba ye shes sdes bsgyur pa/

thams cad yod par smra ba'i bstan bcos gtso bo bdun te, ye shes la 'jug pa dang, rab tu byed pa, rnam shes kyi tshogs, chos kyi phung po, gdags pa'i bstan bcos, 'gro ba'i rnam grangs, khams kyi tshogs bcas te, de bdun byed pa po ni rim par, katya'i bu dang,dbyig bshes, bram ze lhag skyid/ sh'a ri'i bu, mo 'u 'gal gyi bu, gsus po che, gang po bcas 'di bdun la dgra bcom bdun du grags/
chos mngon pa'i rjes su 'brang mkhan nam mngon pa'i lugs 'dzin mkhan/

chos mngon pa mdzod ces bya ba, khams dang, dbang po dang, 'jig rten dang, las dang, phra rgyas dang, lam dang gang zag dang, ye shes dang, snyom 'jug ste gnas brgyad kyi bdag nyid can gyi bstan bcos 'di dus rabs lnga par rgya gar gyi slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung zhig /
nga rgyal bdun gyi gras shig ste, ma thob par thob bo snyam du sems khengs pa/
mchod pa chen po bzhi'i nang tshan zhig
lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gtan la phab pa'i sde de dag mngon par bsdus pa'o/
mngon par skabs yod pa'i gzugs
chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs kyi gras, gzhan la thogs par byed pa'i reg bya dang bral ba bar snang skya sing po lta bu dang gzugs brnyan la sogs pa'o/
1) legs par tshar ba, 2) mngon sum du yod pa/
yan lag grub pa'i yan lag gnyis dang don: gcig
mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams
shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing khams/
mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i yan lag
'grub pa'i yan lag gsum dang don gcig /
mngon rtogs rgyan dang don gcig
mngon par rdzogs par sngas rgyas pa dang don gcig /
mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen

khyad par can gyi dus chen bzhi'i nang gses, hor zla bzhi pa sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin, ston pa thub pa'i dbang po gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du zad mi skye'i ye shes mngon du byas te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dus chen
khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba/
mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa
mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang don gcig
mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa
shes bya'i gnas kun mngon sum du rdzogs par mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pa/
drag po'i las te sngags mthus dgra bo dang gdon bgegs rnams bsgral ba'i las/
1) spyod rgyud kyi lha rnam snang mngon byang/ 2) mngon par byang chub pa'i bsdus ming,
sku lnga'i ya gyal zhig sku bzhi rig pa'i ye shes la lhun gyis rdzogs pas chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du gdul bya'i las dang mthun par sna chogs su snang ba ste, sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa'o/
thugs lnga'i nang gses shig me long lta bu'i ye shes ni mngon byang gis cir yang sa ler mkhyen pa'i thugs zhes rnying gzhung du gsal/
gsung lnga'i ya gyal zhig sgra thams cad rang rig pa'i ngang du lhun gyis grub pas cir yang mi 'gag pa rig pa byin rlabs kyi gsung ni mngon byang gi gsung zhes sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa'o/

bskyed rim gyi lha sku'i sgom tshul zhig ste, zla ba las byang chub pa dang, nyi ma las byang chub pa dang, sa bon las byang chub pa dang, phyag mtshan las byang chub pa dang, sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste lnga/

lha bskyed pa'i tshul zhig ste, padma la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du a'a li las zla ba dang k'a li las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bar du lha'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan par bsgom, de las 'od zer 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las lha'i sku rdzogs par bskyed pa ni mngon byang lnga bskyed ces bya ste, zla ba me long ye shes las byang chub pa dang, nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes las byang chub pa dang, sa bon dang phyag mtshan sor rtog ye shes las byang chub pa dang, thams cad 'dres pa bya grub ye shes las byang chub pa dang, sku rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa dang, sku rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/
(rnying) 1) bun skyed/ 2) rin po che spyi'i ming/ 3) ri mo yod pa'i dong tse/
mngon mtshan can gyi spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, chags sems kyis nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la gser dngul la sogs pa bun skyed dam khe spogs byed bcug pa/
1) nga rgyal byed pa/ 2) nga rgyal byed mkhan/ mi shes shes mdog byed pa'i mngon rlom pa/
mngon par shes pa ste, mngon gyur dang, yul dus thag ring po na gnas pa'i lkog gyur dang, shin tu lkog gyur gyi gnas tshul mngon sum du rtogs thub pa'i shes pa/
rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang, lha'i mig gi mngon shes, lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes, sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes, gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes bcas lnga/
mngon shes lnga'i steng du, zag zad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes bsnan pas drug ste, sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba'i mngon par shes pa'o/
1) (mngon) sangs rgyas/ 2) mngon shes drug dang ldan pa/

1) 'khrul ba min pa'i dngos gnas/ rigs lam mngon sum gyis bsal ba/ byas rjes mngon sum du bzhag pa/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams mngon sum mtshon pa/ 2) lkog gyur min pa'i thad ka/ mig gis mngon sum du mthong ba/ tshig rtsub mngon sum du brjod pa/ mngon sum du skyon brjod byed pa/ 3) «pratyaksha» blo rig bdun gyi nang gses, rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa, dper na, bum 'dzin dbang mngon dang, gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang, 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes lta bu'o/
bcad shes kyi nang gses, rang 'dren byed mngon sum tshad mas rtogs zin pa de slar yang rtogs pa ste, dbang

gnyis pa lta bu dbang mngon gyi bcad shes: dang bum 'dzin mngon sum dang rtog pa gnyis kyi skad cig gnyis pa nyams su myong ba'i rang rig lta bu rang rig mngon sum gyi bcad shes dang, mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skad cig gnyis pa lta bu rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi bcad shes rnams so/
bsal ba bzhi'i gras, dam bca' dang mngon sum gyi myong ba dang 'gal ba, dper na, sgra mnyan bya min par 'dod pa lta bu'o/

mngon sum gyi shes pa skye ba'i tshul gsum ste, mig shes kyi gzugs bzung ba na thog mar dbang mngon skad cig ma gcig skye, de nas dbang mngon skad cig dang pos bdag rkyen byas nas dbang mngon skad gnyis pa dang yid mngon skad cig dang po gnyis dus mnyam du skye, mngon sum de gnyis kyi steng du rang rig mngon sum yod pa bcas mngon sum 'gros gsum mo/
mngon sum brgyad kyis zhi ba

'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed chos bdun gyi nang gses te, de la'ang lung rigs kyi byed pa la brten nas blo rtse gcig tu mthun par gyur pa lta bu rgol phyir rgol gyi mngon sum dang, de nyid rang stobs kyis ma zhi na dpang pos sgrub byed bkod nas zhi ba lta bu gzu bo'i mngon sum dang, des ma zhi na rtsod pa rgyus yod pa'i dge 'dun zhig la brten nas zhi ba lta bu dge 'dun gyis zhi ba'i mngon sum dang, des ma zhi na lung rigs la mkhas pa'i dge slong bzhi yan chad gsol gnyis las kyis bskos te khong tshos zhi bar byed pa gsal ba'i mngon sum dang, des ma zhi na dge slong de dag gis yang du gsol gnyis las kyis mkhas pa bzhan bskos te zhi bar byed pa gsal ba'i gsal ba'i mngon sum dang des kyang ma zhi na gans brtan dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la rtsod pa phul te, de dag gis zhi bar byed pa gnas brtan dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyi mngon sum dang, des kyang ma zhi na kyu gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa la phul te zhi bar byed pa sde snod 'dzin pa la phul te zhi bar byed pa sde snod 'dzin pa'i mngon sum dang, des kyang ma zhi na sus kyang bka' 'da' bar mi nus pa'i gnas brtan mthu ldan la phul te khong gis zhi bar byed pa gnas brtan mthu ldan gyi mngon sum ste brgyad do/
mthong chos sam, dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa/
sgrib med gsal rjen/ bde sdug gnas tshul tshang ma mngon sum rjen gcer du mthong ba/

rtog med 'khrul ba'i shes pa ste, rang snang ba'i shes pa 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus bslad pa'i dbang gis rang yul log par snang ba, dper na, zla gcig zla gnyis su snang ba lta bu grangs la 'khrul ba dang, dung ser snang lta bu kha dog la 'khrul ba dang, ri ljon 'gro bar snang ba lta bu bya ba la 'khrul ba dang, mgal me bar ma chad du 'khor bar snang ba lta bu dbyibs la 'khrul ba bcas te, dang po gnyis ni mig rab rib dang mkhris nad sogs nang gi 'khrul rgyus bslad pa dang, phyi ma gnyis ni grur zhugs pa dang, mgal me myur du bskor ba lta bu phyi'i 'khrul rgyus bslad pa las byung ba'i log shes so/
lkog min dngos mthong gi yul/
dbang shes kyi dngos yul lam, dngos su yod pa rnams/

myong stobs kyis rang yul ji bzhin rtogs pa ste, dper na, sngo 'dzin dbang mngon la mtshon na, sngon po ni gzhal bay dang, sngoon po'i rnam par shar nas sngon po la gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa ni tshad ma, sngon po mngos su rtogs pa ni mngos sum tshad 'bras yin pa lta bu'o/

tshad ma'i nang gses, rtog bral ma 'khrul zhing gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa, dper na, bum 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig dang po dang, mngon shes skad cig dang po dang, rnam mkhyen dang 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes skad cig dang po lta bu, ngo bo rtog bral, yul rang mtshan, dus da lta ba, 'dzin stangs gsal la ma 'dres par 'dzin pa'o/
mngon gsal 'dzems med kyang zer, gzhan la 'dzems bag mi byed pa/ gzhan gyis mthong bzhin du spyod ngan mang po mngon sum 'dzems med kyis byas pa/
dbang mngon dang, yid mngon, rang rig mngon sum, rnal 'byor mngon sum/
yul gyi rnam pa 'khrul ba med pa'i sgo nas: dngos su mthong ba sogs rtog pa dang bral ba'i shes pa rnam par dag pa'i tshad ma dper na, gzugs 'dzin mig shes lta bu/
sgrib med gsal rjen nam, ha cang gsal po/ ma 'ongs pa'i skabs su phan gnod ji yong da lta mngon sum gsal rjen du mthong ba ltar red/
sgrib g.yogs med par gsal thon nam, ha cang gsal por shar ba/ byas rjes gang bzhag mngon sum gsal thon byung yod/

mngon sum la nges pa 'dren tshul gyis dbye na gsum ste, autpal ngo mi shes pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi autpal 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon lta bu mngon sum las dag po ba dang, yid sgra la chags dus kyi bzugs 'dzin dbnag mngon lta bu mngon sum yid ma gtad pa dang, rgyang ring po'i me'i kha dog mhtong ba'i dbang mngon ltta bu mngon sum 'khrul rgyu can rnams so/
mngos mthong gzugs grub ltar rjen par snang ba/ gtso don mngon gsal dod por brjod pa/ dmigs yul gang yin mngon gsal du bstan pa/ grub 'bras mngon gsal du thob pa/

snga ma'i mjug dang, lhag ma/ las don snga 'phro bsdad pa rnams slar yang 'go tshugs song/
re zhig gam gnas skabs/ 'o na snga 'phros khyed rang ma phebs na mnyes/ snga 'phros las ka rgyun gtan byas na 'grig /
dus kyi khyad par te phyi ba'i ldog phyogs/ snga sa nas, gang snga snga/ de ring yong ba'i dus tshod kha sang las snga ba yod/

1) rjes ma la ltos pa'i sngon ma sngon ma/ 2) dus shin tu snga ba/

1) khyo ga snga ma'am skye dman snga ma'i bu phrug / rang gi bu rgyud dang snga tshar/ 2) thog mar byung ba'i slob ma/

sngar dus/ snga logs kyi nyams myong/

snga po snga po'am ha cang snga po/ de ring kho snga gsar gsar nas phyin song/

«mantra:» rdo rje theg pa'i sgrub thabs nang sgrub pa po rang gi yid kyi snang ba phal pa las skyob par byed pa dang, yi dam 'khor bcas rnams skul bar byed pa'i yi ge'i gzungs/ gsang sngags/ rigs sngags/ drag sngags/ ngan sngags/ thun gsos sngags bgrangs/ sngags rgyag pa/
sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod byed myur shos te, dbang po rnon po rgyu 'bras lhun grub la mos pa rnams la 'bras bu lam du byed thabs/
gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs dang, rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang, gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs dang, bzhi pa'i gnas skabs bcas bzhi/
sngags kyi rtogs pa bogs 'don byed kyi spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum/
gzungs kyi sgo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bden tshig brjod na de bzhin du 'grub cing rig sngags gsar du byed nus pa/
bskyed rim la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/
1) sngags pa'i grwa tshang/ 2) sngags pa'i grwa pa/
sngags dang phyag rgya'i bsdus tshig /
1) sngags pa'i rigs rgyud/ 2) «tantram» gsang sngags skor gyi gsung rab/
sngags bzlas te phu btab pa'i chu/
gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan/ sngags 'chang nus ldan zhig bos te skyabs 'chol ba/
gsang sngags rnying ma dang don gcig
yi dam gyi rtsa sngags sogs kyi sngags bsgrubs te rjes gnang byed pa'i thabs/
gsang sngags dang, rig sngags, gzungs sngags te gsum/

gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa'am dam tshig ste, bsdam bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'pho ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa, sdom byed bde ba chen po'i ye shes de 'dzin par dam bcas nas thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa rang rgyu dbang bskur so so las mngon du gyur pa'o/

sngags kyi gzungs 'dzin mkhan nam gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngags chen dang, sngags 'chang, 'joms byed, bstan bdag mthu bo che, rdo rje 'dzin, nus pa can, bsrung 'khor ba bcas so,
sngags kyi lag len yod pa'i dge 'dun 'dus spyi ste rgyud pa'i grwa tshang/

lag bdun pa: phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag dang, mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag bshags pa'i yan lag rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i yan lag bsngo ba'i yan lag ste bdun/
sngags bzlas nas phu btab pa'i mar/
sngags btab pa'i gtor ma zur gsum ma
gyi brda sbyar ba'i yi ge:/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i nang yi dam gyi lha gang yin gyi sngags yig bsgrugs pa/
sngags kyi dam bca' bzhag pa'i rab 'byams pa'am dge bshes kyi nang gses shig /

rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa gsang ba kun gyi gnad rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba, gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag legs par ston pa'i gzhung, dus rabs bcu bzhi par rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa dang, nye char rgya lo tsa ba chos 'phags kyis rgya yig tu bsgyur/

sngon nam snga dus/ sngar nas 'dris pa'i grogs po/ rgyal kha sngar bas kyang che ba/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnam thar/ gnas tshul sngar dang mi 'dra ba/ mthun sgril dam zab sngar las lhag pa zhig byed pa/ sngar byas rgyab bskyur/ sngar byas la rtsad gcod mi byed/ sngar yod rmang gzhi'i thog / sngar byung ma myong ba/ sngar bshad pa ltar/
sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin kyang zer: 'khon 'gras kyi gting nad dam du 'dzin pa/ phan tshun sngar 'khon zhe bzhag gis kha ngan gtong res byed pa/
(rnying) 1) snga ma'i srol/ 2) thengs snga ma/

sngar gyi srol rgyun/ gtong yong tshang ma sngar rgyun gzhir bzhag las, snon phri spor gcog mi byed/ gtor skyon byung ba rnams sngar rgyun sor chud kyi go skabs thob pa/ phan tshun 'thab rtsod 'then 'khyer byas nas sngar rgyun gzhi 'jags ma thub pa/
gna' rabs snga dus/ mi tsho sngar snga mo nas lung pa der gzhis chags pa/

go gnas sogs sngar yod rang sor bzhag: pa

sngon du byung zin pa rnams la bskyar du bsam blo gtong ba/
sngon gyi rgyun nam mu/ 'bad brtson sngar mus su byed pa/ go gnas sngar mus 'dzin pa/
sngon med pa zhig gsar du bzos pa/ lam srol ngan pa sngar med gsar spros ma byed/ sgrig khrims sngar med gsar spros/ khral 'bab sngar med gsar spros byed pa/
sngar ltar ram snga ma nang bzhin/ phan tshun dbar du mthun sgril dam zab sngar bzhin byed pa/ gnas skabs sngar bzhin rang 'jags su 'jog pa/
snga dus kyi lugs srol/ dus chen so so'i byed sgo sngar lam nang bzhin red/
sngar gyi byas nyes mu mthud de byed pa/ sngar lugs sbug 'dren gyi rigs sus kyang byas mi chog
sngar nas gang yod rnams da lta'ang rang gnas su 'jags pa/ srol rgyun bzang ba rnams sngar sa da 'jad byas pa
sngar 'grub pa ltar da lta'ang yong snyam pa/ khyod kyis sngar song da 'gro'i bya spyod de ngas 'khur mi thub/
