sngon 'jug dang, rjes 'jug ming gzhi gsum/
yar rgyas mgyogs tsam yod pa dang, chu tshad mtho tsam yod pas mig dper 'os pa'i rigs/ sngon thon pa/ sngon thon nyams myong/
'khor bar skyes pa'i thog ma'i mtha'/ sngon mtha' mi mngon pa/ sngon mtha' stong pa nyid/ sngon mtha' med pa/
pa'i lta ba bzhi: sangs rgyas kyis lan gsungs yul du ma gyur pa'i lta log gi dri ba rnams sde tshan bzhir dbye ba'i nang gses, bdag dang 'jig rten rtag mi rtag gnyis yin gnyis min du lta ba/
1) sngon la byed dgos pa'i gra sgrig / 2) mdun du rgyug 'gro ba/
sngon gyi srid pa dang don gcig
rjes su yong rgyu'i gnas tshul sngon tshud nas dran pa/ phan gnod ji yong sngon dran gyi sgo nas blang dor 'dzol med byed pa/
sngon tshud nas gtong ba'i 'phrin nam gtam/ khungs so sor sngon brda gtong ba/ sang zhogs char pa 'bab pa'i sngon brda khas gzhes nyin nas btang ba/

mkhyen pa'i stobs: stobs bcu'i nang gses, 'das pa'i dus su bdag dang gzhan sems can ji snyed pa de snyed kyi yul phyogs dang, rgyu dang rnam pa bcas pa dran pa'i yul de rnams la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i mkhyen pa/
sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes
mngon shes kyi bye brag cig ste, sngon rang dang gzhan gyi skye yul dang, ming, pha ma, las, tshe, longs spyod sogs de dang de lta bu'o zhes ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa/
nam mkha'i mdog / rtswa sngon po/ ras sngon po/
snga ma'i 'jug dang, lhag ma/ gzhung don sngon 'phros bshad pa/ las grwa sngon 'phros gtsang mar 'jug bsdus pa/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas chu ser gyi nad rnams 'jam por sbyong bar byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la gyib shing dang, sngo aa tsa ra, bi sha la, shog shing pa bcas so,
sngar byas pa'i las don/ sngon byas la rtsad gcod mi byed/ sngon byas kyi las kar bskyar zhib byed pa/
sngar byung zin pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus sogs/ mkhas pa mang pos bsgrigs pa'i sngon byung gi lo rgyus rnam thar/
da lta'i sngon nas phebs pa/ sngon byon mkhas bzang/ skyes bu sngon byon/ sngon byon rgyal po/
1) sngon su ma byas gong du byed stangs sbyangs pa/ tsha kha sngon byangs/ ltad mo sngon sbyangs/ 2) snga ma nas byang goms thon pa'i yon tan/ skyes bu dam pa'i sngon sbyangs kyi yon tan/

1. snga mo'i dus/ ru sgrig gi sngon ma rnams dmag gi gdong len dpa' bo sha ltag red/ nyi zla'i 'od zer sngon ma nag bzhin gsal ba/ deng sang rang re'i mes po'i rgyal khab nang sngon gyi dus la lhag pa'i skal bzang dga' ston shar ba/ sngon mar bshad pa de tsho sems la bcang dgos/ da lta las sla por shes pa tshang ma sngon mar goms pa sha ltag red/ 2. sngon rjes kyi lnga ma/ dus rabs sngon ma/ mi rabs sngon ma/

bsdus brjod kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sdud byed dpe la sngon med pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i khyad gzhi bkod pa des, de dang chos mtshungs pa'i bsdu bya dpe can sngon med cig bsdus te brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /
spyir nam mkha'i mdog sngon po dang mtshungs shing bye brag mo rigs la sbyor ba'i kha dog gi khyad par zhig / gnam sngon mo/ chu sngon mo/ spang sngon mo/ rta rgod ma sngon mo/ mo drel sngon mo/
sngo spyi bzhur gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig nus pas lhog pa la phan/
sngon tshud nas brgyab pa'i gdeng tshod dam, bting ba'i rtsis gzhi/
dus tshod phyi ma drags pa'am sngon tsam/ bsam blo'i gra sgrig sngon tshud nas byas pa/ dgos nges kyi mthun rkyen sngon tshud du bskrun pa/
ma byung gong nas dpags pa'i tshod/
snga ma nang ltar/ yul thang sngon bzhin du gnas pa/ 'gro lugs sngon bzhin/
sngar nas yod pa/ sgrig lam sngon yod rang 'jags bzhag pa/
snga rol lam sngon du/ sngon rol nas grabs gshom byed pa/
tshe rabs sngon mar bsags pa'i las/ sngon las kyi 'phags pa/
snga rol/ 'thab 'dzing bya rgyu'i sngon logs nas dmag sa btsan po 'tshol ba/
rjes su yong rgyu'i gnas tshul sngon nas shes pa/ khe gyong gang yong sngon shes kyi sgo nas nyo tshong byed thub na tshong pa tshang ma phyug po chags yong/
drang bden gyi don du shi ba'i dpa' bo grags can/
sngar nas bsgrubs pa dang spungs pa/
1) dngos gzhir ma slebs gong nas byed pa'i gra sgrig / 2) sna 'dren/
gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa la rgyun du zhugs nas lus ngag mi sdom pa ste shan pa dang 'jud mthun ma sogs kyi bya ngan dang 'brel ba'i rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs/
g.ya' kyi ma, stong zil, gangga chung, hong len, tig ta, bong dkar, spang rtsi do bo bcas bdun/
yid kyi bgrang bsher byed pa'i don du go ba'i sngo ba'i skul tshig
rngan pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
1) sla nga sogs su rngo ba'i don du go ba'i rngod pa'i ma 'ongs pa 2) 'drid pa'am slu ba'i don du go ba'i rngod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
rngon pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
rngo ba dang rngod pa'i 'das pa,

1. (tha dad pa) bstod pa'am yon tan brjod pa/ spyi tshod ring lugs kyi mes rgyal la bsngags pa/ ngo mtshar can gyi byas rjes la bsngad pa/ 2. bstod ra/ las don bzang po la bsngags pa brjod pa/ mes po'i rgyal khab kyi ngo mtshar rlabs chen smos pa'i sgo nas bsngags pa rjod par byed/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi gnas lugs khyad 'phags ston phyir, mtshon byed dpe la bstod ra btang ba'i sgo nas dpe don phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig /
rgya skad la ja chin zhes pa don 'gyur byas na bsngags smon te, ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me 'brug lo nas rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags 'brug lo bar khrir bzhugs/
bstod ra dang skyo gdung sems khral bya yul/ dmag 'khrug tsha po bsngags 'os skyo 'os shig brgyab song/
ngo grangs tshang ma tshang grangs bsher ba'i tshul/ mi grangs bsngo bgrang byed pa/ ra lug ngo grangs gang yod nyin ltar bsngo bgrang byas pa/
1) gshin po'i ched du bsngo smon zhu rgyu'i 'bul rten/ 2) sngar zhing bran gyi khyim du mi shi tshe gshin po'i rna rgyan nam, de'i tshab dod gang rung mnga' bdag la sprod dgos pa'i khral zhig /

1. sngo ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. yongs su bsgyur ba'am, yongs su spel ba la 'jug pa ste, 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur ba'i dge rtsa rnams byang chub chen po'i rgyur bsgyur ba'am, 'dzad par 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa rnams mi zad par spel ba'i don yin la, rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i zag bcas zag med kyi dge tshogs mtha' dag bla na med pa'i byang chug kyi rgyur bsgyur spel byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig gzhan don du dge ba byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa'o ..
bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi bsdus ming/
dngos su bsngogs pa'i zhib bsher/
bsgyur ba'i spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, khyim pas dge 'dun nam dge slong gzhan la bsngos pa'i yo byad rang nyid la bsgyur ba ste bdag tu bzung ba'o/
mi zhig gi ched du dmigs te bsad pa'i nor lug sogs kyi sha/

bod yig gsal byed lnga pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba rkan lcer phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra med/ 1) ming gzhi'i pho yig cig / 2) ming mtha' la 'jug tshe skabs 'gar gsal byed cha dang 'dra ba/ cha...brag ca/ lag ca/ mtshon ca/ rgyan ca/
(yul) bdag sprod dam gces spras/ gzugs po la ca ga byed pa/ lde mig la ca ga byed/ dngos po rtsa chen por ca ga byed/ sku gzugs la thugs cag gnang rogs/
(yul) gces spras chen po'am gces spras gzab po/ yo byad la ca ga dag po ma byas na 'phro brlag phyin yong/

bcu cha dgu'am brgya cha dgu bcu/ de ring yong dgos mkhan gras nas mi grangs ca dgu slebs 'dug / ca co, 1) ca le co le'i bsdus tshig 2) mi mang tshogs pa'i 'ur sgra/ 'di gar ca co nyung/ ngan shags kha rtsod rgyag pa'i ca co che ba/ nye skor zhig nas glo bur du mi mang gis ca co sgrog pa/ 3) bzhad gad snying tshim gyi ca co/ yid la ngo mtshar rgya cher gyur te aa la la zhes ca co dang, gad mo'i sgra chen po byung ba/
1) skad cha'i sgra gsal po min par sgrog pa/ 2) (mngon) phug ron/
1) ku co'i sgra sgrog mkhan/ 2) (mngon) chang/
sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams gdul bya rnams kyis nam yang nges pa rnyed thub pa/
phar tshur skad cha mang pos rtsod pa/ mi mang po 'tshogs nas ca co lab gleng byed pa/ ca co lab gleng mang stabs bsam 'char gcig mthun byung ma song/
bod yig gsal byed kyi sde pa gnyis pa ste ca cha ja nya/ ca cha ja nya
ka kha'i rim pa ltar bsgrigs pa'i lnga pa mtshon byed/ po ti ca pa/
nor rdzas longs spyod/ ca 'byid, (rnying) gcig la ltos nas cig shos spong ba'am 'dor ba/ mdo sngags phan tshun ca 'byid min/
(yul) mgo rnyog ste, yid sun pa/ don med rna lcog sun po yang yang byed pa 'di 'dra ca ma zing/
(yul) mgo rnyog po/ ca zing dgu zing/ bya dka' byed gtad che ba'i las ka 'di ca zing po zhig 'dug /
dpung 'dzum g.yas nas g.yon bar thig gis sbrel ba'i dkyil du kong gshong zhig 'byung ba de'o/
sgra'i bye brag pa zhig / skya ka'i skad ca ra ra grag /
mdo khams kyi yul gru 'gar ca dang ja gnyis kyi sgra gdangs gcig tu 'bod pas khyad par 'byed byed kyi tshig / ca...ca ja...ca...ca...ja...ja...

1) dus rgyun du'am nar ma/ dus re 'ga' tsam min par rnam pa kun tu ca rer 'bad dgos/ bsam 'char ca rer shod res byed pa/ dogs zon ca rer byed pa/ 2) khra lam mer shar ba/ rtogs pa'i 'char sgo ca rer shar/
nyung tsam mam tha re tho re/ nor 'khrul ca re nya re phog pa/
'brel med gang byung gi gtam sna tshogs smra tshul/ skad cha ca le co les nyi ma 'phul/

don med gang byung bshad tshul/ snying po med pa'i gtam ca le ba mang po zhig shod kyin 'dug / chang gis bzi nas gtam ca le ba shod pa/ cag 1) tsho dang rnams kyi don/ bdag cag / kho bo cag / kho cag / khyed cag / 2) (yul) ca ga'i bsdus tshig
(yul) kun nam thams cad/ zhing ga tshang ma lo 'bras kyis cag ge khengs 'dug / tshong zog rnams cag ge tshang ba/
sgra'i khyad par zhig / zas za dus kha nas cag cag gi sgra sgrog pa
nges nges po'am brtan brtan po/ dad pa cag cag po/ bsam pa cag cag po/ 'gyur ldog med pa'i sems shugs cag cag po/ las ka gang brtsams 'gyur ldog med pa cag cag po zhig dgos/
gces spras thon po/ phyi nang gi dngos rigs bor stor med pa'i cag thon byed pa/
gces spras bag zon/ me rkun sogs kyi gnod skyon mi yong ba'i cag zon byed pa/

1.bon po'i rol cha gshang/ 2.ci'ang gi bsdus tshig / sdug bsngal cang med pa/ sgra skad cang mi grag pa/ yul srol lam lugs kyi cha rgyus cang med/ yang yang dris kyang cang mi smra bar kha rog sdod pa/ kha nas cang mi smra yang, don du dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston gyin 'dug /
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shan rtsa rdzong gi dbus rgyud du yod, de'i chu 'go rdzong 'di'i shar rgyud na yod cing nub ngos su brgyugs te g.yi sbug tshwa kha'i nang du 'bab/
: (rnying) rgyang thag ring tsam byas nas sdod pa/
(yul) bro ba med pa dang, 'khrug po med pa/ lto chas cang cang zhig las mi 'dug / grogs po rnams phyin nas nga tsho cang cang zhig tu gyur song/
rol mo'i bye brag gshang dang dril bu chen po gnyis/
lha'i phyag mtshan da ma ru'i bye brag dpangs mtho la ngos gnyis kyi pags pa'i bar skud pas phan tshun sbrel ba zhig
1) ci'ang shes pa'i bsdus tshig ste gang yang shes pa/ rta cang shes/ cang shes rta pho/ skyes bu cang shes/ 2) mngon shes/
1) ci yang srid/ 2) ae srid/ sngar gyi grogs po dgrar 'dzin pa cang srid dam/
(rnying) dam por 'jus pa/ dpyang thag la cangs kyis 'jus pas bde bar thar byung/

1.drung dang 'khris dang phyogs/ kho'i can du 'gro ba/ nga can du ma yong/ khyed can/ 2.gang la yod pa'i gzhi ston byed dang, bdag sgra gsal byed tsam gyi tshig phrad cig / mig can/ rgyu can/ sems can/ yon tan can/ blo gros can/ deng rabs can/
shing las bzos pa'i phor pa ste btung snod dam, bza' snod/ lag na can ne thang ma zhig thogs 'dug /

1) zas bza' ba'i sgra/ ro bcud cab cab myong ba/ 2) lag pa brdabs pa'i sgra/ lag pas cab cab kyi sgra bsgrags te go brda sprod pa/ cab cob, cab cab dang 'dra, cam, 1.dal bu dang lhod po/ tshab tshub med par bya ba cam gyis byed/ las mjug bsdu rgyu gang yod cam gyis zin pa/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i g.yeng ba spangs nas gnas gcig tu cam sdod byed pa/ 2.(yul) rbad de'am rtsa ba nas/ sngar gyi lugs srol ngan pa rnams cam bzhag byed pa/ las ka 'di cam gyis 'jog dgos/
'cham 'cham/ phar tshur cam cam du phyin na gzugs por phan thogs yong/

1) dal po'am brel ba med pa/ mgo rnyog gi las ka tshang ma cam me ba la bsgrubs zin pa yin/ 2) ling ste'am rbad de/ yong 'bab gang yod ci yod cam me bar bsdus zin/ rang sa rang gnas su cam me bar zhog /
gcig rjes gnyis mthud:/ nyes pa car rgyag nyar rgyag byung/
rgyun mthud pa'am mu mthud pa/ gtam car mar bshad/
rlon pa'i rnam 'gyur/ rtag par rlon car re 'dug /
shing sogs chur lhung ba'i sgra'i khyad par zhig /
chur shing sogs lhung na cal zer ba'i sgra/
ba'i sgra sgrog pa ste: gtam khungs med gzhan la bshad de dkrog pa/
cal le col le'i bsdus tshig
shing sogs chur lhung ba'i cal sgra la 'drogs nas bros pa/ ri bong cal 'drogs/
bab col lam, mi brtan pa'am, gtam nyog gam, 'brel med don med kyi skad cha shod tshul/ gtam cal le col le mang po bshad pa/ smyon pa'i skad cha rnams don med cal col du gyur pa las med/
'khyog po'am kyog kyog / blo cas cus byed pa/ smyug ma cas cus kyis mda' mi yong/

/ 1) dri tshig 'dri ba dang, rtsod pa 'dzugs pa la 'jug pa'i spyi sgra zhig / de ci yin/ lta ci smos/ smos ci dgos/ khyed kyis yon tan gang dang ci shes/ ci bshad la ma nyan, ci las la brtag dgos/ sha tsha snying gtam bshad par ko long gi gtam smra ba ci zer/ las ka ha ri hu ri byas na ci yong/ skad cha rdzig rdzig bshad pa ci mtshar/ 'gro ba mi skyob na snying rje bsgoms kyang ci la phan/ 2) yongs su khyab pa'i spyi sgra zhig / dbang cha ci mchis pa/ ci yod do 'tshal/ sems la ci snyam/ gtam ci smos pa/ dka' las cir yang mi rtsi ba/ las don ci bde bar bya ba/ grub 'bras ci 'dod pa bzhin du thob pa/ rang 'dod ci dgar byas mi chog / 3) brtag cing dpyad pa'i bye brag la 'jug pa'i spyi sgra zhig / gang thub ci thub kyis rogs ram byed pa/ ci thub thub gyis/ mgyogs thabs ci nus kyis las ka byas pa/ mi dmangs kyi phugs don la phan thogs ci 'gro byed pa/
gang khug gi rin 'bab sprod 'jal/ spus nyos kyi dngos por yul thang ci khug rin 'jal drang 'brel byas pa/
(rnying) de skad/ ci ga ci yin nam/
gang 'dra' ci 'dra/ dgos dus med le ci go red/
gang yod dam thams cad/ dngos po ci dgu tshang ma/ nus shugs ci dgu/ bya spyod ci dgu/ bya 'os ci dgu/
kha la nyan pa/ btang 'gro bzhag sdod ci bgyi bka' nyan byed pa/
spyi la khyab pa'i tshig phrad ci ni, zhig ste slad 'dra phyir bcas kyi sngon du 'jug / zhig ste slad 'dra phyir...ci zhig / ci ste/ ci slad/ ci 'dra/ ci phyir/
cha mi 'tshal te nges brtan med pa/ smyon pa'i kha la ci cha yod/ re 'bras 'grub min ci cha/ yong dang mi yong ci cha/
gang 'dra chog / bya ba ci chog dang mi chog gsal po shes dgos
thams cad dam gang yod pa/
1) gang bsams pa/ da lta khyod kyi sems la ci snyam ngas zur tsam shes/ 2) gang yin nam snyam pa/ rgyu mtshan med par 'tshig pa za ba ci snyam/
ji 'dra ba de bzhin nam, de nang bzhin/ ci lta ba bzhin du snyan seng zhu ba/
ji lta bu'am 'dra ba/ gnas lugs ci lta bu zhig /
1) gal te'am gal srid/ ci ste dka' ngal che yang hur brtson byed dgos/ ci ste slob sbyong ma byas na rjes lus thebs yong/ 2) ci'i phyir/ bkur bar bya ba ni pha ma yin gyi, bu ci ste yin/
1) ngo tsha khrel med/ 2) ham pa tsha po/ 3) rmongs rmongs tshod tshod/
gang byung byung/ gtam ci thod thod du bshad na mi mdzes/
1) gang drag gam gang bzang / de 'dra'i grang ngar che bas ci drag / dbugs 'chad la khad du gyur 'dug pas ci drag / 2) yag shos sam bzang shos/ 'bad brtson gang drag ci drag byas pa/
gang 'dod 'dod/ skyed tshal nang du dga' dga' spro spro ci 'dod gang 'dod byed pa/
gang dang mtshungs pa'am, gang zhig dang 'dra ba/ sman 'di ci 'dra byas te 'thung dgos/ don ci 'dra/ gtam ci 'dra/ thabs ci 'dra zhig red/ las ci 'dra byas pa la 'bras bu de 'dra ba 'thob pa/
(rnying) cis kyang ngam nges par du/
nges par ram gang nas kyang/ khyod ci nas kyang yong dgos/ sang nyin ci nas kyang legs sgrub thub thabs byed dgos/
(yul) gang dran shod res byed pa/ mched grogs 'jal nas phan tshun ci 'phros mol 'phros shod pa/
ci bya gtol med dang don gcig
bya thabs bral ba/ las brel sne 'doms kyis ci bya gtol med la thug pa/ the tshom gyi dra bar tshud de ci bya gtol med du bsdad yod/ bya dka' byed gtad che bas ci bya gtol bral du gyar ba/
1) rang gar/ da ci ma yin la sdod dgos med/ 2) (yul) sna tshogs sam gang 'dod kyi bya spyod/ tshong ci ma yin zhig ma rgyag / las don de ci ma yin du ma 'jog /

de 'dra byung na dga' ba la snyam pa'i smon tshig / mi thams cad la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung na ci ma rung/ re ba mtha' dag lag len du 'khyol na ci ma rung/ bdag byang chub thob na ci ma rung/
de 'dra byung na chog aang snyam pa'i smon tshig / than pa byung bas car pa chen po zhig babs na ci mi chog /
ci yang mi bsam pa/ dbul po'i sdug bsngal ci mi snyam du ma bzhag par bsal bar bya/
ci zhig mi 'dra'am 'dra ba'i don/ khong rgyal po bzhugs dang ci mi 'dra/
de las legs pa gang med/ gnya' gnon 'og tu sdod mkhan mi dmangs tshang ma bcings bkrol thob na ci mi legs
ci yang med pa'am gang yang med pa/ don dag ci med cang med kyi skad cha shod mi dgos/
ga tshod dam ji tsam/ 'di nas lam thag ci tsam song na rgya mtsho'i 'gram du slebs yong/ khyod kyis ci tsam za thub pa de tsam du bzas na 'grig /
/ bdag cag rnams ci tsug byed/
(rgya) 'bru'i bye brag tsi tsi zer ba/
gang 'dra zhig / mi ci zhig / rgyu mtshan ci zhig / dgos pa ci zhig yod/ don snying ci zhig yin/ las ka ci zhig bya/
1) ji ltar ram gang ltar/ 2) (rnying) bsgrub dka' ba 'bad rtsol med par 'grub pa/
ci rigs sam ci rung/ mi bsrun blun la ci 'os sbyar/
gang yang/ go ci yang mi chod pa/ brtag dpyad byas kyang nyes skyon ci yang med pa/ thams cad shes mkhan gyi mi med la, ci yang mi shes mkhan gyi mi'ang med/
chos thams cad nam mkha' mtha' yas pa ltar stong pa yin pa/ ci yang med pa'i 'du shes/
ci yang med pa'i skye mched

gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i nang gses, chos thams cad dang de la dmigs pa'i rnam par shes pa yang mtha' yas na, der ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan ci yod ces brtags na ci yang yod par ma mthong nas ci yang med do snyam du sems pa'i sa'o/
ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi rnam thar

gzugs med rnam thar bzhi'i nang gses, rnam shes las gzhan dmigs par bya ba'i gzugs can dang gzugs med pa'i chos cung zad kyang yod par ma mthong nas ci yang med do snyam du snyoms par zhugs pa ste, ci yang med pa'i skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa'o/ ci yang med pa'i snyoms 'jug gzugs med snyoms 'jug bzhi'i ya gyal ci yang med pa'i skye mched la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
drag gang drag ces yi mug pa'i tshig / mi des spyod ngan 'di 'dra byas 'dug pa ci rang drag / rkyen ngan byung ba ci rang drag /

1) sna tshogs/ shes yon ci rigs pa/ drag chas ci rigs pa/ skad cha snyan po ci rigs par bshad pa/ 2) gang yang rung ba/ che chung ci rigs pa/ tsha grang ci rigs pa/ gong bzhin ci rigs par sbyor ba/ gong 'og gi tshig shugs la brten nas ci rigs par rigs pa/
(rnying) rgyu mtshan nam dgos pa gang gi phyir/
ji ltar gsungs pa de ltar sgrub pa/ rim pa gong ma'i ci gsung bka' sgrub zhu ba/
bka' gnang tshad tshul bzhin nyan pa/ slob phrug tshos dge rgan gyis ci gsung nyan pa/
bka' gang gnang ba rnams yi rang gis khas len byed pa/ dbu khrid kyi las bkod ci gsung dang len byed pa/ bgres pos ci gsung dang du len/

1.rjes 'jug ga da ba dang da drag gi mthar sbyar rgyu'i nges med kyi dngos po re re ba ston byed kyi tshig grogs phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / ga da ba...da...dge phrug cig / rgyal khab cig / cung zad cig / 2.skul tshig ston byed kyi tshig grogs shig / lag tu zhog cig / mar sdod cig / me mda' rgyob cig / yo byad skrund cig / lag 'khor skord cig / ja skold cig /

lhan cig gam dus mnyam/ nyi ma shar ba dang cig car du mun pa yal ba/ dran yul nang la sngar gyi gnas tshul mang po cig car du dran pa/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten cig car chags la cig car 'jig pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin/ dus mnyam du btab pa'i lo tog rnams cig car skye ba red/
gcig po'am phyogs gnyis su bzung ba'i ya gcig / mkhas pa'i cig shos ni blun po'o/

ga da ba da drag bcas kyi mthar sbyar rgyu'i mtshams sbyor tshig phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / ga da ba...da drag / dud cing 'gro ba/ skad cha bshad cing lag brda gtong ba/ shing khar 'dzeg cing me tog 'thog pa/
gang gi ched dam gang gi don du/ ci'i phyir bstan, ci'i phyir ma bstan/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir khong khro byed/ nga ci'i phyir yong mi chog /
ci'i phyir ram gang gi ched/ khyod ci'i slad du 'ong ba yin/
gang 'dra zhig tu 'gyur mi shes pa/
'bu sogs srog chags chung ngus sgrog pa'i sgra'i khyad par zhig / ston dus 'bu srin rnams kyis cir cir zhes sgra sgrog pa/
cil li cil li'i bsdus tshig
khang byi'u dang, co ga'i skad 'byin stangs/ cil cil sgra yis rna ba'i tsher ma byed/ cil li cil li'i sgra mtshams mi 'chad par grag pa ci zhig yin/
1) ci nas kyang ngam nges par du/ khyed kyi thugs la cis kyang 'jog dgos/ 2) ci yis kyang ngam gang gis kyang/ thabs shes cis kyang go mi chod pa/
ci yis mi 'dra zhes rgyu mtshan dri ba'i tshig / gnam lcags thog dang cis mi 'dra/
rjes 'jug yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming mthar bcu zhes pa'i tshab tu 'gro ba/ bcu...bcu...sum cu/ drug cu/ bdun cu/ brgyad cu/

(rgya) smyug bcud de rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes bsil la snyoms, nus pas glo tshad dang, rma tshad, tshad pa rus la zhen pa, rims nad rmong bu bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la smyig ma dang, rtsi 'jam, bam sha ro tsa na bcas so,
shing tog cig gi ming ste, de'i sdong por me tog dri zhim dang kha dog dkar po'am dmar skya sogs yod, shing tog ro skyur ba zhig yin, yul skad la lar co le dang, rgya skad du me tsi zer/

chung ngu'am, nyung ngu/ de 'dra byas na cung mi 'grig / las stangs la brtag dpyad gzab gzab ma byas pas cung 'khrul ba byung 'dug / 'ur rdo phog pa'i byi'u'i snying ga da dung cung 'gul gyin 'dug / sang nyin zhogs pa de ring las cung snga ba phebs dgos, ..de ring thag ring nas brgyugs te yong ba yin pas rkang pa cung 'theng tsam byed kyin 'dug / rgyug pa 'di cung sbom drags pas 'khar ba bzo nyan pa mi 'dug / rtsa ba ma tshugs pa'i shing de cung kyog kyog byas 'dug / nad mda' phog nas cung ma gtogs shi ba la thug byung
phran bu zhig gam nyung shas shig / de ring brel ba cung zhig 'dug / khe phan cung zhig / nor 'khrul cung zhig yod/ 'tsho chas ngan ngon cung zhig / dus yun cung zhig ring drags pa/

tshad chung chung ngam, tog tsam, phran bu/ cung zad sgugs dang mnyam du 'gro/ dga' nas cung zad dgod pa/ skad cha'i tshig nad ma theg par cung zad khro ba/ de ring glo bur du cung zad mi bde ba zhig byung/ mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa/ sems cung zad gtad pa tsam/ spyi'i nor rdzas cung zad kyang chud zos su ma gtong/
cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal
rang las mchog tu gyur pa la dmigs nas, 'di las bdag cung zad dman tsam mo snyam du khengs pa'o/
cung zad phrad pa'i rtsol ba
yi ge'i skye gnas rnams thug phrad lhod por byas nas sgra 'don pa'i rtsol ba/
nyung shas tsam mam phran bu tsam/ rkyen cung zad tsam gyis 'gyur ldog 'byung ba/
sngar bod kyi lha mo ba'i tshogs pa thog mar dar sa ngam ring rdzong du yod/
(rgya) shog sgril tha mag 'then byed dang, gang zag 'then byed 'jib kha/

zer na'am bshad na ste ga da ba dang da drag bcas kyi mthar sbyar nas rgyu rkyen ston byed dam dri bas mtshams sbyor byed kyi phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / ga da ba...da drag / yong mkhan 'dug gam mi 'dug ce na/ da dung yod dam med ce na/
khyi spyang/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan g.yo ma dang, ba lang 'tshe, mtshan mo'i ri dwags, wa skyes, ri dwags khram pa, sa myos, slu byed bcas so,
rlung khrag pus mor babs pa'i nad de, nad rtags su ngar gdong nas gnyan gong sbal nag gi bar ce spyang gi mgo bo ltar skrangs pa zhig /

rgya gar du ce spyang zhes pa'i gcan gzan zhig yod pa de ce spyang nas ce spyang gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa'i skye ba lnga pa na rwa skyes pa de nor bu yin par bshad, nus pas nor phyugs kyi nad rnams srung/
mig gdangs te mi g.yo bar lta ba'i khyad par zhig / mig thad kar ce re lta ba/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas cung zhig bdag la spyan ce re gzigs kyin 'dug /
lta ba ltar snang yang mi mthong ba ste ha re long ba/
zer ro'am, bshad do ste, ga da ba dang, da drag bcas kyi mthar sbyar nas tshig mtshams ston byed kyi phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / ga da ba...da drag / chu klung thams cad kyi 'go gangs rir thug ce'o/
'bur tshugs su lta ba/ aa mas gces phrug gi gdong la mig cer lta ba/

ga da ba dang, da drag bcas kyi mthar sbyar nas tshig gzhan 'dren byed kyi phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / ga da ba/ da drag / deng sang gi skad cha snyan po 'dug ces brjod pa go byung/ shes rab ces pa de gang nas 'ong ba yin nam/ lo tog gam lo thog ces kyang bya, lo tog / lo thog
ces zer ba/ mdo sde za ma tog ces bya ba/ bod ces bya ba gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs/
byi'u co ga'ang zer zhing, spu mdog skya zhing sre bo, byi'u mchil pa las cung zad che zhing skad snyan sna tshogs 'byin pa, gnam la thad kar 'phur nas sa la thad kar 'bab pa'i byi'u zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs 'bu su hang ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma 'drub, glo tshad sel;...
(rnying) mi'i mgo spu'am skra/ co to 'bal zhing cho nge 'don/
ku co'i sgra dir ba'am 'ur dir re ba/
1) 'gran zla byed pa'am mtho 'tshams pa/ 2) dma' 'bebs pa'am gnod pa skyel ba/ 3) nyams sad pa/ 4) mtshungs gsal gyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/
rdzong zhig kan su'u zhing chen khongs kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus dang klu chu'i stod rgyud du yod/

'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bka' ltar sa skya ba'i bla ma zhig gis rab byung lnga pa'i shing lug lor da lta kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong du btab pa'i sa skya'i dgon chen zhig ste, rab byung brgyad pa'i sa yos lor chos rje rin chen lhun pos dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta lor co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyis der mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs shing, sa bya lor rgyud grwa btsugs, bar skabs shig la bka' bstan 'gyur gyi dpar shing cha tshang ba zhig bzhengs yod/

dkar chag bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i dgongs: 'grel bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba zhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sbrul lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos mdzad pa'o
ze dang rnga ma bregs ma thag pa'i lo gnyis lon pa'i rte'u/
1) 'thung ba'am rngub pa'am blug pa'i sgra/ 2) chang skyur mo/ 3) ro skyur mo/
1) tho re ba'am phra mo/ nyes pa co le ba tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa/ 2) cu li dang 'dra/
mthar sbyar nas tshang ma dang mtha' dag gi: don ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / rdzogs tshig / yin no cog / skyes so cog / rgyu nor yod do cog / rgya dpe bod yig tu bsgyur to cog /
mi gcig sdod sa'i gur chung ngu/
tsog tsog / ri bong cog ger bsdad 'dug /
tsog tsog / khang pa cog cog steng du dar chen zhig btsugs
lo tog la gnod pa'i srin 'bu zhig lus ljang la mgo smug po, spu rwa thung thung can 'bras kyi lo ma za zhing thag ring la 'phur mi thub pa zhig yin/
1.mi gcig sdod sa'i ras gur chung chung/ ras dkar gyi cog pu/ 2.cog po dang 'dra,
1) gur chung ngu'i nang du sdod mkhan/ 2) gzhan la ma brten par tsog por sdod pa po/
tsog po'am tsog pu/ brag cog po zhig / ri bong bzhin du cog por sdod/ gcig pu cog por sdod pa/
(rgya) phor pa sogs 'jog stegs ring po'am gru bzhi,/ rgya cog /

dus rabs brgyad par khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su ska cog zhang gsum gyi ya gyal lo tsa ba zhig yin zhing, khong gis dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi rgya chen 'grel ba bam po bzhi bcu dang, nges pa'i don dbu ma, sher phyin mdor bsdus, chos gtan la dbab pa'i gal sogs bsgyur/
sngar bod du dar ba'i bon gyi grub mtha' zhig /
mtshal rigs shig ste, rtsa dkar gyi nad dang, rus pa chag pa, reg dug bse mog dug nad bcas la phan/
(rgya) dril bu chen po zhig / cong che chung/ cong gi sgra dbyangs lhang nger sgrog pa/

rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bcud la dro, rus chag gso, mkhal nad dang skrangs pa sel, ro tsa, sha mdangs rgyas, bad kan smug po 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la gcong nad gcig thub dang, rdo bcud, rdo'i da byid, rdo'i dwangs ma, rdo'i tshil bu, tshil bu dar ya kan, mtshan mo'i 'od can, zla ba'i bu, rus pa'i gsos, srid pa'i khams, srid pa'i byang sems, lha bu'i khams bcas so,
cong zhi sran ma tsam bzos nas me thub kyi rdza ma'i 'phrul kong nang blugs shing du ba ma shor bar kha bkag pa'i nus bsregs thal ba la zer te, nus pas bad kan skya smug dang, skran sogs 'joms/
pho cong dang, mo cong, bu cong, bu mo cong, ma ning cong zhi bcas lnga/

g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos mdzad pa'i phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud nang 'khod pa'i cong zhi gtso bor byas pa'i sman sbyor zhig ste, nus pas dug nad dang, bad kan smug po, gab tshad, tshad pa rnying pa sogs la phan/
'og tu gcong rong zab mo yod pa'i g.yang sa/

1) dbu rgyan/ rgyal po'i cod pan/ ming gi rnam grangs la dpung rgyud dang, dbu rgyan, rtse phran, rtse gsum mgo can, zla ba can bcas so, 2) rna ba'i gong rgyan/ 3) longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rigs lnga prog zhu/ dbang rdzas cod pan/
lha mo tshe ring mched lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi gong rgyan gos chen gyis bzos pa'i dar 'dzar/
dpangs dma' zhing smad sbom pa'i dbyibs/ snod zhabs col/ mi gsus col/
byab chung ngam klad chung dang, blo chung/ mi col chung gi gtam la nges pa med/
snying don med pa'am cho med pa'i gtam/
1.klad chung dang, byab med pa'i mi/ col po'i gtam nas snying po mi thon/ 2.cho med pa/ skad cha col po byas nas nyi ma 'phul/
ling nge dang zing nge/ spang gshongs 'di na brag ri nag po mang po col le 'dug /
snyad brko ba'i gtam/ bla ma gzhan gyis drag 'dul byas pas gdon des tshur col lo dang bzhad gad sun 'byin byas nas phan pa ma byung/
gcog pa dang 'chag pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
lus res bde res mi bde ba'i snang tshul/ nga'i gzugs po bde thang med pa'i gcang nge gcong nge kho na red/
gcang nge gcong nge'i bsdus tshig
ngag sgo yangs pa'am, kha 'jam smra mkhas/ mgron po gnas bdag gcang po 'dzoms na blo bag phebs po yong/
'gag lam mam lam gu dog po/
rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi byang rgyud dang rma chu'i lho 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de ma gi thang du yod/
mche sder yod cing sha za ba'i rigs/ nags tshal stug po'i khrod du rgyu ba'i gcan gzan gtum po stag yin/ gcan gzan gyis rang rgyud mi za/
bcos ma'i ngo bstod/ gcam bstod smras pa/ gcam bstod sgrog pa/

1.gtam bcos ma'am bcos ma'i ngo bstod/ khyed la gcam bu'i ngo bstod zhus pa min/ 2.bcos ma'am zol sbyor ram rdzun ma/ gtam gcam bu/ tshig gcam bu bshad de gzhan la mgo skor gtong mkhan tsho nam zhig la rdzun rkub brdol yong/
drang po mi byed mkhan nam zol sbyor mkhan/
rdzun tshig bcos ma'i kha gsag /
1.sa ngos su rdo shing sogs snyoms por bsgrigs pa'i gzhi/ rdo gcal/ pang gcal/ aar gcal/ 2.khod snyoms dang chal ma/ me tog gcal du bkram pa/
1.(tha dad pa) gcis pa, gci ba, gcis, ,gcin pa gtong ba/ gcin pa gang byung sar ma gci/ 2.gcin pa/ bshang gci 'gags pa/

1.yongs rdzogs dang ril po/ mi tshe gcig / byed na byed gcig / rgyag na rgyag gcig / blo gcig sems gcig / mtha' gcig tu legs pa/ gcig tu cha mi mthun pa/ 2.bya tshig gi sngon du sbyar nas de'i lan gcig gam thengs gcig gi don du 'jug pa'i phrad cig / khyod kyis gcig shod dang/ nga la gcig ston dang/ kho la gcig bltas nas phyin song/ rgyug pas gcig brgyab nas bsad pa/ gcig 'gro rtsis yod/ 3. grangs kyi gcig ste, grangs ka ril po'i nyung mtha'/ nad brgya sman gcig / tshig brgya don gcig / gcig la gcig brten/ mang gi rnam grangs la zla ba dang, gzugs, 'od dkar can, ri bong can, bse ru bcas so,
gcig ni/ mang tshogs gras kyi mi gcig ka/
gcig pu rkyang rkyang ngam zla med chig rkyang/ mi tshang gcig rkyang/ zhing las gcig rkyang/ rang nyid kho na bde 'dod kyi bsam blo gcig rkyang gtong ba/
gcig la gcig gis phan gnod kyi rkyen byed pa/
dbang lag chig skyes dbang lag dang 'dra

ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don gnyis ka la thun mong du 'jug rung gi yon tan sgo nas mtshungs kyang, khyad chos gcig gis 'dra ba las ldog ste mi mtshungs pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gcig gis bcu'i go chod pa/
gcig gis gnyis kyi go chod pa/
khag khag ma yin par gyur pa/ gong bu gcig gyur/ blo rtse gcig gyur/ ngos 'dzin gcig gyur/
gcig la gcig gis phan pa/

1) phyogs gcig tu sgril ba/ rdog rtsa gcig sgril/ stobs shugs mtha' dag gcig sgril byed pa/ 2) rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi shar lho'i ngos su yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de drug chen sum mdor yod/
gcig gis gcig la ngar slong ba/ phan tshun gcig ngar gcig slong byas pas las chod chen po byung song/
gcig pu zhig / nags tshal stug po'i khrod du mi gcig cig 'gro ba
nyung nyung dang, lhag chad nor gsum med pa gsal por ston pa/ gzhung khra nang gsal tshang ma gcig gcig gnyis gnyis su rtsis sprad yod/ deng sang gi gtam gsar gcig gcig gnyis gnyis su zhu ba/
las ka 'ga' zhig mi gcig gis chabs cig tu 'gan 'khur ba/ gcig lcogs dge rgan/ do dam gcig lcogs/ las 'gan gcig lcogs/
gis go mang po chod pa: rgyan gos gcig chog / gyon pa 'di nyid dro dang mdzes pa gcig chog red
sa gnas gcig la zhod 'jags dang sa gnas gzhan zhig la zing cha langs pa/
bar mi 'chad par mthud stangs/ grub 'bras gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis thob pa/ rgyal kha gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis blangs pa/ pham nyes gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung/
gcig pu'am de kho na rang/
kha shas sam 'ga' zhig / mi gcig gnyis/
phan tshun yid ches pa'am blo gtad pa/
1) skyon med mdzes pa sha stag / 2) byang chub sems dpa' zhig gi mtshan/
rnam pa rim brtsegs/ las khungs mang po gcig thog gnyis brtsegs su btsugs pa/ gnas tshul bzang po gcig thog gnyis brtsegs byung/
rigs gcig tu gzhi mthun pa/ bsam pa dang gros mol gcig mthun du gyur pa/
bral ba'i mtshan nyid: stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin te, spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid kyi nang gses shig /
gcig dang du ma ste, ngo bo gcig dang mang po/ gcig du gnyis su med pa/
gcig dang du ma gang rung du med pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa zhig /
gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs

gtan tshigs chen po lnga'i nang gses, chos rnams kyi ngo bo la dpyod pa, gcig dang du ma dang bral ba rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong pa nyid ston pa'i gtan tshigs te, myu gu lta bu'i chos kun chos can bden par med de bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du med pa'i phyir, zhes pa khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs so/
gcig du bral gyi dpyad pa
stong nyid sgrub byed kyi rigs pa zhig /
kha thor rnams phyogs gcig tu tshur sdud pa/ nus shugs gcig sdud/
bcu longs gong du sgril ba'i rtsis lugs kyi grangs gnas dang po

1.mthun pa dang, phan tshun mtshungs pa'am khyad med pa/ rin gong che chung gcig pa/ gnam gshis tsha grang gcig pa/ bsam blo gcig pa/ ro gcig pa/ kha gcig rung khog pa mi gcig sngas gcig rung rmi lam mi gcig / dge rgan gcig gi dge phrug pha ma gcig gi bu phrug / 2.so so ba ma yin pa'i chos te, rtog pa'i snang ngor tha dad du mi 'char ba ka ba lta bu/
gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad
rdzas rgyun gcig yin kyang dus la ltos pas 'das ma 'ongs tha dad pas gcig yin na cig shos yin pa 'gal ba, dper na, bum pa gcig gi skad cig snga phyi tha dad lta bu'o/
dbyer med pa/ mtshe ma de gnyis kyi ngo ris gcig pa gcig rkyang red/
gcig pa la dbye na, rang ldog gcig pa dang, ngo bo gcig pa, rigs gcig pa, rdzas gcig pa ste bzhi'o/

kher rkyang ngam, kho na'am, sha stag / rang gcig pu/ kho gcig pus dpe cha klog gin 'dug / nga gcig pur lus pa/ gcig pur gnas shing gcig pur rgyu ba/ gzhan la mi brten par gcig pur tshugs thub pa/ gcig pu dben pa na 'dug / grogs med gcig pu/ gcig pus ham 'dzin byed pa/ gcig pus btsan gcod byed pa/ brgya brgya'i nang nas nyung nyung yin, nyung nyung nang nas gcig pu yin/
/ 1) kher rkyang/ kho rang gcig por yong ba red/ 2) gzhan pa'am cig shos/ mi gcig po de yong mi 'dug / don gcig po de bsgrub dgos/
gcig gis gcig la phan rogs byed pa/ grong pa khyim mtshes chags sdang med par gcig phan gcig grogs byed pa/
gcig yar 'phar zhing gcig mar chag: pa/ khrom thang gcig 'phar gcig chag ci rigs yong/
rgyun bar ma chad du mthud pa/ las rgyun gcig 'phror gcig mthud byed pa,..
las ka gcig byas nas don dag gnyis 'grub pa/ thabs jus mkhas pas las don gcig byas gnyis grub byung ba red/
ma nges pa ston pa'i tshig cig / gcig byas na khong sang nyin yong gi yod 'gro/ khyod rang gis tshod cig ltos dang, gcig byas na 'khyer thub mdog kha po red/
yang yang/ chags sgo gcig min gnyis min byung song/
ltar na rnam dbye dang po de ga rang gcig: tshig yin
gcig pa nang bzhin/ dmigs yul gcig mtshungs/ gom stabs gcig mtshungs/
zla sgril te gong bu gcig tu 'dril ba/
phan tshun blo 'khel ba/ yun ring song mtshams su phan tshun gcig yid gcig ches byung song/
re gnyis te nyung ngu'i don/ mi ngan gcig re gnyis re/ 'gro thengs gcig re gnyis re las med/
kyi rab spel: rab spel gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig brjod 'dod kyi dngos po'i skabs thob sbyar nas bsre bya sre byed dam, spel bya spel byed gcig la gcig ltos kyi rgyan zhig /
gcig bshad gcig gis ma nyan par lan 'debs pa/
tshig re la tshig res lan slog pa/ sems bzang gis bshad pa'i bslab byar mi nyan par gcig lan gnyis lan bslogs pa/
tshig don gcig shes pas gzhan kun shugs kyis go ba/
lgang pa dang, rgyu grog gi gnas su rde'u 'phel ba sogs kyi rkyen byas nas gcin pa 'bab mi thub pa 'gags par gyur pa'i don/
rlan can yul du rgyun ring sdod pa dang bad tshil 'phel ba sogs kyis rkyen gyis rgyun ldan ltar ma yin pa gcin pa grangs mang du gtong dgos pa'am dbang med du shor ba'i don/
gcin dreg dri chu'i dreg pa
sman pas de gzhir bzung nas nad gzhi brtag dpyad byed sa zhig /
dri chu/ gcin pa bro ba/
/ gcin pa gtong dus gsang spyod dran/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyun 'bab dang, dri chu, mi bskyod pa, rab 'dzag bcas so,
gcin pa dbang med du 'chor ba/
dri chu rgyun ldan ltar gtong mi thub pa 'tshag dka' bar gyur pa/
bshang lam nang rma yod pa 'khrud byed kyi yo byad chu mda'/
(tha dad pa) 'tshir pa/ rdo gnyis bar du lag pa gcir/ ras rlon pa'i chu lag pas gcir bar bya/
kyog kyog gam 'khyog po/ shing gcu po/ lam gcu po/
(tha dad pa) gcus pa, gcu ba, gcus, sgrim pa/ gcus gzer gcu ba/ lus sha gcus pa/ gyon pa chur bkrus te gcus pa/
gcus te skyes pa'i shing gi 'dzer pa/
gyong po'am rang shed tsha po/ gcu ru tsha po'i mi/
mthun pa'am mdza' ba/ yid gcugs pa/ gcugs med byas pa/ phan tshun gting nas mthun zhing yid gcugs pa'i grogs po/
yid mthun gyi gtam shod pa/
pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i spun gzhon pa/ bu dang bu mo gcen gcung rnams/
ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gcung po dngos slob cig

sngar rgyal po zhig gi chen ma 'das 'og tu sras don grub zer ba lus pa de dang, chun ma'i sras don yod zer ba gnyis mdza' mthun chen po yod kyang, chun mas don yod la rgyal po'i go 'phang 'thob thabs byed ched don grub rgyang 'bud gtong dus gcen gcung gnyis 'bral ma phyod par mnyam du bros phyin pa'i lam bar dka' tshegs sna tshogs byung nas phan tshun kha 'thor phyis don grub rgyal khab gzhan zhig gi rgyal po'i mag par phyin nas rgyal po byas pa dang, rang gis gcung po don yod btsal te rnyed nas pha med kyi rgyal khab la bskyal pas yab rgyal shin tu mnyes bzhin pa'i ngang don yod kyang rang rgyal gyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba zhes ro sgrung las byung ba'i lo rgyus 'di dag pan chen blo bzang ye shes sogs mkhas pa rim byon dang, mi dmangs tshos rnam thar dang, lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung du bsgrigs yod/
pha ma gcig pa'i bu spun chung ba/
pha ma gcig pa'i bu mo spun chung ba/
(rnying) 1) do gal chen po'i gnad la bkar nas las 'gan sgrub tu bcug pa'am de'i sgo nas btul ba/ 2) gtan la phab pa/ 3) bdag gnyer mi byed pa/
'jun pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig dang ma 'ongs pa/

(tha dad pa) bcur ba, bcur ba, chur,, 1) bar du 'tshir ba/ mi mang po'i khrod du bcur ba/ gzer bu gcur gyis 'byin pa/ 2) ci bya gtol med du gtong ba/ khyim mtshes chu log gcur sar byed pa/ dka' ba'i gnas la gcur/ dgra dmag 'phrang la bcur nas thar thabs med par byas/ 3) 'jur ba'i ma 'ongs pa,
pas ma'i 'dab ma'i mu khyud lta bu'i thig /
gcus ris can gyi phur pa'am pho gcus kyi ming/
gcus ris can gyi gzer/ pho gcus/ mo gcus/
dung res ldan pa'i gzer te pho gcus dang mo gcus kyi spyi ming/
1) gcus gzer ltar gyi ri mo/ 2) grim rgyag pa'i ming/ lag pa gcus ris bskor ba/
sngar bod kyi rus chen zhig /
pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i spun rgyan pa/
(rnying) rtsa ba nas rgyab 'gal du song ba/
kha'i nang 'brum thor mang du skyes nas zug rngu 'byung ba'i kha nad kyi rigs shig /
pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu spun rgan pa/
pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu mo spun rgan pa/
(yul) srab po'am phra po/ phyu pa ha cang gcem po zhig gyon 'dug / khang pa 'di'i shing cha tshang ma shin tu gcem po zhig 'dug pas phugs 'pher yong ba mi 'dug /
/ 1) du ba rngub byed sbu gu ring po zhig / 2) lcags zangs sogs las bzos pa'i sbu gus sman bshang lam nas nang du 'phul bar byed pa'i yo byad kha yangs shing rtse mo dog pa'i sbubs can zhig /

grol lugs chen po bzhi'i nang gses, rang byung gi rig pa la tshogs brgyad kyi shes pa thams cad kyang yul yul can gnyis su med pa skad cig nyid la thog bab chen por rang bzhin gyis grol bas gcer grol zhes bya'o/
sgrib g.yogs med pa'am dmar rjen/ lus gcer bu,..rang gzugs gcer bur mngon pa/ mi ngan gyi nyes spyod gcer bur bton pa/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba rgyal ba pa'i ston pa zhig /

sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' zhig gcer bu la ngo tshar mi 'dzin pas 'dzem med pa dang thal ba pa, phyogs su ldom bu byed pas kun tu rgyu zhes grags so, 'dis 'dod pa'i tshig don dgu ni, srog zag pa, sdom pa, nges par rga ba, 'ching ba, las, sdig pa, bsod nams, thar pa rnams so, yang dus 'khor las, srog ldan dang, srog ldan ma yin pa, zag pa, sdom pa, spang ba, bcings pa, 'phar ba, 'gro ba, 'ong ba ste dgur 'dod par bshad do/
zas sbyin pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dgos pa khyad par can med par phyi rol pa la gtogs pa'i pho mo la zas ster ba/
1) gos med dmar hreng gi ming/ 2) gyon pa ma gyon pa'i bu mo
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig gi dka' thub spyod lugs shig /
mngon sum du 'dzin pa dang, dmar rjen du rtsi ba/ g.yo sgyu'i gtam drang gtam du gcer 'dzin ma byed/ gang bshad gcer 'dzin byed pa/
byams sems kyis skyong ba/ gces skyong gang legs/
mkho che ba'am legs shos snying po rnams bsgrugs pa/ dpe cha 'di gzhung gmang po nas gces btus byas pa yin/
gces pa'am snying po rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba ste rgyas pa nyung du bsdus pa/ legs bshad gces bsdus/
snying nor/ gces nor bdag nyar byed pa/
(tha dad pa) brtsi mthong ngam gtsigs chen po byed pa/ mi dmangs kyi rgyal khab la mi dmangs rang gis gces pa/ spyi rdzas la gces pa/ gzugs po'i bde thang la gces pa/
gal che ba'am gtsigs chen po/ spyi rdzas la gces po byed pa/
mthong chen nam ca ga dag po/ spyi rdzas la gces spras/ mdza' bshes la gces spras byed pa/ nor gyi snying por bzung nas gces spras byed pa/
rtsa ba chen po byed pa'i phru gu
pha mas gces skyong tshad med byed pa'i bu mo/
brtse dung gis 'bod ming bla dwags/
rtsa ba chen por rtse ba'am gtsigs chen po byed pa/ rang shed gces 'dzin byed pa/ mkhas pas mkhas pa gces par 'dzin, dpa' bos dpa' bo'i lar rgya shes/
gces drags nas chags pa'i ngan goms/ ha cang byams drags pas gces lang la shor ba/ phru gu gces lang la btang ba/
gces spras byas nas srung ba/

(tha dad pa) bcag pa, gcag pa, chog, 1) gsil ba/ dum bur bcag pa/ rdo gcog pa/ 2) mgo gnon pa/ sman chu btungs 'phral na tsha gcog / 3) chung du gtong ba/ tshong zog gi rin gong gcog pa/ sgo phyugs la rtswa bcag chu bcag byed mi rung / nyin mo'i zas bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid bcag / gla phogs thog nas zas rin bcag / 4) 'gal ba byed pa/ khas len dam bca' bcag pa/ khas blangs thebs gcog byed pa/
1) 'phri rtsis/ 2) zog gong mar gcog pa'i rtsis/
1. 1) bcos dka' ba'i nad/ gzugs por nad gcong phog pa/ glo gcong khog gcong/ 2) brag gam gad pa'i g.yang sa/ gcong rong/ gcong g.yang/ 2.gog hrul/ gog gcong/ gcong zom/

lus sam sems mi bde ba'i 'o dod dam sdug bsngal gyi skad/ ston dus tha mar ngang pas gcong skad 'byin/ re ba chad pas gcong skad shor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la cho nge mo dang, 'jigs skyes, sdug skad, mya ngan skad, smre sngags bcas so,
ma zhu ba'i nad dang: skran, skya rbab, 'or nad, dmu chu, gcong chen zad byed/
1) lus sems kyi nad tshabs chen po/ 2) gog hrul che ba/ khang pa gog gcong chen po/
gcong chen sde drug gi ya gyal te pho ba'i me drod nyams nas kha zas kyi dwangs ma gnas su ma smin pa dri mar gyur nas lus zungs zad par byed pa'i nad cig /

'dzin 'khrul med lung gi 'khri shing: rab byung bdun pa'i nang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i ma zhu ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i gcong sde bzhi yi ngos 'dzin dang, bcos thabs gsal bar ston pa'i sman gyi dpe tshan zhig /
lus zungs nyams pa/ yun ring po zas 'ju dka' ba byung bas gzugs bzhi gcong po 'dug /
khang pa sogs gog hrul/ lha khang gcong zom/
btsan po'am g.yang gzar/ ri bo gcong g.yang/ brag rong gcong g.yang can/
g.yang sa'am grog rong/ gcong rong du lhung ba/
ma cig lab sgron nas brgyud pa'i phung po gzan bskyur gyi gdams pa/
gur chung chung zhig ste gcod gtong mkhan sdod sa/

1) kha mchu thag gcod byed pa'i dpyad mtshams yi ge/ 2) rgyu nor la rin thang brtsi stangs shig / nyes can gyi khrims chad la dngos po 'jal bar gcod rgya byed pa/ 'bru dngul bun chad kyi tshab tu rgyu nor la rin thang brtsis te sprod len gyi gcod rgya byed pa/ 3) bcad rgya dang 'dra,
thad kar gcod cing dum bur 'breg pa/ 'phrul 'khor la brten nas ngar lcags rgyu chas gcod gtub byed pa/
1) shing sogs gcod pa'i thabs/ 2) las don thag gcod byed thabs/
gcod pa dang 'bras bu 'thog pa:/ shing dang 'bras bu gang byung du gcod 'thog ma byed/

1.(tha dad pa) bcad pa, gcad pa, chod,, 1) gtub pa dang, 'breg pa/ shing gcod pa/ bya gcod pa/ 2) gsod pa/ ske gcod pa/ srog gcod pa/ 3)bar mtshams 'jog pa,..3) bar mtshams 'jog pa/ bar du gcod pa/ dus mtshams gcod pa/ 'khru ba gcod pa/ 4) spong ba'am med pa bzo ba/ tha mag gcod pa/ 'brel ba gcod pa/ dgra ngan tshar gcod pa/ 5) 'gog pa'am rdzong ba/ chu rgyun gcod pa/ sgo bcad pa/ brag phug la rdo pha bong chen po zhig gis bcad nas bzhag / 6) gtan la 'bebs pa dang, gtan du 'khel ba/ blo thag gcod pa/ tshig thag gcod pa/ brgya kha gcig gis gcod mi nyan/ 7) lag len byed pa/ don gcod pa/ nyes chad gcod pa/ khrims gcad pa/ 8) 'tshol ba dang, snyeg pa/ rtsad gcod pa/ rjes gcod pa/ 9) dbye 'byed dang, brtag dpyad byed pa/ bye brag tu gcod pa/ bye brag tu mi gcod pa/ don dam bden pa'i mtha' bcad pa/ 10) 'gro skyod byas nas sleb pa/ rgyang lam rtas gcod pa/ ri klung gcod pa/ bya khyung gshog rdeb byed bzhin nam 'phang gcod pa/ 2.grub mtha' ris med la dar ba'i ma cig lab sgron gyi chos lugs spyod mkhan/
(rgya) ri mor bcad rgyag byed kyi pir phra mo zhig
nyes can gyi rkang lag dang dbang po gcod 'breg byed pa'i khrims/
lcags grang mo gtub byed kyi gzong/
1) shing sogs gcod stangs/ 2) kha mchu sogs thag gcod tshul/ 3) ma cig lab sgron gyi chos srol/
(rnying) 1) khengs dregs/ nga rgyal gcom bskyungs/ 2) lus stobs/ lus gcom gso ba/
1) skad chung ngur smra ba/ 2) khengs dregs spangs pa/
(tha dad pa) bcams pa, bcam pa, gcoms,, kha chad bzo ba'am byed pa/ kha dan gcom pa/ tshig dan bcams pa/ rjes su gang byed kyi gros gcom pa/

(tha dad pa) bcar ba, gcar ba, gcor,, 1) 'gram du gtug pa'am 'khris la 'gro ba/ de ring khong gi sku drung du mi rnams gcor gyin 'dug nga yang mnyam du bcar ba yin/ 2) 'tshir ba dang brdungs te 'joms pa/ sgo nga bcar te bcag pa/ rnag bcar te bton pa/
(tha dad pa) gtor ba'am 'chol du 'jug pa/ kha col chung ngus mi gcol bar, rgya mtsho bzhin du brling bar bya/
gis mnan mnan:/ rkang pas zhing sa bcag bcag byed/ rta ma bzhon gong nas sga la bcag bcag gnang dang/
'grul pa lam bar du nyin shas ngal gsor sdod pa'i zhag lhag / lam du nyin gsum bcag mar bsdad pa/
te phyogs 'grul skabs lam du ngal gso: byas nas bsdad pa'i zhag /
lam du ngal gso byas te zhag 'phar bsdad pa/
1) bdag nyid chen po'i bsdus tshig 2) bdag chen rin po che'i bsdus tshig
khrug khrug lag pa nas 'ju stangs shig / phyag nas bzung ste bcang bcang khrug khrug mdzad
bcad mtshams/ bcad kha med pa'i ras yug cha tshang/
khrims kyis bcad pa'i yi ge/ khrims khang gis bcad khra khyab bsgrags byas song/
mtshams nang sgo bcad kyis bsdad pa/
1) ri mos bcad rgyag pa/ 2) khang pa'i nang bcad rgyag pa/
brtan po'am nges pa can:/ 'gan dbang tshang ma bcad bcad khrig khrig bzos tshar/ so so'i las 'gan bcad bcad khrig khrig grub zin/ 'char gzhi bcad bcad khrig khrig zos pa/
bcad gtubs byas pa'i dum bu/
gos chen gyi rigs shig / bcad ldan me brgya ma/ bcad ldan me che ma/

tshul gyi khyad par zhig ste: chos gnyis po phan tshun gcig yin pa rnam par bcad pas cig shos yin par nges thub pa, dper na, blo gcig gis ka ba lta bu de mi rtag pa yin par yongs gcod du grub na rtag pa yin pa rnam bcad la khegs, rtag pa yin pa rnam bcad la khegs na mi rtag yin pa yongs gcod du grub pa lta bu'o/
gtubs nas zhib tu btags pa/ sman rigs bcad brdar byas nas sman phye bzos/
bcad pa'i lhag ma/ ras cha bcad 'phro/ shing sdong bcad 'phro/
phan tshun dbye ba bcad pa'i bar mtshams/ khrims kyi bcad mtshams/ shing gi bcad mtshams/ sa cha'i bcad mtshams/

blo rig bdun gyi nang gses, rtogs zin rtogs pa'i rig pa ste, rang 'dren byed kyi tshad mas rtogs zin gyi don slar yang rtogs pa, dper na bum 'dzin mngon sum skad cig gnyis pa dang, sgra mi rtag rtog pa'i rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa lta bu, tshad ma'i shes pas sgro 'dogs bcad zin pa de slar yang shes pa'o/
'breg gcod byas pa'i lhag 'phro/ gos chen bcad lhag / shing tog bcad lhag /
snyan tshig tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug 'dres ma'am rim bzhin spel ba'i snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan
tshigs bcad tshig lhug so so dang de gnyis ad lhug spel gsum/
byas nyes sogs gzhan la gsang ste sba ba'i bsam pa/
yo byad/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i bca' ka sta gon thams cad tshang bar gyis/
chog dang mi chog gi bya rim rnam gzhan ston pa'i khrims/ bca' khrims ltar khrims bcod byed pa/
/ rta sga 'khor bcas bcas 'grig cig / go lag bca' 'grig /
bza' dang bca' zhes kha zas kyi ming yin pas, 'dir ka zas la 'debs rgyu'i spod kyi nang tshan sga smug rlon pa'i ming/
sngon du grabs gshom byed pa
bcu grangs sam bcu skor gyi ming/ de ring mi bca' bcu sgor zhig slebs 'dug /
gtan du sdod pa/ bca' sdod dmag dpung/
1.tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'cha' ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.tha mi dang par 'jug pa'i 'cha' ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 3.'dul ba las bshad pa kha zas/
'dul ba las gsungs pa'i dus rung gi sman gyi char gtogs shgi ste, 'jig rten na kha zas su grangs pa'i rtsa ba dang, sdong bu dang, me tog dang, 'bras bu dang, lo ma bcas lnga/

sngar bod rje srong btsan sgam pos bcas pa'i khrims kyi yan lag ste, bsad pa la stong 'ded pa, brkus pa la brgyad 'jal ngo dgu 'ded pa, 'dod log spyad pa la byi rin 'ded pa, rdzun smras pa la mna' sgog pa ste bzhi/
'phrang lam yod sar btsugs pa'i shing zam/
yang du btang ba/ khral rigs bca' yang/ las khur bca' yang/ nyes pa bca' yang/
pa'i yi ge:/ dgon pa'i bca' yig /
bca' bya'i gro nas sogs kyi yos/
rgyun sdod kyi sgo nas srung ba/
leb mo/ thang sku bcar bcar po/ gyang sku bcar bcar po/
(rnying) thad kar ngo sprod pa/ gdams ngag bcar phog gnang ba/
zhar ba'i mig gam mig skyon can
leb leb/ thal mo bcar leb tu sbyor ba/ lcags zangs bcar leb tu rdung ba/
1.'jal ba'i 'das pa, 2.(rnying) 1) 'bul ba/ 2) tshad gzhal ba/
sdom ldan gyis bslab bya'i 'dul khrims te sangs rgyas kyis nyes spyod rnams sdom pa'i ched du bcas pa'i khrims/
bzo bcos/ sngon byas pa'i nang ma 'grig pa mang po yod stabs bcas bcos byed dgos byung 'dug / srol rgyun bzang po gang yod bcas bcos med par rang sor bzhag pa/

1. 1) tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'cha' ba'i 'das pa, 2) tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'cha' ba'i 'das pa, 2.yod pa'am ldan pa/ dang/ lhag ma dang bcas pa/ 'khrul ba dang bcas pa/ 'dzum dmul dang bcas pa/ 3.1) rigs mthun rnams cha tshang bkod zin mtshams su sdeb pa'am sdom pa'i phrad cig / mi dang dngos chas bcas tshang ma 'byor byung/ da lta ba dang, ma 'ongs pa, 'das pa bcas dus gsum/ shar lho nub byang bcas phyogs bzhi/ 2) chabs cig gam lhan cig / aa ma bu bcas/ gcig dang bcas pa'i lnga bcu/ me mda' mde'u dang bcas pa/ khyim bdag ltos par bcas pa phebs rdog thon song/
ma tho ba: sangs rgyas kyis bcas par mdzad pa'i dbang gis rab byung rnams kyis spyad mi rung zhing, khyim pa rnams la sdig pa med par grags pa phyi dro'i kha zas lta bu
ston pas bcas par mdzad pa'i dbyar dgag gso gsum lta bu bslab par bya ba'i gzhi rnams so/

bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang, rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ste dang po ni sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i nang ched du brjod nas khrims su bcas pa'i nyes pa dper na phyi dro'i kha zas lta bu dang, gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas rang gis ma bcas kyang gang dang 'gal ba nyid du rang bzhin gyis nyes par gyur pa dper na srog gcod dang, ma byin len, log g.yem, rdzun smra bcas lta bu/

thag pa sogs kyis bsdams pa/ bcings 'grol, bsdams pa las grol zhing, rang dbang dang 'phel rgyas yong ba ste, dmigs bkar du bstan bya ni log spyod dbang sgyur mgo rting slog par zer/ bsam blo bcings 'grol gtong/
dmangs bcings 'grol gtong ba'i ched du rtsa: 'dzugs byas pa'i dmag dpung la zer/ krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag /
mdud pa dang sgrog thag sdug bsngal sogs las bkrol ba/
sngar mi'i lag sor rgyug dum gyi bar du bsdams btsir byas nas zhu ba len thabs kyi khrims gcod drag po zhig
nad gang sel bar byed pa'i rdzas kyi sbyor ba rnams rlan phabs te na sar ras thum byas nas bcings pa'i lums lta bu la zer te, de la yang tsha sel gyi bcings lums bcu gnyis bcas nyi shu mchis/
grangs kyi bcu/ sor mo bcu/ shog lhe bcu/ lo bcu/ dngul sgor mo bcu tham pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khro bo dang, dge ba, 'jug pa, stobs, phyogs, 'byor ba, sor mo bcas so,
1) grangs bcu longs ma longs tsam/ 2) gcig las bcu 'phel ba/ ston thog bcu skor thon pa
sngar bod dngul srang lnga bcu la lo gcig ring la skyed srang bcu 'khri ba/
bcu tshang ba/ las mi bcu kha tshang ba zhig /
sngar 'brog khul du nor phyugs bcu re nas gcig re khral du bsdu ba'i srol zhig /
grangs gcig bcu ru 'gyur ba'i rtsis/
bod dngul srang bcu brtsi ba'i sgor mo zhig /
grangs ka bcu dang gcig / ming gi rnam grangs la drag po dang bde byed, bde 'byung, 'phrog byed, byed pa, dbang phyug bcas so,
zhal bcu gcig yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs/
bcu'i zur cha gcig / aar las bcu cha gsum tsam grub zin/
sngags kyi bsnyen pa'i bzlas grangs kha skong bcu zur sbyin sreg /
grangs ka bcu dang gnyis/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye mched dang, khyim, nyi ma, rten 'brel bcas so,
sngar khral rkang bcu gnyis re'am 'don drug re'i sa nas gzhung la dmag mi re gtong dgos pa/
(yul) dngul srang bcu ri ba'i chang blug sa'i snod khog ltir/

grangs ka bcu dang drug / ming gi rnam grangs la rgyal po dang cha shas, mi bdag bcas so, bcu drug cha, 1) zla ba'i 'phel cha bco lnga rdzogs pa'i cha gcig ste bcu drug / 2) dum bu bcu drug tu btang ba'i dum bu gcig / 3) (mngon) zla ba/
da lo lo dang por bzhag nas gong du brtsis pa'i 'das lo gnyis pa na ning, gsum pa gzhes ning bzhi pa dgu ning, lnga pa bcu ning yin/
grangs rim ang bcu pa/ zla ba bcu pa/ thengs bcu pa/ le'u bcu pa/
bcu yod pa'i grangs 'bor cha tshang/ don tshan bcu po tshang ma lag len bstar dgos/
grangs ka bcu lon pa zhig / lo bcu phrag 'ga' shas song pa'i rjes
na grangs bcu kha brgal ba'i rta drel lo rgan/
bre bcus gang ba'i 'bru 'jal byed kyi 'bo/
'bru bre bcu 'gro ba'i snod rdza ma/
grangs ka bcu dang bzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs la ma nu dang, yid shed bu, srid pa bcas so,
grangs ka bcu tham pa'i zur gcig gam cha gcig / rgya ma gang gi bcu zur gcig la srang gang yin/
grangs ka rtsi byed kyi yo byad de rgyug pa phra mo gcig la grangs bcu brtsi/
dmag gi sgrig lugs te dmag mi bcu re'i tsho: chung
rtsis rdel lam son phan/ bcu gsum, grangs ka bcu dang gsum/ ming gi rnam grangs la gdugs rim dang, 'dod pa, sna tshogs, myos byed, lus med bcas so,
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'jug pa'i 'das pa,

/ 1) (snying) po dang phan nus/ rdzas bcud/ snyigs ma bcud bral/ sa'i bcud/ sman bcud/ lud bcud shor ba/ 2) nying khu'i rtsi dang ro/ shing tog bcud can/ lto chas kyi bcud/ 3) dkar yol la brten pa'i ja chang dang, sa gzhi'i 'jig rten la brten pa'i sems can sogs la go ba'i brten pa/ snod bcud/
snod kyi 'jig rten la brten pa'i sems can yod do cog /
dngul chu'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
1) zas ro nus dang ldan pa/ 2) (mngon) sa gzhi/
1) bcud nus med pa/ 2) legs sbyar gyi gsal byed yi ge srog med pa/
1) 'bras bu smin pa/ 2) ro bcud bzang por gyur pa/
zas kyi bcud shes pa/ lto chas gang zos kyi bcud tshor ba/
(mngon) 1) bur shing/ 2) thang shing/ 3) bung ba/
lus zungs kyi bcud sha dang, rtsi'i bcud mar, shing gi bcud bu ram, 'bru'i bcud chang bcas bzhi/
1) me tog sogs rdzas la brten nas tshe sring lus stobs skyed byed kyi thabs shes shig / 2) aa ru ra'i shing/
zag med bde ster: dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bcud len gyi skor gsal bar ston pa'i le tshan zhig /
