1) gtam ngo lkog can/ lce gnyis pa'i gtam la cha 'jog mi thub/ 2) (mngon) 1,ne tso/ 2, sbrul/ 3,g.yo khram can/
(rnying) snyad 'dogs pa'am sgyu thabs kyis brdzus pa/
phru gu btsas rjes yig ris kyong brkos nang gur kum gyi phye ma btab ste lce la par rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig /
lce yi dri ma ste lce'i dreg pa/
lce'i thog la chags pa'i dri ma
smra lce sgra gsal la myur ba/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gong dkar rdzong khongs su yod/
sngar go gnas dma' bas mtho bar gus zhabs kyi tshul du lce bsnar gyi yod/
lce phyung ste zas mi za
dge slong gi sdom khrims nang gi nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan zhig /
gnyan nad lce la bab pa'i nad rigs spyi/
lce sgrog dgrol ba/ thabs shes sna tshogs la brten nas lce sbyang byed pa/

1) lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste ro lan tsha la mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas zas 'ju, mig 'byed, ro tsa, mig gsal bar byed/ 2) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas bad rlung grang ba 'joms, ma zhu 'ju, mig gsal bar byed/
1) lce'i rtsa ba/ 2) lce 'og gi gtar rtsa g.yas pa ra rtsa dang g.yon pa lug rtsa zer ba gnyis/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas me drod skyed, chu ser skem, gag pa gcod, rma ngan rul ba la phan/
ra gan dang, zangs dang, lcags dang, 'khar ba sogs las byas pa'i lce'i dri ma bzhar byed cig /
(yul) lce bde po med pa'am kha dig pa/

lce'i rnam par shes pa ste, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lce dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i ro'i skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa, dper na, lan tshwa'i ro myong byed kyi shes pa lta bu'o/
(tha mi dad pa) lcebs pa, lceb pa, lcebs,, rang srog 'dor ba'i ched du chu sogs la mchong ba/ chu la lcebs pa/ sbrang ma mer lcebs pa/ g.yang chen po la lcebs nas shi ba/
lce'i rnam par shes pa skye zhing mched pa'i dbang po/
dbang 'ngon lnga'i nang gses, rang gi bdag rkyen lce'i dbang po las byung zhing rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gzhan rig dper na, lan tshwa'i myong ba'i shes pa lta bu'o/
dbang po lnga'i nang gses, rang 'bras lce shes kyi thun mong min pa'i rten nam bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs ma, dbyibs zla ba bkas pa lta bu'o/

nang don bem po gang zhig lce'i dbang shes kyi bdag rkyen du rung ba, lces yul la 'jug dus kyi lce dbang lta bu rten bcas kyi dbang po gzugs can dang, lces yul la mi 'jug dus kyi lce dbang lta bu de mtshungs kyi dbang po gzugs can yin no/
rkan sbug lce steng rtsa ba'i lce chung/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shan rtsa rdzong khongs su yod/
/ khang thog gi zur lcog / rgya sgo'i lcog /
khang thog sogs su yod pa'i khang chung/
btsas ma brngas te ston thog zhing gi nang du khang bu'i dbyibs bzhin du rtsig pa'i ming/ btsas ma brgyab rjes tshar ma lcog rgyag pa/
1) dbyibs cog bu'i rnam pa/ ri sna lcog lcog / rdo mkhar dmar po lcog lcog / 2) mgo bo'i g.yo stangs shig ste khas len pa'i rnam pa ston pa/ mgo lcog lcog byed/
'bur 'bur ram tsog tsog / grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su khang pa lcog lcog pu zhig 'dug /
cog pu'am, tsog pu/ ri rtse lcog pu/
lha sa'i lho nub phyogs kyi lcags po ri'i ming gzhan/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) khom pa/ gnas skabs lcogs mi yong/ sang nyin lcogs mi lcogs mi shes/ 2) byed nus pa dang, thub pa/ blo nus kyis ma lcogs/ gang lcogs ci lcogs/
sbal ba'i phru gu rnga ma can/ sbal lcong/
autpala rigs dkar dmar sngo ser bzhi'i nang tshan ser po ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo mchin gyi tshad pa dang, bad kan smug po sel, mkhris nad sogs gyen du 'dren zhing skyug par byed/

bod yig gsal byed drug pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen sgra med/ 1. 1) ming gzhi'i ma ning yi ge zhig / 2) brjod bde'i dbang gis drangs pa'i ming gi cha shas shig / skad cha/ dgos cha/ rgyan cha/ dpe cha/ mtshon cha/ yig cha/ ras cha/ lag cha/ 2. 1) zung/ cha sgrig pa/ cha 'grig pa/ cha min ya min/ lham cha gnyis/ gdung ma ring thung phra sbom cha ma yin pa/ 2) rgyus mnga'/ cha ma mchis/ gar song cha med/ sang phod than pa gtong gi yin min da lta cha ma 'tshal/ 3) dum bu'am tshan khag / brgya cha/ stong cha/ stod cha/ smad cha/ thob cha/ chag cha/ 'phar cha/ zla ba'i dkar cha/ byi la ni gcan gzan gyi char gtogs pa red/ 4) 'phrin/ cha skur ba/ phan tshun gyi bar du ngag thog nas cha 'bul ba/ 5) gos kyi zheng tshad/ mi gzugs stobs chen po la gyon pa cha chen po dgos/
mthun rkyen/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen/ sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen/ cha rkyen 'dzoms pa/ cha rkyen med pa/ cha rkyen gsar skrun byed pa/
(yul) mang tshig ston byed/ 'u bu cha kha mnyam du nas zhing la 'gro/
/ 1) nang du bsgril ba'i gos kyi mtha' sne/ gos rnying pa la snam ras gsar pa'i cha ga gtong ba/ 2) (yul) mig mtha'i dkri ga/ mig cha ga can/ byis pa 'di'i mig la cha ga yod/
tsir sgra dang bcas cung zad 'phur zhing mchongs 'gros byed pa'i 'bu zhig /
1) rtsis kyi rnam grangs shig / 2) zung ngam gnyis kyi grangs gnas/
so sor cha gses btang ba/ mi shugs dang, rgyu shugs gcig tu bsdus te cha bgos gtong ba/
nyams myong ngam rgyus mnga'/ gnas tshul la cha rgyus yod pa/ cha yod rgyus yod/ cha rgyus med pa/
(yul) dngos chas 'jug snod mdun du sgo 'byed rgyu yod pa'i shing chas shig /
'og tu ca lag 'jug snod cha sgam dang, steng du mchod pa bsham sa yod pa'i sgam stegs shig /
cha shas can te yan lag 'dzoms pa'i gzhi/ dbang po dang yan lag cha dang, lus po cha can/ 'khor lo dang rtsibs sogs cha dang, shing rta cha can/
zung zung/ ca lag rnams cha cha bsgrigs te zhog / bya ngang pa rnams cha cha byas te 'phur ba/ mi de tsho cha cha ru bsgrigs nas yong/
(rnying) khyon yongs nas/ cha chad, (rnying) dka' tshegs che/
pa dang yid rton pa:/ 'thus mi go chod cha 'jog 'pher ba zhig 'dems bsko byed pa/ cha 'jog yid ches/ cha 'jog blo gtad/
cha gnyis bsres pa'i spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, stan la cha bzhir bgos pa'i cha gnyis las lhag pa bal nag gis byas pa'o/

the tshom gyi nang gses, 'di yin 'di min gyi cha la shas che chung med par mnyam par 'jug phyir don mthun dang don mi mthun du 'dzin pa'i blo gang yang mi 'dren pa'i the tshom, dper na sgra rtag gam mi rtag ci 'dra zhig yin snyam pa lta bu ste, sgra rtag 'dzin dang mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo gang yang mi bskyed pa'o
gnyis ka 'dra ba/ ring thung mtho dma' ma shor bar cha mnyam po byung 'dug / gtong yong cha mnyam por gnas pa/
1) cha mtshungs pa/ 2) mang nyung ngam mtho dma' cha snyoms byung/ bgo bsha' cha snyoms su rgyag pa/
tshod thig / mi so so'i sems la bsam 'char ji yod cha rtogs dka' ba/
tsher ma'am kha spu 'thog byed kyi 'jab tse/
cha 'grig pa'am cha mtshungs pa/ yongs su cha mthun pa/
bzo 'dra ba'am phyogs mthun pa/ gyon chas cha 'dra ba gyon pa/ spun zla gnyis rnam pa cha 'dra ba zhig 'dug / cha 'dra ba tsam/
lag tu gang byung gang thebs/

seng ge : rab byung gnyis pa'i sa yos la 'khrungs, gtsang ne'u thog gi gdan sa lo mang po'i bar du bskyangs, snyan grags shin tu che zhing bu slob kyis bod yul gang ba byung, bsdus grwa'i rigs lam gyi srol btod pa sogs phyag rjes ha cang che, rab byung gsum pa'i sa glang la 'das/
phan tshun rtsod pa'i bar gyi bden dpang/
sman pas gtar gshag sogs byed pa'i yo byad kyi ming ste gtsag bu dang, thur ma lta bu/
1) yo byad dam mkho spyad/ 2) cha dpyad dang 'dra,
cha shas nyung ngu'am zhib mo/ cha phra ba'i yang cha phra ba/
1) nyung shas/ 2) dkyil 'khor gyi thig tshad cig /
ngag lan/ grogs por cha 'phrin bskur ba yin/
chas pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri srol gzhan,
cha lugs/ dmag mi'i cha byad/ bud med kyi cha byad/ mi rigs so so'i cha byad mi 'dra/
zung 'brel lam mnyam gshibs/ cha sgam cha 'brel/ dngos zog cha 'brel byas te btsongs pa/
zung sbrel lam gnyis gnyis mthud pa/ rmon phyugs shed bzang cha sbrel gyis rmon pa rgyag pa/
gang byung mang byung/ khyed kyi gtam de cha ma cho zhig red/
1) nges pa med pa/ 2) zla bral/
(rnying) 'os ma yin nam gnas ma yin/ khyed kyis de 'dra gsung ba'i cha ma yin/
go log cha min cha log dang don gcig
tshul dang mi mthun pa:/ spyod pa cha min cha log / cha lugs cha min cha log / skad cha cha min cha log
1) rgyus med/ mi cha med rgyus med la blo ma bcol/ 2) nges pa med/ khong gar song cha med red/
bye brag smra bas rang gi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i phyogs cha med kyi rdul te phra rab kyi rdul/
cha shas tsam mam zur tsam/ seng ge'i rtsal la ri bong gis cha tsam 'gran par mi bzod do/
kha tshang ba'am 'dzoms pa/ cha lag cha tshang ba/ 'phrul 'khor gyi yo byad cha tshang ba 'dug la skyon yang shor mi 'dug / drag chas cha tshang spras pa/
1) nyi zla'i cha shas gzas 'dzin tshul lam sgrib tshul/ 2) (mngon) dpang po/
yongs su tshang ba/ bco lnga'i zla ba cha rdzogs pa/

1) yid rton pa dang, blos bkal ba/ grogs po la cha bzhag pa/ rgyu mtshan de dag la cha bzhag pa/ yi ge kho nar cha bzhag pa/ 2) gzhir bzung ba/ dpe gsar yang gsar la cha bzhag pa/ mi 'bor mang nyung de ga tsam la cha bzhag pa/ 3) ngos bzung ba/ nor 'khrul med pa la cha bzhag pa/ dngos gnas yin par cha bzhag pa/
1) cha gcig gi ya/ 2) 'dra gnyis kyi cha dang, cha bral gyi ya/
rgyus mnga' zhib po yod pa/ nga gnyis phan tshun cha yod rgyus yod yin/
shing cha ra'i nang gses shig /
shing bu thung ngu rked nyag can/ sgo phyugs 'dogs thag gi sne mor btags pa'i cha ru/ sbra gur chon thag gi thag sne'i cha ru/
(yul) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rtse drung gi gzan dang stod gos/
1) la la'am kha shas, kha cig / dpe cha cha re nga la'ng yod/ 2) zung re/ lham cha re cha re byas nas bsgrigs 'dug /
cha shas can dang yan lag / khang pa'i nang du 'dzin chas cha lag cha tshang yod/ 'phrul 'khor cha lag cha tshang yod/
rol mo'am sbug chal/ gnam sa cha lang rdeb pa lta bu'i 'ur sgra sgrog pa/
ha lam/ las don 'di la da dung cha lam lo gcig lhag tsam zhig 'gor gyi red/ mi grangs cha lam bcu phrag kha shas shig dgos/
lus por chas gos gyon stangs/ rgya'i cha lugs/ bod kyi cha lugs/ hor gyi cha lugs/ dmag mi'i cha lugs/ mi kha shas kyis cha lugs ya ma zung spras 'dug /

1) yan lag / lus kyi cha shas yan lag lnga/ 2) cung zad dam, phyogs re ba/ nang don cha shas tsam rtogs pa/ khong gi yon tan gyi cha shas tsam yang bdag la med/ 3) dbugs gcig ri mkha' ri'i char phye ba'i cha la cha shas byas pa sogs cha shas la mang nyung dang gnas la nges pa med pas skabs dang bstun te, 707 67 13 sogs mang ngo/ 4) zla ba la cha shas bcu drug yod pas grangs bcu drug mtshon/
lag ces bya ba'i rab tu byed pa: bstan bcos shig /

gnas gza' skar dang, chu tshod, chu srang, dbugs bcas bzhi'i man chad la dbugs gcig cha du mar phye ba'i cha shas tha snyad logs su med pas cha shas lnga pa zhes grags, de'i cha shas la cha shas drug pa zhes zer/
tshogs pa'am ril po/ lus cha shas can/ 'phrul 'khor cha shas can/
cha shas can gyi gzugs can
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi cha shas can dpe'i cha shas can gyi gzugs su bkod cing, cha shas rnams gzugs su ma bkod pa'i rgyan zhig /

(mngon) gser spyi/ cha shas gzugs can, gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi cha shas gang yin dpe'i cha shas kyi gzugs su bkod cing, cha shas can gzugs su ma bkod pa'i rgyan zhig /

1) dum bu gsum mam cha shas gsum/ 2) zung du gyur pa'i cha gsum/ 3) mchod yul gong ma spyir gtor ma cha gcig phyogs skyong bcur gtor ma cha gcig rigs drug spyi dang khyad par gdon bgegs la gtor ma cha gcig ste cha gsum/
bgo bsha' cha snyoms te bgo ba/ las 'gan cha gses rgyag pa/ bza' 'bru cha gses gtong ba/
/ 1) nas sran hral btags kyi chag / rta drel rnams la gzan chag ster/ 2) lus tshad 'jal byed sor mo bzhi'i zheng tshad/ 3) (rgya) rtsa blta skabs sman pa'i lag pa'i srin lag gam blta gnas kyi brda/
dngos spyad gas chag tu btang ba/ lag pas shor nas snod spyad kyi kha zhabs lto gsum chag dkrums byung ba/
rta drel la chag ster sa'i snod
mthe bong phar phud pa'i lag pa'i sor mo bzhi brtsegs mar byas pa'i gang la zer te de dang sor bzhi gzhal ba gnyis don gcig /
: bzang ngan 'dres ma'i tshul/ dngos po chag gi chig gi rnams mnyam du bzhag yod/ ca lag de tsho chag gi chig gi sha stag red/
chag pa dang, sil bur zhig pa'i dum bu/ rdza g.yam chag grugs/ dkar yol chag grugs/ shel sgo chag grugs/
dum bu dum bur chag pa dang, cung zad grum pa gnyis kyi bsdus tshig / khog ltir chag grum med pa/
(yul) ngal las byas pas lus po la na zug gtong ba/ rta bzhon te thag ring du phyin pas chag brgyab pa/
gnon byed kyi gad chu:/ tho rangs nas langs te khang pa'i phyi nang du chag chag dang gad bdar byed pa/
rang bzhin gyis grum pa dang, ma tshang bar gyur pa/
chag gi chig gi'i bsdus tshig
yan lag grum pa bcos thabs shig / rkang lag chag par chag chings byed pa/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs khral chag chen po bzhi ste, stong rnying bkrus chag ces khral rkang rtsa stong dang bu lon ha cang rnying pa bcas mna' skyel dag 'bud kyis bkrus nas khral chag btang ba dang, rgya sbyong dmag chag ces rgya sbyong dmag sgar aang gnyis par dmag mi gcig btang yod pas khral chag btang ba dang, zhabs sdod ngo chag ces bod sa gnas srid gzhung du zhabs sdod pa drung 'khor las kar yod pas khral chag btang ba dang, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs lcags mo yos lor bod la sa zhib mdzad rjes khong gi bka' mchan ltar khral chag btang ba bcas bzhi'o/
chag chag btab pa ste, dgon pa sogs kyi sa cha brtags nas sa 'dul sogs mdzad pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) dum bur zhig pa dang, sil bur gyur pa/ dkar yol chag pa/ gdung ma chag song/ 2) rgyun 'chad pa/ slob sbyong mi chag pa/ rtsa chag / 2. chun po'am phon po/ me tog sos pa chag pa gcig / skud pa chag pa gnyis/ spos chag pa gsum/
dngos rigs chag nas byung ba'i dum bu/
rta drel la chag ster snod/
rgyun mi 'chad par 'bad brtson chen pos sgrub pa/
ka ped pho rigs kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig
ring thung gi cha tshad dam phyag tshad/
(rnying) tshwa dang sdor med pa'i thug pa sla po/
rta la chag ster sa'i gzhong pa/
1) nges pa can/ 2) dper mtshon pa/
'khri cha'i grangs 'bor nyung du gtong ba'i ming/ skyed kha chag yang gtong ba/ khral 'bab chag yang gtong ba/ nyes chad chag yang gtong ba/
snod sogs chag dum/ shing sgam chag ro/ gnam gru chag ro/ dkar yol chag ro/
mi sogs kyi rkang lag chag pa'i tshe 'byar chings rgyag pa la dgos pa'i shing byang leb mo/
chags zhen/ yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po la chags 'khri skyes pa/
(rnying) bu lon bda' ba'i dpang rgya/
1) snam bu chu chags byed pa/ 2) lteb tshigs rgyag pa/

rkyen ngan nam sdug bsngal 'byung gzhi/ gzab gzab ma byas pas chags sgo bslangs pa/ rgyab nas chags sgos ded pa/ chags sgo byung ste rta yis gyugs, gyugs sa yag po bye ma'i nang/ nyes pa can la chags sgo dang, bug pa can la lhan pa/ rgyab chags sgos ded pa mi shes par, mdun blo shed che mdog kha po/
'dod chags shugs che ba'i bud med/
snam bu chu la sbangs nas nem nem gyis 'chag pa/
chags pa'i rten gnas/ chags rten med pa'i mi hreng/
thogs thug / lam bar du chags thogs mang ba/ kha nas chags thogs med par smra ba/ gnas lugs tshang ma chags thogs med par rtogs pa/
'dod chags dang zhe sdang ngam dga' ba dang khro ba/ sems la chags sdang skyes pa/ dgra gnyen gyi khyad par phye nas chags sdang ma nor ba byed pa/ chags sdang gi rus thon pa/
gnyen la zhen chags dang, dgra la sdang ba, blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pa/
srid pa dang por chags, bar du gnas, mtha' mar 'jig yang mthar stong par 'gyur ba bcas bskal pa gcig gi gnas skabs bzhi'o/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) 'dod pa/ rgyu nor la chags pa/ 'dod yon la chags pa/ ri bong tshang la chags pa/ 2) gnas pa'am 'jags pa/ gzhis chags pa/ lhing chags pa/ sa bzhin du chags pa dang, rdo bzhin du gnas pa/ 3) byung ba dang, grub pa/ 'brel ba chags pa/ mngal chags pa/ btsa' chags pa/ 'bras bu chags pa/ ma lag cha tshang zhig chags pa/ 2. 'dod pa/ chags pa med pa/ chags pa'i tshig /

bskal pa bzhi'i thog ma 'jig rten stong pa'i gnas skabs rdzogs pa nas gnas pa'i bskal pa la thug pa'i bar gyi yun tshad de, phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'og gzhi'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags pa nas brtsams te, nang bcud kyi 'jig rten dmyal ba mnar med du sems can gcig skyes pa'i bar gyi bar bskal nyi shu'i yun la chags pa'i bskal pa zhes bya'o/
bskal pa thog mar chags pa'i dus/
mi lus thog mar chags pa'i rtsa/ chags spyod, chags pa spyod pa ste 'khrig pa spyod pa/
1) 'dod pa'i chags pa dang bral ba/ 2) sangs rgyas spyi/
nyon mongs phyogs la chags bral lnga ste, phyogs gcig la chags bral ba dang, mtha' dag la chags bral ba, rtogs pa'i chags bral ba, gnon pa'i chags bral ba, legs par ston pa'i chags bral ba bcas lnga
thog ma nas byung ba'i babs sam bzo lta/ lung pa 'di chags dbyibs shin tu mdzes po 'dug /
byung rim gyi gnas lugs/ 'jig rten gyi chags tshul/ grong rdal gyi thog ma'i chags tshul/ ri klung gi chags tshul/ gzugs dbyibs chags tshul/ sdod khang chags tshul/
chags gnas 'tsho rten/ so nam pa'i chags 'tsho sa zhing la brten pa/
1) sdod sa'am gnas sa/ 2) zhen chags skye sa'i yul/
sngar gyi byung stangs lo rgyus/
byung zhing gnas pa'i tshul lugs/

myos byed kyi btung ba spyi'i ming/ 'bras chang/ nas chang/ rgun chang/ sman chang/ chang gi nying khu/ chang gi sbang ma/ chang skyur mo/ chang gar mo/ chang sla po/ chang 'dren pa/ chang langs pa/ chang rnying/ chang rin/ chang gis bzi ba/ mi la nas med par 'dre la chang mi yong/ skyo sems ngo mar chang gis mi phan/ chang rang gis btung na mgo na, chang mis btung na snying na/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khrul byed dang, dga' byed, dga' ma, ca co byed, chu bdag skyes, chu ma, mchog ldan ma, stobs bzang, dri mchog dri rab, 'dod byed, gnod sbyin chang, dpa' mo, spos ngad ldan, myos 'gyur, myos byed, yongs 'bab, yongs 'dzag yongs su thos, rab dwangs, bshol ldan mnyes, bshol ma, lha min nying khu, h'a l'a bcas so,
chang blug byed dam 'dren byed kyi snod rkyan bu/
bskol ldan te chang dang, sngo phyur, rtsam pa, bu ram bcas mnyam du bsres nas bskol ba'i thug pa zhig /
1) chang 'tshong sa/ ming gi rnam grangs la chang 'tshong khyim dang, chang 'tshong khang, myos byed khang bcas so, 2) chang 'jog sa'i khang pa
sbang ma skam po zhib mor byas nas rma khar btab ste rma'i khrag ngan dang chu ser phyir 'dren zhing rma rgod 'dul ba'i bcos thabs shig /
chang btsos pa'i 'bru snyigs te sbang ma
1) yun ring song ba'i chang rnying/ 2) chang la ha cang brkams pa'i mi/
dngos po dang don dag chung ngu'i rigs/ dngos spyad chang ngi chung ngi/ don dag chang ngi chung ngi/ bya spyod chang chung/
chang ngi chung ngi'i bsdus tshig
1) chang phud 'thor ba/ 2) chang gi mchod pa/ 3) (yul) chang 'thung ba'i zhe sa/
chu gnyis pa brgyab pa'i chang/
chang dwangs snyigs phye ba'i snyigs ma,
'bru btsos par chang rtsi btab ste dro sar snyol ba/ gro nas 'bras sogs btsos nas chang snyol bar byed/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, myos 'gyur gyi rigs 'thung ba ste myos 'gyur la brten pa'i bag med pas gzhan ma dad par byed pa'o/
chu dang po brgyab ste btsags pa'i chang/
log ro bcud ldab log yod pa'i chang dang po
chang gis myos pa/ glang chen chang drengs can/
chang btung drags pa'i nad/ chang nad chang gis gso/
1) chang gis brdzis pa'i zan/ 2) chang dang sbrags nas za ba'i kha zas sha tshal sogs/
chang gi dang po'am thog mar bcad pa'i phud/
chang mas gzhung la 'bul dgos pa'i khral/
chang 'tshong mkhan dang, chang gi las ka byed mkhan/
sngar lha sar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i chang dang aa rag 'tshong mkhan rnams kyis tshogs chen zhal ngor chang rag btsongs chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
lo mang phyin pa'i chang gar ma/
bod khams kun tu dar ba'i spro skyid dang gsol ston byed pa dang gling gar spro gseng gtong skabs chang bkyag nas bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i glu'i ming/
chang dang mnyam du za ba'i sha tshal sogs/
chang khang ngam chang 'thung sa'i gnas/
bzang lan ngan 'jal gyi dpe/ chang lan chu 'jal byed pa ni mi gshis ngan pa'i rang rtags red/
pho mo gnyen sgrig gi dga' ston/ mna' seng dwangs/

/ 1) phye las bzos pa'i rdog po/ bye mas changs pa mi yong/ bye ma'i changs pa bshig pa la, byed pa 'o gzhan ltos mo dgos/ 2) sbar mo/ rtsam pa changs pa gang/ lag stong changs stong/ changs pa stong pa/
kha dan dang khas blangs pa'i tha tshig / kha chad/ nyin chad/ ster chad/ chad tshig / 'gro chad byas pa/
ma ldangs pa'am chad pa'i gras/ thob skal chad khongs la su su yod/ sgo khral chad khongs kyi tshong zog / thob skal ma ldangs pa rnams chad khongs su tho bkag pa
nyes pa 'gel ba'am nyes chad gtong ba/ nyes can la chad 'gel byed pa/ skabs 'phral chad 'gel byas pa tsam/
chad lus phar 'gyangs kyi 'khon thogs sam ka kor/

sems gnas skabs kyi yid byed bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, sems gnas gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar 'jug pa'i yid byed sems yengs pa slar yang dmigs pa de nyid la 'jog pa'i skabs su chad cing 'jug pa'i yid la byed pa'o/
1) zad pa dang nyams gud/ 2) (rnying) gnam lcags thog /
chad ran pa'am chad chog chog / srab sa nas rdol chog dang, phra sa nas chad nye/
las 'bras dang, skye ba snga phyi sogs med par smra ba'i lta ba/
ma tshang ba'am chad pa'i grangs 'bor 'gos tho/
thams cad med par smra ba'i mtha'/
1) bar chad pa slar mthud pa/ 2) gsab cha/ chad don, kha chad/ sngar bzhag chad don ltar byed pa/ do bdag phan tshun gnyis kas chad don lag len byed dgos/
kha chad dam khas blangs pa'i tha tshig / sngar gyi chad mdo dang mi 'gal ba/

1. tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'chad pa'i 'das pa, 2.khrims dang 'gal ba'i nyes chad/ jag rkun chad pas tshar bcad pa/ khral g.yol bar chad pa gtong ba/ rang gi byas nyes ngos len byas pas chad pa bkrol ba/ chad pa drag gcod byed pa/ chad pa phab pa/ byed 'dzol che chung la bab bltas te chad pa gcod pa/
khral dang bu lon sogs zha chag byung ba'i chad lan sgrub 'jal/
'jug pa'i yid byed: sems gnas skabs kyi yid byed bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, sems gnas brgyad pa'i skabs su chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid la byed pa'o/
nag can la nyes 'gel gyi srol lugs/
'khor ba'i sdug bsngal med tsam las gzhan don phun tshogs mi 'grub pa'i myang 'das

sngar rgya gar du dar ba'i mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa ste tshe 'di la legs tsam gyis chog par smra zhing skye ba snga phyi yod par 'dod kyang las 'bras yod par mi 'dod pa dang, skye ba snga phyi dang las 'bras gtan nas mi 'dod pa bcas gnyis yod/
hrul nas dum bur song ba/ sked rags chad po chad nag / thag pa chad po/
1) nyes chad 'jal ba/ 2) sprod rgyur bsdad pa'i 'bru dngul sogs sprod pa/
: kha chad byas pa'i yi ge/ gros mol byas nas chad mol gyi yi ge 'jog pa/
chad par smra ba'i bsdus tshig
bu lon sogs kyi grangs 'bor ma tshang bar chad pa'i 'dzin/
kha chad byas pa'i yi ge
khrims kyi nyes chad de, nyes can la chad 'gel gyi bya ba/ khrims dang 'gal bas chad las phog pa/

ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gras, dge slong la pham pa byung yang 'chab pa med na phyir bcos byed rung zhing, byed tshul ni chad pa las kyi bslab pa sbyin te ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du dman pa'i spyod pa lnga dang du len cing khyad par gyi spyod pa lnga spong ba'i sgo nas phyir bcos byed pa'i bslab pa'o/
kha chad/ nyin gsum song mtshams yong rgyu'i chad so bzhag pa/ chad so bdog pa/
ma tshang ba rnams kyi kha skong/ grangs 'bor ma longs pa'i chad gsab byed pa/
mi'am dud 'gro gcig ngal dub kyis thang chad na de'i tshab tu gzhan zhig yong nas bya ba mu mthud du sgrub pa/ da res kyi do po ljid po yin stabs khal ma chad gsor gra sgrig byed dgos/

1) grangs 'bor ma tshang ba dang lhag ma/ 2) lo rtsis nang du gza' gcig nyin snga phyi gnyis kar byung na gza' 'og gi chu tshod gang mang ba'i tshes grangs de chad pa dang, nyin snga phyi'i gza' mchongs na gza' 'og gi chu tshod gang nyung ba'i tshes grangs de lhag pa yin par 'jog rgyu
btsos pa'i bza' 'bru khu ba dang bcas pa/ 'bras chan/ sran chan/ nas chan/ gro chan/
1) gri gug / 2) rngo bzo ba'i ko gri khye bo/
gro nas 'bras sogs ril mo btsos pa'i thug pa
/ 1) rma'i rtsa rgyus gcod byed kyi yo byas cig / 2) (rnying) khye bo'm gri gug /

(rgya) man ju'i rgyal rabs aang bzhi pa'i khri lo'i ming ste, gong ma 'dis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags rta lor bod la bka' shag las khungs gsar 'dzugs kyis bod bzhud aam ban dang, t'a la'i bla ma lhan sbrel gyi zhal bkod ltar bod kyi las don byed rgyu dang, chu glang lor phyin chad t'a la'i bla ma dang, pan chen aer te ni rim byon gyi yang srid ngos 'dzin skor gong nas gnang ba'i gser bum dkrug 'don gyis thag gcod bya rgyu sogs 'phral phugs gal gnad can gyi bya gzhag khag mang gtan 'bebs byas yod pa/

1. 1) chu'i zhe sa/ spyan chab/ zhal chab/ chab tshan/ chab bran pa/ 2) gcin pa'i zhe sa/ dri chab/ chab gdan/ chab gsil ba/ 2. ming 'ga'i sngon la sbyar nas zhe tshig sgrub byed kyi tshig grogs shig / chab srid/ chab 'og / chab 'bangs/ chab zho/
1) chu skol sa'i khang pa/ 2) khrus khang/ 3) (yul) gsang gcod/
1) chu lam/ 2) chu 'gro sa'i khung bu/
ske rags leb mo sogs kyi sne 'dzin/
1) khang pa'i sgo/ nyin mtshan med par chab sgo sdom srol ga la yod/ 2) khrims sgo/
thag pa'i 'gugs len gyi chab tse/

sa cha zhig ste, mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi shar phyogs dang zi ling grong khyer gyi nub phyogs na yod, da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dang gung ho rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/
chab be chob be'i bsdus tshig
nad brtag dpyad byed skabs sman par ston rgyu'i gcin pa/
sngar bod kyi rtse drung gi stod gos shig /
sngar t'a la'i bla ma'i gsol thab kyi chu len byed dre'u/

1) sa khul zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud na yod pa'i sa khul de dang si khron zhing chen, yun nan zhing chen, mtsho sngon zhing chen bcas 'brel nas yod, khul 'dir 'bri chu dang, zla chu, rgyal mo rngul chu bcas chu bo chen po gsum byang nas lhor 'bab cing, sa khul de'i khongs su chab mdo dang, go 'jo, steng chen, mdzo sgang, dpal 'bar, brag g.yab, 'jo mda', dpal shod, rdza yul, spo mes, lho rong, ri bo che, smar khams bcas rdzong khag bcu gsum yod, sa khul gyi spyi khyab las khungs de chab mdor yod/ 2) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud du yod cing, zla chu dang ngom chu 'dzom sar chags yod/
rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma smad byang sems shes rab bzang pos rab byung bdun pa'i me sbrul lor btab ste 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim pas skyong ba'i dgon pa zhig
sngo sman sran ma'i rigs te, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, de'i me tog gsar du bzhad ma thag pas dmu chu la phan, chu 'gag 'byin/
(kamandalu) chu bum gyi bye brag spyi blugs/

rags zhib dang bzang ngan ma phye bar rigs mi mthun pa sna tshogs mnyam du 'dres pa'm bsres pa'i tshul/ ca lag bzang ngan chab be chob be 'dres pa rnams la dbye 'byed byed pa/ g.yag rtsid dang khu lu mang po chab be chob be byas nas phyogs gcig tu spungs pa/ rgyu cha bzang ngan sna tshogs chab be chob be byas nas btang ba/ ja chang aa rag chab be chob be mang po btungs pas na byung/ sgo phyugs rwa can rwa med chab be chob be byas nas mnyam du btags pa
dge slong gi kha bshal chu snod ril ba chung ngu zhig
rgyal po'i mnga' 'og gi gi sde 'bangs mi ser/
khams mo dang hor mo'i sked rags dngul lam tung tshag dkrol ma dang 'gron bu'i rgyan can khab shubs sogs kyi glo 'dogs yod pa zhig /
ko thag gam ske rags leb mo sogs kyi chab lce/
(rnying) chud zos su song ba'am, brlag pa/ chab mi 'tshal ba/
dgon sde khag gi dbyar gnas grol rjes kyi dga' ston/
1) chu btungs pa/ 2) chu blangs pa/ 3) chur zhugs pa/
sngar bod kyi rtse drung gi gzan gos chen gyi mtha' lcags can zhig /
/ chab 'og gi rgyal phran/ rang gi chab 'og tu sdud pa/ chab 'og tu gtogs pa/
rim pa gong mas gnang ba'i yi ge / chab yig bklags shing don rnams khong du chud pa/
tshogs su bum pa khyer nas dge 'dun rnams la rung chu 'grems mkhan/
dar ram 'khyag pa/ chu bo chab rom gyis bsdams pa/
chab rtse'i aa long/ sked rgyan dngul gyi chab long/
1) bka' shog gam spring yig / 2) shog bu/

1) chab 'bangs te mnga' 'bangs skyong bar byed pa'i 'jig rten srid pa'i khrims kyi bya gzhag / 2) gral rim dang, srid tang, spyi tshogs kyi tshogs pa, mi sger bcas kyis rgyal nang dang rgyal spyi'i 'brel ba'i thad la byed pa'i bya spyod rnams la zer/

dus lhan cig gam dus mnyam/ glog 'khyugs pa dang chabs cig tu 'od 'tsher ba/ 'bad brtson chabs cig tu byas pa/ rta mchog skyod pa'i shugs dang chabs cig tu mtshon 'phangs pa/ mgrin pa'i glu dang chabs cig rgyud mang btang ba
cam dang mtshungs pa ste, dal bu dang, gtan gyi don/ gzhan gyis mi mngon par cham gyis song ba/ chos thams cad cham du mi skye ba/
sha chang dang nyin gnyid nyal ba sogs kyis cham pa'i nad gzhi 'khrugs par gyur pa'i don/
zas spyod mi mthun par bsten pa sogs kyis cham pa'i nad gzhi 'khrugs te nad gzhug ma chod nas rgyun ring du lus la zhen pa'i cham pa'i nad rnying pa zhig /

lus dro grang ma snyoms pa dang, mi gtsang ba'i rdul sna sgor shor ba, dri ma ngan pa mnam pa sogs kyis sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi ro rkyang gi rtsa gnyis cham la phab nas byed las nyams par gyur te rim bzhin lus la khyab pa'i nad cig / gre cham/ glo cham/ sna cham/ dug log srab drags pas cham pa phog 'dug / glo bur du cham pa na nas glo rgyag pa/
cham la phab pa ste, g.yung la phab pa'am gtan du pham par btang ba/ dgra bo cham la phab pa/

1) ci yang mi dmigs pa'i stong sang sang gi snang ba 'char tshul ston pa'i tshig cig / sdod mkhan med pas khang pa cham mi bar lus pa/ re don ci yang ma 'grub pas bsam tshul cham me bar gyur pa/ 2) lham me ba ste 'od 'phro ba'i rnam pa/ nyi 'od cham mer shar ba/
zha thul lam zla gam ste ser mo ba phyir bskyod dang nang sdod gnyis ka'i gyon chas dang skya bo nang sdod skabs kyi gyon chas shig /
ste rbad de bzhag pa:/ phan thogs med pa'i las ka cham bzhag byas pa/
kha rlangs sogs brgyud de gcig nas gcig tu 'go ba'i cham pa'i rigs shig /

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dngos po'i rang bzhin mi 'os pa'i rnam pa nges par gsal ba de, g.yo zol gyis sgrib cing mi mngon par byed pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs bzhi ni, 'os pa'i cha, mi 'os pa'i cha, smad pa'i cha las bstod pa, bstod pa'i cha las smad pa rnams so/
char pa las g.yol sa'i gnas/
char pa 'gog byed kyi gdugs sogs/
che chung bar ma ci rigs su 'bab pa'i char gyi rgyun/ dbyar dus char rgyun dus su bab pa/
'jam char/ 'brug sgra dal gyis sgrog pa dang bcas char rgyun zim bur bab song/
1) char pa dang chu/ 2) char pa/ char chu snyom po/ char chu dkon po/ char chu dus bab/ 3) char pa'i chu/
char pa che chung gi tshad/
char ltar du phab pa/ dgos 'dod char du bsnyil ba/
bsdebs nas 'bab pa'i drag char:/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyun 'bab dang, yongs lhung, drag char bcas so,
lus la char pa phog pa/ de ring lam bar la char rdung 'khel byung/
bon gyi lugs srol char 'bebs la dgos pa'i rdzas dud 'gro bsad pa'i rdo zhig /
khug rta'am 'dag byi'u/ char sdod byi'u skom na yang, sa la 'bab pa'i chu mi 'thung/
bya spyod ngan pa'am rkyen ngan gyi sne 'khrid byed pa'i dpe/

chu rlangs grang mo chags shing zil bur gyur te gnam nas mar 'bab pa'i thigs pa/ zhod char/ sbrang char/ drag char/ zim char/ char pa bab tshad/ char pas gos bngas pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mkha' las bab dang, gru char, dgung char, rgyun bab, chu'i sa bon, sprin gyi me tog sprin bcud, sbrang char, rlung gi 'bras bu, lo tog gnyen bcas so,
char pa chu'i grogs po'm, chu yar 'phel ba'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba ste gcig grogs gcig phan gyi dpe/ zhing 'brog phan tshun brje tshong byas na char pa chu grogs bzhin du phan thogs yong/
char pa 'bab rgyu yod pa'i sprin/
1) char pa 'bab par byed pa/ 2) (mngon) brgya byin/
mtshan mo char sprin 'thibs pa'i mun pa nag po/
char rgyun/ char zhod chen po/ char zhod dkon po/ char zhod snyoms po/
'jam char zim po'am char sim yang zer/ char zim bu si li lir bab nas gyon gos bangs pa/ char zim rlung 'jam/
zim char ram 'jam char/ char zim zim zhig bab nas lo tog tshang ma snum thing thing byas 'dug /
char bab pa'i zil pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyun gyi myu gu dang, char gyi zegs ma, char rdul, chu rdul, chu yi zegs ma, chu yi zer bcas so,
char pas mi 'bong ba byas nas g.yol ba/ rgan mo zhig gi khyim du gnas tshang g.yar te char yib byas/
char pa dang lhags rlung/ char rlung drag 'tshub/
char skyob sle'u'am phyar ba/ char gse ba, (rnying) cha shas sam dum bur gshags pa/
char pa dang lhags pa/ mdang dgong char lhags kyi 'ur sgra che bas gnyid khug ma byung/ char lhags bkag pa/
chu rlabs 'phyur skad lta bu sgra'i khyad par zhig / chu brag 'thab sar rba rlabs kyi chal sgra rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa/
1) sgra'i khyad par zhig / mdang dgong mtshan la char pa chal chal gyi sgra dang bcas te babs pa/ 2) rba rlabs sam, chu khol gyen 'phyur gyi sgra/
chal li chil li'i bsdus tshig
chal le chol le'i bsdus tshig
chu'i rba rlabs chal chil brdab pa/ chu rlung 'thab pas rba rlabs chal brdab byed pa
snyoms po dang, thang ma/ thang chen steng du kha ba chal mar khyab 'dug / sa lud chal mar rgyag pa/ me tog chal mar bkram pa/

1) chu'i rba rlabs cher g.yo stangs/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng chal li chil lir langs pa/ rba rlabs chal li chil li 'phyur ba/ 2) zhod char chen po bab tshul/ char pa chal li chil lir bab pa/ 3) char pa 'bab pa sogs kyi khyad par zhig / char pa chal chil rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab/

1) yang dag min pa'i rnam pa/ gtam chal le chol le la snying po med/ las don chal chol min par dngos gtsang byed pa/ 2) bzang ngan sna tshogs 'dres pa'i rnam pa/ bsam tshul chal le chol le sre sre gtong ba/ 3) rig shes mi brtan pa/ kho ni smyon pa bzhin du ci dran 'di dran med pa'i sems chal le chol le zhig red/

/ 1) gos rgyan cha lugs/ pho chas/ bu mo'i chas su zhugs pa/ bod chas/ mo chas/ dmag chas/ grwa chas/ mi rigs so so'i chas ka mi 'dra/ bud med skyes pa'i chas su 'jug pa/ 2) rgyu cha dang yo byad/ lto chas/ 'tsho chas/ mkho chas/ bag mar rdzong chas/ mgar chas/ zhing chas/ 3) phyugs zog gso byed 'bru rigs sogs/ phag chas/ 'do phrug rta pho chas kyis gsos/
(yul) ba phyugs sogs lto ster snod
zhabs bro sogs 'khrab dus chas gyon sa'i gur/
(tha mi dad pa) 'gro ba/ yul gzhan du chas pa/ na nas 'chi khar chas/ tshong la chas/
cha lugs spras pa/ zlos gar gyi chas zhugs pa rnams sdings cha'i steng du yong ba/
gzhan la gzab mchor spras rogs byed mkhan nam, mdzes chos byed rogs kyi mi/
phyi 'jug gi nang gses shig ste, slob ma la byin gyis brlabs pa'i gos dmar po sogs smad g.yogs gsol, stod g.yogs dgab, gtsug tor bskon pa'o/
1) shing 'bras shig / 2) ma nu rta skam ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas bad kan smug ser dang, reg dug sogs la phan/
char chen 'bab tshul dang dri ma 'tshub tshul/ char pa chi li lir 'bab pa/ me tog gi dri ma chi li lir bro ba/
/ 1) rkyang pa/ brgya kha chig chod/ 2) gcig dang mtshungs/ gcig / chig brgya/ chig stong/ chig khri/
gcig pu'i rang tshugs/ las 'gan chig rkya bar sgrub pa/ 'tsho ba chig rkya bar skyel thub pa/
gcig pu'am gcig rkyang/ rang nyid chig rkyang 'gro ba/ las rigs chig rkyang/ khyim tshang nang la chig rkyang du sdod pa/
gcig pur skyes pa'i rtswa shing/
thags kyi rgyu gcig la spun gnyis re yod pa/
1) shog bu sogs kher rkyang re hril por sgril ba/ 2) khag mang phyogs gcig tu sdud pa/ stobs shugs chig sgril/ bsam 'char chig sgril/
mi re kho nar rim brgyud/ gdams ngag chig brgyud/
gcad bya mang po gcod byed gcig gis chod pa/ bcu go chig chod/ bsam tshul mang bas brgya kha chig chod mi thub pa/ lo tog lung pa gang la zor ba gcig gis chig chod byed thub bam/
gcig pus phan thogs pa dang, rang rkya 'pher ba/ sman dkar po chig thub/ srog shing chig thub/ kher rkyang gis chig thub mi yong/
gcig tu sdum pa/ bsam tshul chig 'dril/ chu rgyun mang po rgya mtshor chig 'dril/ mi rnams bsam pa chig 'dril yong ba'i thabs gal che/
rang tshugs 'dzin thub pa/ chig tshugs thub pa'i snying stobs yod/
gros rogs gzhan med par rang gcig pur gtam smra ba/ rang la rang gis skul lcag gtong ba'i chig lab byed/ smyon pa'i chig lab/
yi ge'i shad``,'' ? 'di lta bu'i ming ste, tshig lhug gi ming mtshams dang, tshig mtshams, tshigs bcad kyi rkang mthar rjes 'jug ga yig yod sar 'bri rgyu'i chig shad

1.'ching ba'i skul tshig 2. 1) kha dan gyi yi ge/ zhi chings/ tshong chings/ chings bzhag rgyal khab/ chings 'grig pa/ 2) sa bcad dam don gyi 'gag mdo dril ba'i sdom tshig / spyi chings/ dmag don gyi chings/
gzhung chen klog skabs kyi chings lnga ste, khog dbub stong thun gyi chings dang, sa bcad rnam 'byed kyi chings, 'brel pa 'bru 'grel gyi chings, bsdus don gyi chings, lag len man ngag gi chings/
mdong mo sogs kyi phyi rol gyi sked pa dang mgo mjug nas dam por sdom byed lcags shan sogs/ zom chings/ smyug chings/ mdong mo'i sked chings/ sam ta'i sked chings/ dung rgya gling gi sked chings/
kha dan bzhag pa'i yi ge:/ rgyal khab phan tshun chings yig la ming rtags 'god pa/
dkar po'i rnam pa mtshon tshul zhig / me tog dkar pos skya chib chib tu gang 'dug /
(yul) rta zhon sa dang 'bab sa'i stegs bu
'gro 'ong byed pa'i zhe sa/ gzigs skor du chibs bskyod gnang ba/
rta kha/ mi bgres song gi chibs kha khrid pa/
khye'u rta kha lo sgyur thub tshod du slebs pa/
rta sga'am bzhon sga/ phebs rdog ma thon gong nas chibs sga sgron pa/
rkang thang ngam rta thog nas 'gro ba'i zhe tshig / da nangs nas chibs bsgyur gnang song/ da chibs bsgyur gnang rogs/
'u lag sngar t'a la'i bla ma'i rta drel sogs la ster rgyu'i sran chag skyel 'dren byed pa'i 'u lag cig / chibs chas sga dang srab rmed sogs rta chas, ..
mi chen gyi bzhon rta'i zhe sa/
bla ma'i rta mgor rgyag rgyu'i tog /
sngar t'a la'i bla ma chibs bsgyur skabs rta thog tu dar cha 'khur mkhan/
bzhon pa'i zhe sa/ chibs pa bcibs pa/ chibs pa'i thog nas bshol ba/ chibs pa 'chag sa/
rta drel gyi las ka byed mkhan gtso bo/
1) rta zhon stangs sbyangs pa/ 2) rta la 'gros slob pa/
sngar t'a la'i bla ma'i chibs bsgyur dngos gzhi'i snga nyin tshod lta gra sgrig gi chibs sbyong byed pa/
chibs bsgyur skabs kyi zhabs phyi/ chibs bsgyur skabs chibs zhabs su bcar ba yin/
sngar dga' ldan dgon pa'i mtho rim sku drag rnams la mi ser gyis rta khral re mos kyis gtong ba/
1) bzhon pa btang nas bsu ba/ 2) rta bzhon nas bsu bar 'gro ba/
