1) deng skabs dus tshod 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig ste nyin mtshan gcig gi dus tshod cha nyi shu rtsa bzhir bgos pa'i cha re'i ming/ 2) deng skabs dus tshod brtag byed 'phrul bzos kyi 'khor lo/ chu tshod sgrig pa/ 3) sngar rgya gar du dus tshod 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig ste nyin mtshan gcig gi dus yun cha drug cur bgos pa'i cha re'i ming yin pa de'i yun tshad deng skabs kyi chu tshod skar ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang mtshungs/
sngar dus tshod 'dzin byed bu ga yod pa'i chu snod cig /
1) phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po/ 2) mis bzos chu rdzing chen po/
(mngon) 1) sprin/ 2) bha ga ste mo mtshan/
rgyun du chu bskyil ba'i 'bras zhing/
chu ni dpangs dang, zheng ni kha zheng ngam kha rgya/ chu zheng mnyam pa/
'phred gzhung mnyam pa/ sku gzugs chu zheng gab pa/ gyon gos chu zheng gab pa/ 'dzin chas bzo dbyibs chu zheng gab pa/
rma chu, rgyal mo rngul chu, zla chu ste chu bzhi dang, zla mo sgang, tsha ba sgang, smar khams sgang, spo 'bor sgang, dmar rdza sgang, mi nyag rab sgang ste sgang drug / ..
chu'i zil pa'am thigs pa/ rtswa rtser chu zil chags pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu thigs dang, chu 'thor, nyar ma, dba' rlabs skyes bcas so,
chu blug snod kyi zo ba/
1) chu nang gi zla gzugs/ 2) snang la rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i dpe/
shing las bzos pa'i chu 'chu byed kyi skyogs/
1) mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs hu'u kru'u hor rigs rang skyong rdzong gi dgon pa zhig / 2) lha sa'i nye 'gram stod lung bde chen rdzong khongs chu bzang dgon pa/
mi'i lus por 'phrod pa'i chu/ khu byug gis skad sgrog mtshams nas chu bzang du 'gro/
chu dang 'o ma ro gcig tu gyur pa ste, phan tshun dbye rgyu med pa'i dpe/
chus gang ba'i sa shur/ mkhar srung chu 'obs/
bsil ba dang, zhim pa, yang ba, 'jam pa, dwangs pa, dri ma med pa, lto la mi gnod pa, mgrin pa la mi gnod pa bcas yon tan sna brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu bzang/
chu yi rba 'og tu lus bzed pa'am chu bsil snod du blugs te dugs rgyag pa sogs kyis mkhris nad sel ba'i dpyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
1) chu skyor byed kyi ra ba/ 2) chu ra ma dang don gcig
lcags zangs rdza sogs las bzos pa'i chu gsog snod/
chu 'gog byed kyi rags sam rtsig pa/
sngar chu rags rgyag mkhan gyi 'ul mi gtong: dgos pa'i khral zhig /
ma bskul dang len gyi dpe/ chu rang 'khol ltar rang 'gul gyis zhabs 'degs zhu ba/
gtsang po 'phred la brgal nas 'gro sa'i rab lam/
chu la zhugs skabs gyon rgyu'i smad g.yogs/
btung ba'i chu la rigs mi 'dra ba bdun te, char chu dang, gangs chu, chu klung gi chu, chu mig gi chu, khron pa'i chu, ba tshwa can gyi chu, shing gi rtsa ba las 'bab pa'i chu bcas so/
1) gos chen chu ris can/ 2) kha btags zub she chu ris ma/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste: ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas 'bam grum gyi nad chu rgyus la zhugs pa dang, dri chu 'gags pa la phan/
chu'i rba rlabs/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu'i rba rlabs dang, gnyer ma, mtshar g.yo, rlabs bcas so,
chu bo nas kha gyes pa'i chu phran
1) gcin lam/ 2) chu 'gro'i lam/ grong khyer nang gi sa 'og chu lam bshangs zin pa/
(mngon) nam mkha'i thog gam gnam lcags/
rang byung gi chu tshan nam bdud rtsi lnga'i sman gyi lums lta bu'i nang zhugs nas, yan lag zha rengs sogs la phan par byed pa'i thabs shig /
1) chu rtsa'i lo ma, tha mag gi tshab tu gtong srol yod/ 2) chu rtsa'i lo ma ste ro skyur, nus pas rma gso ba dang, tshod mas bad kan sel zhing dang ga 'byed par byed/
shwa 'od dam glo bur du rgyas pa'i chu chen po/ chu log gang sar rgyug pa/
'bras bu thengs gcig skyes rjes skam pa'i shing zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la glang po'i lcug ma dang, rgyud rnams 'dzin, 'chi 'bras can, nad kyi 'bras can, mdzod lus, shing 'dzin bcas so,
(yul) lus la thon pa'i chu gang ngam chu bur/
chu rgyun 'bab pa'i shugs/ chu shugs glog 'don/ chu shugs thon khungs/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer gyi lho nub ngos skyid chu dang yar klungs gtsang po gnyis 'dzoms sa der yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de zhol grong du yod/
rdo las byung ba'i dwangs shel/ ming gi rnam grangs la nor bu dkar po dang, 'bus nas 'dzag man shel, mig la phan, zla ba'i nor bu, bsil ba'i char ldan bcas so,
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma tshad dang, mes tshig pa'i rma'i tsha dbal sogs 'joms/
shwa 'od de glo bur rdol ba'i chu drag po/
chu yod pa'i sa gshong bu/
chus dri ma bkrus pa/ shel dam chu bshal btang ba/ dkar yol chu bshal gtong ba/ aa cor chu bshal byed pa/
chu blugs nas 'tshag pa/ 'bras chu sing rgyag pa/ bye ma chu sing rgyag pa/ chu sing byas nas lhad 'don pa/
(yul) mi sogs chu'i nang dbugs sub gtong ba/

tshigs mig dang sha pags bar sogs su gnas pa'i khrag gi snyigs ma dang, mkhris pa'i dwangs ma las byung ba'i mdog dmar ser chu ltar sla la 'byar bag gi rtsi dang ldan pa de la zer te, de 'phel zad du gyur na chu ser gyi nad du 'gyur ba yin
bad rlung grang ba shas che ba'i chu ser gyi nad cig ste, nad rtags su lus g.ya' zhing tshigs mtshams bye ba dang, pags pa'i steng shu thor lta bu rma 'byung ba zhig /
skya rbab rigs lnga'i nang tshan chu ser shas che ba'i skya rbab ste, nad rtags su lus g.yo zhing pags par za phrug lang ba zhig /
long tshigs nas ngar gdong ngos su tshon do gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na chu ser gyi nad dang, pags nad za phrug rma rgan sogs la phan/

chu ser dkar nag gi nad gnyis las khrag mkhris shas che ba'i nad cig ste, nad rtags su pags mdog nag la za phrug lang ba dang, skra dang smar smin byi ba, tshabs che ba mdze nad du 'gyur ba'ang gsungs/
lag ngar rgyab phyogs nas zur du gyes pa'i yal ga gnyis pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na chu ser gyi nad dang, pad nad za phrug gi rigs, mchu nad sogs la phan/
1) pho mo'i gcin lam gyi rtse mo/ 2) lte ba'i 'og tsam gyi nye 'khor/
chu sogs kyi sde tshan bcu

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bcu tshan lnga pa chu dang sogs kyi sde tshan la, srog chags ldan pa'i chur longs spyod pa'i ltung byed dang, nyal po byed pa'i khyim du gnas pa'i ltung byed dang, nyal po byed pa'i khyim du 'greng ba'i ltung byed dang, gcer bu pa la zas sbyin pa'i ltung byed dang, dmag la lta ba'i ltung byed dang, dmag gi nang du gnas pa'i ltung byed dang, dmag gi ru bkod byed pa'i ltung byed dang, brdeg pa'i ltung byed dang, brdeg par gzas pa'i ltung byed dang, gnas ngan len 'chab pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/
chu tshod cha drug cur phye ba'i cha re la chu srang, chu srang rer dbugs drug /
srog chags sram gyi bye brag cig /
gcin pa nyung ngu tsam las mi 'bab par gyur pa'i don/
(mkor) rgya mtsho chen po'i chu srin/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun 'joms dang, rgya mtsho'i kham zas can, chu'i srin po, nya mid che, na kra, 'dzin khri, ral gri'i so can bcas so,
khyim bcu pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar gnas nyi shu dang chu tshod bco lnga shar skabs nyi ma chu srin khyim la gnas, ming don khyim bcu gnyis kyi thad na gsal/
nyi ma chu srin khyim du slebs dus te hor zla bcu gnyis pa/
snron zla ba la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs las chu srin gyi zla ba zer/
gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs zur rgyan/
(mngon) 1) chu gter te rgya mtsho/ 2) 'dod pa'i lha/
(mngon) rgya mtsho/ 2) bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gi ming/
srog chags sman gyi nang tshan na gi yang zer ba'i nya khrab can gyi phyi skogs sen mo lta bu de'i ming ste, nus pas rus pa la zhugs pa'i tsha ba sel/
nyi ma mi phog pa'i srib ri'i phyogs/
chu 'gram/ de'i nub mo chu srol zhig tu thang brang btab nas bzhugs/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud dang yar klungs gtsang po'i lho ngos su yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de ae lha rgya ri ru yod/
1) rdzing sogs su chu bskyil ba/ 2) khog chu bsags pa'i nad/
chu bo'i khar gtong ba'i bsangs/

1) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 2) nub kyi phyogs skyong/ ming gi rnam grangs la mchog sbyin dang, lce brgya pa, chu skyes dbang po, chu bdag mchog sems, thags pa can, nub kyi phyogs skyong, lha min lha bcas so,
sgo nas lhog rigs la bzhir dbye ba'i nang tshan mes: tshig pa ltar gyi thor pa du ma 'byung ba zhig /
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'jug pa'i skul tshig
che ba min pa chung chung gi rigs sam gras/ mi sna chung gras/ phru gu chung gras/ phogs thob chung gras/
chung dus nas 'grogs pa'i grogs po/
gzhon nu'i rtse grogs bud med/ chung ngu, shin tu chung chung/ skad chung ngu/ skyon cha chung ngu/ snying stobs chung ngu/ kho dang nga chung ngu nas mdza' ba/
chung ngu'i phyogs/ dka' ngal chung nge'i ngang nas las ka mang po tshar ba/
shin tu chung ba/ bu phrug chung chung/ las don chung chung/
ha cang chung drags pa/ khang pa ha cang chung ches pa/ na tshod chung ches pa/ stobs shugs chung ches pa/
bu dang bu mor lo na chung dus nas pha mas bsgrigs pa'i gnyen dan/ bu phrug pho mo chung gnyen sgrig pa/
chung shos dang, tha ma'am rjes ma/ phru gu chung tha yi mgo 'don byed pa/ spun zla chung tha/
lo na chung dus nas phan tshul 'dris te bsdebs pa'i bza' tshang/

/ 1) che ba'i ldog phyogs te nges can gyi tshad ma lon tsam/ slob grwa chung ba/ lo na chung ba/ gzhi rgya chung ba/ 2) nyung ba ste nges can gyi 'bor tshad ma lon tsam/ 'bor grangs chung ba/ 3) zhan pa/ 'khos bab chung ba/ char pa chung ba/ 4) dman pa/ skyes bu chung ba/ go gnas chung ba/
/ 1) khyo ga yod pa'i bud med/ 2) khyim 'dzin mkhan/ chung ma ma bsrungs pa/ chung ma'i spun/ 3) khyo ga gcig la skye dman rgan gzhon gnyis yod pa'i gzhon pa/
nyi zla'i cha chung ngu zhig sgra gcan gyis 'dzin tshul/
ra lug sogs phyugs rigs chung gras kyi sha/
chung tsam/ gzhon nu gzugs bong chung se ba zhig
byis pa chung ngu nas 'chi bar byed pa'i gdon nam sri/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) tshud pa/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gi 'og tu chud pa/ dmag gras su chud pa/ gral du chud pa/ 2) rtogs pa'am shes pa/ gnad don tshang ma khong du chud pa/ dngos yod gnas lugs khong du chud par dka' ba/ 3) shong ba/ shog sgam 'di'i nang du tshang ma chud pa/ gru gzings nang du ma chud pa/ 2. (rnying) zhing pa/
chud gzon pa dang don gcig
don med 'phro brlag tu 'gyur ba/ dngos po chud za ba/ re ba chud za ba/ long bar zhu mar spar ba de, zhu snum chud du za ba yin/
'phro brlag / dus tshod chud gzon pa mi legs/ gzhung gi rgyu dngos rnams chud mi gzon pa byed dgos/
'phro brlag tu song ba/ gzha' tshan phog pas dngos zog chud gson pa/ sad ser btsa' than bcas byung nas lo tog chud gson pa/
(yul) btsas ma brngas te tshar mar sked 'ching rgyag pa'am chun po sdom pa/
chag pa'am bam po/ me tog gi chun po/ rtswa'i chun po/ lo tog gi chun po/ me shing gi chun po/ btsong gi chun po/
bza' zla bud med gnyis yod pa'i nang nas gzhon pa/
gser gyi gtsug phud ces pa'i bya zhig /
(tha mi dad pa) mthar phyin par rtogs pa'am shes pa/ khong du chub pa/ byang chub pa/ gting zab tu chub pa/ dmag jus khog tu chub pa/
(tha mi dad pa) bag 'khums pa/ 'jigs chum/ 'dar chum pa/
(rnying) 1) 'dod pa dang, chags pa/ 2) bsdus pa/

mngon pa mdzod las bshad pa ltar rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nam mkha' la sprin gser gyi snying po can zhes bya ba 'khrigs pa las char gyi rgyun lo mang por bab pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor chags te rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu yod pa'o
nad pa'i dri chur brtag skabs gcin pa'i khar chags pa'i 'o ma'i kha spris dang 'dra ba'i dngos po zhig ste, kha dog dang, srab mthug sna tshogs 'byung ba zhig /
gcur ba dang 'jur ba'i skul tshig
(yul) ri 'gar skye ba'i skyur zas sdong chung zhig
(yul) shong ba/ sgam khog pa che bas ca lag thams cad chur ba/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, rgod bag gi bsam pas lus phyed nub pa'i chu la rtse ba'o/

1. 'chu ba'i skul tshig 2./ 1) thabs tshul te jus dang don gcig / jus...dmag chus/ tshong chus/ 'tsho chus/ rang gzhan gnyis phan gyi chus/ 2) (rgya) dbye mtshams nges can zhig gi nang du yod pa'i sa khul/
rang nyid yongs su pham yang ma pham snyam pa'i dpe/
'jig bskal gyi skabs su bsam gtan gsum pa yan la chu 'jig mi 'byung bas rtse mo zer
par shing rko skabs yi ge'i bar gyi sa stong che ba rko byed/
/ grong khyer che khag / las don che khag
mdzo glang sogs phyugs rid che gras kyi: sha khog /
mi'i ming gi tshab/ yul ga ge mo zhig na gang zag che ge mo zhig gis sgrung bshad pa/
che ba'i rigs/ yon tan che gras/ las don che gras/ gnad 'gag che gras/
che gras yod tshad dang, mtho ba yod tshad/ mi che dgu/ lha che dgu/ dpon rigs che dgu/ skye bo che dgu/
khengs dregs che ba'i rnam 'gyur/ che 'gying gi nyams ston pa/

1) gang thub ci nus/ ca lag rnams sgam nang che 'gro chung 'gro bsdu gsog byed pa/ dpe cha pod gcig po de ring klog thub min ma nges kyang che 'gro chung 'gro byas nas 'don yong/ 2) thub tshod kyis dbang yod byed pa/ mi 'di nyam chung ba'i thog la che 'gro chung 'gro byed mkhan zhig red/
rgyal rigs sogs las chad pa'i mi rgyud/

che ba dang chung ba'i bsdus tshig / go gnas che chung/ dbang cha che chung/ khang pa che chung/ myur tshad che chung/ byas nyes che chung/ dgon pa sgrig med kyi dung de phu shugs che chung dang, khyim tshang sgrig med kyi 'khrug pa de kha rtsal che chung/
che rigs sam che gras/ dka' tshegs che che 'dra yang sel thub/ las 'gan che che chung chung gang yang 'khur dgos/
che drags pa/ bstod ra gtong shugs che ches pa/ 'ud shob che ches pa/
che ba'i mchog tu gyur pa
che ba brjod pa'am, bsngags brjod/ khong gi yon tan la che brjod byed pa/ byas rjes med mkhan la che brjod mi byed/
'gying nyams te nga rgyal gyi stangs ka/ yar rgyas yong phyir che nyams spangs pa/
che thag che ba'am che shos
/ khong bu spun rnams kyi che thag de yin/
1) go gnas che 'dod byed pa/ 2) che nyams byed 'dod pa/ kun dang mi mthun pa'i rang mthong che 'dod byed pa/
1) che 'don bsngags brjod/ 2) khri 'don/ rgyal po'i che 'don/
che ba dang chung ba'i bsdus tshig / las don che phra tshang ma thag gcod dgos/

/ 1) chung ba'i ldog phyogs dang 'char can gyi tshad las 'das pa/ shas che ba/ blo khog che ba/ don gnad gal che ba/ sa cha rgya khyon che ba/ ngal rtsol gyi sems shud che ba/ lo re nas lo re thon skyed 'phar che ba/ nad pa'i skrang pa snga las che ba 'dug / go sa che ba/ shes rab che ba/ mthong rgya che ba/ 2) rgan pa/ jo jo che ba/ bu che ba/
bdag ni pha rol po dang kun nas mtshungs shing 'dra na'ang sna 'ga' zhig gis bdag che'o snyam du sems pa/
rigs bzang ba dang, gzugs bzang ba, gnyen 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa, 'byor ba che ba, dbang thang che ba, shes rab che ba, lus stobs dang ldan pa bcas bdun no/
che tshad chung tshad gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa/
(yul) shing bzo ba dang rdo bzo ba sogs kyi las ka'i slob dpon nam dge rgan/ shing bzo che mo ba/
mi chen dbang btsan/ che btsan ltag khur gyis gzhan la brnyas bcos byed pa/ che btsan phrag khur/
che nyams/ yon tan slob par che tshugs spangs te slob dpon bsten/
sring mo rgan pa'am gcen mo/
che bzhag chung bshol dang don gcig

'char can gyi las don tshang ma bzhag nas las don 'phar ma zhig gal cher 'dzin pa che bzhag chung bskyur yang zer/ dmigs bsal gyi bya ba 'di thon pas las don gzhan rnams che bzhag chung bshol gyis mtha' gcig tu sgrub dgos/ sang nyin las don che bzhag chung bskyur gyis tshogs 'dur bskyod dgos/
bden rdzun 'byed pa'i dpang po'i ming/ che bzhi med na'ang bden rdzun dkar nag gi thag chod thub pa/
rags pa'am gtso che ba/ nyes skyon che rim nas bkag na 'gog sla, yon tan chung rim nas bslabs na lobs skyen/
rags pa/ go ba che long tsam las len mi thub pa/ gsung rtsom nang nas che long tsam bsdus pa/
che ba'i zhor la chung ba khrid pa/ che shul chung khrid kyis bgo bsha' rgyag dgos/
dngos rigs kyi snang gzugs che ru gtong thub pa'i shel/
1) mtho ba'i phyogs sam go sa mtho ba/ 2) che ba'i gras/
che tsam/ shes bya che se ba/

1. dgos pa'i phyir ram slad/ ci'i ched/ de'i ched/ mi dmangs kyi ched du zhabs 'degs zhu/ thams cad mes rgyal srung ba'i ched du yin/ 2. dmigs bkar dang, rkang btsugs/ ched phan sman rigs/ ched gnyer/ ched spyod gnam gru/ 'di gar ched du yong ba/ rnyog gra ched bzo/
1) ched mngags kyi las don/ 2) rnam dbye bzhi pa/
1) ched du gtong ba/ las ka 'di'i skor la ched mngags kyi mi yod/ 2) dmigs su bkar ba/ ched mngags gdan zhus sku tshab/
ched du dmigs nas bshad pa'am dmigs su bkar nas bshad pa/
dmigs bkar/ ched gtad du kha lan gtong ba/ ched gtad kyis 'phral du thag gcod byas pa/ ched gtad las 'gan gzab nan gyis byed dgos/

(aud'inam) gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, gang zag 'ga' zhig gi phyir gsung ba min par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du bzhag pa'i phyir gzhan gyis ma bskul bar thugs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis ched du gsungs pa'o/

sangs rgyas kyis thor bur gsungs pa rnams dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la bam po bzhi dang mi rtag pa'i tshoms nas bram ze'i tshoms kyi bar du le'u sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa zhig /
1) thun mong ma yin pa'i dmid yul can gyi bsgrub bya/ dus gcig la las ched du bya ba mang po byed mi rung/ 2) rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched/
rkang btsugs nas brjod pa'i don te, sngar gzhung yig gong nas 'og la btang ba'i bka' shog sogs kyi 'gor 'god pa'i tshig cig / sa gnas las byed thun mong la, ched don/
ched du 'bul ba ste gtong yig gi 'gor 'god pa'i tshig cig / 'thus mi lhan 'dzoms kyi drung du, ched 'bul/
ched mngags dmigs su bkar ba/
dmigs bkar gyis gsar 'dzugs byas pa/ so pa ched btsugs/ ched btsugs las khungs/
ched gnyer gyis zhib dpyod mtha' gsal/
ched du smra ba/ tshogs 'du lhan rgyas kyi snyan lam du, ched zhu/
ched mngags gsar skrun byas pa/
ched gtad dam ched du/ gang mkho'i yo byad ched sor bzos pa/
khyim bdag chen ma dang chung ma/
mna' ma snga ma dang phyi ma/

chung ngu'i ldog phyogs spyir btang ngam 'char can gyi tshad las 'das pa/ mnga' thang chen po/ yon tan chen po/ yul gru rgya chen po/ gal chen po/ chen po'i chen po/ chen po'i 'bring/ chen po'i yang chen po/
nam mkha'i khyad chos lnga ste gzugs med dang, thogs pa med pa, rtag pa, mi 'gyur ba, mi 'pho ba bcas lnga'o/
stong nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gsum dang bcud kyi 'jig rten rgyud lngar skyes pa mang zhing rgya che ba de dag ni stong pa nyid do

dmigs pa chen po dang, sgrub pa chen po, ye shes chen po, brtson 'grus rtsom pa chen po, thabs la mkhas pa chen po, yang dag sgrub pa chen po, phrin las chen po ste 'di rnams dang ldan na theg pa chen po'o/
khyo ga gcig la skye dman gnyis yod pa'i sngon ma/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chen rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig /
1) 'od 'tsher tshul/ skar ma'i 'od chem chem/ 2) g.yo 'gul byed stangs/ sa chem chem du g.yo ba/ 3) sgra grag stangs/ rol mo'i sgra chem chem du dkrol ba/
'od dang sgra 'byin tshul/ sgra 'ur chem me ba/ 'od dmar chem me ba/
so sor kha gyes skabs su mngags bcol byas pa'i gtam mam lan/ chems bzhag pa/ kha chems/
sgra chem mer sgrog nyams kyi rjod tshul/ rol mo mang po'i sgra skad chems se chem/

ha cang ngam shin tu/ ches mtho/ ches mang ba/ stobs shugs ches che ba/ ches stobs chung ba/ ches mchog tu gyur pa/ ches myur ba/ ches gsang ba/ ches khyad par du 'phags pa/ ches yid du 'ong ba/ ston mo ches gya nom pa zhig bshams pa/ glog zhu'i 'od ches gsal ba/ bslab pa ches cher rgan pa/ nad kyis yun ring mnar ba'i mi kho'i gdong gi kha stabs sngar las ches rgas par gyur 'dug /
(tha mi dad pa) blo 'khel ba/ mang tshogs kyis yid ches pa/
(yul) snying po'am 'bras bu/ las ka der cho mi 'dug / gtam cho yod pa la nyon, cho med pa'i bya ba ma byed/ kho tsho'i bzo cho gang la brtat kyang tha chad ngan sdug kho na 'dug

las don sgrub thabs dang, bya ba byed stangs sam, go rim/ sman bcos kyi cho ga / mchod pa'i cho ga / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga:/ cho ga nyams pa/ ji ltar cho ga ltar byed pa/ cho ga'i spyi chings/ dga' ston gyi cho ga / bgod pa'i don ni bgod byed kyi, grangs su sdud pa'i cho ga yin/ cho ga 'di yis 'khrul med shes/
lha bskyed pa'i tshul zhig ste, pad nyi la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du lha'i sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las lha'i sku rdzogs par bskyed pa/

smre sngags te sdug skad dang 'o dod 'bod bzhin du ngu ba/ mya ngan ma bzod par cho nge 'bod pa/ sems sdug chen pos cho nge 'debs pa/ cho nge bton nas skad 'gags pa/ snga dus srang lam zhig na dwa phrug mang pos cho nge 'don bzhin du phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu ba/
ngu ba'am mya ngan gyi 'bod skad/ sems sdug yi mug gis cho nge 'o dod 'bod pa/
(yul) bab la bltas pa/ gnas tshul la cho bltas nas las ka byed dgos/
rdzu 'phrul te lus sems kyi shin sbyangs la brten nas skyes pa'i sprul pa'i nus shugs/ rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul/ cho 'phrul yin nam dngos yin snyam/
hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga/

mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i glegs bam ca pa'i nang yod pa'i 'phags pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa, shlo ka dgu brgya pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra sogs dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/

khyad par can gyi dus chen bzhi'i nang gses, hor zla dang po, mchu zla'am rta zla'i yar tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar ni, bdud dang mu stegs can la sogs pa cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas tshar bcad pas cho 'phrul chen po'i dus zhes bya'o/

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mnyan yod dze t'a'i tshal du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa phyogs rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'am zlum po bang rim bzhi pa pad 'dab can no/ ..
rje tsong kha pas rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba ste zla ba dang por lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du btsugs pa'i smon lam chen mo'i mchod pa/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa bzhi ste, ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul dang, byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul, dbang bskur ba'i cho 'phrul, mchod pa'i cho 'phrul te bzhi'o/
bod lugs kyi zla ba dang po ste spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo grangs lnga brgya bcu gcig lor sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pas cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas mu stegs pa rnams btul ba'i zla ba'o/

sangs rgyas kyis gdul byar 'phrin las mdzad pa bstan pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul te sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang, gsung kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul, thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul te gsum/
(yul) bzo lta'am gnas tshul/ stobs shugs che chung gi cho bab/ shes yon gyi cho bab la bltas te las 'gan dkri lugs byed dgos/
pha ma'i rus sam rigs/ cho rigs bzang po/ cho rigs dma' ba/
sho ngos kyi ri mo thig le/
mngon tshul zhig / ri mgo tshang mar kha ba skya cho le ba zhig bab 'dug / mi de'i skra lo skya cho le ba zhig 'dug

1) sho ste, rgyan bzhag nas rgyal pham rtse ba'i rtsed mo zhig / mi mang po 'dus nas cho lo 'gyed pa/ thob shor 'byed pa'i ched du cho lo 'gyed pa/ cho los rtse ba/ 2) sngar gong mas sprad pa'i go thob cig / cho lo 'ja' sa/ 3) sngo cho lo ma, tha mag gi tshab tu gtong rgyu dang tshos gzhi ser po byed rgyu zhig /
sho rtsed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyan po mkhan dang, rgyan po ba, cho lo mkhan, cho lo rtse mkhan, sho 'byed pa, sho rtsed pa bcas so,
1. gcog pa'i skul tshig 2. cho ga'i bsdus ming
rung rung ngam 'grig 'grig / gra sgrig tshar nas 'gro chog chog yin/ kha lag za chog chog yod
byed chog pa'i bka' mchan/ phyin chog pa'i chog mchan bkod pa/ rim pa gong ma nas chog mchan zhu ba/ da dung chog mchan gnang ma byung/
bya rung ngam byas 'thus/ chog 'thus dgongs 'khrol byung/

1. (tha mi dad pa) long ba dang, ldang ba/ da res las grwar bskongs pa'i mi grangs mang nyung de tsam gyis chog pa 'dug / gong gsal de dag gis chog / 2. tshim pa'i ming/ da yod grub 'bras 'di tsam zhig gis chog par mi 'dzin pa/ 3. rung ba dang, 'grig pa/ khyed kyi 'phrin bskur rgyu'i thad ngas mi gcig btang chog pa zhu/ ji ltar byas chog dang mi chog pa'i dgongs skor zhu ba/ bsam 'char bshad chog / skad log brgyab mi chog / khyed la las rogs ngas zhus chog / chu 'di 'thung chog dang mi chog sus shes/ 'di gar gad snyigs bshos mi chog
cho ga byed pa'i rogs pa'am grogs/
'dod pa chung ba'am 'dod pa gang sla ba/ 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa/ chog shes med pa/ chog mi shes pa'i brtson 'grus/
1. gcod pa'i skul tshig 2./ 1) bar gyi gru chod bcad/ shing chod dra mig can/ so phag gi chod/ pang leb kyis chod rgyag pa/ 2) phyod dam rlabs/ sa chod che ba/ las chod chung ba/
kha mchu 'grig pa'i kha chad yig cha/
(tha mi dad pa) bar mtshams chod pa/ lung pa phan tshun ri klung gis bar du chod pa/ le dbar khri phrag gis chod pa/ kha bas 'gro lam chod pa/ 'brel thag rbad de chod pa/
(yul) zhing la chu gtong ched khag chung ngu byas pa'i khag re'i ming/
'dum 'grig byung ba'i yi ge :/ dmag mtshams 'jog rgyu'i chod yig /
kha dan gyi gan rgya 'ba' can nam 'ba' bzhag pa'i chod yig /
/ 1) gos kyi sgab gsham mam mtha'/ phyi chon/ nang chon/ 2) gur gyi zur ram mtha'/
(yul) sbra 'bubs byed chon thag thung ba/
(yul) sbra 'bubs byed kyi chon thag ring ba/
sbra gur 'bubs byed kyi phyi yi thag pa
(yul) chon thag gi sne'i phur pa/
(yul) sbra 'bubs byed kyi chon thag ring tshad bar ma/
zas za ba dang snod du chu sogs blug pa'i sgra lta bu/ shing 'bras btogs nas chob chob ces zhim mdog kha por za ba/
1. 'joms pa'i skul tshig 2. 'ur sgra'i khyad par zhig / g.yul sa nas me sgyogs kyi skad chen 'ur chom sgrog pa/
jag pa dang rkun ma/ chom rkun gyi nyen dogs/
(tha mi dad pa) thul ba/ dgra bcom nas chom pa/ tho ba chung ngus ngar lcags chen po chom par mi nus pa/
1. 'chol pa'i skul tshig 2. cho lo'i bsdus ming/ rus chol/ dung chol/ shing chol/
1) 'byung khungs sam dar sa'i gnas/ rta'i chol kha/ 2) tsho khag gam sde khag /
dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha, mdo stod mi'i chol kha, mdo smad rta'i chol kha ste gsum/
(rnying) 1) mchil snod/ 2) gcin snod/ 3) rkang lag 'khru snod/
tho re ba/ shing nags chol le ba zhig 'dug / kha spu chol le ba/

1. 'chos pa'i skul tshig 2./ 1) shes bya'am dngos po/ 2) lugs srol/ yul chos bzang po rnams sngar rgyun rang sor 'jags pa/ 3) (dharma) rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pa'i don no, dharma zhes don bcu la 'jug ste, 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos zhes pa lta bu shes bya la 'jug pa dang, lam bden gyi chos zhes pa lta bu lam dang, 'gog bden gyi chos zhes pa lta bu myang 'das dang chos kyi skye mched ces pa lta bu yid kyi yul dang, btsun mo'i 'khor dang gzhon nu rnams dang lhan cig tu chos spyod ces pa lta bu bsod nams dang, byis pa ni mthong ba'i chos la gces par 'dzin pa zhes pa lta bu tshe dang, chos 'dul ba zhes pa lta bu gsung rab dang, lus 'di rga ba'i chos yin no zhes pa lta bu 'byung 'gyur dang, dge sbyong gi chos bzhi zhes pa lta bu nges pa dang, lha chos dang mi chos zhes pa lta bu lugs la 'jug pa bcas bcu yod par rnam bshad rig pa las gsungs shing, da lta yongs grags su lugs dang gsung rab dang, shes bya bcas gsum la 'jug pa gtso che ba'o/
bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyi dbang du byas na, rdzogs ldan dang, gsum ldan, gnyis ldan, rtsod ldan bzhi la chos kyi rkang pa bzhi zhes grags/
phyi'i skye mched drug gi nang gses shig ste, chos kyi khams so/
chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs
yid kyi skye mched kyi yul du gyur pa'i gzugs, rdul phra rab dang rmi lam gyi gzugs lta bu'o/
chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs lnga
bsdus pa las gyur pa'i gzugs dang, mngon par skabs yod pa'i gzugs dang, yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i gzugs dang, kun btags pa'i gzugs dang, dbang 'byor pa'i gzugs te lnga'o/
khams bco brgyad kyi gras, tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po gsum dang, rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs dang, 'dus ma byas thams cad do/
sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa/
chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum
bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo gsum bskor ba'i bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dang, bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor, bka' tha ma legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bcas so/
'gyur byang med pa, mdo sde glegs bam sa pa'i nang bzhugs/

'phags pa chos kyi rgya mo bam po gnyis kyi bdag nyid can sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnas bshad pa le'u bcu pa ni rgya yig nas bsgyur te mdo sde glegs bam za pa'i nang du yod/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshab byas nas chos kyi 'khor lo skor mkhan/

brgyad khri bzhi stong: sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos yod do cog ste nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa, bka' sde snod gsum re re nas nyi khri chig stong re dang sde snod bzhi pa nyi khri chig stong bcas brtsis pas bsdoms na brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo/
chos la mnga' brnyes pa'i gang zag /
mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad ni dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/
chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam de kho na nyid/
'jig rten gyi chos kyi mchog ste sbyor lam gyi tha ma'am mthong lam thob la nye ba'i lam gyi mngon rtogs shig

dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa gang zhig dbang po rnon po gzhan gyis bstan pa la mi ltos par bdag nyid kyi rnam dpyod kyis bden pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bden pa mngon par rtogs par byed pa'o/

pan chen aer te ni sku phreng dgu pa 'di rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu lug lor dwags po ru sku bltams, sa byi lor gong ma kvang zhus bka' phab nas gser bum dkrugs te yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang zhing, chu 'brug lor gdan sa'i khri thog tu gdan 'dren zhus, rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug lor dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor ba'i phyi lo shing sbrul la rgya gar du byon, me rta lor gtsang du 'khor, chu phag lor byang thang brgyud pe cin dang, de nas byang shar dang, nang sog nan cin, hang kro'u, mtsho sngon sogs mes rgyal nang khul gyi sa gnas khag mang du phebs te bka' chos gnang, rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi skye dgu mdor g shegs/ ( 1883-1937)/ (1888...)/ (1892...)/ (1905)...)/ 1923...1925...1937 ..
1) gsung rab kyi don gnad snying po/ 2) stong nyid dang byang chub kyi sems/

ji srid 'tsho'i bar rtag tu srung dgos pa'i chos kyi bslab khrims lnga ste, srog gcod pa, ma byin par len pa, log par g.yem pa, rdzun smra ba, chang 'thung ba ste nyes spyod lnga spong ba'i tshul khrims lnga/
1) chos kyi mthu stobs/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
bdag med gnyis kyi ya gyal, gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'o/
bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi ya gyal, thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa'i dbang gis snang ba'i gzugs la sogs pa phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang rang gi mtshan nyid du bden par zhen pa'o/
phung po sogs bden par 'dzin pa'i blo lhan skyes/
sde bzhi'i nang gses shig mngon mtho nges legs kyi rgyu/
lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi ste, 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa, zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba, chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa, mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba ste bzhi'o/
chos kyi grangs 'dren te, 'gres rkang brgya rtsa brgyad lta bu/
gdams ngag ston par 'os pa'i slob ma/
spyan lnga'i nang gses shig ste rten 'brel rtogs pa'i ye shes/

byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i tha ma, sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo sprin lta bus sangs rgyas rnams las thob pa'i chos nam mkha' lta bu tshad med pa la khyab pas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o/
nyon mongs 'dul byed kyi gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs du ma ste, chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong lta bu'o/
gsung chos kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor ro/
chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes
ye shes lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa phung po lnga'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'o/
chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa bstan pa'i le'u
'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo'i glegs bam kha pa'i nang bzhugs pa'i bam po gnyis pa can, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
dam pa'i chos dang 'jig rten gyi snyan ngag dang bzo dang mthu rtsal rnams kyis gzhan la phan 'dogs pa ste, sbyin pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
gzungs kyi sgo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mkhan po dang slob dpon la sogs pa las dam pa'i chos mnyan nas, ji skad bshad cing thos pa'i tshig thams cad nam du yang mi brjed par 'dzin pa/
chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa/
rab byung lnga pa hor rgyal po aol rje'i dus su sngar sa pan khu dbon gyis bzos pa'i sog yig la yi ge mjug ma can mang po bsnan nas chos sgyur thub pa mdzad mkhan sa skya'i bla ma zhig /
1) 'gog lam gyi phan yon nam, khyad chos/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
dgongs 'gal lam tshig pa za ba/
dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can te: bshad pa'i chos dang, sgrub pa'i chos dang, 'bras bu'i chos bcas so/
phal skad ma yin pa'i chos pod nang gi tha snyad rnams/

1) sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi nang gses sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug chos kyi sku ste, zag med kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa sku bzhi'i dbye bzhir gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi sku'o/ 2) sku gnyis kyi ya gyal, rang don du spang rtogs mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa'o/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang tshan, chos kyi sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi ste, ngo bo nyid sku dang, ye shes chos sku, longs spyod rdzogs sku dang, sprul pa'i sku bcas bzhi'o/
rkyen ngan sel ched du chos kyi po ti khur nas dgon mtha' dang grong mtha' la skor ba byed pa/
bstan pa'i chos tshul bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i srung ma/

bod kyi lo tsa ba grags can zhig ste, rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi la 'khrungs, rab byung dgu pa'i shing khyi la dag yig za ma tog thengs dang po brtsams, rab byung de'i me khyi la dag yig za ma tog zhus dag mdzad, rab byung de'i me phag la gshegs/ (1444-1527)...1514...1526...
(dharmatr'ani) sngar rgya gar gyi bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon zhig /
chos kyi khams kyi bsdus ming,
mngon pa kun btus kyi lugs su: chos kyi khams la dbye na chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs lnga dang, tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po gsum dang, 'dus ma byas brgyad de bcu drug go /
mngon pa mdzod ltar na, tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed bcas kyi phung po gsum dang, rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzud dang, 'dus ma byas gsum bcas bdun no/
1) glegs bam 'jog sa'i khri/ 2) chos 'chad sa'i khri/
so byang sngags gsum gyi bslab khrims dang dgon pa'i bca' khrims/
dge bskos te, grwa pa tshogs 'tshog skabs sgrig khrims gnon mkhan/

1) chos kyi 'khor lo ste, snying ga'i rtsa 'khor/ 2) sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos gang zhig mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu 'bras ngo bo nyid gsum gang rung brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i ngag gi rnam par snang ba'i rnam rig ste de ni 'khor lo rin po che lta bu mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus pa dang, lam rnams su 'dor zhing 'jug pa dang, myur du 'gro ba dang, 'phags lam gyi rtsibs kyi yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa sogs kyi chos mtshungs pas chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/

khyad par can gyi dus chen bzhi'i nang gses, hor zla drug pa, chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bzhi'i nyin ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos yul w'a r'a na s'ir, 'khor lnga sde bzang por chos bden bzhi'i chos 'khor thog mar bskor ba'i dus so/

t'a la'i bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtshos rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul lor btab pa'i dgon chung zhig gnas 'dir mtsho zhig yod pa de dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtshor grags shing tshang mas ltas brtag srol yod pa zhig yin/

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos w'a r'a na s'ir chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe gnas der bzhengs pa'i gru bzhi bang rim bzhi glo 'bur dang bcas pa sgo rab brgya rtsa brgyad, 'bring nga drug tha ma bcu drug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi mchod rten/

sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pas dam chos gsung ba'i dus skabs snga bar phyi gsum ste, dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor dang, bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor, mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bcas gsum mo/
1) lha sa dang, bsam yas, khra 'brug gsum/ 2) chos 'khor rim pa gsum mo,

rab tu byung bas bcang ba'i chos gos kyi rgyur rung ba ni bdun te bal las byas pa, rtswa sha na las byas pa, nyi 'og pa'i gos, ras gos, rtswa zar ma las byas pa, rtswa ko tam pa las byas pa dang, rtswa du gu las byas pa rnams so/
gi spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rang gi nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la gos rnying pa 'khrur 'jug pa'o/
«ts'ibaram» snam sbyar dang, bla gos mthang gos bcas gsum/

bsnyen par rdzogs pas chos gos la 'chang ba'i ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir byin gyis brlab par bya ba ste, byin brlab bya ba'i yul de nyid bslab pa rgan na phyag by, min na gnyis ka 'dud pa dang bcas pas snam sbyar sogs phyi nang ma log par bzhi bltab byas pa'i sne mo gcig yul gyi phrag pa g.yon par bkal, sne mo gcig gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag pa g.yas pas mnan te byin rlabs kyi sngags tshig lan gsum brjod cing, thabs legs bya ba'o/

lhag pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, ston pa'i chos gos kyi tshad de, srid du ston pa rang gi khru lnga zhes mi phal pa'i khru bco lnga dang, zheng du ston pa'i khru gsum phal pa'i khru dgu las lhag pa 'chang ba'o/
gos mang po la chags pa'i gnyen por snam sbyar dang, bla gos, mthang gos gsum gyis 'tsho bar byed cing de las lhag pa'i gos mi 'chang ba dam bcas pa'i gang zag /

'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya gyal, tshad ma rigs pa'i rgyan gyi slob dpon dpal chos kyi grags pa ni, dus rabs drug par rgya gar gyi lho phyogs yul k'anytsi na ga ra zhes pa'i phyogs su bram ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs, slob dpon phyogs glang gi slob ma dbang phyug sde las tshad ma kun btus tshar gsum gsan te, tshad ma'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel dang, rnam nges, rigs thigs sogs tshad ma sde bdun brtsams nas slob dpon phyogs glang gi dgongs pa ji lta bar bkral bas tshad ma'i gzhung 'grel ba'i slob dpon du gyur pa'o/
1) chos 'chad nyan byed sa'i ra ba'am sde/ 2) dgon sde/
1) chos kyi bya ba mthar phyin pa/ 2) mi tshe gcig ring rab byung gi sdom pa ma shor ba/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya dngos po'i khyad chos gang rung zhig 'gog byed de dang 'gal ba'i skyon brjod kyi sgrub byed bkod de 'gog par byed pa'i rgyan zhig
1) sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa byed pa'i rgyal po rnams/ 2) las kyi gshin rje/ 3) sangs rgyas spyi

mdo sde dang rgya gar gyi bstan bcos dpag bsam 'khri shing, bod kyi bstan bcos skyes rabs brgya pa sogs kyi nang gsal sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pa'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar gzhir bzhag ste bar lam sdings chen tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis phyogs sgrig gis rgyas su btang ba deng sang bod kyi zlos gar lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung zhig /
'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bsdus ming/
chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum
srong btsan sgam po, khri srong lde btsan, mnga' bdag khri ral gsum/

spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa tsam la khrir bzhugs gnang nas g.yul 'gyed rgya cher btang ste rgya gar gyi sa cha phal che ba zhig la dbang sgyur byas mthar dmag 'thab la yid skyo bas sangs rgyas skyabs su bsten nas yul gru khag la ston pa'i bstan pa dar spel mdzad do/
chos rgyal zla ba bzang po
dus 'khor rtsa rgyud zhu ba po/
dpe cha'i tshig rnams ngag thog nas bskyar te rgyugs sprod pa/
chos kyi brgyud pa gcig pa'i bla ma rim byon nam rim byung/
chos 'chad rtsod dam klog pa'i sgra/
'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bsdus tshig
'dod dang mi 'dod bzhi tshan gnyis kyi chos mgo snyoms pa ste, rnyed dang mi rnyed dang, bde dang mi bde, snyan dang mi snyan, bstod dang smad rnams khyad par mi 'dzin pa/
dbang lung khrid gsum gyi brgyud pa/
1) chos rnams skad yig mi 'dra ba gcig nas gcig tu bsgyur ba/ 2) chos lugs gcig bzhag nas gzhan zhig gi khongs su 'dzul ba/
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, las byed pa po rnams kyis bslab pa la brtson pa rtogs pa'i chos dang, las kyi cho ga dngos su yod pas lung gi chos kyi don tshang ba'o/
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la dmigs nas sgra spyi'i rjes su 'brangs te nyan thos kyi don mngon rtogs thos bsam gyis gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa'o

«aabhidharma» zag pa med pa'i shes rab rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dang, de mngon du bya ba'i thos bsam gyi shes rab la sogs dang, de dag ston pa'i gzhung ste, lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel rnams so/

las btus pa: 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg pa thun mong gi sdom bam po lnga pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po d'i pam ka ra shr'i dzny'a na dang, lo tsa ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
chos mngon pa nyams su len mkhan/
chos mngon pa'i mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa, slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i theg dman gyi mngon pa'i gzhung gi rtsa ba gnas brgyad kyi rang bzhin can/
lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i chos, sde snod gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
kyi bshad pa: slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rang 'grel, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo tsa ba dpal brtsegs rakshi tas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
ming dang, mtshan ma dang, rnam rtog dang, de bzhin nyid dang, mi rtog ye shes so/

1) rtags chos gnyis dang ldan pa'i gzhi ste, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa na, sgra ni chos can yin zhing, sgra la rtags byas pa dang chos mi rtag pa gnyis dang ldan pa lta bu'o/ 2) lugs srol can/ 3) dngos po thams cad/

bo ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, chos can gyi ngo bo mi srid nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, don dam pa'i sgra chos can, rtag ste, ma byas pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu bsgrub gzhi shes bya la mi srid pa ste gzhi ma grub pa'o/

gcig rtags la ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, chos can gyi phyogs gcig rtags la mi srid nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu rtsol byung sgra'i phyogs gcig chu sgra la ma grub pa'o/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya dngos po gang yang rung ba'i khyad gzhi chos can de, 'gog byed khyad chos kyi rnam pa zur tsam zhig las gzhan ma mthong ba'i tshul brjod pa'i sgo nas 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /

rjod byed kyi sgra gang zhig smra ba po dang nyan pa po'i 'dod pas dmigs pa'i don de nyid khyad gzhir ston pa'i sgra, dper na, sgra dngos po yin zhes pa lta bu, sgra de dngos po'i khyad gzhir ston pa dang, shes bya dang, mi rtag pa la sogs khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'o/

brtsegs pa'i thal 'gyur: rtsod gzhi'am chos can du ma brtsegs shing, gsal ba dang rtags re re las med pa, dper na, rnam mkhyen chos can, sgra chos can, 'dus byas chos can, dngos po yin par thal, don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/

tshom za ma grub pa: blo ngor ma grub pa'i rtags gsum gyi ya gyal, chos can de yod med ma nges pa'i rkyen gyis ma grub pa, dper na, sha za bskal don du song ba'i ngor, mdun gyi sha za'i bum pa chos can, mi rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
'phags pa chos bcu pa'i le'u bam po gnyis pa, shlo ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra sogs dang, lo tsa ba bnde ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/
1) chos kyi cha lugs/ 2) chos kyi yo byad/

nges 'byed cha bzhi'i nang gses: so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis bden pa rnams la dmigs te sgom pa na de ma thag pa'i rjes su mthong lam skyes pas 'dzin pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gsal snang 'bring po thob pa'i ting 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'o/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthong lam skyed pa'i nus ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pas sems kun tu gnas pa thob pa'i rtse mo gang zhig sbyor lam chos mchog gis bsdus pa'o/
nyan thos gos dmar ba'i sde pa'i khongs gtogs shig /
1) chos shod pa/ 2) chos kyi tshig don shod mkhan/
1) chos kyi rje bo/ 2) sku rten pa'am lha'i khog rten/
rjes su dran pa drug gi nang gses, lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'o/
chos rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig lung rtogs kyi yon tan don dam par ma dmigs shing kun rdzob tu chos la lam gyi 'du shes rim ldan du dran pa'o/

rjod byed kyi sgra gang zhig smra ba po dang nyan pa po'i 'dod pas dmigs pa'i don de nyid khyad chos su ston pa'i sgra, dper na, sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes pa lta bu, ka bum sogs kyi mi rtag pa las khyad par du 'byed pas, khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra'o/
1) chos gtam rna bar nyan pa/ 2) chos nyan mkhan/
1) rang gshis sam rang bzhin/ lo rgyus kyi chos nyid/ 'bad rtsol la ma brten par rang 'dod 'bras bu chos nyid kyis 'thob mi yong/ 2) rang bzhin stong pa nyid/
rigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste chu thur du 'bab pa dang me gyen du 'bar ba lta bu 'jig rten la grags pa'i chos nyid do/

gyi snang ba: snang ba bzhi'i nang gses, chos nyid ka dag gi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong bas yid dpyod blos btags kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhing khams kyi sgo phye ba'o/
chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba
chos zad blo 'das kyi snang ba dang don gcig
chos blos gtong ba'am, spong ba/
1) chos kyi dus ston nam, dga' ston/ 2) bsod snyoms/
chos ston sogs kyi sde tshan

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bcu tshan dgu pa la, grong du rgyu ba'i ltung byed dang, rgyal po'i pho brang du 'dug pa'i ltung byed dang, khyad du gsod pa'i ltung byed dang, khab ral byed pa'i ltung byed dang, khri rkang 'chos pa'i ltung byed dang, shing bal bgos pa'i ltung byed dang, gding ba tshad lhag byed pa'i ltung byed dang, g.yan dgab tshad las lhag pa'i ltung byed dang, ras chen tshad las lhag pa'i ltung byed dang, chos gos tshad las lhag pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/
1) chos kyi lam ston mkhan/ 2) chos 'chad pa/

drug nyes byas kyi sde tshan bdun pa chos: ston tshul gyi sde la nyan po mi na bzhin du 'dug pa la rang nyid 'grengs te chos 'chad pa dang, de bzhin du nyal ba dang, khri stan che mthor 'dug pa dang, mdun du 'gro ba la rgyab nas chos 'chad pa dang, lam gyi dbus nas 'gro ba la lam po'i 'gram nas chos 'chad pa dang, mi na bar mgo g.yogs pa dang, gos brdzes pa dang, bla gos phrag par gzar ba dang, lag pa gnya' gong du bsnol ba dang, ltag par bsnol ba dang, skra spyi bor bsdus te do ker can dang, zhwa gyon pa dang, cod pan btags pa dang, me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa dang, la thod dkris pa dang, glang chen la zhon pa dang, rta la zhon pa dang, khyogs kyi steng na 'dug pa dang, shing rta'i steng na 'dug pa dang, mchil lham gyon pa dang, 'khar ba thogs pa dang, gdugs thogs pa dang, mtshon cha thogs pa dang, ral gri thogs pa dang, mda' gzhu thogs pa dang, go cha gyon pa bcas la chos bshad pa ste nyer drug go /
chos po ti'i sked chings te glegs thag /
yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po'i mdo: pandi ta pradzny'a warma dang, lo tsa ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/
chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam nyid
rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo mdo bam po bco lnga dang le'u so dgu pa, pandi ta sh'i lendra bo dhi dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/
par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa: rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa dang don gcig
chos thams cad stong pa nyid

phyi nang gi chos rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang, sdug bsngal ba, stong pa, bdag med pa zhes pa de la don dam par chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa ste stong nyid bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig /
ba med par bstan pa'i mdo: mdo bam po gsum pa, lo tsa ba bande rin chen 'tshos bsgyur/
chos nyan bshad sogs byed pa'i yun tshad/
sbyin bdag gis chos kyi don du bzhag pa'i ma dngul lam dngos po/ chos thebs slong ba/
sbyin bdag khag gi sa nas chos kyi thebs: rtsa slong mo zhu ba'i yi ge
1) chos grwa 'tshog dus/ 2) rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gyi ched du phyogs phan tshun gyi chos grwar 'degs pa'i dus tshod nges can zhig /
1) khyad chos 'dra ba/ 2) grub mtha' mtshungs pa/ 3) chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag /
1) dpe don gnyis ka la yod pa'i kha dog dang, dbyibs sogs phan tshun khyad chos mtshungs par ston pa'i dpe/ 2) mthun dpe yang dag dang don gcig
chos mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang
rtags ni sgrub byed yin la bsgrub bya ni chos can yin pas mthun dpe de gnyis dang mi ldan pa/
chos mthun dpe ltar snang lnga

sgrub byed kyi chos ma grub pa dang, bsgrub bya'i chos ma grub pa dang, bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka ma grub pa dang, dpe ma sbyar ba dang, dpe phyin ci log tu sbyar ba ste tshul lnga 'dod pa'i lugs su lnga'o/
ngag sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan gyi ya: gyal rjes khyab dang phyogs chos brjod pa mthun pa can gyi ngag ste, gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab, dper na bum pa bzhin zhes pa lta bu'o/
gtan la dbab pa: rgya gar gyi slob dpon dze t'a ris brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
sems tsam pa'i lta ba dang tshul mthun pa'i gzhung 'phags pa byams pas gsungs pa, byams chos sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
chos la dga' ba/ chos dad rang mos/
chos kyi dung ste rdzas kyi dung dang, chos sgra'i dung gnyis yod/
bar bzhag pa: dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos dag la stong pa dang bdag med par rtogs shing bsgom pa/
chos shes kyang nyams len med par sems gyong du song ba ste chos kyis rgyud ma thul ba/
1) chos 'dzin spel byed mkhan/ 2) chos srung ba po/
bdag med gnyis kyi ya gyal, chos thams cad bden par ma grub pa/
lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung ste 'dul ba lung sde bzhi lta bu'o/

sngar smon lam tshugs dus phyir zhabs brtan du 'gro mkhan grwa pa rnams kyis lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khyim du chos 'don rim gro sgrub par 'gro skyod chog 'thus tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs zhus 'khrol 'dzin/
chos srol yod pa/ chos ldan zhing khams/
bod rigs ri mo ba chos ldan zer mkhan gyis ri mo bris shing, rgya nag yul nas btags pa'i gos chen gyi bye brag cig /
(rnying) 1) chos dpe'i nang na/ 2) chos rgyun du byed pa/
sdig pa'am mi dge ba'i bya ba/
1) chos dang rgyu nor/ 2) 'phags pa'i nor/
dag byang chub kyi yan lag byang chub yan: lag bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid rtogs par byed pa rang bzhin gyi yan lag ste bden don mthong ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/
chos byed mkhan ser skya pho mo/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang don gnyis kyi khyad chos 'dra ba shugs bstan tsam min par mtshungs gsal gyi sgra'i rjes la dngos su gsal bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig
1) chos kyi bya spyod/ 2) bstod tshogs sogs chos kyi 'don cha/
gsung rab kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang, mchod pa 'bul ba, sbyin pa gtong ba, chos nyan pa, 'dzin pa, klog pa, 'chad pa, kha ton du bya ba, chos kyi don sems pa, chos kyi don sgom pa bcas bcu'o/
1) chos byed pa/ 2) chos kyi bya ba byed mkhan/

chos kyi phung po ste chags sogs nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong re re'i gnyen po sangs rgyas sh'akya thub pas gsungs pa rnams lhan cig tu spungs pa'i phung po ste, mngon pa gong ma ltar na tshig le'ur byas pa stong phrag rer chos phung re brtsi ba dang, mngon pa 'og ma ltar na dbang po'i glang po che rab brtan gyis theg tsam gyi snag tshas chos kyi phung po gcig 'bri bar nus pa'i tshad kyi chos de phung po rer brtsis pa'o/
phun tshogs lnga'i nang gses, nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong/
dam pa'i chos kyi ngos sam skor/
chos dad byed mkhan blon po/
1) stong pa nyid/ 2) gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa phung po lnga'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa/
ye shes lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, klong sde'i dgongs pa rtsal du bton nas rdzogs chen gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag ston pa rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan gyi gzhung le'u bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can 'di dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa/
chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bsdus tshig
gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim pa'am mya ngan las 'das pa ste shi ba/
1) chos dad yod pa'i mi ser/ 2) dgon sde khag gi mi ser/ 3) bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma'i slob ma/
1) chos kyi 'byung ba brjod pa'i bstan bcos sam deb ther/ 2) dbyibs gru gsum/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 4) (mngon) mo mtshan/
rab byung dgu pa'i shing byi lor, dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i bod kyi chos 'byung zhig /

stag lung bka' brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rgyas pa 'di rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi lor brtsams shing, kha skong dang bcas khyon bsdoms ldebs lnga brgya can gyi par shing stag lung dgon du yod, de rtsom pa po stag lung pa ngag dbang dam chos bzang po zhes byung yang thu'u kvan chos 'byung du zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhes bris 'dug pas dpyad par 'tshal/
1) mo mtshan/ 2) chos 'byung nang gi pad gdan/
1) chos dang 'byor pa'i bsdus tshig / 2) chos kyis phyug pa/
chos 'chad nyan gyi 'brel ba/ chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma/
1) chos kyi nang don gsang nas ma bstan pa/ 2) theg dman gyi nang gses shig /
chos kyi sbyin pa'am chos ster ba/
dge 'dun dang sbyin bdag mnyam du 'dzoms pa/
/ 1) chos byed mkhan bud med/ 2) btsun ma/
dpe ltar snang: chos mi mthun pa'i dpe de rtags dang bsgrub bya gnyis ldog pa med pas ltar snang zhes bya'o/
chos mi mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang lnga
bsgrub bya ldog pa med pa dang, sgrub byed ldog pa med pa dang, bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka ldog pa med pa dang, ldog pa ma bstan pa dang, ldog pa phyin ci log tu sbyar ba ste lnga'o/
chos mi mthun pa'i sbyor ngag sgrub ngag
yan lag gnyis kyi nang gses ldog khyab dang phyogs chos brjod pa mi mthun pa can gyi ngag gang rtag na ma byas pas khyab, dper na nam mkha' bzhin, sgra ni byas so zhes pa lta bu'o/
rnying ma'i sman bsgrubs sam, bdud rtsi ril bu/
chos kyi go don 'khrugs te smyo ba/
chos gzhis mi rtsa zhes pa'i bsdus ming,

rang gzhan gyi rmongs pa sel zhing, blo gros kyi na 'phar ba dang, rang rang gi lta grub kyi gnad gsang rnams dpyis phyin par rtod shing, sgro skur gyi skyon mi 'jug pa dang, bstan pa 'phel ba'i ched du brgal brtag rigs pas rtsod pa byed pa'am dgag gzhag spang gsum byed pa/
chos kyi dpe cha tshan pa'am, sde tshan/
chos dar sa'i yul gyi lte ba/
chos ra'am, chos thog snga phyi'i bar/
rnyed bkur sogs kyi don du chos 'chad pa/
1) chos byed pa/ 2) grwa pas tshogs yongs la gtong sgo btang nas len pa'i ming zhig / dbon chos mdzad/ grwa tshang chos mdzad/ khang tshan chos mdzad/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spo mes rdzong khongs kyi sde zhig /
sngar dgon pa grwa tshang khag gis bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gzhis ka/
sngar dgon pa khag gi gzhis kas bdag tu bzung ba'i mi ser/
'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa zhes bya ba'i mdo, shlo ka bcu gsum pa pandi ta su rendra bo dhi dang, bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
chos dang mthun pa/ sdig ltung thams cad chos bzhin du phyir bcos pa/ chos bzhin ma yin pa/

kyi snang ba: snang ba bzhi'i nang gses, snang ba thams cad thig le chen po gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dag nas blos btags pa'i chos so cog thams cad chos nyid kyi klong du zad cing chos nyid du 'dzin pa tsam yang med pas zad pa'i mthar phyin pa chos sku'i snang ba mthong ba'o/
rnyed bkur gyi don du 'tshong ba'i chos
chos la rtogs pa'i bzod pa ste, chos mchog gi mjug tu 'dod pa'i khams kyis bsdus pa'i chos la bden bzhi ji lta bar mthong bas mthong spang gi gnyen po bar chad med lam mo/

sdud pa'i mdo: 'phags pa chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u bcu gnyis pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po manydzu shr'i garbha dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/
dam pa'i chos kyi phywa g.yang/
chos 'chad nyan byed sa'i gnas te chos grwa'ang zer/
chos kyi ra ba'i nang du 'gro ba/
yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rnam: 'byed yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang don gcig
kyi bzod pa: stong pa nyid dang, bdag med pa'am, skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa'i don zab mo dag bstan na sems mi dngangs shing de la dad pa dang dga' ba skyes pa'i bzod pa'o/
bsnyon dor gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dngos po 'ga' zhig gi khyad chos dngos la bsnyon nas de min gyi khyad chos gzhan zhig ston pa'i rgyan/
chos la rtogs pa'i bzod pa

rton pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul phyin ci ma log cing ma 'dres par bstan pa dang, chos rnams kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid yang dag par bstan pa'i chos la yid rton pa'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste, mtha' dbus med pa'i chos kyi sgo snang ba kun tu ston pa'o/
rab byung min pas 'dul ba klog pa sogs chos ma thob par longs spyad pa/

mi lus kyi byang khog stod kyi g.yas ngos su gnas shing don lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni khrag gi rten byed cing, zas skom gyi dwangs ma rnams pho ba nas lus la 'dren par byed pa yin no/
skya rbab rigs lnga'i nang tshan mchin par bab cing mkhris pa dang 'doms pa'i nad de, nad rtags su lus skrangs shing mchin steng na la zas mi 'ju ba zhig /

rgyab kyi sgal tshigs dgu pa mchin pa dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na mchin skran dang mchin par bad rlung zhugs pa la phan/

sa cha zhig deng skabs lho kha'i gra nang rdzong gi bsam yas khongs su yod, sba bzhed dang, bsam yas gdan rabs, dbus gtsang gnas yig sogs la gsal/

1. rab bam khyad du 'phags pa/ mchog dman/ tshogs kyi mchog / mkhas pa'i mchog / mi rnams kyi mchog / dge rgan mchog / lha rje mchog / ro mchog / grogs mchog / dkon mchog / gnas mchog / rta mchog / sman mchog / mchog dman bar gsum/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyes bu dang, khyu mchog gong ma, gong ma'i gong ma, gya nom pa, glang po, cang shes pa, che shos, chen po, ches che ba, mchog gi mchog stag dang seng ge, dang po, pad ma dkar, dpa' bo, dpon, phud du bkur, phul byung, bla na med pa, bla ma'i bla, gtso bo, rtse mo, rtse mor 'gro, ya rabs, rab, legs gnas, legs pa, shin tu mchog bcas so, 2. yi ge 'di'i mthar tu zhes sbyar na tshig gi rgyan du 'gro ba'i rab tu shin tu sogs kyi don mtshon par byed/ tu...mchog tu mi gtsang ba/ mchog tu gyur pa/ mchog tu phra ba/ mchog tu phun sum tshogs pa/ mchog tu mdzes pa/ mchog tu yid gcugs pa/ mchog tu yid brtan par gyur pa'i grogs po/ rin po che'i bzhugs khri g.yu byur mu tig sogs kyis mchog tu brgyan pa/

bla na med pa'i dngos grub ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub/

rang lta dang, tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/
mchog gi dngos grub dang, thun mong gi dngos grub bo/
khyad du 'phags pa'am rab kyi rab/
sngags bla med kyi rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing smin par byed pa'i dbang gsum ste, gsang ba'i dbang dang, shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang, tshig dbang bcas so/

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gam pa rdzong gi lho rgyud na yod/

(tha dad pa) 1) mchod rdzas phul te mnyes thabs byed pa/ lha mchod pa/ bla ma mchod pa/ 2) bzhes pa/ zhal lag mchod pa/ na bza' mchod pa/ dbu zhwa mchod mi 'dug / 2. bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par byed pa'i dngos rdzas/ brgya mchod/ stong mchod/ ja chang gi mchod pa/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ mchod pa bla med/ bco lnga mchod pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyas byed dang, mchod byed, bsnyen bkur, rim gro, legs byed bcas so,
mchod pa'i yo byad 'jog sa'i khang pa/
mchod yon dang, zhabs bsil, me tog bdug spos, mar me, dri chab, zhal zas, rol mo rnams so/
dkon mchog mchod pa la gnyis te, zang zing gi mchod pa dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa'am, dngos 'byor dang yid sprul gyi mchod pa gnyis so/

1) phyi dang, nang dang, gsang ba dang, de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ste bzhi/ 2) mu ne btsan po'i skabs lha sar 'dul ba'i mchod pa dang khra 'brug la mngon pa'i mchod pa, bsam yas la mdo sde dang byang chub kyi mchod pa bcas kyi srol btsugs pa de dag la mchod pa chen po bzhi zer zhing, deng skabs lha sa khul du bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin 'dzam gling spyi bsang zhes pa'i dus chen gtong ba'i yul srol 'di yang de nas dar ba'o/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa cho 'phrul bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, lha rnams la phyag dang mchod bstod bya ba'o/
mchog gsum la 'bul rgyu'i mchod rdzas dang, mchod pa 'bul snod/
lha la mchod pa 'bul mkhan sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad yod/
dkyil 'khor bstab pa dang mchod 'bul gyi las gnyer mkhan/
ta la'i bla ma'i mchod dpon/
phor pa'i zhe sa ste bzhes spyad kyang zer/
mchod pa mang po sprin gyi gzugs su bkod pa/
phrag pa nas mchan khung bar skud pa rgya gram 'ching ba'i tshangs skud/

1) yar dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba dang, mar ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba/ bu mos mchod sbyin dge ba byed/ 2) bram ze'i rig byed bzhi'i ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la rgyud bdun pa dang, mtho ris don, sbyin sreg bcas so,
«yadzurbod:» sngar rgya gar bram ze'i chos lugs kyi gzhung bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste mtho ris kyi phyir mchod sbyin byed skabs kyi rig sngags dang smon tshig rnams kyi rig byed do/
lha brgya byin gyis mchod sbyin brgya tham pa byas pa yin zhes zer bas ming de ltar btags/
bram zes lha mchod skabs rta'i sha pags bsregs pa'i du ba/
1) mchod pa 'bul yul dang sbyin pa gtong yul/ 2) (mngon) brgya byin gyi lha gnas/
tshangs skud de phrag mchan bar 'ching byed skud pa rgya gram/
mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs/ me tog mchod rdzas/
lha la 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa sna bcu ste me tog dang, 'phreng ba, spos, byug pa, phye ma, na bza', rgyan, gdugs, rgyal mtshan, ba dan bcas bcu'o/
sngar dgon pa dang bla brang khag gi gzhis ka/
1) mchod gnas dang yon bdag / 2) mchod pa dang yon chab/ 3) sku yon/
mchod gnas sam bla ma dang yon bdag bar dam tshig gtsang ba/
gtong mkhan gyi grwa pa'i ja zhu lto gtong: sogs kyi las g.yog byed mkhan
lha la phul zin nas bsdus pa'i lhag ro/
rgyan gos kyis bklubs shing, sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur can/
mdzes pa'i khengs dregs kyi rnam 'gyur/

mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum ste, chos kyi snying don 'chad pa dang, de don brtsad de brdar sha gcod pa dang, gtsug lag gnyis kyi don gang rung legs par rtsom pa bcas so/

(tha dad pa) bcabs pa, bcab pa, 'chobs, ,mi mngon par byed pa dang, sbed pa/ skyon cha 'chab pa/ nor 'khrul ma bcabs pa/ nad gzhi 'chab pa/ 'chab pa'i gnas/ 'chab pa'i skyon/ 2. bya bar mi 'os pa'i las byas pa rnams gzhan la gsang ba ste skyon sba ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig /
gsang sems kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi rig byed dang rig byed min pa'i gzugs can ci rigs pa'o/

/ 1) 'char ran pa'i mtshams/ nyi ma 'char ka/ zla dkar 'char ka/ 'od zer 'char ka'i sngon la/ 2) (ud'a'a'i:) ston pa'i 'khor drug sde'i gras shig /

(tha mi dad pa) shar ba, 'char ba,, 1) 'byung ba/ nyi ma shar ba/ me tog 'char ba/ dus rabs gsar pa 'char ba/ go skabs nam shar/ 2) 'gyur ba/ rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba/ 3) dran pa/ sngar byas yid la gsal ler 'char/ snang bar gang shar/ gnas skabs blo yul du ma shar ba/ 4) grangs 'bor brtsis pa'i ri mo sogs mngon pa'am grub pa/ lhag med rnam dag ri mo 'char/ mda' ro'i lhag mar gzugs shar na/ rjes ma rjes ma'i zla dag tshegs med 'char/
'byung 'gyur las ka'i gra sgrig gam bya rim gyi rnam gzhag / bslab slob 'char gzhi/ dmag 'thab 'char gzhi/ 'char gzhir 'khod pa/ las don gang byed kyang 'char gzhi med na 'thus tshang mi yong/

1) khungs med kyi gtam/ shes pa rnal du mi gnas par 'chal gtam bshad pa/ 2) mi sems 'khrug par byed pa'i dkrog gtam/ rang 'dod dgos dbang gis 'chal gtam bzo ba/

ja gtum byed kyi ko ba/

/ 1) kha dog dmar smug / 2) ja'i kha dog /

1) bul tog ma btab par bskol ba'i ja gar po/ 2) ja thang ste, ma bsrubs pa'i ja/
do po'i ljid tshad longs pa'i ja sgam gnyis/
btung ba ja'i skal ba/ tshogs la dngos su yong mi thub mkhan rnams la ja rgyugs skyel ba/
ko bas btums pa'i ja do gru bzhi/ ja sgam drug /
'o ma dang ka ra btab pa'i 'thung ja/
yun ring gdus nas khu ba rang sim du gyur pa'i ja skam po/
ja 'dren chang 'dren byed skabs kyi skyid glu/ skyid na ja chang mtshar glu len/
ja khu bton pa'i snyigs ma/
ja khu lta bu'i kha dog /

ja dang thug pa'i bsdus tshig /

ja skol thengs gcig gi dus tshod

khral 'ul bskul nas skyel rgyu'i ja do po/
mar dang 'o ma sogs med pa'i ja dwangs/
ja bzo tshong sger bdag byed mkhan
ja srub snod kyi mdong mo/

tshogs pa lta bur ja gtong ba'am blug pa/ ja 'dren chang 'dren/ gsol ja 'dren pa/
rtsam pa'i thog ja blug pa'i skyo ma/
1) ma bsrubs pa'i ja dwangs/ 2) ja'i rigs shig /
ja btungs nas byung ba'i nad/
ja mngar mo bzo byed kyi ja rigs shig ste, pa ti ni rgya gar gyi skad yin/
dge 'dun la ja 'dren skabs lag bde ba rnams la lta rtog byed mkhan/
ja 'dab rlon pa gru bzhir bcos pa'i rdog po
ja bag chen gcig gi bzhi zur,
1) ja bag khag che ba/ 2) ja 'bru gnyis/

ja lo dang po las bzos pa'i ja/
gcig ja thengs gcig bskol te 'thung ba'i yun

1) ji ltar smras pa'i ngag dang gang bris pa'i yi ge/ 'go khrid pas ji skad bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin byed pa/ da lta skabs babs kyi tshig don rnams le'u snga ma nas ji skad bstan pa ltar go ba len dgos/ sngar gyi lo rgyus ji skad thos pa ltar yi ger 'bri ba/ 2) lung khungs ji 'dra zhig nas drangs pa'i tshig don gsham gsal ltar/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa las ji skad du, yi ge a'a li k'a li gnyis, a'a li gsal byed i sogs bzhi, k'a li sum cu tham pa'o, zhes gsungs so lta bu/ i...
1) ga 'dra/ thabs ji ga byed/ 'bor grangs ji ga yin/ 2) nam yang ngam dus gtan du/ bka' drin ji gar mi brjed pa/ spyod ngan ji gar byed mi rung/
yod tshad thams cad dam gang na ci yod/ dka' tshegs ji dgu/ dogs gnas ji dgu/ rgyu nor ji dgu/
gang dga'am gang legs/ byed stangs ji 'gab lta dgos/ skad cha shod tshul ji 'gab bsam blo thong/ gang 'gab ji 'gab bltas na shes/ las don byed stangs ji 'gab gros bsdur byas/
gang sems pa'am gang dran pa/ rang gis ji snyam pa'i don grub pa/
gang yod dam thams cad/ nus shugs ji snyed pa/ go skabs ji snyed pa/

grangs mang nyung ji tsam yod pa'i 'bor de tsam/ nus shugs ji snyed yod pa de snyed 'don pa/ rang gis ji snyed 'jon pa de snyed kyi las 'gan len pa/ dka' las ji snyed brgyab pa de snyed kyi grub 'bras 'byung ba/ mi grangs ji snyed pa de snyed kyi skal ba bgos pa/
grangs mang nyung ji tsam yod pa/ go skabs ji snyed yod pa/ bsam tshul ji snyed yod pa/ mi grangs ji snyed yod pa rnam la dbye 'byed bsdoms rtsis shig rgyag pa/
kun rdzob kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/
ji 'dra ji 'dra'am gang 'dra gang 'dra/ tshogs 'du'i sar gros sdur ji lta ji ltar byas pa de lta de ltar lag len bstar dgos/

1) chos nyid dam gnas lugs bcos ma min pa/ chos ji lta ba/ 2) ji 'dra ba'am gang 'dra ba/ khyed kyis gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin kho bos bsgrubs yod/ gong du bshad pa ji lta ba da lta yang brjod pas blo la nges dgos/
tshul bzhin nam gang yin pa de bzhin/ don gyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa/ don ji lta ba bzhin ma yin pa/
gang 'dra ba/ dka' ngal ji lta bu zhig byung yang 'jigs mi dgos/ gnas tshul ji lta bu zhig 'byung mi shes/

1) gang 'dra/ ji ltar bsgos kyang rnar gzon pa/ lo yun ji ltar thogs kyang ngas khyed rang phebs sgug zhu rkyang yin/ las stangs ji ltar dga' ba de ltar byed du chug cig / mi so so'i 'jon thang la gzhigs pa'i las 'gan ji ltar 'os pa de sprod dgos/ 2) nang bzhin/ pad ma'i mdzes pa ji ltar zla ba'ang mdzes/ gnas lugs yong rkyen ji ltar gong du bshad pa de ga yin/ dge rgan gyis ji ltar bsgo ba'i man ngag bzhin du slob mas de ltar byed dgos/

1) ga 'dra byas nas byed/ lag len la ji ltar 'jug / lam la ji ltar 'jug / 2) bod kyi brda sprod bstan bcos rtags 'jug nang sngon rjes so so'i 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams la tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug pa/
go ba ga 'dra byas nas len dgos/ tshig la brten nas don dag ji ltar drang/ mdo'i drang don gyi dgongs pa ji ltar drang/
gang ltar yang ngam ji 'dra yin yang/ lto chas zhim dang mi zhim ji ltar yang 'phrod pa de za dgos/
gal srid dam gal te/ khyod rang ngo ma 'di gar ji ste yong ma thub tshe ngo tshab go chod pa'i mi gcig 'phral du gtong dgos/ sgra ji ste ma lobs kyang snyan sum shes dgos/
gang 'dra ba'am ci 'dra ba/ mi ji 'dra ba/ srid jus ji 'dra ba/ ji 'dra ba yi son btab pa, de 'dra ba yi 'bras bu byung/
ci nus sam gang nus/ brtson 'grus ji nus brtsams nas las 'gan bsgrub/ dran gso ji nus gtong ba/
ci 'dra yod pa de bzhin nam ji lta ba bzhin/ dpe cha'i don ji ma ji bzhin shod pa/
gang yang mi sems pa/ don che chung gang yin yang ji mi snyam par 'jog mi rigs/ spyi'i don du rang la khe gyong gang 'dra yong min ji mi snyam pa/

ga tshod dam, tshad gang tsam/ dus yun ji tsam du slob sbyong byas pa yin/ gnas lugs ji tsam khong du chud na de tsam du yid ches che ba yong/ lam thag ji tsam thung yang ma phyin na 'byor mi srid/ spus dag gzhir bzhag thog las ka'i myur tshad ji tsam mgyogs pa de tsam du legs/ ji tsam ji tsam du yul rnams ches shas che ba de tsam de tsam du 'dod chags kyang ches shas che bar 'gyur/
ram gang 'dra:/ ji tsug byas na kun la phan pa 'ong snyam pa/
zhig gam ji lta bu zhig / hur brtson med par: rang dgar sdod pa ji zhig yin/ 'bras bu med pa'i ngal bas ji zhig bya/
ji lta ba bzhin/ bsam don ji bzhin grub pa/ gnas lugs ji bzhin du mthong ba/ gang bshad ji bzhin ma yin pa/ dge rgan gyis gsungs pa ji bzhin shes song/
gang dang mthun pa'am gang 'tshams pa/ bya gzhag ji 'os lag bstar byed pa/ bka' slob ji 'os gnang ba/ blang dor ji 'os bsam gzhig byed pa/
gang yang 'grig pa/ las rigs ji yang rung/ snga phyi ji yang rung/ ngag lan dang yig lan ji yang rung/ nga rang 'gro dgos pa'i bya yul ji yang rung/
gang yod dam yod tshad/ dbang cha ji yod/ rgyu dngos ji yod/ ma rtsa ji yod/ slob sbyong byed dus nus shugs ji yod bton nas slob sbyong byed dgos/

dus ji tsam bar gyi tshad/ ji srid bskal ba ma stongs bar/ byas rjes ji srid bar du gnas/ ji srid dmigs yul ma grub bar du bar mtshams gtan nas mi 'jog / ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu/ byas rjes ji srid nam gnas/
gang nas de bar ram gang dang gang gi bar/ ji srid nad ma drag bar de srid sman bcos byed dgos/ sa cha 'dir ji srid gnas 'dod yod pa de srid du bsdad chog /
skyes nas ma shi ba'i bar gyi dus skabs/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du mi brjed pa/

1. go rim ghzhin nam rigs gyis 'phel 'grib tu 'gyur ba'i don ston byed kyi sgra zhig / je mang du 'phel ba/ je nyung du 'grib pa/ je che je cher 'gro ba/ je chung je chung du 'gyur ba/ zhing las lo ltar je rgyas su yong ba/ 2. (rnying) dang po'am thog ma/

«manydzughosha» ngo bo rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs, rnam pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'chang ba, ngag gi nyes pa'i rtsub reg dang bral zhing, 'jam pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyi bdag nyid do/

/ 1) rtsing rtsub min pa'i mnyen po dang 'bol ba/ reg bya 'jam po/ phyi ngos 'jam po/ gyon chas 'jam po/ gzhi 'jam lu gu'i tsha ru yin, yang 'jam yu mo'i pags pa yin/ 2) btsan po min pa dang, drag po min pa'i zhi ba/ spyod lam 'jam po/ sbyor ba 'jam po/ khengs pa chung zhing gshis ka 'jam pa/ 'jam po lu gu'i tsha ru 'dra, snyan po khu byug ngag dang 'dra/ tshig 'jam po rgya yi dar las 'jam, don rtsub pa skyer pa'i tsher ma 'dra/ 3) dal bu dang, tshod ran pa/ chu rgyun 'jam po/ bshal sman 'jam po/ chu khol drod 'jam/
rdo rje 'jigs byed dang, dgra nag gdong drug gshed dmar sogs 'jam dpal drag po'i rnam 'gyur can/
brgya rtsa brgyad pa: 'gyur byang med pa rgyud kyi glegs bam zhig /

rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa: 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa bstan pa'i le'u bam po bzhi pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo rts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa zhig /
shlo ka phyed dang bco lnga pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba zhig /
'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa'i mdo shlo ka dgu bcu bam po gcig tu byas pa 'gyur byang med pa zhig /

ta la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa stag lor 'khrungs, lcags glang lor gong ma chan lung gi bka' 'brel rgyal srid dang chos srid bzhes, shing byi lor gshegs/ (1758-1804)...
dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa: de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyud kyi gras shig /
'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bye brag cig ste gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rjes zhes bya'o/
shlo ka brgya bzhi bcu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba zhig /
'phrul pa'i le'u: bam po gcig dang shlo ka go bzhi pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa zhig /
'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo
bam po gnyis pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa zhig /

«mnydzushr'igrhosha» rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngag gi rgyal po dang, ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal, brtan pa'i 'khor lo, rdo rje rnon po, blo yi gter, smra ba'i rgyal, smra ba'i seng ge, smra ba'i lha, zur phud lnga pa, ye shes sku, ye shes me long, ral gri can, shes rab sku, shes rab 'khor lo, seng ge rtsen bcas so,
le'u sum cu so drug can, dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'gor lo ts'a ba shakya blo gros kyis bsgyur pa'o/

nyes pa'i rtsub reg yongs su spangs shing 'jam pa'i yon tan mchog tu ldan pas phyogs dus thams cad du bcu drug gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin pa kho nar bzhugs pas na gzhon nur gyur pa'o, 'jam dbyangs kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs shig /
dugs dang lums byug pa lta bu lus phyi nas dpyad 'jam po byas pas nang gi nad zhi bar 'gyur ba'i bcos thabs shig
'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog dkar po/

yongs grags su rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse'am, dil mgo mkhyen brtse, mtshan dngos padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa zhes pa, rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags 'brug lor khams sde dge'i sa char sku 'khrungs, gsang sngags gsar rnying dang, sa gter, yang gter, dgongs gter, rjes dran, dag snang, snyan brgyud bcas bka' bab bdun dang ldan zhing, rnying ma dang, bka' gdams, lam 'bras, mar pa bka' brgyud, shangs chos, zhi gcod, rdo rje'i rnal 'byor, bsnyen sgrub bcas sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi ring lugs gsal bar mdzad pa'i dpe gzhung dang, sgra snyan ngag gso rig skor sogs kyi gsung rtsom mang po mdzad nas, rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu 'brug lor 'das/ (1820-1892)...

shakya rgyal mtshan: phag gru sde srid khri rabs gnyis pa 'di rab byung drug pa'i lcags 'brug lo la 'khrungs, bu ston rin po che sogs las mdo sngags kyi gdams pa du ma mnos, rtse thang gi tshogs pa lo bcu gsum gyi bar du bskyangs, shing sbrul lor pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu phebs te phag gru'i bla dpon mdzad, hor tho gan the mur rgyal pos ta'i si tu chang gu'i gung kwa din gu shri'i go sa dang, bod chol kha gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su 'jug pa'i 'ja' sa gnang thog de rjes chu byi lor ta ming hung 'u rgyal pos kyang kwa din gu shri'i go sa gnang 'dug chu glang lo la 'das/ (1340- 1373)...13 52...1365...(...)...1365...1372...

«loka:» 1) snod 'jig pa la bcud 'khrul ba brten pas 'jig rten zhes bya ste, phyi snod gling bzhi gling phran lhun po nyi zla dang bcas pa dang, nang bcud khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams so/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye 'gro dang, 'gro rten, gnas rten, srid pa bcas so, 2) 'jig rten la sa 'og dang, sa steng, sa bla ste gsum yod pas grangs gsum mtshon/
«lok'abitra» sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bcu'i gras shig /
gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa/
sum tshad ma: skye 'gro kun gyi mthong thos myong gsum gyi nges shes/
1) 'jig rten pa'i bya spyod/ 2) 'khrig spyod kyi chos/
'jig rten gyi ngag rgyun la shod pa'i gtam/
sngar gyi mi'i bya spyod ngo mtshar che rigs kyi rabs brjod pa'i lo rgyus/
bstan bcos dang, ngag rgyun las 'byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi ming brda sna tshogs/

lha dang mi'i 'gro ba gnyis sam, yang na lha'i gtso bo tshangs pa dang, brgya byin, mi'i gtso bo gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang, stobs kyi 'khor sgyur rgyal po lta bu'o/
khyim pa'i bya spyod dam srol lugs/
1) 'jig rten na lhar grags pa'i rgyal po dang btsan la sogs pa mi ma yin stobs ldan rnams/ 2) so skye'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i tshangs pa dang dbang phyug sogs lha mchog dman thams cad/
su dris pa'i mdo: bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa, mdo sde glegs bam ma par bzhugs pa'o/
'jig rten gyi kha rgyun nam 'jig rten yongs kyis khas len pa/
'jig rten gyi lugs srol/ mna' ma dang mag pa ster len byed pa de 'jig rten 'gro lugs red/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i bye brag cig /
chos lugs nas bshad pa'i skye ba snga ma/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang, nang bcud kyi sems can ji ltar chags pa'i tshul te, phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags pas, 'jig rten gyi khams stong pa'i shul, yid mkha' rnam par dag pa la 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags, de'i steng du sprin gser gyi snying po can las char chen po bab pas chu'i dkyil 'khor chags, de rlung gis bsrubs pas chu'i steng du gser gyi sa gzhi chags, de'i dbus su ri rab dang, mtha' bskor du gser gyi ri bdun, rol ba'i mtsho bdun gling bzhi gling phran bcas chags, ri rab kyi bang rim la rgyal chen ris bzhi, rtse mor sum cu rtsa gsum bcas chags, ri rab kyi steng gi nam mkha' nas gyen du 'dod lha rigs bzhi dang, de'i steng du bsam gtan ris bzhi bcas bye ba phrag brgya chags, nang bcud kyi sems can yas nas mar chags pa ste, srid rtse nas mnar med kyi sems can rnams gong nas 'og tu rim par chags pa'o/

phan gnod phran tshegs tsam gyis dga' ba dang mi dga' bar 'gyur ba'i chos brgyad de, rnyed pa dang, ma rnyed pa, snyan pa dang, mi snyan pa, bstod pa dang, smad pa, bde ba dang, mi bde ba bcas brgyad/
mi rnams kyis 'jig rten la 'dzin pa'i lta tshul/

so skye'i rgyud kyi zhi gnas/

sar gnas byang sems kyi tshul bzung ba/
sa bla lha'i 'jig rten, sa steng mi'i 'jig rten, sa 'og klu'i 'jig rten bcas gsum mo/ grags pa 'jig rten gsum na khyab/

«satk'ayidrashta:» 'jig tshogs la lta ba zhes bya ste, phung po lnga po de dag skad cig re re la 'jig cing rdzas mang po du ma bsags pa'i tshogs yin te, bdag dang bdag gi ba'i dngos po med pa la yod par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can/
grub mtha' smra ba kho nas bdag tu btags pa ste, rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag gam, gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i lta ba rnams so/

gzugs bdag tu lta ba, bdag la gzugs rang bzhin gyis ldan par lta ba, gzugs la bdag rang bzhin gyis yod par lta ba, bdag la gzugs rang bzhin gyis ldan par lta ba, bdag la gzugs rang bzhin gyis yod par lta ba dang bzhi ste tshor ba sogs phung po gzhan bzhi la yan gde ltar lta ba bzhi bzhi ste nyi shu'o/
bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i 'jig lta gnyis/
sems can rnams la thog ma nas lhan skyes su yod pa'i nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin ma rig pa/
rmi lam dang, rnam 'gyur sogs kyi sgo nas lus 'jig pa'i ltas sam rtags mtshan mthong ba lta bu/

1.(tha dad pa) bshig pa, bshig pa, shig , 'joms pa dang, med par bzo ba/ mkhar rdzong nang rol nas bshig na las sla/ rang lugs rang gis ma bshig na gzhan gyis 'jig mi thub/ chus khang pa 'jig pa/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) zhig pa, 'jig pa,, 'thor ba dang nyams pa/ rtsig pa zhig pas khang pa rdib song/ 3. gnod skyon/ mtshon cha'i 'jig pa/
'jig pa gsum ste, mtshon cha'i 'jig pa dang, nad rims kyi 'jig pa, mu ge'i 'jig pa'am, me dang, chu, rlung bcas gsum gyi 'jig pa/

bskal pa bzhi'i gsum pa, gnas pa'i bskal pa rdzogs nas ma stong bar gyi yun tshad de, nang bcud kyi sems can las mnar med du sems can skye ba'i 'phro rgyun chad pa nas 'go tshugs te, snod kyi 'jig rten me dang chu dang rlung gis 'jig pa'i bar gyi bar bskal nyi shu'i yin la 'jig pa'i bskal pa zhes bya'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la bskal pa'i mtha' dang, 'gro ba zhig cher 'jig 'jig bskal, dus bskal, dus mtha', zad bskal, rab thig, rab nub bcas so,
mi rtag pa ste snod bcud kyi 'khor ba mtha' dag
bsam gtan gnyis pa dang, gsum pa, bzhi pa bcas ni bskal pa'i me dang, chu dang, rlung gis 'jig mi thub pas 'jig pa'i rtse mo gsum zhes bya/
snod 'jig byed kyi rkyen gsum ste, me bdun, chu gcig de ltar bdun bdun 'jig rjes, mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa bcas kyis snod kyi 'jig rten rnams 'jig par byed pa/
nyams 'jig mi thub pa'i sra mkhregs/ mi rigs so so'i dbar du mthun sgril 'jig med brtan por tshugs pa/
«satak'aya» skad cig gis 'jig cing du ma tshogs pa'i skyes bu'i phung po/
ba lhan cig skyes pa: 'jig lta lhan skyes/
me chu g.yang sa dgra sogs kyi gnod pa las srung ba/ 'jigs skyob lam rogs/
'jigs skrag skyes te sems zhum pa/ glo bur du sa g.yos te 'jigs chum pa zhig byung/
1) 'jigs skul byed stangs/ 2) skrag pa'i rnam 'gyur/
'jigs skrag skyer 'jug pa/ btsan shugs kyis gzhan la 'jigs ster byed bsam pa/
skrag ste mgo rmongs pa/ me sgyogs 'phen pa'i 'ur sgra 'brug skad ldir ba lta bu'i nang du dgra bo rnams 'jigs 'thoms su gyur song/
zhed snang/ 'chi dgos byung yang 'jigs snang med/ dgra bor 'jigs snang skyes na mgo btags zhu rgyu las med/
zhed snang slong ba/ me mda' khyer nas 'jigs snang skul ba/ skad cha 'gan ljid po bshad nas 'jigs snang skul ba/

1.(tha mi dad pa) zhed pa'am skrag pa/ pham par mi 'jigs pa/ btsan dbang la mi 'jigs pa/ shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa/ 2.nyen tshabs che ba'i gnod 'tshe/ lus srog la thug pa'i 'jigs pa/ 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ khrims kyi 'jigs pa la ji mi snyam pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyi bung dang, skyi g.ya' ba, skrag pa, brgyal myos, dngangs pa, nyam nga ba, bag tsha ba, bog rmongs bcas so,

seng ge'i 'jigs pa dang, glang chen gyi 'jigs pa, me'i 'jigs pa, sbrul gyi 'jigs pa, chu bo'i 'jigs pa, lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa, rkun po'i 'jigs pa, sha za'i 'jigs pa ste brgyad/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/

tshogs sbyor na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa'i 'jigs pa ste 'tsho ba med pa'i 'jigs pa dang, mi bsngags pa'i 'jigs pa dang, 'khor gyi 'jigs pa dang, 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang, ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa bcas lnga/

gsang sngags snga 'gyur snying thig gi slob dpon 'di nyid rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya lor dbus kyi 'phyongs rgyas su 'khrungs, yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel dang, rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi rtogs brjod, dgongs 'dus rnam bshad, klong chen snying thig gi gter chos sogs gsung chos po ti dgu yod, rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta lor gshegs/ (1729-1792)...

'jim pa dang 'jim zhal gyi las ka byed mkhan/

1.(tha dad pa) bcil ba, gzhil ba, chil,, skrod pa'am 'don pa/ nad kun 'jil ba sman gyi mchog / dri ngan phyir bcil/ nad pa'i rtsa gnad la gtsag bu btsugs te khrag 'jil ba/ skyon 'jil ba/ 2.
