zas sogs zhu ba'i nus stobs/ pho drod nyams pas kha zas 'ju stobs chung/
'ju sa'i thag pa:/ 'ju thag bzung nas brag ri la 'dzegs/

1.(tha dad pa) 'jus pa, 'ju ba, 'jus,, 'dzin pa/ ma bu phan tshun lag pa nas 'jus te 'bral mi phod pa/ rta'i kha nas 'jus te bzhon du 'jug pa/ glang gi rwa la 'ju 'ju de, bre ser 'brong la 'gro sa med/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) zhu ba, 'ju ba,, lto chas ji bzas bcud du 'gyur ba'i bya rim/ lto chas rjen pa bzas na 'ju dka'/ pho drod che dus lto chas gang bzas kyang 'ju sla ba yong/ zas bzas na pho bas 'ju ba zhig gtam bshad na rdog rtsa 'dus pa zhig / 3. khyi shig /
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhu ma zhu'i mtshams rgyu mar gnas pa zhig ste, byed las zas 'ju ba dang, kha zas dwangs snyigs 'byed pa, lus kyi drod skyed par byed pa/
mkhris pa 'ju byed nad du gyur pa ste, nad rtags su mig dang lce ser la skom dad che ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /

rnying ma'i mkhas pa chen po zhig ste, mtshan dngos mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho zhes pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me rta lor rdza chu khar 'khrungs, sgra tshad sman rtsis sogs thun mong rig gnas kyi skor dang, mdo rgyud kyi gzhung 'grel sogs nang don rig pa'i skor dang, bstod tshogs dang gtam tshogs, 'don chog skor bcas pod grangs so gnyis yod, dgung lo drug cu re bdun bar bzhugs nas rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi lor 'das/ (1846-1912)...
mi phan tshun 'jus nas rtsal 'gran pa'i rtsed mo zhig
1) 'ju sa'i lung dang, 'chang sa'i yu ba/ 2) khungs dang lung/
1) 'gro sa'i lam gyi thog ma/ 'jug sgo ma nor ba byed dgos/ 2) las sam bya ba gang yang rung ba'i 'go/ las ka'i 'jug sgo gang yin ngo shes dgos/
drug nad gang zhig lus la rim bzhin 'jug pa'i: sgo mi 'dra ba drug ste pags la gram pa, sha la rgyas pa, rtsa ru rgyu ba, rus la zhen pa, don la 'bab pa, snod du lhung ba bcas/
bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs 'gro dang, thar pa la 'jug pa'i sgo nges 'byung, theg chen du 'jug pa'i sgo sems bskyed bcas gsum/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, theg chen la zhugs pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste, theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas bla med byang chub kyi ched du don gnyis sgrub pa gang zhig sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas theg chen la 'jug pa'i bya ba'o/
1) 'gro lam mam rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs/ 2) bya ba'i 'jug sgo/
1) snod nang du dngos rigs blug bde ba/ 2) lag len bstar bde ba/
1) phar 'gro ba dang tshur log pa/ lam thag ring thung gang la'ang 'jug ldog gi bya gzhag gzab nan byed dgos/ 2) bya spyod kyi blang dor/ bya ba bzang ngan gyi 'jug ldog lag len ma nor ba gal che/
rtsa ltung dang, nyes byas gnyis te snga ma la bco brgyad dang phyi ma la zhe lnga yod/

bya rgyud mtshan med rnal 'byor gyi sgom pa khyad par ba zhig ste, phung sogs kyi chos thams cad la rnam par dpyad de skye med du rtogs pa 'jug pa dang, mi rtog pa'i go bo mngon du gyur pa gnas pa dang, de las ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje chen po lhag par 'jug pa ni ldang ba/

1.(tha dad pa) bcug pa, gzhug pa, chug , 1) snod sogs kyi nang du 'jog pa dang blug pa/ phru gu bu bcol khang la bcug / 'dzin grwa de'i nang la slob phrug gsar pa re gnyis bcug / nyes can btson rar bcug / tshong zog rnams rlangs 'khor nang du chug cig / 2) gral du 'khrid pa/ chos dad med pa'i mi rnams btsan shed kyis chos la mi 'jug / yul gyar ba dag rang yul du log tu 'jug pa/ 3) byed pa dang, spyod pa/ bkod pa zhib gsal med na 'jug dka', skad cha zhib gsal med na go dka'/ dngos su lag bstar 'jug pa/ lus srog blos btang gis gzhan skyob par 'jug pa/ 'gro lugs ngan par 'jug mi rung/ 4) bya ba gang zhig skul ba'am kha sgyur ba/ rta la rtswa za ru 'jug / nad par sman 'thung du chug / gsang gros 'di'i rigs mi gzhan su la'ang shes su ma 'jug / mi dmangs rnams spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam bzang du 'gro ru 'jug dgos/ nga tsho tshang ma 'gro la, kho gcig pu 'dir sdod du chug / sgo phyugs 'phel du 'jug / 2.(tha mi dad pa) zhugs pa, 'jug pa, zhugs,, rjes su 'brang ba dang 'gro ba/ 'gro chas bsdogs te lam du 'jug / bzo pa'i gras su zhugs pa/ yi ge 'di ni 'gro ba'i don du'ang 'jug / 3...1) ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig ste, rgyu dang 'bras bu rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug pa/ 2) (mngon) nya dang, rus sbal, phag rgod, mi yi seng ge, mi'u thung, mi sdug pa, nag po, dga' byed ra ma na, rgyas pa ra ma na, sangs rgyas ki tra'i rtse ste khyab 'jug la 'jug pa bcu yod pas grangs bcu mtshon/

phyogs mthun nam phyogs mtshungs/ rnga rol rdung stangs dang gar 'cham 'khrab tshul 'jug pa gcig pa/ sngags lam du zhugs pa'i theg chen pa rnams chags can gyi lam du 'jug pa gcig pa/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gnyis chags bral gyi lam du 'jug pa gcig pa/ dug dang spyod ngan gyis rang gzhan phung tshul 'jug pa gcig pa red,/ nas las kyi sgra gnyis 'byung khungs kyi don la 'jug pa gcig pa, nas las...
sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par byed ched pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa'i spyod pa la dngos su 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'o/

sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi lnga pa yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brda dang tha snyad ston pa ste, dper na, 'di ni gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa'o zhes brda sbyar ba dang, ming la ka ba zer zhes tha snyad sbyar ba lta bu/

bya rgyud kyi lam gyi mngon rtogs spyod pa'i sgo bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, dbang nod cing rang gis 'dod pa'i lha dang dam tshig gzung ba sogs dbang gi snod rung du byed pa/

dbyibs nar mo/ la phug phal cher dbyibs 'jong 'jong red/ tshogs khang 'jong 'jong/

thur du 'phyang ba'am lhug pa'i tshul/ gyon chas 'jol thabs ma yin par brtsengs te gyon dgos/
gos gyon stangs ring po/ phyu pa gyon dus 'jol po min pa zhig dgos/
(tha mi dad pa) ring por nar ba'am 'phyang ba/ ska rags dam por ma bcings na gyon 'dabs sa la 'jol yong/ gyon pa 'jol ba de yar rtseng tsam gyis/
1) zla gam ring po zhig / 2) phu thung med pa'i gyon pa ring po zhig /
bye'u'i bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la gre 'gyur mkhan dang, lnga pa'i dbyangs snyan, dus tshigs kun 'gro bcas so,
bzo dbyibs 'phyang nge ba'i rnam pa/ grod pa 'jol le ba/
'bru 'jog sa'i bang ba/ til gyi rjang bu/
shed stobs zhan pa'i lus skem po'am sha rid po/
sha rid pa'am srab cing skem pa/ rta de'i sha shed shor nas ha cang rjud 'dug /
gtso bo dang bran nam gtso 'khor/

yan lag gi rus pa'i nang nas rje bo ltar gnyan zhing dbyibs ral gri'i so ltar ngar ba'i rus pa ste, lag pa'i mkhrig tshigs nas gru tshigs bar dang, rkang pa'i long tshigs nas pus tshigs bar gyi rus rkang che chung gnyis gnyis yod pa de'o/
1) zhabs drung/ 2) sku drag che gras kyi phru gu ser mo ba/
(tha dad pa) brjes pa, brje ba, rjes,, phan tshun sprod len gyis sgyur ba/ gsar rnying rje ba/ sa gnas brje ba/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje/ spyi tshogs lam lugs rtsa ba nas brjes pa/
gtso bo'am mgon po/ mi rje/ yul rje/ rje dbu 'phang mtho dus dal na dga'/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyab bdag dang, mgo 'dren, mgo dpon, bdag po, 'dren pa, dpon po, dbang phyug dbang byed bcas so,
bla ma mchog gam dam pa/
rgyal po dang blon po/ rje blon de gnyis gcig gi gcig gi bzhin la mngon par bltas nas 'bral mi bzod pa/
rgyal po blon po mi ser dang bcas pa/
chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang, lo chen bee ro tsa na, mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal bcas gsum/

bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod du gdan drangs te rgyal po dang gzhan 'bangs mang por gsang sngags kyi chos gsungs te grub pa thob pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga ste, khri srong lde'u btsan, nam mkha'i snying po, sangs rgyas ye shes, rgyal ba mchog dbyangs, mkhar chen bza', dpal gyi ye shes, dpal gyi seng ge, bee ro tsa na, gnyags dzny'a na ku ma ra, g.yu sgra snying po, rdo rje bdud 'joms, ye shes dbyangs, sog po lha dpal, zhang ye shes ste, dpal gyi dbang phyug ldan ma rtse mang, ska ba dpal brtsegs, shud bu dpal gyi seng ge, rgyal ba'i blo gros, khye'u chung lo, 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug rma rin chen mchog lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje, lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas, la gsum rgyal ba byang chub bcas/
gtso bo'am mchog ste gzhan thar lam du 'khrid mkhan gyi ded dpon lta bu yin pas na rje dang, sgo gsum gyi mi dge bas gtan nas ma gos pas na btsun pa zer/ rje...btsun...
sku drag rigs kyi btsun mo/
rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan
grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhe ming/
sgrol ma dkar ljang sogs 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar mdzad pa'i lha mo/
shes rab kyi lha mchog 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/
1) skyabs yul gyi che ba brjod pa'i bye brag cig / 2) sog po khal kha'i bla chen zhig jo nang pa ta ra na tha'i skye srid du grags/
ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam 'dren lnga pa dang, da lta byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung ba nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
rje bor gyur cing kun spyod btsun po'i bla ma/
1) gtso mo'am bdag mo/ 2) sku drag rigs kyi rab byung ma/ 3) lha mo/
ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa: zhes bya ba thar lo'i 'gyur, rgyud kyi glegs bam tsha par bzhugs/
rje tsong kha pa dang, rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen, mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ste gsum/
dpon rigs sam sku drag / ming gi rnam grangs la sku drag dang, jo bo, rje'u rigs, mi drag brla skyes, brla byung, sa reg bcas so,
rje rigs kyi bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye dgu ma dang, skye dgu'i bdag mo, jo mo, rje mo bcas so,
grub mtha' so sos rang rang gi bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'bod pa'i mtshan/
(tha dad pa) brjed pa, brjed pa, rjed,, gus 'dud dam brtsi bkur byed pa/ khong gi mdzad spyod bzang po ni bstod cing rjed par 'os pa zhig go/
1) mngon gsal lam dngos dngos rjen rjen/ gnas tshul tshang ma rjen gcer du mthong ba/ 'grel bshad rjen gcer du brgyab pa/ 2) gos med gcer bu/
'bru rigs ma brngos par btags pa/ dud 'gror rjen btags ster na sha shed slebs/
1) gcer bu hrang nge ba/ sgrib g.yogs med pa'i rjen ne ba/ 2) gsal le ba/ don rjen ne bar blo la shar na brjed dka'/

/ 1) khebs g.yogs med pa/ rkang rjen ma/ stod rjen ma/ lus rjen par 'don pa/ sa rjen pa/ gnas lugs rjen par mthong ba/ 2) ma tshos pa/ sha rjen pa/ 'bru rjen pa/ 'bras rjen pa/ 3) tshwa sdor sod med pa'i zas/ rjen thug / rjen chu/
rjen par btags pa'i phye ma/
rta sogs kyi sgal par sga stan med par zhon pa/ byis pa mang pos rta rjen zhon brgyab nas bang rtsal glod pa/
ma btsos ma bsregs ma brngos pa'i zas kun/
ma btsos ma bsregs ma brngos pa'i zas kyi rid/
bza' chas btsos nas ma tshos pa
(beeshya:) sngar rgya gar gyi mi rigs bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
1. rje ba'i skul tshig 2. shul/ rkang rjes/ rma rjes/ byas rjes/ rjes med shul med/

rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul gnyis pa, de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa ste, byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin pas khyab pa dang, du ba yod pas me yod par nges pa lta bu mthun pa'i phyogs la yod pa'am rtags kyi rjes su bsgrub bya 'gro ba'o/
rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las rnal ma bzhi'i nang gses, rtags de yin na gsal ba de yin pas khyab pa, dper na, byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/

log rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las khyab: pa phyin ci log pa bzhi'i nang gses rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pas khyab pa, dper na, byas pa yin na rtag pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu 'gal khyab rnal ma dang mtshungs pa'o/
snyan dngags le'u dang po nas 'byung ba'i rjes khrid kyi rgyan/
ma 'ongs pa'i gra sgrig / rjes grabs dpung sde/

ming brda 'dogs tshul zhig ste, dngos po byung ba'i rjes su 'dra 'brel gang rung gi rgyu mtshan la brten nas btags pa'i ming, dper na, khyi gu kha che sna nyag la seng ge zhes btags pa lta bu 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa dang, nyi ma'i 'od zer la nyi ma zhes btags pa lta bu 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa'o/
nges tshig gam rgyu mtshan la brten nas btags pa'i ming/
rjes grub kyi ming dang don gcig
1) phyis sam snga ma'i rgyab nas 'gro mkhan/ 2) 'dra ba'am mtshungs pa/
1) rkang rjes rtsad bcad pa/ rkun ma nags su phyin kyang rjes spang la bcad pa/ 2) na tsha rtsa ba nas bcad pa/

gyi rjes kyi cho ga ste: cho ga lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi ba dang lha tshim pa'i phyir zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg bya ba dang, dkyil 'khor mchod bstod dang phyogs skyong la gtor ma dbul ba dang, dkyil 'khor la phyag byas te bzod gsol bya ba dang, ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te rdul tshon chur gshegs dang, dge bsngo dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya ba'o/
1) rtsad bcad nas rnyed pa/ 2) rjes zin/ rkang thang gis rta ba'i rjes mi chod/
1) ming gzhi'i rjes su 'jug rung ba'i gsal byed ga sogs bcu/ ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa...2) rjes 'gro/ mkhas dbang rgan pas rjes 'jug gsar pa skyong/
ga da ba sa bzhi:/ ga da ba sa...
na ra la gsum/ na ra la...
1) rjes shul btsal ba/ 2) mdun bskyod dpung sde'i rgyab nas dgra nyen yong min gyi rtog zhib byed mkhan/
rjes su bsnyegs pa ste rjes zin par byed pa/ phru gus pha ma'i rjes bsnyegs nas phyin pa/ dgra bo bros pa'i rjes su bsnyegs pa/
mjug de ma thag / zhogs pa langs pa'i rjes thogs su lus rtsal sbyong ba/
mnyam par bzhag pa las ldang ba'i skabs/
lta bu'i stong nyid: mnyam bzhag las ldang skabs dbang po lnga'i yul du mthong thos gang byung yang sgyu ma'i ltad mo bzhin du mthong ba/
mnyam gzhag gi stobs kyis thob pa'i ye shes shes bya ji snyed pa thams cad la 'jug pa/

drug dge slob ma'i bsrung bya ste: gser la sogs pa'i rin po che bzung ba dang, 'doms kyi spu 'breg pa dang, sa rko ba dang, rtswa sngon gcod pa dang, byin len ma byas par za ba dang, gsog 'jog byas pa za ba spong ba ste drug /
cha 'dra ba'am phyogs mthun pa/ khyed kyis byas pa'i rjes mthun tsam yang kho bos mi thub/ zhi gnas rjes mthun pa/ lhag mthong rjes mthun pa/
phyis su mi brjed pa'i sems pa/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo rnams kyi byas rjes rjes dran byad pa/ rjes dran tshogs 'du/

bka' gdams pa'i man ngag lnga ste, skyabs gnas bla ma dran pa dang, lus lha'i rang bzhin dran pa, ngag bzlas brjod kyi rang bzhin dran pa, 'gro ba thams cad pha mar shes pa, sems kyi gnas lugs stong par shes pa/
rgyas pa tshos rtag tu mi brjed par dran: bya'i yul drug ste bla ma dang sangs rgyas, chos, dge 'dun, tshul khrims, gtong ba bcas so/
rjes zin par byed pa'i thabs/ rjes 'ded dmag /
1) byas chog pa'i dgongs pa/ 2) lha'i sgom bzlas dang 'chad nyan byed par dbang ba'i byin rlabs gnang ba/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste dgag bya yid la mi 'dod pa'i bya ba zhig 'gog byed rjes gnang gi tshig 'jam po'i sgo nas de'i grub 'bras yid du mi 'ong ba 'phral la 'byung ba zur gyis bstan te 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /

gcig 'phro gcig mthud mtha' 'khyongs byed pa/ bka' khrims kyi brda 'ded rjes gnon mthar skyel byed pa/ sngar bting 'char gzhi tshang ma bar lding 'phro can du ma lus par rjes gnon mthar skyel btang ste 'jug 'khyongs rjes gtsang yong ba byed dgos/
'gal 'dzol la gzhigs pa'i nyes pa drag po gtong rgyu/
(anumana) rtags mthong zhing 'brel ba nges pa'i rjes su bsgrub bya dpog pa'am gzhal bya lkog gyur 'jal ba ste du ba dang chu skyar gyi rtags las me dang chu yod par dpog pa lta bu'o/

bcad shes kyi nang gses, rang 'dren byed kyi rjes dpag tshad mas rtogs zin pa de slar yang rtogs pa'i shes pa ste, sgra mi rtag rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa la sogs pa rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa thams cad do/

rtags stobs kyis rang yul ji bzhin rtogs pa ste, dper na, sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag la mtshon na, sgra mi rtag pa gzhal bya, sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs las sgra mi rtag pa'i rnam par shar nas sgra mi rtag pa la gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa tshad ma, sgra mi rtag par dngos su rtogs pa rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras yin pa lta bu/
rjes dpag tshad ma dang don gcig
1) sgras brjod kyis dbye na, rang don rjes dpag dang, gzhan don rjes dpag ste gnyis/ 2) rtags sbyor gyis dbye na, rjes dpag yang dag dang, rjes dpag ltar snang ste gnyis so/
rang nyid kyi dam bca' sgrub par sbyor ba skyon can bkod nas 'gal ba'i rig pa byung ba/
tshad ma gnyis kyi nang gses, rang gi rten rtags yang dag la brten nas rang gi gzhal bya lkog gyur la gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig dper na, dngos stobs rjes dpag la sogs pa lta bu'o/
rgol phyi rgol gnyis kas khas len pa'i don: gzhir bzung gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba bkod nas phyi rgol gyis sngar dogs pa ma chod pa'i bsgrub bya ji bzhin rtogs pa'i zhen rig /
dngos stobs rjes dpag dang, grags pa'i rjes dpag dang, yid ches rjes dpag ste gsum mo/
phyag phyir 'gro mkhan las byed pa/
mtha' ma'i 'bras bu'am, rjes su yong rgyu'i 'bras bu/
dad sogs dge ba'i sems byung gi bag chags/
rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams kyi bag chags/
phyi ma'am 'jug ma/ mi rabs rjes ma/ gom rim rjes ma/
phyi ma'i yang phyi ma'am mjug ma'i yang mjug ma/
(rnying) lam bgrod skabs gzhan pa'i rjes su lus pa/
lam bgrod skabs gzhan pa'i rjes su lus pa'am, las ka'i byed tshad mgyogs po ma yin pa/
shul med pa/ rjes med du gtong ba/ khang pa rnying pa rjes med du gyur song/
rjes shul 'tshol ba/ lag rjes bzang po gang bzhag gi rjes 'tshol byed pa/
shul 'dzin/ mi rabs snga ma'i rjes 'dzin phyi mas byed pa
sgom skabs lha'i gzhal yas khang 'od gsal: du bsdus pa'i rjes su rang lus 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i rim pa
phyi bzhin/ lam rgyus pa'i rjes bzhin ma 'brangs na 'gro lam nor yong/
rjes su slebs pa/ da lta lam sang phyin na kho'i rjes zin gyi red/ rta rgyug byas rung rlangs 'khor gyi rjes mi zin/
lad zlos/ gzhan gyi rjes zlos byas nas bshad na mi legs/ dge rgan gyi gsung dbyangs ji bzhin rjes zlos byed pa/
thugs rjes bskyangs pa/ dge rgan gyis slob phrug rjes bzung thog yon tan mthar phyin bslabs pa/
rjes la rtogs pa'i bzod pa ste, khams gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos la bden bzhi ji ltar mthong bas mthong spang dngos su spong ba'i gnyen po bar chad med lam mo/
phyis su yong rgyu sngon tshud nas dran pa/ rjes 'ong sngon dran gyis bsam gzhigs byed pa/
rjes su yi rang ba'i bsdus tshig
phyis su yong rgyu sngon tshud nas shes rtogs/
sgom lam ste mthong lam gyi rjes la bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam/
rjes ma zin pa/ shes rig yon tan rjes lus thebs pa/ lag rtsal rjes lus thebs dogs kyis sbyang brtson hur skyed byed pa/
sngar gyi bzo dbyibs sam sa mal/
rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa ste, khams gong ma gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos la bden bzhi ji ltar mthong bas mthong spang spangs te bral 'bras nyams su myong ba'i rnam grol lam mo/
mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/ khyod gdong pad ma'i rjes su rkang pa 'jog /
1) phyi la bgrod pa/ sngon thon pa rnams kyi rjes su 'gro ba/ 2) mtshungs gsal gyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/
yi ge'i steng du 'bri ba'i thig kor/
mtshungs gsal gyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/
rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa
bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bcu drug gi nang gses shig /
1) bshad pa/ 2) mig ston byed pa dang bslab bya byed pa/
sems kyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa'i shas gang che ba brtags nas gnyen po de dang de ston pa/
1) yongs su 'grigs pa'am 'chams pa/ 2) phyogs 'dra ba'am mtshungs pa/
snga ma'i gnas tshul sems la yongs su shar ba'am bsam pa/ sngon dus su sdug bsngal byung lugs rjes su dran pa/ bka' drin rjes su dran pa/

mthar gyis sbyor ba drug sher phyin don bdun: cu las mthar gyis sbyor ba'i chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, chos rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, gtong ba rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa ste drug go/
rjes su gcags pa ste 'gyod pa'i don/
sngon la song ba de'i rjes zin thabs byed pa/ sngon du 'gro mkhan gyi rjes su 'ded pa/
byas chog pa'i dgongs pa 'khrol ba/
sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gleng gzhi dang, mtshams sbyor dang, mthun 'gyur yi rang bcas/
rjes su dpag pas gnod pa
tshig gcig lan gnyis brjod pa zlos skyon du mi 'gyur bar do gal gyis brnan pa'i sgra ste, kye ma kye ma, dge'o dge'o zhes pa rnams so/
1) phyi rjes su 'gro ba/ gzhan gyis bshad pa'i kha rjes su 'brang ba/ bu phrug pha ma'i rjes su 'brang ba/ 2) grangs kyi rgyun/ chu tshod rjes 'brang bcas/
phyi ma snga ma la brten pa'am rag las pa/ bza' las rjes 'brel/ da lta'i gnas lugs gang ci snga ma'i lo rgyus kyi rjes su 'brel ba zhig red
rjes su mya ngan byed pa
sngar byung mi legs pa dran nas skyo snang byed pa/
rang gis dngos su tshor ba/
1) snying rje byed pa/ 2) gar stabs shig
rim gyis 'tshol nyul byed pa/ snga ma'i lo rgyus kyi shul rnying rjes su 'tshol ba/
rjes su yi rang sgom lam
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig rang gzhan gyi dge ba la mngon par dga' ba'o/
yid la bab pa'am mos pa/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba/ khos dmangs la phan thogs yod pa'i bya ba byed par tshang mas rjes su yi rang byas/
1) rtogs pa/ 2) shes pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig
1) phyis su smras pa/ 2) mjug tu bshad pa/
1) rjes 'brang ngam rjes su 'jug pa/ 2) shes thabs byed pa/
rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can
dgra bcom pa drug gi nang gses, gang dbang po rtul po 'dod yon gyis myos na mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa las nyams pa'i skal ba can yin la ma myong na ma yin pa'o/
rjes ma'am mjug / ca lag 'di rjes sor mkho che/
(tha dad pa) brjod pa, brjod pa, rjod,, smra ba/ skyon cha brjod pa/ skad cha rjod pa/ lo rgyus rjod pa/ brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi tshig /
brda'i dbang gis rang yul go byed kyi mnyan bya'am sgra, ming dang tshig lta bu'o/
/ 1) lce'i zhe sa/ 2) ming tshig 'ga' zhig gi sngon du sbyor rgyu'i zhe sa'i tshig / ljags rtsom/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, ljags mnyen pa dang, ljags srab pa dang, ljags dmar ba/
bkod pa/ las ka byed lugs byed stangs kyi ljags bkod gnang ba/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs: mi ser tshos lo ltar srid gzhung la gro skyel 'dren gyi 'ul mi gtong dgos pa'i khral zhig /
sbu gu'i thog na bu ga bdun yod pa'i 'bud bya rol mo zhig gi ming/
bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i bsngo smon/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, tshig 'jam pos 'dul ba nyid kyis ljags mnyen pa/
sgom chen pa'am lha'i sngags 'dren pa po/
ras dar tshon skud sogs kyi dbus su rdo rje'i mdud pa byas nas sngags btab pa'i srung mdud/
lce rtse yar gug ste dril ba ltar byed pa ste khro ba'i nyams/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, chos 'dul ba byis pa'i skye bo chags pa can gyis gting dpag dka' ba nyid kyis ljags dmar ba/
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, 'jam po la sogs pa gsung bas ljags ring ba/
phrin lan/ dge rgan gyis nga la ljags lan gnang ba 'phrod byung/
dpe cha'i lung/ dpe cha po ti mang po'i ljags lung gnang ba/
dpe cha'i khrid 'chad pa/ rig gzhung gi thog mtha' bar gsum nas ljags bshad gnang ba/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, yon tan 'thad pa mang ba nyid kyis ljags srab pa/
1) kha dog ljang dkar/ 2) spang dang dkar rag bbsres pa'i mdog /
tshos gzhi ljang gu shas che ba'i khra bo/
kha dog gi bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la lo ma kha dang, lo ma'i mdog go ,
ljang gu dang sngon po 'dres pa'i mdog /
'jang nas thon pa'i ja dkyus ma zhig /
kha dog ljang gu'i mtshon tshul/ spang ri ljang thing nge ba zhig 'dug /
(yul) rgyu bzang lhad med/ dngul ljang rdung/ gser ljang rdung/
lo tog gi ljang pa'i sdong bu/
ljang gu dang nag po 'dres pa'i mdog /
gro nas kyi myu gu sngon po/ ljang pa lag pas 'then pas skye rogs mi yong/ ming gi rnam grangs la nges sgrib dang, sngo sangs, ma smin pa bcas so,
ser po dang ram gnyis kyi mdangs bton pa'i sprin ris/
lo tog gsar pa'i myu gu btogs nas lam 'grul la sprad de dngul slong rgyag byed ljang pa'i chun po chung ngu/
gro nas kyi myu gu sngon po/
tshal sogs gsar skyes kyi myu gu /
ljang gu dang dmar po 'dres pa'i mdog /

khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gyi sras, gyim shing kong jo khab tu bzhes rgyu byas na'ang, kong jo bod du ma slebs pa'i gong la rgyal sras 'di rtas drud nas 'das so, ljang zhes pa la 'jang zhes pa'ang snang/
(yul) lham gyi yu bar btang ba'i 'ja' ljang gu'i ming/
ljang gu dang ser po 'dres pa'i kha dog /
mi gtsang ba nyal nyil/ sa ljan ljin/ chu ljan ljin/ 'dam rdzab ljan ljin gyi khrod nas nor bu rnyed pa/ drag char btang mtshams ljan ljin gyi rdzab rnyog langs pa/
thal mo khong stong du sbyor ba'i tshul/
drag tu mnan pa'am tshir gyis non por mnan pa/ shal ba gcig gis zhing ga'i rol brgya ljar gyis mnan pa/ gyad stobs ldan gcig gis stobs med mang po ljar gyis mnan pa/
dam por non nges byas te bsad pa/ brag gi 'og tu ri dwags ljar gyis bsad pa/
ljar gyis mnan gyi bsdus tshig
mi phyugs kyi lus nas khrag 'jib pa'i srin bu zhig
lci yang gi tshad 'dra ba/ lcags srang gang dang bal srang gang ljid mnyam red/
lci po yod pa'i rnam pa/ sems ljid tig ge ba'i ngang nas phyin song/ khur po khur te ljid tig ge bar 'gro bzhin pa/
ljid theg khur ljid khyog pa
lci mos sam shugs kyis gnon pa/ rmon mdzo'i mjing pa'i gnya' shing gi ljid gnon chen po yod/
yang ba'i ldog pa/ 'gan ljid pa/ khral ljid pa/ skyed kha ljid pa/ do po ljid pa de g.yag la 'gel rgyu yin/
lci ba ste lci yang gi tshad che ba/ ha cang ljid po/ ljid che ba/ kha ljid po/ ljid po rgyab kyis ma 'drong ba dang, ral po lhan pas ma khebs pa/
khur che la sna grangs mang ba/ las 'gan ljid rdzob che ba zhig 'khris yod pa/ khral 'ul ljid rdzob che ba/
lci thibs thibs sam ljid thibs se ba/ ca lag ljid yor yor ba rnams 'khyer dus shugs skyed dgos/ rdog khres ljid yor re ba de 'khyer khag po yod/
ljid yor yor dang don gcig
/ 1) yul sde dang sa cha/ yul ljongs/ sman ljongs/ nags ljongs/ gangs can ljongs/ rang skyong ljongs/ 2) sngar rgya gar du bram ze sogs mi rigs bzhi tshang ba'i yul phyogs la zer/
ljongs su 'gro ba ste, phyi rol tu lam thag ring tshad rgyang grags tsam gyi sa char 'gro ba/ lug rdzis ra lug bdas nas ljongs rgyu bzhin 'tsho ba/ ljongs rgyu bzhin par dbus yul du 'byor
yul de rang du skyes pa'i mi/
shing gi yal ga'i grib bsil/ ljon grib 'gro lam/

/ 1) skye shing che phra spyi/ lcang ljon/ ljon phran/ ljon pa che la brten pa yi, 'khri shing rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs, tsher ma shing la brten byas na, gnad du zug pa'i sdug bsngal skye/ 2) zangs dmar/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 4) mi'am ci'i yul/
dngul chu dbyangs can grub rdor gyis mdzad pa'i sum cu pa'i snying po/

skye shing spyi'i ming/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang 'thung dang, rkang pas 'thung, mgo lding can, 'gro 'gog 'gro med, chur mi lhung, ljon pa, steng skye ba, 'dab ldan, 'dab ma yangs ldan, sdong po, rnam rgyas, phung po can, rtse mo can, yal ga can, yal ga bres, yal ga 'dzin, yal 'dab can, rlan las skyes, lo ma can, sa skyes bcas so,
skye shing sna tshogs kyi skyed tshal lam gling ga /
mdog sna 'dres nas mi gsal ba'i rnam pa/ kha dog ljob ljob/ lud pa sngo ljob tu lu ba/
rdzig po'am bab chags pa/ gzugs po brjid chags pa/ pho brang brjid chags pa/ brjid chags mdzes sdug dang ldan pa'i tshogs khang chen po/
kyi rnam 'gyur:/ brjid nyams dod po/ btsan shed 'jigs skul la zhum pa med par brjid nyams dang ldan pa'i ngang nas yar langs pa/
gzi brjid kyis pha rol po rang shugs su non pa/ dgra bo rnams rang dmag gi brjid non ma bzod par bros song/
(tha mi dad pa) rngam po'am mdzes por gyur pa/ yon tan gyis brjid pa/ mtshan snyan gyis brjid pa/ rnam 'gyur brjid pa/
gzi rngam chen po/ gdong mdangs brjid po/
yid du 'ong ba/ mi babs brjid bag dang ldan pa/ mi de lus stobs che la bzhin mdzes shing brjid bag dang ldan pa zhig red/
gsar rnying sogs phan tshun brje rgyu'i ming/ brje po slog pa/
brje rgyu'i dngos po'i rin tshab 'phral du sprod pa/
phan tshun brje ba'i sprod len/ tshong zog brje sprod/ ja rta brje sprod/

bar ma rab byung gis chos 'di pa'i bsam pa bskyed pa'i phyir du, bsam pa dang rtags dang, ming brje ba ste gsum mo, de la bsam pa brje ba ni tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don gnyer gyi bsam pa dor nas dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i bsam pa phun tshogs skyed pa dang, rtags brje ba ni lus kyi byi byad skra dang kha spu bregs shing khrus byed pa dang gos chos gos mthang gos gding ba sogs tshad dang ldan pa, snod lhung bzed chu tshags sogs tshad ldan yod pa dang, ming brje ba ni mkhan po'i mtshan gyi mtha' can nam, dpal dang, grags pa dang bzang po la sogs pa'i mtha' can gyi ming 'dogs pa'o/
brje po rgyag rgyu'i tshong/ 'bru dang mar gnyis phan tshun brje tshong byed pa/
brje ba'i res mos/ nyin rer 'gan khur brje res thengs gsum byed pa/ ston dgun mtshams su gyon pa brje res byed dgos/ las byed pa gsar rnying brje res byed pa/
phan tshun brje ba/ skye ba brje len ma byas na, bar do zer ba ga nas mthong/
nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses, dge ba'i dmigs pa mi gsal bar brjed pa dran pa'i mi mthun phyogs te dran pa 'chal ba sems g.yeng ba'i rten byed pa'o/ lo na je cher song na brjed ngas je cher 'gro yong/
don gang yang myur du brjed 'gro ba'i mi/
brjed ngas can dang don gcig
brjed nas brlags pa'am bor ba/
mi brjed pa'i phyir du bris pa'i tho/ zhib gsal gyis brjed thor bkod pa/ bka' slob rnams brjed thor bris yod/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) bskyud pa'am blo yul nas yal ba/ khar sang bshad pa de brjed tshar 'dug / de don ma brjed yid la zung/ na tsha drag na em rje brjed, la mgor bud na rta pho brjed/ 2) rjed pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
mi brjed pa'i phyir bris pa'i tho yig /
1) brjed ngas kyis rig pa 'khrul ba'i nad rigs shig / 2) dran pa gtor byed kyi gdon zhig /
dran gso'am dran skul/ gnangs nyin byed rgyu'i las ka rnams sang nyin brjed gso zhig byed pa/ brjed dogs yod pa'i rkyen gyis yang yang brjed gso byas/
brjod mi lang ba dang don gcig

'dul ba'i brda chad cig ste, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi nang gses, ltung ba gleng yang skabs mi 'byed na brjod pa dang bcas pa byed dgos pa ste, de ji ltar zhe na, tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge 'dun gyis brjod pa dang bcas pa nyid byas pa yin gyi, dge 'dun la ma zhus par khyod gnas gzhan du ma 'gro zhig brjod, des ma thul skabs mi 'byed na gdams ngag bzhag pa dang, gso sbyong dang dgag dbye bzhag pa sogs kyi nan tur bya la, des ma thul na gnas dbyung bya ba'o/
bshad pa'i gtam mam shod rgyu'i skad cha/
1) bshad rgyu med pa dang, lab mi thub pa/ 2) brjod bya'i don med pa/ 3) grangs gnas shig /
brjod du med pa las kyang brjod du med pa

ming gang rung gi mthar sbyar ba'i rjes 'jug des rang ming gi cha shas su 'dren rgyu'i yi ge de, rang dang pho mo ma ning sogs kyi rtags mi mtshungs kyang ngag thog nas brjod bde'i dgos pa gtso bor byas nas skabs su gang bab kyi ming gzhi'i yi ge sgra mthun pa zhig 'dren tshul te, dper na, thog kha, tham ka, 'da' kha lta bu/ thog kha...ga...kha...tham ka... ma...ka, 'da' kha...'a...kha...
1) ngag thog gam kha nas bshad bde ba/ 2) brjod tshig bde ba/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, mtshon byed dpe la skyon dang yon tan gyi cha gnyis gang yod kyang rung, don du mtshon bya dpe can dang phan tshun 'dra'o zhes nan tan gyi sgo nas brjod 'dod yod pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

1.rjod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. 1) ming dang, tshig brjod pa gsum du phye ba'i brjod pa ni tshig mang po sbrel nas grub pa'i don ldan gyi ngag gi phreng ba/ rtse mo phra zhing rno ngar dang ldan pa'i ral gri/ 2) brjod bya/
skad cha bshad rgyu med pa'am spros bral/
gsung lnga'i ya gyal zhig gang la gang 'dul gyi sgra skad dang mthun par dus gcig tu chos ston pa ni sprul sku brjod pa tshig gi gsung zhes sngags rnying ma'i brda chad do/
skad cha bshad rgyu yod pa/
brda las go bar bya ba ste, dper na, ka ba dang, bum pa lta bu rang rang gi ming brjod pa la brten nas rang yul go bar bya ba'i shes bya'i chos thams cad do/
brjod kyis mi lang ba ste, mang drags pas ji tsam bshad kyang rdzogs rgyu med pa/ rgyu mtshan brjod mi lang ba/ byas rjes brjod kyis mi lang ba/ tshig gcig dang gnyis nas brjod mi lang/
skad cha shod stangs/ brjod tshul rnying hrul/ nang gi brjod tshul/ brjod tshul 'dra min sna tshogs/
bshad rgyu'i rtsa ba'am gleng gzhi/

bod yig gsal byed brgyad pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan sna dang bcas pa dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba rkan lce gnyis phrad dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1.ming gzhi'i shin tu mo'i yi ge zhig / 2. 1) chu'i nang la gnas pa'i srog chags rgal tshigs can zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la 'gro ldan dang, rgyab ring, sgong skyes, chur nyal, chus mi 'tshub, rnam 'pho, sna tshogs rgyu, mig mi 'dzum, gser mig can bcas so, 2) nyi zla gnyis kha gtad du 'char bas zla ba 'phel kha gang ba'i dus te tshes bco lnga/

skar ma mgo dang, rgyal, mchu, dbo, nag pa, sa ga ,snron, chu stod, gro bzhin, khrums stod, tha skar, smin drug rnams, nya skar gyi dbang du byas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis po gtso bor mar ngo sngon 'gro can yin/
1) khog pa'i nang du mu tig chags thub pa'i chu skyes 'bu rigs shig / 2) chu bal/
khyim bcu gnyis pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar nyer bzhi dang chu tshod zhe lnga shar tshe nyi ma nya khyim la slebs/
nya'i phags par khrab kyi byang bu nang bzhin yod pa de'i ming/
gri gum btsan po'i bu gsum pa'i ming/
bza' chas dang sman du 'gro ba'i shing/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mig 'grib sel, mes tshig pa'i rma gso/
chu nang du nya 'khyugs te 'gro ba
1) ljid tshad 'jal byed/ nya ga mtho dman med par drang por 'degs pa/ 2) nyag gang ngam srang gang/ 3) ri'i har nyag kha/
1) tshes pa bco lnga/ 2) tshes pa bco lnga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sne gdong rdzong khongs yar klungs gtsang po'i thog gi gru kha zhig /
nya 'dzin byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la dra ba dang, dol, tshogs kyi srad bu bcas so,
zla ba nya gang ba'am zla ba'i cha shas rdzogs pa/
1) nya rigs kyi sgo nga/ 2) nya dang sgo nga'i bsdus ming/
1) nya'i rnga ma/ nya'i rnga ma ltar 'dzin dka' ba/ 2) (yul) me mda'i mjug shing/
1) nya phyis/ ming gi rnam grangs la grol ba can skyed byed dang, nya skyogs, mu tig skye gnas, mu tig 'byung gnas, mu tig ma bcas so, 2) chu nang gi sngo ral pa lta bu zhig ste chu bal yang zer/
chu'i steng nas nya gyen du 'phar ba'am mchong ba/
bzang ngan dbye 'byed mi byed pa'i dpe/ bzang ngan dbye zhib ma byas par nya nyung mnyam bsre byed mi rung/
1) nya 'dzin mkhan/ 2) sngar rgya gar gyi grub chen l'u i pa/
nya gang tshes bco lnga dang gnam stong tshes sum cu gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
tshes bco lnga dang, sum cu, brgyad de dus bzang gsum/
tshes bco lnga la bshams pa'i ston mo/
zla ba nya gang ba dang skar ma smin drug 'dzom pa'i dus te hor zla bcu pa'i tshes pa bco lnga/
nya mgo skor byed pa'i zas rigs/
nor phyugs la thog mar nya nad phog skabs 'khun sgra sgrog pa dang, mjug ma 'dar ba, mig mi 'dzum pa, nang du rgyu ma skam pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi 'gos nad che gras shig /
nya 'dzin mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkyal chen pa dang, chur 'jug nya 'ching pa, nya yis 'tsho ba, dol thogs, dra ba 'dzin bcas so,
mgo nya dang so sram yin pa'i chur gnas srog chags bye brag pa zhig /
nya sha dang, phag sha, sgo nga bcas kyi bsdus ming/
1) rin po che'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas klad skyon gso, rtsa dkar gyi nad sel, dug nad 'joms/ 2) khog pa'i nang du mu tig chags thub pa'i chu skyes srog chags shig /
nya phyis dung gi dbyibs can/
nya phyis las bzos pa'i khebs sam g.yogs/
nya phyis kyi dum bu'am phye ma/
chu'i nang nas nya gyen du 'phyo ba'am mchong ba/
(tha mi dad pa) gang ba/ tha skar gyis nya ba/ smin drug gis nya ba/
slob ma bud med/ skal ldan gyi nya ma/
skyin khebs kyi bye brag cig /
nya spyi'i ming/ rgya mtsho skam nus na nya mo 'chi mi nus pa med/ mtsho gting thag ring na nya mo mang/
1) nya lcibs 'dra ba'i chu rtswa zhig / 2) nya mang po 'du ba'i gnas/
1) nya 'dzin pa/ 2) nya 'dzin gyi rgya'am rnyi/ 3) (mngon) sram/
nya 'dzin yo byad cig / ming gi rnam grangs la lcags kyu dang, nya 'bigs, nya 'dzin bcas so,
nya gral du gshibs pa lta bu/ sgrub khang der 'og tu thog rim gsum dang, steng du thog rim gcig yod pa la gdung bzang po nya gzhib gzhib tu btang/
1) nya pa/ 2) chu bya nya zan/
nya blug snod kyi gzeb bu/
1) bdag gnyer dang, nyar tshags/ sa zhing nya ra byas/ 'di rnams nya ra byed rogs/ 2) dag gtsang gi ming/ khang pa nya ra byed pa/ 3) nya gso sa'i chu rdzing/ 4) (rnying) dogs zon/
1) nya'i rus pa/ 2) (yul) lham gyi rting pa'i 'ja' gnyis pa'i phar phyin/

1) zhag zhig gam dbyibs thon po med pa'i rnam pa zhig / rdog la mi 'dril ba'i khur po nya re nyo re de 'khyer mi bde/ 2) hur brtson med pa'i las ka byed stangs/ tshar dus med pa'i las ka nya re nyo re byed pa/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba'i drod nyams pa dang, dang ga 'gags pa, mkhal ma'i grang ba, khu ba nyams pa sogs la phan/
tshes bco lnga dang, gnam gang/

'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod, chu 'go dmar tsag la nas byung zhing de'i stod rgyud la mdo mkhar gzhung chu dang, smad rgyud la nya bshang chu zhes zer rta dbang chu dang 'dres rjes lho ngos 'brug yul du 'bab/
1) nya'i sgal rgyab tu skyes pa'i gshog pa lta bu/ 2) nya phyis las bzos pa'i bud med kyi rgyan cha sgor sgor zhig / 3) mtsho 'gram dang bye 'dam du gnas pa'i srog chags skogs shun can zhig /
gcig bcom nas gcig gso ba'am, bzang po bcom nas ngan pa gso ba'i dpe/

(legs) bod skad du rkang mang zhes bya zhing, de'i sa bon ni yungs dkar gyi bzhi cha tsam yod pa la lo re la yal ga rgyang grags tsam du khyab par skye bar bshad pas shin tu 'phel stobs che ba'i shing zhig gi ming/ sa bon chung smin nya gro ta'i, yal 'dab rgyas pas rgyang grags khebs/ ming gi rnam grangs la nya gro dha dang, pa da, bhu bad bcas so,
/ 1) kong kong ngam gshong can/ sna nyag / la nyag / 2) mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i tshig / 3) nya ga'i bsdus tshig / lci yang gang yod nyag tu 'dren, bzang ngan gang yin 'bras bur stos/
nyag rong lung pa'i bar cha/ nyag stod smad rked gsum/
nya ga che chung gi bar khyad rtsi tshul/ bcu bdun spor do khal gyi brgyad cha bdun/ bcu gsum spor gang gsum cha sum cha gnyis/
: mi grung ba dang nyog po'i rnam pa/ chu nyag ge nyog ge dwangs su 'jug pa/ gtam nyag ge nyog ge rna ba la gzan/
1) rkyang pa'am kho na/ 'chi rgyu nyag gcig las thabs mi 'dug / ri mtho shos nyag gcig / 2) rkang gcig /

'bri chu'i chu lag cig si khron zhing chen gyi nub phyogs su yod, chu 'go mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ba yan ha ri'i lho ngos nas byung ste shar lho'i khri 'du dang, ser shul, dkar mdzes, nyag chu kha sogs brgyud de mthar 'bri chur 'bab/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus khul du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de spun zla grong du yod/
gshong gshong ngam kong kong:/ la nyag nyag / sna nyag nyag /
lta bu mi gtsang ba sna tshogs:/ phub ma nyag nyig /
1) nyag ge nyog ge'i bsdus tshig 2) (yul) byis pa
nya ga'i mthil lam srang mthil/
'phred kyi kong mo'am, shur shur/ rked pa nyag po/ sna nyag / 'gro lam nyag po gang yod la sa snon brgyab nas sgang gshong cha mnyam bzos pa/
dbul phongs mthar thug gam nyam thag pa/ zas gos kyis dbul ba'i nyag phra tha zhan gyi mi la skyob gso gnang ba/
1) rkang phra po/ thag pa nyag phra ba/ shing nyag phra ba/ 2) zhan pa'am nyam thag pa/ mi cha nyag phra ba/ 'tsho ba nyag phra ba/
myag phran yang zer, mda'/ gtam dang nyag phran drang na dga'/ nyag phran 'phangs pa ltar brgyugs pa/
rkang ngam lcug / spu nyag ma gcig / rtswa nyag ma gsum/ skud nyag kha shas/
(rnying) 1) a phyi'am pha ma'i a ma/ 2) nag mo'am bud med/
khams nyag rong pa'i zhwa mo/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus khul dang nyag chu'i chu rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de bar shog na yod/
gnad la bkar ba/ nyes can rnams khrims khang du nyag la bkag nas zhu ba len pa/
nyag sa'i shur kha/ shing la nyag shur cig bton pa/ rtsig pa la nyag shur bzos pa/
lci yang 'degs spyad nya ga'am srang/
sngar bod kyi rigs rus bye brag cig /
rdzong zhig nying khri'ang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer gyi shar ngos nyang chu'i smad rgyud na yod/
chang nge chung nge dang mtshungs te cung zad tsam/ rtswa nyang nge nyung nge rta drel gyis za rin med/
dbus kyi dwags kong sa khul gyi chu bo zhig ste, sngar bod kyi nyang zhes pa'i rigs rus shig gi tsho pa sdod yul gyi sa cha'i ming la brten nas btags pa'i chu klung zhig /
nyang nge nyung nge'i bsdus tshig
mngon chung sgo nas zhib 'jug byed pa/ dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul la nyang gnon rtog zhib mthar phyin byas nas phar rgol gyi 'char gzhi bting ba/
so pa'am myul ma byed mkhan/
/ 1) yar klungs kyi sa cha zhig / 2) kong po dang spo yul sa 'brel gyi yul spyi'i ming/

nyi ma 'od zer: rab byung gnyis pa'i shing 'brug la 'khrungs pa'i rnying ma'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i nang du gu ru chos dbang dang 'di rnam gnyis la gter ston gong 'og gnyis zhes grangs snyan shin tu che, rab byung gsum pa'i chu byi lor 'das/
1) bya rmyang/ 2) yib nas blta tshul/ gzhan gyis ma mthong bar nyad nyod kyi sgo nas so lta byed/
mis gang bshad kyi rjes su 'jug pa/
nyan snying brod po/ de ring glu sgra nyan snying 'dod po zhig thos byung/

theg pa gsum gyi nang tshan nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa'i gang zag ste, theg chen gyi sde snod rang gis gtso bor nyams su mi len pa dang, sangs rgyas sogs las nyan zhing thos par byed pas na nyan thos dang, thos nas gzhan la sgrog par byed pas na thos sgrog kyang zer/ ming gi rnam grangs la brtul zhugs dbang po dang, thub dbang gsung skyes, theg chung skyes bu, thos sgrog pa, sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa bcas so,

'jug sgo so thar rigs bdun gang rung gi tshul khrims blangs nas ma nyams par bsrung la, lta ba phung lngas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag gis stong par shes kyang chos bdag phra ba cha med gnyis bden par 'dod cing, sgom pa zhi gnas bzhag thabs dgu dang, lhag mthong bden bzhi bcu
theg dman gyi sa lam gyi rnam gzhag dang, blang dor ston pa'i gsung rab/
'byor mngon sum: bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos mthong sgom gyi mnyam bzhag ye shes dang dgra bcom pa'i mkhyen pa rnams so/
nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam gang rung/
rigs gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, theg dman nyan thos kyi chos la mos pa'i gras/
rigs can gsum gyi nang gses, nyan thos kyi rigs sad pa'i gang zag /
dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug nyan zhing shes pa'i sgo nas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa dang nyon sgrib spong ba'i lam/
nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes
dmigs pa bden bzhi gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa mi rtag pa sogs gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs so/
dman pa sa brgyad kyi tha ma/
rang nyid zhi ba don du gnyer ba'i blos 'jigs skyob dang legs smon tsam ma yin par 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs pa'i tshul khrims/
nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa yongs su spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa'o/

ston pa shakya thub pa'i nyan thos nye 'khor bcu ste, sha ri'i bu dang, mo'u 'gal gyi bu dang, 'od srung chen po dang, kun dga' bo dang, sgra gcan 'dzin dang, ka tya'i bu dang, ma 'gag pa dang, gang po dang, rab 'byor dang, nye ba 'khor rnams so/
nyan thos kyi theg pa dang don gcig
nyan thos theg pa'i mchod rten
theg dman lugs kyi mchod rten 'di'i bzo dbyibs snam sbyar lteb tshigs bzhi: brgyab kyi steng du lhung bzed kha sbubs te steng du 'khar gsil bslangs pa lta bu zhig yod
nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad
nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi las gyes pa yan lag bco brgyad de, yod smra sde pa bdun dang, phal chen sde pa lnga, gnas brtan sde pa gsum, mang bkur sde pa gsum bcas bco brgyad do/
nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i sde pa gnyis te bye brag smra ba dang mdo sde pa/
nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi dang don gcig
nyan thos mthong lam pa dang, sgom lam pa, mi slob lam pa bcas gsum/
nyan thos kyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i dgra bcom pa'o/
nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi
sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi ste, thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde dang, phal chen pa'i sde, gnas brtan pa'i sde, mang pos bkur ba'i sde rnams so/
nyan thos tshogs sbyor mthong sgom lam pa/
1) lkog nas nyan pa'am phag nas nyan pa/ 2) (mngon) bang chen/
phag nyan nam lkog nyan byed mkhan/
nyan rna byed pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, phan tshun mi mthun pa'i bsam pas gzhan dag gleng mo byed pa la lkog tu nyan pa/
(yul) lkog gtam la zur nyan dang, bya spyod la spyang grung/ phyi'i gnas tshul nyan rna sbi gsang byed pa/

1. (tha dad pa) mnyan pa, mnyan pa, nyon,, 1) thos par byed pa'am rna bas sgra len pa/ blo la mi 'bab pa'i skad cha nyan 'dod med/ blo kha ma gtad pas mnyan kyang ma thos pa/ snying gtam bshad pa nyan par rna ba legs par blags pa/ 2) dang du len pa dang, khas len pa/ mi nyan pa la kha ta ma byed/ 2. rung ba'am 'grig pa/ za nyan pa/ 'thung nyan pa/ brgya kha gcig gcod byed mi nyan/
(yul) lkog nyan nam phag nyan byed pa/ sgo rgyab tu gab nas gzhan gyis ci bshad la nyan pa rgyag gin 'dug /
rigs la bar dpang gis 'dum 'grig ma byas: gong do bdag gnyis phyogs nas bar dpang gi sar bzhag pa'i khas len gan rgya
nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi bsdus ming/
nyan rang gang zag zung bzhi

theg pa chung ngu'i lam du zhugs nas 'bras bu rim gyis thob pa'i gang zag zung bzhi ya brgyad de, rgyun zhugs zhugs 'bras gnyis, phyir 'ong zhugs 'bras gnyis, phyir mi 'ong zhugs 'bras gnyis, dgra bcom zhugs 'bras gnyis bcas zung bzhi/
nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi lam/
go shes nyan shes can te tshig don legs par rtogs thub mkhan/
ca lag len par lag pa rkyong tshul zhig / lag pa nyab nyab byas nas bza' btung len/
nyab be nyob be'i bsdus tshig

(yul) 1) lag pa brkyangs nas 'dzin pa'am len thabs byed pa/ khang pa mun nag gi nang du ka ba nyab pa ltar/ lag pas shing tog yod sar bsnyabs kyang nyab thub kyi mi 'dug / 2) bsdu ba'am rub rub bzo ba/ sa la 'thor nas lag pas nyab pa/
khams nyog pa'i rnam 'gyur/ lus sems nyab be nyob bes las kar shugs mi thon/
1) gnas tshul zhan pa'am sdug bsngal ba/ 'tsho ba nyam nga ba'i gnas su gyar ba/ 2) bag tsha ba'am 'jigs pa/ dka' tshegs che ba ci 'dra zhig thug kyang nyam nga spu tsam med/
khams snyoms pa'am gzugs po bde thang/
nyam nga ba chung ba dang don gcig
'khos dman pa'am stobs dman pa/ gsar thon stobs shugs nyam chung lta bur mngon yang yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i nus pa che/ phru gu'i ngu sa pha ma dang, nyam chung gi zhu sa dpon po yin/

1) byus nyes sam pham gyong/ btsan 'dzul par mthar nyam nyes yong rgyu nyag gcig yin/ gzhan la nyam nyes btang ste rang gi khe phan sgrub pa/ 2) stobs shugs nyams pa dang, gyong gud byung ba/ yun ring na nas lus por nyam nyes byung ba/
stobs chung ba'am 'khos zhan pa dang skyo ba/ nyam thag pa'i skad kyis ngu ba/ nyam thag pa'i nga ro 'byin pa/ nyam thag dbul phongs/ nyam thag mi 'khyar/ nyam thag mthar lhung/
'khos ka zhan pa'am nyam chung ba/
1) stobs nyams pa/ khang pa yun ring rnying nas nyam dmas pa/ 2) spobs pa bcag pa dang bsnad pa/ 'thab 'dzing drag po byas pa'i mthar dgra bo nyam dmas su btang ba/

/ 1) myong cha dang tshor ba/ sngar byung sdug nyams/ da lta'i spro nyams/ 'khyag nyams/ 2) blo'i 'gyur ba phyi rol tu mtshon pa'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur ram, tshugs ka/ sgeg nyams/ che nyams/ dpon nyams/ rgas nyams/ gzhon nyams dod po/ tshig rgyan gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i phyag bris/ man ngag gi nyams dang ldan pa'i bslab bya/ yon tan med bzhin du yod nyams byed pa g.yo dang, skyon cha yod bzhin du med nyams byed pa sgyu/ 3) cha rgyus/ khyi nyams sprang pos lon nas rgyug pa sked gzer, chu nyams mnyan pas lon nas ko ba 'phred gcod/ bya ba nyams kyis mi lcogs na, gzhan gyis rbad kyang byar mi rung/ 4) sems sam yid/ yul yid du 'ong zhing nyams su dga' ba/
rang gis nyams su myong ba rnams gzhan la khrid 'debs pa/ dge rgan gyis slob phrug la shes yon gyi nyams khrid byed/

snang ba bzhi'i nang gses, lhag mthong gi rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud la bltas pas 'od kyi thig le sku ru smin du nye ba nyams snang gong du 'phel bas 'khrul ba'i snang ba nub cing bar do'i ye shes mngon du byed pa'o/
dam tshig nyams pa'i btsog grib/
mgur glu'am sems la 'char tshul gyi glu/
sems skyid pa'am yid spro ba/ las don tshang ma gra 'grig 'thus tshang grub pas blo sems nyams dga' ba zhig byung/ nyams mi dga' bzhin du phyir log pa/
nyams rtogs ci byung glu dbyangs su len pa'i mgur/
che nyams kyi rnam 'gyur/ nyams 'gying byed pa de mi'i snang bar 'gro dka'/
nyams 'gyur gnyis su phye ba'i blo'i 'char sgo la 'gyur ba zhes dang, 'gyur ba de lus ngag gi thog nas phyir mngon pa la nyams zhes zer/ 'gyur...nyams...
stobs shugs dang 'khos ka nyams pa'am zhan du phyin pa/ rgad po rnams kyi lus stobs nyams rgud du 'gro rgyu ches nyid red/ dmag 'khrug de btsan rgyal nyams rgud du gtong ba'i dmag 'khug yin/
gar gyi nyams sam snyan ngag gi nyams te, sgeg pa, drag shul, dpa' ba, snying rje, mi sdug pa, bzhad gad, rmad byung, 'jigs rung bcas kyi nyams te brgyad, nyams ldan gyi rgyan la'ang ltos/
rdzig mdog gi nyams/ mi nyams bcos can la zhed mkhan bsam med kyi byis pa las med/
legs nyes lta mkhas po/ ca lag bzang ngan lta bar nyams chod po zhig byed pa/
sgrigs lam sogs nyams shing 'chal ba'i ngan spyod/
gzi byin/ dpa' ngar nyams brjid/
1) don la goms pa'i yon tan/ thos bsam dang lag len ma nor ba byas na nyams rtogs kyi grub 'bras gong 'phel yong/ 2) nyams len dang rtogs pa'i bsdus ming/
rig pa stong gsal lam nyams snang stong gsal/
1) lus stobs/ 2) che nyams khengs stobs/
1) nyams stobs rgyas pa/ 2) shed mo rgyas pa/ dbyar dus rta drel gyi sha nyams brtas yong/
blo rig gsal ba/ nyams dang ba'i dus su bsam blo zhig btang/
brjid nyams gsal ba'am che 'gying gi rnam 'gyur tshang ba/ mi 'di'i gzugs byad bag dro bas nyams dod po mthong gi 'dug / kho la 'jon stangs cher med kyang nyams dod po byed pa ni dgod bro/
blo gdeng ngam nyams rgyus/ las ka byed pa'i skabs su nyams drod chen po zhig yod dgos/ seng ge la re dwags gzhan rnams gsod pa'i nyams drod chen po yod/
tshod lta ba/ kho la phugs kyi zhe 'dod ci 'dug nyams drod 'dzin pa/
che ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, nang bsam pa'i 'gyur ba la brten nas phyi rol lus kyi rnam 'gyur sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs brgyad ni, sgeg pa'i nyams, drag shul gyi nyams, dpa' ba'i nyams, snying rje'i nyams, mi sdug pa'i nyams, bzhad gad kyi nyams, rmad byung gi nyams, 'jigs rung gi nyams bcas so/
sems nang 'char tshul/ rang sems 'khrul nas nyams snang bzang ngan ci yang 'char yong/
mthong snang za ri zi ri/ rmi lam du nyams snang ban bun shar ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'jig pa dang, rgud pa/ nus stobs nyams pa/ pho ba'i me drod nyams pa/ bya ba nyams pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa/ gos chen rgas kyang ri mo mi yal, dpa' bo shi yang snyan grags mi nyams/ 2. gas chag zhig ral du gyur pa'i cha shas/ nyams pa sor chud dang, mi nyams gong 'phel/ nyams pa sos pa/
dge tshul gyi bslab bya blangs 'das so gsum gyi nang gses te, khyim pa'i rtags spong ba, rab byung gi rtags len pa, mkhan por gus par bya ba khas blangs pa ste de gsum las nyams pa/
tshod lta byed pa/ las don byed lugs la nyams dpyod zhib mor byed pa/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba sgrub pa'i nyams byed kyi rgyu'i byed las ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
che 'gying byed pa/ gzhan gyis rtsi 'khur yong ched che nyams byed mi rung/
nyams tshod len pa/ rang bzhin 'phros mol gyi zhor la gzhan gyi bsam tshul nyams 'gru ba/
1) che 'gying gi sgrib med pa/ 2) skyon med/
goms byang gi rgyus sam shes rtogs/ nyams myong phyogs bsdoms/ las ka yul ji tsam ring ba byas pa de tsam du nyams myong che/ rang la nyams myong phran yod tsam gyis nga rgyal byed pa/
mngon sum myong grub tu byung ba'i shes tshor/ de'i khyad du 'phags tshul nyams myong mngon rtogs gsal por byung yod/
1) nyams smod pa dang 'dra, 2) nyams gud du song ba/
che ba'i rnam 'gyur dma' bar byed pa/ drag po'i stobs shugs la brtan nas dgra bo'i nyams smod pa/
sbyangs pa las byung ba'i yon tan gyi nus shugs/

skabs bas gnas tshul ci 'dug gi tshod/ mngon chung thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gnas tshul gyi nyams tshod len pa/ gzhan agyi yon tan che chung nyams tshod len pa/ son bzang btab ste skye min gyi nyams tshod lta ba/
ngo mtshar ba'am khyad mtshar ba/ nyams mtshar ba'i ltad mo rnams la bltas pa/
stobs dman pa/ sha nyams zhan pa'i rta drel thag ring du 'gro mi thub/
brtag dpyad zhib 'jug / ngo phebs kyis nyams zhib gnang ba/ nyams zhib gsal por byed pa/ rim gyis nyams zhib byed/
gzhan rkyen la ltos nas byed 'dod byung ba/ gzhan gyis gad mo dgod par mthong dus rang yang nyams 'ur nas gad mo dbang med du shor ba/
khong du chud pa'am sems kyis rtogs pa/ gsar byung gnas tshul mtha' dag nyams 'og tshud pa/
rab byung brgyad pa'i nang gong sman dkon cog phan dar gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag nyams myong gi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
dngos su lag bstar/ nyams len mthar 'khyol/ kha nas 'dra chags po shod mkhan de dngos su nyams len byed mkhan yin pa'i nges pa med/
lag len byed stangs kyi gnad dam thabs kyi: gtso bo
don rang rgyud la sbyor mkhan nam, dngos su lag len bstar mkhan/
kyi brgyud pa: byang chub lam rim gyi brgyud pa gsum gyi ya gyal, rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nas rgyal sras zhi ba lha la sogs par brgyud pa'i rlabs chen spyod rgyud/
rang rgyud du shar ba/ lus sems shin tu bde ba'i nyams shar ba/
tshod lta/ las ka 'grub mi 'grub nyams sad byed pa/ mi zhig la 'phral phugs bsam 'char gang yod nyams sad byas na zhe phugs rtogs yong/
sems la 'gro ba'am yid la 'bab pa/ dgos don rnyed na nyams su 'bab po yong/
rang gis dngos su myong ba/ zas kyi ro zhim po lce yis nyams su myong ba/
lag len byed pa/ las don rang gis nyams su blangs na gzhan la skul lcag thebs yong/
nyams pa gso zhing skyon sel ba/ sdod khang gog po tshang mar nyams gso skyon bsang gis sra brtan phugs 'pher bzo ba/
nyams gud bskyar bzo dang: cha lag sgrig pa/ yo byad rnying pa skyon can rnams nyams gso lhu sgrig byas te mkho yod kyi dngos por sgyur ba/
nya'i dpung steng sha'i ze ba/
nya re nyo re'i bsdus tshig
(tha dad pa) nyar ba, nyar ba, nyor,, 'dzin pa'am gnyer ba/ skabs de'i gnas tshul rnams sems la wal ler nyar ba/ sger gyi dngos chas tshang ma khong gis nyar ba red/
bdag bzung ngam do dam/ bcol bzhag pa'i ca lag nyar tshad yag po byas yod/
1) nyal sa'i ras gur/ 2) sbrang bu sogs srung ba'i gur/
(yul) gnyid khug nas nyal sar gcin pa shor ba/
bye ma'i phung po nyil ba:/ bye ma'i phung po'i steng du 'dzed na nyal nyal shig shig byed yong/
gad snyigs/ khang pa'i nang gi nyal nyil rnams 'phyag pa/
nyal nas 'then rgyu'i tha ma nag po/
khyim du 'greng ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, khyim pa nyal po byed pa'i khyim du 'greng ba'i spyod lam gyis bsdad pa/
nyal po byed pa'i khyim du gnas pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, khyim pa pho mo nyal po byed sar 'dug ste de la bar du gcod par byed pa/
(tha mi dad pa) nyal ba, nyal ba, nyol,, lus po mal phab nas ngal gso ba/ mal du nyal nas bsam blo btang/ chu tshod nyal ba/ khyi sgo khar nyal 'dug /
gnyid nyal ba las byung ba'i bde ba/
nam gyi cha stod smad la mi nyal zhing cha bar pa la seng ge'i nyal stangs kyis nyal ba dang, yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang nas nyal ba/
nyal sa'i mal/ nyal mal du bde bar gnyid khug pa/
grung po med pa'i bzo dbyibs/ lo tog ser bas brdungs nas nyal le nyil le chags pa/
nyal gnas sam nyal yul/ nyal sa byung na rkyong sa dran/
grangs ka gnyis kyi tshab tu 'jug pa'i dmigs bsal tshig cig / gnyis...sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi khri lnga stong/
chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi klo yul sa khul gyi 'bab chu zhig /
nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsdus tshig /

nyi ma skar ma'i gnas su 'gro ba'i bgrod pa la ltos nas 'jog la, de yang rkang pa drug khyim lo re la lan gnyis 'gro bas rkang pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur la, spyad zin pa dang ma spyad pa'i tshad dang rkang sdom ni re'u mig ltar ro/

nyi ma'i rgyug lam khyim bcu gnyis kyi ming/ ming gi rnam grangs la nyi ma'i khyim dang, nyi ma'i gur khang, nyi ma'i lding khang, nyi ma'i rna cha, nye ba'i nyi ma'i khor yug 'od lngas yongs skor bcas so,
1) grangs ka khri gnyis kyi ming/ 2) shloo ka khri gnyis yod pa'i sher phyin po ti/
nyin gcig la phar tshur 'khor ba'm slebs pa/
nyi ma'i mtha'i 'od sgor/ nam mkhar nyi gur phub/
1) nyi ma bsgribs pa'i grib nag / 2) nyi ma dang grib nag /
langs phyogs mi gsal ba'i mi mgo bde po/
1) nyi ma la sems dga' ba/ 2) sngo sman lcam pa'i me tog la bzhed pa zhig dang, lo ma la bzhed pa zhig gnyis mchis/
nyi ma nub kha'i dus tshod/
nyin grangs kyi kha chad/ nyi chad brgal ba/ nyi chad byed pa/ nyi chad bsrings pa/
nyi ma shar ri'i rtse nas thon mtshams/ nyi brnyan, chu nang du 'char ba'i nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan/
skar gnas de'i steng du slebs pa nas brtsams te: nyin de'i tshes longs rdzogs par spyod pa'i grangs yin
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste sbrul gyi dus tshod/
nyi ma'i dhru ba'i bsdus tshig
nyi ma gdan gyi rnam par byas pa/
nyi tshad skyob byed kyi gdugs/ nyi gdugs kyi rtsibs ma/
nyi 'od kyi mdangs/ glog 'od nyi mdangs ltar gsal po 'dug /
(rnying) nyi ma lde ba ste, nyi ma'i tsha zer la lus sro ba/
nyi zer gyi rdul gyi bsdus tshig
nyi ma ldog pa'am log pa:/ dgun nyi ldog / dbyar nyi ldog /
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste bya'i dus tshod/
nyi ma'i snang ba nub pa dang 'gro sa'i lam 'gags pa ste, skyabs bcol yul ma rnyed pa'i dpe/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste rta'i dus tshod/

gang brtsi ba'i tshes zhag de rdzogs mtshams su nyi ma lug khyim las longs spyod ci tsam 'das zin pa'i yul gyi chu tshod rjes 'brang bcas grub kyang rkang longs snon 'phri ma byas pas nyin zhag de'i skar gnas dngos su 'gyur mi 'gyur la nges pa med pas na bar pa ste phung gsum pa zhes pa'i don, gza' lnga skabs kyi drag rkang zhi dal yang de nyid yin/
sgra gcan nyi 'dzin brtag dpyad byed skabs nyi skar la phri bsnan byed tshul/ (bul)...
nyi dag dang sgra gcan rtsa ba gnyis kyi longs spyod bsre ba/

/ 1) nam mkhar 'char ba'i brtan skar nyi ma/ kun gyi nyi ma dang, kun gyi zla ba/ nyi ma la la rgas song/ nyi ma shar phyogs nas 'char ba dang, nub phyogs su nub pa chos nyid yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la ku mud dgra dang, khyab byed, khri can, mkha' 'gro, mkha' nor, mkha' lam pa, 'gro ba'i sgron me, rgyas byed, rgyu ba'i brtul zhugs, sgrol byed, nges sreg bcu gnyis bdag po, char 'bebs, chu yi chom rkun, mchog 'dod, mchod ldan, mchod 'os, 'jig rten dbang po, 'jig rten mig 'joms byed, nyin byed, nyin mo'i 'dren pa, nyin mo'i nor, nyin mo'i dbang phyug nyin mo'i dbyig nyin mo'i 'byung gnas, nyin mor byed, gtum po'i 'od, rta ljang can, rta bdun dbang po, rta bdun pa, bsten bya, 'thung byed, dus kyi bdag po, dus kyi byed pa, dus byed, dus la dga', gdung byed, 'dam skyes mtshan, bdud las rgyal, bdun gyi bdun pa, nad med, nam mkha'i tog nam mkha'i thig le, nam mkha'i nor bu, nam mkha'i mig nor gyi mdzod, rnam sgyur 'gro lus, rnam bcad, rnam gnas, rnam par snang byed, rnam gsal byed, sna tshogs 'od, sna tshogs shing rta, snang ba'i bdag po, snang ba'i mu khyud, snang ba'i mdzod, snang byed, padma'i grogs, pad ma'i gnyen, padma'i rtsa lag padma'i lag phyogs kyi mu khyud, phyogs bdag phyogs snang byed, 'phrog byed, bla med 'od 'byin, dbyig gi khu ba, mi sbyin skyes pa, mig gzugs, mun 'joms, mun pa'i dgra, mun sel, me zlum, tsha ldan, tsha zer can, tshangs pa'i rta, 'dzin byed, gza'i bdag po, gza' bshes, 'od kyi rgyun, 'od kyi sgra can, 'od kyi nor can, 'od 'gyed, 'od 'gro, 'od 'gro rgyas byed, 'od can, 'od stong can, 'od stong 'phro ba, 'od bdag 'od ldan, 'od 'dren, 'od nor can, 'od phung po, 'od phreng can, 'od byed, 'od 'byin, 'od gtsang, 'od gzugs, rig byed 'byung, las sna tshogs, lus skyob, long ba'i kha lo ba, lo'i shing rta, shing rta mtho, bshes gnyen, srid pa'i sgron me, srid pa'i mig 2) nyin zhag gcig / nyi ma gsum/ kho phyin nas nyi ma kha shas phyin song/ 3) nyi ma'i 'od zer/ khang pa'i nang la nyi ma shar ba/ 4) (mngon) 1. chu lug lo/ 2. nyi ma la khyim gyi bdag po ste, dbang po dang, byed po, lam pa, char 'bebs, bstod byed, sngon min, sngon 'phags, mi gzugs, khyab 'jug 'od can, chu bdag gshin rje bcas bcu gnyis yod pas grangs bcu gnyis mtshon/
nyi ma 'phul thabs byed pa/ don med kyi skad cha sha stag bshad nas nyi ma skyel ba/
dwangs gsal 'od du 'tsher ba'i rdo rigs shig
nyi ma 'phul thabs byed gang thub/ las rjes 'di yin ston rgyu med par nyi ma gang 'khyol byed pa/
1) gza' tshes nges pa can nam shar/ 2) nyi 'od gang du phog pa'i sa phyogs/
kun dga' bo las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i rgya gar gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi nang tshan zhig /
gza' skar legs pa'i dus tshes/
nyi ma nub ri'i rgyab tu bzhud pa/
gza' skar mi legs pa'i dus tshes/
nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cha shas shig bsgribs pa'i nyi 'dzin/

lha sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nang gses nyi ma'i lha bcu gnyis te, dbang po dang, byed po dang, lam pa dang, char 'bebs dang, bstod byed dang, sngon min dang, sngon 'phags dang, mi gzugs dang, khyab 'jug dang, 'od can dang, chu bdag dang, gshin rje ste bcu gnyis so/
nyi ma rtag pa re bzhin
nyi ma rnam shar gyi dus/ nyi ma rtag pa re bzhin shar nas shar, nyi ma rtag pa re bzhin nub tu nub, mi tshe lo brgya yud tsam rdzogs 'gro bas, tshang mas mi tshe 'di nyid gces spras gyis/
nyi ma lta bu'i sems bskyed
sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, sa dgu pa'i rgyud kyi stobs kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni gdul bya'i rgyud kyi dge ba'i lo tog yongs su smin par byed pas na nyi ma lta bu'o/
nyi ma la bsdad nas lus bsro ba/
