sngar rgya gar gyi gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig /
mgyogs por yong ba'i sa bon nam rtsa ba/
shakya thub pa'i nyan thos lnga ste, grags pa dang, dri med, gang bo, ba lang bdag lag bzang/
mgyogs por shi ba'i rtags mtshan/
dus mi ring ba nye bar 'chi ba'i ltas te, mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga 'phral du 'gag pa dang, lus kyi rnam pa 'gyur ba, gyen du dbugs brtseg pa dang, lus kyi drod yal ba lta bu/
ser sna la sogs pa sems kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs can gyi sems byung/
nye ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu

sems byung nga gcig gi nang tshan, khro ba dang, 'khon 'dzin dang, 'chab pa dang, 'tshig pa, phrag dog ser sna, sgyur, g.yo, rgyags pa, rnam par 'tshe ba, ngo tsha med pa, khrel med pa, rmugs pa dang, rgod pa dang, ma dad pa, le lo, bag med pa, brjed ngas pa, rnam g.yeng, shes bzhin ma yin pa bcas nyi shu/
mtshams med dang cha 'dra ba'i las dgra bcom ma la 'dod log spyod pa, byang sems nges gnas gsod pa, slob pa'i dge 'dun gsod pa, dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog pa, mchod rten bshig pa ste lnga/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi shes gang zhig snying rje chen po dang, stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab gang rung gis zin pa'i mkhyen pa 'bras bu'i sher phyin bskyed pa'i thabs la mkhas pas ring ba min pa'o/
khang bzang rin po che dang, mal cha rin po che, lham rin po che, ral gri rin po che, gos rin po che, pags pa rin po che, tshal rin po che ste bdun/
sangs rgyas shakya thub pa'i thugs kyi sras, byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo'o/
'jam dbyangs dang, phyag na rdo rje, spyan ras gzigs, sa yi snying po, sgrib pa rnam sel, nam mkha'i snying po, byams pa, kun tu bzang po ste brgyad/
'phral du mkho ba'am shin tu mkho ba/ yi ge 'bri ba la nye bar mkho ba'i snag smyug sogs tshang ma gra sgrig byas yod/
lag tu len pa/ kha bshad tsam ma yin par lag thog nas nye bar sgrub pa/
1) gus 'dud byed pa/ 2) thag nye bar 'jog pa/ 3) sems gnas dgu'i bzhi pa, sems rang bzhin gyis rgya che ba las yang yang bsdus te phra bar byas nas 'jog pa/
1) nye 'khor du sdod pa/ 2) dngos su yod pa'am mngon sum du gnas pa/
longs su spyod pa/ mi tshang mas rgyun du zas gos la nye bar spyod dgos/
dga' bar byed pa/ phan tshun bsam pa nye bar byed pa/

legs par brgyan pa'am spras pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la ri bong gzugs brnyan gyis nye bar mtshan pa/ tshogs 'du 'tshog yul thang chen gyi mtha' skor du tshon khra can gyi dar cha mang pos nye bar mtshan pa/
dpe la sbyor ba'am, dper len pa/ stong gsal nam mkha'i mtshan nyid kyis chos rnams kyi chos nyid nye bar mtshon pa/ 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi dpes mdzes sdug gi rnam 'gyur nye bar mtshon pa/
1) legs par zhi ba'am bde ba/ 2) sdom brtson/ 3) me/ 4) bzod pa/
nye bar zhi ba'i dge ba
nyon mongs pa spong ba dang, 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang, lhag bcas lhag med kyi myang 'das dang, mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa rnams so/
nye bar zhi ba'i lung ma bstan
gzugs gzugs med la spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams te zhi gnas dang ldan pa'i phyir 'bras bu mi 'byin pa/
nyer len bzhi dang don gcig
nye bar len pa'i phung po
nyer len gyi phung po dang don gcig,
nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga
nyer len gyi phung po lnga dang don gcig,
nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i sdug bsngal

sdug bsngal brgyad kyi nang gses, nyer len gyi phung po la brten nas skye ba phyi ma phan chad kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'dren pa dang, da lta na rga sogs kyi rten du gyur pa dang, sdug bsngal gsum gyi snod dang rang bzhin du gyur pa'o/
lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha rnams te lha sum cu rtsa gsum las lha dbang ma gtogs pa rnams/
phra ma'am dbyen byed pa/ mthun po'i bar la nye 'byed byed pa/
gyi zhal lce: zhal lce bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, bza' tshang ya bral song rigs la 'bral rkyen gyi rtsa ba zhib tu bcad de 'gal ba sus byas la nyes chad 'gel lugs kyi khrims/
1) tshig phrad nang gi nye bar bstan pa'i tshig ste 'di zhes pa lta bu/ 'di zhes nye tshig smras pa/ 2) gces pa'i tshig /
skyon cha'am bar chad/ lam thag ring por bskyod de nye zho med par slebs pa/ nye zho med par ci bder gnas pa/
1) nyes skyon med pa/ 2) (mngon) skye bo nad med gcong med/
g.yog po:/ nye g.yog byed pa/
nye du gnyen 'brel gyi phyogs sam gras/
1) yul dus ring thung/ 2) blo phyogs ris can/ 3) chags sdang/
phan tshun su la'ang mi phyogs pa/ gtam bshad na nye ring med pa dgos, zas bgos na che chung med pa dgos/ kun la nye ring med par skyong/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khang dmar rdzong dang rgyal rtse rdzong gi khul du yod, chu 'go hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi byang ngos nas byung zhing myang chu'i yan lag cig yin/
1) skad cig skad cig la 'gyur ba'i nyams/ 2) bzod sran chung ba'am rang tshugs mi thub pa'i rnam pa/ byis pa'i lus po nye re re/ nad pa nyam thag nye re re/

1) nye char te yun ring ma lon pa'i dus skabs/ grong gseb khul du nye lam lo tog la sos skyed yag po byung 'dug / 2) myur por slebs pa'i 'gro lam/ lam gzhung la ma phyin par nye lam nas phyin na mgyogs po slebs yong/
'gram mam 'khris/ ri'i nye logs su khang pa brgyab pa/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas lus stobs gso, chu ser skem, tshe bsring, me drod skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la nye shing tsher ma can dang, nye sug pa, nye'u, dag byed, nel ma lcags kyu, rtsa ba brgya pa, rtsa ba chen po bcas so,
1) nye ba'i sras chen gyi bsdus tshig 2) (mngon) nye sras 'jam dbyangs sogs brgyad yod pas grangs brgyad mtshon,..
nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi bsdus tshig
(rnying) lci yang 'jal byed kyi nya ga
'phur 'phur gtong ba/ gzugs po'i za phrug yod sar nyed nyed byed pa/
(tha dad pa) 'jam por 'phur ba/ rus tshigs na sar lag pas dal gyis nyed pa/
1) rdib nyen che sar btsugs pa'i ka ba/ 2) nyen kha dang 'dra,

gnod skyon 'byung ba'i gzhi/ khe dang nyen kha/ nyen kha dge 'gyur/ nyen kha tshabs chen/ nyen kha'i sang ltas/ nyen khar ma 'dzems pa/ thab sgo'i mdun du me shing spungs na me skyon 'chor ba'i nyen kha chen po 'dug / khe che ba las nyen kha chung ba dga'/
so pa ste, pha rol gyi nyen kha yod med lta mkhan/
nyen kha yong ba'i dogs pa/
nyen dogs srung sdom gyi do dam/
nyen kha yod pa'i gdong du 'gro ba/
(tha mi dad pa) mnar ba/ grang bas nyen pa/ bkres pas nyen pa/ gzugs po nad kyis nyen yang sems la snying stobs nyams med/ nyes med dbul phongs rnams rgyal po'i chad pas nyen pa/
nyes skyon yong dogs kyis lta skyor zhib 'jug /
1) (rnying) mi nyes can glod pa/ 2) chur gnas kyi srog chags srog blu gtong ba/
1) grangs kyi mgor sbyar nas nyi shu'i tshab tu bkol ba'i tshig cig / nyer lnga/ nyer bdun lta bu'o/ 2) nye bar gyi bsdus tshig
nye bar mkho ba'i bsdus tshig
gnyer gnyer te gcan gzan gyi khro nyams ston tshul zhig / stag gis kha nyer nyer byas nas ngar sgra 'byin pa/
thim rim 'char skabs su srod kyi smag rum 'thug pos khyab pa lta bu las gzhan gang yang mi 'char ba'i yid shes phra mo/

1) sta gon nam gra sgrig / snga nas nyer bsdogs shes pa dag dus su bab tshe thogs med 'jug / 2) bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob gong gi sa rang rang gi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob byed kyi thabs sam sta gon du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin te, dbye na bsam gzugs brgyad kyi nyer bsdogs brgyad yod/

bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyi ming ste, bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyang, bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la brten nas 'dod nyon spong ba lcogs pa'am 'dod nyon spang thub pas na nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med ces brjod/
1) nye bar longs su spyad bya'o 'dod yin dngos rdzas/ 2) (mngon) me tog sogs mchod pa'i nyer spyod lnga bgrang ba'i lugs srol yod pas grangs lnga mtshon/
mchod pa'i dngos po me tog dang, bdug spos, mar me, dri chab, zhal zas bcas lnga'o/
(upagupta:) gtad rabs bdun gyi bzhi pa nyan thos dgra bcom pa zhig /
1) gnod pa/ gnam gyi nyer 'tshe/ phyi nang gi nyer 'tshes mi g.yo ba/ 2) (mngon) zla ba gzas bzung ba/
nye bar zhi ba'i bsdus tshig
nye bar len pa ste, rang rgyud rgyun mi 'chad par yang yang bskyed cing mchog tu 'dzin pa/ rje btsun mthu dang ser ba slob pa'i nyer len gyi rkyen ci lta bu zhig byung/
rgyu'i bye brag cig ste, sa bon las myu gu skye ba lta bu, rang 'bras rang gi rdzas rgyun du gtso bor skyed byed do/
las nyon snga ma'i nyer len las skyes pa dang, las nyon phyi ma'i nyer len du 'gro ba'i zag bcas kyi phung po/
nyer len gyi phung po lnga
gzugs kyi phung po dang, tshor ba'i phung po, 'du shes kyi phung po, 'du byed kyi phung po, rnam shes kyi phung po ste lnga'o/
nyer len gyi rgyu la dbye na, dngos kyi nyer len dang, brgyud pa'i nyer len gnyis so/
'dod pa nye bar len pa dang, lta bu nye bar len pa, tshul khrims brtul zhugs nye bar len pa, bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa bcas bzhi/
nyes pa dang skyon cha/ nyes skyon kha 'phangs/ nyes skyon 'gebs skyob/ nyes skyon tshabs chen/
/ mi 'di la nyes khag ci yang med/
nyes can la gcod pa'i khrims/ lag dmar la nyes khrims btang ba/
khrims kyi nyes chad 'gel ba/ nag med nyes 'gel/
nyes pa thams cad 'gog pa dang, legs pa thams cad spel ba/
skyon can nam nag can/ nyes can gte po/ nyes can lag zin/

nyes pa'i chad pa/ nyes chad bca' yang du gtong ba/ nyes chad rtsa yang du gtong ba/ nyes chad gcod pa/ nyes chad bkal ba/ nyes chad 'jal ba/ nyes chad drag po/ nyes chad dngul 'bab/ nyes chad dus thim/
sdom pa nyams pa'i nyes pa/
sngar bsags pa'i nyes ltung rnams bshags pa dang, phyin chad de ltar mi byed pa'i sdom sems/
nyes chad btang ba'i dus kyi yun tshad/ nyes dus phyi 'gyangs/
rdung gtag gam nyes gtag / phru gu 'tshub po la yang nyes rdung ma gtong/

1.(tha mi dad pa) nor ba'am 'dzol ba/ las ka der 'char gzhi yang dag pa zhig ma bting bas nyes song/ dogs gnas gang shar ba rnams dris pas ci nyes/ 2. 1) spyod ngan byas pa'i 'bras bu'am rjes ngan/ nyes pa ngos len/ nyes pa brjod pa/ nyes pa gtong ba/ nyes pa phog pa/ rang gi nyes pa rang gis bcos/ lus ngag gi nyes pa/ so so'i nyes par gzhigs nas khrims chad gtong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyon can dang, khrims gcod yul, nges gzung, mthong ba med, sdom 'ching, nongs pa bcas so, 2) skyon dang, mi legs pa'i cha/ lo nyes/ chu nyes/ ngo gdong nyes pa/ 3) (mngon) mi'i lus por mi sdug pa dang, skra byi ba, dpral ba chung ba sogs nyes pa'am skyon bco brgyad yod pas grangs bco brgyad mtshon/
1) sdig spyod tshabs chen po/ 2) khrims chad 'jigs skrag chen po/
1) skyon ngos zin pa/ 2) (mngon) mkhas pa/
slad de ltar mi yong ba'i ched du nyes chad nan po gtong ba/

1) rnam par ma gyur pa'i skabs lus gso bskyed kyi bya ba byed cing, rnam par gyur na lus la gnod cing sun 'byin pa'i zug rngu'i nyes pa gtong ba'i rgyu byed pa rlung mkhris bad kan gsum la zer/ 2) rgyud la yod pa'i 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi nyes pa dug gi rtsa ba gsum/
ltung ba nyes byas kyi sde tshan lnga ste, dge slong gi khrims las 'gal ba'i nyes ltung pham pa dang, lhag ma, spang ltung, ltung byed, nyes byas bcas kyi sde tshan lnga/
dam pa rnams kyis smad cing 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba skyed pa'i mi dge ba'i las/ nyes spyad slar spyod/
nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims

mi dge ba bcu po thams cad dug bzhin du spong ba'i so thar ris bdun gyi khrims te, dge slong pha ma dang, dge tshul pha ma, dge bsnyen pha ma, dge slob ma bcas kyi bslab gzhi 'di ni tshul khrims gsum gyi ya gyal zhig
spyod ngan gdong gtugs nas bgrang ba/
(dushkriti) ltung ba sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig / nyes byas las kyi rnam smin mngon sum mthong/
dge slong gi spang bya ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses, nyes pa phra mo'i rnag bzhin yin pas nyes byas zhes bya ste, grangs ni brgya dang bcu gnyis zhes mdo'i sdom gyis bsdus pa/
nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis

ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses, nyes byas kyi sde tshan la, gos bgo ba'i tshul bcu dang, 'gro ba'i tshul nyi shu, 'dug pa'i tshul dgu, zas len tshul brgyad, kha zas spyod tshul nyer gcig lhung bzed spyod tshul bcu bzhi, chos ston tshul nyer drug sgrub pa'i tshul gsum, rgyu ba gcig ste sde tshan dgu dang bye brag brgya dang bcu gnyis yod/
skyon med/ bden pa bden thog tu 'khyol zhing, nyes med gtsang sar thon pa/
phan yon dang yon tan gyi ldog phyogs/ sdig pa'i nyes dmigs phan yon du lta bu dang, dge ba'i phan yon nyes dmigs su lta ba'i bsam mno phyin ci log pa ma gtong/
'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs dpe lnga ste ral gri dang, mdung thung, spu gri'i kha'i sbrang rtsi, sbrul gdug me mur lta bu/
nyes can gar yod kyi khungs rtsad rnyed pa/
khrims 'gal byas pa gsal por ra 'phrod pa/
khrims 'gal byas pa'i khungs skyel dngos rigs/
sdig pa mi dge ba'i las/
skad cha skyon can/ legs bshad dang nyes bshad 'byed pa/
nyo ba'am nyo thabs byed pa/
nyo rgyu'i dngos zog / nyo cha rgyag pa/ nyo cha dkon po/ nyo cha 'bel po/ de ring nga khrom du phyin nas nyo cha brgyab pa yin/
tshong zog nyo rgyu'i brjed tho/
(tha dad pa) nyos pa, nyo ba, nyos,, rin sprad nas dngos po tshur len pa/ ca lag nyos pa/ mda' shes nas gzhu nyos pa yin/
ca lag tshur nyo ba dang phra 'tshong ba,
gzhag lugs mthun gyi nyo tshong
nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rin po che ma yin pa'i dngos po 'bru sogs gzhan khe spogs byed pa'o/
mkho dngos nyo sgrub byed grogs/
(yul) chu khol du 'bru rigs kyi phye ma btab nas bzos pa'i zas rigs shig / sran nyog / mar nyog / 'o nyog /
(yul) 1) khams 'khrugs pa dang go rim 'chol ba/ khron pa'i chu brnyogs nas nyog pa/ chang gis bzi nas rig pa nyog pa/ sgrig lam nyog song/ 2) nyog po dang 'dra,
(yul) mi dang ba dang, rig pa mi gsal ba/ chu nyog po 'dug / de ring nga'i rig pa nyog po 'dug /
blo rig nyob po/ mdang dgong gnyid ma khug pas de ring shes pa nyog bying zhig 'dug /
'dres 'khrugs kyi rnyog rdzob/ dka' ngal nyog rdzob che ba'i las don/
grung po med pa'am dwangs po med pa/ gtam nyog se ba bshad na go dka'/ chu nyog se ba de 'thung mi nyan/

nam langs te lag ris mngon pa nas nyi nub lag ris mi mngon par gyur pa'i bar/ ming gi rnam grangs la gdugs dang, bdud 'joms, mdangs gsar, gnas 'jug snang ba ldan, padma bzhad, mun bsal, rtsen dus, gsal snang bcas so,
nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ste thar pa thob pa la gegs su gyur pa'i ser sna la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams/
(klesha:) lus sems gdung ba'i dka' las sam ngal dub dang, mi dge ba'i las bskul bas rang rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i sems byung/
drug nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu drug ste: rten dang dmigs pa, 'du 'dzi, bshad pa, goms pa, yid la byed pa/
nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu gsum
nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal ma spangs pa dang nyon mongs skye ba'i yul nye bar gnas pa dang, tshul bzhin ma yin par yid la byed pa/
kun sbyor dang, phra rgyas, 'ching ba, nye nyon, kun dkris/
1) sdug bsngal can/ 2) nyon mongs pa'i sems dang ldan pa'am gti mug can/
nyon mongs can gyi the tshom
so skye'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i the tshom gyi shes pa'o/
nyon mongs can gyi reg pa gsum
ma rig pa'i reg pa dang, gnod sems kyi reg pa, rjes su chags pa'i reg pa/
nyon mongs bcom pa'i dge slong
nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa mang
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste mtshungs ldan grogs kyi sgo nas chung, spang bya'i sgo nas chung, rten rnam shes kyis chung ngur bzhag pa bcas/
nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa mang bcu
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste khro ba dang, 'khon 'dzin, g.yo, sgyu, phrag dog 'tshig 'chab pa, ser sna, rgyags pa, rnam par 'tshe ba bcas bcu'o/
sa mang drug ma dad pa dang: le lo, rmongs pa, rmugs pa, rgod pa, bag med bcas drug go /
kun btags kyi nyon mongs dang, lhan skyes kyi nyon mongs gnyis so/
snyigs ma lnga'i nang gses shig ste, chags sdang med pa'i bzang po'i yon tan rnams zad de 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang phrag dog dang ser sna la sogs pa lhag par che ba'i ngan pa'i tha mar gyur pa/

gi dmigs pa: zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, nyon mongs kyi sa bon nyams smad par byed pa tsam gyi dmigs pa ni, sa 'og ma'i rags pa dang gong ma'i zhi bar lta ba'i zhi rags kyi rnam pa dang, sa bon rtsad nas spong ba'i dmigs pa ni, bden pa bzhi'i khyad chos mi rtag pa la sogs pa bcu drug go /
lus sems ma zhi ba'am gdung bar byed pa dang, ngal dub tu gtong ba/ tsha gdug che bas lus po nyon mongs pa/ ma mjal yun ring song ba'i bar der sku khams nyon mongs par ma gyur tam/
nyon mongs pa can gyi yid
rnam shes brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig,
nyon mongs pa can gyi sems
rtsa nyon dang nye nyon sogs kyi sems byung/
nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i yid
dge ba'i sa mang sogs kyi sems byung/
bral ba'i dge slong: dge slong dgra bcom pa'o/
rtsa nyon drug dang don gcig
nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang, las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa, skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa bcas gsum mo/
nas nyon mongs pa: rten 'brel bcu gnyis las ma rig pa dang sred pa dang len pa rnams so/
nyon mongs pa'i lta ba lnga
lta ba lnga dang don gcig
ma drug nyon mongs la brten nas byung ba'i: dri ma rags pa drug ste sgyu dang, g.yo dang, rgyags pa dang, 'tshig pa dang, 'khon 'dzin dang, rnam 'tshe rnams so/
bdud bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa shas che ba'i dbang gis dge ba'i bar chad byed pa/
nyon mongs pa'i bdud phra mo
dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags lta bu/
nyon mongs pa'i bdud rags pa
nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal
nyon mongs pa'i byed las bcu

rtsa ba brtan par byed pa dang, rgyun gnas par byed pa, zhing du sgrub par byed pa, rgyu mthun par sgrub par byed pa, las kyi srid pa mngon par sgrub par byed pa, rang gi tshogs yongs su 'dzin par byed pa, dmigs pa la kun tu rmongs par byed pa, rnam par shes pa'i rgyun 'khrid par byed pa, dge ba'i phyogs las g.yo bar byed pa, khams las mi 'da' ba'i tshul gyis 'ching ba'i don du khyab par byed pa rnams so/
nyon mongs pa'i lam dang, las kyi lam dang, skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i lam rnams so/
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste, rtag tu nyon mongs can gyi sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'byung la sems gzhan gyi 'khor du mi 'byung ba zhig /
nyon mongs pa'i sa mang drug
1) nyan thos/ 2) chags sogs dang bral ba/
dmigs pa gzhan rgyud la dmigs nas rnam pa nyon mongs mi skye bar rjes su srung bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ste, zag med ye shes kyi sde tshan nyer gcig gi nang gses shig /
nyon mongs med pa'i yan lag gsum
byang chub yan lag bdun gyi nang nas, shin sbyangs ni nyon mongs med pa'i gzhi dang, ting nge 'dzin ni nyon mongs med pa'i gnas dang, btang snyoms ni nyon mongs med pa'i ngo bo nyid de gsum/

rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi nang gses, 'phags lam ma thob kyi bar du kun gzhi'i rnam shes la dmigs nas rtag tu ngar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid can yid kyi sa'i nyon mongs pas bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i gtso sems/
rig pa'am khams dwangs po med pa/ mi nyob nyob kyis las ka spus dag byed mi shes/
grung po med pa'am las ka la mi brtson pa/
khams nyog tshul zhig / nyi tshad kyis khams nyob thibs se ba byas byung/
rig pa bying nyog / chang btungs pas rig pa nyob 'thib pa byas byung/
(tha mi dad pa) lus kyi khams nyog pa'am las su mi rung ba/ tsha bas gdungs te gzugs po nyob pa/
(yul) zhig pa/ lcags ri'i rtsig pa nyor ba nyams gso byas/ bye phung gi steng du 'dzegs na bye phung nyor ba las 'os med/
bod kyi yab 'bangs rus drug gi ya gyal zhig /
bzang yang ston snyags kyi ming gzhan zhig /

/ 1) rgas pa'i skabs su rwa co sgor sgor du 'khyil nas skyes pa de ha cang ring zhing lci bas thur du 'bab ma thub par skom grir 'chi ba'i ri dwags shig / 2) sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig / 3) gnyan nad skyel ba'i sa bdag cig / sa gnyan/ chu gnyan/ shing gnyan/ rdo gnyan/
gnyan rigs bco brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig ste, mkhal ma la bab pa'i gnyan nad cig /
pho ba dang rgyu ma sogs la bab pa'i gnyan nad dang 'doms pa'i glang thabs shig /

1) ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dbus, gnam mtsho'i lho ngos su yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 7111 yod/ 2) ri rgyud cig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'dam gzhung rdzong gi nub rgyud nas chab mdo sa khul gyi dpa' shod rdzong bar dkyus su brgyugs nas yod/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas pags nad dang, mdzer pa skyes pa la phan/
1) lhog pa'i nad/ 2) dug drag po yod pa'i rtsi shing rigs shig /
phyi rol gyi dug can srin bu parpa ta dang, nang gi lhan skyes kyi khrag srin gnyis 'doms pa'i nad shin tu gnyan pa zhig ste, nang gses su klad gzer sogs rigs bco brgyad tsam mchis/
ske dang, lkog ma, mjing pa'i ldebs sogs su skrangs 'bur 'byung ba'i gnyan nad cig /
shin tu nyen che ba'i gnas te, mgo bo'i klad pa dang, byang khog gi snying lta bu'o/
btsan shed chen po'am khro ba/ sa cha gnyan po/ lha gnyan po/ khrims gnyan po/ dam tshig gnyan po/ bka' gnyan po/

bod rgyal nyer bdun pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la nam mkha' nas za ma tog cig bab pa kha phye ba'i nang, mdo za ma tog snying po yi ge drug ma dang, spang skong phyag brgya ma, gser gyi mchod rten zhig bcas byung ba'i ming du bshad la, de nas bzung dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin par bshad/
mi min gnyan rigs phra mo/
rma nad kyi bye brag cig /
gnyan nad 'bar 'bur lta bu lus kyi gnas gang du skrangs pa 'bar 'bur 'byung ba zhig /
ngan khrag rlung gis bsgril ba la lhan skyes kyi srin dang bsdongs nas sha rus rtsa la zhen par gyur pa'i 'bras nad cig /
gnyan nad dang tshad pa gnyis 'doms pa'i nad de gnyan tshad gzer thung lta bu'o/
rma khar tsha ngad langs pa/
stod yul zhang zhung ste bod ljongs mnga' ris khul la dwags kyi ming rnying pa/
gral rim mtho dma' dang, drag zhan/

gnyan nad bab sa'i dbang gis rigs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad kyi bsdus ming ste, gnyan nad klad gzer dang, gag pa, gzer thung, gnyan glang, rgyu gzer, me dbal, gnyan rmen bu, nywa log lhog pa, gnyan 'bras, 'dzum ltag dgye, mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nang lhog gnyan kha med, 'khyam po, gnyan 'bur, rna rtsa phus 'debs, ngam ru bcas so/
'khyam po dang 'ba' 'bur lta bu gzhan la 'go ba'i gnyan rims spyi/
srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan ri dwags gnyan gyi rwa ste, nus pas gzhan la 'go ba'i rims nad srung zhing zhi bar byed/
1) sa cha btsan po/ 2) bka' yul gnyan pa'i sa cha ste, mi min gdug can gnas sa/

1) gnyan nad parpa ta dang, khrag srin gnyis 'doms pa'i nad/ 2) gnyan kha yod pa'i so srin gyi nad zug rngu drag po 'byung ba zhig / 3) rma'i nang dug can srin bu zhugs te skrangs shing khrag nag po 'dzag pa dang, zug rngu drag po 'byung ba zhig /
rma nad sel byed kyi sman rigs/

deb sngon du khri btsan po 'od lde zhes pa dang don gcig bod rgyal rabs kyi thog ma de gang nas byon pa la, gzugs khams 'od gsal lha las babs pa dang, shakya'i rgyal rgyud yin pa sogs gtam rgyud 'dra min yod cing, gang ltar yul gang zhig nas bod yul btsan thang sgo bzhir slebs pa'i tshe bod mi rnams kyis mthong ste mi las 'das pa'i mtshan dang ldan pas ya mtshan skyes te gang nas byon dris par, skad brda ma 'phrod par gnam la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par go nas, bod khams kyi rgyal por 'os so zhes gnya' bar btegs nas 'ong bas gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags la, de dus bod la yul rje bcu gnyis yod pa'i spyi'i dbang por gyur pas bod spyi'i rgyal po'i thog ma yin la, gnam gyi khri bdun du grags pa'i dang po yang yin/
mi phyugs sogs kyi gnya' ltag / lag gnyis gnya' gong du bsnol ba/
(yul) rgyu nor longs spyod glo bur du phun sum tshogs par gyur pa/ lo shas ring du mi tshang de dag tshang ma gnya' rgan chags pa/
nga rgyal dang spobs pa bcom pa/ stobs shugs chen pos dgra bo'i gnya' bcag pa/
gnya' lpags te gnya' shing la dkri rgyu'i snam bu'am phying pa/
dpa' zhum pa'am bag 'khums pa, pha rol gyi rgol ba tshang ma gnya' chag 'dug / ngar ngar shor shor ji tsam byas kyang gnya' mi chag /
rta drel soggs kyi gnya' ltag skyob byed kyi snam bu dang phying pa sogs/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho nub rgyud du yod, 'di'i lho ngos bal po dang sa 'brel yin, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de tshong 'dus su yod/
gnya' nang nas thon pa'i shog bu/
gnya' 'am ltag pa nas gnon pa/ btsan shed gnya' gnon 'og tu sdod mi dgos pa byung/
btsan gnon gyis ngo smad du 'jug pa/
mjing pa'am ske'i rgyab/ a mas bu chung gnya' bar khur, glang rdzi glang po'i gnya' bar zhon/ ming gi rnam grangs la mjing pa dang, gnya' ltag ltag pa bcas so,
ngan pa gnya' rengs/ phru gu gcun mkhan med pas lang la shor nas gnya' ba hrangs pa/
/ 1) dpang po'am khag theg / 2) (yul) mag pa dang mna' ma skyel bsu byed mkhan/
rgyab byed po'am rogs byed mkhan/
nga rgyal chag pa'am, stobs nyams pa/
gnya' ltag steng gi rgyan dar zhig/
mjing pa'i rus pa/ gnya' rus chag pa/ gnya' rus mi chag pa/
ngan lang du shor te dred pa'am gyong ba/ mi gnya' rengs zhi bas 'dul dka'/ mi 'di gnya' rengs 'dug /
dud 'gro'i mgo dang lag pa gnyis thag pas mnyam du bsdams pa ste phyugs sdeb sbyor byed thabs shig /
rmon mdzo'i gnya' gnyis sbrel byed so nam pa'i yo byad cig / ming gi rnam grangs la gnya' phur dang gshol mda' 'dren no,

1) «yugandhara:» gser gyi ri bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, nyi zla 'char sa'i rtse mo na brag shing rta'i gnya' shing lta bu yod la, ngos su dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri dang, mtha' skor du sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum dang brgyad khri yod/ 2) (mngon) shing rta/
/ 1) bod yig thog mar srol gtod mkhan thu mi sam bho ta'i 'khrungs yul lho kha khul gyi sa cha zhig / 2) sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig /
lho rgyud gnyal dre'u lhas dgon pa/

lho brag rdzong gi sa cha zhig sngar 'di ga'i yul mi rnams kyi nang nas tshong las sam tshong pa nyi tshe ba byed mkhan mang ba dang sa thag ring thung gang sar khyab che bas grags pa che ba'i yul zhig tu gyur/
(rnying) gnyis ka/ 'gro sa de gnyi ga min pa'i phung gsum pa med/ rang gzhan gnyi gar bde ba thob pa/

gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, lus nyams chung zhing dub pa dang mun pa yid la byed de, rmugs rmugs por 'dug pa'i dbang gis rnam par shes pa yul la 'jug mi nus shing, lus kyang 'dzin mi nus par nang du 'dus nas bya ba kun shor ba'i mtshan nyid can/ mdang dgong nga tsho tshang ma gnyid skyid po khug byung/ tshad nad phog nas gnyid kyis 'thums te bsdad 'dug / ming gi rnam grangs la mnal dang, mig 'dzum pa, rmongs pa'i grogs po, gzims bcas so,
(rnying) gnyid la chags pa'i le lo'am gnyid la dga' ba'i sgyid lug /
gnyid dkrog gnyid las slong ba
/ mgo la thug thug btang nas gnyid dkrog pa/
gnyid la song ba/ 'grangs pa gnyid khug kyang, ltogs pa gnyid mi khug /
gnyid khug dus gtong ba'i dbugs sgra/
sad dka' ba'i gnyid/ grod pa rgyags pas gnyid lci po khug pa red/
1) gnyid khug ma thub pa/ las ka ma tshar ba'i dngangs skrag gis dgong mo gnyid chag byung/ 2) gnyid nyal long ma byung ba/ mtshan gang las brel la g.yengs te gnyid chag pa/
sad dka' ba'i gnyid/ sems khur med na gnyid che ba yong/
gnyid khug pa/ nam dkar la gnyid nyal, zla dkar la shig btus/
gnyid khug nas bshad pa'i skad cha/ mi la las rtag par gnyid gtam shod pa/

sad dka' ba'i gnyid/ gzhan gyis sug sug btang yang mi sad pa'i gnyid stug po yun ring khug pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la gnyid kyis ro ba dang, gnyid log nyal ba, gnyid song, rmi lam, legs phab, sems myos pa bcas so,
gnyid bro nyams sam gnyid khug la nye ba/ mi gcig pur sdod yun ring bas gnyid thibs thibs byas byung/
gnyid khug thengs/ gnyid thun gcig /
gnyid nyal ba'i dus skabs/ mdang dgong phar 'gro tshur yong gi brel zing gis gnyid thebs chag pa/
gnyid kyis non pa/ gzugs po thang po med pas nyin mo'ang gnyid 'thibs yong gi 'dug /
1) mtshan mo'i ming/ 2) gnyid nyal ba'i skabs/

rdzogs rim gyi chos shig ste, gnyid kyi shes pa snga ma rnam par dag cing slar rmi lam gyi rtog pa dang rlung sbyong byed kyi gnyid snga ma'i rigs 'dra ma skyes pa'i bar der rtog pa dang bral ba'i chos kyi sku bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dag cing 'od gsal ba ston gnam dwangs pa lta bu zhig 'char ba/
gnyid med cing zas kyang mi dran pa/ rgyal khab 'dzugs skrun gyi don du gnyid 'dor zas brjed kyi ngang nas 'bad brtson shugs drag byed pa/
gnyid har sad brgyab pa/ glo bur 'ur sgra drag po thos pas gnyid 'drogs song/
(tha mi dad pa) gnyid khug pa/ phru gu gnyid gnyid pa red/ da lta gnyid rgyu red/
gnyid mi khug pa/ na zug langs nas gnyid yar rgyag pa/
gnyid la song ba/ mtshan mo nyal ma thag tu gnyid la yur ba/
gnyid la song ba/ zhum bu gnyid la shor kyang bsam rgyu bye'u/
lab 'chol te, gnyid khug nas bshad pa'i gtam/
rmi lam/ gnyid lam skyid po gtong ba/
/ rdzi bo gnyid log na lug spyang kis za nyen yod/
gnyid dwangs pa/ byi'u'i skad snyan thos nas gnyid sangs song/
gnyid dwangs pa/ skad sgra brgyab nas phru gu gnyid sad pa/
gnyid mi khug pa'i thabs byed pa/ nad pa'i gzhogs la bsdad nas gnyid srung ba/
gnyid khug la nye ba/ khams nyog ste gnyid slebs pa/
gnyid las slong ba/ skad btang nas gnyid gsod pa/
(yul) gnyid 'drogs nas sad yong ba/ phru gu gnyid hab sad brgyab pas ngus pa/
grangs ka'i gnyis/ nga gnyis/ bza' tshang gnyis/ phyi nang gnyis/ mchan khung gnyis/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khrig pa dang, bgrod pa, thabs shes, mig mtshe ma, zung, lag pa bcas so,
gnyis yod pa tshang ma'am phan tshun gnyis/ pha ma gnyis ka/
rnam par grol ba: dgra bcom pa gang nyon sgrib dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gnyis las grol te rnam par thar pa brgyad la snyoms par 'jug nus pa'o/

ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don gnyis khyad chos 'ga' zhig gi sgo nas rnam pa mtshungs kyang, thun mong min pa'i khyad chos re re'i sgo nas mtshungs pa las ldog ste mi mtshungs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
(mngon) 1) bya/ 2) bram ze/ 3) so'i ming gi rnam grangs yin pas grangs sum cu so gnyis mtshon/
(mngon) 1) mkha' lding/ 2) tshangs pa/ 3) zla ba/
gnyis pa'i rjes su gsum pa mthud pa ste rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dpe/
gyi rta babs: gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi'i rta babs kyi bzo dbyibs shig /

skal bzang rnam 'dren gsum pa 'od srung byon pa'i skabs 'dzam gling mi rnams kyis chos dang, nor, 'dod pa, bde ba bzhi las cha gnyis nyams nas cha gnyis la longs su spyod pa'i dus te de'i yun tshad la lo grangs brgyad 'bum drug khri bzhi stong yod par bshad/
1) phyi gzung ba dang, nang 'dzin pa gnyis su snang ba/ 2) nyi zla dang skra shad sogs mang por snang ba rab rib can gyi gnyis snang/
1) grangs rim zhig / 2) (mngon) khyim bdag mo/
rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa/
phan tshun gnyis ka'i phyogs/ gnyis phyogs chings yig /
bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'od gsal gyi rim pa gtso bor ston pas gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do/
dang po'i yan lag ming mtha'i dag gi: ming / 2...dag /
1) rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis su 'dzin pa/ 2) yul yul can tha dad du 'dzin pa/
phyogs lhung med pa:/ bar dpang byed dus gnyis lo drang gzhag gi skad cha shod dgos/
logs su dbye rgyu med pa/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur 'di gnyis su byar med pa/
dbye ba med pa'am gcig pa yin pa/ chu yi nang du 'o ma blugs te gnyis su med par gyur pa/
skad cig ma'i sbyor ba: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, chos thams cad gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad du ma grub par skad cig ma gcig la mngon sum du rtogs nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /
gnyis su med pa'i shes pa
rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i blo/
/ 1) gnas lugs/ 2) gdod ma'am gzhi ma/ gnyug ma'i don/
sngar nas der yod pa'i dge 'dun/ rgyal pos kyang gnyug ma'i dge 'dun dang gzhan gyi yul nas dge 'dun spyan 'dren pa/
rang bzhin du gnas pa'am ye nas yod pa'i rig pa ste gdod nas dag pa'i rang byung gi ye shes sam gzhi'i ye shes/
srog 'dzin gyi rlung phra mo'am rlung sems dbyer med kyi dwangs ma'i lus te, de ni 'khor ba thog med nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa/
rgyun du gnas pa'i sems sam gzhi'i sems/
rgyun du sdod pa'am gtan du gnas pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i mi/
gnas gcig la rgyun du sdod pa'i dmag /
(tha dad pa) so lta ba'am 'tshol ba/ phyogs kun gnyul ba/ gnas tshul legs par gnyul te phyir log phebs shig /
long ga'i gzhug dang gzhang gi mgo gnyis bar gyi cha shas/

nye du rtsa lag / pha gnyen/ bshes gnyen/ ma gnyen/ ming gi rnam grangs la cho 'brang dang, nye du, nye 'brel, gnyen 'dab, gnyen gshin, snag gi gnyen, 'brel ba, rtsa lag mdza' bshes, rigs mtshungs, rigs rus bcas so,
1) khyo shug bral ba/ 2) mthun grogs rgyab 'gal du song ba/
bag mar slebs pa dang mag par slebs pa/
slong chang gtong nyin bu mna'i khyim phyogs gnyis nas bzhag pa'i gan rgya/
1) mdza' mthun byung ba/ 2) khyo shug 'brel ba/
gam bza' tshang byed pa:/ na tshod dar la bab pa'i pho mo phan tshun blo mos ltar gnyen sgrig byed pa/ gnyen sgrig ston 'brel/ gnyen sgrig ston mo/
spun dang mdza' grogs sems pham/ sha tsha can gyi gnyen nye blo pham yong ba dang, phrag dog can gyi dgra bo dga' spro yong ba'i las ka ma byed/
gnyen sgrig byed skabs kyi ston mo/
bza' tshang dga' mthun gyi las 'brel/
(rnying) phan tshun gnyen tshan du sgrig pa/
sha rus gang rung gis mi rabs bdun brgyud tshun chad du 'brel ba'i gnyen te nye du dang don gcig / glo bur gnyen 'dun longs spyod kun dang bral/
1) bza' tshang mthun sdeb/ 2) gnyen nye sgab mthun byed pa, sngar pha tshan mi rabs bdun brgyud dang ma tshan mi rabs lnga brgyud tshun chad la nye du'am gnyen 'dun zer/
mgo gnon nam, 'dul byed dang, spong byed, zhi bar byed pa'i stobs te log phyogs 'joms pa'i thabs/ nad gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po sman/ dgra 'dul ba'i gnyen po zhi drag gi stobs shugs gnyis/
spyod pa'i stobs: sdig pa 'chags byed kyi gnyen po stobs bzhi'i nang gses, phyag 'tshal ba dang yig brgya bzla ba sogs mthol bshags kyi las byed pa/
dam pa'i chos la brnyas pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa brgyad 'dul ba'i phyir du theg chen gsungs pa lta bu/
gnyen po phyogs kyi shes rnam
rang gi mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus kyi mkhyen pa'o, sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses/
spong ba'i gnyen po dang, gzhi'i gnyen po, thag sring ba'i gnyen po, rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/
nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa de dag rnam par sun 'byin pa dang thag bsring ba dang spang ba dang 'bral bar byed pa'i lam la brtson pa/
sgrib pa spong byed kyi gnyen po'i stobs/
rten gyi stobs, rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs, nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs, gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bcas bzhi/
gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi shes gang zhig thabs snying rje chen po dang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen po byed nus pa theg chen 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'o/
bsam gtan bzhi'i yan lag cig ste: bsam gtan bzhi'i rang sa'i spang bya spong ba'i gnyen po dang, gnyen po des thob pa'i gong ma'i yon tan/
sgrib pa spong byed kyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i lam ste, mthong sgom gyi bar chad med lam lta bu/
gnyen sgrig skabs phan tshun gnyis phyogs bar gyi dpang po/

nye du rtsa lag kun/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khon med dang, grogs po, gnyen bshes, mthun phyogs, blo nye, mdza' gcugs, mdza' bas bcings, mdza' bshes, zun, yid gcugs, yid mthun pa, rang phyogs bcas so,
pha ma sogs gnyen gny 'phrad pa/
1) mdza' mthun/ 2) khyo shug gi 'brel ba/
spun nye'i sde tshan/ gnyen tshan mda' smyug skye skye yod/
gnyen ya'am gnyen phyogs grogs po/
gnyen bsgrig sa'i yul/ gnyen ya ma dma', dgra ya ma mtho/
bag ma gtong len gyi gan yig /
bag mar phyin rjes dus mtshams gang rung zhig tu bu bu mo nang mi dang bcas pa pha ma'i khyim du thengs dang po 'gro ba
nye du mdza' mthun/ phyogs gnyis dbar du gnyen gshin gyi 'brel lam dam zab cig yod/
nye du mdza' grogs/ khyod la gnyen bshes gcig kyang med/ gnyen bshes dgrar langs/
bdag gnyer ram do dam/ dngos po rnams kha 'thor du mi 'gro ba'i gnyer kha byed pa/
1) khro ba'i ngo 'dzum nag po gnyer gnyer ston pa/ 2) mche ba ring po gnyer gnyer byed pa/ 3) don gnyer/
srung mkhan du bskos pa/ gnyer du gtad pa'i spyi rdzas tshang ma bor brlag 'thor rkyen du mi 'gro ba byed dgos/
bcol mngag gnyer gtad/ 'phral phugs kyi byed sgo'i rnam gzhag gnyer gdams byed pa/

do dam byed mkhan/ dkon gnyer/ sku gnyer/ khang gnyer/ gzhis gnyer/ mgron gnyer/ yig tshang gnyer pa/ ming gi rnam grang la lde mig pa dang, nang gi gru 'dzin, nor skyong, nor gyi srung ma, mig gi chos can, mdzod pa bcas so,

(tha dad pa) 1) 'tshol ba/ slob gnyer/ don du gnyer ba/ khog la rang don gnyer te kha nas gzhan don shod/ 2) do dam byed pa/ yo byad gnyer ba/ 3) khro tshul ston pa/ stag gis kha gnyer nas ngar skad sgrog pa/ 4) (rnying) 'bod pa/

sul ma ste 'dus pa'am, 'khums pa'am, brtsegs pa'i ri mo/ khro ba'i gnyer ma/ rgas pa'i gnyer ma/ chu'i gnyer ma/ gnyer mas gang ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ lo na mthon por slebs na gdong dang gzugs po'i pags pa gnyer ma 'khum yong/
bza' bca'i rigs sogs 'jog sa'i khang pa/

(tha dad pa) gnyags pa, gnyag pa, gnyogs,, 1) zas sogs sos zhib mor ldad pa/ bza' bca' gnyags nas mid/ 2) rdung rdeg byed pa/ lcag gis rta la gnyog / byis pa ma gnyog / khang pa'i mthil zhal gnyog pa/
(rnying) rin thang dang, bud med kyi rin/
(rnying) 1) 'khos ka chung ba'am, stobs chung ba/ 2) gtong phod chung ba/ 3) bsran chung ba/
stobs zhan pa'am sems chung byas nas sdod mkhan/ gnyom chung sdod lugs mkhas pas na, btsan pos bya thabs rnyed par dka'/
skad cha rna bas nyan lugs nor ba/
1.nyan pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.gru pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skya ba 'dzin dang, gru mkhan, gru yi kha lo ba, gdos pa 'dzin, rna ba 'dzin bcas so,
mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed
rang dang sems can thams cad lhan cig tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems bskyed/
(shrabsti:) mnyan du yod pa ste sngar shakya mu ne bzhugs gnas rgya gar gyi grong khyer rnying pa zhig gi ming/

shakya mu nes me 'brug lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nyin nas bco lnga'i bar phyi rol mu stegs pa dang cho 'phrul 'gran nas mu stegs kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pa'i dus chen rjes dran du lo ltar lha sar zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar mnyan yod cho 'phrul mchod pa'i smon lam chen mo tshogs srol tshugs yod/
rol cha mang po dus mnyam du 'bud dkrol byed pa/
mnyam du bgo bsha' rgyag pa/ phru gu rnams la kha tog mnyam bgos byed pa/
chabs cig tu skyod pa/ lam thag ring ba'i gzhan yul du slob gnyer la mnyam 'gro byed pa/
gshibs pa/ mnyam 'grogs byas nas 'gro ba/
mgyogs por 'gro ba:/ dmigs yul du ma slebs bar mnyam rgyug byed pa/
dus gcig la sgra skad khag mang 'byin pa
mnyam du byed thub pa/ rtsam pa 'gam rgyu dang gling bu gtong rgyu mnyam lcogs mi yong/

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses, dpe can gang zhig dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa des, rang gi ngang tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bya ba byed pa 'os min gyi skyon yod pa dang, bya ba'i yul nyid la'ang skabs gang yin gyi skyon yod pa bcas yul dang yul can gnyis ka'i nyes pa mnyam du ston pa'i rgyan zhi/
sgom gyi mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyi bsdus tshig
1) gcig mtshungs kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin/ 2) kun tu khyab pa'i rang bzhin te stong nyid/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses rjod byed sgra gcig la gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba gnyis kyis brjod bya dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig /
byang chub sems dpa'i mnyam nyid lnga ste, bdag gzhan mnyam nyid dang, phan gnod mnyam nyid, 'jig rten chos brgyad mnyam nyid, sangs rgyas sems can mnyam nyid, srid zhi mnyam nyid rnams so/

chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa'i mnyam pa nyid dang, mtshan ma med pa'i mnyam pa nyid, mtha' bzhi las skye ba med pa'i mnyam pa nyid, ma skyes pa'i mnyam pa nyid, dben pa'i mnyam pa nyid, gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i mnyam pa nyid, spros pa med pa'i mnyam pa nyid, blang dor med pa'i mnyam pa nyid, chos rnams rmi lam mig yor chu zla gzugs brnyan sprul pa lta bu'i mnyam pa nyid, dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i mnyam pa nyid bcas bcu'o/
snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ngo bo la bzang ngan med par rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du mkhyen pa'i ye shes/

dgongs pa can bzhi'i nang gses, 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang, shakya thub pa gnyis chos kyi sku dang, phrin las sogs che chung mi mnga' bar mnyam pa nyid la dgongs nas nga sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su gyur to zhes pa lta bu'o/
sangs rgyas kyi mnyam pa nyid gsum ste, tshogs bsags par mnyam pa nyid dang, chos sku brnyes par mnyam pa nyid, 'gro ba'i don spyod par mnyam pa nyid/
dus tshigs nyer bzhi'i nang tshan gnyis te, hor zla gnyis pa'i sgang tshad la dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang, hor zla brgyad pa'i sgang tshad la ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa/
thun mong du bdag gnyer byed pa/
ril bor tshes bsres ma nus bgos pa'i thob nor gzugs me mi mnyam zhing, thig mig mtsho rnams mnyam pa'o, mi mnyam rim min mnyam rim pa, nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i ya gyal pho ba'i me drod mkhris pa 'ju byed dang mnyam du gnas pa zhig ste, byed la nang khrol kun tu rgyu zhing zas skom 'ju bar byed pa zhig /
/ 1) mtshungs pa'am 'dra ba/ dus mnyam pa/ rigs mnyam pa/ lag mthil ltar khod mnyam pa/ ring thung mnyam pa/ 2) 'tshams pa dang ran pa/ grim lhod mnyam pa/ mtho dman mnyam pa/ dro grang mnyam pa/
thugs lnga'i ya gyal zhig mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni longs sku mnyam pa chen po'i thugs zhes sngags rnying ma'i brda chad do/
sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig rang nyid 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi dag la sgra dang rtsol ba mnyam pa ste, shin tu lhod pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa/ ma...
sman sna tshogs sbyar ba lta bu sbyor tshul gyis dri shas mi che ba'o/
1) ran par 'jog pa dang, 'tsham par 'jog pa/ 2) sems gnas dgu pa, sems mnyam par gyur pa na btang snyoms su byed pa/
mtshungs gsal gyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

pa mi mnga' ba: nyan thos dag 'phral la mnyam par 'jog cing ldang gi , sangs rgyas ni 'byung 'jug mi mnga' bar spyod lam bzhi'i dus thams cad du sems mnyam par 'jog pa, ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i gang zag ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te
rjes thob la gnas pa'i gang zag /
sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i skabs/
lhan cig / mnyam por phyin nas slob sbyong mthar phyin gyis/
mtshungs zla med pa/ sra brtan mnyam bral gyi snying stobs/

'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i mjug 'gril rjes 1945 lor btsugs pa'i rgyal spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yin zhing, de'i las khungs a ma ni a me ri ka'i grong khyer nyi'u yu'e la yod, de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rgyal spyi'i zhi mthun dang bde 'jags srung skyob byed rgyu dang, rgyal khab bar gyi mdza' bshes kyi 'brel ba spel rgyu, dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sogs thad kyi rgyal spyi'i mnyam las skul spel byed rgyu bcas red/
phan tshun gcig tu sbrel ba/
mang po sdeb tshogs/ mi mang mnyam 'dzoms/ las mang mnyam 'dzoms/
(sam'ahita:) cha mnyam par bzhag pa ste ting nge 'dzin sgom skabs gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid la sems rtse gcig tu dmigs nas mnyam par bzhag pa/
lta bu'i stong nyid: mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi yul bden med stong pa nyid/
de kho na nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/
thun mong du longs spyod pa/ skyid la kha'i rtswa la mnyam za dang, sdug ko mog gi chu la mnyam 'thung/
1) mang po sdeb 'dzom/ 2) mnyam du rub brgyab pa/
mang po lhan cig tu bsdebs pa'i don/ mi mang po khang pa gcig tu mnyam gshibs byas nas sdod pa/
gnyis sam, mang po mnyam du bsres pa/ dkar nag mnyam bsres/ mar dang phyur ba mnyam bsres byas nas thud brdzis/
(yul) ko ba'i sha gcod byed gri/
(tha dad pa) mnyes pa, mnye ba, mnyes,, 'phur 'phur gtong ba/ ko ba mnyes te rkyal pa btsems/
min par ldem zhing phra ba:/ lcang ma'i yal ga mnyen lcug dang ldan pa/
/ 1) snyi ba'am, 'jam pa'am, dul ba/ lus mnyen po spre'u lta bu/ lcang ma'i lcug phran mnyen pa/ phyag mnyen pa/ 2) sra ba las ldog pa/ sman gyi yon tan mnyen pa/
(tha mi dad pa) ngal ba'am thang chad pa'i zhe sa/ khyed rang sku mnyel ma song ngam/
sa ming zhig ste, snye thang yang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chu shur rdzong khongs kyi yul zhig /
mchod chang gtsang dag mchod pa
1. mnyed pa'i 'das pa, 2. (tha mi dad pa) dgyes pa'am rangs pa'i zhe sa/ thugs rab tu mnyes te 'di skad gsungs so, shin tu legs so, led so/
dga' po'i zhe sa/ dpe cha bklag par ha cang mnyes po gnang gi 'dug /
dga' tshor/ rgyal kha thob pa'i 'phrin bzang gsan nas mnyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dug /
sems rgyud zhi zhing, kun la byams pa'am, mdza' ba/ a ma dam pa'i mnyes gshin gyi rnam pa yid la dran pa/ mi de grod po la mnyes gshin gyi 'du shes ldan pa zhig red/
(tha dad pa) brnyas pa, brnya ba, rnyos,, 1) phar tshur g.yar ba/ rang la yon tan med na gzhan nas brnya rgyu med/ rgyu nor brnya bskyi gtong ba/ 2) thub tshod gtong ba/
mi gtsang ba yang yang bshal ba/
rnying pa'am rnying hrul/ lham gog rnyang rnying/ gyon pa rnyang rnying/
dri chen sla mo/ ba ma shi bar du rnyang ma mi zad/
(tha dad pa) brnyan pa, brnyan pa, rnyon,, g.yar ba/ khong gis nga la dngul brnyan byung/
lag pa brkyangs nas ca lag len tshul zhig / shing 'bras smin pa rnams lag pas rnyab rnyab kyis 'thog pa/
rnyab bi rnyib bi'i bsdus tshig
shing 'bras dang me tog sogs rnyid pa'i rnam pa/ shing tog rnyab bi rnyib bi bro ba zhan/
rgya'am dol/ rnyi 'dzugs pa/ rnyi la thebs pa/ rnyir tshud pa/ bya de rnyi las thar nas mgyogs por 'phur/ khyung mkha' lding rnyi la zin rabs med, stag dmar yag thag pas btags rabs med/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dkar mdzes dang gser thar bar gyi 'bab chu zhig ste, byang nas lho ru brgyugs te nyag chur 'bab/
rwa rnyi'i lhu lag ri dwags kyi rkang pa 'dzin byed thag pa
rwa rnyi'i lhu lag ri dwags la gzhu byed dbyug pa/

snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po che'i rtogs: brjod 'dzam gling tha gru khyab pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba ston pa 'jig rten du byon tshul dang, 'phags yul du bstan pa dar tshul te rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi rnam thar, bod yul du bstan pa dar tshul, khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su gsang sngags nang rgyud byung tshul, rnying ma'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu rnams kyi lo rgyus dang bstan pa'i bab so, dam pa'i chos kyi rnam gzhag spyi dang bye brag tu bshad pa, bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar brtsams tshul, rnying rgyud gled bam gyi bzhugs byang, yongs su bsngo ba bcas rab byed dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi gzhung 'di ni dus rabs bco brgyad par rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas mdzad pa/
gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos lud/
gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i bstan pa/
sha sogs la rnying dri bro ba/

dus yol ba dang, dus yun ring por lon pa'i rnam pa ste, gsar pa'i ldog pa/ skad cha rnying pa/ grogs po rnying pa/ yi ge rnying pa/ brda rnying pa/ mi rnying pa dang, gos gsar pa/ me tog rnying pa/ gos rnying pa la lhan pa gsar pa/
1. rnying ma ba'i bsdus tshig 2. sngon dus thon pa'i rgyu rnying pa rin thang can/ dkar yol rnying ma/ dpe cha rnying ma/

theg pa rim dgur grags pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i chos lugs zhes chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan sku dus bod skad du thog mar 'gyur zhing, slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis dar rgyas su spel ba'i ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa/
rnying pa'i lugs la chags pa/
yun ring song nas rul ba/

rim pa dgu: nyan thos, rang rgyal, byang sems te sprul sku shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i thun mong gi theg pa gsum, kri ya, u pa, yo ga ste longs sku rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyi phyi'i theg pa gsum, bskyed pa ma ha yo ga , lung a nu yo ga , rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ste chos sku kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa'i nang gi theg pa bla na med pa gsum bcas dgu'o/
shin tu rnying pa rtsab ral/ ca lag rnying hrul tshang ma khang pa 'di'i nang la bcug 'dug /
/ 1) rnying drags pa/ kha zas ha cang rnyings pa bzas na pho ba na yong/ 2) rnying pa dang 'dra,
zla ba gcig phan chad 'das pa'i tshad pa rnying par gyur nas lus zungs dang 'dres te lcags la btsa' dang ras la snum zhen pa ltar gyur pa'i tsha ba'i ming/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) skam min rlon min du 'gyur ba/ dgun dus rtswa shing rid phal cher rnyid nas skam yong/ 2) snying stobs shor ba dang, nyams pa'i tshul/ bsam don ma grub pa tsam gyis rnyid nas sdod pa snying stobs med pa'i rtags red/ 2. skam ma rlon/ sha rnyid/ shing tog rnyid pa/ me tog rnyid pa/
so rnyil la phog pa'i nad/
rnyed pa dang bkur sti ste, nor rdzas 'bul mtshon dang, bkur sti gus 'dud/
ldan min 'du byed las thob pa'i bye brag sngar med gsar du rnyed pa ste, sdom pa gsar du thob pa lta bu/

1. (tha mi dad pa) sngon med gsar du thob pa/ rnyed dka' ba/ rnyed sla ba/ btsal te rnyed pa/ nges pa rnyed pa/ bden don rnyed pa/ sman pa dor ba'i nad pa der, sman bzang rnyed pa ga la srid/ rgya mtsho'i gling du ma phyin na, yid bzhin nor bu ga la rnyed/ 2. 1) dngos po'am
bye brag smra ba'i lugs la chos de sngar ma thob pa'am nyams pa gang rung slar rnyed pa la gegs byed kyi rdzas shig /
bsod snyoms pa: gang rnyed des chog gi bsod snyoms tsam la brten pa/
rnyed pas rnyed pa sgrub pa
rnyed pas rnyed 'tshol dang don gcig
log 'tsho lnga'i nang gses shig rnyed pa chung ngu phar bstabs nas rnyed pa chen po tshur don du gnyer ba la zer/
(rnying) gta' ma'i tshul gyis sbyin pa/
rang la rgyu nor mang po yod pa'i khengs sems/

mgo rnyog gam gyod chags/ phan tshun kha rtsod thug ste gcig rgyab gnyis langs kyis rnyog gra gang min bzos song/ mi 'grub khas len byas pas rnyog gra mang po byung/ rnyog gra bslangs pa/ don med dkrog gtam bshad nas rnyog gra ma slong zhig /
1. 'dam snyigs can/ gyod ya phan tshun gnyis kar dge bshad sdig bkrol gyi babs gsed byas pas da cha 'khon rtsod kyi rnyog pa rtsa ba nas dwangs pa/ 2. rnyog po dang 'dra,
dwangs po med pa/ chang rnyog po/ rdzing bu rnyog po/ skad cha rnyog po/ rtsod gleng rnyog po gtsang bsangs byed dgos/
1. snyigs ma/ chu snod du dwangs rdzas btab nas rnyog ma bgrungs te gtsang mar byas pa/ 2. dwangs po med pa/ chu rnyog ma btungs na na thag chod red/
kha mchu rnying pa bskyar slong gi dpe/ rnyog ma gting slong gis rtsod gshags byed pa/
rnyog tsam zhig / drag char btang ba'i rjes su rdzing chu rnyog se ba zhig 'khyil 'dug / rtsod pa de rnyog se ba zhig red/
'dam snyigs can du go ba'i rnyog pa dang 'dra,
bye ma dang chu gnyis lhan du g.yos te rnyogs pa ltar tsha ba chu ser dang bsdongs nas lus zungs rnyogs par byed pa'i tshad pa'i ming/
bya dka' byed gtad kyi gnas/
/ 1) rnyi'am, gal lam, rgya/ sha ba ri pa rnams kyis ri dwags gang du 'khor sa'i gnas brtags te rnyong btsud nas gsod pa/ 2) zhal ba/
(tha dad pa) brnyangs pa, brnyang ba, rnyongs,, rkyong ba/ rkang pa yar ma bskums par mar rnyongs shig / shing nags nang du rgya rnyi brnyangs nas ri dwags 'dzin/
kong kong/ lus kyi dku'am dpyi ma rnyongs pa/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) ring tshad kyis slebs pa'am 'dang ba/ lag pas bsnyabs kyang ma rnyob/ 2) lag pas len pa/ mgo ma tshos gong du lce la rnyob/
(rnying) gnyid nyal ba'am dran pa stor ba/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur bska kha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rgyu long sogs snod kyi tsha ba sel, tsha 'khru gcod/
snyigs ma/ sa snyags snyigs/ chu snyags snyid/

/ 1) skyon cha dang, klan ka'am khag 'gan/ dkar yol 'di la snyad phran bu 'dug / 2) kha 'phangs pa'i thabs shes te rgyu mtshan ltar snang/ glo bur na khul byas pa de ni thag ring du 'gro 'dod med pa'i snyad ka red/
gzhan la don med du klan ka 'tshol ba/
snyad se snyod se'i bsdus tshig
skyon med bzhin du yod par sgro btags te skyon rjod pa/ snyad 'dogs rgyu za/ skyon med la snyad 'dogs byed pa/ las ka brtan po ma byas na mis snyad ka btags yong/
skyon med skyon dkris/ mi dang rtsod pa rgyag skabs yang snyad med snyad dkris byas na don la mi phan/
skyon med skyon 'dogs kyis snyad 'tshol byas pa/ 'khon 'gras zher bzhag gis skyon 'dogs snyad gtses thal na phung krol bzos yong/
skyon 'tshol ba/ gzhan la rogs ram mi byed par snyad 'tshol kho na byas na yag po ma red/
skyon 'dzugs pa/ rang gis ma byung ba mi sems par mi la don med snyad 'dzugs ma byed/
'khang tshig gam snyad gtam sna tshogs smra tshul/ snyad snyod mang pos sems rtsa dkrug par byed/
/ 1) rna ba'i zhe sa/ 2) ri dwags gnyan gyi 'bri srol gzhan zhig
skad snyan pa'am gtam snyan pa/
rna ba sun po byas pa/
skul lcag btang ba'i zhe sa/ bka' lan 'phral du ma thon pas snyan bskul zhu ba/
1) rna kor ram rna rgyan/ 2) mdo sde phal bo che'i mtshan gzhan zhig /
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, snyan mnyam pa dang, snyan dbang nyams pa rnam par spang ba/
ming grags sam skad grags bzang po/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun grags dang, kun shes, grags pa, snyan pa bcas so,
ngag thog nas zhu ba'i gnas lugs/ bya rim byung lugs yang yang snyan sgron zhus pa/
gong rim la snyan seng zhu mkhan/
bla rabs rim bzhin snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag / gso rig snyan brgyud kyi man ngag /
snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang
rab byung bdun pa'i nang byang pa mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa dang chu brtag thabs skor gsal bar gsungs pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
chos gang lung dang bcas pa dang, lung man ngag dang ldan pa, man ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa, brgyud pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa/
1) rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal/ 2) tshigs bcad, tshig lhug spel ma gsum gang rung gi sgo nas brtsams pa'i snyan tshig /
1) snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i mi/ 2) (mngon) gza' pa sangs/
snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i mi/
snyan ngag shes mkhan gyi mchog /
don nyams pa dang, don 'gal ba, don gcig pa, the tshom can, rim pa nyams pa, sgra nyams pa, gcod mtshams nyams pa, sdeb sbyor nyams pa, mtshams sbyor nyams pa, yul dus sogs dang 'gal ba/

rgya gar gyi slob dpon snyan ngag mkhan po dbyug pa can gyis rgya gar shar pa dang, lho pa'i lam srol tha dad pa dang, shar lho'i lam srol thun mong ba rnams kyi snying po bsdus nas le'u gsum gyi gzhung tshad du dril bar mdzad pa 'di nyid, 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i skabs, shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang, rgya gar gyi pandi ta lakshim'a ra gnyis kyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bod yig la bsgyur te phyis su dpang lo blo gros brtan pa dang, zha lu lo ts'a ba chos skyong bzang po sogs snga phyi'i mkhas pa mang pos rgya gzhung dang bstun te 'gyur bcos dag ther rim par mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung chen/
rtsom pa snyan tshig gi nyams ldan pa/
glu'i gdangs kyi 'gyur khug sogs snyan pa'i nyams dod po/
sgra rna bar snyan pa dang, sems la 'bab pa/ snyan 'jebs kyi dbyangs/ ri mgo nas snyan 'jebs kyi glu dbyangs thos pas yid 'phrog pa/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, 'dod chags la sogs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyis snyan gnyis ring thung med par mnyam pa/
rna bar 'jebs shing mig la mdzes pa/
rna ba gtad nas nyan pa/ dge skyon gsal 'debs zhus pa la snyan gtod pa/
lha'i sku brnyan la bsgron rgyu'i kha btad/ rten mjal zhu dus snyan dar sgron pa/
rna bar zhus pa/ da lo'i byas rjes rnams snyan du gsol ba yin/
gtam rna bar 'khyol ba/ dmangs kyi bsam 'char zhu tshig tshang ma snyan du lhong ba/
ngag thog nas snyan gsan zhus pa/ lung pa der gnas tshul ji byung tshang ma ngas khong la snyan mnan bzhag yod/

1. grags pa/ de'i snyan pa rgyang nas thos/ mkhas pa'i snyan pa rgya chen po/ 2. 'jeb po/ gtam snyan pa/ mi snyan par brjod pa/ glu snyan mo/ tshig snyan mo'i bden gtam/ byi'u chung gsung skad snyan yang, sku sha rgya srang do red/
rgya lu chas gyon dus kyi rna rgyan/
rna ba dang sems la 'bab pa'i sgra dbyangs/
grags snyan ba dan gyi gzud su bkod pa/
snyan grags rlung gi gzud su bkod pa/
1) gtam 'jam por shod pa/ 2) bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
gong rim la dbyen sbyor byed pa/ brtag dpyad dag ther ma byas par snyan phra'i zhu tshig gi dbang du shor na mi 'grig /
1) snyan tshig gi 'phrin yig / 2) skad cha snyan po/
rna ba'i dbang po/ snyan dbang rin po cher zhu gsol/
rnam par spangs pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, sems can thams cad kyi rgyud ma nyams par mdzad pa nyid kyis snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa/
rna bar 'bab pa/ glu snyan mo'i gre 'gyur snyan gyis gson, tshig snyan mo'i bden gtam thugs la dpyod/
rna ba sun po/ don med snyan gtser mang po zhus nas thugs 'khrugs pa/
1) rna bar snyan pa'i tshig / 2) snyan ngag /
«sam' bed:» sngar rgya gar du bram ze'i chos lugs kyi rig byed bzhi'i gras shig ste sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa'i bstod bsngags kyi snyan tshig ldan pa'i rig byed/
tshig rgyan sbyar ba'i bskur yig /
1) snyan ngag gi sgo nas bris pa'i gtam rgyud/ 2) snyan ngag gi byung rabs/
1) rna bar shod pa/ 2) zhu yig /
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi byang ngos rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud shag chu'i chu rgyud du yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de ser khang du yod/
1) rna mjug gi sha 'phyang/ 2) rna rgyan/ 3) snyan dar kha btags/ snyan shal gyi lha rdzas bzang por bstar ba/
rna bar sun gtser/ snyan shas su ma dgongs par nged kyis da res thengs gcig zhus pa de dam don mdzod/
1) rna cog phyi rol gyi sha leb/ 2) lha mo 'khrab dus lha mo'i rna rgyan shog khra/
rna ba sun po/ khyed la yang yang snyan sun ma zhus thabs med byung/

gong rim la ngag thog nas gnas lud zhu ba/ tshogs 'du chen mo'i thog la srid don snyan seng mdzad song/ 'gro khar brel ba byas nas khong la snyan seng tsam yang zhu rgyu ma byung/ byed sgo'i rnam gzhag tshang ma 'phral 'phral snyan seng zhus yod/
skad cha thos tshad la yid ches pa'i don/ snyan srab pa'i mis bden rdzun gyi dbye ba gsal por 'byed mi thub/
ngag thog nas gnas lugs zhu ba/
rna bas gsal por thos thub pa/ khong sku na bgres kyang snyan gsang po 'dug / khyed la mi gsan dgu gsan gsan rgyu 'dug pas de 'dra'i snyan gsang po ya mtshan/
ngag thog nas gnas lugs zhu ba/
ngag thog nas skul brda gtong ba/ gzhes nyin mdzad sgo chen mo'i thog phebs rogs gnang zhu rgyu'i snyan gsan 'bebs pa/
gzab gzab byas nas mnyan pa/ dngos 'brel gyi zhu tshig thugs la bab pas 'go nas gzhug bar snyan lhan ner gsan pa/
bsam blo 'khor ba/ tshul de lta bu'o snyam du dgongs pa/ tshang ma bde ba dang ldan snyam du bsam pa/
'di'o snyam du sems la 'jog pa/ sdug kyang bde'o snyam du 'dzin pa/
'di 'dra yin no snyam du go ba/ 'gro sa'i mdun lam bzang po ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kho na yin no snyam du shes pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 'dod pa dang, myong tshor byung ba, yid la sems pa/ phan snyam pa shar/ sman btungs nas nad drag par snyam pa/ dpe cha lta snyam pa/ skyon cang med snyam pa/ 'jigs so snyam pa yod re skan/
nges nges mi byed par kha tsam tshig tsam/ sems 'jog med pa'i snyam me snyom me byed pa/
'jam pa'i don du go ba'i snyi ba dang 'dra,
1. 1) (yul) lci ba rlon pa/ 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas cham pa'i nad dang, glo yu'i tshad pa sogs la phan/ 2. 'jam pa/ sa snyi ba/ reg bya snyi ba'i shing bal/
shun lpags mkhregs po min pa/

(tha dad pa) bsnyigs pa, bsnyig pa, snyigs,, bdams nas glhag mar byed pa dang snyigs mar byed pa ste mi rung ba rnams logs su dgar ba/ 'bru nang gi sa rdo bsnyig pa/ sngo tshal gyi lo ma ser po bsnyigs pa/ lhung bzed bsnyigs pa/
gad snyigs blug sa'i snod sgam/
dus mthar tshe dang bsod nams sogs kyi dwangs ma rim gyis zad de ngan snyigs su lhag pa'i dus/
(yul) 1) gting la bying ba/ bye ma chu'i zhabs su snyigs pa/ 2) rjes su lus pa/ rta kha rgan pa de rjes la snyigs song/
/ 1) ro ma/ dwangs snyigs dbye ba phye ba/ mar gyi snyigs ma/ chu snyigs/ sman snyigs/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal srid skyong dka' ba/ 2) lhag ma dang tha ma/ zog snyigs/ 'bru snyigs/
tshe'i snyigs ma dang, nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma, sems can gyi snyigs ma, dus kyi snyigs ma, lta ba'i snyigs ma rnams so/
snyigs ma shas chung ba'i dus
snyigs ma srab cing nyung ba'i dus/
snyigs ma shas che ba'i dus
nad mang po dang, dmag 'khrug rgyun mi 'chad pa, char chu dus su mi 'bab pa, lo phyugs rtag tu mi legs pa sod la zer/

/ 1) mi lus kyi byang khog stod du gnas shing don lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni tshe srog gi rten byed pa dang, sems kyi bde sdug sogs dran pa gsal bar byed pa, khrag la sogs pa'i dwangs ma rnams lus kyi cha shas kun tu khyab par byed pa sogs yin/ snying 'phar ba/ snying la rus pa yod na, rdo la i khung 'bigs/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun skyed byed dang, chos kyi rtsa 'khor, snying sha, thugs, rnam shes rten, sha mchog sems kyi khang pa, srog gnas bcas so, 2) sems/ snying bde ba/ 'gro snying ma 'dod nyal snying 'dod/ bshad snying 'dod dam mi 'dod/ gtam bzang thos pas snying dga' ba/ 3) blo khog / mi ngan spyod ngan la ngo rgol byed par snying ma chung zhig / dgun kha'i kha ba 'bab snying che, nyi ma byung na chu la shor/
1) blo sems dkar ba/ nga gnyis snying dkar sa zhig yin/ 2) khyi sogs kyi snying ga'i thad du spu thig dkar po yod pa/ khyi nag snying dkar/
snying dang srog rtsa la bab pa'i rlung nad shas che ba'i skya rbab ste, nad rtags lus skrangs shing snying mi bde ba 'byung ba zhig /
snying yod sa'i thad phyogs, mdun/ snying kha 'phar ba/
1) phod tshan/ snying khams can/ 2) dran rig dang 'brel ba'i lus kyi khams/ snying khams kyi nad/ snying khams mi bde ba/

snying khong rus pa'i dkyil yang zer, sems kyi gting ste, kha tsam tshig tsam min pa'i dpe/ ngas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas yid ches byed kyi yod/ rdo la ri mo brkos pa ltar, snying khong rus pa'i gting du nges/ snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas thugs rje che zhu ba/
snying ga'i thad kyi rtsa dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab brgyad gdud kyi rtsibs ma ltar kha yar phyogs te yod pa zhig /
snying ga'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa
dbang rnon rdor bzlas la brten pa ste, bdag mdun gyi lha la gsal snang grub cing rlung dang dbang po nang du bsdus la yid kyi bzlas pa/
rtsa'i 'khor lo lnga'i ya gyal zhig
sems kyi gces nor te, mchog tu dga' ba'i mdza' grogs sam rgyu nor/
blo thub kyi grogs po'am shin tu mdza' ba'i grogs po/
nad sogs kyi stabs kyis snying g.yo ba/ khrag rlung langs nas snying 'gul bar byed pa/
mi zhed pa'i snying stobs can/
blo drang min kyog kyog / mi snying gcus can gyi gtam/
blo shin tu nye ba'am byams pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i phru gu gcig la snying gces gces byed pa/
sems la nan tan bzung ba/ spyi don snying bcangs/
snying po'i snying po/ 'bum dmag chen po'i snying bcud de, sngar ma wa mos ga la yong/
snying la chu bsags pa'i nad, snying nad bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
blo khog med pa/ snying chung gis dpa' 'jog mi thub/
blo khog chen po/ dgra dang dngos su 'thab dus, snying chen yin min shes thub/
yid 'phrog pa/ lo rgyus kyi gsungs sgros ha cang snyan che bas snying 'chu ba/
tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i nang gses, nad sogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can de dag sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa ste, rnam par 'tshe ba'i sems kyi gnyen po'o/
sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed pa/
snying rje chen po'i pad ma dkar po'i mdo
bam po drug dang le'u bcu gsum pa, dzi na mi tra sogs kyis bsgyur pa/
kun la khyab pa'i brtse sems chen po ste, sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang 'bral bar byed 'dod kyi blo/
1) snying rje nas mi bzod pa'i rnam pa/ snying rje rje skad du 'o dod 'bod par byed/ 2) dga' dga'i ngang nas byams po byed pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i phru gu zhig la snying rje rje byed/
nye ring med pa'i brtse sems/
snying rje pad dkar gyi mdo
bam po bco lnga dang le'u drug pa, pandi ta dzi na mi tra sogs dang, lo ts'a ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa/
1) yid du 'ong ba/ phru gu de tsho snying rje po sha stag 'dug / 2) 'dra chags chags/ kha nas skad cha snying rje po shod pa las lag tu yang dag par len pa gal che/
sdug bsngal can rnams sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi blo skyes pa/ 'khyag ltogs kyi sdug bsngal yod mkhan tshor snying rje ba tsam gyis cang mi phan/
tshad med bzhi'i ya gyal, dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar bya'o snyam du sems pa'o/
par 'jug pa: snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa/
sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang, chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje, dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje bcas so/
nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi nang gses, sdug bsngal drag po myong ba'i yul dang phrad pa'i stobs kyis nang du snying rje rgyas pa'i rnam 'gyur brtse nyams ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa'i brtse sems/
sems can la brtse sems mi lhod pa'am mi 'dor ba/
mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi kun rdzob la ltos te sems bskyed khyad par can gyis zhi mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/
sems mdza' ba/ snying nye ba'i grogs la snying gtam bshad/
(yul) sngar bod dbus phyogs su mi tshang 'bring gi khyim bdag mo la 'bod pa'i zhe sa/
blo bkal ba'am blo gtad pa/ grogs po blo thub can la snying gtad pa/

1) drang po'i gtam/ phan pa'i snying gtam/ sman ro kha rung nad la phan, snying gtam rtsub rung mi la phan/ 2) snying nye ba'i skad cha/ brtse ba'i snying gtam/ mdza' grogs phan tshun snying gtam shod res byed pa/

blo stobs/ snying stobs chen po/ snying stobs srab mo/ snying stobs chung ba/ las don dka' tshegs che gras la snying stobs ma bskyed na mi 'grub/ yon tan gyi ri rtser 'dzeg thub pa'i ched du snying stobs che bskyed kyis slob sbyong la hur brtson byed pa/
1) blo stobs dang ldan pa,../ 2) blo stobs yod pa'i mi/
sems kyi gting/ snying thag pa nas gdung sems zhu ba/ snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu ba/
thig le ste snying po'am yang snying gi: don ..
1) dran pa mi gsal ba'am rig pa nyob pa/ gnyid rmugs kyis gzir nas snying 'thibs pa/ 2) snying nad bdun gyi nang gses shig /
yid du 'ong ba'am 'bab pa/ mi de kun gyi snying du sdug par 'dzin pa/
yid du 'ong ba/ phru gu phal che ba'i snying du 'bab pa rtsed mo red/
rta'i brang du 'dogs pa'i dom dom ste, sngar rta chas kyi che rtags/
blo khog / pho snying gdos gting nas mi che ba'i, gtam kha rgod stong bshad mkhas mdog kha/
sam yid la shin tu 'bab pa'i mi pho: mo
1) snying la nad phog pa/ 2) yid mi dga' ba'am khro ba/
1) snying gi na tsha/ 2) snga ma'i 'khon rnying/ snying nad sangs pa/
snying nad kha le nag po
snying nad bdun gyi bye brag cig
mya ngan dang sems 'khrugs pa sogs las byung ba'i snying gi nad bdun te, snying 'phyos dang, snying gzer, snying tshad, snying chu, snying 'thibs, snying srin, snying nad kha le nag po/

1) khong khro 'jags pa'i thabs/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul lhug por bshad de snying gnon pa/ 2) byas nyes 'doms pa'i nyes chad/ khyod kyi byas nyes la snying gnon nyes pa gser srang gang song ba sgrubs/

/ 1) nying khu dang bcud/ bdud rtsi'i snying po/ zho'i snying po mar red/ zas kyi snying po bcud red/ 2) gtso don nam tsa che'i don/ don dag snying po/ srog gi snying po/ dgongs pa'i snying po/ snying po med pa la snying por 'du shes pa/ gso rig gi snying po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ sa'i snying po/ 3) dkyil dang, lte ba/ shing gi snying po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ kham bu'i nang snying/ 4) sha'i snying/
bu ram, zhun mar, sbrang rtsi, til mar, lan tshwa ste lnga/

srog sdom gzer bzhi'i ya gyal, sgra grag sngags kyi rang bzhin du shes pa ste, mar 'khor ba'i dus kyi bag chags dag par byed, yar sangs rgyas kyi tshe gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'char ba'i 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs, bar lam dus su ngag rlung gi rang bzhin sngags kyi rnam par sbyang ba rlung la brten pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba/
don med pa'am dgos pa med pa/ snying po med pa'i gtam mi shod cing, snying po med pa'i las mi byed/
gal po cher 'dzin pa/ zhing las kyi gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu'i las don de snying por 'dzin pa/
don med pa'am don gyis stongs pa/
sems la brtan por nges pa'am, gting ring por zug pa/ bka' slob bzang po gang gnang ba rnams snying phur thebs pa/
snying g.yo ba/ las 'gan gal 'gangs che tshul dran pas snying 'phyo ba/ de ring dga' drags nas snying 'phyo ba lta bu byas byung/
snying nad bdun gyi nang gses shig /
'bras nad snying la babs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su snying 'phar zhing gzer la dran pa mi gsal ba mun pa 'thib pa ltar 'byung ba zhig /

1) brtse ba'i 'bod sgra ste snying rje ba la zhes pa'i don/ dwa phrug nyam thag de tsho snying ma rje/ 2) zur za dang khyad gsod kyi tshig cig / sdug ro kho 'dra po zhig gis a pho nga la 'thab rtsis byed pa snying ma rje gad mo bro/
1) blo khog med pa/ 2) legs nyes sam bzang ngan mi shes pa'i blo,/ 3) snying po med pa'i bsdus tshig
nang snying med pa/ phyi rol gyi rnam 'gyur rdzig rdzig 'dra yang snying med khog stong de tshor 'jigs dgos don ci yang med/
nad pa'i lag pa g.yon pa'i tshon 'og nas blta rgyu'i nang khrol snying gi rtsa 'phar stangs/
sdug bsngal can thams cad sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi sems/
sdug bsngal 'bral 'dod kyi brtse sems sam byams sems byed pa/ smyon par khong mi khro la, dgra bor snying mi brtse ba/
snying brte med pa'i stan bcos
thar pa 'thob byed ma yin pa'i bstan bcos/
sdug bsngal 'bral 'dod kyi sems brtse zhing, phan 'dod kyi byams sems/
'jigs zhum zhum/ dgra mthong ba'i tshe snying tsha skyu ru ru ma byed/
snying nad bdun gyi nang gses shig tsha ba snying la zhugs pa'i nad/
mo nad snying la byer ba'i nad de, nang gses su dbye na snying gi khrag tshabs dang, snying gi rlung tshabs gnyis mchis/
sems dga' ba'am 'dod pa gang ba/
gzhan sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' spro skyes pa'i tshig brjod pa/ mi ngan la god chags byung na tshang mas snying tshim bgrang yong/
gzhan la sdug bsngal byung ba la snying tshim rgyag pa/
gzhan la sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' ba'i tshig rjod pa/ 'khon dgra'i khyim la me shor yang snying tshim ma 'debs/
snying gi phyi rol gyi tshil/
sems 'tshab 'tshub/ bya spyod las brel mang po yin yang snying 'tshub langs mi nyan/
sems zhi ba'am 'jam pa/ phrag dog mkhreg bzung gi snying zhi nas gzu bor gnas/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la skyur, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas snying gi tshad pa sel/
(rnying) 1) sems gso gtang ba/ 2) gsang gtam bshad pa/
snying nad bdun gyi nang gses shig ste snying la gzer zug rgyag pa'i nad/
snying 'phar ba/ ri la yar 'dzeg dus snying g.yug yong/
sha mi tsha ba'am brtse dung med pa/ grogs po la snying ring ba/
brtson 'grus/ snying rus bskyed nas 'bad nus na, srid na dka' ba gang yang med/ mkhas kyang dpe dang ma bral, sdug kyang snying rus ma chung/ dka' spyad snying rus/ snying rus gyis la yon tan slobs/
1) shin tu brtse ba'i nyams/ phru gu bsam med 'khyags te lus pa snying re rje/ 2) khyad gsod dang zur za'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i sgra/ gang yang mi shes pa'i spobs pa chen po de tsho snying re rje...
blo khengs pa'am yid tshim pa'i tshig cig / dgra bor ya lan 'phrod pas snying re tshim/
don med par sems sdug pa sogs kyi rtags ston pa'i rlung nad kyi bye brag cig ste, zhugs gnas la brten nas ming btags pa/
snying rlung tshabs chen langs pa/
dran pa stor ba/ bgegs dbang gdon bskyod kyis snying brlags te ci dran 'de dran med par gyur/
yid la 'thad pa'am blor 'bab pa/ snyan zhing don gnad yod pa'i gtam snying la 'bab pa/
snying nye lags kyi bsdus tshig
sems khur ram sems khral/ sger gyi khe phan snying las su gyur/ snying las chung ba/

snying nad bdun gyi nang tshan srin las gyur pa'i snying nad de, nad rtags snying drag tu 'phar zhing zug rngu 'brad snyam sems pa 'byung ba zhig /

rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bdun pa snying dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na snying 'phyo ba dang, lus 'dar ba, smyo ba, 'bog pa sogs la phan/
dran pa 'thor ba/ glo bur du na tsha chen po byung nas re zhig snying had de lus pa/
/ 1) pha'i gcung po/ 2) bza' zla'i bu spun/
/ 1) pha'i gcung mo/ 2) zhang po'i chung ma/ 3) bza' zla'i bu mo spun/
snyim pa gang gi bsdus tshig
lag pa'i khyor ba gnyis kha sbyar nas byung ba'i tshad/ chang snyim par blugs nas 'thung ba/

(tha mi dad pa) bsnyungs pa, bsnyung ba,, na ba'i zhe sa,..rims nad 'gos nas ha cang sdug po bsnyungs 'dug /

nad kyi zhe sa/ snyun dwangs pa/ sku snyun gyis bzung ba 'dug /
