khams bde 'dri ba/ grogs po'i sku khams bde sdug gang yin snyun 'dri zhu/ stangs dpyal 'khor bcas kyi sku gzugs bde thang yin min snyun 'dri zhu gzhin du yod/
(tha mi dad pa) bsnyun pa, bsnyun pa,, nad na ba'i zhe sa/ khong zas dug gis gsol grod bsnyun song/
khams bde 'dri ba/ mched grogs mjal 'phrad byung ma thag tu snyun gsol ba lugs srol yin/
nang la 'bru son med pa'i snye ma/
zhing khar snye ma tshang ma thon pa/ bod la hor zla drug pa'i nang snye kha 'grig yong/
snye ma'i mgo/ zhing khar snye mgo thon 'dug / gro nas snye mgo thon skabs lhags pa bzang, chu 'bras snye mgo thon skabs char pa bzang/
lha sa'i nub phyogs chu shur rdzong khongs kyi sa gnas shig ste, jo bo rje sa gnas 'dir lo dgur bzhugs te mthar 'das, snye thang sgrol ma lha khang gnas yul yang 'di yin/
rab byung gsum pa'i shing glang lor rgya 'ching ru pas btab pa'i ra ba stod dgon pa zer ba de yin/
zhing kha'i snye mar gnod pa srung byed tho yor/ nas zhing la snye tho 'dzugs/
sre da ste snye mgo nag po 'bru med pa zhig /
snye ma'i phung po ste, lo tog gi snye ma mang po phyogs gcig tu spungs pa'i phung po/ sbra yi tshugs shing ber ka yis, lus po snye phung bzhin du brdungs/
(tha dad pa) bsnyes pa, bsnye ba, snyes,, lus kyi rgyab bam gzhogs gzhan la brten pa/ sku rgyab sngas la bsnyes te bzhugs/
gnyen sgrig gi bya ba byed mkhan nam gnyen dpang/ rgya mo 'un shing kong jo khyod, dka' las byas nas snye bos bkug /
1) rgyab snye sa'i 'bol/ 2) mgo 'jog sa'i sngas 'bol/
lo tog gi 'bru son mang po sdong rtser mnyam du skyes pa de'i ming/ gro'i snye ma/ snye ma stong pa/ snye ma 'bus pa/ spang ljang khu g.yu lo me tog de, 'bras snye ma smin dus yal te 'gro/
skyid sdug mnyam gcig gi dpe
snye mar 'bru chags pas 'bru shun gang la khad yod/ lo tog gi rtsa rtse legs par rgyas te snye mar mig blugs pa/
snye ma'i 'bru phra ba'm snye ma stong pa/ sdug rigs sdug tshad kha 'phang mtho, snye ma long ba mgo 'phang mtho/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer gyi nub ngos yar klungs gtsang po'i byang rgyud du yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de dar grong du yod/

bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa zhig ste, sngar shangs ri bo rtse pa bar grags pa las, rjes su snye mo lhun grub sgang pa dang, bya sgo'i mi ser zer ba'i tshogs chung gnyis su ming don gnas 'phos par grags/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung nang snye mo: ba'i yig 'bri mkhan
yul snye mo nas thon pa'i shog bu

(tha dad pa) bsnyegs pa, bsnyeg pa, snyegs,, 1) 'ded pa/ gcig rjes gcig snyeg / 2) gnas 'phar bar byed pa'am, mtho bar byed pa/ go 'phang mthor snyeg / 3) rjes su 'brang ba/ dpung tshogs kyi nang du snyegs/

1.(tha mi dad pa) bsnyengs pa, bsnyeng ba,, 'jigs pa/ dka' ngal la bsnyengs nas las don byed 'dod med mkhan gcig kyang med par gyur song/ 2.(rnying) rkyong ba dang ring du sring ba/ rkang lag snyeng ba/
ru'i ldebs su rmed sgrog byed kyi thag: pa phra mo
sga'i rmed kyi rmed hril lam, tsha hril/
1.tshad nges bzung med pa'i tsam gyi don ston pa'i phrad cig / ji snyed pa/ de snyed cig / ngal rtsol gyi yon tan ji snyed cig dang ldan pa/ 2.lo gsum yan lon pa'i lug
(tha dad pa) bsnyen pa, bsnyen pa, snyen,, thag nye sar slebs nas bsten pa'am sgrub pa/ dge rgan mang po bsnyen pa/ sngags snyen pa/
(tha mi dad pa) bsnyems pa, bsnyem pa,, nga rgyal byed pa/ yon tan med kyang yod par bsnyems pa/ nga rgyal gyis snyem pa/ bsnyems pa'i tshul bstan pa/ snyems chung, sems chung/
/ 1) nga rgyal lam dregs pa/ snyems pas gzhan la brnyas mi bya/ gzhan nor snyems pas 'khyer ba/ 2) (rnying) nyam chung/
bdag 'dzin las byung ba'i 'khrul snang zhig ste, myos byed dam 'khrul byed kyi bdud cig gi ming/
spobs pa dang bral ba ste, spobs pa med pa/
gnyer ma'm sul nyer nyer byed tshul/ stag gis kha yi pags pa snyer snyer por bsdus nas mchongs song/
gnyer ma'm sul nyer por sdud tshul/ khro gnyer snyer po bsdus pa/
(tha dad pa) bsnyer ba, bsnyer ba, snyer,, gnyer ma sdud pa/ dpral ba bsnyer ba/ khong khro skyes nas gdong yang rab tu bsnyer/

(tha dad pa) 1,bsnyogs pa, bsnyog pa, snyogs,, dkrug pa/ khron pa'i chu ma snyog / khong khro bslangs nas sems bsnyogs pa/ bsnyags pa, bsnyag pa, snyogs,, 'ded pa/ bu lon dus thog tu sprod ma thub pas snyog mkhan yang yang yong ba/
chu'i nang du 'dres pa'i rdzas gzhan/

(tha dad pa) 1,bsnyad pa, bsnyad pa, snyod,, 'chad pa/ rmi lam snyod pa/ lo rgyus snyod pa/ drang gtam bsnyad pa/ bsnyod pa, bsnyod pa, snyod,, 1) gso ba dang, bza' btung kha'i lce rtse nas khar 'jug pa/ byi'u zas kyis bsnyod de cher gyur pa/ 'o mas phru gu snyod pa/ 2) phra sbom snyoms por byed pa/ bal skud snyod pa/
(tha dad pa) bsnyon pa, bsnyon pa, snyon,, ham rtsod byed pa/ dang por med pa la rjes mar yod ces bsnyon pa/ bdag gis ma byas kyang byas so zhes bsnyon byung/
(tha dad pa) bsnyabs pa, bsnyab pa, snyobs,, lag pa brkyangs nas len pa'am 'dzin pa/ zas la snyob pa/ shing 'bras lag pas bsnyabs nas 'thog pa/ snyob pa'i lag pa su ring ma byed/
1.(tha dad pa) bsnyams pa, bsnyam pa, snyoms,, mnyam par byed pa/ ring thung bsnyams pa/ mang nyung bsnyams pa/ sgang gshong bsnyam pa/ 2.(rnying) g.yel ba/
cha mnyam pa/ bgo bsha' snyom po brgyab na rtsod pa mi yong/
le lo'i bye brag bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa sogs/ kho mi dar ma yin yang snyom las mkhan zhig red/
chos nyan pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa la sogs pa mi byed par, nyal ba dang 'phros pa la sogs par 'bad pa/
le lo can/ ming gi rnam grangs la snyom las can dang, blo chud zos, le lo can bcas so,
nyam chung ngam 'khos chung/ snyoms chung tshul ldan/
(sam'apatti:) bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus pa'i lus kyi 'byung ba chen po'm sems sems byung dmigs pa la cha mnyam du byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems rtse gcig pa
mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis te, 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang, 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug /
mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i grub mtha'i nang gses shig /

gzugs med skabs kyi snyoms 'jug bzhi ste, nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang, rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang, ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang, yod min med min skye mched de gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi zhes gzugs med pa'i khams su ming bzhi'i phung por rang dbang du gnas bzhir rtse gcig tu 'jug pa/
mnyam pa ste, bar ma dang, spang blang med pa'am, nyon mongs med pa/ khod snyoms pa/ btang snyoms/ bsod snyoms/ mgo snyoms/ snyoms shing drang ba/ 'grang ltogs snyoms pa/
1) ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa/ 2) 'khrig pa/
ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa'i skabs kyi dga' bde'i ro/
'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug la gnas pa'i sems kyi ting nge 'dzin/
1) ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa/ 2) 'khrig sbyor/
1) chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms kyi sems/ 2) (rnying) the tshom/

(tha dad pa) bsnyor ba, bsnyor ba, snyor,, 1) gzhu ba/ phru gur nyes skyon byung ba tsam gyis ma snyor/ 2) 'og tu rdzi ba dang brdal ba'am bshig pa/ rta'i rkang lag 'og tu khyi gcig bsnyor te bsad pa/ 'bru'i phung po bsnyor nas 'bo la gshor ba/ 3) bdag skyong byed pa dang, nyams rgud slar gso byed pa/ byis pa snyor ba/ nad pa snyor ba/

(tha dad pa) bsnyal ba, bsnyal ba, snyol,, 1) skyur rtsi'am phab btab ste zho chang sogs chags su 'jug pa/ chang bsnyal ba/ zho bsnyal ba/ gro zhib snyol ba/ 2) nyal du 'jug pa/ phru gu mal du bsnyal yod/ 3) mar sgyel ba/ sman btang nas nad gzhi'i 'go bsnyal ba/ shing sdong sa la bsnyal ba/ zhe sdang bsnyal ba/ spu snyol ba/ byings ma bsnyal ba/ , (rnying) 'jigs pa/
(yul) chang snyol byed kyi rdza khog /
g.yar ba dang skyi ba/ rang la cha rkyen yod bzhin du gzhan la brnya skyi byed pa don med red/
rnyan pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
gzugs brnyan gyi 'dra par/ brnyan par khang/
/ 1) tshab ma/ gzugs brnyan/ skra brnyan/ 2) g.yar po/ phyag brnyan/ brnyan po'i rgyan cha/ dngul brnyan po gtong ba/
mthong chung ngam mi brtsi ba/ brnyas bcos gnya' gnon/ mi la brnyas bcos byas pas rang nyid mtho ru mi 'gro/
smod tshig gam pha rol por gtsigs med kyi gtam/
(tha dad pa) 1) thub tshod gtong ba/ brnyas che na ngo rgol che/ phru gu la brnyas na mi 'grig / rgyal khab chen pos rgyal khab chung ba la brnyas pa/ 2) rnya ba'i 'das pa,
thub tshod kyis rgyu nor 'phrog bcom
brnyas bcos dang smod tshig / gcig gis gcig la brnyas smod byas pa/
thub tshod kyis rna ba sun po bzo ba/
thub tshod gtong ba'i go skabs 'tshol ba/
(tha mi dad pa) rtogs pa dang chen po'i gnas thob pa/ rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa/ go 'phang brnyes pa/ yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa/
(tha mi dad pa) brnyogs pa, brnyog pa,, kha 'dris pa'm kha lang la shor ba/ rta 'di rtswa ra'i nang gi sngo rtswar kha brnyogs te rtag par yong gi 'dug /
'ded pa'i don du go ba'i snyog pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
'ded pa'i don du go ba'i snyog pa'i 'das pa,
'chad pa'i don du go ba'i snyod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
bsnyad 'dogs thabs byed pa/ skabs bstun bsnyad 'tshol/
1) gleng gzhi/ 2) khag 'dogs sa'i rtsa ba/
khrag gtar skabs rtsa mi 'gyur zhing khrag gtar mig tu 'byung ba'i ched du gtar gnas gong 'og tu thi gu'i dkri tshul zhig /
1.snyol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.(rnying) 'khrud pa/
snyil ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
nyung nyung bzo ba/ gzhi rgya che drags pa rnams bsnyung bsnyung du khu bsdu byed dgos/
zas nyung ngur bsten pa'i sdom pa'am cho ga zhig
snyun pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ong pa,
(rnying) brtson 'grus sam rtsol ba drag po byed pa/
1.snyeng ba'i 'das pa, 2.'jigs pa dang, bag tsha ba/
1) 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ 2) (mngon) dpa' bo/
sri zhu'm zhabs tog / rgan rgon la bsnyen bkur zhu ba/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur byas pa/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa stob pa/
bsnyen bkur bsngags pa'i lhag ma
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, sems can la chags pa'i lhag ma lnga'i nang gses, chags sems kyis bud med la bsnyen bkur na legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod pa/
sri zhu zhu yul mchog tu gyur pa bla ma: dang pha ma
yi dam gyi sngags bzla ba dang sgom sgrub byed pa/
yi dam rgyun ring sgrub pa'i thabs shig /
nyin zhag re'i mtha' can du srung ba'i khyim pa'i so thar sdom pa'i bye brag cig / bsnyen gnas la gnas pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la brtul zhugs dang gso sbyong ngo,
rtsa ba bzhi dang chang dang, gar phreng sogs, mal stan che mtho, phyi dro'i kha zas te yan lag bzhi bcas nyin zhag gcig spong bar khas blangs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa/

bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga: ste yul slob dpon nam rten gyi drung du kun slong gus pa dang bcas pas spyod lam stan dma' ba la 'dug cing rgyan gsar pas mi rgyan par, dus snga dro'i dus su nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dus khrims de, slob dpon gyis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa tshang bar 'bog pa'i cho ga'i tshig rjes zlos lan gsum du byed pa/
bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa
srog gcod dang, ma byin len, mi tshangs spyod, rdzun smra, chang 'thung, khri stan che mtho, glu gar dang dri rgyan, phyi dro'i kha zas te brgyad spong ba'i sdom pa/
1.snyen pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.yi dam lha dang nye bar 'grogs pa'i spyod pa/ bsnyen pa skyel ba/ bsnyen pa gtong ba/
dge slong gi sdom pa ma mnos pa/
bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig 'don pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, rgod bag gi bsam pa'i sgo nas bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhanb cig tu chos kyi tshig gdangs sna tshogs kyis 'don pa/

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod, dus kyi kun slong thob shes, 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral gyi bsam pa, mthun rkyen phun tshoggs gsum ldan gyi bsam pa de thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas rtsis zin pa/
1) dge slong gi sdom pa nod pa'am dge slong bsgrubs pa/ 2) bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa/
bsnyen par rdzogs pa mngon du gyur pa bcu
mngon gyur bcu dang don gcig
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong
mkhan po dang slob dpon las tshul khrims yang dag par mnos pa'i dge slong/
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga'am bya ba/
lha'i bsnyen pa skyel ba'i ched du mtshams la bsdad pa/
dge slong ste, rdzogs pa ni spang rtogs mthar thug pa'i myang 'das yin la, bsnyen pa ni de dag myur du bsgrub pa la 'jug pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bya/
(up'adhyaya:) dge slong gi sdom pa gnang mkhan/ bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa, dge slong gi sdom pa/
nye ring/ bsnyen bsring bral ba'i snyoms pa'i khrims lugs/
snyer ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
brjed ngas/ khong la zhabs skul zhus na ma gtogs bsnyel ngas chen po yod/
(tha mi dad pa) brjed pa'i zhe sa/ las don de gal chen po zhig yin pas ma bsnyel ba gnang rogs gnang/
sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi yon tan zhig ste, chos thams cad mkhyen pa la thogs pa dang chags pa med pa, ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid
gdul bya'i don mdzad pa la dus las yol ba med pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs lta bu dus su 'gyangs nas phyi bsnyel mi mnga' ba ste, zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi nang gses shig /
mi brjed pa'i dran gso/ phyag las gnang rgyu'i rigs sngon tshud nas bsnyel gso byung na yag po yong/
dkrug pa'i don du go ba'i snyog pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
dkrug pa'i don du go ba'i snyog pa'i 'das pa,
gso ba'i don du go ba'i snyod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
khag btags ham bshad kyis btsan 'phrog byed pa/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dngos po 'ga' zhig gi gnas tshul dngos de yin pa la ma yin zhes ham pas bsnyon nas don gzhan cung zad khas blangs te ston pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs gsum ni, chos la bsnyon pa, yun la bsnyon pa, rang bzhin la bsnyon pa/

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi dngos por ham pas mngon sum du bsnyon nas yin pa las min par bsgyur te dpe dang ngo bo gcig tu byas pa'i sgo nas don du dpe can khyad 'phags ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
ma byas par byas pa'am min pa la yin zer ba'i ham bsnyon byed pa/ rang nongs rang gis ngos len byed dgos pa las gzhan la bsnyon 'ding ba mi chog /
snyon pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
ham spobs kyis byung ba/ mi khram pa'i nor rdzas tshang ma bsnyon pas thob pa sha stag las, bden pas thob pa med/
rtsod pa med pa'am nor 'khrul med pa/ gang ci'i sgo nas bsam blo btang yang bsnyon med red/
yod la med dang, yin la min pa'i skyon 'dogs pa'am ya la dkri ba/
skyon 'dogs kyi ham pa/ nam rgyun mi la bsnyon ham sna tshogs byed pa/
gi zhal lce: zhal lce bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, yin pa la min dang, min pa la yin zhes ham 'dzugs kyi bsnyon byung na lha srung dpang du btsugs nas mna' bkar bden rdzun 'byed pa'i khrims/
snyor ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,

bod yig gsal byed dgu pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba so dang lce rtse phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra med, ming gzhi'i pho yig cig /
mdo khams kyi yul gru 'ga' zhig la ta dang da gnyis kyi sgra gdangs gcig tu 'bod pas khyad par 'byed byed kyi tshig / ta...ta da...ta...ta...da...da...

1) gsal byed kyi sde pa gsum pa ste ta tha da na/ ta tha da nam ? 2) legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed kyi sde pa bzhi pa ste, ta tha da dha na/ ta tha da dha nam ?, legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed kyi sde pa gsum pa ste, ta tha da dha na/ ta tha da dha na,
ta dben dang 'dra,, 1) dar dmar po/ 2) (rgya)...
ta ming dang 'dra,, (rgya) rab byung lnga pa'i sa sprel nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprel bar gyi krung go'i rgyal rabs kyi ming/
1) 'u su'i ming gi rnam grangs shig / 2) gser rdo'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
kyi rgyal khab cig gi ming: phyis su po zi dang, deng dus dbyi lang zer/
rtse mo bcad na slar mi skye ba'i shing gi bye brag cig / ta la'i shing 'bras stong phrag lon, skam yang rlan dang phrad na skye/ , ta la dang 'dra,
(mngon) mi'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
shing be ta, de'i 'bras bur khu ba mang bas btung du rung zhing, 'bras bu bza' rung la snum yang 'tshir thub pa, 'bras bu'i pags pa'i tshi sna ni dra ba bzo byed cig yin/
yi ge : sngar rgya gar sogs su shing ta la'i lo ma ni dpe cha 'bri gzhir spyod pas, der bris pa'i dpe cha rnams so/
1) mdzes pa/ ta ler gyur pa/ 2) wa le dang gsal le/ yid la ta ler shar/ ri chen po ta ler phug pa/
(rgya) man ju'i rgyal rabs skabs bod kyi dpon rigs ser mo ba'i go ming zhig /

hor rgyal po'i dbu bla, de'i gdan rabs rim byon gyi lo tshigs ni, rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags sprel lo nas rab byung lnga pa'i me byi'i bar 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa, de nas sa yos bar 'phags pa'i gcung rin chen rgyal mtshan, de nas me khyi'i bar 'phags pa'i tsha bo dharma pa la, de nas shing rta'i bar 'phags pa'i slob ma ye shes rin chen, de nas chu yos bar 'phags pa'i mchod dpon grags pa 'od zer, de nas shing sbrul bar shar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan, de nas shing stag bar sangs rgyas dpal, de nas shing glang lo'i bar kun dga' blo gros, de nas sa sbrul bar kun dga' legs 'byung, de nas chu bya'i bar rin chen bkra shis, de nas sa khyi'i bar lo nyer lnga kun dga' rgyal mtshan, de nas chu stag bar bla chen bsod nams blo gros, de nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gi bar du rim bzhin byon no/
ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan

sa skya'i chos rgyal bdun pa 'di bzang po dpal ba'i sras yin zhing, khri thog la lo gsum bzhugs mtshams su sa skya ba'i srid dbang nyams te phag gru pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod dbus gtsang phal che ba dbang du bsgyur/
(rgya) dngul sgor mo ljid tshad zho bdun skar gnyis yod pa dang ri mo yon hri kha'e yi mgo can zhig /

(legs) 1) sgrol ba'i mgon po/ 2) jo nang pa'i slob dpon zhig yin pa 'di rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag lor 'khrungs, mtshan dngos kun dga' snying po yin, rgya gar chos 'byung dang jo nang pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos du ma brtsams, rin spungs sde pa karma bstan skyong dbang po sbyin bdag bsten nas jo nang dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su rtag brtan phun tshogs gling phyag btab, rgyal dbang bzhi pas me tri bya ba'i mtshan gsol, sog po khal kha'i yul kha bong du lo grangs nyi shu'i ring la bstan pa spel zhing dgon pa du ma btab, jo nang pa'i lugs nyams gso mdzad, sog yul du rje btsun dam pa zhes su grags, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing khyi lor 'das, de'i yang srid mong gol rgyal po thu she thu han gyi sras su 'khrungs, rgyal dbang lnga pa'i skabs rtag brtan phun tshogs gling dge lugs par bsgyur nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes btags, de nas bzung dbus gtsang du grub mtha' de 'dzin pa'i sde rim gyis nyams par gyur/

don du rgya mtsho bla ma zhes bya zhing, ta la'i zhes pa ni sog skad yin pa de bod skad du rgya mtsho'i don du 'jug ming rgyal rabs kyi hrin tsung khri lo brgyad par, mtsho sngon gyi sog po al than rgyal pos bod kyi dge lugs pa'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtshor che bstod kyi mtshan gsol ba zhig yin zhing, rjes su dge 'dun grub dang, dge 'dun rgya mtsho so sor yang ta la'i bla ma'i sku phreng dang po dang, gnyis pa'i mtshan de gsol zhing, ching hrun kri'i khri lo bcu par blo bzang rgya mtshor ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa zhes bya ba'i cho lo bstsal nas da bar rim byon sku phreng bcu bzhi byung yod/
(yul) phyi tho ste snam bu sogs 'thag byed lag cha zhig
khal do chung chung gi rnam pa/ do po tag gi tig gi brtsegs te 'gel ba/

1) nges pa can nam 'phyugs pa med pa/ dpe tshad ltar ring thung tag tag byung 'dug / dus thog tu tag tag 'khel song/ tag tag 'gal zlar 'gyur ba/ 2) sgra sgrog stangs/ sgo la tag tag btang nas 'bod pa/ tag tag ces rkan sgra sgrog / 3) rkyang rkyang ngam kho na/ sha tag tag za/ bod yig tag tag sbyang/
kha thug 'khel ba'am chad lhag med pa:/ ngas tag tag tig tig byas chog /
tag gi tig gi'i bsdus tshig
(rgya) thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas snying la tsha ba zhugs pa dang sha dug phog pa sogs la phan/
tong tong gi sgra sgrog stangs/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sde rong rdzong gi la zhig /
(rgya) spyir srid tang gi khongs mi yin zhing, bye brag tu rang rgyal nang krung go gung khran tang gi khongs mir zer/
tan tan tig tig gi bsdus tshig

1. bod kyi yi ge gtan la phab pa'i skad gsar bcad ma byas gong ming mthar da drag yod pa'i na ra la'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / da...na ra la...yar byon tam, mar byon/ khab thar tam, skud pa thar/ phar bskyal tam, tshur bskyal/ 2. da drag can ming mtha' na ra la'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / na ra la...yar byon tam, ma byon/ khab thar tam, ma thar/ tshur bskyal tam, ma bskyal/
me lhar bstab bya'i gtor ma'o/
(yul) sngar bod kyi tam gcig ri ba'i khab/
(yul) sngar bod kyi tam gcig ri ba'i chang blug snod khog ltir/
(yul) sngar bod kyi dngul gyi rtsis gzhi zhig ste tam rdo re la dngul srang lnga bcu yin/
(rgya) sngar sa cha dang mi dmangs la bdag skyong byed pa'i dpon rigs che gras kyi go gnas shig yin zhing, rgya nag tu phebs pa'i bod kyi bla chen sogs la mnga' gsol ba'i mtshan gyi che ba zhig /

chub rgyal mtshan: phag gru sde srid khri thog dang po 'di rab byung lnga pa'i chu stag lor 'khrungs, spyi lo 1351 lor chos grwa chen po rtsed thang rgya cher btab, rab byung drug pa'i shing rta lor khri dpon mdzad de sa skyar dmag drangs nas dpon chen dbang brtson bzung, hor rgyal po'i drung du mi rten 'bul dang bcas pa btang bar brten, mi rabs la phan pa'i 'ja' sa dang bka' lung bzang po byung nas ta'i si tu'i go gnas 'dzin pa dang, sne gdong rtser phag gru sde srid kyi bstan jus btsugs shing, de rjes sngar bod chos rgyal gong ma'i khrims lugs rnams bden rdzun thang mar brdal nas khrims gsar zhal lce bco lngar gtan la phab, sngar gyi gzhis ka rdzong du bsgyur nas rdzong dpon gtong srol gsar du btsugs/
glog 'phrin, 'di ni rgya gar gyi skad yin/ tar lan/ tar yig /
glog 'phrin gtong len gyi las khungs/
shar rgyag gam tal ma/ lcags zam gyi steng du tal rgyugs kyis phyin/ pang leb mthug por bu ga tal rgyugs su phug /
skya gnyis kyi bar la ka ba mi dgos par tal mar yod pa'i gdung ma/ lcags kyi tal gdung/
tal rgyugs sam shar rgyug / lam bar du kar kor med par tal mar phyin/ khang pa'i nang du gdung ma tal mar btang/
(yul) cung zad tsam/ sa bon tal tsam zhig btab pas 'bras bu mang po thon 'dug /
sti ga dang 'dra,, (legs) dpe gzhung rtsa ba gang yin gyi 'grel bshad dam, 'grel pa/

sngar rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig ste ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rgyu gzer 'joms, dmar bshal dang tsha 'khru gcod, rma 'drub, shig srung/

1) sngo chog kyang zer ba'i lcags rigs mdog dngul dang 'dra zhing de las sngo ba zhig ste, 'di 'phrul kong byas nas bsregs pa'i dud pas mig nad la phan/ 2) rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su dbye na mdog dkar ser dmar gsum mchis, bsregs thal gyi nus pas rma 'drub pa dang, mig nad la phan/
(rgya) rgyal po'i dbu bla ste, ser mo ba'i go sa zhig gi ming, sngar ta dben rgyal thog rim byon khrir phebs skabs bod kyi bla ma slob dpon du bsten cing, bla ma der ti shri'i cho lo stsal srol yod/
ti shri kun dga' blo gros

rab byung lnga pa'i sa phag lor sa skya bdag nyid chen po'i sras su 'khrungs, hor gyi rgyal sar byon nas bu yan rgyal po dang, gi gan rgyal po, ye sun the mur bcas gsum gyi ti shri mdzad, de yan chad kyis gdan sa thun mong du dbang bsgyur, 'di pas gdan sa de sku mched so sor bgos te gnang bas bzhi thog bla brang dang, lha khang bla brang, rin chen sgang bla brang, dus mchod bla brang bcas bzhir gyes, shing glang lor 'das/
ti shri rin chen rgyal mtshan
'gro mgon chos rgyal gyi gcung po rin chen rgyal mtshan, 'phags pa rab byung lnga pa'i me bya lor rgyal sa nas bod la log pa'i shul du rgyal po'i dbu bla ti shri lo gsum mdzad, sa yos la 'das/
(legs) gangs ri/ ti se gangs ri/
'grel chen, gzhung don gsal bar byed pa'i t'ika chen/
nyid snang ba: mkhas grub rjes rab byung bdun pa'i shing stag lor brtsams pa'i 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi rgya cher 'grel/
pa'i rgya mtsho: mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa/
/ man ngag gi yang tig / gzhung lugs kyi yang tig /

(legs) kha ba ste sngo sman gyi rigs shig ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag dang mkhris pa'i tsha ba dang, mchin tshad sogs la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'joms byed dang, sdig pa'i bran mo, sdong bu gcig gnas gcig 'dzin, rig pa'i rna ba, ro ldan, legs ldan bcas so,
rgya tig dang, bal tig sum cu tig gam lcags tig gsum/
1) thigs pa rgyag tshul gyi sgra tsam/ 2) nges nges kyi don/ skad cha de dag tig tig yin nam/
/ 1) nges po'am don dril po/ khos skad cha tig po zhig bshad song/ 2) 'khos 'byor yag tsam yod pa/ dud tshang 'di gzhan la re ma dgos pa'i tig po zhig red/
(yul) cung zad tsam/ bza' bca' la spod sman tig tsam btab/ khyod rang tig tsam sgugs dang nga mgyogs po sleb yong/
/ 1) yon chab 'bul snod li dang dngul sogs kyis bzos pa zhig / ting gtsang ma'i nang du chu blugs/ 2) sgra/ rol cha ting sgra sgrog pa thos byung/
ting la par brgyab pa'i bu ram dang shel ka ra/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs khongs spu hreng rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5230 yod/
tho bas lcags brdungs pa lta bu'i sgra/
(sam'adhi) yang dag par 'dzin pa ste brtag pa'i dngos po'am dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig sbreng chags su 'dzin pa'i sems byung ngo/
dngos snang thams cad mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su bsdus te rig pa ma bcos pa'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa/
sems shin tu gsal ba'i gsal cha'i ngar dang ldan pa dang, sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i mi rtog pa'i gnas cha dang ldan pa/
'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i mdo, shi la dharma dang rnam par mi rtog pas rgya las bsgyur pa/
ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs nyes pa lnga
le lo dang, brjed nges, bying rgod, 'du mi byed, 'du byed pa/

rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa cho 'phrul bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, dbus su rnam par snang mdzad, shar du mi bskyod pa, lhor rin chen 'byung ldan, nub tu snang ba mtha' yas, byang du don yod grub pa rnams rang rang gi rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bzhis bskor bar bsgom pa'o/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi stobs lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rtag tu rnam par g.yeng ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/
ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs drug zhi gnas sgrub par byed pa'i
stobs drug ste thos pa dang, bsam pa, dran pa, shes bzhin, brtson 'grus, yongs su 'dres pa bcas kyi stobs drug /
byang phyogs so bdun gyi dbang po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, sems gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i yul la g.yeng zhing 'phro ba med pa'i cha/
ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par gzhag pa
bstan bcos shig thang shun kro'ang gis rgya yig tu bsgyur nas, rjes su rgya'i dge slong ha shang zab mo sogs kyis rgya yig las bod yig tu bsgyur pa/
zhi gnas sgrub par dgos nges kyi dge rtsa/
lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang don gcig
byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka': thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang don gcig
pa mi mnga' ba: dus thams cad du ting nge 'dzin du zhugs nas mi nyams par 'jog pa, ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
chub yan lag byang chub yan lag bdun gyi: ya gyal zhig ste mnyam par bzhag stobs kyis yang dag pa'i shes rab bskyed de nyon mongs rnams spong bar byed pa zhig /

1) ma ha yo ga'i bskyed rim rnams ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub pa ste, de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin, kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin, rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ 2) rnal 'byor rgyud yan chod kyi bskyed rim spyi'i rnal 'byor gsum ste, dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang, las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin, dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin te gsum/

srog sdom gzer bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, snang srid lha'i 'khor lor bsgom pa ste, de mar 'khor ba'i skye gnas bzhi'i lus kyi bag chags sbyang zhing dag par byed, yar sangs rgyas kyi tshe sku gang 'dul du snang ba'i 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs, bar lam dus su rtsa'i drwa thams cad lha ru sbyangs pas, rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sde dge rdzong du yod/
1) ting ting zhes pa'i sgra'i ming/ 2) rta drel sogs kyi ske rgyan/
ting ting zhes pa'i skad sgrog cing, che chung byi'u dang 'dra ba'i chu bya zhig /
ting la par brgyab pa'i bu ram dang shel ka ra/

yul nges lnga'i nang gses, bden pa dang skyon yon dang zhi rags sogs rang spyi'i mtshan nyid brtag bya'i dngos po la dmigs nas rtse gcig pa'i shes pa rnam g.yeng gi gnyen po shes rab bskyed pa'i byed las can no/

rab rtog gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste: sems med kyi dngos pos sems ldan gyi bya ba byed bsam med bzhin du yod par sgro btags te rab rtog gsal byed kyi bzhin sgra sbyar ba'i sgo nas brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /
sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi nang gses shig ste, ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar sa bon nam phyag mtshan bsgom pa'o/
(yul) ming gzhan phor ther mgo skon yang zer te zangs bzo ba'i lag cha zhig /
zan gyi kong bu chung ngur mar snum gang rung gis gtams pa'i mar me chung chung/
(legs) rgya gar phyogs su yod pa'i star kha nag po/
(yul) ko lham rta sgro sogs kyi mtha' 'gril dang, mthongs rgyan, srub zan sogs la gtong rgyu'i pags pa tshos sngon can/
kha che'i yul sogs nas thon pa'i rta mchog gi ming ste yul skad la ti pi cag zer/
sngo sman 'bras bu'i rigs te dkar nag gnyis mchis, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rlung 'joms, lus stobs 'phel bar byed, chu ser la'ang phan/
til brdungs nas snum 'don pa'i til rdung mkhan/
til dkar nag gi 'bru/ til 'bru tsam gyi don/ grub 'bras til 'bru tsam mi yong/ phan thogs til 'bru tsam yang ma byung/
til las byung ba'i snum/ bye ma btsir ba las til mar mi 'byung/
til snum 'don pa/ 'tshir spyad kyi 'khor los til 'tshir bar byed pa/
la don gyi phrad cig / la...
1) spos kyi bye brag cig / 2) sngar kha che'i yul gyi gar log rigs/
(rnying) 1) tur te myur ba'am lhang nge ba/ 2) dus rgyun pa/ 3) 'bad brtson/
che zhing ljid pa'i sgra ste, rdo sogs sa la lhung ba dang, thag ring gi rta'i rmig sgra lta bu/ rbab rdo tug 'gril chum 'gril/
gsal zhing dma' ba zhig / byis pa tug tug: brgyugs
sgra mi gsal zhing cung ring tsam sgrog pa'i sgra zhig /
1) rdza rnga sogs kyi thag ring gi sgra/ 2) rta dang bong bu sogs 'gro ba'i sgra/
(rgya) tung las bzos pa'i yo byad brkos tshag can
t'ung ni shar dang kus ni rgyal blon sogs la zhe sa'i che 'bod/

1) gsal po/ rig pa tur tur po de dran skyen po zhig yong/ 2) skabs re gsal la skabs re mi gsal ba'i tshul/ sems la 'char mi 'char gyi nyams tur tur zhig 'dug / 3) las ka sogs rdzogs la khad pa/ las mjug ha lam tur tur zhig la slebs 'dug /
brtan pa'am gsal ba/ dran 'dun tur re ba/ yid la tur re shar/

ming mtha' na ra la sa dang da drag can gyi rjes su sbyor ba'i lhag bcas kyi sgra'i phrad cig / na ra la...da...de'ang sems can yin te nya yin pa'i phyir/ bka' 'gyur te sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rgya gar skad nas skad rigs gzhan du bsgyur nas 'gyur ba rnams so,/ thag ring du bskyal te bzhag / ras cha dras te gyon pa 'tshem/
rnga chung/ sems dga' nas te te rdung bzhin 'khrab/
(yul) 'jur mig gi bu ga mang po yod pa'i lcags leb ste, mgar bas lcags skud phra bo dang lcags gzer bzo byed lag cha zhig /
(rnying) 1) shin tu'am rab tu/ 2) legs pa/ 3) sra ba/ 4) dam pa/ 5) drag pa/ 6) tshabs che ba/
(rnying) nyes rdung ha cang chen po btab pa/
sre mong las che tsam gyi srog chags dri ngan can/
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gdon nad 'joms, chu ser skem pa sogs la phan/

«ti lli pa» dus rabs bcu pa'i skabs su byung ba'i na ro pa'i bla ma, khong gi thog ma'i mtshan la shes rab bzang po zer, gsang sngags nyams su blangs te grub pa brnyes, snum 'tshag mdzad pa gnang myong bas mtshan la tee lo pa thogs/ to, da drag can gyi mthar sbyar rgyu slar bsdu'i phrad cig / da...
(yul) shing gzhog byed kyi lag cha zhig /
(rgya) thebs tse yang zer te lto snod cig /
gser dngul zangs lcags sogs las bcos pa'i nad dmigs sreg byed kyi yo byad cig /
lde sprin btsan dang nyi btsun mang ma rje gnyis kyi sras, sngar bod rgyal nyer bzhi pa ste btsan lnga'i ya gyal zhig 'di man nas 'bangs dang gnyen bsres so/
/ 1) dbal lam rtse mo/ dar shing gi tog / 2) go gnas mtshon byed kyi zhwa mo'i rgyan cha zhig / rim pa gsum pa'i tog gnas/ 3) nying khu'am snying po/
(rnying) 1) glo bur du khyer ba/ 2) cha tshang lings te blangs pa/
phran bu'am, yud tsam/ da dung tog tsam sgugs dang kho rang slebs yong/ kha snon tog tsam brgyab na tshad long yong/
sa rko byed 'jor/ ming gi rnam grangs la rko byed dang 'jor ro,
las ka go rim ltar mi byed par cig car du byed pa'i dpe/
sngar go gnas mtshon byed tog yod pa'i zhwa mo/
1) che zhing gsal ba'i sgra/ 2) bong bu sogs kyi ske la 'dogs rgyu lcags las bzos pa'i tong tong/
bab col smra ba/ rtog dpyod med par skad cha tob tob smra/
bu ga che ru gtong byed kyi lag cha zhig /
glo bur dang thol byung/ kho cang mi smra bar tol gyis phyin song/
(legs) rtse gsum yod pa'i mtshon cha zhig /
bon lugs kyi tha snyad cig ste nang pa'i yum chen mo'am sher phyin dang 'dra/
(legs) rims smyon pa ste nag po sum sgril gyi ming gzhan zhig /
si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul brag 'go rdzong gi sa cha zhig /
(legs) 1) sbrang rgod mdung gsum pa/ 2) sre mong/
1) tre bo dang mtshungs, 2) khams byang rgyud rong pa tsha nas rta'u bar gyi yul spyi'i ming/
1) tre bo khams pa sogs kyi gyon lham/ 2) (yul) tres sam mam, sman phye/
zhang zhung skad kyi grum bu'i skad dod cig ste, nang gses su dbye na rtsa trem dang, rus trem, sha trem, chu trem, trem dkar, trem nag bcas rigs drug mchis so/
grang ba shas che ba'i grum bu la'o/
khrag mkhris tsha ba shas che ba'i grum nad cig /
sman sbyor gyi phye ma zhib tu btags pa'i ming/
(rgya) cig car ba ste, sngar krung go'i nang du dar ba'i nang pa'i grub mtha' zhig /
(rnying) gzhan la rdung rdeg gtong ba'am 'tshog pa/
nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
'phrin gtam bskur yig / gtang yig gtong ba
kyi legs 'bul lam: drin gso'i yon/ dga' ba'i gtang rag rgya chen po byas/
rdzas sngags kyi sgo nas gzhan gnod kyi mthu gtad/ mnan gtad rgyag pa/
lha mo tshe ring mched lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
gter srung la gnyer du gtad pa/
sbyin pa'am sprod pa'i don du go ba'i gtod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
ba'i spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, sbyin bdag gis gtad pa'i dbyar gyi rnyed pa dbyar mtshams kyi nang du longs spyod pa'o/
'di yin 'di min gyi gtad so med pa'am, cha 'jog byed mi rung ba/ las ka gtad med cho med cig /
1) gcig nas gcig tu rim gyis sprad pa'i rgyun/ 2) ston pa shakya thub pa'i bstan pa gtad sa'i brgyud 'dzin gyi rabs/
sngar rgyal bstan dgra bcom pa gcig nas gcig tu sprad pa'i byung rim 'od srung dang, kun dga' bo, sha na'i gos can, nye sbas, dhi ti ka, nag po, legs mthong chen po ste bdun/
sprod len/ las byed gsar rnying phan tshun spyi dngos gtad len byed/
1) blo gtad sa/ 2) dngos po sprod sa/ 3) mda' dang me mda' sogs kha gtad sa/

bka' gdams pa gong ma'i thud bcud phugs nor bcu'i nang gses shig ste, blo phugs chos la gtad, chos phugs sprang la gtad, sprang phugs shi la gtad, shi phugs grog po skam po la gtad ces pa'i gtad sa bzhi'o/
blo rtse gtad yul dang cha 'jog sa/ gtad so med pa'i mi/ dmigs pa gtad so/

1) dus gnas skabs tsam min pa/ nam zhag gtan du mig ltos yar lta byed/ gtan du 'tsho zhing gzhes, gtan du bde ba thob/ 2) rtsa ba'am nam yang/ gtan nas med/ 'gog thabs gtan nas med pa/ mthun thabs gtan nas mi byed pa/ snga ma dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba/
bka' shog gtan tshigs dang khra ma'i bsdus tshig / srid gzhung gi gtan khra yig rigs/
dge bsnyen dang dge tshul sogs rang rang gi cho ga la brten nas sdom pa blangs te, de dag gi sdom khrims ji srid 'tsho'i bar gtan du srung ba'i khrims/
thag chod pa'i don/ byed phyogs gtan 'khel ba/ 'gro lam gtan 'khel/ dus tshod gtan 'khel/
phugs 'khyol/ las ka 'go brtsams nas mjug ma tshar bar 'bad brtson gtan 'khyol snyug bsring byed dgos/
phugs kyi don/ las don gang zhig sgrub kyang gtan gyi don la bsam blo gtong dgos/
phugs kyi byus sam re 'dun/ gtan gyi 'dun ma grub pa/
phugs don gyi bsam blo/ mi so so'i gtan gyi bsam blo gtong stangs mi 'dra ba red/ gtan grogs, tshe gang gi mdza' grogs sam bza' zla/
'u lag dus rtag par las la bkol ba'i 'u lag /
gtan phebs sam, rgyun du gnas pa/ khug kyog gi yul gru so sor gtan chags sdod pa'i mi/ gnas yul gtan chags/ gtan 'jags, rgyun du gnas pa/ sngar bzhin gtan 'jags su gnas yod/
dus rgyun du mi tshang nges can zhig nas las gla blangs te g.yog rgyug dgos mkhan/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs: gzhung sger gyi dngos zog skyel 'dren nam dgos dus de 'phral rta khal skul 'ded chog pa'i rgyun gtan lag 'khyer bka' shog /
rtag pa dang brtan pa/ 'gyur med gtan du ba/
rgyun du rtag sdod/ grong khyer nang du gtan sdod kyi mi 'bor/
dus yun du gnas shing mi yal ba/ mi dmangs kyi dpa' bo'i snyan grags gtan gnas mi nub/
/ 1) sgo'i nang ngos nas gnon byed a shing/ sgo'i gtan pa rgyob/ 2) sngar gyi khrims chas shig /
gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin
rgyun chad med pa'i mchod sbyin rgya chen po/
gtan pa med pa'i sbyin pa
slong ba pa la rgyun ma chad par phangs pa med par sbyin pa ste, sgo la gtan pa med par gtong ba rgya chen po'i sgo 'phar phye ba'o/
med pa'i mchod sbyin: drin gsob yong snyam pa'i bsam blo med pa'i mchod sbyin/
gtan la phebs pa dang don gcig
sgo gnon te sgo 'phul mi thub pa byed pa'i yo byad/
lo ltar gtan 'jags su sprod len byed pa'i bogs ma/
phugs 'pher thag gcod/ gsar du gtan 'bebs byas pa/ 'char gzhi 'di da res tshogs chen thog gtan 'bebs byung ba zhig red/
phugs sam, yun ring/ nam phugs gtan ma'i 'tsho thabs/
rtsa ba nas med pa/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gi lam lugs gtan med bzos pa/ dgra bo gtan med du btang ba/
rtags te gsal ba la mi 'jug pa ste, gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs sam mi mthun phyogs gang rung dang, gnyis ka la gtan nas med pa'o/
'bebs byed kyi tshig ste: rgyu mtshan ston pa'i ngag gtan tshigs kyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig /
1) don gtan la 'bebs byed kyi tshig phreng gi tshigs sam dum bu ste, sgrub byed dang, rgyu mtshan no/ 2) gzhung dam 'khod pa'i bka' shog gi yi ge khungs btsan/
gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can

ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang don gnyis byed las kyi sgo nas phan tshun ha lam mtshungs kyang, mi 'dra ba'i gtan tshigs sam, rgyu mtshan gcig gi sgo nas so sor ldog pa'i rgyan/
dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i 'gor bod srid skyong karma bstan skyong dbang pos 'degs gshor gyi dngos po 'jal byed tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs bzos pa'i 'bo dang rgya ma rnams kyi ming/

dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rtags sam rgyu mtshan chen po lnga ste, gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs dang, rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs dang, yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs dang, mu bzhi skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs dang, rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs bcas lnga'o/
tshul gsum ma tshang ba ste, 'gal ma nges ma grub gsum gang rung gi skyon dang ldan pa'i rtags, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra rtag par bsgrub pa lta bu'o/
'gal ba'i gtan tshigs dang, ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs dang, ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs te gsum mo/

gtan tshigs kyi thigs pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes pa, phyogs chos dang khyab pa spyir gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhung, slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun las 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi'i gras shig /
dam bcas pa'i tshig snga mar rgyu mtshan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra zhig / me yod de du ba yod pa'i phyir/
sgrub byed kyi rtags yang dag /
rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ya gyal, don gyi 'khrul ba tshar gcod par byed pa tshad ma rig pa'o/
yul lkog gyur 'jal byed rjes dpag gi gzhi'am rten du gyur pa'i rtags kyi rigs pa'o/
bka' shog gi 'char gzhi'am zin bris/
'bras bu'i rtags dang, rang bzhin gyi rtags dang, ma dmigs pa'i rtags te gsum mo/
tshe gang sdod dgos pa'i g.yog po
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi bcu gnyis pa chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid rgyas par ston pa, dper na, chos mngon pa'i sde snod lta bu/
bstan pa'i sde: gtan la phab pa'i sde dang don gcig
thag bcad de chod pa/ tshong khrom gyi nyo thang tshang ma nyag srang tshad mas gtan la phebs pa/
gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba
'phags pa thod med kyis mdzad pa'i sems tsam pa'i gzhung sa sde lnga'am rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa'i ya gyal zhig /
thag gcod pa/ dpyad bdar gyis gtan la 'bebs pa/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don gang yin khyad par 'byed dka' yang, rgyu mtshan gyi nges tshig yang dag sgo nas ma nor bar so sor nges pa rnyed pa'i rgyan zhig
dus nam yang yag po/ gtan legs kyi bya ba/

/ 1) brjod pa'am skad cha/ snying gtam/ gsang gtam/ blun gtam/ tshod gtam/ dpyad gtam/ gtam sngog pa/ gzhan gyi gtam la rna ba gtad de nyon/ bu skyes pa la ming, chang drangs pa la gtam/ mi rnams thams cad phyug po'i bu la dga', gtam rnams thams cad 'dod pa'i phyogs su 'gro/ pho rog sha khyer lung pa'i phu dang, sprang po gtam khyer lung pa'i mda'/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam/ 2) ming grad/ ro sa 'og tu song yang, gtam sa steng du sdod/
1) bang chen nam pho nya/ 2) nang gtam phyi la shod pa/
skad cha khungs med/ rgyu mtshan 'di yin shod rgyu med pa'i gtam 'khyams la yid ches mi rung/
gcig nas gcig tu mched pa'i skad cha'am, khungs med kyi gtam/
skad cha'i 'byung gzhi/ gtam gyi dngos po, gtam gyi don/ gtam gyi dngos po las don byung ba/
gtam rna bar 'jebs la don dang ldan pa bdud rtsi 'dra ba/

1) khengs dregs kyi skad cha rtsing po/ nga rgyal gyis rgyud brlams te gtam gyong po sha stag shod/ 2) gnya' mi chag pa'i skad cha/ kho la sdigs stangs ji ltar byas kyang da dung gtam gyong po kho na shod kyi 'dug /
'phros mol/ dga' spro'i gtam gleng byung ba/
smra lce bde po/ phru gu de gtam mgyogs por shod thub mkhan zhig red/
mtha' skyel dgos pa'i gtam dpe:/ las don byed sgo gang yod gtam 'go las mjug mtha' 'khyongs byed dgos/
phan tshun gleng gtam 'dum pa/ phan tshun rtsod gleng gi gtam 'grig pa'i chod don bzhag song/
rtsod gleng brgyab nas rgyal kha thob pa/ khrims sar kha mchu rtsod res byas nas gtam rgyal ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha rgyal ba dang, rtsod pa thob pa, shags rgyal ba bcas so,
sngon byung gi lo rgyus bshad rgyun/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud/ rgya mtsho'i gtam rgyud/ bya sprel gtam rgyud/
skad cha bshad pa dang, yig rigs bklags pa/ gsar 'gyur nang du gtam bsgrags pa/
1) skad cha ngan pa/ mi ngan kha nas gtam ngan 'byung/ 2) bkra mi shis pa'i skad cha/ 3) ming ngan pa/
ming ngan chags pa/ tshul min bya spyod byas na gzhan gyi gtam ngan mi kha zug yong/
mdun rgyab mi mthun pa'i skad cha/
1) skad cha ga re thos/ 2) skad cha thos tshad/
don med gang byung gi gtam/
gzhan gyi skad cha shod 'phro phrogs te rang gis shod pa/ gzhan gyis skad cha shod pa'i sgang la gtam lcebs byas nas gros don 'thor rkyen byed/
1) skad cha'i 'phro skyong ma thub par chad pa/ thog mar skad cha mang po bshad nas mjug tu gtam chad pa red/ 2) rjes kyi byed stangs kha dan/ phan tshun rogs res bya rgyu'i gtam chad byed pa/
khungs med kyi gtam/ gtam 'chal bshad na khungs mi 'khyol/
1) skad cha'i mjug ma bshad par rang gis mtshams bcad pa/ 2) gzhan gyi gtam mjug shod du ma bcug par mtshams bcad song/
pa'i skad cha:/ brjod bya'i don dang mi ldan pa'i gtam nyog kho na bshad pa/
rna bar 'gro ba'i tshig gam bkra shis pa'i skad cha/ sha tsha'i kha nas gtam snyan mi thon/ gtam snyan thos na dga' zhing spro ba 'phel/
skad cha shor ba/ ci 'phros mol 'phros kyi zhor la don gnad che rigs kyi gtam thon pa/
skad cha thos pa/ blo la mi 'bab pa'i gtam thos pa tsam gyis zhe 'gras pa/ las don 'grub tshul gyi gtam thos pa/
gtam dang don gnad gcig tu 'dril ba/ gros bsdur byas pa'i snying po gtam don 'dril ba gal che/
rang la gtam snyan yong 'dod/ mi de gtam 'dod chen po zhig yin pas ngo bstod la ha cang dga' po 'dug / yin lugs dngos dang ma 'brel ba'i gtam 'dod shod pa/
skad cha 'dri ba/ bde 'tshams kyi gnas tshul gtam 'dri byed pa/
1) skad cha'i don dag dbye ba ma chod pa/ 2) (rnying) mthun pa'i tshig gis phan tshun smra res byung ba/
skad cha zad pa/ sems la sngangs skrag skyes te kha nas gtam rdugs pa/
skad cha'i tshig mi gsal ba/ mi lce dig gis shod pa'i gtam ldib kyis brda don mi 'phrod/

(tha dad pa) 1) 1, btams pa, btam pa, gtoms,, brjod pa dang, 'chad pa dang, gleng ba/ kha chad btams nas thag bcad pa/ kha mchu btam pa/ 2, gtams pa, gtam pa, gtoms,, gtod pa dang, 'chol ba/ tshong zog bsgo gtam byed pa/ rgyu nor gtam pa/ 2) gzhan du 'chol ba'i don du go ba'i 'dam pa'i ma 'ongs pa,

gyi zlos gar: rab byung bcu bzhi pas rdzogs chen dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi gtam zhig ste, lha chos dang mthun pa'i gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar zhes bya ba brjod bya sngon 'gro'i nyams len gyi rim pa dang, chos dang chos min gyi dbye ba sogs rjod byed tshig bcad lhug spel ma'i snyan ngag gi gtam phal skad go bde ba'i tshig tu bsdebs nas brtsams pa'i gzhung zhig nye char lo ts'a ba kru'u we han mchog gis rgya yig tu bsgyur pa'o/
dgos pa dang bstun pa'i shod tshul 'jam rtsub sogs kyi dpe/
skad cha snga phyi nang 'gal med pa/ bsam 'char gyi gtam 'brel chags pa zhig bshad/ tshig 'jam po'i sgo nas gtam 'brel chags pa zhig bshad pa/
smra lce bde po/ smra lce bde pos bshad pa'i gtam myur drags pas tshig don ha cang gsal po rang go thub kyi mi 'dug /

rgyal blon dang, bla grwa, 'bangs 'khor sogs yul mchog dman bar gsum la rang rang gi ngo skal dang 'tsham par spang blang gi bslab bya rnams tshig bcad lhug ci rigs kyis gtam du byas pa'i gsung skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig
skad cha'i rtsa ba las yan lag mched pa/ zhing las thon skyed kyi gros bsdur byed bzhin du bzo las rgya skyed gtong rgyu'i gtam gzhan 'phro ba/
'phrin nam skad cha yag po/ tshang ma nang gshin bde thang yin lugs kyi gtam bzang thos pa/
gzhan zhig brgyud nas skad cha go bar byed pa/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de gtam rlung la skur ba/ gang byung gis gtam rlung la bskur ba las dngos su bshad pa legs/
skad cha'i lan po/ gtam la gtam lan med na lkugs pa, zas la zas lan med na sprang po/
1) skad char brtag zhib byed pa/ gtam bsher byas nas bden rdzun shes/ 2) gtam 'gran sdur byed pa/
gtam snga phyi 'brel chags po/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyi brjod gtam lhu 'grig po byung song/
(tha dad pa) 1) gtams pa, gtams pa, gtoms,, 'gengs pa/ bang mdzod nor gyis gtams/ 2) gtod pa'i don du go ba'i gtam pa'i 'das pa,
(rnying) brgyab pa'am, brdegs pa'am brdungs pa/
(rnying) 1) chung ngu'i dus nas lang tsho nyams te stobs shugs med pa'i mi/ 2) bu lon yod pa'i mi/
rtsis kyi rim gro'i 'chos thabs shig /
bu lon gyi dmigs rten rin thang ldab ri ba/
lha la 'bul ba'i mchod gtor gyi bye brag cig /
bu lon 'jal rgyu'i dmigs rten dngos po rin can/ rgyan cha gta' mar 'jog pa/ mi gta' mar 'jog pa/
bu lon gyi gta' ma kha chad kyi dus las brgal te bun bdag gis za ba/
bu lon g.yar skabs bzhag pa'i dngos po dngul sprad nas tshur len pa/
khrag rtsa'i gtar dmigs thog tu gtsag bu brdegs nas nad khrag phyir dbyung ba'i thabs shig / nad pa'i lag sor la gtar kha rgyag / gtar ga 'debs/
gtar dmigs nas phyir dbyung ba'i khrag /
(tha dad pa) gtar ba, gtar ba, gtor,, khrag gtsags nas 'don pa/ khrag gtar mkhan sman pa zhig gis nad pa'i mgo la khrag gtar song/
khrag gtar sa'i rtsa dmigs te skra mtshams nas sor bzhi gzhal bas na mtshog gsang dang, gru mo nas sor bzhi gzhal bas na ru thung lta bu'o/
gtsag bu brdegs nas khrag gtar du rung ba'i rtsa ste, nang gses su dbye na rtse chung dang, snod kha, rtsa bo che lta bu bdun cu rtsa bdun mchis so/
gtar dmigs steng gtar ba dang: me btsa'i gsang dmigs steng bsreg pa/
(yul) ba lang gi lci ba brdzis nas rtsig ldebs dang brag rdo sogs kyi thog leb mor sbyar te bskams nas me shing byed pa/
1) blo rgya chung ba/ blo chung gti thug dbang gis bya ba gang yang byed mi phod/ 2) (yul) 1, u tshugs/ 2, ser sna can/
gti mug ma rig pa ste
chos kyi tshul yang dag par ma rtogs pa'am phyin ci log tu rtog pa'i rmongs pa/ gti mug bdo ba/ gti mug mun pa'i khung bur 'jog mi rung/
1) phag gi sna'i gab ming ste, nus pas gnyan nad dang lhog pa'i nad la phan/ 2) (mngon) phag pa/
phag nag po: ma rig pa'i gti mug de phag pa nag po'i gzugs su bkod pa/
so sor brtags pa'i sgo nas don la ma rmongs pa dang nyes pa la mi 'jug par byed pa, dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi ya gyal zhig /
dge ba'i rtsa ba: dmigs med ye shes kyi rtsis zin pa'i dge rtsa/
mchu zla ste hor zla dang po, rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs las gti mug zla ba zer/
ha cang glen zhing lkugs pa/ ci yang mi shes pa'i gti mug ro nyal zhig /
'dod pas sems myos pa'i mi/ 'dod yon la ha cang gti lum pas ngoms dus med/
(tha dad pa) btigs pa, btig pa, gtigs,, chu thigs 'bebs pa/ snod kyi nang du chu btigs song/ khog ltir chus bshal nas chu lhag ma gtig gtig yag po gyis/ mig gi nang du mig sman gtig pa/
gtig pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
zhabs dang mthil/ rgya mtsho gting ring/ mi gting che ba/ kha dkar gting nag / gting dpag dka' ba/ ri rab rtse yi nyi zla, rgya mtsho'i gting gi nor bu/
klo yul dbus sam, mthil du gnas pa'i klo pa/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud na yod, rdzong de'i lho ngos bal po dang sa 'brel dang shar lho 'bras ljongs dang sa 'brel yin/
blo rgod tshig 'jam/ mi gting gyong kha 'jam la dogs zon byed dgos/
1) mi blo sgam pa/ 2) chu gting zab pa/
1) gting thung ba/ 2) blo sems mthun pa/
don gnad kyi mthil lon pa/ dngos yod kyi gnas lugs gang yin gting rtogs nges shes rnyed pa/

zab pa'i tshad dang rgya khyon gyi tshad/ rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dpag dka' ba/ shes bya gting mtha' tshad las 'das/ grangs tshad kyi gting mtha' mtha' yas pa/ 'khor ba'i gting mtha' shes dka' ba/ bya las kyi gting mtha' mi mngon pa/
don gnad kyi tshod len pa/ phyogs so so'i bsam tshul gyi gting don len shes byed pa/
'og khung du rdib pa/ mig gting la rdib/

1) rlung dang rba rlabs kyis mi g.yo ba'i ched du gru gzings kyi 'og tu btags nas thur du 'then par byed pa'i rdo/ led na thar ba'i gru gzings lus 'di yin, nyes na 'khor ba'i gting rdo lus 'di yin/ 2) nya 'dzin dra ba'i mas kyi rdo/
sems ngan la kha rtsub pa/ mi gting gnag kha tsha phan tshun bar la mthun sgril ga nas yong srid/
/ gting dpag dka' ba'i don blos dpog par mi nus/
go don gyi gnad rtogs pa/ gros bsdur bya rgyu'i don gnad kyi gting phigs song/
1) zab pa'am sbug thag ring po/ ri'i khog pa brus pa'i sa sbubs gting phug ring po/ 2) rtogs dka' ba'i don/ dpe cha'i tshig don gting phug ring po/
don gnad mthar phyin pa/ gros bsdur gting phyin pa zhig byas pa/
gting du nub pa/ ko gru ha cang ljid che na gting bying gi nyen kha yod/
tshod ma thig pa/ gnas lugs ngo ma gang yin gting ma chod na gros thag gcod thal byed mi rung/
1) gting shin tu zab pa'am, gting mi mngon pa/ rgya mtsho'i klong bzhin blo gros shin tu zab yangs gting med pa/ 2) gting ha cang thung ba/ rdzing chung gting med la rkyal rgyag mi thub/
gzhi'am phugs/ pha rol po'i bya spyod bzang ngan gyi gting rtsa rtogs thub kyi red/
1) rtsa ba tshugs pa/ las don rmang gzhi gting tshugs pa zhig byed pa/ 2) mthil phyin pa/ go ba gting tshugs pa zhig rnyed thabs byed pa/
gting dpag pa'am gting tshod len pa/
gting ring po/ rgya mtsho gting zab/ tshig don rgya che gting zab/
phugs sam tshad dpog dka' ba/ 'phral du thag gcod dka' ba'i rtsod gzhi mgo rnyog la gting ring ba zhig 'dug /
(tha dad pa) gtibs pa, gtib pa, gtibs,, dkrig pa'am 'thibs par byed pa/ nam mkhar sprin gtibs/ sa gzhir mun pa gtibs/ smug pa gtibs nas mig lam bsgribs pa/
sogs bzo byed bu ga che chung sna tshogs yod: pa'i lcags leb
bzi ba/ chang gis bzi nas gtu lum chags/ ngar ma'i myos byed btungs na gtu lum 'gyur/

(tha dad pa) gtugs pa, gtug pa, gtugs,,1) reg pa dang, thug par byed pa/ grogs po rnams rtag gtug byed kyi 'dug / mgo gtugs pa/ dpung gtugs lag 'dzing/ mtha' la gtugs pa/ 2) mjal ba dang, bsten pa/ ngo gtugs pa/ dge rgan gyi zhabs la gtugs pa/ 3) 'gran pa/ pho rgod zhan dgra dang gtugs na shes/ 4) gyod gzhi gong rim la thag gcod par zhu ba/ snyan zhu zhu gtugs/ nyes can khrims khang la gtugs pa/ khrims la gtug /
khrims gtugs kyis bden rdzun sbyangs bsher byed pa/
1) khrims la gtug mkhan/ 2) phan tshun gtug mkhan/
gyod gzhi sogs gong rim la thag gcod par zhu ba'i bya spyod/ khrims sar gtug bsher byas nas bden rdzun dbye 'byed byed/
1. gtug pa'i 'das pa, 2. (tha mi dad pa) 'dzad pa dang, 'dzangs pa, klas pa/ dngul lag gtugs pa/ kha tsha dgos gtugs/ nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa/
/ 1) gtun yas mas spyi ming/ rdo gtun/ lcags gtun/ shing gtun/ sgog gtun/ khrog sman gtun gyis rdung ba/ rus pa gtun rdung byed/ 2) (yul) mas gtun/
sha rus sogs rdzog snod kong po/
/ 1) mas gtun chung ngu/ 2) (yul) yas gtun/
(tha dad pa) gtubs pa, gtub pa, gtubs,, dum bur gcod pa/ sha gtub pa/ shing dum bur gtubs nas me la 'bud/ ras gtubs te gyon pa 'tshems/
sha sogs dum bur gtub byed lag cha/
'jigs su rung ba'i tshul/ rang phyogs la zhi zhing des la, dgra bor gtum rngam chen po 'dug /
1) shin tu ma rungs pa/ 2) dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
1. (tha dad pa) btums pa, gtum pa, thums,/ mgo bo gos kyis btums te bsdad 'dug / dngul thum bur thums shig / shing sgam ko bas gtum dgos/ 2. gtum po dang 'dra,
khro bo'am drag po/ khyed rang thugs gtum po 'dug / khro zhing gtum la snying rje med/ gtum zhing rgod pa/ tshig gtum po mnyan du mi 'os pa/
phyag drug pa: mgon po sogs lha khro bo/
sngar shakya mu ne zhal bzhugs skabs rgya gar ka tya rgyal po zhes shin tu rgyud gtum pa zhig yod pa mthar bcom ldan 'das kyis btul nas bzang por gyur pa/
/ 1) bud med khro mo/ 2) lus kyi rtsa'i bye grag cig / 3) lha mo u ma/ 4) gtum mo'i me'i bsdus ming,
lte ba'i gtum mo'i me sbar nas spyi bo'i a: thung las zhu bde'i byang sems 'dzag pa

(tsantalii) rdzogs rim gyi rtsa ba'i chos shi ste, rtsa rlung thig le gnad du bsnun pas lte ba'i a thung las bde drod sbar bas phung khams ma dag pa rnams sreg cing nyon mongs rnam rtog thams cad 'joms pa gtum pa'i las byed cing, lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes myur du skyed par byed pa'o/
gtum pa'i 'das pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
dra phad lta bu'i dngos po 'jug snod/

(tha dad pa) 1) dud pa gtong ba dang, 'thul bar byed pa/ spos ring sbar nas du ba gtul/ 2) phye ma'i rigs cung zad re dngos rdzas gzhan gyi thog tu gtor ba/ rma thog la sman phye gtul/ ja khar rtsam pa gtul/
/ 1) nyes can gtso bo/ 2) mi gzugs po thung ngu/ gte po'i nang gi gzugs bzang/ 3) (rnying) 'go pa, rje bo/
bu lon 'jal rgyu'i dmigs rten du bzhag pa'i dngos rigs/ bu lon gyi gte bar khang pa 'jog pa/ gte bar 'dzud/
(yul) gta' ma ste bu lon gyi dmigs rten/ bu lon g.yar na sprad rten gte ma 'jog /
bu lon sprad nas gteng pa tshur len/

/ 1) mdzod/ chu gter/ zab gter/ lcags gter/ 'bru gter/ yon tan gyi gter/ chos gter/ 2) gter chos kyi bsdus ming,3) (mngon) gter la pad ma can dang, dung can, pad ma chen po, chu srin can, rus sbal can, rnga can, dga' ba can, sngon po, 'dzin byed ces dgu yod pas grangs ka dgu mtshon/
lcags dang rdo sol sogs sngog 'don byed sa'i khungs/ lcags gter/ rdo sol gter kha/ gter kha sngog 'don/ gter kha 'byed pa/ gter kha btsal 'tshol/
gter kha yod sa'i sa khul/
1) mi mngon pa'i gnas nas chos 'don mkhan gter ston chen po/ 2) gter kha chen po/ 3) grangs gnas shig /
dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bum pa bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig rin po che 'dzad pa med pa'i rtags mtshon byed/

gter nas gdan drangs pa'i chos te, slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs kyis 'gro don dus la ma bab par ston du mi rung zhing ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi don du ri brag chu shing sogs su re zhig mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya dang bcas mi mngon par rgyas btab pa'i gsang sngags kyi gdam zab rnams phyis grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis gter nas bton te yi ger phab pa'i yang zab bla na med pa'i chos skor/ gter lta bu'i sems bskyed, sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, sa dang po ba'i rgyud kyi sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod kyis sems can thams cad tshim par byed kyang mi zad pas na gter chen po lta bu'o/
mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can dang, gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug ste, gter ston 'di gnyis ni rnying ma'i gter ston gyi nang nas ha cang skad grags che ba gnyis red/
1) gter gyi bka' srung ngam gnyer du gtad pa'i gter rnams srung ba'i lha/ 2) gter kha'i bdag po/ 3) (mngon) rnam thos sras/

mtshan dngos padma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje zer, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me khyi lor grwa nang dar rgyas chos gling du 'khrungs, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug lor o rgyan smin grol gling gi dgon pa btab, gsung chos glegs bam bcu gsum tsam yod, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta lor 'das/
bzhu btul byed rin yod pa'i rdo/
1) gter kha yod sa/ 2) nor gyi bang mdzod/
gter nas blangs pa'i chos sam nor/
kyi tshig mtshams su bris pa'i tsheg ril nyis: brtsegs bar du 'phred bcad can
1) nor mdzod/ 2) rin chen gter mdzod kyi bsdus ming,
1) gter nor/ 2) g.yang rdzas/ 3) gces nyar byed pa'i nor rigs rtsa chen/
gter kha srung mkhan srung ma/
gto bcos kyi glud rdzongs gnod phyogs gang yin la skyel ba/
rim gro'i sgo nas rkyen sel gyi bcos thabs/
(yul) bstan bshig tsha po/ mi de su dang mi 'dra ba'i gto bcos tsha po zhig yod/
gto bcos la brten pa'i bcos thabs/
(tha dad pa) gtogs pa, gtog pa, gtogs,/ se gol gtogs pa'i sgras brda btang/ rkan sgra gtog pa/
1) (mngon) lha dbang phyug chen po/ 2) (rnying) gzhan nor 'phrog 'dod pa/
1. gtog pa'i 'das pa, 2. (tha mi dad pa) the ba'am 'du ba/ khongs su gtogs pa/ ma gtogs pa/ jus med jus gtogs/ 3. (rnying) phrogs pa/
1) 'gro song/ 2) gtong yul nges pa can la 'char can zang zing gi rgyun gtong ba'i byed sgo/ sngar dge bshes kyi ming btags byed ched du nges par gtong sgo rgya chen po zhig gtong dgos pa/
dgon sde khag gi nang du gtong sgo gtong skabs su bshams pa'i mchod rdzas/
kha lo sgyur ba/ 'phrul 'khor gtong 'then byed pa/
ster sbyin gyi snying stobs/ gtong phod can/ lus srog blos gtong phod pa/
zas nor ster sbyin gyi snying stobs chung chung/

1) (tha dad pa) btang ba, gtang ba, thong,,1) ster ba'am byin pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ 'gro song gtang ba/ bu lon btang ba/ 2) 'dor ba/ rang srog blos btang/ 3) glod pa/ ra lug rtswa khar btang ba/ brtson pa btang ba/ tshe thar gtong ba/ zhing chu gtong ba/ thab la me gtong ba/ 4) rgyag pa/ glud gtong/ 5) mngags pa/ dmag mi gtong ba/ lan gtong ba/ brda gtong ba/ 6) kha lo sgyur ba/ ko gru gtong ba/ gnam gru gtong ba/ rta gtong ba/ 7) byed pa/ slob gso gtong ba/ bsam blo gtong ba/ 2. sbyin pa/
gtong ba rjes su dran pa
rjes su dran pa drug gi nang gses, sbyin pa'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'o/
gtong ba rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, kun rdzob tu chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa'i yon tan rim ldan du dran pa'o/
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses, zang zing gi dngos po sogs gzhan la sbyin pa ste, bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen 'grub pas glang po rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
skad rta 'then pa'i gdangs ring po/
phar gtong gi 'gro sgo dang, tshur len gyi yong sgo/ rgyu nor bed spyod mkhas po byas na gtong yong 'go thug rgyu nges can red/
nor phar sprod tshur len 'go gtug pa/ 'gro song gtong tshod ran po byas na gtong yong kha 'thab nges par thub kyi red/ lo re'i gtong yong kha 'thab dang mi 'thab ci rigs yong srid/
sprod len byung song kha 'thab pa'i lhag ma/ khe las khag gi gtong yong 'khrol 'khyil gang mang byung ba/

1) yong sgo dang 'gro sgo gnyis rtsis 'go mi thug pa/ byung song he bag che drags pas gtong yong ga 'dzol byung ba red/ 2) tshur yong sgo nyung la phar gtong sgo mang ba/ 'bab khungs nyung la 'char 'phar 'gro khungs ha cang mang bas gtong yong ga 'dzol du gyur pa red/
sprod len byung song kha 'thab tu phyin pa/ lo re'i gtong yong 'go snyoms pa las, 'phar chag hang song che ba yong gi med/
phar gtong rgyu dang tshur yong rgyu'i rtsis khra/

(tha dad pa) 1. btod pa, gtod pa, gtod,, gsar bzo'am gsar 'dzugs/ srol bzang khag mang sngar med gsar du gtod pa/ 2. gtad pa, gtad pa, gtod,,1) bcol ba dang, sprod pa/ blo snying brang gsum gtod pa/ las 'gan 'di nga la gtad chog / ca lag de dag kho rang gi lag par gtad pa yin/ 'dod pa can la nor ma ston, ngan sems can la blo ma gtad/ 2) kha bstan pa/ mda' 'ben la gtad nas 'phen pa/ khang pa'i rgyal sgo lho phyogs su gtad/ rkyang lho la shi yang mgo byang la gtad yong/ 3) sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/ rna ba gtad nas nyon/ mig gtad nas dpe char lta/ dmigs rten la sems gtad pa/
gtam pa dang gtams pa'i skul tshig
'thor brlag gi skyon/ gnas khang yo byad sogs gtor skyon byung ba/ khrims lugs gtor skyon tshabs chen byed pa/

/ sngags pas dgra bgegs la gtor rgyag rgyag gin 'dug /

gtor ma'i steng du 'dzugs rgyu'i dar/
gtor ma'i steng du 'dzugs rgyu'i gdugs/

/ 1) mchod chas sogs yo byad tsag tsig blug snod/ 2) chos gos rnam gsum 'jog sa'i snod/

cha'am rgyus dang, gdeng, nges pa/

tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'thag pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
1.1) tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'thag pa'i 'das pa, 2) 'dogs pa'i 'das pa, 2.rdzas med rdzas su grub par smra ba/ 3.(rnying) 1) khrims bsgrags pa/ 2) phal pa/
/ 1) (yul) 'thag chas 'thag sha/ 2) thags grub kyi gos dar sogs/
ming 'dogs tshul gyi bye brag cig ste, 'dra 'brel gang rung gi rgyu mtshan la brten nas rjes grub tu brda sbyar nas btags pa'i ming, dper na, mi blun po la ba lang zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/
rang 'dzin sgra dang rtog pas btags pa tsam du grub pa'i chos, dus dang, gang zag lta bu ldan min 'du byed dang, kun btags kyi chos rnams so/
ming gi btags pa tsam du yod pa'i mtshon bya'i chos gsum ste, mtshon bya yin pa, rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa, rang gi mtshan nyid las gzhan pa'i mtshon bya mi byed pa bcas gsum mo/

gang du btang sa la 'gro zhing, gang du bzhag sa la sdod pa'i kha lo sgyur bde ba/ btang 'gro bzhag sdod mi shes pa/ las don gang zhig yin kyang theg pa khur len btang 'gro bzhag sdod 'pher ba zhig byed thub/ btang 'gro bzhag sdod gang 'os kyi las khur dang len zhu ba/

1) dgra gnyen bde sdug chags sdang sogs kyi phyogs su ma lhung ba'i bar ma/ 2) dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi ya gyal zhig ste, lus dang sems la gnod par byed pa med pas 'bral 'dod kyang med, lus dang sems la lhag par bde zhing phan par byed pa yang med pas 'grogs pa'am phrad par 'dod pa yang med do/ 3) tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i nang gses, sems can rnams la nye ring med par snyoms pa ste, chags sdang gi gnyen po'o/
rnam par mi rtog par skye ba dang, phan gnod med par skye ba'i bar ma'i tshor ba'o/
1) do snang med pa'i 'du shes/ 2) chags sdang gnyis ka bral ba'i blo/
tshad med bzhi'i ya gyal, dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms ngang la gnas par bya'o snyam du sems pa'o/

byang chub yan lag byang chub yan lag bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, sems nyon mongs pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i mi mnyam pa dang rnal du mi 'dug pa dang, rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs kyi gnyen po byed pa zhig /

phyi nas 'thum par byed rgyu'i rgya/ yig 'phrin khag la shog bu dang, ras kyi btums rgya byas nas phyogs su skur/

/ 1) phyugs kyi bye brag cig / gyi ling rta/ zing rta/ rta zhon pa/ rta rgyab la sgal rma ma bzos na, sga shing la rma bzo dogs med/ ming gi rnam grangs la skal ldan dang, mgyogs 'gro, rgya mtsho skyes, rgyab 'dzin, rnga yab mjug ma can, rngog ma can, rtag tu za, 'dren byed, rnam par gnon, dpal gyi bu, bang ldan, blo gsal, myur 'gro, rmig pa can, rlung gi shing rta, rlung las skyes, gser ldan bcas so, 2) skad kyi dbyangs gdangs/ dbyangs rta/ glu rta/ 3) sman 'ded byed kyi btung ba/ sman rta chang la byed/ 4) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / shing rta/ 5) dor ma'i rta/ rta yod/ rta med/ 6) (mngon) nyi ma la rlung dang, yid mgyogs, mdog lnga pa, thig le can, nges brjod, shin tu rgyal mtshan, ri 'joms te rta bdun yod pas grangs bdun mtshon/
