rta zhon pa'i mi tshogs kyi gral phreng
rnam thar gtong ba'i dbyangs ring ba/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gting skyes rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 3375 yod/
lo skor gyi nang tshan rta yi lo/
1) dpyi rus kyi sha/ 2) rta'i sha/
1) rta'i spu shad byed lag cha/ 2) rta zhon bang chen rta rkyang mi rkyang 'gro mkhan/
mi hreng dang khal ma sogs 'grul rogs med par shar rgyag 'gro ba'i rta pa/
(yul) thun mong du bdag pa'i rta/
(yul) rta sga med du bzhon nas rkub la bzos pa'i rma/
1) rta'i so/ 2) ri ldebs su yod pa'i dgon pa sogs kyi lcags ri thur du bang rim byas nas khrid pa'i dbyibs/
shel ka ra'i bye brag cig /
rta'i kha lo sgyur byed srab/
sga brgyab ma thag pa'i rta na chung/
skul lcag la ma bltos par rang bzhin gyis mgyogs por 'gro ba'i rta/
rta rgyud spel phyir bya ma byas pa'am 'bras bu ma phyung ba'i rta/
rta rgod ma la pho rta sbyor ba/ rta skye 'phel gyi ched du rta gseb gtong dgos/
skul lcag la ma bltos par rang bzhin gyis mgyogs por 'gro ba'i rta/
tshur rta yis bsu ba dang, phar mdzub brdas skyel ba ste bsu skyel gyi bya ba mi mthun pa/ mgron rigs la rta bsu mdzub skyel min par dga' bsu dga' skyel babs 'brel lugs mthun byed dgos/
ba'am 'pher ba:/ mi hrag rta hrag brgya phrag bcas song/
'drog mgo med pa'i rta brling po/
rgyun mi 'chad par skyong thub pa/
rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus/ rtag 'grus kyi nus shugs 'don pa/
sgra gcan skyes skar steng nas kha nub tu phyogs te g.yas bskor gyis skar khyim spyod cing, de'i tshe rtag longs la rkang pa'i 'phel 'grib med pas rtag 'gros can du grags/

can gyi bdag mi 'jig pa'i rtag pa dang: cha med pa'i gcig pu, tshugs thub tu grub pa'i rang dbang can du 'dzin pa ste sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i grub mtha' smra ba zhig gis 'dod pa'i gang zag gi bdag /
bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i rtag lta dang gtan med du 'dod pa'i chad lta gnyis/
rgyun gtan bar mi 'chad pa/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par slob sbyong byed/
byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi slob ma zhig
phar tshur thug 'phrad:/ dga' po nye po dang phan tshun rtag gtug byed/
rgyun gtor te dus rgyun du 'jog pa'i gtor ma/
rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma ste, nam mkha' sogs dngos med kyi chos rnams rtag pa la rtag par nges pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/
bden grub kyis rtag par lta ba/

1./ 1) rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed cing 'pho 'gyur med pa, nam mkha' lta bu'o/ 2) mnyam nyid/ 2. brtan pa dang, 'gyur ba med pa, rgyun du mi nyams pa'am, rgyun mi 'chad pa/ dgun dus rtag par nyi ma 'char rgyu yod/
rnam pa thams cad kyi rtag pa dang, re 'ga' ba'i rtag pa gnyis/
'gyur ldog med pa'i rang bzhin:/ bsgyur bcos mi thub pa'i rtag pa ther zug gi dngos po gang yang med/
rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha'
med pa la yod par 'dzin pa rtag pa'i mtha' dang, yod pa la med par 'dzin pa chad pa'i mtha'/
nam mkha' dang, 'gog pa gnyis, de bzhin nyid bcas bzhi/
'gog pa gnyis dang, nam mkha' bcas gsum/
chos rnams rang ngos nas bden par grub par lta ba/

tshes nyer dgu'i phyi char bkra shis dang, gnam stong snga char rkang bzhi'am bzhi mdo, gnam stong phyi char byed pa klu, tshes gcig snga char mi sdug pa ste, 'di rnams rtag tu nges pas na rtag pa'i byed pa zhes bya'o/
sngon rgya gar du byung ba'i grangs can pa dang, tshangs pa ba, khyab 'jug pa, dpyod pa ba, dbang phyug pa, bye brag pa, rig pa can pa, gcer bu pa bcas kyi grub mtha'/
dus dang rnam pa kun tu/
rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas ris shig /
sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i grangs can pa dang, dbang phyug pa, khyab 'jug pa, gcer bu pa bcas bzhi'i spyi ming/
(mngon) 1) lha dbang phyug / 2) sangs rgyas/ 3) spyan ras gzigs/
rtag pa'i longs spyod de, gza' rnams kyi zhag gsum longs spyod der rtag tu nges pas na rtag longs zhes brjod/

/ 1) mtshon byed/ ming rtags/ rgyal rtags/ glen rtags/ rang rtags/ 'chi rtags/ zhing la sa rtags btsugs/ mtshal rtags brgyab pa/ 2) gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan te, byas pa'i rtad kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa na, byas pa rtags su bkod pa'am rgyu mtshan du bkod pa lta bu'o/ rtags gsal btang yang rtags ma grub/ ming gi rnam grangs la de sgrub kyi sgrub pa'i chos dang, phyogs kyi chos, sgrub byed, gtan tshid, rgyu mtshan rnams so, 3) rgya/ bka' shog la phyag rtags phab pa/ lug gi rna rtags/ nor gyi rwa rtags/ 4) pho mo'i mtshan ma/ pho rtags/ mo rtad/

ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, rtags kyi ngo bo mi srid nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, skyes bu 'di chos can, bdag dang bcas pa yin te, bdag gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed rang nyid shes bya la mi srid pa ste gzhi ma grub pa'o/
sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'jug tshul te gang la 'jug pa dang, gang gis 'jug pa, ji ltar 'jug pa, ci phyir 'jug pa rnams kyi don gsal ba'i bstan bcos thu mi sam bho tas brtsams pa de yin/
drang don gyi rdor dril lam, mtshan ma'i rdor dril/

chos can la ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, rtags kyi phyogs gcig chos can la mi srid nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes chos can, mngon sum yin te, rtog bral ma 'khrul ba yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu zla ba gnyis snang la rtog bral grub kyang ma 'khrul ba ma grub pa'o/
rang gi dam bca' sgrub 'dod kyi bsam pas gzhan la rtags chos don gsum dngos su sbyor ba'i ngag /
rtags kho na ma grub pa
thal 'gyur la bkod tshod kyi sgo nas rtags kho na ma grub pa, dper na, sangs rgyas pa'i ngor, sgra chos can, ma byas pa yin par thal, rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu/

khas blangs kyis grub pa: sgra mig shes kyi gzung bya dang mig shes kyi gzung bya la rtag pas khyab par khas len pa'i gang zag gi ngor, sgra chos can, rtag pa yin par thal, mig shes kyi gzung bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes bkod pa lta bu/
rtags khyab gnyis ka grub pa
thal 'gyur dgod yul gyi blo ngor, tshad ma'am khas blangs kyis rtags khyab gnyis ka grub pa'o/
rtags khyab gnyis ka grub pa'i thal 'gyur bzhi

rtags khyab gnyis ka tshad mas grub pa dang, rtags khyab gnyis ka khas blangs kyis grub pa dang, rtags tshad mas grub cing khyab pa khas blangs kyis grub pa dang, khyab pa tshad mas grub cing rtags khas blangs kyis grub pa'i thal 'gyur te bzhi'o/
rtags khyab gnyis ka ma grub pa

thal 'gyur la bkod tshod kyi sgo nas rtags gsal gnyis ka ma grub pa, dper na, sangs rgyas pa la 'phangs pa'i sgra chos can, gzhal bya ma yin par thal, rtag pa yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu/
rtags khyab gnyis ka tshad mas grub pa

sgra chos can, mi rtag pa yin par thal, byas pa yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu, de yang sngar sgra rtag par khas blangs na khyab rtags tshad mas grub cing dam bca' la khas blangs kyi bsal ba 'bab pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag dang, sgra rtag par khas ma blangs na khyab rtags tshad mas grub cing dam bca' la bsal ba med pas rgol ba de la thal 'gyur ltar snang du 'gyur ba'o/
bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi bsdus ming,
1) rum 'thags kyi ri mo'i rnam grangs shig / 2) gos chen gyi bye brag cig /
bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo tshang ba'i ri mo bum pa'i gzugs dbyibs can zhig /
nyin mo bde legs kyi nang gses kha btag legs gras shig /
gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis la zer, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir zhes pa'i sbyor ba la mtshon na, byas pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis so/
ldog pa gcig pas ma grub pa gsum gyi gras, rtags chos tha dad med nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, mi rtag pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
rtags zhes pa sgrub byed dang, chos zhes pa bsgrub bya'i chos dang, don zhes pa bsgrub gzhi'am rtsod gzhi bcas gsum mo/
'gal ba dang, ma nges pa, ma grub pa bcas kyi rtags yang dag min pa gsum mo/
sgrub byed rtags su bkod pa'i shugs sam nus pa/
las gang zhig byas rung de'i rtags sam mtshan ma thon pa/

gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba 'god tshul la cha shas gsum ldan gyi dang po phyogs ni rang gis bsgrub par bya bar 'dod pa bsgrub bya'am phyogs yin pa dang, gnyis pa dpe ni mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i dngos po dpe ru 'jog pa, gsum pa rtags ni rgyu mtshan yang dag pa bkod par brten nas pha rol por dam bcas pa'i don khas len byed du 'jug pa'o/

rtags sam sgrub byed du ma spungs shing, chos can dang, gsal ba re re las med pa, dper na, rnam mkhyen chos can, gzhal bya yin par thal, tshad mas rtod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir, yod pa yin pa'i phyir, gzhi grub pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
rtags kyi sbyor ba'i bsdus ming,
ngo bo mtshon byed kyi mtshan ma/

thal 'gyur ltar snang bzhi'i nang gses, sgrub byed kyi rtags khas blangs sam tshad mas ma grub pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtag par thal, mnyan bya ma yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu gtan tshigs ma grub pas thal lan rtad ma grub ces brjod pa'o/
nang rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mi ldan par phyi dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa'o/
ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad lo lnga brgya phrag bcu'i tha ma lnga brgya phrag gcig la rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam las mi 'byung bar bshad pa de'o/
cing khyab pa khas blangs kyis grub pa: byas na rtag pas khyab pa khas len pa'i gang zag gi ngor, sgra chos can, rtag pa yin par thal, byas pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa lta bu/
rtags dang mtshan ma/ rigs lam khong du chud pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa/

ming gang rung gi mthar sbyar ba'i rjes 'jug des, rang ming gi cha shas su 'dren rgyu'i ming gzhi'i yi ge de, ngag thog nas brjod bde'i dgos pa gtso bor ma byas par rjes 'jug rang dang pho mo ma ning sogs kyi rtags mthun pa'i ming gzhi'i yi ge 'dren tshul te, dper na, sos ka, zhing ga, dbyar kha lta bu'o/ sos ka...ka, zhing ga...ga, dbyar kha...kha...sa nga ra...

rjes dpag gi rgyu, rtad kyi tshul 'dzin pa'i blo ste, tshul gsum dus gcig la dran pa'i blo, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par rtogs kha ma'i gang zag gi rgyud la de sgrub kyi rjes su dpag par bya ba'i gzhi yod pa dang, de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs la yod pa dang, mi mthun phyogs la med par nges pa'i blo skye ba lta bu'o/
phyogs chos 'jal ba'i rtags 'dzin sems dang, khyab pa 'jal ba'i rtags 'dzin sems te gnyis so/

rtags sam gtan tshigs kyi sbyor ba 'god pa na, rgyu mtshan du ma bkod pa'i cha shas sam zur, dper na, bum pa chos can, dngos po'i bye brag yin te, bum pa dngos po yin, bum pa dngos po dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, bum pa ma yin zhing dngos po yin pa du ma grub pa'ang yod pa'i gzhi mthun du dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir zhes rtags zur gsum yod pa lta bu'o/

gsum tshang ba ste: phyogs chos grub cing 'brel ba nges pa, dper na, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la, rtags byas pa rtsod gzhi chos can gyi steng du grub pa dang, gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab pa mthun phyogs la yod pa nyid dang, gang rtag na ma byas pas khyab pa mi mthun phyogs la med pa bcas kyi rjes su 'gro ldog gi 'brel ba nges pa'o/

1) bsgrub bya'i chos kyi sgo nas dbye na, dgag rtags yang dag dang, sgrub rtags yang dag gnyis/ 2) rtad sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na, don sgrub kyi rtags dang, tha snyad sgrub kyi rtags te gnyis/ 3) phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu'i gras kyi rtags yang dag gnyis te, mi mthun phyogs la gtan med mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa dang, mi mthun phyogs la gtan med mthun phyod la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa'o/

1) rtags yang dag la sbyor ba'i sgo nas dbye na, 'bras bu'i rtags dang, rang bzhin gyi rtags dang, ma dmigs pa'i rtad bcas gsum mo/ 2) sgrub byed kyi sgo nas dbye na, dngos stobs kyi rtags dang, grags pa'i rtags dang, yid ches kyi rtags te gsum mo/
rtags rigs kyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
tshad ma'i rigs lam gyi nang nas rtags sam gtan tshigs yang dag dang ltar snang skor gyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i gzhung zhig /

za nas ma grub pa: blo ngor ma grub pa'i rtags gsum gyi ya gyal, rtad de yod med ma nges pa'i rkyen gyis ma grub pa ste, dper na, du ba dang rlangs pa gang yin ma nges pa'i ngor, skya rdzas dang ldan pa'i la la chos can, me yod de, du ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs dang bsgrub bya'i chos/
pa sgo brgyad: rtags gsal phan tshun gyi khyab pa rnal ma bzhi dang, phyin ci log bzhi ste brgyad do/
gtan tshigs rigs pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi bya ba lag len gyi rnam gzhag /
1) rtsod pa'i skabs dbye nas thal ba 'phen pa'o/ 2) mtshan nyid bgro gleng/ yin min bden rdzun gyi skor la rtags gsal ma gtong zhig /
myur ba'i brel zing tshab tshub po/ dgra bo pham nas rtab rtab por bros song/ 'phral du zin dgos pa'i las ka rtab rtab por byed/ rtab rtab pos song nas ji ltar gyur pa'i gtam smras pa/
rtab be rtob be'i bsdus tshig

1. (tha mi dad pa) brtabs pa, brtab pa, ,skrag pa dang, bred pa/ mdun du spyang ki dang, rgyab tu stag mo yod par brtabs pas gom pa gcig kyang yar spo phyir 'then byed mi nus pa/ 2. mgyogs pa dang, brel tshabs che ba/ byi las zin nyer yod stabs byi'u rtab par 'phur song/ skad cha rtab par smra ba/
1) brel zing gi rnam 'gyur/ 'gro 'ong rings pa'i rtab rtob brel zing byed/ 2) 'jigs skrag / blo rtab rtob gyur pa/
rta'i mjing steng du skyes pa'i ze spu/
chol kha gsum gyi nang gses, rma chu'i khug pa man chad mdo smad rta'i chol kha/
sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i phyi rol pa'i lugs kyi thar pa 'thob byed kyi cho ga zhig ste rta stong gis mchos sbyin byed pa lta bu/
rtas nyin gcig la bgrod thub pa'i lam thag /
rta'i mgo la g.yog pa'i mthur mgo/
rta las skyes pa'i rwa co khyad nor du rtsi ba zhig /
bzhon rta bzhon drel gyi kha lo sgyur byed srab/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus khul dang, nyag chu'i stod rgyud du yod/
dud 'gro'i rkang pa'i rting pa dkar po/
dran skul lam skul lcag / las kar rting skul gtong mi dgos pa/
1) rta drel gyi rkang pa'i rmig lcags/ 2) ko lham gyi rting lcags/
(yul) bal gyi rtsa ba'i cha bal ngan
rting pa'i rdog pa:/ lham la rting rdog rgyag pa/
(yul) lham gyi nang sha'i rting pa'i thad kyi kha thum/
/ 1) rtsa ba dang, rmang gzhi/ ka rting/ rtsig pa'i rting pa/ rkang pa'i rting pa/ 2) phyi ma dang rjes ma/ tshig gi rting par don gyis gnon/ 3) sgo phyugs kyi phru gu/ be'u rting/ rte'u rting/
rting pa sa la brtan por tshugs pa/ rkang pa'i rting pa tshud pa byung na 'gyel brdabs mi yong/
rting pa yangs pa'i mtshan bzang
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang tshan zhig ste, 'tsho ba la phan btags pa'am srog bsrungs pa nyid kyis rting pa yangs pa/
ma 'ongs pa/ rting po la bdag sleb yong/
/ 1) rjes ma'am phyi ma/ zla ba rting ma/ zhag rting ma/ 2) mtha' ma/ de ni rang cag mjal thengs rting ma yin/
dmag 'thab kyi rgyal kha len pa/ de byas kyi
nga dpa' bo min pa'i rtags la zhog /
(yul) 1) dkrug byed 'khor lo'i rkang shing gi mar sne gnyis rten sa/ 2) lham gyi rting pa rgyong byed shing/
rjes dang, phyi ma/ dka' ba'i las rnams sngon la tshar na rting sor bya rgyu las sla ba yong/
lham gyi rting pa'i thad kyi mthil lhan/
'gram skyor med pa'i lham gyi ming/
dri chen nam, skyag pa skam po/ rtug 'gags, srin dang thur ser log pa sogs kyi rkyen nas rtug pa ste dri chen mi 'bab par 'gags pa'i don/
'og rlung/ rtug dri kha/ rtug dri gtong ba/ rtug dri ngan po nga min kho yin, spos dri zhim po nga yin kho min/
mi gtsang ba dang, skyag pa/
mi rno ba'am zhan pa'i don du go ba'i rtul ba dang 'dra,
snying stobs che ba/ dpa' mdzangs rtul phod/ rtul phod che ba/

1. (tha dad pa) brtul ba, brtul ba, rtul,,1) mjug sdud pa dang, phyogs gcig tu sdud pa dang, khu sdud pa/ bkram pa'i dngos po rnams phyir rtul ba/ rtsing spyod brtul ba/ 2) 'dul ba/ rta rgod thag sgrog gis bcings te rtul bar byed/ 3) (rnying) rtsol ba dang, 'bad pa/ 2. 1) mi rno ba dang, zhan pa/ brtson 'grus rtul bas las don mi 'grub/ dbang po rtul bas tshig don ji bzhin go mi thub/ mtshon cha rtul bas dgra bo 'joms mi thub/ sman gyi yon tan rtul ba/ sman nus rtul ba/ 2) dpa' ba/ dgra bo thal bar rlog pa'i snying stobs rtul phod dang ldan pa/ 3) (rnying) 'jam pa/
1. rten pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) gzhi'am, gnas sa/ 'tsho rten/ khral rten/ dmag rten/ dmigs rten/ mi'i lus rten/ lha rten/ 2) skyes kyi rten/ skyabs rten/ mjal rten/ zhu rten/
sku gsung thugs rten gyi skal ba/
rten la g.yog rgyu'i dar gos kyi khebs gru bzhi zhig /
sku gsung thugs rten sogs 'jog sa'i mchod khri/
1) rten gsum gnas pa'i khang pa/ 2) 'dre btsan sogs gnas pa'i khang pa/
sku gzugs dang glegs bam mchod rten sogs/
ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brten pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas dpe don gnyis mtshungs kyang, rten sa gnas kyi sgo nas mi 'dra bar so sor ldog pa'i rgyan/
sems gnas pa'i rten byed pa'i dbang po ste, dbang po gzugs can pa lnga dang, yid dbang dang, srog dbang bcas bdun no/
rten gral gyi dbus su bsgrigs pa'i rten 'gangs che ba de'o/
gnas kyi yan lag dang don gcig
rten gnad che ba'am, gtsigs che ba/
(rnying) rol mo mkhan gyi bye brag cig /
sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can/
rten can gyi dbang po gnyis

pho mo so sor rtog pa'i rten can du byed pa'i dbang po ste, pho dbang dang, mo dbang ngo/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba, rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba'am, phan tshun ltos 'jog gi tshul gyis med na mi 'byung ba'i 'brel ba, dper na, sa bon las myu gu dang skye ba las rga shi, pha ri la bltos nas tshu ri lta bu'o/

rang 'bras dbang shes kyi thun mong min pa'i rten nam bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang po, dbang shes yul la dngos su nye bar spyod pa'am dngos su 'jug bzhin pa'i skabs kyi mig rna sna lce lus kyi dbang po rnams so/
sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod pa'i yo chas/
sku gsung thugs kyi rten mthong ba/
lha rten mjal ba, phyag 'tshal ba, mchod me 'bul ba/
1) lus brjes pa/ 2) rtags sam, cha lugs bsgyur ba/
gnas pa dang gnas mkhan te, rten gzhal yas khang dang, brten pa lha lta bu'o/
rten gzhal yas khang dang brten pa yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor/
rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba'i sgra'i nang gses shig / khang pa'i steng gi rgyal mtshan/ gdan steng gi mi/
sku brnyan bzhengs dus thog mar lha bzo bar 'bul ba'i dngos rdzas/
chos skyong sogs kyi phyag mtshan mdung/
1) rten sa'i gnas/ 2) rnam dbye bdun pa/

rten pa'i gzhi dang, brten pa'i chos gnyis so sor 'byed cing, brten pa'i chos gang rten gzhi gang la gnas yod med ston par byed pa'i rnam dbye bdun pa'i la don gyi phrad cig ste, dper na, rgya mtsho'i nang du nya yod, thab na me yod, mig la skyon med lta bu'o/
(tha mi dad pa) brten pa, brten pa, rten,,1) ltos pa/ 'khar rgyug la brten nas ga ler 'gro ba/ rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas 'bras bu byung/ 2) gnas pa/ nya dang sbal lcong chu klung rdzing bur brten/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i bad kan lnga'i ya gyal zhig bad kan gzhan rnams kyi rten gzhi byed cing, byed las chu'i byed las dang 'dra ba/
drug khams bco brgyad kyi nang gses: mig gi dbang po, rna ba'i dbang po, sna'i dbang po, lce'i dbang po, lus kyi dbang po, yid kyi dbang po ste drug /
gzigs rten 'bul ba/ lo ltar rgyal po la rten 'bul zhu dgos/ me tog gi phreng bas dga' bsu'i rten 'bul byed/
rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bsdus tshig

1) snga ltas sam 'byung 'gyur gyi rtags mtshan/ rten 'brel log pa/ rten 'brel 'phyugs pa/ 2) mdzad sgo/ rten 'brel zhu tshig / rten 'brel zhu ba/ lo gsar gyi rten 'brel/ 3) rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bsdus tshig 4) rten 'brel la yan lag bcu gnyis yod pas grangs bcu gnyis mtshon/

gtan tshigs chen po lnga'i nang gses, chos thams cad bden med du sgrub pa'i rigs pa'i rgyal po rten 'brel chen po'i gtan tshigs te, dngos po rnams chos can, bden par ma grub ste, rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi 'gal dmigs kyi rtags so/
rten 'brel bcu gnyis yan lag bzhir bsdus pa'i 'phen pa'i yan lag dang, 'phangs pa'i yan lag mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i yan lag mngon par grub pa'i yan lag bcas bzhi'o/
'phrad pa'i rang bzhin dang, ltos pa'i rang bzhin, brten pa'i rang bzhin te gsum/
ma rig pa la ltos nas 'du byed sogs rten 'brel 'byung bar rigs pa ste ltos grub kyi rigs pa/
bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po ched du spel zhing 'du byas pa/ bkra shis bde legs yong ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa/
1) phyi nang gi rten 'brel gnyis/ 2) 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi rten 'brel gnyis/

nang gi rten 'brel te bcud kyi sems can rnams 'byung ba'i tshul gyi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis te, 'phen pa'i yan lag gsum dang, 'phangs pa'i yan lag bzhi dang, 'grub pa'i yan lag gsum dang, grub pa'i yan lag gnyis bcas bcu gnyis so/
1) ma rig pa 'gag pas 'du byed 'gag 'du: byed 'gag pas rnam shes 'gag pa sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis rim bzhin 'gag pa/ 2) rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi go rim ldog pa/
1) ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 'byung ba dang 'du byed kyis rnam shes sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis go rim bzhin 'byung ba'o/ 2) rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis go rim bzhin 'byung ba/
lus rten dma' ba/ mi las dud 'gro rten dman pa red/
rag las pa'i gnas yul/ mgo nag rten sa spu nag red, spu nag rten sa spang rtswa red/
sku'i rten sangs rgyas kyi gzugs, gsung gi rten chos kyi dpe cha, thugs kyi rten mchod rten bcas gsum mo/
(yul) shing la shur 'don byed kyi 'bur len zhig /
da lo skyes pa'i rte'u/ mi gcig yong na chung nas yong, rta gcig yong na rte'u nas yong/ ming gi rnam grangs la rta phran dang, rta yi bu, rten thur, thu ru bcas so,
skyes nas lo gnyis song ba'i rta'i phru gu/
gtan tshigs la brten nas lkog don smra ba ste rtog pas btags pa'i rig pa/
rang lta mchog 'dzin shas che ba'i rtog ge pa/
phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i rtog ge sde lnga ste, grangs can pa dang, rgyang 'phen pa, bye brag pa, rig pa can pa, gcer bu pa rnams so/
dngos po'i gnas lugs ci bzhin ma mthong bar rtog dpyod kyi rjes su 'brang mkhan gyi rig pa smra ba po/
gtan tshigs rig pa'i bstan bcos/
mtshan nyid pa lta bu rtog dpyod mkhan gyis shes par bya ba'i gnas/

tshad ma'i gzhung gi bstan don brgyad de, mngon sum dang, rjes dpag gnyis po re re la yang dag dang ltar snang gnyis su phye ba'i bzhi ni bdag nyid kyis rig pa'am go bar byed pa'i thabs dang, sgrub ngag dang, sun 'byin gnyis po re re la yang dag dang ltar snang gnyis su phye ba'i bzhi ni gzhan gyis rtogs par byed pa'i thabs bcas shes pa'i char gtogs bzhi dang, rjod byed kyi sgra'i char gtogs bzhi ste brgyad do/
dngos po de kho na nyid don spyi tsam du rtog btags kyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa'i bstan bcos so/
rtog dpyod kyi sa ste bsam gtan dan po'o/
yid kyi 'du shes lta bu bkra bar 'dzin pa/

1. (tha dad pa) brtags pa, brtag pa, rtogs,, rags par dpyod pa/ brgal brtags/ rang skyon la rtog pa/ gnas tshul la legs par brtags pa/ las bya ba'i sngon du ma brtags na, mthar 'gyod pa skyes pas ci la phan/ khyod cag gis rtog par gyis shig / 2. 1) le'u dang skabs/ 2) bsam pa'am rnam rtog / 3) rtog bcas rtog med kyi zlas phye ba'i rtog pa ste, sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dper na bum 'dzin rtog pa lta bu, bum pa'i ming gi cha 'dra blo la snang ba dang, bum pa'i cha 'dra snang ba gnyis ka bum pa'i sgra spyi dang don spyi gnyis po 'dres pa'am 'dres chog chog gi tshul du 'dzin pa ste snang ba'i sgo nas rang yul la zhen pa'i shes pa'o/ 4) rtog dpyod gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i rtog pa ste, gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, sems pa dang shes rab la brten nas dmigs pa'i dngos po'i don 'ol spyi tsam 'dzin pa rtsing ba'i rnam pa can gyi shes pa'o/
rtog pa log shes dang don gcig
1) bsam pa che ba/ gzhan la phan pa'i rtog pa che ba zhig / 2) rnam rtog che ba/ khang stong rkun ma'i rnam rtog che/
gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa/
rang yul yod pa can gyi rtog bcas kyi shes pa ste, dper na bum 'dzin rtog pa dang, sgra mi rtag par rtog pa lta bu don dang mthun pa'o/
rang yul med pa'i rtog pa, dper na, sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang, ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa lta bu'o/
gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa med pa/
rtog pa med pa dang dpyod pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin
bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chod kyi ting nge 'dzin/
bsam pa dngos gzhi'i zur nas gzhan mang po la 'phro ba'i dran pa/ sger gyi khe phan 'tshol 'dod kyi rtog pa 'og 'gyu spangs pa/

log shes kyi nang gses, rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i zhen rig dper na sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang, gang zag bdag 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang, ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa lta bu min pa la yin pa dang, med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'o/
rnam rtog gi spros pa'am 'ching rgya/
rnam par rtog pa'i gtad so'am yul/
rgyu mtshan la brten nas zhib dpyod byed pa'i bsam blo/ las don gang rung la 'jug pa'i thog mar rtog dpyod nan tan byed dgos/
rtog pa dang bral ba ste, rtog med do/
sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bral ba'i shes pa ste, mngon sum gyi shes pa rnams dang, mngon sum ltar snang gi shes pa rnams so/
rtog med log shes dang don gcig
rmi lam gsal snang gi shes pa lta bu/

log shes kyi nang gses, rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i gsal snang can gyi shes pa, dper na, dung ser snang gi dbang shes lta bu dung dkar po de ser por snagn yang don la phyin ci log tu snang ba'i shes pa'o/
rtog dpyod zhib 'jug / dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la rtog zhib nan tan byas pa/ rtog zhib 'phyugs med/
rang 'dod blo bzo'am rig bzo/ rtog bzo rang dgar mi byed/
khog tu tshud par dka' ba/ shes yon rtogs dka' ba rnams/
1) skyes rabs dang rnam thar/ 2) rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde'i bsdus tshig
1) chos kyi nyams rtogs can/ 2) (mngon) 1, mkhas pa/ 2, sangs rgyas/
1. (tha mi dad pa) shes pa/ go rtogs/ rang rtogs/ shes rtogs/ bzang ngan dbye ba rtogs pa/ 2. shes pa'i ming tsam/

«abad'anam» gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi bdun pa ma rtogs pa'i don dpe dang bcas gsal bar ston pa ste dper na, rgyal po tshangs byin gyi sngon gyi byung ba ston pa'i mdo lta bu 'dul ba'i sde snod du gtogs pa'o/
rang don shes bya rtod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ste, gang zag dang chos la bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid 'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam bzhag so so rang gis mngon sum du rig pa/
rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa
mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, chos thams cad mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa yin pas de la 'jig rten na mthu che ba sus kyang de ltar ma yin zhes rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/
pa drug rtogs pas bsdus pa drug dang don: gcig
dag pa'i sgyu lus dang don gyi 'od gsal: gnyis sku thugs su ngo bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i zung 'jug ste slob pa'i zung 'jug khyad par can no
rtogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i chos can dang don gcig
gang gi chags pa dang bral bar byed pa lam bden gyi chos dang, gang zhig chags pa dang 'gog bden gnyis bsdus pa'i chos/
rtogs pa'i chos dang don gcig

blo'i byed pa la brten nas yul la nges pa 'dren pa'i nus pa, dper na, bum 'dzin mig shes kyis bum pa rtogs pa dang, sgra mi rtag rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa lta bu rang yul gyi chos gang yin pa de yang dag par shes pa'o/

gyur pa'i chos can: dgra bcom pa drug gi nang gses, gang dbang po rtul po 'dod yon gyis myos kyang rung mthong ba'i chos bde bar gnas pa las yongs su nyams pa'i skal ba can ma yin la dbang po rnams sbyang ba'i skal ba can yin pa'o/
bslab pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan/

drug sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco: brgyad kyi nang tshan 'dun pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba, brtson 'grus nyams pa mi mnga' ba, dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba, shes rab nyams pa mi mnga' ba, ting nge 'dzin nyams pa mi mnga' ba, rnam par grol ba nyams pa mi mnga' ba ste drug /
shes sla ba/ sbyangs pa tsam gyis rtogs sla ba zhig byung ba/
rta sogs spang la brtod de rtswa za ru 'jug pa'i 'khor rgya/ rtod kha spo ba/
rta drel rtod byed thag pa phur pa can
(tha dad pa) brtod pa, brtod pa, rtod,, rtswa sar rtod thag ring pos sgo phyugs btags nas rtswa za ru 'jug pa/ sgo phyugs rnams rtswa khar brtod/
1) rtod thag gi phur pa/ 2) drang srong phur bu/
1. (tha dad pa) brtan pa, brtan pa, rton,, blo 'gel ba'am yid gtod pa dang, cha 'jog pa/ mi ngan la yid rton mi rung/ 2. yid rton yul lam rton sa/ rton pa med pa rnams kyi pha dang mar gyur/

lam du 'jug skabs kyi blang bya'am yid ches par bya ba'i chos bzhi ste, gang zag la mi rton chos la rton, tshig la mi rton don la rton, rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton, drang don la mi rton nges don la rton pa'o/

1. 1) rtol ba'i skul tshig 2) (rnying) phyin pa'am slebs pa/ 2. mdzo mo dang g.yag 'dus pa las skyes pa'i phyugs/ , ,'bigs pa'am phyung ba/ rnag khrag rtol ba/ bug pa brtol ba/ skyon mtshang brtol ba/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) brtol ba, brtol ba, ,slebs pa/ yul gzhan du brtol/ phyin phyin pa'i mthar grong khyer chen po zhig la brtol song/ sdod gnas su brtol/
(yul) ma mdzo mo dang pha g.yag bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i be'u
mdzo mo shi ba'i rtol gog /
(yul) pha glang dang, ma mdzo mo 'dus pa las skyes pa'i pho phyugs shig /
1. (tha dad pa) brtol ba, brtol ba
1) cha med dam snang med/ rtol med sems kyis gnas 'dir 'ongs/ 2) nges pa med pa/ 3) thabs med pa/
pha glang dang, ma mdzo mo bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i mo phyugs shig /
pha glang dang, ma mdzo mo bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i pho phyugs shig /
pha glang dang, ma mdzo mo bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i mo phyugs shig /
g.yag ste pha g.yag dang ma mdzo mo bsdebs: pa las skyes pa'i pho
ma mdzo mo dang pha g.yag bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i be'u/
lta zhib dang skul 'ded byed pa/
gnas tshul lta myul/ lta skor tshogs pa/
de lta bu yong mi srid/ las ka brtsams tshad tshang ma 'grub pa lta ga la 'gyur/
so sos khas len gyi lta ba dang grub mtha'/ lta grub gtsang ma/
lta ba'i mgur ma ste chos lugs pa so so'i lta ba 'grol byed kyi mgur tshig /
lta ba ngan pa ste, dngos po'i gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i lta lugs ngan pa/
bshad mi dgos pa/ khyod rang 'gro thub rgyu lta ci nga rang yang 'gro mi thub/
zer ci dgos te, bshad mi dgos/ dpe cha gzhung chen po rtsom shes na yi ge 'bri klog shes pa lta ci smos/
mig gis lta zhing 'tshol nyul byed pa/
ngam bsam gzhigs:/ phru gur lta rtog / nad par lta rtog / mig gis lta zhing yid kyis rtog pa/ rgyal mtshams la lta rtog dang, srung skyob byed pa/
mig dang sems kyi lta lugs/ zhi ba'i lta stangs/ khro bo'i lta stangs/

1) lta na sdug pa dang don gcig 2) «sudransha» gser gyi ri bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ri'i rtse mo mdzes pas lta na sdug dang de'i ngos rer dpag tshad lnga 'bum sum khri re dang mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum nyi khri yod do/ 3) grong khyer lta na sdug /
mdzes pa ste mig gi lam du mtshar zhing sdug pa/ ca lag dpe gsar 'di snang ngor lta na sdug pa zhig 'dug kyang, don la phan thogs yong min da lta tshod mi thig /
mthong tshul/ gzhan gyi lta snang la mdzes po mi yong/
mi so so'i lta stangs dang mthong tshul/ mi so so'i lta snang mthong phyogs gcig tu ma nges pa/
lta ba dang spyod pa'i bsdus ming ste, sems kyi lta ba dang, blang dor gyi bya spyod/ sngags kyi lta spyod/

1. (tha dad pa) bltas pa, blta ba, ltos, ,1) mig gis rig par byed pa/ phan tshun du lta ba/ dpe deb la blta ba/ mig gnyis kyis bltas te gsal por mthong/ mun nag gi nang du bltas kyang mi mthong/ gzhan la lta ba'i mig yod kyang, rang nyed lta na me long dgos/ 2) brtags dpyad dam zhib 'jug byed pa/ rtsa lta ba/ phan gnod blta ba/ tshod lta ba/ 3) chags pa'am brtse gdung byed pa/ spyi'i khe phan la blta ba/ rang gi lus srog la mi lta ba/ sger gyi khe grags la ma lta/ 2./ 1) 'dod tshul/ kho gnyis kyi lta ba mthun gyi mi 'dug / 2) rang mthong ngam, rang nyid rtsis mthong/ lta ba gcog pa/ lta ba chag pa/ 3) chos lugs kyi lta sgom spyod gsum kyi nang tshan lta ba/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ log lta/ ngan lta/
kyi phyag rgya bzhi: 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang, zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba, chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa, mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba bcas bzhi'o/
shes rab nyon mongs can gyi lta ba lnga ste 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang, log par lta ba, mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba, lta ba mchog 'dzin, tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin bcas lnga'o/
lta ngan dang, de gang las 'byung ba'i phung po sogs la dmigs nas rnam pa mchog tu 'dzin cing, byed las lta ngan la mngon par zhen pa'i rten byed pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can zhig /
lta ba nyon mongs can thams cad de, lta ba ngan pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'o/
sgro 'dogs kyi lta ba dang, skur 'debs kyi lta ba'am, rtag lta dang, chad lta gnyis so/
snyigs ma lnga'i nang gses shig ste, rtag chad kyi mthar 'dzin cing, lta ba yang dag pa las nyams pa'o/
nga rgyal gyi nyams chen po/ chu bo kha zheng che yang, 'gro sa zam pa'i 'og red, rta pho lta ba mtho yang, rta sga'i 'og la yin 'gro/
rlom sems che ba/ lta ba mthon por yon tan med, snye ma mthon por 'bru mi chags/
dad mos dang yid ches sogs med par gyur pa/
khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lta ba lnga po ste, chu bo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
nags tshal tshang tshing ltar 'dzings pa'i lta ba/
zag pa bzhi'am srid pa'i chu bo bzhi'i ya gyal, khams gsum gyi lta ba nyon mongs pa rnams so/
ji tsam bltas kyang ngoms pa med pa/ yang yang lta bas chog mi shes pa'i ltad mo shin tu che ba zhig mthong byung/
ji tsam bltas kyang yid mi tshim pa/ mdzes sdug gi rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar lta bas mi ngom/
mtshungs gsal gyi sgra ste 'dra ba/ mdzes pa pad ma lta bu/ 'jam pa shing bal lta bu/ de dang de lta bu/
lta ba min pa'i sems pa'i nyon mongs can lnga ste, 'dod chags dang, khong khro, nga rgyal, ma rig pa, the tshom bcas lnga/
bshad mi dgos/ lung pa 'dir shing phal pa yang med na tsan dan lta smos kyang ci dgos/
mig dang yid kyi lta lugs/ lta tshul mi 'dra ba/ khros pa'i lta tshul/ dga' ba'i lta tshul/ chab srid kyi lta tshul/ mthong rgya chung ba khab mig gang gi lta tshul/
ji 'dra 'dug gi nyams tshod/ re zhig lta tshod bltas pa/
lta rtog zhib 'jug / las ka tshang mar lta zhib byas pa/
phar zhog / ja lta zhog chu'ang mi 'dug :/ rgyan cha lta zhog gos kyang mi 'dug / me mda' lta zhog dbyug pa yang mi 'dug /
mang pos gcig la sdeb gcig tu lta ba/
lta ba log pa'i bsdus tshig

1) gyon pa sogs kyi mtha' 'gril 'tshems stangs shig / 2) lam lugs spyi byings dang mi mthun par mtho sa nas bskor te rang don sgrub thabs byed pa/ 3) khang pa sogs kyi rgyab nas skor ba/ 4) gzhan la bskor nas go rgyu'i skad cha shod pa/
1) mjing pa'i rgyab kyi kong kong/ spag kha la za bar lam ltag khung nas skor don med/ 2) yas kyi ltag gong/
dpon sogs ngom pa/ dpon po ltag khur gyis gzhan la sdigs mo byed pa/
(yul) rgyab phyogs su 'gyel ba/ gom stabs brtan po ma tshud na, ltag dgye log pa'i nyes skyon yong/
khang pa'i rgyab tu yod pa'i sgo/
mgo bo'i ltag pa la spu med pa/ rgad po ltag sgre can la lcang lo'i re ba med/
grwa pa'i zhwa mo sgro btsems ma/
mgo 'dren yod nyams ston pa/ mtho snyeg ltag ngoms che na, nam zhig rang tshugs shor yong/
1) rdzing gi rgyab phyogs sam ltag nas 'bab pa'i chu/ ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu dang dpung rod med pa'i dpa' bo/ 2) ltag pa nas mjing pa'i bar zug pa'i chu ba leb mo/
sun 'byin ltar snang ste lan phyin ci log pa/

'gal ba brjod pa'am phyin ci log 'phen pa, dper na, yul mi thams cad kyis khral 'jal dgos na, mi tshang 'dis 'jal mi dgos pa gang yin zhes pa lta bu, spyi la khyab pa'i tshul des bye brag la ma khyab par dpyad pa'i tshul gyis 'gal ba brjod pa'o/
1) gan rkyal du nyal ba/ 2) rtsa snod ka dang, mjing pa'i rtse chung sogs 'phar rtsa dang 'brel ba'i rtsar rgyag byed kyi gtsag bu zhig /
mgo ltag la spu med pa/
ltag pa'i mdud sgo'i bsdus ming,
/ 1) ske rgyab kyi steng cha/ mgo ltag dbye ba 'byed dgos/ 2) steng ngam rgyab/ gri'i ltag pa/ sta re'i ltag pa/ 3) mgo 'dren/
1) gnya' chag pa/ gzhan gyis gnad la bkar bas ltag pa chag ste zhum zhum bur gnas pa/ 2) mgo 'dren brlag pa/ blo phugs gtod sa'i rgyab rtsa 'thor nas ltag pa chag pa/
mgo 'dren yod snyam pa'i ltag shed khengs dregs chen po/
rna ba g.yas kyi rtse mo nas g.yon gyi rtse mo'i bar du thig btab nas de'i dkyil la zer te der me btsa' bzhag na rlung nad kyis mgo bo 'khor nas 'gyel bar 'gyur ba la phan/

1) ltag pa dang ltag pa sbyor ba'am, rgyab dang rgyab sprod pa/ thod pa ltag sprod byas pa'i da ma ru/ 2) mi mthun pa'am 'gal ba/ phan tshun 'gal ba ltag sprod kyi rtsod gshags de 'grig rgyu'i re ba med/
gong ma'am steng ma/ yi ge ltag ma/ grong ltag mar phyin/ gral ltag mar bsdad/

1) gnya' ltag gi rtsa, ltag pa'i mdud sgo'i steng nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'phred la sor gsum re dang, de nas gyen du sor gsum gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na klad tshad dang, mjing rengs sogs la phan/ 2) mgo 'dren/ ltag rtsa ngoms pa/
rgyab rtsa'am mgo 'dren zab po/ rang la bden pa med kyang ltag rtsa bzang po yod/
gong 'og go ldog / khang pa ltag 'og go brjes/
(yul) gos kyi mtha'i sor bzhi tsam gyi mtshams kyi thog ma'i 'tshem bu/
mur gong gi skra gseb tu sbrul 'khyug pa dang 'dra ba'i rtsa 'phred nyal can te, de gtar na mgo bo gzer ba dang, rna ba na ba, so la zug rngu 'byung ba bcas la phan/
/ 'dod don ma grub par ltag log brgyab pa/
mgo 'dren ngoms pa'i dbang shed/ dpon ngan kha 'khyer gyis ltag shed byed pa/
ko bas gtums pa'i do po/ mar ltang gcig dang 'bras ltang gsum/
rkyal pa'am sgro ba chung chung/

zlos gar dang, yul ljongs sogs mig gi mdzes snang du gyur pa'i le tshan rnams/ mi ltad/ ltad mo ston pa/ rig tshad ltad mo min, thos tshad bden gtam min/ byis pa'i rtsed mo'i ltad mo ltar col chung bya ba/
ltad mo ston sa'am, lta sa'i khang pa/
glu gar sogs la lta ba/ zlos gar dang glog brnyan la ltad mo lta ba/ gzhan gyi gra ma 'grig la ltad mo bltas nas ma sdod cig / ril ril rbab la lhung dus, 'jong 'jong ltad mo ma lta/
(mngon) tha skar zla ba ste, hor zla dgu pa/
par shing la snag tsha byugs te shog bu bzhag pa'i steng nas mnan sgril byed pa'i lag cha zhig /

1) snod legs par khengs pa'i tshul/ snod rnams bcud kyis ltam me ltem mer gang/ 2) gcang gcong gi na stangs shig / rtag tu sku ltam me ltem mer lus song/ 3) rgyun chags ma yin pa/ byang chub sems kyis ma zin pa'i lus ngag gi dge sbyor ltam ltem thams cad ma rig pa'i rkyen gyi 'du byed yin/

sra brkyang 'ding ba'i dgos pa, ltung ba bcu bag yangs su bya ba'i ched du ste, bcu ni, 'chang 'bral 'jog gsum, yang yang za ba, 'dus shing za ba, ma smras par grong du 'gro ba, gos slong ba, rnyed pa thun mong du 'gyur ba, byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i gos dum 'chang du rung ba, snam sbyar med par ljongs rgyu rung ba bcas so/
so thar gyi dgag pa'i bslab bya ltung ba sde lnga ni, pham pa dang, lhag ma, ltung byed, sor bshags, nyes byas kyi sde bcas lnga'o/
ldom pa nyams pa slar gso ba ste, ltung ba byin rlabs, mthol ba, bshags pa, chad las bcad pa rnams so/
ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, sdom pa nyams pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi bdun gyi nang gses, ltung ba phyir bcos byed pa la bzhi ste, spro ba mthol bshags kyi phyir bcos byed tshul spyod pa gzhan na gnas pa'i gzhi dang, dus dang dus min bsdus pa'i gzhi dang, gdams ngag gso dgag bzhag pa'i gzhi ste gsum dang, mi spro ba nan tur gyis phyir bcos byed tshul gyi gzhi gcig bcas bzhi'o/

ltung ba phyir bcos kyi nang gses shig ste, ltung ba'i rnam smin mi 'phel ba dang gnyen pos zin pas nus pa chung du 'gro ba dang las kyi kha skong rung ba'i ched du gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis byin gyis brlab pa'o/
bslab bya rnams mi shes pa dang, bag med pa dang, nyon mongs mang ba dang, ma gus pa bcas bzhi'o/
ltung ba 'byung ba'i rgyu bzhi dang 'dra,
ltung ba bshags nas dag pa na rang bzhin gyi gnas su sor chud pa ste spo mgu dbyung ba lta bu'o/
bslab pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung rnams sba gsang med par mthol bshad byed pa/
dbyar gnas kyi skabs su ltung ba gleng mi chog pa dang dbyar grol ba'i skabs nas bzung ltung ba gleng chog pa'i mtshon byed du rtswa dur ba mdud pas ltung ba'i dgag dbye bya ba'o/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gyi gras shig ste, ltung ba gleng yang khyad du gsod pa'i gang zag la, ltung ba ngo ma shes pa shes par bya ba'i phyir du ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ltung ba'i ngo bo nyid 'tshol ba chad las kyi tshul gyis sbyin pa'o/
byang sems kyis spang bya'i ltung ba la gnyis te pham pa'i sde tshan dang, nyes byas kyi sde tshan no/
so thar gyi pham pa bzhi lta bu sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong zhing ngan song du ltung bar byed pa'i sdig ltung ches lci ba/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i shan gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, phyir ma bcos pa'i ltung bas 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i nus pas ltung ba gzhan gyi yang 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa'i nus pa 'phel bar byed pa'o, de la'ang nang gses su, gos la brten pa'i ltung shan dang, sman la brten pa'i ltung shan dang, lhung bzed la brten pa'i ltung shan te gsum yod do/
«p'ayattik'a» so thar gyi ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses shig /
dge slong gi spang bya ltung ba sde lnga'i nang tshan, spang ltung sum cu dang, ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dag go/

dge slong gi spang bya ltung byed kyi sde'i nang gses te, de la'ang bcu tshan dgu yod cing, 'di rnams ni spyad na ngan 'gror ltung bar byed cing bshags pa'i tshe yang spang 'bral sngon du gtang mi dgos par bshags pa tsam gyis 'dag pas ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa'i sde zhes bya'o/

'gog pa'i rtags: phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi rtags sbyor gyi nang gses, ltos pa dang bcas pa yin pa rtags su bkod nas, dgag chos nges pa 'gog pa'am ma nges pa sgrub pa ste, dper na, sngon por 'gyur rung gi gos dkar chos can, rang grub tsam nyid nas tshon can du ma nges te, tshon can du 'gyur ba tshon sogs la ltos dgos pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/

rtsis med khyad gsod/ mi su yin kyang bca' khrims la ltos med rdog rol byas mi chog /
gcig la gcig ltos te grub pa, ring ba la ltos te thung ba zer ba dang, thung ba la ltos te ring ba zer ba lta bu'o/

phag mo gru pa'i slob ma stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal nas brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud, de'i yang slob sangs rgyas dbon khams su byon nas rab byung lnga pa'i me byi lor ri bo che'i dgon pa btab, de nas bzung stag lung ya thang ma thang gnyis su gyes, lugs de'i lo rgyus chos 'byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya bar gsal/
rab byung gsum pa'i lcags byi lo la stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyis btab pa'i lha sa'i byang phyogs su yod pa'i dgon pa zhig / 1180...
chos rje stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa'i phyi ma rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyas pa zhig
si khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rnga ba rdzong gi ri bo zhig /

bkra shis dpal: 'gro mgon phag gru pa'i slob ma rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho khyi yi lo la 'khrungs shing, gdung gva zi, dgung lo nyer bzhi'i dus su phag mo gru pa'i nye gnas mdzad, thugs rtsis che zhing gdams pa rdzogs par gnang, phag gru gshegs nas mal gro mchad ka pa las bka' gdams gsan, dgung lo so dgu pa la po to ba'i bzhugs shul du stag lung dgon pa btab, de nas bzung stag lung bka' brgyud ces pa byung zhing 'dul ba'i phyag len zhib par mdzad pas grwa rgyun rnams kyis kyang de'i rjes su dam por 'dzin par grags, dgung lo drug cu re dgu pa rta lo la gshegs/ (1142-1210)...

(tha mi dad pa) stongs pa, stong pa,, 1) dben pa dang, zad par 'gyur ba/ la 'go shing gis stong pa/ lung pa chus stong pa/ gor nad byung nas sgo phyugs stong pa/ khyim gzhi stong pa/ mi shi khyim stong/ gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa/ chos kyi bdag gis stong pa/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ 2) smin pa dang, phan pa/ thabs shes gang gis kyang mi stong/ 2. 1) mnan na mi 'phar ba'i rtsa 'phar stangs shig / 2) zla re'i gnam gang/ 3) (mngon) yar ngo'i tshes bzhi dang, dgu, bcu bzhi bcas dang, mar ngo'i tshes bcu dgu dang, nyer bzhi, nyer dgu rnams so/ 4) bdag gir lta ba'i mi mthun phyod kyis stong pa, bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug gi nang gses shig / 3) snod kyi nang du bcud gang yang med pa/ khang pa stong pa/ thang stong/ nam mkha' stong pa/ brag stong/ lung stong/ shog stong/ sa stong ri stong/ dbul zhing stong pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la snying po med dang, stong pa nyid, 'bras bus stong, ya ma brla, gsog gsob bcas so, 4. ang grangs thig le'i ming/

stod mnga' ris phyogs nas dar zhing mched pa'i 'dul ba ste, lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku ring la rgya gar shar phyogs kyi pandi ta dharma p'a la de'i slob ma'i gtso bo sa dhu p'a la, gu na p'a la, pradzany'a p'a la ste p'a la rnam gsum bcas spyan drangs, de dag las zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis sdom pa blangs, de'i slob ma dpal 'byor dang zhang mo che ba byang chub seng ge la sogs pa nas brgyud de mched pa rnams la stod 'dul ba zhes grags so/
lus kyi stod du byung ba'i nad/ stod nad na ba/
(tha dad pa) bstad pa, bstad pa, stod,, 1) grabs gshom byed pa/ rta la sga bstad tshar 'dug / 'gro cha bstad grub song/ 2) gtod pa/ gdong sna bstad pa/ blo sna bstad pa/ dgung bstad nas 'phur/
lus dang yul sogs kyi smad cha'i ldog pa/

lus la khrag tshad rgyas pas lus stod gzer ba'i mkhris pa'i nad rtags shig /

sngar stod lung snang rtse khul du dar ba'i zlos gar tshogs pa zhig /

(tha dad pa) bstan pa, bstan pa, ston,, 1) 'chad pa/ gnas lugs gsal por bstan/ gzhung don cha tshang bar bstan/ chos ston pa/ 2) phyir mngon nas gzhan la shes su 'jug pa/ ltad mo ston/ rnam 'gyur ston pa/ dga' nyams ston/ khro nyams bstan/ 'gro lam ston pa/ khong du chub pa'i rtad bstan/ 2. lam srol 'byed pa po/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyi pa'i ston pa drug /
1) chos ston mkhan/ 2) lam ston mkhan nam, cha rgyus ston mkhan/
ston pa phun sum tshogs pa
phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i nang gses, bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sogs/
pa tsug ston la mi ston te ston pa 'dra mo: sbed pa 'dra mo/
ston pa sha kya thub pa
bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren bzhi pa zas gtsang sras/
stag gzig 'ol mo lung ring du 'khrungs pa'i bon gyi ston pa/
ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa/
dus chen bzhi: lha yul nas bab pa dang, chos 'khor bskor ba, cho 'phrul bstan pa, mngon par sangs rgyas pa bcas kyi dus chen bzhi'o/
ston dus bregs pa'i lug bal/
sngar so nam pa tshos rang btab zhing ga'i: ston 'bras bu lon gyi dmid gter 'jog pa
lo tog brngas zin pa'i bstar rtsig /
ston zla gnyis pa'am, hor zla brgyad pa'i dkyil tshad/
ston zla gnyis pa'am hor zla brgyad pa'i 'go tshugs/

dga' spro'i gsol tshigs dang, de 'brel gyi ltad mo/ dus chen gyi ston mo/ dga' ston/ shi ston/ gsol ston bshams pa/ ston mo 'dren pa/ mgron rigs la ston mo gtong ba/
1) gsol stin gshom pa/ 2) ltad mo 'khrab pa/

sngar khri srong lde btsan skabs hwa shang maha ya na'i lugs 'dzin ston min pa ste cig car pa dang, de min pa'i rtsen min pa ste rim gyis poa gnyis phan tshun chos rtsod byed pa/

(tha dad pa) bstabs pa, bstab pa, stobs,, 'bul ba'am ster ba/ sku mgron rnams la gsol tshigs dang, phebs rdzongs stob pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bstabs/ zas gos kyi sbyin pa bstab par bya'o/ rang gi lto gos gzhan la stob/

phar phyin bcu'i nang gses shig ste, mi mthun phyogs kyis rdzi bar mi nus shing rang gi ngo bo shin tu rgyas pa'i gnas skabs kyi shes rab khyad par can no, 'di la dbye na, kun brtags pa'i stobs dang, bsgoms pa'i stobs gnyis yod/
shugs 'gran pa/ rtsal po che'i gyad phan tshun lus shed kyi stobs 'gyed pa/

nus mthu zhan pa/ lus stobs ngan pa/

1) dad pa dang, brtson 'grus, dran pa, ting nge 'dzin, shes rab ste byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan stobs lnga/ 2) 'phen pa'i stobs dang, goms pa'i stobs, sun 'byin pa'i stobs, dkar po sa bon gyi stobs, smon lam gyi stobs te blo sbyong don bdun ma'i stobs lnga/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ste, gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang, las kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs, mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs, khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs, dbang po mchog dman mkhyen pa'i stobs, thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs, bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin snyoms 'jug sogs mkhyen pa'i stobs, sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i stobs, 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs, zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs bcas bcu/
1) (mngon) sangs rgyas spyi/ 2) stobs bcu'i nang gses zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/
1) nus shugs chen po/ 2) (mngon) 1, dpa' bo/ 2, rlung dang, rlung lha/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dge rgyas rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
kyi skabs sems gnas dgu 'grub pa byed pa'i: thabs shig ste thos pa'i stobs, bsam pa'i stobs, dran pa'i stobs, shes bzhin gyi stobs, brtson 'grus kyi stobs, 'dris pa'i stobs bcas durg go /
1. 1) (mngon) 1, khu ba'am thig le/ 2, glang po che/ 3, mi stobs po che/ 4, g.yag / 2) lha min/ 3) las kyi dbang/ 4) klu'i rgyal po zhig gi ming/ 2. stobs shugs chen po/ rgyal khab stobs ldan/

stobs ldan bu tig gos can

rab spel kyi rgyan kyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod kyi dngos po'i bsre bya'am, spel bya'i rgyan thams cad rang dbang stobs mtshungs su ston pa'i rgyan zhig

nus shugs/ las ka'i byed bab la brtags na stobs shed che chung ha go yong/
star ba dang stor ba'i skul tshig
1) khrus chu sogs 'dor yul khung bu/ 2) (mngon) mi gtsang ba 'bab yul/

1. (tha dad pa) bstar ba, bstar ba, stor,, 'thor bar byed pa dang, byi dor byed pa/ sa gzhi gtsang mar bstar ba/ gad chu stor ba/ gnyen grogs dgra yis stor gyur tshe, yun ring dran nas brtse bas gdung/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) bor ba'am brlag pa/ dngul khug stor nas mi 'dug / lam stor te 'gro sa mi shes pa/ rnga mong gis rnge'u stor/ a mas bu phrug stor ba/
/ spyi pa'i nor rdzas stor brlag chud zos btang ba/
(tha mi dad pa) brtas pa, brta ba,, rgyas pa/ lus stobs brtas pa/ phyag bris spyi bor phebs pas dga' spro brtas/ yid mchog tu brtas/
1. rtog pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. le'u, bka' dang bstan bcos sogs kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ kye rdor rgyud kyi brtag pa gnyis pa/
brtag bya ma nges pa'i mtha' gnyis las, mtha' gcig nges par bzung ste thag bcad pa/
1) brtag dpyad bgyis pa/ 2) lha dang bla mar mo dang lung bstan zhus pa/
rtog dpyod de yul 'jal ba/ gang yang brtag dpyad med par hol rgyug byed mi nyan/
rtog dpyod byed sa'i gzhi ste dpyad gzhi/
/ bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyis brtag gzhig byed pa/

1. rtog pa'i 'das pa, 2. (rnying) gus pa'am sgrin pa/
sor brtags pa la brten nas bag la nyal gyi: sa bon khegs pa min yang skyed byed kyi rgyu rkyen ma tshang bas 'bras bu mi bskyed pa'o
(rnying) glo bur ba'i dus skabs/ snang med brtad pa zhig la byes nas 'grul pa 'byor pa/

1) nan tan/ brtan brtan byas na nor 'khrul nyung/ rtsa ba brtan brtan tshugs zin pa/ rang 'khri'i las ka 'thus shor med par brtan brtan byed pa/ 2) 'gyur ba med pa dang, nges pa/ khos bshad pa'i skad cha de brtan brtan yin 'dug / las ka brtan brtan med/ sang nyin las 'go 'dzugs rgyu brtan brtan red/ spyang pos bsam blo lan stong btang na yang, 'phyugs pa thengs gcig brtan brtan yong bar 'gyur/
nan nan khrig khrig / lhod yengs med par: brtan brtan tig tig byed dgos/ gros sdur gang byung min par brtan brtan tig tig byas pa/ bsam blo brtan brtan tig tig btang ba yin/
1) brtan po/ sngon gyi lo rgyus khungs lung brtan ldan 'dug / 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/

1. rton pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. 1) skar ma brtan pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang steng bu dang, gan rkyal bu, rgyu skar tog stod phur, snang ldan shing rta, gza' yi rten, lugs bzang skyes, gser phur bcas so, 2) (mngon) 1, khyab 'jug...2, mkhas pa/ 3, sa gzhi'am snod kyi 'jig rten/ 4, lha dbang phyug chen po/ 3. brtan po dang 'dra,
phyi snod kyi gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa bem dngos/
ba'i rdzas yod: rdzas yod kyi nang gses, nam mkha' lta bu 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i cha nas rdzas su yod pa'o/

'gyur ldog med pa dang sra ba/ skad cha brtan po/ rmang gzhi brtan po btsugs/ las ka brtan po byas/ bsam pa brtan po/ gzhan phan gyi byas bzang mi'i sems la brtan por gnas/ drang bden gyi phyogs su brtan por gnas pa/ mi so sos rang gi lta stangs brtan por 'dzin pa/ brtson 'grus brtan po byas/
sa'i lha mo/ ming gi rnam grangs la bdud la skyengs ster dang, bden dpang, phag gi shing rta can bcas so,

bod khams skyong bar khas blangs pa'i mo rgyud kyi yul lha zo dor bcu gnyis te, kun grags ma dang, g.ya' ma skyong, kun bzang mo, bgegs kyi gtso ste bdud mo bzhi dang, spyan gcig ma dang, dpal gyi yum, drag mo rgyal, klu mo dkar mo ste gnod sbyin mo bzhi, bod khams skyong dang, sman gcig ma, g.yar mo sil, g.yu sgron ma ste sman mo bzhi bcas khyon bsdoms bcu gnyis so/
yun ring brtan par bzhugs pa/

brtan po/ brel 'tshab mi byed pa'i brtan lhing chen po/
brel dngangs tshab tshub/ brtabs brtabs po byas nas bros song/
(rnying) 1) rtsol ba drag po/ 2) gzu lum dang rang bzo/ 3) gzhan la gnod pa/ 4) 'dod pa che ba/
brtson 'grus/ khag snang mi byed pa'i brtun pa brtan po 'dug / bya bar brtun pa dang ldan par zhugs/ rtag tu brtun pa bskyed/
snying stobs che ba/ nyam nga med pa'i brtul phod che ba/
1. rtul ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. 'jam pa/
snying stobs 'gyur ba med pa/ mes rgyal la sha zhen che ba'i dpa' bo brtul ba brtan pa/
1) rtsol ba'i rang bzhin can/ 2) 'jam pa'i ngang tshul can/ khengs dregs med pa brtul ba'i ngang tshul can/

1) bya ba snga ma bsdus nas phyi ma la zhugs pa ste tha mal rang ga ba'i spyod pa brtul nas thun min gyi spyod pa'i gnas la zhugs pa'o/ 2) cha byad dang, tshul dang, lus ngag gi 'jug pa nges par byed pa'i spyod pa/
lag gar phreng sogs spong ba dang: mal stan che mtho spong ba dang, dus min gyi zas spong ba bcas so/
1) brtul zhugs la gnas pa/ 2) drang srong/
khyi dang ba lang gi brtul zhugs sam, skra 'bal zhing 'breg pa la sogs pa rnams byas pas grol bar 'gyur ro snyam du sems pa'o/
sdom khrims brtan por bzung ba/
1. rten pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. bcud dam sems can sogs/
kyi khams drug khams bco brgyad kyi nang: gses mig gi rnam shes, rna ba'i rnam shes, sna'i rnam shes, lce'i rnam shes, lus kyi rnam shes, yid kyi rnam shes te drug

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor dang po'i skabs su thob pa'i sa gnyis pa ste, 'di'i skabs kyi mngon rtogs rnams brten pa sbyor lam sogs bskyed pa'i gzhi yin pas brten pa gzhi'i sa zhes bya'o/

'gro ba'i sa: sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor gsum pa'i skabs su thob pa'i sa drug pa ste, mthong lam du don gyi 'od gsal mngon sum du mthong ba de la brten pa zag med kyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro bas, sa drug pa la brten pa'i khyad par du 'gro ba'i sa zhes bya'o/
rtod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
rtol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
mthong ba tsam gyis tshig pa za ba/ che 'gying chen po'i mi de blta bas khong khro ba zhig red/
blta bas chog mi shes pa
1) blta bas ngoms pa med pa/ sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ 2) gzugs mdzes pa/
nad blta yul gyi lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i yar zur rus pa 'bur po'i ngos kyi 'phar rtsa de'o/
ji tsam bltas kyang zhan du mi 'gro ba/ tshong khang khag la tshong zog blta shed chen po tshar du dngar nas yod/
1. lteb pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. nyis bkug can/ nyis bltab byas nas bzhag yod/
bltabs tshigs yag po ma brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis chags pa'i gnyer ma/
ras sogs kyi sgril kha/ gos chen bltabs dril gnyis/ ras khra bltabs dril gsum/
stod thung dang, gos thung sogs la mdzes khyad kyi ched du bltabs te bzos pa'i ri mo 'bur dod dam, 'bur ris/
1) ras sogs kyi sgril kha/ 2) (yul) par shing gi steng du snag tsha byugs nas shog bu bzhag ste sgril byed kyi ming/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khrungs pa/ skyed pa'i yab dang bltams pa'i yum/
mig gis yang yang ngam rgyun ring bltas pa/
phan tshun bltos nas grub pa/
bu pha la bltos te byung bas na, bu ni pha'i bltos chos so/
la bltos nas tshu ri dang: bu la bltos nas pha zhes 'jog pa/
ltos pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
gang la'ang ma bltos pa ste, mtha' gcig pa'am rang rkya ba/
bu pha la bltos te byung bas na, pha ni bu'i bltos sa'o/
1. stang ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2./ 1) mgon nam grogs/ 2) snying po dang, don snying/ bstang bas yongs su ma bzung ba/
stod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod skyel mkhan/
rig gnas skor dang bka' mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos bod yig tu bsgyur ba glegs bam nyis brgya dang bco brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'o/
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rigs drug gi 'gro ba'am sems can/
lha sa grong khyer na yod pa'i dgon rnying zhig ste, man ju'i rgyal rabs chan lung dang, ca chin, kwang shu gsum gyi dus skabs so sor dgon bdag de mo ho thog thus bod kyi srid skyong snga phyir byas/

1) ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis sangs rgyas kyi bka'i don bshad cing thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa'i legs bshad 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis ldan no/ 2) gzhung lugs 'chad rtsom gyi dpe cha/ rtog ge'i bstan bcos/
brjod bya dang, dgos pa, nying dgos, 'brel ba bcas bzhi'o/
bstan bcos kyi rtsis mgo lnga
rtsis 'go yan lag lnga dang don gcig
drug don med pa'i bstan bcos dang: don log pa'i bstan bcos, ngan g.yo'i bstan bcos, brtse bral gyi bstan bcos, thos pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos, rtsod pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos bcas drug /
don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos, sdug bsngal spong ba'i bstan bcos, sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos te nang pa'i bstan bcos so/
bstan bcos kyi nang don ma tshang ba rnams la bsnan pa'i kha skong ngam snon ma/
1. ston pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi chos/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ bstan pa yongs su nyams pa/ bstan pa gsal byed/ bstan pa gnas pa/ bstan pa snub pa/
bstan pa rgyus yod kyis bshig pa ste cha: rgyus yod mkhan gyis rang phyogs gtor bshig byed pa'i dpe/ rang phyogs kyi jus gzhi'i gnas tshul bstan pa rgyus bshig byed pa/

sngar gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su dbu brnyes pa nas bzung, srong btsan sgam po'i dus su srol gtod dang, khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su 'phel rgyas btang, khri ral pa can gyi dus su skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa de, glang dar mas ma bsnubs bar gyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la zer/
lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med par 'gyur ba/

'di'i dus mtshams kyi brtsi tshul la mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod de, bu ston rin chen grub kyi bzhed srol ltar na rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo nga gsum pa chu bya lor bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes lo de nas brtsis pa dang, 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi bzhed srol ltar na rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo zhe brgyad pa sa stag lor klu mes tshul khrims shes rab sogs mi bcus bla chen las sdom pa blangs pa'i lo nas brtsis pa, yang lo ts'a ba rin chen bzang po'i gsang sngags kyi chos bod du bsgyur ba'i skabs nas brtsis pa bcas yod cing, gzhan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar nas p'a la rnam gsum spyan drangs te bod du 'dul ba'i sdom pa spel ba'i skabs nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs par brtsis yod/
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par byed pa/
bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i che brjod/
1) ston pa shakya thub pa:/ 2) bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa/

pan chen er te ni sku phreng bdun pa 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu stag lor 'khrungs, rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing 'brug lor ta la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa dgung na phra zhing, skabs de'i rgyal tshab tshe smon gling hu thog thu la byas nyes byung rkyen gong ma da kwang gis bka' phab pa bzhin bod kyi rgyal srid dang chos srid gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes, shing sbrul lor gong ma chen pos yang bskyar gser gyi 'ja' sa dang, gser tham gnang, me rta lor ta la'i bla ma mkhas grub rgya mtsho la dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang nas rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bshol te gdan sar phebs, rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing stag lor gshegs/

mdo lugs la, ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lo lnga brgya phrag bcu gnas te, phug lugs la dus bzhi snga ma dang phyi ma bsdoms pas lo lnga stong brgya dang bzhi'o/

pan chen er te ni sku phreng brgyad pa: 'di rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing yos lor 'khrungs me 'brug chen sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gyis khrir phebs lag khang gi jo bo rin po che'i mdun du gser bum dkrugs te pan chen sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gyis khrir phebs mdzad, rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing phag lor bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes, chu rta lor 'das/
1) brjod bya'i don/ 2) bstan pa'i rtsa ba ste, mdo phyogs nas 'dul ba dang, sngags phyogs nas gsang 'dus/
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byung ba'i rabs/
brtan ma bcu gnyis dang don gcig
mthong thabs bya rgyu med pa'am, mig lam du bstan rgyu med pa/
bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs
sgra dri ro reg bya bzhi dang mig gi dbang po sogs lnga ste dgu po de rnams mig lam du bstan du med la thogs pa dang bcas pas na de ltar brjod do/
bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs
rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs lta bu/
lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa skyes chen dam pa rnams dus nam tshod byon pa'i lo grangs gsal bar ston pa'i rtsis rig /
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa/
sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong mkhan skyes bu rnams/
bstan du yod pa ste, mthong thabs bya rgyu yod pa'am, mig lam du bstan rgyu yod pa/
mig gi yul du bstan du yod pa dbyibs dang kha dog gis bsdus pa'i gzugs rnams so/
bstan yod thogs bcas kyi gzugs
gzugs kyi skye mched de mig la bstan du yod la thogs pa dang bcas pas na de skad brjod pa ste ka bum sogs kyi gzugs lta bu'o/
bstan yod thogs med kyi gzugs
me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/
bstan pa'i rabs dang don gcig
1) bstan pa 'jig par byed pa po/ 2) bzhad gad slong ba/
gad mo sha stag slong mkhan/
chos lugs dang chab srid gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong dang bstan pa srung ba po kun/
gral lam phreng/ khang pa bstar pa gcig /
1. star ba dang stor ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. (rnying) 1) bsgoms pa/ 2) yod pa/
gnas khang dang ngal gso ba'i khang pa/
tshig gi zhe sa dang lus kyi gus 'dud/ dge rgan la bsti stang zhus nas slob khrid nyan pa/
1) rgyun du gnas pa'i yul/ 2) rten gzhi/ 3) ngal gso ba'i gnas/
1. sting ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. 'phya ba'am zur za byed pa/
rtsub tshig gam 'phya smod kyi tshig /
zur gyis dri ba dang 'phya smod byed pa/
(rnying) 1) mnar ba/ lus sems bstir ba/ 2) bar mtshams/
(rnying) bar mtshams med pa dang, mnar med pa'am, ngal gso med pa/
stud pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
brgyud ma'am gcig rjes gcig mthud dam bar ma chad pa/ bang chen bstud mar 'byor ba/ mkhas pa bstud mar bsten pa/
grogs dang mthun par byed mkhas pa/ mi'i bsam sbyor la bstun mkhas kho na byas pa/
stun gang thub byed pa ste sprel lad 'khrab pa/
blo bstun pa dang gtam 'dri ba/ mi la bstun dri mi byed pa/ mi ngan la bstun dri ma byed/ bsam 'char mi mthun pa gang yod pa rnams bstun dri yang yang byed pa/
stun pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
bsten cing gus 'dud zhu ba/ slob dpon bsten bkur byed pa/
1. sten pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2./ 1) lte bar yod pa'i lus 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rtsa'i bye brag cig / 2) sten gtugs/ bsten med nyam chung/
(rnying) grogs byas pa'am gzhan dang mthun par rjes su 'jug pa/
che brjod/ rang las yon tan che bar bstod bkur byed pa/
glu gzhas gtong ba'i sgo nas che brjod byed pa/ bstod glu ring po/
che brjod kyi bstod ra/ khyed rang thugs rgyud drang po tshad ldan red ces bstod bsngags brjod pa/

rje tsong kha pas brtsams pa'i bstod pa chen po bzhi ste, rten 'brel bstod pa dang, byams bstod mnyes gshin pa, 'jam bstod bstod sprin rgya mtsho, rnam rgyal ma'i bstod pa sa gsum 'gro ba'i re skong ma bcas bzhi'o/

1. (tha dad pa) bsngags pa/ gna' bstod deng smad/ bzang bstod ngan smad/ brgya bstod stong bstod/ bdag bstod gzhan smad/ rang gis rang la bstod pa/ ngan pas rang bstod, khwa tas sgro bstod/ bstod 'os pa la bstod dgos, smad 'os pa la smad dgos/ 2.gzengs su bstod pa'i bya ba ste bsngags brjod/ bstod pa phul ba/
las yang dag par 'das pa: bstod pa ji tsam byas kyang bstod mi tshar ba'am, bstod kyis mi lang ba/
bstod pa'i cha las smad pa
cha'i rgyan gyi nang gses, g.yo zol gyi tshig gis bstod pa'i khul byas nas don la smad pa'i cha'i rgyan zhig /
mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan gyi nang gses, brjod 'dod bstod yul la yon tan khyad par can ldan pa brjod pa'i sgo nas mtshungs par bstod pa'i rgyan zhig /
yon tan bsngags brjod kyi mgrin dbyangs/ mes rgyal la bstod dbyangs 'bul/
byed pa'i tshig / ming gi rnam grangs la: bsngags pa brjod dang che brjod, mchod tshig bstod pa smra, mtho bar bya, gzengs bstod pa, legs smra bcas so,
sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma sogs yul gong ma rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa byas pa'i gsung skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig /
bstod pa byed 'os pa/ nga tshos bstod 'os pa sha stag red/ ming gi rnam grangs la bsngags 'os dang, mchod 'os, mchog gyur, ltad mor che, phul byung, shin tu bzang bcas so,
bstod tshig gis brgyan pa'i yi ge
bstod pa/ mi bzang las bzang la bstod ra gtong ba/ legs so zhes bstod ra che brjod zhus pa/
phan tshun phar bstod tshur bstod res mos/ phan tshun spyod bzang la mgu nas bstod res byed pa/

bod yig gsal byed bcu pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen sgra med, ming gzhi'i ma ning gi yi ge zhig /
(tharka) rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la rta ldan dang, dbyu gu , gsal ba'i bu mo bcas so,
nye dbang so gnyis kyi nang gses, tha skar gyi bu gnyis te, tha skar gyi lha dang, gzhon nu'i lha ste gnyis/
skar ma tha skar dang tshes bco lnga'i zla ba mnyam 'dzoms byung ba/
1) hor zla dgu pa/ 2) 'dul ba las zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar la tha skar zla ba zer/
du rdzas tha ma kha blug snod
(rnying) 1) zhi ba/ 2) cung zad/ 3) snying po/ 4) rgyang tsam dang, mtha' tsam gyi bar/
cung zad tsam/ sman tha ge re 'thung/
1) yul gru/ tha gru yangs pa/ 2) rgya khon/
1) sa rgod ma dul ba/ sa zhing tha rgod/ 2) mi srun pa dang, ma rabs/ sems rgyud tha rgod/ spyod pa tha rgod/ 3) ngan pa dang, ngan ngon/ gnas mal tha rgod/ lto gos tha rgod/
1) ma rabs dang, ma dul ba/ spyod ngan tha chad/ bu tha chad/ 2) dman pa'am sdug shos/ 'tsho ba tha chad/
1) tha ma/ dpyid zla tha chung/ spun dgu'i tha chung gnyis/ 2) (mngon) 1, nu bo/ 2, mdzub chung ma/
1) ming ngam, shes brjod 'jug gsum gyi yul/ de dang de zhes tha snyad du grags so/ 2) rig gnas so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjod byed skad cha/ tshad ma'i tha snyad/ gso rig gi tha snyad/
lag bzo gso sgra sogs rig gnas kyi: gzhung
ming dang grags pa'i rda'i gzhi/
1) bshad yam tsam la zhen pa'i mi/ 2) thog mar ming 'dogs mkhan/
bu ston rin chen grub kyi bzhed pa ltar na dbu ma rigs tshogs drug gi drug pa/

tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags yang dag ste, rtags chos la mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel ba grub pa'i gtan tshigs, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu mtshan nyid rtags su bkod nas bsgrub bya sgrub pa'o/
tha snyad lnga ldan gyi mi
'dul bar bshad pa'i mi tha snyad lnga ldan ni mi yin pa dang, smra shes pa, don go ba, shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa, ma ning sogs min pa bcas snga tshang ba zhig /
1) lus kyi lag pa/ 2) yi ge/ 3) ming tshig /
gzhi gang la ming de chags pa'am 'jug pa'i dus te, kun gyi mthun snang du grub nas 'bod pa'i dus/
1) 'jig rten la srid tshad/ 2) so so'i skye bo/ 3) ming/
ming dang grags pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i yul/
ming ngam, brda chad brjod pa/
mi yin pa dang, shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa, 'dod khams pa'i sa pa yin pa ste gsum/

so so ba'i chos te, rtog ngor gnyis su snang ba, ka ba dang, bum pa gnyis lta bu'o/ rang bzhin tha dad pa/ rigs tha dad pa/ lugs tha dad pa/ chu dang rlangs pa ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa/ bya byed tha dad pa/
tha dad pa la dbye na, rang ldog tha dad pa dang, ngo bo tha dad pa, rigs tha dad pa, rdzas tha dad pa ste bzhi'o/
ngo bo'am ldog pa so so ba'i 'du shes/
tha dad pa'i 'du shes mi mnga' ba
'khor 'das kyi chos rnams la bden dngos kyi blang dor gyi dri ma mi mnga' ba, ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dngos po gnyis kyi sbyar chos rnams phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor byed kyi tshig 'dra la gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis don tha dad ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
tha dam tshig tha tshig gam
dam tshig ste, kha chad tshig dan nam, khas blangs dam bca'/

ma mthar/ phan pa'i rogs ram bya rgyu phar bzhag tha na legs so zhes pa'i tshig tsam yang bshad mi 'dug / mi lta ci, tha na srog chags grog sbur tsam yang mi 'dug / tha na bzhad gad tsam gyi ched du'ang gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa/
(yul) rag zangs shing sogs kyis bzos pa'i sder ma zhabs ra can/ lung pa spar mo gang la dpon po tha spag gang/
1. 1) zhe sdang dang, khong khro/ 2) nyon mongs pa/ 2. 1) rengs pa dang, sra ba'am mkhregs pa/ sa zhing tha bar lus pa/ 2) rtsub mo/
lo mang rengs pa'i sa zhing gi kha dog / lo gsum bstud nas than pa btang bar brten sa zhing tshang ma tha ba skya chags su gyur/
sdug bsngal dang log lta dang nyon mongs pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i tha ba ngan pa gtong ba/
1) khong khro spangs pa/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/

1.mjug ma dang, rjes ma/ 'phrad pa'i tha ma ni 'bral/ tha mar dge ba/ zas kyi tha ma za/ gnyen gyi tha mas bskor/ skye ba'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ 2.dman pa dang, chung ba dang, zhan pa/ rim pa rab 'bring tha gsum/
kha la 'then rgyu'i du ba/ tha ma kha 'then pa/ tha ma kha gcod pa/
tha ma'i cha mthun gyi kun sbyor lnga
tha ma'i cha mthun lnga dang don gcig,
khams tha ma'i cha mthun nam 'dod khams kyi kun sbyor lnga ste, kun sbyor gsum dang, 'dod 'dun dang, gnod sems bcas lnga'o/
dngos po la chags 'dzin gyi blo/

dkyus ma dang, phal pa, rang bzhin pa/ mi tha mal pa/ bya ba tha mal pa/ bsam blo tha mal pa/ ras cha 'di spus tha mal pa'i gras red/ deng skabs gzugs khams bde nyen gnyis bral tha mal pa'i ngang du gnas lags/
so so ma yin pa/ phan tshun tha mi dad pa/ bya byed tha mi dad pa/

1) mna' tshig dang dam tshig ste, dam bcas pa'i tshig / sngon gyi tha tshig gnyan po/ tha tshig bor ba/ 2) tshig gi rtsa don nam, tshig gi don gal che ba/ 3) tha snyad kyi tshig dang, tha snyad btags pa'i tha ma'i tshig gam, nges pa'i tshig
: ma go ma thos zer sa med pa'i brda sprod/
nyam chung ngam nyam thag / 'tsho ba tha zhan/ byed stangs tha zhan/ goms gshis tha zhan/
1) lo tog skye thon zhan pa'i sa zhing/ 2) dbyar bsnyal bslang byed dgos pa'i sa zhing tha ma/
1) 'thor ba'am zag pa'i rnam pa zhig / chu thigs zegs ma tha ra ra/ 2) 'gro ba'am rgyu ba'i rnam pa zhig / rta pa mang po tha ra ra rgyug 'dur gyis 'gro bzhin yod/

1) ngan pa/ gzhan gyi mig ltos shas rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tha ram gyi spyod pa byed du mi 'jug / 2) zhing rgod tha ba dang lam khar skyes pa'i ram bu'i rigs shig ste, ro mngar la bska ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, 'brum nag dang, mes tshig pa'i rma gso, glo lu ba 'jags par byed/ 3) rtswa ram pa/
tshags mi 'thug pa'am, nyung ngu tho re ba'i rnam pa/ tha re tho re'i lo 'bras/ shing thar thor skyes pa/ ca lag tha re tho re 'jog pa/ me tog thar thor zhig las med pa/ mi tha re tho re lus pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brong pa rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
rta drel thal mdog lo bzhi lon pa/
(sog) dbyar kha khal kha zug phyu pa'i stod du gyon rgyu'i stod khebs kyi ming
dman pa'am, zhan pa dang, ngan pa/ tha shal ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ mi tha shal ba ma yin/ spyod pa tha shal ba/
bar gyi ring tshad dam bar khyon:/ sa thag le dbar khri phrag gis chod pa/
thag pa la dpyang ba'am 'khyud de 'gro sa'i skas ka/
'dra ba tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas dngos don la lta stangs nor ba'i dpe/
me tog 'khri shing gi gras kyi me tog cig /

: 1) lag pa sogs kyis reg tsam thug tsam byed stangs/ nad pa la thag gi thug gi ma mang/ rgas 'khogs la phru gus thag gi thug gi sun po ma bzo/ gcig gis gcig la thag thug med pa/ 2) thug thug mang tshul/ kar kor thag thug mang po byung ba/
thag pa phra mo'am, thung ngu/
bar thag ring po/ grong khyer nas grong khyer gyi bar du thag 'gyangs po red/
gang byung 'gro 'ong mi chog par bar mtshams gcod byed kyi thag rgya/ ltad mo ston yul gyi mtha' skor du thag rgya btang ba/ bkag sdom thag rgya/
'dom pa bzhi'i ring tshad yod pa'i bar thag / thag rgyang gcig gi rgyang 'ben/

1) gtan 'khel byed pa dang, nges nges byed pa/ sang nyin 'gro rgyur thag gcod pa/ don gnad ji yod tshang ma thag bcad zin/ tshogs 'du'i thog nas gros thag gcod pa/ rgyal pham thag gcod pa dka'/ 2) bar mtshams gcod pa/ 'brel thag bcad pa/ sems thag gcod pa/ 'o thag bcad pa/ re thag bcad pa/
(yul) thag pa sogs mkhregs po'i rigs 'tshem dus dgos pa'i lcibs mo che ba'i ming/
thag chig thog tu chod pa

ka dag khregs chod kyi sgom rim nyams su len tshul zhig ste, yul gyis ma bsgyur, 'dzin pas ma bslad, spang gnyen ma zhugs pa'i rig pa de nyid ji ltar 'dug kyang chos sku rang byung gi ye shes las ma 'das pa'o/

1) nges pa'am gtan 'khel ba/ thag chod rgyur bsad pa'i las don rnams thag chod pa/ 'gro rgyur thag chod pa/ med par thag chod pa/ min par thag chod pa/ 2) chod pa/ 'brel thag chod pa/ sems thag chod pa/ re thag chod pa/ thag ma chod pa'i don gnad de dag 'phral du thag gtsang mar gcod dgos/
don rtsa thag chod lugs brtan po/ phyogs gnyis kyi rtsod gleng 'khrun gcod skor la tshab tshub ma yin par thag chod lhing po byas 'dug /
thag pa'i steng nas mchong rgyag pa'i rtsed mo/ thag mchong rgyag pa'i rtsed mo/
dus sam, bar khyon rgyang thag nye ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la glo dang, nye 'khor, nye logs, tho 'khor, drung bcas so,
1) thag pa thung ngur btang ba/ 2) dus dang lam thag nye ru btang ba/
(yul) 1) chu 'khor gyi steng du btags pa'i lding rkyal nang gi yos rnams bkag gtong byed pa'i shing zhig / 2) sgra'i khyad par zhig /
dang thi gu'i bsdus ming ste: thag pa ring thung phra sbom spyi ming/
thag gi thug gi'i bsdus tshig
brkyangs pa'i thag pa tshur dril ba'i thag bsdogs/

1.tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'thag pa'i 'das pa, 2.sdom byed zhags pa/ bal thag / lcags thag / rtsid thag / ras thag / 'dogs khyi thag pas btags pa/ rtswa sar rta khal rnams thag pas brtod/ gru gzings thag pas 'then pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgril ma dang, 'ching thag thig gu , zhags pa bcas so,
1) thag pa dum bur chad pa/ 2) rgyun chad pa/ lag sne gtong dngul gyi thag pa chad pa/ 3) 'brel ba chad pa/ bar 'dum 'grig rgyu'i thag pa chad pa/
1) lag pas thag pa brgyangs te 'then pa/ 2) (yul) pho mo'i bar la tshul min gyi 'brel ba sbyor ba/
rkya bzhi leb mor bslas pa'i thag pa/
thag pa thur du glod pa/ brag ri gzar po'i steng nas thag dpyong gtong ba/
thag nye 'gyangs kyi tshad/ pe cin nas lha sa'i bar du thag ring thung ga 'dra 'dug /
bar thag ring po/ thag ring gi gnyen las thag nye'i khyim mtshes dga'/ sdod gnas thag ring por byed pa/ lang shor thag ring por spangs pa/ lam thag ring pos bcad pa/
thag ring du dpung dmag gtong 'jug /
gnyen po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, rnam grol gyi lam dang po sdug bsngal la chos shes ma gtogs pa de yan chad kyi khyad par gyi lam ste thob pa thag sring ba'o/
/ 1) ras snam sogs kyi thags/ ras thags/ snam bu'i thags/ thags kyi bkad/ thags kyi rgyu/ thags kyi spun/ thags kyi ran ma/ 2) gral lam star/ tshems kyi thags/
bkal btags kyi bar gseng hral zhib/ snam bu 'di'i thags rkang hral hral zhig las med/
snam bu sogs 'thag byed kyi sgrom stegs/
1) thags las byed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la tha ga pa dang thags ma'o, 2) (mngon) 'bu sdom/
thags 'thag byed kyi snal ma'am, rgyu spun gyi gru gu /
snam bu sogs 'thag byed kyi sgrom stegs/
'gal rkyen nam, bar chad/ 'gro lam du thags thogs byung ba/ las 'go brtsams nas thags thogs med par legs 'grub byung ba/
pa'i spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, khyim pa nye du ma yin pa la gla rngan ma byin par thags 'thag tu bcug pa'o/
ras snam sogs 'thag pa/ mi'i lag rtsal gyis thags 'thag pa/ 'phrul 'khor gyis thags 'thag pa/
ri mo btags yod pa'i dar gos sogs/
thags kyi rgyu skud bran 'then byed pa/ ras dang snam rigs 'thag pa'i sngon la snal ma thags bran dgos/
bar mtshams ral 'grig pa/ tshems thags bzang ba/
1) btags pa'i thags kyi ri mo/ snam bu la thags ran zhib po byung na mkhregs po yong/ thags ran bzang ba/ 2) (rnying) gos btags pa/

1. 1) sa cha gu yangs/ spang thang/ byang thang/ bye thang/ dpa' khog na yod na mtshon thang na yod/ thang gi rdo blangs nas rum gyi bro lhung/ 2) (rgya) sha sogs btsos pa'i khu ba/ rus thang/ nor bu bdun thang/ ma nu bzhi thang/ 3) rin gong/ yul thang/ 4) lan nam tshar/ thang cig 'gro myong/ 5) tshad gzhi/ mnga' thang/ dbang thang/ thob thang/ 2. 1) mun nag min pa/ khang pa 'di thang dkar po 'dug / char pa chad nas gnam thang song/ 2) kham khum min pa/ gnyer ma kham khum rnams thang sha gcod pa/ 3.yin mdog kha po/ kho'i gtam 'di bden na thang/
bya rgod/ thang dkar rgod po gshog rtsal 'dzoms pa khyod/ pha thang dkar rgod po la, bu khwa ta skyag zan skyes/
ras gzhi la bres pa'i sku/
spangs g.yo spyad ma btsem pa'i skyi ko'i snod
gi nang nas thon pa'i tshe dang ldan pa'i: khrag lta bu'i khu ba zhig /
ri mo bris yod pa'i ras sam shog bu bsgril nas dril chog pa'i rigs/
nad gang yang thog mar smin sdud 'byed pa la nus pa rno myur ldan pa ro'i las byed pa shas che ba thang gi sde ste, sman gang chol tsam brdungs nas chur skol ba'i khu ba khong du bsten dgos pa zhig /
1) thang ga'i 'go / 2) klung thang gi stod phyogs/

ring min thung ngu sna tshogs kyi rnam pa/ glu thang thung zhig thong/ dus yun thang thung zhig tu las ka byas nas phyin song,.. bud shing thang thung bsgrugs te log pa/ skud pa thang ngi thung ngi mang po yod/
(lab:) skad cig ma drug cu'i tshad yin par mngon pa las gsungs so/ thang cig tsam du bar chad byed pa/ thang cig tsam mi bde bar gnas pa/
thang sha gcod pa'i bsdus tshig
dka' las khag tsam byung ba/ dka' las byung nas thang chad de bar gyur pa/
shugs nyams pa/ lus thang chad pa/ yi thang chad pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngal ba dang, chad pa, nyon mongs, dub pa bcas so,
1) shug pa dang gsom shing sogs las bab pa'i tshi/ 2) gu gul dkar nag /
'khums pa bsangs te sangs pa/ snam rigs bkrus nas skam sa la thang chod par rgyang rgyag pa/
(rgya) srong btsan gyi btsun mo rgya bza' kong jo'i yab/
yun nan zhing chen gyi rgyal thang rdzong khongs 'bri chu'i 'gram du yod pa'i gru kha zhig /
sa thang stong pa/ thang stong skya mo/

mtshan dngos kam kam pa brtson 'grus bzang po yin zhing, rab byung drug pa'i shing glang lor gtsang stod kyi chab 'og ngam ring rdzong gi 'ol ka lha rtser 'khrungs shing, rje tsong kha pa dang dus mnyam, grub thob kyi snyan pa phyogs kun tu khyab, shangs pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin, rgya gar nag dang bod dbus gtsang khams sogs yul gru mang por phebs nas 'gro don mdzad, bod yul stod smad du lha khang dang lcags zam gru shan bcas mang du btsugs, lha ldan gyi lcags po rir lha khang bzhengs shing sman rgyal ri zhes mtshan gsol, bod kyi chos rgyal sogs kyi rnam thar zlos gar gyi lam nas ston pa deng sang a ce lha mo zhes grags pa'i 'khrab gzhung brtsams, gso ba rig pa'i skor la khong nad kun 'joms ril bu dkar po dang, gnyan rims 'joms byed ril bu dmar po sogs man ngag mang po mdzad, dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga pa rab byung dgu pa'i sa mo sbrul la gcung ri bo cher gshegs/
thang stong rgyal po'i slob ma/

1) dam dam mam grim grim/ snam bu rlon pa de thang thang byas nas 'then dgos/ 2) sra ba'am, mkhregs pa/ gzugs po thang thang yod skabs snang ba skyid po yong/ 3) ma chag pa'am ma grums pa/ lcags snod thang thang/
thang ngi thung ngi'i bsdus tshig
1) bya rgod thang nag / 2) thang shing gi bye brag cig /
sra ba'am, mkhregs po/ zam pa de thang po mi 'dug / gzugs po thang po 'dug /
1) ming gzhan sol nag thang po che zer te, 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi sa cha sngar bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal zhig / 2) thang chen po/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'jo mda' rdzong gi shar rgyud du yod/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la kha zhing tsha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas gag lhog 'josam ?, glang thabs gsod, ro tsa bar byed, dug shas che/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la bska zhing tsha ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas long srin 'joms, gag lhog la phan, dug shas che/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la bska zhing tsha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas srin nad dang lhog pa la phan, dug shas che/
khang pa med pa'i sder thang du mtshan mor sdod gnas/ nub mo grog shur zhig tu thang brang btab nas bzhugs pa/
grong las thag ring gi sa thang/
thang gi sbyor ba dang don gcig
/ 1) khod snyoms po/ 'bru 'bras thang mar brdal nas nyi ma la bskams pa/ 2) sra ba dang, mkhregs po/ bar lam sku gzugs thang ma yin shag /
ci dgar rgyu ba/ phyugs rigs rtswa kha bzang sar thang myul bag yangs su ci bder gtong ba/
thang shing gi bye brag cig /

1) gdus te khu ba 'thung rgyu'i sman rigs/ 2) rdza ri g.ya' gngas sogs ri rtse mtho sar skyes pa ma yin pa thang la shas cher skyes pa'i sman, rtsa ba rgyas shing lo sdong sogs lo rer shing ltar skye yang dgun dus rtsa ba ma gtogs sngo ltar rgas nas lo re bzhin brje ba ma nu dang, lcum lta bu'i rigs rtsa ba shing, sdong po ldum, lo ma sngo'i rang bzhin can la zer te, de la'ang btu ba'i tshe rtsa ba dang, lo ma, me tog 'bras bu ste bzhi po so sor dgos rigs dang, rtsa lo me 'bras bzhi ga dgos pa, lo sdong me 'bras bzhi'am sdong po dor ba'i gsum btu dgos pa'i rigs bcas mchis so/
1) bya rgod thang smug / 2) thang shing gi bye brag cig /
yud tsam/ thang tsam nas khyed rang 'di gar phebs rogs gnang/
thang shing gi rtsa ba'am sdong dum rul ba las chags pa'i shing las byung ba'i lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, ro lan tsha la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas 'bras nad 'dul/
thang la yod pa'i zhing ga/
sngar bod kyi bla chas nang gses dbyar zhwa zhig
rin thang 'jal ba/ ca lag 'di'i rin thang gzhal ba/
