(rgya) thang rgyal rabs skabs ho nan yan hri zhan du chu khyi lor 'khrungs, chung ngu nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan la shyan tsang zhes gsol, dgung lo nyer dgu pa nas nub phyogs kyi yul gru du ma brgyud de kha che dang rgya gar mtha' dbus kyi sa gnas mang por phebs, pandi ta du ma dang mjal, gtso bor shr'i na len dra'i mkhan chen 'dul ba bzang po las byams chos sde lnga'i skor dang, tshad ma mngon pa mdzod sogs zhib tu gsan nas byang chub par mdzad de dam bca' bzhag cing, bstan bcos kyang brtsams pas mkhas pa kun gyi thugs 'phrog par gyur, 'phags yul du ma ha ya na de war 'bod, rgyal po tshul khrims nyi ma sogs sa skyong mang po'i mchod gnas su gyur, rgya gar du lo bcu bzhi dang, phar tshur lam bar du lo gsum bcas lo bcu bdun 'gor ba dang, shing sbrul lor khrang an du phyir phebs, thang gi can ku'an rgyal pos bsnyen bkur rgya chen bgyis shing, ched du dgon pa dang sgyur grwa gsar btsugs kyis sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa dang byams chos kyis gtsos pa'i bka' bstan rgya dpe glegs bam drug brgya dang nga bdun gsar du bsgyur, 'gyur rnying mang po la 'gyur bcos dang, mdo sde 'ga'i tika, bstan bcos mang po gsar rtsom bcas mdzad de sems tsam pa'i lugs dar rgyas shin tu che ba byung ste rgya skad du thang zan tsang ste sde snod gsum 'dzin gyi slob dpon du grags, lo bzhi bcu tsam gyi ring 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad nas shing byi lor 'das/
1) rnam thar lo rgyus/ 2) kha chems/
lo pan bka' thang dang, btsun mo bka' thang, rgyal po bka' thang, blon po bka' thang, lha 'dre bka' thang bcas lnga'o/
sa cha thang stong kha yangs pa'am, thang kha rgya che ba/
ko ba sogs rlan skam du bcug ste 'then zhing 'khum rgyu med par bzo ba/ ko ba brgyangs te kham khum gyi thang sha gcod pa/
gzugs khams thang po/ mi 'di thang sha dod po zhig 'dug /
grwa pas phyag 'tshal ba'i dod dam, tshab/ thang shad lan gsum byas nas dgongs gsol zhu ba/
shing gi bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la bcud 'dzin dang, ljon pa ser po, thang chu shing, gsom shing bcas so,
thang shing las byung ba'i snum tshi/
byang gnyan chen thang lha ste gzhi bdag cig /
grim lhod dang dam lhod/ las ka byed skabs thang lhod ran po zhig dgos/ thag pas thang lhod snyoms por bsdams pa/ zog kha thang lhod/
gang de'i skor dang, phyogs/ las don 'de'i thad/ de'i rang bzhin thad kyi bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug / gang sa ci thad/ gang ci'i thad/

1. 1) mdun phyogs kha gtad dang, drang thad/ sgo'i thad ka/ khang pa'i thad ka nas 'ur sgra byung ba/ 2) logs sam, mtha' skor/ steng 'og dang thad ka/ thad ka'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ 2. drang po/ shar nas nub phyogs su thad kar 'gro ba/ dkar yol shugs kyis bskor nas 'khor yang chu rnams thad kar mi 'bo ba/ bsam 'char thad kar smras na go sla/ shing sdong thad kar gshog pa/
1) mtha' skor gyi ri/ 2) mdun phyogs kyi ri/
don thob la ma brtsis par skad dod ltar thad kar sgyur ba/
kha thug dang drang po/ rang gi mdun phyogs thad drang bar snang gi dbyings su gnam gru mang po lding skor rgyag pa/
drang thad du btags pa'i dpyangs thag /
mig gis dngos su mthong ba dang, yid kyis dngos su dran pa'i thad ka'i tshor ba/
skabs su bab pa'i mtshams/ las khur rang thog babs pa'i thad mtshams/
thad ka/ drang gtam thad sor bshad na go bde/
ltas ngan pa'am, bkra mi shis pa'i sngon ltas/
1) nye 'khor ram, nye logs/ khang pa'i than kor la chu yur dang, rtswa shing tshal zhing yod/ 2) mtha' skor/
than pa btang ba'i gnod pa/ than skyon bsal nas lo legs yong ba byed pa/
bkra mi shis pa'i gtam mam, 'phrin ngan bskur ba/ kun nas kun tu mi snyan pa'i than 'gyed pa/
nyung zad tsam mam, chang chung/ zas than thun tsam zos pa/
1) ltas ngan gtong ba'i 'dre/ 2) lo tog la gnod byed char pa 'bab mi 'jug pa'i 'dre/

/ 1) char pa yun ring mi 'bab pa/ yun ring po'i bar than pa chen pos lo tog dang rtswa'i tshogs kyang shin tu nyams par gyur/ than pa sngon 'gog / than pa btang ba/ lung pa 'dir chu rgyun thon khungs mang bas than pa ji tsam btang yang ston thog la gnod skyon byed thub kyi ma red/ ming gi rnam grangs la char 'gog dang, char med, char med steng 'bar, gnam gyi skyon, gnam gyi 'jigs pa, gnam gyi nyer 'tshe, gnam dmag mu ge skyed, tsha bas nyen, zhod kyi gegs bcas so, 2) bkra mi shis pa'i sngon ltas/
srin bya ste 'u gu chung dang, 'ug pa/
1) lo tog la than pa byung ba/ 2) ngan pa'i gtam thos pa/
chags sgo dang bkra mi shis pa/
me gtong sa'i thab/ lcags thab/ lto thab/ mgar thab/ ja thab/ sbyin sreg gi thab/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgyed pu dang, me thab, g.yos thab bcas so,

thab tu me gtong mkhan nam, zas g.yo mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la phyag tshang ba dang, ma byan, 'tshod byed pa, zan ma, zas gnyer, zas byed, g.yos dpon, g.yos ma, lag bde, lag bde'i dpon po bcas so,
thab dkyil gyi sa ste sa sman zhig /
thab nas me 'dzin byed kyi skam pa/
bla dpon phyogs thon dang, mna' ma mag pa thon skabs khyim nas bar thag le dbar kha shas kyi sar bza' btung bshams nas skyel ma byed pa/
thab steng gi me 'gro'i i khung/ mun nag nang nas rig rgyu dang, thab khung nang nas skye rgyu med/
thab chas zangs lcags kyi khro rigs/
me gtong sa'i ras gur ram, sbra gur/
me shing 'bud sa thab sgo'i phyogs/
thab kyi g.yas g.yon sogs nye 'gram/
1) thab chas 'jug sa'i sgam/ 2) me gtong sa'i thab/
nyam chung ltar snang yang, nus shugs che ba'i dpe/
1) thab bi thib bi'i bsdus tshig 2) grangs gnas shig
thab tshang nang gi thab chas dang gdan cha/
cog tse sogs phyis bdar gtong byed kyi ras snam sogs/

1) sprin 'thibs pa dang, gangs chen po 'thul ba'i tshul/ gnam thab bi thib bi'i dkyil nas kha ba thab bi thib bir bab pa/ 2) rig pa mi gsal ba'i tshul/ shes pa nyob ste thab bi thib bir gyur pa/ nad pa de'i rig pa thab bi thib bi yin pa/
'dzugs sa'i thab kyi khung bu:/ thab mig gsum yod pa'i lcags thab/
g.yos khang ngam, me khang/ ming gi rnam grangs la tshang bang dang, tshang mang, g.yos khang, bsro khang bcas so,
khyim 'dzin gyi 'tsho thabs sam, 'tsho rten/ thab tshugs ma zin pa/
khyim tshang btsugs te 'tsho skyong byed pa/
bsreg rdzas min pa me nang shor ba'i thab gzhob/
1) thab khang nang gi lag g.yog / 2) sngon bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dpon po phyogs 'grul gyi thab khang g.yog mkhan
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi skyid rong rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 4610 yod/
1) khyim shor ba'am, khyim stongs pa/ 2) sha sogs dmar rigs thab nang shor ba/
thab ka'i nang zas rigs bsregs pa'i dud pa/
thab kyi btsog pa sel thabs su bsangs gtong ba dang khrus byed pa/
thag nye ring gang 'os sar thab brgyab ste ja sogs 'dren pa'i phebs bsu/

tshul dang, cho ga'am lugs sam, srol/ 'tsho thabs/ sgrub thabs/ las ka byed thabs/ gzhan du 'gro thabs med/ rtsis kyi snon 'phri sgyur bgod de thabs bzhi/ stag bzhon nas gzhol thabs med pa/ mi'i rgyu nor thabs kyis len pa/ mgron thabs su spyan drangs/ thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la, g.yo sgyur thub pas ma gsungs so/
lam gzugs brnyan thabs kyi dkyil 'khor te, rdul tshon dang, ras bris dang, tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor rnams brda la brten dgos pas brda'i dkyil zhes kyang bya'o/
bya ba'i thabs shes kyi phyogs/
bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs thabs rgya che zhing mang ba dang, thabs la ma rmongs pa dang, thabs la dka' ba med pa sogs phar phyin theg pa las khyad par 'phags pas thabs kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/

tu phyin pa: pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i nang gses shig ste, dge ba'i rtsa ba mang nyung ci bsags pa cung zad yan chad kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por bsngos pas de'i 'bras bu dpag tu med pa zad mi shes par 'gyur ba'o/
1) las don sgrub sla ba'i byed phyogs/ 2) zla ba yar ngo'i phyogs/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed 'grub dka'i don zhig sgrub par skul ba'i thabs shes kyis 'gog par byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
las don byed tshul la mi rmongs pa/ las don byed thabs mkhas po yod pa/ thabs mkhas jus mang/
nang gi sangs rgyas kyi chos 'grub par bya ba'i tshul dang, phyi'i sems can smin par bya ba'i tshul la mkhas pa'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'o/
'phags pa thabs mkhas zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gnyis ldan/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, thabs la mkhas pa'i yul rnams mngon du byed pa la dus dang dus min shes pa'i sbyor ba'o/

dag pa sa gsum na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yod pa'i ye shes bcu ste, bdud bzhi las rgyal ba dang, don dam par mi gnas shing tha snyad du gnas pa, gzhan don sngon gyi smon lam gyi shugs kyis 'phen par byed pa, thun mong ma yin pa, chos thams cad la bden par rang bzhin med pa, bden par mi dmigs pa, mtshan ma med pa, smon pa med pa, phyin ci log bzhi las grol ba'i rtags, tshad med pa bcas kyi thabs mkhas sbyor ba rnams so/
thabs jus mang po/ kho rang mi gcig las lus med kyang thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas las don 'grub pa'i khur blangs pa/
lhan cig / nga gnyis thabs cig tu 'gro/ khong rnam pa tshang ma thabs cig tu bzhugs yod/
1) bya thabs zad pa/ dgra bo 'phrul thabs chag nas mgo bo sgur ba/ yod na des chog med na thabs chag / 2) thebs chag dang 'dra,
las don sgrub byed kyi tshul lugs/ thabs jus zab mo/ gang dga' ci legs kyi thabs jus sngon bting zin pa/
thabs zad pa'am, thabs med pa/ lam kha'i gad pa chad nas 'gro thabs rdugs pa/ 'tsho thabs rdugs pa/ mkhas pa ji ltar thabs rdugs kyang, blun po 'jug pa'i lam mi 'gro/
bsam gnag khrel med/ de 'dra'i thabs sdug pa la ang/ g.yo sgyu lang shor mi ngan thabs sdug po/
thabs jus mang po'i 'phrul thabs/ thabs 'phrul sna tshogs kyis gzhan mgo ma skor/
las don sgrub byed kyi thabs med pa/ las don sgrub pa'i thabs bral ba rang ma red/
thabs dang blo gros gting nas bskyed pa/ thog mtha' bar gsum du thabs blo zhe bskyed byas pa/

byed stangs zad pa/ dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs nas gang 'tshams kyi spor gcog mi byed thabs med pa/ rgyun mi 'chad par slob sbyong mi byed thabs med dang, rang gi skyon cha rim gyis mi sel thabs med red/
1) las ka byed stangs tan teg / nges par du thabs btsan po zhig yod dgos/ 2) drag po'i las thabs/ thabs btsan pos drag gnon btang ba/
las don sgrub byed kyi lugs/ kho pas spyod pa'i thabs tshul de, kho pa rang nyid myong du 'jug /
1) byus 'ding ba/ dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas su gtong ba'i thabs 'tshol ba/ 2) don du gnyer ba/ tshong pas khe bzang yong thabs 'tshol ba/
bya thabs rdzogs nas med pa/ brtson 'grus mi byed mkhan la rig rtsal slob pa'i thabs zad pa/
1) jus sam, 'jug sgo/ lugs mthun gyi thabs lam/ 2) gsang sngags kyi lam/
1) byed stangs sam jus/ thabs shes 'jam po/ thabs shes mkhas pa/ 2) thabs sems bskyed sogs dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ 3) (mngon) thabs dang shes rab gnyis su nges pas grangs gnyis mtshon/
thabs snang ba'i cha dang, shes rab stong pa'i cha gnyis so/
1) thabs dang, shes rab gnyis phan tshun sbrags pa/ 2) thabs byang chub kyi sems dang shes rab stong pa nyid gnyis ya ma bral ba/
/ 1) dam phrug / tham ka dmar po/ 2) dam phrug phab yod pa'i yi ge/ bka' tham rin po che spyi bor phebs pa/
dam phrug gi kha ris yi ge
1) am gtsigs bsdams pa/ so tham tham byas nas dka' tshegs bzod thabs byed pa/ grang ba ma bzod par so tham tham byed pa/ tshig pa zos te so tham tham byed pa/ 2) so tham tham pa'i bsdus tshig
tham me thom me'i bsdus tshig
bcu 'gyur gyi grangs ka'i mtha' rten/ bcu tham pa/ brgya tham pa/ brgya tham pa'i kha khebs kyang, stong tham pa'i mig mi khebs/
gzhung dam phab pa'i yi ge/ bka' yig tham 'byar ma/ 'dzin shog tham 'byar ma/
lus sems bzi 'khyom du gyur pa'i tshul/ chang gis bzi nas tham me thom mer gyur pa/ mi tham me thom me/
tham ga la byug rgyu'i mtshal/

tshang ma'am yod tshad/ mi grangs thams cad tshang 'dug / rnam pa thams cad du 'gal ba med pa/ bsam 'char thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa/ gnas lugs thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun dang, cha tshang, sna tshod, ma lus, tshang ba, zad pa, yod tshad, lus med, lhag med bcas so,
1) mang po'i nang gi zhan shos/ ca lag ngan hrul 'di dngos po thams cad kyi tha ma red/ 2) grangs du ma yod pa'i rjes ma/ yong mkhan mi thams cad kyi tha ma kho rang red/
tshang ma thams cad/ mi thams cad kyi thams cad/
tshang ma'i nang gi rjes ma/ kho rang gcen gcung thams cad kyi mtha' ma chung tha red/
tshang ma'i nang gi thog ma/ bkra shis rtags brgyad thams cad kyi dang po rin po che'i gdugs/ rgyal srid sna bdun thams cad kyi dang po 'khor lo rin po che/ gza' thams cad kyi dang po gza' nyi ma/
«bishwabhukra» sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
sa bcu rim gyis 'das te sangs rgyas kyi sar ye shes bzhi dang sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs shig /
thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa
rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge srung gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
«sarbadzny'a:» chos thams cad ji bzhin gzigs pa'o/
stong pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /

ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs: lam 'ga' zhig rgyal ba nyid du 'gro ba dang, lam 'ga' zhig rang rgyal gyi byang chub dang, nyan thos kyi byang chub tu 'gro ba dang, lam 'ga' zhig ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro sogs su 'gro ba'i lam yang dag pa dang log par nges pa'i lam rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa ste stobs bcu'i nang tshan zhig /
1) dong du bcug pa/ 2) btson rar bcug pa/
(sog) sngar sog po'i go sa'i ming zhig /
(rgya) rab mchog dang gtso bo'i bdag po/
1) sgra'i khyad par/ snod kyi nang nas sran ma thar thar du sar 'thor ba/ 2) spus ka'am, rkang zhan pa/ snam bu 'di thar thar zhig las mi 'dug /
tho ba kha dbyibs gru bzhi can/
tha re tho re'i bsdus tshig

'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyis sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgyad cu gnyis pa rgya nag gi 'gyur/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha la mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas gnyan nad sogs tsha grang gnyis ka'i nad rnams thur du sbyong bar byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la khu ba ldan dang, char 'bab, nye ba'i ri mo can, tha dad phreng ldan, bde byed ma, bu'i phreng ldan, byi ba'i lo ma bcas so,

bcings pa las grol ba ste 'khor bar 'ching byed las dang nyon mongs gnyis yongs su spangs pa'i cha/ ming gi rnam grangs la grol ba dang, nges legs, 'chi med, don dam, rdul bral, rdul med, rnam grol, spangs pa, byang grol, byang chub pa, mya ngan 'das, myang 'das, zhi ba, yang srid med bcas so,
nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog bden thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas skabs kyi lam ste tshogs lam/
pa'i rjes su mthun pa: thar pa cha mthun dang don gcig
tshogs lam gyi yan lag lnga dang don gcig
sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, chos mthun gyi bya ba sgrub pa'o/
(tha mi dad pa) grol ba dang 'chor ba/ ri bong rgya las thar te rang tshang du log / chu las thar nas skam sar slebs/ tshe thar gtong ba/ lam gzhi nyil nas thar ma song/ nad las thar ba/
grol zin pa/ nad thar ma/ lha 'brum thar ma/
dngul bzo ba'i lag cha zhig /
'khor ba las thar pa'i lam ste, nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i lam/
tshogs lam dang, sbyor lam, mthong lam, sgom lam, mi slob lam bcas lnga/

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam bshad thar lam phyin ci ma log par gsal bar byed pa zhes pa'i bsdus ming, rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel ba/
yul gcig nas yul gzhan du thar ba'i lam/ zam pa chad nas gtsang po'i phar phyogs la thar sa mi 'dug /
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas pags nad sel, chu ser skem, srin nad gsod/
1) sngo dkar/ glang chen thal kar mche ba drug ldan/ 2) (mngon) glang chen/
chos kyi rtsod pa byed pa'i thog mar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sa bon dhi: yig skad mthon por sgrog pa'i skad/ dhi:...
tshad las brgal ba'i skyon/ phar sprod tshur len gyi byed sgo tshang ma thal skyon med pa/

tshad las brgal ba dang tshad ma zin pa/ gzhung sger gyi 'gro song gang btang tshang mar thal 'khums kyi hang zom med pa/ rgyu mtshan khungs thub gzhir bzung gis thal 'khums med par rtsod gleng byed pa/
phrag tshigs nas mjing tshigs bar gyi cha shas de'i ming/
thal gong rgyas pa'i mtshan bzang
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, sman la sogs pa byin pas thal gong rgyas pa/

phyogs snga sun 'byin par mi 'dod pa'i thal ba 'phen pa'am, rgol phyi rgol gnyis la mthun snang grub nges kyi tshul gsum 'god pa'i ngag dper na, sgra rtag par 'dod pa'i gang zag gi ngor, sgra chos can, ma byas par thal, rtag pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sun 'byin pa dang, yang na, sgra chos can, mi rtag pa yin par thal, byas pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu tshul gsum tshang ba'i ngag go/
sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur gyi chos gsum ste, rtags phyi rgol gyi bden zhen gyis khas len pa, ldog khyab tshad mas grub pa, dam bca' la tshad mas bsal ba zhugs pa bcas so/

phyi rgol gyis tshur thal ba 'phangs pa la rgol bas skyon spong gi lan 'debs pa ste, thal 'gyur yang dag la lan gyis bzlog mi nus kyang, thal 'gyur ltar snang la 'gal ma nges ma grub sogs kyi skyon dang ldan pas der dngos lan brjod pa'o/
lan gyis bzlog par nus pa'i ngag ste rtags ma grub pa'am, ma khyab pa, khyab pa 'gal ba, 'dod bcas kyi lan 'debs nus pa'o/
rtags ma grub pa dang, khyab pa 'gal ba dang, khyab pa ma nges pa dang, 'dod lan thebs pa ste bzhi'o/

1) thal ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba/ 2) thal 'gyur tsam gyis phyir rgol gyi rgyud la bsgrub bya rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skye bar 'dod pas na thal 'gyur ba zhes brjod pa ste, slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyang dang zla ba grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin gyis ma grub par gtan la phab cing tha snyad 'jig rten grags pa dang mthun par stong dang rten 'byung 'gal med zung 'jug gi grub mtha' smra ba'i dbu ma pa zhig /
lan gyis bzlog mi nus pa'i thal ba 'phen: pa'i ngag ste thal 'gyur 'god yul gyi blo ngor rtags dang khyab pa grub cing, dam bca' la tshad mas bsal ba 'bab pa'i rtad ston pa'i thal ngag rnam dag go/
sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dang, sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur te gnyis so/
1) thogs med du 'gro ba/ nya mo chu'i nang du thod thug med par thal rgyugs su 'gro ba/ 2) ma brtags pa'i 'gro stangs/ 'gro lam bde min la ma bltas par rang gar thal rgyugs su 'gro ba/
rtags su bkod de mi 'dod pa'i thal ba 'phen: pa'i ngag ste dper na, sgra rtag par 'dod pa'i ngor, sgra chos can, ma byas par thal, rtag pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
thal mos brgyab pa'i lcag / thal lcag: gzhus pa
tshad las brgal ba'i skyon cha/ gtam thal cha chen po ma shod/ phan tshun 'khrug zing slong ba'i thal cha ma bzo/ 'khrug pa shor nas thal cha chen po btang song/
mi ro bsregs pa'i thal ba/
rtsig khug tu spungs pa'i thal ba/

bee sngon du lug ru ser po dang, shel phreng du lug ru smug po la ngos 'dzin mdzad, gzhan du utpal la'ang 'jug / ming gi rnam grangs la klu yi lce dang, sngo sangs 'khri shing, sngo sangs mtha' yas, mtha' yas rtsa, ba glang srung, me tog phra mo, sa 'tsho bu mo bcas so,
mtshams tshod ma zin pa dang,
thal rdul ring du chags pa'i dreg pa
yun ring du chags pa'i thal rdul/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) tshad las brgal ba/ kha thal/ gtam de thal drags song/ phyi thal nang 'khums med pa/ tshig thal/ 2) song ba dang phyin pa/ gar thal gtol med/ yar thal mar thal/ yal thal ba/ rim gyis je nyung du thal/ lo lnga bcu thal/ 3) shar mar 'gro ba/ brag la phar thal tshur thal du 'gro ba/ mar gyi zangs thal du 'gro ba/ yar gyi zangs thal du 'gro ba/ 2. 1) skyon cha/ thal ba 'phen pa/ 2) rnyog ma'am, lhag ma/ go thal/ thug thal/ bya thal/ zhum bu'i skyag par thal ba'i khebs g.yogs/ thal ba spungs pa/ gang sa gang la thal ba langs pa/
(yul) sna tha la bsre rgyu'i shing thal/
thal rdul dkar po chags tshul/ bsgrigs bkod kyi yo byad rnams la rdul phyis ma brgyab pas thal ba skya chags su khebs pa/
thal rdul lang tshul zhig / gad chu ma gtor na gad bdar byed dus thal ba chil chil lang yong/
phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' ba zhig /

pha rol po'i rgyud kyi log rtog sun 'byin pa dang, log smra tshar gcod pa'i phyir du, rtags khyab tshad ma'am khas blangs kyis grub pa bkod nas mi 'dod pa sgrub pa, dper na, sgra rtag par 'dod pa'i phyi rol pa sun 'byin pa'i phyir du, sgra chos can, ma byas par thal, rtag pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu 'dod pa rtags su bkod nas mi 'dod par thal ba 'phen pa'o/
thal ba long long/ rlangs 'khor phyin shul du thal ba bun bun du lang yong/
rtsa med du 'gro ru 'jug pa'i dpe/ dgra bo'i mi rta tshang ma thal ba rlung bskur bzhin du rtsa med du song 'dug /
nyes pa'am, skyon gyi phyod su lhung ba/ de ltar u tshugs byas na skyon du thal bar 'gyur/
rdul phran tsam du gtor ba/ dgra dmag thal bar brlag pa/ brag ri thal bar brlag pa/
thogs med du byung ba/ snyung bu rnon pos pang leb thal byung du phug nas bug pa 'don pa/ nyi 'od khang pa'i nang du thal byung du phog pa/
1) thogs med du 'gro ba/ dpa' bo snying stobs can gyis dgra la 'jigs snang med par g.yul sar thal byung du 'gro ba/ 2) (mngon) dpa' bo/
thal mo'i nang ngos phan tshun sbyar ba/ lag pa thal sbyar gyi gus 'dud zhu ba/
thad ka/ me mda'i shud kyis rtsig pa thal mar phug 'dug /

lag pa'i sor mo ther ther du gshibs te bsgrengs pa'i bzo dbyibs/ thal mo gan rkyal du bstan pa/ thal mo rdeb pa/ thal mo snun pa/ thal mo bsnol ba/ thal mo sbyar ba/ thal mo brdabs sgra drag char btang ba ltar sgrog pa/
thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag rgya ste gus pa'i nyams/
bad kan rang rgyud can gyis bskyed pa'i grang ba'i nad gtso cher sel ba'i phyir lan tshwa dang cong zhi lta bu me la nus ldan bsregs pa'i thal ba/
shing sna dang ldum sogs mer bsregs pa'i thal ba las bzos pa'i tshwa rigs te, ro lan tsha la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas grang ba sel, pho ba sbos pa 'joms/
thal rdul dor sa'i sa khung ngam tshang/
thal ba'i 'tshub long/ thal 'tshub mang po lang ba/ thal 'tshub 'phyur ba/
bar snang du 'khor ba'i thal rdul gyi mdangs zhag
ha cang dpa' thal che drags pa'i 'gal 'khrul/ thal zing 'gal 'dzol du ma song ba'i bab lhing brtan po zhig dgos/
dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang, rang rgyud pa'i bsdus ming/
thal ba dang 'dres pa'i lhags pa/
thal 'gyur gyi lan gyi bsdus tshig
thal lan rnam thar sgo bzhi

phyi rgol gyis thal ba 'phangs pa la thal 'gyur ltar snang gi rigs bzhi yod pa der lan 'debs tshul rnam pa bzhi ste, rtags ma grub pa dang, khyab pa 'gal ba dang, khyab pa ma nges pa dang, 'dod lan thebs pa bcas so/
phar thal tshur lus kyis 'khyar ba/ gzhan 'khyar thal lus med pa/ thal lus he bag med pa/

1) sgrib med dam thogs med/ ri rtser rtswa shing med par thal le bar 'dug / mdun dang rgyab med par phyogs thams cad du thal ler bar gzigs pa/ 2) ya yo 'khyag 'khyog med pa/ lam chen po de thal le bar btod 'dug / 3) kha dog skya shas che ba mngon tshul zhig / sa skya thal le ba/
skyong ljongs snye mo rdzong nas thon pa'i: shog bu dman gras thal mdog can zhig /
thag pa phra mo/ lag zung phyin ci log tu thi gus bcings 'dug /
sbom po min pa'i thag pa khra bo/ sngar dug sbrul khra bos srog bcad pas da thi gu khra chung la yid mi ches/
las don 'thus shor gyi dpe/ las don tshang ma thi gu sne shor med pa/
de sho legs dang klu sman mer mo gnyis kyi sras, sngar bod rgyal bcu gnyis pa ste sa'i legs drug gi ya gyal zhig
skud pa lta bur bris pa'i ri mo:/ tshangs thig / zur thig / rtsa thig / zlum thig / kyog thig / nag thig / mtshal thig /
sgor mo'i dbyibs can gyi ri mo/
thig rgyag byed kyi thig sa blug snod/
thig rgyag byed kyi skud pa/
thig sa blug snod kyi khug chung/
yi ge'i thig rtsa/ yi ge'i thig sgrom/
thig skud kyis thig rgyag pa/ pang leb 'dra ba'i sngon du gdung ma la thig gdab pa/

brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste: lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng du gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sems can de'i lus la thig nag po bzhi brgyad sogs btab pa'i steng du lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas dra bar byed cing de ltar yang yang du gshog cing gcod pas sdug bsngal ba'o/
shing bzo ba'i thig skud dang snag bum

1. (tha mi dad pa) tshad shes pa'am tshad 'dzin thub pa/ tshod thig pa/ 2. mo dang, lung bstan sogs don thog tu 'khel ba/ lung bstan thig pa 'dug / spyir btang du gnam gshis sngon brda btang ba rnams thig pa yod/
don thog tu 'khel ba'i thig pa dang 'dra,
thig rgyag byed kyi yo chas/
shing bzo ba'i thig skud kyi snod snag bum/
/ 1) bkal btags rigs la yod pa'i thig le'i ri mo/ btags ma dkar po thig ma can/ 2) tshos ma thig le'i ri mo can/ thig ma dkar po/
khang pa dang yo byad lha sku sogs bzo skrun byed par thig gdab tshul bshad pa'i dpe cha'i ming/
cha tshad/ thig tshad len pa/ thig tshad rob len/
1) thig rgyag byed kyi rdul tshon/ 2) thig dang tshon/ ri mo'i thig tshon legs pa/
rngon pa sogs 'khrab dus gyon rgyu rked pa nas thur du dpyong pa'i thi gu khra bo'i dra ba/
1) btags ma sogs kyi thig le'i ri mo/ 2) thig brgyab pa'i ri mo/
ri mo la brten nas rgyag pa'i rtsis/

/ 1) klad kor/ 2) grangs gnas 'dzin byed kyi thig le/ ming gi rnam grangs la stong pa dang nam mkha'o, 3) nying khu/ snying gi thig le/ 4) gsang sngags las gsal ba'i rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i thig le ste bde ba chen po'i snying po'am sa bon du gyur pa, rtsa rnams kyi gnas su dwangs snyigs sna tshogs kyi rnam par gnas pa'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la kunda dang, khams dkar po, khu ba, dwangs ma, sa bon bcas so,
dkyil du thig le gcig dang de'i phyogs bzhir thig le re yod pa/
1) nyi ma'i rta bdun gyi ya gyal zhig / 2) (mngon) glang po che/
thig le stong pa'i sgron ma
sgron ma bzhi'i nang gses, dbyings rig 'char ba'i rnam pa rtsol byed kyi rten no/
khu ba rang bzhin du shor ba/
(yul) rgya lu chas kyi phor shubs/

cung zad cung zad zags nas 'bab pa'i rlan gyi rigs/ snum thigs/ chu thigs/ char thigs/ sdong thigs sam mchod thigs rgyag pa/ phyi char pa'i char thag chod kyang, nang thigs pa'i thigs thag chod mi yong/ thigs pa rgyag pa/ thigs pa bsags pa'i rgya mtsho, phra rab spungs pa'i ri bo/ kha bshad chu yi lbu ba, lag len gser gyi thigs pa/
khang thog nas thigs pa rgyag sar bya rgyu'i bcos tshags/ char dus ma shar gong nas o kha thigs tshad nan tan byed dgos/
thigs pa bzed sa'i snod spyad/
(yul) gos sogs ral che ba'i rnam pa/ gos kyang thid ral 'phrul 'phrul zhig /
chu'i thigs pa 'gog byed kyi sa/

dngos po'i ngo bo dang, bya spyod sogs kyi rnam pa ston byed tshig grogs shig / mtshan mo nag thing thing du mi long rta long la bzhon te g.yang sar kha gtad nas rgyug pa/ ri khrod 'jam thing thing zhig la gcig pur gnas pa/ dgun dus khang pa dro thing thing gi nang du ngal gso ba/ za nyes 'thung nyes kyis rkyen pas grod pa na thing thing byas byung/ rtswa thang sngo thing thing/ nam mkha' sngo thing thing/
(tha mi dad pa) things pa, thing ba,, slebs pa'am, son pa/ lag tu things pa/ snyan du things pa/ grang lhags dpe med rus par yang things pa/
chu bya mdog dkar zhing, rkang pa dmar la, skad snyan pa zhig /
(rgya) sngo sman zhig nus pas tshad pa 'jags pa dang, dri chu 'byin pa, lud pa sel ba sogs la phan/
mun pa/ smag rum thib pa'i khrod du mgo bo 'thom nyen yod/
mun pa/ mtshan mo thib bu/
grib ma stug po/ shing nags thibs po'i nang du 'dzul nas 'gro lam nor/
sprin dang, mun pa, kha char sogs 'khrigs tshul lam, bab stangs shig / sprin pa thibs se 'khor/ mun nag thibs se 'thibs/ kha char thibs se bab/
(tha mi dad pa) nub pa/ chu bye ma'i nang du thim pa/

/ 1) chang gi rdza ma'i gsham gyi i khung/ mgo rdza ma'i nang du bcug thim bu la chas bkag pa ste, mi tshang mas ha go ba'i skad cha de khyod kyis da dung ma shes pa gang red ces gshe ba'i gtam/ 2) (yul) lo tog brngas zin pa'i shul gyi snye ma/
chang gi rdza ma'i thim bu 'gog byed kyi shog bu'am so ma ra tsa/
'chi ba'i rtags kyi snang ba ste, 'byung ba thim rim dang, snang mched thob gsum gyi snang ba 'char ba'o/
gsar du kha 'bus pa'i me tog gi thi'u/
(yul) chu tshod sogs kyi ting ting gi sgra bsgrags pa/
thir brda sgrog rgyu yod pa'i chu tshod/
(sog) hor sog lugs kyi dmag zhwa'i bye brag cig
ngan pa/ khyi thu po/ mi thu po/ khrims thu po/
1.gos kyi thu ba/ shing tog thu ba'i nang du blugs pa/ thu ba nang ma/ thu ba che ba/ 2.lhag pa'am, ngan pa/ nang dgra de rnams phyi dgra las kyang thu ba 'dug /
/ 1) gtso bo/ sras kyi thu bo/ 2) phu bo dang rgan pa/ sku mched lnga'i thu bo/
sngar sambho ta 'khrungs sa'i bod thon yul gyi rus shig

srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi blon po zhig ste, na gzhon dus su rgyal po'i bka' bzhin rgya gar du byon nas sgra rig pa dang chos sbyangs, bod du log rjes samskrita'i sgra gdangs dang bod skad kyi sgra gdangs la brtag dpyad byas te bod yig gsar gtod dang brda sprod pa'i gzhung brtsams, sangs rgyas kyi chos thog mar bsgyur ba sogs phyag rjes shin tu che bas 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi par bsngags so, de yang thu mi zhes pa ni rus ming dang, sam bho ta ni bod mkhas pa zhes rgya gar pas brtsi bkur byas pa'i mtshan zhig yin no/
1) (sog) sog po o rod tsho bzhi'i ya gyal zhig / 2) (yul) thabs med dam ka med/ mi shod thu med/ khas mi len thu med/
drag po dang gtum po/ nad thu mo/ khyi thu mo/ khrims thu mo/ bka' khra gtan tshigs thu mo che/
1) shing bu'i thur ma/ 2) rgya ma chung chung/
rgyun nam, bar ma chad pa/ mig gis thu rer lta ba/ dran pa thu re brtan pa/
(yul) phyu pa'i thu ba/ bang med kyang thu la gzengs gzengs/
thur du 'bab tshul dang, gyen du 'phyur tshul zhig / kha ba skya thu lu lu babs/ du ba sngo thu lu lu 'phyur/ spos kyi dri zhim thu lu lu khyab pa/
kha'i mchil ma/ khros te thu lud 'debs pa/ thu lud ltar dor ba/
1) tho ba/ lcags kyi thu lum/ shing gi thu lum/ 2) gong bu/
(yul) bod chas kyi thu ba steng ma/
(yul) bod chas kyi thu ba nang ma/
gos kyi thu ba'i sgab gsham/
/ 1) dgon sde khag gi khang thog gi rgyan zhig / 2) 'bras bu ma bton pa'i ra lug / ra thug / lug thug /
thug pa'i skal ba gtong rgyugs/
1) dngos po gnyis phan tshun 'phrad nas grag pa'i sgra/ 2) sgra'i khyad par zhig / 3) thug pa 'thung ba'i hub sgra/
lha khang gi thog kha'i thug bzo byed kyi rnga rtsid/
thug chom zhes pa'i sgra'i khyad par zhig /
thug pa 'thung skabs kyi mchod pa/
lha khang gi thog kha'i thug nag skud pa ljang gu can/
thog kha'i thug dang dar lcog /
thug pa'i rdzas te sha rus sogs lta bu/

1.(tha mi dad pa) reg pa dang, 'phrad pa/ 'bu de glog la thug tsam gyis shi yong/ dka' las khag po dang thug pa/ grogs po thug pa/ mthar thug pa/ sang zhogs nga gnyis yud tsam zhig thug dgos/ gdong thug gis 'thab 'dzing byed pa/ 2.zas shig / rnyog gra thug pa nang bzhin bskol yong/ rgya thug / rtsam thug / 'bras thug / bag thug / ming gi rnam grangs la skyo thang dang, skyo tsa, khyab byed, 'jam thug phye thug bcas so,
(rgya) thug pa'i bye brag lheb gtubs shig
thug pa dang, 'phrad pa/ dgra bo'i dmag sde dang thug 'phrad byung ba/ ma bu phan tshun thug 'phrad byung mtshams dga' nas mig chu shor ba/
srog chags sman gyi nang tshan ra thug dang, lug thug sogs kyi rlig 'bras te, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas khu ba zad pa dang, ro tsa nyams pa sogs la phan/
1) gcig gis gcig la thug pa med pa/ 2) mthar thug pa med pa/ 3) «asamanta:» grangs gnas shig /
phan tshun phrad pa'i mtshams/ drang thig gnyis kyi thug mtshams/ thag sne thug mtshams/
thug pa blug byed gzar bu/
1) mthar thug pa med pa/ 2) grangs gnas shig /
1.blo dang, yid dang, sems kyi zhe sa/ thugs dgyes pa/ thugs skyo ba/ 2.ming gi sngon du sbyar ba'i zhe sa'i tshig grogs shig / thugs dogs/ thugs sems/
brlabs pa'i bka' gsum: thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang, thugs thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa dang, thugs bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa ste gsum/
dom mkhris kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig
1) gzhan phan gyi sems bskyed de byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ 2) gzhi rgya che ba'i bya ba bsgrub 'dod dang, sgrub phod pa'i snying stobs bskyed pa/

brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams nas gyen du tshon gang bcal, de nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su tshon re dang phun re bcal, de'i steng tshon gang bcal ba'i sar yod pa'i glo bu thugs khab kyi stong pa'i gsang sa zhig /
1) do khur dang, do snang/ thugs khur gzab bzhes gnang ba/ 2) las 'gan dang, 'gan khur/ rang 'khri'i 'os 'gan tshang mar thugs khur che bzhes gnang gin 'dug /
1) do khur byed pa/ 2) 'gan len pa/
las 'gan rkang len/ las don 'di'i skor la khong rang gis thugs khur gtsor bzhes gnang ba/

1) sems ngal/ thugs khral tshad med gnang ba/ 2) sems sdug / bzhed don 'ga' zhig rkyen dbang gis ma grub pas thugs khral gnang ba red/ 3) gzhan skyon mthong bas sems mi bde bar 'gyod pa/ bsgo ba rnar gzon gyi bu la pha mas thugs khral gnang ba/
tshig pa za ba dang sems mi bde bar gyur pa/ rkyen phra mo res kyang thugs 'khrugs pa/
'dun pa dang sems kyi bsam mno/
1) nga rgyal/ thugs rgyal 'khrungs pa/ 2) khong khro/ don med thugs rgyal bzhengs pa/
1) sems kyi rgyun/ 2) sems kyi gshis ka'am, rang bzhin/ thugs rgyud sgam po/
1) yi thang chad pa/ pham nyes byung yang thugs ngal ma gnang/ 2) mya ngan byung ba/ mdza' grogs gshegs pas thugs ngal mdzad pa/

sangs rgyas kyi 'bras chos nyer lnga'i nang gses shig rnying ma'i gzhung du bshad pa'i mi rtog chen po'i thugs dang, mnyam pa chen po'i thugs, 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs, mi phyed rdo rje'i thugs, mngon byang gi thugs te lnga'o/
sun po/ khyed rang la thugs ca zing po zhus song/ de 'dra thugs ca zing po ma gnang/
sems dkrugs pa/ bab col gyi snyad snyod mang pos khong gi thugs bcad pa ma legs/
blor nges pa'am, khong du tshud pa/ phyag dpe 'di'i nang don mtha' dag khong gi thugs chud zin pa/
yid ches pa/ ngas las 'gan bsgrub thub pa der khong thugs ches pa gnang ste mnyes po byung song/
sems thag chod po/ rang gi sku srog kyang phangs med gtong nus pa'i thugs chod po ha las pa zhig red/
snying rje/ thugs rje can/ thugs rje chu bo dang 'dra ba/ bka' nyes thugs rje gang che/
1) snying rje che/ 2) bka' drin che/ sem kyi gting nas thugs rje che zhu ba/ brtse bas rtag tu bskyangs pa thugs rje che/

1) mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la phan bde sgrub pa'i dgongs pas gdul bya'i khams la dus rtag tu gzigs shing sdug bsngal sogs las skyob par mdzad pa ste, zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi nang gses shig / 2) spyan ras gzigs thugs rje chen po'i bsdus tshig /
thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal
spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal/
brlabs pa'i bka': thugs kyis byin brlabs bka' gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
snying rjes yongs su zin pa/ dus rtag tu thugs rjes zin pa/
snying rjes dgongs par mdzod/ da res lan gcig zhal bzhes thugs rjes gzigs rogs gnang/
pa'i cho 'phrul: nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gnyen po ston pa, cho 'phrul gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
skyes chen dam pa kha shas kyi sku gdung bzhu ba na, snying dang lce mig gsum ma tshig par lus pa thugs gsung sku mtshon byed kyi gdung rten/
'dun pa'am, don gnyer/ sku yon thugs gnyer mdzad pa/
gyi cho 'phrul: sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul gsum gyi nang gses, thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul/
thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'
sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'i nang gses shig ste, lha dang, klu dang, gnod sbyin sogs kyis rang rang gi sngags smras pa sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'o/
thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mdo
shes rab snying po lta bu'o/
thugs brtag mo phywa'i zhe sa
/ legs nyes ci 'ong thugs brtag zhus pa/
1) gtan khel ba/ mtshon cha khyer nas 'thab 'dzing bya rgyur thugs thag chod pa/ 2) re ba chad pa/ blo kha ma khug kyang thugs thag chod mi 'dug /
gyis brlabs pa'i bka': thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang don gcig
rang dbang du longs spyad pa/
sems mthun zhing kha 'cham pa/ phan tshun thugs mthun zhal 'cham byung/
1) dam bca'/ ji ltar thugs dam zhal bzhes ltar gnang ba/ 2) nyams bzhes/ 3) mo/ thugs dam brtag pa/ 4) yi dam/
bka' sdod dam can rnams kyi thugs re rdzogs par byed pa/
thugs rgyud kyi nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba/
thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya
thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi bsdus tshig,
thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor
nyon yid kyi glo bur gyi 'khrul ba bsal nas rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du bya ba ste, rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
1) yid tshim pa'am, sim po/ bzhed don thams cad lhun gyis grub pas thugs bde po byung song/ 2) blo sems bag phebs/
rang skyon ngos len pa'i don/ nga rang gis nyes song bas dgongs dag thugs bden/

gyis brlabs pa'i bka': sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'i nang gses shig ste, sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyi mthus ri dang, shing dang, nam mkha' dang, 'od zer dang, rol mo sogs las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba lta bu'o/
1) re ba dang 'dod pa/ 2) mos pa/
sems gtsang ma'am, sems bzang po/
yid snang skyo ba'i zhe sa/ thugs snang skyo bas spyan chab bsil ba/
sems la do snang ma shar ba/ bya spyod bzang ngan la thugs snang med pa ma gnang/
phan tshun sems mthun pa/ zhe 'khon med pa'i thugs snang gshin pa yod/
1) dga' ston nam, gsol tshigs/ 2) sems skyid po'am, sems dga' ba/ bzhed don gtsang mar ma grub gong du khong thugs spro bag phebs ga la yong/
sems skyo zhing yang yang dran pa/
/ yul ljongs kyi bkod pa mdzes pas thugs 'phrog pa/
blo'i tshugs ka bde zhing lhod pa/
brel ba tsha po/ thugs brel ma gnang yud tsam bzhugs/ thugs brel ma mdzad/
1) sems lhod yangs med pa/ 2) mi brjed pa/
sems la ma bab pa'am, mi mos pa/
thugs bden zhes pa ste, rang gi nyes skyon ngos len pa'i don/ rang nyid kyis 'grig mi 'dug pas thugs mad lags/
sems skyo ba dang, yi mug pa/ bzhed don ji bzhin ma 'grub kyang thugs mug gnang mi dgos/
1) smon lam/ sku gzugs bde thang yong ba'i thugs smon 'debs pa/ 2) 'dun pa dang mos pa/
bka' bkyon drag po gnang shag shag gi thugs gnyan po/
'tsher snang byas pa/ zas za 'dod kyang thugs 'dzems gnang nas ma bzas pa/ thugs 'dzems ma gnang/
blo kha phyogs pa'am sems gtad pa/ nye skor gyi gnas lugs la thugs gzhol ba/
1) bsam blo/ las don mtha' dag thugs bzhed ltar grub song/ 2) 'dod pa/ phan tshun thugs bzhed 'char sgo nang 'gal med pa/
bsam blo mthun pa/ chu dang 'o ma bzhin du phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi ngang nas bka' mol zhib lhing mdzad pa/
blo 'khel ba/ drang bden gyi mi la thugs yid ches pa/
1) sems gzhan du g.yeng ba/ thugs g.yeng med par sgrim po mdzod/ 2) sems las sam, sems khral/ las don rnams la thugs g.yeng gnang mi dgos/
blo mchog tu gsal ba'am mkhas pa/
sems la nges pa'am, sems la yod pa/ gnas lugs tshang ma thugs la mnga' ba/
sems la 'jog pa/ ma bsnyel bar thugs la 'dogs par zhu/
sems la gnod pa/ dgon pa'i khyi la bzhus na bla ma'i thugs la phog yong/
yid la 'thad pa'am, 'gro ba/ mi tshang ma'i thugs la 'bab pa/
1) 'phrin las/ 2) sems khur ram, sems khral/ las don 'grub song bas thugs las gnang mi dgos/
blo tshod lon pa/ 'grogs yun ring bas khong gi thugs lon pa/
sems la 'os shing 'bab pa/ khong gi rnam 'gyur la bltas na skad cha de thugs su 'thad pa 'dra po 'dug
thugs la mnga' ba'am, mkhyen pa/ legs nyes kyi dbye ba kun thugs su tshud pa/
sun po bzos pa/ de ring khyed la thugs sun zhus pas dgongs 'gal med pa zhu/
sems pa yag po/ mi 'di thugs sems bzang po yin pa'i skad grags 'dug /
thugs nye ba'i slob ma/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs sras/ thugs sras dam pa/ thugs sras bu chen/
sems gso ba/ gtam snyan gsol te thugs gso ba/ thugs gso bar phyin pa/
sems sdug sel thabs su gtong ba'i kha btags/
thugs dwangs gsal gyi rnam pa/ brel zing gi 'gal rkyen med pas thugs lhan ner gnas pa/
1) sa tshigs nas sa tshigs sam, sa thag thung sa nas thung sar skyel dgos pa'i khral 'ul/ 2) skyel ma thung ngu/
bar thag thung ngur rgyug pa'i khral
thung ba/ dus tshod thung ngu zhig / lam thag thung ngu/ lus po thung ngu/ 'gro lam thung ngur stung ba/
ring po ma yin pa/ mi de spro thung thung red/ bsam blo thung thung ma gtong/
ring po min pa/ yun thung ba/ skud pa thung ba/ gting thung ba/ mig rgyang thung ba/
ring po/ dus yun thung min zhig 'gor tshod kyi las ka de dus tshod ring min zhig la tshar/
(rgya) skad gnyis pa'am, skad sgyur ba/
1.'dud pa'i skul tshig 2.mar phyur mnyam du brdzis pa'i zas shig /
mar phyur bsres pa'i thud gru bzhi ma/
thud blug pa'i snod kha gcod rang 'grigs/
mar phyur mngar cha mang po 'dzoms pa'i thud zhim po/ thud tsho po mar gyi bka' drin/
/ 1) dus kyi tshad dang, sman gyi tshad/ nyin thun/ mtshan thun/ nam gyi thun gsum pa/ snga thun/ phyi thun/ sman thun rer ril bu gsum re yin/ 2) sngags brgyab pa'i yungs kar sogs/
mtshams thun dngos gzhi'am, lte ba/
chos mtshams sdod skabs smra ba dang mi gzhan dang thug 'phrad spong ba/
mtshams thun bzhag nas lang ba/
1) yungs kar gyi thun 'debs pa/ 2) mtshams thun gyi mthar 'bul gtor/
tsho tsho'am, sde tshan sde tshan/
thun gyis 'brab sa'i 'brub khung ngam, sa dong/
thun bzhi'i steng du mtshan gyi cha stod dang cha smad gnyis bsnan pas dus drug tu bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len,..
/ 1) nam tshod 'dzin mkhan/ 2) mtshan mo kha ton gyi dge sbyor skyong mkhan/ 3) mtshams thun 'dzin mkhan/
1) sman gyi thun phyed/ 2) nyin mtshan gyi thun phyed/
nyin mtshan gyi thun so so'i bar mtshams/
yungs kar gyi thun gyis brabs pa'am, gtor ba/
(yul) lo tog brngas zin pa'i shul gyi snye ma/

phyug gi yon tan brgyad: de bzhin gshegs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang phyug brgyad de, sku yi dbang phyug dang, gsung gi dbang phyug thugs kyi dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug kun 'gro'i dbang phyug gnas kyi dbang phyug ci 'dod kyi dbang phyug phrin las kyi dbang phyug rnams so/

bkod pa chen po lnga'i zhing khams na zhing dang gzhal med khang gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang, 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pas brgyan pa blos sprul nas bla ma longs sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba'i mandal/
1) so sor ma yin pa spyi/ thun mong gi skad cha/ gsar skrun thun mong ma yin pa/ 2) (mngon) lcags khyi lo/
mi kun gyis rtsi 'jog dgos pa'i dpang rgya'i yi ge/
theg pa che chung thun mong du bgrod pa'i lam/
thun mong gi theg pa gsum
gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs kyi nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems gsum/
tshe bsod rgyas pa sogs 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i las/
rdzas sngags kyi sbyor ba la brten nas phyi pa dang nang pa thun mong du thob pa'i 'bras bu/
ril bu dang, mig sman dang, sa 'og dang, ral gri dang, nam mkhar 'phur ba dang, mi snang dang, 'chi ba med pa dang, nad 'joms te brgyad/
las don rang gzhan mnyam por sgrub pa/ las don 'gangs che'i rigs thun mong mnyam sgrub byed dgos/

zhing khams grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lha mi'i yo byad dam pa mtha' dag blos blangs pa dang, rang gi kha rje dbang thang dge rtsa dang bcas pa gces dgu'i dngos po thams cad bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba'i mandal/
thun mong ba'i ma nges pa

ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis kyi ya gyal, mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gnyis kar 'jug pa, dper na, sgra mi rtag pa la gzhal bya bkod pa lta bu, mthun dpe bum pa sogs la 'jug cing, mi mthun dpe nam mkha' sogs la'ang 'jug pas thun mong ba yin zhing khyab pa la the tshom bskyed pas ma nges pa'o/
thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i rtags drug dngos kyi ma nges pa'i
rtags bzhi dang lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i rtags gnyis te drug go/
gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi thun mong du bsgom rgyu'i srung 'khor/
thun mong ma yin pa'i chos
gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos lta bu skal bzang dbang rnon gyi spyod yul las skal dman dbang rtul dang thun mong du ma gyur pa'i chos/
thun mong ma yin pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa
de bzhin gshegs pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa rnams so/
thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor
gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyud kho nas bsgom rgyu'i srung 'khor/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can mdzes chos kyi yon tan ha cang mtshar drags pas, mtshungs chos la 'gran zlar 'os pa'i dpe gzhan ma rnyed par rang gi 'dra dper rang nyid ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
thun mong min pa'i ma nges pa

ma nges pa'i rtad gnyis kyi ya gyal, gang la rtags su song ba'i rgol bas mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gang rung la rtags yod par ma mthong ba ste, sgra mi rtag pa la mnyan bya bkod pa lta bu, mthun phyod bum pa dang, mi mthun phyogs nam mkha' la mnyan bya yod par ma mthong bas ma nges pa'o/
thun mong min pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi

mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gnyis ka la rtags med nas ma mthong ba dang, gnyis ka la yod kyang ma mthong ba dang, mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba dang, mi mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba ste, dper brjod rim bzhin, sgra chos can mi rtag ste, mnyan bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa bum pa dang nam mkha' la mnyan bya med pa lta bu dang, skyes bu 'di chos can, lha las tshe 'phos te, mig dang ldan pa'i phyir, zhes pa lha las 'phos ma 'phos gnyis kar ma mthong ba lta bu dang, rig byed kyi sgra rtag par 'dod pa'i ngor, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir, dpe rig byed kyi sgra bzhin, zhes pa lta bu dang, nam mkha' chos can, rtag ste, ma byas pa'i phyir, rig byed kyi sgra bzhin zhes bkod pa lta bu'o/
nang rig pa phud pa'i phyi nang thun mong gi bslab bya/
1) spyi la dbang ba'i sa cha/ 2) (mngon) rgyal po'i skyed tshal/
dus kyi cha ste nyin thun gsum, mtshan thun gsum lta bu/
thun tshod du rung ba'i sman dang don gcig
thun tshod du rung ba'i sman

'dul ba las bshad pa'i sman bzhi'i gras snga dro nas mtshan mo'i thun tshod tshun chad du byin gyis brlabs shing, skom pa'i nad sel ba la gtso bor gnang ba'i sman bcas ldan dge slong gis thun tshod kyi mtha'i bar byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod du rung ba btung ba'i rgyu brgyad dam, thun tshod du rung ba'i sman gsum dang, gzhan yang bcos pa'i tshwa, 'bru'i tshwa, zho'i kha chu, rtsab mo'am tsang shur grags pa rnams te mtshan nyid lnga ldan gyi btung ba'o/
1) dus mtshams/ nyi ma 'char nub kyi thun mtshams/ 2) thun so so'i bar mtshams/ 3) (mngon) dgong mo/ 4) lha dbang phyug chen po/
tho rangs, snga dro, nyin gung, srod rnams su bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/
yungs kar gyi thun gtor ma la gzer ba'i gtor zor/
1) mtshams bsnyen pa sogs kyi skabs su ngag thun bzung ba/ 2) nyin mtshan dus drug sogs yun tshad nges can zhig gi nang du bsgom bzlas byed pa/
thun rdzas blugs pa'i rwa co'i snod/
1) gzhan gyis pham par byed dka' ba/ 2) slob dpon rta dbyangs kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/
thub pa chen po'i bsdus tshig

ta la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa 'di rab byung bco lnga pa'i me byi lor dwags po glang mdun du 'khrungs, sa yos lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma kwang zhus bka' phab pa ltar gser bum dkrug mi dgos par rtse pho brang gi gser khrir gdan 'dren zhus, shing lug lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' 'brel rgyal srid chos srid bzhes, lcags byi lor mtshan zhabs sog po rdo rje zer ba u ru su rnying par sku tshab tu btang, shing 'brug lor dbyin jis lha sar btsan 'dzul byas rkyen sog yul brgyud nas sa sprel lor pe cin du phebs te gong ma kwang zhu la mjal 'phrad zhus, sa bya lor pe cin nas bod du chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i phyi lo lcags khyi la rgya gar du byon te chu byi lor bod du 'khor, chu bya lor sku gshegs/

1. (tha mi dad pa) glags rnyed pa/ ngan dgu thub pa/ nyon mongs thub pa/ ras rkyang thub pa/ chu thub pa/ me thub pa/ dug gis mi thub pa/ 2./ 1) «muni» sgo gsum mi dge ba dang nyon mongs pa las yang dag par bsdams pa/ 2) (mngon) 1, dgra bcom pa/ 2, rnam gzigs dang, gtsug tor can, thams cad skyob, 'khor ba 'jig gser thub, 'od srung, shakya thub pa ste thub pa la bdun yod pas grangs bdun mtshon/ 3. nus pa/ dgra bo 'joms thub pa/ grogs po la btsan gnod byung tshe rang nyid ltad mo lta ba ltar logs su sdod mi thub/
thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod
bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtso bo/
thub pa gnas bcus bskor ba
dgra bcom pa bcu drug gis bskor ba'i sangs rgyas shakya thub pa'i sku brnyan/
thub dbang sangs rgyas kyi sku tshab bam, shakya thub pa'i 'dra sku'i che brjod/
thub pa'i dbang po'i bsdus tshig
nus tsam mam glags rnyed tsam/ bed spyod thub tsam gyi yo byad spus zhan/
btsan po dbang yod/ don med thub tshod btang ba/
gzhung go rim med par 'ur 'don byed pa'i ming
ras sogs kyi nang du bsgril ba'i thum po/
thum bu'i ske la btab pa'i thel tshe/
khud du dril ba'i rdog po chung gras/ 'bru thum thum/ dngul thum thum/
khyug tsam/ gnyid thum pa tsam zhig khug pa/
khud du dril ba'i rdog po chung gras/ thum po rgyag pa/
(rnying) gnyid thum tsam mam, gnyid srab mo/
/ 1) khud du dril ba'i rdog po chung gras/ shog thum/ ras thum/ dngul thum...2) gzar bu/

1) (rgya) a mdo dgon lung dgon gyi dge lugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku grags can zhig / 2) (sog) ta yon hor rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po zhig / thu'u kwan grub mtha', grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa legs bshad shel gyi me long zhes bya ba thu'u kwan sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags bya lor brtsams, 'di'i brjod bya ni spyir rgya gar, ma ha tsi na, bod, sog po, li yul, sham bha la rnams su grub mtha' mi 'dra ba ji tsam byung dang de dag so so'i 'dod tshul rnams dang, lhag par bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis kyi nang du rnying ma ba dang, bka' gdams pa, bka' brgyud pa, zhi byed pa, sa skya pa, jo nang pa, grub mtha' nyi tshe ba 'ga' zhig bcas dang, yang sgos dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' rgyas par ston pa'i gzhung zhig /

chos kyi nyi ma: a mdo dgon lung dgon gyi dge lugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku grags can zhig yin, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul lor 'khrungs, rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags bya lor grub mtha' shel gyi me long brtsams/
(rgya) yon ming ching rgyal rabs gsum gyi ring la nub byang dang lho nub sa khul du btsud pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi 'go pas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i dpon gnas/
gyen gyi ldog pa/ la thur/ ri'i steng nas thur du 'gro ba/ rdo gcal nas thur du babs song/ snye ma smin dus snye mgo thur du dud pa/ 'bab chu brag nas thur du lhung ba/
rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las rnal ma bzhi'i nang gses, gsal ba de yin na rtags de yin pas khyab pa, dper na, mi rtag pa yin na byas pa yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/
log rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las: khyab pa phyin ci log pa bzhi'i nang gses gsal ba de yin na rtags de ma yin pas khyab pa, dper na, rtag pa yin na byas pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/
thur ma tshigs bdun can btsugs te nyi ma'i grib tshad brtag pa dang, nyi ldog dang nyin tshad brtag thabs/
rbab tu shor ba'am, thur du 'gril ba/ ri 'go nas rbab rdo thur 'gril du gtong ba/

lus kyi lte 'og man gyi nad rnams thur phyogs su gzhol zhing 'gro ba'i sa chu'i rang bzhin shas cher las byung ba a ru mchu ring gi mchu lta bu nang gi nyes pa rnams bkru zhing bshal bar byed pa'i sman/
snying chu dang, mig nad bar 'grib lta bu la lus phyi nas thur ma brgyab pas nang gi nad sel bar mngon sum mam rjes dpag gis dpyad nas rtogs pa'i dpyad sde zhig /

/ 1) dbyug pa phra mo/ 2) khyem bu/ 3) grib tshod dang, dus tshod snga phyi 'jal byed shing dbyug sor tshad can zhig / 4) em chi'i gshags las yo byad spyi/ 5) mer bsregs te yan lag gi rnag chu yod sar i khung 'bigs byed kyi yo byad cig /
bskal pa tha mar thur mas zas btsal te za ba'i mu ge'i dus shig gi mi/
cha bdun thur ma'i rang grib bdun/
rgya thur la 'jal ba'i zho tshad/
dkan gzar po nas thur du 'gro ba/ la mthon po nas thur gzar 'bab dus rkang 'gred mi 'chor ba'i gom tshugs brtan po zhig dgos/
1) thur du 'gro sa'i lam/ 2) (mngon) bshang lam/
1) shing bu'i thur ma/ 2) thur srang gi shing/

lus kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i ya gyal gzhang dkar nag la gnas pa zhig ste, byed las skyes pa'i khu ba dang, bud med kyi zla mtshan, bshang ba dang gcin pa, mngal du phru gu 'byin sdom bcas byed pa zhig /
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs nyi shu pa thur sel rlung dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang ste, der me btsa' bzhag na phyen gtong mi thub pa'am 'gag pa'i nad la phan/
gser sogs lci yang 'degs byed kyi thur srang/
1. 'dul ba'i skul tshig 2. gna' snga mor bod la sgo phyugs ngo grangs nges can zhig yod pa'i khyu tsho'i ming/
sbom pa dang, rags pa dang, rgya che ba/ gzugs po thul che ba/ sa thul che ba/
nang du spu yod pa'i zla gam/ lug thul/ ra thul/ spyang thul/ zha thul/
1. (tha mi dad pa) las su rung bar 'gyur ba'am, 'jam por 'gyur ba/ gyong po thul ba/ mi bsrun pa thul bar thag chod/ rta rgod btul na thul bar the tshom med/ 2. (mngon) drang srong/
'phyur re'am, long nge/ du ba thul le ba/ rlangs pa thul le ba/ dri bzang thul le ba/
sdud pa dang sgrug pa'i don du go ba'i 'thu ba'i skul tshig
jus med jus gtogs byed mkhan/
jus gtogs/ rgyal khab gzhan dag gi nang srid las don la the jus byed pa/ pho rog tshang la 'ug pas the jus mi dgos/
(tha mi dad pa) tshud pa dang, gtogs pa/ lkog g.yo ngan pa'i bsam sbyor de'i nang la kha the lag the byas med/ rang dang 'brel ba med pa'i las don nang du the nas rnyog gra byung ba/
rdzong zhig kan su'u zhing chen khongs kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho phyogs dang klu chu'i stod rgyud du yod/
gtogs mi gtogs/ las don 'di la the mi the sna tshogs yod/
(rnying) yid gnyis sam, som nyi ste, blo rtse gnyis/
dam bca' ba'i don/ las don 'di byed ces the btsugs pa de kho na bzhin du grub/
jus gtogs/ don med the tshogs byed mi rung/

blo rig bdun gyi nang gses, rang yul la blo rtse gnyis su 'jug pa'i nyon mongs can gyi shes pa, dper na, sgra rtag gam mi rtag snyam pa dang, du ldan gyi la la me yod dam med snyam pa lta bu ste rtsa nyon drug gi ya gyal zhig kyang yin no/ the tshom spu tsam med pa/ 'thus min gyi the tshom skye ba/ dgongs skor zhus nas the tshom gcod pa/ the tshom 'dri ba/ the tshom bsal ba/ las don chen po 'di 'grub e yong snyam pa'i the tshom byed pa/ the tshom mngon du rgyu ba/ the tshom bag la nyal ba/ don 'gyur ba'i the tshom/ don mi 'gyur ba'i the tshom/ ming gi rnam grangs la nem nur dang, 'phyang mo nyug ma nges, yid gnyis, som nyi bcas so,
dogs gnad bsal rgyur bsdad pa'i kha mchu'i rigs/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, phan tshun mtshungs chos ha cang 'dra ches pas dpe don so sor ngos ma zin par sems the tshom du gyur tshul ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya dbye ba mi phyed pa'i the tshom gyi don gnyis, 'gog byed dngos yod kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag gi sgo nas so sor nges pa rnyed nas cig shos 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
the tshom dra ba'i gzugs su bkod pa/
phul byung gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'jig rten grags tshod la 'byung mi srid pa'i the tshom gyi gzhi phul byung ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
blo mtha' gnyis su dogs pa/ bden nam mi bden snyam du the tshom za ba/
don gyi khyad par la brtag cing dri ba la 'jug pa'i phrad gzhan dbang can gam sogs bcu gcig / gam... khyed la smyu gu yod dam/
na...na...sa bon 'di btab na skye'am mi skye/
yid gnyis byed bzhin pa/ 'gro dang mi 'gro'i skor da dung the tshom log ge bar bsdad yod/
theg pa chung ba ste, nyan rang gi theg pa/
nyan thos pa dang rang rgyal ba/
theg pa chen po'i bsdus ming,

sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bdun gcig song rjes rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs bi ma sambha ba'i ri la rgyal sras 'bum phrag bcu 'dus te 'jam dpal gyis mngon pa dang, byams pas 'dul ba, phyag na rdo rjes mdo sde bcas bsdus par grags so/

'byed cha mthun: thabs kyis khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i don mngon rtogs te, thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas shing bden pa mngon rtogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i theg chen 'jig rten pa'i lam de'o/
pa cha mthun: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, rnam mkhyen rang rgyud la sgrub par mkhas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi chos mngon rtogs so/
'byor mngon sum: byang phyogs kyi chos so bdun mngon du brnyes shing bdag med gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems mthong sgom gyi mnyam bzhag ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen rnams so/
1) sems bden grub kyis stong pa/ 2) 'tshang rgya rung gi nus pa/
rigs can gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gnas lugs zab mo'i don la mi skrag cing, snying rje chen pos gzhan don lhur len par spro ba'i rigs can/
theg chen gyi byang chub tu bgrod par byed pa'am, der bgrod zin pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa de'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i lam lnga ste, theg chen gyi tshogs lam dang, sbyor lam, mthong lam, sgom lam, mi slob lam/
theg chen gyi sems bskyed bzhi
mos pas spyod pa dang, lhag bsam dag pa, rnam par smin pa, sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed bcas bzhi'o/
theg chen gyi bsam gtan bzhi
byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan dang, don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang, de bzhin nyid dmigs bsam gtan dang, de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba bsam gtan bcas bzhi'o/
theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/
theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas bla med byang chub kyi ched du don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya ba/

ched du bya ba: byang sems gang gi ched du sgrub par 'jug pa'i 'thob bya mthar thug pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi sems chen po byang chub kyi sems dang, spong ba chen po mi gnas pa'i myang 'das, rtogs pa chen po stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu rnams so/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, sems can la dmigs pa'i rnam pa khyad par ba dang ldan zhing, sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mos spyod kyi ye shes so/

kun bkras pa: sa skya'i bla ma chos rje kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'di nyid rab byung drug pa'i sa mo glang la 'khrungs, rang lo re bzhi pa rab byung bdun pa'i chu mo sbrul la gong ma'i mdun du byon nas lo gnyis bzhugs, ta ming rgyal pos theg chen chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol, shing sbrul lo la 'das/
pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang, gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis/
theg chen thar pa cha mthun
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, bla med byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam gang zhig rnam byang dbang po'i ngo bor ma gyur pa'i gnas skabs kyi lam mo/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses: bla med rdzogs byang du sems bskyed pa'i gang zag gis don du gnyer bya'i lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams 'thob par byed pa'i thabs ma nor bar ston pa'i rjod byed/
theg chen sems bskyed rgyud ldan gyi gang zag
theg chen du rigs nges ma nges gnyis dang, yang na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa dang, 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa ba gnyis so/
bsam pa sems bskyed dang, spyod pa phyin drug /
rang rgyu theg chen tshogs lam gyi rjes su skyes pa'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs/
bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis mtha' yas pa bsags nas rnam mkhyen rang rgyud la bsgrub pa la mkhas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi chos mngon rtogs/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, dmigs pa sems can thams cad la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral nas bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i snying rjes gzhan don la dmid pa'i zur dang, shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i zur te zur gnyis sam don gnyis ldan pa'i sems bskyed do/

rten khyim pa dang rab byung gang rung gis yul so thar sdom ldan nam rten gyi drung nas, kun slong byang chub sems kyis cho ga sngar byon pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam thar gyi rjes su bslab pa'i khas len lan gsum byas te dge ba gso zhing, sdig pa sbyong bar byed pa'o/
theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa
bsam pa byang chub sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa'i sbyor ba bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa bsrung zhing sha bza' ba spangs pa'o/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud bcu bdun rtsa bar bzhag ste man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu'i don 'grel rgya cher bshad pa skabs nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i bdag nyid can gyi gzhung, dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/

1. (tha mi dad pa) bzod pa'am, bteg nas theg pa/ ljid tshad chen po de 'dra theg mi thub pa/ skyid theg sdug theg / nad pas nad theg kyang, em chis nad mi theg / mis mi theg pa gtam dang, chus mi theg pa rdo/ lag pas mi theg so yis mi chod/ 2. 1) bzhon pa dang khyogs sogs/ rta'i theg pa la zhon pa/ theg pa stong phrag bshams nas stobs shugs ston pa/ 2) lam dang thabs/
mthar thug nges don snying po'i theg pa ste 'bras bu'i theg pa'o/
theg pa chung ngu pa gnyis
nyan thos kyi theg pa ba dang, rang rgyal gyi theg pa ba/
byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ste, theg dman nyan rang las chen po bdun gyis 'phags pas theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/
theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos

byams chos sde lnga'i nang gses, theg pa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par byed pa'i mdo zab mo rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos, pandi ta sadzdza na dang, lo ts'a ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur pa'o/
1) theg chen dang, theg chung/ 2) rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang, 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa/

nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems te mtshan nyid sde gsum mam phyi kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum, kri ya u pa yo ga ste phyi rgyud sde gsum mam gsang ba dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum ste rnying ma'i theg pa rim pa dgu'o/
go rim ma 'tshol bar 'gro ba:/ slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum la theg pa rim 'dzeg gis 'gro ba/
nyan thos kyi theg pa, rang rgyal gyi theg pa, byang sems kyi theg pa ste gsum/
theg pa dman pa ste nyan rang gi theg pa/
theg dman dgra bcom pa gnyis
nyan thos kyi mi slob pa dang, rang sangs rgyas kyi mi slob pa/
theg dman sde pa bco brgyad
nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad dang don gcig
dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa dang, rigs kyi sa, brgyad pa'i sa, mthong ba'i sa, bsrabs pa'i sa, 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa, byas pa bsrung ba'i sa, byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ste brgyad/
(tha mi dad pa) 'gro ba'i zhe sa/ phyogs la thegs pa/ lam kha 'di nas thegs song/
glo nad theng po la ltos,
(tha mi dad pa) thengs pa, theng ba,, grangs tshad slebs pa dang, rdzogs pa'am tshang ba/ mi 'bor thengs pa/ dus sgo thengs pa/ bsnyen chen thengs pa/
lan nam, tshar/ dbugs rngubs gtong thengs gcig la rtsa 'phar thengs lnga re tsam/ tshod 'du thengs dang po/ thengs rjes ma/
lan kha shas/ thengs 'ga' tsam ma yin pa/
lan mang po/ nor 'khrul thengs mang byung ba/ thengs mang mthong ba/
gcan gzan gyis bsad pa'i srog chags kyi ro lhag ma/ ri dwags thed ro/ bu lon lhag ma dgra bo'i thed/
(yul) rnying pa dang ral po/ gyon pa thed po/
1) yal bar bor ba'am, mthong chung/ 2) lhag ro g.yugs pa/
(rgya) a rag gi bum rdza'i khar 'jog rgyu'i zangs kyi snod cig /

kan su'u zhing chen khongs bod rigs rang skyong rdzong zhig 1950 lo'i zla 5 tshes 6 la then kru'u rang skyong sa khul btsugs, 1954 lor then kru'u bod rigs rang skyong sa khul du bsgyur, 1955 lor rang skyong rdzong du bsgyur, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung an yon kren du yod, sdod mkhan mi rigs bod dang, rgya, hor, kha che, sog po sogs yod/
(rnying) gtan du'am, rgyun par ram, rtag tu/
(rnying) zhen pa dang, chags pa/ khyim la then zhing 'dug /
thebs pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
phugs kyi dmigs rten/ mchod thebs/ gtong thebs/
po bzos pa:/ blo mi 'dra ba bkal nas, thebs chu 'dra ba bcag byung/

rgyur go tshod tsam zhig tu gyur pa'i ngan: ngon dang yag po rang ma yin pa/ lto gos thebs chag tsam las med/ thabs chas thebs chag tsam zhig gra bsgrigs pa/ mi de thebs chag thebs chag red/ sdod khang thebs chag cig las med pa/
(yul) gos kyi am phrag sogs sum byed kyi sgrog bu/
zhing la son btab zin mtshams su 'tshogs pa'i dga' ston/
(tha mi dad pa) son pa ste, btab nas phog pa/ zhing la sa bon thebs bzhag / nad kyis thebs pa/ dus tshod gang 'tshams shig la nga'i lag par thebs yong/
bya sgro sogs las bzos pa'i rkang rtsed kyi rtsed chas shig /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mchod rgyun gyi ma thebs 'jog sa'i las khungs shig /
mchod rgyun gtong thebs kyi ma rtsa/
tshong pa ha log nas dngos rdzas yod tshad bun bdag la bu lon gyi dod du brtsis te sprad pa'i don/
1) thengs re'am, skabs re/ 2) cung zad/ ja thebs re sprod pa/
gyon pa sogs sum byed kyi srog lung/
1) 'dzeg skas/ khang pa'i them skas/ lha gnas bgrod pa'i them skas/ ming gi rnam grangs la steng 'gro can dang 'dzeg skas so,2) sgo'i them pa'i phyi nang du btsugs pa'i skas 'dzeg thung thung/
sgo'i them pa'i 'og gi khung bu/
sdod khang gi sgo grangs yi ge/
khyim dud dang, khyim tshang, mi tshang/ rgya khyab tu dril bsgrags byas nas them dud tshang mar gsal por shes su 'jug dgos/
mi tshang them pa gang yod kyi tho bkod pa'i deb yig
/ 1) sgo'i ya them ma them/ 2) them skas kyi bang rim/
nges med kyi dpe/ nad pa gson dang mi gson them pa'i sgang gi byi'u ltar gnas yod/
them pa'i sgang gi ril ma
nges med kyi dpe/ 'grul pa 'gro dang mi 'gro them pa'i sgang gi ril ma ltar da lta brtan brtan mi 'dug /

1) rang gi sdod khang gi sgo'i phyir gyar du mi 'jug pa'i man ngag sogs/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs lho kha sa khul khongs mtsho sna rdzong gi sa cha mon yul sbrang nang tsho drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, yul de'i nags khrod cig mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i 'khrungs sa yin skad/
/ 1) skas kyi gdang bu/ 2) chang gi rdza ma'i gsham gyi i khung gi don du go ba'i thim bu'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
gri bar sman 'debs byed kyi yo byad sman thur zhig
sgo'i ya them gyi ming byang yi ge /

sgo'i ya them gyi ming byang yi ge
skas kyi gdang bu'i rim pa/
/ 1) dam phrug / 2) me tog kha ma 'bus pa/ 3) tho ba chung chung/ rdo the'u/

mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'byung po'am, yi dwags kyi rigs shig /
dbang po lag pa mchog dman rigs gnyis kyi nang tshan dman pa zhig /
bal gyi skud pa phra po/
ther thag ther ge'i thag pa'am
khal do sdom byed kyi thag pa/
snod kha yangs pa/ kha ther ther byas nas gad mo dgod/ ja dam kha ther ther/ kong kong min pa'i tshal slang ther ther/
kher rkyang zur 'don/ nyes can gyi skyon ther 'don byed pa/ ther 'don dag 'bud/ byas nyes ther 'don dag 'bud byed pa/
1. 1) sla nga sogs snod spyad kha yangs pa/ 2) rang byus bzhag nas gzhan byus la the tshogs byed mi/ 2. sgrib byed med pa'i rjen gcer/ skra med spyi ther/ rtswa shing med pa'i sa ther/
bod rang nas thon pa'i snam gos 'jam legs/

bal las btags pa'i gos rgyu srab mo zhig / rtsed ther/ gtsang ther/ snye ther/ rong ther/
/ 'jig rten khams na 'gyur med ther zug gi dngos po med/
rtag pa rtag pa'am: brtan pa brtan pa/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams ther zug ther zug tu gnas so/
ther mas bzos pa'i gra chas kyi nang tshan zhig /
tham 'dzin gtong ba dang, bka' lung sgyur ba/
dam phrug / kha la thel tse brgyab pa/
mi mang pos thun mong du gan rgya 'jog skabs tshang mas rang ming bkod de phab pa'i the'u/
/ 1) mi brjed pa'i ched bkod pa'i yig deb/ ming tho,/ zin tho/ brjed tho/ nyin tho/ 2) rtags brda mtshon byed/ rdo tho/ mtshams tho/
sngar manydzu'i rgyal rabs kyi dmag mi'i 'go byed kyi go ming mtho ba zhig /
tho yig 'dri ba/ zhib bsher gyis tho 'god pa/
ming tho sogs 'god sa'i re'u mig gi ri mo

1) spyod pa rtsing po dang ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i tshul min spyod tshub/ tho co'i rtsing spyod byas pa/ 2) don med bzhad gad slong ba'i ca co/ bag med tho co'i spyod pas mi la sun po ma byed cig / 3) gnas lugs dang mi stun pa'am nyen khar mi 'dzem pa/ nad gzhi la sman bcos tho co ma byed/
mgar bas lcags che ba rdung byed dang, chung ba rdung skabs 'og stan du'ang rung ba zhig /
tho yor lhar mos nas de la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga zhig /

lcags gzer 'don byed kyi tho ba zhig /

yi ge :/ don gnad dran gso'i tho yig 'god pa/
sa rdo brtsegs pa'i tho po/ tho yor la mi gzugs bcos pa/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste, nam gyi cha smad dam, nyin mo'i thog ma ste stag gi dus/
tho rangs 'char ba'i skar chen te gza' pa sangs/ nam tho rangs skar chen shar/
sngar bod kyi chos rgyal lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi mtshan gzhan zhig /
tha re tho re ste, nyung ngu'am, phran tshegs/ sa tha'i zhing la lo tog tho re ba zhig las skyes mi 'dug / rtswa shing tho re ba/
thar thor dang cher mi gsal ba/ lo rgyus tho re long nge ba zhig las bshad rgyu mi 'dug /
glo bur/ 'gyod sems tho ler byung ba/
dre'u sogs gzugs bongs thung ba dang chung: ngu/ rta tho log / dre'u tho log /
yi ger bltas nas tshang min bsher ba/ gzhung dngos tho bsher byas/ mi ming tho bsher byed/

/ 1) nam mkha'i thog / nam mkhar sprin bya ro tsam sa gzhir thog g.yag ro tsam/ gnam lcags thog 'bebs,/ thog babs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la lce snying med dang, lce 'bab pa, lce 'bar ba, chad nyams, chu 'dzin skyes, chu las 'bar, chus mi nyams, rdo rje'i char pa, rdo rje'i zegs ma, nam mkha'i tho ba, gnam lcags, sprin gyi me bo che, sprin gyi zer 'phro ba, sprin gyi 'od zer, 'phro 'joms, 'bigs byed, me char, ri 'joms bcas so, 2) khang pa'i thog ka'am, steng/ khang pa'i thog 'gebs ran pa/ 3) tog / shing thog / lo thog /
khang pa'i thog steng/ kha ba bab na thog khar 'bab, 'grul pa yong na sgo rtsar yong/

1) khang thog gi dral lcam sogs shing cha/ 2) thog bab pa ltar mgyogs por mtshong rgyug gis 'ong ba'i tshul/

nam mkha' nas thog bab pa las byung bar grags pa'i sa 'og tu bskal par lus kyang btsa' zhu sogs ma byung ba'i lcags rigs kha dog dang gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'byung ba zhig ste, nus pas rtsa dkar gyi nad la phan/
tu yod pa'i dbus dang zur gyi lcog: chung

khri thog rje btsan dang don gcig khri sgra dpung btsan dang sman bza' klu steng gnyis kyi sras, sngar bod rgyal nyer bdun pa ste btsan lnga'i ya gyal zhig 'di dus lha yi rol mo gling bu byung, 'di yan la chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa las sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dar srol ma byung/
mjug bar ram: bar mtshams med pa ste, thams cad/ mtshan thog thag tu bsgugs pa/ lam gyi thog thag tshang mar bde bgrod byung/ mtshan thog thag tu ngu zhing bsdad/
1) rdo la tho ba brgyab pa'i skad lta bu sgra'i khyad par zhig / 2) (rnying) dang po
gong 'og gam, thog ma dang mtha' ma/ thog mtha' 'gyur med/

dus ring ba dang nye ba/ thog drung rim pa dbyer ma mchis/
thog / bar snang khams kyi thog mda' de, bab na gar bab rtsa brlag gtong/

'go gsar du 'dzugs skabs dang, snga shos kyi skabs mtshams/ dang thog / rten 'brel gyi thog ma bkra shis yin/ gtam gleng ba'i thog mar 'dzum mdangs ston/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'go ma dang, snga ba, sngon ma, dang po, rtsom byed bcas so,
ma med pa: dang po dang mtha' ma'i nges gzung med pa/
thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid
stong nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, 'khor ba la thog ma dang tha ma zhes bya ba dang, 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum gyi dngos po med pa'o/
dang po 'di yin brjod du med pa/
1) las ka'i 'go 'dzugs kyi skar ma/ 2) rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi dang po'i skar ma/ 3) skar ma zhig /
(mngon) 1) dus 'khor/ 2) dang po'i sangs rgyas dang kun tu bzang po/
khyim der slebs mtshams kyi nyin mo'i yun tshad/
dang po'i ya mtha' thug pa med pa/
bdag tu rmongs pa'i ma rig pa/
gsar du kha 'bus pa'i shing lo/

ye thog ma'am sngon mtha' med pa'i dus/ nga ni thog med dus nas khyod kyi mgon/
thang sder lta bu'i zlos gar do ra/

gnam lcags dang, ser ba drag po/
thogs reg dang bcas pa'i dngos po/

1. (tha dad pa) 'khyer ba dang, 'dzin pa/ dar cha dmar po mthon por thogs pa/ lag tu mtshon cha thogs nas 'thab 'dzing gi gra sgrig byed pa/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) 1) phyir 'gyang ba dang, 'gor ba/ glo bur na nas thogs song/ yun ring po rang thogs ma song/ 2) thug reg gis ma thar ba/ khon thogs/ khon khon thogs thogs/ lhags pa gyang la thogs nas tshur rgyag mi thub/ bya 'phur shes na gshog sne brag la mi thogs, mi 'gro shes na rkang sne rdo la mi thogs/ rkang pa rdo la thogs nas 'gyel/ 3) thon pa'am skyes pa/ bya la gshog sgro thogs/ kham sdong la 'bras bu thogs 'dug / 3. rdugs pa ste gcig gi go sar gcig rdugs nas gzugs can gnyis pa mi 'byung ba'o/
bar chad ma mchis pa dang, rgyun mi 'chad pa/ lam bar thogs pa med pa/ kha nas rgyu mtshan thogs pa med pa zhig bshad rgyu 'dug /
mig sogs khams bco brgyad la brten nas phye ba'i sgrib pa'i thogs pa dang, yul la thogs pa, dmigs pa la thogs ste gsum/

reg pa'i tshogs drug po las mig gi 'dus te reg pa la sogs pa thogs bcas kyi dbang po lnga la brten pa'o, dper na mig gi 'dus te reg pa ni, mig gi dbang po dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam shes gsum 'dus te yul yongs su gcod pa 'byung ba ltar ro/

'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya gyal, rgya chen spyod pa'i srol 'byed kyi shing rta slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med ni, ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo dgu brgya lhag lon cing, dus rabs bzhi pa tsam na, bram ze mo su pra k'a sha shi la zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs, ri bo bya rkang du byon nas rje btsun byams pa bsgrub pas zhal dngos su mjal, theg pa chen po'i mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ston pa'i byams chos sde lnga mi yul du drangs, de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang, sdom rnam gnyis sogs mang du brtsams, dbyig gnyen sogs rjes su bzung nas chos mngon pa dar bar mdzad do/
1. gtong ba'i skul tshig 2. (rnying) rmon lcad/

/ 1) lo gsum lon pa'i re'u dang lu gu pho/ 2) zhing rmo byed kyi gshol/

(rnying) dgra sha len par yong mkhan gyi mi/
ske stong tsa ra khung nas gyen du tshon gang gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na snying la tsha ba zhugs pa dang, glo lu ba, dbugs gtong mi bde ba sogs la phan/
lo gsum lon pa'i re'u dang lu gu pho mo/
1) sa zhing rmod mkhan/ 2) sngar bod kyi lam yig thog tu rta khal skul 'ded chog 'thus rdzong dpon gyis bkod pa'i mchan 'dzin/
lus kyi thong ga ste brang gi 'og /
1) zhing kha rmo byed/ thong gshol 'dzin pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rmo byed dang, sa 'joms, gshol bcas so, 2) rgyu skar zhig /
gshol lcags sam, thong lcags kyi rtse/
/ 1) mgo dkri byed/ de skabs bod du la thod 'ching srol cher med/ 2) thog gam steng/
1) yi ge'i thod kyi klad skor/ 2) lha mo 'khrab dus kyi zhwa mo zhig /

mi'i ka li'i nang du bkang ba'i khrag /

par 'jug pa: ting 'dzin rim gyis bsgom pa la ma ltos par rim 'das kyi sgo nas mnyam par 'jog pa'o/
1) mgo rgyan/ 2) steng du gdags bya'i gnam rgyan/

dar ras sogs mgo bor dkris pa/

steng la g.yog rgyu'i pang leb/

mgo rus thod pa'i dum bu/

ngal rtsol gyi rgyu chas dang ngal rtsol bya yul la zer zhing, de ni mi rnams kyis dngos po'i rgyu chas thon skyed byed skabs nges par du dgos pa'i cha rkyen zhig yin/

ngal rtsol gyi nus pa yod pa'i mi dang thon skyed rgyu chas te, thon skyed kyi lag cha dang, ngal rtsol byed yul zung du sbrel nas grub pa'i rang byung khams 'dul ba dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'i nus shugs/

mi rnams kyis dngos po'i rgyu chas thon skyed byed pa'i brgyud rim nang chags pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba la zer, der thon skyed rgyu chas dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi rnam pa dang, mi rnams kyis thon skyed byed pa'i nang gi go sa dang phan tshun gyi 'brel ba, thon rdzas bgo bsha'i rnam pa bcas 'dus yod, de'i nang nas rag las sa'i nus pa thon pa ni thon skyed rgyu chas dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi rnam pa de yin/
can btson 'jug byas nas btson khang nas: thon nyin thon lcag ces rta lcag brgya nas nyis brgya'i bar gzhu srol yod
thon kha'i phyag 'bul:/ thag ring du 'gro dus thon phyag zhu ba/ sems mi dga' bas thon phyag ma zhus par rdog thon byas song/
1) thom bu dang 'dra, 2) (rnying) gzhan gyi chung ma dang 'grogs pa las skyes pa'i bu/

1) snye mo thon zer ba'i yul/ 2) thon la gnas pa'i mi/
thu mi sam bho ta'i mtshan gyi 'bri srol gzhan zhig
dngos rigs thon sa'i yul lung/

sde khag gang gi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa/
gtsang rnam gling rdzong gi khongs sa gnas shig ste, ta la'i sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'khrungs yul/
1) thob tshod kyi 'os 'bab/ 2) gang la de 'tshams kyi go gnas/
1) bgo bya'i grangs bgod byed kyis bgos pa'i ci thob kyi grangs/ 2) so sor thob pa'i rgyu nor gyi skal pa/
