(rnying) byung ba'i res mo'am, byung rim/
dbang lung sogs chos rgyun thob pa'i brjed tho
dbang lung sogs thob pa'i rim pa/
1) hab thob dang, hab sha/ rgyal kha thob sha 'gyed pa/ 2) thob skal gyi sha/
rkyang gi gdeng tshod:/ rgyal kha rang la thob shag shag byed pa/
rgyal pham dang, rnyed pa dang brlag pa/ khe bzang thob shor ma brtsis pa/
hab thob dang kha gshags 'gyed pa/
gzhan du 'chol ba'i don du go ba'i 'dam pa'i skul tshig
sog po o rod tsho bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
gyen du ker gyis bcings pa'i gtsug tor lta: bu/ mgo mtho ba'i steng du thor cog /
1) zhogs pa dus yun thung ngu zhig la 'tshogs pa'i chos ra/ 2) chos phran bu/
1) mgo skra gtsug tor lta bur bcings pa/ 2) (rnying) rtse mo/
thor nag thor pa nag po'am
1) gzhung gi sa bcad che ba'i khongs su ma gtogs pa'i kha thor du gnas pa'i nad skad 'gags pa sogs le'u bcu dgu'i spyi ming zhig / 2) thor pa dang don gcig
thor god nas thon pa'i snam bu/
pags pa'i steng du 'brum bu thon pa'i nad cig /
kha 'thor ram, phran bu, dum bu, phran tshegs, nyung ngu/ dpe cha thor bu 'ga' zhig 'dug / nya mo de'i rigs rgya mtsho'i nang gang sa gang du thor bur gnas yod pa/
tha re tho re nyung ngu tsho tsho yod pa/ shing bu thor bu thor bu/ rtsom yig thor bu thor bu/
pags nad kyi bye brag cig /
phran tshegs sam, phran bu/ yo byad thor ma/ ca lag thor ma/
lo gnyis lon pa'i mo rte'u/
nyung tsam mam, tha re tho re tsam/ da nang zhogs pa kha ba thor tsam babs bzhag / lhad pa brgyab nas me tog thor tsam gtor 'dug /
skra gyen du bcings pa'i gtsug tor ram, thor cog /
'brum bu dang me dbal lta bu ma yin pa thor rims kyi bye brag cig /
cung zad/ bshad pas thor re ba go/
tho le zhes pa'i bsdus ming ste, glo bur/ tho le...nad gzhi thol skyes/ dgra bo'i tshur rgol thol gyis byung yang bya dka' byed gtad kyi gnas su gyar med pa/
glo bur glo bur ram, skabs skabs/ rtogs pa thol thol du skyes pa/ chu bur thol thol du byung ba/ thor pa thol thol du skyes pa/
1) chos thos pa tsam gyis grol ba/ 2) rnying ma'i gter ston karma gling pas gter nas drangs pa'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i ming/
go rgya/ thos rgya chung ba/ thos rgya chen po/
thos rgya chung ngu/ gzhung don zab mo thos chung gis gting mi dpog /
thos pa'i nor gyi bsdus tshig
go ba'i tshul lugs/ thag ring nas thos snang byung ba'i gnas tshul la nges tan rang med/

1. (tha mi dad pa) rna bas mnyan te go ba/ glo bur 'brug sgra thos nas zhed snang dbang med du skyes/ than brda thos te sems mi dga' ba/ rgyal zhes thos kyang ma khengs, pham zhes thos kyang ma zhum/ bslab bya mang du thos pas mkhas par gyur/ 2. go ba'i ming/ thos pa rgya che ba/ thos pa chung ba/
rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mtshan/
tshig le'ur byas pa: rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge srung gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab
thos byung gi shes rab dang don gcig,
thos pa las byung ba'i sa
mos pas spyod pa'i sa ste tshogs lam/
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses, gzhung lugs rab 'byams gsan bsam mdzad pa ste, log rtog gi g.yul ngo bzlog pas dmag dpon rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
tu phyin pa: gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyangs pa rab kyi rtser son pa/
thos pa mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i gzungs/
thos pa byas pa'i dge mtshan/
1) rna thos tsam las mthong yul las 'das pa'i lam/ 2) shi ba/
gsung rab kyi tshig mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag las nyan pa dang, blo la 'dzin pa dang, kha ton dang gshar sbyang byed pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas tshig dang don la dpyod pa'i shes rab/
dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam lung tshad ma la brten nas sgra spyi tsam gyi nges pa rnyed pa/

shes rab rnam pa gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gsung rab kyi don gang yang rung ba la sgra spyi tsam gyi sgo nas nges pa rnyed pa'i zhen rig dper na, byas pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gtan la ma phebs par bum pa mi rtag pa rtog pa lta bu'o/
rna lam du gang go ba tshang ma/ bsam tshad kha nas ma shod, thos tshad yid ches ma byed/
rna bar ji tsam go tshod/ ngag lan thengs gnyis btang ba yin pas thos tshod yin/
thos song zer ba dang thos pa'i khul/ go lo dang thos lor bzhag nas nyams su ma blangs pa/
cog rna bar thos tshad thams cad
gzhan las bslab bya'i don nyan pa dang de'i don yid la byed pa/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod pa/ thos bsam gyi nus pas the tshom gyi dogs gnas sangs pa/

gzhan las nyan pa dang thos pa las shes par byed pa ni thos pa dang, thos pa'i don de rang gis lung dang rid pas tshul bzhin du bsams te rang stobs kyis nges par byed pa ni bsam pa dang, de ltar thos bsam gyis nges par byas te the tshom dang bral ba na yang dang yang du 'dris par byed pa ni sgom pa bcas gsum mo/
thos bsam gyi nus pas the tshom gyi dogs pa sangs pa/
grub mtha' kun la phyogs ris med par nyan pa dang dpyad pa/
stangs kyi khyad par zhig ste: lham sgra lta bu/
/ 1) smad cha/ 2) bud med kyi sta zur mdun ngos dang sked pa'i 'og cha/

«antarbas:» 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi nang gses, chos gos rnam gsum gyi ya gyal snam phran lnga dang glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa, tshad zheng du khru do dang srid du khru lnga'am bzhi, tha ma lte ba man chad pus mo yan chad de 'khor gsum khebs pa'i tshad kyang rung la, lus sbom pas mi yogs na ral kha dpung chad bsnan kyang rung ba'i smad gos shig bod du yongs grags su sham thabs zhes par grags/
mthang sprad pa dang don gcig

/ 1) zad pa'i mu dang, mtshams sam, sne/ gangs ri chen pos yul lung 'di'i mtha' nas bskor ba/ gzhong dbyibs can gyi sa bab mtha' mtho la dbus dma' ba/ gtso bo'i mtha' la bskor nas bsdad pa/ dmag gis mtha' bskor ba/ 2) yi ge'i mtha' rten/ ga mtha' can/ ga...'a mtha' can/ 'a...
grangs kyi tshad gzung du med pa'am, 'byams klas pa/ nam mkha' mtha' klas pa/
gyon pa dang thang ga sogs kyi gong gsham mthar btang ba'i skud pa/
1) mtha' 'am phyi logs kyi khor yug / grong khyer gyi mtha' skor lam chen/ 2) phyi nas bskor ba/ lcags ri ring pos mtha' bskor ba/ dgra bo mtha' skor byas nas rtsa med du gtong ba/
las ka byed 'phro ma bzhag par mjug skyel ba/
thag ring du spyugs pa/ btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gang nas 'ong sa de nyid mtha' skrod gtong ba/
1) rig gzhung ma dar ba'i yul/ 2) sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i yul/ mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa/ 3) rgyal khams sam yul gru zhig gi mtha' mtshams sa khul/
bya ba ma rdzogs bar du bskyangs nas byung ba/
bya ba mtha' mjug bar du son pa/ gang byed mtha' 'khyol/
grol lugs chen po bzhi'i nang gses, rang byung gi rig pa de nyid dus gsum dang shes bya gang du'ang mi gnas pas mtha' grol zhes bya'o/
mtha' gcod pa'am, gtan la 'bebs pa/
gos kyi mtha' rgyan sram lpags lta bu/
mtha' 'jags sam, mtha' nas bsgril te 'tshem pa/ gyon chas kyi mtha' sgril ba/ mtha' ngos, dbus min pa'i zur gyi cha/
1) rjes 'jug dngos su yod pa'i ming ngam tshig / 2) zad mtha' 'am, pha mtha' yod pa/

tu nges pa'am yongs su gtan 'khel: ba/ bshad srol de bzhin yang dag yin min da lta nyid nas mtha' gcig tu dbye 'byed bya mi rung/ rang lugs mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa/ chud zos su gtong bar mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed/
(yul) 1) par shing gi mtha' skor ri mo/ 2) gos sogs kyi mtha' 'gril/ gos la mtha' lcags btang ba/
mtha' nas 'dus pa/ bya spyod tshang ma mtha' chums byas pa/
the tshom mam dogs pa sogs kyi rtsa ba chod pa/ dogs gnas kyi mtha' chod nas yang dag pa'i don nges pa/
'byung 'gyur/ gral bstar gyi mtha' mjug / yig phreng de'i mtha' mjug la yod pa'i yi ge/ phyi lo'i mtha' mjug tu tshur log yong/
gos sogs kyi mtha' chags sam, mtha' 'gril/ gyon pa 'tshem skabs mtha' mar mtha' 'jags gtong ba/
1) phyogs gnyis/ yod med kyi mtha' gnyis/ bzang ngan gyi mtha' gnyis/ mtha' gnyis su dogs pa/ 2) chad mtha' rtag mtha' gnyis sam srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis so/
mtha' gnyis spang ba'i spyod pa
rab tu byung ba rnams kyi 'tsho ba rgyas drags pa dang, zhan drags pa'i mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba ste, 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang ngal dub la sbyor ba'i mtha' gnyis spang ba'o/
lta ba rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' spangs pa dang, 'tsho ba bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang, ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa/
pha mthar gtugs pa ste mtha' la slebs pa/ dus snga phyi'i mtha' gtugs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' gtugs pa/
yi ge'i rjes 'jug / ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa...
slob ma rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir tsaka li sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun dang, bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad sogs kyi dbang bskur ba'o/
mtha' ma gang yin gyi ltag ma ste de'i gong ma
brgyab pa'i thig ris:/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' thig / dpe cha'i mtha' thig /
mang tshig cig / yul gru mtha' dag
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi yan lag dang yan lag can mtha' dag dpe'i yan lag dang yan lag can gyi gzugs su bkod pa'i rgyan zhig /
las don thag chod pa'i mtha' ma'i don gnad/
mthar thug gi bar 'dum/ mi mthun pa thams cad kyi mtha' 'dum par byas pa/

bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod chags yul gyi sa dbyibs srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba lta bu'i dpung mgo g.yas g.yon dang, dpyi mgo g.yas g.yon gyi kha gnon du bzhengs pa'i gyon ru khra 'brug dang, g.yas ru gtsang 'gram, dbu ru bka' tshal, ru lag grum pa rgyang ste lha khang bzhi/
mthar ma thug bar 'ded pa'am rtsad gcod pa/ bden rdzun gyi dbye ba mtha' 'ded gsal por byas/
mtha' mjug tshang bar 'dus pa/ 'phral phugs 'gyur ldog med pa'i mtha' 'doms kyi gan rgya 'jog len byas pa/
mjug sdom mam, mjug sdud pa/ nyams myong rnams mtha' sdom byed pa/
'gyur ldog mi 'byung ba'i phyir thag gcod kyi bris dan/ phan tshun gnyis phyogs nas mtha' bsdoms gan rgya 'dzugs rgyur mos mthun byung/
sa cha yul grong sogs kyi mtha' la gnas pa'i mi/ dgon pa'i mtha' pa/
gzhung don dka' gnad kyi mtha' la dpyad pa byed pa/ gzhung don zab mo la lung dang rigs pa sbyar nas mtha' dpyod pa/ rang la the tshom yod na gzhan la 'dri sdur byas te mtha' dpyod byed/
1) mtha' med/ sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' bral yang, kha skor shes na skam sar slebs/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
mtha' dang dkyil/ nam mkhar mtha' dbus med/ yul gyi mtha' dbus/ gral gyi mtha' dbus/
rgyang 'bud/ nyes can rigs mtha' 'bud gtong ba/
1) mtha' klas pa/ 2) «tsarmam» grangs gnas shig
rjes ma/ mi byed dgu byed mang drags na mtha' ma'i ngan 'bras brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig 'khor yong/ me la rtsed mo brtses pa na, mtha' mar rang nyid 'tshig par 'gyur/
1) yul gzhan dang phyi rgyal gyi mi/ 2) yul khams kyi mthar gnas pa'i mi/
1) mtha' mngon mi thub pa'am mu med/ mtha' med 'khor ba rnams kyi tshang tshing khrod/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
rgyal khab phyi rol gyi dgra dmag /
mtha' bzang ba'am, phugs brtan pa/ rgya khyab mi dmangs rnams la rgyab rten bcol na mtha' btsan pa zhig yong/
'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i mtshan gzhan zhig / mtha' tshar, snam ras sogs kyi kha tshar ram, phud tshar/
sa mtshams/ mtha' mtshams brtan srung/ mtha' mtshams sa khul/
rgyal khab phan tshun gyi mtha'i dbye: mtshams sa thig /

1) phyogs bzhi'am, ngos bzhi'am, mtha' skor/ 2) mu bzhi/ 3) skyes nas lo bzhi lon pa'i rta drel sogs/ 4) skyes mtha' 'chi ba, 'dus mtha' 'bral ba, bsags mtha' 'dzad pa, mtho mtha' lhung ba ste bzhi/ 5) bden par grub pa'i rtag mtha' dang, tha snyad tsam du med pa'i chad mtha', bden par grub pa dang tha snyad du med pa gnyis kar yod pa'i yod mtha', bden par med pa dang tha snyad du yod pa gnyis kar med pa'i med mtha' bcas bzhi ste, yod mtha' dang, med mtha', gnyis ka'i mtha', gnyis min gyi mtha' rnams so/
par rgyal ba: mtha' skor gyi phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/

dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus su yul lung gzhan nas gdan drangs pa'i rgya gar gyi sman pa shanti garbha dang, kha che gu hye bdzra, rgya nag nas stong gsum gang ba, ha shang ba la, hang ti pa ta gsum, ta zig nas ha la shanti, gru gu nas seng mdo 'od chen, dol po nas khyol ma rung rtse, bal po nas dharma shi la ste dgu'o/
1) tshad med pa/ 2) klu rgyal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / 3) (mngon) sa gzhi/
mtha' med pa/ nam mkha'i rgya khyon mtha' yas pa/
'du shes tshad med pa ste nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min man chad kyi 'du shes so/
(mngon) 1) sa gzhi/ 2) dpal ldan lha mo/
rang yul min pa'i gzhan yul/ rgyus med mtha' yul du 'gro ba/
phugs la thug pa/ brtag dpyad zhib mor byas nas don snying gi mtha' la reg pa/
mu med pa'am, mtha' med pa/
mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid
yod med gang du bzung na mi mthun phyogs kyi g.yang du lhung ba'i rtag mtha' dang chad mtha' las 'das pa'i chos nyid de, stong nyid bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig /
rgyal khab kyi mtha' mtshams srung dmag /
gsal ba/ dkar nag mtha' gsal/
gnas tshul mngon sum du ra 'phrod gsal po byung ba/
1) mtha' skor gyi yul/ 2) mtha' skor gyi rgyal khab/
rim gyis/ sbyangs na mthar gyis shes par 'gyur/ mi tsho mthar gyis yong bzhin yod kyang da dung tshang 'dzoms mi 'dug / lag rtsal mthar gyis sbyang ba/
mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs me
bzhi sogs kyi gnas re re nas rim pa mthar chags su bgrod de rang lam gyi mnyam bzhag la snyoms par 'jug pa,
mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu
bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar go rim mthar chags su gnas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang, snyoms 'jug bzhi dang, 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste dgu'o/

mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa la brtan pa thob don du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad rim gyis rta rgyug pa ltar dkyus thogs gcig la go rim nges can du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig

chos bcu gsum: sher phyin don bdun cu las sbyor ba bzhi'i chos so drug gi nang tshan mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum ni, pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang, rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang, dngos med ngo bo nyid du shes pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba bcas bcu gsum mo/
1) rim gyis bzhag pa'am, gral bsgrigs pa/ 2) (rnying) 'jur mdud med pa/
bsod snyoms pa: grong mthar chags su slong ba'i dge slong lta bu'o/
mthar phyin pa/ rgyal kha mthar gyur pa/
go rim bzhin nam, rim pa bzhin/ skad cha mthar chags kyis bshad dgos pa dang, las don mthar chags kyis byed dgos pa/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis mthar chags su rgyu ba/
pha rol tshu rol gyi bar mtshams dang zad mtshams la gtugs pa/ mthar gtugs nas bshad na/

mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ste, 'jig lta'i yul gyi bdag la dmigs nas rtag pa ther zug pa'am phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba med pa'i chad par lta ba'i rnam pa can, byed las dbu ma'i lam gyi nges par 'byung ba la bar du gcod pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can/
zad mtshams la slebs pa'am son pa/ legs grub mthar thug bar/ ma rabs kyi mthar thug pa/ mthar thug rgyal kha/ mthar thug dmigs yul/

'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis las nyon rtsa ba nas sbyangs te mthar thug rnam dag sgyu ma'i lha sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam pa can mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'bras bu'i tshul du 'grub par 'gyur ba'o/
phugs kyi gnad 'gag gcig tu bsdoms pa'i don/
mthar thug pa'i lam ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes/
thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes/
khyad chos gsum: ngo bo ka nas dag pa rig stong dbyer med dang, rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa gsal stong dbyer med, thugs rje kun la khyab pa snang stong dbyer med de gsum/
brdung bya'i dngos spyad khod snyoms zhun mthar 'don byed kyi yo byad cig /
mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i bsdus ming,
legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed ya ra la wa ste bzhi/ ya ra la wa...wa...pa...la...ta...
gi pha mtha' la skrod pa:/ mi ngan rnams lung pa'i mthar spyug pa/
pha rol tu phyin pa/ yon tan mthar phyin pa slob dgos/ gnas tshul mthar phyin par rtogs pa/ mi tshe mthar phyin pa/ legs bcos mthar ma phyin pa/ mthar phyin pa'i phra ba/
chub sems dpa': sa bcu'i rgyun mthar gnas pa'i byang sems/
sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/
mtha' la 'bros pa/ g.yul sa'i mthar 'byol ba/
mthar ma thug pa'i shes pa
byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi shes pa/
bdag gam phung po lnga la rtag pa dang chad par 'dzin pa 'di dbu ma'i lam gyis nges par 'byung ba la bar du gcod pa'i las can no/
ge : legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed, ksha...
pha rol tu slebs pa dang, zad mthar phyin pa/ sbyong brdar mthar son pa byed/
tshad mtshams zad pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs/
rdo tshon sngon po zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la ku shu'i khams dang, dus kyi me tog bya khyung rdo, mig sman sngon po, me tog mig sman, me tog ze, gsal ldan, gsal ba can bcas so,
gzhi sngon po la ri mo dkar po yod pa'i dar rigs shig / mthing khra'i g.yab dar gyis g.yobs shig / dkar yol yu ring la mthing khra'i dar khebs g.yogs shig /
lha mo tshe ring mched lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ding ri rdzong gi lho ngos su yod/
rdo sman gyi rigs dbyibs rgyus phran gshib pa dang 'dra zhing mdog mthing ga zhig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas chu rgyus chad pa dang, chu rgyus rengs 'khums gyur pa sogs la phan/
rdo sman gyi rigs mdog sngo nag can zhig ste, nus pas mkhal ma'i nad dang, dri chu sri ba, rgyus pa 'grams pa bcas la phan/
zhing nag po:/ sku mdog mthing nag rab tu brjid/
rma gting shin tu ring por lus pa'i zug rngu 'don byed kyi skam pa chu bya mthing ril gyi mchu 'dra ba zhig
sngo mdog tu 'gyur ba'i tshos shing shig /

/ shog shog bu sngon po/ ,/ 1) dbus sam, gtso bo/ grong khyer gyi mthil/ las don gyi mthil/ nang don gyi mthil shes pa/ 2) 'og zhabs sam gting/ rkang mthil/ lag mthil/ lham mthil/ rgya mtsho'i mthil/ gtsang po'i mthil/ dkar yol gyi mthil/
phugs don dang, snying po mig la ston pa'am bshad pa/ las don gang 'dra byas na phan thogs che ba'i zhal ta bslab bya'i mthil ston rogs gnang/
1) snod kyi zhabs brtol ba/ 2) nyes can gyi mtshang brtol ba/ nyes spyod kyi mthil brtol ba/ rdzun gtam mthil brtol/
snod dang chu bo'i gting mtha'/
mthar phyin/ lag len mthil phyin bstar ba/ rtsad gcod mthil phyin pa byed/ sman rig mthil phyin pa rtogs pa/
tshod len mi thub pa'i gting ring ba/ brtson 'grus ldan na gzhung don gyi dgongs pa'i mthil mi reg pa gang yang ma red/
khang pa'i mthil gyi zhal ba/
(yul) lham gyi rdog pa'i lhan pa/
rkang pa'i mthil tsam 'khor ba'i lham zhig /
/ 1) stobs/ mthu nyams pa/ snying stobs kyi mthu phul du byung ba/ 2) ngan sngags/ mthu gtong ba/ mthu rgyag pa/ mthu 'debs pa/ ngan sngags kyi mthu gnod gtong ba/
1) nus stobs chen po/ 2) sngags kyi mthu nus chen po/ 3) khyab 'jug gi ming/
gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/
byad ma mkhan gyi ngan sngags/
mthu'i stobs sam nus pa/ dgra phyogs rnam par gnon pa'i mthu stobs chen po yod pa/
1) nus pa thob pa'am rnyed pa/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
nus pa phul du phyin pa/
mthu stobs dang dpung shugs mnyam bsdongs byed pa/ mthu bsdongs dpung bsdongs byas te dgra la rgol ba/
1) nus pa dang gzi brjid dam mnga' thang/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
mthu phun tshogs kyi zol bstod

zol bstod kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bstod yul dpe can la rang nyid nus mthu'i khyad par lhag 'dod kyi rgyags pa ste nga rgyal med kyang, yod pa ltar du smad de don du dpe mthu ldan gzhan zhig bkod nas de dang mtshungs pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs par zol gyis bstod pa'i rgyan zhig /
ngan sngags mkhan gyi mthu dang byad stems/
nus pa nyams pa/ lo rgas nas lus mthu bri ba/
nus pa med pa dang, thabs med pa/ rang la 'gan 'khri yod kyang sgrub pa'i mthu med pa/
nus pa dang ldan pa/ gan rgya mthu mo che bris 'jog byas pa/ dpung sde mthu mo che/ yi dwags mthu mo che/
stobs rtsal nus pa/ rgyal srung dpung sde'i mthu rtsal gyi chu tshad/
nus pa chen po yod pa/ rang la mthu yod pas gzhan dring kho nar mi 'jog /
ting nge 'dzin: sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/
dpangs tshad/ lcags ri mthug rngams chen po/
/ 1) ngos gnyis kyi bar tshad che ba/ snam bu mthug po/ shog bu mthug po/ 2) stug po/ shing nags mthug po/ mi tshogs mthug po/ sa bon mthug 'debs/
rgya gar skad kyi gsal byed yi ge'i sde tshan las gha dzha sogs kyi ming/ gha dzha...
shog bu bregs kha gnyis sbyar ba'i mthud mtshams su brgyab pa'i the'u/
(tha dad pa) sbrel ba'am, sbyor ba/ chad pa'i thag pa rnams mthud pa/ chad mthud yo bsrangs/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud/ skad cha gcig 'phror gnyis mthud/
/ 1) gra bsgrigs nas bzhag pa'i dngos rigs/ 2) lhan pa/ gyon pa rnying par mthud ma khag mang brgyab pa/
gra bsgrigs nas bzhag pa'i dmag gi dpung rogs

phan tshun mthud pa'i bar mtshams/ phan tshun mthud mtshams shor te kha bral ba/ mthun rkyen, 'bras bu 'byung ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i rkyen nam rgyu, dper na, nas myug skye ba'i mthun rkyen chu lud dang, 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen zas gos lta bu/ mthun rkyen sgrig pa/ 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong ba'i mthun rkyen byed pa/ mthun rkyen smin pa/ mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa/

rab tu byung ba la mthun rkyen lnga dang ldan dgos pa ste, yul mchog gsum dang mkhan slob bzhugs pa dang, rgyud tshogs su ma tshang zhing sdom ro med pa dang, tshigs snga ma sngon du song ba, rtags skra dang kha spu bregs shing yo byad tshang ba, bsam pa rgyu dus kyi kun slong dang ldan zhing nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa, cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang ba bcas lnga'o/
zas gos gnas mal sogs kyi cha rkyen gsol ras gnang ba'i skal ba/
1) bsam pa mthun pa'i grogs po/ 2) phan pa sgrub pa'i grogs po/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar nye dang, blo dkar ba, snying sdug mdza' bshes bcas so,
mthun 'gyur gyi skad cha'am, gcig mthun gyi gros mol/
1) rogs ram dang mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba/ 2) gcig mthun du 'gyur ba/
: grogs byed pa'i yi ge / mthun sgril, thun mong gi phugs re'am las 'gan legs 'grub byed ched nus shugs gcig sdud kyis mnyam du sgril ba/

1) gzhan dang mthun po byed 'jug pa/ rgyab 'dre rgyag mkhan gnyis phyogs mthun 'jug byed pa/ 2) gzhan dang bstun pa/ rang snang gang dran min par gzhan gyi bsam blo dang mthun 'jug byed pa/ mi gzhan la bstun pa'i mthun 'jug can/
bsam blo mthun zhing mnyam du 'grogs pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) mdza' ba dang, 'chams pa/ mi mthun pa rnams mthun par gyur/ bya rog 'ug pa mi mthun pa/ 'phros mol zhib gsal byas pa'i mthar nged gnyis kyi bsam tshul gzhi nas mthun song/ 2.gcig pa dang, mtshungs pa/ kha gting gnyis mthun/ gros mthun pa/ snga tshig dang mthun pa/ lta ba mthun pa/ gzhi mthun pa/ rigs mthun pa/ blo sems mthun pa/ bshad tshul gzhan dang mi mthun pa/ bde sdug gang zhus tshang ma gnas lugs rgyu mtshan dang mthun pa sha stag red/
sngon byung bya gong ma sreg dang, ri bong, spre'u, glang chen bzhis rgan gzhon brtsi bkur byas pas de'i yul du bde skyid byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi ri mo zhig /
mdza' grogs kyi bar du dkrug shing rgyag pa/

tshig phrad kyang sogs tshig don snga phyi mthun pa'i rgyan la 'jug pa/ kyang yang 'ang...khong gis bod yig sbyangs kyang sbyangs yod la, mkhas kyang mkhas po yod/ glog zhu btsugs kyang btsugs yod la, gsal yang gsal lo/ ngas khong la rogs ram byas kyang byas la, khong dga' yang dga' song/
phan tshun 'gal ba med pa'i dngos po/
shog bu sogs la me sbar te btsugs na rlung khrag 'thabs pas gzer ba dang, phyi skran mtha' dag gcur byed kyi yo byad me bum/
rang 'dra skyed par byed pa'i rgyu/
nad bab dang mthun pa'i gso byed kyi sman/
'dul ba'i lugs dang mthun pa'i dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad/
'gro phyogs dang mthun pa'i rlung/ ming gi rnam grangs la rjes mthun rlung dang, 'dod pa'i rlung, ba dan dar gyi shugs 'gro bcas so,

gso sbyong drug gi nang gses, tshe 'di'i zag pa 'gog cing lhag pa'i tshul khrims dag par bya ba'i phyir mthun pa'i gso sbyong zhes bya ste, de la'ang nang gses su gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa dang, bco lnga pa dang, gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong dang, 'khon pa bsdum pa'i gso sbyong dang, bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong dang lnga yod do/
gcig pa dang, mtshungs pa'i don du 'jug pa'i mthun pa dang 'dra,
rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god skabs bsgrub bya nges pa'i ched du bkod pa'i mtshungs dpe'am rang dang rigs mthun gyi dpe/
rtags chos gnyis dang mi ldan pa'am, bsgrub bya nges pa'i sngon du khyab pa nges byed kyi gzhir ma gyur pa, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun dper sgra bkod pa lta bu'o/

dpe yang dag gnyis kyi ya gyal: rtags chos gnyis ldan gyi chos mthun sbyor gyi dpe ste, bsgrub bya nges pa'i sngon du rjes khyab dngos su nges pa'i gzhir gyur pa, byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun dper bum pa bkod pa lta bu'o/
1) skal pa gcig pa'am sde tshan gcig pa/ 2) mdza' mthun gyi gnyen grogs/ 3) de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyis mi stong pa ste, bsgrub bya'i chos dang, rjes su mthun pa'am ldan pa rjes 'gro'i tshul/

byed mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug: pa phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi'i ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs la khyab cing mi mthun phyogs la khyab ma khyab gnyis ka'i cha yod pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtsol byung yin te, mi rtag pa'i phyir, dpe rnga sgra dang, glog dang nam mkha' bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, mi rtag pa de sgra rtsol byung du sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug cing, mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa ste, rtsol byung la mi rtag pas khyab, rtsol byung ma yin pa la rtag mi rtag gnyis ka yod pa'o/

med mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug: pa phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las 'gal rtags gnyis kyi ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs la med cing mi mthun phyogs la khyab pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir, dpe nam mkha' dang bum pa bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, byas pa de sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs la gtan med dang, mi mthun phyogs mi rtag pa la khyab pa'o/
mthun phyogs la gtan med mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug

pa phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las 'gal rtags gnyis kyi ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs la gtan nas med cing mi mthun phyogs la yod med gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan pa, dper na, dung sgra chos can, rtag ste, rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir, dpe nam mkha' dang bum pa dang glog bzhin zhis pa lta bu, rtsol byung de dung sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs la gtan nas med cing, mi mthun phyogs mi rtag pa la rtsol byung yin min gyi cha gnyis ka yod pa'o/
bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mthun phyogs la yod pa, dper na, byas pa rtags su bkod nas mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshe byas pa de mi rtag pa'i mthun phyogs la yod pa lta bu/
mthun phyogs la yod par nges pa
bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mthun phyogs la yod par tshad mas grub pa/
phyogs gnyis mthun par byed pa/
phyogs gnyis phan tshun mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba/

phan tshun mthun pa'i las la sbyor ba/ bzo zhing gnyis bar la mthun sbyor gyi las ka yag po byed pa/ bya spyod nor ba la mthun sbyor ma byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la nye bar sbyor ba dang, mthun phyogs, mtshams sbyor, mdza' byed pa bcas so,
phan tshun bsam pa dang, spyod pa, skad brda, cha lugs sogs ris mthun pa dang, mi mthun pa gnyis/

gnyis ka la gtan med du 'jug pa: phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las thun mong min pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags te, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gnyis ka la gtan nas med pa ste, dper na sgra chos can, rtag ste, mnyan bya yin pa'i phyir, dpe bum pa dang nam mkha' bzhin, shes pa lta bu, mnyan bya de sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs nam mkha' la gtan nas med cing, me mthun phyogs bum pa la'ang gtan nas med pa'o/
mthun mi mthun phyogs gnyis kar khyab byed du 'jug pa

phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi'i ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gnyis ka la khyab par yod pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtag ste, gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir, dpe nam mkha' dang bum pa bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, gzhal bya de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs rtag pa'i phyogs dang, mi mthun phyogs mi rtag pa gnyis ka la khyab byed du 'jug pa ste, rtag pa yin na gzhal bya yin pas khyab, mi rtag pa yin na gzhal bya yin pas khyab pa'o/
mthun mi mthun phyogs gnyis kar rnam pa gnyis gnyis su 'jug pa

phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi'i ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs la khyab ma khyab gnyis ka dang, mi mthun phyogs la'ang khyab ma khyab gnyis ka'i cha yod pa, dper na, zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes chos can, mngon sum yin te, dbang shes yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu, dbang shes de phyogs gnyis la rnam pa gnyis gnyis su 'jug pa ste, mthun phyogs mngon sum la dbang shes yin min gnyis yod cing, mi mthun mngon sum min pa la'ang dbang shes yin min gnyis yod pa'o, yang na 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran rtag pa dang reg bya can gzhi mthun du 'dod pa'i ngor, sgra rtag ste, reg bya can ma yin pa'i phyir, dpe nam mkha' dang rdul phran dang glog dang bum pa bzhin zhes pa lta bu'o/
phan tshun mnyam 'brel gyi chod don gan rgya/
thun mong gi las don zhig 'phel rgyas gtong ched du btsugs pa'i mang tshogs kyi tshogs pa/ zhing pa'i mthun tshogs/
yid mthun gyi rogs sam, zla bo/
byad dbyibs sogs gzhi mthun gyi gzugs/
phan tshun mthun pa'i 'brel lam/ spun zla mi rigs phan tshun dbar gyi mthun lam/
rta bong gi mgor bskon nas 'khrid 'dogs byed pa'i yo byad cig / rta la ma bzhon gong du srab mthur skon pa/
srab las gzhan pa'i rgyun du mgo la bskon rgyu zhig
rta drel la gyog rgyu'i mthur 'go dang: mdzo g.yag la gyog rgyu'i sna thag /
rta drel gyi mthur 'gor btags pa'i thag pa
rta drel gyi mthur 'gor btags pa'i thag pa
mthur 'gor btags pa'i rta drel 'khrid byed kyi thag pa/
stobs shugs kyis gzhan nor rku ba/ btsan dbang gis 'phrog pa dang, gyo thabs kyi mthus rku ba gnyis gang byas kyang nyes tshabs khyad med/
gis gzhan nor 'phrog pa:/ rgyu nor mthus 'phrog /
sor mo sbom shos/ ming gi rnam grangs ni sor mo'i thu bo'o,
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs yul 'ga' zhig tu zhing bran mthe bong lag par skyes tshad kyis mnga' bdag gi zhing ga'i snye ma sgrug par 'gro dgos pa'i khral zhig
mthe bong gi dpangs zheng gi tshad de mtheb tshon dang mtshungs/
mthe bong la bskon rgyu'i krad kor/
zan la mthe bong gis kong kong bzos pa'i gtor gsos kyi mtheb skyu/
mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis phan tshun rdeb pa ste se gol gtog pa/
(yul) gzhan gyi am phrag nang gi ca lag thabs kyis rku ba po'i ming/
mthe'u chung ste rkang lag gi sor mo lnga'i tha ma/
mtheb gri ba dang mtshungs te gzhan gyi am phrag gi nor rkun/ mtheb dras rgyag mkhan/
mthe bong la brten nas 'bebs pa'i mo pra/
lag pa'i sor mo dang po la mthe bong zhes pa de'i tshigs gnyis pa la'o/
mthe bong dang srin mdzub gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
rkang lag gi sor mo tha ma/
/ 1) mthe bong gi rtse nas gung mo'i rtse bar gyi ring tshad/ 'jim sku mtho gang ba/ mdzub mtho/ gung mtho/ ras cha mtho do/ 2) sor mo bcu gnyis kyi zheng tshad/
mtheb rtse nas gong mdzub kyi rtse'i bar tshad de dang sor bcu gnyis gzhal ba gnyis don gcig /
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, gding ba gsar pa drub pa'i tshe, rnying pa nas bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang gi tshad de mi'i khru phyed do ma glan par longs spyad pa'o/
ring thung la mtho tshad brgyab pa/
ring thung la mtho tshad rgyag pa/

1) go gnas gong ma gong mar snyeg 'dod byed pa/ 'dod chen mtho snyeg byed mkhan la, spyir phan lhag bsam spu tsam med/ 2) mgo 'dren nam, rgyab gnyer mtho bo 'tshol ba/ rang mgo rang 'don ma thub par, kha drag mtho snyeg ci zhig phan/
che mthor rlom pa'i nga rgyal/ yon tan che yang mtho snyems kyi khengs dregs med/
lta ba'am snang ba mthon po'i rtsing spyod/

/ 1) mi dma' ba'am rtsa rtse yang na steng shod bar gyi tshad che ba/ sa mtho ba/ shing mtho ba/ rba rlabs mtho ba/ khang rtseg mtho ba/ 2) khyad par du 'phags pa'am mchog / rigs rus mtho ba/ rang nyid mtho bar sems pa/ snang ba mtho ba/ yon tan mtho ba/ riin gong mtho ba/ ri ltar mtho zhing chu ltar ring ba/ mtho nam mkhar nyi zla nyin ltar 'khor/
mtho sra sprel lad 'khrab pa dang, nyam chung la thub tshod byed pa'i gtam dpe/ ma rabs rang rtags mtho 'byar dma' rdung der, su zhig yin yang zhen log yi thang chad/
drag zhan nam, mchog dang tha shal/ go sa mtho dman/ bslab pa mtho dman/
sgang gshong ngam, gyen 'phang gi mtho tshad che chung/ sa bab mtho dma'/ dbyar dus kyi chu ngos mtho dma'/
sgang gshong khod snyoms pa/ lam ga'i sa cha 'bur kyong gang yod mnyam par brdal nas mtho dma' snyoms po byas pa/
phyag mchod gsol 'debs kyi rten tshogs zhing sgom tshul zhig ste, gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar gcig thog tu gcig brtsegs nas bzhugs pa'i rnam pa/
1) gyen 'phang mtho ba'i tshad/ 2) lag mtho'i tshad/ 3) tshad mthon po/
1) 'gran pa/ ston pa la mtho 'tsham zhing bar du gcod par 'dod pa/ 2) gnod pa dang brnyas bcos byed pa/ dgra la mtho 'tsham pa/
rim pa mtho ba/ mtho rim mi sna rnams lhan cig tu gros mol byas/

mthon po'i phyogs sam rigs te lha dang mi/ ming gi rnam grangs la skabs gsum gnas pa dang, skyo med, rgyal srid, 'chi med gnas, steng gi 'jig rten, dal 'dzin, bde 'gro, bde ldan, ram mkha'i khyim, gnas bzang, rol pa'i sa, sa bla, sum rtsen, lha yi grong, lha yi yul, lha yi 'jig rten bcas so,
mtho ris lha mi'i dge ba ste, zag bcas kyi dge ba/
rigs bzang ba dang, gzugs mdzes pa, tshe ring ba, nad med pa, skal ba bzang ba, nor phyug pa, shes rab che ba ste bdun/
lha dang, mi, lha ma yin te gsum/
mjal ba tsam gyis thar pa thob pa ste sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku brnyan 'gar gsol ba'i mtshan/ thub dbang mthong grol ma/ byams pa mthong grol ma/
mig gis mthong na dga', rna bas thos na dga'/
mig gis mthong yul gyi rgya khyon che chung/
1) yon tan cher med pa/ 2) sa cha gu dog po/
1) yon tan chen po/ 2) sa cha gu yangs po/
1) shes yon med pa/ 2) sa cha'i mthong yul rgya chung ba/
snang chung/ rang nyid mtho snyems kyi nga rgyal dang, gzhan la mthong chung gi khyad gsod ma byed/ dgra bor mthong chung byed pa/
gtsigs mthong chen po'am, gal cher brtsi ba/ ngal rtsol la mthong chen po byed pa/
da lta'i dus skabs 'di la mthong ba'i chos/
'jig rten tshe 'di'i lus sems kyi bde ba la gnas pa'o/
mthong chos bder gnas kyi lam lnga

tshe 'dir bde bar gnas pa'i lam nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dang, rnam shes mtha' yas kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug ci yang med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug 'gog pa'i rnam thar te lnga/
tshe 'der bsags pa'i las 'bras tshe 'dir myong ba/
tshe 'di la byas pa'i las stobs ldan tshe de nyid du smin pa rnams/
mthong lam thob pa'i mi tshe de nyid la mya ngan las 'da' ba ste myang 'das thob nges kyi phyir mi 'ong/
dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, mthong ba'i chos la zhi ba 'thob pa ste, phyir mi 'ong dang po thob pa'i rten la dgra bcom pa thob pa phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi gras shig /
mig mthong rna thos/ sngar gyi mthong thos kyi yul las 'das pa/ sngar mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo/
spyod yul thams cad la zing cha slong ba/

mig gis mthong ba, rna bas thos pa, yid kyis dogs pa gsum/ gnas tshul gsar pa mthong thos dogs gsum ji byung tshang ma snang med du ma 'jog / rang gi mthong thos dogs gsum ji byung tshang ma dran thor bkod pa/
mig gis mthong ba dang: rna bas thos pa, yid kyis dran pa, lus kyis reg pa bcas so/
mthong ba tsam gyis nad phog pa'i dug /
gzhan mthong gi the tshom med pa/ kho rang nga rgyal che drags nas nyam chung rnams mthong dogs med/
mthong tshul lam, mthong phyogs/ 'khyag pa krad kor tsam la mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna kha bdun/
/ tshul min gyi spyod lam byas na gzhan gyi mig yul la mthong snang mdzes po mi yong/
mthong lam gyis spang bar bya ba ste, nyon mongs kun btags kyi cha dang shes sgrib rad pa rnams so/

mthong lam gyis spang byar gyur pa'i kun tu sbyor ba gsum ste, 'jig lta kun btags kyis thar ba la skrag nas 'gro mi 'dod kun sbyor dang, tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyis lam ma yin pa la lam du 'dzin pas lam nor gyi kun sbyor, lam la the tshom byas nas thar ba'i gegs byed pas the tshom gyi kun sbyor bcas gsum mo/
mthong spang brgya dang bcu gnyis

'dod pa'i mthong spang bden pa bzhi po re re'i spang bya phra rgyas bcu re bcu re brtsis pas bzhi bcu dang, khams gong ma gnyis su khong khro med pas so drug pa tshan pa gnyis bcas khams gsum gyi mthong spang bsdoms pas brgya dang bcu gnyis yod par mngon pa kun btus las gsungs/
mthong spang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad

'dod khams kyi mthong spang so gnyis dang, gzugs khams kyi mthong spang nyer brgyad, gzugs med khams kyi mthong spang nyer brgyad bcas khams gsum na khyon bsdoms pas mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i phra rgyas gya brgyad yod par mngon pa mdzod las gsungs/
phan tshun mthong skabs 'bul res byas pa'i phyag
snang tshul/ mthong phyogs yang dag pa/ mthong phyogs gcig gyur/ lta snang mthong phyogs/

1.(tha mi dad pa) rig pa dang, snang ba/ mig mthong gzud grub/ mig mthong lag zin/ nyin mor bltas kyang mi mthong long ba yin/ mig 'phrul yin pas mig gis mthong yang yid mi ches/ gdong ris ngan pa mthong na 'jigs su rung/ mdun lam gsal por mthong ba/ zab don legs par mthong/ 2.rtsis mthong/ mi'i bsam 'char mthong med du ma 'jog /
mthong ba tsam gyis don dang ldan pa/
1) mthong ba don dang 'brel ba/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 3) ta la'i bla ma'i mtshan gyi che ming zhig /
mig mthong gzugs grub kyi don dag /
mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan
rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag, yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba: 'khor ba las yongs su thar ba'i zhi ba myang 'das/
rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mngon rtogs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis gang zag gi bdag med dang po mngon sum du mthong ba 'di dman pa sa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
mthong bas spang bar bya ba
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga'i ya gyal mig la gnas pa zhig ste, byed las phyi rol gyi yul bltas nas mthong bar byed pa zhig /
mur gong gi gshong na gnas pa'i mig gi rtsa gnyan zhig /
ngos 'dzin byed stangs/ mthong tshul gcig gyur/ 'jig rten gyi gnas tshul la mthong tshul mi 'dra ba yod/
mig gis mthong ba dang, rna bas go tshor/
mthong yul/ mthong g.yel rgya che ba/ grog rong gi nang du slebs skabs mthong g.yel chung ngu las med/

lam lnga'i nang gses, rnam par grol ba'i 'jug ngogs gang zhig de kho na nyid sngar ma mthong ba gsar du mthong zhing 'phags pa'i sar phyin par byed pa dang, chos nyid ji lta ba bdag med mngon sum rtogs shing chos can ji snyed pa'i don yang ci rigs par rtogs pa dang, byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bsgoms pas, spang bya mthong spang gi nyon mongs pa rnams rtsad nas bcom pa'i tshul gyis spong zhing, 'jigs pa lnga dang bral zhing yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sod thob par byed pa'i lam mo/
bcu drug mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig: bcu drug go
mthong lam gyi bzod pa brgyad

mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi bar chad med lam brgyad de, sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang, sdug bsngal rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa, kun 'byung ba la chos shes pa'i bzod pa, kun 'byung ba la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa, 'gog pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa, 'gog pa la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa, lam la chos shes pa'i bzod pa, lam la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa/
shes skad cig bcu drug bden pa mthong ba'i: lam gyi bzod pa brgyad dang shes pa brgyad
mthong lam gyi shes pa brgyad

mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi rnam grol lam brgyad de, sdug bsngal chos shes pa dang, sdug bsngal rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa, kun 'byung ba la chos shes pa, kun 'byung ba la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa, 'gog pa la chos shes pa, 'gog pa la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa, lam la chos shes pa, lam la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa/
skad cig bcu drug mthong lam gyi ye shes: skad cig bcu drug dang don gcig
mthong spang spangs nas bral ba'i thob pa nyams su myong ba'i lam, shes pa brgyad de sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba mngon du byas pa'o/
mthong lam bar chad med lam

mthong lam gyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i spang bya kun brtags kyi cha rnams spong ba'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i lam bzod pa brgyad de, sbyor lam gyi rjes thog tu gzhan gyis bar ma bcad par sgrib pa spong ba'o/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa gang zhig mthong spang bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs so/
mngon sum mthong chos kyi yul/ mig lam du mthong gsal ltar red/ tshang mas mthong gsal ltar/
/ 1) bar stong gi dbyings/ 2) khang pa'i rgya mthongs/
lcog tse'i mdun ngos su g.yog byed gos chen sogs kyi rgyan spros/
khang pa'i dkar khung ngam, du ba 'gro sa'i thog khung ngam gnam khung/ mi kha rog sdod sar snyad mthongs khung nas rko/
sbra'i mthongs 'byed byed kyi rgyug pa
(yul) thang ga sogs kyi gong gsham gyi mthongs 'jug /
(yul) mthongs g.yog byed kyi re lder btags pa'i thag pa phra bo
rin chen sngon po'am, indra ni la/ ming gi rnam grangs la dbang sngon dang, nor bu'i snying po, indra snyil bcas so,
rngams che ba'am, dpangs mtho ba/ rtswa shing mthon po skyes pa/ rba rlabs mthon po/ ri mthon po/ chu tshad mthon po/ lo na mthon po/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma stod rdzong gi ri bo zhig mtho tshad mtsho ngos las smi 4810 yod/
1) gong du bkur ba'i don/ 2) gyen du bkyag pa/ dar cha dmar po mthon por bteg pa/
1.(tha mi dad pa) sgrog pa'am, mi gsang bar smra ba/ sdig pa ci yod rnams mi 'chab par mthol ba/ 2. nyes ltung byung ba rnams spa gsang med par bshad pa ste, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi nang gses shig /
rang gi nyes pa mi gsang bar shod pa/ spyang kyi rgas nas mthol bshags/
(yul) mtho drags pa'am, mtho che ba/ gdan 'di phran bu mthos pa red/
1) sked rags dang, lham sgrog pang gdan thag pa sogs 'thag las byed mkhan/ 2) rtsam pa sogs 'thag mkhan/ 3) (mngon) sdom/

1.(tha dad pa) btags pa, btag pa, 'thog, 1) 'joms pa dang, med par bzo ba/ dgra dpung phye mar btags pa/ bgegs bar tshang ma rmeg med du btags pa/ 2) zhib mor bzo ba/ nas rnams brngos nas rtsam pa btags pa/ 3) ras sogs 'thag pa/ bal skud bkal nas snam bu btags pa/ lag shubs 'thag pa/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) thag pa, 'thag pa,, skam por 'gyur ba/ sha khu thag song/ chu 'thag tu bcug pa/

spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pas thags btags nas rang la ster bar khas blangs pa na thags mkhan la gla rngan byin nas sbyin bdag gi blo dang mi 'tsham pa'i bzang rin chen por 'thag tu bcug pa'o/
lham sgrog 'thag mkhan gyi lag cha zhig /
thags 'thag byed kyi shing leb mo so can/
mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang dngos stobs rjes dpag dang yid ches rjes dpag ste tshad ma gsum gang rung gis grub pa'i rigs pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 1) rigs pa'am, 'os pa dang, rung ba/ skad cha de ltar bshad na mi 'thad/ chu yod dam med kyang 'thad/ 2) 'dod pa'am, dga' ba/ las don de nga'i blo la'ang 'thad do/ 2.rigs pa'am, rgyu mtshan/ drang min kyog por bshad pa mang yang 'thad pa min/
mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam grangs shig /
tshad ma'i rid pa dang don gcig
phyi bshol lam, phar 'gyang/ las ka 'phral 'phral du mi byed par 'than ne 'then ne byed pa/
(rnying) 'gyur ba med pa'i brtan po'am, bya ba la blo sgrim pa'i nan po/
1) phyogs gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa slong ba dang, 'thab pa'am, 'khrug pa/ 2) gnod pa'i rgyu/
dmag 'khrug la bkod pa byed stangs kyi 'char gzhi dang thabs shes/

(tha dad pa) 'thabs pa, 'thab pa, 'thobs,, 1) 'dzing ba/ kha 'thab tshig 'thab/ kha shad 'thab pa/ tsha grang 'thab pa/ kha tshub dang 'thab pa/ brag chu 'thab pa/ dka' ngal la mi 'dzem par dgra dang 'thab pa/ 2) rtsis 'go gtug pa/ gtong yong kha 'thab byas nas 'go thug gi mi 'dug /
gral rim 'ga' zhig gam srid tang 'ga' zhig gis thun mong gi dmigs yul gang zhig gi ched du btsugs pa'i mna' 'brel der zer/
«y'am'a:» 'dod lha ris drug gi nang gses, ri rab kyi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar gnas shing, lha ma yin dang 'thab mi dgos pas 'thab bral zhes bya/
'khrug pa/ rang dgra gnyis phyogs nas 'thab mo sprod pa/
1) dmag 'khrug / 2) lag 'dzing/ 3) kha rtsod byed pa/
dgra la 'thab 'dzing byed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'thab mi dang, 'thab 'dzing pa, dmag mi bcas so,
dmag 'thab byed stangs kyi rtsa don dang thabs shes shig /
1) dmag 'khrug pa'am, g.yul 'gyed pa/ 2) 'dzing ba/ gral rim 'thab rtsod/
pha rol rgol ba po'am, dgra ya/
dgra dpung dang 'thab 'dzing dngos su tshugs pa/ g.yul sar 'thab ra 'phrod pa'i dmag sde la rgyab dpung gtong ba/
'thab zhor/ dmag gi 'thab rol tu shi ba/
lus kyis 'thabs shing tshig gis smad pa/

(tha dad pa) 'thams pa, 'tham pa, 'thoms,, 1) dpung gis 'khyud pa/ phan tshun 'thams nas dga' bshum gnang ba/ phan tshun sked pa nas 'thams te lus stobs 'gran bsdur byed pa/ phru gus a ma'i mjing pa nas 'tham pa/ rta sga la 'thams nas ma g.yud tsam byung/ 2) lag pas dam por 'dzin pa/ 'thams nas mi glod pa/ mtshon char 'tham pa/ 3) dam po 'tshum pa'am, btsums nas mi 'byed pa/ kha 'thams pa/
1. 'tham pa'i 'das pa, 2. (rnying) 1) byams pa/ 2) gtam chad byed pa/ 3) spyo ba/ sdang mig bltas te 'thams pa/
(yul) bar du btsir te sha lpags sogs la skyon byung ba/ lag pa rdos 'thar nas khrag gi chu gong skyes pa/
/ 1) sra ba dang, mkhregs pa/ sa rgyu 'thas pa/ 2) zhen pa che ba/ de 'dra'i mi a 'thas tsha la/
'thibs pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa gnyis kyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
(tha mi dad pa) 'khrigs pa dang mi gsal ba/ blo'i dbang po 'thibs pa/ gnam 'thibs pa/ ri 'gor smug pa 'thibs pa/ khang pa'i nang la du ba 'thibs pa/
1. stug po'am 'thug po/ mun nag 'thibs po/ rig pa 'thibs po/ rtsi shing 'thibs po/ 2. (mngon) nad tshal/
sger so so nas spyi thog tu nyer mkho'i dgos chas sdud pa'i bsdu cha/

(tha mi dad pa) 1, btus pa, btu ba, thus,, 1) sdud pa/ bud shing 'thu ba/ sman btus pa/ lo ma skam po rlung gis btus/ me tog btus te bum par btsugs/ 2) sgrug pa/ khyim bya des 'bru 'thu bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'gro ba/ sngags btu/ 2, 'thus pa, 'thu ba, 'thus,, bsdu cha rgyag pa/ lag dngul 'thus nas lto chas nyo/
'thug po'i khyad par zhig / shing nags 'thug ge ba/ gos 'thug ge ba/
zhing la sa bon 'thug por 'debs pa/
shing nags dang skra sogs 'thug la phan tshun 'dres pa/
phor pa dang, dkar yol sogs/

(tha dad pa) btungs pa, btung ba, 'thungs,/ chu de btungs na lto bar gnod pa med/ chang btungs te ra ro bar gyur/ kho bos ja 'thung gin yod/ rgya mtsho btungs nas ma ngoms, ri rab bzas nas ma 'grangs/ sha za khrag 'thung/
btung ba la zhen pa che ba/
gtub pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
'thums pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa gnyis kyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig

(tha mi dad pa) nang du tshud nas dbugs 'gag pa dang, rig pa mi gsal bar gyur pa/ du bas 'thums te glo rgyag pa/ 'phyi tshang nang du 'phyi ba du bas 'thums te shi ba/ sbrang ma pad ma'i sbubs su 'thums nas shi song/ blo sbug 'thums pa/ zhed nas 'thums 'dug /
gyen du 'phyur tshul zhig / du ba 'thul 'thul ba/ sha btsos pa'i rlangs pa dri zhim 'thul 'thul du thon pa/
(tha mi dad pa) thon pa dang, 'byung ba/ du ba 'thul ba/ khyim du du ba lhang lhang 'thul ba/ dri ma 'thul ba/ spos dri zhim po 'thul ba/
bsdu cha rgyag pa'i don du go ba'i 'thu ba'i skul tshig
las don gra 'grig byung ba/ dngos su lag bstar gyi byed thabs 'thus sgo tshang ba/
chog mchan te bka' 'khrol ba'i yi ge mdor bsdus/ 'thus mchan rgyag pa/

1.bsdu cha rgyag pa'i don du go ba'i 'thu ba'i 'das pa, 2.(tha mi dad pa) 'grig pa dang chog pa dang rung ba/ lto gos bzang ngan de tsam gyis 'thus/ 'gro 'thus/ bshad pas 'thus/ sman 'di btung bas 'thus/
tshang 'dzoms sam, chad lhag med pa/ mthun rkyen 'thus tshang byung ba/
don gcod 'thus mi ngo ma de'i las tshab byed mkhan/ mkhan po'i 'thus tshab/
las byus nyes pa/ phar khag tshur dkri'i za zi kho na byas na las ka 'thus shor ba las yong rgyu med/ nges par 'thus shor med pa zhig bsgrub dgos/
1. rkang pa zha kyog can/ 2. rkang pa zha kyog / rkang pa 'theng por 'gro ba/ rkang zha lag 'theng/
(tha mi dad pa) 'thengs pa, 'theng ba,, zha ba/ rkang pa 'thengs kyang 'gro snying 'dod/
khungs gcig nas 'then te khungs gzhan zhig tu 'jug pa/ las byed pa kha shas 'then bskong byas nas kha tsha dgos mkho'i las ka byed du 'jug pa/
(yul) ca lag lag pas phar tshur 'then pa dang, don gnad la gros mi 'cham par rang 'dod byed pa/
gros ma 'chams pa'i kar kor/ phyod zhen 'then 'khyer kar kor mang na gros 'chams thub pa khag gi red/
sha spu sogs 'then pa dang 'thog pa

(tha dad pa) 1) 'dren pa dang, 'khrid pa/ btsan dbang gis 'then 'gro ba/ sgo mar 'then tsam gyis ang/ g.yul sa nas phyir 'then pa/ thag pa de 'then nas chad song/ pho mo'i bar du thag pa 'then pa/ 2) khral 'jal ba/ rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs 'then pa/ 3) nar ba'am, 'gyang bar byed pa/ dbyangs 'then pa/ dus sgo ngang 'then byed pa/ 4) rngub par byed pa/ tha ma kha 'then pa/ dbugs gtong 'then ga ler byed pa/
lhag po/ gos 'theb pa/ zas 'theb pa/ mi gcig 'theb pa byung song/
(tha mi dad pa) thems pa, 'them pa,, tshang ba/ sngon bkag grangs 'bor thems pa/ mi grangs thems pa/

(tha dad pa) btogs pa, btog pa, 'thogs,, lag sor gyis gcod pa'am, 'then pa/ tshal zhing nas sngo tshal gyi rtse mo 'thog pa/ shing tog smin pa tshang ma btogs pa/ phan mi thogs pa'i yal ga rnams 'thog pa/ me tog 'thog pa/ ja lo btogs pa/ sha'i spu rnams gtsang mar btogs nas tshos/

(tha mi dad pa) thon pa, 'thon pa, thon,, 1) 'gro ba/ 'di nas thon te gang du 'gro/ khang pa'i nang nas phyir thon cig / 2) 'byung ba/ de ring don dag chen po gcig thon song/ lung pa de nas yul zog phon chen zhig 'thon rgyu yod/ 3) 'char ba/ zhing kha'i nang nas son gyi myu gu 'thon nyer 'dug / phru gu gsum skyes pa tshang ma mgo thon pa red/ rang mgo thon ma thub pa/
'thob la khad dam, 'thob grabs yod pa/ grub 'bras 'thob tu cha ba/
(tha mi dad pa) thob pa, 'thob pa,, rnyed pa/ go skabs thob pa/ skal ba thob pa/ mi ngan la go sa thob na rang snang gang dran byas yong/ slong mi mang ste 'thob mi dkon/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, yid la 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'thob bya'i rgyu thabs shes kyi g.yo 'phrul ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
(yul) mi shes bzhin du bya ba la 'jug pa/ bya ba la brtag dpyad mi byed par 'thom rgyag tu ma 'jug /
(yul) gang yang byed mi shes pa'am, rig pa mi gsal ba/
(yul) shes rig mi gsal ba'i mi la smod: tshig /
rig pa mi gsal ba/ mi 'thom 'thom zhig /
'thoms pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa gnyis kyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
rig pa mi gsal ba/ las don mgo mi 'tshos par 'thom me bar sdod pa/
(tha mi dad pa) mgo bo 'khor ba/ mgo bo 'thoms nas ci yang mi shes par gyur/
kha ma tshang ba dang, chag zhig gi dngos po'i bsdus tshig / yo byad 'thor grum can nyams gso byas pa/
kha yan nam, kha 'thor nas sdod pa/

1. gtor ba'i da lta ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig 2. (tha mi dad pa) thor bur 'gyur ba dang, phyogs re bar 'gyur ba/ khyim tshang 'thor ba/ gos srubs 'thor ba/ lug khyu 'thor ba/ lag yod rgyu nor tshang ma 'thor song/ ma bu kha 'thor/
phyogs kun nas ldang ba'i rlung drag po/
rol shul tsam du ma yin par zhing kha gang sa gang du son 'debs pa/
(yul) lhag po'am, lhag ma/ yon tan ji tsam mang rung 'thol pa yin par ma sems/ gla cha 'thol pa/ khur po 'thol pa/

bod yig gsal byed bcu gcig pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba so lce phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1. 1) ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2) sngon 'jug ma ning gi yi ge zhig / 3) rjes 'jug pho yig gi skyes bu tha ma zhig / 4) da drag gam snga dus rjes 'jug ma ning gi rjes su 'jug pa'i yang 'jug cig / 2. dus 'di nyid/ da skabs/ da dus/ da lo/ da 'gro dgos/ da 'grigs song/ da ha go song/ da zhog cig / da dka' las mi 'dug /
1) yi ge da yig rkyang pa/ da 2) mdo khams kyi yul gru 'gar ta dang da gnyis kyi sgra gdangs gcig tu 'bod pas khyad par 'byed byed kyi tshig / da...ta da...ta...da...

(yul) 'di bzhin nam, 'di 'dra ba zhes pa'i tshad bzung gi sgra zhig / dus yun nges can zhig gi bar da ga da ga'i ngang nas hur brtson byas pa/ las ka da gas yong ba 'dug / ca lag da gas 'grig pa 'dug /
(yul) 'di tsam mam 'di lta bu/ las ka da ga tsam byas nas mtshams zhog cig / dngos po da ga tsam byung na chog

(yul) 1) don med gang byung ngam, dngos gnas min pa mtshon pa'i tshig cig / skad cha de da ga se bshad pa ma red, dngos gnas yin/ 'char gzhi zhib gsal ma bting bar las 'go da ga se btsugs na mi 'grig / 2) de 'dra zhig / las ka da ga se byas na cho gang yod/ de ring las brel med pas nang la da ga se bsdad yod/
(yul) nye sngon/ da gin mi gcig slebs song/
(yul) da lta'i gong nas/ ngas khyod la da gin nas labs pa yin/
da sngon nam sngar/ da gong phan chad su la'ang ma smras pa yin, da khyod la bshad par bya'o/
(yul) de ring dgong mo/ da dgong skar 'od chem chem du 'phro ba/
sgal tshigs sam brgyungs par nad zhugs nas rus tshigs phyir 'bur ba'am nang du gug par 'gyur ba zhig ste, de yang nang gses su dbye na rlung nad da rgan dang, mkhal nad da rgan gnyis so/
rlung nad sgal gzhung gi brgyungs par zhugs pa: zhig ste nad rtags su ske bstungs shing brang du bsdus te ro stod 'bur ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
rlung nad sgal gzhung gi brgyungs par zhugs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su brang 'bur zhing gnya' ba bstungs la ltag pa dgye ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
da cha dang, bye brag / spyir gong zhus ltar dang, da sgos zhu don gyi snying po gsham gsal/

'das ma thag gam cung zad song ba'i dus/ mi de da ci 'di nas phyin ma thag pa yin/ kho la da ci nas skul lcag btang ba yin/ da cha, da lta'i cha/ na tsha da cha drag 'dug / sngar de ltar yin yang da cha de ltar ma yin/
mtshal rigs kyi nang tshan zhig ste, nus pas rus pa chag pa sbyor, chu ser skem, gnyan nad 'joms/
mtshal tshwa'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /

1) (yul) da 'grigs/ 2) bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga'i gras shig ste, sngon chog gi rjes su bcas pa'i gsol bzhi'i las 'khor dang bcas pa ston pa 'das nas da lta'i bar du byed pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga/
gyi rigs te ro skyur: zhu rjes drod, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, glo gso, skyug pa dang yi ga 'chus pa sel/
dus 'di nyid/ da lta phan chad/ da lta man chad/ da lta yan chad/ da lta nyid du bsreg par bya/ nga da lta 'phral du sleb yong/ chu tshod drug dang phyed ka nas da lta'i bar/

1) dus gsum gyi nang gses dus skabs 'di nyid de dngos po gang zhig zhig pa'i cha'am, ma 'ongs pa'i cha gang yang ma yin par skye la ma 'gag pa'i cha 'di nyid/ 2) rtags 'jug gi skabs su bya byed tha dad mi dad gang rung gi bya ba byed bzhin pa'i don zhig la go dgos pa dang, bya byed tha dad pa'i byed po gtso phal dang, de'i byed las dang bcas pa'ang dus da lta ba'i khongs su bsdu dgos/

ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa: da ltar kho na phyogs bcu thams cad na, chos ci dang ci 'byung ba thams cad mkhyen pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
1) dus 'di nyid/ 2) dus da lta la/ da ltar gyi dus/ da ltar gyi rkyen/
dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi nang gses, sangs rgyas shakya thub pa'o/
phyin chad/ da ste ring min gzhan du 'gro dgos/
rjes 'jug bcu'i nang gses dang, na ra la gsum gyi mthar thob pa'i da drag gam, yang 'jug gnyis kyi ya gyal da mtha', da...da...da.

yang bskyar dang, da lta yang/ da dung ma yong na 'phyi drags pa red/ sngar bshad par ma zad, da dung yang shod kyin 'dug / sngon nas thugs khur bzhes dang bzhes mus su yod par ma zad, da dung yang, byams dang snying rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dor ba gnang dgos/

na ra la gsum gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i yang 'jug: da mtha' 'di nyid dus rabs dgu par bod rgyal khri ral gyis skad gsar bcad byed skabs zor yang ba'i ched du dor nas da char brda rnying ma gtogs 'bri srol med/ da...da...
1) rjes su'am phyis su/ da gdod gzhi nas shes byung/ da gdod shog ang/ 2) gzhi nas,/ da gdod dbye ba 'byed thub/
de ring snga dro'am de ring zhogs pa/
da phyin chad/ sna sun phog pas da nas bzung brtag dpyad gzab nan byed dgos/ sngon chad byas pa mi legs kyang da nas bzung legs lam du 'gro ba'i brtson pa skyed cig
dus snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor skabs dus da lta ba ched du ston pa'i tshig phrad cig / da ni las 'gan grub song/
da nas bzung ste phyin chad/ phan tshun 'brel lam gtsang mar bcad de da phyin thug 'phrad mi byed pa/
sngar nas da lta'i bar/ thog ma nyid nas da bar/
(rnying) sreg gnas sam tsha sreg gi gnas/
sgrib byed dang rlung 'gog byed kyi glegs bu leb mo/

sman du 'gro ba'i srog chags kyi rigs shig de'i rnam grangs du ma yod cing, gangs sbal ni sman nus rab dang, skyin gor ni 'bring tsam, rtsangs pa ni tha ma zhig yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la te'u le ba dang, bdag skyes, sa 'dzin, sa 'dzin skyes bcas so,
bya rgod sug pa'i ming gi rnam grangs/
'phral du/ nad gzhi dza drag che bas da mod sman bcos byed dgos/
(yul) da gang dang da ga re/

si khron zhing chen 'bar khams rdzong gi khongs, rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas dgon pa brgya dang brgyad btab pa'i tha ma 'di yin pas, dgon brgya rtsa brgyad da tshang song gsungs nas da tshang du ming chags/
tshur dkar gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
da lta nyid/ sang nyin da tshod tsam la phebs ang/
/ da zhag khyed rang gang du phebs pa yin/
1) gzhi nas/ kho rang mkhas pa yin pa da gzod shes byung/ ..thengs mang gsungs nas da gzod go byung/ 2) rjes nas dang phyis nas/ da gzod nas bzung yi ge 'bri rgyu'i 'go tshugs shig
mar bton zin pa'i 'o ma skyur mo/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu skya dang chab skya'o,
(yul) 1) de ring zhogs pa/ da rang snga po nas phyin song/ 2) da lta'i dus tshod mtshams 'dzin/ da rang byed ran song/
yang bskyar dang, da lta yang/ da rung khrims dang mi mthun pa'i bya spyod kha shas gnas yod/
thengs 'di nyid/ da res rgyal kha thob byung/ da res lan cig 'gro dgos shar/ go skabs byung ba da res tsam/
thengs 'di nyid dam, tshar 'di nyid/ da lan khyed phebs thub pa gnang rogs/ da lan kho bo gang du'ang mi 'gro/
nye char/ da lam lan cig zhal 'dzoms byung/ da lam slob sbyong gnad smin byung/
me tog ser skya dri zhim pa'i shing rigs shig /
lo 'di/ da lo rtswa chu 'dzoms po 'dug /
mong gol hal ha ste khal kha'i yul, deng mong gol mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa wu'u lan pa thu'o yi gna' ming/
dus rabs brgyad par kasmir 'khrungs shing, khri srong lde'u btsan skabs bod la gdan drangs pa'i drin can lo pan gsum gyi ya gyal/
(legs) gsang sngags pa'i rol cha zhig ste g.yas g.yon gnyis phyogs bskrogs nas brdungs chog pa'i lag rnga chung ngu zhig /
1) da ma ru rdung ba'am, 'khrol ba/ 2) phra ma byed pa'am, dbyen sbyor byed pa'i dpe/
/ 1) gnyis tshig la 'gro ba'i rnam dbye dang po'i ming mtha' zhig / mi 'di dag / las ka de dag / 2) mang tshig la 'gro ba'i rnam dbye dang po'i ming mtha' zhig / mi 'di dag / las ka de dag /
mdo sngags dpe cha po ti che chung dang: mang nyung gang zhig yin rung de 'go nas 'jug bar ma chad pa dang ma nor bar klog pa
lo ma dri zhim can gyi sngo sman zhig ste, rtswa ldum rnams sman du bkol rung ba'o/
bzo bcos gtsang ma/ 'char gzhir dag bcos byed/ nor 'khrul la dag bcos byed/
1) ming dang tshig gi 'jug tshul nor dang ma nor ba'i khyad par/ yi ge dag cha can/ yi ge dag cha mi 'dug / 2) dri ma sbyang ba'i cha shas/
rtsis rgyag gtsang rjes mchan 'god byas pa'i yi ge /
zhus dag gam legs bcos/ skad gsar bcad kyis dag ther byed pa/ kun spyod dag ther byed pa/ dpe cha la dag ther gtong ba/
dag dug gos hrul ba dang
snang srid snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i zhing du snang ba ste sku dang ye shes kyi rol bar snang ba/
1. 'dag pa'i 'das pa, 2. lhad med pa dang, skyon gyis ma gos pa/ bsam blo dag pa/ spyod lam dag pa/ yi ge dag pa/ las spus dag pa/ khron chu dag pa/ smon lam dag pa/
nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis dag pa ste sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad dag pa bzhi ste, lus dag pa dang, dmigs pa dag pa dang, sems dag pa dang, ye shes dag pa ste bzhi'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba nas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin bar gyi sa gsum po ste, der gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' la nga rgyal yongs su dag cing med pas dag pa sa gsum zhes bya'o/
1) (mngon) 1. dngul chu/ 2. nyan thos/ 2) ma dag pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i zhing khams/
rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gyi gras shig ste, sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i ye shes kyi sku rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa/
gzhan dbang gi nang gses, 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyi shes pa snang la ma zhen pa dang, bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing khams rnams so/
yang dag pa'am, gtsang ma/ yi ge dag po/ sgra dag po/ bsam pa dag po/ gos sogs khrus dag po/
(mngon) 1) kha dog dkar po/ 2) chu/ 3) me/ 4) gtsang po/ 5) rtswa ku sha/ 6) rlung/ 7) rlung lha/ 8) a ru ra/
bden pa yin lugs rjod pa/ rim pa gong mar dag 'bud yag po zhu ba/ rang la byas nyes kyi gnong med pa'i dag 'bud byed pa/
kha gtad la bden pa sprad pa/ ngas nor song khyod kyis bshad pa de bden pa rang yin zhes dag 'bul byas pa/
dag bsher/ ye ger dag sbyangs byed pa/
bya ba bzang lam du 'jug thabs/ bsam spyod ma dag pa byung rigs la dag sbyor byed pa/
1. rdza las bzos pa'i ko ba snyol snod/ 2. lhad ma zhugs pa'i gtsang ma/ gser dag ma/
smra brjod bde po rang med pa

sngags nang rgyud kyi bskyed rim spyi'i ngo bor dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang dgos pa ste, 'khor ba'i skye 'chi bar do gsum dang skye gnas bzhi la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang mthun par bsgoms pas srid pa gsum po'i zhen snang thams cad sbyang zhing dag par gyur pa dang, myang 'das dang mthun par ting 'dzin gsum dang, zhing dang, lha sogs kyi rnam pa bsgoms pas 'bras bu sku gsum gyi yon tan rnams gzhi la rdzogs pa ste mngon du sad rung gi nus pa khyad par can 'byung ba dang, de ltar dag rdzogs gnyis ka'ang rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun nas rdzogs rim gyi dpe'i ye shes dang don gyi 'od gsal skye ba'i smin byed du 'gro ba/
1) 'gro song khungs skyel zhu ba// 2) bden rdzun khungs skyel zhu ba/
dag byed kyi dpe cha'i ming:/ yi ge'i dag cha mi shes pas dag yig sngog pa/

sgra, tshad, bzo, gso, dbu ma, phar phyin, 'dul ba, mngon pa, gsang sngags sogs kyi chos skad rnams sde tshan so sor phyes te bsgrigs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs, dus rabs bco brgyad par lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/
ngag gi sgron ma'i ming gzhan zhig

tog dag yig rin chen za ma tog ces bya ba: bod kyi ming brda'i gnas la rmongs 'khrul sel bar byed pa'i gzhung, dus rabs bcu drug par zha lu lo ts'a ba chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i dag yig gi gzhung tshigs su bcad pa zhig /
zhu dag dang zhib 'jug / yig rigs rtsom sgyur gang byas tshang mar dag bsher gzab nan gtong dgos/
shes sgrib phra ba rnams spong bar byed pa'i byang sems kyi sa/
nyes skyon med par bzo ba/ skyon med skyon 'dzugs byas par dag sel byed pa/

1. sum cu par, gsum pa la ni gnyis pa sbyar, de ni sdud dang 'byed pa dang, rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga'o, zhes pa ltar dang sgra 'di ni don lnga la 'jug pa'i phrad cig / dang...1) sdud pa la 'jug pa/ skra dang kha spu/ gcig dang gnyis/ 2) 'byed pa la 'jug pa/ 1. gzhi gcig nas du ma 'byed pa/ dbang po lnga ni mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus so/ 2. 'byed sdud rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag gang yang ma yin par bya tshig sogs dang sbyar ba/ khong dang lhan cig tu sleb pa/ khyod dang mnyam du 'gro/ khrims dang 'gal ba/ khrims tshul bzhin khur na dang, gal srid ma khur na nyes pa yong/ gong dang mtshungs pa/ mi dang 'dra ba/ grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ dgra dang 'thab pa/ chu dang gcig me dang gnyis, rlung dang gsum/ lugs dang mthun pa/ chu dang thag nye ba/ nyen kha dang 'phrad pa/ gnyen dang bral ba// pha ma dang 'grogs pa/ yi ge dang sbrags nas btang ba/ 3) rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa/ sman zos pa dang nad drag pa/ 'grel bshad zhib gsal byas pa dang don gnad rtogs pa/ 4) tshe skabs la 'jug pa/ nyi ma shar ba dang phyin pa/ kho slebs pa dang 'go btsugs pa/ 2. gdams ngag la 'jug pa/ ltos dang/ legs par slobs dang/

de rje btsun sa pan gyis: dang khyog ni glang po che'i sna lta bu'i a yin la, de yang yi ge'i dang por 'jug pas de ltar btad par gsungs, la las sngags kyi dbur om yig 'god srol yod pa bzhin bod yig gi dbur yang om yig bkod pa rim gyis yi ge'i tshul zhig pa dang kyog yin par bshad do/ */ a...om...om...
/ 1) zas za 'dod kyi 'dod pa/ dang ga 'gag song/ yun ring du na bas dang ga log pa/ lto'i dang ga phye song/ 2) pho ba'am lus khog gi pho ba yod sa/ lto ma 'phrod pas dang ga na ba/
zas za 'dod che ba'am zas la rngams pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la grod che dang, chog med pa, lto che, tshim med bcas so,
chabs cig tu yod pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa/
1) dang bas bstod pa/ 2) (yul) gzab gzengs/ mi 'ga' zhig ca lag la dang bstod chen po yod/ gyon pa la dang bstod tsha po byed kyi yod/
thog ma'i dus:/ phyogs gnyis kyi lta tshul dang thog nyid nas gcig mthun byung yod/
las don la gzab pa'i hur brtson gyi tshul/ bya ba dang dang dod dod kyi sgo nas byas na 'thus shor nyung/
1) rang mos/ 'os 'gan bsgrub rgyu dang du len pa/ 2) khas len pa/ yang dag pa'i 'go khrid dang du len pa/ sdug bsngal dang du len pa/
chabs cig tu yod pa dang, rang chas su yod pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/

1. 'go ma dang, thog ma dang, snga ma/ ngas dang po nas gsal por bshad yod/ khos dang po nyid nas khas blangs pa, yin na'ang phyis su lag len byas ma song/ dang po dang tha ma tshang mar 'gyur ba med pa/ 2. ang grangs dang po/ thengs dang po/ le'u dang po/ ang dang po/

ting nge 'dzin: bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, dkyil 'khor pa'i lha sprul ba po gtso bo yab yum gyi ting nge 'dzin de lhag ma gnyis kyi thog mar byung bas dang po dang, thabs shes gnyis med du sbyor bas sbyor ba zhes bya/
rgyal sras kyi lam la bslab pa'i thog mar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/
1) gdod ma'i sangs rgyas/ 2) kun bzang rdo rje 'chang/
(mngon) shing lo gsar du kha 'bus pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) yid dga' ba'am dad mos skye ba/ dang bas hur len/ gzhan gyi yon tan la dang ba/ spyod bzang la dang bar bya/ 2. 1) dad mos kyi sems/ dang ba ston pa/ dang drag po/ dang ba 'dren pa/ dang ba mi phyed pa/ mgrin pa'i lam nas legs par sgrog pa yis, yid la dang ba mchog skyed mdzad pa khyod/ 2) rnyog pa med pa'am ra ri med pa/ dang ba'i gzugs/ dang ba'i sems/ dang bar gyur pa'i dmigs pa/ mos gus dang ba'i yid kyis hur brtson byed/
dad pa bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, dad yul gyi yon tan shes nas skyes pa'i mos pa/
dang du blangs pa'am khas blangs pa/ dka' ba dang du blangs pa/ dang blangs zhu yig /
dang dod/ lto gos la dang zhen byed/
sgrog rus/ 'phur 'dod byi'u dang rus chag / bya rgod kyi dang rus las bzos pa'i gling bu/
1) chu mig 'dra ba'i rdzing bu/ 2) thog ma/
dang du len pa'i bsdus tshig
mna' ma len pa'i lugs srol zhig ste, nga'i nor dang khyod kyi nor dbye ba med par 'dus nas 'tsho ba'i bza' tshang/
yon tan mthong ba'i dad pa dang, bka' drin dran pa'i mos gus/ dad gus chen po/
sku la dad, gsung la gus, thugs la spro/
sred zhen che ba/ chang dad che ba'i khyo ga 'chal po dang, khyo dad che ba'i bud med 'chal mo gnyis, khyim gcig nang du 'dzoms na 'grigs pa min/
dad pa dang gus pa chen po/
kyi 'dun pa: 'gyur ldog med pa'i dad pa dang dam tshig / sa lam ring pos bcad kyang dad dam 'pho med kyi 'dun pa chad med lags/
yid kyis gus shing mos pa/ yon tan la dad 'dun bskyed nas slob sbyong byed pa/
dad mos kyis 'dus pa/ dad 'dus kyi nya ma rnams/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) dang bas yid ches pa/ gnas lugs ji bzhin du rtogs nas rang yid dad song/ 2) dga' ba dang chags pa dang sred pa/ skoms dad pa/ dmar dad pa/ chang dad pa/ 2. 1) dga' ba dang chags pa/ gnyid dad che ba/ nor dad chen po/ khyed rnal 'byor pa bya ba skyur dad che ba yin/ 2) yang dag pa'i gnas la dang ba'i yid ches dang 'dun pa'i rten byed pa ste dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi ya gyal zhig / dad pa rnyed pa/ dad pa nyams pa/ dad pa log pa/ rmongs pa'i dad pa/ chos dad rang dbang/ ba spu g.yo ba'i dad pa thob pa/
chu bal te dad pa cher med pa'am kha tsam gyi dad pa/
dang ba'i dad pa dang, 'dod pa'i dad pa, yid ches pa'i dad pa, phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa bcas bzhi/
sku la dang ba'i dad pa, gsung la yid ches kyi dad pa, thugs la mngon 'dod kyi dad pa bcas gsum/
dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa gang zhig dbang po rtul po pha rol gyis bstan pa kho na'i rjes su 'brangs nas bden pa mngon par rtogs par byed pa/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi stobs lnga'i nang gses shig ste mchog gsum la ma dad pa la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs kyis rdzi ba med pa'i dad pa/

pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo: 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po lnga dang shloo ka bdun cu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur pa/
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses, las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa ste, nyin mtshan dge ba'i lam la 'dren par byed pas 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi dbang po lnga'i nang gses shig ste bden bzhi la mngon par yid ches pa/
dad pa dang, brtson 'grus, dran pa, ting 'dzin, shes rab bcas yul la gtso bor mkhas pa'i gnas skabs kyi lam ste tshogs lam dang don gcig /
blos bslangs kyis phul ba'i dad rdzas 'bul bzhes/
chos la dad pa dang 'dun pa yod mkhan/
dad pa can gyis phul ba'i dngos rdzas/
sngar gyi dad mos de log nas med par gyur pa'i mi/
mi 'gyur gtan du khel ba'i gcig mthun gyi nges don/ kha dan/ gros dan/ chod dan/
dan da rigs gsum gyi nang nas khra bo'i ming ste, nus pa dan rog dang mtshungs/
(rgya) 'jim pas byas pa'i ril bu 'phen byed gzhu/
rogs byed mkhan/ stobs rtsal can gyi dan grogs/

zhing chen hwa lung rdzong na yod pa'i grub: pa'i gnas chen zhig glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i rjes su bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum mdo smad du bros nas gnas 'dir yun ring bzhugs pa dang mkhas pa gsum las bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs, bla chen gyis dbus gtsang gi mi bcu la so thar gyi sdom rgyun spel ba la brten bstan pa phyi dar dus su bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas gsos zhes pa'i grags pa don dang ldan pa de dan tig gi gnas 'di nas byung ba yin, si tu'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag tu legs sbyar ltar dantig ces bris yod/
khungs skyel thub pa'i rtags mtshan gsal po/
gyi rigs dan da dkar nag khra gsum gyi nang: tshan nag po ste ro tsha zhing kha la mngar ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas ma zhu ba sogs ldan 'dus kyi nad rnams thur du bshal bar byed/
dus rabs bcu bdun par bod mkhas mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa/
sgra mi gsal ba'am ngag ldab ldib/ kha nas skad cha dab dib las ma thon pa/
dab be dob be'i bsdus tshig
1) btsun gzhon bag med pa ste, chos mi klog cing, sgrigs khrims mi srung ba, 'khrug 'dzing byed par dga' ba'i grwa pa dar ma/ 2) (yul) shugs rtsal ldan pa'i nyams 'gyur/ bu dab dob/

1. ming mtha' da'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi phrad cig / da...bde skyid dam, sdug bsngal/ yod dam med/ 2. ming mtha' da'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / da...las 'gan 'di bzhin khyod rang gis len phod dam mi phod/
khas blangs dam tshig las 'gal ba/ nyer 'tshe'i rkyen phran bu zhig phrad 'phral dam 'gal byas yong/
1) thel rtse/ 2) (rnying) 1. dpang rgya/ 2. khrims rgya/ 3) dam tshig gi phyag rgya/
khrims kyis 'doms pa'am do dam btsan po/ mtshan mo 'gro bzhud la dam bsgrags byed pa/ dam bsgrags yun bsrings kyis slob gso gtong dgos/
1) dam bca' khas len pa/ 2) dam tshig la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi srung ma/
dam can mgar ba nag po
dam can ra zhon te 'jig rten pa'i srung ma zhig /
bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can gshin rje chos rgyal/
dam can rdo rje legs pa
slob dpon pad mas bka' bgos pa'i 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dam can seng zhon/
1) khas len/ tha tshig dang ldan pa'i dam bca'/ 2) khas blangs pa'i bsgrub bya'i don te, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, zhes pa lta bu'o/
khas len pa/ las don la 'bad brtson bya rgyu'i dam bca' ba/

1) khas len byas pa/ rang srog blos btang gis mes rgyal srung skyob byed pa'i dam bca' bzhag pa/ 2) rtsod grwa'i rigs lam gyi rang rang gi yig cha la brten nas phyogs snga bkod pa'am grub mtha'i bzhed pa khas len pa/
dam bca' lhag bcas kyi sgra

tshig snga ma dam bcas pa de'i gsal byed dam, sgrub byed du tshig phyi ma 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra 'di'i nang la dbye ba 'dren pa dang, gtan tshigs 'dren pa, nges tshig 'dren pa, rgyas bshad 'dren pa ste bzhi yod/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ste, sdug bsngal ba dang, kun 'byung ba, 'gog pa dang, lam gyi bden pa'o/ dka' tshegs gang yin kyang sel thub ste, hur brtson chen po byed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas te, ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs pa dang, shes bya la blo gros rgyas pa'o/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa ste, pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu po thams cad yin no/
1) dam bca' las 'gal ba/ 2) sems thag bcad nas 'phya smod byed pa/
dam pa'i chos kyi bsdus tshig
1) dam tshig nyams pa/ 2) dam tshig nyams pa'i gang zag /
dam mi dum mi'i bsdus tshig
lhod po dang yangs po min pa:/ sgrigs khrims nyams 'chal du mi 'gro ba'i dam dog nan tan byed pa/ mi spyod ngan la dam dog chen po byas pa/
gzab nan/ khyed rang gis bka' mngags gnang ba thams cad ngas 'phral du dam don zhus chog / dmangs kyi khe phan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i las don yin phyin dam don gyis byed dgos/
dam tshig khas len du 'jug pa/
bla slob bam mchod yon bar la bsrung bya'i dam tshig rnams ma nyams par ldan pa/
1. 'phags pa/ 2. 1) yang dag pa dang, mchog tu gyur pa/ don dam pa/ skyes bu dam pa/ blo gros dam pa/ 2) shi mkhan gyi zhe sa/ pha dam pa/ slob dpon dam pa/ rgyal po dam pa/ 3) dam po dang 'dra,
gzugs sku dam pa dang, chos sku dam pa gnyis/
shakya thub pa dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin na bzhugs pa'i dus kyi mtshan/

phyin drug sgrub pa'i tshul dam pa drug dang ldan par nyams su blangs pa ste, rten dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa dang, dngos po dam pa sbyin sogs phyogs re ma yin par gzhi thams cad la 'jug pa, ched du bya ba dam pa sems can thams cad kyi don du spyod pa, thabs dam pa 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa, yongs bsngo dam pa bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba, rnam dag dam pa sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen du spyod pa rnams/
rgyal ba'i phung po lnga bde gshegs dang, khams bzhi yum, skye mched drug sems dpa', yul lnga rdo rje ma ste nyi shu po rigs lnga lngar phye ba'i gsang 'dus kyi lha brgya/
gang la dmigs na lus can rnams kyi sgrib pa zad pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste, lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi chos so/
pa nye bar gzhag pa: mdo sde dran pa nye bar bzhag pa shloo ka stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug bam po bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bdag nyid can ba tshab lo ts'a bas bsgyur pa'o/
ma dkar po'i mdo: bam po bcu gsum dang le'u nyer bdun pa, pandita su rendra bo dhi dang lo ts'a ba bande sna nam ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/
1) rgyal ba'i sku brnyan/ 2) bzang po yin pa'i bzo tsam/ dam pa'i gzugs brnyan ston pa tsam las don du mi tha shal ba zhig red/

dra ma lnga: ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das pa na ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtser gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes gsang ba'i rgyud mtha' dag gsungs pa'i gdul bya dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga ste, lha grags pa mchog skyong dang, klu rgyal 'jog po, gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong, srin po blo gros thabs ldan, mi li tstsha b'i dri ma med par grags pa bcas so/

lhod yangs min pa/ sgrigs lam dam po/ lag pa dam po/ gral star tshags dam por sgrigs shig / rked rags dam por bcings/ lag tu mtshon cha dam por 'dzin pa/ 'gro chas dam du bsdams nas thon chog chog gyis/
/ bka' rgya de la dam phrug dmar po phab 'dug /
kha dog la lto che ba'i bum pa'am chang rag sogs blugs snod/ skom chang dam be gang/
thel rtse brgyab yod pa/ phyag bris dam 'byar ma/
1) dum bur bcad pa'i rnam pa/ shing dam mi dum mis ka ba mi nyan/ 2) tho re ba/ tshigs bcad dam mi dum mi brtsams pa/ skad cha dam mi dum mi zhig las ma bshad/ man ngag dam dum zhig shes pa/
zhib tshags sam, tan tig / dngos zog de dag dam tshags kyis nyar ba/ bden rdzun la brtag dpyad dam tshags kyis 'byed pa/
'byar rtsi dam po'i rigs/ shing leb gnyis kyi srubs bar dam tshis sbyor ba/

1) «samya:» 'da' dka' rdo rje'i tha tshig ces ji ltar bcas pa las mi 'da' bar g.yar dam gnyan por khas blangs pa'i tha tshig / dam tshig srung ba/ dam tshig nyams pa/ 2) (yul) 'khon 'gras/ dam tshig bsags pa/ dam tshig bzos pa/ 3) (yul) sha zhen dang, mdza' ba'i 'du shes srung sems/ dam tshig mthun po/ dam tshig shor ba/ phan tshun gcig sems gcig 'dzin gyi dam tshig mthun po byed pa/
yid kyis bsgoms shing gsal btab pa'i bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/
gsang sngags kyi yo byad cig /
yid kyis bsgoms pa'i bdag mdun gyi lha/
rgyud sde bzhi po so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lag pa'i phyag rgya/
1) chos phyogs kyi khas len dam bca' ma nyams pa/ 2) (yul) 'jug rten gyi mdza' bshes blo nye phan tshun dbar 'khon 'gras ma zhugs pa/
cho gas bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang/
bskyed rim sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi nang gses shig ste, yi dam gang rung gi cho gas bskyed pa de nyid do/

1) thub dbang nang tshan thub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po/ 2) dam tshig gsum la gnas pa ste khri la mi nyal ba, chang mi 'thung ba, phyag rgya 'dra ba mi za ba bcas gsum ste, phyi ma'i don ni zas la lha'i phyag mtshan pad ma dang rdo rje sogs kyi dbyibs byas te mi za ba'i don/
1) dam tshig gi rdzas te sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dngos po/ 2) dam bca' can la mkho ba'i nor rdzas/
do dam dang rdzi gsang/ 'gyur ldog che ba'i gnas tshul rnams la dam rdzi gang gzab byed pa/
dam po dang, zab nan/ phan tshun dbar la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa/
dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
bdag dam tshig pa dang, lha ye shes pa gnyis mchog dman rje khol gyi tshul du lta ba'am, mchog dman mnyam pa spun grogs kyi tshul du lta ba/
bdag dam tshig pa bskyed par lha ye shes pa bkug bstim byas te chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dam ye dbyer med kyi ngang nas bzlas pa byed pa rnal 'byor rgyud yan chod kyi mtshan bcas kyi bskyed rim/
'dre srin sogs mna' dam la bkar nas btul ba/
dam tshig khas blangs ji bzhin du gnas pa/
dam tshig khas len la 'dzul ba/

nang 'jug gi nang gses shig ste, slob ma rnams lha rnams dang nang gi skal mnyam bya phyir dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bar phan yon gyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang, ma bsrung bar nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang, gnyis ka'i sgo nas bzhag pa dang, bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa ste dam bzhag bzhis mna' chu blud de dam la bzhag pa/
1) nang 'khon te khas blangs ji bzhin mi rtsi bar dor nas byung ba'i 'khon 'gras/ las rogs phan tshun dam sel zhugs pa/ 2) dam tshig nyams chag /
dam nyams kyi 'dre'am 'byung pos mi sems dkrug pa ste, mthun pa mi mthun pa bzos pa'm log pa'i lam du khrid pa'i dpe/

/ 1) dar cha/ dar dmar/ dar chen/ dar tshon sna lnga/ mi tshang mas dar 'phyar dung 'bud byed pa/ 2) gos dar/ mjal dar/ skyel dar/ lag tu dar thogs pa/ bzang po rgud na dar las 'jam, ngan pa rgyags na shing las rtsub/ 3) chab rom/ mtshe'ur
1) gos dar dkar po/ 2) kha btags dkar po/ 3) 'khyags pa dkar po/
'phel nas khyab pa/ bshad lugs de dag deng skabs dar khyab ha cang che/
dbugs len, mngal gnas, lus rdzogs, btsas pa, khrus byed, gos gyon, las byed, dar ba, gud pa, na ba, shi ba, dur zhugs rnams so/
(sog) dmangs kyi gzhung la byas rjes bzhag nas thob pa'i go sa zhig /
dar ba dang rgud pa/ rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs dar rgud/ tshong las dar rgud/
yar rgyas sam gong 'phel/ 'tsho ba dar rgyas byung ba/ nyin re bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gam pa rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
gam dus yud tsam zhig / dar cig bsam blo: btang nas dran byung / de nas dar cig nas dran pa slar sos pa/
gi thog ka dang: lha rten khag la 'dzugs rgyu'i shing rtser dar ras tshon sna'i byang bus brgyan pa'i dar lcog yal 'dab phra mo'i mgo ling can/ 'brong bsad pas ma tshad rnga ma'i dar lcog /
bsam blo brtan po med pa dang, gzhan gyis ngan skul byed pa'i dpe/
rgyal dar, dmag dar, ru dar sogs/ dar cha sgreng mkhan/ rlung gis dar cha lhab lhub skyod/
rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dar lag rdzong du yod/
1) kha btags 'dogs pa/ 2) gos chen thags btags pa/
mi gsal zhing snyan pa'i sgra ste sbrang bu'i skad lta bu/

dar gyi lda ldi ste, bod lo gsar tshes skabs khyim chen gyi thog skor dang, ri rtse ri dpung, chu klung gi 'gram ngogs sogs la 'grems rgyu'i dar lcog tshon sna thag skud la spel te brgyan pa'i dar ldi/
1) dar gyi pang khebs/ 2) lha'i mdun du g.yogs pa'i dar/
dar khyab che ba/ dmangs gzhas dar po yod/
1) dar lcog chen po/ dar po che dgung sngon mthongs la 'phyar/ 2) gru gzings kyi rlung g.yor/
1) dar gyi cod pan/ 2) dar skud kyis btags pa'i thag pa/
dar lcog mang po mnyam du btsugs pa/
1) gyen du bslangs pa dang, thur du dpyangs pa'i dar gyi phon po/ 2) (yul) rngon pa'i 'bag gi rna ba g.yas g.yon du btags pa'i tshar phod/
dar gos las bzos pa'i ka ba'i rgyan cha/
rmog gi rtse mor btags pa'i dar tshon/

1. (tha mi dad pa) rgyas pa'am rgya cher 'phel ba/ bstan pa snga dar/ bstan pa phyi dar/ dpal 'byor shin tu dar ba/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar dar rgyur thag chod/ bod kyi yig srol dar ba nas da bar lo chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam song yod/ 2. da ra dang don gcig
dar la bab pa ste na tshod dar mar slebs pa/
sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che ba'i: sngon 'gro mgron gnyer gyis lag tu 'khyer rgyu'i gos chen gyi 'bog hril ring po zhig /

/ 1) na tshod dar la bab pa ste 'dod yon la spyod rung ba'i dus/ ming gi rnam grangs la gzhon nu dang, lang tsho can, shar pa bcas so,2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
