«shamshan» mi'i ro skyel sa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'jig gnas dang, pha mes nags, mtshun gyi tshal, zhi ba'i gnas, ro nyal, ro gnas, gshin gyi gnas, sreg gnas bcas so,

mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang, mi mgo'i do shal, glang chen gyi pags pa'i stod g.yogs, zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi, stag lpags kyi sham thabs, zhag gi zo ris, khrag gi thig le, thal chen gyi tshom bu bcas brgyad do/
dur khrod chen po brgyad dang don gcig /

shar du gtum drag dang, byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa, nub tu rdo rje 'bar ba, lhor keng rus can, dbang ldan du drag tu rgod pa, mer bkra shis tshal, bden bral du mun pa drag po, rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa bcas brgyad/
keng rus gzugs can mi min zhig /
dur khrod kyi gnas su phyin te nyams len byed mkhan/
rgya gar gyi dur khrod cig /
(yul) las dang bya ba gang la'ang ru nga nyams myong che ba'i mi'i bla dwags kyi ming/
1) dur khrod du ro skyel skabs za ba'i lto chas/ 2) ro dang mnyam du gtong ba'i zas gos sogs/
bon chos las bshad pa'i gshin po'i dur sgo 'gog byed kyi cho ga zhig /
ro skyel ba'i nyin mor 'bul ba'i mchod pa/
dur khrod du yod pa'i mi ro'i thod pa/
mi ro za mkhan bya kang ka/ dur bya rgyab dkar/ ming gi rnam grangs la kam ka dang rgyab dkar ro,
ro phung gang du sbas sar btsug pa'i ming byang/

thang sman gyi rigs te ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rma rul gso, nad tsha grang gnyis ka sbyong/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun rjes 'byung, dum bu gsum pa, dor byed ma, mda' 'joms, rdul can, phur ma gsum pa, tshangs gsum, lo ma gsum pa bcas so,
ro sbed sa dang, mer sreg sa/
dur khrod la gnas pa'i 'dre srin/

btul te 'jam por gyur pa'i zhi ba dang, g.yung ba/ sems rgyud dul ba/ spyod lam dul ba/ 'dzum dkar sngon btang gis zhi zhing dul ba'i ngang nas tshig smra ba/ gshis ka gyong po btul nas zhi zhing dul bar gyur pa/
1. na chung ma'i ming gzhan/ 2. thabs shes kyis btul nas las rung du gyur pa'i rigs/ rta dul ma/ sman dul ma/ gser dul ma/ rag dul ma/

/ 1) tshe skabs/ gna' snga ma'i dus/ pha mes kyi dus/ deng dus/ dus de'i bar/ rang nyid 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i dus don yod par byed pa/ rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dus las mi yol bar 'phyur ba/ dus dang dus su mdza' bar byed pa/ las khungs la dus thog tu 'gro ba/ tshes bzang dus bzang/ ming gi rnam grangs la bgrang bya dang, yang dag 'gro, slar byung bcas so, 2) (mngon) dpyid dang so ga , dbyar, ston, dgun stod, dgun smad de dus mtshams la drug yod pas grangs drug mtshon/ 6. 3) rgyu dang 'bras bu rgyun du 'byung ba'i yun gyi gnas skabs, ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig /

dge tshul slong sgrub skabs, bsam pa'i mthun rkyen las dus kyi kun slong thob shes pa dgos pa ste, sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga las gsol ba song nas las brjod pa gsum gyi tha ma ste, bdag brjod dang bya ba brjod pa rdzod ma thag thob par ngo shes pa/
bskal don gsum gyi nang gses, dus yun ring pos bar du chod pa'i dbang gis rtogs mi thub pa, dper na, skye ba snga phyi lta bu/

«shr'ikalts'akra» 1) bla med rgyud sde zhig ste gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag thams cad phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus sbyor dang 'brel bas dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ 2) gnyis med rgyud kyi yi dam zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la khams gsum 'khor los sgyur ba dang, gnyis su med, tha ma med, thabs shes bdag nyid, thog ma'i mgon po, dang po'i sangs rgyas, rdo rje sems dpa', sdom pa la 'dus pa, rnam kun mchog ldan, rnal 'byor rnam pa, 'pho med, byang chub sems, zhi ba, rigs kun khyab bdag rigs med pa, shes dang shes bya'i bdag nyid mchog e wam yi ge bcas so,

phyi nang gzhan gsum: phyi dus kyi 'khor lo ni, ri rab, gling bzhi, gling phran brgyad sogs snod kyi 'jig rten khams yin, nang dus kyi 'khor lo ni, 'dod khams lnga, 'dod lha drug gzugs khams bcu drug gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ste nang bcud kyi 'jig rten srid pa sum cu so gcig sogs yin, gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo ni, bskyed rim gyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang, rdzogs rim gyi rtsa rlung thig le sogs yin/

dgag dbye'i nang gses, dus nges pa dbyar gnas zla ba gsum rdzogs pa'i tshes bco lnga la dgag dbye bya ba ste, dbyar snga ma khas blangs na dbyug pa'i nya la zhes ston 'bring tha skar gyi tshes bco lnga dang, dbyar phyi ma khas blangs na smin drug gi nya la zhes ston tha chung gi tshes bco lnga la dgag dbye bya ba/
dus yun ring thung 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi/

dbugs dang, dbugs khug pa drug la chu srang gcig chu srang drug cu la chu tshod gcig chu tshod drug cu la nyin zhag gcig nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig lo mang po bsags na bskal pa/
snyigs ma lnga'i nang gses shig ste, nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa dag gis gdungs pa/
1) snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus/ 2) 'chi kha'i dus/
skad cig ma ste dus mtha'i skad cig ma/
(mngon) 1) 'chi bdag gshin rje/ 2) sa rta'i lo/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
'chi ba'i dus kyi dpe/ dus kyi zhags pas bcings pa/
nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig tu byas pa'i zla ba'i ming/

sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang tshan, 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa dang, ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa dang, da lta'i dus la ma chags ma thod pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa ste gsum/
bzos pa'i tshe skabs:/ dus bkag gong nas las 'gan 'grub pa/ bu lon yod pa lag dang med pa dus bkag byed pa/
khrims gcod byed stangs shig ste: lo zla grangs bcad kyis btson la 'jug pa/
1) tshe skabs/ dus skabs mnyam pa/ dus skabs thog ma/ dus skabs mtha' ma/ dus skabs bar ma/ dus skabs rnyed pa/ gzhon nu'i dus skabs/ 2) bskal pa/
lo zla zhag sogs dus skabs bar mtshams med pa/

nya stong brgyad gsum sogs kyi dus bsnyen gnas bsrung ba, bsnyen gnas sdom pa dang ldan pa las de ring nyi ma ma shar gong du blangs nas, sang nyi ma ma shar bar nyin zhag gi mtha' can du bsrung ba'i khrims/

bsnyen gnas kyi bsrung bya ste, rtsa ba bzhi phyogs mthun dang bcas pa spong ba tshul khrims brtan par byed pa'i yan lag bzhi dang, chang gi btung ba spong ba bag yod gong 'phel byed pa'i yan lag dang, mal che mtho dang gar phreng la sogs pa dang, phyi dro'i kha zas te de gsum spong ba brtul zhugs dag par byed pa'i yan lag gsum bcas brgyad/
bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa srung ba/

mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las phyung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud, le'u lnga pa, kha che'i pandi ta so ma n'a tha dang, lo ts'a ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing, phyis shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'o/
dri med 'od rgyan: mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi lor brtsams/ 1478...
sho lo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis yod kyang bod du dum bu gcig ste dbang mdor bstan ma gtongs ma 'gyur/
ga dus dang, nam zhig / dus gang dang gang la dgra phyogs kyi tshur rgol byung ba de dang der phar rgol byas chog / sku mgron rnams dus gang rung zhig la 'dir phebs/

sdom pa thob mtshams kyi dus go bar brjod pa zhes rab byung gi sdom pa 'bog pa'i rjes kyi cho ga zhig ste, bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes pa'i ched du, sdom pa thob ma thag pa'i gang zag la, dus go brjod pa'i dge slong gis, sdom pa thob ma thag tu grib tshod rig par byas nas, lo dang dus tshigs zla ba'i ngos kyi bye brag dang, tshes grangs dang, nyin mtshan gyi cha shas rnams, skyes bu dang rkang pa'i tha snyad kyis, bkra shis pa'i gnas 'di zhes bya bar, mkhan po dang slob dpon mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob pa yin no zhes brjod pa'o/
skabs 'ga'/ dus 'ga' rer lam bar du phan tshun thug yong/
dus yun ring du song ba/ dus 'gyangs chad lus,..de ring sman pa bsten sar yong mkhan mang bas sman bcos byed dus 'gyangs pa/
dus tshod kyi gnas tshul 'gyur ba/ tshod dpag byed dka' ba'i dus 'gyur/
dus tshod skabs 'khel ba/ khyed rang yong ba dang nga la las brel med pa dus 'grig pa/
nam zhag rgyun ldan/ rang gi bsam sbyor dus rgyun du brtag dpyad byed dgos/
tshe skabs kyi mtshams/ sngon bkag dus sgo/ las thog gi dus sgo gtsang ba/
mi tshe gcig gi dus skabs brgyad de mngal na gnas pa'i dus dang, btsas pa'i dus, byis pa'i dus, gzhon nu'i dus, lang tsho'i dus, dar la bab pa'i dus, rgas pa'i dus, 'khogs pa'i dus bcas brgyad/
dus tshes gtan 'khel ba/ dus nges pa med pa/

mthun pa'i gso sbyong gi nang gses, gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa dang, bco lnga pa gnyis dus nges pa'i gso sbyong zhes bya ste, lo gcig la zla ba bcu gnyis yod cing zla ba re la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i gso sbyong gnyis gnyis 'byung bas nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod la, de yang yar ngo'i bcu gnyis dang, mar ngo'i drug ste bco brgyad zhag thub bco lnga pa dang, mar ngo'i drug zhag mi thub bcu bzhi pa yin/
dus 'khor dang mngon pa mdzod gnyis/
dgun, dpyid, sos, dbyar, ston te lnga/
dus tshod thung ngu/ las 'go btsugs nas dus cung zad cig las ma song/
dus skabs lan gcig la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig la/
rgya rtsis las, khe bzhi la dus chung gcig dang, dus chung nyer bzhi'am khe go drug nyin zhag gcig gi tshad du nges/
dga' ston nyin mo/ dus chen snga bsu/ rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i dus chen/
nang pa'i dus chen bzhi ste, gnyis pa'i yar ngo la cho 'phrul bstan pa, bzhi pa'i bco lngar mngon par sangs rgyas pa, drug pa'i drug la chos 'khor bskor ba, dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la lha las babs pa/

sa ga zla ba ste hor zla bzhi pa'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin, ston pa thub pa'i dbang po lhums su zhugs pa dang, mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang, sku mya ngan las 'da' ba ste sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gsum bstan pa'i dus chen/
dus kyi chos nyid kyi bsdus tshig
dus tshigs nges can gyi mchod pa/
dus mtshungs pa/ skad thos pa dang ngo shes dus mnyam/ dus mnyam du 'byor nas lhan cig tu bsdad/
dus kyi snyigs ma'i bsdus ming,
rnam kun/ dus gtan du gnas pa/ dus gtan du mnyam las byed pa/
tshe skabs rang la slebs ran pa'am dus tshod zad ran pa/
dus tshigs nges pa can la 'bul ba'i mchod gtor/
dus chad byas pa'am dus tshod bsgrigs pa/ zla tshes gang la 'gro rgyu'i dus btab pa der 'gro dgos/
nam rgyun/ sngar gang bslabs pa rnams la dus rtag par bskyar sbyong byed/ dus rtag par lus shugs kyi ngal rtsol nang du zhugs pa/

dus tshes nges can gyi dga' ston/ lo gsar gyi dus ston/ 'dul ba'i tshig zin la yod pa ni, lumbhi'i tshal du sku bltams pa'i dus ston, gtsug phud bzhag pa'i dus ston, bregs pa'i dus ston, mngon par byang chub pa'i dus ston rnams so/
dam dus kyi rgyun:/ dus thag ring ba/ dus thag nye ba/
dus la slebs pa/ tshogs 'du 'tshog dus thug pa/ gan rgya'i nang gsal zla dus thug pa/
pa'i dus skabs:/ kho rang dus thog la slebs song/ tshogs 'du 'tshog sar dus thog nges phebs yod pa zhu/
1) dus yun thung shos/ 2) bskal pa'i mtha' ma/ 3) nad mug mtshon 'khrug dar ba'i dus/
dus yun thung ba'i mthar thug pa ste, skyes bu nad med stobs dang ldan pas se gol gcig gtog pa'i yun la cha drug cu re lngar phye ba'i cha gcig yin zhes mngon pa'i gzhung las gsal/
dus me'ang zer, bskal pa 'jig par byed pa'i me ste, nyi ma bdun gyi tsha reg /

bsdus pa'i gzhi: ltung ba bcabs ma bcabs bye brag tu 'chad pa dus dang dus min bsdus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi zhes pa ste, gzhi ltung ltung min gyi rnam dbye shes shing dran nus pa'i dge slong kho nas, bsam pa gsang 'dod kyi bsam rgyun ma chad pa, sbyor ba lus ngag gis 'chab par brtson pa, mthar thug sang gi skya rengs shar bar bcabs pa ste yan lag bzhi ka tshang na bcabs pa'i lhung ba dngos gzhir 'gyur zhing, ma tshang na mi 'gyur ba dang, pham pa 'chab bcas gsor mi rung zhing, 'chab pa med na las kyi bslab pa sbyin pa'i sgo nas phyir bcos byed pa dang, lhag lhung byung na spo mgu sogs kyi chad las bsgrub pa dang, spang ltung gang la brten nas ltung ba byung ba'i dngos po de zhag gcig tu spangs pa dang, gzhan rnams lus ngag yid kyis bshags pa byed pa sogs rang rang gi cho ga bzhin byed pa/
ga dus yin na'ang/ las ka byed stangs thad dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'dra mtshungs mi 'gyur ba zhig yong mi shes/
skabs skabs sam, mtshams mtshams/ lung pa de'i sa bab dma' tsam 'dug pas dus dus su zhing ga rnams chus gnon pa'i gnod skyon yang yong/ legs nyes gang yin dus dus su so sor brtag pa/
1) nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste drug / 2) dpyid, sos ka, dbyar, ston, dgun, dgun smad bcas drug /
dus tshod nges can bzo ba/ chu tshod dang por mnyam du 'dzom rgyu'i dus gdab pa/
zing 'khrug med pa'i dus bde zhod 'jags/
yun nam dus rgyun/ dus mda' thung ba/ dus mda' ring ba/
1) dus gsum gyi nang gses shig / 2) dus yol ba/ 3) shi ba/
gnas brtan bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa'i bkod pa ltar zangs gling na bzhud pa'i gnas brtan zhig /
rnam dbye lnga pa'i nang gses/ chu tshod dang po nas lnga pa'i bar/ nas...
ga dus yin rung/ dus nam yang brjed mi thub/
dus snga bsnur byed pa/ 'char gzhi 'grub dus bsnur ba/ rdog thon byed dus bsnur ba/
(rnying) 'dzin pa che ba'am, ser sna che ba/
gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa mi rnams tshe lo brgya nyi shu thub pa'i dus sam rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo/
dus 'gyangs pa/ mjug sgril dus phyir nud pa/
las ka mi byed par dus tshod skyel gang thub byed pa/ le los dus ma 'phul zhig / nyin 'phul dus 'phul gyis mi tshe bskyal ba/
1) dus la bab pa'i bsdus tshig 2) (rnying) 'chi ba/
1) dus thog tu 'gro 'ong gi bya rigs khug rta dang khu byug lta bu/ 2) dus gdab pa/
1) tshe las 'das pa'am, shi ba/ 2) dus tshod bsgrigs pa'am, kha chad byas pa/ 'gro dus byed pa/
'dul ba las bshad pa'i chos ldan gyi don dper na dge 'dun spyi'i lha tshon sogs kyi don 'di lta bu'i tshe ston pas gnang ba yin snyam du dus dran byas nas reg pa/
dus kyi byed po'i bsdus tshig
dus tshod 'phro brlag tu ma song ba/
dus nges pa'i gso sbyong dang don gcig

1) tatak'ala ? zhes pa ste, nyin zhag gcig la khyim bcu gnyis kyi dbang gis lug gi dus sbyor nas nya'i dus sbyor bar bcu gnyis nyi ma gar gnas pa'i sa nas rim par nyin zhag phrugs gcig la lan re 'khor bas dus sbyor bcu gnyis brtsis te, sa dum bu bcu gnyis po re re bzhin lug khyim sogs gsar du 'char ba nas phal cher chu tshod lnga'i ring la khyim de dang de'i dus sbyor zhes btags pa yin la, de yang sngon chad nyin mor sor bdun can gyi thur grib sogs la brten nas brtags pa dang, mtshan mor skar ma la brten nas brtags shing, khyim gang gi dus sbyor 'char skabs khyim de'i steng du gza' dgu po'i gang rung gnas mi gnas zhib tu brtags nas legs nyes kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa la ches stobs dang ldan pa yin pas dus sbyor yon tan 'bum ldan zhes bsngags pa yin no/ 2) dus tshod kyi 'phrod sbyor dang mthun sgrig byed pa/
zhag gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya phyi nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa 'byung 'jug gi mtshan nyid can/
dus ma nges pa'i gso sbyong

mthun pa'i gso sbyong gi nang gses, zla ba phyed phyed kyi tshes bco lnga lta bu'i dus nges gtan med par gso sbyong bya ba ste, de la'ang bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong dang, gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong, 'khon pa bsdum pa'i gso sbyong ste gsum yod do/
skabs la ma babs pa ste 'dul ba las bshad pa'i dus ma yin pa'i zas dang, dus ma yin par nyal ba, dus ma yin par smra ba sogs kyi don 'di lta bu/
za ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gling 'di'i nyi ma phyed yol nas sang gi skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du dus rung gi sman te zas za ba'o/

dgag dbye'i nang gses, dus la ma bab par dgag dbye bya ba ste, dbyar zla ba gsum du gnas pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'am, 'gal rkyen nye bar gnas pa na zla ba gcig gam phyed dang gnyis 'das pa na dgag dbye byar rung ba/
skye ba de'i tshe tshad ma rdzogs par tshe 'pho ba/
skabs la ma bab pa ha go ba bya pho dang skar mkhan lta bu/

1) gza' dgu'i ya gyal, sgra gcan dang phyogs kha gtad du gnas pas na sgra gcan gyi mjug ma zhes pa'i tha snyad thob/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgra gcan mjug dang, sna tshogs mdog can, mig sman mdog can bcas so, 2) dus mtha'i me ste 'jig rten stong skabs su nyi ma bdun shar nas 'jig rten sreg par byed pa'i me/
dus bkag btson 'jug gi bsdus tshig
dus tshod kyi tshad gzhi/ dus tshad bkag pa/ dus tshad las 'da' ba/
1) dus kyi bar mtshams/ dus tshigs 'gyur ba/ dus tshigs bde ba/ 2) (mngon) lo/

dbyar phyi ma khas len shes pa'i ched du 'dul gzhung las dus tshigs lngar dbye ba ste, hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar zla ba hril po bzhi ni dgun gyi dus dang, hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar zla ba hril po bzhi ni dpyid kyi dus dang, hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i bar zla ba hril po gcig ni dbyar tsam gyi dus dang, hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug pa zhag gcig dbyar thung ngu'i dus dang, hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug nas hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ste, zla ba gsum la zhag gcig ma tshang ba ni dbyar ring po'i dus/
dgun ra ba, dgun 'bring, dgun tha chung, dpyid ra ba, dpyid 'bring, dpyid tha chung, dbyar ra ba, dbyar 'bring, dbyar tha chung, ston ra ba, ston 'bring, ston tha chung rnams so/

dpyid zug kha ba char ldog srin bu 'gul, dpyid mnyam, nam mkha'i mdangs gsal, 'bru char, dbyar zug bri ba gang, rmon 'debs, dbyar nyi ldog tsha chung, tsha chen, ston zug bsil 'gug zil dkar, ston mnyam, bad nag sad lhung, dgun zug kha ba chung, kha ba che, dgun nyi ldog grang ngar chung, grang ngar che bcas so/
dgun smad, dpyid, sos ka, dbyar, ston te drug /
dgun zla ra ba 'bring tha chung, dpyid ra 'bring tha chung, dbyar ra 'bring tha chung, ston ra 'bring tha chung ste bzhi/
dgun dang, dpyid, dbyar bcas yin zhing ston gyi tsha ba che zhing char pa 'bab pas dbyar khar brtsi ba/

1) tshe skabs kyi rgyun ring thung gi 'bor tshad dang, snga phyi'i mtshams/ dus tshod khag bgos/ dus tshod mchog / dus tshod nyes pa/ dus tshod zur bkag / tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu'i dus tshod 'gyangs song/ 2) nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dbang du byas na, nam langs yos kyi dus tshod nas nyi nub bya yi dus tshod sogs dus tshod bcu gnyis yod, da lta'i dus tshod 'khor lo dang bstun na, dbugs bco lnga skar ma gcig skar ma drug cu dus tshod gcig dus tshod nyer bzhi nyin zhag gcig gi yun tshad yin/

nyin zhag phrugs gcig dus tshod bcu gnyis su phye ste nam langs, nyi shar, nyi dros, nyi phyed, phyed yol, nyi myur, nyi nub, sa sros, srod 'khor, nam phyed, phyed yol, tho rangs te bcu gnyis so, nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i skabs su nam langs yos, nyi shar 'brug ces sogs sbyor, dus tshod re rer yang chu tshod lnga re yod/

rgya rtsis las, thig le byi smad nyin mo'i mgo, bse ru glang stod mig glang smad, me mig byi stod nyin mo'i mtha', dus 'og thun nam phun yin de, tshes thob nor khe lhag phun dang, dus tshod gang shar da lta ba, khe phun de steng 'das pa'i mtshams/
tshe skabs kyi mtshams sam go skabs/ nyin mtshan gyi dus mtshams/ rgyal pham dbye 'byed kyi dus mtshams gal cher slebs pa/ phar rgol byed pa'i dus mtshams 'tshol ba/
dus mnyam pa/ lhags pa chen po rgyag pa dang dus mtshungs su char pa chen po'ang 'bab bzhin 'dug /
dus 'doms pa/ las ka khag mang dus 'dzings byung bar brten brel ba che tsam 'dug /
bde ba can du skye bar smon lam btab pa tsam gyis der skye'o zhes pa lta bu/

1) nam zla dus bzhi ste, dpyid, dbyar, ston, dgun/ 2) 'di la bskal ba rdzogs ldan, gsum ldan, gnyis ldan, rtsod ldan te bskal ba'i dbang du byas pa bzhi dang, sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas kyang rdzogs ldan sogs bzhi dang bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyi dbang du byas nas dus bzhi bshad pa sogs mang/

dang phyi ma: rigs ldan drag po'i yan gyi lo sum stong sum brgya dang bzhi (spyi lo'i sngon gyi 880 nas de man gyi 2424 bar) dus bzhi snga ma dang, rigs ldan drag po'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad lo chig stong brgyad brgya dus bzhi phyi ma, gnyis ka bsdoms na lo lnga stong brgya dang bzhi dus 'khor lugs kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad yin/

rigs ldan drag po'i bstan pa lo stong dang brgyad brgyar gnas pa de cha mnyam bzhir bgos pa'i cha re re la lo bzhi brgya lnga bcu yod pa la, rim bzhin rdzogs ldan, gsum ldan, gnyis ldan, rtsod ldan te dus bzhi phyi ma zer/
rum gdan gyi thags ris kham bu'i me tog dang: lcang ma, 'bras bu, smyug ma bcas bzhi/
dus mi bde ba'am 'khrugs pa/ spyi tshogs la dus zing byung na mi dmangs la dka' ngal 'byung/
dus tshod kyi zla ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'jal byed dang, nyin zhag tshogs pa, dbugs skyes, lo yi cha shas, lo yi mdzod, lo yi yan lag bcas so,

1) tshes zla dag pa'i rtsis 'phro'i ang grangs la brten nas lo hril po'i dus rtags ji 'byung tshod 'dzin gyi re'u mig / 2) dbugs sgang gis lo gcig gi ring la nyi ma gar gnas ston par byed la, de'i rkyen gyis sa la dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba yang 'chol med du ston pas na, dus bzhi mi 'gyur gnad kyi gzer zhes bya/
dus tshod legs pa/ tshes bzang dus bzang/
dus kyi ring tshad/ 'dzugs skrun las don dus yun thung ngu zhig gi nang du dar rgyas ha cang chen po byung yod pa/
1) dus btab pa las yol ba/ 2) dbyar dgun sogs rim gyis yol ba/ stong gtam bshad pas dus yol bar byed pa/
snga phyi'i rabs/ dus rabs nyi shu pa/ dus rabs bar ma/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i sman bzhi'i ya gyal, skya rengs shar nas nyin gung tshun la longs spyod du rung zhing bkres pa'i nad sel ba la gtso bor gnang ba'i sman, bcas ldan dge slong gis spyir btang la phyi dro longs spyod du mi rung ba'i bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga lta bu'o, de dag ni snga dro'i dus kho nar longs spyod du rung bas dus rung zhes bya/
skabs shig / dus re zhig la pham nyes: byung
skabs 'ga' zhig / sems shugs dus res 'gar che la, dus res 'gar chung ba/
skabs la bab pa/ dus la bab na sha mong gis spang brtol yong/ dkar nag dbye ba'i dus la bab/
1) dus thog tu slebs pa/ 2) nyi ma khyim bcu gnyis so sor dus skabs su 'khor ba/
1) 'jig rten tha snyad spyir grags pa'i dus 'das, ma 'ongs, da lta gsum/ 2) rtags 'jug skabs bya byed tha dad mi dad kun la khyab pa'i 'das, ma 'ongs, da lta gsum/
slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung zhig /
'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad, da lta'i sangs rgyas shakya thub pa, ma 'ongs sangs rgyas byams pa mgon po,

1. thag ring ngos 'dzin gyi phrad rang dbang can zhig / dus de'i bar/ dus de'i ring/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas/ de dang 'dra ba/ de la ci yod/ 2. ming mtha' da yig gi rjes su sbyar rgyu'i lhag bcas kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / da...
gong gsal lam, sngon du brjod pa'i gtam de 'dra ba/ nye sngon bdag gis de skad thos byung/ mi tshang ma la dmid bsal med pas khyed rang gis de skad ma zer/ de skad smra ba/
de 'dra bshad pa/ rang don kho nar lta mkhan ma gtogs de skad ces zer mi yong/
1) de 'ba' zhig gam de sha stag / mdun skyod de kho na ni 'od snang ldan pa'i lam mo/ rtag par de kho na bzhin du gnas pa/ 2) bden pa/ de kho na nyag gcig / bden don ni de kho na rang yin/
1) gzhan dang ma 'dres pa/ 2) stong nyid de gnas lugs mthar thug /
de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa
bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi mchod pa/
de kho na nyid kyi don
de kho na nyid kyi don la phyogs gcig pa
chos rnams kyi ming de dag stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab skyes pa ste, byang chub sems dpa'i mos pas spyod pa'i cha bzhi'i nang gses shig /
de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel
rgya gar gyi slob dpon ka ma la shi las brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa
rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
bya rgyud kyi de kho na nyid bzhi'i bsdus tshig
de kho na de bzhin nyid
stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes pa/
de'i rigs dang, de'i gras/ tshe skabs kyi sgra ni dus kyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming rnams te, de ring dang, sang nyin, zhogs pa, nyin dgung sogs tshang ma de khongs su yod/

de yin pa nyid du ngos gzung ba'i tshig cig / khyed rang gis gsungs pa de de ga rang red/ yul lung de'i gnas tshul de ga rang du 'dug / bsam 'char zhug rgyu de ga rang las gzhan med/ de ring 'khrid rgyu'i dpe cha de ga tsam gyis 'grig / bsam pa de gas rdzogs pa/ de ga 'dra po'i tshig pa za dgos dogs med/
de 'dra zer/ sngar byung gnas tshul de ga zer gyi 'dug ste, bden pa yin min da dung brtag dpyad byed dgos/
de yin pa nyid du ngos gzung ba'i tshig cig / gnas tshul ngo ma de ga rang red/
de ring dgong mo zhes pa'i bsdus ming/

sbyar yul gang yang rung ba'i ming dngos su tshig zin du yod med ji ltar rung, de'i ma mthar sbyor ba'i thag ring ngos 'dzin byed kyi tshig phrad cig yin te, sum cu par, tha snyad dbang du gsum yin te, dngos po'i dbang du bzhi ru 'gyur, dus kyi dbang du gnyis yin no, zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ 1)...1, rnam grangs gzhan zhig la sbyor rgyu yod pa'i tha snyad ston pa/ gzhung lam de mi'i 'gro sa'ang yin pa dang, rta drel gyi 'gro sa'ang yin pa, 'khor lo'i rigs kyi 'gro sa'ang yin/ 2, ming mtha' da yig gi rjes su 'jug pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra'i tha snyad ston pa'i phrad cig da...shing bcad de 'bud/ 3, 'das pa'i tha snyad ston pa/ gong du bshad pa de/ 2)...1, bden pa'i dngos po la 'jug pa/ khyed kyis gsungs pa de de bzhin no/ 2, gsang ba'i dngos po la 'jug pa/ de 'dra ma shod/ de su red/ ? de gsod dgos/ khyod kyis de rnams gzhan la ma ston zhig / 3,bdag gi ba'i dngos po la 'jug pa/ nga'i pha yul de/ bdag gi las don byed stangs de tsho/ 4, pha rol po'i dngos po la 'jug pa/ khyod kyi gyon pa de dag / kho'i spyod pa de gras/ 3)...1, dus 'das pa la 'jug pa/ na ning gi lo de/ 2, dus ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa/ sang phod kyi lo de/
de rjes phyogs kyi lhag ma
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, bsgo ba las gyur pa'i lhag ma bzhi'i nang gses, dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa de'i rjes su phyogs pa'am grogs byed pa lan gsum gyi bar du bzlog kyang mi nyan pa/

1) de yin pa nyid du ngos gzung ba'i tshig cig / mi de nyid/ 2) (mngon) sngar rgya gar gyi mu stegs grangs can pa tshos khas blangs pa'i de nyid zer ba'i gras su mig dang, rna ba, lce, sna, lag pa, rkang pa, 'phongs, pags pa, 'doms, ngag yid, sgra, reg gzugs, ro, dri, nam mkha', sa, chu, me, rlung, gtso bo, chen po, nga rgyal, skyes bu bcas nyer lnga yod pas grangs nyer lnga mtshon/ 3) dam pa/ mkhan po de nyid/ 4) de kho na nyid kyi bsdus tshig

las dang, bya ba so sor 'byed kyang, ming tshig gang rung gi gzhi gcig la sbyor ba'i tshe, bya las ngo bo tha mi dad par bya ba gcig la sbyar nas go dgos par brten, bya yul de nyid bya ba'i rang bzhin nyid du 'grub par ston pa'i rkyen ni, skabs 'di'i las sam, bya ba'i yul de ming rkyang yin na rnam dbye'i rkyen de 'gyur ba'am, 'grub pa'i don du go rgyu dang, las tshig gam, khyad chos yin na rnam 'gyur zhig mtshon pa'i don du go dgos pa, dper na, mer 'bar, 'od du 'tsher, gong du 'phel, gnyen dgra ru 'dzin, chu chang du mos, zhes pa lta bu ming rkyang dang, gnas lugs shes par byed, re don 'grub par 'gyur, bsam 'char bshad par bya, zhes pa lta bu las tshig thag pa ring du gtong, gom stabs 'khyog por sgyur, phyugs rnams ga ler log yong, zhes pa lta bu'o/

can tshig phrad: skabs skabs su bstan bya lhag ma gzhan ston pas don gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan dang, skabs skabs su don zur pa mi ston yang tshig gi kha skong lta bur 'jug pas tshig mdzes byed kyi rgyan ci rigs su sbyor ba'i tshig phrad cig ste, dper na, shin tu, kun tu, rab tu, mchog tu, khyad du, rmad du, phul du, yang dag par, mngon par, rnam par, nye bar, nges par, khyad par, rjes su la sogs pa lta bu/

sngags kyi de nyid bcu ste, dkyil 'khor dang, sngags dang, phyag rgya dang, bdag dang, gnas la sogs pa bsrung ba dang, lha rnams spyan drangs pa'i cho ga dang, bzlas brjod dang, bsgom pa dang, phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi sbyin sreg dang, nye bar bsdu ba dang, gshegs su gsol ba rnams so/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang, don gnyis phan tshun khyad chos 'dra che bas nor nyen yod mod, 'on kyang ma 'dres ma 'khrul bar dpe don gyi gnas lugs so sor nges pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
stong nyid rtogs pa/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa, 'dod la spyod kyang zhen pa med/

mang nyung de tsam du ngos gzung ba'i tshig cig / nus shugs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi las ka byed/ dgra bo ji snyed cig slebs pa de snyed cig rtsa gtor btang ba/ dka' tshegs ji snyed cig byung ba de snyed cig bsal ba/ de lta, de lta bu'i bsdus tshig
de 'dra yin tshe'am de 'dra yin na/ skad cha shod stangs de lta na ni ha cang thal bar 'gyur/
de 'dra yin gshis/ thon rdzas kyi spus ka dang 'brel gnad chen po yod pa dang, de lta bas na tshang mas do nan dam gzab byed dgos/
de 'dra po/ mi de lta bu dkon po red/ rang gis gzab gzab ma byas pas de lta bur 'gyur ba/
1) de ltar byung ba/ 2) sngon byung lo rgyus dang, gtam rgyud, rnam thar bcas/
de lta bu byung ba'i sde
«itibritak:» gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi brgyad pa sngon gyi gtam rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang ldan par ston pa, dper na, mdo sde las brgya pa lta bu 'dul ba'i sde snod du gtogs/
de 'dra yin na'ang/ gsar skyes nus shugs chung tsam zhig las med pa yin, de lta mod kyi, mthar stobs rnying hrul dang 'thabs te rgyal kha len rgyu nges can red/
de 'dra bar dang, de lta bur/ 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta/ de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byas rjes 'jog mkhan rnams la nga tshos dga' gus yid smon chen po byed bzhin du yod/
de ltar bsam pa'am rtsi ba/
de 'dra red kyang, de ltar yin na yang/
de 'dra yin yang/ spyir btang de ltar yin mod kyi, dmigs bsal la nges pa med do/

de lta bu yin pa'i phyir na zhes pa'i don/ de ltas dge ba nyam chung nyid la rtag sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa, de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa, dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/
1) mang tshig / mi de dag / de dag dang mtshungs pa/ de dag thams cad/ de dag las gzhan pa/ de dag las bzlog pa/ 2) gnyis tshig /
nges gzung gi sgra zhig / lung pa de dang de la gnas tshul de dang de byung ba/
1) mi de dang thug pa/ 2) rkyen de dang phrad pa/
de dang phan tshun mthun zhing ran pa/ dbang po'i rim pa de dang 'tshams pa'i slob gso yang yang byas/
/ de dus nga yang phyin pa yin/
de ga rang red/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gang gsungs pa de de bzhin no/
1) gong du bshad pa de'i don/ de don ma brjed par gyis/ de don dgongs dbyings su 'jags pa 'tshal/ 2) de'i don du'i bsdus tshig
de dang mtshungs pa/ gri de 'dra ba zhig nyos dang/ de 'dra ba byas na mi chog /
de dang ldan pa ste, de 'dra yod pa/ yon tan de ldan gyi mi/
de'i mu'am de'i rjes/ sa de nas gser byung/ dang po bsam blo btang de nas gtam bshad pa/
bya ba snga phyi mtshams sbyor gyi phrad/ mi gzhan btang bar ma zad de nas ni kho rang yang phyin song/
yul dus nges can de nas bzung/ dus de nas gzung lo grangs mang po'i bar/
mi kho pa/ mi blo gros can de pas thabs bzang mang po bshad pa/
yul dus nges can de phan chad/ yul de phan chad kho tsho'i yin/ dus tshod de phan chad 'das pa'i dus yin/
khyim bya pho spu mdog dmar po/
de nas rjes su/ sngar de ltar byung yang de phyin chad las don de ltar byung med/
de'i slad dam de'i don du/
'phral mar/ ma brtags bsams tshad de 'phral brtsams na skyon cha yong/
de'i lhag ma dang, dus tshod de'i rjes/ dngul gzhung 'bul lag 'byor byung zhing, de 'phros rnams khyod tshos nyar na 'grig /
1) shing zhig / 2) sngon sman gyi rigs te, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo ba'i tshad pa dang, rims tshad sel/ 3) (legs) lha/
da yod las lhag pa/ thon skyed de bas kyang dar rgyas che ba/ nang gi don snying de bas kyang cha lag tshang ba/ grogs po de bas kyang mang ba/ gsar brje'i mthu stobs de bas kyang che ba/
de yi phyir ram, des na/ 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sogs je legs su phyin pa red, de bas na mi'i lus khams bde thang du gyur pa red/
de min spyi byings/ der yod zhing ga'i brgya cha lnga tsam la sngo tshal btab cing, de byings tshang mar bza' 'bru btab/

'brel ba'i nang gses, de las de byung gi 'brel ba ste, rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba, dper na, me dang du ba lta bu, rdzas tha dad pa yin zhing, me log na du ba log par 'gyur ba rten 'byung gi 'brel ba'o/
de dang mtshungs pa, de dang dus mnyam/ 'tsho ba je legs su song bar ma zad, de 'brel rig gnas kyi chu tshad kyang mtho ru phyin yod/
/ 'bod mi 'byor ba'i dus de ma thag tu phyin pa yin/ skabs dang po'i las grwa grub pa'i de ma thag tu skabs gnyis pa'i las 'go btsugs pa yin/
de ma thag dang don gcig
rkyen bzhi'i nang gses, sems sems byung mtshungs pa rnams kyis snga ma gang zhig 'gag pa'i de ma thag tu rang gi phyi lod kyi sems sems byung skyed pa'o/
mtshams shig gis bcad pa'i don/ sa cha de man chad rong khul yin/ lo dus de man chad da lta'i dus rabs kyi khongs su brtsi dgos/
de ma yin pa/ gong du zhus pa rnams las de min bsam 'char med/

de'i ngang dang, de lta nang bzhin/ mi gsod me rgyag gi rtsing spyod gang byas de mur gtan nas bzod sgom mi rung/ tshul min gyi bsam blo de mur bzhag nas legs bcos ma btang na rang nyid la phan pa gtan nas med/
1. 1) khyim bya mo/ 2) kong yul gyi sa cha zhig / 2. (rnying) dgos pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kong po dang spo yul bar gyi la zhig /
de'i tshe na/ skad cha 'di dag skabs de tsa na smras pa red/
tshad 'dzin gyi sgra zhig / khong khro de tsam byed mi dgos/ rin dngul de tsam sprod dgos kyi ma red/ yun de tsam gyi bar du bsgugs pa/ dmag ji tsam brgyab pa de tsam gyis stobs che ru 'gro ba/
grangs can pas bzhag pa'i shes bya nyer lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste gzugs, sgra, dri, ro, reg bya bcas lnga/
de 'dra zhig gi ngang nas rdzogs pa'am, tshar ba, zad pa/ kho rang gi mi tshe'i ring byas pa'i las ka'i grub 'bras de tsam du zad pa red/
1) de ltar/ khyed kyis de tsug byas sam/ 2) de gang/
de la gzhigs pa/ mi tshang mas hur brtson byed kyi yod gshis de rtsis khyod rang gis kyang hur brtson byed dgos/
rang 'bras dbang shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rten nam bdag rkyen du gyur pa ma yin pa, gnyid log pa'i dus skabs kyi mig rna sna lce lus kyi dbang po rnams so/
(yul) deng sang / kho gang du phyin pa yin nam de zhag mthong ma byung/

1) de ltar/ .gsham gsal don tshan rnams kyang gong 'khod de bzhin du sbyar chog / khyed kyis gsungs pa de bzhin kho bos ji bzhin par rtogs byung/ 2) dngos po so so'i ngo bo nges gzung gi mtshon dpe/ khang pa de bzhin/ lug rdzi de bzhin/ las ka de bzhin/ skad cha de bzhin/
spros pa dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings so/
ngo bo nyid: stong nyid kyi stong nyid/
ro gcig pa: chos dbyings su ro gcig pa/
chos dbyings sam: dam pa'i bdag /
de bzhin nyid dmigs bsam gtan
sa dang po yan chod sa bcu pa man chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings stong pa'i don sa re re bzhin ye shes kyi khyad par gyis rim par bsgom pa/
mngon pa kun btus lugs su de bzhin nyid ni chos nyid la khyad med kyang, chos can rten tha dad pa'i sgo nas dge ba dang, mi dge ba dang, lung ma bstan gyi de bzhin nyid gsum mo/
de bzhin gshegs pa dang don gcig
«tathagta:» srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi lam la brten nas byang chub chen por mngon par gshegs pa/
de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa

sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang don gcig, thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs sems can la: gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, su rendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'i mdo sde zhig /
de bzhin gshegs pa dri med zla 'od
de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par
rgyas pa theg pa chen po'i mdo shloo ka brgyad brgya pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur pa'o/
de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan
brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na shi la dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa'i mdo sde glegs bam nga par bzhugs pa/
de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod pa
de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i le'u bam po lnga dang le'u lnga pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na shi la dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/
rgyal ba rin chen mang, gzugs mdzes dam pa, sku 'byams klas, 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/
de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga
rnam snang dang, mi bskyod pa, 'od dpag med, rin 'byung, don grub bcas lnga/
de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba
dge tshul pha ma dang, dge slong pha ma bcas bzhi'o/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba bsam gtan

shes bya thams cad ma lus par thugs su chud cing nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus par spangs pas ci la yang rnam par mi rtog par lhun gyis grub nas bdag dang gzhan gyi don ma lus par 'dzin pa/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku
sku gsum gyi nang gses sangs rgyas kyi chos sku ste spang rtod mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi sku/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa

'phags pa de bzhin gshed pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po

1) 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gcig pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shakya pra bha dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/ 2) bde gshed snying po ste rang bzhin gnas rigs/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu
stobs bcu dang don gcig, bstan pa: lung dang rtogs pa'i chos/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa
sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ste mthar thug gi theg pa'am theg pa chen po/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril bu
de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa
thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jig pa bzhi
mi 'jig pa bzhi dang don gcig, mtshan dpe: sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu tshang ba/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs sku
gdul bya'i snang ngor sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhin lag can gyi rnam par shar ba/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab
pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gsum pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang pradzn'a warma, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur pa'o/
1) rigs gsum gyi nang gses theg pa chen po'i rigs te sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyan zhing bsgom pa'i bag chags yod pa/ 2) sngags lugs kyi rigs gsum gyi nang gses shig /
sangs rgyas kyi sa ste kun tu 'od kyi sa/
de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa
bam po bcu dang le'u nyer lnga pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o, mdo dkon brtsegs nang du bzhugs pa/
sngar bshad phyi mar bskyar ba'i tshig phrad cig / khyod kyis sngar smras pa'i don gang yin pa de yang legs so/ de yang 'di skad ces gsungs pa/
mtshams shig / de yan la bskyod mi chog /
(yul) de 'dra yin pas/ mi de nad pa yin tsa na dgongs pa gnang dgos/
(yul) nye char ram kha sang / de rag ngos mjal zhu skabs,..
rang nyid du ngos gzung ba'i tshig cig / kha sang yong mkhan mi de rang red/
da lta'i nyin mo/ de ring gi las ka de ring 'grub pa bya dgos/ de ring nas bzung dus mtshams gsar pa zhig shar byung/
de ring yan chad kyi nyin shas ring/ de ring kha sang gnam gshis tsha grang snyom po 'dug /
de ring kha sang dang don gcig
da lta'i sngon chad dang phyin chad/
1) de ring dang phyi nyin gnyis/ 2) de ring man chad kyi nyin shas ring/
de 'dra yin stabs/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas phan tshun 'brel lam dam zab byung ba/
gcig gtso bor bton nas de byings sogs sgras bsdus pa/
tshur byed stangs la dpags nas de ltar lan slog pa/
1) 'byung khungs nges bzung/ de las ldog pa/ de las bzlog pa/ rgyu brtson 'grus de las byung ba'i 'bras bu mkhas pa/ 2) dgar chos nges bzung/ de las gzhan pa gang yang med/
e sho legs dang rmu lcam bra ma na gnyis kyi sras, sngar bod rgyal bcu gcig pa ste sa'i legs drug gi ya gyal zhig
dus de'i ring ngam dus de'i bar/ nam 'tsho ba de srid kyi bar du mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/ deng, de ring gi bsdus tshig
de ring nas sam, da nas/ deng nas bzung ste rgyab 'gal dang nar 'gyang byas mi chog /
deng phan chad dam de ring phan chad kyi bsdus tshig
dus da lta'i sngon chad dang, phyin chad/
ma 'ongs pa'i don/ deng phyin chad las ka yag po byed dgos/
1) de ring dang sang nyin/ 2) da lta'i dus skabs/
tshong pa'i 'go khrid dam, gru gzings kyi kha lo pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la zho sha rnam bdun pa'o,
shog bu mang po gcig tu bsdebs nas byung ba'i glegs bu/ yig deb/ dpe deb/ klog deb/ ri mo'i deb/
1) gnas lugs deb thog tu 'god pa/ 2) yig zam deb skyel/
don gnad gang rung deb thog tu 'khod yod pa rnams/

rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi lor mdo smad kyi mkhas pa chen po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis brtsams pa'i bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas btsan po mang srong mang btsan bar gyi bod kyi rgyal rabs shig / 1946...

'gos lo ye bzang rtse ba gzhon nu dpal gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel nas sa khyi lo'i bar la brtsams, dge lugs ma dar gong gi grub mtha' so so dang, brgyud pa'i lo rgyus, bstan rtsis kyi lo tshigs phra zhib bcas pa le'u bco lngar bkod pa'i lo rgyus khungs ldan zhig yin, par shing sngar zhwa dmar pa'i yangs pa can dgon par yod kyang, phyis su kun bde gling du s pos/ (1392-1481)...1476-1478...

rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs: gangs can yul gyi sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris rgyal blon gtso bor brjod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgyal mtshos rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu lug lor mdzad, brjod bya chos srid gnyis las srid phyogs gtso bo dang, dus rabs snga phyi gnyis las phyi rabs glang dar man chad gtso bor bstan cing, lhag par du sa skya pa dang phag gru gnyis 'phel 'grib bam dar rgud kyi lo rgyus rgyas par bkod yod, gsung 'bum gyi dza bam du shog grangs brgya dang bcu gsum yod, pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis kyang lcags par du bskrun yod/ (1617-1682)...1643...dza...

deb ther dmar po'i dang po hu lan deb gter zhes bya ba, tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes rab byung drug pa'i me khyi lor brtsams, rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs dang shakya'i gdung rabs dang, rgya nag gyi rgyal rabs, hor gyi rgyal rabs, bod kyi btsan po rim byon dang sa skya bas dbang bsgyur ba yan chad, bod kyi chos 'byung bcas skabs bzhi yod pa dang, khyad par du rgya yig gi deb ther mang du drangs nas rgya bod bar gyi 'brel lam zhib tu bkod pa zhig yin, sngar bris ma thar thor las par ma med, de'i rtsom pa po tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros yin par bshad tshul yang yod, pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis lcags par du bskrun yod, gzhan yang pan chen bsod nams grags pas rab byung dgu pa'i sa khyi lor sbyar ba'i kha skong ma deb ther dmar po gsar ma zhes bya ba bris ma zhig kyang yod/ 134 6...(1478-1554)...(1538...)
ma rtsa deb kyi nang du bkod pa/
deb tu bcings pa'i yi ge
deb tu 'khod pa/ sngon byung lo rgyus deb gsal bden min dbye 'byed brtag dpyad bzab nan byed dgos/
gzhung khra'i nang du gsal zhing lam lugs: dang yang mthun pa
(rgya) chu rab brgal yul rkang stegs/
gong gsal gnas lugs de 'dra yin gshis/ nad gzhi de'i rkyen gyis bar mtshams chad pa/
dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu/
1) ma 'ongs pa'i dus de'i skabs/ 2) 'das pa'i dus de'i skabs/
gnad don gang yod pa de'i skor/ de'i skor la nga tshos do snang chen po byed dgos/
rnam dbye gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gang rung bsdu ba ste, grong du 'gro ba la grong 'gro zhes rnam dbye gnyis pa bsdus pa bzhin no/
1) dus tshod de'i thog la/ 2) de'i skabs la/
1.ri 'bur po chung ngu/ de'u 'bur/ 2.(rnying) nye ba'am myur ba/ de'u shi ba/ de'u bsad pa/
cung zad min na/ me mda' kha shor nas de'u min na mi la phog song/

bstan 'dzin phun tshogs: rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang sku 'khrungs, dgung lo brgyad kyi thog nas gso ba rig pa sogs rig gnas kun la thos bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad de bod chen po'i ljongs 'dir de'u dmar pan chen zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gyis khyab par gyur, mdo khams go 'jo ru de'u dmar zab rgyas chos gling phyag btab, gsung rtsom yang nang rig pa'i skor dang, sgra rig pa, bzo rig pa, skar rtsis sogs thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas sna tshogs dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i skor la bdud rtsi sman gyi rnam dbye, ngo bo, nus pa, ming bcas rgyas par bshad pa shel gong phreng dang, lag len gces bsdus sman kun bcud du bsgrub pa'i las kyi cho ga kun gsal snang mdzod, gso rig mngon brjod nyer mkho'i don gsal, me btsa' dang gtar ga'i skor sogs dpe tshan brgya la nye bar brtsams, slob ma yang dpal spungs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs mkhas btsun ldan pa mang po bskyangs pa sogs mdzad rjes shin tu che/
de'u dmar zab rgyas chos gling
rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdo khams go 'jo'i gser kha ru chag btab pa'i dwags po bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin mkhan dgon pa zhig /
cung zad tsam re'am, tog tsam re/ de'u re min na g.yang sar lhung song/
de tsam las med/ yi ger gang 'khod kyi tshig don der bas so/
de tsam gyis mi tshad/ phyag dpe 'di khyed la yod pa der ma zad gzhan la'ang 'dug /
de tsam las med/ grog mas ri rab g.yo 'gul gtong rtsis ni rang stobs rang gis tshod mi thig pa'i rtags der zad do/
de gas chog pa'am de yis rung ba
de yi phyir na'am de lta bas na/ khong byas rjes chen po yin pa des na kun gyis bsngags brjod byas pa red/
zhi zhing dul ba'am, rang bzhin bzang po/ sems rgyud des pa/ des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson/
bam po gcig pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/

1. 1) zung ngam gnyis/ ja dkar yol do las ma 'thung/ lag do/ 2) kha sdeb/ dga' mgu che ba nor bu rnyed pas do ma yin/ 'dzam gling yongs la do med pa/ 2.da mthar sbyar rgyu slar bsdu'i phrad cig / da...3.ming gi sngon du 'jug pa'i tshig grogs shig / 1) don gyi ngo bo gang yang mi ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / do snyoms pa/ 2) nye ba'i don ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / do shi/
mgo'i skra gtsug tor ltar bcings pa'i mi/
do bdag dang khag theg byed mkhan
sems khur ram do snang/ spyi pa'i khe phan la do khur chen po byed pa/
gnad 'gag gam 'gan/ dgra btul rgyal len thub min gyi do gal che skabs gzab nan byed gal che/ las don do gal che chung la gzhigs nas snga rting gi go rim sgrig pa/
gal che zab nan/ rang gi lta lugs ji yin do gal nan tan gyis kha gtad pa rnams la gsal bsgrags byed pa/
do po bzo mkhan nam, do po rgyag mkhan/

go chod pa'am go 'pher ba/ do bdag ngo ma yong ma thub tshe ngo tshab do chod cig btang na'ang 'grig /
cha mnyam mam yang lci sogs mnyam pa/ rgyab khal do mnyam byung na rang dgar khal log mi thebs/
1) bdag sprod/ gal che'i dngos po rnams do dam yag po byed dgos/ 2) btson 'jug / btson par do dam byed pa/
1) bdag sprod byed mkhan/ 2) gu dog po yin pa dang lhod yangs med pa/
gzhan la mngags nas do dam byed du bcug pa/
bdag po'am ngo ma:/ do bdag rnams la 'dri rtsad zhib gsal byas pa/
do bdag ngo ma/ lam zur nas bsgrugs pa'i dngos po rnams brlag mkhan do bdag ngo ma'i lag tu bskyal ba/
do bdag dang le thogs pa'i mi ngo ma/
'gran zla/ kha gtad stobs ldan dang do bsdur byed phod pa/
'gran zla byed pa/ stobs shugs do bsdo bar byed pa/ 'khu sems kyis do bsdo bar byed pa/
gzab nan/ don gyi ngo bo gang yin par brtag dpyad do nan byed dgos/

/ gna' rdzas rnams la do phog btang mi chog
1.(tha mi dad pa) nus pa/ khyod 'gro e do/ ?snying rje do mi btub pa/ kho dang shugs tshad na mi do ba ngas ha go byung/ 2.sngo zhig /

1) rtsed ra'am, 'cham ra/ zhabs bro'i do ra/ 2) 'brog thang/ 3) 'bru'i snye ma g.yob byed cig /

phreng ba khug pa can gyi rgyan cha g.yu dang byu ru spos shel sogs yod pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'phyang phrul dang, brang gi rgyan, se mo do bcas so,
rgyan cha'i phreng ba khug pa med pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'phyang phrul dang, brang gi rgyan, se mo do bcas so,

gsod du nye ba'am, de'u gsod dam, gsod la khad/

sngar rgya gar gyi grub thob sa ra ha pa dgyes pa'i glu ste, rgyal po do ha dang, blon po do ha, dmangs do ha bcas gsum, gzhan yang do ha mdzod dang, rgyal po do ha, btsun mo do ha ste gsum las dang po sa ra ha'i gsung yin la phyi ma gnyis bal po a sas byas par grags zhes bu ston gsungs/
(yul) skud pa'i dog pa lag par dkri ba'i ming/
/ 1) gang bu/ rgya sran ma'i dog pa gas song/ 'bru'i dog pa phal cher smin 'dug / 2) ril bu'am gong bu/ 3) chun po/ me tog dog pa gcig / 4) ze 'bru/ 5) skud pa/ 6) dog po dang 'dra,
gu yangs po'i ldog phyogs/ khang chung dog po/ gnam yangs po sa dog po/ mi de blo sbubs dog po zhig 'dug / dog cing ring ba'i sa khul/
yangs su khengs pa/ sprin nag gis bar snang mtha' dag dog por khyab pa/ dpe cha mang drags pas dpe khri dog por khyab 'dug /
1) dog pa dang 'dra, 2) dog ma dang 'dra,
(rnying) chu bsro sa dang zas g.yo sa'i snod/
dogs zon byed dgos pa'i mi/
the tshom sel thabs/ dge rgyan gyi sku mdun la bcar te dogs gcod zhu ba/
the tshom gyi don sel ba po/
yid kyi dogs pa bsal ba/
the tshom gyi gnas gtso che ba/ gzhung don gyi dogs mtha' bcad pa/
the tshom gyi 'dri ba/ dge rgan la dogs 'dri zhu ba/
the tshom gyi snang ba'am bsam pa/ las ka de ga 'dra byed min nga la dogs snang ma byung/

1.(tha mi dad pa) the tshom za ba/ rtag tu 'khyag ltogs kyis dod nas 'tsho thabs skyel ba'i dus skabs de rtsa ba nas yol song/ gzhan gyis 'phya smod byas yong snyam nas dogs pa byas te kha rog sdod pa/ zam pa'i 'og nas 'ur sgra byung bar dogs pas rta 'drog pa/ dogs pa mi dgos par bag phebs par byos shig / thob re shor dogs/ 2.the tshom/ dogs pa skye ba/ dogs pa tsha po/ the tshom gyi dogs pa sel ba/ pha rol po'i 'dod lugs la dogs pa bkod pa/ 'di ltar yin nam ma yin snyam du dogs pa za ba/ tshig don la bdar sha zhib tu bcad pas dogs pa yal ba/
sngon nas dogs zon gyi bsam blo gtong ba/ dka' ba'i gnas la dogs pa sngon du bsus nas dgag sgrub byed pa/
1) the tshom med pa/ 2) yong srid pa'i skabs med pa/ mthong dogs med/ bros dod med/ mi gsod dogs med/ khyi 'dzing yang khyi lpags ral dogs med/
dogs pa'am, the tshom/ don med dogs tshom byas nas rang gis rang la rnyog gra ma bzo/
the tshom dang 'brel ba'i do snang/ dogs zon che bskyed/ dgra bor rtag tu dogs zon byas na nges med tshur rgol byung yang bya dka' byed gtad mi yong/
dogs zon lhod med/ mi ngan gyi 'tshe ba yong min dogs zon g.yel med byed pa/
the tshom za ru 'jug pa/ tshig don gang gi cha la 'gal skyon yod med dogs slong byed pa/
/ 1) sa'i khung bu/ chu dong zab mo/ me dong/ dong lam/ sa dong du gzhug pa/ 2) sbubs/ lcags dong/ shing dong/ smyug dong/ 3) sa'i 'og gi btson khang/ sdig dong/ sbal dong/ tsher dong/

shing sman gyi rigs te, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mchin nad dang byis pa'i mkhris nad sogs 'jam por sbyong bar byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khor lo 'dra dang, rgyal po'i shing, nad 'joms, me tog phreng ba, zhi byed, lo ma bzang, sor mo bzhi pa bcas so/
mda' shubs/ ming gi rnam grang la mda' snod dang, mda' 'dzin, mda' yi gnas, brtsang rtsa bcas so,
(rgya) zangs sogs kyi dong tse ste sngar gyi zangs dngul/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul du yod/
sha rul 'bu rul sa rul sogs kyis gang ba'i btson khang ngam, sa dong nyam nga dri ma can/
'dong ba'i skul tshig gi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
spom tshod kyi dod dngul sprod pa/ lo 'khor gyi dgos cha tshang ma 'dod sgril spom sprod byed pa/
tshab byed thub pa/ gser gyi dod thub dngul/ bye ma ka ra'i dod thub bu ram/
(tha mi dad pa) dbyibs dang ri mo ji bzhin du thon pa/ ka bar brkos pa'i ri mo sna tshogs 'bur du dod pa/ sprang po nyam thag pa'i nyams dod po byas/
1.tshab/ gsol dod/ na bza'i dod por sgor mo lnga bcu tham pa phul/ 2.dbyibs sam rnam pa sogs gsal por mtshon pa/ ri mo 'bur du dod po 'dug / mi de nyams dod po 'dug / grung sha dod po/

1. 1) las ka/ spyi don/ sger don/ rang don/ gzhan don/ 2) go bya'i don/ dgongs don/ tshig nyung zhing don dril ba/ tshig gi don rtogs dka' ba/ tshig zur lhang tsam bshad pas don go ba/ 3) dngos yod gnas lugs/ bsam pa de rnams tshang ma don du gnas pa/ kha nas de lta bshad kyang, don du de 'dra ma red/ gang bshad pa rnams don dang mi mthun pa/ 4) phyi don gzung bya'i yul/ don lkog tu gyur pa/ 5) nang khrol zhig / 2.dngos po gang yang rung ba'i grangs bcu gnas ang yig bdun yin pa'i gcig gnas su 'jug pa'i tshig grogs shig / bdun cu don lnga/ don brgyad/
1) don dag thams cad grub pa/ 2) shakya thub pa/ 3) (mngon) yungs kar/
bskor ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bskor bya gcig gi gnas lugs, skor byed don gcig ming gi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba mang pos yang yang skyar zlos kyi tshul du ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi sa cha zhig ste, sngar bod kyi rgyal po 'ga'i bang so der yod/
gyi dbang mngon tshad ma: bus pha'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon tshad ma lta bu/
don gyi snga phyi go rim bsgrigs pa/
brten pa lta bur snang ba'i chos te, dper na bum pa'i byas mi rtag sogs dang mdzes mi mdzes sogs lta bu gzhi'i steng du yod pa'i khyad par gyi chos rnams so/
rgya gar lho shar thun mong du 'dod pa'i snyan ngag gi don rgyan so lnga/
rten lta bur snang ba'i chos te, dper na bum pa lta bu byas mi rtag sogs kyi khyad chos du ma ldan pa'i gzhi'o/
sngon rjes ming gsum tshig phrad rnam dbye dang bcas pa don gang dang gang la 'jug pa'i tshul/
bdag po ngo ma'am gtso bo/
sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mang du thos pa btsal ba dang nor gsog srung byed pa/
don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel gyi bsdus tshig
gzungs kyi sgo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, ming dang tshig gis brjod pa'i don gang dang gang yin pa'i dmigs pa myur du go zhing ming brjod par 'dzin pa/

rdzogs rim gyi chos shig ste, gnyid 'khrul la brten pa'i mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis ka'i sgrib gnyis kyi sa bon yang lam gyi 'od gsal stobs ldan gyis spangs pas gzhi'i 'od gsal glo bur dri bral du gyur pa/
shugs kyis rtogs pa/ zhib gsal ma smras kyang, dka' gnad phal cher don gyis go byung/
1) don kun grub dang don yod grub pa'i bsdus tshig 2) (mngon) 1, yungs dkar/ 2, sa lug lo/
1) 'char can gyi las don dang gnas tshul las gsar du 'gyur ba/ 2) skad rigs gcig gi don snying skad rigs gzhan zhig tu sgyur ba/

the tshom gyi nang gses, rang yul don mthun du 'dzin pa'i yang dag pa'i blo skyed par byed pa'i the tshom, dper na, sgra rtag gam mi rtag phal cher mi rtag las che snyam pa lta bu ste, des sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo bskyed pa'o/
1) don snying gang yin 'grel bshad rgyag pa/ 2) tshig gi 'bru mi gnyer bar don gyi go ba rnams mthar chags su bshad pa'i gzhung/

rtsa ba'i gzhung me long ma'i le'u gnyis pa, sde bzhi la sogs pa 'dod bya'i don gyi sbyor ba gtso bor ston pas don rgyan zer zhing, rgya gar shar phyogs pa dang, lho phyogs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan thun mong du 'dod pa'i rgyan du grags la, nang gses kyi rnam grangs ni, rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni, gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang, 'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang, ldog pa can dang srid pa can, bsdus dang phul byung rab btags dang, rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim, dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can, rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan, rgya che bsnyon dor sbyar ba dang, khyad par mtshungs par sbyar ba dang, 'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang, zol bstod nges par bstan pa dang, lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis, rab spel de nas dgongs pa can, 'di dag tshig rnams dag gi ni, rgyan du sngon gyi mkhas pas bstan, zhes gsungs pa ltar sum cu so lnga yod/
don zhib cing gsal ba/ don rgyas tshig rgyas/

bsod nams rin chen: gnyal gyi yul du rab byung dang po'i sa lug lor 'khrungs, chung dus sman dpyad kyis nad pa mang po'i don mdzad pas lha rjer grags, dgung lo nyer drug la chos sgor zhugs nas mdo sngags kyi chos la sbyangs pas mkhas shing byang chub, dgung lo so gnyis pa lcags stag lor rje btsun mi la'i snyan pa gsan nas stod phyogs su byon, gdams ngag gsan te nyams myong gi rtsal thon, dbus su phebs te dwags lha sgam por dgon pa btab ste bzhugs, bka' gdams pa'i lam rim dang, mi la'i phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gcig tu dril nas lam rim thar rgyan mdzad, gdul bya'i dbang po rno rtul gang la gang 'tshams kyis gdams pa gnang, slob ma mtha' yas pa bskyangs nas dwags po bka' brgyud ces pa'i srol btsugs, dgung lo don lnga pa chu bya lor 'das/

1.(tha mi dad pa) gsal bar gyur pa/ rig pa dwangs na blo skyed 'phel/ chu dwangs na nya mo gsal/ thugs dgongs dwangs yong/ 2. dri ma dang bral ba'am, rnyog pa med pa/ chu dwangs pa/ chuang dwangs pa/

phyi gsal nang gsal rnyog med dri bral gyi shel/
khrims yig dwangs shel me long gi bsdus ming,
rnyog pa med pa/ mi 'di dwangs sang zhig 'dug / rdza ri las 'bab pa'i chu dwangs sang nge ba/
rnyog pa dang bral ba'i tshul/ rig pa dwangs sing nge ba/
rnyog ma'am dri ma med pa/ sprin bral ston zla'i nam gkha' dwangs gsal che/
(rnying) 1) sngo tshal/ 2) pha ma shi ba'i bu phrug
dwo ba rdzong ste bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong gi ming rnying yin/
dra gcod kyi yo byad gri/
(yul) dra pang gi sne rten mkhan/
skud pa'i dra bas bzos pa'i snod sgye mo/
jem tses dra ba dang, khab dang 'khor los 'tshem pa/
ko ba sogs dra sa'i 'og gi pang leb/
(yul) shog bu dra sa'i pang leb/
gos dang shog bu sogs dra byed kyi dngos po spyi'i ming/
1) skud pa'i dra ba can gyi snod/ 2) gzan pa sogs blug snod dra phad/
1) (yul) rtsig pa'i ldebs su bris pa'i sham bu'i sgang gi ri mo/ 2) mchod rdzas rgyan phreng nar dpyangs khug phyed can/

1.'dra ba'i ma 'ongs pa,2. 1) mchod rdzas rgyan phreng nar dpyangs khug pa can/ 2) gcig nas gcig la mthun pa'i rgya dang, rnyi/ 'grim 'grul gyi dra ba/ rtog pa'i dra ba/ the tshom gyi dra ba/ 'od zer gyi dra ba/ nyes can su yin tshang ma khrims kyi dra ba las 'bros dka'/ phyag dang zhabs dra bas 'brel ba/ ngang pa'i rkang pa dra bas 'brel ba/
(mngon) 1) 'bu sdom/ 2) lcags gos dang go cha/ 3) ku ba/
1) sgo 'phyor dang mthongs sgor sogs kyi mdzes rgyan/ 2) lha khang sogs kyi gdung khebs mchod rdzas kyi bye brag cig /
/ 1) mkhas pa dang, ya rabs/ 2) legs pa dang, gsha' ma, yang dag pa/ gos chen dra ma/ las 'gan mtha' dag dra ma bsgrubs song/ khyed kyis bka' mngags gnang ba rnams ngas dra ma zhig zhus chog /
dra ba can gyi tshags spyad/ 'bru ma brngos gong nas dra tshags su btsags pa/
drag gza' gsum gyi rkang 'dzin dang zhi gza' gnyis kyi dal bar te, gang brtsi'i nyin gyi nyi bar de nyid yin/
skyugs sman gyi sbyor sde ril bu dril nas btang ste drag po'i sgo nas nad gyen du skyugs par byed pa'i thabs shig
nad bab yang du 'gro ba/ yun ring na nas da dung drag skyed byung ma song/ deng sang nad gzhi drag skyed cung zad 'dug
gsang sngags kyi las bzhi'i nang gses drag po'i chos shig /
char pa chen po/ drag char bab cing rlung 'tshub langs pa/ drag char gyi gnod skyon byung ba/
dmag chas go lag bcas/ mang tshogs tshang mar drag chas spras pa/ mi rnams kyi bsam blor gsar brje'i rigs lam gyi drag chas spras pa/
khrims drag pos bcun te bslab bya rgyag pa/ khrims 'gal mi srun pa'i rigs la drag 'jun byed pa/
dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nang gses shig
shin tu khro ba'i rnam pa/
mchog gam mtho gras mnyam sdong byed pa/
nad drag po/ drag nad na nas 'tsho ma thub pa/
rtsub po'i sgo nas 'dul ba/ khrag dri bro ba'i drag gnon/

1.(tha mi dad pa) na tsha sangs pa/ sman bcos byas nas nad drag song/ 2. 1) shugs che ba'am tshabs che ba/ sgra drag pa/ rtsa 'phar shugs drag pa/ 2) yag pa dang legs pa'am, mchog gam, bzang ba/ las byed drag pa/ sdod khang drag pa/ sa babs drag pa/ mi de tsho'i nang nas las ka su drag pa 'dug / khyed la thugs rgyus yod pas drag pa ma gtogs dbu 'thom yong/ 'dir bsdad pa las der phyin pa drag / 3) mtho ba/ mi drag pa/
sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba dang, rjes 'jug gi pho yig ga da ba sa bcas rang rang 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi dag la sgra dang rtsol ba drag par 'jug pa/ ba/ ga da ba sa...

1. 1) (mngon) 1,lcags spre lo/ 2,lha dbang phyug chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs la ma skyes rkang gcig dang drag po sogs bcu gcig yod pas grangs bcu gcig mtshon/ 2) drag po'i gzungs sngags/ 2.zhi 'jam ma yin pa'i btsan shugs che ba/ spyod lam drag po/ zhi drag gnyis 'pher gyi yon tan tshang ba/ kha rdung drag po btang nas sma 'bebs byed pa/ lag gnyis dam por bzung nas shugs brgyab ste drag tu 'then pa/ gsol ba drag po 'debs pa/
rdzas dang, sngags kyi nus pa la brten nas dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i las/

lha sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nang gses drag po'i: lha bcu gcig ste ma skyes dang, rkang gcig 'phel dang, 'jog po dang, drag po dang, brtson 'grus ldan dang, 'phrog byed dang, bde 'byung dang, mig gsum pa dang, gzhan las rgyal dang, dbang ldan dang, sa gsum pa bcas bcu gcig /
pags pa sogs 'dral ba dang, rus pa sogs gcod pa, sha dang rus pa'i nang gi zug rngu sogs 'drud pa, khong pa'i nang du mde'u shor ba sogs phyir 'byin pa lta bu'o/
1) spyod pa rtsub po/ 2) dka' ngal dang du blangs pa/
(mngon) zla ba mar ngo ste, tshes bcu drug nas gnam gang bar/
gdon bgegs 'joms byed kyi sreg chog /
drag po mngon spyod dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las te, bsreg mnan 'phen gsum gyi las sbyor ro/
1) shugs che'i bshal sman gtong ba/ 2) dmag thabs la mkhas par byed pa/ 3) slob sbyong shugs drag po byed pa/
kar myang rtsis las shakya'i 'das lo de: drag po ste bcu gcig gis sbyangs pa'i lhag ma mtsho yis dor lhag la me shar na kun 'jug ces zer te yul kun khyab par sbrang char 'bab
/ 1) bud med gtum mo/ 2) (mngon) 1,lha mo u ma/ 2,lha drag mo/
1) drag cing btsan pa/ 2) gtso drag dang don gcig
kha drag dbang btsan kha 'khyer gyis khengs dregs byed pa/ drag btsan ltag 'khur gyis gzhan la brnyas bcos byed pa/
drag cing gtum pa'i nus pa/ drag rtsal snying stobs gzhan gyis 'gran zla med/
zhi ba min pa/ spyod pa drag rtsub/ skad cha drag rtsub can/
bzang ngan/ mi tshang gi skyid sdug drag zhan/ yon tan drag zhan/ spus ka drag zhan/ slob sbyong gi grub 'bras drag zhan bar gsum du dbye ba phye ba/
nyi ma, mig dmar, phur bu, spen pa bzhi, g.yas kyi yan lag tu 'gyur bas na drag gza' zhes bya'o/
1) sku drag gi rigs/ 2) ya rabs bzang po'i rigs/ 3) drag shul can gyi rigs/
drag po'i las kyi bsdus tshig
lus ngag tu thon pa'i khro ba'i rnam 'gyur/ drag shul gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ drag shul gyi sems/ skad cha drag shul can bshad na mi'i rna bar 'bab dka'/
drag spyod dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs/
nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, yid du mi 'ong ba'i yul dang phrad pa'i stobs kyis mang du khro ba 'phel ba'i rnam 'gyur drag nyams ston pa'i rgyan zhig
1) khro ba'i ngang tshul can/ 2) ngar skad dang ldan pa/ 3) stobs rtsal can/ 4) (ugaha)? ston pa shakya thub pa zhal bzhugs skabs kyi khrims bdag cig ston pa'i zhal slob tu gyur pa'o/
1) stobs rtsal che ba/ 2) khro nyams che ba/
gzi ldan drag shugs ha cang che ba/ dmag dpung gi drag shul 'od 'bar lhag ger gsal ba/
khong pa'i nang gi nad rnams shugs drag po'i sgo nas thur du 'khru bar byed pa'i sman/
gza' mig dmar, phur bu, spen pa gsum/
go don nyi bar dang 'dra'ang, myur rkang sgrub byed dam 'dzin byed yin pas de ltar grags/
brtsi bya'i nyin der drag gza' rnams rang 'gros kyis lug khyim nas yul gyi chu tshod ci tsam spyad zin pa, dal dag cung zad ma grub pa'i bar na gnas pas na de ltar grags/

1.(rnying) sdom pa/ ston thog gi tshar ma drags te g.yul khar bskyal pa/ 'gro chas kyi khur po drogs shig / 2.thal ba/ gzhas btang drags na mid pa tsha yong/ glog bzhu gsal drags na mig kyang gdang mi thub/
drang don dang nges don gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
drang nges legs bshad snying po
rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i mdo sde la drang nges 'byed tshul gyi sgo nas lta ba'i gnad rnams ston pa'i gzhung/
khog drang zhing nye ring med pa/ drang snyoms lugs mthun/
bden pa'i skad cha/ rtsod pa rgyag rgyu yin na'ang drang gtam shod dgos/
kyog min gyi kha phyogs/ shar nas drang thad kyis nub la phyin pa/
drang ba'i don gyi bsdus tshig
drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde dang don gcig
mtshon byed rtags kyi rdor dril/

mi rton pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, 'khor ba la skyo ba skye ba dang, kun rdzob la 'jug pa la sogs pa gdul bya yongs su ma smin pa rnams gnas skabs drangs pa'i don du bstan pa'i chos la yid rton par mi bya ba'o/

/ 1) bden pa'am g.yo med dang, gzu bo'am mi slu ba/ skad cha drang po smra ba/ las ka drang po gyis/ bsam blo drang po zhig 'chang ba/ drang na ka ba mda' yis chog / ming gi rnam grangs la 'khyog med dang, sgyu med pa, g.yo med, rang bzhin bzang po, gshis bzang, srong ba bcas so, 2) kyog kyog min pa/ 'gro lam drang po'i thog nas 'gro dgos/ ka ba bzo rgyu shing drang po dgos/ tshul min gyi bya spyod drang po 'chos/ shing ma drang ba ma red, thig ma drang ba red/
nye ring phyogs lhung spangs pa:/ bar dpang byed dus phan tshun gnyis la drang po drang gzhag byed dgos/
lugs srol dang mthun pa'i spyod pa drang po/ bgo bsha' rgyag dus drang po lugs mthun byed dgos/
drang por gshegs pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, rtag tu sems gya gyu mi mnga' ba nyid kyis mi yo bar gshegs pa ste drang por gshegs pa/

gdul bya thun mong ba rnams kha drang ba'i phyir du 'jig rten snang tshod du grags pa gtsor byas pa, gang zag dang sems can dang, phung khams skye mched la sogs pa dang, de dag gi skye 'gag 'gro 'ong la sogs pa smra bsam brjod pa'i rim pas gzhal zhing sgro btags nas bstan pa dang, de rjod byed kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'o/
drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde
mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po sogs gdul bya rnams kha drang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i mdo sde zhig /

sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi bzhi pa gzhan gcod cing bye brag 'byed par byed pa ste, dper na mi'i mgo zhes khyad gzhi dang khyad chos sbyar bas mgo de khyi sogs kyi mgo yin pa bcad nas, mi'i mgo bye brag tu ston par byed pa'o/
drang po'i khrims kyis khyab 'doms/ nye ring med pa'i drang 'brel khrims 'doms byed pa/
gzhan rkyen gyis sgul mi thub pa'i rang tshugs/ g.yas 'khyog g.yon 'khyog med par drang tshugs zin po byed pa/
drang po lugs mthun dang don gcig
1) 'gro sa'i lam ga drang po/ 2) yang dag pa'i lam lugs/

1) lus ngag yid gsum g.yo sgyu med par drang po'i phyogs su srong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun tu rgyu dang, dka' thub spyod, khrus kyi brtul zhugs can, dge bar slong, ngag bsdams pa, nyon mongs thul, brtul zhugs can, thul ba, bden smra, sdom brtson dbang po, pha rol 'dod, mi smra, smra ba bcad, gtsang gnas, tshangs pa'i spyod pa, rig byed klog bcas so, 2) glu dbyangs nges pa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig / 3) (mngon) 'od zer can dang, nyi ma, rgyun shes, 'od yangs, lha min 'joms, mchod sbyin can, gnas 'jog ste skar ma smin bdun la gnas pa'i drang srong bdun yod pas grangs bdun mtshon/
lha khro bo'i sku'i nyams shig
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smar ba zhig gi ston pa rgyal ba dam pa'i rjes su 'brang mkhan rgyal ba par yang grags/
drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa
rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, zhu chen gyi lo ts'a ba bnde ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus byas pa/
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/

mig sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba: po zhig yin pa de rtog ge la shin tu byang ba zhig byung ste des rang gi bu mo la 'dod pa spyod pa'i phyir skye ba snga phyi med par smras te dge ba la phan yon dang, sdig pa la nyes dmigs med par ston pa'i gzhung 'bum phrag gcig brtsams, de'i rjes 'brang rnams la mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa bya ba'i tha chad de byung ngo/
1) sngo sman zhig / 2) (yul) rum gyi ri: mo'i bye brag cig /
1) drang po shod mkhan/ 2) drang po shod pa/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig yin pa 'dir rkang mig pa'ang zer/
mig dmar, lhag pa, phur bu, pa sangs, spen pa ste lnga'o/
gzegs zan pa dang don gcig
sngar rgya gar gyi drang srong zhig gis 'ug pa lhar 'khrul nas tshig don drug rnyed par 'dod mkhan zhig /
sngar rgya gar gyi drang srong ser skya zhes bya ba ral pa ser skya yod pa mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa zhig byung/
(yul) sran ma zhib mo btags pa'i rta drel gyi chag
(yul) phar tshur yang yang drad pa/ sa la yang yang drad drad kyis rkang lag rmas pa/ rta drel gyis rkang lag drad drad byas nas sa la shur thon 'dug /
dus su dran du 'jug pa'i skul lcag / srid don slob sbyong gi dran skul 'debs pa/ 'khar rnga brdungs nas mi rnams la dran skul gtong ba/
mi dran dgu dran/ dran rgya mang na don mi grub/
1) mi dran dgu dran tsha po/ 2) bsam pa dran 'phrul skyen po/
sems la 'char sgo sna mang ba/
snga ma'i kha dan la ma gnas par bskyar nas dran pa'i gtam gsar du spel ba/
sngar byung rjes dran gyi ched du bzhag pa'i dngos po/ 'dra par zhig dran rten du 'jog pa/
/ phyi rol yul mthong nas dran rtog 'char: ba
mi brjed pa'i ched du bkod pa'i yi ge /
brgyal nas dran pa nyams pa slar sos pa/
dran mi thub pa'am brjed pa/

1.(tha dad pa) sems la yang yang 'khor nas mi brjed pa/ dran pas ma zin/ sngon ma'i gnas tshul dran du 'jug pa/ sngar byung sdug bsngal rnams yid la dran pa/ da lta'i bka' drin dran pa/ 'grul pas rang gi pha yul dran pa/ pha mas rang gi bu phrug rnams dran pa/ chang gis ra bzi nas dran pa mi gsal ba/ 2.yul nges lnga'i nang gses, sngar 'dris pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas mi brjed pa'i shes pa brjed nges kyi gnyen po mi g.yeng ba'i byed las can no/
sems mi g.yeng bar byed pa/
dran pa drug po'i thog tu rnal 'byor rjes su dran pa dang, sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang, skye ba rjes su dran pa dang, 'chi ba rjes su dran pa bzhi bsnan pas bcu/
sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ don gnad gal chen la mno bsam gtong dus sems gzhan ma g.yengs par dran pa 'jog pa/
mi dran par gyur pa/ dngos po nyo rgyu'i dran pa brjed pa/
sems la dran rgyu med par gyur pa/ dran pa nyams pas gang byas shod rgyu med/
dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba

sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa dang, bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba dang, dbang po la sogs pa dang, gnyen po dang, mi mthun pa'i bye brag gang la gang gis 'dul ba la sogs pa snga nas mkhyen cing dran pa ye shes kyis zin pas nyan thos dag da ltar 'phral la dgongs pa mi 'tshal ba, sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /

bzhag pa gsum: de bzhin gshegs pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum ste, gus pas chos nyan pa la'ang chags pa med par thugs dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang, ma gus pas mi nyan pa la'ang sdang ba med par thugs dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang, nyan pa dang, mi nyan pa gnyis ka med par thugs dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/
dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo

'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo shloo ka stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa, rgya gar gyi pandi ta a'a bha y'a ka ra gubha dang, shakya rakshi ta dang, su bhu ti tsantra sogs dang, bod kyi lo ts'a ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'o/

dran ni shes rab ste: chos kyi mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin ma nor bar shes pas lhag mthong dang sbyar zhing, nye bar bzhag pa ni ji ltar shes rab kyis dpyad pa de nyid rtse gcig tu 'jog pas zhi gnas dang sbyar/

lhag mthong sgom skabs kyi dmigs rnam bzhi ste, lus dran pa nyer bzhag dang, tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag sems dran pa nyer bzhag chos dran pa nyer bzhag bcas byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan zhig /
1) dran pa bskyar du sos pa/ mgo yu 'khor te brgyal ba las slar yang dran pa rnyed pa/ 2) phru gu dran pa gsar du thob pa/
dran med du brgyal ba/ tsha ba'i nad kyis na ste dran pa 'thor ba/
mi brjed pa dang blang dor gyi gnas nges pa/
rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug la ltos
sems nang du mi gnas pa/ sems gzhan du 'phros nas dran pa mi gnas pa/
lus dang, tshor ba, sems, chos te bzhi/
byang chub kyi yan lag byang chub yan lag bdun: gyi ya gyal zhig ste dran pa'i stobs kyis yan lag gzhan rnams dmigs rnam las mi g.yeng bar byed pa gnas kyi yan lag
sems stor ba/ glo bur 'jigs skrag gis dran pa brlag pa/
dran pa gsal du gtong ba/ phru gur bslab bya brgyab nas sngar byung dbul phongs sdug bsngal gyi dran pa gso ba/
(mngon) 1) sangs rgyas/ 2) lha dbang phyug chen po/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi stobs lnga'i nang gses shig ste brjed nges sogs kyis mi rdzi ba'i dran pa/
1) (mngon) mkhas pa/ 2) byang phyogs so bdun gyi dbang po lnga'i nang gses shig ste, bden bzhi'i dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, lhung ba glengs nas gsal por mi dran pa la lhung ba byung ma byung dran du bcug nas ma byung bar nges na dag pa sbyin, byung bar nges na phyir bcos te gdams ngag sbyin par byed pa/
mi brjed pa'i sems kyi don du go ba'i dran pa dang 'dra,
dran pa'i dbang po'i bsdus tshig
sems kyis tshor rgyu med par brgyal ba/ nad tshabs che bas dran med du bog pa/
sngon gyi las don slar sems la shar ba'i dus na/ bu chung zhal ras yid la dran tsa na/
gang dran bcos med du smra ba/
1) nges shes brtan pa'i phyir du brda skul gtong thabs shig / 2) dran pa'am mi brjed par byed pa/ dran 'dzin dam po/
kyi zhal lce: zhal lce bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, lus chad mi thob pa'i rigs la phyis 'doms dran 'dzin gyi ched du rgyu nor gyi chad las 'gel len byed lugs kyi khrims/
1) sems la nges bzhin nam, 'jags bzhin/ 2) mi brjed pa'i sems/
1) sems kyi nges shes/ mi smyon pa'i dran shes rnal du mi gnas/ 2) blo sbyong skabs kyi dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi bsdus tshig /
sems tshor zhan du song ba/
bsam mno gtong shes shing bag phebs po yod pa/
1) dran pa 'thor ba rnams bskyar du rnyed pa/ 2) brjed pa'i don rjes su dran pa/ brjed pa rnams dran sos byung ste 'phral du tho la bkod yod/
sngar byung gnas lugs yid la bskyar du shar ba'i ming/ dran gso khang/ dran gso bskul ba/
khang pa'i lcam shing thog 'grems pa'i drab shing dang, ko gru'i mthil du 'grems pa'i shing/
khang pa'i dral ma dang, lcam shing/
gral ma, khang pa'i lcam gyi steng du gral gshibs 'jog pa'i shing/
(rgya) rgya nag gong mar yar snyan gsan phul ba'i zhu shog /
shing bshags gtubs byas pa'i dral ma/
shing hril mos bzos pa'i dral ma/
(yul) 1) slob phrug gi yig gzugs la dge rgan gyis skyon 'don pa/ 2) gos rgyu sogs 'dra gcod byed pa/
/ slob gnyer byed skabs dras thag ma chod pa yod na gros bsdur gyis dras thag gcod dgos/
'dra ba dang mthud pa'i bsdus tshig /
ko ba sogs 'breg gcod byed sa'i 'og gdan/
gos dang shog bu sogs 'dra byed spyi'i ming/
gos chen lhu bsgrigs te thang sku bzo ba lta bu/
sman bcos kyi yo byad cig /
gser bzo bas gser dngul sogs kyi skud pa la 'bur hril che chung bzo byed yo byad cig /
dri ma dku ba'i bsdus tshig
rjen brngos gang rung gi phye zan la bzos pa'i glud dmigs yul su yin gyi kha dris bsgos pa/
sna la gdung ba skyed pa dri mi zhim pa, sha rul gyi dri lta bu'o/ dri nga ba med pa/
dri bsung gi nus pa/ dri ngad ngan pa/ dri ngad zhim po/
dri ma ngan pa/ dri ngan phyir bcil/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri ma can dang, dri mas gos pa, dri mas bslad pa, nogs pa bcas so,
bya ba ngan pa thabs kyis 'gebs pa'i dpe/
1) tsan dan dang, gla rtsi, dz'a ti, gur kum, ga pur te lnga'o/ 2) dus 'khor las bshad pa'i dri lnga ste gla rtsi dang, tsan dan, dri chu, dri chen, sha rus bcas kyi dri rnams so/

sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i nang gses shig ste, sangs rgyas kyi sa na gnyis snang yod par 'dod pa dang, rnam shes rnams ma rig pa'i mthus phyi rol gyi gzung ba'i rnam par snang bas, rnam shes rang gi ngo bo rnam pa rdzun pa des gos par smra ba'o/
gcin/ dri chu 'gags pa/ dri chu 'dor ba/ dri chu bsdams pa/
dri ba'i sgo nas phugs gtugs pa/
dri ma 'tshub pa/ chang dri 'thul ba/
dri drug zhim pa'i dri dang
dri nga ba, mnyam pa'i dri, lhan cig skyes pa'i dri, sbyar byung gi dri, gyur pa las 'byung ba'i dri ste drug /
1) dri bzang ngan gang rung dang ldan pa/ 2) dreg pa can/
bod la tsan dan dkar po dang, dmar po, shug pa sogs bsregs nas lha gsol dang mgron po phebs bsu zhu ched dri ldan sku bsangs zhes pa gtong srol yod/

btsog par bzos pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri ldan dang, dri ma can, dri ma gos, dri mas sun phyung, nag nog can bcas so,
