bod mi phal che ba'i gdong mdog skya bo rang min par dmar shas che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod yul la gdong dmar can gyi yul zhes zer, mdo las kyang, gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro, zhes dang, rgya'i deb ther du bod mi rnams la gdong gi mdzes byed du tshos dmar po bgo ba'i goms srol yod par bshad pa dang, bod rang gi yi ge rnying pa rgyal po'i bka' thang sogs las kyang sha zan gdong dmar can zhes kyang snang ngo/
1) ngo mdog dmar po ste khong khro za ba'i gdong mdog / tshig pa bzas nas gdong dmar por phyin song/ 2) ngo tsha ba'i gdong mdog / mtsher snang gis gdong dmar por gyur song/
1) sngar bod rigs kyi ming la de ltar zer/ 2) gdong gi kha dog dmar ba/
gdong dmar can gyi yul dang don gcig
gdong sa la phab pa/ rdzun rkub rdol te ngo tsha nas gdong smad pa/
ngo tsha mtsher snang/ gdong tshan chung ba/ gdong tshan che ba/ gdong tshan mthug po yin pas ngo tsha zer ba mi shes/

dpral ko mthug po'am, ngo tsha 'dzem bag chung ba/ gdong tshan can gyi mi tshos gang yang byas yong/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyengs pa med dang, gnong med, dpral ko can, spyi brtol can, 'tsher ba med, log par spobs bcas so,
chos po ti'i mtshan yig 'khod pa'i 'dzar/
sgra gcan gdong dang nyi zla phrad de 'dzin pa'i ming/

rim brgyud kyis ma zhus par zhu yul gtso bo de rang gi mdun du rang nyid kyis thad kar zhus pa/ snga phyi'i bde sdug yong rkyen tshang ma don gyi bdag po ngo ma rang gi sku mdun du gdong zhu mthar phyin byas pa yin/
mi mang 'dzoms pa'i don/ don dag de'i skor nga rang tsho gdong bzhi mig brgyad kyis gros thag bcad pa yin no/
glegs bam gyi gdong khebs steng gi yi ge
rgya rim pa bdun gyi nang gses, glegs bam mi 'khrug par byed pa'i rtags te gdong 'dzar/
phyi 'jug gi nang gses, slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor mthong ba re zhig bsgrib pa dang, ma rig pas ldongs pa mtshon byed du mig dar dmar po dpral bar bcing ba'o/
ngo gdong/ gdong ris ngan pa/
mdun du 'gro ba/ dmag gi mtshon cha'i gdong len/ gdong len 'thab 'dzing pa/ phar 'gro dmag gi gdong len yin, tshur yong dpung gi rjes ma yin/ sprang po yin na khyi kha gdong len pa zhig dgos/
(yul) lham gyi gdong rgyong byed kyi shing/
ngo gdong gi rnam 'gyur/ kho'i rdzun rkub rdol bas kha skyengs nas gdong gshis 'gyur song/
phan tshun gdong thug gis rtsod pa/ gyod ya gnyis gdong gsher byed du 'jug pa/
dngos su gdong thug nas ra sprod byed pa/ phan tshun gnyis kyi bshad tshul 'gal 'dzol che bas gdong bsher ra sprod mi byed thabs med byung/
tshur yong mkhan gyi gdong la phyin nas bsu ba/ gdong bsus nas phar rgol byed pa/ gdong bsus te khyim du slebs pa/ thag ring bar du 'grul pa gdong bsu la 'gro ba/
mdun phyogs nas rgyag pa'i rlung/ gdong lhags rgyag dus gru skul dka'/
chos kun don dam par skye ba med pa'i don/
gzhi rtsa ba nas bral ba/
thog ma'am dang po/ gdod ma'i dus/ gdod ma'i nags tshal/
1) thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'am chos sku kun tu bzang po/ 2) gzhi dus kyi sangs rgyas te gzhi rgyud bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/
mi min gyi gnod byed cig / kho'i sems rgyud gdon gyis brlams pa ltar smyon par gyur/ rang dbang med par gdon zhugs pa/
lha klu gza' btsan lta bu mi min gyis gnod pa btang ba'i nad gza' grib dang mdze nad lta bu/
mi zhig gi lag rtsa 'phar stangs la brten nas kho la gdon 'dre'i gnod skyon sogs byung yod med brtag dpyad byed pa'i mo phyva ste ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi nang gses shig /
the tshom med pa/ dgras rgol bar lhags pa gdon mi za ba/
mi ma yin mi'i khog par zhugs pa/ rgyud la gdon zhugs te smyos song zer/
bar chad yong ba'i nor rdzas
gdon gnod dus su ldang ba'i sri/
steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar, bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po, 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bcas gsum/
'dam pa'i skul tshig thom dang don gcig

«tsandala» bshan pa, sngar rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs nang gi dman pa'i rigs shig / ming gi rnam grangs la glang po dang, chos med, nyi tshe ba, gtum po, thub tshod can, sdig pa can, ma rungs pa, mi dge spyod, mi bsrun bcas so,
mi bsrun rtsub po'i spyod pa/
sngar rgya gar gyi rigs bzhi'i tha ma dmangs rigs las kyang dman pa'i mgar ba dang, bshan pa, rngon pa, nya pa, thags mkhan, chom po sogs spyi'i ming/
/ 1) bem po'i char gyur pa'i gzugs kyi bongs/ sha gdos chen po/ ja sgam gdos chen po/ bu ram rtswa sgor gdos chung ba/ 2) ryga dang dra ba/
rags pa'i gzugs can/ gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus/
gdos su che ba'i bsdus tshig
/ 1) gru/ 2) skya ba/ 3) gru gzings kyi steng du btsugs pa'i rlung dar/ 4) mnyan pa/
/ 1) shing bu las byas pa chu tshod kyi snod 'dra ba dge slong bsam gtan pa gnid slong byed/ 2) gru'i rlung g.yor/
'ja' tshon lta bu'i gzugs phra ba/
bongs tshad dang, ljid che chung gi tshad/
1) ljid che ba/ 2) bongs tshad che ba/

/ bdag gi pha ma las kyang bka' drin che/ bdag tu ma bzung ba/ gzhan gyis gdag tu 'dzin pa/ don gnad 'di nga la rgyus yod pas bdag drag snyam pa 'dug / gdag rkyen, 1) byas rjes bzang po la gzengs bstod pa'i dngos po/ 2) rkyen bzhi'i nang gses, 'bras bu 'byung ba la dbang byed pa ste, mig la sogs pa'i dbang po ni rang 'bras shes pa skyed pa'i bdag po byed pas bdag po'i rkyen zhes bya'o/
gdag nyid skyid par ma zad gzhan gyis smon pa'i gnas su'ang gyur pa/ gzugs po bde po yin na bdag skyid gzhan smon yong ba red/
(mngon) 1) chang/ 2) da byid/ 3) phru gu/ 4) bram ze/ 5) tshangs pa,..
1) (mngon) tshangs pa/ 2)bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ste, rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor gyi bzlas pa dang nyer bsdu bya ba la sogs pa/
1) rang phyogs/ 2) rang gi grub mtha'i phogs/
nga la yod pa'i mig sna sogs/
spyod rgyud kyi bzlas pa yan lag bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'o/
rang gi shes rgyud dam, rang gi lus sems/
ming gi ma mthar gang zag mtshon par byad pa'i sgra sngar me pa la gsar du pa po dang, ma mo sbya bas rim bzhin pho dang mor go dgos...pa. ..po,ma... mo...pa...po...ma...mo...
/ 'bangs kyi bya ba bdag cag gis mi sgrub na su zhig gis sgrub/

'brel ba'i nang gses, ngo bo bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba ste, dper na, dngos po dang bum pa, bum pa dang bum pa'i ldog pa lta bu, ngo bo gcig tu grub cing ldog pa tha dad yin la, dngos po dang, bum pa log na bum pa dang bum pa'i ldog pa log par 'gyur ba'o/
gces spras/ rgyal khab kyi rgyu dngos rigs la rnam kun bdag gces lhod med byed pa/
sa skya'i gdung rgyud sa skya rang khongs kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha 'dzin mkhan gyi che ming/ gong ma/ gdag chen.

dbang ma bskur gong: slob dpon rang nyid ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing lha'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang dbyer med du lta ba'i dbang blangs pa dang, slob ma gzhug par gnang ba nod pa/

1) rang nyid dam nga rang/ bdag nyid la gson cig / rgyal po bdag nyid/ bdag nyid kyi 'gal ba/ 2) rang bzhin nam ngo bo/ 3) bdag po/ mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ nus pa'i bdag nyid/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba po dang, skyes bu gtso, gang zag rang, mchod sbyin sbyor, nyer skrun pa, shed bdag shed bu, shed las skyes bcas so,
so rang gi rig pa: rang byung gi ye shes/
1) rang gis rang bstod/ 2) (mngon) bya rog
rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra'i nang gses/ gser gyi bum pa/ rgya mtsho'i chu/
1) bdag po chen po/ 2) (mngon) sangs rgyas spyi/
bdag sprod/ spyi rdzas bdag gnyer yag po byed/

ma rig pa: 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin te, bden don mi shes shing phung po rnams rtag pa dang, bde ba dang, bdag dang, ril po dang, sems can du 'du shes pa sogs dngos po'i rang bzhin dang mi mthun par phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa'o/
phung po la bdag tu zhen pa/
rigs pa'i dgag bya gnyis te, chos kyi bdag dang, gang zag gi bdag go /
bag chags bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bdag gzhan ris su bcad nas bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba skyed pa la dbang bar byed pa'i bag chags/
rang la bsngags shing gzhan la 'phya smod/
ca lag sogs la gces spras yag po byed pa/
rang gi don dag la rang gis do snang ngam 'bad brtson byed pa/
(tha mi dad pa) dbang ba/ rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang mi dmangs la bdag pa/ bu pha bdag dang, bu mo ma bdag /
dbang ba po'am gtso bo/ bdag po'i 'du shes/ don gyi bdag po/ khang bdag / zhing bdag / 'brog bdag / mnga' bdag / mi bdag bdag tu re, bdag po sgo khyir 'don/
gyi 'brel ba: rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra'i nang gses/ sger gyi ma rtsa/ nga'i khang pa/
srung 'dzin byed mkhan med pa/ bdag po med pa'i sa zhing la lo tog yag po skye mi thub/
bdag po byed pa,rang rang gi yo byad gang yin ngos bzung nas bdag sprod byed pa/
kyi byang chub sems: byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag khyad par ba zhig ste, rang las gzhan gces par bzung nas bde sdug gtong len byed pa'o/
pa'i rim pa: bdag gi ma dag pa'i phung khams skyes mched rnams sbyang nas rdo rjje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga/
1) bdag po sprod pa/ rin thang can gyi dngos por bdag byed yod pa smos ci dgos/ 2) bdag sprod byed mkhan/
rang gi dbang cha/ bdag dbang lag len byed/
lnga'i nang gses: rang rgyus rnag dbang du bskyed par bya ba ste, sdig pa byas pas yul ngan par skyed zhing, dge ba byas pas yul bzang por skyes nas bdag po byed pa byed rgyu'i 'bras bu rnams so/
bdags gzhi phung lnga re re nas btsal kyang bdag ces pa rdul tsam yang ma mchis pa ste med pa/
1) bdag bzung byed mkhan med pa/ nor bdag med byang gi 'brong/ 2) bdag med pa'i bsdus tshig
gang zag gi bdag med dang, chos kyi bdag med gnyis/
bdag tu lta ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis bdag med pa, bden bzhi'i rnams pa bcu drug gi nang gses shig /
bdag med pa dris pa'i mdo
'phags pa bdag med pa dris pa zhes bya ba'i mdo, rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gubha dang, lo tsha' ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/
gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i ddzas yod kyis ma grub pa dang, gang zag rang bzhin gyis ma grug pa gnyis/
srung 'dzin ma byas par rbad de dor ba/ spyi'i dngos rigs bdag med ling skyur byed mi rung/
gang zag gi bdag med dang, chos kun gzung 'dzin dang rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa dang, chos bden grub kyis stong pa/
/ 1) khyim bdag mo/ 2) sa skya gong ma'i bdag mo/ 3) bla ma'i gsang yum/
gus phran nam, gus chung zhes pa lta bu'i khengs skyung ngam, rang brnyas kyis tshig / bdag dman par bsam pa'i sgo nas sgyid lug pa/
phung po lnga gang rung la brten nas bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo'am nga'o snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin/
dmigs pa nga la dmigs nas rnam pa rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa/
lam gyi dgag bya gnyis te chos dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin/ , lam dgyi dgag bya gnyis te chos dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin/

1) rtag 'jug skab skyi byed pa po dang bya ba'i yul yin la de yang byed po gtso phal dang bye pa'i las bcas dngos po bdag gi khongs su 'du ba dang, bya yul bya las dang bcas pa dngos po bzhan gyi khongs su 'du/ 2) rang gzhan gnyis/ bdag phan gzhan gnod kyi las ka/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems/
byang chub kyi sems: bdag gi bde ba gzhn la ster, gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang gis len par bsgom pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul zhig /
bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bsdus ming/
bdag dang gzhan sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mnyam pa'am mtshungs pa/

byang chub kyi sems: byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul zhig ste, bdag bzhan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal 'bral 'dod dang bde ba ldan 'dod yin par gcig tu mtshungs pas, bdag la gces par 'dzin cing gzhan la sdang bar 'dzin pa'i sems spangs te mnyam par 'dzin pa'o/
bdag po byas yod pa/ rang gi ca lag la rnag igs bdg bzung byed pa/ bdag bzung yod pa'i bud med/ bdg bzung yod pa'i bud med/
mgnon sum dang, rjes dpag ltar snang dang bcas pa'o/
rang gi nyes spyod la rna gis mtsher snang mi byed pa/ 'dod pas ngo tsha bsgribs nas bdag la mi 'dzem pa'i spyod ngan gang byung byed mi 'jug /
kyi byang chub sems: byang chub gyi sems bsgom tshul zhig ste, rang la sdug bsngal byung bar sems kyis mi bzod par sdug bsngal khur khyir gyi sems bskyed pa/
bdag shes rig gi skyes bu
grangs can pas 'dod pa'i bdag ste shes bya nyer lnga'i ya gya zhig /
rang srog rang gis gcod pa/
mang po'i nang nas sgrug pa'i don du go ba'i 'dam pa'i ma 'ongs pa,

1) spyi dmangs rnams khrims lugs ltar rgyal khab kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyi 'thus mi'am las ka'i 'gan khur nges can zhig tu 'os zhugs chog pa'i dbang cha/ 2) rtsa 'dzugs sna tshogs kyi khongs mi rnams rang rang rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'thus mi'am 'go khrid pa'i 'os su zhugs chog pa'i dbang cha/
mang po'i khrod nas bdams te nyo ba/
bdams te khyer ba'i lhag snyigs/

1) bu lon 'ded pa/ 'bru dngul bu lon len rgyu bda' 'ded byed pa/ 2) don rtsa rtsad gcod byed pa/ gyod don gyi rtsa ba 'da' 'ded byed pa/ khrims 'gal gyi byas nyes rnams bda' mthil phyin byed dgos/
1.'ded pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.ro zhim pa/ zas bda' ba kho na za ba dang, gos bzang ba kho na gyon mkhan kyis dka' spyad byed thub mi yong/
phyi mar brdar ba'i spos sam spos phye/

brad bdar ches pas srab rdol phyin pa/
brtag dpyad byas nas thag chod pa/ the tshom la brtag dpyad byas nas yin min gyi bdar sha chod pa/ don 'di bdar sha chod song ngam/
(tha dad pa) bdal ba, bdal ba, bdol,, rdal ba/ dngos zog rnams 'tshong rgyur bdal ba/ nor bdal ba/
(tha dad pa) bdugs pa, bdug pa, bdugs,, me la bdug pa/ khang pa'i nang du spos dri bdugs shig /

bdug spos bdug byed kyi yo byad/
grib dang mi gtsang ba sel bar byed pa'i rdzas shig /

/ 1) «m'ar» sems can la gnod 'tshe dang dge ba la bar chad byed mkhan, 'dod lha rigs drug gi nang gses shig / bdud kyis brlams pa/ bdud stobs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/ bdud phyir rgol ba/ bdud kyis mi bskyod pa/ 2) (mngon) bdud la lha'i bu dang, nyon mongs pa, 'chi bdag phung po bcas bzhi yod pas grangs bzhi mtshon/

gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de, 'dod lha rigs drug gi nang tshan zhig /

1) (mngon) 'dod lha/ 2) bdud dga' rab dbang phyug /

1) «amrita» 'chi med de 'chi ba 'joms byed kyi rdzas/ dam chos bdud rtsi stsal gsol/ 2) sman gyi skabs su bdud ces skyes bu'i tshe srog la gnod par byed pa'i nad dang, rtsi zhes sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las byung ba'i nad kyi zug rngu 'joms byed kyi gnyen po sman/
khro rgyal gyi bye brag cig /

sngo sman gyi rigs te, ro mngar la kha ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo nad gso, tshad pa 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrab can 'khor lo brtsegs pa dang, grangs bcud 'dzin pa, blon po dar thod can, shang len smug po bcas so,
gsang sngags kyi nang mchod kyi rdzas su 'gro ba'i dri chen dang, dri chu, rakta, mam sa, rdo rje'i zil pa bcas so/

yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi: rgyud bdud rtsi snying po dpe dang dgos pa, yan lag brgyad pa brjod bya'i don, gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces rjod byed kyi mtshan bstan pa ste, gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dpe dang dgos pa brjod bya rjod byed sogs la bltos nas btags pa'i mtshan zhig /

rab byung bdun pa'i mjug tu zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes dwags kong phyogs kyi sman pa rnams bsdus te bka' bgros nas brtsams pa'i sman gyi dug 'don dang, ngar 'don, rno 'don sogs gsal bar 'khod pa'i gzhung zhig /
bdud rtsi lnga dang don gcig

dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i gnyan nad kyi bcos thabs zab mo zhig ste, khong gis ma 'ongs par phan pa'i slad du gter du sbas pa las phyis su gter ston rdor 'bum chos kyi grags pas byang spra dun rtse'i rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon gyi thugs ka nas gter bton pa'i sman gyi rgyud gzhung chen po zhig /

1) rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang bkra 'bum pas mdzad pa'i nad sman sprad pa'i nyams yig cig / 2) bdud rtsi bum chen gyi mtshan gzhan/ 3) rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang sman rtsis 'go 'dzin mkhyen rab nor bus mdzad pa'i sman gyi sbyor tshad sogs gsal ba'i bsdu sbyor skor zhig /
bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsgom pa/

'bru mar dang 'dra ba'i sems can lnga'i zhag ste nya dang, chu srin, ri bong, dom, phag bcas kyi tshil bzhus pa'i zhag bskol zhing btsags pa zhun mar dang 'dra ba, 'dul ba las bshad pa'i zhag bdun pa'i sman gyi bye brag cig /
1) sngar rgya gar gyi rgyal po seng ge 'gram gyi bu bzhi'i gcig ste, shakya mu ne'i khu bo zhig / 2) (mngon) lha/
1) sngo sman rtag tu ngu'i ming gzhan/ 2) (mngon) zla ba/
kha stod spang la skyes pa'i 'dzin pa me tog dkar nyams can 'char ba'i lo ma ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims tshad dang, gnyan tshad sogs la phan/

1) sman sogs kyi bcud bzang po'i thigs pa phra mo/ 2) (mngon) zla 'od/
