yig 'bru bdun re rkang par bcad pa'i tshig /
mi shi nas zhag bdun re la dge rtsa re sgrub pa'i dus tshigs te rgya bza' kong jo phyi mas srol btod pa'i lugs srol zhig /
mi shi nas bdun phrag bdun gyi ring bdun phrag nam shar la mchod pa 'bul ba'i ming/
1) dgra zla'am shin tu mi mthun pa/ 2) byi ba sogs kyi lo skor bcu gnyis po rang gi bdun pa gang yin de ni bdun zur te dper na, byi ba'i bdun zur rta dang rta'i bdun zur byi ba yin pa bzhin/
dpung sde'i sngon du 'gro ba'i dmag mi/ mdun bdar dpung khag /

bde zhing skyid pa/ mi'i rigs la bde skyid skrun pa/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa/ bde skyid ldan/ bde skyid yong thabs byed pa/ lus sems bde skyid byung ba/ mtha' dbus yul gru kun tu bde skyid dar ba/
rgya skad du khang shis zhes pa don 'gyur byas na bde skyid de, man ju'i gong ma 'di rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu stag bar lo drug cu re gcig ring khrir bzhugs/
phun sum tshogs pa'i go skabs shar ba/ mtha' dbus yul gru kun tu bde skyid dar ba/
lus khams dwangs shing sems spro ba/
lam du bar chad med par thar ba/ thag ring lam bar la chu 'phrang gsum bde bgrod thub pa/
lha dang, mi dang, lha ma yin bcas gsum/
gzugs po ljid nyams med pa'i yang sha dod po'am lus zor yang po/ spre'u bzhin du bde cag 'khyug po 'dug /
1) bde nyams 'char tshul zhig / lus sems bde cham me ba byas byung/ 2) bde lhang nge'am bde shig ge/ sdug bsngal las grol nas bde cham me bar gnas 'dug /

1) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi stag rtse rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul de yin/ 2) yun nan zhing chen khongs kyi bod rigs rang skyong khul zhig zhing chen 'di'i nub byang phyogs su yod, khul 'di dang bod rang skyong ljongs, si khron zhing chen bcas sa cha 'dabs 'brel yin, gzhogs shar du 'bri chu dang nub tu zla chu 'bab, khul de'i khongs su 'jol dang 'ba' lung, rgyal thang bcas rdzong khag gsum yod cing, khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de rgyal thang du yod/ 3) lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi bde ba'o/
yun nan zhing chen gyi 'jol rdzong khongs su yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig /
bde chen phyag rgya chen po
bka' brgyud pa'i nyams len gyi mthil grol lam phyag rgya chen po ste, yul rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang yul can 'gyur med kyi bde ba chen po gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug tu sbyor ba'o/
nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams te sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams/

«heruka» bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du brnyes par byed pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa ston pa'i bla med ma rgyud kyi rgyud gzhung dang, de'i yi dam zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la mkha' 'gro'i dbang dang, 'khor lo sdom pa, thod pa can, rdo rje 'khor lo, dpa' bo rdo rje, zla ba'i cod pan, ri khrod pa bcas so,
rim rim lnga: bdag byin rlabs kyi rim pa dang, sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa, nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa, dza landha ri'i rim pa, bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa bcas lnga'o/
mi la ras pa nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog gi gdams zab cig /
bde mchog rdo rje sems dpa'
bde mchog gi lha ste yi dam zhig /
gsang sngags kyi yi dam zhig /
dus bde zhod 'jags sam, bde skyid lhing chags pa/ zing 'khrug med pa'i bde 'jags kyi dus byung ba/ bde 'jags skyong ba/ zing 'khrug rnyog dra'i rgyun bcad nas bde 'jags bzo ba/
tshur rin gong bde po byas te nyo ba dang phar drang po byas te 'tshong ba/
sngags lugs kyi yul can bde ba chen po dang, yul stong pa nyid gnyis/
stong nyid yul du byas pa'i thabs bde ba chen po'i ye shes/
bde stong phyogs chad du ma lhung bar zung 'jug mnyam pa nyid kyi cha/
thabs bde ba chen po dang, shes rab stong nyid ro gcig tu gyur pa/
gzugs po nad med/ bde thang stobs ldan/ gzugs gzhi nad med bde thang gi skabs su las ka byed par snang dag med/
bde sdug gi bsdus tshig / khong tsho dang mjal 'dzoms byung 'phral sku khams kyi gnas tshul bde dog gang yod 'tshams 'dri zhus pa yin/
bde ldan ma lung bstan pa
'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa mdo sde glegs bam tsa par bzhugs pa/ tsa...
dang sdug bsngal gyi bsdus ming:/ bde sdug la sems khur byed pa/ rgyal po'i bde sdug ni 'khor gyi skye bo'i lag na'ang gnas/
skyid po dang, byang goms che ba, las sla ba sogs kyi don du go ba'i bde ba dang don gcig

1. dga' zhing sim pa'i tshor ba'am myong ba/ sdug bsngal las bsgral te bde bar bkod pa/ tshe smad du bde ba dang ldan pa byung ba/ bde ba bla na med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ 2./ 1) skyid po dang, sim po/ nad 'tshe med pas bde bar gnas pa/ nyin mor las rtsol byas nas mtshan mor bde bar gnyid kyis log pa/ lus sems bde ba/ 2) byang goms che ba'am mkhas po/ lag pa bde ba/ kha bde lce bde/ skad cha bde ba/ 3) las sla po/ rgya lam bde ba zhig la 'gro/ 'char gzhi 'ding dus nas lag len 'jug bde yod med la bsam blo gtong dgos/
bde ba can gyi bkod pa
sho lo ka sum cu pa pandita d'a na shi la dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa/
ting nge 'dzin: zag med bde stong gi ye shes sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin/
bde ba nyams su myong ba
dga' skyid la longs spyod pa/ rten 'brel dga' ston gyi bde ba nyams su myong ba/ lha mi'i bde ba nyams su myong ba/ rang dbang la dga' mgur longs spyod pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba/
«sugta:» sangs rgyas te, lam bde ba byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la brten nas 'bras bu bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar gshegs pas bde gshegs zhes bya'o/

(mngon) 1) klu/ 2) gur kum/ 3) brgya byin mtshon cha/ 4) chu srin gyi bye brag cig / 5) pho rtags/ 6) dbang phyug / 7) sman pa/ 8) sos ka'i dus/ 9) hong len/ 10) a ru ra/ 11) lha dbang phyug chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs la ma skyes rkang gcig dang, 'phel ba, bstod pa, drag po, brtson 'grus ldan, 'phrog byed, bde 'byung, spyan gsum, gzhan las rgyal ba, dbang ldan, sa gsum bcas bcu gcig yod pas grangs bcu gcig mtshon/
po'am myur ba:/ las ka goms na bde blag tu sgrub thub, tshur yong skabs lam bar du dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu bgrod pa/ bya ba'i 'jug ldog la dka' ba med par bde blag tu spyod pa/
1) bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ 2) (mngon) 1, bzhad gad/ 2, dbang phyug chen po/ 3, lha dbang phyug chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs yin pas grangs bcu gcig mtshon/
gzugs po nad med pa bde po/ nye zho med par bde mor slebs pa/ ma mjal bar du bde mor bzhugs/
lus rtsal che la myur ba/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig ste mi ser gyi 'tsho bar lta rtog byed mkhan/
'khrug long sogs yul khams mi bde ba'i zing cha/ yul khams glo bur lhags pa'i bde gzar lhing 'jags su btang ba/
1) bde zhing yangs pa/ 2) sde yangs kyang zer, khyams/
bde bar gnas thub pa byas pa/ mi dmangs bde la bkod yod/
'phral skyid phugs legs/ gnyen sgrig rten 'brel bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa byung song/
cig smon tshig cig / rgya che'i yul khams: thams cad bde legs su gyur cig / mi rgan rnams tshe ring nad med bde legs su gyur cig /
bde bar gshegs pa'i bsdus tshig
zur chung shes rab grags kyi mtshan gzhan zhig /
sman bla bde gshegs mched brgyad de, mtshan legs dang, rin chen, gser bzang, mya ngan med, chos grags, mngon mkhyen, sman gyi bla, shakya thub pa rnams so/

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa shakya thub pa sku bltams pa'i tshe grong khyer ser skyar bzhengs pa, mchod rten zlum po padma'i 'dab ma can gyi bang rim bzhi'am bdun brtsegs pa pad 'dab kyis spras pa'i mchod rten/
sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye nas gnas pa'i gzhi rgyud bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba thugs rje kun khyab kyi bdag nyid can/

chos drug gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i rtog: pa med pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i snang ba med pa, rdul phra rab kyi gzugs med pa, mtshan ma'i g.yo ba med pa, de rnams kyis stong pa'i med dgag las 'das pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba, rang gi ngo bo so so rang gis rig pa'i mtshan nyid can no/
beed'uraya'i 'od kyi rgyal po: sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ste bde gshegs mched brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
lus bde zhing rig pa gsal ba/ sman gyi nus pas lus sems bde sing nge ba byas byung/
gzugs po yang zhing, sems lhod lhod/
bden pa gzhan la ster ba/ pham kha rang gis khur nas gzhan la bden kha byin pa/

bden par grub pa ste, blo la snang pa'i dbang gis gzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa de bden par grub pa'i tshad yin, rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa dang, rang bzhin gyis grub pa, rang ngos nas grub pa, yang dag par grub pa, don dam par grub pa, de kho na nyid du grub pa sogs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/
bden pa'i rgyab skyor/ khrims dpon gyis bden rgyab byas byung/
bden pa yod pa'i mi de mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng che/
kun rdzob bden pa dang, don dam bden pa gnyis/
chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi grub pas stong pa/
gyis brlabs pa'i bka': thugs kyis byin brlabs bka' gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, nam mkha' dang ljon shing sogs las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba rnams so/
yid ches mi rung ba'i gtam,/ gsung gsung yin 'gro bden mdog med/ pho rog lhags pas khyer ba bden mdog med/ ngang pa chus khyer ba bden mdog med/

1. rdzun ma'i ldog phyogs te dngos gnas/ bden pa'i dngos po/ da res kyi kha mchu de'i bden pa nga la thob byung/ bden lung pa gnyis de phu thag ring, rdzun a bra gnyis de mjug ma thung/ 2. drang po'am dngos gnas mi slu ba/ skad cha bden pa bshad pa/
mthong lam ste, bden pa mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa'i lam de'o/
stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa/
bden pa'i tshig brjod pa/ slu med bden pa bdar bas shing skam po nas lo ma skyes te 'bras bu'ang chags pa'i sgrung/ dam can rnams kyi ming nas bos, yul mis sdug btang tshul bden pa bdar/
bden don bden thog tu 'khyol ba/ khos gang bshad tshang ma bden pa bden 'khyol byung song/
ha cang drang po/ g.yo zol spu tsam med par bden pa bden thub kyis bar dpang byas song/

sangs rgyas shakya thub pas chos 'khor thog mar bskor skabs gsungs pa'i 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras dang myang 'das kyi rgyu 'bras ma lus pa bsdus nas blang dor bya ba'i gzhi 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ste, sdug bsngal bden pa dang, kun 'byung bden pa dang, 'gog pa'i bden pa dang, lam gyi bden pa rnams so, chos bzhi po 'di dag 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor de kho na ltar ma nor bar nges pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes bya'o/
bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor ro/
mdo sde glegs bam sa par bzhugs pa/ sa...
dngos 'brel khungs skyel/ mthong thos nyams myong dngos 'brel gyi bden pa ra sprod byed pa/
chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa/
1) gzhan gyi gtam sogs la yid ches te dngos gnas yin par sems pa/ 2) chos rnams bden par grub pa'am rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa/
1) g.yo zol med pa'i las kas mi tshe mthar phyin pa/ 2) bden pa yod stabs rgyal kha thob pa/
(mngon) 1) srin po/ 2) lho nub kyi mtshams/
drang zhing tshad pa/ zol med bden 'brel gyi las ka byed pa/
rang la khungs lung med pas gzhan la rtsod shags 'debs rgyu'i re ba zad pa/
1) yang dag pa'i tshig / snying nas zhus pa'i bden tshig / 2) sngags skad
bden tshig gi dmod sbyor brjod pa/
grub mtha' smra bas 'phral du brtags pa'i bden 'dzin/
gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes pa phra mo'o/
thog ma med pa nas rjes su zhugs pa, grub mthas blo bsgyur ma bsgyur gnyis ka la yod pa'i bden 'dzin/
bden pa dang rdzun pa/ bden rdzun dbye 'byed/ legs nyes bden rdzun shan 'byed dgos/
gtam dang bya spyod legs nyes
bden par 'dzin pa'i blo shugs che ba/

bcu drug bden pa bzhi po re re la rnam pa: bzhi bzhir dbye bas bcu drug ste sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang, kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang, 'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang, lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang bcu drug go /
bden pa yod tshul gyi yus bdar ba/ phan 'dogs sogs byas tshul gyi bden yus bshad pa/
bden pa yod pa'i yus bshad pa/
drang gtam 'gran bsdur/ khrims sar gyod ya phan tshun bden bsher rgyag pa/
bar chad med par slebs pa/ lam bar gegs med bder bgrod thub pa byung song/
bder gnas rkyen gyi gzhi lnga
'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, bslab pa bsrung ba'i gzhi dgu'i nang gses bde bar gnas pa rkyen gyi gzhi la lnga ste, gos kyi gzhi gsum dang, sman gyi gzhi, gnas mal gyi gzhi rnams so/
bde po yin khul byed pa/ rtag tu yid bder rlom gyi tshul du bsdad pa/
bde bar gshegs pa'i bsdus tshig
rgyas pa'i sgang/ bde skyid bdo 'phro la 'khel ba/
(tha mi dad pa) dar ba dang 'phel ba'am rgyas pa/ srol bzang kun nas bdo ba/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba/ lang tsho yongs su ma bdo ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'dug pa'am yod pa/ bdog pa bdog / bdog pa'i dngos po/ gtsang por nya bdog / nyes skyon gang du bdog / thabs bdog dang mi bdog / 2. rgyu nor dang, dngos po/ bang mdzod bdog pas khengs pa/ rang yod bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba/
me ma thal lam, me ma mur/ mdag ma'i dong/
mdang dgong skyes pa'i byis pa ste skyes ma thag pa/
snga nub mtshan mo/ mdang sum nyal ba'i rmi lam bzang po zhig ma byung/
/ 1) mdog gam bkrag / 'od mdangs/ zhal mdangs/ brtse ba'i mdangs/ 2) lus kyi khu ba'i yang khu dwangs ma mthar phyin pa/ 3) (mngon) rkang mar/
tshon mdog gam kha dog sna tshogs gsal ba/ 'od mdangs bkra ba/
tshon mdangs mi snum pa/ ngo mdangs skya lhag ge ba/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga'i ya gyal mchin par gnas pa zhig ste, byed las kha zas kyi dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs kyi kha dog rnams so sor sgyur bar byed pa/
g.ya' phog pa'am shugs rkyen thebs pa/ nyi ma'i mdangs phog pa dang lus la bde drod 'bar phyung/
(yul) tshon mdangs kyis ri mo'i nyams 'don pa/

1) kha dog yal bar byed pa/ 2) snying ga'i phyogs na gnas pa srog 'dzin par byed pa'i rdzas kyi bye brag cig la mdangs zhes bya la, de phrogs na tshe ring du mi gnas so/ 3) gdon sbyin mdangs 'phrog pa zhig /
bkrag mdangs nyams pa/ lus kyi nang bcud nyams pas phyi'i mdangs mi snum pa/ khang pa'i nang gi rdzas stong pas phyi rol gyi mdangs mi snum pa/
tshon mdangs gsal por 'tsher ba/ ston kha'i zla ba'i 'od mdangs 'tsher lhag ge ba/
1) 'od mdangs legs pa/ 2) snying stobs ngar dang ldan pa/
tshon mdangs nyams gso byed pa/ cha sgam la tshon btang ste mdangs gso ba/ kha zas bcud can bsten te lus kyi mdangs gso ba/
/ 1) 'gram pa'i don du go ba'i ldan pa dang 'dra, 2) sgo'i gtan pa/

/ 1) lung pa'i mdo/ lung pa'i phu mda' tshang mar sa zhing gshin po yod/ 2) 'phang bya'i mtshon gyi bye brag cig / smyug mda'/ me mda'/ skar mda'/ btang na mda' dang bkug na gzhu/ mda' drang na byang thang gi 'brong yang bsad/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgra can dang, sgro ldan, lcags sbubs can, nyag phran, ltong can, dug gi byug pa can, drang 'gro, 'dab ldan mtshon, 'bigs byed, 'ben bsnun, mi 'khyog 'gro, rtse mo can, mtshon cha'i gtso, 'ur sgra can bcas so, 3) sbubs can 'drong po/ tha ma kha'i gang zag gi mda'/ srang mda'/ rgya gling gi mda'/ 4) (mngon) bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gi mda' la myos byed dang, sred byed, rmongs byed, skem byed, 'ching byed bcas lnga yod pas grangs lnga mtshon/
mda' brgyab pa'i skad de gling bu btang ba'i skad du bsgyur ba ste rdzun tshig bden gtam du bsgyur ba'i dpe/
1) mda' bzo mkhan/ mda' mkhan rang gi mda' yis bsad/ 2) mda' 'phen mkhan/
1) lung pa'i mda'i grong/ 2) mda' dong ngam mda' shubs/
mda' rgyag skabs len pa'i glu/
mda' 'phen pa/ pho tshod yod nas 'brong la mda' brgyab pa yin, mda' shes nas gzhu nyos pa yin/ 'ben mthong nas mda' rgyag dgos/
mda' 'phen thengs gcig gi shud kyis ji tsam 'gro ba'i bar thag / mda' rgyang gang/
mda' rgyang nas 'phen pa/ mda' rgyang nas 'phen pa sdar ma yin, gri bcar nas g.yug pa dpa' bo yin/
1) mda' 'phen 'gran skabs 'jog pa'i rgyan/ 2) mda' la btags pa'i rgyan cha/
mda' 'phen 'gran bsdur byas te rgyal kha thob pa/
sngo sman gyi rigs 'bras bu dmar po byu ru dang 'dra ba sne nag po can ming gzhan dmar ru mgo nag zer ba ste, ro kha bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rtsa kha 'byed, mngal nas bu 'byin, mo nad 'joms/
yun nan zhing chen gyi rgyal thang rdzong gi shar ngos 'bri chu'i 'gram du yod pa'i gru kha zhig /
mda' la sbyar ba'i bya sgro/
lha gzhan 'phrul dbang phyug la yod pa'i myos byed dang, sred byed, rmongs byed, skem byed dam rgod byed, 'ching byed dam brgyal byed kyi mda' ste lnga/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
mda' la nye ba dang 'ben la ring ba ma yin pa ste nye ring med pa'i dpe/
1) gzhu rgyud dang sbyar rgyu'i kha/ rgyud la mda' ltong sbyar te gzhu bkang ba/ 2) zlum hril gyi dngos por 'jam mthar 'don byed tshag pa'i yo byad cig /
mda' la dar tshon sna lnga dang, me long sogs btags pa'i mda' dar te bag ma len skabs dang tshe g.yang 'gug pa'i las sogs su dgos pa'i rdzas shig /
1) lha mo 'khrab dus dgos pa'i mda' dar/ 2) dar btags pa'i mda' ltong kha lnga pa/
lag shugs kyis 'phen pa'i mda' dang rdo'i bsdus ming/ 'ben btsugs te mda' rdo rgyag pa/ phru gus 'gyig gzhu la brten nas mda' rdo 'phen pa/
mda' rdo 'phangs nas 'jigs snang bskul ba/ dpa' rtsal can la mda' rdos bsdigs kyang ga la 'jigs/
/ 1) mda' 'phen pa po/ 2) lung pa'i mdar sdod mkhan/ 3) sa cha zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtswa mda' rdzong khongs su yod/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag dpon gi gnas che gras shig man ju'i rgyal rabs gong ma chan lung gi dus mjug tu mda' dpon re'i mnga' 'og tu dmag mi lnga brgya re gtan 'bebs bzos shing, rjes sor rim bzhin mang du btang yod/
mda' 'phen red:/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyud las grol ba dang, rgyud las 'phos, drag po'i shugs 'gro bcas so, 2) (mngon) gzhu/
/ 1) mda' gzhu'i mda'/ 2) mda' la brten nas bzang ngan brtag pa'i mo phyva/
mda' gzhu'i mda'/ mda' mo che gsum phog pas rta'i steng nas lhung ba/
lag mda' 'phen shugs che chung gi 'phong rtsal/ gling kha'i nang du mi kha shas kyis mda' rtsal 'gran gyi 'dug /
ring thung gi tshad mda' gang tsam mam, mda' la tshad bzhag pa'i dngos po/
'phang bya'i mda' dang, 'phen byed kyi gzhu/ sha ba sgo khar slebs dus mda' gzhu bzo ba/
mda' rgyag yul la phog nas gting la zug pa/
(yul) rtsam pa 'jal byed snod chung zhig /
1) mda' mo gsar du bzo ba/ 2) mda' bzo mkhan/
1) khang thog gi gyang rtsig pu shu'am nya skyor/ 2) gser zangs sogs kyi bya 'dab/

1) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gras phyogs 'gro'i skabs rta khal mi gsum gyi khral 'ul bskul phyir sngon tshud nas ras dmar la bris te mdar btags nas gtong ba'i yi ge/ 2) mda'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i legs sbyar gyi yi ge zhig
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong gi nub rgyud dang lho yul gyi shar rgyud du 'bab/
gcig gi shul gcig gis 'dzin pa'i dpe/
gdeng tshod yod nas bya ba byed pa'i dpe/
mda' la sbyar ba'i bya sgro
bag ma len skabs mda' dar bag ma'i sgos kyi gong bar gzer te mda' bshad rgyag srol/
mi lus kyi brang khog g.yas g.yon bar du yod pa'i phug ron gsang sogs/
mtshon cha zhig / lcags mdung/ 'phang mdung/ mdung ring/ mdung bsnun pa/ mdung 'phen pa/ dgra la mdung brgyab pa/
(mngon) 1) rtsangs pa sgal ral/ 2) 'bu phra mo/ 3) pho ril dkar po/
mdung thung thung/ gri thung rked par btags, mdung thung lag tu thogs/
mdung rtser btags pa'i dar cha/
mdung gi rtse mo/ mdung rtse kha sprod/
rdo sman gyi rigs te, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag sbyor, klad skyon sel, mig nad bar 'gribs la phan/
rdo sman gyi rigs mdog smug nag bcag tshe mdung so ltar dum bur 'gyur ba zhig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag sbyor, mig gsal, klad par rmas skyon shor ba sogs la phan/
mtshon cha mdung gi bye brag gcig /
yan lag gi rnam gsang 'bigs byed kyi yo byad cig /
mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi a mdo rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
yu bar thag pa ring po btags te 'phen rgyu'i mdung/
mdung rtse'i lcags kyi dbyibs zla tshes dang 'dra ba'i mdung/
pho mtshan gyi nad kyi bye brag cig /

1. (tha mi dad pa) mdud pa 'debs pa'am, rgyag pa/ thag pa chad pa de rnams mdud pa mdud nas mthud pa/ 2. mdud pa brgyab pa'i ming/ skud par mdud pa rgyag pa/ bal thag de gnyis mdud pa bcings nas mthud pa/ lus nang gi rtsa mdud/ ser sna'i mdud pa/ ol mdud/ sbrul mdud sbrul bshig
mdud pa rang bzhin gyis grol ba/ ska rags kyi mdud pa zhig nas sbo lhug mar gyur/
brnab sems dang, gnod sems, tshul khrims mchog 'dzin dang, brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin bcas bzhi/
mdud pa 'grol dka' ba rgyag pa/

drung dang, nye 'gram/ mdun gral/ mdun phyogs/ sku'i mdun du bcar ba/ lus po mdun du bsgur nas gus 'dud zhu ba/ g.yul sa'i mdun du kha gtad pa/ rgyal kha 'thob bzhin par mdun nas mdun du 'gro ba/ gnam gru mang po mdun gyi nam mkhar lding skor rgyag pa/ rgyab logs su bsgrigs pa rnams mdun du spo ba/ mdu brten sa'i 'khar ba, rgyab dro ba'i slog pa/
mdun du dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed nas, rdul tshon la sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa dang, thams cad la ye shes pa bcug nas mchod cing bstod pa sogs bya ba/
nu ma g.yas g.yon gnyis po thig gis sbrel bas de'i dkyil de snying dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na 'phyo ba dang 'dar ba snying mi bde ba sogs la phan/
bka'i mdun na 'don dag gi bka' gros/ mdun gros la dbang ba/
dmag sa'i mdun phyogs su 'thab mkhan shi 'phral du rgyab snon byed mkhan gyis mu mthud nas 'dzing ba/
rgya lu chas gyon dus mdun du dpyangs pa'i gos chen gyi 'phan lta bu gnyis/
1) khyo shug khyim thabs/ 2) mna' ma'am, bag ma/
mdun du byas pa'i dge ba
dge ba mchog gsum gyi rten mdun du byas te mchod pa byed pa/
(yul) lha mo 'khrab dus mdun phyogs su spo ba'i gom pa/
blon po ste rgyal po'i mdun du gros 'don mkhan/
drung na sdod pa'i yi ge 'bri mkhan
nye 'gram du sdod pa'i g.yog po
mdun phyogs su yod pa'i ri/
mdun phyogs/ khang pa'i mdun rol nas phar phyin pa/
1) mdun phyogs kyi 'gro lam/ 2) ma 'ongs pa'i gnas tshul/ mdun lam bzang po/ mdun lam zad pa/
1) yi ge'i deb kyi mdun ngos phyod/ 2) dpe cha'i shog ldeb kyi mdun phyogs/ mdun shog nang ma/
mdun nas srung skyob byed mkhan/
sngon bsu byed pa/ 'grul pa'i mdun nas bsu ba/ dus chen mdun bsu/
mda' yi mde'u'i dbyibs gzugs shig /
shing bzo ba'i lag cha gsor/
bod mda'i mdel ril lugs rgyag sa'i par/
bod mda'i nang blug rgyu'i zha nyes bzos pa'i mde'u ril/

/ 1) nyung ngur bsdus pa'i sdom mam gnad 'gag / 2) chu dang, lam sogs kyi 'dzoms 'gag / lam bzhi mdo/ chu gsum mdo/ brag gsum mdo/ lam mdor lus pa/ 3) khang pa sogs kyi phyi'am mda'/ khang pa sbug mdo/ lung pa'i phu mdo/ 4) sde snod gsum gyi nang las mdo sde/ 5) mdo sngags kyi zlas dbye ba'i mdo/

byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'm spyod pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung dpal mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa, bam po lnga pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/
skad cha'i snying po/ mi de'i skad cha mdo kha 'gril po 'dug /
1) a mdo dang khams gnyis kyi spyi ming/ 2) ming gzhan smad khams te da lta 'bri chu stod rgyud kyi gyas gyon la zer/
smad mdo khams sgang drug dang don gcig
sngar lha ldan smon lam skabs gdan sa gsum gyi sgrig khongs la dngos su ma 'dzul ba'i tshogs khang gi mdo na bzhugs pa'i btsun gral/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo'm, sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo le'u bdun cu don lnga pa'i bdag nyid can, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dhar ma bo dhi dang, d'a na rakshi ta dang, zhu chen gyi lo ts'a ba che btsan skyes kyis bsgyur pa/
1) khang pa'i bar khyams/ 2) lam dang chu sogs kyi 'dus mdo/ 3) don gnad kyi snying po/
mdo sngags kyi gzhung las bshad pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa dang lam gyi rnam bzhag /

za ma tog bkod pa dang: pad ma snying po'i mdo, zhal bcu gcig pa'i mdo, bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs, don yod zhags pa, don zhags phyi ma, pad ma mchog dbang bsgyur 'khor lo, chog sngags kyi rgyud, yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs, snying rje chen po mi gshol ba, 'od zer rnam bkod, pad ma cod pan gyi mdo, yi ge drug pa'i mdo, dam chos pad dkar, punta ri ka'i mdo, chu klung sna tshogs pa'i mdo, snang ba rol pa'i mdo, mtshan brgyad rtsa brgyad pa, mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa'i mdo, phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs bcas nyer gcig go/

gsang sngags rnying ma'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum gyi rgyud gzhung gtso bo rnams te, mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa, rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste dpal gsang ba snying po, sems mdo ma bu bco brgyad rnams so/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma stod rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig /
tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang: mthun pa'i mdo pandi ta dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa'o/
mtshan mchog ces bya ba: sho lo ka bzhi bcu tham pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa'o/
mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa zhes bya ba
sho lo kha bzhi bcu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sgs pas bsgyur pa'o/
pa nyid ces bya ba: sho lo ka dgu bcu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa'o/
mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po
bam po phyed pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la soga pas bsgyur pa'o/
pa chen po'i mdo: gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi gras, 'gyur byang med pa, rgyud 'bum glegs bam ba par bzhugs pa'o/
can snying bos bsu ba zhes bya ba: bam po phyed pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa'o/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dang, mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi ming rnying/
rtsa ba'i don/ skad cha mang po ma bshad par mdo don bshad na go bde/
bzhag dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo dang don: gcig

(s'utantra) yul gang du gang zag gang gi phyir du gsungs pa smos pas gnas dang, kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa'i mtshan nyid smos pas mtshan nyid dang, phung khams skye mched la sogs pa smos pas chos dang, dgongs pa'i don zab mo dag ston pas don bcas bzhi smos pas mdo sde zhes bya'o/

byams chos sde lnga las rgyan rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste, drang nges kyi mdo sde sna tshogs pa'i don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i gzhung, le'u nyer gcig pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shakya sing ha dang, lo ts'a ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur la blo ldan shes rab kyis 'gyur bcos byas pa'o/
mdo sde'i rjes su 'brangs nas, rang rig dang phyi don gnyis ka bden zhen gyis khas len pa'i theg dman gyi grub mtha' smra ba/
dbu ma pa: slob dpon legs ldan gyis srol phye ba'i phyi don rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa khas len pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/
mdo sde pa dang don gcig

tog gi snying po: bod rje tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi thugs dam gnyan po gsang bar grags pa'i nang tshan bod la thog mar byung ba'i mdo sde zhig thu mis bod yig gsar gtod byas rjes gzhi nas bod yig tu bsgyur/
lung gcig las 'phros pa dang, bar ma, ring mo, phran tshogs te bzhi/
mdo sde rgyan dang don gcig
bod rgyal mu ne btsan po'i skabs bsam yas su btsugs pa'i dus mchod chen po zhig /

lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa, gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang nas mdo'i sde dang, dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde dang, tshigs su bcad pa'i sde dang, ched du brjod pa'i sde dang, lung du bstan pa'i sde dang, shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang, rnad du byung ba'i sde bcas bsdus pa'i sde snod do/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khams mdo smad spyi khyab/ mdo phyogs, rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung/
khang pa nang ma dang phyi ma'i bsdus ming

1) da lta chab mdo sa khul gyi ming gzhan zhig / 2) ming gzhan gyer mo thang ste da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho sngon po'i lho nub rgyud dang rma chu nas lho phyogs su phyin pa'i sa rgyud spyi'i ming/

mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho zhes bya ba, 'di brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing glang lor bsgrigs, bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi par mar shog grangs dgu brgya tham pa yod, de'i nang don a mdo'i yul gru khag gi dgon ma lag so sor byon pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu dang, grwa rgyun mang nyung, sa tshigs ring thung, 'byor pa thon khungs sogs zhib tu bshad cing, khyad par du dbu na chos 'byung rgyal rabs rnam grangs drug brgya lhag tsam gyi mtshan byang dang rtsom pa po bkod yod pa de lo rgyus smra ba dag la mkho gal che bar snang/ 1 865...900...600...1982...
rgyas pa rang min pa/ mdo tsam bstan par bya ba ni 'di lta ste/
zlos gar gyi 'khrab bya'i don gang yin pa de'i gzhung srong ba po/
khyogs sam byams khri/ mdo li 'degs pa/
mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims
srong btsan sgam pos bod du lag bstar byas pa'i khrims yig cig ste bden rdzun dbye 'byed skabs kha drag zhan gnyis rtsod na drag pa mi skyengs shing zhan pa yi mi 'chad par thag gcod pa/
1.kha dog...sku mdog / sha mdog / sa mdog / ras mdog / mdog bzang ba/ mdog ngan pa/ mdog mi sdug pa/ 2. yin khul dang, yod tshul sogs/ mi 'jon 'jon mdog sngo lo langs 'phyar/
kha dog gi don du go ba'i mdog dang don gcig

1) bya tshig gi mthar shas che ba'i don la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad cig / yong mdog kha po/ 'gro mdog kha po/ ster mdog kha po/ 'grig mdog kha po/ 2) khyad chos kyi tshig gi mthar cha 'dra ba'i don la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad cig / che mdog kha po/ dkar mdog kha po/ mdzes mdog kha po/ mtho mdog kha po/
tshon mdog khra thing nge ba/ stag gzig gi spu mdog khra shig ge ba yong/
mdog rang bzhin gyis 'gyur ba/ dgun dus spang dang nags tshal gyi mdog 'gyur ba/
tshon mdog ched du sgyur ba/ snam bu bkrus nas mdog sgyur gyi tshos las byed pa/
nyi ma'i rta bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
1) kha dog mthun pa/ 2) (mngon) bya rog /
bkrag mdangs yal ba/ lto skya gos hral gyis mdog nyams par gyur pa/
tshon nam, tshon kha ma legs pa/ bzo dbyibs legs kyang mdog nyes kyi dngos po lta snang la mi 'gro/
tshul lam khul:/ mi shes pa shes mdog mdog byed pa/
kha dog lta na sdug pa/ mdog mdzes me tog /
kha dog bzang po/ rtags ma mdog legs shig legs skyes su stsal ba/
kha dog shor ba'am nyams pa/ lus stobs nyams na mdog shor yong/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga'i ya gyal pags la gnas pa zhig ste, byed las lus kyi pags pa'i mdog gsal zhing dang bar byed pa yin/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa rigs lnga'i nang tshan mdog gsal nad du gyur pa ste, nad rtags su pags mdog sngo la nag cing reg bya rtsub par 'gyur ba zhig /
ja dang 'o ma sogs srub snod/ ja srub snod mdong mo rag shan ma/
(rnying) 1) ngo dga' byed pa/ 2) drang gtam/
/ 1) sgro thig / rma bya'i sgro mdongs bkrag mdangs can/ 2) dud 'gro'i dpral ba'i dkar thig che ba/ mi ming can, rta mdongs can/ mi dkar la zhwa nag rta dkar la mdongs nag /
gdong la dkar thig yod pa'i rta drel/
mig zhar ba/ mig mdongs pa/
pho mo'i mtshan ma gnas yul don du go ba'i 'doms dang 'dra,
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gdul bya 'dul ba'i don du rgyas bsdus bcad lhug ci rigs kyi sgo nas brjod bya sna tshogs ston pa'i mdo nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod du gtogs pa zhig /
don gnad gang rung mdor bsdus te bstan pa'm rags rim tsam bshad pa/ mdor bstan pa'i tshig / mdor bstan par gzhag pa/ re zhig rgyas bshad kyi spros pa dor te mdor bstan tsam zhus pa yin/
nyung ngur bsdus pa/ rgyas pa las mdor bsdus te bshad pa/ yi ge'i spros bshad dor te mdor bsdus stabs bde bris pa/
mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ mdor bsdus na gang du gnya' gnon yod sa de nyid du ngo rgol yang yod pa/
1) sdom bsdu na'm mdor bsdu na/ mang du bshad zin cing, mdor na snying po 'di yin/ 2) tha na/ khang pa 'di'i nang du 'dzin chas mang po phar bzhag mdor na gdan gcig kyang mi 'dug /
mchod sbyin gyi tshab bam glud rdzas 'di la gnyis dbye rgyu yod pa'i yas stags ni lha la mchod pa 'bul rgyu dang, mas stags ni gdon bgegs rnams la sbyin pa gtong rgyu yin/
mdos skud dkri sa'i smyug sgrom ste nam mkha' mtshon byed cig /
dgra bgegs sogs la gtor rdzas kyi glud rdzongs btang ba/
mdor bsdus kyi sgo nas brda sprod pa/
gdon bgegs sogs la gtor rdzas kyi glud rdzongs gyugs pa/
mchod sbyin du bya rgyu'i mdos dang gtor zor/ mdos zor brgyab pa/
gto bcos kyi mdos dang de'i rdzas cha/
skud pa tshos tshogs spel ba'i nam mkha' dang khyung tshang sogs mtshon byed kyi ri mo/
1) khrus rdzas sam, 'dag byed kyi rdzas/ 2) ba byung lnga ste ba las byung ba lci ba dang, gcin pa, 'o ma, zho, mar bcas lnga la mchod rdzas gtsang bar byed pa'i rdzas lnga zer/
'dam bag gis gang ba'i sa kong dong/ 'dag dong nang du rkang pa tshud pa/
nas 'dal ba'i gro zan gyi thug pa lta: bu/ tsha sdor med pa'i bag thug 'dag 'dag de 'thung mkhan gyi dang gar mi 'gro/

1. (tha mi dad pa) dag pa, 'dag pa,, gtsang mar 'gyur ba/ dri ma legs par bkrus na mi 'dag pa med/ nam mkha' gya' dag pa dang, sa gzhi rdul dag pa/ 2. 'dam dang, 'jim pa/ char pa ma bab na thal ba dang, bab na 'dag pas khengs pa/
'gro lam sogs kyi 'dam bag gnas skabs sel thub tsam ste sla bcos kyi dpe/
1) sgo sogs khang pa'i bu ga 'dag pas 'byar ba/ gyang rnying par 'dag 'byar rgyag pa/ 2) 'dam bag gos pa/
bur pa sogs 'dag pas bkag pa/ sgo 'dag sbyar gyis bkag pa/
'dam bag gi zhal ba/ rtsig par 'dag zhal brgyab/
(yul) 1) zhen chags pa'am brtse gdung/ nga rang rang gi pha yul la 'dang che/ 2) bsam blo/ mi 'di su yin ngas 'dang yun ring brgyab kyang dran ma song/
(tha mi dad pa) 'dangs pa, 'dang ba,, tshad nges can longs pa/ mi grangs lnga bcu tham pa 'dangs ma song/ lo gcig gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen 'dangs la khad cig 'dug / ras gos 'dang gcig /
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho chen rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
longs tsam/ rtsam pa 'di tsam zhig byung na lam rgyags 'dangs tsam yong ba 'dug /
(rnying) gshin por dmigs pa'i dge sgrub/
(rnying) 1) gshin por sems 'phreng ba'am chags sems can/ 2) gshin po'i ched du dge ba sgrub mkhan/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'jo mda' rdzong khongs yin zhing, 'bri chu'i nub 'gram du yod/
sgo'i gtan pa'i don du go ba'i mdan pa dang 'dra,
me tog gi 'dab ma'i kha/ pad ma'i 'dab ma kha bye 'dug /

bya rigs/ ming gi rnam grangs la mkha' skyod dang, mkha' 'gro, mkha' rgyu, mkha' la rgyu, sgong skyes, sgro can, sgro gshog can, nyug byed, nyul byed, gnyis skyes, 'dab ldan, 'dab ma can, 'dab ma'i shing rta, nam mkhar 'gro, nus 'gro, nus can, nus ldan, gnam skyod, 'phur 'dod, 'phur nus, 'phur byed, tshang skyes, shing gnas, gshog 'gro, gshog rgyas, gshog ldan bcas so,
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho ngos su yod/
smin ches pa'i shing 'bras lta bu reg bya snyi ba'i dngos po zhig / lo gsum kham bu smin nas 'dab be 'dob be chags 'dug /
/ 1) shing gi lo ma dang, me tog gi 'dab ma/ me tog dmar po rgyas kyang 'dab ma sngon pos skyong dgos/ pad ma'i 'dab ma dkar la dmar/ 2) gshog pa/
me tog pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/
bya'i gshog pa sprug sprug byed pa/ gtam ma bshad gong nas bsam blo gtong, bya ma 'phur gong nas 'dab ma sprug /
1) bya yi gshog pa legs pa/ 2) lo ma legs pa/ 3) (mngon) 1,khyung/ 2,so ma r'a dz'a/
me tog sogs kyi 'dab ma lhe pa/
ngogs sam 'khris/ ri'i 'dabs/ grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs/ nags 'dabs/ mchin pa'i 'dabs/

thag nye ba'i sar chags pa/ grong khyer gyi 'dabs chags pa na ngas tshal chu klung gis khor yug tu bskor ba/ rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha 'dabs chags su byung ba/ nyer mkho'i yo byad sna tshogs pas 'dabs chags su gang ba/
'dam sgrug / ka...kha ga...nga...bzang ngan 'dam kha ma nor gces/
kha mchu thag ma chod tshe 'dam bag bskol ba: de'i nang du rde'u dkar nag blugs te gyod ya phan tshun sgrug tu 'jug pa'i srol ngan zhig /
'dam rdzab kyi dkyil/ 'dam khrod du skyes kyang 'dam gyis mi gos/
'dam bag rdung byed kyi rgyug pa
mang po'i nang nas yag sgrug / sa bon 'dam sgrug/
man ju gong ma chan lung gi dus su srol chags pa'i bod kyi byang 'brog nang tshan 'dam gzhung sde shog khag brgyad pa/

1) sa 'dam mam, na 'dam, bye 'dam bcas su 'khyil ba'i chu/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'dam gzhung rdzong gi dbus su yod pa'i 'bab chu zhig yin zhing, 'phen yul ngan chu'i yan lag cig yin/ 3) 'bab chu zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rdza stod rdzong du yod/
rlon blugs nas 'dul sbyong byed pa

brje po rgyag nus pa/ kho rang na ba las rang nyid 'chi ba 'dam nus pa/ 'dam pa, 1. (tha dad pa) 1, bdams pa, bdam pa, 'doms,, mang po'i nang nas gang rung zhig sgrug pa/ 'gro lam rang gis 'dam, 'bras bu rang gis myong/ 2, btam pa, gtam pa, thom,, gzhan du 'chol ba/ bdag gnyer gtam pa/ snga lor kho la btam pa'i rgyu dngos rnams skyon cha med par bsdad 'dug / 2. sa chu 'dres pa'i 'dag rdzab/ rkang gnyis 'dam pa'i nang du bying ba/ 'dam che sar rta phyugs zug na 'don dka'/
(yul) me tog pad ma'i ri mo can gyi rum gyi ming/
gyi 'dag pa:/ 'dam bag brdzis nas khang par byugs/
sngo sman gyi rigs te, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo tshad dang, mchin tshad, rtsa tshad bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la ljang lo chig skyes dang, rtsa mngar, rtsa da byid bcas so,
sha rus kyi gseb na lus pa'i zug rngu 'don byed kyi skam pa bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba gnyis/
'dam rtswa skyes pa'i tshal/ 'dam bu'i tshal na chu skyes mdzes pa ste, ra ris ldan yang zla ba yid 'ong nyid/

mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab rdzob yod pa/ lo mang chags pa'i 'dam rdzab bton nas sa lud bzo ba/ bong bu 'dam rdzab tu bying nas thon mi thub pa/ 'dam rdzab nang du tshud de bya dka' byed gtad kyi gnas su gyar ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'jim pa dang, 'bying byed, rdzab bcas so,
'dam nyog chag chig / char zhod ches pas: khang pa'i nye skor du 'dam rdzab nyag nyig mang po chags 'dug
'dam rdzab nang 'gro skabs rkang pa'i rdog sgra/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer byang ngos su yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de 'dam chu kha ru yod/
'jim bzo bas 'dam skur g.yogs rgyu'i ras rlon pa/
nags khrod du gnas pa'i seng ge/
mdo sde zhig ste 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes sho lo ka bcu pa, rgya yig las bsgyur pa/
'gal mi nus pa/ rang gis dam bcas pa'i don las 'da' dka' ba/ skad cha ji ltar mang po bshad kyang don 'di dag las 'da' dka' ba/
'chi kha/ tshe las 'da' kha la thug kyang gson re byed pa/
'chi kha ma/ tshe 'da' ga mar kha chems bzhag pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'das pa, 'da' ba,, 1) mtshams las rgal ba/ sngon bkag dus tshod las 'das pa/ mi grangs las 'das pa/ las 'go btsugs nas zla ba brgyad 'das pa/ blo yul las 'das pa/ 2) tshe rdzogs pa ste 'chi ba/ tshe 'das pa/ dus 'das pa/ 2. shing bal dang bal sogs zhib mor bsed pa'i leb mo/ lus shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkris pa/
'dar tshul zhig / chang gis bzi nas gzugs po 'dar khyom khyom byas byung/
'phar zhing g.yo ba'am, 'gul zhing ldeg pa/ gzugs po rang tshugs mi thub par 'dar 'khyoms byed pa/ sa g.yos pas khang khyim tshang ma 'dar 'khyoms ling ling byed pa/
yom yom/ grang zug ma bzod pas gzugs po 'dar 'dar byed pa/
sha 'gul rgyug pa/ rta la sha sbrang gis so brgyab pas lus po 'dar phril phril byas yong/
(tha mi dad pa) yom yom du 'gul ba/ grang bas 'dar ba/ snying rtsa 'dar ba/ mgo 'dar ba/ kha 'dar ba/ lus 'dar ba la kha'i dar lcog 'dra/ lag pa 'dar nas yi ge 'bri thub pa mi 'dug /
rims nad nang tshan rlung rims shig ste, nad rtags su lus yun ring du 'dar zhing phrum ser khyer ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
'gul zhing ldeg pa/ sgyogs chen 'phangs pas dgra gnas thams cad 'dar zhing 'phyo ba zhig byung song/
skrag pa'am grang ches pas lus 'phar tshul/ dgra bo skrag nas 'dar zhum zhum byas nas 'phral du bros song/
g.yo zhing 'khyoms pa/ rlung khrag rgyas pas mgo lus 'dar yom rgyag pa/ rlung chen langs pas ljon shing tshang ma 'dar yom yom byed pa/
'phar zhing 'khyoms pa/ glo bur 'ur 'drogs langs nas glo snying 'dar yom me ba zhig byung/ chu chen rba rlabs g.yos pas gru gzings 'dar yom me ba byas song/
sog pa nas sgal gzhung bar 'brel ba'i sha/
mi phyugs sogs kyi gzugs po g.yo tshul/ phyugs thag pas bsdams te lus 'dar shang shang byed 'dug
g.yo tshul zhig / mtshan dgung 'khyags: 'jigs gnyis ka 'doms nas gzugs po 'dar shig shig byas byung / 'brug skad drag po bsgrags nas khang pa yang 'dar shig shig byed 'dug /
gzugs po g.yo tshul zhig / gangs khrod du phyin pas ha cang 'khyags te mgo lus tshang ma 'dar shum shum byas byung/
grang ngar ma bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur/ dro lug gis bshan pa mthong ma thag tu 'dar sig sig byas yong/ grang chu'i nang du zhugs 'phral lus 'dar sig sig byed/
'khyags 'jigs kyi rnam 'gyur/ 'khyags nas gzugs po 'dar sil sil byed kyi 'dug / dngangs skrag ma bzod par 'dar sil sil byed pa/
lus 'phar zhing dbugs 'tshang ba'i nyams/ glo bur du zhed snang drag po skyes nas re zhig 'dar had de bar lus pa/
khyab che ba'am rgya che ba/
khyab 'gro ba'am mched 'gro ba/ bag leb sob sob ja chu'i nang du btab ma thag tu 'dal 'gro ba/
1.(tha mi dad pa) mched pa/ snag tsha 'dis yi ge bris na 'dal nas klog mi thub pa zhig chags yong/ shog bur snum thigs pa gcig 'thor na rgya chen por 'dal 'gro ba red/ 2.(rnying) dal ba/
nyi ma lug khyim la slebs nas gang brtsi'i zla ba de'i bar du khyim ci tsam 'das pa'i grangs/
mi 'das rjes bsngo smon zhu ba/
1) tshe 'das nas lo 'khor skabs kyi mchod 'bul/ 2) tshe 'da' skabs kyi mchod 'bul/
tshe 'phos mi shi'i gnas tshul sbron pa'i brda/

1.'da' ba'i 'das pa, 2. 1) dus gsum gyis dbye ba phye ba'i nang gses shig / 'das pa'i dus/ 2) rtags 'jug skabs su bya byed tha dad dang mi dad gnyis ka'i bya ba byas zin pa'i don/ 3) gshin po/ 4) song zin pa'i rigs/
dus tshod 'das pa/ dud 'gro las ngan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel ba'i dus skabs de 'das pa'i char gyur pa/

ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug: pa bskal ba grangs med pa'i mdun du chos ci 'byung ba dang, las dge sdig ci spyad pa'i lo rgyus thams cad ma 'khrul bar mkhyen pa, sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
sngar byon zin pa'i sangs rgyas/
bya ba byas zin pa ston pa'i tshig /
khyim der slebs nas zhag ci tsam 'das pa'i: grangs te brtsi bya gang yin gyi dus yan gyi zhag grangs yin

1) brtsi bya'i lo de'i zla ba dang po nas gang brtsi ba'i zla ba de'i bar gyi zla grangs/ 2) gza' rnams kyi tshes zla'i dkyil 'khor dang, nyin zla'i dkyil 'khor, khyim zla'i dkyil 'khor las sngar ci tsam 'das pa'i zla grangs/

'dir khyim lo gtso bas gza' rang rang gi zhag gsum mthun lo dang, drug cu'i skor mthun dag pa'i lo tshogs las ci tsam 'das zin pa dang, da lta gnam lo gang la gnas pa sogs dus skabs so sor ma 'dres par 'byed pa'i gzhir gal che ba zhig yin no/
slar sos pa:/ 'das log chos mdzad snang sa 'od 'bum/
thag nye ba dang, da lta ba ston byed kyi ming/ skabs 'di/ mi 'di/ lung pa 'di skyid po 'dug /

'di lta bu'i gtam mam 'di lta bu zer/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa/ skabs der ngas 'di skad ces dris pa yin/ rgyas pa'i tshig gis zhu ba 'di skad do/ khos de skad dris na khyod kyis lan 'di skad gdab par bya/
'di las gzhan med pa/ bsam blo 'di kho na ma gtogs gzhan med/

thag nye ba'i dus dang gnas/ zla dus tshes grangs 'di ga'i nang du nad gzhi drag yong ba'i nges pa mi 'dug / sa gnas 'di ga'i gnas tshul dang, de ga'i gnas tshul 'dra po mi 'dug / khyod rang 'di ga rang du sdod/
'di gcig pu'am 'di rang/ gnas 'di nyid/ dus 'di nyid/ mi 'di nyid/
tsam zhig / lo ltar thon 'bor grangs tshad: 'di snyed cig byung zhes khams dwangs shod dgos
'di lta bu yin te/ dus gsum ni 'di lta ste, da lta ba dang, 'das pa, ma 'ongs pa'o/ 'dus byas chos ni 'di lta ste, bum pa dang, ka ba lta bu'o/

'di nang bzhin/ ca lag 'di lta bu dkon po 'dug / don gyi gnas tshul 'di lta bu mang po yod/ yi ge 'di lta bur bris shig / 'di lta bu min na gzhan pa ci zhig yin/ 'di lta bu thos nas khong khro me lce ltar 'bar ba/
'di nang bzhin du/ mi tshang ma bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'di ltar du yong ba shog / khyod la 'di ltar bshad kyis nyon/ khyod kyi 'dod tshul 'di ltar yin na ha cang thal drags song/
sam 'di tsho:/ mi 'di dag thams cad rdog rtsa gcig tu bsgril ba/
'di bzhin nam, 'di lta bu/ srol rgyun bzang po 'di 'dra ba zhig / nus pa 'di 'dra ba zhig /
thag nye ba nges gzung gi sgra zhig / gnas lugs 'di ni nam yang yong mi shes pa zhig red/
mi 'di'am 'di nyid/ 'di pa'i gdong 'di gar phyag bris 'byor byung/ bang chen 'di pa/ 'phrin skyel 'di pa/
las gzhan med pa:/ 'di 'ba' zhig bden/
'di'i ngang ngam 'di'i 'phror/ zla 'phul zhag 'phul gyi phyi bshol 'di mur ma lus par mgyogs myur hur brtson gyis shig /
'di ga'i rgyun/ drang min gyi spyod tshul 'di mus su bzhag na mi 'grig / yun ring bar du 'di mus la hur brtson byas na nges par legs 'grub thub yong/

nges bzung gi spom tshad/ mang nyung 'di tsam gyis chog / tshig 'di tsam gyis don rtogs par mi nus/ yo byad nyung ngu 'di tsam gyis mi mang la mi ldeng/ skad cha mang po 'dug kyang don snying 'di tsam du zad do/
'di nang bzhin dang, 'di dang 'dra ba/ ka dpe 'di mtshungs shig khyod kyis bris dang/
'di lta bu/ khos blo sems gcig bsgril gyis dpe cha lta bzhin 'dug khyod kyis kyang 'di bzhin gyis/ mi 'di bzhin/ yi ge 'di bzhin/
yin min mtshams 'byed kyi gsal kha/ gnas lugs yong rkyen 'di yin 'di min kha gsal bshad na go bde ba yong/
'di ga rang/ las ka 'di rang/ ca lag 'di rang yag po 'dug
'di gras/ gnas tshul 'di rigs snang med du 'jog mi rung/
(tha dad pa) bting ba, gding ba, thing,, sa la 'grems pa'am sgrig pa/ 'char gzhi 'ding ba/ lam du rdo bcal bing ba/ bzhugs gdan 'ding ba/

1) don gnyer/ lto gos kyi 'du 'god byed pa/ nam mkha'i khyon la mdzub mo'i 'du 'god kyis tshad 'jal bar mi nus pa/ 2) gra sgrig / 'char gzhi 'du 'god byed pa/ 3) phar gtong tshur len gyi byed sgo/ 'char gzhi'i 'du 'god tshags tshud po 'dug /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig las 'gan ni 'bru dngul bsdu tshags kyis dmag phogs go sgrig byed rgyu de yin/
'tshogs shing 'phrad pa/ me rdo dang me lcags 'du 'phrod byas na spra bar me 'bar yong/ drod gsher gyi 'du 'phrod la brten nas lo tog skye ba/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'dus pa, 'du ba, 'dus,, tshogs pa/ khyu 'dus pa/ 'dus sdod/ brgya tshogs stong 'dus/ chu bo thams cad rgya mtshor 'du/ gzhon nu pho mo de gnyis khyo shug tu 'du ba/ khyod tsho tshang ma 'dir 'dus shig / 2. 1) lus khams sam gzugs phung/ 'du ba mi bde/ 2) (rnying) nor rdzas/
khams mi bde ba'am, lus kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa/
lus kyi 'byung bzhi cha snyoms pa'am bde ba/ 'du ba snyoms shing nad med bde bar 'gyur/
lus kyi cha shas phra mo dang bcas pa'i gnas su phan tshun mtshan nyid mi mthun yang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis gcig la gcig brten nas 'du ba rnam pa gsum ste, rlung dang, 'khris pa, bad kan bcas so/
nad gcig bcos na gcig gi gshed du babs nas gso dka' bar gyur pa'i srog gcod nad dgu'i ya gyal zhig ste, dper na, tsha ba bcos na grang ba'i gshed du babs pa lta bu/
sems mngon par 'du byed pa ste, 'du byed kyi phung po dang don gcig go/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtag pa/ 'du byed po bdag yin/ 'du byed pa bdag gnas pa/
las kyi kun 'byung ste, sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i gzhi dkar nag gi las mngon par 'du byed pa'o/
nyon mongs pa can gyi chos rnams bsal zhing nyon mongs pa can med par gnas pa/
khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang don gcig

phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, sems dang mtshungs ldan dang, mtshungs ldan min pa'i 'du byed sogs sems yul lam dmigs pa la mngon par 'du byed pa dang, yul sna tshogs la sems g.yo zhing skul bar byed pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems pa du ma spungs pa'o/

lag rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang: gses ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te bsod nams kyi las dang, bsod nams min pa'i las dang, mi g.yo ba'i las bsags pas kun gzhi la sa bon 'debs par byed pa'i las mngon par 'du byed pa'o/
bsod nams kyi las, bsod nams ma yin pa'i las, mi g.yo ba'i las bcas gsum/
te 'da' ba: 'du byed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsdus ming,

pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa: dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas yin pa gzhir byas nas, tshangs chen ma gtogs pa'i gzugs khams bcu drug gang yang rung ba'i gnas su skyes nas lam la 'bad rtsol med par 'da' ba'i rigs can/

su mya ngan las 'das pa: dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi ya gyal, tshangs chen ma gtogs pa'i gzugs khams bcu drug gang yang rung ba'i gnas su skyes nas lam la 'bad rtsol dang bcas te 'da' ba'i rigs can/
'du byed med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsdus ming,
nyi mas bum pa'i khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla dang po'i ming/
'du ba dang tshogs pa/ mi mang po 'du tshogs byas nas dus chen gyi dga' skyid la rol ba/

1) yul rkyen la brten nas byung ba'i brel zing gi rnam pa/ sdod gnas 'gol po zhig yin stabs, 'du 'dzi med pa'i khu sim bag phebs shig byung/ 'grul pa rnams 'du 'dzoms kyis 'du 'dzi zang ngi zing ngi zhig byung/ 2) g.yeng ba/ 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng gi ngang du ma sdod/
'du ba dang, 'dzoms pa/ mi mang po 'du 'dzoms kyi thog nas gros bsdur byed pa/
mi mang po 'dus pa'i zang zing/

1) bsam pa'am, mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ spun zla'i 'du shes/ pha bu'i 'du shes/ 'du shes 'khrul ba/ 'du shes ngan pa/ mes rgyal gyi 'du shes/ rkun por pha ma'i 'du shes 'jog pa/ 2) kun 'gro lnga'i ya gyal, yul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan ma rang stobs kyis 'byed pa'i shes pa'o/

phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, don dang, tha snyad la mtshan mar 'dzin pa lta bu, rkyen gsum mam bzhi sogs 'dus te shes par byed pas yul gyi khyad par ram spu ris ma 'dres par so sor 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems pa du ma spungs pa'o/

1) yin pa la min dang, min pa la yin zhes sogs lta bu bsam pa phyin ci log tu bsgyur ba/ gnas tshul dngos 'brel ma yin pa zhig la dngos 'brel yin pa lta bur 'du shes bsgyur ba/ 2) bsam blo'i 'khyer so gsar rnying brje ba/ bsam tshul rnying pa skyon du mthong nas rnam pa gsar pa zhig tu 'du shes bsgyur ba/

chos 'chad dus kyi 'du shes lnga ste, rang la sman pa dang, chos la sman, nyan pa po la nad pa, de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa, chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa bcas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa/
don la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang, tha snyad la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes gnyis/

1) mtshan bcas kyi 'du shes dang mtshan med kyi 'du shes, rgya chung ba'i 'du shes, rgya che ba'i 'du shes, tshad med pa'i 'du shes, ci yang med pa'i 'du shes bcas drug / 2) chos nyan pa'i skabs kyi 'du shes drug ste, rang la nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes, chos la sman lta bu'i 'du shes, dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa lta bu'i 'du shes, nan tan nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes, chos kyi tshul la ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes, de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes rnams so/

shes med min skye mched kyi rnam thar: gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi'i nang gses, 'du shes 'di ni nad dang shu ba dang zug rngu lta bu ste skyon can yin no zhes bkag nas je phra je phrar gyur pa dang 'du shes gtan nas med na yang rmongs par 'gyur te mi rung ngo snyam nas 'du shes phra mo la gnas te snyoms par zhugs pa ste yod min med min skye mched rdzogs par byas pa'o/
'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched

gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i nang gses, ci yang med do snyam du sems pa'i 'du shes de yang nad dang zug rngu lta bu yin pas spang ngo zhes je phra je phrar bkag nas 'du shes rags pa med cing, 'du shes de gtan med par gyur na yang mi rung ngo snyam nas 'du shes shin tu phra ba med pa min pa ste srid pa'i rtse mo la gnas pa'o/
'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi lha
gzugs med kyi khams yod min med min gyi gnas su skyes pa'i lha/
'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug des 'phangs nas 'du shes med pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i gang zag gi sems dang sems byung rnams 'gog pa'i ldan min 'du byed kyi gras shig /

'du shes med pa ba dang don gcig, ba: bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas 'bras bu che ba'i phyogs gcig na grong las dgon pa'i tshul du yod cing, der skyes ma thag dang 'chi ba'i tshe ma gtogs pa, sems dang sems byung gi rgyu ba 'gags nas bskal chen mang por gnas pa'i gang zag cig

snyoms 'jug dge rgyas kyi 'dod chags dang bral: la khams gong ma'i 'dod chags dang ma bral ba zhig gis yid la byed pa'i sgo nas sems sems byung rgyun brtan pa ma yin pa 'jug shes drug po rnams gnas skabs su 'gog par byed pa ldan min 'du byed kyi gras shig /
bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas 'bras bu che ba'i phyogs gcig na yod pa'i lha/
tshur 'du ba dang phar 'thor ba gnyis/
lag shogs che ba dang, 'gro song la mi 'dzem pa/ 'tsho ba skyid po'i ched du 'du lhong che ba byed/
sdod sa'i gral/ 'dug gral gyi gral 'gor bzhugs pa/
1) sdod pa'i rnam 'gyur/ 2) byed lugs byed stangs/ spyi tshogs kyi 'dug stangs/ rgyus mnga' med pa'i yul lung gsar pa zhig la slebs pas 'gro stangs 'dug stangs mi shes pa/
sdod sa'i gnas/ 'dug gnas spro po/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) sdod pa dang gnas pa/ phran sngar rgyun ltar 'di gar 'dug yod/ kho tsho gdan la 'dug ste gtam shod pa/ 2) mngon pa ste yod pa'i don/ kha sa tshogs 'du grol dus mi de gang du 'dug gam/ chu tshod gsum pa'i thog la las khungs nang su 'dug gam mi 'dug / da lta chu khol ma 'dug / deng skabs khong pe cin la bzhugs 'dug / mi des las ka 'di la phan thogs yong ba mi 'dug / bsam tshul mi gcig pa'i mi tshos tshogs 'du'i thog nas rtsod pa rgyag gi 'dug / 2. red, yin par go ba'i don/ kha sang bstan pa'i glog brnyan de yag po 'dug / yag po byas blta dus nga'i stod thung 'di chung drags 'dug
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lhan cig dben pa skyabs yod du sdod pa/

nyes byas kyi sde tshan gsum pa, stan la 'dug pa'i sde tshan la, khyim bdag sogs kyis ma bsgos pa dang, srog chags yod med sogs ma brtags pa dang, lus kyi lcid phab pa dang, rkang pa bsnol te brkyangs pa dang, brla bsnol ba dang, long bu brtsegs pa dang, hor 'dug gi rnam pas rkang pa khri'i 'og tu bkug pa dang, rkang pa phan tshun gdangs pa dang, 'doms mthong bar byas pa bcas kyis bsdad na nyes byas su 'gyur ba ste dgu/
sdod pa'i snga phyi rim pa/ nged so ba la 'dug res tshang/
1) bza' zla/ 2) mnyam sdod rogs pa/ 'gro rogs 'dug rogs/
1) sdod stangs/ 2) spyod tshul/ za lugs 'gro lugs 'dug lugs gsum, drin chen pha ma'i bslab bya yin/
1. (tha dad pa) btud pa, gdud pa, thud,, gus pa/ zhabs la 'dud pa/ mgo btud pa/ yan lag lnga sa la btud pa'i phyag byed pa/ gzhan dag gis re zhing 'dud par byed pa/ 2. gus pa'i rnam 'gyur/
1) gus 'dud byed pa'i lugs/ 2) gus 'dud byed pa'i khul/
gshin por mya ngan byed pa'i rtags/ nyin bdun ring 'dun byed pa/
gros bsdur/ las don byed stangs kyi skor la 'dun gros yang yang byas pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) don gnyer 'dod pa dang, re ba byed pa/ tshan rig la 'dun pa/ rang gi mes rgyal la 'dun pa'i mi zhig yin phyin de la phan thogs pa'i las don kho na byed dgos/ 2./ 1) 'dod pa'i ming tsam/ chang 'thung ba'i 'dun pa med na ja 'thungs shig / skyid 'dod dal 'dod kyi 'dun pa bzlog pa/ gsar brje byed pa'i 'dun pa nyams pa med par yid la bcangs pa/ 2) «tstshdan» shakya thub pa'i nyan thos drug sde'i ya gyal zhig / 3) yul nges lnga'i nang gses, gang 'dod pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas de don gnyer gyi shes pa brtson 'grus kyi rten byed pa'i byed las can no/
mi mnga' ba: sangs rgyas ni bla na med pa'i byang chub dang, sems can ma lus pa'i don la mos pa 'dun pa nyams pa med pa ste sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge 'dun las la mi mthun pa med par bya ba'i phyir du 'dun pa phul bar slar 'dun pa phyir byin cig ces ldog tu bcug pa/

gso sbyong sogs kyi las gral du dngos su zhugs ma thub kyang blo mthun par bya phyir 'dun pa 'bul ba ste, yul las byed pa'i dge 'dun dang, dge 'dun des 'dun pa len pa la bskos pa'i dge slong la, las gral der 'du ba'i rkyen ma tshang ba'i gang zag gis las la mi mthun pa med cing mthun pa sgrub pa'i ched du, 'dun pa 'bul ba'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa/
blo sems rtse gcig sgril:/ rang nyid yar thon yong ba'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu bzung nas slob sbyong byed pa/

rnal 'byor lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste rnying ma'i gzhung rnams su, tshogs lam gyi dus su stong pa'i 'od gsal dang snang ba'i lha sku gnyis ka 'dun pas drangs pa'i mos pa tsam gyi yul du byed pas 'dun pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/
'phrad 'dod kyi 'dun pa, mi bral bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa, don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa bcas gsum/
'dun pa drag po'i gus sbyor dang, brtson 'grus rgyun ldan gyi rtag sbyor la brten nas byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/

/ 1) thabs jus/ gtan gyi 'dun ma/ 'dun ma slob 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin, 'dun pa drag po'i gus sbyor dang, gros mol/ las don 'di'i skor nga tshos 'dun ma'i thog nas gros bsdur gyis thag gcod byed dgos/ rtsod gzhi'i don gnad 'gal 'dzol che bas re zhig 'dun ma ma 'grig pa red/
gros byed sa/ 'dun sar gros byed pa/
ri rab kyi rtse mor lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer gyi phyi rol lho nub mtshams su sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'du ba'i gnas shig /
kha mchu bsdum pa'i yi ge/ phan tshun gnyis phyogs la 'dum khra btang ba/
'dum thabs byed pa:/ phan tshun rtsod rnyog gang yod kha rul nang bshang gi sgo nas 'dum 'grig byed pa/
bsdums nas mthun por gyur pa/ phan tshun gnyis kas la nyag mdzo gzengs byas pas 'dum mthun gang legs byung ba/
stabs bde po/ gtam tshig nyog med pa'i 'dum bde po bshad dgos/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 'dums pa, 'dum pa,, 1) mthun pa dang, 'grig pa/ kho tsho'i bar gyi 'gal ba rnams 'dum pa'i gnas med/ gnas skabs kyi rtsod gzhi legs par 'dums song/ 2) (rnying) thung du 'gro ba/ 2. bar dpang/
1) 'dum byed pa'i gnas/ 2) stabs bde sa/ skor 'khyog mi dgos par lam 'dum sa nas 'gro ba/ 3) thag nye sa/
dal brel snyoms pa'i 'gro stangs shig / rtas 'dur 'gros brgyab nas 'gro ba/
1) dal brel snyoms par 'gro ba/ rta 'dur rgyugs btang na zhon mkhan la bde po mi yong/ 2) mchog dman drag zhan khyad med mnyam rgyugs kyi khral/
mchog dman drag zhan khyad med mnyam sgrub kyi khral/
dal brel snyoms par rgyug tshul/ kho rang 'dur 'dur brgyugs nas bdag gi mdun du slebs/ sdar ma rnams spyang mo 'dur 'dur gyis bros/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) dal brel ran par 'gro ba/ rta bzhon te 'dur nas phyin pa/ 2) sil bur gyur nas zhig pa/ shog bu chu'i nang du 'dur ba/ sha ha cang tshos drags pas 'dur ba/ 3) mnan te non pa/ khrims 'og la 'dur ba/ phyugs chag bsgor nas tshar ma 'dur ba/ 2. 'gro stangs kyi khyad par zhig / 'dur chen byed 'jug pa/ 'dur 'jam/
pham par byed pa'am 'os thob/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po de, seng chen nor bu'i 'dul skal red/
'dul ba'i bcas khrims te dam chos 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i spang blang gi khrims/

1. (tha dad pa) btul ba, gdul ba, thul,, ngan pa bzang por 'chos pa/ sa zhing 'dul ba/ mi ngan 'dul ba/ rta rgod 'dul ba/ dgra bo btul ba/ mi 'jam gyis 'dul, rang rtsub kyis 'dul/ gdul dka' ba/ 2. «binya» ltung ba sde lnga dang, ltung ba 'byung ba'i rgyu dang, ltung ba las ldang ba dang, ltung ba las nges par 'byung ba dang, gang la brten nas bslab pa bca' ba gang zag bslab pa bcas pa dngos, de'i rab tu dbye ba, ltung ba dang ltung med rnam par nges pa bcas don rnam pa brgyad ston pas 'dul ba zhes bya'o/
lo ts'a ba chen po rin chen bzang po'i dus su mnga' ris phyogs su dar ba'i 'dul ba'i lugs/

'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i bstan bcos shloo ka nyis stong bdun brgya dang, bam po dgu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa, pandi ta dzi na mi tra dang, lo ts'a ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'o/

so sor thar pa'i 'grel ba 'dul ba bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon khyad par bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bam po bcu gsum pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lentra bo dhi dang, zhu chen gyi lo ts'a ba bee ro tsa na rakshi tas bsgyur pa/
gtan la dbab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa: bam po gnyis pa, sho lo ka drug brgya pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/

sangs rgyas shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i nang gses, so thar gyi don zhib tu rnam par 'byed pa ste, dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed kyi so thar du ltung rkang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum po re re la, bslab pa 'cha' ba'i rgyu gleng gzhi, bslab pa bcas pa'i phan yon, bslab pa 'cha' ba'i tshul, ltung ba'i rnam gzhag ltung med, bslab bya ste don tshan drug drug gi sgo nas phal che bar bshad pa dang, rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun rgyas par bshad pa dang, dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed ltung rkang sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i skor rnams rgyas par ston pa'i gzhung/
'dul ba lung phran tshegs kyi bsdus tshig
'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud ces bya ba 'phad pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa bam po lnga pa, bal po'i pandi ta dza y'a ka ra dang, bod kyi lo ts'a ba pradzny'a kirtis bsgyur pa/
bsnyen par rdzogs nas sdom rgyun bar ma chad pa'i brtan pa'i yon tan dang, 'dul ba shes shing 'chad spel byed mkhas pa'i yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong/

cho ga : bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi gsum ste, dbyar gnas, gso sbyong, dgag dbye rnams tshul ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa gsal bar ston pa'i lag len gyi cho ga , dus rabs bco lnga par 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/

sangs rgyas shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i nang gses, gzhung dam pa'am, gzhung bla ma zhes pa yongs rdzogs bod du 'gyur med la, de las zhu ba dang 'dul byed, gleng gzhi, gtam gzhi sogs le'u bcu gcig da lta yod pa/
'dul ba gzhung dam pa dang don gcig
sangs rgyas shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i theg dman gyi 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi gzhung bzhi ste, 'dul ba rnam 'byed dang, 'dul ba lung gzhi dang, 'dul ba phran tshegs dang, 'dul ba gzhung dam pa'o/

sangs rgyas shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i nang gses, pu ti gnyis kyi tshad du langs pa'i sho lo ka stong phrag bcu bdun dang bdun brgya yod pa dang, sgo rnam pa brgyad yod cing, sgo re re la spyi'i sdom re re, de re re'ang sdom gyi tshid su bcad pa bcu bcu'i sgo nas ston pa'i gzhung/
'dul ba gzhung dam pa dang don gcig
sangs rgyas shakya thub pas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i nang gses, gzhi bcu bdun gyi rnam gzhag gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhung ngo/
sngar rgya gar gyi slob dpon shakya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya, sho lo ka sum brgya yod pa'i bstan bcos shig /
'dul ba la lhad zhugs pa ste rung min gzhi bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa'i rnam gzhag dang 'gal ba'i 'dul ba/
dus rabs bco lnga par 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i skabs su gleng gzhi ji ltar byung ba'i tshul brjod pa rje dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa dang 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa zhig kyang yod/
bod rgyal mu ne btsan po'i skabs lha sar btsugs pa'i dus mchod chen po zhig /

lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa, gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang nas gleng gzhi'i sde dang, rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde dang, de lta bu byung ba'i sde dang, skyes pa rabs kyi sde rnams 'dul bar bsdus pa/
so thar gyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung/
sems gnas dgu'i lnga pa, ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan bsams nas de la dga' ba/
1) rta dang glang po sogs phyugs rigs gyong po rnams lhing po bzo thabs/ 2) gser dngul sogs kyi lhad bton nas mnyen po 'chos thabs/
rgya gar gyi 'dul 'dzin slob dpon mchog gnyis te yon tan 'od dang, shakya 'od/
sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya'i zhing khams/
mnyam du 'dzoms shing lhan cig gnas pa/ tshogs khang nang du 'thus mi mang po 'dus 'khod yod pa/ mi rigs khe gtsang gcig 'dus 'khod kyi yul lung/
lam sogs 'dzoms pa'i 'gag / mi mang po 'dus mdor phyin na 'tshang ga chen po yong/ 'phred thig dang, gzhung thig gnyis kyi 'dus mdo nas drang thig gzhan zhig 'debs pa/
dge 'dun pa mang po 'dus pa'i sde ste dgon pa/
sna tshogs 'doms pa'i nad/ rlung mkhris 'dus nad/

1. 'du ba'i 'das pa, 2./ 1) tshogs pa/ 2) dge 'dun pa/ 3) tshigs bcad rtsom tshul zhig ste, brjod bya'i don gcig la rjod byed sho lo ka du ma yod pa la bya tshig kyang du ma yod pa/ 4) (mngon) lus/ 5) gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsdus tshig

theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las de bzhin gshegs: pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum dang le'u bzhi pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzny'a de wa dang, lo ts'a ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur pa/
'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs
bam po brgyad dang le'u bcu gsum pa, pandi ta shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bande ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/
'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa
mdo sde zhig bam po bcu dang le'u brgyad pa, rgya'i mkhan po hwa shang zab mo la sogs pa dang, lo ts'a ba bande rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/
'phags pa klu sgrub dang, sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs so so nas brgyud pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gnyis/
rlung dang, mkhris pa, bad kan bcas mnyam du 'dus pa'i nad de, mtshon byed bad kan smug po lta bu'o/
rlung dang, mkhris pa, bad kan bcas mnyam du 'dus pa las byung ba'i tsha ba'i nad cig /
1) mi mang po 'dzoms pa'i tshogs sde/ 2) dge 'dun pa'i tshogs pa/
gzhi gcig la 'dzoms shing thug pa/ lcags lam khag gsum 'dus phrad 'byung sa'i grong khyer der 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren 'khrug po yong/
rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus nas byas pa'am skyes pa ste, phung lngas bsdus pa'i chos rnams so,
rgyu rkyen dang, de ma thag rkyen, dmigs rkyen, bdag rkyen bcas bzhi/
rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa las byas pa'am skyes pa'i dngos po ste, phung lngas bsdus pa'i chos rnams so/
skye ba'i mtshan nyid dang, rga ba'i mtshan nyid, gnas pa'i mtshan nyid, mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid bcas bzhi/
stong pa nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i khams gsum snod kyi 'jig rten gyi chos nyid/
sa khul zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi pa snam rdzong khongs su yod/
sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i sbyor ba/ sman sna mang po 'dus sbyor byas pa de nus pa che/
skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'am dngos po ma yin pa/

mngon pa kun btus ltar na, 'dus ma byas kyi chos brgyad de, de bzhin nyid gsum dang, 'du shes med dang, 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi dus kyi sems 'gag pa'i gnas skabs gnyis dang, 'dus ma byas gsum bcas brgyad do/
stong pa nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams dngos po yod snyam na yang dngos po med pa'am stong pa'o/
rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'i chos bzhi ste, so sor brtags te 'gog pa dang, so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa dang, nam mkha' dang, de bzhin nyid bcas bzhi/
nam mkha'i khams dang stong nyid/
mngon pa mdzod kyi lud su 'dus ma byas kyi chos gsum ste, so sor brtags 'gog dang, brtags min 'gog dang, nam mkha' ste gsum mo/
rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ka 'dus pa'i rtags ston pa'i smyo byed nad kyi nang tshan zhig /
1) 'dus pa'i tshogs pa'i bsdus tshig 2) 'dus shing tshogs pa/
sngar rgya gar gyi bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon zhig /
rlung mkhris bad kan gsum po 'dus te, nad rtags ma nges pa ston pa'i rims nad cig /
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, mtshams nang du bsam pa mi mthun pas dge 'dun spyi las logs su 'dus te za ba/
spyi gtsug dang, mtshogs ma, sdud sgo gsum gyi bsdus ming zhig /

khri 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di, mang srong mang btsan dang 'bro bza' khri long gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs so drug pa yin la, yab 'das nas zhag bdun lon pa na skyes, mgar btsan snya ldom bu dang mgar khri 'bring btsan brod gnyis kyis chab srid bskyangs, 'di'i ring la rtsal po che mi bdun byung ba deb ther na gsal, ga gon dang, hor dang, sog po btul te, da shab hab kyi la rgyud la gtug par mnga' mdzad de, mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus, lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i thog 'jang gi yul du dmag drangs te der 'das/
na grangs brgyad dgur slebs pa'i rta drel/
(rnying) mer lde ba ste bsro ba/ grang dus nyi mar 'de ba/
'jim sku bzheng skabs 'bur kong snyoms byed kyi yo byad gdbyu gu zhig /
lha sku bzheng skabs 'jim pa 'jam du gtong byed dbyu gu rtse snyung snyung min pa zhig /
lha sku bzheng skabs 'jim par ri mo rtsub po 'don byed dbyu gu zhig /
(yul) 'degs khal rer nya ga nyi shu re yod pa/
bteg nas tshad 'jal ba/ sha mar sogs 'degs 'gyogs byas nas 'tshong ba/ mdzod khang du da yod 'bru mar rnams 'degs 'gyogs byas pa/
(yul) 1) sa gdan sogs 'thag dus shing sgrom la rgyu dkris te dam du gtong ba'i don// 2) khang pa rdib zhom bzo bcos byed skabs gdung ma sogs kyi 'og nas 'degs pa/
zhu yig dang mnyam du 'bul rgyu'i dngos rdzas/

(tha dad pa) bteg pa, gdeg pa, theg , 1) gyen du slong ba dang bkyag pa/ ka bas gdung ma 'degs pa/ go sa mthon po zhig la bteg pa/ lcags gdung chen po yar 'degs pa/ 2) rgya mar 'gyogs pa/ lci yang gang yin 'degs rgyar 'degs pa/ 3) 'gro ba/ byes su bteg pa/ phyogs 'di la zhabs sor bteg pa/
srang tshad dam, nya gar 'ded pa'i tshad/
nya gar 'degs pa la 'degs dang, bre dang 'bo la 'jal ba la gshor zer/ 'bru rigs phar sprod tshur len skabs 'degs gshor phra zhib byed pa/
ldang ba'i tshod/ bza' btung 'deng tshod yod pa/
skul 'ded gtong ba/ bu lon ngo skyed grangs tshang 'phral mar dgos zhes 'ded skul tsha po gtong ba/

(tha dad pa) bdas pa, bda' ba, ded,, 1) mthar skrod pa dang, rjes su snyeg pa/ dgra bo gang nas 'ongs sa de nyid kyi bar phyir log tu bda' ba/ 2) skul ba dang, byed du 'jug pa/ khal ma bdas nas ga ler phyin pa/ phyugs rdzi phru gu gcig gis sgo phyugs rnams rtswa khar 'ded pa/ bun bdag gis bu lon ded pa/ dpon ngan gyis khral 'ul 'ded pa/ 3) rtsi ba'am rtsad gcod pa/ rgyu rkyen gang yin bdas te khungs su bskyal ba/ rid pas 'ded pa/
bu lon nam g.yar dngos sogs phyir len pa'i bda' 'ded/ gcig mjug gnyis bstud kyis bu lon 'ded sbyang byed pa/
bu lon dang, g.yar dngos sogs yang yang 'ded pa/ bun bdag gis chad bun 'ded sbyang rim byed kyi gtser sun gtong ba/
zhing btab nas bdag gnyer byed pa/
rang gi 'thung jar 'debs rgyu'i ja/ ja 'di tshong ja ma red 'debs ja red/
dbyar bsnyal bslang byed pa'i sa zhing gi so nam lta bu/
sa zhing dge bed spyod mkhan

(tha dad pa) btab pa, gdab pa, thob,, 1) gsar du 'dzugs pa/ shing son 'debs pa/ 'bru son 'debs pa/ thang chen du dmag gur btab pa/ grong khyer gsar du 'debs pa/ dgon pa btab pa/ tshal zhing btab pa/ 2) rgyag pa dang, byed pa/ btang yig la rgyas btab pa/ gzugs por nad kyis 'debs pa/ ngan sngags kyis btab pa/ 'gro rtsis btab pa/ las don gyi gros 'debs pa/ dran skul 'debs pa/ ja la tshwa 'debs pa/ zug gzer 'debs pa/ 3) zhu 'bul byed pa/ smon lam 'debs pa/ gsol ba btab pa/ ngo sprod 'debs pa/
sa bon 'debs pa dang shing 'dzugs pa/
son ma bshos gong tsam la rgyag pa'i lud/
'og skor ba ste, sran shul la nas 'debs pa lta bu/
dkyil nas bdams te sgrug pa:/ 'dems sgrug byed pa'i 'gran bsdur/
mang po'i nang nas gang rung zhig sgrug pa'i don du go ba'i 'dam pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig

1) spyi dmangs rnams kyis khrims lugs ltar rgyal khab kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyi 'thus mi 'dems bsko byed pa'i dbang cha/ 2) rtsa 'dzugs sna tshogs kyi khongs mi rnams kyis rang rang gi rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'go khrid pa'am 'thus mi 'dems bsko byed pa'i dbang cha/
shing zhig lus gso ba dang gzer 'jags pa'i nus pa can/
spyang grung dang, rdzi gsang ngam, sbi gsang/ pho mo rang 'do che chung da res red/
rta/ 'do ba rta yi bang dang 'dra/
gnad 'gag gam, khe nyen sogs go shes kyi bsam blo med pa/ 'do med pa/
gnad 'gag gam khe nyen sogs dpyod pa'i bsam blo/ kho la 'do zungs yod med las don zhig mngags na shes yong/
gnad 'gag gam khe nyen sogs go shes kyi bsam blo yod pa/
: wa dang, ya ra la bzhi'i smad 'dogs can gyi ming gzhi/ wa ya ra/ la...gva gya gra...gla...

(tha dad pa) btags pa, gdags pa, thogs,, 'ching ba/ rta de sgo ra'i nang du btags yod/ phru gu de la ming zhig gdags dgos/ kho la phan btags pa/ lus la go mtshon 'dogs pa/ thugs la 'dogs pa/ dam la btags pa/ rgyu mtshan la rgyu mtshan can btags pa/ rgyu la 'bras bu btags pa/
1) smad 'dogs kyang yod la sngon 'jug kyang yod pa'i ming gzhi/ 'gyu bkra...2) 'dogs yig dang 'phul yig /
sogs la 'dogs byed lung thag brgyu sa'i: mig khung
gdags gzhi gang yin la 'dod pa'i ming tshig /
bar snang du 'gel ba'i bca' zam/
ya ra la'i 'dogs yig bzhi/ wa ya ra...la...
dngos spyad gyen du 'dogs byed kyi lung thag /
sha 'khyag skam gtong ba ste dgun kha sha lcug thag par bkal nas 'khyag btang ste skam par 'dogs sha btang ba zer/
(tha mi dad pa) dong ba, 'dong ba, dengs,, 'thon pa'am, 'gro ba/ rang gnas su dengs shig / gos 'khrud du 'dong/ lam bzang de'i thog nas 'dong dgos/ nam mkhar dong ba/ rgyal kha'i phyogs su dong ba/

'dod pa'i khams 'di'i sems can rnams ni kham zas dang 'khrig pa la 'dod chags dang bcas shing 'dod yon lngas 'tsho ba'i phyir dang, snod kyang 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi gnas yin pas de ltar brjod/
spang drug 'dod pa'i khams 'dir sgom lam: gyis spang bar bya ba ma rig pa dang 'dod chags dang, khong khro dang, nga rgyal dang, 'jig lta dang, mthar lta bcas drug

spang so gnyis: 'dod par sdug bden gyi spang bya bcu dang, kun bden gyi spang bya bdun, 'gog bden gyi spang bya bdun, lam bden gyi spang bya brgyad bcas mthong spang gi phra rgyas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par mngon pa mdzod las gsungs/
tsha dmyal brgyad kyi gnas brgyad dang, yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i gnas gnyis te ngan 'gro'i gnas rigs bcu dang, mi'i gnas gling bzhi dang, 'dod lha rigs drug gi gnas drug bcas nyi shu/
rang gi 'dod don kho na 'grub thabs byed pa/ mi drang po min pa tshos 'dod khyer kho na byas yong/
'dod pa thams cad/ bya ba 'dod dgur grub pa/ dga' bde'i dpal la 'dod dgur spyod pa/

1) rang 'dod kho na tsam/ ma bsams 'dod rgyal gtam la gtad so med/ 2) ming brda 'dogs tshul zhig ste, dngos por thog mar brda' sbyor ba na rgyu mtshan la ma brten par brda sbyor mkhan gyi 'dod pa dbang btsan du byas nas rang dgar btags pa'i ming, dper na, sa, chu, me, rlung zhes pa lta bu'o/ 3) 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i bsdus tshig
'dod rgyal gyi ming dang don gcig
nges tshig gi 'grel bshad dang rgyu mtshan gang yang brjod rgyu med par rang 'dod kho nas thog mar sbyar ba'i brda/
ma brtags par dran tshad gang byung du smra ba/
cha bcu gsum du byas pa'i cha, de yi gzugs bug gzugs bug cha 'dod pas bgos na ri mkha' ri'i char 'gyur/

rtsa nyon drug gi nang gses, khams gsum pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po la chags pa ste srid pa'i sdug bsngal skyed par byed pa'o/ ming gi rnam grang la brkam chags dang, mngon 'dod, mngon zhen, chags pa, rnyed 'dod, thob 'dod, 'dod pa, 'dod spro, zhen pa, yid kyi shing rta, re ba, sred pa bcas so,
bya mchu dmar: 'dod chags srin bya'i gzugs su bkod pa/
phyi la chags pa, nang la chags pa, sdug bsngal la chags pa, gzugs la chags pa, 'jig tshogs la chags pa bcas lnga/
'dod nyon mtha' dag la chags pa dang bral ba ste dgra bcom pa/
'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog (mngon) sangs rgyas kyi
chos, ba'i lam: dgra bcom pa'i lam/
theg dman sa brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, mi slob pa'i sa'am phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mngon rtogs/
gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i 'dod chags dang, lag pa bcangs pa'i 'dod chags, rgod pa'i 'dod chags, bltas pa'i 'dod chags bcas bzhi/
zas gos sogs la ham 'dod med par gang byung ba zhig gis sems mgu ba/
1) gang 'dod ster ba/ 2) (mngon) 1, dpag bsam shing/ 2, rnam thos sras/
'o ma ci 'dod ster ba'am re ba skong bar byed pa'i ba/
dgos 'dod ster ba'i bum pa mchog /
'dod pa'i khams kyi rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu/
1) 'dod chags kyi skad cha/ 2) rang 'dod kyi gtam/
'dod pa'i lha mi gang rung gi lus rten/
blo sna thung ba/ las grwa'i 'go btsugs ma thag tu las mjug bsdu rgyu'i 'dod thag nye ba byed/
'dod don thog tu bab pa/ las don gang brtsams thams cad 'dod thog smin pa/
1) re don dang, dgos don/ 'dod don thams cad lhun gyis grub pa/ 2) khas blangs pa'i don/

ston pas yongs su bkag pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i 'dod yon gyi dngos por zhen pas bag med par longs su spyad pa'o/

'dod pa'i sgom spang rnams gcig tu bsdus shing, de che 'bring chung gsum dang, de re re la'ang che 'bring chung gsum gsum du phye bas dgu'o/

de ltar du 'dod ces lan btab pa'i don te, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag pa yin par thal, byas pa yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la 'dod lan btab pas sgra mi rtag pa yin par 'dod ces khas blangs pa'o/

khas len tshul/ sngon chad kyi 'dod lugs ltar lag len bya rtsis yod/

(tha dad pa) bton pa, gdon pa, thon,, 1) 'gog pa dang, logs su 'byed pa dang, 'byin pa/ dbul phongs sdug bsngal yong rkyen gyi rtsa ba bton pa/ mdzod khang nang nas 'bru mar 'don pa/ bsam 'char 'don pa/ rang skyon rang gis bton pa/ nus shugs yod dgu bton pa/ nga ro 'don pa/ skad gdangs 'don pa/ mchi ma bton pa/ 2) kha ton byed pa/ chos 'don pa/ sngags 'don pa/ dpe cha bton pa/ 3) mnga' gsol ba dang, gong du 'god pa/ khrir 'don pa/ che sar bton pa/ gru gzings nas skam sar bton pa/ 2. kyi snod nas phan tshun brje ba:/ khang pa 'don bshug byed pa/ snod spyad che chung nang gi dngos po phan tshun 'don bshug rgyag pa/

(tha dad pa) dor ba, dor ba, dor,, skyur ba dang, gtong ba, spong ba, 'bor ba/ dam pa'i spyod pa 'dor bar mi byed pa/ mi dge ba dor nas dge bar 'jug pa/ gzhung don du rang srog 'dor ba/ gom pa 'dor ba/

spang bya 'dor ba dang, blang bya len pa'i bsdus ming/ gang byed 'di byed nang nas khyed kyis 'dor len gnang rogs/
1) zhi zhing dul ba/ kho'i gshis ka 'dol 'dol ba zhig yin stabs, don med khong khro gtan nas byas mi yong/ 2) 'bol 'bol/ sa cha 'dol 'dol ba nas chu mig byung ba/
'bol po'am sob sob po/ sa gshis 'dol ba la sa bon gang btab skye/
sa 'bol po'am, 'jam po yod pa'i zhing ga /
'bol sa ste, sa gshin po'am legs pa/
sku 'dra'am, sku brnyan/ 'dra sku bzhengs pa/
1) cha sgrig pa'am 'dra 'dra gshibs te sgrig pa/ 2) ngo ma ma yin par de dang 'dra ba'i tshab sgrig pa/

rdzig po'am, yin mdog kha po/ mi de 'dra chags po zhig 'dug / skad cha 'dra chags po kho na bshad pa/ kha mkhas 'dra chags/

ltar snang du 'dra ba'i rdzun bsgrigs:/ kha nas 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig mang po zhig shod kyang don la ji yin mi shes/

(tha mi dad pa) ril ba dang 'gril ba/ rbab rdo ri bo'i ngos nas 'dril ba/
byang chub pa'am, myong ba thon pa/ lag rtsal la 'dris goms mthar phyin pa byung/

lo rgyus su bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su byung ba'i mi'u gdung drug gi ya gyal te, klungs shod kyi yul ris la dbang ba de'o/

1) khang pa thog gcig ma/ ka gdung lcam dang dral ma rnams, tshogs pas yid 'ong lding khang grub/ 2) 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang/ 3) (mngon) nyi khyim/
lding bzhin du 'khor ba/ dur khrod yod sar bya rgod lding 'khor byed pa/ skyed mos tshal du gser sbrang g.yu sbrang mang po lding 'khor gyis sgra snyan dir dir sgrog pa/
ras g.yab/ lding gur 'og tu zhabs bro 'khrab pa/
1) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs yul tsho so so'i mi ser gyi 'go byed/ 2) dmag mi'i zhal ngo/

sgra mi dag pa'am sgra mi gsal ba/

1.(tha mi dad pa) skad chen sgrog pa/ 'brug skad ldir ba/ 2. 1) skad chen po sgrog tshul zhig / me sgyogs ldir ldir rgyag pa/ 2) dbyibs 'bur tshul zhig / bum pa'i lto ldir ba/
(tha dad pa) ldugs pa, ldug pa, ldugs,, blug pa dang, 'jug pa/ snod kyi nang du chu ldugs nas bzhag pa/ gnas skabs bed spyod mi dgos pa'i dngos chas rnams sgam gyi nang la ldug pa/
(tha dad pa) btung ba blud pa'am sbyin pa/ phru gur 'o ma ldud pa/ rta khal rnams la chu ldud pa/ sman thang ldud pa/
ko byi la'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
glo lu ba dang lud pa lu bar phan pa'i sngo sman zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs te, ro kha mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma gso, rtsa kha sdom/
/ 1) sngo spyi, bza' nyan pa dang bza' mi nyan pa tshang ma 'dus/ me tog dang sngo tshal gyi ldum ra khag so sor 'jog dgos/ 2) sne'u zhes pa'i sngo bza' nyan pa zhig / 3) (rnying) mkhar/

zangs rtsi'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
