(tha mi dad pa) mnyen po'am 'bol por gyur pa dang, 'dal ba'am 'dag 'dag chags pa/ sha tshos drags nas ldur ba/ rgya thug skol yun ring drags pas ldur ba/
1) bag zan sla ba dang, phye ma bskol ba'i skyo ma/ 2) khu ba gar po/ 3) dri bzang sbangs pa'i chu/

sbrang chu bcad pa dang, mar gyi wu snyigs phyung ba, bu ram chur bsdus pa bcas kyi steng du nad gang sel bar byed pa'i sman phye bsrel te dkrug de'i steng ka ra zhib btags btab nas skyo ma gar po bsten dgos pa'i rnying zhing zhen pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i zhi byed kyi sde tshan zhig /
lde snol po'i bu sngar bod rgyal nyer gnyis pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
rgyal po lde brgyad kyi bsdus tshig
lde mig bdag sprod byed mkhan te dgon pa dang bla brang che khag gi gnyer pa/
se snol po lde'i bu sngar bod rgyal nyi shu pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
lde snol nam gyi bu sngar bod rgyal nyer gcig pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
lde rgyal po'i bu sngar bod rgyal nyer gsum pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
(tha dad pa) ldes pa, lde ba, ldes,, sro ba dang, tsha bar byed pa/ nyi ma lde ba/ me lde ba/
(yul) phyur ba'i bye brag cig ste, mar bton zin pa'i 'o ma la skyur rtsi btab nas bzos pa'i phyur ba bag leb lta bu zhig /
lde mig pa dang don gcig
lde mig ngo ma min pa/
(tha mi dad pa) bldegs pa, bldeg pa,, 1) g.yo ba/ sa ldeg pa/ 2) so rgyag pa'am sos blad pa/ sha rus 'byar ma zhig la so yang yang ldeg pa/
(yul) tshad long ba/ ras 'dis gos ldeng ba yod/
tshad kyis 'dang mi 'dang/ ras yug 'dis yas gung mas gung gnyis ka
shog lhe/ ldeb ma sum brgya tsam yod pa'i po ti gcig /
logs/ gyang gi ldebs/ ldebs su 'jog pa/ ri'i ldebs ngos/ ldebs logs 'jam po/
skya ldebs la bris pa'i ri mo/
rtsig pa'i ldebs kyi zhal ba/
skya ldebs la bris pa'i ri mo/ rtsig pa'i ldebs ris par du btab/
bris 'bur gang rung gi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rnam pa can/
'khyog po'i dgongs pa'am, drang po ma yin pa'i bsam pa/
gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa dang, mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa dang, gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa ste bzhi/
go rgyu can gyi gtam bskor te brjod pa/
'khyog po'i gtam mam, thad kar mi shod pa'i skad cha/
g.yo tshul lam 'gul tshul zhig / lhags pa lang dus rtswa shing tshang ma ldem ldem du 'gul yong/ ljon pa rnams 'bras bu bzang pos dud pa las rlung gis brgyab ste ldem ldem du 'gul 'dug /
lus bde zhing khyug pa:/ zlos gar 'khrab dus gzugs po ldem ldem lcug lcug gi sgeg nyams ston pa/
/ 1) 'khyog po'am drang min/ skad cha ldem por ma shod/ gom stabs ldem por 'gro ba/ 2) lus dang shing sogs phra zhing mnyen pa/ ldem por g.yo ba'i lus kyi gzhon nyams mdzes/
zhwa tog gi khyad par zhig /
'gul zhing g.yo ba'i nyams/ mkha' lding khyung gi ldem 'phrul mdzes/
gnyid mi khug pa dang, ngal sla ba, sha rim gyis rid 'gro ba, lto'i dang kha zhan pa bcas kyi mchin nad cig /

/ 1) dri ba dris lan byed mkhan mi gnyis kyis gab tshig dri bshad ngos 'phrod min la brten pas rgyal pham rtsi ba'i ngag rtsed kyi rnam grangs shig / lde'u'i tshig / 2) skar ma snron/ 3) lde gu dang 'dra,
1) phyir log myur ba/ 2) tshon mdog log sla ba/

rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul gsum pa, de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyi don ldog dang 'brel bas de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la med pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa ste, dper na, rtag pa yin na ma byas pas khyab pa lta bu mi mthun pa'i phyogs la med pa'am bsgrub bya ldog na rtags ldog pa'o/
rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las rnal ma bzhi'i nang gses, gsal ba de min na rtags de min pas khyab pa, dper na, mi rtag pa ma yin na byas pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/

log rtags gsal khyab pa sgo brgyad las: khyab pa phyin ci log pa bzhi'i nang gses gsal ba de ma yin na rtags de ma yin pa ma yin pas khyab pa, dper na, rtag pa ma yin na byas pa ma yin pa ma yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/

rtog pa la rdzas kyi yon tan du snang ba'i chos gang zhig dngos po ma yin pa, dper na, bum pa'i ldog pa dang, rtog ngor shar ba'i gzugs kyi mi rtag pa lta bu, rang gi dgag bya bcad pa'i ldog cha nas rtog ngor snang ba tsam du grub pa'i chos so/
ldog chos la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na, kun btags dang, ldan min 'du byed, yongs grub dang gsum mo/
dus tshigs nyer bzhi'i nang tshan, nyi ma lho bgrod mthar thug la dgun nyi ldog dang, byang bgrod mthar thug la dbyar nyi ldog go /

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) log pa dang, phyir 'ong ba/ nyi ma ldog pa/ lam nor ba las ldog nas 'gro sa yang dag par 'gro ba/ 2) rang bzhin gyis 'dor ba/ blang dor 'jug ldog / dge sdig 'jug ldog / 3) kha dog sogs yal ba dang, 'gyur ba/ ras kyi tshos ldog pa/ snying stobs phyir mi ldog pa/ 2. 1) phyogs dang ngos/ ka ba'i rang ldog / ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa/ 2) mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ yin ldog / min ldog / yod ldog / go ldog / 3) bzlog pa ste, dgag pa/ 4) rtog pa la rigs mi mthun pa'am tha dad pa las log par snang ba'i chos, dper na, bum pa ma yin pa las log tsam gyi cha ni bum pa'i ldog pa yin pa ste rtog pa la snang ba'i gzugs lta bu'o/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sgra don gang rung gi sgo nas dpe dang don gnyis mtshungs par gyur pa las slar khyad chos 'dra min gzhan zhig gi sgo nas mi mtshungs par dbye ba 'byed pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs bcu ni, gcig gi ldog pa can, gnyis kyi ldog pa can, sbyar ba'i ldog pa can, 'gog pa'i ldog pa can, gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can, rten gyi ldog pa can, dpe las dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can, mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can, mtshungs chos shugs dang 'byed byed sgras zin gyi ldog pa can, rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can bcas so/
ldog pa can gyi gzugs can

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang, dpe can gnyis phan tshun khyad chos 'dra ba ltar snang yang, khyad gzhi ngo bo mi mthun par mthong bas mtshungs pa las ldog pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, ldog pa tha dad med nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, sgra yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
ldog pa gcig pas ma grub pa gsum
gzhi rtags gcig pa, gzhi chos gcig pa, rtags chos gcig pa ste gsum mo/

log tu sbyar ba: chos mi mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang lnga'i nang gses, gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba 'god tshul gyi chos mi mthun pa'i dpe de ldog pa phyin ci log tu sbyar ba'i skyon la zer, sgra mi rtag ste, thogs pa med pa'i phyir, mi rtag pa yin na thogs bcas yin par mthong nas bum pa bzhin zhes pa lta bur mtshon na, thogs bcas thams cad mi rtag pa yin no zhes brjod pa lta bu rgol phyi rgol gnyis kas rdul phran thogs bcas yin la rtag pa yin par 'dod do/

chos mi mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang lnga'i nang gses, gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba 'god tshul gyi chos mi mthun pa'i dpe de ldog pa ma bstan pa'i skyon la zer, sgra rtag ste, thogs pa med pa'i phyir, chos mi mthun pa'i dper mi rtag pa rnams thogs bcas yin pas, dper na bum pa bzhin zhes brjod na, 'dir mi rtag pa nyid dang, thogs bcas su mthong ba tsam brjod pa las, thogs bcas ni mi rtag pa'i 'brel gzhir mi 'jog pas, thogs med kyi rtags su rtag pa'i bsgrub bya'i rjes su 'brang rgyu bstan ma thub pas skyon du gyur to/
rigs gcig pa'i bye brag cig ste, ldog pa rigs mthun pa, dper na, ka ba'i mi rtag pa dang, bum pa'i mi rtag pa gnyis lta bu'am, bum pa'i bdag med dang, ka ba'i bdag med gnyis lta bu'o/
ldog pa rigs gcig pa gnyis
ldog pa rigs gcig pala dbye na, sgrub ldog rigs gcig pa dang, dgag ldog rigs gcig pa ste gnyis so/
rang ldog dang, don ldog gzhi ldog ste gsum/
'gog bden gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
ldog pa tha dad du phye ba/
cig shos sam gzhan phyogs/ gsar brje'i ldog phyogs su 'gro ba/ gnas tshul ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba/
cho ga de las ldog ste bya ba'i tshul/
rang bzhin gyis tshur ldog pa'i shugs/
snga rabs kyi sgrung gtam las bshad pa'i mi'u gdung drug gi ya gyal zhig /
long ba/ mi ldong bar long 'khrid mkhan gcig yod/

(rnying) glan pa/ dris lan ldon pa/ bzang lan bzang ldon/ ngan lan ngan ldon/
(tha mi dad pa) ldobs pa, ldob pa,, lob pa'am goms pa/ ma shes pa rnams bslabs nas ldob pa/
1.ldab pa'i skul tshig 2.g.yo sgyu'am rdzu bag / ha go yang mi go ba'i khul byed pa de 'dra'i ldobs tsha ba la/ ngo shes kyang mi shes pa'i tshul gyi ldobs byed pa/

ma yin yin tshul byed mkhan/
/ 1) sa phyogs nges med rgyu ba'i 'khyam po/ mi 'khyam ldom po phyogs kun nyul/ 2) bdag bzung byed mkhan med pa'i phyugs sogs/ khyi 'khyam ldom po grong yul 'grims/
1.bsod snyoms/ gnas skor ba zhig ldom bu byed du byung ba/ 2.(rnying) myul ba/
bsod snyoms pa'am, slong mo ba/
byams po'i ldog phyogs te gzhan la 'khu ba'i ming/ gcig gis gcig la sdang po byas pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 'khu ba dang, khro ba'am mi dga' ba/ spyi phan la gnod 'tshe skyel bar mi tshang mas sdang bar byas yong/ dgra la sdang ba tsam gyis cang mi phan/ 2.dgra ru 'dzin pa'i sems sam, khong khro/ log spyod pas mi dmangs rnams la sdang ba chen po byed kyi 'dug /
sdang bas zil gyis gnon pa
1) khong khros sems ma zhi bar byed pa/ 2) khong khros gzhan spa bkong bar byed pa/
dgra bo/ sdang byed dgra bo thabs kyis 'dul dgos/
mig log / zhe 'gras mi gnyis sdang mig lta res byed pa
sam mi dga' ba'i sems:/ gcig gis gcig la sdang zug byed/
gnod pa skyel 'dod kyi sems/ sdang sems 'dzin pa/
zhum zhum mam zhed pa'i rnam pa/ sdar sdar byed pa de blo khog med pa'i rtags red/
(tha mi dad pa) skrag pa'am zhed pa/ nyen khar thug kyang phran bu tsam yang sdar med/ kho rang phran bu sdar ba/
snying stobs chung ba'i mi/ sdar ma rnams snying stobs dang mi ldan pa/
rgyal khab la pha rol gyi rgol ba dpung tshan che ba byung na dgra phyogs las rgyal ba ma byung yang, mi pham pa'i thabs jus rtsom thabs kyi khrims/
khyim brgyad pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar bco lnga dang, chu tshod zhe lnga shar tshe nyi ma sdig khyim du spyod, de'i ming don khyim bcu gnyis kyi thad na gsal/
bsags pa'i sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa/
1) sdig pa dang ldan pa/ sdig can khrims la ma sbyar na, nyam chung mgo bo bkyag mi thub/ 2) (mngon) rdzun smra mkhan/

sdig pa'i bsam sbyor rtsub po/ sdig to'i bsam pa 'dor bar bya/ khrims 'gog par byed pa'i ma rungs pa sdig to can tshar bcad/
ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, ston pa'i gsung la yid mi ches pa'i sdig lta skyes pa gzhan gyis bzlog pa'i mtha' la mi gtong ba'o/
sdig pa dang ltung ba'i bsdus ming/

1.(tha dad pa) bsdigs pa, bsdig pa, sdigs,, 1) 'jugs snang skul ba dang, 'jigs su 'jug pa/ drag shugs kyis gzhan la sdig pa/ grwa dmangs la sdig pa/ 2) gshe ba/ phru gu la tshig rtsub kyis bsdigs na mi 'grig / 3) 'ben la gzas pa dang, rdeg par rtsom pa/ dgra'i mgo bor me mda' bsdigs pa/ 2. 1) mi dge ba dang, ngan pa/ las ngan pa'i sdig pa ma bsags na, skrag dgos pa'i gshin rje chos rgyal med/ ming gi rnam grangs la dge ba'i 'gal zla dang, ngan 'gro'i lam, ngan lhung, nyes pa, nyes spyod, sdig blta, nongs pa, spang bya, dams byed, mtsher 'gro, bzang las byol bcas so, 2) nyi ma'i rgyu lam khyim bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / 3) sdig pa rwa tsa'i bsdus ming,
sdig pa 'khyer ba ste mna' tshig cig / kho bos don gnad 'di sdig pa 'khur shes ma song/ las don yag po zhig mi byed re sdig pa 'khur/
sdig pa khyab bsgrag tu shod pa/
dus 'khor las gsungs pa'i sdig pa lnga ste, gzhan la 'tshe ba dang, rdzun smra ba, 'dod log ma byin len pa, chang 'thung ba bcas lnga/
mi dge ba'i las byas pa gzhan gyis shes dogs nas gsang ba byed pa/ sngar bsags sdig pa 'chab pa las, 'phral 'phral bshags pa byas pa legs/

'dod pa'i khams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba dang, de dag skyed pa'i rgyu 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa ni bdag dang gzhan la gnod cing rnam par smin pa yang sdug bsngal chen po skyed cing, dge ba dang mi mthun zhing 'phags pa rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas su gyur pa/
sdig pa mi dge ba bcu
mi dge ba bcu dang don gcig, ba bcu'i las: lus kyi las gsum, ngag gi las bzhi, yid kyi las gsum ste bcu'o/
'bras bu legs nyes gang 'byung la mi lta ba'i u tshugs/
sdig pa rwa tsa dang don gcig
sdig pa rwa tsa dang don gcig
dug can gyi 'bu zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la du bas 'chi dang, mar gyis nyams byed, lus mi sdug bcas so,
mi dge ba'i las sba gsang med par bshags pa/
sdig pa bshags pa'i stobs bzhi
rten gyi stobs dang, sun 'byin pa'i stobs, sor chud pa'i stobs, gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bcas bzhi/
sdig pa'i kha snon longs pa/
nyi ma'i rgyu khyim zhig gi ming ste khyim bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig /
sdig pa'i gnyen po stobs bzhi
rten dang, gnyen po kun tu spyod pa dang, rnam par sun 'byin pa dang, nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs bcas bzhi/
rgyu mi dge ba las 'bras bu sdug bsngal ba smin pa'o/
sdig pa'i bya ba so nam gyi gzugs su bkod pa/
nag po'i las spangs nas dkar po'i bya ba dang du blang ba/ bya ba gang byed sdig spangs dge bsgrub dgos/
1) sdig pa rwa tsa'i phru gu/ 2) zangs sdig chung chung/
nag po'i las la dga' ba'i blon po/
sdig pa rwa tsa dang, sbrul gyi bsdus ming/
1) mi dge ba'i tshig / 2) gzhan la zhed snang skul ba'i tshig /
tshul min gyi bya bas bsgrubs pa'i lto chas/
(yul) bud med kyis 'ching rgyu'i dngul gyi ska rags rgyan can zhig /
1) sdig pa rwa tsa'i bsdus tshig 2) byis pa 'khur chas gzan chung gi sne sgrog byed sdig rwa'i dbyibs can/

sngar bod kyi lha lcam gzab spros spras skabs mdun phyogs su 'dogs pa'i rgyan zhig ste, steng gos kyi sked pa'i thad nas sgrog byed sdig rwa gser dang dngul gyis bzos shing, rgyan mu tig dang byu ru sogs kyi zhags pa sked pa nas pus mo'i gsham du 'dzar ba zhig /
mi dge ba'i las ka/ sdig las bsags pa/

srog chags sman gyi rigs te, ro mngar la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas mkhal ma'i drod dang nus pa nyams pa dang, chu bsags pa gnyan nad nywa log bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang mang dang 'phrog byed do,
rang gi byas nyes rang gis 'khur ba/
'jugs skul gyi stangs ka'am, rnam 'gyur/ sdigs pa'i gad mo/
'jigs skul/ gzhan la sdigs mo bya phyir nam mkhar me mda' 'phen/
gzhan la zhed snang skul ba'i tshig /
'jugs skul gyi stangs ka/ mi ngan spyod ngan la drag po'i sdigs ra skul ba/
mna' tshig dang sbrags pa'i 'jugs skul gyi: skad cha dza drag po/ mi gnya' rengs rnams la sdigs ra'i tha tshig bsgrags song/
/ 1) mtho sa'am, sgang du yod pa'i gshong gshong/ sa'i sdings/ spang sdings/ ri sdings/ 2) dkyil lam dbus/ dkyil 'khor sdings/
zhabs bro sogs 'khrab yul stegs sam sgang gi ming/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'bab chu zhig byang nas lho phyogs su li thang dang sde rung rdzong brgyud de 'bri chur 'bab/
sdug bsngal myong ba'i las bskul ba/ dud 'gro nyam thag rnams la zhon 'gel sdug bkol gyi mnar sdang ma byed/
sdug bsngal ma bzod pa'i skad/ 'khyag ltogs kyis mnar nas sdug skad rgyag pa/ zug rngu ma bzod par sdug skad lhang lhang rgyag pa/
tsho nge'am sdug bsngal gyi sgra/ 'khyag ltogs gnyis kytis mnar bas mya ngan gyi sdug skad tse re 'don pa/
sdug bsngal gyi khur bskur ba/ sdug bskur khral 'gel byas pa/
1) sgrub dka' ba'i khral/ 2) khral ngan la smod tshig /
sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khyer bzhin pa/ rkyen ngan sdug 'khur/ sdug 'khur mi thub pa/
myong bar nad 'khyag pa'am: nad theg pa/ phugs don la dmigs nas dka' tshegs la sdug 'khyag byed pa/
sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul/ a kha gnas tshul ngan pa de 'dra byung ba sdug ga/ dka' las che la byas 'bras chung ba sdug ga la/
sems sdug skyo shas kyis ngu shor gad mo/ sngar myong dka' sbyong gi snang tshul drasn nas sdug gad shor ba/
sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul/ kho la gra ma 'grigs pa sdug ge ba zhig byung bzhag /
sdug pa'i pham gyong/ chung dus nas hur brtson ma byas pas rgan dus su blo pham yid chad byung yang sdug gyong red/ bong bu sdug pa rang sdug khal 'khyer ba sdug gyong/
gyong gun 'khur ba/ thub tshod ji tsam btang yang ngan lan ma bslogs par sdug gyong 'khur ba/
1) gyong bskur ba/ mkho chas g.yar nas tshab skyin ma sprad par sdug gyong btang ba/ 2) rtsis med du dor ba/ 'tsho ba'i dka' tshegs la ma brtsis par sdug gyong btang ba/
thar du med pa'i thor nad cig /
sdug bsngal mnyam 'khur gyi rogs pa/
sems sdug skabs gtong ba'i glu/
1) sdug bsngal yang yang myong ba'i rgad po'am rgan po/ 2) mi tshe gcig la sdug bsngal kho na myong mkhan/
dka' gyong khur te bsgur nas sdod pa/ gnas tshul ngan kyang bzod sran gyis sdug sgur byed pa/
sdug bsngal byung nas ngu ba/ dga' ngu dang sdug ngu gnyis mi 'dra/
mi dga' ba'i gdong mdog / kho la chags sgo byung nas sdug ngo rdza ri lta bu ston gyi 'dug /

1) mya ngan/ sdug bsngal dos drag pa/ sdug bsngal bgrang ba/ sdug bsngal ma myong na skyid mi go/ skom pa'i sdug bsngal btung bas sel/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog 'og tu lus sems kyi sdug bsngal ci rigs pa myong ba/ bcings 'grol thob ste sdug bsngal las grol ba/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs tshang ma'i don du sdug bsngal dang du len phod pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khong chud dang, gdung ba, sdug mnar ba, brnag dka', bro 'tshal ba, mya ngan, zug rngu, yid gdung, yid nang chud, rab tu tsha, sems khral, sems sdug sems g.yeng bcas so, 2) lus sems la gnod pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir sdug bsngal ba ste, bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug gi nang gses shig
bo chen po bzhi: skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang, rga ba'i sdug bsngal, na ba'i sdug bsngal, 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal te, sdug bsngal chu bo'i gzugs su bkod pa'o/
sdug bsngal gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, tshor ba sdug bsngal yul dang bcas pa ste skyes tsam nas lus sems gdung bar byed pa'i sdug bsngal/
yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang 'phrad pa las byung ba'i nyams su myong ba'i shes pa'o/

bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston skabs su gsungs pa'i sdug bsngal brgyad de skye ba dang, rga ba, na ba, 'chi ba, sdug pa dang 'bral ba, mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa, 'dod pa btsal kyang mi rnyed pa, nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i sdug bsngal bcas brgyad/

mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes sdug bden gyi chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes shing sngar goms par byas pa mngon du gyur pa'i zag med shes rab kyis spang bya spang ba mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/
nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mjug de ma thag tu spang bya las rnam par grol ba thob pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/

nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, khams gong ma gnyis kyi sdug bden gyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes nas spang bya spang ba ni sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa thob pa bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/

nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, sdug bsngal rjes bzod kyi mjug thog tu khams gong ma la dmigs pa'i spang bya spangs pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/
sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma'am rang bzhin/
gyi bzod pa: dge ba byed pa'i dus na bkres shing skom pa dang, grang zhing tsha ba la sogs pa gnod pa'i rkyen gang ci byung yang mi gtong ba ste dge ba'i rgyun mi gcod pa/

pa med pa'i sdug bsngal: ngoms pa med pa'i sdug bsngal, lus yang yang 'dor ba'i sdug bsngal, yang yang nying mtshams sbyor ba'i sdug bsngal, yang yang mtho dman du 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal, grogs med pa'i sdug bsngal te 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs drug /

bden pa bzhi'i nang gses, rang rgyu las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i nyer len gyi phung po ma dag pa'i snod bcud zag bcas 'bras gyur gyi dngos po thams cad de, de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi phung po nad lta bu shes par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bslu bar snang bas sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/

rnam pa bzhi: bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, skad cig re re nas skye zhing 'jug pa'i chos can yin pas mi rtag pa dang, sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun mi 'chad par 'tshe bas sdug bsngal ba dang, phung po lnga'i nang na rtag gcig rang dbang gi bdag med pas khang pa'i nang mi med pa lta bu stong pa dang, phung po lnga po nyid kyang rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag ma yin pas khang pa mi ma yin pa lta bu bdag med pa bcas bzhi'o/
skye ba dang, rga ba, na ba, 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal bcas bzhi/

shes pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po rnams sdug bsngal bar shes pa/ sdug bsngal gsum, sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal, 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal, khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bcas gsum/

1) ngan pa'am ma rabs/ mi sdug chags/ khyi sdugs chags/ las ka sdug chags/ gnam gshis sdug chags/ 2) smod pa'i tshig grogs shig yin zhing skabs 'gar chags zer ba bsdus nas sdug gcig pu ming gi sngon du sbyar yang 'thad/ sdug...sdug zhwa/ sdug lham/ sdug khyi/ sdug bun/ sdug lag / sdug rkang/ sdug shi brgyab pa
1) sdug bsngal byung tshul gyi skad cha/ sngar myong gi sdug gtam zhib tu gsol ba/ 2) bkra mi shis pa'i gtam/ rna bar mi snyan pa'i sdug gtam zhig thos pa/
/ zhing bran rnams zas gos med pas sdug thug nas lto slong du phyin pa/
sdug bsngal bsran thub pa/ dka' ngal ji tsam byung yang zhum pa med pa'i sdug theg pa/
1) sdug bsngal bstud mar byung ba/ kho tshor mi shi rgyu brlags kyis sdug thog sdug brtsegs byung 'dug / 2) ngan pa las kyang ngan pa/
sdug bsngal bden pa'i bsdus ming,
sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi
mi rtag pa dang, sdug bsngal ba, stong pa, bdag med pa ste bzhi/
sdug bden gyi spang bya bcu
'dod pa'i khams 'dir sdug bden mthong bas spang bar bya ba lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga ste phra rgyas bcu'o/
yod pa'i nyams bstan pa:/ mi sdug sdug mdog byed/
sdug bsngal nad gzugs su bkod pa/ thub tshod btang grangs mang bas sdug nad theg re bral ba/ don med pham gyong 'khyer dgos pa'i sdug nad mi theg /

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) yid du 'ong ba/ yid la sdug pa/ 2) skyo ba/ sems sdug nas ngu ba/ nga'i sems sdug pa la tshad ma byung/ 2. 1) mdza' bo/ rang gi sdug pa dang bral ba/ 2) gsang yum/ 3. 1) mdzes po/ phru gu mtshar sdug can/ mi sdug pa'i rnam pa/ 2) zhan pa/ sdod sa sdug pa/ bza' rgyu sdug pa/
sdug gyong gyis zhes ma rangs pa'i tshig:/ mi khyod la de 'dra zhig dgos pa yod la byung yang byung 'dug sdug pa gyis shig /

ba'i sdug bsngal: sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ches phangs pa'i gnyen la sogs pa dang bral ba na des sems la mya ngan skye ba dang, ngag tu smre sngags 'don pa, lus la gnod pa bskyed pa, yul de'i yon tan dran zhing 'dod pas yid gdung ba, de'i longs spyod ma tshang ba'i sdug bsngal bcas so/

rnam thar brgyad kyi ya gyal, gzugs sdug pa sprul ba la dga' ba ste 'bad pa'i blo skye ba dang, gzugs mi sdug pa sprul ba la mi dga' ba ste mi 'bad pa'i blo skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa de dag gi gnyen pa'o/

1. gnod 'tshe/ skyid sdug / bde sdug / sha sdug khyi sdug / dngos shugs brgyud gsum gang ci'i sgo nas sdug po btang byung/ dgra gshed phan tshun gcig gis gcig la sdug po byed pa/ 2. 1) khag po/ lam bar kha char babs nas sdug po byung ba/ 2) ngan pa/ bsam blo 'khor stangs sdug po/ las ka byed stangs sdug po/ khyim nang gi 'khos ka sdug po/
sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i rgyu kun 'byung ngo/
dka' sbyong ngam dka' ngal/ sdug sbyong myong ba/ sdug sbyong btang ba/
don med 'phro brlag / mi tshe don med sdug zad la mi gtong bar 'phral phugs la phan pa'i snying po lon thabs byed dgos/
yul lam lung par smod pa'i tshig /
byas yus la smod tshig / phan chung btags par ngo so'i sdug yus bgrang ba/
sdug bsngal sems ngal gyis lus rgud pa'i nyams/ kho dka' ngal byung nas gzugs po sdug rid la song 'dug /
1) gyon chas sogs dngos po rnying hrul mkho med rigs/ 2) mi bsam ngan zhe gnag can/ mi sdug rul/ gyon pa sdug rul/
bzod bsran nam u tshugs/ sdug rus chen po byas nas dka' ngal bsal ba/
dka' sdug bzod bsran chen po/ dka' ngal ji ltar byung yang sdug rus theg po yod/
1) brtson 'grus chen po/ 2) u tshugs tsha po'am, bzod bsran chen po/
sdug res byung na lab res
sdug po byung na bshad res yong ba'i don/
1) rang gzhan sdug bsngal ba'i las sam bya ba/ 2) las ka la smod pa'i tshig / khos nga la sdug las bskul byung snyam du ma sems shig /
mi 'dod pa'i gtam smra ba/ khos nga la sdug po btang byung zhes sdug shod mug shod byed pa/
1) rang gis rang nyid kyi sems la smod pa'i tshig / las don nor ba de sdug sems 'dis ma byung ba red/ sdug sems 'di brjed ngas che ba la ang/ 2) gzhan la snying rje ba'i sems/
sdug rus sam, bzod sran/ tsha grang bkres skom ji ltar byung yang sdug sran theg pa'i mi mang po yod/ sdug sran theg mi thub pa/
dka' sdug gis nor rdzas gsog pa
sdug bsngal gyi khur phab pa'am, dor ba/
sman gzhung las 'byung ba'i lus kyi gnad gsang zhig ste ltag khung/

(tha dad pa) bsdus pa, bsdu ba, sdus,, 1) gsog pa'am 'gugs pa dang, 'dzoms par byed pa/ mi mang po'i blo gros phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ phyogs khag so so'i bsam 'char sdud pa/ mi rgyu zog gsum gyi stobs shugs bsdus te mgyogs nas myur du spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa/ slob grwa chung ba khag mang gsar btsugs kyis slob na son pa'i phru gu rnams slob sbyong du sdud pa/ stobs ldan gyi dmag dpung rnams rang gi dbang du bsdus nas dgra rnams zil gyis mnan pa/ 2) sdom pa/ gnad che'i tshig don mdor sdud pa/ lo tog sdud pa/ las grwa'i mjug sdud pa/

1) rnam dbye lnga pa'i nang gses yul dus dngos po grangs ka bcas kyi mtshams 'dzin cing sdud pa'i don la 'jug pa'i nas sgra/ nas...shar phyogs nas nub phyogs bar/ sngar nas da bar/ gcig nas brgya'i bar/ zhwa nas lham bar/ 2) tshig don rnams phyogs gcig tu sdud pa'i phrad gzhan dbang can gam sogs bcu gcig dang, kyang la sogs pa dang, phrad rang dbang can dang sgra bcas la zer/ gam...dang...kyang...shar ram, lho'am, nub bam, byang ni phyogs bzhi'o/ bdag kyang 'gro dgos/ khong yang phebs byung/ 'das pa dang, ma 'ongs pa dang, da lta ba ni dus gsum mo,..
tshur sdud pa dang phar sprod pa/ gzhung sger gyi 'bab yong thog nas sdud sprod byed sgo mtha' dag 'bo bre nyag srang sogs 'jal byed tshad ma gzhir bzhag sprod len tshul mthun byed dgos/

gzhan nas tshur rub bsdu'am, 'or 'dren/ brngas pa'i tshar ma g.yul khar sdud len byed pa/ bkrus nas bskams pa'i gyon chas tshang ma sdud len byed pa/ mi ngan rnams kyi lag cha gzhung gis sdud len byed pa/

1. (tha dad pa) bsdums pa, bsdum pa, sdums,, mthun par byed pa/ phan tshun bar du res dkrugs res sdum mang du byung ba/ rtsod gzhi bsdums nas sngar bzhin 'cham por gyur/ 2. (rnying) khyim mam khang pa/
(tha dad pa) bsdur ba, bsdur ba, sdur,, 'gran pa'am sgrun pa/ dngos po legs nyes bsdur te dbye ba 'byed/ lus rtsal bsdur ba/
rigs dang, tshoms dang, mang po'i tshogs pa/ rang sde/ gzhan sde/ dmag sde/ chos sde/ lha sde mi sde/ g.yas sde g.yon sde/ yul gru rnams sde sder bgos pa/
1) dge 'dun nang mi mthun pa bzo ba'i dbyen dkrug / 2) yul lung dkrug pa/ sde dkrug mkhan khram pa, sa dkrug mkhan a bra/
1) dgon sde/ 2) grong sde khag / 3) sde tsho/
khag so so:/ grong sde khag / mi sde khag / yul sde khag / shog sde khag /
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi nub byang ngos dang 'bri chu'i shar 'gram na yod pa'i rdzong zhig rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de ni dgon chen na yod/
si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul sde dge'i shar rgyud kyi ri zhig /

khams sde dge dgon chen dpal lhun grub steng gi chos grwa zhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug lor, grub chen thang stong rgyal pos phyag btab, sde dge rgyal po rim byon rnams kyis mchod gnas su gyur cing, par khang chen mo sogs rig gnas kyi shul bzhag chen po yod pa'i sa skya'i dgon pa grags can zhig /

dkar chag bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs: can gyi brdas drangs pa'i phyi mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam blo ldan mos pa'i kunda yongs su kha bye ba'i gzhon nu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba ston pas chos 'khor bskor tshul bka' bsdu byung tshul dang bcas pa dang, 'phags bod kyi yul du bstan pa bskyangs tshul, mi'i dbang pos ji ltar par du bsgrubs tshul, bzhugs byang dkar chag dngos, dgos ched phan yon bsngo smon dang bcas skabs lnga'i bdag nyid can, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu mo glang gi lor dpal spungs si tu karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang bas mdzad pa/

dkar chag kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi: bka' lung gi dgongs don rnam par 'grel ba'i bstan bcos gangs can pa'i skad du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal ba'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar pa zhes bya ba bstan pa gang las byung ba, bstan skyong rnams kyis bya ba byas pa, dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par gzhag pa, bstan bcos kun gyi rnam par gzhag pa, par du sgrub par skul ba, ji ltar par du sgrub pa, chos kyi bzhugs byang smos pa, dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba bcas rab byed brgyad kyi bdag nyid can gyi gzhung 'di ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu phag lor zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/

par khang chos mdzod chen mo bkra shis sgo mang zhes, sde dge dgon chen du, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya lor, sde dge'i rgyal rabs zhe gnyis pa chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gi sku dus su bzhengs pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur dang, sa dge bka' rnying gi bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sna tshogs sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i par shing 'bor chen yod pa'i par khang zhig /
khyim pa'i grong sde dang, dgon pa/
lha, klu, gnod sbyin, dri za, lha ma yin, nam mkha' lding, mi'am ci, lto 'phye chen po bcas brgyad do/
bod kyi dge 'dun pa'i sde gnyis te, gos dkar lcang lo'i sde dang, rab byung ngur smrig gi sde gnyis so/
1) grong sde yod pa'i thang/ 2) yul thang/ tshong dus gcig la sde thang gnyis mi yong/
sde bdun yid kyi mun sel
tshad ma sde bdun gyi rgyan yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba'i bsdus ming, mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi spyi don/
pa'i sgo don gnyer yid kyi mun sel: rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i spyi don/
«pitka» bre'o che la 'jug pa ste, dper na bre'o che la bre'u chung mang po 'dus pa lta bu, mang po 'dus pa'i snod do/
theg pa che chung gi sde snod rigs gnyis/
'dul ba, mdo sde, mngon pa bcas kyi don nyams su len pa po/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad brjod bya bslab pa gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas rjod byed sde snod gsum du bzhag pa ste, 'dul ba'i sde snod dang, mdo sde'i sde snod dang, mngon pa'i sde snod rnams so, de gsum gyi nang du gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi don dang, tshig thams cad dang, gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi shes bya'i chos thams cad 'dus pas sde snod ces bya'o/

'dzin gyi phyag 'dul ba'i klad du thams cad: mkhyen pa dang mdo sde la sangs rgyas byang sems dang, mngon pa la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal smos shig ces lo pan gyis bkas bcad de la phyi rabs pa rnams kyis ma nges pa'i rgyu mtshan du bshad nas, lo ts'a ba rang dad pa'i lha la phyag byas par 'chad mod, 'on kyang sngon bsgyur ba'i 'dul ba dang, mngon pa dang, mdo sde phal mo che la nges pa can du smos 'dug pas, phyis ma nges kyang dang po'i chos rgyal rnams kyi dus su bkas bcad par nges so/

/ 1) yul lung so so'i las mi'i 'go byed/ 2) gsal byed kyi sde tshan/ bod yig gsal byed sde pa dang po/ ka kha ga nga...3) (mngon) sngar rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas pa tshor gnas brtan pa dang, thams cad yod par smra ba, mang pos bkur ba, phal chen pa ste rtsa ba'i sde pa la bzhi yod pas grangs bzhi mtshon/
bod yig gi gsal byed sum cu tham pa bzhi bzhi sde pa rer brtsis pa'i ka sde nas ra sde bar sde pa bdun dang, ha a gnyis sde pa phyed de sde tshan phyed dang brgyad do/ ka...ra...ha a...
sngar gyi bod sa gnas srid gzhung/
legs sbyar gyi gsal byed sde pa lnga so so'i yi ge lnga pa ste, nga nya na na ma rnams so/ ka tsa ta da pa...nga nya na na ma/
1) tsho pa'i 'go pa/ 2) sde tsho mang po'i spyi dpon/
tsho dang, bam po, le tshan, dum bu/ yig rigs khag mang phar tshur mi 'dres pa'i ched du sde tshan du sdem pa/ dngos rigs yag nyes gang dang gang yin sde tshan spu ris 'byed pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs yul sde'i gyod don skor la rtsad zhib byed sa'i las khungs/
phun tshogs sde bzhi'i bsdus ming,
(yul) bsnogs pa'am 'khrugs pa, yo 'khyoms chen po/ cog tse'i steng gi dpe cha tshang ma sde zing dgu zing bzos pa/
dmag 'khrug tshabs chen byung ste mi rnams rang sar ma chags par 'ur 'gro ba/
sde tshan gyi khongs gtogs/ dpon 'bangs sde ris dang bcas pa g.yul du zhugs pa/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho nub ngos dang 'bri chu'i shar 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de sang smad du yod/
yul dgon gang rung gi yan lag /
1) yul sde'i srid dbang/ 2) yul sde'i srid dbang 'dzin mkhan te sde pa'ang zer, bod du chos srid gnyis ldan gyi lam lugs dar ba'i skabs srid phyogs kyi bya ba byed mkhan gtso bo/
srid dbang sde tshan gcig pa'i sa cha/
sde srid mi gcig pa'i sa
srid dbang sde tshan mi gcig pa'i sa cha/
bka' brgyud pas bod kyi srid dbang 'dzin skabs kyi rgyal po rting ma ste, sog gu shr'i bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis drag shugs la brten nas de tshar bcad cing srid dbang 'phrogs pa red/
sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho

rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul lor lha ldan byang phyogs nyang bran grong smad gzhis kar yab a sug dang, yum bu khrid gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs, dgung lo bzhi lnga'i thog nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sum rtags sogs la thugs gzhol, dgung lo brgyad kyi thog rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku mdun du bcar nas mdo sngags sogs spyi dang bye brag gi gzhung don mang po gsan, 'dar pa lo ts'a las skar rtsis dang, sgra rig pa, lu 'go bla mkhyen ngag gi dbang po las dbyangs 'char, byang pa lhun sdings pa rnam rgyal rdo rje las byang khog yul thig dang, rtsa rgyud sdong 'grems, gsang sman tshig brgyud skor gyi man ngag bcas gso ba rig pa sbyang ba sogs mdor na mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas kun la dpyis phyin par mdzad, rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos chos srid gnyis ka'i rgyal tshab kyi las ka bstsal bas lo nyi shu rtsa drug gi ring sde srid bzung nas srid bskyangs, rtse pho brang dmar po nyams gso dang rgya skyed gnang, rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig bzhengs, gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi la zhus dag mdzad de dpar du bskrun pa sogs mdzad rjes shin tu che, gsung rtsom skor la phug lugs rtsis kyi legs bshad beed'urya dkar po dang, beed'urya dkar po'i g.ya' sel, gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag khrims yig dwangs shel nyer gcig gso ba rig pa'i khog 'bubs legs bshad beed'urya'i me long drang srong dgyes pa'i dga' ston, dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa beed'urya sngon mo, man ngag rgyud kyi lhan thabs dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri sogs legs bshad rmad du byung ba'i bstan bcos sna tshogs pod nyi shu rtsa drug tsam mdzad, gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don rnams ma 'dres mtsho la zla skar shar ba ltar mig lam du gsal bar 'char ba'i sngon med kyi bris cha thang deb grangs bdun cu don bdun gyi mtshon byed dpe ris bkod, lcags po rir sman gyi slob grwa 'gro phan rig byed gling btsugs pa sogs sku tshe hril por bstan don kho na mdzad, mthar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing bya lor sog po lha bzang han gyis bkrongs/
(yul) rigs dang gras/ sran ma dang, zhog khog rigs ni 'bru'i sdeb rgya red/ la ba ni snam bu'i sdeb rgyar rtsi/
min pa'i stabs cig gam chabs cig / lo: gsar gyi dgos mkho rnams sdeb gcig tu nyo ba
tshong zog mang po sdeb gcig la tshur nyo ba/ dngos zog sdeb nyo sdeb 'tshong byed pa/

(tha dad pa) bsdebs pa, bsdeb pa, sdebs,, 1) 'grogs pa/ mig sems dang bsdebs nas lta ba dang, rna ba sems dang bsdebs nas nyan pa/ ngan pa mnyam sdeb/ blo mthun pa'i grogs dang sdeb pa/ 2) sbyor ba'am sgrig pa/ dpe deb mang po'i don snying gcig tu bsdebs nas bstan bcos gsar pa rtsom pa/ gras su bsdebs pa/ yi ge dbyangs gsal bsdebs nas ming tshig grub/
cig car du blangs pa/ dgos cha rnams sdeb blangs byas/

1) dngos po gnyis yan chad cig sdeb cing sbyor ba/ 2) bod yig sngon rjes ming gsum brtsegs 'dogs rnams bsdebs nas sbyor ba ste yi ge'i sbyor ba/ 3) rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, tshigs bcad rtsom lugs sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba dang, legs sbyar gyi yi ge'i lci yang spel ba'i rtsom tshul gyi gzhung zhig /
bratita dang dz'a ti la yi ge lci yang sogs phan tshun bsdebs nas tshig sbyor legs par ston pa'i gzhung slob dpon shanti bas mdzad pa/
bstan bcos kyi 'go rgyan mchod brjod sogs su lanytsha, wartu, bod yig gsum lci yang bsdebs te sbyar ba'i sum phab kyi bratita'i zur chag /
lanytsha, wartu, bod yig gsum sbyar ba'i sngags/
sdeb gcig tu brtsi ba/ sngar gyi chad bun rnams de ring sdeb rtsis brgyab pa yin/
mnyam 'tshogs/ rtag par bzhugs gral sdeb 'tshogs byed pa/
tshong zog mang po sdeb gcig la phar 'tshong ba/
gser bris ri mo brdar nas 'od mdangs 'don byed kyi gzi/
mi mang gi kha nas dus gcig tu sgrog pa'i skad sgra/ skad cha rim bzhin shod pa ma gtogs mi mang sdeb 'ur brgyab nas ma shod/
1) sman gyi sbyor thabs 'khod pa'i dpe cha/ 2) shog lhe mang po sdeb gcig btsems pa'i yig deb/
(yul) chun po'am sgril kha/ ras cha'i sdem ka rer yug bdun re yod/ shog bu bcu deb kyi sdem ka lnga/
gshibs te 'ching ba zhig / shing sdem chag: byed pa

lo gsar sogs kyi skabs mar snum gro zhib kyis bzos pa'i dkar spro'am kha zas dbyibs gzugs sna tshogs ya grangs dgu bdun lnga gsum gang rung du brtsegs pa dang, shing 'bras, 'bru sna sogs snod bzang du bshams bsgrigs rten 'brel gyi rdzas/
sa cha kha yangs pa'i thang/
srog chags rkang lag sder mo can gyi rigs/ sder thogs nang gi rgya stag yin/
zhabs ra mthon po yod pa'i zas snod/ rag sder/ shel sder/
gcan gzan sogs kyi sen mo/ stag shi yang sder mo skam dogs med/
sder mos 'bal te 'brad pa/ zhum bus sder shad brgyab yong/

(tha dad pa) bsdos pa, bsdo ba, sdos,, 1) brje ba/ bden don gyi ched du rang gi lus srog sdo phod pa/ sa thag ring por bskyod pa'i dka' tshegs dang bsdos pa/ rang dbang 'thob pa'i don du dgra la bsdos pa/ 2) sdur ba dang, 'gran pa/ do bsdo zhing phod btsugs pa/ gzhan gyi mthong chung khyad gsod ma bzod par sems thag gtsang bcad kyis 'gran cing sdo ba/ 3) bshad pa/ khyed rnams bdag gis bsdo ba bzhin bgyid na bdag de ltar bgyid do/

(tha dad pa) bsdogs pa, bsdog pa, sdogs,, 1) sdud pa'am 'dril ba/ chu rabs brgal bar gyon pa yar bsdog dgos/ thag pa bsdogs pa/ 2) sta gon nam grabs gshom byed pa/ sang nyin gyi ja mar de ring nas bsdogs tshar/
1) mchod me'i sdong rkang/ 2) rtswa'am shing gi sdong rkang/ ming gi rnam grangs la yal ga 'chang dang, yal ga rtsa ba'i bar gyi shing ngo,
mnyam du gshibs pa'i grogs po/ mi rnams kyis sdong grogs mdzod cig /
mchod me sdong rkang rgyun 'dzugs yod sar kha gsos phran bu re blugs pa'i mar khu'i thigs pa/ dkar mer zhal gso'i sdong thigs rgyag pa/
shing sdong gi chag dum mam, shing sdong rnying pa 'gyel zhing 'thor ba'i dam dum/ sdong dum tshig pa/
yal ga gyes gzhi'i rten/ pad ma'i sdong po/ shing sdong khong rul/ gyod kyi rtsa ba dang, rnag gi sdong po/
sdong po'i bkod pa'i snying po
'phags pa sdong po bkod pa gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs, rgyud 'bum glegs bam pha par bzhugs/
shing sogs kyi sdong po thung la phra ba'i rigs/
(tha dad pa) bsdongs pa, bsdong ba, sdongs,, mnyam du gshibs pa'am 'grogs pa/ grogs dang bsdongs te phyogs su 'gro/
/ 1) sgron me'i sdong ras/ 2) sdong po chung chung/
sgron me'i sdong bur dkri bya'i ras/
sgron me 'bar zin pa'i sdong bu'i ro ma/
mchod me'i sdong ras dkri sa'i shing/
gang du gnas sa'i grong khyim/
(tha mi dad pa) bsdad pa, bsdad pa, sdod,, gnas pa dang, 'dug pa/ tshang ma mar sdod cig / gnas nges can zhig la sdod dgos/ nga'i chu tshod 'khor lo 'di bsdad song/
yul gang zhig la gnas chog pa'i dbang cha/
(yul) gzhan gyi rta nor 'phrog mkhan jag pa rnams tshan pa gnyis su bgos te gcig gis rta nor ded nas 'gro ba dang, gcig gis ra mda' 'gog phyir sdod pa der zer/
sdod gnas/ snga ma'i sdod mal du yid chags pa/
1) rang gnas su sdod thub pa/ sdod ma tshugs/ slob phrug rnams slob grwar tshul bzhin sdod tshugs pa/ 2) tshod zin pa/ khong khro langs kyang kha dang lag pa sdod tshugs pas 'thab rtsod mi byed pa/
gzhan gyis bzod mi bde ba bzos pa/ sbyin bdag gis sdug po btang bas sdod bzod mi bde ba byung/
sdod dus re mos/ mtha' mtshams srung dmag rnams sdod res byed pa/
1) so so'i gnas su 'dug stangs/ 2) gnas lugs sam, stong nyid/
'dug pa'i khom pa/ rang gi khyim du las ka byas te sdod long yod pa/ rtag par sdod long med pa/
gnas gzhi'am sdod yul/ sdod sa 'dzin pa/
sdod gnas bcas te srung ba/

/ 1) ba thag gi dra rgya byed mkhan 'bu zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la lte bal can dang, 'thag mkhan, dra ba can, spre'u 'dra, bal can bcas so, 2) «utan» mang po phyogs gcig tu sdom pa/ las sdom byed pa/ gzhung don snga phyi phyogs gcig tu sdom rgyag pa/
sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa
tshig don gyi mjug sdom pa'i tshul gyis tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/
so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud rim/
sdom rgyun gnang ba ste spel ba'o/
sor byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa'i bla brgyud/
gzims chung gi sgor mjal mi gtong gcod byed mkhan/
1) le'u chung ba zhig gi sdom tshig / 2) srog chags kyi rigs shig /
1) le'u che ba zhig gi sdom tshig / 2) srog chags kyi rigs shig /
1) 'ching rgya/ 2) sdom byed kyi thag pa/
sdom tig dpag bsam snye ma
lo chen dhar ma shr'is rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rnam nges kyi 'grel pa zhig /
srog chags sdom gyi kha nas byung ba'i skud
'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg pa thun mong gi sdom mngon pa kun las btus pa dang, theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom theg bsdus te gnyis/

1. (tha dad pa) 1, bsdams pa, bsdam pa, sdoms,, 1) 'khyig pa'am 'ching ba/ phon por sdom pa/ thag pas lag pa dam por bsdams te 'gul skyod byed du mi 'jug pa/ 2) mi 'da' bar byed pa/ ri rgya dang klung rgya bsdams pa/ kha khrims sam gsang rgya bsdams pa/ sgo rgya bsdams pa/ sger sems bsdams pa/ 2, bsdoms pa, bsdom pa, sdoms,, sdud pa/ bzhi dang drug bsdoms na bcu yod/ 2. gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa spong zhing 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi rgyun sdom zhing 'gog pa/ sdom pa skye ba/ sdom pa nyams pa/ sdom pa 'dzin pa/ sdom pa len pa/ sdom pa shor ba/
sdom pa nyams pa'i rgyu bzhi
ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi ste, mi shes pa dang, ma gus pa dang, bag med pa dang, nyon mongs pa mang ba rnams so/
byang sems kyi bslab bya ston cing tshigs bcad nyi shu yod pa'i bstan bcos shig ste slob dpon tsandra go mis mdzad pa/
sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu bzhi

so thar gyi sdom pa spyi'i gtong ba'i rgyu ni bzhi ste, brda 'phrod pa'i gang zag gi drung du bsam pa thag pa nas bslab pa phul ba dang, shi 'phos pa dang, rgyu 'bras med par lta ba sogs sdig lta skyes pa dang, mtshan gnyis cig car byung ba dang mtshan lan gsum gyur pa rnams so/
bslab pa yar phul te skya sar bab pa/
ston pa'i sku gzugs dang, chos, mkhan po, slob dpon, dge 'dun bcas lnga/

1) sngags kyi sdom pa, byang sems kyi sdom pa, so thar gyi sdom pa ste gsum/ 2) 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa so thar gyi sdom pa, gzugs kyi sas bsdus pa bsam gtan gyi sdom pa, khams gsum las 'das shing 'phags pa'i sas bsdus pa zag med kyi sdom pa ste gsum/
nyes spyod mtha' dag las ldog par byed pa ste, mi dge ba bcu la kun slong nas kyang mi rgyu bar sdom sems bsten pa'o/
khang chung/ skyed tshal gyi mtha' sdom bus bskor ba/
1) dpe cha'i kha yig / 2) khag mang phyogs bsdus kyi tho yig /
gdon bgegs 'ching byed kyi phyag rgya/
rab byung/ sdom brtson ldan pa'i bshes gnyen/

rigs gsum mgon po dang, mkhan slob chos gsum, lo ts'a ba sogs mtshon pa'i dpe ris shig ste, ral gri de 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang khri srong lde'u btsan mtshon byed dang, po ti de phyag na rdo rje mtshon byed, ri mo'i dkyil du yod pa'i pad ma de spyan ras gzigs dang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas mtshon byed, ngang pa mgo gnyis can de zhi ba 'tsho mtshon byed, ne tso mgo gnyis can de lo ts'a ba mtshon byed bcas red/
don mang po tshig nyung ngur bsdus pa'i yi ge
phan tshun sdom byed kyi gzer bu/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i mthun rkyen lnga'i nang nas bsam pa'i mthun rkyen zhig ste, dge tshul gyi sdom pa lan gcig blangs kyang rtsa ltung 'chab bcas kyi sgo nas nyams pa ma yin pa sdom pa rnying pas rgyud ma bkag pa/
nyes pa phyis mi byed pa'i spong sems/ sngar byas la 'gyod sems dang, phyin chad sdom sems/

rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi cha lag sdom pa gsum rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos, theg dgu'i rnam bzhag spyi dang, so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob pa'i tshul, thob pa mi nyams pa bsrung ba'i thams, tha mar nyams na gso ba'i tshul bcas kyi rnam bzhag bye brag tu bshad pa ste, sdom gsum spyi'i bshad gzhi dang, 'dul ba so thar gyi rim par phye ba dang, byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed kyi bslab bya bshad pa dang, gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i rim par phye ba dang, sdom gsum spyir dpyad pa'i rim par phye ba ste rab byed lnga ldan gyi gzhung 'di, dus rabs bco lnga par mnga' ris pan chen pad ma dbang rgyal gyis mdzad pa/

sdom pa gsum rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba, so thar, byang sems, gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ste rab byed gsum gyi bdag nyid can ni, dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/
1) bsha' rgyu'i phyugs rigs tshang du bcug nas gsos pa/ phag pa sdom gsos/ 2) bslab sdom nyams pa bskyar gsos/
thug pa skyo tsha la gdab rgyu'i sha tshil sogs zas bcud skyed byed kyi rdzas/ thug sdor/ ja sdor/
smyung gnas sogs dmar zas spangs nas dkar gsum gyi zas la rten mkhan/
thug pa la gdab rgyu'i sdor dang phye rtsam/

/ 1) go byed/ mig brda/ brda tsam btags pa/ lag brda/ 2) yig thog gam, ngag thog nas btang ba'i lan/ phebs brda/ 'phren brda/ mgron brda/ dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyi sgo nas brda btang ba ltar 'og grabs byed pa/
1) ming brda dang skad rigs/ 2) skad dod/
1) skad yig sgyur mkhan/ 2) rigs mi 'dra ba'i skad yig gcig nas gcig tu 'bebs pa/
1) shes bya'i rigs mi 'dra ba so sor thun min gyi sbyar ba'i ming brda/ 'dul ba'i brda chad/ 2) skad dod/
mnga' bdag khri ral yan chad kyi bod brda/
go brda sprod pa/ byed lugs byed stangs gang ci'i brda ston pa/
'phrin gtong byed kyi yi ge/ dngos rigs len pa'i brda tho btang ba/
tshogs 'du'i thog skad cha'am lag rkyong sogs kyi sgo nas don rtsa gtan 'bebs byed pa/
1) yi ge'i brda thob ma nor ba/ 2) sgra dang snyan ngag phud pa'i sum rtags dang, dag yig lta bu/
rags pa tsam shes pa/ ming tshig brda dum shes pa tsam gyis gnas lugs zab mo'i dka' gnad khong du chud pa dka'/
gzhi gang la ming thog mar sbyar ba'i dus/
ming dang skad kyi go don/
rtsad gcod dam, zhib 'jug / byed gte su yin rgyu ma phu 'ded kyis brda 'ded mthil phyin gtong ba/ ngan gros gshoms mkhan gang yin brda 'ded zhib nan byed pa/

1) (by'akarana:) 1,ming brda tha snyad rnams ji bzhin go bar byed pa'am, ma nor bar ston par byed pa'i gzhung, dper na, sum rtags dag gsum lta bu/ 2, sgra'i bstan bcos/ 2) lan sprod pa dang go don shod pa/
yi ge'i brda dag ston pa'i gzhung/
1) lung ston pa/ 2) gtam shod pa/ 3) lag pa sogs kyis brda gtong ba/ 4) mu stegs tshangs pa ba'i nang gses grub mtha' mkhan zhig /
yi ge'i brda dag ston pa'i rig gnas/
yi ge'i brda dag gi bstan bcos
go don khog tu tshud pa/ phan tshun 'phros mol gang byas brda 'phrod go shes byung song/ bod skad la byang chub pa zhig gis bod rigs pa skad cha gang bshad brda 'phrod pa yong/
brda sprod mkhan nam ming thog mar 'dogs mkhan/
1) brda sprod pa'am, lan sprod pa/ 2) zhu gtug byed pa/ khrims khang la brda sbyor zhus pa/ 3) ming brda gsar pa sbyor ba/
ming thog mar 'dogs mkhan/ tha snyad...
don med pa'i ming rkyang tsam/
1) brda'i bstan bcos/ 2) lan gtong ba'i yi ge / 3) thun mong ma yin pa'i brda'i thog nas bris pa'i yi ge / mkha' 'gro'i brda yig /
go byed kyi ming tshig sgrub par byed pa/
ngag dang yig 'phrin gang rung gi lan/ mes rgyal gyi 'bod skul gnang bar brda lan phul ba/ kho tshor brda lan thogs/
log tu sprod pa:/ skad cha 'di go nyes brda log byung song/
1) skad yig sogs kyi go don shes pa/ 2) grangs gnas shig /
bod rgyal khri ral skabs bkas bcad mdzad pa'i rjes kyi bod brda/
ming brda rnam par gcod pa/
phra ma 'jug pa/ phan tshun mthun pa'i bar du brdab dkrug rgyag pa/
'dred pa'am 'gyel gyin 'gro ba/ chang gis ra bzi nas lam bar brdab 'chos te 'gro ba/
rdul sogs gsig gsig byas nas med pa bzo ba/ gyon chas la sa rdul 'gos pa brdab brdab sprugs te ltebs tshigs brgyab pa yin/
ji yod tshang ma:/ dngos po gang yod kho rang la brdab brdab gsig gsig byas nas sprad pa yin/

1.rdeb pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.(tha mi dad pa) brdabs pa, brdab pa,, shed kyis reg pa'am, thug pa/ chu la bshal, brag la brdabs/ sa la 'gyel te rkang pa brdabs song/ sgo'i ya them ha cang dma' bas rtag par mgo brdab kyi 'dug / yar langs na mgo brdabs, mar bsdad na rkub brdabs/

las ka gang yin rung mi gcig gis byas na tshang mas byed pa'i 'ur langs pa/ mi rnams brdab zhogs langs nas slob sbyong byed pa/ skad cha brdab zhogs byas nas bshad pa/ gros gtam lhod dal gyis mi shod par brdab zhogs chen pos shod pa/

/ sa rnams 'bar 'bur ma yin par snyoms por brdal dgos/
rdal ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
1) gzhan gyi dngos zog skyel 'dren bya rgyu blangs nas gla cha len pa/ 2) gla cha len mkhan/
ma byas pa'am ras su bor ba:/ mna' chings brdal bshig tu btang ba/
brdungs te lhu bsgrigs pa/ lcags shog brdungs sbyar gyis bzos pa'i snod spyad/
nyes brdungs/ bzung dmag la brdungs btsogs mi byed/
rdeg byed kyi mtshon cha spyi'i ming/
'gyel ba'am lhung ba/ sa la brdeg 'chos pa/ g.yang du brdeg 'chos pa/
