rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs drug pa khri sde btsan po'i dus su bod du dar ba'i bon gyi chos lugs shig ste sngon gyi bshad srol du sngar gdug 'dres byis pa zhig yul khams gzhan du khrid de nus pa bslabs nas mngon shes thob pa dang, phyis kyi deb ther khag gi nang du chab srid bon gyis bskyangs zhes gsal ba'i bon po de nas byung/
ldad pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
da lta ma stongs par bsdad yod pa'i grong/
da lta ma stongs par bsdad yod pa'i mi tshang them dud/
sdod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
sngar bsdad myong ba'i khyim mam sa cha/
sogs thag pas 'ching ba:/ g.yag lug thag pas bsdam bkyig byed pa/
bkag sdom byed rgyu'i khrims rgya/
'khyig pa dang mi 'da' bar byed pa'i don du go ba'i sdom pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod de, sdom gsum rang rang gi spang bya rnams so/
dge tshul gyis bsrung bya blangs 'das so gsum las gzhan pa'i dge slong gi spang bya rnams yid kyis bsdam par bya dgos pas bsdam bya'i nyes byas zhes bya/
bya ba gang byung byas mi chog pa'i dam bsgrags/
'khyig pa dang mi 'da' bar byed pa'i don du go ba'i sdom pa'i 'das pa,
gzhung sger nges can zhig gis ma gtogs gzhan gyis nyo tshong mi chog ces dam bsgrags byas pa'i tshong las/
(yul) mig gis gzas pa/ so khung nas 'ben la bsdigs khung sprad de me mda' rgyag pa/
mang po nas cha snyoms sam mang nyung gis bsdu ba'i bya ba'm dngos po/ bsdu cha rgyag pa/ bsdu cha bsdus nas 'gro song btang/
bsdu ba dang nyar ba'i bsdus tshig / dngos rigs tshang ma rang gnas su bsdu nyar byed dgos/
yong sgo bsdu len byed pa'i deb gzhung/

slob ma rnams bsdu ba'i thabs bzhi ste, chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong ba dang, gtam snyan par smra ba, don spyod pa'am gdul bya'i 'dod don dang mthun par spyod pa, don mthun pa'am gtul bya'i bya spyod la bstun nas bsgrub pa bcas so/
sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i stobs/
sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi gnyis pa don dang ldan pa'i tshig bsdus nas yi ge nyung ngur byed pa ste, dper na, utpala yang yin sngon po yang yin pa zhes pa bsdus nas, utpala sngon po zhes brjod pa lta bu/
bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa
gzhung gi skabs bab kyi don rnams bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/
tshur bsdu ba dang bdag po sprod pa/ spyi pa'i rgyu dngos la bsdu tshags dam don byed pa/
bskyed rim rnams rim gyis dmigs med kyi dbyings su sdud pa'i rjes chog gi rim pa'o/
tshur 'gugs pa'am gsog pa/ dmag mi bsdu rub/
slob grwa ba sogs tshur 'gugs pa'am rtsis len pa/ slob grwar phru gu bsdu len byed pa/
yo byad phyogs gcig tu rub cing 'jog: pa/ phyogs la ma thon gong du khyim nang gi ca lag bsdu gsog rgyag pa/
sdur ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
ma yin par bsdus klog brgyab ste klog: pa
1) gdus khu/ 2) snying po dang bcud/

gtan tshigs rig pa'i sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu dang mtshan nyid rigs lam thog mar slob pa'i gzhung zhig ste, cha ba chos seng sogs kyis mdo sde pa'i rig pa'i 'gros dang sbyar nas tshad ma'i gzhung gi don bsdus pa'i bsdus grwa zhes pa'i srol btod, de la bsdus chen bco brgyad byed pa dang, nyer gcig byed tshul gnyis sogs sna tshogs yod/
bsdus grwa'i rigs lam sbyong skabs, dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum dang bstun par bsgrigs pa'i bsdus chen dang, bsdus 'bring, bsdus chung ste gsum mo/
tshig don mdor bsdus te bkral ba'i 'grel pa/
bsdus grwa'i rigs lam chung ba ste, kha dog dkar dmar, yin log min log rgyu 'bras chung ba, spyi bye brag rdzas ldog 'gal 'brel sogs las dang po bas thog mar slob rgyu'i bsdus tshan rnams so/
bsdus grwa'i rigs lam che ba ste, thal 'gyur che ba, gzhan sel, sel 'jug sgrub 'jug rgyu 'bras che ba sogs dbang po rab rnams kyis slob rgyu'i bsdus tshan rnams so/

tsha dmyal brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, lcags kyi gtun chen po yul ljongs tsam pa re'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa blugs nas, lcags bsregs kyi tho ba ri rab tsam pa re gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyi klad la bskor nas brdungs pa dang, ri thams cad ra lug la sogs pa'i mgo brnyan can gyi rwa rtse me 'bar bas rdung kha bkye ba'i bar du dmyal ba'i sems can rnams 'tshir ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'o/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod dpe can gyi dngos po 'ga' zhig la bsams par byas nas de dang chos mtshungs pa'i dpe'i dngos po gzhan dag tshig tu bkod pa'i sgo nas dpe can de shugs kyis bsdus pa'i tshul du brjod pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs bzhi ni, spyi'i bsdus brjod, khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod, khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs dang mi mtshungs gnyis ka'i bsdus brjod, sngon med bsdus brjod rnams so/
tshig bsdus te bstan pa'i don/ gong gsal rnams bsdus don snying po gsham gsal ltar yin/
chings snga'i ya gyal zhig gzhung don mdor bsdus te bsgrigs pa'i sa bcad/
1.sdud pa'i 'das pa, 2.rgyas pa'i ldog phyogs/ lam rim bsdus pa/ 3.(rnying) 1) za ba/ 2) changs bu/
bsdus pa las gyur pa'i gzugs
chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs lnga'i nang gses shig ste, rtog pas phye ba'i chung mtha' rdul phra rab kyi gzugs mig la bstan du med pa'o/
mang po nas btus te phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i sdom/
tshigs su bcad pa: tshig don mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sdom tshig tshigs bcad du bsgrigs pa/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don dang, dpe gnyis khyad chos gcig tsam min par mtshungs chos gzhan gyis kyang 'dra bar bsdus pa'i rgyan zhig /
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi khyad gzhi khyad chos 'ga' zhig dpe'i khyad gzhi khyad chos dang ngo bo dbyer med du bkod cing, bar gyi 'brel sgra bsdus pa'i rgyan zhig /
rgyas po ma yin pa/ gsol tshigs bsdus po/ bsdus bris/
bsdus grwa'i rigs lam 'bring ba ste, drug sgra rtsi tshul, dgag gzhi rtsi tshul, dris 'phangs kyi rnam gzhag sogs dbang po 'bring ba rnams kyis slob rgyu'i bsdus tshan rnams so/
bsdus gzhung nang gi tshan pa la zer, dper na, kha dog dkar dmar zer ba bsdus tshan gcig yin log min log ces pa bsdus tshan gcig rgyu 'bras chung ba zhes pa bsdus tshan gcig byas pa lta bu/
gtan tshig rig pa dang mtshan nyid rigs lam slob pa'i dpe deb/
tsheg khyim gcig tu ming gnyis gsum tsam bsdus pa'i yi ge dper na, srgyas, 'khoor sogs/ srgyas...'khoor...
bsdus grwa ste mtshan nyid rigs lam gyi thog mar slob pa'i gzhung zhig /

pa'i gzugs can: gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi khyad gzhi khyad chos 'ga' zhig dpe'i khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi gzugs su bkod cing, bar gyi 'brel sgra 'ga' zhig bsdus la, 'ga' zhig ma bsdus pa'i rgyan zhig /
(yul) sdeb 'phung thebs pa/ khang chung gcig gi nang du ca lag mang po bsdebs 'dzogs thebs 'dug /
bsdog rgyu'i yo byad/ dngos po bsdog chas brgyab nas phyogs la thon pa/
1.sdog pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.(rnying) 1) bshams pa/ 2) ko lham sot kyi lhan pa/
sdog pa'i 'das pa, bsdong ba, sdong ba'i ma 'ongs pa,
sdud pa'i don du go ba'i sdom pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
sdud pa'i don du go ba'i sdom pa'i 'das pa,
khyon bsdoms kyi mang nyung,/ gong gsal rtsis grangs kyi bsdoms 'bor gzhir bzhag nas: gsham du cha 'grems byed dgos
gzhug bsdoms brgyab pa'i brjod tshig /

bod yig gsal byed bcu gnyis pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so sna dang bcas pa dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba so lce phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1. 1) ming gzhi'i shin tu mo'i yi ge zhig / 2) rjes 'jug gi ma ning yi ge zhig / 2./ 1) mi'i lo grangs kyi tshod/ lo na mthon po/ phru gu nar ma son pa/ 2) lo lnga lon pa'i rta drel gyi lo/ 3) chu rlan che ba'm chu 'khyil mang po yod pa'i spang ljongs/ rkyang kha dkar rmig bzhi na la zug / 3. tshig phrad na yig / na...1) dmigs kyis dbye ba/ dngos su na/ mdor bsdus na/ yin grang na/ 2) rgyu mtshan ston pa/ me yod na du ba 'byung/ sa bon btab na 'bras bu skye/ 3) rgyu mtshan don gyis ston pa/ nad med na sman pa ci'i phyir bsten/ chang ma btungs na ra bzi don med/ chu med na nya ga la yong/ 4) tshig 'gal bar ston pa/ kho rang mkhas pa yin par grags na'ng bzang ngan gyi dbye ba 'byed mi shes pa'i rmongs pa zhig red 'dug / 5) 'os par dka' ba/ khyi la'ang 'jigs na seng ge la bshad mi dgos/ mi rgan pas 'khur mi thub na phru gus lta ci smos/ nad pa de phar tshur 'gro thub na yar lang thub pa smos ci 'tshal/ 6) phyi tshig nges par byed pa/ dud 'gro rnams shin tu rmongs na mi'ng de ltar 'dug / 'brog pas zhing 'debs mi shes na so nam pas zhing kha 'debs mi shes pa'ng 'dug / 7) smon pa/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs tshang ma bcings 'grol thob na ci ma rung/ 8) the tshom ston pa/ sa bon ni btab zin na 'di las myu gu 'byung ngam mi 'byung/ sman btang yod na nad e sos mi sos/ gdan 'dren zhus zin na kho yong ngam mi yong/ 4. la don zhig / la...
(legs) chu srin chen po/ rgya mtsho rin chen 'byung gnas de, gdug can na kra'i grong yang yin/
1) srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs nya khrab can gyi phyi'i skogs lpags sen mo lta bu dri zhim pa zhig ste nus pas rus pa'i tsha ba sel/ 2) mgron bu zhig / 3) sngo zhig /
lo rgas nas rig pa nyams par gyur pa/
1) na tsha tshabs chen/ 2) 'khon chen po/ 'khon 'gras yod mkhan bar na rgyu chen po byung/
1) lus na ba dang tsha ba/ 'phrod bsten yag po byas na na rgyu tsha rgyu mang po mi yong/ 2) 'khon 'dzin zhi nad/ skad cha na rgyu tsha rgyu mang po ma bshad/
na spang gi dum bu bsgrigs pa'i sa cha/
1) mi lo chung ba/ 2) rta sogs kha chung ba/
bud med lo tshod chung ba/
lo tshod 'dra ba/ khong gnyis ka 'brug lor skyes pas na mnyam red/
1) na tshod 'dra ba'i bu mo/ 2) (mngon) grogs mo/
na tshul zhig / mgo bo nyi mas dros nas na thing thing byed kyin 'dug /
lo rgas khag 'dogs/ rang nyid na mtho kha 'khyer gyis las 'dzems byed/
rta drel mdun so tshang ma brjes tshar ba'i lo ste lo lnga phyin pa der zer/
chu dang bcas pa'i spang thang ngam na gzhung/
na la 'dred pa dang spang la thogs pa ste, rang gis yag po byed ma thub par khag 'dogs sna tshogs byed stangs kyi dpe/
na tsha'i ldab tshig / nye char nga la na na tsha tsha mang po byung/ mi 'ga' zhig la lo chung dus nas na na tsha tsha mang po yod/
lo snga ma/ gyang na ning log nas thal 'tshub da lo lngas byung/
1. (tha mi dad pa) nad phog pa/ na lugs na stangs/ na lugs lo rgyus/ lus na ba sman gyis 'chos, sems na ba gtam gyis 'chos/ 2. na 'dam/
chu bo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, na ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo'i gzugs su bkod pa/

sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, lus kyi 'byung ba'i khams rnams cha mi mnyam par shas che chung du 'khrugs pas sha zhu pags skam sogs lus la gdung ba bskyed cing sems la mi bde ba bskyed pas shin tu bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal/
chu rgyud sogs su 'khrigs pa'i dud rlangs 'dres pa smug pa'i rigs shig / ri'i rked par na bun 'khrigs/

srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan phyi skogs dung dkar 'dra ba'i nang du gnas shing dbyar dus na bun long ba'i skabs lus phyir mngon pa zhig ste, nus pas klad pa 'dzag pa gcod, rma gso, rus chag sbyor/
/ 1) rtswa'i bye brag cig / 2) me shing du rung ba'i spang zhig / 3) nyin mo/ , (legs) zhes bya ba'i skad dod/
(legs) ldum bu dri ma can zhig /
/ 1) spang thang/ na mo che/ 2) (legs) 'dud do'am phyag 'tshal lo/
'dul ba'i skabs su yan lag gcig ma tshang ba'i ltung bar na smad pa zer bas ltung ba de ldan pa'i mi/
nad kyis na ba dang tsha zug skye ba/ na tsha phog pa/ na tsha 'chos pa/

/ rkyen gcig nas byung ba'i na tsha, ko ba gcig nas dras pa'i rgyun bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la khams mi bde ba dang, nyams mi bde ba, nye bar gdung, snyun, 'du ba 'khrugs pa, na ba, nad, brnag dka', bro nad, bro 'tshal, zug rngu bcas so,
na tsha'i 'gal rkyen mang po dus gcig tu bslangs pa/
nad gzhi lod po'm na tsha dza drag po/
(yul) na tsha rnying pa chags pa/ sman bcos dus thog tu ma 'khel bas na tsha ros pa red/
1) na lugs na stangs kyi gnas tshul/ nad pas em chir na tshul shod pa/ 2) mi na na khul/ mi na na tshul gyi nad rdzu byas pa/
lo grangs ji tsam lon tshod/ na tshod yongs su nyams pa/ na tshod shin tu phra yang gtam lan dpe don sbyar te gnad la 'khel ba zhig bshad/
lo tshod dar la babs pa'am na tshod longs pa/
lang tshod dar ba'i mi ste lo sum cu bzhi bcu lon tsam zhig /
(mngon) 1) khu byug / 2) bya rog / 3) skyu ru ra'i shing/ 4) na tshod dar ma/
1) tshad bkag gi lo grangs longs pa/ 2) byis pa'i lo tshad las yol ba/
lang tsho rgas pa'm lo rgas pa/
na med na rdzu byed pa/ na med na rdzu btab pa/
gos kyi zhe sa/ na bza' dam pa/
tshod tshod dam spam spam/ ma brtags ma dpyad par na yam ma shod/
lang tsho rgas pa'm na tshod song ba/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
1) sne mo 'dzar ba'am 'phyang ba/ 2) rgyun mi 'chad pa/
(legs) dmyal ba ste na rag kyang zer/
1) rim pa bstar chags/ 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, rgyu gzer la phan/
1) na tshod kyi rim pa/ rgan gzhon na rim bzhin du gral bsgrigs pa/ 2) rabs sam rim pa/ mi rabs na rim,/ 'dzin grwa na rim bzhin du slob sbyong byed pa/

zer ba/ khong na re, khyod rnams nyon dang, gtam snyan po zhig yod zer/ mi gzhan dag na re, 'di 'dra byas na yag po 'dug zer/ , no re, nor 'khrul/ tshig na re no res don mi go/ na re ba, rgyun chags pa'm nar ma/ las grwa btsugs pa nas bzung ste las rgyun na re bar 'dzin mus red/
bod yig gi dbyangs bzhi'i tha ma mtshon byed kyi brda zhig
don med ston pa'i tshig cig / don med 'khyams pa rkang pa na rogs red/
pho ba ris kyi ming gzhan zhig /
na ba'i dus/ nga na shul ring la khong gis gang cir rogs ram yag po gnang byung/
lo tshod dam lo na/ na so gzhon gzhon/
rta drel skyes nas lo bdun lon pa/
nad kyi zug tshor tshul/ gzugs po mi bde ba na lhang lhang zhig 'dug /
klu'i ge sar ram glang po'i ge sar te, shing sman me tog gi rigs, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo tshad dang, mchin tshad, snying tshad sogs la phan/
(legs) sngar rgya gar gyi yi ge'i rigs shig
pan chen n'a ro pa nas brgyud pa'i mkha' spyod ma ste sngags bla med kyi yi dam zhig /

rgya gar gyi pan chen na ro ta pa nas brgyud: pa'i gdams pa ste 'di la chos drug 'dren lugs gnyis las gcig ni, gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang, 'od gsal, sgyu lus, bar do, 'pho ba, grong 'jug bcas drug yang gcig ni, gtum mo dang, 'od gsal, sgyu lus, zung 'jug 'pho ba, grong 'jug ste drug /

dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i skabs su byung ba'i rgya gar gyi grub chen tee lo pa'i dngos slob, bod kyi mar pa lo ts'a'i bla ma yin zhing, mar pa lo ts'a la bde mchog dang n'a ro chos drug sogs kyi gdams pa spel gnang mdzad/

sngar rgya gar ma ga dha rgyal khab kyi rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na yod pa'i dgon pa grags can zhig dus rabs lnga pa nas drug pa'i dus 'go'i bar du btab, der dgon chen brgyad yod pa dang dge 'dun gzhis byes mi grangs chig khri tsam zhig rgyun du bzhugs, der theg chen theg chung dang, rig byed, tshad ma, sgra rig pa, gso ba rig pa sogs bslab pa'i gnas yin pas rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi slob grwa mtho shos shig tu gyur, rang rgyal thang rgyal rbas kyi shyan tsang (htang zan bla ma) dang dbyi cing sogs der slob gnyer lo mang mdzad, dus rbas bcu gnyis pa'i dus mjug tu bsnubs shing, nye rabs gzhi nas de'i rjes shul khag gcig la 'og nas bton/
nag shas che ba'i khra khra/ nag ge nog ge, ri mo tshon sogs zub pa'i rnam pa/ mdog ris nag ge nog ge med par gsal po 'dug / tshon ris rnams nag ge nog ger gyur 'dug /
skyon dang, dri nog chags tshul/ gos rnying nag ge ba/ bya spyod nag ge ba/
nag po 'gro shes kyi bsdus tshig
nyes pa yod mkhan/ nag can gte po/ nag can lte ba/

1) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi grong khyer lha sa'i byang shar ngos na yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de byang nag chu kha ru yod/ 2) 'bab chu zhig chu 'go gdang la'i lho ngos nas byung zhing bod rang skyong ljongs kyi a mdo rdzong khul gyi nag mtshor 'bab, de nas nag chu rdzong brgyud de 'bri ru rdzong khul du shag chu dang 'dres shing, de nas sog rdzong khul du sog chu dang 'dres rjes gzhi nas rgyal mo rngul chu zhes zer/ 3) sa khul zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi byang rgyud du yod cing 'di'i byang ngos zhin cang yu gur rang skyong ljongs dang mtsho sngon zhing chen gnyis dang 'brel nas yod, sa khul 'di'i khongs su nag chu dang, a mdo, snyan rong, sbra chen, sog 'bri ru, dpal mgon, lha ri, shan rtsa bcas rdzong khag dgu yod cing, sa khul gyi las khungs nag chu khar yod/
gyi zhal lce: zhal lce bcu drug gi nang gses snga dus khrims 'gal tshabs chen byas rigs la dbang po gcod 'breg sogs lus steng gi chad pa gcod lugs kyi khrims/
gzhung chen rnams kyi yig 'bru'i zhabs la snag tshas bris pa'i mchan 'grel/
bya ba nyes pa'i skyon/ nag nyes chen po nam mkhar mi shong ba/
mun pa'm mdog shin tu nag po/ dkar gsal med pa'i khang pa nag ting nge ba/ zhal nag ting nger gyur nas phyin song/ rdo sol ltar nag ting nge ba'i brag rdo/
kha dog nag tshul/ ngo dkar sing sing, sems nag thing thing/
mun pa dang grib so 'thibs pa'i kha dog / nyi ma nub nas gnam nag thib thib tu gyur song/
glo bur mun pa 'thibs pa lta bu'i snang ba 'char stangs shig / nad pa nag thum mer brgyal song/ lhags pa phog nas zhu mar nag thum mer shi song/
1) mun pa rub pa/ zhu mar glo bur du nag thom ste shi song/ 2) rig pa mi gsal ba/
dkar gsal med pa/ mun khang nang du nag thom thom du lus 'dug /
thab snod sogs kyi mthil dreg /
nag ge nog ge'i bsdus tshig

/ 1) rgyu skar zhig gi ming ste, hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar du nag zla zer, zla ba nya rgyas dus su skar ma nag pa dang zla ba gnyis phal cher 'grogs pas na de ltar brjod/ 2) tshos gzhi/
(mngon) dpyid tha ma'am hor zla gsum pa/
rtsi nag po btang ba'i yi ge 'bri gzhi'i pang leb/
hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga skar ma nag pa dang zla ba mnyam bgrod kyi dus/

1./ 1) bya ba ngan pa'm nyes pa/ dkar po la gyen 'ded dang nag po la thur 'ded byed pa/ 2) nyan thos dgra bcom pa zhig ste, bstan pa'i gtad rabs drug pa/ 2. kha dog gi bye brag cig / sol ba nag po/ ras nag po/ mtshan mo nag po/ sems nag po/ ngo nag po ston pa/ 3. ha cang ngam shin tu'i don/ dgra bo dgra nag / lkugs pa lkugs nag / dpe nag po bsags song/ ha nag po las song/ zhe nag po 'gras song/
tshig 'bru dkyus gcig tu shar gyis 'don klog thub pa/ go dka' ba'i gzhung don rnams nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa/
'khor bar 'khyams byed kyi rgyu kho na ston pa'i grub mtha' smra ba zhig /
tshos gzhi gzhan dag ma 'dres pa'i nag rkyang/
sngar rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig ste grub thob brgyad cu'i ya gyal zhig /
ham bsnyon gyis nyes skyon 'dzugs pa/
phyi rol gyi dug can srin bu parpa ta dang, lus nang gi khrag srin gnyis 'doms te gnyan tshad rlung gsum mnyam du slong ba'i nad gdug pa can 'phral du srog la rgol ba zhig /
1) zla ba mar ngo/ 2) bya ba mi dge ba/
1) zla ba mar ngo'i dus/ 2) sdig spyod kyi rigs/

1) yi ge nag zub/ snag tsha 'dal nas yig 'bru nag 'byams la phyin 'dug / 2) dkar cha'm snang ba thams cad 'grib pa/ char mun 'thibs te mun pa nag 'byams la song ba/ 3) srol ngan rgyun chags/ sgrigs lam nyams nas srol ngan nag 'byams su gyur pa/
nyes pa med pa/ nag med nyes btsugs/ mi nag med la nag dang, rdo zur med la zur/ nag med nag 'khel/
byas nyes med bzhin du nyes khag dkri ba'am nyes pa med par nyes chad gtong ba/
nyes pa med par nyes khag bkal ba/ gyod ya phan tshun nag med nag btsugs kyis rtsod shags brgyab mi chog
/ 1) bud med/ nag mo khyo med/ 2) (mngon) ske tshe/
nag med nag btsugs dang don gcig
khang pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung gi mtha'i nag rtsi/
rde'u dkar nag brtsis nas lus srog dbang thang klung rta'i 'byung khams rnams kyi dar rgud brtsi tshul/
(yul) 1) gnag phyugs yod pa'i 'brog dud/ 2) re ldes bzos pa'i sbra dbyibs gru bzhi ma/ 3) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shan rtsa rdzong gi mi ming rnying yin/
grib ma'am mun pa dang rlung nag tshub tshub/ thal rlung chen po nag tshub tshub cig langs 'dug /
lan tshwa'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rma rul gso, skran nad bshig skra dkar nag por 'gyur, so rnyil dang kha'i nad sel/

ba tshul khrims rgyal ba: rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo grangs bcu bdun pa lcags phag la sku 'khrungs shing gu ge'i rgyal po byang chub 'od kyi bka' bzhin rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang lhan cig tu jo bo rje gdan 'dren du 'phags yul du phebs pa'i lo ts'a ba zhig /
gsang thabs kyi sgo nas yul thang las rin gong che ba'i nyo tshong byed pa'i tshong/
kha dog nag po bzo byed kyi mtshur zhig /
nag khra/ ba phyugs nag zal/ mdzo mo nag zal/
grib nag gi rnam pa zhig / mtshan mor thag ring gi khang pa rnams nag yo re ba zhig las mthong rgyu mi 'dug
sol ba'i mdog / mgal dum nag rog ge ba/ khros te gdong nag rog ge bar bsdad 'dug /
yang dag pa min pa'i las ka/
kha dog nag po'i khyad par zhig / skra spu nag seng ba/
kha dog gi khyad par zhig / ras nag ser gyi phyu pa bra bo'i mdog /
(yul) dkar rag dang snag tsha bsres pa'i mdog /
bug pa stong pa'i mngon tshul zhig / khang pa'i sgo nag hu rer phye 'dug / seng ge'i kha nag hu rer gdangs 'dug
skyon nam dri nog chags tshul/ gos rnying nag hrul le ba/
nog chags tshul:/ shog bu nag lhag lhag la yig 'bru gsal po mi yong/
yang dag pa la skyon lhad 'dres pa/
nang lugs su phan tshun thug phrad/ grogs po phan tshun nang phrad byung ba/
skye shing mang po yod sa/ nags stug po/ nags 'thibs po/ nags kyi shing mi drang ba min par shing mkhan thig ma drang ba red/
rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i nags tshal stug po/ gna' dus nas chags pa'i nags klung/
nags tshal can gyi sa khul/
shing nags mthug po'i nang khul/
shing nags kyi gsham mam nye 'khor/
(mngon) 1) khu byug / 2) glang po che/ nags na gnas, 1) gnas brtan bcu drug las lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig / 2) (mngon) spre'u/
(mngon) sha ra bha ste seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa/
yun nan zhing chen gyi rgyal thang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i mtsho zhig /
shing nags nang gi sbrang ma/
rus pa chag par sbyor ba la phan pa'i sngo sman zhig
gsom thang shing gi thang chu ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rnag 'bigs, chu ser skem/
nags tshal la mched pa'i me/
rang byung gi shing nags/ ming gi rnam grangs la dgon pa dang, stug po'i nags, 'thibs po, nags klung, tshang tshing can, tshal shing ldan bcas so,
lo ma can: ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal dang don gcig
shing nags yod pa'i ri bo/ nags ri dang gangs ri spang ri gsum gyi nang nas gangs ri mtho/
shing cha dang nags thon dngos rdzas 'don pa'i ched du nags tshal 'dzugs gnyer gyi thon skyed las don/

/ 1) phyi nang gi zlas phye ba'i nang/ sems nang/ khang pa'i nang/ chu'i nang/ mi mang po'i nang du 'tshang ba/ tshogs khang gi phyi nang tshang ma mis gang 'dug / nang skor kha 'chams, phyi skor gros mthun/ nang dpa' bo'i dpa' gral ma bshig na, phyi ge sar dmag la skrag mi dgos/ 2) khyim mam sdod sa/ khong nang la bzhugs mi 'dug / khong nang la log phyin song/ 3) 'phros don sems la'ang 'jug / dka' tshegs che yang nang du ma zhum/ 4) 'phros don gsang ba'i don/ nang khul gyi yig cha/
(yul) sbra 'bubs byed nang gi ka rgyug /
(yul) shing rdog khog pa dkrug byed kyi lag cha phyogs gcig la so yod pa zhig /
nang gi rkun ma/ dogs zon byed dka' ba ni nang rkun yin/
nye ba'i rkyen nam nang nas byung ba'i rkyen/
1) nang logs kyi khongs/ 2) nang don/ 3) skor lam nang ma/ 4) g.yas skor/
sngar khral pa tshos sger dpon so sor 'jal dgos pa'i khral/
1) nang khul gyi sgrigs khrims/ 2) sger ram khyim tshang gi sgrigs khrims,
rang khyim gyi dngos po phyir 'tshong ba/
rgyu ma glo mchin grod pa sogs khog nang don lnga snod drug spyi'i ming/
bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs skabs mnga' bdag gi khyim du nyar ba'i nang ma'i 'khor g.yog /
'byung ba chen po bzhi dag rgyur byas pa'i gzugs can dang ba, mig gi dbang po sogs bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs dang, yid sogs bstan med thogs med rnams so/
nang gi skye mched drug skye mched bcu gnyis kyi nang gses shig
ste mig rna, sna, lce, lus, yid bcas rten gyi cha nas shes pa skye ba'i sgor gyur pa drug go/
khams bco brgyad kyi bye brag cig ste: mig rna, sna, lce, lus, yid bcas kyi dbang po'i khams rnams so/
cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can: srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag nas, nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad tsam gyi 'bras bu ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

nang bcud kyi sems can rnams rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis rim bzhin 'byung ba ste, ma rig pa las 'du byed dang, de las rnam shes sogs rgyu snga ma las 'bras bu phyi ma 'byung ba dang, rgyu 'gag pas 'bras bu 'gag pa'o/
gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs la ma ha a nu a ti gsum/

phyir bzlog gnyis, dbang bzhi bskur ba, kha sbyor dbye ba, gtor ma, rdo rje'i bzlas pa, drag shul sgrub pa, rab gnas, dkyil 'khor sgrub pa, mchod bstod bya ba, bdag 'jug len zhing rjes su gnang ba nod pa rnams so/
1) sems kyi sdug bsngal/ 2) rang khyim du gra ma 'grig pa'i sdug bsngal/
nang gi rdul du grub pa ste, dbang po gzugs can pa rnams so/
yi ge klog skabs kha nang gi skye gnas dang byed pa rnams kyi rtsol ba/
yid kyi tshor ba'am, sems kyi tshor ba, yid shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba'o/
bde sdug btang snyoms kyi khyad par lta bu/
nang gi rgya mtsho ste, rol ba'i mtsho bdun nam, ri rab nas mu khyud 'dzin la thug pa'i ri de dag gi bar na yod pa'i mtsho bdun gyi nang ma drug /
nang gi mtsho drug sbrang rtsi
mar, zho, 'o ma, chu, chang ste drug /
skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs te, dbang po lnga lta bu nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa'o/
nang gi gzugs can dang ba
nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig,
nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa
rnam g.yeng drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, bying ba dang, rgod pa dang, ro myong bar byed pa ste, skyon de gsum gyis ting nge 'dzin med par byed pa'o/
mandar, nishada, nor bu'i 'od, dro na, bsil ri rnams so/
nang rig pa dang don gcig
bod nang khul gyi thog ma'i rigs rus mched gzhi ni se sde, rmu sde, ldong sde, stong sde bzhi'o, mi bu rigs bzhi'ang zer/
bdag rang gi lus te sha khrag rus gsum las grub pa'i gzugs dang nang gi dbang po gzugs can lnga lta bu'o/
1) gyon gos nang ma/ 2) snga dus rgya nag gong ma'i mdzod nas thon pa'i gos chen/
1) lto dang gros kha mnyam mtshungs kyi nang mi'i gras/ blo mthun nang gras/ gnyen tshan nang gras/ 2) nang gi rim pa/
phyi mis thos su mi rung ba'i nang don gyi gros/ zhib nan chen po'i sgo nas nang gros byas te jus gzhi 'ding ba/
rang phyogs nas bsam sbyor log pa byed mkhan/
nang logs kyi rgya khyon/ khang pa'i nang rgya ha cang che/
rgyugs dngos su ma blangs gong la nang khul du rgyugs len pa/

rnying ma ba'i lugs las nang bla med kyi rgyud rnams rdo rje 'chang chen pos chos 'byung yangs pa'i zhing khams su gsungs, de dag las bla na med pa'i theg pa ni gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas dag sa la gnas pa'i gdul bya rnams la bstan pa'o/

rnying ma'i gzhung lugs la rgyud ma ha yo ga , lung a nu yo ga,man ngag a ti yo ga ste yo ga rnam pa gsum ni, sems nyid sku dang ye shes kyi rnam par snang ba snod bcud thams cad lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med spyod yul dang bral bar gtan la phab ste chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid chen por dbang bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas pas dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/
nang gi gnas tshul/ nang rgyus lon pa/
1) rang phyogs kyi gnas tshul rgyus mnga' yod mkhan/ 2) rig gnas gang rung zhig byang chub mkhan/
nang gi nad dang 'byung khams kyis skyed pa'i mig nad cig /
nang gi phyogs/ khang pa'i nang ngos su mkho che'i yo byad rnams rim bzhin bsgrigs yod/
rgyar bka' gtan tshig la bsgyur bkod med: pa'i thog nas khral pa nang khul phan tshun gros mol gyis khral chag btang ba
1) dor ma sogs 'ching byed kyi ska rags/ 2) gsang ba'i ngang nas bzhag pa'i kha dan yig rigs/
rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho rgyud dang rdza chu'i lho 'gram du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de shar mdar yod/
1) gos kyi nang gi mtha' 'jags/ 2) sbra gur nang gi chon thag /
sngags lugs gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas rigs/
sngags kyi mchod pa'i snod spyad gras ka p'a li/
phyu pa'i 'og gi gyon chas shig / stod thung nang 'jam/ gos thung nang 'jam/

rnams lha dang skal ba mnyam par gzhug pa'i: phyir yol ba nang 'jug bya ba ste shar sgo nas gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs te lha rnams la bskor nas phyag bya ba dang, dam tshig bsrung dgos par dam bzhag byed pa dang, ye shes pa phab ste dam ye dbyer med du brtan par byed pa dang, bden stobs brjod de me tog dor ba dang, rigs bdag gi rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba rnams so/
mtsher snang dang rtsi 'jog med pa/
1) nang gi tshi gu / 2) nang gi snying po/ 3) bag leb sogs kyi nang bcud/
nang gi thabs jus don skor gyi skad cha/
nang gi gsang gtam gzhan la shod pa/
dngos don dang mtshungs pa'am ji ma ji bzhin/ ngo ma nang ltar/ 'char gzhi nang ltar sgrub dgos/ khong gis gsungs pa nang ltar sgrubs shig /

stong pa nyid bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug dang de'i rten lus kyi phung po lnga dag ni nang zhes bya la, de dag la chos dang gang zag ches rtag pa ther zug tu gnas pa'i dngos po rdul tsam yang med pa/
phyu pa'i thu ba nang ma/
nang khul bsam gros mthun pa/ phan tshun nang mthun byung ba de las don 'grub pa'i cha rkyen zhig red/
nang tshags mi mthun pa'i 'thab rtsod/
sems mthun po/ nang khul tshang ma 'thab rtsod med pa'i nang dag po sha stag yin/
1) nang du shong ba/ ca lag mang drags pas khang pa chung ngu'i nang du chud thabs med/ 2) khong du chud pa dang rtogs pa/ dngos yod gnas tshul nang du chud pa/
khongs su gtogs pa/ log spyod pa rnams mi dmangs kyi nang du tshud med/
dus 'khor phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nang gses shig ste rtsa rlung thig le'u chags tshul/

1) dpe cha sogs kyi brjod bya/ khong gis gsungs pa'i nang don gal chen po 'dug / dpe cha'i nang don/ phyi sgrom che yang nang don stong pa red/ skad cha rdzig kyang nang don stong pa red/ 2) rgyal khab bam khyim tshang so so rang gi las don/ 3) gzugs sems gnyis su phye ba'i sems phyogs kyi chos/
nang gi rdul du grub pa ste, nang gi gzugs can dbang po lnga po'o/
gyod gzhi nang 'grig / phan tshun dbar gyi rtsod gzhi nang 'dum yong thabs byed pa/
sne mang mnyam du 'dzoms pa/ snga phyi'i go rim ma bsgrigs na las don byed rgyu mang po nang 'dom yong/
rgyal khab kyi nang du sdod gnas bcas pa'i phyi rgyal gyi mi/

ma ha yo ga'i 'jug sgo ste, rang don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can la nyan dbang dang sgom dbang gnyis, gzhan don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can la 'chad dbang dang phrin dbang gnyis, gnyis don nus pa la rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang dang lnga'o/
nang gi nom pa ste khyim gyi rgyu dngos/ mi tshang de la nang nom mang po yod/
/ 1) nangs pa dang 'dra, 2) chos phyi nang gnyis su phye ba'i nang pa ste sangs rgyas pa/
shakya thub pa'i chos lugs 'dzin pa po/
dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu 'dzin zhing, lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/
nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba gnyis
nyan thos sde pa dang, theg chen smra ba/
lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi/
sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs srol gtod mkhan shakya thub pa/
/ khang pa'i nang phug / lung pa'i nang phug / las don gyi nag phug /
1) khang pa dang, ra ba sogs kyi nang khongs/ 2) nang khul/ 3) grub mtha' phyi nang gi zlas phye ba'i nang sde/
/ sangs rgyas dang cha 'dra ba'i bon po/
1) bran g.yog / 2) khong du chud pa'am nges par shes pa/
khong du chud pa'am rtogs pa/ shes bya mtha' dag nang byan chud pa/
rgyal po dang thag nye ba'i blon po'am blon po gtso che ba/
phyi dbugs chad nas snying ga'i drod thag ma chad bar/
sbu gu can gyi khog pa/
sngon 'gro gra sgrig gam sngon byed pa'i sbyong brdar/ ltad mo dngos gzhi ma bstan gong nang sbyong nan tan byed pa/

/ 1) nang tshags/ 2) nang 'khor/ 3) gsang ba/ las don nang ma/ gsung nang ma/ nang ma'i bka' bris/ nang ma'i bka' mchid/ 4) bod kyi zlos gar gyi nang gses shig ste, ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rtag tu srid blon gzhan dag dang lhan du nang ma khang du thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhas dang zhabs bro'i gzigs mo gzigs pa nas bzung rim gyis dar spel byung zhing dmangs khrod du yongs su khyab pa'i gzhas rigs shig /
nang lugs kyi yi ge'am, gtam/
1) khyim gcig pa'i mi/ 2) phyi mi'i ldog pa/
phyir ma gyar bar nang khul du gros mol byed pa/ nang mol thon pa/
nang logs rul ba/ phyi rol mdzes kyang nang myags pa des phan mi thogs/
nye skor 'gangs che sa srung mkhan gyi dmag /
rus gcig pa sogs nye du phan tshun gsod res byed pa/ phu nu nang dme byed pa/ rgyal po'i tshang gi nye du phan tshun nang dme dar nas gsod res byed/
1) mi phan tshun dga' mthun blos 'khel ba/ mched grogs tshang ma blo mthun nang gtsang sha stag yin/ 2) blo snying dkar po/ shes rgyud lhad med nang gtsang yin/
nang gi gnyen grogs/ nga tsho nang tshags yin pas nang de 'dra gsung dgos dogs med/
gos kyi nang tshangs sam bar tshangs/
bar tshangs bcug pa'i gos stan sngas 'bol nang tshangs can/ .srin bal gyi nang tshangs can gyi gos/
kham bu sogs kyi nang gi tshi gu
khog pa'i nang gi tshi lu/ dud 'gro tshon po la nang tshil mang po yod/
nang gi 'tsho thabs sam nang gi bde thabs/
1) nang don gyi gnas tshul/ las don 'di skor gyi nang tshul zhib gsal shod/ 2) nang ma yin khul/ nang tshul mdza' ba'i zol tshig smra bar rna ba ma gtod/
nang khul du tshong rgyag pa/
khang pa'i dbus kyi tshoms chen nam khang mig che ba/
'tshang kha brgyab ste nang du zhugs pa/ mgo bde nang 'tshangs byed pa/
1) kha btags legs gras shig / 2) khang pa'i nang gi bang mdzod/
nang khul kha 'thab lag 'thab byed pa/ dbang hab thob kyi ched du nang 'dzing rgyag pa/
mnga' bdag gi nang khyim dang gzhis ka/
'dra mtshungs/ khyod kyi smyu gu nang bzhin zhig nga la'ang yod/ kha nas bshad pa nang bzhin lag len byed/
1) khyim mi ste, gtong yig 'bri srol du nang bzhugs lhan rgyas lta bu/ 2) rang khyim du bzhugs mkhan te byes la bltos nas btags pa'i khyim mi/ 3) gzungs su bzhugs pa'i rten/
nang du lto za mkhan te sngar bod kyi mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi khyim nang du lto za ba tsam la brten nas gla med tshe g.yog rgyug mkhan/
nang khul gyi zing cha/ phan tshun yid mi ches par nang zing rgyag gi 'dug /
khyim bzung ba/ pho mo gnyen sgrig byas nas nang bzung ba/
1) sems gu yangs pa/ sems nad med pa'i blo gu nang yangs pa/ 2) nang khog rgya che ba/ tshogs khang nang yangs par mi grangs mang po shong/
1) nang gi sems rgya yan nam gu yangs byed mkhan/ 2) gsang don phyir gyar ba/ 3) (rnying) khyim nang du g.yog rgyug mkhan/
khang pa'i nang gi ra ba/ sgo zog nang ra btsan po'i nang du 'jug /
bslab pa gsum dang, bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len sogs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ston pa'i rig pa/
nang nas gnod 'tshe skyel ba dang ngo log byed mi/
1) khog pa'i nang rul ba/ shing sdong rnying pa'i nang rul ba/ sgo nga'i nang rul ba/ 2) nang mi mthun pa/ nang mi nang rul ba/
1) lus kyi rlung khams spyi/ 2) srog rtsar zhugs pa'i rlung/
spros pa dang 'dra chags po byed mi dgos pa nang khul gyi byed stangs/ blo nye ba'i mi la nang lugs byas kyang 'grig
nang ma'i gsung mchid dang don gcig
nang khongs sam, nang phyogs/ khang pa'i nang logs su bsdad nas las ka byed/
nang gi rkang tshigs kyi rus 'bur/
1) nang khrol/ 2) gos stan sogs kyi nang sha/ zhwa mo la nang sha gtong ba/ 3) nang snying/
nang khul du gros mol byas nas kha dan thag gcod byed pa,..
nang logs su yod pa'i pags pa srab po'i rigs/ sgo nga'i nang shun/ star ka'i nang shun/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, nang sems rgyud kyi dngos po'i gnas tshul shes par byed pa'i rgyu'i rgyan zhig /
sa nas khe sang ma blangs par phar tshur: rogs ram byed pa'i ca lag nyo tshong / dngos rigs 'khrol 'khyil nang bshug gtong res byed/
sems rgyud/ phyi spyod rtsub kyang nang sems 'jam po yong shas che/
'gal cha'am nang ma mthun pa'i skyon shor/ mdza' grogs phan tshun nang sel med/
sa mtshams su so lta mel tshe mkhan/
1) sog yul sa mtho phyi nang gnyis su phye ba'i nang ma'am lho ma/ 2) rang rgyal gyi nang sog rang skyong ljongs kyi bsdus ming/

1947 lo'i zla ba 5 pa'i tshes 1 nyin dbu brnyes shing, ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung hu'u ho ha'o the grong khyer du yod, gzhis chags kyi mi rigs sog po phud, rgya dang, hu'i rigs, man ju rigs, khra'o zhan rigs, ta wor rigs, o wun khe rigs, o lun khrun rigs sogs yod cing, rang rgyal gyi byang rgyud na yod pa'i rang skyong ljongs de phyugs las kyi rten gzhi'i sa gnas gal chen zhig red/
rgyal khab so so'i nang khul gyi chab srid las don/
rgyu ma'i nang du gnas pa'i 'bu srin/
1) nang du gsal bar bkod pa/ yi ge'i nang gsal ltar byed dgos/ 2) nang nas mthong ba/ shel ni phyi gsal nang gsal zhig red/
nang tshan nam nang gi bye brag /
nang gi gnas su babs nas lhog pa lta bu'i: nad rtags ston pa zhig /
nang gi bar chad dam 'tshub cha/ nad dang bar chad kyi nang lhong/
(rnying) thog ma'i dus dang, gna' bo'i dus/
zhogs pa dang dgong mo/ dgun dus nangs nub grang la nyin gung dro/
snga dro/ da nangs/ sang zhogs nangs pa/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab/ ngas nangs par gdams ngag bshad pas de nub khyed la phan thogs pa yong/
zhogs ltar dgong ltar/ las don bzang po tshang ma nangs re dgong re tsam du tshar 'dod kyi ngang thung ma byed/
nangs re dgong re dang don gcig

lus dang sems la gnod cing zug rngu 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal ba zhig ste, nang gses su dbye na nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang, stong dang rtsa gnyis sogs 'dren tshul mchis so/ cham nad phog pa/ rims nad 'go ba/ kha zas ma 'phrod pas pho nad langs/ rlung nad kyis gzer rgyag pa/ sems nad kyis mnar bas rig pa rnal du mi phab/
dus dang, dbang po, spyod lam sogs la brten nas nad kyi rnam pa mang du skye zhing, stobs 'phel ba'am rim bzhin lus la mched par gyur pa'i don/
tshe lo bcu pa'i skabs, nad rims gos tshad tshang ma 'phral du shi ba'i nad kyi bskal pa zla ba bdun dang zhag bdun 'byung ba de'o/
lus nad, byis nad, mo nad, gdon nad, mtshon nad, dug nad, rgas nad, ro tsa'i nad de brgyad/
nad yong ba'i phyi nang gi rkyen/
nad pa'i gzugs po'i khrag ngan
1) na tsha bzod thub pa/ nad pa nad 'khyog sar sman pa sems mi 'khyog / 2) bzod pa sgom thub pa/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog drag po 'di 'dra'i nad 'khyog pa mi 'dug /
phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen yod tshad zhi ba'i dpe/
nad lus la gram pa'am byer ba/
nad par sman bcos dang ngal gso'i gnang ba/
rims nad mi yong ba byed pa/ nad rgas pa, nad rnying pa/
nad na ba'i phyi nang gi rgyu/ nad rgyu shes na sngon tshud nas 'gog thub/
1) nad mang 'joms thub pa'i sman:/ 2) 'gyur ba med pa'i dpe/
na ba'i snga ltas/ glo bur nad ngo byung 'phral 'gog thabs byed pa/
lus kyi zungs bdun dang, dri ma gsum, rlung mkhris bad kan bcas gang 'phel ba'am, zad pa, 'khrugs par gyur nas nad du gyur pa'i don/
(mngon) sbrum ma'am phru gu skye rgyu yod pa'i bud med/
sman pa'i dbugs phyi nang gi rgyu ba rer 'phar rtsa lnga yan brgal ba'am lnga man nyung bar gyur pa/
1) nad kyi bcos thabs/ 2) na tsha bcos pa/
nad la bcos thabs byas te nad pa'i lus srog skyob pa/ gzhan skyon rjod skabs nad bcos srog skyob kyi lhag bsam 'khyer dgos/
na tsha ngan pa'am lod po/
nad shugs sam nad stobs/ sman khab brgyab ste nad gnya' bcag pa/ nad gnya' chag pa/
yun ring song ba'i na tsha rnying pa/

nad kyi rtags la brten nas nad ngos gzung ba'i thabs shig ste, rlung yin pa'i rtags su mgo bo 'khor ba dang, mkhris pa yin pa'i rtags su sha drod tsha ba, bad kan yin pa'i rtags su zas mi 'ju ba lta bu/
nad babs la gzhigs nas sman bcos byed pa/
lan gcig na nas yang bskyar mi na ba'i mi phyugs/ lha 'brum thar ma/ sib bi thar ma/ hon nad thar ma/ kha tsha mig tsha'i nad thar ma/
1) nad bzod thub pa/ 2) mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal bzod nus pa/ dka' las ji tsam byung yang nad theg thub/
sman bcos las khungs kyis nad pa'i na tshul dang sman bcos thabs shes sogs 'god sa'i tho/
nad sos pa'am nad las thar ba/ nad drag pa'i rjes la sman pa brjed, chu pha rol slebs rjes gru pa brjed/
bzod dka' ba'am bcos dka' ba'i nad ljid po/
nad dang gnod 'tshe byed mkhan gyi mi ma yin/
rlung dang, mkhris pa, bad kan rkyang pa re dang, de dag gnyis ldan gsum, gsum 'dus gcig bcas bdun no/
na ba'i mi/ ming gi rnam grangs la gdung bas gzir dang, nad kyis btab pa, nad can, bro nad can, bro 'tshal ba, mi bde ba, mi sdug gyur, zug rngu can bcas so,
nad gzhi lci yang gi gnas babs/
nad gzhi chung rigs sam na tsha chung gras/
(mngon) skye bo nad med gcong med/
nad skyed byed 'bu chung phra rab/
bon gyi spyod pa'i skor gyi gzhung lugs shig

1) lus kyi zungs bdun dang, dri ma gsum, rlung mkhris bad kan bcas 'phel ba'am, zad pa, 'khrugs pa bcas kyi phyogs su ma lhung ba snyoms par gnas pa zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la sku gzugs bde dang, khams bde, gcong med, nye zhos dben, nyer 'tshe med, snyun med, nad bu med, bro mi 'tshal, 'byung bzhi snyoms bcas so, 2) (mngon) a ru ra'i shing/
nad 'di yin dmigs bsal brjod rgyu med kyang gzugs stobs zhan po yin pa'i mi/
kha dog 'bri mar bzhus pa dang 'dra ba, snar dri ma snom na sbre dri ltar mnam pa sogs 'byung ba'i mi nad med kyi dri chu/
sman pa'i dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe 'phar rtsa lan gnyis dang, dbugs nang du rngub pa'i tshe lan gnyis, bar du gcig bcas lnga 'phar ba la zer/
mi na na khul/ nad rdzu 'debs pa/
na tsha yang lci'i gzhi/ nad gzhi yang po/ nad gzhi thu po/ nad pa so so'i nad gzhi la brtag dpyad byed/ nad gzhi ljid na sman pa su byung 'bod, grod khog ltogs na zas la dbye ba med/
zug gam gzer mig / bza' btung ma 'ju bas pho: bar nad zug langs byung / sman btung nas nad zug chag song/

1) na tsha rnying pa'am nad gzhug ma chod pa'i ro ma/ spyod lam 'tsham po ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis slar yang nad ro langs pa/ 2) sngar khon gting nad/ gyod gzhi'i nad ro bskyar du langs pa/

1) do gal dang u tshugs/ 2) 'dul ba las bshad pa'i ltung ba phyir bcos mi spro ba la chad las kyi bya ba ste, 'og tu gzhug cing bshung ba'am smad pa'i don no/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi'i nang gses, ltung ba phyir bcos byed par mi spro ba'am mi 'dod na nan tur gyi las bya ba ste, nang gses su nan tur bzhi dang, gnas dbyung bdun gcig tu byas pas lnga yod do/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi'i nang gses, mi spro ba nan tur gyi phyir bcos bya tshul khag gcig ste, 'thab krol byed pa la bya ba 'di thong zhig mi gtong na gnas nas dbyung ngo zhes bsdigs pa nan tur dang, lhag ltung phyir mi bcos par rgyun du byung ba la gang zag rang dbang can yin kyang gzhan la chos shig ces pa smad pa nan tur dang, khyim sun 'byin pa gnas de nas phyir phud pa bskrad pa nan tur dang, khyim pa sogs la brnyas thabs byed pa la mdza' gcugs kyi dngos po spangs nas phyir 'gyed pa ste bzhi'o/
do do tan tan byed tshul/ las don gang cir khur bsam chen pos lcag lcag nan nan byed pa/
ched dmigs kyis nges bzung ba/ mi mang po'i nang nas drag shos gcig nan brnan gyis 'dems bsko byas pa/

ru nga ba'am zhib tshags pa/ mi do nan pa zhig gtong dgos/ gtam nan pa zhig bshad song/ mi ngan rigs khrims la bcur te nan gyis 'jun pa/ tshul min gyi bya spyod la nan gyis gshe ba/ ngas nan gyis gtad pa de khyod kyis ma skyur yang/
1) don gyi gnad la bkar ba/ 2) nan tan gyis mngags pa/ 3) btsan pos khral sogs bkal ba/

rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la rgyal stod dang, sbyin mo'i lha mo, shu kra ma bcas so,

1. 1) gang gi dus su/ char pa nam 'bab nges med/ las 'gan nam 'grub yong/ slob grwar nam 'gro/ sngon chad nam yang thos ma myong la phyin chad kyang nam yang 'byung mi srid/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs bde skyid 'thob ched nam yang 'bad brtson lhur len byed/ gza' nyi ma nam shar la ngal gso yin/ 2) mtshan mo/ nam mi langs ka med nyi mas 'ded/ 2.ming mtha' na'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / na...dga' ston nam tshogs 'du/ g.yas g.yon nam stod smad/ 3.ming mtha' na'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / na...yin nam min nam/ sman 'dis na tsha 'di rigs la phan nam mi phan/

1) thogs reg med pa'i bar snang stong pa/ nam mkha' dwangs po/ char sprin nag pos nam mkha' yongs su dkrigs/ bya rigs 'ga' zhig nam mkhar lding skor rgyag / gser sa 'og tu yod na 'od nam mkhar khyab yong/ nam mkha'i bya dkrog sa gzhi'i 'bu dkrog / ming gi rnam grangs la kun khyab dang, kun 'gebs, kun 'gro, kun gsal, khyab 'jug gnas, go 'byed, dgung, rgyu skar lam, chu sgrog chu mthongs, rtag sdod, mtha' bral, mtha' med, gnam, sprin lam, bar snang, bar med, bya lam, mi 'gyur, mi 'da', mi g.yo, me zhal, lus med, lha rtsen, lha yi rdzing ring, lha lam bcas so, 2) (mngon) nam mkha' stong pa yin pas grangs klad skor mtshon/
sprin med pa'i nam mkha'i mdog /
nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched
gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i nang gses, chos thams cad nam mkha' tsam du zad la nam mkha' ni mtha' yas so snyam du sems pa'i sa pa'o/
nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar

gzugs med rnam thar bzhi'i nang gses, mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa lnga nub ste mi 'byung bas de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang, de dang 'grogs pa'i 'du shes kyang mi 'byung de ltar phyi'i yul dang yul la rgyu ba'i rnam par shes pa mi 'byung bas na chos thams cad nam mkha' tsam du zad la, nam mkha' ni mtha' yas so snyam du snyoms par zhugs pa ste nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa'o/
nam mkha' mtha' yas snyoms 'jug gzugs med snyoms 'jug bzhi'i ya
gyal nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
bar snang sprin pa dang du ba sogs kyi g.ya' dang bral ba/
(garuta:) bya rgyal mkha' lding ngam khyung/
(yul) thang ga'i stod cha'i nam mkha'i: mtha' rim gyis mi gsal bar thig le chung ngu bris pa'i ming
(yul) thang ga'i stod cha'i nam mkha'i mtha' rim gyis mi gsal bar 'phred shad byas pa'i ming/
1) 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dpe/ 2) mchod pa'i rdzas rnams zag med ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs te mi zad pa'i gter du spel ba'o/
ting nge 'dzin: sa dang po'i skabs su thob pa'i sbyin pa la dbang thob pa'i ting nge mdzin/
nam mkha' sgrib byed dang bral ba; nam mkha' g.ya' dag sa gzhi rdul dag /

1) med pa'am mi srid pa'i dpe:/ 2) (mngon) rgyu skar/

1) byang sems shig gi mtshan/ 2) nor ci 'dod 'byung ba'i bang mjod/ 3) 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, bam po brgyad pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dza ya shi la dang, shi lendra bo dhi dang, lo ts'a ba bnde ye shes sdes bsgyur te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/
gnam g.yer ba'i skabs ba mo 'byung ba'i chu rdul/
gza' rnams rgyu ba'i lam ste, nyi khyim bcu gnyis/

mtshan mo cha gsum du bgos pa'i cha gsum pa/

dus rgyun nam rtag par/ bsam tshul nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba/ mi gshis bzang ngan gang yin nam rgyun gyi spyod lam la brtags na shes/
nam gyi cha stod kyi bsdus tshig
(yul) 1) nam mkhar sprin mi 'khor ba/ 2) dbyar kha char mi 'bab pa'i than pa/ 'di lo nam thang nas lo tog la skyon chen po shor song/

1) lo gcig gi dus bzhi'i spyi ming/ dbyar dgun gyi nam dus dro grang la dpags pa'i gyon pa gyon, dngos yod gnas lugs la dpags pa'i las don gyi 'char gzhi 'ding/ 'bru son nam dus dang bstun nas 'debs dgos/ 2) dus skabs/ me tog bzhad pa'i nam dus/ chu rgyas pa'i nam dus/
dpyid dbyar ston dgun te bzhi/

zhal lce bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, sngar rta drel mdzo g.yag sogs sgo zog phyugs rigs g.yar po sprod len gyi nam zhag snga phyi'i bar du shi god byung na g.yar mkhan la nyes khag 'khri min zhib dpyad kyis nyes chad 'gel 'then ji 'os brtag pa'i khrims/
dus mthar thug pa/ khas len thengs gcig byas na nam phugs 'gyur ba med/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi cha shas shig ste byi ba'i dus tshod/
mtshan gang ngam mtshan hril po/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi cha shas shig ste glang gi dus tshod/
nam mkha'i mtho dma'i tshad dam dpangs/ bya rgod kyis nam 'phang gcod pa ltar bya gzhan gyis gcod mi thub/
gnam 'thibs pa dang, sa sros pa'am mun rub pa/
nam gyi cha smad kyi bsdus tshig
mtshan mo'i thun snga phyi'i tshod/ bya med sar bong bus nam tshod dang, khyi med sar zhum bus rus pa mur/ khyim byas nam tshod thig /
nyi ma nam shar gyi zhag dus

shig gam nyin zhig / nam zhig phar thon: tshur sbyor tshang ma nges gtan byed dgos/ rdzun gtam ji tsam bshad mkhas kyang nam zhig gzhan gyis ha go yong/
char zhod/ da lta nam zhod che stabs gtsang po ha cang rgyas 'dug /
1) nam dus kyi mjug ste phal cher ston dus la zer/ 2) gtan gyi phugs/

1) skar ma sa ga/ 2) nam ma langs gong/
dus gang du yang/ blo brtan po nam yang 'gyur ba med/
mtshan mo'i dus ring ba/ nyin thung na nam ring/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ding ri rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste, yos kyi dus tshod/ nam langs langs dang nyi ma shar shar red/
mtshan dus yol ba'am nam gsal ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la dang po gsal dang, rab snga gsal, rab sad bcas so,
skya rengs tha ma shar ba/ bya skad gsum pa brgyab nas nam gsal yong/ nam (legs) 'dud do'am phyag 'tshal ba:
dus tshod phyir bshol/ las ka nar 'gyangs su gtong ba/ las don 'di nar 'gyangs phyi bshol du ma song bar dus thog so sor byed dgos/
dbyibs nar mo'am 'dzar 'dzar/ thag pa nar nar du drud/ chu nar nar du rgyug pa/ gos nar nar du 'dzar/ gtan 'khel gyi dus tshod nar nar du byas mi chog /

1) dkyus ring ba'i dbyibs/ sgor mo nar nar po/ gru bzhi nar nar po/ 2) 'dzar 'dzar po'am nyor nyor po/ las ka tshar rgyu med pa'i nar nar po ma byed/ 3) mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'i gsum pa'am, mi lus mngal du chags pa'i bdun phrag gsum pa ste mer mer po las sha dbyibs ha cang snyi ba lta bur gyur pa mnan du mi bzod pa'i dus/
na re no re'i bsdus tshig
ring du phyin pa/ 'gyig gi skud pa de 'then na nar yong/ mchi ma nar te 'dzag / las ka de dus thog nas cung zad nar ba red/ las ka nar na 'gyur ldog mang/
rgyun chags pa'am rgyun mi 'chad pa/ zas nar ma/ bza' btung nar mar gtong/ snga phyi nar mar snyan sun zhu ba/ las ka nar mar byas/
dkyus ring mo/ smyu gu'i dbyibs nar mo red/ der rdo nar mo zhig 'dug /
nar nar ring po/ sa rgyud nar ring/ khang pa nar ring/
phyi 'gyangs su gyur pa/ las ka zhig byed dgos bsam pa'i ngang nas da bar nar lus shor ba/
/ 1) pad rag 'dra ba'i rin po che kha dog cung zad smug shas che ba zhig / 2) rus gcig pa'i khyim thab/

1. 1) 'bru rigs shig / ming gi rnam grangs la mchu ma dang rtsi dkar ro,2) sngar gyi 'jal byed tshad gzhi zhig gi ming/ 2./ 1) chos gang nas gang zhig byung ba ston byed rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / zhing kha'i nang nas za 'bru thon pa/ shar phyogs nas nyi ma shar/ 2) yul dang, dus dang, dngos po sogs mtshams 'dzin cing sdud pa'i don ston byed rnam dbye lnga pa'i sdud sgra'i rkyen zhig / gna' snga mo nas da lta'i bar/ ya gling nas la ting me gling gi bar/ brgya nas stong bar/ 3. mtshams sbyor ba'i lhag bcas ston pa'i phrad rang dbang can zhig / cog tse'i 'khris su bsdad nas kha brda lhug por byed pa/

sngags lugs ni gu mkha' 'gro nas brgyud pa'i: chos drug ste gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar, sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol, rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs, 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas, bar do rgyal ba longs sku rnams so/

gzhi las logs su dgar ba'am, dmigs kyis 'byed pa dang, nges gzung ngam, nan gyis brnan pa dang, tshig gi kha skong bcas la 'jug pa'i phrad rang dbang can zhig / mthing ga ni sngo sangs las gzhan no/ khyod ni dpa' zhing khyod ni mdzangs/ las don myur du tshar bar ni, brtson 'grus chen po skyed dgos so/

rtug skam dang, gzhang srin lta bu lte 'og man gyi nad la sman bskol nas khu ba grod pa'i nang blug ste gshang lam nas mas btang dgos pa zhig ste, nang gses su dbye na sbyor ba rnon po dang 'jam po, bar ma bcas gsum mchis/
lan tshwa'i rigs kyi nang tshan mtshur sngon te, ro lan tsha, nus pa drod, 'bras kyi nad dang, skran la phan, mig gi ling thog len/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas tshad pa dang, skom dad, yi ga 'chus pa sogs sel, pags nad dang, me dbal 'joms/
(legs) nor bu'i rigs rdo sngon po zhig /
(tha dad pa) nus pa, nu ba, nus,, 'o ma 'thung ba/ byis pas ma'i 'o ma nu ba/
gcung po ste pha ma gcig pa'i bu spun chung ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la gcung po dang, rjes skyes, rting las skyes, tha chung, phyi skyes bcas so,

'o snod/ nu ma sgril ba/ nu ma 'thung ba/ phru gu dmar 'byar la nu ma bsnun/ rtswa chu rgyas dus mo phyugs bzhon ma'i rigs nas nu ma 'bab pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar 'dzin dang, 'dod pa'i myos bum, brang skyes, 'o 'dzin, lang tsho'i mtshan ma, logs skyes bcas so,
pha ma gcig pa'i bu mo spun chung ba ste, gcung mo/
mo nad khrag tshabs rigs shig ste, nu ma skrangs shing zug gzer cher 'byung ba zhig /
(rnying) chang dang bdud rtsi'i nying khu/
1) 'o ma/ nu zho ldud pa/ a ma'i nu zhor phru gu dga', bcings 'grol thob par mi dmangs dga'/ 2) 'o ma dang zho/
slong chang gtong nyin bag ma'i mar sprod pa'i dngul/

la gnas pa'i sde: phal chen sde pa lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
lha mtshams dang, snron, snrubs, chu stod, chu smad, gro bzhin, byi bzhin rnams so/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha ri rdzong gi shar rgyud du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5776 yod/
nub phyogs su yod pa'i sgo/
nyi ma nub sar kha lta ba'i phyogs/
nyal ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu mtshams nang gcig tu nub gnyis las lhag par nyal ba'o/
nub tu kha gtad pa/ khang pa sgo nub blta/
nub phyogs stod smad gnyis su phye ba'i stod cha/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) nyi zla sogs bzhud nas mi mngon par 'gyur ba/ nyi ma nub song/ 2) chu'i nang du 'bying ba/ gru gzings rgya mtsho'i gting du nub/ 3) srol rgyun sogs nyams par 'gyur ba/ byas rjes kyi snyan grags ji srid du mi nub pa/ lag rtsal gyi rgyun bzang nub tu mi 'jug /

nub phyogs su sdod mkhan spyi/

«abargod'anaya:» gling bzhi'i ya gyal ri rab kyi nub ngos rgya mtshor chags pa'i gling chen zhig ste, ba lang dang nor bu la longs spyod pas ba lang spyod dang, dbyibs zlum po dang, mtha' skor dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin la, chu zheng ngam srid zheng gnyis la dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang gsum yod do/
1) nub dang byang/ 2) nub byang bar gyi mtshams/
(mngon) nub byang gi phyogs skyong rlung lha/
nub phyogs su yod pa'i khang pa dang grong khyer sogs/
nyi ma nub nas ma shar bar gyi dus te mtshan mo/
nub phyogs stod smad gnyis su phye ba'i smad cha/
nub ri la gnas pa'i sde
phal chen sde pa lnga'i ya gyal zhig

«kallam» mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'i dang po'am, mi lus mngal du chags pa'i bdun phrag dang po ste pha ma'i khu khrag zho sla po lta bur gyur la spris ma chags med pa'i dus 'di la yungs dkar tsam gyi dus kyang zer/
gza' 'dzin skabs sgra gcan gdong mjug gang rung la chu tshod gzugs me sogs zla ba bzhi dang zla phyed kyi longs spyod kyis phri ba dang, gza' dag pa'i longs spyod kyi steng du nur ster tshul sogs/
dbang ngam shugs/ rang la nus stobs med na gzhan gyis brtsi 'jog mi byed/
stobs shugs/ gzhan rogs skyor bar rang la nus mthu dgos/
1) phan pa'am stobs shugs yod pa/ byed thabs nus ldan/ dpung sde nus ldan/ 2) (mngon) 1, ga bur/ 2, bang mdzod/ 3, hor zla bcu gcig pa/

1. nu ba'i 'das pa, 2. mthu stobs dang, rtsal dang, phan pa/ mi'i nus pa/ sman gyi nus pa/ rdzas kyi nus pa/ sems kyi nus pa/ lo rgas nas nus pa shor/ 3. thub pa dang phod pa/ bsam nus pa/ shod nus pa/ byed nus pa/ da lta'i gnas lugs la gzhigs nas rjes su gang yong dpag nus/ rgyal kha len thub mi thub kyi gnad 'gag de 'thab 'dzing byed nus mi nus la thug yod pa/

'byung ba lnga'i stobs las byung ba'i sman thams cad kyi nus pa mi 'dra ba brgyad de lci ba dang snum pa gnyis kyis rlung nad sel ba dang, bsil ba dang rtul ba gnyis kyis mkhris nad sel ba, yang ba dang rtsub pa tsha ba rno ba bcas bzhi pos bad kan gyi nad sel ba yin/
rtsal shugs kyi grub 'bras/ chu yur gsar bskrun de rnams kyi nus 'bras thon pa/
(mngon) rgyal zla ba ste hor zla bcu gnyis pa/

'dra ba'i ri dwags shig ste gna' ba: pho
snga rabs kyi rjes shul ming grags can/
gna' bo'i gshis lugs/ gna' gshis kyi shugs/

/ 1) sa cha'am yul khams/ sa gnas/ go gnas/ mchod gnas/ skyabs gnas/ grong khyer chags pa'i gnas/ 2) sdod sa/ rgyal po'i gnas/ khyim pa'i gnas/ 3) dgon sde sogs sku gsung thugs rten yod sa/ 4) thags khri'i yan lag cig / 5) yul/ gad mo'i gnas/ ngo tsha ba'i gnas/ dogs pa'i gnas/ 6) bla ma'am slob dpon/ gnas kyi slob ma/ 7) gcig bcu brgya stong khri sogs kyi grangs gnas/ bgod byed mtha' dbus thig le ni, rang gnas 'dzin las bgod nus med/ gnas mi mtshungs na bsre mi rigs/ 8) skar ma chu tshod nas cha shas bar gyi gnas rnams/ skar gnas/ dbyu gu'i gnas/ de nyid gnas drug tshar lnga bkod/ cha shas mang nyung dang gnas la nges pa med/

1) bsam gtan bzhi'i yan lag cig ste: bsam gtan bzhi'i gnyen po'i yan lag dang phan yon gyi yan lag gnyis po 'byung ba'i gzhi sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ 2) dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/
'dul ba las bshad pa'i slob dpon lnga'i nang gses, gnas 'cha' ba'i slob ma la dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab bya slob par byed pa'i dge slong/
bla ma'i gam du gnas 'cha' ba'i slob ma/
1) 'phral sgang ngam re zhig ste, dus gtan nam phugs ma yin pa/ 2) dus tshod nges can zhig gi bar/
sngags lugs las bshad pa'i sa chu me rlung dang, dkar lam, dmar lam, nag lam, snang ba bcas thim rim gyi gnas skabs brgyad/

lus la rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs pas gnas skabs bzhi 'byung ste, de gsum gyi rang ngo ma shes shing gzung 'dzin du zhen pa'i dbang las tshogs drug mi gsal bar kun gzhi la bsdus pa gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs dang, de las yid 'du byed dang bcas pa rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang, tshogs drug yul la 'jug pa tha mal gyi dus te sad pa'i dus dang, de las 'pho ba'i bag chags nyams su myong ba snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs te bzhi'o/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rta khal: gyi khral 'ul thengs re tsam skul 'thus kyi lag 'khyer
gnas rten rim bzhin mjal gyin 'gro ba/
gnas rten mjal skor byed mkhan/
gnas pa'i bskal pa'i bsdus tshig
'jig rten chags nas ma zhig pa'i bar gyi dus bzhi ste, rdzogs ldan dang, gsum ldan, gnyis ldan, rtsod ldan bcas so/
dngos po'i rin gong/ ngal rtsol gyi thon skyed las chod rim gyis spar nas thon zog gi gnas gong rim gyis bcag pa/
gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams/
gnas tshang g.yar ba'i gla cha/
lam bar gyi gnas tshang dang der yong mkhan/
sngar gyi gnas tshul de gzhan zhig tu 'gyur ba/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying gi rang bzhin gnas 'gyur ba/ bde sdug thams cad rang bzhin gnas 'gyur ba/
(yul) gzhan gyi mna' mar phyin zin kyang rang gi pha ma'i khyim la zhen pa'i bud med/

1) skye gnas mi legs par skye ba ste, da lta sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i gzhi yin pas na gnas dang slar sdug bsngal phyi ma 'dren pas na ngan len zhes bya/ 2) sgo gsum las su mi rung ba/ 3) yul can phyin ci log gong nas gong du bskyed pa'i nus pa sems rgyud la gnas pa'i bag chags/ 4) (rnying) ltung ba/
g.yeng ba: rnam g.yeng drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, snying nas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan 'dod kyang bdag ni bsam gtan pa'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal mngon du byung ba/
pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dgos pa khyad par can med par dge slong gzhan la pham lhag gang rung gi ltung ba byung ba shes bzhin du 'chab pa'o/

pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, pham lhag gang rung byung ba'i dge slong la rang nyid de'i ltung ba gleng bar ma bskos bzhin du bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la smra bar byed pa'o/
lus kyi gnas lnga ste, spyi bo, mgrin pa, snying ga ,lte ba, gsang gnas bcas so/
sems gzhan du mi g.yeng bar gnas pa'i cha ste, sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i cha de'o/ gnas cha dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan/
gzhis chags pa ste, yul nges can zhig la gtan du sdod pa/ lung pa 'di la dga' zhen byas te gnas chags pa red/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang du gnas chags ma thub/
gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling ste, sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srung ma gtso bo chos skyong rdo rje grags ldan gnas sa'i dgon pa de'o/
gnas chung dgon gyi ming gzhan zhig
gnas chung chos rgyal chen po
gzhung bsten dgra lha pe har rgyal po/
1) rtsa 'gangs che ba'i sa gnas/ 2) gnas mchog dang don gcig
'dzam gling gi gnas chen lnga ste, yul dbus rgya gar rdo rje gdan, shar gyi ri bo rtse lnga, lho'i po ta la, nub kyi o ti ya na, byang gi shambha la bcas so/
1) chos lugs kyi sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs yul mchog tu gyur pa/ 2) lo rgyus kyi don snying chen po ldan pa'am nus pa chen po thon myong sar zer/ gsar brje'i gnas mchog yan an/
1) gnas rten mjal ba/ 2) gnas mjal mkhan/
1) gnas tshang g.yar ba/ glo bur du lhags pa'i mgron po la tsha zhag gi gnas gtong ba/ 2) rang gnas spong ba/
1) chos lugs kyi gnas 'gangs can dang rten gsum/ 2) gnas sa'am gnas gzhi/
rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i dge slong gi che brjod de 'dul ba'i brda/

shakya thub pas bstan pa gnyer du gtad: pa'i dgra bcom pa bcu drug ste yan lag 'byung, ma pham pa, nags na gnas, dus ldan, rdo rje mo'i bu, bzang po, gser gyi be'u, bha ra dhwa dza gser can, ba ku la, sgra gcan 'dzin, lam phran bstan, bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len, lam chen bstan, klu'i sde, sbed byed, mi phyed pa ste bcu drug /
theg dman sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses, rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa dang, 'jigs med ri la gnas pa, gtsug lag khang chen na gnas pa ste sde gsum/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnas brtan 'phags pa'i rigs yin par smra bas gnas brtan par grags la, mdo 'don pa'i tshe bi shwa tsi'i skad du 'don, mkhan po smyig ma mkhan gyi rigs ka ty'a ya na, snam sbyar snam phran lnga nas nyer gcig man chod la rtags dung, dge slong gi ming 'byung gnas dang go cha'i mtha' can, grub mtha' 'gog snyoms la sems yod pa dang, log shes med pa dang, grangs med bcu yan nas sum cu man gang rung gis 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'o/
dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, 'og min gyi mthar thug par 'gro ba gang tshangs chen ma gtogs pa gnas gzhan thams cad brgyud nas 'og min gyi rten la 'da' ba'i rigs can no/

yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs: de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, las dang nyon mongs pa ni sems can skyed pa'i rgyu yin par shes la bdag dang byed pa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa ni sems can skyed pa'i rgyu ma yin par mkhyen pa dang, dge bas mtho ris su skye ba'i gnas yin la, des ngan song du skye ba'i gnas ma yin par mkhyen pa dang, mi dge ba spyad pas ngan song du skye ba'i gnas yin la, des mtho ris su skye ba'i gnas ma yin par mkhyen pa sogs so/
1) yul phyogs dang dus skabs/ 2) sdod pa'i skabs/
yul dang dus bab la bstun nas bya ngan byed pa/
gnas bde zhing dus skabs lhing 'jags/
(rnying) rang sa nas gzhan du 'bud pa/

1) yod pa'am brten pa, chags pa, sdod pa/ thab nang du me gnas pa/ nags tshal nang du gcan gzan gnas/ khyim du gnas pa'i khyim bya, ri la gnas pa'i ri dwags/ byas rjes 'od 'bar lo stong bar du gnas/ lung pa der spos rung gnas thub ma song/ khrims la gnas pa/ bshad srol de gras don la gnas pa/ son btab nas myu gu skye rgyur gnas pa/ 2) slob ma/ 3) ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig ste, 'du byed kyi phung po de dag byung nas de skad cig ma'i rgyun mthud pa nam ma shi'i bar du 'dug pa de'o/
ston pa dang, chos, dge 'dun, slob dpon, mkhan po, bla ma, gnas, gang zag yul bcas dgu la brten pa'o/

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor lnga pa'i skabs su thob pa'i sa brgyad pa ste, mthar lam du, dbyings ye dbyer med kyi dgongs pa la rtag tu gnas shing 'pho 'gyur med pas, sa brgyad pa la gnas pa mi 'gyur ba'i sa zhes bya'o/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, dge sbyong gi 'bras bu la gnas pa bzhi ste, rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dang, phyir 'ong 'bras gnas dang, phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas dang, dgra bcom 'bras gnas rnams so/

bskyod pa'i chos can: dgra bcom pa drug gi nang gses, gang dbang po rtul po 'dod yon gyis myos kyang rung ma myos kyang rung mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa las yongs su nyams pa'i skal ba can ma yin la dbang po rnams sbyang ba'i skal ba can yin yang ma yin pa'o/

bskal pa bzhi'i gnyis pa, 'jig rten chags zin pa nas 'jig la thug pa'i bar gyi gnas pa'i yun tshad de mnar med du sems can gcig skyes pa nas gnas bskal gyi mgo tshugs pa yin zhing, mi rnams kyi tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri dang, de nas sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gser thub, 'od srung, shakya thub pa ste byams pa ma byon bar bskal pa ya thog ring mo yin zhing, de rjes mar 'grib tshe lo bcu pa nas yar 'phel brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel ba'i bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad dang, sangs rgyas stong gi tha ma sangs rgyas mos pa byon pa nas bskal pa ma thog ring mo bcas bar bskal nyi shu'i yun la gnas pa'i bskal pa zhes bya'o/
gnas pa'i bar bskal nyi shu
ya thog ring mo'am bar bskal dang po dang, khug pa bco brgyad de bar bskal bco brgyad dang, ma thog ring mo'am bar bskal tha ma ste bsdoms pas bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu'o/
nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu tsam thob nas rang rgyal du gyur pa/
/ 1) gnas tshang bdag po/ 2) khyim gyi bdag po/ 3) tshong dpang/
1) sdod gnas spo ba/ 2) go sa spar ba/ 3) chos lugs ltar gshin po'i rnam shes gnas gong mar spar ba/
sdod gnas gzhan du spo ba/ sdod khang gsar pa'i nang du gnas spo ba/ dbyar dus ru ba rnams rtswa chu gang bzang du gnas spo ba/
phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i nang gses, 'og min, dga' ldan sogs lha yul dang, w'a r'a na si, bya rgod phung po'i ri, ri bo ma la ya sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos gsungs pa'i gnas/
1) sdod pa'i sa phyogs/ 2) lta ba 'dzin stangs/
1) sdod gnas gzhan du 'gyur ba/ 2) skye gnas gzhan du 'gyur ba/ 3) go gnas gzhan du 'gyur ba/
sdod babs sam, gnas tshul gyi babs/ gnas babs ha cang bzang/ gnas babs bya dka' byed gtad du gyar ba/

rab tu byung bas rgyun du spyad par bya ba'i 'tsho ba'i spyod lam rigs bzhi ste, gos bzang ngan gyi mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba dang, zas mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba, gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba, sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar spyod pa bcas bzhi'o/
rab byung rten sa'i gnas brtan/
zang zing med pa'i gnas dgon ri khrod sogs/
1) rang sa nas rgyang ring du 'bud pa/ khrims 'gal nyes can rnams gnas dbyung gtong ba/ 2) go gnas 'bebs pa/ las don byas nyes byung nas gnas dbyung gtong ba/

ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi'i nang gses, mi spro ba nan tur gyi phyir bcos byed pa'i tshul zhig ste, lhag ma la sogs pa'i ltung ba byung bar kun la grags kyang phyir bcos byed mi 'dod pa'i gang zag rang bzhin gyi gnas nas phyir dbyung ba la, ltung ba ma mthong zer ba, ltung ba phyir mi 'chos pa, sdig lta can, 'thab krol byed pa, 'thab krol gyi rgyu nye bar sgrub pa, dge slong ma dang 'phyar g.yeng dang rtsa hral gyis 'dris shing gnas pa, chos rnam par gtan la phab pas kyang rtsod pa zhi bar ma gyur pa rnams ni gnas nas dbyung ba bdun no/
1) gnas gzhi'am sdod sa gtan 'cha' ba/ grong khyer gyi nang nas grong gseb tu gnas 'bebs pa/ 2) go gnas gcog pa/ las nyes byed 'dzol la gzhigs nas gnas 'bebs pa/
gnas kyi slob dpon dang don gcig
/ 1) mna' mar phyin zin pa'i bud med/ 2) skar ma khrums stod/
mang bkur ba gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
gcig gnas nas bcu gnas dang, brgya gnas, stong gnas sogs mang por brtsegs pa/

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gnas mal las gyur pa'i ltung byed de khri la sogs pa dge 'dun gyi gnas mal rang gis longs spyod pa'i mthar tshags ma byas par nyi ma char pa sogs kyis chud zos su 'jug pa'o/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, bder gnas rkyen gyi gzhi lnga'i nang gses, gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma ltung bas bde bar gnas pa'i gzhi ste gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas, sgo khang du srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa sogs bri bar bya zhing, dri gtsang khang du bstan pa'i gtso bo dang, logs su thub pa'i skyes rabs sogs bri ba dang, gzhan yang mdzod dang zas khang la sogs pa dang, gang zag so so'i khang pa spyod lam bzhi shong gi tshad can, mchod rten dang lcags ri, rgyal mtshan la sogs pa gzhung mthun du bya ba'o, de dang 'brel bar mchog la rab tu byug bas phyag bya ba dang, mnyam na rgan pa dang, bud med kyis dge slong la phyag byed pa sogs kyi bslab bya bcas so/
1) 'os min pa/ bye thang lo tog 'debs sa'i gnas min/ 2) bya ba byed mi rung ba'i gnas/ dgra bo snying rje byed sa'i gnas min/
sdod gnas khyim gzhis gang yang med pas nges med du 'khyams nas sdod mkhan/

1) 'os med pa'am mi 'thad pa/ ngal rtsol ma byas par thon 'bras kyi bgo skal rtsod sa'i gnas med pa/ 2) go skabs med pa/ dgra bo'i btsan 'dzul ngan jus lam lhong yong ba'i gnas med/ 3) sdod sa med pa/ sngar gnas med pa rnams la da lta gnas gsar pa yod/ spyi tshogs rnying par dbul po rnams la sdod sa'i gnas med/ 4) (mngon) rlung spyi/
sdod gnas med pas yul phyogs nges med du gyar ba/ btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug gi rkyen ngan byung nas mi dmangs rnams gnas med phyogs gyar du gyur pa red/
/ 1) gnas tshang gi bdag mo/ 2) khyim gyi bdag mo/
ri rtse zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spu hreng rdzong khongs ma pham g.yu mtsho'i lho ngos su yod, mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 7728 yod/
gtsang ma'i gnas ris lnga ni 'phags pa'i gnas yin pas gnas gtsang ma zhes bya'o/
mi che ba, mi gdung ba, gya nom snang, shin tu mthong, 'og min te lnga/
g.yar ba'i sdod khang/ rang la sdod khang med pas gzhan nas gnas tshang g.yar ba/
mang nyung ngam che chung gi tshad/ rin gong gi gnas tshad/ dus yun gyi gnas tshad/ shes yon gyi gnas tshad/

yul dang, bya ba, dngos po, dus tshod sogs kyi babs sam yong stangs dang chags stangs/ dngos yod gnas tshul/ gnas tshul ngo ma/ gnas tshul dmigs bsal can/ gnas tshul rgyun ldan/ gnas tshul thor bu/ gnas tshul hril po/
1) sdod sa'i yul lam khang gzhis/ 2) rnam dbye bdun pa/ 3) (mngon) khang pa/

rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas kyi sgra ste, gzhi gang la chos de ldan pa'am mi ldan par ston pa'i la don gyi phrad sbyar ba'i sgra zhig / gnam la nyi zla yod, sa la srog chags yod, bar snang la gang yang med/
gnas gzhi ston pa'i sgra dang don gcig
(yul) 1) 'tshe ba med pa/ deng sang mi tshang ma gnas zos bde po red/ 2) kha khu sim po/ skad sgra 'ur sgra thos rgyu med pas gnas zos bde po 'dug /
1) sdod sa bzang po/ 2) (mngon) 1, lha yul/ 2, rtswa ri gangs ri sogs/
lha khang dang gnas kyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sman gling rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
phar gnas tshul yi ge btang ba'i yig lan/
1) gnas tshul/ rang khul gyi gnas lugs yongs rdzogs gong rim la zhus/ 2) chos thams cad kyi ngo bo'am dngos po yongs rdzogs kyi rang bzhin/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, med pa, phyal ba, lhun grub, gcig pu'i rnam grangs rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde'i rang skad ma nyams par brjod don tha dad du gnad 'gag bkrol zhing yin lugs gnad thog tu phab nas 'gag bsdams, rang grol bsam ngo las 'das pa'i chings su bcings, 'bad rtsol rgyu 'bras la ma ltos par la bzla ba ste, rdo rje'i gnas chen po bcu drug gsal bar ston pa mdzod khang ngam le'u lnga pa'i bdag nyid can rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan gyi gzhung 'di dus rabs bcu bzhi par kun mkhyen klong chen gyis mdzad pa'o/
gnas dang rten gsum gyi lo rgyus brda sprod/ lha khang rnying par gnas bshad gsar pa/ dir gnas srung po, (mngon) rnam thos sras/
gtsang rin spungs khul gyi lung pa zhig dang der gnas bod kyi yab 'bangs rus drug nang gi rus ming zhig /

khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su byung nas bod dang, bal po dang, rgya gar dang, bru sha'i mkhas pa mang po bsten zhing, 'di la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bka' thams cad gcig tu babs pa yin par grags, so zur gnubs gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
rang gi nyes pa khas len pa/
rang skyon rang gis ngos len pa/ gzhan gyis sna mdzub ma btsugs gong du rang gnong 'khur ba/
nyes skyon byung ba'i gnong dang 'gyod pa/ rang skyon la gnong 'gyod skyes te phyis 'doms byed pa/
(tha mi dad pa) gnongs pa, gnong ba,, skyon gyis bag 'khums dang nyes pas 'khums pa/ ngo gnong ba/ zhe gnong ba/ nyes skyon byung bas gnongs pa/
sems zhum pa'am ngo tsha ba'i rnam pa
nyes skyon gyi gnong 'gyod med pa/
nyes pa la ngo tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur ston pa/ mi mang gi dbus su rang skyon gyi gnong len pa/
1.gnang ba'i skul tshig 2.skyon nam nyes pa/
gzhan la skyon gtong ba/ phar tshur gnod skyel byed pa/
'gal rkyen nam nyer 'tshe/ rang byung 'byung ba'i gnod skyon sel ba/ dmag 'khrug gi gnod skyon byung rigs mgyogs myur gso ba/ gzhan la gnod skyon btang tshad rang la 'khor ba/
gnod pa gtong ba'am, sdug bsngal bzo ba/ sgrigs lam la gnod 'gyed pa/ spyi pa'i khe phan la gnod 'gyed pa/
gnod 'tshe'i nyen kha/ btsan 'dzul byed mkhan ji srid gnas pa de srid dmag 'khrug gi gnod nyen yod/
bar chad 'byung ba'i blo dogs/ dus kun gnod dogs yod tshe yid gzab bya/
«dzambhala:» gnod sbyin nam, mi min nor lha'i rigs/

1.(tha dad pa) mi bde ba'am 'gal rkyen byed pa/ gnod pa sel ba/ nad kyis lus la gnod pa/ sad ser gyis lo tog la gnod pa/ dkrug shing brgyab nas mthun sgril la gnod pa/ 2. 1) nyer 'tshe/ dug sbrul gso ba'i mi de la, mjug tu sbrul gyis gnod pa byed/ 2) sdug bsngal ba/
gzhan la 'tshe bar byed pa/ gzhan la gnod pa skyel ba'i las mi byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan byed pa dang, nyes byed, mtho 'tshams pa, gnod skyel ba, rnam 'tshe, 'tshe bar byed bcas so,
gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong
mthun pa'i gso sbyong las dus ma nges pa'i gso sbyong gi gras shig ste, ser ba dang, chom rkun, nad yams sogs gnod pa byung zin bzlog pa'am slar mi 'byung ba'i phyir gso sbyong byed pa'o/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum gyi nang gses, gzhi med kyi skur 'debs dang, bag tsam gyi skur 'debs gnyis ni gnod pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma'o/
mi dge ba: sems can la gnod pa byed pa/ gnod pas 'dzag pa, rkyen ngan phrad de lus zungs sa bon shor ba/
gnod pa gtong mkhan 'dre dang 'byung po sogs/
mi snyam pa'i bzod pa: phan btags pa'i sems can la sogs pa gzhan gyis brdeg pa dang, bcing ba la sogs pa'i gnod pa sna tshogs byed kyang de la mi khro zhing ngan sems mi skye ba/
1) «yaksha» mi min lha 'dre'i rigs/ 2) nor lha'i bye brag 'ga'/
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sna dkar rtse rdzong dang rgyal rtse rdzong gi bar mtshams su yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 7191 yod/
1) gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rje bo ste, rnam thos sras lta bu/ 2) (mngon) phyag na rdo rje/
sdang mig gam tshig pa za ba'i lta stangs
phog thug byed pa'i skad cha:/ dgos med zhen pa sreg pa'i gnod tshig ma shod/
do phog gam gnod skyon/ gnod 'tshe skyel ba/
gzugs khams la mi 'phrod pa'i lto/
gso sbyong gsum gyi nang gses bar chad zlog byed gso sbyong zhig /
ngan byas pa'i lag pod/ dus yun ring song yang gnod lan 'jal sems mi gtong ba/
gzhan la mi bde ba bzo 'dod kyi sems/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan sems dang, sdug sems, ma rungs sems, 'tshe sems bcas so,
sgrigs khrims kyis gcun pa/ log spyod pa rnams la khrims srol gnon sdom legs par dgos rgyu/

(tha dad pa) mnan pa, mnan pa, non,, steng nas 'og tu shugs kyis brdzis te 'gul du mi 'jug pa'am gzhom par byed pa/ chu smyon 'gog pa las mi mang po'i kha lab gnon dka'/ nyi 'od kyis mar me zil gyis mnan pa/ drags shugs kyis gnon pa/
