1) rab tu gus pa/ 2) «binataka» gser gyi ri bdun gyi ya gyal, ri'i rtse dbus kyi phyogs la 'dud par yod pas rnam 'dud dang, ngos rer dpag tshad lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong lnga brgya re dang, mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum chig khri yod/
rnam par snang mdzad kyi bsdus tshig

rkang pa skyil krung, lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang po bsrang ba, mgrin pa cung zad gug pa, dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang ba, mig sna rtser phab pa, lce rtse ya rkan la sbyar ba ste bdun no/

1. 1) rigs sam dbye ba/ lta tshul gyi rnam pa mi 'dra bar bsam blo'i 'khyer so mi mthun pa yong/ las ka byed stangs rnam pa sna tshogs/ mtshon cha rnam pa bco brgyad/ shes bya'i rnam pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rnam grangs dang, rnam pa tha dad tshul, ming gzhan, so so bcas so, 2) tshul dang stangs ka/ skad cha shod pa'i rnam pa/ rgyun gtan gyi rnam pa/ 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rnam pa/ bsam pa'i rnam pa/ 3) dbyibs gzugs dang bzo lta/ gru bzhi'i rnam pa can/ sgor sgor gyi rnam pa/ rnam pa gsar pa/ rnam pa mdzes pa/ ngal rtsol la brten nas lus sems gnyis ka bde thang gi rnam pa chags pa/ 4) ras snam yug bcad kyi dum bu/ phyu pa'i khog la rnam pa drug btang ba/ 2.ming gi mthar sbyar nas mi gnyis sogs kyi tshogs sde la 'bod pa'i zhe sa/ khyed rnam pa gnyis/ khong rnam pa bzhi/ sku tshab rnam pa/ sku mgron rnam pa/ 3.'di'i mthar ra sbyar na tshig gi rgyan du 'gro ba'i rab tu dang shin tu sogs ha cang gig don zhig / ra...mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa/ tshon ris rnam par bkra ba/ rnam par 'grel ba/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings te ng ro sgrog pa/ bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa/
dus sogs shes bya mtha' dag /
dus sogs phyi nang gi shes bya tshang ma/
rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa
phra mo'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsam blo sngon btang med par lus kyi rnam 'gyur gsar pa zhig ngang gis gsal ba'i sgo nas sems kyi 'char sgo mtshon par byed pa'i phra mo'i rgyan zhig /

1) rab tu mdzes pa/ rgyan gos rnam par bkra ba/ 2) gsal por snang ba dang so sor gsal ba/ kha dog rnam bkra/ nyi ma'i mtha' skor du 'ja' gur rnam par bkra ba zhig phub 'dug / 3) mi dran dgu dran nam bsam blo mi 'char dgu 'char/ rang 'dod rnam bkra/
sgrib pa gnyis las rnam par grol ba'o/
rnam par grol ba nyams pa mi mnga' ba

nyan thos dag ni zhi ba phyogs gcig tu thim zhing nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam zhig nyi tshe las grol ba ni nyams pa zhes bya, sangs rgyas ni nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis ka las grol te mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob cing 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don mdzad pa, sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
ye shes mthong ba'i phung po: ye shes bzhi mngon du gyur nas, rnam par grol ba la bdag rnam par grol ba'o snyam pa'i ye shes mthong ba'o/
1) mi mthun phyogs las rab tu rgyal ba/ 2) khyad par 'phags pa/
dbab pa bsdu ba: 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'i nang tshan zhig /
1) bsam blo gtong ba/ 2) yid kyis sna tshogs dran pa/
rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan

khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi'i nang tshan zhig ste, dmigs pa rang mtshan pa dngos min par de'i rnam pa blo la snang ba la gzugs brnyan zhes bya la, de la dmigs nas dpyod tshe bpyod byed kyi rnam rtog yod skabs rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan zhes bya'o/
rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan

khyab pa'i dmigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, dmigs pa dang mtshan pa dngos min par de'i rnam pa blo la snang ba la gzugs brnyan zhes bya la, de la dmigs nas mi dpyod par sems 'jog pa'i tshe dpyod byed kyi rtog pa med pas rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan zhes bya'o/
rnam thar brgyad dang don gcig
mya ngan las 'das pa thob par byed pa'i thabs sam ting nge 'dzin/
rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum

rnam par thar pa thob par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum ste, stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang, mtshan ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo ,smon pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo ste gsum/
mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor zhig /
rnam dag dang don gcig, sa gzhan na gnas pa: spyod pa sa gzhan na gnas pa'i nang gses shig ste, spo ba gsum dang, mgu ba gsum dang, spo ldan, mgu ldan, spo mgu dbyung ba bcas so/
rnam par dag pa'i rgyu lnga
lam dngos yongs su dag pa dang, nyer bsdogs yongs su dag pa/
rgyun du zhugs pa nas sangs rgyas kyi bar/
ma smas pa: dran pas yongs su zin pa, mya ngan las 'das par bsngos pa bcas lnga'o/
1) (mngon) 1,nyi ma/ 2,zla ba/ 2) «beerotsana:» rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
bsam blo zhib mor gtong ba/
smra ba'i sde: nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor zhig
1) gtsang sbra dag pa'am goms byang song ba/ 2) rnam par grol ba/

sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi drug pa, sgra gcig kun tu btub pa zhes sgra gcig don kun la 'jug tu rung ba'i tshul ston pa ste, dper na, chos zhes pa'i sgra gcig po de skye ba'i chos dang, gnas pa'i chos, mi rtag pa'i chos zhes kun la sbyar rung ba dang, sgra de shes bya, lam, gsung rab, tshe sogs don bcu dang, yod pa thams cad la 'jug tu rung ba lta bu/ chos...chos...
pa'i 'du shes: mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor zhig /
rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan
rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan/
rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes
stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes/

dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi nang gses, dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa bzod pa'am brtse ba'i rnam pa can byed las gnod 'tshe spong bar byed cing, zhe sdang med pa'i char gtogs kyi sems byung/
1) legs par smin pa'a rab tu smin pa/ 2) las kyi 'bras bu/ dge ba'i rnam par smin pa/ sdig pa'i rnam par smin pa/ nyes byas rnam smin rang gis myong bar 'gyur/
rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi yon tan gyi rigs rnams skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /

skad cig ma'i sbyor ba: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi sbyin sogs nas dpe byad brgyad cu'i bar gyi yon tan gyi rigs rnams skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /

rnam smin gyi rgyu dang don gcig, sgrib pa: ngan 'gro rnam pa gsum dang 'du shes med pa'i sems can dang byang gi sgra mi snyan du skyes pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa ste, sngar gyi las kyis rgyud ngan par 'phangs pa'o/
smin gyi 'bras bu dang don gcig, sems bskyed: dag pa sa gsum thob skabs kyi byang chub sems bskyed/
rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed dgu

sems bskyed nyer gnyis las rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed dgu ste, yid bzhin nor bu'i sems bskyed dang, nyi ma lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, glu dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, bang mdzod lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, lam po che lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, bzhon pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, bkod ma'i chu lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, sgra snyan lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams so/
nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses, gsod spyugs dang brdeg 'tshog la sogs pa gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa/
rnam par zhi bar byed pa
sems gnas dgu'i bdun pa, chags sems dang yid mi bde sogs zhi bar byed pa'o/
bshad srol dang, lam lugs sogs gsar du gtod pa'am legs par 'dzugs pa/
«bipashy'i» sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ya gyal zhig...
rnam par rig pa tsam nyid du grub pa
rgya gar gyi slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
1) blo'am sems/ 2) lus ngag gi las/
rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs
phyi'i gzugs dang nang gi gzugs/
rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs bcu
dbang po lnga dang don lnga/
rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs

rang kun nas slong byed kyi kun slong ni rang gi yid shes kho na'i yul du snang zhing gzhan gyi blo yul du rig par mi byed pa'i kun btags kyi gzugs te, so thar gyi sdom pa dang, bsam gtan gyi sdom pa, zag med kyi sdom pa, sdom min, bar ma'i dge ba lus ngag gi sdom pa lta bu/
mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor zhig /

1) yul gyi ngo bo rnam par rig cing shes par byed cing, rang gi dmigs pa'i ngo bo so sor rtog pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems te, mig gi rnam par shes pa nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar gyi rnam shes tshogs drug rnams so/ 2) bar do'i yid lus/ rnam shes gyen spor/ rnam shes 'gugs pa/ rnam shes mar 'bebs/
rnam shes tshogs drug dang don gcig
rnam par shes pa'i khams drug
khams bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang, de bzhin, rna, sna, lce, lus, yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams rnams so/
rnam par shes pa'i khams bdun
khams bco brgyad las rnam shes kyi phung po'i char gtogs pa bdun te, mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams bar drug dang, yid kyi khams bcas bdun no/
rnam par shes pa'i phung po
phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, mig shes sogs yul gyi ngo bo rnam par rig cing shes par byed pas rang rang gi dmigs pa'i ngo bo so sor shes pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems du ma spungs pa'o/
ma skyes pa skyed pa dang skyes zin gnas pa rnam shes kyis byed pa/
sgo bsdu ba: 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga'i bam po zhig /
pa'i gnyen po: gnyen po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bden pa dang po gnyis la dmigs pa'i lam gang gis dmigs pa de mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam par sun 'byin pa'o/
blo gros sam shes rab ste, don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par la dpyod pa'i rig pa/ rnam dpyod rtsal ldan/
kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang ba ste, mya ngan las 'das pa'o/
nyon mongs pa dag spong ba'i gnyen po mi gtsang ba dang byams pa dang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la sogs pa'o/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, dad pa dang, brtson 'grus, dran pa, ting nge 'dzin, shes rab ste lnga/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, dad pa dang, brtson 'grus, dran pa, ting nge 'dzin, shes rab ste lnga/
rang bzhin gyi rnam byang dang, dmigs pa'i rnam byang, rnam dag gi'am sgrub pa'i rnam byang, thob pa'i rnam byang bcas bzhi/
1) brjod don phan tshun ma 'dres par so sor 'byed par byed pa'i sgra'am rkyen/ 2) khyad par/
la don gyi rnam dbye la dgag sgra sbyar ba rnams kyi ming ste, dper na byang du mi 'gro, phru gu la chang mi ster, ring du ma gyur ces sogs lta bu/ la...la...la...
ngo bo brjod pa dang, las su bya ba, byed pa po, dgos ched, 'byung khungs, 'brel ba, gnas gzhi bcas bdun/
la don dang, byed pa dang, 'brel ba rnams dang, mkhas pa la las rnam dbye lnga pa'ang yin par bshad/ la...nas las...
rnam dbye'i rkyen gyi yi ge/
shes rab/ rnam 'byed gsal bas don kun bde blag nyid du grub pa/
rnam par smin pa'i bsdus tshig
rgyu drug gi nang gses shig ste, rang 'bras rnam par smin pa skyed par byed pa, zag bcas kyi dge ba dang, mi dge ba gang rung gis bsdus pa'i chos rnams so/
'bras bu lnga'i nang gses, zag bcas kyi dge ba dang mi dge ba gang rung gi rnam par smin pa'i rgyu las skyes pa ste, zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lta bu/

sbyang gzhi bar do'i lus gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, skye nas ma shi'i bar du skye shi bar do ni dge sdig du ma'i las bsags pas bde sdug sna tshogs su smin zhing myong bas rnam par smin pa'i lus zhes bya'o/

sngags rnying ma'i sa lam bgrod tshul rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mthong lam gyi gnas skabs su, dang po bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas sems nyid lhar smin yang, 'byung ba'i snyigs ma sbyang ma nus pa'o/
sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i nang gses shig ste, phyi don bden dngos su ma grub par ma zad, dbang shes la snang ba ltar ma grub pas sems su'ang mi bden par 'dod pa'o/
rnam kun mngon rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsdus ming,

chos bcu gcig sher phyin don bdun cu las sbyor ba: bzhi'i chos so drug gi nang tshan rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig ni sbyor ba'i rnam pa dang, sbyor ba dang, sbyor ba'i yon tan dang, sbyor ba'i skyon dang, sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang, theg then thar pa cha mthun dang, theg chen nges 'byed cha mthun dang, slob pa phyir mi ldog pa dang, srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang, zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang, thabs mkhas sbyor ba ste bcu gcig /
1) tshul lam lugs srol gsar gtod dang sgrig 'jog / 2) (mngon) 'bul ba/
le lo'am bag yangs/ byas rjes gang yin rnam g.yeng ngang nas byung ba gcig kyang med/ ming gi rnam grangs la mi brtan dang, g.yo ba, sems mi gnas, so mi bsod bcas so,
rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa bcu

dngos po med par rtog pa dang, dngos po yod par rtog pa, sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa, skur ba 'debs pa'i rtog pa, gcig tu rtog pa, tha dad du rtog pa, ngo bo nyid du rtog pa, khyad par du rtog pa, ming ji lta ba bzhin du don rtog pa, don ji lta ba bzhin du ming rtog pa bcas bcu'o/

pa'i yon tan dag la sems rnam par 'phro: ba ste rang bzhin gyis g.yeng ba dang, phyi rol tu g.yeng ba dang, nang gi g.yeng ba dang, mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba dang, gnas ngan len gyi g.yeng ba dang, yid la byed pa'i g.yeng ba ste drug yod/
don med du g.yeng ba dang spyod tshul bag med pa/
sems tsam pa dang don gcig
rnam par shes pa'i bsdus tshig
ming dang gzugs skye ba'i bya ba byed pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i rnam shes te srid par skye ba'i rten/
mig dang, rna, sna, lce, lus, yid bcas kyi rnam shes kyi khams drug dang, yid kyi khams dang bdun no/
rnam par shes pas zhen 'dzin bya yul/
rnam shes kyi gnas pa bdun

mi rnams dang lha kha cig ste, tshangs ris kyi lha gang dag dang por byung ba de dag dang, 'od gsal gyi lha rnams dang, dge rgyas kyi lha rnams dang, nam mkha' mtha' yas dang, rnam shes mtha' yas dang, ci yang med pa bcas kyi skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba'i lha rnams so/
rnam shes kyi gnas pa bzhi
zag pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs la nye bar spyod pa dang, de bzhin du tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed bcas bzhi la nye bar spyod pa'o/
blo'i yul du du ma spungs pa ltar snang zhing, rang stobs kyis yul gyi ngo bo so sor rnam par rig pa'i sems/
rnam shes drug gam brgyad kyis lus srog la phan 'dogs pa'i rnam par shes pa ste zas bzhi'i nang tshan zhig

lag rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang: gses 'du byed kyis srid pa'i skye gnas rnams su yang srid phyi ma 'phen par byed pa ste sa bon dang mthun par skye gnas su khrid par byed pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/
rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang don gcig
rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched
gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i nang gses, chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa de la dmigs pa'i rnam par shes pa de yang mtha' yas so snyam du sems pa'i sa'o/
rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar

gzugs med rnam thar bzhi'i nang gses, nam mkha' de mtha' yas par ma zad kyi nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam du dmigs pa'i 'du shes dang 'grogs pa'i rnam par shes pa de yang nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' yas so snyam du snyoms par zhugs pa ste rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa'o/
rnam shes mtha' yas snyoms 'jug gzugs med snyoms 'jug bzhi'i
ya gyal rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
rnam shes tshogs drug dang don gcig
bu ga dgu: tshangs bug smin mtshams, mig rna ba, sna, kha, lte ba, chu lam, bshang lam bcas dgu'o/
sems tsam pa dang don gcig
rnam shes tshogs drug dang, nyon yid kyi rnam shes dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes te brgyad do/
mig gi rnam shes dang: rna ba'i rnam shes, sna'i rnam shes, lce'i rnam shes, lus kyi rnam shes, yid kyi rnam shes te drug go/
(mngon) nyi mas nya khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla gnyis pa'i ming/
rnam shes la mi rton pa

mi rton pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, tshu rol bden par lta ba dang, bdag dang phung po la sogs pa mtshan mar rtog pa dang, 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i bde ba la der 'dzin gyi blo'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa la sogs pa ni rnam par shes pa ste de la yid rton par mi bya'o/
dus rabs bcu bzhi par rje blo bzang grags pas sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gsungs pa'i zhal lung bzhin rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i phar phyin gyi 'grel pa zhig /
rnam thos sras kyi bsdus tshig
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rtse po ta lar yod pa'i nang gi bang mdzod cig /
rang gi ched du bsad par mthong thos dogs gsum med pa'i sha'o/

tshang ma'am thams cad/ rgyal khab rnams/ tshogs 'dur yong mkhan rnams/ 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag rnams/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi 'byor med pa rnams mnyam 'brel gyis shig / rgyu dngos de rnams la bdag sprod gzab nan byed dgos/
gtam rna bar snyan pa dang don yid la 'bab pa/
«yog:» yang dag pa'i lam dbang du gyur pa/

«yog:tandra» nang thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa gtso bor gyur pas sam, zab pa don dam pa'i bden pa dang rgya che ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa kun shes shing rig nas de gnyis dbyer med du sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gtsor byed pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya'o/

sngags rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu'i ya gyal zhig 'jug sgo rig pa'i dbang lnga dang, slob dpon gyi dbang ste drug thob par byas nas lta ba don dam par chos thams cad mtshan ma med par rtogs pa'i byin rlabs las kun rdzob rdo rje dbyings kyi lhar blta ba, sgom pa mngon byang lnga dang, cho 'phrul bzhi, phyag rgya bzhi sogs bsgom pa thabs kyi rnal 'byor dang, lta ba'i ngang la 'jog pa shes rab kyi rnal 'byor bsgom zhing, spyod pa khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs grogs tsam du bsten nas, 'bras bu rigs lnga stug po bkod par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod do/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam tshig bcu bzhi

mchog gsum la skyabs su brten pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsum, rdo rje dang, dril bu'i phyag rgya dang, slob dpon bzung ba ste rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsum, chos dang, zang zing dang, mi 'jigs pa dang, byams pa'i sbyin pa ste rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig bzhi, phyi bya spyod dang, nang rnal 'byor rgyud dang, theg pa gsum gyi chos 'dzin pa ste pad ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsum, mchod pa'i las la brtson pa las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gcig ste sgrub phyogs kyi dam tshig bcu bzhi'o/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dum bu bzhi
rdor dbyings kyi dum bu dang, khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dum bu, 'gro 'dul gyi dum bu, don grub kyi dum bu bcas bzhi/
me tog phreng dang, chu dang, cod pan dang, rdo rje dang, dril bu dang, ming dang, rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bcas bdun/
sangs rgyas dang, rdo rje dang, rin chen dang, pad ma dang, las kyi rigs rnams so/
rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa, bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo, cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po ste gsum/

mngon sum bzhi'i nang gses, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul yang dag pa'i don la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i mkhyen pa, dper na, bum pa mi rtag pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo dang, mthong sgom mnyam bzhag dang, mi slob pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu'o/

mngon sum tshad ma'i nang gses, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin las byung zhing rang yul yang dag pa'i don la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa, dper na, rnam mkhyen dang, mthong sgom mnyam bzhag skad cig dang po lta bu'o/

gsang sngags rnying ma'i a nu yo ga'i lugs su lam lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rnal 'byor lnga ste, tshogs lam 'dun pa sems kyi rnal 'byor, sbyor lam rigs chen 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor, mthong lam dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rnal 'byor, bsgom lam lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor, mi slob lam rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te lnga/
rgyud sde bzhi'i bzhi pa ste bla med kyi rgyud/
1) dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i bye brag cig / 2) rnal 'byor pa/
dbu ma pa: dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i nang gses shig ste, kun rdzob tsam du shes pa zhig khas len zhing phyi don khas mi len pa'o/
med pa'i rgyud: «bitantantra» thabs dang shes rab dbyer med du sbyor bas rgyud thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa, de'i gong na rgyud gzhan med pas na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud ces bya'o/
«yogini» 1) yang dag pa'i lam sgrub pa mo/ 2) mo rgyud kyi lha zhig /
lhan skyes dang, zhing skyes dang, sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma ste gsum/

bka' brgyud pas phyag rgya chen po bsgom pi lam zhig ste, sems la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad pas rtse gcig dang, sems spros bral du rtogs pas spros bral dang, snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs pas ro gcig dang, mtshan bcas kyis sgom du med pas sgom med bcas bzhi'i/
gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa dang, gzung 'dzin gnyis stong rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa, bden stong rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa bcas gsum/

/ 1) yang dag pa dang bden pa'am yin lugs dngos/ gtam rnal ma/ go bsdur rnal ma/ gnas lugs rnal ma/ 2) gnyug ma dang tshul bzhin nam, gnas lugs gsha' ma dang mthun pa/ nyen tshabs che ba'i gnas tshul byung skabs sems rnal du phab ste brtag dpyad byed dgos/ dran pa rnal du bzhag nas rtsod pa rgyag pa/ shes pa rnal du mi gnas pa/
lus la rang chas su yod pa'i rlung sems te, ye shes kyi rlung dang rig pa'o/
gnyug ma'i sems te rang byung gi ye shes/
rgyun lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bsam pa/
brtan brling bag phab pa/ sems rnal mo byas nas rtsom yig brgyab/
rnal ma'i lan te, rtsod pa'i skabs dbye ba na, thal lan rnam thar sgo bzhir 'debs pa'am, dri ba dang rtsod pa spong ba'i lan dngos brjod pa'o/
1) mtshon cha'i rtse'am so rnon po dang rtul po'i bsdus tshig / 2) rig pa'am dbang po gsal dang mi gsal/
brdar te rnon po bzo ba/ sked gri la rno 'don pa/
brdar nas rnon po bzos pa/ lag tu yod pa'i mtshon char rno phyung ste dgra bo'i gdong len du sgug pa/

/ 1) 'bigs byed dam gcod byed kyi nus pa che ba/ mtshon cha rno ba/ mdung rtse rno ba/ sman nus rno ba/ sman gyi yon tan rno ba/ sha ma tos pa ma shes par gri mi rno ba'i mgo la gtong/ 2) rig pa gsal ba/ rig pa rno ba/
dka' gnad kyi gting 'bigs nus pa'am las sla por shes thub pa'i blo gros/
mtshon brdar te rnon por byed pa/ dpa' dam ngar med rno len pa sla la rno rdugs pa'ang sla/
mtshon gyi rno rdugs pa/ gdug rtsub dgra nag 'dul ba la, snying stobs ral gri rno ma log /

(tha dad pa) 1,brnags pa, brnag pa, rnogs,, 1) dran pa dang, sems pa/ yid la brnags/ sngar gyi sdug bsngal rnog bzhin par da lta'i bde skyid la srung skyob byed/ 2) bzod pa/ na tsha brnag dka' ba/ gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug nang dka' tshegs ji byung tshang ma brnags thub pa/ 2,brnogs pa, brnog pa, rnogs,, sbed skung byed pa'am gsang ba byed pa/ spyi nor sger du brnogs pa/ na tsha ji tsam brnogs pa de tsam sdug byas nyes ji tsam brnogs pa de tsam che/

1. 1) 'bigs byed dam gcod byed kyi nus pa che ba/ gri rnon po/ mda' rnon po/ khab rtse rnon po/ pho rgod po rang gis ma byung na, mtshon rnon po mi yi lag cha red/ 2) rig pa gsal ba/ blo rig rnon pos don gnad rnam par 'byed/ 2. (mngon) lcags/

/ 1) dri 'dzin dbang po/ kha chag sna ral/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri 'bab dang, dri 'dzin, dri len, sna bug snom byed, shangs bcas so, 2) gdong ngam, sne mo'am mtha'/ grong sna/ ri sna/ gnam mtha' mtsho sna/ bcings 'grol brtson len gyi 'thab 'dzing byed skabs mang tshogs kyi sna la 'gro ba/ 3) rigs/ zas sna/ gos sna...mtshon sna...sman sna/ chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du yod/

srog gcod dang ma byin len gnyis spong ba'o/

sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi bsdus tshig
sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen

cham pa snar bab nas ya ma 'khrugs te na ba nad rtags su gdong skrangs shing, sna 'gag la, sna nas rnag dang chu ser 'dzags pa zhig /

1) spu sna thung ba/ bal sna thung ba/ sring bal sna thung/ 2) spro thung ba'am ngang rgyud thung ba/ ngo rgol byed pa'i skad cha la'ang ngang rgyud ring pos nyan dgos pa las sna thung ma byed/ 3) dkon po'am nyung ba/ lag sne sna thung ba/ 4) (yul) 'bur len chung ba zhig /
sna khung gi dri ma'am snabs rdul/
lham mgo'i sna'i 'og gi snam bu,..
1) sna khung gi dpangs zur/ 2) ri'i sna zur/ ri ma gi'i sna gdong du grong tsho chung ngu kha shas yod/

kha sna gnyis nas mnyam du 'don pa'i sgra/ nga nya na ma/
sna ldan gyi yi ge gang yin gsal bar mtshon pa/

1) sna khug rtsig pa sogs la thug reg byung ba/ 2) re don ma grub par kha skyengs pa'i dpe/ rdzun rkub rdol nas sna brdabs pa/
bkra mi shis pa'i rnam grangs shig ste, gar song du don mi 'grub pa'i mi zhig /
sna khug gi na tsha/ sna nad khrag 'dzag / sna nad rnag 'dzag /

gna' dus bod kyi rus rgyud ming/

bod rje khri lde gtsug brtan nam, mes ag tshom can gyi btsun mo zhig ste, gyim shing kong jo la sras khri srong lde btsan bltams dus zhe sdang gis kong jo'i sras phrogs te mo rang las skyes pa ltar byed mkhan de yin/
rdzi spyang po'am rdzi rno ba/ wa mo'i sna rno bas thag ring po nas dri tshor yong/
1) dri tshor sla po'am rdzi gsang dod po/ 2) sna rtse rnon po'am snyung snyung/ 3) (rnying) bya ra ba'am so pa/
sna khung gi lud pa'am zag chu/
rgyus ston mkhan nam rgyus yod byed mi/
lus bsnad de yan lag ma tshang ba'am, sgur 'khyog can nam, lus gcong can/
/ 1) gtso bo/ 2) gros dpon nam cha rgyus ston pa po/
blon po'am gtso bo drag pa/
sna'i dbang po ste, rang 'bras sna'i rnam shes skyed byed kyi dbang po/
sna rgyug gzhus pa dang don gcig

1) rmon mdzo'i sna sbrel byed kyi thag pa/ 2) thag pas sna sbrel ba'i gnag phyugs cha gcig /
/ 1) dz'a ti'i ming gi rnam grangs shig / sna ma'i me tog bkab na yang, dri zhim kun tu ldang bar 'gyur/ 2) sna phug pa'i gnag phyugs/ 3) khal ma/
sngar srol ltar phyogs 'gro'i lam bar du mi gcig gis bdag sprod bya rgyu'i sna ma ste gnag phyugs ngo grangs nyi shu tham pa re'i ming, dbus gtsang du dre'u lag gam, g.yag lag zer/
sna grangs rnam pa sna tshogs mang po/
sna ma shing zhes dz'a ti'i shing gi ming gi rnam grangs yin pas de'i 'bras bu ni dz'a ti'o/
'dra dang mi 'dra ba mang po/ thabs bzang sna min sna tshogs spyod pa/ shes bya sna min sna tshogs ji bzhin rtogs pa/
1) sna thag brgyu sa'i bug pa ral ba/ 2) sna thag med pa'i sgo phyugs/ 3) sna phug med pa'i mdzo g.yag sogs/
mgo dang nam tshong yan chad kyi nad la sman sna nang du btang nas nad phyir sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs shig /
mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'am cha tshang ba/ byed thabs sna tshang gcig / lag cha sna tshang/ gyon pa sna tshang/
1) mi 'dra ba mang po/ tshos gzhi sna tshogs yod pa'i ras khra/ 2) (mngon) 1,'dod pa dang, dus dang, gang ba la sogs pa sna tshogs kyi lha la bcu gsum yod pas grangs bcu gsum mtshon/ 2,chu rta lo/
sna tshogs skyogs brgya dang don gcig
rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa/

pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar po dang, shar lho dang, nub byang gi mtshams gnyis kyi 'dab ma ser po, lho nub kyi 'dab ma ljang gu, byang shar gyi 'dab ma nag po bcas yin pa'i pad ma'o/
sangs rgyas kyi sku rten rnams/
sgrig 'dra la 'dra min mang po phyogs sgrig /
(yul) sna khung nas dbugs gtong len byed dka' ba/
sna la mdzub mo 'dzugs pa ste, byas nyes ra sprod kyi stangs ka/ mi ngan kho la sna mdzub btsugs nas skyon mtshang ra sprags pa/
1) sna la mdzub mo 'dzugs pa/ 2) skyon mtshang ra sprod pa/ kho tsho'i byas nyes rigs la gdong thug gis sna mdzub sprad pa/
sna thag 'dzin mkhan nam bya ba'i sne 'dzin/
dus nges gtan zhig la par du skrun pa'i dus deb nang don sna tshogs yod pa zhig /
rigs mi 'dra ba mang po 'dus pa'am tshang ba/ sman sna 'dzoms yod pa'i sman khang/ zog sna 'dzoms pa'i tshong khang/
glang chen gyi sna zhags pa'i gzugs su bkod pa/
(mngon) 1) glang po che/ 2) phag rgod/ 3) sman pi pi ling/ 4) 'ug pa/
1) bal sogs spu ring ba/ 2) ngang rgyud ring po/ 3) 'bel po dang mod po/ 'tsho mkho'i rgyu chas sna ring pa/ 'brog khul gyi thon zog sna ring shos bal mar red/ 4) (yul) 'bur len ring po zhig /
drag zhan ci rigs mang po 'dres pa/
1) sna tha blug snod spyi/ 2) rwa co las bzos pa'i sna tha blug snod/ 3) (rnying) dbyangs yig na ro mtshon byed kyi brda/
dngos po re zung ngam kha shas shig /
rwa co las bzos pa'i sna thag blug snod/
sna khug gi i khung la rgyu ba'i thag pa/
1) sna'i sha/ 2) dud 'gro mdzo sogs kyi sna'i thag pa/ sna sha gzhan la ma sprod/
1) sna'i nang du shu thor skyes te rma 'byung ba'i sna nad cig / 2) sna rlung gi shu sgra/

sna'i rnam par shes pa ste, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen sna dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i dri'i skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa, dper na, spos dri snom byed kyi shes pa lta bu/
g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi phyi'i sha 'bur: po'am sna'i bya gshog / nad pa'i khog nang tsha ba che bas dbugs gtong len byed skabs sna gshog brgyangs yong
sngar pham nyes byung myong ba/ pham nyes byung yang da dung sna sun phog rgyu med/
dbugs 'byin rngub dka' bar gyur pa'i sna nad cig /
1) rkyen sel/ 'gan rkyen bar chad ma byung gong nas sna sel sgrub pa/ 2) 'gro sa'i gdong lam bde po bzo ba/
/ 1) gnyen dang spun nye du/ 2) sngar bod kyi rus shig / 3) snag tsha/
1) snag bum/ 2) snag tsha dbur sa'i snod/
bod lugs snag tsha dbur sa'i shing snod dam, lcags las bzos pa'i snod cig /
pha ma gcig pa'am, pha ma gnyis phyogs gang rung las byung ba'i spun zla/

(yul) rdza sogs las bzos pa'i snag tsha blug snod
sru mo'i bu'am sring mo'i bu/

1) snag tsha dang smyu gu'i bsdus ming / 2) bod yig 'bri byed kyi yo byad/
1) yi ge 'bri byed kyi tshon rtsi nag po/ 2) snag gi tsha bo'i bsdus ming,
snag tshas bris pa'i ri mo/ lha bris pas ras gzhi'i steng du dang po sol ris dang gnyis pa snag ris rgyag pa/
(rnying) 1) bud med la btsan dbang gis g.yems pa/ 2) gtsang ba'i dngos po dri mas sbags pa/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud yar klungs gtsang po'i chu rgyud du yod/
bag yangs blo bde'am sems spro blo bde/ rgyal kha thob pa'i phrin bzang thos nas ha cang snang skyid blo bde byung/
gzugs snang zhing, sgra grag pa dang, yid gsal ba/
kun gyis mthong zhing yongs su grags pa/ grod ltogs mkhan la zas 'phrod sla ba dang, kha skom mkhan la btung 'phrod sla ba tshang ma'i snang grags red/
rlung 'gros kyang zer, skar khyim rlung stobs kyis nyin zhag rer 'khor thengs gcig g.yas su bskor ba de mig yul du shin tu gsal bas na snang 'gros zhes grags/
1) sems kyi 'char tshul/ sems kyi snang ngor ngo shes pa'i mi'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba/ 2) phyi'i mthong tshul/ phyi'i snang ngor khong gnyis mthun pa 'dug /
1) mdun phyogs sam mthong phyogs/ 2) mthong sang gi phyogs/
mthong chung ngam gtsigs chen po ma yin pa/ gcig gis gcig la snang chung rtsis med ma byed/ dgra bor snang chung byed mi nyan/
mthong chung lhod yangs/ spyi don tshang mar snang chung khur med ma byed/
snang ba, mched pa, nyer thob gsum gyi bsdus ming/
gzugs brnyan/ , snang ba thabs dang stong pa shes rab/
snang ba thabs dang stong pa shes rab dbyer med pa ste, yul gyi cha nas snang stong zung 'jug /

1) do snang dang gnad 'gag / snang dag med/ brtson 'grus yod na mkhas par 'gyur ba snang dag med/ bka' slob de'i nang du dgongs don gal che ba zhig 'dug pa la khyod rang snang dag byung ngam ma byung/ sger gyi khe phan la snang dag ma btang ba/ 2) dogs pa/ khyed rang thugs lhod lhod gnang nas phebs dang, 'di phyogs ngos kyi las don la snang dag gtong mi dgos/
1) mthong ba'i cha/ 2) dkar gsal gyi phyogs/ 3) thabs kyi cha/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) 'char ba'am gsal ba/ nyi zla skar gsum mnyam du snang ba'i dus skabs kyang yod/ lam ston sgron me nas 'od chen snang ba/ glog bzhu mang pos nyin mo ltar gsal por snang ba/ 2) mthong ba'am mngon pa/ ri dwags shing nags nang du bros nas mi snang bar gyur pa/ mig la snang ba tsam gyis blo la nges dka'/ mdun phyogs su bde skyid kyi lam bzang zhig snang 'dug / 3) yod pa'am gnas pa/ las don 'di'i skor la thabs shes snang ngam mi snang/ tsha zer zhes pa nyi ma'i ming du snang/ de lta bu'i zer sgros phal skad la snang/ 2. 1) 'od zer/ nyi ma'i snang ba/ blo gros kyi snang ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgron ma dang, mngon par gsal ba, snang byed, snang gsal, 'od gsal, 'od mdangs, 'od zer 'bar ba, rab gsal, gsal ba bcas so, 2) phyi'i gnas tshul/ dmag 'khrug gi snang ba/ zhi bde'i snang ba/ rmi lam gyi snang ba/ 3) nang gi bsam tshul dang mthong tshul lam, sems kyi 'char sgo/ 'khyags snang ltogs snang/ rang snang gang dran/ mi'i snang bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha ma shod/ nyams snang/ mthong snang/ 4) (mngon) nyi 'od/ 5) thim rim 'char skabs, thog mar ston gnam dwangs pa la mtshan mo zla 'od kyis khyab pa ltar stong pa dkar lam pa'i snang ba 'char gyi, de las gzhan gang yang mi 'char ba'i yid shes phra mo zhig / snang ba skyid po, sems bag phebs po'am sems spro po/ las 'gan tshags su tshud na snang ba skyid po yong/ dogs zon med pa'i snang ba skyid por sdod mi nyan/ .
sems 'khrul ba/ thag khra dug sbrul du 'dzin pa ni snang ba 'khrul ba'o/
mthong snang log pa'am sems kyi 'char sgo 'gyur ba/ thon skyed 'thab rtsod nang du dngos su zhugs nas ngal rtsol la mthong chung byed pa'i snang ba 'gyur thub pa byung ba/
sgyu lus kyi nang gses shig ste, chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma ltar snang la rang bzhin med par snang ba'o/
byang chung sems dpa'i mos pas spyod pa'i cha bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, ming gis brjod pa'i don gyi dngos po la sgyu ma tsam du med pa'i shes rab skyes pa/
bsam tshul 'gyur ldog che ba/ dga' sdug gi snang ba nyin srib lta bu 'gyur ldog che ba/
byang chub sems dpa'i mos pas spyod pa'i cha bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, phyi nang gi chos la ming du btags pa'i ming thams cad sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i shes rab skyes pa/
1) (yul) 'do zungs med pa'i mi la smod tshig / 2) (abhitabha) sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi mtshan/
spobs pa chen po'am nga rgyal chen po/ rnam par rgyal yang snang ba mthon po mi byed/
mthong tshul skyon cha bral ba/
goms che bas snang dag mi gtong ba/ gzhan gyi ngal rtsol thob 'bras ham 'phrog bya rgyur snang ba dred pa/ sgrigs khrims la snang ba dred par byas pa/
rang shed tsha po/ rang 'dod gang dran mthar skyel gtong ba'i snang ba gdong 'ded byas pa/
rmi lam dang, sgyu ma, smig rgyu, sgra brnyan, gzugs brnyan, dri za'i grong khyer, sprul pa bcas bdun/
sems bde ba'am sems skyid pa/ em chis nad pa seng drag song ba'i ngo gdong mthong dus rang la snang ba bde ba tshad med pa zhig 'char yong/
bar 'gro ba: bde nas bde bar 'gro ba/
khrod du 'gro ba: bde 'gro'i lus rten bor nas ngan song du 'gro ba/
sems kyi 'char sgo med par gyur pa ste shi ba/
nyams snang gsal la mi gsal/ don gnad la dbye zhib byed dus tig gtad med pa'i snang ba ban bun tsam la yid ches mi rung/
do snang ma byung ba/ mi ngan gyis gnod skyon byed par snang ba ma byung/
/ las don la snang ba med par yang yeng byas nas nor 'khrul chen po byung ba/ 2) 'od med pa/ mar snum gyi bzhu mar la dkar gsal gyi snang ba med pa/

gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nyams su blangs pa las thob pa'i slob lam nas mi slob lam bar gyi lam gyi snang ba ste, chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba, nyams snang gong 'phel gyi snang ba, rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba, chos zad blo 'das kyi snang ba rnams so/
1) mthong snang nges pa med pa/ rmi lam gyi snang ba za zi 'char ba/ 2) 'od snang mi gsal ba/ sprin gseb nas zla 'od kyi snang ba za zi zhig 'phro ba/
sems gyeng ba/ gzhan la snang ba gyeng bzhin du las ka byas na don thog 'khel mi yong/
sems la gang dran te 'os dang mi 'os kyi bsam gzhigs med pa/ snang ba gang shar gyis las ka byed mi rung/
(mngon) 1) nyi ma/ 2) mig / 3) 'od zer spyi/ 4) me/

1) mthong med/ 2) ji mi snyam pa'i tshul lam do gal mi byed pa/ mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char snang med du skyur mi nyan/ gzhan skyon mi rjod pa mi 'grig la, rang skyon snang med du bzhag nas mi sel ba de bas kyang mi 'grig / 3) (mngon) 1. mtshan mo/ 2. mun pa/
do snang med cing khe nyen mi tshor ba/
rang mthong rang 'gying gi snang med rtog bzo/ snang med gyang gyeng gis rang che rang bstod byed pa/
khur med sems gyeng ngam rang dgar 'jog pa/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs, lha sa'i gling skor nang khongs sgrigs khrims gnon gcod byed mkhan gyi las khungs yin zhing, las khungs tshugs yul khrom stod sa khul sngags pa snang rtse ba zer ba zhig gi sdod shag tu byas pas ming snang rtse shag ces thogs so/
1) 'od che chung gi tshad/ 2) mthong tshad dam rig tshad/ spyi pa'i las don mig la snang tshad tshang mar bdag sprod byed dgos/
1) yid la shar tshul/ 2) mig la mngon pa'i tshul/
si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba rdzong gi bon dgon che gras shig /
mthong ba'i yul la chags pa/
snang ba bzhi dang don gcig

snang la ma nges pa'i yid mngon
snang la ma nges pa'i blo'i nang gses, yid shes la rang yul gsal bar snang yang, rang yul la nges pa 'dren mi nus pa, dper na dus mtha'i skad cig ma'i yid mngon lta bu'o/

dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du byung ba'i bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus kyi lo ts'a ba grags can zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la tsha, zhu rjes snyom, nus pas srin nad sel, yi ga 'byed/
1) dpal be'u dang cha 'dra'i ri mo'i rigs shig / 2) nya skyogs kyi dbyibs mtshungs rgya mtsho las byung ba'i 'bu zhig gi ming/
(legs) 1) pags sgrog ste rnga zhig / 2) sgra snyan/
1) bod yig gsal byed kyi sde pa bzhi pa ste pa pha ba ma/ pa pha ba ma 2) legs sbyar gsal byed kyi sde pa lnga pa ste pa pha ba bha ma/ pa pha ba bha ma
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud dang myang chu'i sked rgyud na yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de nor bu khyung rtser yod/
pa yag gi ming gzhan zhig

gyi rigs shig ste: ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, rtsa bas glo nad sel, glo rnag 'dren, lo mas rma gso, 'bras bus snying nad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba rgyun gcod dang, kho yag pa, rgyal po gtsug na nor bu, thog nag mgo dgu, bya rog nor bu, bya rog bu, g.yag snying, g.ya' ldum lu gu snying, lug snying, shu ba tog len bcas so,
(yul) brtan po med pa'am mgo bde dran 'phrul/ mi de pa ri pi ri tsha po zhig 'dug pas slob gso nan po zhig gtong dgos/
1) tshos rgyag sa'i snod dang, rtsam chang sogs blug snod rdza ban che ba zhig / 2) phor pa zhig gi ming ste, pa ram yang zer, a mdo'i yul 'gar ba ru zer/ pa ram...ba ru...
(yul) mtshams mtshams sam skabs skabs/ khyed rang pa ru pa ru la nga'i nang la phebs a/ ngal rtsol gyi pa ru pa ru la don gnad gros sdur byas kyang chog /
(legs) keng shu ka ste rgya skyegs shing/
skra lhas ma/ gnag snum pa lo bregs pa/

res gza' zhig srod dang tho rengs mthong thub pa'i skar chen zhig skyes khyim skar drug ste nabs so'i chu tshod thig nyin dkyil nyis brgya nyer bzhi dang bcu cha bdun, tshes dkyil nyis brgya nyer brgyad dang bcu cha gnyis mda' 'dod drag cha bdun stong dgu brgya go bzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs la khu ba dkar po dang, ngan spong bu, ngan las rgyal, bcu drug 'od ldan, mchu las skyes, snyan dngags mkhan, dbyangs bcu pa, tshig brgya'i dbang, lha min bdag po, lha min bla ma bcas so,
(yul) lham zon pa'i lham yu dang mthil sgrog mtshams 'tshem stangs shig /
(sog) sba dur yang zer, g.yul 'gyed pa'i mi sna dpa' rtsal can/

sngar rgya gar gyi slob dpon pandi ta dhar ma p'a la'i slob ma'i gtso bo gsum ste, s'a dhu p'a la dang, gu na p'a la, pradzny'a p'a la bcas gsum po de dus rabs bcu pa nas bcu gcig pa'i bar mtshams su mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po ye shes 'od ces pas dhar ma p'a la bod du gdan zhu skabs lhan du phebs, de rnams kyis bstan pa bskyar du dar bar mdzad/
(sog) 1) bod kyi bla ma rgya nag tu phyin te chos bshad nas thob pa'i go ming zhig ste, dge rgan nam slob dpon/ 2) btsun pa dang bla ma/

(legs) rta mchog kha 'bab ste yar klungs gtsang po, bod kyi gnas yig rnying pa'i nang nas gsal ba ltar mtsho ma dros pa'i nub phyogs su beed'urya'i brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas byung ba'i chu bo pakshu zhes pas beed'urya'i bye ma 'dren zhing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas mtsho ma dros pa la g.yas skor lan bdun byas nas nub kyi rgya mtshor 'bab pa zhig go /
1) (rgya) rgya'i sgrung shod mkhan/ 2) sog skad pakshi'i sgra'i zur chag / pakshi...
pags pa las bzos pa'i rkyal pa/
sman dpyad gser khab rgyag sa'i gnad gsang gi pags pa/
pags rigs kyis bzos pa'i gyon pa/
pags pa'i skyi mo 'brad byed dam bzhar byed kyi gri/
lug lpags spu tshogs che la ring ba/
lus kyi chu ser sogs nad du gyur nas pags la gram pa ste, nad rtags su pags pa mdog 'gyur zhing, za 'phrug langs pa dang, shu thor sogs 'byung ba zhig /

shun pa dang, skogs pa dang, shubs bcas kyi don du go ba'i ming 'di bzhin dag yig lugs ltar na sngon du gzhi dang ma 'brel ba dang, 'brel yang bar du drug sgra yod sar 'jug rgyu/ pags zhwa/ stag gi pags pa/ gzig gi pags pa/ lus kyi pags par za phrug langs pa/ shing tog gi pags pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skogs pa dang, khrag 'dzin, rus gzeb, shun pa, shun lpags bcas so,
(mngon) shing gro ga ste shing stag pa/
nye ba'i rin chen bdun gyi gras sbrul lpags/
'jam pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, khang bzang la sogs pa dam pa byin pas pags pa srab cing 'jam pa/
'dra ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, gding ba gya nom pa byin pas mdog gser 'dra ba/
dwags kong gnyis kyi pags gos mgo nas mar gyon bya zhig /
pags pa'i 'dab can dang don gcig
lug chen gyi pags pa las srab cing, lug phrug gi pags pa las 'thug pa'i pags pa ste sbong tshar yang zer/
pags pa'i gyon pa ste slog pa
1) pags pa dang tsha ru'i bsdus tshig / 2) (yul) pags rigs kyi gyon pa spyi'i ming/
1) pags pa'am shun pa/ 2) pags pa dang shun pa gnyis kyi bsdus tshig /
srin nad pags la bab pa ste, nad rtags su lus g.ya' zhing tsha khyug byed pa dang, thor pa chu ser 'dzags pa can 'byung ba zhig /
pags slog mdo khams kyi bod rigs tshos nam: rgyun gyon pa'i zhwa mo zhig /
pags pa sbubs bshus kyi nang brgyangs te phyi dbyibs ma nyams par bzos pa'i 'dra gzugs/
pang leb kyis brgyab pa'i khang pa'i bar bcad
gos kyi thu ba'i dri len snam ras sogs/
phru gu skye skabs mngal nas byung ba'i khrag /
pang par 'degs pa/ gyad rdo pang 'gyogs kyi 'gran sdur byed pa/
lus kyi pang pa'i steng/ bod rigs bud med kyi pang sgang la pang gdan 'ching srol yod/
khang pa'i mthil du pang leb bsgrigs pa'i gcal/
1) lus kyi pang pa'i sgang/ 2) spang rten dang 'dra,
pang gdan 'dogs byed kyi thag pa
lus kyi mdun phyogs gos kyi thu ba'i sgang ste brla gnyis steng phyogs/ gces phrug chung ngu pang du gso ba/ phru gu chung ngu pang du len pa/ dpe cha pang pa'i steng du 'jog /
(yul) lag gnyis kyis pang du blang ba/ phru gu pang du pang ba/ khyed kyis rdo chen 'di yar pang e thub/
phru gu skye skabs su 'byung ba'i ma'i tshad nad cig
shing leb/ sog les shing sdong pang leb tu gshags pa/
lag pa'i phyag rgya'i bye brag cig / lag pas pad kor byed pa/
me tog pad ma dkar po/
phug pa lhun grub rgya mtshos rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos lor brtsams pa'i skar rtsis kyi gzhung zhig
snum bzo byed kyi rgyu cha 'bru rigs rdog chung la shun pa dmar po yod pa zhig / pad kha'i snum/
bod rang skyong ljongs khongs gnya' nang rdzong dang skyid rong rdzong gi mtshams su yod pa'i mtsho zhig /
1) rdza snod la pad ma'i ri mo 'don byed kyi shing zhig / 2) pad khang gi lo 'bras bton zin pa'i rkang
sku 'dra sogs kyi zhabs stegs pad 'dab kyi ri mo can/
1) me tog pad ma'i 'dab ma/ 2) (yul) rgya lu chas gyon dus kyi rna rgyan ya gcig gi ming/
me tog pad ma'i ze'u 'bru chags pa'i rdul/
me tog pad ma'i sdong po/
pad kha las byung ba'i snum/
khrag 'jib mkhan chu'i srin bu skud pa 'dra ba zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la khrag 'thung dang, chu yi snang ba, za ma tog can, rus pa'i zong bcas so,
me tog pad ma'i lte ba'am 'dab ma kha zum pa'i nang gi sbubs stong/

/ 1) 'dam skyes me tog / pad ma'i ge sar/ pad ma me tog mdzes kyang lo ma sngon pos rgyan dgos/ ming gi rnam grangs la ge sar can dang, chu skyes, chu rgyan, chu'i lang tsho, nyi mas bzhad, dri bzang khang, 'dab brgya pa, 'dab stong, 'dam skyes, dpal gos, dpal gyi 'dab ma can, sbrang rtsi 'dzin, sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan, mtsho las skyes, ze'u 'bru can bcas so, 2) mo mtshan/ 3) sngo sman zhig / 4) rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho rgyud dang rgyal rong rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de se la'i thang du yod/ , pad ma'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
1) me tog pad dkar/ 2) sngo sman me tog gi rigs shig ste, ro kha la bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas snying tshad sel/
rab byung lnga pa'i shing bya lo la o rgyan gling pas bsam yas dang shel brag nas gter du bton pa'i gu ru pad ma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa'o/
deng skabs bod rang skyong ljongs kyi me tog rdzong gi ming rnying/
1) me tog pad ma'i 'dab ma'i dbus su chags pa'i 'bras bu/ 2) pad ma'i skra'am ze ba ste, shing sman gyi rigs, ro bska la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas snying gi tsha ba sel/
pad ma dang rgya bya'i ri mo yod pa'i gos chen zhig /
gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
(mngon) 1) khyab 'jug gi chung ma/ 2) spyan ras gzigs/ 3) bud med/
klu chen brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
pad ma chen po ltar gas pa
dmyal ba'i sems can gyi lus khengs nas tshan pa so gnyis sogs su gas pa ste grang dmyal brgyad kyi brgyad pa/
lha khang sogs kyi sgo dang gdung ma'i rgyan brkos ri mo/
dmyal ba'i sems can gyi lus khengs nas brgyad tshan du gas pa ste grang dmyal brgyad kyi bdun pa/
'dab ma brgya yod pa'i pad ma/
'dab ma brgyad yod pa'i pad ma/
pad ma spungs pa'i mchod rten
bde gshegs mchod rten gyi mtshan gyi bye brag cig /

mkhan slob chos gsum gyi nang gses, slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas ni o rgyan gyi yul du sku 'khrungs, rgyal po indra bo dhis spyan drangs te pad ma 'byung gnas dang mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol, za hor gyi yul du byon nas slob dpon pra bha hasti las rab tu byung nas mtshan shakya seng ger grags, rig 'dzin chen po brgyad las sgrub pa sde brgyad, sangs rgyas gsang ba las sgyu 'phrul, shri sengha las rdzogs chen gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gnas la gsan bsam gyi pha rol tu phyin, za hor dang o rgyan gyi yul rnams su gdul bya skal bzang rnams chos la bkod cing mtshan pad ma rgyal por grags, dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil tsam la bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis spyan drangs te bod du phebs, dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs, bod phrug shes rab can rnams la lo ts'a bslabs, 'phags yul nas pan chen bi ma mi tra sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang po gdan drangs, mdo sngags kyi bka' dang bstan bcos gtso che ba rnams bod skad du bsgyur, mnga' bdag rgyal po dang, ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs las can gyi skyes bu rnams la bka' brgyad dang rdo rje phur ba man ngag lta phreng sogs gsang sngags kyi chos kyis smin cing grol bar mdzad, rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i bshad grwa dang, 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgom grwa btsugs, rab byung ngur smrig gi sde dang, gos dkar lcang lo'i sde zhes dge 'dun gyi sde gnyis dar rgyas su btang ba sogs phyag rjes 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad, mthar lho nub rnga yab gling du byon nas srin po'i rgyal po raksha thod phreng rtsal zhes su grags so/
'dab ma dmar po'i me tog pad ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngur pa sbrang byin dang, chu skyes dmar po, utpala dmar po bcas so,

sngar rgyal po zhig gis rang gi mnga' 'og tshong dpon 'byor pa che ba ming la nor bu bzang po zhes par rang gi dbang thang shor dogs kyis rgya mtsho'i nang du nor bu len par btang ste bsad pa'i rjes su tshong dpon gyi bu pad ma 'od 'bar skyes pa de yang gsod thabs thengs mang byas kyang gsod ma thub pa'i mthar, pad ma 'od 'bar gyis rgyal po la mgo skor btang nas srin po'i yul du khrid bsad kyis dgra sha blangs te rgyal po'i go sa bzung ba'i sgrung 'di dang mthun par bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi zlos gar lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung zhig /

(legs) pad ma dmar po ste rin po che'i rigs mdog dmar po zhig nus pas klad skyon rtsa nad dang, gza' gdon sogs 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la mdog dmar dang, pad rag rin chen dmar po bcas so,, pad ma r'a ga'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
sngo zhig de'i rtsa ba dang pags pa sman du spyad chog cing, nus pas khrag tshad sel/
grwa pa'i zla gam gong rgyan pad 'dab kyi dbyibs can yod pa zhig /
byang chub sems dpa'i bzhugs stangs shig
sngo zhig sman du btang na tshad pa 'jags pa dang, khrag rgyu ba, zla mtshan snyoms pa bcas la phan/
me tog pad ma'i rtser chags pa'i 'bras bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la pad ma'i lte ba dang sa bon mdzod do,
rigs gsum gyi nang gses shig /
me tog pad ma'i rtsa ba/

me tog pad ma yod pa'i mtsho/ ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu yi snying po dang, pad ma can, pad ma ldan, pad ma'i 'byung gnas, pad ma'i rdzing bu, bzhad ldan ma, lhas bkang bcas so,
slob dpon pad mar za hor rgyal pos phul ba'i dbu zhwa/
(legs) pandi ta chen po ste mkhas pa chen po/
kha che'i pan chen shakya shri nas brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun/

kha che pan chen yang zer ba de ni rab byung gnyis pa'i me lug lor kasmir 'khrungs pa dang rang lo nyer gsum la rab tu byung nas rgya gar dkyil khul gyi na lendra'i mkhan thog mjug ma byed ring la kha che'i dmag gis dgon sde gtor bas slob ma gtso bo dang lhan du bod la phebs, mtshur phur byams pa'i sku brnyan chen po bzhengs shing, sa pan la bsnyen rdzogs gnang, chos grags kyi tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs kyang spel, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing khyi lor rang yul kasmir log nas rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya lor 'das/

(sog) bod kyi dge lugs sprul sku zhig gi mtshan te, pan zhes pa ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin zhing, pandi ta'i bsdus ming yin, bod skad du mkhas pa'i don du 'jug er te ni zhes pa ni sog skad yin zhing, bod skad du rin po che'i don du 'jug de ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu sbrul lor pan chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la manydzu gong mas che bstod kyi mtshan gsol ba zhig yin pas, de nas bzung sku phreng rim byon la pan chen er te ni zhes 'bod, pan chen sku phreng dang po mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang nas da bar sku phreng bcu byon, de dag gi gdan sa ni gtsang bkra shis lhun po yin/
pandi ta'i zhwa mo sne ring zhig /
(legs) lnga rig pa ste rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i mkhas pa/

ma p'a la: (legs) rgya gar shar pa ba yin pa de dus rabs bcu gcig pa shar ba tsam la mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gdan drangs te mnga' ris su byon, bod du 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun spel, zhi gnas sgom thabs khrid pa sogs, bstan pa phyi dar skabs mnga' ris su sdom pa len pa'i dbu brnyes te stod khul du 'dul ba brgyud spel byas/
na mi tra: dzi na mi tra dang don gcig
steng du yi ge'am gzugs brnyan bkod nas par du 'debs byed cig / dpe cha'i par/ shing par/ lcags par/ lugs par/ 'dra par/
1) par rko mkhan/ 2) par du rko bzhin pa/
dpe don rnam pa dbyer med lta bu 'dra tshul/ skad cha bshad stangs de gnyis par kha btab pa lta bu 'dra po 'dug /
1) dpe cha'i par shing 'jog sa'am 'debs yul/ 2) brnyan par rgyag sa'i khang pa/
(rnying) 1) glo bur du gyen du 'phar ba/ 2) rgyang gis 'phar ba sbal ba'i 'gro stangs lta bu/

1) 'dra dpe 'gebs pa/ yul lung gcig gi nyams myong yul lung gzhan zhig la par 'gebs kyis lag len bstar na mi 'grig / sger don la gzhung don yin khul gyi par 'gebs byas na nor 'khrul red/ 2) ha cang 'dra ba'i dpe/ ltad mo 'khrab dus khong gnyis kyi gzugs byad dang rnam 'gyur gang ci nas phan tshun par 'gebs byed pa rang red/
par 'debs skabs par shing gi sne gcig 'dzin mkhan/
1) shing par sogs la dpe deb par rgyag pa/ 2) mi dang, dngos po, yul ljongs sogs kyi 'dra par rgyag pa/
1) par shing 'jog sa'i sgrom/ 2) brnyan par sgrig sa'i sgrom/
1) brnyan par rgyag byed kyi 'phrul chas/ 2) dpe cha par rgyag byed kyi 'phrul chas sam yo byad/
(rnying) mtha' sne rta'i ze rngog dang 'dra ba'i gdan te rngog stan grum ze yang zer ba 'bol gdan gyi steng du gding ba'i kha gdan 'phred zhol dang, kha gang ma rigs gnyis/
par 'debs dus par shing 'jog sa'i stegs/
1) par shing thung ngu/ 2) dpe cha par ma ldeb thung/
ras sogs la ri mo'i par rgyag pa dang: tshos rgyag pa/
dpe cha par rgyag byed kyi snag tsha
dpe deb kyi par rgyag mkhan/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims tshad dang, dug tshad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khri shing ral pa can dang, sngon po chig thub, mi rgan ral pa can, rims 'joms bcas so,, (legs) gnyan nad kyi rgyu byed pa'i dug can srin bu'i ming ste, bod skad du bsgyur na srog 'phrog byed ces pa'i don/
'phar tshul lam 'phag stangs/ khang byi'u rnams thang du par par 'phar nas 'gro/
pa ri pi ri'i bsdus tshig
dpe cha par rgyag mkhan gyi 'go khrid/
sngar bod du par 'debs mkhan spyi pa'i ming/
dpe cha sogs kyi par gzhi gsar du brkos nas thog mar btab pa'i dpe cha gsar pa de dag gzigs phud kyi tshul du 'bul ba'i ming/
(rnying) snod chung ngu zhig / mar par/ zhag par/ smyug ma'i par bu/
par gyi mjug byang/ par byang smon tshig tshul du bkod/
par brgyab nas byung ba'i dpe cha sogs/ pe cin par ma/ lha sa'i par ma/ sde dge'i par ma/
dpe cha sogs par du brko rgyu'i thog mar shog bur bris te par shing la sbyor ba'i par gzhi'i yi ge/
par gzhi'i yi ge par shing la sbyar ba/
lcags par shing par sogs kyi gzhi/
mkhan gyi rogs pa ste par 'debs skabs par: shing gi sne gcig 'dzin mkhan sogs lta bu
1) par shing ring po mda' tshad ma/ 2) dpe cha par ma ldeb ring/
1) 'dra par dang, bris ris kyi bsdus tshig / 2) par gyi ri mo/
par brko gzhi'am, par gyi ri mo brkos yod pa'i shing/
par rko sa'i mkhregs shing bye brag cig
dpe don rnam pa dbyer med kyi 'dra tshul/ bshad rgyu'i nang don gcig kyang mi so so'i shod stangs par bshus brgyab pa nang bzhin mi yong/
rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab cig gi: ming deb ther du stag gzig gam ta zig dang, deng sang dbyi lang zer ba de yin/
(rnying) 1) mi sha la longs spyod mkhan gyi rigs shig / 2) par sig pa/

/ 1) chang sogs snod gzhan du blug byed kyi pi pi/ 2) rgya gling gi dbugs 'gro sa'i bu gar bskon rgyu 'dam rtswa'i rkang las bzos pa zhig / 3) chang 'tshod skabs bum rdza'i nang du bkal nas chang thigs bzed de phyir 'dren snod cig /

(legs) grog sman te, shing sman gyi rigs shig ro tsha la mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba'i drod nyams pa dang, bad rlung gi nad, dbugs mi bde ba sogs la phan, nad khrag dang zungs khrag 'byed nus/ ming gi rnam grangs la grog ma'i gzugs can dang, drod skyed byed, drod sman, drod sman 'jang mo, drod sman ljang mo, drod sman nar mo, nag po grog rked, nag po tshandha, sna ring, spod nar, byang chub ljon shing, byi ril, sman nag tsha ba la, yul dbus skyes, g.yo byed, lus 'phags skyes, sreg byed bcas so,
rgyud dam skud pa gcig las med pa'i pi wang/
rgyud dam skud pa mang po yod pa'i pi wang/
rgyud dam skud pa gsum yod pa'i pi wang/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spu hreng rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod cing, mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5320 yod/
(legs) skad rigs chen po bzhi'i nang gses shig: ste sha za'i skad
(yul) sngar bod du 'tsho ba skyel stangs rags rgyab pa dang gcig pa yin yang thob cha phyed skal las mi 'thob pa'i tshogs pa zhig /
/ 1) (rgya) spu smyug / ming gi rnam grangs la bris smyug dang 'bri byed do, 2) chur gnas srog chags dbyibs 'khar rnga kha sbyar ba ltar yod pa zhig /
chur gnas pa'i sems can dbyibs 'khar rnga kha sbyar ba ltar mtha' 'khor ba'i kha so can zhig ste, de'i rus pas byis pa'i gdon nad dang, chung sri 'joms/
rkang pa'i mthe bong gi spu skyes sar yod pa'i chu rtsa sbu gu can gyi yan lag cig ste, der bcad brdung shor na rlung 'phyo zhing lus kyi bya ba nyams par 'gyur ba zhig /
lha ris pa'i pir gyi snod/

sngar bod rgyal dgu pa pu de kun rgyal zhes pa'i zur chag stod kyi steng gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig khong gis sku mkhar phying dbar stag rtse brtsigs, rgyal po 'di'i sku dus su 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi dang po ru las skyes kyis chu yur bur drangs, spang zhing du rmos, rdo bzhus nas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton, chu la zam pa 'dzugs pa sogs byas, mtshan gzhan bya khri btsan po yang zer/
(yul) bya rigs shig ste pu shud kyang zer, bya khra bo mgo la sgro lcog yod pa zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la sgro yi gtsug phud can dang, mchu ring, dri nga'i 'dab chags bcas so,
(legs) 1) gang zag pho go bar byed pa'i tshig phrad pa po/ pa...po...dbus pa/ phyug po/ lta ba po/ 2) pho'i rtags/
khang pa'i nya rgyab bam chu skyor te rgya skad du lan kan zer/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas skyug pa gcod, bad kan tsha ba sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la ba la dang, mirmu la, rtswa ga bur, u ri sha bcas so,
sman 'u su'am sngo bsod nams dpal 'dzoms/

slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis dam la btags shing bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsten pa'i lha gtso bo zhig
1) pho mtshon par byed pa'i bdag po'i sgra zhig / 2) ming mtha' zhig /
1) ri bo gru 'dzin te, legs sbyar skad po ta la'i zur chag / po ta la...2) lha sa rtse pho brang/ , (legs) ri bo gru 'dzin te, 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams/
brang dkar po: rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya lo la bzhengs 'go btsugs nas rab byung de'i sa byi lo la grub/ 1694...1648...

rab byung dang po'i lcags lug lor 'khrungs, mtshan rin chen gsal, 'brom ston gyi dngos slob sprul pa'i sku mched gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal, bla ma 'das rjes yun ring la gtso bor sgrub pa nyams len mdzad, dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig nas bzung ste bka' gdams gzhung drug gi 'chad nyan mdzad de gzhung pa'i srol btod, po to dgon pa'ang btab pas dge bshes po to ba zhes grags, rab byung gnyis pa'i shing bya lor 'das, slob ma dag gis de'i gsung sgros bsgrigs te 'grel ba sbyar ba la be'u bum sngon po zhes zer/ (1031-1105)
tshig mthar bdag sgra po sbyar ba mang po cha bsgrigs pa'i bstod tshig / po...
dbyibs 'bur 'bur ram tsog tsog / ri po mtho/ ri brag po mtho/ na kha po mtho/

(rnying) spos phor te bdug spos bsreg snod/
(rnying) ba gam ste pho brang gi sdings cha/
rab byung brgyad pa'i nang gong sman dkon mchog bde legs kyis mdzad pa'i gangs ri'i khrod kyi sman gyi lag len dang, man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos grags chen zhig /

slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i byams chos kyi sde tshan rab tu byed pa brgyad de, mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed rnam gnyis te gsum gyi 'grel ba dang, rnam bshad rigs pa dang, las sgrub pa'i rab byed, phung po lnga'i rab byed, nyi shu pa'i rab byed, sum cu pa'i rab byed de brgyad do/

(legs) sngar rgya gar gyi skad rigs chen po bzhi'i nang gses yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad, spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs lnga pa'am drug pa nas bzung tshad mar 'dzin pa'i skad rig shig tu bsgyur, rjes sor de go med grag med du gyur na'ang spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu pa'i bar du yig skad dang chos skad du bed spyod mu mthud byas, sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba dang sbrags si li lan kha dang 'bar ma sogs ya gling lho ma'i rgyal khab kyi nang pa'i chos skad du gyur pa'o/
me long dang mthe bong sogs la brten nas mo 'debs mkhan/
pra phab pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma/
sngar srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa'i stod sa khul du yod pa'i yang 'dul gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
