me long sogs la brten nas 'byung 'gyur gyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i thabs sam cho ga zhig / pra phab pa/
sbrang rtsi'i snyigs ma, spra tshil yang zer/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas pho ba'i tshad pa dang, mchin tshad, glo tshad bcas sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun 'joms ga bur dang, klu mo gur gum, mchin nad tsi'u, 'jib bu, ting le byin, rte'u rngog pa, dan tig dar sngon 'phyar ba, dre'u rngog bod gur gum, btsun mo gur gum, rtsi'u dri chen, g.yu rngog g.yu lo dar ya kan bcas so,
pre ta pu ri'i rgyal khams
/ zhwa'i mdud prog / khyim bya'i ze: prog /
lus kyi shed stobs chen po/ kho dpag chen gyis mda' 'phangs pa ltar shar mar phyin song/
grangs brjod du med pa'am mtha' yas pa/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi grangs 'bor dpag tu med cing bsam gyis mi khyab/ mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang, gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu'ang len/
tshad 'jal thub pa/ yul lung zhig gi mi grangs mang nyung dpag tu rung ba zhig red/
dpag tu med pa'i bsdus tshig

«yodzanam» 1) mngon pa'i lugs la rgyang grags brgyad kyi tshad de rgyang grags rer gzhu 'dom lnga brgya yod/ 2) dus 'khor lugs la sor mo nyer bzhi la khru gang, de bzhi la gzhu 'dom gang, de nyis stong la rgyang grags gcig de bzhi la dpag tshad gcig /
mtha' yas pa'am gzhal du med pa/
1) tshod brtag pa'am gzhal ba/ 2) blos dpag bya'am bsam bya'i yul gyi don/

snyan ngag gi lam las drangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa, rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa lak'am'i k'a ra dang, bod kyi lo ts'a ba shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/
yongs 'du sa brtol te, 'bras bu dang lo ma las zas gos 'byung ba'i shing zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la rnga yab can dang gser shing ngo,
(rnying) phan tshun kha 'chams mthun grub kyi chod dan gan yig /
sngar gyod ya phan tshun gnyis kyi bden dpang bzhi bzhi ste brgyad/
tshad mar 'dzin rung ba'i rtags mtshan/ dpang rtags khungs btsan yod pa/
bstan pa'am dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha srung rnams dpang bstod pa ste gzengs bstod byed pa/

/ 1) bar mi'am gnya' bo ste, phyogs gnyis dbar du bden rdzun shan 'byed byed mi/ bden dpang/ mi dpang/ bar dpang/ ming gi rnam grangs la mgo 'thu ba dang, khas len pa, cha 'dzin, bar mi bcas so, 2) rgol ba gnyis kyi rtsod pa'i rgyal pham mam legs nyes shan 'byed mkhan gyi gang zag /
bar gyi che bzhir 'jog 'os pa ste, rtags dang rgyu mtshan khyad par bar 'dzin rung ba'am 'jog 'os pa/ drang po tshad ldan gyi mi de dpang 'pher ba zhig yin/
bar dpang byed pa/ phan tshun bar 'dum gyi dpang byed pa/

rab byung lnga ba'i me byi lo la 'khrungs pa'i bod kyi lo ts'a ba zhig ste, 'dis tshad ma kun las btus pa'i 'grel pa rgyal dbang blos mdzad pa dang, dus 'khor gyi bshad sbyar snying po snang ba la sogs pa bsgyur cing, tshogs gsum gsal ba sogs brtsams/
dpang por 'jog pa'am 'khrid pa/ zhugs nyi dpang 'dzugs lta bu mna' tshig /

'phang dang mtho tshad dang srid dang khrun/ pho brang dpangs su mtho/ dar chen dpangs su ring/ sku gzugs dpangs che ba/ dbu dpangs ri las mtho/ nyal khri dpangs mtho ba/ gdan bkyag dpangs mthug pa/ 'bol gdan dpangs dma' ba/
mtho tshad dang ring tshad gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
mtho bar bstod pa/ dpa' bo'i spyod bzang la dpangs bstod chen po byas pa/
mtho tshad dang zheng tshad gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs sam ngar shugs/ dgra bo'i dpa' zhum par byed pa/ rta gcig mgyogs kyang la mi chod, mi gcig dpa' yang dgra mi thub/
pha rol po'i snying stobs zhum par byed pa/ mi dmangs dmag gi stobs shugs chen pos dgra bo'i dpa' bkong ba/
dpa' gtam ste dpa' bo yin khul gyi gtam/ rang gis mi 'jon bzhin du gzhan la dpa' skad bshad pas ci la phan/ dpa' skad g.yu 'brug grag grag red/
pher sha tsha po'am 'jon mdog gi tshul/ mi shes shes mdog gi dpa' skyed tsha po byed pa/
snying stobs chag pa/ dka' tshegs mthong tsam gyis sdar ma gang yin dpa' gong ba/
snying stobs 'phel ba/ dgra bo'i gnas lugs gsal por shes nas rang dmag gi dpa' rgyas pa/

dpa' dang ngar gyi bsdus tshig / dpa' ngar stobs ldan/ dpa' ngar gyis chu log 'gog thabs byed pa/ dgra bo'i dpa' ngar yongs su 'joms pa/ dgra dpung pham 'thor ma byung bar du dpa' ngar zhum med kyis 'dzing rkyang byed pa/
snying stobs ldan zhing 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa ldan pa/ phyi nyams bltas tshe dpa' rngam che mdog kha yang don la wa las sdar/
dpa' bo'i nyams tshul lam bzo dbyibs/
'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs/ thang yangs po'i dkyil nas dpa' snying bsdur/ dka' ngal la 'dzem dogs med pa de dpa' snying mnga' ba'i rang rtags red/
dpa' snying che ba'i khengs dregs sam spobs pa/ rang tshul dang mi mthun pa'i dpa' snyems byed pa ni gad mo 'chor ba'i rgyu red/
dpa' che drags pa/ las ka byed stangs dpa' thal ba/ khyed rang gis bshad pa de dpa' thal ba'i skad cha zhig red/ ham pa dpa' thal byed mi rung/
dpa' bo'i gzigs bzos sam bya dga'i dar/ rkun por dpa' dar g.yogs, spyang ki tshe thar btang/
dpa' yod pa'i nga rgyal/ dpa' dregs byas na pham nyes kyi nyen kha yod/
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi nub byang nas byang shar bar gyi sa mtshams srung ba'i stod smad bar gsum gyi dmag sde/

1. nus pa'am phod pa/ 'gan khur chen po len dpa' ba, rang gi bsam 'char sba gsang med par shod dpa' ba/ dgra bo stobs dang ldan pa'i gras la 'thab 'dzing byed par dpa' ba/ rgyal kha len dpa' ba/ 2. snying stobs kyi 'phel cha che zhing brtan pa/ g.yul sar dpa' ba med na pham rgyu las med/

kyi zol bstod: zol bstod kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bstod yul dpa' ba phun tshogs can zhig la rnam pa skyon brjod kyi khul byas nas, don du dpa' ba phun tshogs kyi yon tan la shugs kyis bstod pa'i rgyan zhig /
nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, rgyu ma bsgrubs par 'dod don chen po grub pa'i stobs kyis nang du spro ba khyad 'phags can 'phel ba'i rnam 'gyur dpa' nyams ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

/ 1) snying stobs can/ grags med dpa' bo/ dpa' med kyang dpa' bo'i tshul dang, chos med kyang bla ma'i tshul/ pho rgod po'i nang gi dpa' bo de, yin min 'gag la gtugs na gsal/ ming gi rnam grangs la gyad mi dang, 'jigs med, nyam nga med, snying stobs can, bsnyengs bral, gtum pa'i dpung pa can, stobs chen, brtul phod pa, thal byung 'gro, rnam gnon can, pha rol gnon, bag mi tsha, mi 'gong ba, tshom pa med, zhum pa mi mnga' zhe sdang ldan, g.yul ngor brtan, g.yul na brjid bcas so, 2) 'phags yul gyi chen po bzhi'i ya gyal slob dpon dpa' bo ste, rgya gar nub phyogs su yab bram ze che'i rig byed yan lag brgyad la byang chub pa sman pa chen po seng ge gsang ba dang, yum rin chen dngos grub gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas bram ze'i chos rig byed bzhi dang, rig byed kyi yan lag bzhi, nye ba'i yan lag bzhi, las drug sogs la mkhas par sbyangs, khyad par du yab las gso ba rig pa bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen, phyi pa'i bstan pa la zhugs, gsung snyan pas rta dbyangs su grags, mu stegs rtag pa smra ba'i lugs la mkhas par gyur nas nub phyogs kyi nang pa'i pandi ta rnams dang brtsad pas rta dbyangs rgyal te nang pa'i bstan pa bsnubs nas phyi pa'i lugs su bsgyur zhing lho phyogs su rtsod par phebs pa las, slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma 'phags pa lha, rta dbyangs dang phyi nang gi grub mtha' rtsod par phebs nas rta dbyangs tshar bcad de nang pa'i ring lugs su bsgyur, phyis su dpal mgon klu sgrub yab sras kyi slob ma mdzad, phyi nang gnyis kyi grub mtha' dang snyan ngag sogs rig byed la shin tu mkhas par gyur, mtshan dkon cog 'bangs zhes grags, sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa'i las byas pa rnams bshags pa'i ched du ston pa rin po che'i skyes rabs la bstod pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mtshon pa'i bstan bcos spyi dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung yan lag brgyad pa chen po, yan lag brgyad pa la 'jug pa, yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa, de'i rang 'grel sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga'i gzhung mang du mdzad par grags so/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug tshad dang, tshad rims la phan/
rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu pho mo/
ya nga bag tsha mi byed pa'i dpe/
'khor dang yum med pa'i yi dam lha/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa/
nad kun 'joms thub pa'i sman zhig /
1) sngo sman gyi rtsa ba'i khungs su gtogs shing glang chen chig thub kyang zer te, ro kha la bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad dang tshad rigs sel/ 2) bong nga nag po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce
zhal lce bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, snga dus rang gi rgyal khab la pha rol gyi rgol ba byung na zhi drag thabs jus gang mkhas kyi sgo nas dgra bo 'dul lugs kyi khrims/
dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba

rab byung brgyad pa'i shing byi lor 'khrungs, zhwa nag pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i slob ma yin, khong gis lho brag lha lung gi gdan sa bskyangs, spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang, rtsis kyi bstan bcos, chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston sogs mang du brtsams, rab byung dgu pa'i me stag lor 'das/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims tshad dang, dug tshad la phan/
ha ha bsdigs pa'i gad mo dang, hi hi dgyes pa'i gad mo, he he sgeg pa'i gad mo, ho ho zil gyis gnon pa'i gad mo bcas brgyad/
sdar ma'am snying stobs zhan pa/ dpa' blo khog med na drag chas rdzig kyang ci phan/
/ 1) blo khog che ba'i bud med/ 2) 'jig rten las 'das spa'i lha mo/
yid kyi dpa' dang lus kyi rtsal gnyis kyi bsdus ming/ gsar brje'i don du rang srog blos btang gi dpa' rtsal 'don pa/ g.yul ngor yang yang 'thab pa'i mi, dpa' rtsal snying stobs ldan par gyur/
dpa' bo'i bzo lta/ sdug na mchi ma mi gtong ba, skyes pa pho yi dpa' tshul yin/
stod stag smad gnyis dang: zer chen zar chung gnyis, gong ras stag slog gnyis te srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod du lag len bstar ba'i bya gzhag rigs gcig /
snying stobs che la thabs mkhas pa'am ya rabs pa/ dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyis mdun du bskyod pa/
dpa' che ba dang, thabs mkhas pa, shes rgyud mjam pa ste gsum/
sus kyang 'gran mi thub pa'i dpa' bo/
gyi dpa' bo ste dpa' bo dngos:/ dpa' yang dag su red de ring lta/
si khron zhing chen khongs smi li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong du yod pa'i ri bo zhig /
gri'i yu ba la btags pa'i lung thag /
tsha ba dpa' shod de rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud dang rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de pad mar yod/
si khron zhing chen khongs smi li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong gi la zhig /

/ 1) bkra shis sam phun tshogs dang, g.yang ngam bcud/ gzi byin gyi dpal/ tshe'i dpal/ mthu stobs kyi dpal/ 2) bod du sangs rgyas pa tshos mdo sde dang, yi dam, gnas chen sogs kyi ming gi thog ma dang, bla sprul rnams kyi ming mthar sbyor ba'i zhe tshig cig / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ dpal bsam yas/ 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa dpal bzang po/

po'i go phang: sangs rgyas kyi go phang ste, rnying ma'i ring lugs la rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam la brten nas 'dod chags chen po'i lam gyis 'bras bu'i dbang bskur bas snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags phra ba sbyangs te mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'bras bu'i chos nyer lnga po dbyer med lhun grub kyi ngo bo sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can no/

sa ming zhig si khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul khongs mdzod dge rdzong gi shar rgyud na yod, 1935 lo'i zla ba brgyad par krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag rgyang skyod byed skabs kyi lam bar sa cha 'dir krung gung krung dbyang gis chab srid cus kyi gros tshogs shig 'tshogs nas krang go tha'o yis krung dbyang kha bral du gtong ba'i nag nyes la dgag pa brgyab cing, dmar dmag mu mthud nas byang phyogs su bskyod rgyu'i gros thag bcad pa red/
dpal sgang yang zer zhing, sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig dang de'i khyim ming, deng skabs kyi bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su yod/

gtsang gi bzhad shar phyogs dpal khang zhes pa'i khyim du 'khrungs, mtshan dngos ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sder 'bod pa dag yig ngag sgron rtsom pa po ste, karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang dus mnyam du byung ba zhig /
dpal gyi kun dga' ra ba
(mngon) bza' shing gi ra ba ste skyed tshal/
tsan dan dkar po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /

1) gzi brjid ldan pa'i skyabs sam dpal gyur pa'i skyabs/ 2) chos skyong mgon po'i ming/ 3) kha 'dzin sdong grogs/ ma rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro mthu stobs can, dpa' 'dan ma khyod la dpal mgon mdzod/ 4) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnam mtsho'i byang ngos dang nub ngos la yod, sngar gyi ming rnying la gnam ru rdzong zer, deng sang gi ming 'di brang khog mtsho'i ming rgya yig thog phab dus, 'di 'dra zhig bris pa de slar bod yig tu sgyur skabs dpal mgon zhes su bsgyur pas deng sang de ltar grags, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de phu bur gnas/ brang khog mtsho...dpal mgon...
phag gru sde srid khri rabs dgu pa/
1) gzi brjid chen po/ rgyan gyi bkod pa dpal stug po dang ldan pa'i pho brang zhig / 2) sangs rgyas spyi'i mtshan/
sa ming zhig yar 'brog dpal di ste bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sna dkar rtse rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/

bla na med pa'i rgyud sde zhig dus zhes pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang, 'khor zhes pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yin la, bde stong gnyis su med pa'i don gyis dpal zhes bya'o, de lta bu'i dus kyi 'khor lo de nyid phyi 'jig rten gyi khams, nang rdo rje'i lus, gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i chos su 'char ba'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la khams gsum 'khor los sgyur ba dang, mchog gnyis su med, thabs shes bdag nyid, thog ma tha ma med, thog ma'i mgon po, dang po'i sangs rgyas, rdo rje sems, sdom la 'dus pa, rnam pa kun mchog ldan, rnal 'byor, 'pho med, byang chub sems, rigs kun khyab bdag rigs med pa, shes dang shes bya'i bdag nyid, e wam zung 'jug bcas so,

1) dge mtshan nam yon tan mang po yod pa'am, gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams/ 2) mdo sde sogs kyi ming gi thog ma dang bla sprul rnams kyi ming gi mthar sbyor ba'i zhe tshig gi don du go ba'i dpal dang 'dra,

gsang sngags kyi slob dpon te, 'khor ba'i chos rgyab tu dor ba, 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa, lag len la mkhas shing nyams myong yod pa, rgyud kyi tshig don la mkhas shing sgrub la brtson pa, lta ba'i don la mkhas shing nus pa rdzogs pa, snying rje che zhing gtong la dga' ba ste mtshan nyid drug ldan gyi bla ma/
dpal ldan tshangs pa sde bzhi
'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa, nor phyug pa, lung rtogs kyi chos 'phel ba, 'di phyir bde zhing thar pa thob pa'o/

pan chen er ti ni sku phreng drug pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta lor 'khrungs, rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa phag lor gong ma chan lung gi bka' ltar pe cin du phebs, lo de nyid la gong nas g.yang ti'i 'ja' sa dang, g.yang ti'i tham ga sogs gzigs bzos chen po gnang, rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags byi lor pe cin hong si zhes pa'i dgon par 'das, sku phung gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar gser sdong gsar bzos nang du bcug /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs srid blon dang zhabs pad kyi ming gi 'gor sbyor ba'i che bstod kyi tshig /
dbyangs can lha mo drag tu khros pa'i chos skyong zhig /

sde dge dpal spungs dgon pa thub bstan chos 'khor gling zhes pa, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug lor si tu chos 'byung gis phyag btab, mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi chos grwa btsugs te bka' brgyud kyi grwa sa'i lte bar gyur/

chos kyi dbang po: rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa 'brug lor byang rdza chu khar sku 'khrungs, dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi yang sprul du ngos 'dzin byas nas mtshan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang por btags, khong gi sku tshe hril por bya bral gyi mdzad pa bskyangs, khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs nyams len dang zhal gdams kyi skor dang, byams chos kyi 'grel ba sogs gzhung bshad kyi skor, gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar sogs gtam tshogs skor bcas pod grangs bdun tsam yod la, rab byung bco lnga pa'i me phag lor 'das/
«shribtva» bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

1) gzi brjid 'bar ba'am phun sum tshogs pa/ 2) ras snum sbyar ba'i rtswa'i sgron me'am shing gi sgron me/ 3) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar byang ngos dang rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de rdo dmar thang du yod/
1) phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor ba/ 2) dpal 'byor rig pa'i thog la spyi tshogs kyi dngos po'i thon skyed dang, slar yang thon skyed byed pa'i bya bar zer/
dpal mar me mdzad ye shes
jo bo rje a ti sha'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs shig /
/ 1) bud med mchog / 2) sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i grub thob btsun ma zhig / 3) khyab 'jug gi chung ma/
jo bo a ti sha'i yum ste sngar bham ga la'i rgyal po'i btsun mo/
gzi brjid ldan la mtshar ba/
dge zhing legs pa rnams tshang ba/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang gi dpal 'dzoms pa'i rgyal khab chen po/
bod kyis bla sprul dang, slob dpon sogs kyi ming mjug tu sbyor ba'i che brjod kyi tshig cig / 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa dpal bzang po/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs khongs go 'jo rdzong gi dbus rgyud na yod cing, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 4642 yod/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi nub ngos dang 'bri chu'i shar 'gram na yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de mar thang na yod/
1) dge zhing legs pa'i yon tan/ 2) bkra shis sam phun tshogs/ dpyid kyi dpal yon phyogs kun nas shar ba/
dge zhing legs pa'i snying po'am bcud/
dpal ldan lha mo'i bsdus tshig
sngar lha sar hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin dpal lha dang, grib rdzong btsan gnyis zhal 'dzoms pa'i dus ston/

/ 1) g.yul gyi tshogs pa/ dpa' ngar ldan pa'i dpung tshogs/ rang dpung/ dgra dpung/ 2) rgyab rten nam rgyab snon/ rgyab dpung bzang po/ 3) phrag pa/ lus kyi dpung pa/ ri'i dpung pa/ g.yag gi dpung par rnga dmar btags/ mgo thar dpung 'dzud/ lag zad dpung thug /
phrag tshigs nas gru tshigs bar gyi rus pa de la dpung pa zer zhing, de'i sbubs su rkang mar 'byung bas dpung rkang zer/
dpung sde skong ba'i brda tho/
1) gzhogs 'degs dmag sde/ 2) rgyab snon dmag sde/ 3) dpung 'degs las rogs/
lus kyi phrag pa'am phrag gong/
lus kyi dpung pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan cha/
mi mang phyogs gcig sdeb pa/ mi ngan dpung sgril gyis gtor brlag byed mkhan la khrims gcod gtong ba/
dmag dpung drag shugs che ba/
dpung shugs yod nyams ston pa/ sa phyogs gang sar dpung ngom btsan 'dzul gyi sdig spyod byed pa/
1) phu dung med pa'i stod thung/ 2) dge slong ma'i nu sgrib kyi ras/
dpung dmag btang nas dgra bo dbang du sdud pa/
rlung nad rigs shig ste, rlung nad phrag pa'i rtsa dkar la zhugs nas der gnas pa'i rtsa 'khums shing bya ba nyams pa zhig /
/ thag ring du drag po dpung 'jug byas/
dgra thog dmag dpung gtong rgyur gros dan bca' ba/
1) rgyab dpung bzang po/ 2) rogs mgon te rgyab skyor byed mkhan/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed mkhan gzhan su mchis/
phrag pa g.yas g.yon gyi ngos su 'dogs pa'i mtshan ma/
dpung dmag gi stobs shugs/ dpung stobs dar zhing drag pa/ rang nyid kyi dpung stobs las byung ba ma yin/
dpung gshibs nas 'gro tshul zhig / khong: gnyis dpung gdang shig shig byas nas phyin song
1) dpung tshogs 'gro ba/ g.yul sa dang nye bar dpung 'degs pa/ 2) las rogs byed pa/
dpung tshogs skyod skabs langs pa'i thal 'tshub/
1) dmag sde/ 2) mi mang po'i tshogs pa/
mi mang dpung shugs gcig tu sgril ba/ dmag tshogs dpung sdeb/
dpung stobs kyis pha rol gnon pa/ me sgyogs drag tu 'phangs nas dgra dpung gnon pa/
dmag dpung gi snon ma'am, kha snon/
/ 1) lus kyi gru mo nas sog pa'i bar/ mgo las dpung pa mtho/ lag zad dpung par thug / dpung pa ngom pa/ dpung pa mnyam gshibs/ 2) dmag sde'i stobs shugs/
'gran sdur byed pa/ kho gnyis rgyal kha sus thob kyi ched du deng sang dpung pa rdar ba'i sgang red/
pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, snyan par smra ba dang legs par smra ba'i rjes su mthun par byas pas dpung mgo shin tu zlum pa/
dpung pa mnyam gshibs/ tshang mas lag gdang dpung sbrel gyi sgo nas las ka 'bad brtson chen po byed pa/
dpung pa'i lug gzhug nas thur du sor gsum gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na glo tshad dang, khrag tshad sogs la phan/
dpung lag gnyis kyi rus mtshams/
1) dmag mi mang po'i tshogs pa'am rogs zla mang po'i tshogs pa/ 2) dmag rigs/
'khor sgyur rgyal po'i dpung sde rigs bzhi ste, rta'i dmag dang, dmag bcas bzhi'o/
phrag dpung mdun g.yas g.yon gyi kong mo/ dpung ya, 'gran ya'am kha gtad/ dpa' bo'i dpung ya/
grogs byed mkhan nam rogs pa/ pho rgod kyang rgyab tu dpung rogs dgos/
1) dmag dpung gi stobs shugs/ 2) lag pa'i nus shugs/ khres khur chen po phrag steng du sangs kyis 'gyogs pa'i dpung shugs skyed pa/
1) dmag sde'i stobs shugs/ 2) lag pa'i nus shugs/ gyad rdo chen po dpung shed kyis 'degs pa/ shing sbom po dpung shed kyis gcog pa/
dpung pa mnyam gshib/ dpung gshib kyi ngang nas mdun nas mdun du skyod pa/ dpung gshib mnyam 'gro'i sgo nas dar rgyas su 'phel bzhin yod pa/
ba'am snyad 'tshol ba:/ gzhan la don med dpung sug btang ste snyad rko byed pa/
gsig gsig byed pa:/ khur chen 'khyer dus dpung gsig yang yang brgyab na ngal dub chung/
go thang gi dmag sde/ dgra bo zil gyis gnon pa'i dpung hrag pa zhig gtong ba/

/ 1) don gyi gnas lugs gsal byed dam mtshon byed/ mdzes pa'i dpe pad ma/ zab pa'i dpe rgya mtsho/ brtan pa'i dpe ri bo/ mi 'dra'i phyir na dpe ma yin/ shes bya'i rnam grangs dper na rgyu skar bzhin, dus kyi 'gyur ba dper na glog lta bu/ 2) tshad 'dzin sa'i dpe/ bzo dbyibs dpe dang mthun pa/ zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa/ khong ni nga tsho'i mig dper 'os pa'i mi zhig red/ rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung ba dper mi srid/ chu med 'khyags pa chags pa dper mi srid/
dper mi 'os pa'am dpe de rang la skyon yod pas dper 'dzin mi 'os pa/
dpe skyon can ma yin pa
dper 'os pa'am dpe don la sbyor 'os pa/
1) dpe cha gsar du par 'debs pa/ 2) mig ltos kyi dpe bzang 'jog pa/ sngon chad byung ma myong ba'i byas rjes bzang po'i dpe skrun byed pa/
dpe cha'i khang pa'am dpe deb sna tshogs yod pa'i khang pa/
dpe cha'am deb blug snod kyi khug ma
gzhan la dpe cha'i tshig don brda sprod pa/ dge rgan gyis slob phrug la dpe khrid byed pa/
1) man ngag shes kyang ser snas gsang ste mi ston pa/ 2) (rnying) snod chas/
smod pa'i tshig / khyod kyi dpe gog de phyir: thon nga'i rten mchod rnams la btsog pa shor 'ong/
dpe spyi mtshungs su rigs 'gre byed pa/ slob sbyong byed thabs dpe 'gre byas chog /
dpe cha shes ma shes dag bsher gtong ba'i rgyugs/ dpe rgyugs len pa/ dpe rgyugs sprod pa/
don dang 'gal ba'am mi 'os pa'i dpe/
shes bya yig thog tu bkod pa'i glegs bam mam deb/ dpe cha rnying pa/
dpe cha shog bu'i dkyus la khru gang yod pa/
dpe cha shog bu'i dkyus la mda' gang yod pa/
gzhung lugs la thos bsam byed mkhan/
byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i nang don rnams 'jig rten gyi kha dpe las dras pa'i dpe chos te dge bshes po to ba'i gsung sgros rnams so/
dpe chos rin chen spungs pa
bka' gdams dge bshes po to bas mdzad pa'i dpe chos kyi 'grel pa brag dkar bas brtsams pa/
dpe cha'i gsham mam smad cha
dpe nyer 'jal ba'i tshad ma dang don gcig

'dra ba'am dpe rtogs zin gyi rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten nas rang la lkog gyur gyi don de dpe de dang 'dra bar rtogs pa'i rjes dpag dper na, myu gu bden par med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra'o snyam pa dang, ba min ba lang dang 'dra'o snyam pa lta bu'o/
cha mi tshang ba sogs mkho phan med pa'i dpe cha
gtan tshigs rig pa'i rtags sbyor la chos mthun pa'i dpe dang, chos mi mthun pa'i dpe gnyis yod/
dpe skyon can te, bsgrub bya nges pa'i sngon du khyab pa nges pa'i gzhir bzung yang nges par mi nus so/
gzhan la mig dpe ston pa/ mang tshogs kyi nang du las ka byed stangs kyi rnam gzhag dpe ston byed pa/
1) nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi ya gyal gos dmar ba'i nang gses shig / 2) mdo lung dpe'i sgo nas ston mkhan gyi sde zhig dpe ston pa dang don gcig /
mdo sde pa'i ming ste chos thams cad dpe'i sgo nas ston pa'i grub mtha' smra ba zhig /
'bri dus mi 'khyog pa'i ched du btab pa'i: thig /
srol gsar mched pa/ mi tshang ma ngal rtsol la dga' ba'i dpe dar ba/
dpe cha mgo btsems ma/ dpe deb dang tshags par/
'dra dpe'am 'dra mtshungs/ 'brog pas bal 'breg stangs kyi dpe 'dra'i zlos gar zhig 'khrab pa/

tu sbyar ba: tshul lnga 'dod pa'i lugs, chos mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang lnga'i nang gses, gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba'i 'god tshul sbyar skabs sngon la rtags dang rjes su bsgrub bya brjod dgos pa dper na gang byas pa thams cad mi rtag pa nyid yin te zhes brjod par bya ba las mi rtag pa thams cad byas pa yin zhes brjod pa'o/

sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste, sen mo'i gsum dang, sor mo'i gsum dang, rtsa'i gnyis dang, zhabs kyi gsum dang, gshegs stangs bdun dang, dbu'i gsum dang, dbu skra'i drug dang, spyan gyi lnga dang, smin ma'i bzhi dang, snyan gyi gnyis dang, shangs kyi gnyis dang, zhal gyi gnyis dang, ljags kyi gsum dang, tshems kyi lnga dang, gsung gi gnyis dang, phyag gi gnyis dang, phyag gi ri mo'i gsum dang, sku spyi'i yon tan bcu dang, sku la skyon med pa'i yon tan bzhi dang, sku smad kyi bzhi dang, lto ba'i gnyis dang, kun spyod spyi'i yon tan gsum bcas brgyad cu'o/

skyes bu chen po mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan gyi khyad par ram cha shas rnams rdzogs par byed pa ste, me tog gi cha shas ze'u 'bru yin pa ltar mtshan gyi me tog la dpe byad kyi ze'u 'brus mdzes pa zhes pa'o/
dpe len sa'am blta sa'i bzo dbyibs/

tshul lnga 'dod pa'i lugs, chos mthun pa'i dpe ltar snang lnga'i nang gses, don de la dpe sbyor ba gtan med pas bum pa la sogs pa la sgrub byed dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis 'ba' zhig kho na ston pa ste, dper na, bum pa la byas pa nyid dang mi rtag pa nyid brjod pa lta bu'o/
dpe don 'gal ba'am mi mtshungs pa/ dpe mi mthun pa zhig bzhag nas skad cha bshad na go brda 'phrod mi thub/
1) mtshungs pa med pa/ mi de dpa' bo dpe med cig red/ 2) (mngon) sangs rgyas/
don dngos min pa/ nyi ma'am zla ba lta bu'o zhes pa ni dpe tsam las dngos ma yin/
mtshams la bsdad de dpe tshig blo la 'dzin mkhan dang, don la rtog dpyod byed mkhan/
dpe cha 'jog sa'am dpe deb sna tshogs yod pa'i khang pa/
dpe cha sna 'dzoms 'jog sa'am blta sa'i khang pa/
legs nyes kyi mig dpe blta sa'i gzhi/ spyod bzang gi dpe gzhi la bltas nas de'i rjes su slob sbyong byed pa/ gzugs ris sbyong rgyu'i dpe gzhi bris pa/
dpe can gang zhig gi dpe'am dpe zla/ dgra dang phrad na dpa' ngar dpe zla med/
1) dpe gsar pa bcos pa/ 2) (yul) rkyen ngan chags sgo byung skabs shod rgyu'i 'gyod tshig cig / lhod yangs byas pa'i rkyen gyis las don gra ma 'grig dpe bzos song/
bya nges pa'i sngon du khyab pa nges pa'i: gzhir gyur pa ste byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa'i dpe bum pa bkod pa lta bu'o/
mthun dpe yang dag dang, mi mthun dpe yang dag ste gnyis so/
yig gzugs sbyong dpe ste yig dpe yang zer
dpe cha sgril byed kyi ras/
dpe blta sa'i ri mo/ jus 'god kyi dpe ris/
dpe blta sa'i ri mo dang: ang grangs bkod pa'i re'u mig /
lhag pa'i ldog pa can: ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can khyad chos lhag pa'i sgo nas mtshungs pa dngos su ldog cing, shugs la dpe don 'dra bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khri 'du rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig /

kha dpe'am gtam dpe sogs kyi bshad pa/ kho la go rtogs yong ched sngar gyi lo rgyus dpe bshad, lung drangs, lung thag ske la brgyus pa yin/ skad cha don la ma khel na dpe bshad lung 'dren mang yang phan med/
(yul) yod dogs med ces ston tshig / khyed rang lag shes mkhas po zhe drag yod pa red zer gyi 'dug lags dpe srid pas, dpe srid pas, nga 'dra po brgya stong mang po yod pa red/
mig dpe/ byas rjes bzang po'i dpe srol 'jog pa/ las stangs cha tshang dpe srol bstan pa'i sgo nas slob khrid byed pa/
bzo dbyibs sngar med gsar pa/ thong gshol dpe gsar/ mtshon cha dpe gsar/
gsar pa'i nang gi gsar pa/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel lam dpe gsar yang gsar zhig chags yod/ dpe gsar yang gsar gyi 'phrul 'khor/
(rnying) 1) mkho ba/ 2) phangs shing yid du 'ong ba/ 3) gus pa/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, mtshon byed dpe dang, mtshon bya don gyi dpe can gnyis phan tshun 'dra ba'am, mtshungs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs sum cu so gnyis ni, chos dpe, dngos po'i dpe, bzlog pa'i dpe, phan tshun gyi dpe, nges pa'i dpe, nges med kyi dpe, bsdus pa'i dpe, phul byung gi dpe, rab btags kyi dpe, rmad byung gi dpe, rmongs pa'i dpe, the tshom gyi dpe, gtan la 'bebs pa'i dpe, sbyar ba'i dpe, mnyam nyid kyi dpe, smad pa'i dpe, bsngags pa'i dpe, brjod 'dod kyi dpe, 'gal ba'i dpe, dgag pa'i dpe, mdzes pa'am ngo bstod kyi dpe, de nyid brjod pa'i dpe, thun mong min pa'i dpe, byung min gyi dpe, srid min gyi dpe, mang ba'i dpe, rnam 'gyur gyi dpe, phreng ba'i dpe, ngag don gyi dpe, zla bo dngos po'i dpe, mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe, rgyu'i dpe bcas so/
sgyu lus kyi nang gses shig ste, rdzas sogs la brten nas don la med bzhin glo bur du rta glang sogs 'char ba'o/
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, phal pa dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dang, gtso bo dpe'i khyad gzhi gnyis la yod pa'i khyad chos mthun par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
rdzogs rim gyi chos shig ste, rlung sems snying gar bsdus stobs kyis gnyid 'khrul la brten pa'i sgrib gnyis mngon gyur dang bral ba'o/
phan tshun khyad sdur gyi dpe zlar 'gran pa/ blo gros kyi gting zab pas rgya mtsho'i dper bsgrun pa/ rnam rig gsal bas nyi 'od kyi dper bsgrun pa/
don dag go byed kyiu dpe bstan pa/ de ring ngas bshad pa'i skad cha de dper brjod pa tsam du zad pa yin/
dpe bshad na'am dpe mtshon na/ dper na rang la bde skyid 'dod pa ltar gzhan la'ang bde skyid dgos/ dgra dmag pham nas 'thor ba ni dper na ri bo nyil ba bzhin/
'dra dpe la bzhag pa/ rnying pa dper byas nas gsar pa bzo ba/
yong mi shes pa/ nyi zla thang la lhung ba dper mi srid pa/
dper gsal ba'am dper go ba/ pham nyes ji tsam byung ba de tsam gyis smyo rlabs cher 'phyur ba ni dgra bo'i ham spyod kho nas dper mtshon pa/
'dra dpe la 'jog pa'am, ma dpe ltar bzo ba/ lham gog bzo dus zhwa mo dper len mi nyan/

dngos su dri ba'i zol gyis ldog pa nas yong shes kyi ma red ces ston tshig / ya rabs tshad ldan zhig gis spyod ngan de 'dra byed pa dper srid dam/ sngar gyi lam lugs ngan pa de rigs spyi tshogs gsar pa'i khrims srol la yong ba dper srid dam/

(tha dad pa) dpags pa, dpag pa, dpogs,, lkog gyur 'jal ba'am rtog par byed pa/ dngos yod gnas lugs ji bzhin 'ol tshod tsam gyis dpog mi thub/ ma 'ongs 'byung tshul la rigs pas dpag pa,..bya spyod legs nyes la brten nas bsam blo bzang ngan gyyi dbye ba dpog pa/ las byed pa'i sngon du ma dpags na, byas tshar rjes 'gyod pas ci la phan/
tshod rtsis/ phyi rol gyi snang tshul la gzhigs nas nang gi don snying dpog rtsis rgyag pa/
(rnying) 1) ra skor/ 2) chos grwa/ 3) grwa shag / 4) 'dus sa/ 5) rtsen sa/
(tha dad pa) mi zhig gis rim bzhin bshad nas mi gzhan zhig la yi ger 'god 'jug pa/ khyed rang gis yi ge 'bri rogs gnang, ngas dpod yong/ yi ge dpod pa/
1) thu'u si/ 2) sa khul khag gi dpon rigs/
mi rabs kyi mi rtsa'i bdag po/
mi rgyud kyi skye rus bdag po/
rigs rus kyi rgyud gcig pa'i dpon gras/ bran g.yog spyi tshogs skabs dpon rgyud kyi mi rabs mang pos bran g.yog la dbang sgyur byas pa/
dpon po'i go gnas 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa/
bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs sam ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam lugs kyi rgyal khab nang gi dpon rigs dang las byed ngan pa/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin phyed tsam dang mi ser spel yul phyed tsam gyi rgyal khab nang btsan rgyal ring lugs dang zhing bdag gral rim gnyis dang ngan 'brel byas te rgyal khab kyi srid dbang bzung nas, rgyal yongs kyi dpal 'byor srog rtsa sger sdom byed mkhan phyir rten tshong pa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'byor chen gral rim/
mi chen gyi nyams sam rnam 'gyur/

don dngos dang kha bral ba dang, mang tshogs dang kha bral ba, mang tshogs kyi khe phan la sems khur mi byed pa, bka' 'bebs bkod gtong kho na byed pa las zhib 'jug brtag dpyad mi byed pa bcas kyi las ka byed stangs dang 'go khrid byed stangs/
dpon thag 'bangs gcod kyang zer, thag gcod dbang med bzhin du thag gcod pa/
/ 1) dbang cha 'dzin mkhan/ zhi ba'i dpon po/ drag po'i dpon po/ khrims dpon/ stong dpon/ khri dpon/ las dpon/ dpon gnas/ 2) dge rgan/ dpon slob/ ded dpon/ 3) gtso bo/ dpon g.yog /
1) rgyal blon/ 2) dpon po dang blon po/ snga dus dpon blon stag spyang las kyang rtsub/
dpon po dang, g.yog 'khor, mi ser/
dpon po rim byung gi mi rabs/
1) slob dpon dang slob ma/ 2) dgon chung 'ga' re'i slob dpon nam mkhan po'i ming/
rtsis gzhi gtan la phab pa'i khral/ sa zhing gi dpya khral/
khral 'ul 'jal dgos kyi thob cha'am khral 'bab/

(tha dad pa) dpyas pa, dpya ba, dpyos,, smad ra gtong ba'am, gzhan skyon rjod pa/ so so rang gis ma byung bar gzhan la dpyas pas ci phan/ mi'i skyon kho na dpyas na rang skyon nam yang mthong mi yong/

1) steng nas thur du btang ba'i thag pa/ brag steng nas dpyang thag btang bar 'jus te yar 'dzeg pa/ 2) rtsed chas shig / phru gus rtsed rwa'i nang du dpyang thag rtsed/ 3) yid gnyis sam the tshom/ drang bden gyi lam du 'jug par yid gnyis dpyang thag 'dzin don med/
thur du glod pa'i thi gu'am thag phra
thur du 'phyang ba'i dar gos sam, dar dpyang/
thag par btags te thur du glod pa'i rdo/
thur du dpyangs pa'i dngos po rlung gis bsgul nas g.yo tshul zhig /
thur du btang ba'i lung thag

sems kyi dpyad pa zhib mo'i sgo nas lus kyi phyi nas nad mngon mngon sum 'byin pa'am 'phral du zhi bar byed pa'i nad bcos thabs shig ste, nang gses su sbye na 'jam dpyad dugs lums byug pa gsum dang, rtsub dpyad gtar bsreg dbug pa gsum, drag po 'dral bcod 'drud 'byin bzhi bcas so/
rta glang sogs 'dul sa'i sa cha/
1) dpyad mtshams khra ma'i bsdus ming/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rim gro sgrub skabs dgos cha'i grangs 'bor thag bcad pa'i yi ge sbug dam 'byar ma/
stong nyid sgom pa'i tshul zhig ste, bdag med pa'i don la shes rab kyis so sor dpyad nas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa'o/
gtar ga dang, me btsa', dugs, lums, byug pa bcas lnga'o/
dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom res mos byed pa/
don dang dngos por dpyad pa'i gtam/
bshal sman dang, skyug sman, sna sman, 'jam rtsi, ni ru ha, gtar kha, me btsa', bdug lums, thur ma sogs la brten nas nad pa gso ba'i thabs shes/
dpyad thabs brgyad khri bzhi stong
bon lugs phrin las skor gyi gzhung zhig /
lkog gyur gyi don rnams ji ltar rig pas dpyad cing mngon gyur gyi sgo nas gtan la phab nas nad zhi bar byed pa'i thabs te, gtar ga dang, me btsa', dugs, lums, byug pa, thur ma bcas sde tshan drug go/
rtog dpyod zhib cha/ gros gzhi tshang mar blo bsdur dpyad brdar gyi thog nas gtan 'bebs gzab nan byed pa/
brtag zhib go bsdur/ bsam 'char gang bton dpyad bsdur gyi sgo nas don gnad thag bcod byed pa/
dpyod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
mngon sum dang, rjes dpag gam dngos stobs rjes dpag yid ches rjes dpag gam grags pa'i rjes dpag ste rigs pa gsum gyis dpyad pa'o/

dag pa'i lung: sangs rgyas kyi bka' tshad ma lta bu, gzhal bya'i gnas gsum char brjod byar ston zhing, mngon gyur ston pa la mngon sum gyis gnod pa med pa dang, lkog gyur ston pa la rjes dpag gis gnod pa med pa dang, shin tu lkog gyur ston pa la rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba med pa bcas mngon rjes rang tshig gsum gyis mi gnod pa'am skyon dag pa'o/
gyod rtsod thag bcad pa'i khra ma/
kha mchu thag bcad pa'i yi ge/
brtag dpyad dam zhib 'jug bya yul/ dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs/
brtag dpyad dag bsher 'pher ba/ las don gang byas zol zog gi lhad ma zhugs pa'i dpyad bzod pa zhig dgos/
khra ma mdor bsdus sam nyung ngu

rlung zhi bar byed pa'i dpyad la til mar la sogs bsku mnye bya ba dang, hor gyi me btsa' brgyab pa, mkhris zhi bar byed pa'i dpyad la rngul dbyung ba dang, gtar kha bya ba, chu yi 'phrul 'khor bya ba, bad kan zhi bar byed pa'i dpyad la dugs brgyab pa dang, me btsa' bzhag pa bcas gsum mo/
sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig dpyal lo ts'a ba chos bzang de las 'khrungs pa yin/
'phya smod byas pa'am skyon btags pa/ mi la skyon brjod byed na don la phan pa zhig shod dgos pa las dpyas btags pa tsam gyis mi phan/
sgo dang sge khung gi ru bzhi'i zur sner yod pa'i dpyi mig tu rgyu rgyu'i yas mas kyi sne'i shing lce/
sked pa'i 'og sta zur g.yas g.yon/ lag pa gnyis dpyi mgor rten pa/ gos thung mi 'bud pa'i gdeng tshod dpyi mgor yod pa/
1) sgo dang sge khung gi dpyi dkri rgyu yul yas mas kyi shing sbubs stong / 2) dpyi'i 'khor mig gi bsdus ming,
dpyi mgo'i zur ram, dpyi rus kyi zur sne/
/ 1) dpal dang phun tshogs dang g.yang/ 2) khams dkar dmar/
/ 1) dus bzhi'i dang po/ 2) snying po/ 3) (rnying) na tshod yol dang rgan po/
dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs
bod kyi rgyal rabs te lo rgyus ston pa'i gzhung dus rabs bcu bdun par rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa zhig /
dpyid dus kyi phun tshogs/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dpyid kyi dpal yon ltar yar rgyas 'gro bzhin du 'dug
(mngon) 1) khu byug / 2) shing zhig gi ming/
dpyid drod 'khor nas bskyar du yong ba'i grang ngad/
lu gu me tog gam g.yar mo thang
dpyid ka'i nyin mo dang mtshan mo dus yun ring thung mnyam pa/
dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam gyi bsdus tshig
dpyid kyi thig le'i bsdus tshig
hor zla gnyis pa'i bcu drug nas drug pa'i bco lnga'i bar ro/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyed pa'i dus dang, dri zhim zla, drod phebs, bde byed dus, 'dod pa'i dus, me tog ldan dus, myu gu'i dus bcas so,
lo re'i thog mar 'byung ba'i drod/
dpyid dus su sa bon 'debs pa/
dpyid kyi yon tan nam dge mtshan/
sa kha 'byed dus kyi rmon pa/
'go tshugs pa ste hor zla dang po'i dbugs: thob dus dpyid kyi 'go tshugs

hor zla dang po/ dpyid zla gsum, dpyid zla ra ba dang, 'bring po, tha chung bcas gsum ste, hor zla dang po, gnyis pa, gsum pa zhes dang, hor zla bcu gcig pa dang, bcu gnyis pa, dang po gsum la ngos 'dzin tshul gnyis yod/
dpyid kyi drod rlung/ dpyid rlung langs pa/
'brog pa'i ru ba dpyid dus sdod gnas/
dpyid ka'i lo gsar dus chen rgya lugs kyi lo 'go/
bod zla dang po'i zla dkyil lam gnyis pa'i nang: chu mig gi 'gram dang spang du skye ba'i me tog mdog dmar skya zhig lung pa la lar rdzi bo me tog kyang zer/ rdzi bo me tog
mig lus kyi dpyi mgo'i rus mig /
gting phyin pa'am mthar phyin pa/
(tha dad pa) dpyangs pa, dpyangs pa, dpyongs,, 'phyang bar byed pa/ thur du dpyong ba/ gdung rgyan du dpyangs pa'i dra ba dra phyed rnams mdzes po 'dug / thag pa gcig 'phred du dpyangs pa/
1) rnam dpyod can nam mkhas pa/ 2) (mngon) gza' phur bu/

1. (tha dad pa) dpyad pa, dpyad pa, dpyod,, phra zhib tu rtog pa'am blos gzab nan gyis 'jal ba/ srang dbar zer sgros kyi skad cha gang thos la bden rdzun phra zhib dpyod dgos/ las don gyi zab gnad la nan tan dpyod cing khong du chud pa/ mi mang po'i nang gi shes rgya can, tshig mang por brtags nas dpyad na shes/ 2. gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i nang gses, sems pa dang shes rab la brten nas don de'i khyad par so sor gzhigs nas 'dzin pa zhib pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes pa'o/

/ 1) dpang po/ 2) sngon rgya gar du byung ba'i grub mtha' zhig yin zhing, de la rgyal dpog pa yang zer des mchod sbyin kho nas tshangs pa lta bu'i mtho ris kyi go 'phang thob pa yod par 'dod la, sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa ni med par 'dod do/
bar mtshams sam dbar/ khang pa gnyis kyi dprag lam/
(yul) mig yan chad dang skra mtshams man chad kyi dpral ba/
1) spyi brtol can nam u tshugs can/ 2) bsod nams dang ldan pa/
1) u tshugs tsha po/ bod kyi brda sprod mi shes par, ham rtsod dpral ko mthug pa'i skyon/ 2) snying tshan che ba'am snying stobs che ba/
1) rngon pa'i lha gar 'khrab dus 'bag gis dpral bar mi gnon pa'i gdan/ 2) rta drel dang bong bu'i gdong rgyan/
smin ma gnyis kyi mtshams su yod pa'i gsang/
mig yan chad dang, skra mtshams man chad kyi dpral ba/ sdod sa dpral ba byas nas, mig la thal ba 'debs/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyan gnas dang mig 'dzin no,
ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, smra ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa nyid kyis dpral ba rgyas shing dbyes che ba/

'byes pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, lta bas byas pa thams cad kyis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba nyid kyis dpral ba legs par 'byes pa ste skra mtshams legs par 'byes pa/
smin mtshams nas yar sor bzhi gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na dpral ba lci la gzer zhing mig mi theg par gyur pa'i nad la phan/
khong khro'i nyams sam 'jigs pa'i rnam 'gyur/ kho khros nas dpral rtsa sgreng ba/ kho zhed nas dpral rtsa sgreng ba/
bud med kyi dpral bar btags pa'i g.yu rgyan/
dpral bar bris pa'i sa dkar gyi ri mo, bram ze'i srol te, dpral bar sa dkar gyi ri mo gsum byas pa'o/
lus kyi srin dang chu ser 'phel ba sogs las byung pa'i lpags pa'i nad de, sha bkra dang, glang shu, mdzer pa, za rkong, shu ba, srin thor, ngo shig khabs, khye ma sogs so/

pags pa'i don dang gcig pa yin yang dag yig lugs ltar na sngon du gzhi dang 'brel zhing, bar du drug sgra med na la mgo can gyi lpags pa 'di bzhin sbyor rgyu/ pags pa/ stag lpags/ gzig lpags/ shing tog lpags pa/ lus lpags/
lus kyi pags pa rul myags su 'gro ba'i mdze nad pags la gram pa zhig /
lus kyi pags mdog glang po che'i pags pa ltar thal skya reg bya rtsub par 'byung ba'i mdze rigs shig bad rlung ldan pa'i mdze nad kyi ming/
/ 1) dpa' dang don gcig pa ste, spobs pa dang, khengs dregs sam nga rgyal/ stobs shugs drag pos pha rol po'i spa bkong ba/ 2) rgyan nam mdzes pa'i cha/ gser dngul gyi spa chas/
pha rol po'i dpa' 'joms par byas pa/
gtsang mo'i mgo rgyan gyi bye brag cig /
smug ma'i nang du chags pa'i cu gang/
sa gnas srid gzhung gi shod drung tsho'i mgo: bo'i skra lcog /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi shod drung tsho'i skra lcog steng du rgyag pa'i rgyan zhig /
rgyan cha 'dogs byed kyi thi gu

kyi bud med kyi mgo rgyan: de la rigs mi 'dra ba gsum bzhi yod, lha lcam spa phrug ni mu tig yin, dkyus ma rnams kyi spa phrug ni g.yu byur spel ma yin, gtsang mo la spa lung dang, spyi gu zer ba gnyis yod/
1. (tha dad pa) brgyan pa dang spras pa/ gos kyis spa ba/ rgyan gyis spa ba/ yon tan rgyan gyis byin chags spa/ 2.mdzes pa dang byin chags spa/ lang tsho spa ba/ 'gro 'dug kun spyod spa ba/
sman du 'gro ba'i shing spa ma'i 'bras bu/
shug pa dang 'dra ba'i shing bongs thung tsher ma can lo 'dab sngo ba, bsang rdzas dang me gsos su mkho ba zhig /
1) skra lhas ma'am lan bu/ 2) (rnying) spobs pa'am ham pa/
1) shing spa ma dang shug pa'i bsdus tshig / 2) (rnying) khyo shug /
/ 1) rtsam pa brdzis pa'i zan rigs/ spags g.yo ba/ spags kha la za bar lam ltag khung du skor don med/ 2) (rnying) 'phag pa/
spags g.yo byed kyi khu ba ja chang sogs/
spags ril ril bzos pa/ sgo phyugs 'tsho bar 'gro dus spags bsgongs te 'khyer ba/
(yul) spags g.yo snod pags pa'i khug chung/
spags dang mnyam du za ba'i zas rigs/
1) spog pa'i 'das pa, 2) (rnying) sta gon byas pa/
spags pa slong ba'i spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses shig nye min khyim pas blos gang spogs kyis sbyin par rtsom pa'i tshe, de las lhag pa'i rin thang sogs bzang ba zhig dgos zhes bslangs pa lta bu'o/
1) spags g.yo ba dang za ba'i snod/ 2) shing sogs las bzos pa'i rtsam phor/
spags kyis dreg pa'am nag nog phyi ba/
spags dang mnyam du za ba'i zas/
sha'i ched du spags byin nas gso ba'i lug /

/ 1) rtswa sngon thung ngu khyab par skyes pa'i sa cha/ dbyar kha'i spang la mi skye dgu skye skye, 'jig rten mi la mi yong dgu yong yong,/ 2) tshon ljang khu ste spang ma yang zer/ 3) zangs kyi 'g.ya' ljang khu la yang zer/
1) tshon spang ma rkyang rkyang/ 2) shing nags med pa'i spang ri dang spang thang kher rkyang/ spang rkyang ljang gu mar gad sa gzhi 'dra/
rtswa sngon skye ba'i thang steng/

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi nub rgyud ru thog rdzong du yod pa'i mtsho zhig yin zhing, mtsho mo 'di'i nub ngos kyi sne mo de kasmir gyi nang du chud cing mtsho 'di'i nub rgyud de tshwa chu dang shar rgyud de mngar chu yin/
1) spang rgyan me tog gi bsdus ming, 2) sngo sman zhig rtsa phran gyis pho drod skyed bar byed/
sngo sman me tog gi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas gre ba'i dug tshad 'joms, skad 'gag sel/
sngo sman gyi rigs spang rgyan me tog sngo nag 'char ba zhig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas 'brum nad dang, grum bu, me dbal sogs la phan/

spang gi thog shar ba'i me tog chung chung: tshos gzhi sna tshogs yod pa zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la kun tu gas dang khyab 'jug gnon pa, ston gyi me tog ba lang zas, gzhan gyis mi thub, gzhan las rgyal, ri bo'i rna rgyan bcas so,

rdo sman gyi rigs dbyibs rgyus phran gshib pa dang 'dra zhing mdog spang ma dang mtshungs pa zhig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas chu rgyus chad pa dang, chu rgyus reng 'khum du gyur pa sogs la phan/
rtswa sngon skyes pa'i yul ljongs/ spang ljongs ne'u gsing me tog rgyas pa/

spang ba'i ltung byed de, gang la ltung ba 'byung ba'i dngos po ste byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i gos stan sogs spang ba'i sgo nas phyir bcos byd dgos shing, ma bcos na rnams smin ngan song du ltung byed pa ste so thar gyi ltung byed pa ste so thar gyi ltung ba sde lnga'i nang tshan zhig /
spang ltung bcu tshan gnyis pa

dge slong gi spang bya spang ba'i ltung ba sum cu las, bcu tshan gnyis pa ste, srin bal gyi stan gyi spang ba dang, bal nag gi stan gyi spang ba dang, cha gnyis bsres pa'i spang ba dang, lo drug gi spang ba dang, mtho gang gi spang ba dang, lam du bal thogs pa'i spang ba dang, bal 'khrur 'jug pa'i spang ba dang, rin po che la reg pa'i spang ba dang, mngon mtshan can gyi spang ba dang, nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ba ste bcu'o/
spang ltung bcu tshan dang po

spang ba'i ltung ba bcu tshan gsum gyi dang po la, gos lhag 'chang ba'i spang ba, 'bral ba'i spang ba dang, zla 'jog gi spang ba dang, chos gos 'khrur 'jug gi spang ba dang, gos len pa'i spang ba dang, slong ba'i spang ba dang, lhag por len pa'i spang ba, spags pa slong ba'i spang ba, so so nas spags pa slong ba'i spang ba, bskul ba'i spang ba ste bcu'o/
spang ltung bcu tshan gsum pa

dge slong gi spang bya spang ba'i ltung ba sum cu yod pa las, bcu tshan gsum pa la, lhung bzed 'chang ba'i spang ba dang, lhung bzed lhag po 'chang ba'i spang ba dang, thags 'thag tu 'jug pa'i spang ba dang, 'thag pa bskyed pa'i spang ba dang, byin 'phrog gi spang ba dang, gtad pa las byung ba'i spang ba dang, dgon pa'i 'bral spang, ras chen gyi spang ba dang, bsngos pa gzhan du bsgyur ba'i spang ba dang, gsog 'jog gi spang ba ste bcu'o/

dge slong gi spang bya ltung byed kyi sde'i nang gses, gang la ltung ba byung ba'i dngos po de spang ba'i sgo nas phyir bcos dgos shing, ma bcos na rnam smin ngan song du ltung bar byed pa dang, grangs ni bcu tshan gsum yod do/
spang rtswa sngon po skyes pa'i sa thang/ nyams dga'i spang thang/
'og tu chu yod pa'i spang sa rdol ba/ glo bur spang rdol lta bu'i bya dngos gsar pa mang po thon pa/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro cung zad kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug tshad dang, snying tshad tsha bas lus skrangs pa bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri sras dang spu can no,
1. spong ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. (rnying) mi 'jigs pa/
phyogs pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge 'dun gyi gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong dang lhan cig spyod lam mthun pa'o/
dge slong gi ltung ba zhig /
byed mi rung ba ste, rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon la sogs pa'i spang bya/

spang bya yan lag bcu'ang zer, dge tshul gyi spang bya bcu ste, rtsa ltung bzhi dang, chang 'thung ba, gar sogs, phreng sogs, mal stan che mtho, dus min kha zas, chags pas gser dngul len reg byed pa bcas bcu'o/
sdug bsngal bden pa dang, kun 'byung bden pa/
mngon 'gyur re zhig nyams smad pa dang, sa bon gtan du spangs te skye mi rung gi chos can du byas pa'o/
khams gsum gyi spang bya rnams ris lngar dbye ba ste, mthong lam du bden bzhi mthong bas spang bya kun btags kyi cha bzhi dang, sgom lam gyi spang bya lhan skyes bcas ris lnga/

spang bya dang blang bya gnyis kyi bsdus ming ste, spang bya ni bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs dang, blang bya ni bsam sbyor bzang po'i rigs so/ bya spyod la dngos su ma zhugs gong nas rtog dpyod spang blang 'dzol med byed dgos/
rtswa sngon gyis khyab pa'i de'u 'bur/ spang 'bur chung chung zhig gi steng du slebs/
tshon ljang gu/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngon po dang, spang ma btul ma, spang ma'i mig sman, rma bya can, rtse can mgrin bcas so,

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims dang, dug tshad, tsha ba gsar rnying, dreg grum, khrag nad, rgyu gzer, tsha 'khru bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun byed rgyal po dang, chig thub dkar po, the'u rang mgo, thog dkar mgo dgu, do bo mo, bdud rtsi 'chi sos, be do, mi rgan mgo bo, rtsi mgo rdog zla ba'i bcud, a mgo ber ga ,a mgo ber gyon bcas so,
mtshe ldum nang tshan spang la skye ba zhig /
1) tshon ljang gu'i khu ba/ 2) rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nus pas mkhris nad sogs skyug par byed/
spang la skyes pa'i ram bu ste, nus pas 'khru ba gcod/
spang rtswa skye ba'i ri/ ra dga' ba rdza ri dang, lug dga' ba spang ri/ ming gi rnam grangs la spang gi ri bo dang sman gyi ljongs so,

shes rab rno yang brtson 'grus med pa'i dpe/ shes rab rno ba spang la me shor 'dra, brtson 'grus can gyis rdo la bug pa 'bigs/ 'phral hur la mthar mi 'khyol ba spang la me shor lta bu'i tshab tshub byed pa/
spang las skyes pa'i sha mo/
1) spang ljongs te rtswa sngon gyis khyab pa'i sa cha/ 2) spang ljongs dma' sa/
(yul) ljang skya las dkar shas cung zad chung ba/

dri ma bral zhing yon tan khong du chud pa ste, sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang ba dang, ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa mngon du brnyes pa ni bde bar gshegs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'o/
sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan gnyis te, nyon shes kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs shing, ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya thams cad rtogs pa'o/
spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu

rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, mi 'dod pa 'byung ba'i nyes rgyu rtsa ba nas spangs nas med pa'i rgyu dngos med des, 'bras bu phun tshogs 'phel ba dngos por gyur pa bskyed pa ston pa'i rgyu'i rgyan zhig /
spangs pa stob pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge slong gzhan gyis spangs pa'i zas lhag por ma byas bzhin du byas so zhes bstabs na stob pa po la ltung ba'o/
