rlung langs nas zhi ba'am chag pa/ re zhig ngang sgug byas nas kho spro shi ba dang thabs mkhas kyis gros sdur byed pa/
sems skyid nyams che ba/ rnam 'gyur spro sing nge ba zhig ston pa/
spro nyams sam dga' nyams che ba/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i go skabs thob na sems spro sing sing zhig yong/
dga' zhing spro ba'i sems chu rlabs bzhin 'phyur ba/ gsar brje legs 'grub byung bar spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas bkra shis bde legs zhu ba/
gung gseng ngam gling ga sogs su bskyod nas skyid po gtong ba/
lcug ma'am smyug bshags kyis bslas pa'i slo ma chung ba/ spos sprog /
dkar chag nang bkod de rtsis len rtsis sprod byed dgos pa'i yig cha'i rigs/
rtsis sprod rtsis len byed sgo'i bka' shog /
rtsis sprod kyi dngul lam, 'jal sprod kyi dngul/
rtsis sprod rtsis len byed sgo'i dngos rigs/ spyi dngos sprod chas rnams 'thor rkyen btang na mi 'grig /
rtsis sprod rtsis len byed skabs kyi deb yig /

(tha dad pa) sprad pa, sprad pa, sprod,, 1) ster ba dang gtod pa/ phyir sprod pa/ yi ge sprod pa/ 'phrin sprad pa/ skyin tshab sprod pa/ mdun lam sprad pa/ rtsis sprod byas pa/ 2) thug pa dang phan tshun sbyor ba/ 'thab mo sprod pa/ dgra lan sprod pa/
rtsis sprod skabs kyi dpang po'am lta rtog byed mkhan/
phar tshur gang rung sprod dan gyi 'dzin yig /
phar sprod tshur len/ gzhung gi dngos chas gang yod sprod len yag po byed dgos/
spras pa dang spro ba'i skul tshig
1) snang srid kyi dngos po thams cad/ 2) rgyas spros tshang ma/
1) gzab cing rgya che ba/ 2) bden grub kyi zhen pa/ 3) rgyas shing rgya che'i spros pa dang bcas pa/
1.spro ba'i 'das pa, 2. 1) rgya che ba'i mtshan ma dang, rtog pa/ bag med rgyas spros/ spros pa chod pa/ spros par ltung ba/ spros pa'i bag chags/ 2) (rnying) las ka'am las 'gan/
lta ba phyogs su lhung ba ste, skye, 'gag rtag chad, 'gro, 'ong, gcig tha dad bcas mtha' brgyad/
mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang, stong nyid dam chos nyid/
dbu ma thal 'gyur bas stong nyid kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa na spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba ste, skye, 'gag rtag chad, 'gro , 'ong, gcig tha dad bcas dang bral ba ste med pa'o/
rgyas pa med pa/ spros med snyan zhu/
rgyas rgyas bzang bzang gi gshom ra/ dang dod kyi 'tsho ba'i spros gshom spong ba/

bod yig gsal byed bcu bzhi pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mchu dang, byed pa mchu, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen sgra med/ 1.ming gzhi'i ma ning gi yi ge zhig / 2...1) skyed byed/ pha'i ma/ pha'i sring mo/ pha bzang gi bu mo rigs bza ma/ pha dga' bu skyid/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye srid sa bon pa dang, skyong byed, yab, gso ba po bcas so, 2) thabs kyi phyogs/
pha bzang po las skyes pa'i bu/
gcig gis gcig la khag dkri tshul/
pha ri'am pha rol gyi phyogs/
pha rol/ pha gi na 'dug / pha gi mi de su red/
1) pha lo na mthon po/ 2) grwa pa la smod pa'i ming ngan/ pha rgan dar nag 'khyer mkhan/
rdo rje theg pa'i snang phyogs sgyu lus sam thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud/
bon lugs bskyed rdzogs kyi 'bras bu'i skor gyi gzhung zhig /
thabs phyogs pha rgyud kyi yan lag /

bka' gdams pha ston 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis dri ba zhus te jo bo rje a ti shas dri lan gsungs pa zab rgyas lam gyi gnad las brtsams pa'i zhal gdams mang po dang, jo bo'i sku tshe de nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas bsdus, bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi bla brgyud rnam thar bcas gtso bor ston pa'i chos po ti zhig /
bka' gdams pa'i pha chos dang, bu chos zhes pa'i gzhung gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
(yul) lho brag pa'i yul skad la pha'i ming/
1) pha shi rjes las 'khur byed nus pa'i bu/ 2) mngal chags nas pha shi ba'i rjes su btsas pa'i bu/
pha shi rjes bus shul 'dzin tshul/ rgan rabs kyi spyod bzang la kha mig yar lta byas te pha rjes bus 'dzin thub pa zhig byed dgos/
pha'i las khur bus theg pa/ lus stobs che ba pha rjes bus zin byung/
1) pha'i zer rgyun bu rgyud la mched pa'am bsdad pa/ 2) gzhan gyi zer sgros su 'brang ba/ sngar byung gtam rgyud shod srol sna tshogs la pha gtam bu 'jags su cha 'jog byas na mi 'grig /
1) pha rol gyi mtha'/ grong khyer gyi pha mthar bzo grwa mang po yod/ 2) mu khyud/ pha mtha' mi mngon pa/ pha mtha' bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/
pha mtha' med pa/ nam mkha'i rgya khyon pha mtha' yas/ shes bya'i gnas ni pha mtha' yas/
1) pha dang pha'i spun mched kyi bsdus ming/ 2) pha phyogs kyi spun mched/ pha spun dgra la song yang rus pa gser/
1) pha gi'i phyogs sam, pha rol/ 2) pha'i phyogs kyi gnyen tshan/

sha mong gi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas khrag gcod, rtsa kha sdom, mes tshig pa'i rma dang, sbrul gyi so dug la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'dre thal thum dang, 'dre mo thal rkom, 'dre sha sgo ti, 'dre sha mang, pha bong gol gol, ma bsregs pa'i thal ba bcas so,
rdo sman nag po gru bzhi sho dang 'dra ba zhig nus pas khrag 'khyil sel, zug gzer 'joms, rus chag sbyor, pha wang long bu zhes kyang bris/
pha bu go ldog gi phyva
'byung rtsis nang pha'i lag rtsar brten nas bu tsha'am, bu tsha'i lag rtsar brten nas pha la gegs rtsub yod med sogs brtag pa'i mo phyva ste ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi nang gses shig /
rdo gong bu ha cang chen po/ pha bong chen po de rus sbal gyi dbyibs dang 'dra/
1) rdo pha bong gi steng/ 2) srong btsan sgam pos lha ldan gtsug lag khang phyag ma btab gong du skyid chu'i klung thang gi nub byang ri 'dabs su gsar rgyag byas pa'i sgrub gnas shig /
pha ba dgo dgo'i ming gi rnam grangs shig
1) pha dang ma/ pha ma dang ldan pa/ pha ma nongs pa/ pha ma gcig pa/ pha ma spun mched/ pha ma'i dod po/ lus sbyin pha ma/ 2) thabs dang shes rab/ 3) pho mo/ dge slong pha ma/
pha dang ma dang gnyen grogs/
yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi la zhig /
1) pha dang ming po/ 2) pha'i ming/
rang gi pha dang pha'i pha sogs rgan rabs/ pha mes yang mes/
mi thog gong ma gong ma'i lo rgyus kyi yig cha/
pha dang bu tsha bo rgyud pa/ mes po pha tsha bu rgyud dang bcas pa/
phar tsam/ ri 'di'i pha tshad cig na mtsho chen po zhig yod/
pha'i phyogs kyi gnyen tshan/ pha tshan gcig pa/ pha tshan che ba/ pha tshan rags la mang ba/
pha'i dus dang bu rgyud kyi dus/
pha rus gcig pa'i skor tsho/

bya ma byi'am pags bye'u ste, so dang gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi sems can zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la khyim du 'gro dang, pags pa'i 'dab chags, pags byi'u, bya rog dgra bo, mtshan dus rgyu, gzhan du phyogs bcas so,
pha ba dgo dgo'i ming gi rnam grangs shig
yul 'gar gser rdo zer ba'i rdo nag po gru bzhi sho dang 'dra ba zhig sman la 'gro zhing rang byung zangs red zer srol yang yod/
mi so so'i pha mes dus nas bzung ba'i gzhis ka'am, sa zhing/
1.mtha' dang pha rol/ pha zad gtugs pa/ gtsang po'i pha zad du phyin pa/ 2.phar tsam/ dus tshod pha zad 'gyangs song/ chu skyogs 'di pha zad khol cig /
pha gshis rgyud yag po/ pha bzang gi bu/ pha bzang gi bu mo/ pha bzang po'i bngul khug de, bu ngan pas ja khug byed/
sngo sman zhig ste, ro mngar la kha ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo tshad dang, lud pa dang, dug sel ba la phan/
pha tshab bam, pha gnyis pa/

pha mes rnams kyi sdod sa'am, rang rang skye sa'i yul/ pha yul gcig pa/ pha yul ba/ pha yul dmyal ba yin yang skyid snang 'char/ mi rgas na pha yul dran, bya rgyas na shing yul dran/ pha yul bral yang pha skad mi shor/
1) pha rol gyi ri/ pha ri mtho zhing tshu ri dma'/ 2) chu'i pha rol/
pha bu ltos sa ltos 'jog gi res skor/
1) phar phyogs/ chu bo chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa/
/ 2) skye ba phyi ma/ 3) zhi ba myang 'das/
pha rol gyi sems shes pa
shes pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, gzhan sems rtogs par byed pa'i shes pa,.., shes pa'i mngon shes: gzhan sems kyi dran tshul mngon sum du rtogs pa ste mngon shes drug gi ya gyal zhig /
1) phar ngos su song ba/ 2) «par'amta:» pha mthar son pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/
pha rol tu phyin pa bcu

pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi steng du thabs dang stobs, smon lam, ye shes te bzhi bsnan pas bcu,.., pa drug «p'aramitashata» sbyin pa dang: tshul khrims, bzod pa, brtson 'grus, bsam gtan, shes rab ste drug /
pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa
pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug sher phyin don

bdun cu las mthar gyis sbyor ba'i chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan byin pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, tshul khrims kyi mthar gyis pa dang, bzod pa'i mthar gyis pa dang, brtson 'grus kyi mthar gyis pa dang, bsam gtan gyi mthar gyis pa dang, shes rab kyi mthar gyis pa ste drug go /
(mngon) 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba'i tshe dus las 'das pa/
1) gzhan zil gyis gnon pa/ 2) (mngon) dpa' bo/
1) mtha' mi mngon pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol mi mngon/ 2) (mngon) rgya mtsho/
phar phyogs tshur phyogs/ chu bo'i pha rol tshu rol thag ring po 'dug /
1) tshe pha rol tu 'phos pa/ 2) pha mthar phyin pa/
rin chen rdo rje pha lam/
pha shi ba'i rjes kyi las ka sogs bus 'dzin pa/ snga rabs kyi srol rgyun bzang po rnams pa shul bus 'dzin byas te dar 'phel du gtong ba/
/ 1) lkog gam rgyab/ sgo phag nas bltas pa/ gyang gi phag tu mi zhig yibs nas bsdad 'dug / 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / chu phag /
bud med kyi ske rags shig /
kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la: mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas dug nad dang, bad kan smug po lus la byer ba sdud/
phag mo gru pa'i bsdus tshig
phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po nas bsgyud pa'i bka' brgyud, nang gses phye na, 'dri gung dang, stag lung, 'brug pa, g.ya' bzang, khro phu, shug gseb, smar tshang rnams so sor gyes/

phag mo gru pa'i yul sde'i srid dbang 'dzin mkhan, khri rabs dang po ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug lo bar srid bskyangs pa dang, de nas gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs gu shris shing sbrul nas lo brgyad, gsum pa grags pa byang chub kyis shing stag nas lo bdun, bzhi pa gu shri bsod nams grags pas lcags bya nas lo bzhi, lnga pa dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis shing glang nas lo bzhi bcu zhe drug drug pa dbang grags pa 'byung gnas kyis rab byung bdun pa'i chu byi nas lo bcu gnyis, bdun pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis lo bzhi, brgyad pa dbang kun dga' legs kyis rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug nas lo dgu , dgu pa dpal ngag gi dbang po, bcu pa dbang ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan, bcu gcig pa zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa bcas kyis rim par bskyangs/
1) sems can phag gi mgo bo/ 2) rdo sman gyi rigs phag gi mgo dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rus pa sbyor, chu ser skam/

1) phag pa'i lce ste srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rus mdzer dang, rus 'bras la phan/ 2) dkrug shing gi lkog lab/ phag lce byed pa'i g.yo sgyu'i mgo skor la ma thebs pa gal che/
phag zhag skabs 'bab pa'i char pa, char chu de dug tu 'gyur bas sman dpyad sogs 'dzem dgos pa'i bshad srol yod/
phag pa'i mchu to/ phag mchus sa slog /
skog nas nyan pa/ gsang gtam la phag nyan rgyag pa/
lkog lta/ gsang ba'i yig char phag lta byed pa/
phag spu sogs las bzos pa'i dreg pa 'khrud byed/
lkog tu nyar ba'i rgyu nor,..g.yu byur mang po phag nor du bzhag pa/
dud 'gro phag / ri phag / yul phag / phag gi lto snod/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khor lo'i sna can dang, ngur sgra can, mchu ring, spu ring, mang skye, sa 'joms bcas so,
gsod rgyu'i phag pa shed mo mgyogs po len ched phag tshang gi nang kho nar bcug nas gsos pa/ phag pa sdom gsos byas pa bzang la mngon, rta rgan sgal bcos byas pa ngan la mngon/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas mkhris skran dang, zas mi 'ju ba, mkhris pa grang mkhris, gnyan rims sogs la phan/
phag pa'i dri chen me la dud pa ma shor ba bsregs pa'i thal ba/
/ 1) mo phag / 2) rdo rje phag mo/
bod rang skyong ljongs sne gdong rdzong gi khongs sngar bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal du gtogs pa'i yul zhig

1) sde srid phag mo gru pa ste rab byung drug pa'i shing rta lor ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis btsugs pa'i srid dbang de yin zhing, rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta lor karma pa bstan skyong dbang pos bsnubs/ 2) phag gru bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod mkhan/
phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po

mdo khams lho rgyud 'bri lung sne shod du lcags stag lor 'khrungs, dgung lo bcu dgu la dbus su byon, dwags po lha rje bsten, phag gru'i gdan sa btab nas gtan chags par bzhugs pas phag mo gru pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs, sgam po ba nas brgyud pa'i chos rgyun rgya cher spel bas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur, rang lo re gcig pa lcags stag lor 'das/
phag pa'i sdod sa'am, ra ba/ phag pas bltas na phag tshang gzhal yas khang/

1) phag pa'i tshil bu/ 2) srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad lus la byer ba dang shu thor za 'phrug sogs pags nad kyi rigs, rkang lag la ser ga gas pa bcas la phan/
1) lkog tshong/ 2) phag pa'i nyo tshong/

nyi ma 'khrig khyim du slebs nas zhag bcu bdun 'das nas zhag bdun gyi bar lho phyogs dzambu briksha'i shing la dur phag 'dzeg pas char bab pa dug tu 'gyur bas sman dpyad chu yi las la 'dzem dgos zer, nyi bar tshad 5,46,30,0 shar/
1) lkog zas/ 2) phag pa'i lto chas/
1) phag pa'i gnya' steng gi spu rtsing po/ 2) phag spu las bzos pa'i dreg pa 'khrud spyad cig /
lkog lab/ tshogs 'du'i thog bsam 'char thad kar shod pa las phag zer mi chog /
phag pa 'jug sa'i ra skor ram phag tshang/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gro mo rdzong khongs su yod cing, rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad smi 4200 slebs pas 'dzam gling gi grong khyer sa bab mtho shos zhes par grags/
phag pa'i mi gtsang skyag pa/
phag brun bsregs thal te sman zhig /
lo skor bcu gnyis kyi mtha' ma'i ming/ phag lo pa/
phag pa'i rkang pa dang lag pa/
sgra snyan te, gtong skabs phang par 'khyer dgos stabs phang 'gro zhes btags so/
1) shing 'bras lo tog sogs legs par smin pa'i rnam pa/ kham bu phang ngi phung ngir smin pa/ 2) lang ling ngam, 'bar 'bur du g.yo tshul/ sprin nag phang ngi phung ngir lding ba/
phang ngi phung ngi'i bsdus tshig

gces shing yid du 'ong ba'am, snying du sdug pa, gtsegs che ba, mnangs che ba de phar shor ba'am, tshur ma thob par yid pham tshul/ mi ngan de gson bzung byed ma thub pa phangs pa la/ mda' mo dongs pa'i nang du rgas pa phangs/
1) brtsi mthong med pa/ 2) ser sna med pa/ rang srog phangs med kyis gzhan srog skyob pa/
ser sna'i sems/ rgyu nor phangs sems med par 'phro brlag gtong ba/
phan pa/ phan kha med pa'i las mi byed/
1) phan thabs kyi rogs ram/ 2) phan 'dogs pa'i mdza' grogs/
phan thogs/ sman 'dis kho bo'i nad la phan cha chen po byung song/ phan cha yod pa/

1) dus sngon chad dang phyin chad gnyis kar go rung ba/ da sngon phan chad kyi byas nyes spangs nas de ring phan chad de ltar ma byed/ 2) phar phyogs tshur phyogs kyi phar phyogs/ rdo ring 'di phan chad kyi sa cha/
phan thogs chung na drin chung ba/

nus pa thon pa'am go chod pa/ khyed kyi bka' slob la brten nas nga la phan thogs chen po byung/ thon skyed gong spel la phan thogs pa'i nyams myong spel res byed pa/ chu yur de nas bar thag ring pos chod pa'i zhing kha rnams la phan mi thogs pa'ang yong srid/ phan thogs nus shugs/ phan thogs byung 'bras/
khe phan dang nus pa/ thabs shes gnad du ma khel bas phan don ma grub/

phan pa dang bde ba/ las byed kyi phan bde/ mi dmangs kyi phan bde/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal gyi phan bde'i grib bsil snum por 'tsho zhing gnas pa/ phan bder longs spyod pa'i go skabs sbyin pa/

ma bu le lag rab byung bcu gsum pa'i nang: 'bri gung tshe dbang brtan pa'i slob ma dbon tshang ye shes bsam gtan gyis mdzad pa'i sman gyi man ngag gces rigs bsdus pa'i le tshan zhig dang gces bsdus phan bde'i snying po'i zhal shes snying gi khu ba logs su bkod pa dang gnyis so/

1) rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang 'bri gung tshe dbang brtan pas mdzad pa'i nad sman sprad pa'i man ngag sna tshogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig / 2) rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang dpal spungs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi 'brum bcos dang, gsar 'gyur rtsa yi brtag thabs, rin chen ril nag chen mo'i skor sogs 'khod pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
phan grogs byed pa/ thabs shes gang zab kyi sgo nas rig gnas kyi las don la phan 'dogs pa/
bsdu dngos bzhis sems can la phan 'dogs pa/
phan thogs/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la phan 'drong che nges byung ba/
1) phyang phrul gyi rgyan rigs 'jol ba'i tshul/ phyang phrul mdzes rgyan dar phod phan phun g.yo/ 2) rnying hrul lam dam dum thor bur gyur nas bed spyod du mi rung ba'i tshul/
phan thogs kyi nus shugs/ chu bed las grwa de nas phan nus thon pa/
1. (tha mi dad pa) phan thogs pa/ sman gyis nad la phan/ slob sbyong byas pas rang la phan pa/ dngos su mi phan yang brgyud nas phan yong/ 2. khe phan nam phan thogs/ phan pa'i lhag bsam/
phan ni phun ni'i bsdus tshig

phar tshur/ blo mthun pa phan tshun slob sbyong dang, phan tshun rogs ram gyi sgo nas yar thon yong thabs byed pa/ phan tshun gcig sems gcig gis 'dzin pa/ phan tshun brtse zhing dung ba/ phan tshun dkrugs pa/ phan tshun dgrar 'dzin/ phan tshun lta skul/ phan tshun tha dad pa/ phan tshun the gtogs mi byed pa/ phan tshun mthun pa/ phan tshun 'dra ba/ phan tshun bsdur ba/ phan tshun bslu dogs/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang, don gnyis kyi mtshungs chos phar tshur 'jal res byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
ca lag sogs phan tshun bzang ngan bsdur ba/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying gnyis kyi bde sdug bzang ngan khyad par phan tshun 'gebs bsdur byed pa/
gza' skar gyi 'bras bu brtag pa'i 'khor lo ste, gnam gshis bzang ngan char chu 'bel dkon sogs brtag thabs skar dpyad ri mo'i 'khor lo/
gcig la gcig rten du gyur pa/
1) phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu gyur pa/ 2) tha dad du gyur pa/ phan tshun nang 'gal, nang don phyogs 'gal/
phar tshur bsre ba'am, dkrugs pa/
'gal ba'i bye brag cig ste, phan tshun spang ba'i sgo nas mi mthun par gnas pa, ka bum gnyis dang, rtag mi rtag gnyis lta bu'o/
phan tshun spang 'gal gyi rtags sbyor

'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig phan tshun spangs 'gal la brten nas rang gi khyab 'brel nges dgos pa, mdun gyi rwa can 'di chos can, rta ma yin te, rwa yod pa'i phyir, zhes dang, bum pa chos can, rtag pa ma yin te, byas pa yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu gcig gi don dang ldan na cig shos yin pa bkag tsam gyi 'gal zlar gyur pa'i rtags sbyor ro/
phan tshun spang 'gal gyi rtags sbyor gnyis
phan tshun spangs 'gal la brten pa'i snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags kyi sbyor ba 'god tshul la rnam pa gnyis te, nges pas ltos pa 'gog pa'i rtags dang, ltos pas nges pa 'gog pa'i rtags so/

gyi thal 'gyur: gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bcu bzhi'i nang gses, phan tshun spangs 'gal du gyur pa'i 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog na khyab byed dang 'gal ba dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, ma byas par thal, rtag pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, mi rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur ro/
1) phar tshur lhu bsgrigs pa/ 2) dngos rigs ster res byas pa/
phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, phan tshun yin pa med pa'i rgyu dngos med des, sems la 'dod pa'i 'bras bu dngos por gyur pa bskyed pa'i rgyu'i rgyan zhig /
phar tshur gcig gzhogs gcig 'degs kyi rogs ram/
phan tshun bzod pa sgom res/ phugs kyi phan don bsgrub ched du gnas skabs phan tshun bzod sgom byas kyang 'grig /
phan tshun gyod 'dzing gi kha gtad 'jal ba/ dgrar 'dzin dpung sde khag gnyis phan tshun ya bzung byas nas yun ring 'thab pa/
lus la phan pa'i kha zas/
phan pa'i yon tan nam nus pa/ nad drag pa sman gyi phan yon red/
lag 1) bsam gtan bzhi'i yan lag cig ste: bsam gtan bzhi'i rang sa'i tshor ba'o/ 2) dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/
gzhan la yag po yong ba byed 'dod kyi bsam pa/
phab be phob be'i bsdus tshig
gos sogs phyi bong che ba'i tshul/ cha lugs phab be phob be stabs mi bde/
(rgya) gdong sogs 'byid byed kyi ras a cor/
rin thang gi khyad par rtsi tshul/

/ 1) zho chang sogs bsnyal ba ldang byed kyi phabs sam, ru ma ste, zho rtsi chang rtsi sogs/ 2) sman du 'gro ba'i chang rtsi ste, nus pas chu rgyus 'grams pa dang, byis pa'i lte 'khor gyi nad, mngal nad, rta bong gi grang nad bcas la phan/
rgyun dang, ru ma'am, phabs rtsi/ chang gi phabs rta/ sman gyi phabs rta/
gyong gun/ tshong la pham kha 'khel ba/
gyong 'khyer ba'am bzod par byas pa/
pham kha dang rgyal kha/ pham rgyal su la yong min dbye ba 'byed pa'i gnas/ pham rgyal myur du 'byed yong/
pham pa/ pham nyes gtong mi thub pa/
gyong gtong ba/ nyo tshong drang po byed pa las, phar tshur pham ster ba mi chog / dgra dmag la 'dzings nas pham ster ba/
dge tshul gyi ltung ba thams cad nyes byas kho nar 'du zhing, rtsa ba bzhi ni sdom pa nyams pa'i rgyu yin pas pham 'dra'i nyes byas zhes bya'o/
1. 'pham pa'i 'das pa, 2./ 1) rgyal kha blangs pa'i ldog zla/ pham pa rgyal ba'i rgyu rkyen yin/ 2) «par'adzika» so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ba nyams pa/

dge slong ma'i spang bya, dge slong pha dang thun mong du gyur pa'i pham pa bzhi'i steng du thun min gyi pham pa bzhi ste, skyes pa la chags sems kyis lus 'khyud cing reg pa dang/ skyes pa la chags sems kyis lus gan rkyal du bkan pa dang, zla mor pham pa byung ba shes bzhin du 'chab pa dang, dge slong 'ga' zhig dge 'dun gyi gnas nas phyung ba la slar yang 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bzod par gsol ba de nyid lus ngag gi sgo nas zlog par byed pa'o/
dge slong gi rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste, mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa dang, ma byin len gyi pham pa, srog gcod kyi pham pa, mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyi pham pa bcas bzhi/
rtsa ba bzhi gang rung las nyams pa na, gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i yan lag bzhi tshang ba'o/

dge slong gi spang bya ltung ba sde lnga'i dang po ste, nang gses su pham pa bzhi yod cing, dge slong gis 'di bzhi gang rung la spyad de skad cig ma gcig la bcabs kyang sdom pa lhag ma tsam yang med par gcod par byed pas na rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang, mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po mthu med par bcom pa'i phyir pham pa'i sde zhes bya'o/
rtsa ba bzhi gang rung las nyams pa na, gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug gi yan lag bzhi po gang rung ma tshang ba'o/
yid skyo po/ de ring khong ma mjal bas sems pham po byung/
1) zas sogs dngos rdzas sam lag rtags/ zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la, bde ba lha yi pham phab yod/ 2) zas lhag
gyong gun ha cang che ba/ btsan 'dzul dgra dmag la pham tshabs che ba zhig yong nges red/
rin gong ma gnas las chung bar 'tshong ba'i tshong/ pham tshong brgyab na dgos pa med/
(rnying) gos kyi bye brag zla gam/
rab byung pho'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa,
pha rol zhes pa'i bsdus tshig ste, tshur gyi ldog phyogs/ glu phar gcig blangs na tshur gcig len pa/ phar 'gro tshur 'ong/ rgya bod bar du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed/
'drong po'am drang po min pa/ 'thab lam phar kyog tshur kyog bskor nas gsar brjer rgyal kha gzhi nas thob pa/
/ 1) pha rol gyi ngos/ chu'i phar kha/ phar kha lta ba/ 2) (yul) bu ram spus ka zhan pa/
dus tshod phyir bshol/ dus sgo phar 'gyang gtong ba/ las ka phar 'gyang btang nas 'thus shor byung ba/
1) 'gre log rgyag pa/ spang kha'i steng du rta dang dre'us phar 'gre tshur 'gre byed pa/ 2) phan tshun rigs 'gre gtong ba/
phar 'gro ba dang tshur 'ong ba/ rlangs 'khor phar 'gro tshur 'gro rgyun mi 'chad pa/
phar 'thab/ rang srung phar rgol gyis dgra dmag thal ba'i rdul du brlags/
phar tshur mgyogs por 'gro tshul/ bya ba gnad la ma 'khel na, phar rgyug tshur rgyug stong ngal yin/
mgyogs po song zhig ces pa'i skul tshig /
pha rol gyi ngogs sam 'gram/ rta bzhon nas chu'i phar ngogs su phyin pa/
pha rol gyi ngos/ rang ngos dang phar ngos gnyis ka mthong dgos/
(rnying) mig phar tshur bsgrims te lta tshul/
gos chen dang, 'go snam sogs kyi steng du dar skud tshem drubs kyis bkod pa'i mdzes rgyan ri mo/
phyir log pa/ rang yul du phar ldog pa/ skyon tshur bkal nas phar ldog pa/ dgra bo phar ldog pa/
gzhan la phar gtod pa/ rin 'bab phar sprod pa/ g.yar ba'i dngos po phar sprod/
dngul dngos sogs gzhan la phar gtod pa dang, rang gis tshur len pa/
je ring je ring/ yul phar phar brgal ba/ dus yun phar phar 'gyangs/

1) mthar bskrad pa/ btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams rang sa nas phar phud cig / 2) chas gos sogs brje 'bud/ dgun chas phar phud nas dbyar chas tshur gyon cig / 3) logs su bkar ba/ rgas 'khogs rnams phar phud, de byings kyis ngal rtsol byas/

«par'amita:» 1) pha rol tu phyin pa ste, theg chen gyi bsgrub pa'i bslab bya gang zhig khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i dge ba mtha' dag sgrub pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o, de ni 'jig rten pa dang nyan rang gi dge ba kun las phul du byung bas phar ngos su song ba'am, pha mthar son pa'o/ 2) shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes pa'i gzhung gi ming/
mthun phyogs drug ser sna dang: tshul 'chal, zhe sdang, le lo, rnam g.yeng, shes 'chal bcas drug go/

pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ste khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba 'das nas sa bcu rim gyis thob par byed pa'i sbyin pa dang, tshul khrims, bzod pa, brtson 'grus, bsam gtan, shes rab, thabs, smon lam, stobs, ye shes te bcu/
bdag nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su smin par byed pa dang, sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang, sems can thams cad la phan pa'i spyod pa mi gtong ba bcas so/
rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa/
khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi sbyin pa dang, tshul khrims, bzod pa, brtson 'grus, bsam gtan, shes rab ste drug /
1) pha rol gyi phyogs dang tshu rol gyi phyogs/ 2) phar nye tshur nye/
yul dus sogs kyi bar thag thung tsam/ grong khyer gyi phar tsam du sman khang chen po zhig yod/ dus tshod phar tsam song nas zhing gar son 'debs ran/
bar thag nye ba/ grong khyer de gnyis phar tshad tshur tshad du chags yod/

pha rol tshu rol te phan tshun nam phar phyogs tshur phyogs/ phar 'gro brgya dang tshur yong stong/ me tog gi skyed tshal du phar tshur 'gro ba/ phar tshur gong sgrig pa/ phar tshur bsnyon 'dzugs lab gleng mang ba/ gzhung lam gu yangs sar rlangs 'khor gnyis phar tshur bzur nas gtong ba/
lta ci smos/ yi ge 'bri rgyu phar zhog klog kyang shes pa mi 'dug /
lta ci smos sam shod ci dgos/ ja phar bzhag chu yang mi 'dug / kho la gdung sems byed rgyu phar bzhag da dung gshe gshe gtong gi 'dug /
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spo bo rdzong khongs kyi 'bab chu zhig chu 'go ra 'og mtsho yin zhing, yid 'ong gtsang po dang 'dres nas yar klungs gtsang po'i nang du 'bab/
phar tshur log res:/ skyon phar log tshur log byed pa/ kha phar log tshur log byas nas lta ba/
pha rol gyi phyogs/ gtsang po'i phar logs la byang ngos dang, tshur logs la lho phyogs gnas/
phal pa'i skad de yongs grags kyi yul lung so so'i skad/ yig skad dang phal skad gnyis la khyad par phran bu yod/
mang che ba/ thon zog phal che ba 'char gzhi'i nang gsal spus tshad dang mthun pa/
1) mdo sde phal po che'i bsdus ming/ 2) nyan thos sde bzhi'i gras phal chen sde pa/
nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, shar nub ri la gnas pa dang, gangs rir gnas pa, 'jig rten 'das par smra ba, btags par smra ba ste sde lnga/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i nang gses, sngon gyi dge 'dun phal che ba 'dus pas phal chen pa'i sde zhes su grags shing, ston pa 'od srung chen po yin la, snam sbyar snam phran nyer gsum man chad bdun yan chad byed pa dang, grwa'i rtags dpal be'u dang dung, sor mdo 'don pa'i tshe, pra kri ti rang bzhin gyi skad du 'don pa'o/
mang che ba// las 'gan phal cher bsgrubs zin pa/ tshogs 'dur phebs dgos mkhan phal cher 'dzoms bzhag /
phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen
srog gcod dang, ma byin len, 'dod log dang gsum spong ba'i dge bsnyen no/
skad cha spyir btang pa'am dkyus ma/
dkyus ma'am spyir btang pa/ mi phal pa/ rin chen phal pa/ shes yon phal pa/

mdo sde sangs rgyas phal po che zhes pa brda rnying du sangs rgyas rma ga chad du grags shing, yang snyan gyi gong rgyan du'ang bsgyur ba yod la, mdo sde 'di sho lo ka 'bum dang, le'u brgya yod par grags pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, lo tsa ba ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur cing lo chen bee ro tsa nas dag par phab pa'o/
1) phal cher ram mang che ba/ mi phal mo che/ las ka phal mo che/ 2) mdo sde phal chen/
pha rol/ phas kyi rgol ba/
1) pha rol po'i rtsod gleng/ 2) pha rol gyi gnod byed dgra bo/
(par'adzika) pham pa'i ltung ba ste, pha rol rgyal nas rtsa ltung 'di dag gis sdom pa las nyams shing 'jig par byed pa zhig /
mi gsod pa dang, mi chos bla ma'i rdzun shod pa, mi tshangs par spyod pa, ma byin par len pa ste bzhi/
(yul) phyi zhes pa'i zur chag phyi...
(yul) phyi pa ste nang pa'i ldog phyogs/
(yul) 1) sha khu spyin rengs pa ltar chags pa/ 2) mi tshab tshub can dang, bab col gyi gtam smra mkhan rnams la gdags pa'i bla dwags kyi ming zhig /
(tha mi dad pa) 1) rtogs pa/ yig rigs kyi snying don phigs pa/ 2) (yul) brtol thub pa/ bu ga phigs pa/ rtsig pa'i nang ngos nas i khung gcig phug nas phigs pa/
zur phyin par bshad pa/ rtogs dka' ba'i gnad don phigs par smra ba/
(rgya) rgyu sran ma las grub pa'i zas kyi bye brag cig / lab phing/
sran ma rlon par btags pa'i phye ma/
1) phing dang sha bsres pa'i tshal rigs shig / 2) (yul) mdza' ba'i dpe/ khong gnyis phing sha rang red/
(yul) rang 'thag gam chu 'khor gyi lcags stegs kyi sner bsgar ba'i rdo'i ming/
khang pa'i thog khebs/ rgya phibs/ gser gyi rgya phibs/ g.yu'i rgya phibs/ dkar phibs/

/ 1) dbugs/ ja tsha po la phu grang btab nas 'thung ba/ zhun mar phus bsad pa/ me la phu brgyab nas 'bar ba/ rkang 'khor la phu ma brgyab na bzhon nas 'gro skyod byed mi thub/ sgron me la phu btab nas bsad pa/ sa bzhu skyon can la phu btab kyang phu brtan po mi sdod/ smyu gur snag tsha phus 'dren pa/ 2) lung pa'i phu/ lung pa'i mda' nas phu'i bar du rim bzhin 'dzeg pa/ phu la dgon pa btab pa las, mda' la kha mchu med na bde/
yas mas tshang mar dkrug pa:/ ga sa ga la phu dkrog mda' dkrog bzo ba dang, ga sa ga nas pham nyes bzed pa/
lung pa'i phu nas 'bab pa'i chu/ dbyar dus phu chu rab tu rgyas kyang chu'i 'jigs pa mi yong ba/

rab byung dang po'i lcags lug lor 'phan yul du 'khrungs, mtshan gzhon nu rgyal mtshan, 'brom ston gyi thugs sras, sprul ba'i sku mched gsum gyi ya gyal, bka' gdams pa'i nang gses kyi man ngag pa'i srol phyes, dgung lo bdun cu don brgyad la 'das/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi shod drung gis gyon pa'i rgya lu chas kyi stod gos phu dung can/

1) sbug gi ring tshad de lung pa'i phu nas mda'i bar gyi ring thung/ phu lung gsum gyi phu thag ring thung de, mdo lung gsum gyi gtsang chu mthong bas shes/ 2) khungs sne'am, nang tshul/ gzhung don phu thag bcad nas legs par rtogs thabs byed dgos/ sum rtags phu thag chod pa/
gos kyi phu dung/ phu thung brdzes pa/ phu thung phrag 'gel/
mthar thug gam yang rtse/ dbu ma'i phu mtha' bcad pa/
1) lung pa'i phu dang mda'/ zas ngan gcig gis khog pa'i stod smad dkrug mi ngan gcig gis lung pa'i phu mda' dkrug / 2) rlangs 'khor sogs la phu rgyag byed lag cha zhig /
lung pa'i sbug dang, mda' 'am mdo, bar te gsum/
lung pa'i stod smad dang, ri mgo lung gzhung bcas kyi bsdus ming/
phu mda' bar gsum dang don gcig
1) phu bo dang, nu bo'i bsdus ming/ phu nu gnyis ka lhan du song/ 2) (yul) a mdo'i yul skad du gnyen nye du rtsa lag gi ming/ phu nu mang pos dpung sgrig byed/
lung pa'i phu la sdod pa'i mi/
lung pa'i sbug gi sbug / lung pa 'di'i phu phu na mtsho zhig yod/
gcen po/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngon skyes dang, gcen po, jo jo, a jo bcas so,
phu ri srubs:/ lung pa phu dbrag sa zhing nyung/
lung pa'i phu la yod pa'i 'brog pa
bod kyi bud med kyi dbyar gos phu dung med pa/
gyon gos phu dung yod pa/
lung pa phu gsum nas yong ba'i chu/
lung pa'i phu nas 'ongs pa'i rlung/
1) phug ron skya bo/ 2) kha dog dkar po zhig /
phug la thug nas 'gro sa med pa/
1.'bigs pa'i 'das pa, 2.ke'u tshang/ brag phug / sa phug / gad phug / dben phug /
phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho
bod kyi rtsis rig la mkhas pa zhig rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos lor rtsis gzhung pad dkar zhal lung mdzad/
blo bur gri mtshon phog pa sogs phyi rkyen las byung ba'i rma rigs kyi nang tshan sha pags kyi gting du zab zab por phug pa'i rma/
sbug ma/ mdzod khang phug ma/ khang pa phug ma/ don rtsa phug ma/
(yul) par shing zhu dag gtong skabs par shing la gdab bya'i gzong zhig /

khams phyogs su mug gu zhes pa dang, dbus phyogs su 'ang gu zhes pa ni yul skad yin/ mug gu/ 'ang gu ming gi rnam grangs la skad cig 'dod ldan dang, rgya phibs gnas 'cha', ca co sgrog dig snyan, rdo yi zas can, 'phrul ba'i mig can bcas so,

don snod sogs med pa'i lus kyi stong cha phug ron thar tsam gyi gsang zhig ste, ske stong tsa ra khung nas nu ma'i steng thig gcig dang, nu ma nas sgrog rus phyi zur bar thig gcig sgrog rus nas ske stong bar thig gcig bcas sbrel ba'i bar gyi gru gsum stong cha de'o/
sa sbubs ri sbubs sogs 'gro lam/
phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho'i rtsis kyi lugs/
dus gtan nam yun ring po/ phugs kyi khe phan/ phugs kyi blo/ phugs bsam/
mthar 'khyol/ slob sbyong phugs 'khyol byed dgos/
nam phugs mi 'gyur ba/ grogs po phugs brtan pa/ bya ba phugs brtan pa/
yun ring du brtan thub pa/ lcags zam phugs thub pa/ lag rtsal phugs thub pa/
phugs kyi bde ba/ 'di skyid phugs bde/
yun du phan pa'i dngos po rtsa 'gang che ba

bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams kyis chos rnal ma zhig bsgrub par tshe 'di blos gtong ba'i gdams ngag phugs nor lta bu bcu ste, thebs med rdo rje sngon du gtong, khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs, blo phugs chos la gtad, chos phugs sprang la gtad, sprang phugs shi la gtad, shi phugs grog po skam po la gtad, mi gral nas bud, khyi gral bsnyegs, lha gral thob pa ste, bcu'o/
dus yun ring po'i go chod thub pa/ yon tan phugs 'pher ba/ nyer mkho'i yo byad phugs 'pher ba/ las ka phugs 'pher byed mkhan la bstod bsngags gtong ba/
las ka byas pa'i rjes 'bras/ dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis 'bad rtsol hur thag byas pa'i phugs 'bras thon skyed bzang po byung ba/
1) dus yun ring po'i cha rkyen nam, dmigs rten/ 2) mthar thug blo gtad sa'i dmigs yul/
don gnad kyi 'gag rtsa/ nor 'khrul gang nas byung ba'i phugs rtsa rtsad gcod byed pa/
phugs dmigs kyi dngos zog gam nor phyugs
phugs kyi dus yun ring ba/ phugs yun gyi 'char gzhi/
phugs kyi don rtogs pa'am rtsa ba rtogs pa/ mi phugs mi yis lon la, chu phugs nya yis lon/ las ka'i phugs lon pa/
khungs lung/ gtam de la phugs so e 'dug / gtam phugs so med na rdzun gtam red/
nam phugs gang yong gi bsam blo/ las ka bkod sgrig ma byas gong du phugs bsam zhib tshags shig gtong dgos/
nyams pa'am nyes pa/ rgyal khab phung la sbyar ba/ thon skyed las don phung la 'debs/
phung byed dam rlog byed/ rang gzhan phung krol gyi las/
phung po drug dang: khams drug dbang po drug yul drug las kyi dbang po drug las kyi dbang bya ba'i drug ste so drug /
khyim stong mi stong bzo ba'i gyod gzhi/
phung byed kyi mi ngan/ phung rgan bstan bshig
phung por phung tshul/ shing 'bras mang po phung nge bar spungs 'dug / nags khrod du shing lo phung nge bar 'dug / me tog gi rtse mor chu'i zil pa phung nge bar chags 'dug /
phung byed kyi mi ma yin/

/ 1) rdul rdzas sam rgyun snga phyi'i cha bsags pa'i gong bu/ sa'i phung po/ rdo phung/ shing phung/ 'bru rigs phung por spung ba/ bka' drin gyi phung po bgrang bar mi nus pa/ tsher ma'i phung po'i steng du 'dug pa dang 'dra/ 2) ro/ shi ba'i phung po mer sreg / 3) (rashi) tshogs pa'am spungs pa'i don te, rigs mthun gyi chos du ma spungs pa'am, de nyid kyi khyad par thams cad 'dus pas na phung po zhes bya'o/ 4) (mngon) phung po la gzugs dang, tshor ba dang, 'du shes dang, 'du byed dang, rnam shes lnga yod pas grangs lnga mtshon/
zag bcas kyi phung po lnga dang zag med kyi phung po lnga'o/
tshor ba, 'du shes, 'du byed, rnam shes, ye shes te drug /
thig le dgu skor: bon lugs kyi lta ba ston pa'i gzhung zhig /
bod kyi ri chen bzhi'i ya gyal, gtsang khul du yod/

1) phung po gsum pa'i mdo ste, ltung bshags/ 2) sdig pa bshags pa dang, rjes su yi rang ba, dge ba bsngo ba'i phung po gsum mam, yang na, sdig pa bshags pa dang, rjes su yi rang ba, chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba bcas kyi phung po gsum mo/
bdud bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i phung po 'di grub na rang dbang med par na ba dang, rga ba dang, rgud pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis dge ba'i bar chad byed pas so/

theg dman gyi mdo las bden med ston tshul, gzugs ni dbu ba rdol ba 'dra, tshor ba chu yi chu bur 'dra, 'du shes smig rgyu lta bu ste, 'du byed rnams ni chu shing bzhin, rnam par shes pa sgyu ma ltar zhes so/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
phra ma 'jug pa'am dkrug shing byed pa'i bya spyod/
chags sgo'am gnod 'tshe/ skye rgu'i phung sel byed pa rnams, bsad na rgyal khams bde zhes pa/
chos lugs pas sri rigs sde tshan mang por 'dren pa'i nang tshan phung bar byed pa'i gdon 'dre zhig /
mtha' gnyis ma yin pa'i gzhan zhig / yang na gsar brje byed pa dang, yang na gsar brjer ngo log byed pa gnyis las 'gro sa phung gsum pa gzhan zhig med/
ja chang sogs kyi phud 'jog snod/
zas gos la sogs pa'i phud kyi mchod pa/

ja chang sogs kyi phud 'jog snod/

legs tshogs thams cad gong du 'phel ba/
chos phun sum tshogs pa dang, dus phun sum tshogs pa, ston pa phun sum tshogs pa, gnas phun sum tshogs pa, 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ste lnga/

chos nor 'dod thar bcas 'jig rten dang, 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs sde bzhi ste sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba dang, nor longs spyod dang ldan pa, 'dod yon lnga la spyod pa, chos la brten nas thar pa mya 'das kyi go 'phang 'thob rgyu yod pa bcas so/
rgyu dang, 'bras bu, phan 'dogs pa bcas gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa/

dge tshul slong bsgrub pa la, mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa gsum dang ldan dgos pa ste, gang la sdom pa blang ba'i yul mkhan slob, gang gis sdom pa 'bog par byed pa'i cho ga, gang bslab par bya ba'i gnas la tshul bzhin du bslab par 'dod pa'i bsam pa ste phun sum tshogs pa gsum mo/
legs shing cha tshang ba/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa/
1.'bubs pa'i skul tshig 2.mda' gri sogs srung byed go cha sba smyug sogs kyis bzos pa zhig / ko phub/ sba phub/
mtshon cha skyob byed phub kyi mthil lam dkyil/
sbun pa/ nas phub gro phub bong bu'i zas/ phub ma'i 'og gi chu dong/ sbun phub 'phyar la snying po med/
glo bur du byung ba'i rkyen ngan tshabs chen gyi dpe/
mtshon cha 'gog byed kyi phub lag tu thogs pa'i dmag
lcug mas btags pa'i slel po chen po/
phur mong rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog sngo dkar 'char ba zhig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas srin gsod, pags nad shu thor sogs 'joms/

'dul ba'i brda chad cig ste, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi nang gses, ltung ba glengs pa'i skabs phye yang mnyan par mi byed na phur bcas bya dgos la, ji ltar bya na, tshe dang ldan pa khyed gzhi gang rung la brten pa'i ltung ba 'di dang 'di bcas pa yin no zhes ltung ba khur du bkal nas nyes pa bstan te btang bar bya ba ste, dper na rta dmu rgod phur pa dang bcas nas btang ba la phur bcas zhes su grags pa dang 'dra bar dge slong de yang ltung ba'i dri ma dang bcas pa grags su gzhug pa'o/
1) phur pa yod pa'i gdang thag / 2) gos sogs 'gel gdang/
rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog sngo nag 'char: ba zhig ste ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas srin gsod, gnyan nad 'joms, shu thor dang sha bkar sogs la phan/

/ 1) dud 'gro 'dogs byed sogs sa la gdab bya zhig / lcags phur/ shing phur/ gur phur/ gdang phur/ mtshams bzhir phur pa brgyab nas ras gur 'bubs pa/ rtsig pa'i ldebs la gos 'gel sa'i phur pa 'debs pa/ 2) gdon bgegs 'dul byed kyi sngags chas shig /
yi dam phur pa la brten nas sri gnon pa'i cho ga zhig /

/ 1) res bza' phur bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgra mkhan dang, sgra mkhas, bcu gnyis 'od, nyi ma'i rigs skyes, mtho ris thob, pha bdun pa, blo ldan, dbyangs bdag 'bar ba ldan, mi bzhi skyes, tshig bdag rig byed bdag lha'i bla ma, lha'i slob dpon bcas so, 2) phur pa chung ngu/ 3) me lce/ 4) (mngon) sa sprel lo/
lha sa'i se ra'i rgyab kyi ri khrod cig /
/ 1) dri zhim po'i sman spos kyi phye ma thum bu/ spos phye phur ma'i dri zhim khor yug khyab/ 2) dar gos sogs kyis bzos pa'i mchod rdzas gdung ma dang g.yab skor sogs la dgram bya zhig /
phur mong dkar nag smug gsum gyi spyi'i ming/
rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog smug po 'char: ba zhig ste ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gzhang srin dang, pags srin sogs la phan/
thad kar ram blo rtse gcig pa/ bsam blo phur tshugs su btang nas las don byed/ mig phur tshugs su lta ba/ gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/

1) shing lcags gang rung gi phur pa 'debs pa/ rtswa thang gi thog la gnag phyugs 'dogs sa'i phur 'dzugs byed pa/ 2) yul 'gar zhing ga 'debs lugs shig / rmon phyugs med sa'i lung par lo tog phur 'dzugs byas te 'debs srol yod/ phur 'dzugs byas na son 'gro chung/
dbu can gyi yi ge'i bar gyi gcod mtshams dang, mjug tu 'bri rgyu'i shad ris ``,'' 'di lta bu'i ming/
phur pa bzo byed kyi shing/

1.'bul ba'i skul tshig 2. 1) sngar bod lugs bre gang gi drug cha gcig / bre gang la phul drug yod/ 2) lag pa'i sor mo cung zad bskums pa'i khyor ba/ sa bon phul gang/ 3) mtha' dang khyad par ram, mchog gam rab/ tsan dan dkar po ni tsan dan kun gyi phul/ 4) skar ma chu smad/
nas 'bras sogs bre phul mang po khal du bsgril tshul/ phul zhe lnga ni khal med bre bdun phul gsum yin/
khyad par du 'phags pa/ grub 'bras phul du phyin pa zhig thob pa/
khyad par du 'phags pa/ byas rjes phul du byung ba/
phul du byung ba'i bsdus tshig
phul du byung zhing khyad du 'phags pa/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod dngos po gang yang rung ba'i khyad chos kyi yon tan mchog tu gyur pa brjod bsams pa de rjod byed kyi tshig 'jig rten grags tshod kyi mtshams las brgal ba'i 'ud chen po'i sgo nas phul du byung bar brjod pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs bzhi ni, khyad 'phags phul byung, the tshom phul byung, nges pa phul byung, grags pa phul byung ngam, ngo mtshar phul byung bcas so/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang dpe can gnyis 'byed chos kyi khyad par mang du yod mod kyang gcig kho na las med par 'ud brjod pa'i sgo nas dpe don phan tshun ha cang 'dra bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
spu bal rtsub po las btags pa'i snam ther thags ma'i ngos kyi ri mo 'bur dod/
ting shags las che tsam gyi rol mo'i bye brag cig

skyel ma'i zhe sa/ thag ring bar du phebs skyel zhu ba/

1) gong rim gyi bka'i don/ da res kyi phebs sgo ltar gyi las don rnams sgrub bzhin pa yin/ 2) sngar mdzad sgo'i skabs rim pa gong mas bstsal ba'i kha zas sogs/

phar tshur phebs kha'i gsol ston/
phebs pa dang mnyam du'am phebs dus/ khong phebs gdong la gnas tshul gyi yi ge phul yod/
phyogs phebs kyi grabs/ khas nyin gzhes nyin nas phebs rdog thon song/
(tha mi dad pa) 'gro 'ong gi zhe sa/ phar 'khyug tsam phebs te de nas brel stabs su tshur phebs pa/ phebs su cha ba/
bag phebs par byas nas gtam shod pa/ bslab bya phebs par smras na mi'i sems la 'bab sla po yong/

tshur phebs mkhan bsu ba/ sku tshab tshogs par phebs bsu zhu ba/

1) phar ngos su gtong ba/ 2) srog gcod pa/

pho snying stobs che ba/ pho rgod kyang rgyab na dpung zhig dgos/
, stobs shugs sam 'jon thang/ pho sgo can de kun la mkho/
che nyams sam spam rdzu/ pho sgrob kyi rnam 'gyur ston pa/

cong zhi ri lnga'i nang tshan mkhregs shing lci la rta so bcag pa lta bu zhig ste, nus pas khrag mkhris kyi nad dang, pho nad 'joms/
pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi slob ma yar lung pa sma ra ser po nas brgyud pa'i gcod lugs/

lcam pa rigs gsum gyi nang tshan ldum rar skye ba'i me tog dkar po dang, rgya dmar smug kha can 'char ba zhig ste, ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pa me tog gis sa bon 'dzag pa gcod, rtsa bas gcong chen zad byed dang, yi ga 'gag pa la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la mdog ldan dang, 'dzag gcod, ha lo bcas so,

1) g.yog mo'am pho mo'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan gyi bud med/ 2) grogs mo/
skyes pa'i kha pho che/ pho gtam ngo gtugs nas shod dgos, dri ma chus bkrus nas dag dgos/
rngon pa 'khrab dus gyon rgyu'i stod gos/
pho'i tha ma ste sdar ma'am zhan pa/ pho tha 'khyogs pa rdo 'khyod red, rdo gor mo 'khyogs na bzo rgyu med/
1) khengs pa/ pho theg che ba/ 2) (rnying) khur khyer ba/

pho ba'i thad kyi gsang zhig /
1) zas skom mi 'phrod pa bsten pa dang, pho ba'i me drod nyams pa sogs las byung ba'i nad de, nang gses su dbye na pho tshad dang, pho rgud sogs rigs bcu drug mchis so/ 2) skyes pa'i nad/
mdzo g.yag glang sogs dos khal dbor 'dren dang rmos mdzo byas chog pa'i dud 'gro pho'i rigs/

mi lus kyi byang khog smad kyi char yar sne mid pa dang mar sne rgyu ma ru 'brel ba'i snod drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni zas skom rnams myag bzhu sbyong zhing 'dres par byas nas thur du gtong ba sogs byed pa yin no/
lto ba stobs zhan nam nad can/
zas skom mi 'phrod pa bsten pa las byung ba'i pho nad cig ste, nad rtags su zas mi 'ju zhing dang ga 'gag pa dang, sha skem la zas zos ma thag skyug pa zhig /
zas ma zos kyang pho ba gang ba ltar gyur pa'i bad kan gyi nad rtags shig /
lto ba stobs ldan nam, nad med/

shing sman gyi rigs 'bras bu la nor lug gi pho kha'i ri mo ltar dod pa zhig ste, ro tsha, nus pas drod skyed, zas 'ju, bad kan dang grang nad gzhil/ ming gi rnam grangs la drod sman hril mo dang, na le sham, pho tshe, ma r'i tse soo panydza na, shi ku ma ni, ha re nu ga, a ba ku tsa, a blku dza rnams so,
pho ba'i be snabs kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig
pho ba'i nang du zas skom myag bzhu sbyong ba sogs me dang mthun pa'i drod kyi las byed pa de la me drod ces zer, ngo bo ni lus kyi rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga'i ya gyal 'ju byed mkhris pa yin no/
tshabs rigs drug gi tshabs nad pho bar byer ba'i nad cig ste, nad rtags su pho ba sbo zhing ldang dub byed pa dang, kha zas 'ju dka' ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
lhen sne'i rtse nas thur du tshon do dang, de nas gyas gyon du sor gsum re gzhal mtshams su yod pa'i grar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na pho ba'i tshad pa dang, pho ba'i glan thabs sogs la phan/

rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bcu gnyis pa pho ba dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na pho ba'i me drod nyams pa dang, zas mi 'ju ba, rtag tu khog pa bshal ba, pho ba'i grang skran bcas la phan/
bu spun rgan pa a jo'i ming ste, phu bo dang mtshungs/
bong bu pho mo'i zlas phye ba'i bong bu pho/

1) rgyal po sdod sa'i khang pa/ pho brang rnying pa/ 2) skabs 'gar rgyal po'i zhe sa la'ang 'jug / 3) 'du tshogs byed sa'i khang pa/ rig gnas pho brang/ dga' ldan pho brang,/ 4) me mda'i nang mdel 'jug sa/
sham bha sa'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi bzhugs gnas su grags/
1) rgyal po'i btsun mo/ 2) rgyal po'i 'bangs/ 3) rgyal po'i sdod gnas kyi nye skor/
sngar rgyal po'i pho brang gi nang du shod pa'i skad/
sngar rgyal po'i pho brang phyi nang gnyis su phye ba'i nang ma/
dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i skabs bod kyi stod mnga' ris kyi rgyal po rab byung gi rten can zhig /
dgon pa zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho kha sa khul khongs lhun rtse rdzong khongs su yod/
1) lus dbang gi bye brag cig ste, nga ro gsang mtho ba sogs pho'i chos nyid la dbang byed pa/ 2) pho mtshan/
pho ba'i me drod/ pho me nyams pas lto chas ma 'ju bar skyug mer langs pa/
pho dang mo gnyis/ pho mo 'dra mnyam/
rlung gi rang bzhin gyis bskyed pa'i nad med kyi rgyun rtsa'i 'phar tshul zhig ste, 'phar rtsa'i rgyud sbom la rags par 'phar ba zhig /
lte ba'i gyen du tshon gang gzhal ba'i sa nas 'phred la gnas pa'i pho ba dang 'brel ba'i rtsa zhig /
, lus kyi rtsal gsum dang, ngag gi rtsal gsum, yid kyi rtsal gsum bcas dgu, yang shod srol gzhan zhig la gtam yig rtsis gsum dang, mda' rdo mchong gsum, bang rkyal sbe gsum bcas dgu/
1) pho ba'i drod dam zas zhu ba'i nus pa/ 2) zas dug gi bskyed pa'i pho nad cig /

1) rang tshod dam gdeng tshod/ don gnad thag gcod par pho tshod che dgos/ rang srog 'dor nus kyi pho tshod yod med nyen kha tshabs chen phrad pa'am gdng gtugs kyi 'thab sar zhugs na shes yong/ mi la pho tshod yod na 'brong la mda' 'phen phod,
rgya skyegs kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /

skyes pa pho mtshon pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la chags pa'i rgyal mtshan dang, dran pa'i ka ba, 'doms kyi mjug ma, 'doms kyi sba ba, pho yi rtags, dbang po, myos byed lcags kyu, myos byed shing, mtshan gtun shing, lingga bcas so
rdo rje rtag tu 'greng ba dang, so btab pa lta bu pho mtshan gyi pags pa 'gas pa'i nad cig /
ya gnyis ma gnyis te so bzhi ma gtogs brjes tshar ba'i rta drel/
bod kyi khyo ga'i lham zon pa/
1) ma yin yin mdog gi rnam 'gyur/ pho bzo 'don pa'i dus ma yin, snying rus 'don pa'i dus yin/ 2) rang bzo dang 'ol tshod/
bza' zla med pa'i skyes pa/

ngag thog nas yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas kyi rtsol shugs che shos sam, grims shos yin pa'i yi ge rnams/ 1) gsal byed sum cu tham pa/ ka...ao ? 2) ming gzhi'i pho yig / ka ca ta pa tsa...3) sngon 'jug gi pho yig / ba...4) rjes 'jug gi pho yig / ga da ba sa...
skyes pa pho blo rgya chen po yod pa/ pho rab cig gi khog la rta brgya rgyug sa'i thang yod/

spod rdzas dang pho ba drod skyed byed kyi sman zhig / pho ril dkar po/ pho ril nag po/
bza' zla med pa'i skyes pa/
1) khwa ta las che ba'i bya rog / pho rog thams cad nag mnyam yin/ pho rog la skra dkar nam skye/ 2) spu mdog nag po'i rta drel/
1) bya pho rog gi mig / 2) sngar bod kyi bla chen tsho'i gyon chas rta phying/ 3) sngo sman gyi rigs bya rog nyung ma ste, ro mngar, nus pas glo tshad dang, 'bras nad la phan, rma gso/
pho bar grang rlung zhugs pa'i nad de, nad rtags su pho ba sbo zhing stong sgreg byed pa dang, stong skyugs byed pa'am 'khrog cing lbu ba can 'khru ba zhig /
bsam spyod skyon ldan gyi skyes pa le lo can/

lo khams pho la khel ba'i lo/ me pho stag / sa pho 'brug / chu pho 'brug /
