1.sbyin pa'i don du go ba'i 'bog pa dang 'bogs pa'i 'das pa, 2.(tha mi dad pa) 'khel ba'am thebs pa/ nyi 'od phog pa/ zas dug phog pa/ nad phog pa/ gtam de khong gi thugs la phog song/ gza' phog pa/ 'ur rdo phog pa/ gnad du phog pa/ mda' 'phen na 'ben la phog dgos, tshig bshad na gnad la 'khel dgos/
'tsho dod/ lo phogs/ zla phogs/ 'bru phogs/ dngul phogs/
sngar grwa par phogs rgyag rgyu'i ma rtsa 'bru dngul sogs/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi phogs dpon dang, mda' dpon, rtsis dpon, sras rnam pa bcas kyi bsdus ming/
sngar dmag phogs do dam byed mkhan gyi 'go khrid/
phogs blangs nas las ka byed mkhan/
(tha mi dad pa) phongs pa, phong ba,, dbul ba/ rig pas phongs pa/ mi shugs kyis mi phong ba,/ rgyu nor gyis phongs pa/
ltogs grir shi ba/ a ma phongs grir shi, sring mo lto gos sprung phyir 'khyar/
dbul po'i rnam pa/ sngar yod phongs rtags mthong rgyu med par gyur song/
1.phong ba'i 'das pa, 2...1) rgyu nor med pa'am dbul ba/ 2) dbul po/
1.gos sogs kyi sgab gsham sne 'dzar ram, dar gos dang stong skud sogs kyis bzos pa'i phod 'dzar/ 2.blo nus sam, snying stobs/
sngar sngags pa'i kha gyon gyi gos dang sngags pa'i 'cham gos/
(mngon) skar ma du ba mjug ring/
blo khog chung ba/ blo zhum phod chung byas na las don gang yang 'grub mi thub/
blo nus sam snying stobs zhan pa'i nyams/ byis pa rgyus med mi dang 'phrad dus phod chung nge ba zhig yong/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lhun grub rdzong khongs su yod/
thub pa dang, nus pa/ phod pa can/ las 'gan chen po 'khur phod pa/ pha rol po'i rgol ngan la lan sprod phod pa/ mdza' grogs phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa/
nus pa can dang spyi brtol can gyi gang zag /
dngos su thon nas snyad 'tshol ba/ tshur phod btsugs pa'i dgra bor ya lan sprod/ phan tshun spyi'i las 'gan legs sgrub kyi ched du phod btsugs pa/
dar gos stong skud la sogs pa las bzos pa'i rgyan zhig /
'bor che ba'am grangs ka mang po/ dngos zog phon che ba/
chun po'am chag pa dang, bam po, tshogs pa/ tshar ma'i phon po/ rtswa phon po gcig / me tog phon po/ dar skud kyi phon po/ kha btags phon po gcig /
dar gos dang stong skud sogs kyis bzos pa'i 'dzar rgyan/
phor pa dkrug byed kyi dkrug 'khor/
phor mkhan gyi lag cha rtse mo rno leb lcags kyu ltar gug pa zhig /
can ne'am 'thung snod/ dngul phor/ shing phor/ rdzab phor/
'thung snod phor pa gting zab pa/
phor pa 'byid byed dam, phyi byed kyi ras/
lto snod phor pa chung ngu/
ja thang gi khar 'debs rgyu'i mar/
phor pa sgril byed dam phyi byed kyi ras/
rwa las bzos pa'i me mda'i rdzas 'jal snod cig /
'brum bu phra mo yod pa'i rma 'bras sgor mo 'khor lo'i dbyibs mtshungs kyi ming/
phol mig gi rma dang 'bras nad gnyis mnyam du bsdongs pa'i nad cig /
1) pags nad dbyibs 'khor lo ltar sgor zhing mdog sngo nag g.ya' za mi bzod pa 'byung ba dang rim bzhin rmar 'gyur zhing gzhan la 'go ba'i pags nad gdug pa can zhig / 2) (rnying) 'khor lo/
bza' tshang kha phral byed skabs bden pa mo la che na phos bor zer/
sems rab tu g.yo ba/ phya ma phyo'i glu 'di blangs pa/
mi dang, rta, khyi gsum po'i phru gu mngal du gnas skabs kyi brun/
mi rta khyi gsum gyi phru gus ma'i nu zho ma 'thung ba'i sngon du btang ba'i brun la zer te, nus pas sbyar dug dang, sha dug la sogs pa'i dug nad sel/
(yul) re lde/ phya ra'i steng du 'bru nyi mar bskams pa/
phyar ba gru 'degs dang don gcig
ngos mnyam pa'i dbyibs te, mtho dman dang 'bar 'bur med pa/
phya le ba ma yin pa
ngos mi mnyam pa'i dbyibs te, mtho dman sgang gshong 'bar 'bur yod pa'i dbyibs so/

/ 1) lag pa'i zhe sa/ phyag sor/ phyag bde po/ phyag zhabs/ 2) ming 'ga' zhig gi sngon du sbyor ba'i zhe tshig gcig / phyag dam/ phyag rdzas/ 3) phyag 'tshal lugs kyi rnam grangs shig / 'byor phyag / thon phyag / phyag 'os su gyur pa'i yul la phyag bya ba/
lag pa'i pad kor gyi phyag rgya/ phyag kor dang bcas te zhal 'don gnang ba/
kha che'i chos lugs pa sogs kyi phyag 'tshal sa'i khang pa/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, phyag ring zhing rgyas pa dang, phyag shing bal ltar 'jam pa'o/
dpe byad gsum: dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, phyag ris mdangs gsal yod pa dang, phyag ris zab pa dang, phyag ris ring ba bcas gsum mo/
gang rtsig 'gyel ba lta bu'i phyag ste lus sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal ba/
1) phyag dam/ gzhung yig la phyag rgya 'debs pa/ 2) lag pa'i brda/

1) 'bras bu mthar thug gam mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang, de la rgyas 'debs pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs skad cig dang por thob pa de las bri ba dang gang ba med par ye ji bzhin pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis nam mkha'i ji srid pa de srid du rtag tu gnas shing gzhar yang de las 'dar mi spyod pa nyid kyis phyag rgya yin la, spong ba dang rtogs pa dang sems te chen po gsum dang ldan pas na chen po ste phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ 2) sku phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor te, kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khrul ba glo bur ba bsal nas rang bzhin me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du bya ba ste, rnal byor rgyud kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /

rgyal tho tho ri gnyan btsan skabs bod du: 'byor ba'i glegs bam spang skong phyag rgya dang mdo sde za ma tog gzhan yang gser gyi mchod rten, g.yu'i mchod rten, mu dra'i phyag rgya, tsittamni'i skos phor bcas kyi spyi'i ming/
bla ma'i gsang yum ste, sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas bsten pa'i rig ma/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa'i phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bzhi ste, las kyi phyag rgya, dam tshig gi phyag rgya, chos kyi phyag rgya, phyag rgya chen po bcas so/
chos thams cad bdag med pa dang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa, zag bcas kyi 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal ba/
thugs kar phyag mtshan 'khor lo rdo rje sogs bsgoms nas rigs gang yin gyi lha de'i dam tshig gis rgyas 'debs pa ste bya rgyud lha drug gi nang gses shig /
lag len bstar rgyun/ gsar brje'i phyag rgyun bzang po/
bde ba dang stong pa ga'u kha sbyor bzhin dbyer med du bsgoms nas 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i gdams pa zhig /

sngags rnying ma'i sa lam bgrod tshul rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bsgom pa'i lam bsdus te mthong lam 'od gsal de las langs pa'i slob pa'i zung 'jug ye shes sku can gyi phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin no/
lha la 'bul ba'i phyag dang mchod pa/
/ dge rgan gyis slob phrug rnams la phyag 'jug gnang mi chog /
ngo 'phrad skabs lag 'ju res byas pa/
1) lag rtags sam, legs skyes/ 2) rang lag gis bris pa'i rtags/
1) mjal rten/ 2) 'bul rgyu'i dngos po spyi/
spyan ras gzigs phyags stong spyan stong/

dra bas 'brel ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, bsdu pa'i dngos po bzhi bsten pas phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo ngang pa'i rgyal po lta bur dra bar 'brel ba/
1) gad snyigs/ 2) khang thog tu 'dzugs byed dang, gtor rgyag skabs mis lag tu thogs pa'i dar cha/
gad snyigs kyi dkyil lam dbus/ phyag dar khrod du bskyal/
phyag dar khrod kyi chos gos
gad snyigs khrod nas bsgrugs pa'i chos gos/
gad snyigs khrod kyi gos drug tshal gyon mkhan/
gad snyigs nang nas bsgrugs pa'i gos/
phyag 'tshal ba'i dus su gting bya'i gdan/
rdul phyags shing bdar ba/ khang pa'i nang du phyag bdar yang yang byed dgos/
1) sngar bod kyi dgon sde khag gi tshogs chen sogs kyi nang du dge 'dun par 'thung ja 'dren mkhan gyi grwa pa/ 2) lag bzo mkhas pa/
1) me mda'/ don med phyag mda' bskyon mi chog / 2) mda' gzhu'i mda'/ 'ben ma btsugs par phyag mda' skyon don med/
bla mas mdud pa'i srung mdud kyi zhe sa/
bzo skrun/ rig gnas pho brang g.yu rtsi'i rgya phibs can zhig gsar du phyag 'debs par mdzad/
phyag na rdo rje'i bsdus tshig
sngo sman rtag ngu rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog sngo nag 'char ba zhig /

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo gcig tu bsdus pa mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid can phyag na mtshon byed rdo rje bsnams pa'i nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la mthu chen thob dang, mthu stobs bdag po, rdo rje can, rdo rje'i dbang phyag phyag rdor, lag na rdo rje, gsang ba'i rgyal, gsang ba'i bdag po, gsang ba 'dzin bcas so,
lag sne'i zhe sa ste skabs 'phral 'gro song gtong byed kyi dngul sogs/
chun po'i don du go ba'i chag pa dang 'dra,
1) lag pa'i dpung pa/ 2) lag rogs/
1) g.yog po/ phyag phyi pho mo/ 2) lam du 'gro mkhan gyi rjes 'brang ba/ da lan bdag kyang phyag phyi la 'gro bar zhu zhus/
1) phreng ba'i zhe sa/ 2) rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho nub ngos su yod cing, yun nan zhing chen dang sa 'brel yin/
yi ge/ dge rgan gyi phyag bris 'byor byung/ brtse ba'i phyag bris/ khong gi phyag bris yag po red/
lag pa gzhan gyi mgor bzhag nas byin rlabs byed pa/
lag pas gus 'dud zhu ba/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo la phyag 'bul zhu ba/
mdzod sbug dang de'i gnyer kha byed mkhan: gnyis ka'i ming / grwa tshang phyag sbug /
phan tshun gcig gis gcig la phyag dus mnyam du 'tshal ba/
nyar tshags/ rgyal khabs kyi dngos po phyag tshags legs par gnang nas skyon mi 'chor ba byed pa/
1) lag cha/ 2) rtags mtshan te, rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa/
(namra:) lusngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mchog t gus 'dud byed pa/ spyi bos phyag 'tshal ba/ phyi phyag 'tshal ba/
sngar bod du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho'i tshab byas nas de'i rgyu nor nyar tshags byed pa po/
sngar bod kyi sde dpon mi drag che khag gi phyag mdzod pa'i gzab chas/
rgyu nor gyi zhe sa/ khong phyag rdzas phyug po red/
gzhon sha chags pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste gos gya nom pa byin pas phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa/

sogs kyis brgyan pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis dang, g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa/
zhal gcig phyag bzhi yod pa'i lha/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/
1) lag len/ mi rigs srid jus phyag bzhes yang dag par bstar bas mi rigs mthun sgril dam po byung ba/ 2) lag rgyun nam srol rgyun/
gzhan gyi gus 'dud dang du len pa/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i phyag bzhes pa/
mi gang zhig gi lag pas dngos su bzos pa'i dngos rdzas/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, mchog tu gnod pa bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag ring zhing rgyas pa/
pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, nor bdog pa la slong ba po'i skye bo phyir ma spangs pas phyag ring zhing mdzes pa/
1) lag pas bris pa'i ri mo/ 2) lag pa'i ri mo/ 3) phyag bris/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, mdangs yod pa'i dge sbyong chen po brnyes pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo gsal la mdangs yod pa/
phyag ris zab pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, chos zab mo la gnas pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo gting zab par dod pa/
phyag ris ring ba'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, phyi rjes su yang dag par yongs su dag pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo ma chad par ring du dod pa/
phar phyag 'tshal ba la tshur phyag lan 'tshal ba/
1) lag len/ 2) cho ga'i lag len/
'jam pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, lus la sogs pa zo mdog bde ba 'thob pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa/
1) lag pa bkrus pa/ zhal lag ma mchod gong la phyag bsil ba/ 2) lag pa 'khyags pa/ dgun kha shar rung lus rtsal mang tsam gnang na phyag bsil mi yong/
lham gyi zhe sa/ zhabs phyags/
phyin pa/ sa gnas gzhan du phyags bteg pa/
1) 'ong ba/ khyed thugs dal skabs nga sar phyags phebs gnang rogs/ 2) slebs pa'am 'byor ba/ nga tsho'i grong tshor phyags phebs gnang byung/
gad snyigs 'phyag byed lag cha zhig / 'jag ma'i phyags ma/ ku sha'i phyags ma/ spen phyags/
lham/ phyags lham gsol ba/ phyags lham bsil ba/
'jol le ba ste, ring por 'dzar ba'i rnam pa/ ba glang gi lkog shal phyang nge ba/ phyal phyang nge ba/
thur du dpyangs nas phrul ler gnas pa'i ngang tshul/
thur du nar nar ba'am thur du phrul phrul ba/ rgyal sgo'i rgyan du lgang bzhu tshon khra kha dog rnam par bkra ba phyang phyang ba/
thur du phyang zhing, phrul ba'i rgyan/
1) srang bar gyi gtam 'khyam po/ 2) (rnying) 'phrin las/
ma brtags gya tshom/ gom pa phyad de phyod de brgyab nas phyin pa/ bsam pa phyad de phyod de byas nas ma brtags ma dpyad par skad cha ma shod/
/ 1) rgyun pa dang rtag pa/ 'bad brtson phyad par ma byas na, 'gan khur 'grub thub ga la srid/ 2) thal byung,/ byi'u phyad kyis 'phur ba/ chu'i nang du nya mo phyad kyis 'gro ba/
phyad de phyod de'i bsdus tshig
lcam rtsa gnon byed rdo sogs/
lcam shing 'degs byed kyi gdung ma dang rtsig pa/
khang pa'i lcam shing gi sne mo/
ngos mtho dma' med par mnyam pa/ grong khyer rnying pa'i khor yug tu bskor ba'i ra ba btsan po phyam me ba/
'phya smod/ gzhogs kyis phyar ka gtong ba/
1) re lde'am phyar ba chen po/ 2) sbra gur chen po/

1.'phyar ba'i 'das pa, 2.spu rtsid ko ras sogs las bzos shing, 'bru 'bras sogs 'grems stan dang, khebs g.yog byed pa'i yo byad cig / 'bru rnams phyar ba'i steng du bkram nas nyi skam byed/ slel phyar/ ko phyar/ ras phyar/ smyug phyar/ char pa 'bab tshe phyar bas 'bru rigs 'gebs pa/
sle'u gru sne bzhi nas 'gyogs pa ste, las don la tshang mas hur skyed dgos pa'i dpe/ mi tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs kyi sgo nas thon skyed do dam byed bzhin pa/
1) re lde las bzos pa'i phyar ba/ 2) phyar ba nag po lta bu'i mdangs/
rnam g.yeng/ sems phyar g.yeng mi byed par brtson 'grus byed pa/
gsus pa'am grod pa lhug lhug /
phyal phyang nge ba'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, chos zad pa rnam par zlog pa nyid kyis phyal phyang nge ba, sku'i phyal te lto ba mtho dman med pas phyang nge ba/
sbrul ma ste mngal khub ba'i bud med/
(yul) phyi gling pa ste phyi rgyal gyi mi/ , rgyal khab bam gling phran gzhan gyi mi/
(yul) phyi dro/ , (yul) phyi dro'i sgra zur chag /
gan gyal/ nyal khri'i thog byis pa phyi bkan du bsnyal ba/ sbe ga rgyag mkhan gyis rtsed zla phyi bkan du bsgyel ba/ lag pa g.yon pa phyi bkan gyi steng du me mda' 'dzin pa/
'gros bzhi'i nang gses dal 'gros dang, 'byung 'gros gnyis so/
phyi'am gzhan ngos byung ba'i rkyen/
shubs dang pags pa/ yi ge'i phyi skogs/ nas kyi phyi skogs/ star 'bras kyi phyi skogs/ min gig rnam grangs la phub ma dang, sbun pa, shun pa bcas so,
1) mchod rten sogs lag pa g.yon du bzhag ste bskor ba/ 2) phyi nang bar gsum du phye ba'i phyi'i skor lam/
phyi'i khams te, rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i khams rnams dmigs pa yin pas na yul drug ces kyang bya/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs mnga' bdag so so'i nang khrungs ma yin par gzhung la 'jal dgos pa'i khral/
phyi nud de sngar gnas las ltag rgyab tu 'then pa/ gri lan gnyis g.yugs kyang khos phyi gyed byas pas ma thebs/
phyi'i rgyal khab bam gling phran gzhan/
rta sga'i rgyu glo/ rta rgyug skabs snga glo dang phyi glo gnyis ka dam por bsdam dgos/
phyi logs kyi dgra/ phyi dgrar mtshon ston, nang mir blo ston/
'jug phyi logs kyi dgra bo nang khungs su khrid yong ba
phyi nang sgo gnyis kyi bar 'gag /
kha mdun phyogs su gtad nas gom pa rgyab phyogs su 'then te rgyag pa'i 'gro stangs/ ji srid bla ma'i zhal ras ma mthong gi bar la phyi bar la phyi 'gros kyis song/
phyi dro nyi ma rgas kha/

1) phyi nas tshur rgol ba/ dgra phyogs nas phyi rgol nam byung tshe 'phral du ya lan sprod pa/ 2) dgra dang tshur rgol ba po/ 3) phyogs snga sun 'byin par khas len pa'am thal ba 'phen mkhan gyi gang zag / ming gi rnam grangs la phyogs phyi ma dang yang dag bzung ngo,

te ma grub pa: rgol ba la ltos te ma grub pa'i rtags gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, dper na, snga rgol gcer bu pas phyi rgol sangs rgyas pa la, shing chos can, sems ldan yin te, shun pa bshus na 'chi ba'i phyir, zhes bkod pa lta bu, sangs rgyas pas shun pa bshus pas shing skam par 'dod kyi 'chi bar mi 'dod pa'o/
nang khul min pa'am gzhan phyogs/
rang rgyal ma yin pa'i phyi'i rgyal khab/ phyi rgyal gyi skad yig /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig yin zhing, 1943 lor btsugs, bod rang btsan zer ba zhig byed rgyu'i re ba bcangs te phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba byed mkhan gyi las khungs shig / 1943...
rnying ma ba'i lugs kyi phyi kri ya'am bya rgyud rnams ston pa shakya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs, u pa'am spyod rgyud dang, yo ga'am rnal 'byor rgyud rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/
pa bklags pas kun shes: rab byung brgyad pa'i nang byang pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i phyi ma rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyas pa zhig /

rnying ma'i gzhung lugs la kri ya ste bya ba dang, u bha ya ste gnyis ka zhes spyod pa dang, yo ga ste rnal 'byor bcas phyi rgyud sde gsum ni khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa'i dka' thub bram ze'i rig byed rnams dang tshul mthun par spyod pas dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/
dkyil 'khor nang gi phyi'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi ste, sgeg pa ma dang, phreng ba ma, glu ma, gar ma bcas bzhi'o/
khang pa'i sgo phyi ma/ sdod khang gi phyi sgo shar lta/
spam rdzu'i rnam 'gyur/ rgyan gos bzang po'i phyi sgrob mdzes pa/ phyi sgrob che la nang snying stong pa/
phyi'i khog / khang pa'i phyi sgrom/ las don 'char gzhi'i phyi sgrom bting ba/
phyi'i ldebs ngos sam, phyi logs/
1) lag pa'i phyi ngos kyis gzhan la rdeg stangs/ 'gram par phyi lcag gzhu ba/ 2) lag pa phyir g.yugs nas rta lcag gzhu tshul/ rta la phyi lcag yang yang brabs nas bang 'gros mgyogs po gtong ba/
1) gos kyi phyi'i mtha' 'jags/ 2) sbra gur gyi phyi'i chon thag /
sangs rgyas pa ma yin pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i chos/
phyi la 'jam zhing nang la rtsub pa/

slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir yol ba phyi 'jug bya ste, gsol ba btab nas chas su bcug cing lhar bskyed de shar sgor bzhag pa dang, thun mong dang thun min gyi sdom pa bzung zhing rigs dang mos pa dri ba dang, thams cad rnal 'byor gyi sems bskyed cing gsang ba sdom pa rnams bya ba'o/
1) slad ma'am rjes ma'i cha/ 2) song ba'i shul/
sprang po'am phyi rol tu 'khyams pa po/
1) dus phyis sam deng sang/ 2) rkang pa'i rting pa/ rkang pa'i snga rting sar btsugs nas phyi rting bteg ste 'gro ba/

stong nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig ste, rnam par shes pas ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang dbang rten khog pa dang rnam par shes pa'i yul sogs bem po'i rang bzhin can ni phyi zhes bya ba dang, de dag bden par grub pa med pa ni phyi stong pa nyid do/
1) 'byung 'gyur gyi dus/ 2) a gsar med par 'grogs yun ring ba/ bsdongs pa'i mi la phyi thag dgos, bzhon pa'i rta la snying rje dgos/ phyi thag ring ba/
gtum byed/ ja yi phyi thum ko bas byas pa/
(yul) sa gdan sogs 'thag dus dgos pa'i shing gi tho ba zhig /
rjes su dar ba/ bstan pa phyi dar/ lugs srol phyi dar/
'gor ba'am 'gyangs pa/ 'grul pa phyi dal med par 'byor yong/
1) rgyal khab kyi phyi 'brel las don/ 2) gzung ba yul gyi don/
phyi'i rdul du grub pa ste, phyi'i gzugs don lnga po'o/
nyin mo cha gsum du btang ba'i cha tha ma dang, nyin phyed phan/
'jug pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim du nyin gung yol nas sang gi skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du gnas pa/
thal rdul 'phyag tshul/ yo byad la phyi bdar yang yang btang na thal rdul gyis mi nog pa'i khyad yod/ khang par phyi bdar yang yang byed dgos pa ltar bsam blo la'ang phyi bdar yang yang gtong dgos/
mda' dang me mda' phyi rgyag byed pa/ rjes 'ded yong mkhan dgra bor phyi mda' rgyag pa/
rkang pa rgyab tu 'dred pa/ 'khyag rom steng la 'gro dus gom tshugs brtan po ma byung bar phyi 'dred shor song/
1) 'phongs phyi ba'i rdo/ 2) rgyab tu phyir 'phangs pa'i rdo/
1) ngos 'bur 'bur la khog pa stong shig shig / 2) kha pho che ba bshad kyang, yon tan gang yang med pa/
phyi logs dang nang logs/ gyon pa phyi nang bslogs nas gyon pa/ khang pa'i phyi nang gtsang ma byung ba/ phyi nang lag 'brel/
phyi rol mu stegs pa dang, nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ring lugs/
bdag las ni phyi dang, rtsi shing sems med las ni nang ste, sems can gzhan gyi lus so/

stong nyid bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, skye mched bcu gnyis po nang dang phyi gnyis la dngos po med par bstan kyang, phyi nang gnyis ka 'dus pa'i spyi la ni dngos po zhig yod do snyam du sems na yang dbang po drug dang yul drug de la dmigs shing brten pa rnam par shes pa drug tsam du zad de, de dag la yang dngos po med pa/
grong khyer sogs kyi phyi nang tshang ma/ phyi nang gsang gsum, gsang ba dang, gsang ba min pa'i las don tshang ma/
phyir 'then/ dgra la phyi nud byas na dpa' bo min/ dmag sar phyi nud mi byed par 'dzing ba/
phyir 'gyangs/ las don bsgrub dgos tshang ma 'phral 'phral du byed dgos pa las, phyi nur du bshol nas byas na 'thus sgo 'chor rkyen byas yong/
phyi'i gnag phyugs sogs dang, nang gi ca lag /
phyi rol gyi mthong snang/ las don gyi phyi snang mthong ba tsam gyis nang don mi rtogs/
'jig rten chags gnas sa yi go la/
phyi rol pa ste, sangs rgyas chos lugs pas rang nyid la nang pa zer zhing, rang gi chos lugs ma yin pa rnams la phyi rol pa'am mu stegs pa zer/
phyi bdar gtong byed kyi rdzas spyi/

ma ha yo ga'i 'jug sgo'i dbang ste, snying po lnga dang, dbu rgyan dang, bum pa dang, cod pan dang, phreng ba dang, go cha dang, rgyal mtshan dang, gdugs dang, phyag rgya dang, bza' btung gi dbang rnams so/
yul gzhan du 'gro khar rang gi bla mar 'tshal ba'i phyag /
1) rjes su/ rgyug khyi bdag po'i phyi phyir du phyin pa/ 2) slar yang/ las don thengs gcig byas nas phyi phyir du byed mi dgos pa zhig dgos/
(yul) 'byid pa dang, sub pa/ lus kyi rmas khrag gtsang mar phyis nas yang bskyar yar langs pa/ gdong gi dri nog phyi ba/
rgyal khab kyis phyi rgyal nas blangs pa'i bu lon/
sngar phyi logs kyi las don sgrub mkhan blon po/
phyi rol gyi rlung khams kyi dwangs ma nang du 'dren ma thub pas dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad de rlung srog 'dzin sogs kyi nus pa med par gyur nas myur du 'chi ba'i ltas shig /
tshur rjes su 'byor nas phar sngon la log pa/
1) rjes su 'gro ba/ 2) rjes su 'gro mkhan/
rgyal khab cig gis phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba byed pa'i rgyun ldan byed sgo/

1) rjes ma/ lo phyi ma/ bshad lugs phyi ma/ las don phyi ma/ phyi ma phan chad/ phyi ma phyi ma/ 2) nang gi cig shos/ sgo ra phyi ma/ khang pa phyi ma/ skye ba phyi ma/ phyi rdzig pa las nang snum pa dga'/ phyi char pa'i char thag chod kyang, nang thigs pa'i thigs thag mi chod/

1) dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal dum bu bzhi pa gso ba rig pa'i lag len gyi skor rnams ston pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud de le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa'i sman gzhung tshad ldan zhig / 2) gsang sngags bya ba'i rgyud kyi ming/
(rnying) phyi dro/ phyi ma bred, (rnying) phyi dro/
phyi mtha' rig pa ste, tshe phyi mar rang gzhan gang du 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i gnas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab ste rig pa gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
rjes ma'i mjug gam, ma 'ongs pa'i zad mtshams/ sngar de ltar byung med la dus rabs phyi ma'i mtha' la'ang de ltar yong mi srid/

brten pa'i lta ba bzhi: sangs rgyas kyis lan gsung yul du ma gyur pa'i lta log gi dri ba rnams sde tshan bzhir dbye ba'i nang gses shig ste, bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan mi ldan gnyis yin gnyis min du lta ba'o/
gzhan phyogs kyi mi/ phyi mi nang la btang mi chog
1) mig gis rgyab tu lta ba/ 2) slad kyi don la mno bsam gtong ba/ 3) dran gso byed pa/

/ 1) pha ma gnyis kyi a ma/ 2) ka kha lta bu yi ge'i rtsa ba dang gzhi ma/ ka kha...3) yi ge'i ma dpe/ mi rabs mang po song nas phyi mo nub pa/ 4) bzo pa'i dge rgan/ shing bzo phyi mo lags/ 5) btsun mo/
phyi rol tu gnyul ba'am 'tshol ba/ 'tsho rten med pas phyi myul du 'gro dgos byung ba/
chen ma dang chun ma gnyis las chun ma'i bu rgyud/
gsham du gsal ba'i skad cha/

ston pa'i rgyan: tshig snga phyi gnyis phan tshun mi mthun pa'i don gsal byed kyi phrad cig ste, rnam dbye drug pa dang, na yig / na...mi 'di sngar brtson 'grus cher med na da ni 'bad brtson chen po zhig tu gyur 'dug / yon tan bslabs na shes kyi, ma bslabs na de ltar mi yong/
byed pa'i rgyan: tshig phyi mar nan gyis brjod pa'i phrad cig ste dper na na yig lta bu/ na...
lus kyi phyi sha'i tshil bu/
phyi ngos dang, bzo dbyibs dang, snang tshul/
phyi nas bltas na rdzig mdog kha la nang stong pa/
1) rnam pa'am bzo lta/ 2) rjes su 'brang ba/ nga yang khyod nyid gang du gshegs pa yi, nags khrod dben pa bsten phyir phyi bzhin 'gro/ bya gnyis 'phur te song ba'i phyi bzhin du gzigs/
slar yang ngam yang nas yang/
phyi yul la gtogs pa'i gzugs te, gzhan rgyud dang sems can min pa dper na yul drug lta bu/
1) phyi gzung ba yul/ 2) gzhan yul lam, lung pa gzhan/
mi rabs dang dus rabs rjes ma/ bu tsha phyi rabs pa/ gna' dus phyi rabs/ phyi rabs kyi rtsom rigs/
dreg pa sogs phyi byed kyi ras/

1) phyi'i rig pa ste, sngar rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs las gzhan pa'i rig byed pa dang, grangs can pa, bye brag pa, spyod pa ba zhes rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i rig gnas kyi gzhung/ 2) nang don rig pa las gzhan pa'i tha snyad rig pa/
khang pa sogs kyi phyi rol gyi ra ba phyi ma'i rim pa/ lcags ri phyi rim/ 'dzing ra phyi rim/
1) rta sga sogs kyi snga ru dang phyi ru gnyis kyi phyi ru/ 2) phyi rol tu/ khang pa'i phyi ru ljon shing mang po btsugs pa/
phyi rol gyi don grub pa
phyi rol gyi don grub pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes pa'i bsdus ming, rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge srung gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
kyi 'jig rten: mi sogs gnas 'cha' sa'i yul khams/
1) phar phyogs kyi lung pa/ 2) gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i rnam pa/
rnam g.yeng drug gi nang gses, yid kyi rnam par shes pa phyi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la g.yeng ba'o/
sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs las gzhan pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/
dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas mi len par ma zad lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas mi len pa'o/
dge rtsa kun tu chad pa/
pha rol gyi mi ngan dang phyi dgra/ phyi lag nang sbrel/ phyi lag nang lag 'brel ba/
(rnying) sngar nyes byed pa'i steng du yang nyes pa byed pa/
rang nyid gang nas yong sa der phar phyir log tu lan skur ba/
phyi nang mi 'dra ba'i ngan pa/
sang phod dam, lo rjes ma/
tshur log ste 'ong ba/ kho phyi log ma byas bar du bsgugs pa yin/
phyi rol/ khang pa'i phyi logs/ rgyal khab kyi phyi logs/
rkang ske'i phyi rgyab kyi long bu'i tshigs rdog /
1) gos kyi phyi sha/ 2) lus kyi phyi'i sha/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, shes bya phyi rol gyi dngos po'i 'pho 'gyur sogs kyi gnas tshul shes par byed pa'i rgyu'i rgyan zhig /
phyir 'gyangs pa'am phyir 'then/ de ring gi las don sang gnangs la phyi bshol ma byed/
mi gtsang ba dri chen nam skyag pa/ phyi sa gtong ba/ phyi sa'i dri/ phyi sa'i 'dam/
sa mtshams phyi'i gnas tshul mel tshe byed mi/
sog yul sa mtho phyi nang gnyis su phye ba'i phyi ma'am, byang ma ste sngar krung go'i mnga' khongs sa cha yin zhing, da lta mong gol mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab ces bya'o/
deng skabs sam phyi rabs kyi lugs srol/
phyi nang thams cad mthong ba'i dwangs gsal/ kho'i bsam sbyor gang 'dra yin min phyi gsal nang gsal du mthong ba/ shel dam phyi gsal nang gsal/ phying gur, phying pa las bzos pa'i gur/
phying pa las bzos pa'i gos/
phying pa ril ril/ bal phying tho chags na skud pa 'khel rgyur phan mi thogs/
phying pa bcags zin pa'am, snam bu chags bcags zin pa ma skam gong la phying dril byed pa zhig /
thags su ma byas par chu chags kyis bcags pa'i bal gos/ rdo chung yang ri bo rtsig thub, bal phra yang phying pa bzo thub/
sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, chos gos gsum dang gos lham ci 'chang ba thams cad bal las byas pa sha stag 'chang bar dam bca' ba'o/
bod rang skyong ljongs 'phyong rgyas rdzong du yod pa'i gna' dus kyi mkhar rdzong zhig /
phying pa las bzos pa'i zhwa mo/
phying pa las bzos pa'i rta sga'i 'og stan/
1.ldeng ba dang 'phyong ba sogs kyi don du go ba'i 'byid pa'i 'das pa, 2.(rnying) rgan po/
pa'i yongs grub: yongs grub kyi nang gses, gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i shul na gnyis med kyi shes pa ste 'phags pa'i stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes so/
yang dag pa ma yin pa'am nor ba/ spyod pa phyin ci log pa/ lta ba phyin ci log pa/ 'gro lam phyin ci log pa/ gtam phyin ci log pa/
log lta bzhi ste, mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar 'dzin pa dang, bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa, sdug bsngal la bde bar 'dzin pa, mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa bcas bzhi'o/
phan chad dam slad kyi cha/ de ring phyin chad 'di 'dra ma byed/
pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi bsdus tshig
phyin drug gi khyad chos bzhi

phar phyin rang rang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang bral ba dang, grogs 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa, byed las gzhan gyi 'dod don rdzogs par byed pa, 'bras bu byang chub gsum smin par byed pa ste bzhi/
phyin drug gi phan yon bzhi

gzhan don rdzogs byang la dmigs pas dmigs pa rgya che ba dang, lan dang rnam smin la re ba sogs med pas kun slong zang zing med pa, sems can thams cad mngon mtho dang nges legs la 'god pas byed las don che ba, stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi thabs dang bsngo bas zin pas 'bras bu phung po lhag med du mi zad pa ste bzhi'o/
'o ma dang, zho dang, mar ro/
'byung ba chen po bzhi dag rgyur byas pa'i bstan yod thogs bcas kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs rnams so/
skye mched bcu gnyis kyi nang gses shig: ste gzugs, sgra, dri, ro, reg chos bcas dmigs pa'i cha nas shes pa skye ba'i sgor gyur pa drug go/
khams bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, gzugs, sgra, dri, ro, reg chos bcas kyi khams rnams so/
mu khyud 'dzin dang khor yug gi bar gyi ba tshwa can gyi chus gang ba'o/
zad ston pa'i srid pa can: srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag nas, phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung zad tsam gyi 'bras bu ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gyi yi dwags: chu dang shing thog rgyang nas mthong yang nye bar gcar dus shul tsam med par gyur te bkres skom gyis gdungs pa'i yi dwags shig /

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rnams rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus shing tshogs pas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la ltos nas 'byung ba ste, sa bon las myu gu, de las 'dab ma dang, sdong bu dang, sbu gu dang, snye ma dang, 'bras bu rnams snga ma las phyi ma rim bzhin 'byung ba'o/
nyan rang byang gsum gyi theg pa'o/
gza' skar sogs phyi snod kyi 'jig rten te dus 'khor phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /

gsang sngags sgrub pa'i sbyor ba bcu ste gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor dang, dang po sbyor ba sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin, lha la rgyas 'debs pa'i phyag rgya, stangs stabs 'dug stangs, las la sbyor ba, slar bsdu ba, bzlas brjod, sbyin sreg mchod pa bcas so/
drang don gyi rdor dril te, mtshan ma rdzas kyi rdor dril/
yi ge klog skabs kha'i nang nas sgra dang dbugs rnams phyi rol tu 'don pa'i rtsol ba/
lus kyi tshor ba dang, dbang po'i tshor ba'o/
sngo ser sogs kha dog dang, dbyibs kyi khyad par lta bu/
skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i gzugs te, gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams so/
rnam par shes pas ma zin pa gzugs sgra dang rtsi shing la sogs pa'i bem gzugs snod kyi 'jig rten/
phyi'i bar chad kyi rtags mtshan/
1) ched dam, slad dang, stabs sam, gshis/ de'i phyir du/ ci'i phyir/ der mi yod de, du ba yod pa'i phyir/ 2) slar/ phyir 'ong ba,/ 3) phyi la/ sgo phyir bskrad pa/ gom pa gang phyir 'then pa/
phyir 'then rgyag pa/ bsam 'char phyir bskums pa/ dgongs zhu phyir bskum/
phyi logs su 'gro ba/ rta bzhon nas phyir skyod byed pa/
phar phar yun ring 'gor ba/ kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi las don phyir 'gyangs su ma bzhag par dus thog tu byed dgos/
dmag sogs phar 'gyed pa'am spro ba/ rtsod lan tsha po zhig phyir 'gyed pa/ drag po'i dpung sde phyir 'gyed kyis rgol lan sprod pa/
tshur log / dgra nyen che chung gang zhig yod kyang phyir 'gros gtan nas mi rgyag /
1) rgol lan/ khungs med dkrog gtam la dngos yod gnas lugs kyis phyir rgol byed pa/ phyir rgol gyi dri ba/ 2) rgol lan sprod mkhan/
pha rol tu bskrad pa'am bton pa/ lug lpags gyon pa'i spyang ki lug khyu'i nang nas phyir bsgral ba/ gru gzings btang nas 'grul pa rnams chu klung chen po'i phyir bsgral ba/
phyir bton pa/ sman gyis nad gzhi phyir bcil ba/ rkang par zug pa'i tsher ma phyir bcil ba/

nad dang, nor 'khrul, bslab pa sogs slar gso ba/ las don nor 'khrul byung rigs la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gis phyir bcos byed pa/ na tsha rnying pa la zhi drag sman dpyad kyis phyir bcos gang 'os byed dgos/ skyon cha phyir bcos yang yang byas na legs/
'dul ba gzhi'i phyir bcos kyi gzhi/
'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses, sdom pa nyams pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi la, ltung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi, rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum ste bdun/
gzhan la chod pa/ ma dngul lhag ma phyir chod du gtong ba/
1) slar 'phel ba/ 2) gsang ba phyir bsgrags pa/ gsang ba dam po byed dgos rigs phyir mched mi rung/

1) phyi rol tu bskrad pa/ mi ngan rnams phyir bsnyil nas gsar brje'i dpung sde dwangs gtsang gcig gyur bzo ba/ 2) mar bshig pa'am, bsgyel ba/ lcags ri rnying pa phyir bsnyil nas khang pa gsar pa bzo skrun byed pa/
phyir rten tshong pa'i gral rim

mi ser spel yul dang mi ser spel yul phyed tsam gyi rgyal khab nang du btsan rgyal ring lugs dang ngan 'brel byas thog btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul srid jus la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan 'byor chen gral rim la zer/
1) phyi ltas slog pa/ 2) blo kha phyir phyogs pa/
1) phyi logs su phyin pa'am song ba/ 2) phyi la mngon pa'am gsal ba/
1) phyi la bshol ba/ las don la 'thus shor tshabs chen byung ba'i las byed pa phyir 'then byas pa/ 2) dus tshod phyir 'gyangs byas pa/ da res kyi tshogs 'du 'di zla ba gcig phyir 'then byed pa/
ched du'am, don du'am, slad du/ mi dmangs kyi phyir du zhabs 'degs zhu ba/
(yul) 1) phyi logs su 'gro ba'am song ba/ 2) phyi la mngon pa'am gsal ba/ sems la bsams tshad kha nas phyir don pa/ shing bal gyi sa bon btab nas myu gu ring min nyid du phyir don pa/
gtam tshur dris pa'i lan du phar 'dri ba'am, phar dris pa'i lan du tshur 'dri ba gang rung/

tshur phyogs nas phar 'dren pa'am, phar phyogs nas tshur 'dren pa/ grong khyer nas bzo las thon zog grong gseb tu phyir 'dren pa dang, grong gseb nas zhing las thon zog grong khyer gyi nang du phyir 'dren pa/
tshur rdung rdeg byas pa'i lan du phar rdung rdeg byed pa/ khu tshur gyis tshur brdegs pa'i lan du dbyug pas phyir rdeg pa/
tshur log yong ba/ phyogs su phyin nas phyir ldog pa/ tshur rgol dgra bo phyir ldog par byed pa/ lhag bsam dmar po'i rang mdangs nam yang phyir mi ldog pa/
1) phar 'gyangs/ las mjug bsgril rgyu phyir nud song/ 2) mdun du 'gro bzhin par phyir 'then brgyab pa/ dmag 'thab drag po brgyab par brten dgra bo bzo lta shor nas phyir nud rgyag dgos byung song/
dus tshod phyi 'gyang byed pa/ de ring byed rgyu'i las ka sang 'gyangs gnangs 'gyangs phyir bsnur byas na mi 'grig
1) tshur log yong ba/ 2) phyi ru song ba/ 3) 'og rim nas gong rim la phul ba'i snyan zhu sogs kyi lan du gong rim nas btang ba'i lan/
nang nas phyir skrod pa/ chu yur nang nas btsog chu phyir 'bud pa/ rnag dug phyir 'bud byas na rma rnying drag yong/
1) yong mkhan tshur slebs pa/ rang rgyal du phyir 'byor ba/ 2) ca lag tshur 'phrod pa/ gzhan la g.yar ba'i dngos po phyir 'byor ba/
rjes su 'gro ba/ tang gi gsung la nyan te snying thag pa nas phyir 'brang ba/

theg chen sbyor lam drod thob pa nas sgom lam rgyun mthar gnas pa'i byang sems rnams dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum dang mthun par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags te, gzugs la sogs pa'i chos las ldog pa dang, the tshom zad pa dang, mi khom pa brgyad zad pa dang, bdag gzhan dge ba'i chos la sbyor ba dang, sgrib pa lnga zad pa dang, gtsang ba dang, lus la srin bu mi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i rtags sna tshogs yod pa'o/
phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa
dad pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, skyid sdug legs nyes mctho dman cir 'gyur rung dkon mchog la yid ches byed shes kyi dad pa'o/
phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems
slob pa phyir mi ldog pa dang don gcig
'gro ba thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bskal pa'i bar du brtson pa mi 'dor ba'o/
dge 'dun nyi shu las phyir mi 'ong bcu ste, phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang, bar dor 'da' ba dang, skyes nas 'da' ba gsum dang, 'phar ba gsum dang, mthong chos zhi ba dang, lus mngon byed rnams so/
dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi'i nang gses, 'dod pa'i sgom spang dgu po spangs te 'dod khams su phyir 'ong mi dgos pa'o/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la gnas pa ste, 'dod pa'i sgom spang dgu pa spangs pa'i theg dman slob pa'o/
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can
bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs nas srid rtse dgu pa'i bar spong ba'i sbyor ba la gnas pa'o/
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can bzhi
gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba dang, gzugs med du nye bar 'gro ba dang, mthong chos zhi ba dang, lus mngon byed de bzhi'o/
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po ba
khams gong ma'i nyon mongs spong ba'i sbyor ba la mi gnas pa'o/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa ste, 'dod pa'i sgom spang bdun pa nas dgu pa'i bar spong ba'i sbyor ba can, dge 'dun nyi shu'i gras shig /
gzhan la 'tshong ba'am phyi logs su 'tshong ba/ rgyu dngos 'khrol 'khyil phyir 'tshong dang, dgos mkho tshur sgrub/
slar yang/ sman pa phyir zhing mu mthud bsten na nad gzhi sangs drag yong thub par yid ches yod/ phyir zhing dad par gyur/
yang bskyar yang bskyar/ las don gang la'ang dang thog dka' ngal che yang, ngang bsrings snying stobs bskyed na phyir zhing phyir zhing sla ru 'gro ba chos nyid yin/
1) slar yang skyes pa/ 2) rjes su 'brangs pa/ 3) (rnying) 'phel ba/
phyir bskrad pa/ gnod 'tshe rnams phyir bzlog pa/
1) phyir log pa/ 2) «sakrid'ag'am'i:» 'dod nyon drug pa zad par gyur pa'i nyan thos kyi 'bras gnas bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi'i nang gses, 'dod pa'i sgom spang drug pa man chad spangs shing 'dod khams su lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'o/
zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la gnas pa ste, 'dod pa'i sgom spang drug pa spangs shing dgu pa ma spangs pa'i theg dman no/

dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, 'dod pa'i sgom spang bdun nam brgyad spangs pas phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa la nyon mongs gcig gis bar du chod la myang 'das 'thob pa la tshe gcig gis bar du chod pa'o/
dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, khams gong ma'i nyong mongs spong ba la mi brtson pa'o/

zhugs gnas brgyad kyi nang gses, lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa ste, 'dod pa'i sgom spang drug pa ma spangs shing, dang po nas drug pa'i bar gang yang rung ba spong ba la brtson pa'i gang zag dge 'dun nyi shu'i gras shig /
dge 'dun nyi shu'i phyir 'ong gsum ste, phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang, phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po ba, phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa bcas gsum mo/
slar yang/ phyir yang bsam blo btang nas thag bcad pa/ phyir yang snga ma bzhin/
tshur len pa/ dgrar shor sa cha phyir len pa/ bor brlag tu song ba'i dngos po phyir blangs pa/
slar rang gnas su 'gror bcug pa/ 'dzin bzung dmag mi rnams phyir log btang ba/
tshur yong mkhan brgyud/ dgongs skor zhus rigs phyir log gdong bka' gsal yod pa mkhyen/ 'di ga'i gnas tshul che phra tshang ma phyir log gdong snyan seng zhus chog
phyi ru 'khor ba/ tshur byung dngos po phyir log tu sprod/ 'gro lam ma shes par phyir log brgyab nas slebs byung/
phyir 'then/ g.yul sa nas phyir shig gom gang ma brgyab par dgra bo'i mdun phyogs su rgyug mchong byed pa/ dgra dmag gi stobs shugs chag ste 'thab sa nas phyir shig rgyag gin bros pa/
phar gshe gshe btang ba'i lan du tshur gshe gshe gtong ba/ gtam ngan gyis phyir gshe mi byed par drang 'brel gyi gsed dkrol gtong dgos/

1) dus tshod phar 'gyang/ zhing gar son 'debs dus tshod phyir bshol byas drags na ston thog yag po skye rgyu'i re ba cher mi 'grub// 2) las khur bzhag pa/ dka' tshegs byung bar lag pa phyis nas 'gan 'khri'i las ka phyir bshol byed pa/
slar skye ba/ lo mang song ba'i shing sdong skam po la lo 'dab gsar pa phyir sos pa/ dbugs chad de shi nas phyir sos pa/
1) rang gnas su slar gtong ba/ kho bos grogs por yi ge btang ba ma 'phrod par phyir slog byas byung/ 2) gos sogs kyi nang ngos phyir ston pa/ gos phyir slog byas nas gyon pa/
'dag par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'byid pa'i skul tshig
dus yun 'gor ba/ tshogs 'du sng bsnur phyis 'gyang mi byed par dus thog tu 'tshogs pa/
phyis gnon byed pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gtsug lag khang la sngar zhugs pa'i dge slong la lus ngag gang rung gis gnod pa rtsom pa'am, rang gi lus kyis gzhan brdzis shing gnon pa'o/
'dag par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'byid pa'i 'das pa,
'byung 'gyur ma 'ongs pa/ da lta'i skabs babs kyi 'char gzhi 'ding dus phyis 'byung gi gnas tshul la bsam blo gtong dgos/
rjes su snyeg pa'am 'gro ba/ lag rtsal gyi thad la gzhan gyi phyis 'brang kho na byed mi nyan/
dreg pa sogs 'byid byed kyi ras/
1) slad kyi 'gro lam/ phyis lam khegs pa/ 2) rjes su lang shor gyi mig dpe ngan pa/
tshar tshags sogs kyi phyu pa sram lpags kyi mtha' lcags can/
sprin dang du ba rlangs pa sogs thon tshul zhig / mthongs khung nas du ba phyu ru ru thon/ rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor nas mkho med rlangs pa phyu ru ru gtong ba/
(tha mi dad pa) mang po'am chen po yod pa ste, brgyan pa'am brjid pa la'ang 'jug / lang tshos phyug pa/ yon tan gyis phyug pa/ stobs kyis phyug pa/

rgyu nor dang ldan pa'i mi/ kho phyug po zhig red/ phyug po gsog 'dod na zas mi za, dbul po 'u thug na las mi byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la nor gyi dbang phyug pa dang, nor can, nor ldan, nor dbang, phyug chen, 'byor ldan, rdzas ldan, yang dag 'byor, yo byad can, lhag 'byor bcas so,
'byor pa yod pa dang 'byor pa med pa/ phyug dbul gyi khyad par ha cang chen po rang mi yong/
ldad rgyag mkhan khyim gso'i dud 'gro/ gnag phyugs/ sgo phyugs/ bdag gnyer 'thus tshang byung bas phyugs rigs 'phel chen po byung/ lo phyugs legs pa/
phyugs 'phel ba'i rtsa ba'am, sa bon lta bu'i thog ma'i phyugs nyung ngu/ phyugs rigs skye 'phel yong ba phyugs kyi ru ma bzang dgos/
'bri g.yag dang ra lug gi spyi ming/
sgo phyugs chu bo las sgrol ba/
ra lug sogs phyugs rigs tshang ma na ba'i pags nad cig /
1) phyugs nad bcos mkhan/ 2) sgo phyugs kyi nad bcos pa/
g.yul las gtong skabs ston 'bras tshar ma'i steng du phyugs ded de 'chag pa/ bod du ston thog g.yul khar bskams nas phyugs 'chag sgor ba'i lugs srol yod/
gnag phyugs la do dam byed mkhan/
1) sgo phyugs kyi bdag po/ 2) sgo phyugs kyi lha ste, dbang phyug chen po/ 3) klu'i rgyal po/
sgo phyugs la rmos las dang, khal 'khyer rgyu sogs slob pa/ 'brog pa rnams phyugs 'dul ba la rab tu mkhas/
'bri g.yag ba mdzo sogs rmig pa kha dbrag can gyi phyugs rigs la 'byung ba'i nad rigs shig /
nor lug gi kha sna nas chu 'bab pa dang, ske skrangs shing dbugs 'gags te nyin gcig gnyis tsam nas 'chi ba'i phyugs kyi 'gos nad cig /
phyugs nad 'gog bcos kyi em chi/
gzhon nu ma grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa/
phyugs rigs kyi ngo grangs 'phar chag ji byung gi rtsis/
phyugs la ster rgyu'i gzan rtswa/
phyugs skyong ba/ phyugs 'tsho'i rdzi bo dmigs bkar gyis btsugs te btang yod/
nor phyugs 'tsho mkhan/ dpyid zog nad pa red, phyugs rdzi sman pa red/ ming gi rnam grangs la phyugs skyong dang, phyugs bgrang ba, ba 'jo, ba lang rdzi, 'brog pa, rdzi bo bcas so,
gnag phyugs kyi glo bar phog pa'i nad cig /
gnag phyugs kyi rgyu mar phog pa'i nad cig /
nor phyugs 'dogs yul gyi ra ba/
rta nor ra lug sogs phyugs rigs tshang ma la 'byung ba'i shig ces srin bu zhig /
phyugs rigs skyong yul/ rtswa chu gnyis 'dzoms kyi phyugs sa/
phyugs rigs gso skyong byed pa/
nor phyugs 'dogs sa dang nyal sa'i ra ba sogs/
(yul) bod chas phyu pa chen po'i bsdus ming/
dar ba bskol te phyur ba bton zin pa'i sngo khu/
phyur khu yun ring bskol nas chags pa'i lde gu mdog rgya smug cig /
yar mthon por langs pa dang, gtams pa'i rnam 'gyur/ snod phyur por gang ba/ 'bru phung phyur po/ gro sog phyur por spungs 'dug /
phyu ra/ mngar phyur/ skyur phyur/ sngo phyur/ skya phyur/
(yul) zhib zhib dang hrob hrob gnyis ka min pa'i bar hrob/
phyu ba zhib zhib min pa/

byur bu dang mtshungs te, snod khengs nas 'bur du thon pa'i tshul/ dkar gzhong nang du shing 'bras phyur bur blug pa/ ras phad nang du 'bras phyur bur gtams pa/ rlangs 'khor nang du dngos zog phyur bur gang ba/
rdul dang du ba sogs langs tshul zhig / khyim brdibs nas sa tshub phyur re bar gyur/
rtsam snod rkyal pa'am khug ma/ phye rkyal bong la bltas nas za lugs dang, lam 'phrang chu la bltas nas 'gro lugs byed/
1) rtsam pa sogs 'gams zin pa/ 2) 'gam rgyu'i rtsam pa/
1) rtsam pa gtor ba/ 2) (yul) ngo bstod/ zol bstod kyi phye gtor la dga' ba/
rtsam pa dang gro zhib sogs kyi thug pa/
rtsam pa sogs 'thag pa/ 'bru rigs brngos nas phye 'thag pa/
mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ste, ras dang gos chen sogs kyis bzos pa'i dri bzang phye ma phur ma'i snod cig /
(yul) gro so phye mar blug sa shing gis bzos pa'i 'bo ste, lo gsar sogs rten 'brel skabs bsgrig rgyu'i shing 'bo nyis sbrel ya gcig tu phye mar dang, ya gcig tu gro blugs sa byed pa zhig /
zhib mor btags pa'i dngos rdzas/ lcags phye/ bag phye/ sman phye/ shing phye/ 'bras
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spu hreng rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod cing mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 6175 yod/
lceb 'dre ma ste, srog chags rkang pa drug dang, gshog pa bzhi ldan zhig /
spyir btang rtsam par mar snum btab pa'i zan yin zhing, dmigs bsal sder ma'i nang rtsam pa dang mar bsres te bshams pa lo gsar sogs kyi rten 'brel gyi rdzas shig /
phye ma leb kyi bsdus tshig
bu ram gyi wu ba'am kha shun bsdus pa, 'dul ba las bshad pa'i zhag bdun pa'i sman gyi bye brag cig /

dum bu gnyis su bgos pa'i ya gcig / nam phyed/ mtshan phyed/ nyin phyed/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ zla ba gnyis dang phyed ka/ rgyal khams pho phyed mo phyed, lung pa rtswa phyed chu phyed/ thag ring gtam de phyed bden phyed mi bden/
skad cha rkyong skum byas pa/ skad cha phyed skung phyed bshad byas pas ha go don rtogs dka'/
skyil krung phyed pa ste, rkang pa ya gcig bskums la ya gcig brkyangs pa/
cha gnyis su phye ba'i stod cha/
phyogs gsum chu dang 'brel la phyogs gcig skam sa dang 'brel ba'i gling phran/
mang nyung 'dra gnyis byas te bgos pa/ dpe deb bco brgyad mi gnyis la phyed bgos byas pa/
1) sngar bod kyi dngul rtsi stangs la skar phyed brgyad gnyis la tam ga gcig zer/ phyed brgyad...2) bre sogs kyis 'jal ba'i grangs bdun dang phyed ka/
cha gnyis su bgos pa'i dum bu gcig / khyon 'bor ha cang che drags pas phyed cha bskyungs kyang 'grig /
(yul) kha gang gsum mam, skar phyed brgyad ri ba'i chang 'gro ba'i snod khog ltir/
gza' phyed dag gi grangs gnas 'og ma'i ming/
yi ge'i sgra 'dra bas tshig rkang brtsegs pa'i tshigs bcad nar mo'i dbyibs can gyi phyed du 'khor bar bkod pa'i rgyan zhig /

(tha mi dad pa) 1) dbyed mtshams ma 'dres pa/ skra dang, dpral pa gnyis kyi mtshams phyed pa/ 2) khyad par shes pa'am ma 'dres par rtogs pa/ brtag dpyad byas nas bden rdzun gyi khyad par phyed pa/ spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba phyed pa/
phyed ka re/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi mar phyed phyed kyis 'phri ba/

dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, 'og min gyi mthar thug par 'gro ba gang tshangs ris su skyes, de nas shi 'phos te bar pa rnams bor te gnas gtsang lnga'i dang po gsum gang rung du skyes, de nas kyang bar pa rnams dor te 'og min du 'da' ba'i rigs can no/
dngos po gang yin gyi phyed ka/ smyug sdong phyed mar gsheg pa/ bzhi'i phyed ma gnyis/
bye ma spu rug dang don gcig
phyed ka tsam smin pa'am, tshos pa/ shing tog phyed smin pa/
phyed ka las cung zad nyung ba'am, cung zad mang ba ste ma nges pa'i tshad/ las don 'di da lta phyed tsam las grub ma song/
phyed mes tshig cing, phyed ma tshig pa/
nyi zla'i phyed cha 'dzin tshul te, sgrib tshul/
lha'i zhal ras g.yas g.yon phyed ser la phyed sngo ba lta bu/
las ka sogs phyed ka byas te mtshams 'jog pa/ las ka phyed lus ma byed/
(yul) sngar zhing bdag gis so nam pa'i ston thog phyed ka len pa'i bogs ma gtong srol zhig /
dkyil nas dum bu gnyis su bkas pa/ sran ma phyed gshags btang ba/
1) phyed ka las mang tsam/ sprin nag gis zla ba phyed lhag tsam bsgribs song/ 2) phyed ka lhag mar lus pa/ 'gro rgyu'i lam thag phyed lhag pa/
'og rlung ngam rtug dri/ phyen shor ba/ phyen lung stong la btang na sngo lo bzhugs gral la 'phyar yong/
khyi rbod pa'am skul ba'i sgra/

/ 1) nyi mas bstan pa'i ngos/ steng phyogs/ 'og phyogs/ shar phyogs/ nub phyogs/ rang phyogs/ dgra phyogs/ yul phyogs tshang mar gzigs zhib tu phebs/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun khyab dang, nyi ston, 'phrog byed, gsal gnas bcas so, 2) ris dang, sna ga/ mthun phyogs/ 'gal phyogs/ zla ba'i dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs/ khas len dam bca'i phyogs/ rgyab rten rigs pa'i phyogs/ chos can snang phyogs dang chos nyid stong phyogs/ 3) «baksha» zla phyed la'ang phyogs zer te, dkar phyogs dmar phyogs dang, lo gsum phyogs gsum, sgra gcan phyogs longs zer ba bzhin no/ 4) (mngon) phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og ste phyogs la bcu yod pas grangs bcu mtshon/
(mngon) 1) mu stegs gcer bu pa'i ming/ 2) dbang phyug chen po/

1) 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya gyal, tshad ma rig pa'i rgyan gyi slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po ni, rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyud du rgyal rigs kyi sras su sku 'khrungs, mkhan po rgyal ba'i dbang po las rab tu byung, slob dpon dbyig gnyen bsten nas tshad ma la shin tu mkhas par gyur te, tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu rnams bsdus te lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhung tshad ma kun btus rtsa 'grel gnyis dang, dmigs pa brtag pa rtsa 'grel, dus gsum brtag pa, rigs pa la 'jug pa, phyogs chos dgu'i 'khor lo la sogs pa tshad ma'i gzhung mang du brtsams te nang pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i srol 'byed pa'i slob dpon du gyur pa'o/ 2) phyogs brgyad srung mkhan glang po/
sgra'i gnas brgyad kyi bdun pa skyes bu'i ldog pa phyogs gcig ston pa ste, dper na skyes bu 'di ni stobs dang ldan pa'o zhes dang, yon tan dang ldan pa'o zhes pa lta bu/
bu mo phyogs kyi gzugs su bkod pa'i snyan ngag gi rgyan/ phyogs...bu mo...phyogs...?
phyogs kyi bu mo dang don gcig
phyogs kyi bu mo dang don gcig
brgya byin sogs phyogs bcu srung ba'i lha bcu/

phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi lha ste, shar du dbang po, lho ru gshin rje, nub tu chu bdag byang du gnod sbyin, shar lhor me lha, lho nub tu bden bral, nub byang du rlung lha, byang shar du dbang ldan bcas brgyad yod cing, phyogs mtshams rang rang la ming de ltar thogs pa/
dbang po dang, gshin rje, chu bdag gnod sbyin, me lha, srin po, rlung lha, 'byung po, tshangs pa, sa'i lha mo dang bcu/
phyogs skyong bcu'i steng du nye dbang, tshogs bdag nyi ma, zla ba, thag bzang bcas bsnan pas bco lnga/
yul lung gzhan du 'gro ba/ dngos yod gnas lugs rtogs zhib kyi ched du las khungs nas thon te phyogs skyod byas pa/
yul gzhan du myul zhing 'khyams pa/
rang yul du sdod dbang ma byung bar sa phyogs gzhan du 'gro dgos byung ba/
ming mi gsal ba'i yul zhig /
1) gcer bu dang gos med/ 2) phyogs thag ring la 'gro skabs gyon rgyu'i gos/
phyogs kyi gos can dang don gcig
phyogs kyi glang po'i bsdus ming,
1) phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i 'gron po/ 2) phyogs la 'gro mkhan/
tshan pa so so ba rnams phyogs gcig tu sdeb pa/ yig cha phyogs sgrig / gtam dpe kha 'thor ba rnams khu bsdus phyogs sgrig byas pa/
bya ba dang spyod lam phyogs gcig tu sgril ba/
1) gzhan gyi lugs sam pha rol po'i 'dod pa/
nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig tu byas pa'i zla ba'i ming/

1) ya gcig gam ngos gcig / gnas tshul bden rdzun ji ltar yin min phyogs gcig nas bltas pas shes dka'/ phyogs gcig nas slob sbyong dang, phyogs gcig nas thon skyed byed pa/ bya ba sgrub pa la bsam pa phyogs gcig tu mthun par bya dgos/ 2) gnas gcig / ca lag de tsho phyogs gcig tu spungs nas bzhag pa/ yig cha rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ 3) ya gcig / tshar gnyis bkod pa'i phyogs gcig / sgra gcan rtsa ba gnas gnyis bkod pa'i phyogs gcig gis, 'khor lor rim phri gdong skar yin/
zla ba yar ngo dang mar ngo la mtshan ma 'gyur ba'i ma ning/

shar, lho, nub, byang dang de dag gi mtshams bzhi dang, steng 'og gnyis ste bcu/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa grangs med pa/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing khams/
1) phyogs kyi cha shas/ don gnad yongs rdzogs ma mthong bar phyogs cha'i rtog pa tsam gyis mi rtogs/ 2) ris su chod pa'i cha/ phyogs cha can/

rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul dang po, de sgrub kyi shes 'dod chos can skyon med pa'i steng du 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa ste, dper na me dang chu mi snang yang du ba dang chu skyar snang ba la brten nas yul de na me dang chu yod par rtogs pa lta bu rjes su dpag pa la yod pa'am rtsod gzhi chos can gyi steng du rtags grub pa'o/

slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'khor lo'i dngos bstan ltar phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu 'khor lo'i re mig tu bkod pa ste, steng 'og gnyis la yang dag dang, logs la 'gal ba gnyis dang ni, zur bzhi thun mong ma nges bzhi, dbus na thun min ma nges pa'o/
phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs dgu
phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu dang don gcig

rtags 'dzin sems: rtags 'dzin sems gnyis kyi ya gyal, rjes dpag gi rgyu phyogs chos kyi tshul 'dzin pa'i mngon sum dang rjes dpag dang yid dpyod gang rung gi shes pa, dper na byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa la thog mar sgra byas par 'jal ba'am nges pa'i blo skye ba lta bu'o/

slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma mdo'i dngos bstan ltar, rtags sbyor 'god tshul gyi dpe 'jog lugs thog nas rtags yang dag dang ltar snang nges byed kyi rigs pa la dbye na, rtags yang dag gnyis dang, 'gal rtags gnyis dang, dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtags bzhi dang, thun min gyi ma nges pa'i rtags gcig bcas dgu'o/
1) ris gnyis/ 2) yul phyogs khag gnyis/ 3) rang gzhan gyi cha gnyis/
rigs sam khongs su the ba mtha' dag / snyan ngag dang mngon brjod sdeb sbyor sogs ni sgra rig pa'i phyogs gtogs red/
phyogs cha'i rtog pa ste, phyogs re tsam mam, cha shas re tsam rtog dpyod byed pa'i bsam blo/
phyogs gcig tsam mam cha shas tsam shes pa/
phyogs rtogs byed kyi srang mda'i 'khor lo/
1) ngos sam kha phyogs ston pa/ sa gnas gang du 'gro dgos phyogs ston byed pa/ 2) rgyus yod byed pa/ las ka byed lugs phyogs ston byed pa/ 'byor med gral rim la gsar brje'i phyogs ston byed pa/
phyogs lta 'khor lo dang don gcig
1) sa mtha'/ 2) phyogs dang mtha' ste phyogs kun/ grong khyer nang du phyogs mtha' nas yong ba'i mi mang po yod/
1) rigs gcig pa/ 2) cha shas tsam 'dra ba'am phal cher 'dra ba/ sngon dang da cha'i gnas tshul phyogs mthun tsam yang med/
phyogs re ba tsam shes pa'am
/ yongs rdzogs nyams len du 'khyer shes pa lta zhog, phyogs mthong gi go ba chags pa'ang dkon par gyur/
phyogs ris 'then 'khyer/ phyogs 'then dgag sgrub kyang 'thad ldan yin min brtag par 'tshal/
shar sogs phyod bzhi dang shar lho sogs mtshams bzhi/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu snyan pa rgya chen por grags pa/
shar lho nub byang steng 'og bcas/
phal cher 'dra ba'am ha lam 'dra ba/
khag mang gcig tu bsgrigs pa/
mang po gcig tu bsdoms pa/ stobs shugs phyogs bsdebs pa/
mang po mnyam bsdebs/ thon skyed nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas nas thon skyed las phyod gong du spel ba/
phyogs rer mi lhung bar drang por gnas pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 1) kha ston pa/ shar ngos su phyogs pa/ g.yas mda' dang, g.yon gzhu la mi phyogs pa/ rang yul rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ 2) bya spyod la 'jug pa/ lugs dang mi mthun pa'i lam lugs nub par mngon du phyogs pa/ thon skyed 'dzugs skrun nang du rim gyis phyogs pa/ 3) blo sems gzhol ba/ blo gcig sems gcig gis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun la phyogs pa/ drang bden gyi las don bsgrub rgyur sra brtan 'gyur med kyis phyogs pa/ 2.rjes su 'brang ba po'am phyogs 'dzin pa po/
phyogs su 'khyams nas 'tsho ba slong ba'i dbul po/
1) rtsod pa'i phyi rgol/ 2) (mngon) zla ba mar ngo/
yul phyogs phan tshun/ phyogs phyogs nas 'grul pa mang po slebs pa/ phyogs phyogs su rnam par 'thor ba/
phyogs ris dang bral zhing drang pos gzhung bsrangs pa/
phyogs gcig gi rjes su 'gro ba po/
rgya khyab kyi yul lung gcig tu ma nges pa/
zur tsam zhig / byed thabs phyogs tsam zhig bstan pa/
1) bkra shis pa'i phyogs/ 2) sngar bod du mi shi ba'i phung po skyel ba dang gsur khog g.yug skabs thog mar kha ston sa'i phyogs/
phyogs dang mtshams te shar sogs phyogs dang, shar lho sogs mtshams gnyis kyi bsdus ming/ phyogs mtshams kun nas bung ba'i tshogs rnams 'dus/
1) phyogs zhen byed pa/ 2) lugs 'dzin pa/
klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa thal 'gyur ba dang, rang rgyud pa'i phyogs so sor 'grel mkhan/
sngar bod kyi mnga' bdag phyogs la 'gro dus gyon rgyu'i zhwa mo'i bye brag cig /
rang phyogs la zhen pa'am chags pa/ dga' nye phyogs zhen/ phyogs zhen can/
shar lho nub byang gi phyogs bzhi/
phyogs bzhi dang phyogs mtshams bzhi la zer/
1) shog kha/ 2) phyogs 'dzin chags sdang/ phyogs ris med pa/ phyogs ris su lhung ba/ dgra dang gnyen bshes mtha' gcig tu phyogs ris chung ba/
nyi tshe ba'am cha mi tshang ba/ lta tshul phyogs re ba tsam gyis don gnad thag gcod yang dag pa byed mi thub/
phyogs gcig la dpung rogs byed pa/ bden rdzun yin min gyi dbye ba ma phye bar rang 'dod kho nas gzhan gyi phyogs lang byed mi rigs/
phyogs su sdud pa/ khyab spel byas nas phan nus thon pa'i nyams myong rnams phyogs slon pa/
lam phyogs nor ba/ las don byed phyogs bslad pas phugs don ma grub/

mthong spang brgya dang bcu gnyis, sgom spang bcu drug bcas khams gsum gyi spang bya brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa mngon pa kun btus las gsungs/

rtsa nyon drug dang don gcig

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsam blo sngon btang gi sgo nas go bya'i don brda thabs zur gyis thon pa dang, bsam blo sngon btang med par 'phral la lus kyi rnam 'gyur gsar pa zhig ngang gis gsal ba'i sgo nas nang sems kyi 'char sgo mtshon pa'i phra zhing rtogs dka'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses gnyis ni zur gyi phra mo dang, rnam pa'i phra mo'o/
rags rim min pa/ las stangs phra zhib/ mno bsam phra zhib gtong ba/ gnas lugs phra zhib tu rtog pa/ dogs gnas phra zhib tu dpyad pa/
phra zhing zhib pa'i gnad tshang zhing go chod pa/ bka' rgya phra zhib 'thus 'doms gnang ba/
1) gser bzo ba ste, phra rgyan bzo mkhan/ 2) phra rgyan bzo las byed pa/
chung ngu dang chen po/ don gnad phra rags med par rang nyid kyis thag chod byed dgos/
phra ba rab tu phra ba'am shin tu phra ba/ rdul phra rab/
bzo dbyibs phra zhing ring ba/

/ 1) tshar ram tsho/ brgya phrag / khri phrag / bdun phrag gcig / lnga phrag / 2) bar mtshams/ rtsig pa'i phrag / mi gnyis kyi phrag / ri gnyis kyi phrag / chu gnyis kyi phrag / sog phrag / smin phrag /
phrag pa la 'khyer rgyu'i khur po/ thag ring bar du phrag khur ljid po khyer ba/
khong khro'i char gtogs pa, rang rnyed bkur sogs la chags nas gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi bzod par sems khong nas 'khrug pa nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses shig / brnab sems phrag dog bya mi rung/
gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi bzod pa'i blo ngan dam por bcangs pa/
gzhan 'byor sogs la mi bzod pa'i zhe nad/
rgan rgya bo: phrag dog chen po yod pa'i mi la smod pa'i dpe/
ca lag sogs phrag tu 'khur byed kyi shing/ phyogs la 'gro dus khres po chen po phrag gdang khur ba/
dpung pa dang, lag pa'i dpung mgo/ gdang shing phrag tu khur ba/ khur po phrag pa la 'gel ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khur gnas dang, mgo 'dzin, dpung mgo bcas so,

phrag pa'i rus tshigs/ khang thog nas zags te phrag tshigs bud pa/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
phrag tu khur 'khur byed shing/ phrag shing ldem ldem byed/
slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel pa/
tshig don snga phyi spel ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi tshig /
yi ge'i skye gnas rnams dngos su thug nas sgra 'don pa'i rtsol ba/

bdag / phran bkra shis nas phul/

1.chung ngu dang, nyung shas sam cung zad/ rdul phran bu/ skyes phran bu/ kho'i yon tan phran bu 'phel 'dug / cha phran bu/ chu phran/ dka' tshegs phran bu thug 'phral dpa' ma 'khums/ 2.lus kyi gnad gsang zhig /
nyung zad dam cung zad tsam/ spyi rdzas phran bu tsam yang 'phro brlag btang na mi 'grig / yi ge phran bu tsam las mi shes/
nad gzhi che ba'i khongs su ma 'dus pa'i thor bu'i nad kyi nang tshan te, gre bar gra ma zug pa sogs nad chung ngu'i ming/
chung ngu'am nyung ngu/ ca lag phran tshegs/ yig rigs phran tshegs/ las don phran tshegs/

yo byad gsum gyi tshad du ma longs pa'i zhwa lham ska rags lhung bzed kyi snod sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs dang, mkho lhag yo byad kyi rgyur bsngos shing khru gang gi tshad du ma longs pa rnams so/
phra mo/ nyes pa phra'u tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa'i mi mthong rgyu dka' ba/ rta 'di 'jigs pa phra'u tsam gyis kyang 'drog chog chog cig 'dug /

(tha dad pa) phral ba, phral ba, phrol,, 1) 'dor ba dang, 'bral du 'jug pa, tha dad du byed pa/ rab byung gi rtags dang phral ba/ zug rngu phral ba/ dkrug shing brgyab nas mdza' bshes phral ba/ btsan dbang byas te bza' tsho kha phral ba/ 2) ral du 'jug pa/ gos phral nas g.yugs pa/
(rnying) phyi shun bud pa'i nang gi skyi shun/
thur du gzhol ba'i 'bab chu'i rgyug stangs shig / yur bu'i nang nas chu rgyun phri li li 'bab pa/
phar tshur bskur ba'i gtam mam yi ge / ngag phrin skyel ba/ yig phrin bskur ba/ lan phrin btang ba/ thag ring nas kha phrin sbring ba/ cha phrin sgug pa/ phrin ngan/ phrin bzang/ phrin bzhag pa/
1) gtam mngags pa'am las don gnyer ba/ 2) bod kyi sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa tshos chos skyong la 'dod don zhu gnyer byed lugs/
gnas lugs go byed kyi brda/

'phrin phar bskur ba la tshur byung ba'i lan/
mdzad spyod kyi 'phro 'du/ mdzad pa phrin las me ltar 'bar ba/ deng sang phrin las 'gro don che ba lags/
rgya'i rnal 'byor: sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi 'khrul ba bsal nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba ste rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi ya gyal zhig /
sangs rgyas kyi 'bras chos nyer lnga'i nang gses, zhi ba dang, rgyas pa dang, dbang ba dang, drag po dang, lhun gyis grub pa ste lnga/
(rnying) 1) phye ma/ 2) phub ma/ 3) rngog ma/ 4) sa zhing, phru slog /

lo na chung ba'am phra ba'i mi dang dud 'gro/ slob grwa'i phru gu/ lug gi phru gu/ bya yi phru gu/ mi yong na phru gu'i dus nas yong, rta yong na rte'u'i dus nas yong/ mo phyugs tshang mar dus thog nas phru gu 'khor 'jug pa/ phru gu chags yod pa'i rta phyugs rigs la bkol spyod sdug po ma byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la khye'u dang, bdag skyes, bu rgyud, byis pa, brang skyes, lus las 'phel bcas so/
(yul) skyes nas yun ring ma lon pa'i phru gu/
phru gu bde bar skye ba'i thabs shes/
1) phru gu skye ma ran gong du phyir thon nas shi ba/ 2) phru gu sa cha gzhan du rgyugs shor ba/
phru gu ngan lang du gtong ba/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam sbyor gyis phru gu slod par ma byed/
rdza ma'i dreg pa/ phru dreg gri yis gzhog pa/
rdza khog 'khrud byed kyi yo byad cig /
sla nga dang khog ma sogs thab tu btsugs pa/
rdza snod/ ming gi rnam grangs la khog ma dang, khol mo, btso rdza, zan rdza, g.yo snod bcas so,
/ 1) bu snod dam sha ma/ 2) dmag sgar/ ri la phru ma btab pa/ g.yul gyi bya ba rdzogs nas so so rang rang gi phru ma la ldog pa/ 3) rgyal po'i pho brang/
1) sa zhing rmo ba/ dpyid ka phru slog son 'debs dang, ston kha btsas ma rnga ba/ zhing pas phru slog cing 'dug / 2) sa zhing gsar du slog pa/
(rnying) sla nga thab tu btsud pa/
/ 1) phru gu'i bsdus tshig / bu phrug / slob phrug / dge phrug / dwa phrug / bya phrug / khyi phrug / phag phrug / 2) snam bu
snam bu spu phrug gi gdan/
btsugs phrug las bzos pa'i thul pa/
snam bu btags tshar rjes 'jam po bzo byed dang spu slong byed kyi yo byad cig /
1.'phrug pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) cha'am zung/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig / 2) sde tshan/ phyag dgu phrugs/ rlung dgu phrugs/ lnga phrugs/
/ 1) 'o mar phyur ba btab ste bsnyal ba'i skyo ma sla po/ 2) rus pa'i a phrum/
1. 1) phrum rus/ 2) dar skud kyis bzos pa'i sne rgyan/ 2.char chu sogs kyi rgyun 'bab tshul zhig / chu thigs phrum phrum 'bab pa/ mig chu phrum phrum 'bab pa/
1) zho'i snod/ 2) 'o ma dang dar ba bskol ba'i snyigs ma/
'o ma dang dar ba spyar nas bskol ba'i snyigs ma gsar pa/
(tha mi dad pa) thur du 'phyang ba/ gzhung sgo'i rgya phibs 'og tu sgam bzhu khra chem mer phrul 'dug /
1) 'dzar 'dzar du 'phyang tshul/ lcang ma'i yal ga gsar pa phrul phrul du 'phyang ba/ 2) sngar bod kyi sku drag mi drag tsho'i bud med gzab spros mdun ngos kyi lus rgyan zhig
phreng bsgrigs pa/ phru gu rnams phreng bkod byas nas lus rtsal sbyong ba/
phreng ba'i gzung thag / phreng rgyud mkhan/ gla rgyun gyis bzos pa'i phreng rgyud mkhregs po yong/
las don khag mang dkyus gcig tu phreng ba ltar bsgrigs pa/
sbreng tshar du bsgrigs pa/ lam chen g.yas g.yon du skye shing phreng bsgrigs kyis btsugs pa/
phreng ba byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags/
1) phyag na phreng ba can/ 2) gnod sbyin zhig
grangs ka 'dren byed phreng ba'i rdog po/

/ 1) sbreng ba'am go rim du bsgrid pa'i gral/ sku phreng/ yig phreng/ grog ma'i phreng ba/ gangs ri'i phreng ba/ sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba/ rba rlangs phreng ba/ me tog phreng ba 'dogs pa/ mu tig phreng ba/ phreng bar sgrig pa/ nyin zhag bdun gyi phreng ba/ rgyu skar phreng ba/ 2) rdog po mang po skud 'pa dang thag pa sogs la brgyus pa'am gcig rjes gcig bsgrigs pa'i dngos po/ grangs ka 'dren byed kyi phreng ba/
phreng rdog re re bzhin bsher zhing phud pa/ sngar byung sdug bsngal phreng ba rdog phud byas nas bgrangs pa/
bcu tshar te grangs gnas rtsi byed dngul lam zangs las bzos pa'i phreng chung yod pa'i 'dzar phod/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don snga ma snga mas dpe don phyi ma phyi ma'i gnas tshul gsal bar byed pa phreng ba lta bu'i rim par spel ba'i rgyan zhig /
gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, gsal bya phyi ma phyi ma'i don, gsal byed snga ma snga mas gsal bar byed pa ngag gi phreng bar spel ba'i rgyan zhig /
dge tshul gyi bslab bya blangs 'das so gsum gyi nang gses, rgyan gyi rigs byed phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan dang, spos nyug pa dang, kha dog 'chang ba ste gsum mo/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gting skyes rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
hril hril du chags tshul lam, 'od mdangs thon stangs shig / snga dro me tog gi steng du zil pa phrom phrom chags pa/ chu shel las rang mdangs can gyi 'od zer phrom phrom 'phro ba/
hril hril du chags tshul lam, 'od mdangs thon stangs shig / pad ma'i lo ma'i steng du chu'i zil pa phrom mer 'khor ba/ glog bzhu'i 'od phrom mer 'bar ba/
(yul) sa nas yar 'phag bzhin skor ba rgyag pa'i 'khrab stangs shig /

(tha dad pa) 'phags pa, 'phag pa, 'phogs,, gong du 'phar ba'am gyen du ldeg pa/ lus gyen du 'phags nas chu'i pha gir mchongs pa/ byi'u 'phag bzhin du 'phur ba/ ra ma 'phags nas ra khang mi shigs, tsi gu rgyugs nas byang lam mi chod/
1) lus 'phar tshul/ 'phag 'phag byas nas rtsed mo rtse sar phyin pa/ 2) chu 'khol che ba'i sgra/
lus sa las cung zad 'phag par byed tshul zhig / g.yul kha'i nang du byi'us 'phag tsam 'phag tsam byas nas 'bru rdog bsgrugs te za ba/
(yul) 'gul ldeg gam rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab/ rta gsar la thog mar zhon dus 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa/ gzig tshang sgo 'gram la gla bas 'phag 'tshag brgyab/
ri rab kyi lho phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen te rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
sngar rgya gar gyi yul zhig /
sangs rgyas dang byang sems sod skye bo khyad par can rnams/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 'phag pa'i 'das pa, 2.phul du byung ba/ lam lugs khyad du 'phags pa/ stobs shugs bla na 'phags pa/ 3. 1) theg dman gyi mthong lam thob pa dang theg chen gyi sa dang po thob pa yan chad/ 2) bod kyi chos lugs pas sangs rgyas dang, chos dang, dge 'dun sogs kyi mtshan gyi snga phyi la sbyor ba'i zhe sa/ sangs 'phags/ byang 'phags/ nyan thos 'phags pa/ rang rgyal 'phags pa/ 3) rje bo/ 1.(rnying) 'jug pa'am 'gro ba/

dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su bal yul lho mtshams su skyes pa'i tsan dan shing sdong gcig dum bu bzhir bcad pa las bzos pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku wa te dang, dbu khang, 'ja' ma li, lo keshwara: ste bzhi las wa ti zhes pa de bod ljongs skyid grong rdzong gi dgon par yod cing, lo keshwara: de lha sa'i rtse pho brang du yod, de min gzhan gnyis ni bal yul du yod/
sngar bal yul du tsan dan sdong po las rang bzhin gyis byung ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sku mched lnga'i nang gses 'ja' tshon ma/

dus rbas lnga pa tsam la rgya gar dbus su 'khrungs shing, rab tu byung nas, dbyig gnyen dang, dge 'dun skyabs bshes gnyen du bsten nas 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa mdzad pa po yin/

sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing lug lo gtsang gi sa skyar 'khrungs, chu glang lo sa pan skabs de'i hor yul shis lang du bskyod pa'i zhabs phyir byon pas se chen go be la dang mchod yon du 'brel, lcags sprel lo se chen rgyal sar thon pa'i dbu blar gyur nas hor yig gsar pa'i srol gtod rgyu khas blangs, shing byi lo bod kyi chos srid spyi khyab kyi 'gan khur blangs shing, shing glang lo bod du log snyan sgron zhus pa ltar shakya bzang por dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi khrims kyi byed po so wa'i si'i shel tham gnang ste gong ma'i lung gis bod kyi dpon chen bsko ba'i lam srol de nas btod, me yos lo yang bskyar pe cin du bcar, sa sbrul lo hor yig gsar pa gtan phab kyis phul te gong nas rgyal yongs su khyab bsgrags byas shing, phyin chad gzhung yig yod do cog hor yig gsar pa 'di dang yul khams so so rang gi yi ge nyis sbrags kyis 'grems dgos pa'i bka' lung phab, lcags rta lo rgyal po la gsang sngas kyi dbang chen lan gsum phul ba sogs kyi gtang rag gi yon du bande shed skyed ma zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang gyang ti'i tham ga'i kha yig tu gnam gyi 'og sa'i steng na rgya gar lha'i sras po sprul pa'i sangs rgyas yi ge rtsom mi rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug pa po gnas lnga rig pa'i pandi ta 'phags pa te shri zhes gsal ba zhig dang, bod khri skor bcu gsum sogs phul, rab byung lnga pa'i me byi lor bod du phyir phebs nas sa skya'i chos rgyal mdzad, dpon chen shakya bzang pos bod kyi khrims kyi byed po byas pas bod du sa skya bas chos srid zung 'brel gyi srol btod, dus skabs de dag nas bzung bod ljongs mes rgyal dang kha bral du mi rung ba'i mnga' khongs gras la dngos su gyur, rang lo zhe drug pa lcags 'brug la gshegs/ (1235-1280 )...1253.. .1260...1264...1265...1269... 1270...1276...
tsan dan sbrul snying gi khog pa las byung ba'i rang byung gi spyan ras gzid li dkar las grub pa zhig phyis su lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar bzhugs par grags/
(a'aryadewa) slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma mtshan snyan par grags pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig 'dis dbu ma bzhi brgya pa sod mdzad de klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa rgya cher bkral/
bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag /
gtor ma gtong skabs kyi mgron 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams/
1) 'phags lam/ 2) 'phags pa'i gang zag gis gsungs pa'i chos/
bden pa bzhi 'phad pas gzigs pa ltar gnas la, byis pa phal pas mthong ba ltar mi bden pas na 'phags pa'i bden pa zer/
dad pa dang, tshul khrims, thos pa, gtong ba, ngo tsha shes pa, khrel yod pa, shes rab ste bdun/
'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/
so skye'i sa las ring du 'phad pa'i lam gyi yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten du gyur pa'i sa ste, mthong sgom mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i sa rnams so/
byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gyi go 'phang thob pa rnams/
rgya gar gyi ming rnying pa/

sems gtsang la 'dod pa chung ba ste, zas gos gnas mal sogs ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa, spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyes bu dam pa dang, khrims gnas, dge slong, mchog nags na gnas, tshangs par spyod, rigs chen, rigs bzang, legs ldan bcas so,

'phags pa'i rigs la mnga' ba'i yon tan gyi khyad par bzhi ste, chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang, gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa, bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa, spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba bcas bzhi'o/
theg pa gsum gyi mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam rnams so/

yang dag pa'i lta ba dang, yang dag pa'i rtog pa, yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha', yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba, yang dag pa'i rtsol ba, yang dag pa'i dran pa, yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin bcas brgyad de byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang gses sde tshan zhig /
'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa/
/ 1) srid dam dpangs/ go 'phang/ khri 'phang/ nam mkha'i 'phang/ las khri 'phang mthon po/ dbu 'phang mthon po/ 'phang du dpag tshad du tsam/ 2) skud pa 'khel byed lag cha zhig /
'phang gis bal skud 'khal ba/ 'brog khul gyi ngal rtsol bud med tshang ma 'phang 'khel gyi las kar mkhas po yod/

bod rang skyong ljongs sne gdong rdzong khongs pho brang chus kyi ming rnying ste, sngar bod rje khri lde gtsug brtan nam, mes ag tshom can gyi bzhugs yul dang, de'i btsun mo rgya bza' kong jo phyi ma'i sras khri srong lde btsan gyi 'khrungs sa yin/
sngar bod rgyal khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs pa'i pho brang zhig /
1) pho brang 'phang thang ma/ 2) bod rje sad na legs mjing yon te khri lde srong btsan skabs gsar du bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag 'phang thang ma/
mdung zhags te, phar 'phangs te tshur 'then byed thag pa btags pa zhig /
/ 1) skud pa 'khal byed yog shing/ 2) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, 'bras bu ro mngar, nus pa snyoms, snying la tsha ba zhugs pa dang, mo nad la phan/
1) shing rta sogs kyi 'khor lo/ 2) pus mo'i lha nga/ 3) bal 'khal byed kyi 'phang lo/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis nang gi ming gzugs dang, skye mched drug reg pa, tshor ba bcas bzhi po 'phang ba'i yan lag tu bsdus pa/

rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan, ming gzugs kyi yan lag dang, skye mched kyi yan lag dang, rig pa'i yan lag dang, tshor ba'i yan lag bcas ni ma rig pas kun nas bslangs, 'du byed kyis las bsags, rnam shes la bag chags bgos nas 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu yin phyir 'phangs pa'i yan lag bzhi'o/
