bag ma gtong len gyi ched du brtsi ba'i tshes grangs dang gza' skar/
sems zhum pa/ bar chad byung ba tsam gyis bag 'khums na las don ji ltar 'grub/ dka' ba'i gnas la bag 'khums na, bya ba gang yang 'grub ma 'gyur/
, 1) gsal mi gsal gyi skad cha shod tshul/ bag gi bug gi'i gtam de gsal por go dka'/ 2) sa phug sogs chang ngi chung ngi/ de snga sa cha 'di la khang pa bag gi bug gi mang po 'dug /
, 'khril bag mi chags pa'i gos/ stod thung bag ge bog ge/ gu thung bag ge bog ge /
mna' ma len pa'i skabs la 'byung ba'i grib/
bag dro byin che ba dang 'dra,
bag ma gtong len gyi skabs su gtong ba'i glu/
bag dang ldan pa'am tshul ldan/

1) nang sems kyis phyi yul bzang ngan bar ma sna tshogs la goms pa song ba'i nus pa bag la nyal rnam shes kyi steng na 'gos yod pa'i cha'o/ bag chags ngan pa 'thug po zhig bsdad 'dug / 2) bya ba bzang ngan gyi shugs rkyen nam shan/ da res kyi 'thab 'dzing nang du khong gis bag chags bzang po bzhag song/ las kar sla bcos byas na bag chags ngan pa bzhag yong/
kun gzhi'i bag chags sam shes sgrib phra mo/
sbyang gzhi bar do lus gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, gnyid du song nas ma sad kyi bar rmi lam bar do ni tshe 'di'i bag chags sna tshogs rmi lam du 'byung bas rmi lam bag chags kyi lus so/
mngon brjod kyi bag chags, bdag lta'i bag chags, srid pa'i yan lag gi bag chags, rigs mthun pa'i bag chags te bzhi'o/
bag chags yang dag bcom pa

sgo gsum gyi gnas ngan len nyon shes kyi sa bon phra ba tsam du ma zad de dag gi bag chags tsam yang yang dag par bcom pa'am gtan nas med pa ste, zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi nang gses shig /
kar gling zhi khro'i le lag cig /
lus ngag yid bcas kyi bag chags gsum/
gro zan leb mor bzos pa'i 'khur ba/
ja bag khag gi don du go ba'i sbag chen dang 'dra,
lkog tu gyur pa'am mi mngon par gnas pa/ bag nyal gyi sdig pa/ bag la nyal gyi nyon mongs pa/

'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi bag nyal dang, khong khro'i bag nyal dang, srid pa'i 'dod chags kyi bag nyal dang, nga rgyal gyi bag nyal dang, ma rig pa'i bag nyal dang, lta ba'i bag nyal dang, the tshom gyi bag nyal bcas bdun po 'di dag so so'i phyogs mthun gyi gnas ngan len rnams la bag la nyal zhes bya'o/
bag ma blangs pa'i dga' ston/
gro zan ril mo btsos pa'i thug pa/
sems gu dog po/ spro thung ba'i mi'i sems bag dog po/
byin chags pa'am yid du 'ong ba/ mi bag dro ba// rnam 'gyur bag dro ba/ gnas khang bag dro ba/ kha bag dro ba/ skad cha bag dro ba/ glu gzhas bag dro ba/
gzi brjid che zhing bab chags pa/ khang bzang bag dro byin che ba/
gro zhib kyi skyo ma tshi can/
sems lhod por byas pa/ mi'i sems bag phab pa/
blo sems lhod po'am skyid por gyur pa/ blo bde bag phebs/ mi dmangs rnams bag phebs kyis thon skyed ngal rtsol byed du 'jug pa/ bag phebs pa'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs gleng ba/
nyams dga' zhing zang zing med pa/ mes rgyal gyi pang khar phyir log slebs dus sems ha cang bag phebs lhing 'jags shig byung/
gro zhib/ bag phye yag po yod na bag leb zhim po yong/
1) bag gi bug gi'i bsdus tshig 2) (rnying) brag phug
bag ge bog ge'i bsdus tshig

mna' ma gsar pa/ bag ma yag la bag ston gzab pa/ bag ma gtong ba/ bag ma len pa/ bag ma slong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khab 'dzin ma, khyim thab ma, khyim bdag mo, khyim 'dzin ma, khyim gsar ma, khyo 'dam ma, chung ma, chos bcas ma, mchis 'brang, nye bzung ma, dang po'i rdul can, bdag po'i brtul zhugs ma, mna' ma, bag gsar, rang dga' ma, rigs kyi ma, rigs skyong, lag pa 'dzin, lhan cig spyod bcas so,
1) bu mo mna' mar sbyin pa/ 2) bu la mna' ma len pa/
1) tshul min/ spyod tshul bag med/ 2) (mngon) chu mo glang lo/ rab byung lnga pa'i bag med kyi lo la bris/

1) ngo nongs mi shes pa'am, dge skyon la ji mi snyam pa'i sems byung zhig / kun spyod bag med pa/ bag med lhod g.yeng/ bag med longs spyod/ bag med 'ud shob/ bag med kyis gzan rgyag byed pa/ 2) bag tshi med pa/ ras dkar bag med pa/ 3) dri ma'am g.ya' med pa/ rul sungs kyi bag med pa/
cung zad tsam mam cha shas tsam mam tog tsam/ mar la sungs dri bag tsam kha/ nag nog bag tsam chags/ yon tan bag tsam 'dug /
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, gnod pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma gnyis kyi ya gyal, dge slong gzhan la snyad ka bag tsam yod pa la brten nas pham pa'i skur 'debs byas pa'o/
bag ma gtong len byed pa'i rtsis/
'jigs pa dang, zhum pa, mtsher ba/ mi rung las ngan spyod par bag tsha ba/ dka' las che sar 'gro rgyur bag mi tsha ba/
1) nyam nga ba med pa/ 2) (mngon) dpa' bo/
(yul) ngo tsha'am 'jigs skrag ches che ba/
ras dang dar gos sogs la gtong ba'i bag 'dag /
snum nang 'tshos pa'i bag leb sogs/
blo zhum pa/ snying stobs chung bas dka' ngal la bag mtsher ba/
bu mo bag mar 'gro bar sprod pa'i skal ba/
bag la zha ba'i bsdus tshig
blo 'khums pa/ rgyu mtshan yang dag mang po drangs nas tshar bcad de pha rol po'i blo bag zhum par byed pa/ pham nyes phran bu byung nas bag zhum pa'i mi de sdar ma red/
gro phye brdzis pa'i zan/ bag zan brdzis te bag leb bzos pa/
the tshom dang 'brel ba'i do snang/ mi ngan gyi bya spyod la rtag tu bag zon byed pa/
lag chang spong ba ste: chang 'thung na tshul khrims rdzogs kyang bag med par 'gyur bas de spong ba bag dang ldan par 'gyur ba/

1) dran pa brtan po yod pa, dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi ya gyal zhig ste blang dor gyi gnas la gzob pa lhur len pa srid zhi'i legs tshogs sgrub pa'i las can/ bag yod tshul mthun/ bag yod tshul gnas/ 2) bag tshi yod pa/ bag yod pa'i ras de spus ka yag po min/ 3) dri ma'am g.ya' yod pa/
mna' ma'am mag pa'i skyo grogs/
mna' ma'i g.yog mo'am zhal lta ma/
cung zad re/ dus tshod bag re tsam yang 'phro brlag tu ma btang ba/
mi mngon par gnas pa'am, mi mngon par gyur pa/
bsregs te bzos pa'i gro zan leb mo/ sha bag leb/ bu ram bag leb/ bag leb bsregs ma/
skyo log ste, bag ma rang khyim du thengs dang po log nas cung zad sdod pa'i ming/
gnyen log skabs mna' ma'i pha mar sprod rgyu'i lag rtags/

rim bzhin nam rim gyis/ rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang bar, bags kyis bsgrubs na ci yang 'grub/ grogs bzang gser gyi sbram bu dang 'dra 'go ba dka' ba, grogs ngan sbur ma dang 'dra ba de bags kyis 'go / lus phung bags kyis rgyas/ nad pa bags kyis sos/ zas bags kyis za/
/ 1) myur ba'i gom 'gros/ bang gtong ba/ bang rgyug pa/ bang mgyogs pa 'do ba rta dang 'dra/ 2) bya bang/

rgyug shugs sam rgyug rtsal/ rta dkyu sar rgyug shugs che drags pas bang kha thal ba/ ngag gi rtsed mo rtse tshod ma zin pa'i bang kha thal ba/ rkang 'khor gtong stangs mgyogs drags pas bang kha shor nas sa la dbyugs/ ston kha'i sprin pa bang kha mgyogs, bser ma byung na 'thor la shor/
'bru sogs blug snod kyi bang ba'am, khang pa/
phru gu skye skabs mngal nas byung ba'i khrag /
gyang logs su sbyar ba'i 'jog stegs/ dpe cha bang khri'i steng la bzhag /
1) rgyug stabs kyis 'gro mkhan/ 2) mchong 'gros byed pa/ ches mgyogs pa'i bang 'gros kyis bskyod/ bang 'gros pa sngangs snang skyes/
bang rtsal gyis song ba/ rta bzhon te bang brgyugs nas phyin pa/
pho nya'am gtam skyel mkhan/ bang chen 'byor nas gtam snyan bsgrags/ ming gi rnam grangs la nyan rna dang, gtam skyel, pho nya, 'phrin skyel, 'phrin khyer, bya ma rta bcas so,
mgyogs por 'dur rgyug byed pa/ rta bzhon te bang 'dur ba/
bod kyi goms srol ltar 'bru mdzod kyi nang nas thog mar bton pa'i 'bru phud/

1.(tha mi dad pa) bangs pa, bang ba,, rang bzhin gyis brlan pa/ bzha' tshan che sar bzhag pas bangs 'dug / rmi lam skyo po zhig rmis te gnyis sad pa dang sngas mchi mas bangs 'dug / 2.'bru sogs nor spyad 'jog yul/ 'bru bang/ rtsam bang/ bang ba 'bru yis gang na blo sems bde/
bang chen pa ste pho nya/ bang mi ched du thongs la brda sbyor gyis/
rgyug pa'i nus pa'am rtsal/ bzhon pa bang rtsal che ba/ mi bang rtsal che ba/ lus rtsal thang du bang rtsal bsdur ba/
bud med kyis phru gu btsas pa'i rjes su ma la mngal tshad dug thabs kyi nad gzhi bskyar du ldang ba zhig /
nor rdzas 'jog khang/ bang mdzod nor rdzas kyis gang ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la bkar khang dang, 'dun khang, mdzod khang bcas so,
bang mdzod lta bu'i sems bskyed

sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni dge ba'i tshogs mang po sdud pa'i gnas lta bu yin pas bang mdzod lta bu'o/
bang mdzod pa dang don gcig
yar mar brtsegs pa'i them rim/ rdo skas kyi bang rim/ mchod rten gyi bang rim/ las don snga phyi'i bang rim legs par bsgrigs pa,
1) phru gu skyes rjes kyi a ma'i nad drag pa/ 2) bang sangs gtong ba/
ro khang ngam ro sbed sa/ dpa' bo'i bang so la me tog phul ba/
ba mo ste rtswa rtser chags pa'i zil pa dkar po/ dgun dus bad kyis gshongs sa dkar/
khang thog pu shu'i 'dabs sne/ bye'u mchil pa bad kar sdod/
lus kyi cha shas su gtogs shing, rkyen dang phrad na rtsa ba'i nad gsum gyi ya gyal du'ang 'gyur ba zhig /
zas mgrin par thogs pa'i nad kyi bye brag
lus kyi rtsa ba'i bad kan lnga ste, rten byed dang, myag byed, myong byed, tshim byed, 'byor byed bcas so/
bad kan nad rigs drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, kha zas ma zhu bas rkyen byas nas pho ba'i nang sul du lcags kyi dreg pa ltar nag po chags nas kha zas mi 'ju ba skyug pa sogs 'byung ba zhig /
bad kan nad rigs drug gi nang tshan pho ba'i bad srin 'phel ba'i nad de, nad rtags su kha zas zos kyang 'grangs mi shes pa dang, sha skam zhing stobs chung la gsus pa shin tu che ba zhig /
bad kan rang gi ldang tshad rags pa'i dbang du byas na rang gi snyim pa bzhi yin pas de las 'phel bar gyur na nad du gyur te bad kan 'phel ba zhes zer/
bad kan rigs drug gi nang tshan, pho ba'i me drod nyams nas zas mi 'ju zhing mjug tu dmu skran du 'gyur ba zhig /
bad kan gyi bye brag cig /

nad kyi rang mdog la bltos nas btags pa'i 'dus nad mtshon byed kyi ming zhig ste, rlung gi rang mdog sngo, mkhris pa'i rang mdog ser, bad kan gyi rang mdog skya, khrag gi rang mdog dmar, chu ser gyi rang mdog ser smug bcas nyes gsum khrag chu ser bcas 'dus pa la smug po zer/
bad kan rang gi ldang tshad rags pa'i dbang du byas na rang gi snyim pa bzhi yin pas de las zad par gyur na nad du gyur te bad kan zad ces zer/
ma yi mngal nang lus chags pa'i skabs su khu khrag gnyis bad kan shas che ba'i rgyu des lus can de nyid kyang lus bongs che zhing sha rgyas la kha dog dkar ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i mi'i ming/
rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba'i bad kan gyi nad drug ste, lhen na dang, lcags dreg me nyams, mgul 'gags, grum bu dkar po, 'ju skem bcas so/
pa'i mo nad: mo nad bye brag pa zhig /

bad kan smug po ste, khrag ngan rgyas pa'i skabs la zer, nad rtags su mgo dang lus stod gzer zhing brang rgyab tu khrag thor 'byung ba dang, skabs re khrag bag tsam 'dres pa'i rgya bshal lta bu skyug pa zhig /
bad kan dang mkhris pa 'doms pa'i nad de, nad rtags zas mi 'ju zhing kha kha ba dang mgo bo lci la mtshog ma mi theg pa zhig /
1) khang pa'i bad ka'i sne/ 2) bad kan shas che ba'i mchu nad cig ste, nad rtags su mchu mdog skya bor 'gyur zhing slog pa chags nas skrangs pa zhig / 3) mchu'i zur/
(yul) gri thur shing bu sogs kyis brad rdar byed pa'i ming/ dreg pa bad bad gtong ba/
dgu pa'i dbugs thob nas ba mo 'bab pas bad nag: ces pa'i dus tshigs su slebs pa yin
(tha mi dad pa) 1) ngoms pa'am tshim pa/ sha zos nas bad pa/ 2) bzi ba/ chang gis bad nas gnyid log /
khang pa'i bad phur gnon byed rdo g.yam/
rgyu ma'i nang du gnas pa'i srin bu leb mor yang zer ba de'o/
1) ben dang 'dra, 2) ban de'i bsdus ming,
ban de rgan pa'i bsdus ming,
grwa pa chung chung ngam btsun chung/ ban chung ka kha dag por klog thub kyi 'dug /
grwa btsun chen po/ ban chen gyis bslab gsum nyams bzhes mdzad/
(legs) sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dge 'dun/ ban de ban de'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
1) grwa pa bgres pa/ 2) btsun pa bslab pa rgan pa/
btsun pa chen po ste, bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang khri ral pa can gyi skabs su thob thang blon chen gyi gong du yod pa'i btsun pa rnams la zer/
btsun pa dang bon po gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
thar thor dang, shag shig dang, zar zir sogs 'di yin 'di min nges bzung med pa'i tshul/ nyams snang ban ni bun ni/ rmi lam ban ni bun ni/ 'phros gtam ban ni bun ni/
grwa pa dbul po/ ban sprang yul mthar 'khyams te bsod snyoms slong/
ban ni bun ni'i bsdus tshig
ban de bon de'i bsdus ming,
grwa btsun te grwa pa dang btsun ma'i bsdus ming/ ban btsun rang kha rang gso byed/
dgon sde so so'i grwa pa 'byung sa'i khyim tshang/
btsun pa dang btsun ma'i cha byad can/
ban gzugs khrims ral lam khrims 'chal/
grwa pa chos ma thon par skya la bab pa/ ban log khyim du log ste gnas/
/ 1) babs dang 'dra, 2) bod lugs khang pa'i sgo thod mdzes rgyan gyi bye brag cig /
bod lugs khang pa'i sgo thod mdzes rgyan gyi bye brag cig /
ma brtags ma dpyad pa/ gdong thug skabs bsam 'char mi smra bar lkog nas bab col du brjod pa/ las ka bab col du thag gcod byas nas 'thus shor byung ba/ bab col gtam gyis gnad mi phigs/
(rnying) ma bsams par lan rgyag pa/
gnas tshul dngos la blta ba/ bab blta'i sgo nas don gcod pa/
go bab bam byed bab dang mthun pa/ slob ma so so'i blo rig gi bab dang mtshungs pa'i dpe khrid byas pa/
ma bsams par smra ba'am gang byung mang byung shod pa'i ming/ mi'i kha nas gang thon gyi skad cha bab bab smra ba la bden 'dzin ma byed/
zhag por sdod sa'am tshugs 'bab sa/ da nas bab mal lnga la tshwa khar slebs snyam/
khrims chad gtong dus chad 'bab ji tsam 'khris pa de'i bzhi zur re drung yig la smyug dod du sprod dgos par zer, de yang don dngos ni chad dngul zhig red/ bab gzigs, bab blta dang don gcig
bab brtan pa/ las ka bab brling ldan pa/ bab brling brtan gsum ldan pa/ bab brling yin mdog /
thob thang ngam gnas tshul/ dus babs/ gnas babs...go babs/ gros sdur byed babs la gzhigs nas thag gcod rgyu/
tsha drag gi ngag bkod shod ltangs shig ste nyes chad gcod kyi yin zhes pa'i don/
rang la babs pa'i 'gan khur/ rang rang gi babs khur bya ba legs par sgrub pa/
1) mdzes pa'am spam pa/ lus stobs babs chags pa/ 2) ran pa'am 'tshams pa/ gtam rjod lugs babs chags pa/ rnam 'gyur babs chags pa/
'bab sa'i stegs bu/ rta las 'bab dus babs stegs kyi steng du babs pa/
dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun par byas pa/ dngos yod gnas lugs la babs bstun gyis 'char gzhi 'ding ba/ yong sgor babs bstun byas nas 'gro song gtong ba/
'os thob bam 'os bab/ ngal rtsol gyi babs thob la gzhigs nas thob cha sprad pa/

lo re bzhin mi so sor babs pa'i spar kha la zer, de yang brtsi bya skyes pa yin na spar kha li thog nas g.yas su bskor bas lo grangs gar babs kyi spar kha dang, bud med kham thog nas g.yon du bskor bas lo grangs gar babs kyi spar kha'o/
gnas tshul dngos dang mthun pa'am 'os thob kyi 'brel ba/ babs 'brel chags pa'i gtam/ mi so so'i 'jon thang gi babs 'brel la gzhigs te las bgos rgyag pa/

skyes pa bud med gang yin yang gnam lo pho yin na dbus ma nas shar thon byang shar nas g.yon skor du brtsis pas lo grangs gang babs kyi sme ba dang, mo lo dbus nas shar thon g.yas skor du brtsis pas gang babs kyi sme ba'o/
'os tshod/ so so'i nus shugs kyi babs tshod la gzhigs pa'i las khur sprad pa/
gnas lugs yong rkyen go brda sprod pa/ rtsod gzhi thag gcod pa'i ched du phan tshun gnyis kar babs gsed byed pa/
brtan po/ btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la kha gtad 'jal rgyu'i gra sgrig babs lhing ldan pa zhig dgos/ gom pa babs lhing brtan gsum gyis mdun du spo ba/

1. ro ste, dbugs dang bral ba'i sems can gyi phung po/ 2. ming mtha' ba'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / ba...ri'i rgyab bam mdun phyogs/ lcags thab bam rdo thab/ 3. ming mtha' ba'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / ba...re 'dod bsam bzhin du 'grub bam, mi 'grub/ khong tsho'i dgongs par 'bab bam mi 'bab thugs bsam sgron/
mi shi ba'i ro sbos skrangs/
rgya rim pa bdun gyi gras, bam po mi 'khrug par byed pa'i rtags te bam po dang po zhes pa lta bu/
1) mi ro'i dri ma/ 2) rul dri/ sha rul nas bam dri kha/
(tha mi dad pa) rul ba/ ro rnam par bam pa/
dum bu dang, chun po'am chag pa/ glegs bam 'dir bam po brgyad yod/ me tog bam por 'ching ba/ me shing bam por bsdams te rgyab tu khur ba/
bam grangs kyi rgya dang don gcig
rgya rim pa bdun gyi gras, sho lo ka mi 'khrug par byed pa'i rtags te`` ,, ,,'' ? lta bu/
bam po zhes pa ni gzhung gi dum bu yin zhing, de'i tshad ni bam po rer sho lo ka sum brgya re'o, de'ang sho lo ka rer tsheg bar sum cu'am sum cu so gnyis re byed pa sna tshogs yod/
dbar dang, mtshams, dbrag / la gnyis bar/ chu gnyis bar/ rgya nag nas bod bar/ sngar nas da bar/ de'i bar/
bar bar du 'byung ba'i rkyen rigs/ las grwa 'dzugs yun la bar rkyen 'ga' shas byung myong yang skyon chen po ma shor ba/

1) dus snga phyi'i bar mtshams/ dmag 'khrug gnyis kyi bar skabs la chings sgrig dang, ngal gso'i dus tshod cig 'jog dgos/ 2) gnas skabs/ lugs srol de bar skabs shig la nub nas dar mi 'dug / bar skabs der mthun lam ma byung ba/
su bcad pa: rtsom yig tshig lhug gi bar bar du ngal gso'i snyan tshig spel ba'i tshigs bcad/
bar gyi bskal pa ste, bskal pa chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi so sor rang rang gi mgo brtsams pa nas mjug rdzogs pa'i bar gyi bskal pa chung ngu rnams te, gnas pa'i bar bskal nyi shu lta bu'o/

mi'i tshe lo dpag med nas tshe lo bcu'i bar bri ba de bar gyi ya thog ring mo'am bskal pa dang po dang, de nas yar lo brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel zhing mar lo bcu'i bar du bri ba de bar gyi bskal pa gnyis pa, de lta bu'i khug pa bco brgyad song mtshams slar yang tshe lo bcu nas brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel ba ni bar gyi ma thog ring mo'am bskal pa tha ma ste bsdoms pas bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu'o/
chags pa'i bskal pa, gnas pa'i bskal pa, 'jig pa'i bskal pa, stong pa'i bskal pa/
1) khang mig gsum gyi bar ma/ 2) thog brtsegs gsum gyi bar thog khang pa/

ya thog ring mo'i rjes nas ma thog ring mo'i bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad de tshe lo bcu pa nas yar brgyad khri'i bar 'phel ba dang, yang brgyad khri nas mar bcu pa'i bar bri ba de gnyis po gcig tu bsdus pa bar gyi bskal pa re'am bar gyi khug pa re re byas pa'i khug pa bco brgyad do/
nyo 'tshong phyogs gnyis kyi bar du za ba'i tshong khe/ bar khe za ba/

1) che chung mtho dma' mang nyung la sogs pa'i bar gyi khyad par/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying gnyis kyi lam lugs bzang ngan bar khyad che/ 2) ri mo dang ri mo'i bar gyi khyad par/ nyin tshes khyim zhag gi rtag longs so so'i bar khyad/
khang pa'i phyi nang gi bar du yod pa'i g.yab dkar gsal can/
bar gzab kyi gos/ de ring gyon chas bar gos shig gyon na legs/

sngar bod rgyal sum cu pa 'brong gnyan lde ru dang, so gcig pa stag ri gnyan gzigs gnyis kyi ming, lugs gzhan zhig la gdung rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan po dang, dgu pa bya khri btsan po gnyis la bar gyi steng gnyis zer/
spus ka'am che chung sogs 'bring gras/ gos chen bar gras/ ras snam bar gras/
gling chen gnyis gnyis kyi bar du chags pa'i gling phran rnams/
mdo sbug gnyis kyi bar mtshams kyi 'gag /
re 'ga'am thengs 'ga' / gnam gshis bar 'ga' la dwangs shing bar 'ga' la 'thibs pa/
mig gi rgya mo'i shun pags bar gyi 'grib rkyen/
bya ba dang dngos po dus rim zhig nas rim gyis dus rim gzhan zhig tu 'phel bar 'gro ba/ bar brgal dus skabs/

1) gnod byed kyi bgegs/ don sgrub par bar gcod 'byung yang dpa' ngar bskyed de sel thabs byed dgos/ 2) bar mtshams gcod pa/ nga tsho spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mdun lam bzang por skyod pa 'di stobs shugs gang gis kyang bar gcod byed mi thub/
dpe cha dang gsar 'gyur sogs kyi steng du don gsal byed du bar mtshams su bkod pa'i ri mo/

1) gnod rkyen nam gegs/ srog gi bar chad/ bde 'jags kyi bar chad/ 'gro lam du bar chad med par bde bgrod byung ba/ las don la bar chad gtong ba/ 2) rgyun chad dang, mtshams chad/ bzo grwa khag gi 'phrul 'khor rnams nyin mtshan kun tu bar chad med par gtong ba/
gnod rkyen yong ba'i phyi'i rtags mtshan/

ting nge 'dzin: ming de dag gis brjod pa'i don gyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab skyes pa ste de ma thag tu sa dang po gnon pa ste byang chub sems dpa'i mos pas spyod pa'i cha bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, rgyun mtha'i bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin te mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i rang 'bras rnam mkhyen dngos su skyed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go/
bar chad med lam dang don gcig
rang lam gyi sgrib pa spong byed kyi dngos gnyen du gyur cing, rang 'bras kyi ye shes phyi ma skyed pa la gzhan gyis bar du ma chod pa'i lam/

1) ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun gnas pa dang khyad par du 'gro ba la bar chad bzhi ste, ro myang can dang, nga rgyal shas che ba dang, ma rig pa shas che ba dang, lta ba shas che ba bcas so/ 2) sor sdom thob pa'i bar chad de, ma ning dang mtshams med byas pa sogs la sdom pa phog kyang mi skye bas skye ba'i bar chad dang, rgyal po dang pha mas ma gnang ba sogs la sdom pa skyes kyang rang dbang du ma gyur pas yun ring gnas pa'i bar chad dang, bya rog skrod mi nus pa'am nad dang sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa sogs la sdom pa gnas kyang bslab pa la sbyor mi bzod pas yon tan khyad par du 'gro ba'i bar chad dang, skra ser can dang lag rdum shan pa sogs kha dog dang dbyibs rigs sogs la skyon chags pa rnams kyis bslab pa la slob nus kyang bstan pa la ma dad pa'i rgyu byed pas mdzes pa'i bar chad bcas bzhi'o/ bar chod, bar chad dang 'dra,
mi dge ba: dge ba'i bar chad byed pa'i chos rnams/
bar gseng ngam stong cha/ khang chen phan tshun gyi bar stong sa cha/
(yul) bod kyi yul srol la ar las sogs las don rgya chen byed skabs kyi bar gyi ston mo/
rgyang thag ring thung gi tshad/ lung pa gnyis kyi bar thag ring ba/ dus skabs de nas bar thag ring po ma song ba/
(yul) rdo bzo sogs kyi tho ba 'bring ba/
khang pa thog brtsegs gsum gyi bar ma/
dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs bon po rgya bo byang chub kyis sangs rgyas pa'i chos kha bsgyur byas nas bon lugs dang bsres te brtsams pa'i bon gzhung de dag gi rjes 'brang rnams/
chos lung ston pa la mi 'jigs pa: mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig 'dod yon dang thar pa la chags sogs bar du gcod pa mngon sum du gzigs pas de ltar ston pa la rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/

'jug pa'i yid la byed pa: yid byed bzhi'i nang tshan, sems gnas dgu'i gsum pa bsdus te 'jog par byed pa dang, bzhi pa nye bar 'jog par byed pa dang, lnga pa dul bar byed pa, drug pa zhi bar byed pa, bdun pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa rnams kyi skabs su, bying rgod kyis bar du bcad nas thun ring po skyong mi nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
snga lus bor nas phyi lus ma thob pa/ rnam shes srid pa bar dor 'khyams/
sgyu lus kyi nang gses shig ste, yid las byung ba'i bar do'i lus dbang po kun tshang thogs med du rgyu ba'o/
snga ma'i lus rten bor nas phyi ma'i lus rten ma rnyed pa'i bar gyi sems can/
'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor: bar do'i skabs su grol ba'i sngags lam zhig /
sems can shi rjes rnam shes 'khyams sa'i lam 'phrang ring po/

gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba gsum gyi nang gses, gzugs khams kyi tshangs chen gyi bar do ma gtogs pa gzhan bcu drug gi bar do gang rung du nying mtshams sbyor ba'i rten de nyid la mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob pa ste, dge 'dun nyi shu'i gras shig /
bar dor mya ngan las 'da' ba gsum ste bar dor skyes ma thag tu 'da' ba gyur pa dang, bar do'i tshe dkyil du 'da' ba gyur pa ma yin pa dang, bar do'i tshe gzhug la 'da' ba yun ring mo bcas so/
mya ngan las 'da' ba: bar do'i skabs su mya ngan las 'da' nges kyi phyir mi 'ong ba/
(yul) thags khri'i ru gnyis bar gyi sgrog shing/
chos lugs pa'i shod srol ltar btsan dang rgyal 'gong sogs mi ma yin gyi sde tshan zhig /
kha mchu sogs bsdums te 'grig par byed thabs/ nang khul gyi rtsod gzhi la dge skyon gsed bkrol byas te bar 'dum byed pa/
bar 'dul kha che'i brgyud pa dang don gcig
klu sgrub nas rim bzhin brgyud pa'i mthar, phyis su kha che'i pan chen shakya shr'i las sa skya pan chen sogs bsnyen par rdzogs shing de las kyang rim par dar ba'i sdom rgyun/
las ka bdag sprod med par lus pa/ 'char gzhi zhig bting yod kyang lag len ji ltar bstar rgyu'i thad da dung bar lding du lus nas thag chod mi 'dug /
phyogs gnyis phan tshun ma mthun pa mthun par byed thabs/
rtsom pa'i sde tshan re re'i bar du sbyor ba'i sdom tshig tshigs bcad/ gzhung de'i bar sdom tshigs bcad gnyis pa/
phyogs gang du'ang ma 'dzul bar bar mtshams su yod pa/ bar gnas kyi rgyal khab/
thogs sgrib med pa nam mkha'i klong ngam mthongs/ sems bzang pos bar snang la rta rgyug 'dod kyang, rgyu dngos pos sbar mthil la so mi thebs/
don med re dogs kyi stong bsam dngos med khang chen gyi gzugs su bkod pa/ bar snang khang chen bskrun 'dod kyi 'khrul snang/

'dod lha rigs drug las, sum cu rtsa gsum dang, 'thab bral dang, dga' ldan dang, 'phrul dga' dang, gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bcas kyi lha rnams ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng gi bar snang la gnas pa'o/
/ 1) 'bring ba dang dkyil ma'i don du go ba'i bar ma dang 'dra, 2) cha dpang ste bar dpang/ 3) (mngon) bud med dar ma/
mtshams mtshams sam dus la la/ dgra dang drag po'i 'thab 'dzing byed pa'i bar bar du zhi ba'i gros mol yang byed kyin yod/
ba re bo re'i bsdus tshig
tshong dang 'khrug rtsod 'grig thabs byed pa/ 'jam mol gyi sgo nas phan tshun mthun 'grig gi bar byed pa/
sngar rgyal po'i phyi blon nang blon min pa'i las byed blon po/

bod yul stod smad bar gsum du phye ba'i bar phyogs de sngar chos rgyal srong btsan skabs gtsang la g.yas ru dang, ru lag dbus la dbu ru dang, g.yo ru ste ru bzhir phye ba de dag phyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun par g.yas ru dang, g.yon ru, sbus ru, gung ru zhes pa'i ming du bsgyur/
/ 1) 'bring ba dang dkyil ma/ le'u bar ma/ lam bar ma/ 2) glu dbyangs nges pa bdun gyi nang gses, khrung khrung sgra sgrog pa lta bu/ 3) gar mkhan ma/ 4) (mngon) rked pa/
rgyun ma chad pa/ nyin mtshan kun tu gtsang chu bar ma chad par 'bab pa/

1) spyi sa bar sa'am 'di yin nges bzung med pa/ mi tshang mas hur brtson cher bskyed kyis 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin par rang nyid gcig pu las khur 'di bya 'di byed med par bar ma do'i ngang du sdod mi nyan/ 2) snga ma'i lus rten bor nas phyi mi'i lus rten ma thob pa'i dus kyi srid pa/ 3) gtan 'khel med pa'i dus skabs lta bu/
mtshams ma bzhag pa// zla shas ring la las ka bar ma bzhag par mu mthud de byas pa/

dge bsnyen thob cing, dge tshul du ma gyur pa'i snga rol tu, dge tshul gyi brtul zhugs myur du thob par bya ba'i phyir du sbyor ba bar ma rab byung bsgrub pa ste yul khyad par can la zhu zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang, brje ba rnam gsum bya ba'o/
bar ma rab byung gi bslab bya
dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba, mkhan slob la gus par byed pa, khyim pa'i rtags spong ba, rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par len pa bzhi la gtso bor bslab pa'o/
grong khyer lha sa'i po t'a la'i nub phyogs kyi ri zhig ri'i sgang la kon ti lha khang yod pa der rgya mi'i lha khang zhes kha skad du bshad/
gnod pa'am gnod pa'i gzhi dag phyogs re spong ba'am phyogs re la 'jug pa/
mthun sgrig yong thabs kyi bden dpang byed mkhan/ kha mchu sdum pa'i bar mi byed pa/
1) rgyun mi 'chad pa/ nyin mtshan bar med du slob sbyong la brtson/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
gos sogs kyi bar tshangs/ srin bal bar btsangs can gyi gos shig /
bar mtshams/ dpe deb blug sgam nang gi bar tshags dam po brgyab song/
gos sogs kyi phyi nang gi bar du bcug pa'i nang tshangs/ dgun chas kyi bar tshangs srin bal gtong ba/
grong khyer ram tshong 'dus sogs nas dngos zog nyos te lung chung 'gar sil 'tshong rgyag mkhan/
1) tshong pa phan tshun bar du tshong sgrig thabs byed mkhan/ 2) tshong zog rtsag rtsig 'tshong mkhan/

1) dus snga phyi'i rgyun mtshams/ lo snga ma dang phyi ma'i bar mtshams/ 2) phan tshun dbar gyi bar stong/ pang leb kha sbyar ba'i bar mtshams/ g.yul 'gyed gnyis kyi bar mtshams/ las ka mtha' ma 'khyol bar bar mtshams mi 'jog / bar mtshams sa khul/
1) rgyun bcad pa,/ rims nad kyi bar mtshams bcad pa/ 2) las ka 'phro la bzhag pa/ 3) dbye ba phye ba/ las don gsar rnying bar mtshams bcad pa/
bar du 'tshang ga rgyag pa/ gzhan gyi skad cha'i khrod du bar 'tshang rgyag pa/ mgo sngas la shing bal bar 'tshang rgyag pa/
(yul) gsol zhib dang, dmangs rtsam min pa'i rtsam pa spus ka 'bring ba/
sngar yi ge sgyur skabs zhus dag la rogs ram byed mkhan lo rtsa ba/
g.yu spus ka'am bzang ngan 'bring po/
bar skabs sam nye lam/ bar lam ma mjal ring sku gzugs bde thang byung 'dug /
bar skabs kyi rtsod gleng/ bar lam 'then 'khyer gyis yul khams 'khrugs pa de lhing 'jags bzo dgos/
(yul) rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa 'bring gras/
sha dang, pags pa'i bar gyi skyi mo/
khang pa'i steng shod gang rung gi phar tshur 'gro lam/ bar shur ha cang dog pas 'gro 'ong dka'/
phan tshun dbar gyi dbyen dkrug / grogs po phan tshun gyi bar sel nam mkha' g.ya' dag ltar gtsang mar bsal ba/ mi rigs bar gyi bar sel med pa bzo ba/
grong nang khang pa phan tshun bar gyi srang lam/ grong khyer de'i bar srang gi g.yas g.yon du shing sdong btsugs pa/
bar do ba ste, 'jig rten 'dir gang gi snga ma'i 'chi srid dang, phyi ma'i skye srid kyi bar du byung ba'i srid pa/
gseng dbar/ sgo'i bar srubs/ pang leb kyi bar srubs/
bar stong/ sgo'i bar gseng nas bltas/ spyi don gyi bar gseng dang bstun zur khrid byed pa/
bar srubs sam khrod/ nags tshal gyi bar gseb nas bltas pas ri dwad mthong/
(yul) skabs skabs:/ bar hrag bar hrag las ka dang, bar hrag bar hrag slob sbyong byed pa/
'phrul 'khor dang tshigs pa sogs kyi bar mtshams/ gcus gzer btab nas 'phrul 'khor gyi bar lhu sgrig pa/
spu'i nang gses shig / lug bal/ shing bal/ sring bal/ yul bal/ bal 'jam po/ bal rtsub po/ bal 'breg pa/ bal 'bal ba/ bal gsed pa/
bal skud bsgrims pa/ sngon la bal bkal de nas snam bu btags/
bal gyi skud pa/ snam bu'i gos 'tshem byed bal skud legs shos red/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis 'brog dud khag la bkal ba'i bal gyi sgo khral/
(yul) bal gcus te bzos pa'i sgor sgor/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rang gi nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la bal 'khrud pa dang rmel ba dang 'tshod du 'jug pa'o/
bal po nas thon pa'i gur gum ste, nus pas mchin tshad sel/
bal po dang gor sha'i bsdus ming/
bal las btags pa'i gyon pa/
lug dang ra'i bal dang spu 'breg byed kyi gri/
lus stobs che la gom stabs myur ba'i glang chen gyi bye brag cig /
bal gyi rgyu dag / bal rgyu bzang na snam bu legs/
bal gcus te bzos pa'i bal do sgor mo/ tshwa ya bal gyis ma non na, bal sgor chu la sbang rgyu yin/
bal spu'i lhad ro/ bal snyigs kyis gos rgyu mi nyan/
bal yul du skye ba'i tig ta'i rigs shig /
1) bal gyis bzos pa'i thag pa/ 2) bal do 'ching byed kyi bal gcus/
bal do po/ bal do lnga brgya'i thon skyed byung/
bal yul nas thon pa'i dril bu/
bal bsed pa'i ling ling/ dgos med kyi tshig nyog bal 'dab rdo gnon du bzhag /
bal nag stan gyi spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, bal nag po 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i stan byed pa'o/
bal mo he le 'bar ma zhes ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas des btang bar grags pa'i 'go ba'i rims nad drag po zhig gi ming/
bal spu'i tshi sna'am dkyus/ bal sna ring thung la brten nas bzang ngan dbye ba/
lug bal las bzos pa'i snam bu/
1) rtswa dres ma/ bal pa dza'i thag pa/ 2) rtswa byi 'dzin/ 3) rtswa'i bye brag cig /
nee p'a la spyi dang nang gses kyi mi rigs shig la'ang/
bal yul nas thon pa'i gur kum/
bal yul nas thon pa'i se'u 'bru/ bal po'i se'u ma zos kyang, kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/
(yul) sngar bod du lha mo 'khrab dus kyi lag rnga zhig /
1) bal dang spu/ lug gi bal dang rta spu bsre mi rung/ 2) phyugs rigs kyi lus la skyes pa'i spu'i spyi ming/
shing sman gyi rigs dwa lis lo sdong ste, nus pas ma zhu ba dang, bad kan grang nad sel/
ston kha dang dpyid kar zhing bran gyis mnga' bdag gi lug bal 'breg pa'i khral zhig /
bal phying pa ltar gyur pa'am, bal 'phyings pa'i tshul/
bal yul nas thon pa'i sbub chal/
bal las byed mkhan gyi bud med/

bal mo bza' khri btsun te, bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo, bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo yin la, khong gis shing rta lor sangs rgyas shakya thub pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang, rang byon tsan dan gyi sgrol ma sogs sku gsung thud kyi rten sogs rdzongs skal du drangs, lha sa'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/
1) bal gyi zhag tshi/ 2) lug gi spu sna/
1) bod du bal gyi nyo tshong byed mkhan/ 2) bal nyo tshong/
(yul) snam ras sogs btags tshar rjes 'jam po bzo ba dang spu slong byed kyi yo byad cig /
(yul) bal las bzos pa'i zom lham/
sne mor srin bal dkris pa'i shing bu sman bcos kyi yo byad cig /
lug bal 'khal 'thag byed pa'i las ka/
bal yul nas thon pa'i sku 'dra li ma/
smyug mas bzos pa'i bal gsed byed/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis btang ba'i bal gyi sho khral sdud mkhan/
gnyan rims bal nad dang, lhog pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming/

1) las sgra dang 'jug pa mtshungs pa'i dgar sgra zhig / las...'tsho ba sngar bas kyang bzang ba/ mthun sgril de bas kyang dam zab che ba/ tha ma bas kyang ches tha ma/ 2) rgyu mtshan ston byed kyi phrad/ de lta bas na/
1) sa mtha'am yul mtha'/ grong gi bas mthar gnas pa/ gsar btsugs kyi bzo grwa grong khyer gyi bas mthar nye ba/ 2) dben gnas/ bas mthar sgo gsum dben par gnas/
pags nad kyi nang tshan ba yis bldags pa ltar gyi sha mdog gzhan dang ma 'dres pa 'brum chung skya zhib 'byung ba zhig
'dzad pa dang, mtha' dag pa, yongs su rdzogs pa/ kho bos shod rgyu de tsam kho nar bas pa/ rnam g.yeng nyid du bas pa/ dge rgan gyis kyang bas par bgyi dka' ba/
sngon 'jug ba yig gis byas pa, ba...
bi kra ma la shi la
(legs) tshul khrims dri ngad ldan pa'i dgon pa, rgya gar chu bo gangg'a'i 'gram na chags pa'i dgon chung zhig ste mnyam med jo bo a ti sha sogs pandi ta mang po bzhugs myong sa zhig /
(yul) 'pher sha tsha po/ 'byon rgyu med pa'i bi tshur tsha po/
(legs) rnam gzigs sam rnam par gzigs te sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi dang po/
(legs) dri med bshes gnyen te bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus bod du byon pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig /
dpag bsam shing 'bras te dzam bha la ser po'i phyag mtshan du bsnams pa/
rlung nad nang tshan lag sor gyi bya ba nyams pa zhig
rtsed chas mda'i rtse mor sgar byed shing ril sbubs can mig khung bzhi ldan sgra gsang po sgrog pa zhig /
(legs) rnam dag seng ge ste, bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus bod du byon pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig
bee shwa karman te lha'i bzo pa zhig /
(legs) khyab byed nag po ste, bong nga nag po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
lan tshwa'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur la lan tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas 'bras dang, skran bshig mig gi ling thog 'joms/
(bilba) shing 'bras dmar po zhig / bim pa lta bu'i mchu sgros dmar/ phru gu de'i gdong mdog bim pa ltar dmar ba/
bod mda'i me spar byed bir thig gam, a mdo'i yul la lar bir lto zer ba'i me thag 'jug snod/

ka bed pho mo rigs gnyis kyi nang nas chung ba mo rigs shig ste, ro skyur zhing bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas tsha 'khru gcod/ , (legs) 'bras bu tshig rus can gyi shing thog ku ba'am ka bed de, 'di'i 'bras bu'i shun skogs mthug po snod spyad du rung ba zhig /
1) shing tog bil ba'i 'bras bu/ 2) shing sman zhig
(legs) ku ba chen po'i shing ngam de'i shing thog
(legs) ku ba chung ba'i shing ngam de'i shing thog
1. 1) bu dang bu mo gnyis su phye ba'i pho'i ming/ pha bu gnyis/ 2) mi pho'i ming/ bu rgod po/ bu dpa' bo/ 2.tshig grogs shig / kham bu/ bong bu/ phran bu/ lam bu/
bu lon gyi skyed ka'i skyed ka/
sngar bu mo mang po skyes tshe bu skye ba'i rten 'brel gyi ched du bu mo'i ming la bu 'khrid ces ming btags yong/ bu 'khrid...
/ 1) dmig bu ste, dbus phyogs kyi yul skad la i khung zer/ sa 'og bu ga / lus la bu ga dgu yod kyang, za ba'i dbang cha kha red/ 2) lus kyi bu ga la dgu yod pas grangs dgu mtshon/
bu ga sgo dgu dang don gcig
mi'i lus la yul lnga'i shes pa sod rgyu ba'i sgo lta bu'i bu ga dgu ste, mig gnyis dang, rna ba gnyis, sna bug gnyis, kha, gshang lam, gci lam bcas so/
gzhang 'brum phyogs gang na yod med brtag byed kyi yo byad cig /
bu bu mo zhes pa'i bu'i gras/
bod kyi dgon sde che gras kyi dgon lag / bu dgon gyi byed sgo rnams ma dgon gyi srol ltar byed dgos/
rus rgyud gcig pa'i mi rabs rjes ma/ pha ma gcig gi bu rgyud nang bzhin/
1) gces pa'i bu phrug / 2) bu phrug la sha tsha byed pa/
nu zho nu mkhan dang, slob lo ma lon pa'i byis pa nyar gso byed sa/
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa kong po sa khul du yod pa yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig
1) mgron bu'i bye brag cig / 2) (mngon) bud med sbrum ma/
slob ma gtso bo/ thugs sras bu chen/

jo 'brom gnyis ka'i slob mar gyur pa bu rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis zhus te jo bo rje a ti shas gsungs pa 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs rnam thar mang po dang, mjug tu jo bo sku gshegs nas 'brom la bka' gdams bstan pa gtad tshul ston pa'i chos po ti zhig sprul pa'i glegs bam yang zer/
mi dang rta'i bsdus ming/ bu rta bzang gras bsdus pa/ bu rta gang hrag /

bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba, khro phu pa bu ston rin chen grub kyis rab byung lnga pa'i chu khyi lor bsgrigs, gsung 'bum lha sa'i par ma shog lhe khyon 212 nang brgya dang nyer gnyis yan chad rgya gar dang bal yul du dam pa'i chos byung tshul dang, de man chad bsil ljongs su bstan pa byung tshul, mjug tu bka' bstan bod du bsgyur to cog gi dkar chag kyang bkod yod pa'i lo rgyus khungs ma zhig / (1290-1364 )...212...ya...122...122...1322...

rab byung lnga pa'i lcad stag lo la gtsang shab smad du 'khrungs, bka' brgyud pa khro lo'i yang slob, zhwa lu chos sder 'chad nyan yun ring mdzad, rgya gar nas bod du 'gyur ba'i glegs bam mtha' dag zhib mor dpyad de bsgrigs rim snga phyi gtan 'bebs mdzad de bstan 'gyur de rnams gcig tu bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur, mdo sngags gnyis dang rig gnas che chung gi gzhung dang 'grel bshad brgya phrag du ma brtsams te gsung 'bum po ti nyi shu rtsa drug yod, de'i brgyud 'dzin rim byon rnams la zhwa lu ba'i grub mtha'am bu lugs zhes grags, rje tsong kha pas de'i slob ma las rgyud kyi skor gsan, rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug la 'das/ (1290-1364)...
1) ma deb la brten nas bshus pa'i bu deb/ 2) sngar bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung skabs mnga' bdag gi zhing khral bsdu byed deb/
bu tshab/ bu dod cig blangs pa rig pa rno/
'byung rtsis nang ma la brten nas bu'i gnas tshul rtsi ba'i thabs shig /
'ong ba'i bu:/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa'i bu sdug cig skyes/
1) phru gu skyes rjes kyi ma'i nad/ bu nad drungs nas dwangs/ bu nad log pa,/ 2) phru gu skye ba'i zug / bu nad kyis gzer nas bu btsa' la khad du 'dug /
bu rgyud dang nor longs spyod/ bu nor gnyis 'dzoms/
phru gu ma'i mngal du sdod sa'i snod/
phru gu chags snod mtshan ma nas phyir thon pa/
bris bshus zin pa'i dpe cha gsar pa/ ma dpe dang bu dpe bsdur te zhus dag btang ba/ ma yig la brten nas bu dpe bshus pa/
pha'am ma gcig pa yin pa'i bu rgan gzhon/
mi'i phru gu/ pha phyug po'i bu phrug skyid lang red/
bu ma phyin pa'i mo nad
bu skye ma thub pa'i mo nad/
bu dang bu mo gnyis su phye ba'i mo'i ming/ bshad sa bu mo dang phog sa mna' ma/ bu mo skyo sar a mas mi phan/
bcom ldan 'das la 'o thug 'bul mkhan bu mo zhig /
1) skyes pa dang ma phrad pa'i bu mo/ 2) rang gi khyo ga ma gtogs khyo ga byung ma myong ba/
lang tsho rgyas pa'i bu mo/
pha'am ma gcig pa'i bu mo rgan pa/
'phang lag tu bzung ba'i bu mo ste, gna' dus su blo khog med pa'i mi'i ming 'dogs la zer/
skyes pa ma phrad pa'i bu mo/
lang tsho dar sgang gi na chung ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'thab mo can ma dang, na chung ma, nor ldan ma, phyogs med ma, bu mo gzhon ma, ma 'ongs rdul can, lang tsho dang po bcas so,
bcom ldan 'das la 'o thug 'bul mkhan gyi bu mo zhig /
nyi ma'i khyim gyi drug pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar bcu gcig dang chu tshod bco lnga shar tshe nyi ma bu mo'i khyim du spyod, ming don khyim bcu gnyis kyi thad na gsal/
1) ma dang bu mo/ 2) (yul) bud med/

1) ma bu dgra grogs kyi 'byung ba rtsi skabs shing bu me lta bu bu dang 'phrad pa de la bu rtsa zhes zer/ 2) bud med kyi mngal du bu chags nas zla ba lnga lon skabs mkhrig ma'i 'phar rtsa'i sgo nas mngal gnas de bu dang bu mo gang yin brtag thabs shig / 3) bu tsha yong rgyu yod med sogs brtag pa'i pha ma'i lus kyi 'phar rtsa zhig /
1) bu dang bu'i bu/ 2) bu dang tsha bo/
bu tsha yang tsha gsum tsha
rang gi lus las mched pa bu, de las mched pa tsha bo, de las mched pa yang tsha, de las kyang mched pa gsum tsha/
gzhan gyi bu rang gi bur gsos pa'i bu dod/
bu phrug yod pa'i bud med/
bu phrug skyong mkhan bud med/
kha ba dang rlung mnyam 'tshub kyis 'bab pa'i ming/ la khar slebs dus glo bur du bu yug 'tshub pa/
bu'i dod dam tshab, bu yar yang snang/

1) bu ram shing gi khu ba las bzos pa'i mngar cha/ zhim rgyu bu ram zhim yang, za rgyun rtsam pa ring ba/ 2) ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rlung nad 'joms, drod skyed, lus stobs nyams pa gso, rlung nad la phan pa'i sman gyi nus pa rtsar 'khrid par byed/
bzhus bsgar byas pa'i bu ram/
bu ram rdog rdog bzo ba/
bu ram mar khu'i nang du bsgar ba'i mngar cha/
ting la par brgyab pa'i bu ram dang shel ka ra mchod ting gi dbyibs can/
1) bu ram bzhus pa'i khu ba rnyog ma med pa/ 2) lhad med pa'i bu ram/
bu ram spus ka zhan pa zhig /
bu ram bzo byed kyi shing/
1) sngar rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas shakya thub pa'i rigs rus/ 2) (mngon) sangs rgyas shakya thub pa'i mtshan/
1) mngal nas sha ma ma thon pa/ 2) phru gu shi ba'i ro mngal du bsdad pa/
dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs su byung ba'i zha lu bu ston rin chen grub kyi rjes su 'brang mkhan/

'bru dngul sogs g.yar bar skyed kha sprod len byed pa zhig / skyed lci'i bu lon/ skyed yang bu lon/ dom chags bu lon/ lan chags bu lon/ bu lon zug pa/ bu lon chags pa/ bu lon 'jal ba/ bu lon gtong ba/ bu lon dag pa/ bu lon 'phrod pa/ bu lon gsob pa/ bu lon len pa/ bu lon sel ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la dom dang, 'bun skyed, gzung ba bcas so,
phar g.yar ba'i bu lon gyi dngos po tshur 'khyer shog ces dza drag gi skul lcag gtong ba/ zhing bdag gis bu lon tsha 'ded byed stangs de bya rgod sha la 'grim pa dang 'dra/
pha ma gcig pa'i ming sring/ bu sring gnyis po yar thon gyi lag rtsal la byang chub pa 'dug /
nye gnas sam sgrub btsun sogs slob ma/
'bab chu zhig chu 'go mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs then cun rdzong gi lho nub phyogs nas byung ste mthar mtsho sngon por 'bab, de'i stod rgyud la shar dge chu zer/
bug pa'i sgo / bug sgo'i nang nas phyi rol mthong/ dgun dus su bug sgo 'dag sbyar byed pa/
i khung rdol ba'am bug pa rdol ba/

khung bu'am bu ga / khab kyi bug pa/ rtsig par yod pa'i bug pa bkag nas khegs pa/ rdza khog gi mthil du bug pa rdol ba/ lcags leb la 'phrul 'khor gyis bug pa brtol ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khung bu dang, khong stong, pad ma'i mig bu ga , rlung 'byung, sa mthongs bcas so,
bug pa dbyung ba'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gtsug lag khang gi steng thog snyi ba la khri rkang rnon pas btsugs te steng du ljid phab nas bug pa phug pa'o/
(yul) rul dri la dga' ba'i srin bu gnod pa can sbrang nag /

/ 1) sbrang ma'am sbrang bu spyi'i ming/ sbrang tshang du bung bas sbrang rtsi gsog pa/ sha rul la bung ba mang po 'du ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang drug dang, 'khor 'gro, 'khor byed, rgyan can, mchog sbyin, sbrang rtsi 'joms, sbrang rtsi 'thung, sbrang rtsi byed pa, sbrang rtsi myong, sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs, me tog 'thung, me tog myong, g.yo byed, ra yig gnyis pa bcas so, 2) (mngon) rdo stang zil/
1) sbrang ma nag po/ 2) (mngon) rdo stang zil gyi mdog /
1) sbrang ma'i tshang/ 2) glo nad bye brag pa zhig lud pa'i dri ngan kha zhing mdog sngo ba, nang la rnag thig mang ba nya mig lta bu yod pas ming de ltar btags/
rgya khyon cher btang ba/ chu rdzing bungs bskyed gtong ba/
rgya khyon gyi stobs/ thon zog bungs tshan/ khang pa'i bungs tshan/
mthar skrod pa'i don du go ba'i 'bud pa'i skul tshig
sdod mkhan gyis stongs pa'i grong pa/
yun ring stong bar lus pa'i khang pa dang, sa zhing sogs/
mi rgyud bud de khyim stongs pa/ snga dus gzhan dbang bshu gzhog gis mnar bas khyim tsho ma zin par bud stongs su phyin pa/
khang khyim 'thor nas mi rnams yul gzhan du 'khyar ba/ sngar bud stongs yul gyar gyi mi rnams da lta bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba thob pa/
(legs) sangs rgyas/ bud dha yi 'bri srol gzhan zhig
(legs) sangs rgyas bskyangs te, rgya gar gyi dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' smra ba'i slob dpon zhig /
(legs) slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa shes 'grel pa ste, gzhung gsung ba po'i sgo nas mtshan btags pa/
(legs) bod du phebs myong ba'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig /

1.(tha mi dad pa) logs su'am phyir thon pa/ rkang lag gi tshigs bud pa/ khyim nas bud pa/ skra tshang ma bud nas mgo dmar chags pa/ so bud pa/ mdun du skyod skabs dpung sde'i gral star nas bud de lam phyogs brlag pa/ 2.mthar skrod pa'i don du go ba'i 'bud pa'i 'das pa,
skye dman nam lus phra ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba mo dang, skyed ma, sgra can ma, gnas byed, mi mo, mtshams ldan ma, 'dzin ma, lan bu can bcas so,
rigs dang chos dang rgyal mtshan gyis bsrungs te khyo bo dang ma phrad pa'i bud med/
(mngon) bud med zla mtshan ldan ma/

bud med mtshar sdug can/ ming gi rnam grangs la rked med ma, kha dog mchog glang chen 'gros, dga' byed ma, dga' ma, sgeg mo, mchog gi lcug ma, mchog ldan ma, 'jigs can, 'dod ldan ma, 'dod ma, sdug gu ma, mig yangs ma, myos gsal ma, smad chen ma, mtshan ldan ma, mdzes ma, zla zhal ma, yan lag mchog ldan ma, yid 'ong ma, g.yon mig ma, rab skyes, rab myos ma, ri dwags mig can ma, lus mchog ma, lus phra ma, lus bzang ma bcas so,
bud med sems ma dul ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khro byed ma dang, 'jigs byed ma, gtum mo bcas so,
gcig tu nyal ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, khrims grogs med par mtshams nang gcig tu bud med dang nub gcig lhan du gnas pa'o/
cig tu 'gro ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lhan cig tu khrims grogs med par rgyang grags las 'das pa'i lam du 'gro ba'o/
bud med na tshod dam lang tsho gzhon ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la khengs ldan ma dang, dar bab ma, dregs ldan ma, rdul bcas ma, bar pa myos ma, me tog gsar, rtse dga' ma, lang tsho ma bcas so,

bud med 'dod chags che ba/ ming gi rnam hgrangs la 'khrig pa'i dga' ston ma dang, mngon 'gro ma, chags ldan ma, dus gdab ma, 'dod 'gro ma, 'phyon ma, dben 'gro ma, myos pa'i phreng ldan ma, g.yel ma, rigs myur ma bcas so,
zla mtshan 'bab pa'i skabs kyi bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la rked nad can ma dang, khrag ldan ma, dus ldan ma, bud med chos ldan ma, me tog ldan ma bcas so,
ston pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, skyes pa gzhan med pa'i sar bud med la tshig lnga drug las mang ba'i chos ston pa'o/
blo gros dang ldan pa'i bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la mkhas ma dang, rnam mkhas ma, blo ldan ma, shes ldan ma bcas so,
1) mer 'bud bya'i shing/ ming gi rnam grangs la sbar bya dang, me shing, 'tshed shing, yam shing, shing skam, bsreg bya bcas so, 2) sbyin sreg gi yam shing/
bu lon gyi bsdus ming/ dngul bun/ 'bru bun/
1) bu lon dang skyed ka/ 2) bu lon gyi skyed ka/ bun skyed lci mos dbul thog dbul brtsegs byung/
bu lon sprod len bya rgyu'i dngul/ bun dngul 'jal ba/
bu lon gyi dngos po bsnyegs te len pa/ sprod dmigs zhan la bun 'ded mang ba snga dus kyi bun len dbul phongs kyi snang tshul la ltos/
lang long du 'phyur stangs shig / chu bun bun du 'khol/ byi bas sa khung bun bun 'bru/ chu mig bun bun du rdol/
bun bdag dang bun len gyi 'brel ba/ sprad nas 'phrod rgyu med pa'i bun 'brel/
bu lon phar sprod tshur len gyi yi ge /
phran bu re/ byas rjes bun re/ nyams myong bun re/ ma dngul bun re/
1) 'bru dngul gyi bu lon len mkhan/ 2) bu lon len pa/
pham kha/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin, gyong dang bub ka rang gis len/
gyong gud che drags pa'am ha log pa/
ras snam sogs yug ril po'am, cha tshang/
dngos po gang rung cha tshang ba/ gos chen bubs tshang gcig / lug sha bubs tshang/
snam ras sogs yug tshang ngam yug hril/ ras cha bubs ril/
yug tshang/ gos chen bubs long/

bum pa lhar bskyed pa dang, gzungs thag rdo rjes bum lha'i rgyud bskul ba, dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul bas lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur pa sogs cho ga bzhin bum pa bsgrub pa'o/
nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis kyi gras shig ste khyim bcu gcig pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar gnas nyer gnyis dang chu tshod sum cu 'char tshe nyi ma bum pa'i khyim du spyod/ 30...

1) bum pa'i nang gi chu/ 2) 'bab chu zhig chu 'go bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnya' nang rdzong gi byang rgyud lha rgod gangs ri'i lho ngos nas byung zhing ding ri rdzong dang gting skyes rdzong brgyud nas bal yul du 'bab/
bum par g.yog bya'i kha btags/
yon tan phyir mi ngoms pa'i dpe/
/ 1) kha g.yer ba dang lto ldir ba'i snod cig / chang gi bum pa/ me tog bum pa/ snag bum/ 2) chu 'khor dang lag mchig gi 'bru blug khung/
rang la yod pa'i gdam ngag sogs gang yod bu slob tshang mar blsabs pa'i dpe/
1) rlung sgom thabs shig / 2) (mngon) me tog pad ma/

dbang gi sta gon gyi cho ga'i nang gses shig ste, bum pa'i rgyu dang mtshan nyid dang grangs dang nang gi bcud dang mgul chings dang kha rgyan la sogs pa tshul bzhin du byas la, der dam tshig gi lha bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur la mchod cing bstod de bzlas pa bya ba'o/
1) 'dod 'jo'i bum pa ste rgyal srid sna bdun gyi nang gses shig / 2) yul srol rnying par g.yang rdzas blugs nas sa 'og gter du sbas pa'i bum pa/
bum pa de bum pa rang gi phyogs cha yin pa'i cha de nyid de, cha rang rang gi phyogs de la rang gi ldog pa zhes pa'o/

rgyud sde phyi nang thun mong du bskur ba'i smin byed kyi dbang ste, rdul tshon dang ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas chu dang dbu rgyan sogs slob ma'i lus la bskur zhing lus kyi dri ma sbyangs nas, lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul ba'i sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog byed kyi dbang/

chu dang, cod pan, rdo rje, dril bu, ming dbang ste slob ma'i dbang lnga dang, rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang sngags kyi dbang, lung bstan dang dbugs dbyung gnyis gcig tu mdzad pa'i dbang, rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang, spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang, rjes gnang bcas bcu gcig /
chang 'bebs skabs sbang glum 'tshod snod kyi rdza ma/
bum chu'i nang du 'debs rgyu'i rdzas/

nas dang, gze ma, gro gsum po mnyam du btsos nas bsnyal ba'i glum la bu ram gyi chus bsings pa'i chang ste, nus pas rlung nad spyi dang khyad par du glo snying mkhal mar zhugs pa'i rlung dang rus pa'i rlung tshabs rnams sel/
bu ram mar phyur rnams brdzis pa'i thud/
bu ram shing/ ming gi rnam grangs la bcud 'dzin dang ro mngar shing ngo,
ja khu 'don byed kyi bul tog /
dal ba'i gom stabs/ bul 'gros mtshams ma bzhag na rus sbal thag ring du sleb yong/
1) ja'i khu ba 'don byed cu gang 'dra ba zhig / 2) lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, ro mngar la lan tsha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas kha zas 'ju, glang thabs 'joms, sbos pa gzhil, rma rul ba gso/
dal ba sogs kyi don du go ba'i bul ba dang 'dra,
1.lus kyi rtsa 'phar stangs dal ba/ 2.dal ba'am 'gor ba/ rta las bong bu bul/ las ka'i sa phyod mgyogs bul ran pa/ gom 'gros bul ba/ rkya pa'i lcag gis ma bskul na, brtson 'grus rta yi bgrod pa bul/
dal bu dal bu/ 'phrul 'khor bul bul du gtong ba/ lam du bul bul byas nas yong ba/
gtong ba'i don du go ba'i 'bud pa'i skul tshig
1.gtong ba'i don du go ba'i 'bud pa'i 'das pa, 2.byis pa chung chung/ bus pa'i lad mo rgan pas byed/
(yul) nags chen du gnas pa'i srog chags sre mong las chung zhing yang rtsal shin tu che ba, mjug ma'i spu ring la sbom pa mthong 'dod pa zhig /
shing be do'i tshi ba ste, ro bska la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gre thor dang gre tshad 'joms/
gzhan la 'go ba'i rims nad sib bu'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
dbyu gu'am rgyug pa/ mkhregs shing gi be con/
be shing gi logs su skyes pa'i re ral gyi rigs shig ste, nus pas sha dug dang, sbyar dug sogs dug nad kun la phan/
shing sman zhig ste, rtag tu sngo ba'i shing sdong zhig shing tog za rung/ ming gi rnam grangs la ta la'i rgyal po dang, 'bras bu rtag 'bras bu'i phung po, gshol ldan, sa 'tsho 'dab bcas so,
dbus phyogs su be rdo dang, khams dang a mdor be lo zer ba'i shing zhig be do bris pa'ang yod/

1) snabs/ 2) kha zas kyi snyigs ma las byung ba'i pho ba'i nang gi 'byar bag gi tshi dang ldan pa be'u'i ngar snabs lta bu pho ba'i bad kan yang zer ba de'o/ 3) rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag sbyor, rmen ngan 'joms, rma'i sha'u skye bar byed/
shing be nag gi 'bras bu mon cha ra ste, ro bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas 'khru ba gcod/
(yul) za phrugs langs pa'i thor nad cig /
mgo chag gi rus pa 'don byed yo byad cig /
sra zhing mkhregs pa'i shing shig /

(legs) 1) rnam par snang mdzad/ 2) bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan skabs snye mo gan jag ba gor zer ba'i sras su 'khrungs shing, bsam yas su bod kyi rab byung thog mar sgrub dus btsun pa len nam mi len tshod lta byas pa'i sad mi mi bdun gyi ya gyal dang, lo tsa ba rgan gsum gyi nang tshan zhig kyang yin, 'dis rig pa drug cu pa mdor bshad dang, snang mtha'i mtshan brjod sogs bsgyur/
/ 1) mgon po beng zhes lha'i bye brag cig / 2) lha'i phyag mtshan beng dbyug /
lag cha dbyug pa chen po ste bzo dbyibs gru bzhi dang, rtse mo'i ngos bzhi 'bigs dang 'dra ba lha'i phyag mtshan khyad par can zhig /
khe phan nam dgos pa/ mkho bed/ go bed/ khe bed/ sa bed/ chu bed/ dngos po bed yod du bsgyur ba/ bed chod pa dngos po'i mtshan nyid yin/
bed bcad nas chod pa ste, phan thogs pa/ lag cha gcig legs bcos byas nas mkho chas mang po'i bed chod song/ nad gzhi dang mi 'phrod pa'i sman mang po btang yang drag skyed kyi bed ma chod/
longs su spyod pa/ za 'bru bed spyod mkhas po byed pa/ nyin mkho'i yo byad kyi phan nus ma rdzogs bar du bed spyod pa/
longs su spyod rung ba/ shing gdung yin yang lcags gdung gtong sar bed spyod 'pher/
(rgya) ban yang zer, chang dang chu blug sa'i snod/ chang ben/ chu ben/ dung ben/ chu 'chu bar phyin nas ben stong par mi log /
ben snod du blugs pa'i chang/

/ 1) sems med pa'am, srog bral gyi dngos po/ bem po ltar lkugs pa/ bem dngos bzhin du tshugs thub pa/ 2) lhan pa mang po brtsegs pa'i mal gos mthug po/ bem po sum brtsegs 'khyag dogs med/ bem po brtsegs na dro// 3) rdul du grub pa ste, rang nyid rdul rdzas yin pa'i gzugs kyi dngos po rnams so/
yon tan med par yod mdog gis kha shob rdzig po shod mkhan/
'brum bu dkar po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
lus dang shes pa/ gdams ngag nyams rtogs ci yod de, rang nyid bem rig bral nyin gsal/
lus sems bral ba ste shi ba/
sems ldan dang sems med/ bem shes gcig par thal ba'i skyon/
'bri dang, ba mdzo'i phru gu spyi'i ming/ mngal chags pa'i ma phyugs la bdag sprod yag po ma byas pas be'u shor ba/ be'u chung ma yi rjes su 'brang/
(yul) 'bri dang ba phyugs kyi phru gu'i lhas te be'u tshang yang zer/
be'u ljang sngon gyis 'drid pa ltar mgo skor ram, slu 'drid byed pa'i dpe/ ma rungs khog bcangs kyis be'u ljang 'drid lta bu'i rogs ram byed khul la dang len byed rgyu med/
be'u rnams bstar bsgrigs te 'dogs sa'i thag pa/
1) 'bri sogs kyis be'u lces ldag pa/ 2) (yul) mi'i khar skye ba'i rma shu'i rigs shig /
1) be'u/ 2) ngos gnyis kar spu shin tu ring po yod pa'i snam gos/
man ngag mang po bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam chung ngu/

bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes glang thang pas dmigs pa rnams sa bcad brgyad du mdzad pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma la zer bar grags shing, sha'o sgang pa'i blo sbyong zer ba de yin nam snyam zhes thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i grub mtha' las bshad/
bka' gdams pa'i byang chub lam rim gyi skor dge bshes po to ba'i gsung sgros ltar dol pa shes rab rgya mtshos bsgrigs pa zhig /
ngos gnyis kar spu yod pa'i ras,
lag 'khar ram dbyug pa/ sba ber/ shing ber/
shing ber dos bzos pa'i ber dbyug 'di sngar khrims chas su spyod pa zhig /
ber ma lcag gi bsdus tshig
mkhregs shing gi rigs shig ste be rdo'am be lo yang zer/
sngags pa'i chas kyi gos nag po zhig /
dbyug pa dang rta lcag gnyis kar go chod pa'i ber rgyug lcag tshan can/
ber do'i sdong po'i khrod du skyes pa'i sha mo/
mkhregs shing ber dos bzos pa'i gshol/
shing ber do bsregs pa'i sol ba/
be'u/ 'bri bel/ ba bel/ bel pho mo/
mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis sbyar ba'i shugs kyis gtogs pa'i sgra/
1) bad kan gyi skyugs pa/ 2) me rdo legs pa 'od can zhig / 3) rdo sman zhig /
1.ming gi cha shas shig / kha dog skya bo/ chu bo/ ri bo/ 2.sum 'grel 'gar pho mtshon par byed pa'i bdag sgra la 'jug par bshad/ 3.ba mthar sbyar rgyu slar bsdu'i phrad cig / ba...
snod nang gi chu sogs bo dang, snod sogs sgyel ba'am 'gril ba/ ma mthong bo sgyel sna tshogs byed/
(rgya) 'phreng ba'i rgyur rung ba shing 'bras kyi tshi gu zhig /
bod ljongs gzhis rtse sa khul gyi sa cha zhig 'dir bo dong e'i dgon pa yod/
bo dong pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan/

'di la phyogs las rnam rgyal dang, 'jigs med grags pa, chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig yod, rab byung drug pa'i shing yos la 'khrungs, rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags lug la 'das, bo dong e'i bshad grwa las thon pa'i mkhas grub 'di mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad thugs su chud pa'i grags pa che, khyad par du snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i phul du byung bar gyur, de nyid 'dus pa sogs pu ti brgyar longs pa tsam brtsams, bod du bstan bcos brtsams pa la 'di mang, dpal mo chos sdings sogs dgon sde kha shas btab, der 'chad nyan mdzad pas bo dong ba'i grub mtha' byung na'ang 'phel rgyas yun ha cang ring po ma byung ba 'dra'o/
rab byung dang po'i sa glang lor dge bshes mu tra pa chen pos btab pa'i gtsang phyogs kyi dgon pa zhig /
(legs) 1) byang chub sems dpa'/ 2) mkhan slob chos gsum gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/
lham mthil gyi mgo phyogs kyi rdog pa
(yul) rang bzhin gyis zag pa'am lhung ba/ dkar yol brtan brtan ma bzung na ja bo yong/
dgu bog kyang zer, mdel grangs dgu 'gro ba'i me mda'/
1.brgyal ba'i don du go ba'i 'bog pa'i 'das pa, 2. rlung nad dang, rtsa dkar gyi nad, gza' nad sogs kyis smra brjod mi shes pa brgyal bar gyur pa'i don/ 3.(rnying) brgyal ba/
sha ba'i rwa gsar du brjes ma thag pa'i khrag rwa/
/ 1) khe bzang/ sa bogs/ mi bogs/ 2) phan nus/ lo tog gi ljang pa ring tsam skyes mtshams thog mar brgyab pa'i gting lud kyis gzhi nas bogs thon yong/

1) bogs ma dang skyed ka/ 2) grub 'bras sam phan 'bras/ slob sbyong byas nas bsam blo yar thon yong ba'i bogs skyed byung ba/ da res kyi las 'gan sgrub par dka' las che tsam byed dgos byung la, bogs skyed mi chung ba zhig kyang thon yod/
blo skyed kyi sa chod pa/
sa zhing dang, rtswa kha, gnas khang sogs gzhan la bogs mar gtong ba/
phan nus thon pa'am yong thabs byed pa/ las don gang dang gang gi nang du mi shugs kyi bogs 'don thub pa gal che/
sngar gyi bogs ma'i steng du gsar du bsnan pa'i bogs ma/
/ 1) khe bzang ngam 'bab sgo/ 'bru bogs/ dngul bogs/ sa bogs/ ri bogs/ mi bogs/ zhing bdag gis sa zhing bogs mar gtong ba/ zhing med zhing pas sa zhing bogs mar len pa/ 2) nus pa/
bogs ma gtong len bya rgyu'i zhing kha/
bogs ma sprad de g.yar ba/
sa zhing dang, rtswa kha, gnas khang sogs gzhan dag nas bogs mar len pa/
sa zhing sogs bogs mar len mkhan khyim tshang/
bong nga dkar po'i bsdus ming,
bong bu'i gom 'gros/ bong 'gros kyi zla ba gcig
ri bong 'dzin byed kyi rgya rnyi/
bong bu la bstad bya'i sga/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug tshad dang, rims tshad, mkhris tshad, rgyu tshad bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la gangs kyi zhun chung dang, nye ba'i dug dug las brgal, sprel sman bcad 'byor, byed ldan snang, dmar skya, sman chen, 'tshe byed, rwa can, shin tu dug med, so sor dug med, slar dug a dze sha bcas so,

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas gag lhog dang, gnyan rims, srin nad, chu ser, mdze nad, smyo byed, steng gdon, snying rlung bcas la phan, dug shas che/ ming gi rnam grangs la nag po zil can dang, dpa' bo kha la me khyer, btsan dug 'dzin pa, ra dug gsod byed nag po, ha la ha la, lhog dug nag po bcas so,
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas sha dug dang, btsan dug mkhris rims, 'khrugs tshad bcas 'joms/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas sha dug dang, sbyar dug btsan dug sogs dug nad 'joms/
lo gnyis par son pa'i bong bu, co pa'ang zer/
1) bong bu'i rna ba/ 2) (yul) gro snum btsos kyi kha zas shig /
sa'i gong bu/ sa'i bong ba/ zhing nang gi sa'i bong ba rnams zhib mor rdung ba/
bong ba gser du brtsi ba ste, dman pa'am tha shal bzang por brtsi pa'i dpe khengs skyung gi brjod tshul zhig

/ 1) sgo phyugs bong bu/ pho bong/ mo bong/ bong bu'i rna bar gser blug pa/ bong bu bzhon nas bong bu 'tshol, bong bu rang 'og yod kyang rmongs/ bong bu sngon la sa thal rjes/ ming gi rnam grangs la skad chen dang, grong du 'dren, mgrin bzang, chos can ring, rna chen, byin pa gtsang, bzod pa'i mu khyud, shugs 'gro'i pha bcas so, 2) (mngon) lcags mo yos lo/
sngo sman sga tsha'am lce tsha me tog /
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas grum bu dang, rus tshigs kyi chu ser rgyas pa sogs la phan/
za nyal 'khrig spyod tsam byas te sdod pa'i dpe/
bong bur lto ster sa'i kha bres sam bong ra/
po tho'am la ma'i me ste, spang me yang zer/
bong nga dmar po'i bsdus ming,
1) bong bu'i rnga ma'i 'og tu bskon rgyu'i sga chas shig / 2) lte ba nas gyen du tshon gang gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i pho ba dang 'brel ba'i rtsa zhig /
bong bu'i sdod gnas sam bong ra/
1) srog chags sman gyi nang tshan bong bu'i tshil bu ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas pags nad za 'phrug dang, glang shu sogs sel/ 2) sngo zhig /
lo 'dir phru gu med pa'i bong bu mo/
1) ldong ros kyi rigs shig / 2) bong nga ser po'i bsdus ming,
gzugs kyi gtos/ lus bongs che chung snyoms po/ mi de'i gzugs bongs chen po 'dug /
gzugs kyi gtos che chung gi tshad/
gzugs sogs kyi gtos che chung gi tshod/
gzugs po tshad longs pa/ lus bongs rdzogs pa'i gzhon nu/
1) bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi yul gru ste, stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang, bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi, smad mdo khams sgang drug bcas so/ 2) bod rigs/ 3) bod ljongs/

sngar bod yul ru chen ltar 'byed pa dang: yul gyi dbang ris rnam pa bco brgyad du gcod pa, rgod kyi stong sde drug cu re gcig tu 'byed pa, g.yung gi mi sde kheng dang yang kheng du 'byed pa, zhang gsum blon bcas kyis dbus kyi 'dun sa 'dzin pa, dpa' sde gsum gyis mtha'i so kha srung ba ste srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod du lag len bstar ba'i bya gzhag gi rigs shig /
bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnam gsum ste sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang, kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dri med 'od zer, rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa bcas gsum mo/
lha sar yod pa'i lcags po ri dang, lho kha bsam yas su yod pa'i has po ri, lha sa'i lho nub mtshams su yod pa'i chu bo ri, gtsang khul du yod pa'i phung po ri bo che ste bzhi/

rba khri gzigs te, ming gzhan sang shi ta zer ba 'di nyid bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan skabs mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dang, rgyal pos bod kyi rin po che zhes mtshan gyis gzengs su bstod cing, da lta bod yig gi sher phyin gyi mdo de kho rang gis rgya gar nas gdan drangs te bod skad du bsgyur ba zhig red/

rang rgyal bod kha ba can gyi mi rnams kyis brda la nye bar bkol ba'i skad de, spyir rong 'brog gnyis las 'brog pa'i skad ni 'brog sde stod smad bar gsum kun tu khyad par med cing, sgra gdangs drag cing gyong nyams che la sngon gyi sgra sbyor gyi zur ma nyams par thon pa dang, zhing sde'i yul lung rnams su skad kyi khyad par sna tshogs yod pas gdangs 'don tshul sogs gcig tu ma nges, da char yongs grags su bod kyi yul gru stod smad bar gsum la ltos te nang gses rigs gsum du phye ba ste, stod dbus gtsang gi skad dang, bar khams pa'i skad, smad a mdo'i skad rnams so, bod skad ni hor sog la sogs pa grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan pa khag cig gis bed spyod gtong bzhin yod par ma zad, bal po dang, 'bras ljongs, 'brug pa bcas kyi rgyal khab rnams su'ang bed spyod gtong bzhin yod/
shing gdung mar nyag ka bton nas bzos pa'i 'dzeg skas/
gangs ris bskor ba'i bod yul gyi ljongs/
pham dge legs rnam rgyal: rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta lor 'khrungs, bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i grags pa can/
snyan ngag me long gzhung gis bstan pa'i dper brjod legs par bshad pa sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes pa, dus rabs bcu bdun par bod mkhas mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'o/
gangs ris bskor ba'i bod yul gyi ljongs/
1) pri yang ku'i ming gi rnam grangs shig / 2) ldum rar skye ba'i gur gum/
1) gra ma ring po yod pa'i gro dmar mdangs can zhig / 2) bod pa'i gro zhib/
'bod pa'i sgra ste, kye dang kwa ye lta bu/

sngar bod sa gnas kyi rgyug dngul yin pa de'i rtsa ba'i 'jal tshad t'a ching skabs kyi rgya srang yin pa dang, srang las che ba'i 'jal tshad srang lnga bcu re yod pa'i rdo tshad ni de dus mes rgyal nang khul du dar ba'i dngul rta rmig ma dang mtshungs pa dang, srang las chung ba'i dngul sil ma'i gras su gnam skyong rgyal po'i khri lo lnga bcu nga bdun par do dam dpon rigs shig ched bskos kyis lha sar btang ste zho phyed do dang, zho gang, zho phyed bcas so sor yod pa'i dngul par rgyag 'go btsugs pa dang, de rjes zangs kyi pad sha zho lnga dang, zho gsum, zho gang, phyed brgyad, skar lnga bcas kyi par yang brgyab yod, lcags phag gi gsar brje byung rjes bod du shog dngul lor gyi ngos su srang lnga dang, srang bdun zho lnga, srang bcu, srang nyer lnga, srang brgya re dang de min zangs tam bcu sgor sogs 'dra min sna tshogs kyang par skrun gyis bkram pa de rnams la spyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 10 par rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bka' phab pa ltar 'gro rgyug rtsa bkag gnang ba red, gzhan yang t'a ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma kwang shu'i skabs dngul sgor srang gsum zho drug re yod pa zhig si khron du par skrun gyis khams khul du dar rgyun byas pa rnams kyang de snga nas 'gro rgyug bkag zin pa red/
mnga' ris skor gsum dang, dbus gtsang ru bzhi, mdo khams sgang drug bcas yongs su rdzogs pa der zer/
ja khu dang mar tshwa sogs mnyam du bsrubs pa'i ja ste ja bsrubs ma/
1) bod yul/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi bsdus ming,
bul chur brdzis pa'i gro zan gyi thug pa'i bye brag cig /
rta kha 'byed rgyu yod pa'i dor ma/
bod bzos rdzas mdel me mda'i kha nas blug dgos pa zhig
bod kyi me mda'i mde'u blug snod/
1) 'bod pa'i brda/ 2) bod kyi yi ge'i brda/ bod pas bod brda ma shes par, legs sbyar shes rlom bzhad gad gnas/
bod du skyes pa'i sngo ldum zhig /
bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra
rnam dbye brgyad pa/ kye...kye grogs po slob sbyong yag po gyis/

gang gi ming brjod pa'i tshe gtso cher ming de'i thog mar dang, tshigs bcad kyi skabs ming de'i bar dang, mtha' mar yang sbyor ba'i 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra, kye, ka ye, kwa sogs 'di rnams la rnam dbye brgyad pa'i ming thob kyang, gong gsal sgra skad mtshon byed kyi ming tsam las logs su rnam dbye'i rkyen ster rgyu med pa dper na, kye gtso 'dzin chen po, 'thus mi lhan rgyas gson dang kwa zhes sogs lta bu/ kye...
rnam dbye brgyad pa ste gsal byed kyi sgra ni kye, ka ye, wa ye rnams so/ kye ka ye wa ye...
bod yul nas thon pa'i phag pa, de sa mtho'i gnas bab 'phrod pa, nad rims 'gog shugs che ba, grang ngad bzod thub pa, phag lto rtsub po za dga' ba bcas kyi dge mtshan yod pa/
1) bod pa'i 'brog pa/ 2) (yul) zhing pa dang 'brog pa'i bsdus ming/
bod sman mkhas pa mi dgu

chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su byung ba'i bod kyi sman pa grags chen dgu ste, stod na cher rje zhig po dang, 'ug pa chos bzang, bir che legs mgon gsum, bar na g.yu thog mgon po dang, mi nyag rong rje, brang ti rgyal bzang gsum, smad na gnya' pa chos bzang dang, mthar bzhi dar po, stong pa grags rgyal gsum ste dgu'o/
khab rtse nang du bkug ste 'tshem stangs shig /
bod kyi lo tho'i rtsi stangs ltar brtsi ba'i tshes grangs/

am ban zhes pa man ju'i skad yin zhing bod skad du gong ma'i bkas mngags, rgyas ming la gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i bkas mngags bod kyi las don dbye 'byed blon chen zer ba 'di thog mar t'a ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma g.yung kring gi khri lo lnga par rgan gzhon gnyis bskos te dbus gtsang so sor bzhugs nas sa gnas kyi chab srid 'dzin skyong la lta rtog byed pa dang, gong ma gnam skyong rgyal po'i khri lo bco lnga par 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi dus zing zhod 'jags su btang nas bka' shag gsar 'dzugs kyis bod kyi las don gnad che dang, dpon rigs bsko 'then, bod dmag gtong 'then bya rgyu sogs tshang ma t'a la'i bla ma dang, am ban rnam gnyis kyi bka' bkod bzhin du byed dgos pa, gong ma gnam skyong rgyal po'i khri lo lnga bcu nga brgyad par bkas bcad bod kyi las don byed phyogs don tshan nyer dgu pa gtan 'bebs byas gsal ltar bod kyi las don che phra tshang ma bod bzhugs am ban gyi bka' bzhin du bya rgyur gtan la phab, 1911 lor lcags phag gi gsar brje byung nas phyir 'then byas pa red/
bod srol ltar mar phyur gyi khu ba dang, mngar cha bsres nas brdzis pa'i rtsam spags kyi mar zan dang, btsos sha skam sha sder sgrig sha rjen btsabs pa sogs gtso bor byas pa'i bza' btung rgyas pa/
zong ni zog gi don yin pas bod nas thon pa'i dngos zog / deng sang khrom du bod zong mang po 'tshong rgyu 'dug
bod kyi lo tho'i rtsi stangs ltar brtsi ba'i zla ba ste hor zla yang zer/

rang rgyal bod rigs kyi yi ge ste spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi mkhas pa thu mi sam bho tas rgya gar gyi yi ger dpe blangs, bod kyi skad lugs gzhir bzhag nas gsar du btod pa'i yig srol zhig ste, rgya gar gyi gsal byed sum cu so bzhi las log yig lnga dang, 'thug yig lnga, mthar zad zer ba gcig bcas bcu gcig dor, bod skad kyi brda la nyer mkho'i ca cha ja zha za 'a bcas yi ge drug gsar du bsnan, a yig gsal byed du bsres te gsal byed sum cu dang, rgya gar gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug las bod la ring thung sogs kyi tha snyad mi dgos pas dbyangs bzhir gtan la phab cing, de la ming gzhi gtso bor byas pa'i sngon 'jug dang, rjes 'jug yang 'jug bcas kyi dbye ba phye ba de dag sngon ming rjes yang gi go rim bzhin du g.yon nas g.yas su 'bri ba dang, ming gzhi la'ang, gsal byed rkyang pa dang mgo can, 'dogs can, mgo 'dogs gnyis ldan gyi brtsegs yig bcas dang, de dag gi steng 'og tu dbyangs mtshon byed kyi brda gang rung zhig sbyor dgos yod med skabs bstun bya rgyu, yig gzugs la dbu can dang dbu med gnyis su phye ba'i dbu med la'ang ka kha dang, zlos hral, tshugs ring, tshugs thung, 'khyug ma tshugs, 'khyug sogs kyi khyad par yod pa dang, hor yig gi thog nas 'bri srol yang yod, bod rigs sa khul khag so sor rang rang gi yul lugs skad gdangs sogs mi 'dra ba mang tsam yod par ma zad, yi ge'i nga ro 'don stangs kyang sngon yang mgo 'dogs rnams kyi sgra zur gsal dang mi gsal sna tshogs shig yod kyang, yi ge 'bri srol tshang ma gcig mthun yin, sngar bod yig 'di'i thog nas rig gzhung khag mang rtsom sgyur byas yod par ma zad, bcings 'grol btang rjes chab srid dang, dpal 'byor, rig gzhung, gzhan yang tshags par dang, dus deb sogs 'bor chen zhig rtsom sgyur dang, par skrun, khyab spel byas dang byed mus su yod, mi rigs gzhan dang, phyi rgyal bod skad dar ba'i sa khul du bod yig bed spyod byed mkhan yang yod 'dug / ca cha ja zha za 'a...

rang rgyal lho nub kyi bod rigs rang skyong ljongs shig yin pa de'i khongs su stod mnga' ris dang, dbus gtsang, chab mdo sa khul bcas tshud yod pa de'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi khri tsho 125 tsam yod, mi 'bor ni sa ya gcig dang brgyad 'bum dgu khri lhag tsam yod pa'i nang brgya cha dgu bcu tsam ni bod rid yin zhing, de min rgya dang, hu'e, mon pa, lho pa sogs kyi mi rigs kyang yod, sa bab ni nub byang mtho zhing grang ba dang, shar lho rong sa yin pas tsha ba che tsam yod, ri rgyud ni lho nub tu hi ma la ya dang gangs te se dang, byang na khu nu ri rgyud dang gdang la, shar na 'phred rgyug ri rgyud rnams so sor yod, ri mthor gangs rgan gyis gang ba, chu bo yar klungs gtsang po de nub nas shar du gzhung dang, rgyal mo rngul chu dang, rdza chu, 'bri chu bcas byang nas lhor 'bab cing, gzhan yang chu bo gang g'a dang, sindhu sogs kyi chu mgo ljongs der yod, mtsho mtshe'u dang nang rgyu gtsang pos ljongs yongs su khyab cing, sa mthor rtswa kha bzang bas 'brog las spel 'os pa dang, rong sa gshin po yod pas zhing las byed rung ba, nags tshal dang gter kha, chu bed, tsha chu thon khungs sogs phun sum tshogs po yod, thang sung rgyal rabs dus su bod kyi mnga' khongs dang, yon rgyal rabs skabs shun krin yon gyi mnga' khongs su gyur pa'i dbus dang gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum bcas shun wa'i hri si khag gsum gyi chab khongs yin zhing, ming rgyal rabs su dbus gtsang dang mdo khams gnyis kyi tu kri hu'i si dang khran hwa dbang sogs chos rgyal dang, gu shri rnams kyi mnga' khul yin, ching rgyal rabs skabs bod bzhugs am ban btsugs nas t'a la'i bla ma dang lhan du ljongs yongs kyi don gnyer mdzad, spyi lo 1951 lor bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas, 1956 lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs shing, 1965 lor rang skyong ljongs dngos su btsugs, lte gnas grong khyer lha sa yin/ 125... 189...1951... 1956...1965...

rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi ya gyal bod kyi mi rigs zhes pa, lo rgyus kyi yig cha rnying pa phal mo che rnams las 'di skad ces gsungs te, thog mar mtsho yod pa rim gyis bri nas nags tshal stug po rgyas par mched pa'i skabs shig na yul gru 'dzin nas thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u zhig 'ongs pa de dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las, bod mi bu gdung drug byung ste de nas rim bzhin mched par grags, da lta 'di'i mi 'bor gyi grangs sa ya gsum dang brgyad 'bum bdun khri lhag tsam yod pa rnams bod rang skyong ljongs dang, mdo smad mtsho sngon, kan su'u, si khron, yun nan bcas zhing chen khag gi sa khul du kha gram nas gnas yod, de dag las dbus phyogs su sdod mkhan la dbus pa dang, gtsang phyogs su sdod mkhan la gtsang pa, mnga' ris khul du sdod mkhan la stod pa, kan su'u dang, mtsho sngon rgyud du sdod mkhan gyi bod pa la a mdo ba, si khron dang yun nan du sdod mkhan gyi bod pa la khams pa zhes 'bod, mi rigs rang gi skad dang yi ge cha tshang ba yod pa'i thog yul srol 'tsho ba'i goms gshis sogs khyad par can yod cing, sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs la dad pa byed pa dang, sgra tshad bzo gso nang don sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i rig gzhung zab cing rgyas pa yod cing, shes rig lag rgyun yang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod, thon skyed ni gtso cher 'brog las dang, zhing las, zhor du lag shes bzo las sogs dar ba yin, bod 'bangs rnams las la brtson zhing rtul phod che ba, phyi'i btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol dang, mes rgyal gcig gyur la 'tsho srung, mes rgyal bzo skrun bcas kyi lo rgyus nang du byas rjes rtsa chen bzhag pa red/
bod kyi sa gnas sam, sa khul/
bod kyi sran ma'am sran ril/
bod du bzos pa'i ko bse/
bon gyi theg pa rim dgu

phywa gshen dang, snang gshen, 'phrul gshen, srid gshen te rgyu'i theg pa bzhi dang, dge bsnyen dang, drang srong, a dkar, ye gshen te 'bras bu'i theg pa bzhi, khyad par chen po'i theg pa gcig ste dgu'o/
chos lugs kyi rta dbyangs bon gyi 'don stangs su sgrog pa/

sngar bod rje pu de gung rgyal skabs chos lugs kyi bya spyod la brten nas rgyal srid skyong byed gsum gyi ming ste skye bo tha mal ba rnams la lung gi chos go sla bar bya ba'i phyir gzungs kyi snye ma la sogs pa'i sgrung bslabs, rigs pa'i chos go bar bya ba'i phyir lde'u bslabs, zhang zhung yul nas bon po zhang zhung lha sde spyan drangs nas bon po a ba rnam gsas zhes bya ba la slob tu bcug nad pa la mo 'debs pa dang, lha gsol ba dang, bon byed pa dang, 'dre brdung ba sogs gcig gis gcig la bslabs pas dar bar gyur te gdung rabs nyer bdun bar chab srid bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyis bskyangs par grags so/
bon chos shig ste sngar bsgyur bon gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan bcos bsgyur nas byung ba rnams so/

sngar bod kyi yul du dar ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa 'di'i srol gtod mkhan gshen rab zer ba'i lo dus thad re zhig dpyad gzhir bzhag chos lugs de dar che ba'i skabs su brdol bon dang, 'khyar bon, bsgyur bon gsum du phye ba'i bon dkar dang, bon nag gnyis yod cing, snga dus su chos spyod gtso bo lha 'dre la gsol mchod dang, gdon sri gnon pa sogs kyi sgo nas gshin gson rnams kyi rkyen sel kho na sgrub pa dang, bod rgyal pu de gung rgyal skabs nas bzung rgyal srid kyi 'dun ma'i gros khongs la dngos su tshud nas rgyal srid skyong rogs byas, de rjes bod kyi rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs la dad pa byas par brten chos bon gnyis kyi dbar du 'khon 'thab drag po byung ba dper na khri ral gyis chos la bkur sti dang, bon la gnon thabs chen po byas pas bon blon gyis khri ral bsad pa dang, glang dar mas bon blon gyi 'dod pa ltar chos lugs snub thabs byas pas nang pa'i dge slong gis dar ma bsad pa sogs bod kyi rgyal brgyud sil bur thor te med par 'gro ba'i nye rkyen zhig tu'ang gyur, phyis su chos lugs 'dir lta spyod sgom gsum sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dang 'dra ba'i rig gzhung mang po thon, de nas yang du cung zad nyams dams su song ba'o/
