bya bye'us zas 'tshol ba ltar nyin re'i 'tsho ba nyin rer 'tshol ba/ dge sbyong gis 'tsho ba bya 'tshol gyis 'tsho ba/
bya dang byi bas zas 'tshol ba ltar te, zas gos yul nges med nas 'tshol ba'i dpe/ ngas 'tsho ba dka' thub dang bya 'tshol byi 'tshol byed pas sa zhing gi dgos pa med/
bya 'tsho mkhan/ bya rdzis bya gag gso skyong byed pa ni kho pa'i ched las kyi thon skyed yin/
bya ba byas zin pa'am grub pa/ ston bsdu'i bya ba rdzogs la nye/
bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma
bya ba gang yang rung ba zhig byas nas rdzogs pa'am grub zin pa/
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas zas skom mi 'ju nas skyug pa'i nad la phan/

dgun nyi ldog nas log zhag nyer bzhi rdzogs rjes su zhag bzhi bcu'i ring la bya zhag zer, de yang bya ma'i zhag drug gshog zur zhag drug dpung zhag gsum, mjing khung zhag bdun, kha gdong zhag gsum, gshog rtse zhag lnga, bya bu zhag bcu ste zhag bzhi bcu'i ring kha char dang grang ngar sogs la brten nas sad ser zhod than sogs yod med brtag srol zhig ste bya go bos sgo nga gsos nas rim pas bya phrug chags pa'i bar du dpe sbyar nas bshad srol yod pa'o/
bod ljongs lhun rtse rdzong khongs bya yul ba'i bud med kyi zhwa mo/
las ka dang de byed stangs kyi rnam gzhag / bya gzhag yod tshad bkod 'doms ltar byed pa/
1) bya'i mjug ma/ 2) skar ma byi bzhin/
bya'i lto chas/ bya la bya zan ma byin par mo byas sgo nga ga la gtong/
bya ba gcig la lhur len mi byed par blo yi bye brag mang po 'gyur ba'i dpe/
hor zla brgyad pa/ sa lug lo'i bya zla ba'i tshes la/
las ka byed sa'i gnas yul lam kha gtad/ bya yul la 'dra min sna tshogs yod kyang mtho dman dang legs nyes kyi dbye ba med/

mtshan gzhon nu 'od ces pa rab byung dang po'i shing yos lor stod lung gi gol go lung du 'khrungs, stod lung pa rin chen snying po dang spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar gyi nye bar gnas pa la, bla ma la bkur sti shin tu nan cher mdzad, bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdam ngag thob, dwags po'i lho rgyud kyi bya yul du dgon pa btab ste slob ma mang du 'dus nas bka' gdams gdam ngag pa'i chos spel, bka' brgyud bla ma dwags po lha rje yang de las chos gsan, rab byung gnyis pa'i sa rta lor 'das/

1) lta rtog gam nyin mo'i so pa/ sa mtshams la bya ra byed pa/ dgra ya'i gnas tshul la bya ra byed pa/ 2) re'u mig gi kha byang/ 3) phreng bstar/ dbus kyi bya ra bzung/ mda' ro'i lhag ma'i byar grangs ltar bzung ba/
lta rtog pa'am so lta byed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la mel tshe pa dang so pa'o,
bya ba byed pa'i snga phyi'i go rim/ las grwa'i bya rim/ las 'gul gyi bya rim/

pho rog ste bya nag po zhig / dgra dang rang phyogs gnyis ni bya rog dang 'ug pa lta bu zhig red/ ming gi rnam grangs la khwa ta dang, 'khrig pa sbed, grong khyer spyod, dga' bas rgyu, brgya byin skyes, 'chi med gtor za, gtor mas rgyas, thos sgrog bdag nyid sgrog bden pa'i ngag mdog gcig pa, rdo rje'i mchu can, na tshod gnas, tsher ma'i tshang can, gzhan gso, rab dga', lan cig skyes bcas so,
khye'u pho rog skrod nus pa ste phru gu lo brgyad tsam du son pa/
khwa ta chen po/ ming gi rnam grangs la ka ko la, mgrin nag 'chi ba bslu bcas so,
lus kyi sha'i nang du rus pa zug pa 'don byed kyi skam pa kha gnyis shig /

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rma gso, 'bras nad 'dul/ ming gi rnam grangs la tha dad phreng dang, 'dab byed rtsub mo, nad med lam skyes, bum nges, mdzes ldan gnyis, yan lag dmar, shin tu spyod bcas so,
mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus mar mthe bong gi tshigs sbyar ba'i tshad/
1) glo bu thugs khab kyi gsang nas steng du tshon gang gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i byang khog stod kyi mda' gsang zhig / 2) sngo sman bya rog nyungs ma'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
(yul) phru gu bya spyod rtsing po/
bya byed tha dad yin pa gang zhig bya yul dang 'brel ba'i bya ba/ chu la zam pa gzugs par bya...gzugs par bya...gzugs par bya...bya las
las ka zhib tshags mi byed pa ste ha le ho le dang mtshungs/ las ka gang ci bya le byo le byas na gnad smin gyi grub 'bras yong mi srid/
lo skor bcu gnyis kyi gras shig /
bya ba phyin ci log / g.yo sgyu zol zog gis bya log spyod log byas pa'i grub 'bras snye ma long ba dang mtshungs/
cha snyoms su bgos pa/ bya sha sen bgos kyis bu lon 'jal ba/ kha zas nyung ngu las med kyang bya sha sen bgos ltar bu gu rnams la sprad/
sngar gyi gtam rgyud du smad bya la stod mi yin pa gshog pa can zhig /
gsang dgos pa'i don dgra bos shes pa/ gsang ba'i yig cha gal che gzhan la bya shor med pa zhig dgos/
pags byi'u ltar mgo bde dran 'phrul byed pa'i dpe, bya khral byi so la'ang ltos/
bya rngon pa/ 'tsho ba'i thabs la bya gshor ba'i bya bar zhugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la bya rgya ba dang, bya rnyi ba'o,
(legs) brda sprod pa'am lung ston pa/
1) mda' mkhan/ byag mkhan skyen pos bya khra nam mkhar bsad/ 2) jag pa/ 3) gar mkhan/ 4) sngar lha sar po ta la'i rtse nas zhol rdo ring bar thag pa'i thog rgyug pa'i sgyu rtsal pa zhig /
/ 1) byang phyogs/ mdo smad khul gyi sa bab phal cher byang mtho la lho zhol ba zhig yin/ 2) bod kyi byang phyogs su yod pa'i 'brog khul/
mon gre dang, mon gru, khrums stod, khrums smad, nam gru, tha skar, bra nye rnams so/
1) lus kyi khog stod kyi nang ngam mdun/ 2) mgo dang yan lag bzhi bcas phar phud pa'i de byings nang du don lnga dang, snod drug gnas pa'i yul de'o/
mchin dri yan chad la byang khog stod dang, mchin dri man chad la byang khog smad ces zer/
mgo dang yan lag bzhi phar phud pa'i de byings kyi lus phyi nang du mtshon sogs phog nas phyi rkyen blo bur du byung ba'i rma la'o/

mi lus kyi byang khog nang gi don lnga dang, snod drug bcas kyi gnas sa dang, che chung 'dra dbyibs bcas gsal bar rtogs pa'i phyir du lus kyi phyi nas thig btab pas nang gi yul rnams 'tshol ba'i thabs shig /
bod kyi byang hor phyogs nas thon pa'i sha khyi zhig /
srog chags sman gyi rigs 'bu byang pa dmar khra/
shes rig yon tan nam las ka sogs khog tu chud pa'i myong 'dris/ lag rtsal byang goms thon pa/
'ga' zhig gis khab 'then 'tshem spyad dang, la las gnod srung byed pa'i khrab kyi byang bu bug pa dgu yod cig /
nyi ma la mtshon na dgun nyi ldog nas gzhu sogs khyim zla drug la nyi ma byang bgrod zer te, nyin je ring dang mtshan je thung du 'gro ba'i skabs so/
(yul) rta rgyug chen po'i skabs nyin bcu tsam la rtswa mi ster bar 'bru sogs byin nas rgyug ma ran gong la rta mgyogs pa kha shas brgyugs nas tshod lta ba'i ming/
byang gi khul lam byang gi phyogs/ bod kyi byang rgyud du yod pa'i mtsho'i nang nas gnam mtsho che shos red/

«uttarkuru:» ri rab kyi byang ngos rgya mtshor chags pa'i gling chen 'dir gnas pa'i mi rnams 'chi ba'i zhag bdun gyi gong du khyod 'chi'o zhes sgra mi snyan pa nam mkha' las 'byung bas na sgra mi snyan dang, dbyibs gru bzhi dang, tshad ngos bzhi ka re re la dpag tshad nyis stong re yod pas mtha' bskor dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad yod do/
nad bab lci po min pa res zhi res lang gi snang tshul/ byang ngi bying ngi'i nad de ngos 'dzin dka'/
1) byang goms kyi tshad/ 2) byang phyogs kyi cha shas/
1) khrab kyi byang bu chung ngu/ 2) shing sogs kyi byang bu chung ngu/
1) goms 'dris mthar son pa/ 2) «bodhi:» spang bya'i dri ma mtha' dag byang zhing, rtogs bya'i yon tan thams cad khong du chub pa ste mi slob lam la byang chub ces bya'o/
mchod pa bzhi'am mchod pa chen po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
chos thams cad stong par khong du chud pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi grogs su gyur pa/
spang rtogs kyi yon tan rnams mngon du byed pa'i lam/

dmigs pa gzhan don la dmigs nas rnam pa rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa las byung zhing theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing du gyur pa'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can, de la dbye na smon sems dang 'jug sems gnyis/
byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu bzhi

rgyal ba'am de'i sprul pas bskul ba dang, byang chub sems kyi phan yon thos pa, sems can mgon med par mthong nas snying rje'i sems nye bar bzhag pa, sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mthong nas dga' bas sems bskyed pa bcas bzhi'o/

srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i theg chen mi slob lam ste, spang bya sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing rtogs bya mkhyen gnyis kyi ye shes yon tan thams cad khong du chub pa'i sangs rgyas la byang chub chen po zhes bya'o/
byang chub chen po'i pho brang

dgra bcom pa nyer sbas kyis bstan pa bskyang dus yul ma ga dha na sangs rgyas kyi zhal dngos su mjal ba'i bram ze mo zhig yod pa de'i bu bram ze dge ba zhes pas rdo rje gdan du lha khang dang, sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i ston pa'i sku bzhengs shing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba zhig bzhugs pa de la ma ha bo dhi ste byang chub chen po zhes grags so/
mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa shakya thub pa rgyal po'i khab tu mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe der bzhengs pa'i gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa can gyi mchod rten/
1) shing zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la glang po'i zas dang, shing dbang, a shwattha bcas so, 2) shing sman gyi rigs pi pi ling gi ming gzhan zhig /
1) rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ 2) sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang/
1) goms 'dris mthar son pa,/ lag rtsal byang chub pa/ 2) spangs rtogs brnyes pa/
nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bla na med pa'i byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par byed pa'i thabs sam grogs su gyur pa'i chos so/
byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun
byang phyogs so bdun dang don gcig
rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa'o/

spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i thog mar bod rgyal glang dar ma nas brtsis pa'i rgyal rgyud kyi mi rabs brgyad pa ste a ti sha bod du gdan 'dren zhu mkhan, stod mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma zhes pa rab byung gi rgyal po zhig gi ming/

ting 'dzin dang shes rab mnyam par 'jug pa'i chos bdun ste, dran ya yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang, chos rab tu rnam 'byed byang chub kyi yan lag brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin sbyangs yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bcas bdun no/
byang chub lam gyi sgron ma
a ti sha bod du phebs nas brtsams pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gyi gzhung zhig /
byang chub lam gyi rim pa
rje btsun rtsong kha pas mdzad pa'i byang chub lam rim gyi gzhung che 'bring chung gsum/
byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i bsdus ming,
byang chub lam rim chen mo

phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par bsdus nas ston pa'i gsung rab spyi'i dgongs 'grel, dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i mjug rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas mdzad pa, nye char rgya lo tsa ba chos 'phags kyis rgya yig tu bsgyur/
tsha ba'i sa khul du skyes shing rgyun du sngo ba dang, shing sdong nas thon pa'i 'o chu de spyin bzo rung ba'i rtsi shing zhig /

«bodhisatwa:» theg chen slob lam pa'i gang zag ste, byang chub chen po thob ched bskal pa'i yun dang, 'gro mang gi mtha', dbu dang yan lag gi sbyin pa gtong ba la sems mi zhum pas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/
byang chub sems dpa' las dang po ba
theg chen gyi lam la thog mar zhugs pa'i gang zag /
byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po
byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma ba
tshe de la 'tshang rgya nges kyi byang chub sems dpa'/
ltung ba bshags pa: phung po gsum pa'i mdo/
byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa
gzhan phan don gnyer gyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te, gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa spang zhing, gzhan phan gzhi dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i tshul khrims so/
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa

byang chub sems kyi phan yon dang, sdig pa bshags pa dang, byang sems yongs bzung ste, kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i le'u gsum, bag yod dang, shes bzhin dang, bzod pa ste skyes pa mi nyams par byed pa'i le'u gsum, brtson 'grus dang, bsam gtan dang, shes rab ste mi nyams pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i le'u gsum, de ltar spel ba'i 'bras bu gzhan don la bsngo ba dang smon pa'i le'u gcig ste, gzhung le'u bcu'i bdag nyid 'di rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mdo
'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sho lo ka brgya nyi shu pa'o/
byang chung sems dpa'i mos pas spyod pa'i cha mthun bzhi
snang ba thob pa dang, snang ba mched pa dang, de kho na nyid kyi don la phyogs gcig pa dang, bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bcas bzhi'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims
byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang don gcig
theg pa chen po'i sa bcu po'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu
rab tu dga' ba dang, dri ma med pa, 'od byed pa, 'od 'phro ba, shin tu sbyang dka' ba, mngon du gyur pa, ring du song ba, mi g.yo ba, legs pa'i blo gros, chos kyi sprin te bcu/
bad kan rang bzhin gyis bskyod pa'i nad med kyi rgyun rtsa'i 'phar tshul zhig ste, 'phar rtsa'i rgyud rgyun ring 'jam la dal bar 'phar ba zhig /
dge lugs kyi ri khrod pa 'ga'i zhwa mo zhig /
nyan thos kyi byang chub dang, rang rgyal gyi byang chub, theg chen gyi byang chub bcas gsum/
byang chub mchod rten dang don gcig
rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis gter nas drangs pa'i las bzhi'i chos tshan rnams so/
kha byang du bltas pa/ sgo byang bltas/ dkar khung byang bltas/

1) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi byang khul la yod pa'i gangs ri te se dang, khu nu ri rgyud, gdang la bcas kyi bar bar du chags pa'i rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i 'brog thang chen po zhig yin pa 'di'i sa bab rgya mtsho'i ngos las smi lnga stong tsam yod pa der tshwa kha dang, mtsho, mtshe'u bcas mang po yod pa'i thog gnam gshis skam shas dang grang ngar ha cang chen po yod/ 2) rtswa thang ngam 'brog thang/
1) dgon pa'i dbu mdzad de 'don pa'i 'go skul ba po/ 2) mgo rtsom pa/ las ka'i byang 'dren pa/ las grwa gsar pa'i byang drangs nas dus yun zla ba gsum song ba/
byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs 'dam gzhung rdzong gi byang phyogs thag nyer gnas pa'i mtsho/

/ 1) bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i phyogs khag mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi nang tshan byang pa rnam rgyal grangs bzang gi bzhed srol 'dzin mkhan/ 2) byang gter gyi chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan/ 3) srog chags sman gyi rigs 'bu byang pa dmar khra ste ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rtsa nad kyi rigs dang, brgyal gzer, dri chu 'gags pa sogs la phan/ 4) byang phyogs la gnas pa'i mi/
byang pa rnam rgyal grangs bzang

rab byung bdun pa'i shing phag lor gtsang ngam ring gi rgyal sde chen por sku 'khrungs, dgung lo bcu'i thog pan chen nags kyi rin chen dang, bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs yongs 'dzin mang po bsten nas mdo sngags dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa la mkhas par sbyangs, rgya nag gong ma t'a ming gis ta'i si tu'i go sa gnang, gsung rtsom yang nang rig pa'i skor dang, sgra rig pa, bzo rig pa, skar rtsis sogs dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i skor la yan lag brgyad pa thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu rin po che bya ba'i bstan bcos le'u brgya dang nyi shu yod pa zhig dang, rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal byed sgron me, bshad rgyud kyi 'grel pa bdud rdzi'i chu rgyun, phyi ma rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dgos 'dod 'byung ba sogs mang du mdzad, mi yi nyi ma mthong ba don ldan sogs slob ma mang po bskyangs, dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad/
sngar bod sa gnas srod gzhung nas nag chu sa khul du btang ba'i byang pa'i spyi khyab ste hor spyi/
byang gi phyogs su gnas pa po/
dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang, yang dag spong ba bzhi, rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi, rnam byang dbang po lnga, rnam byang gi stobs lnga, byang chub yan lag bdun, 'phags las yan lag brgyad de so bdun/
1. 'byang ba'i 'das pa, 2. goms pa'am 'dris pa/ lag rtsal byang goms thon pa'i mi/
shing dang ras shog sogs gru bzhi nar mor dras pa'i tshal bu/ shing byang/ shog byang/ ras byang/ brjed byang/ kha byang/
byang ngi bying ngi'i bsdus tshig
bod byang phyogs sa khul la gnas pa'i hor 'brog / byang 'brog hor pa...
byang thang la sdod pa'i ri dwags 'brong/
/ 1) byang la yod pa'i dngos po/ khang pa byang ma/ grong pa byang ma/ 2) goms byang can/ lag shes byang ma/ 3) (yul) rtswa chu bkag pa'i rta/ rgyug rta byang ma/
bal dang tshwa sogs byang thang gi thon zog nyo tshong byed par 'gro ba'i tshong las/
stod mnga' ris sogs nas thon pa'i rang byung gi tshwa mdog dkar po shel ltar dwangs pa zhig /
byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang dang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje gnyis/
1) kha byang du bris pa'i ming sogs/ 2) gshin po'i ming byang yi ge /
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dpal mgon rdzong gi nub byang ngos su yod/ byang lam, byang rgyud kyi lam kha/ bod ljongs nas byang lam brgyud de mtsho sngon du song/
byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang gi dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud kyi bshad sgros dang, sman gyi ngos 'dzin sogs srol rgyun ma nyams pa 'dzin mkhan gyi brgyud 'dzin spyi la'o/
'dzam gling zhing khams sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste rigs ldan gyi zhing/
1) byang dang shar/ 2) byang shar gnyis kyi mtshams/
1) byang chub kyi sems/ 2) byang chub sems dpa'/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs la rgyal ba'i myu gu dang, rgyal sras, 'phags mchog bcas so,

'jug sgo smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa blangs nas, lta ba bdag med gnyis rtogs shing, sgom pa byang phyogs so bdun bsgom la, spyod pa bsdu dngos bzhi dang phar phyin drug la bslabs nas 'bras bu gnas skabs sa bcu dang, mthar thug kun tu 'od kyi sa thob par 'dod pa'o/
theg chen gyi thar par bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs sam, byang sems kyi mkhyen pa'o/
(mngon) skyes pa'i khams dkar po dang, bud med kyi khams dmar po gnyis/

sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs don ltar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas blo sbyong tshul dang gcig sdong po bkod pa'i mdo sogs kyi dgongs don bslab btus dang spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas blo sbyong tshul dang gnyis so/
byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa ste sa dang po nas sa bcu sa man chad la gnas pa'i theg chen gyi gang zag /
byang sems kyi tshogs lam pa dang, sbyor lam pa gnyis/
mos spyod kyi sas bsdus pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa/
ming byang bzhu sreg ste dge sgrub kyi: cho ga zhig /
/ 1) ngo'am gdong/ gdong byad kyi bkrag mdangs/ 2) spyad/ cha byad/ yo byad/ cha byad/ 3) dbyibs tshugs sam rnam pa/ 4) byad ka dang don gcig
mthu gtad sogs gnod byed kyi nus pa/
1) gtad rgyag mkhan nam dmod pa byed po/ 2) gdong gi mtshan ltas mkhan/
mthu gtad kyi gnod pa 'grol byed dam zhi byed kyi cho ga zhig /
1) mthu byad kyi mtshan ma/ 2) gdong gi mtshan ma/ byis pa 'di'i bzhin gyi byad ltas bzang/
ngan sngags kyi mthu gtad dam dmod mo/
byad stems kyis btang bar grags pa'i gdon nad cig ste, nad rtags su lag tu shing 'dzin zhing gcer bur rgyug pa dang, gnas stong pa la 'dug pa sogs byed pa zhig /
bzhin gyi bzo'am rnam pa/ byad dbyibs mdzes pas yid la dga' ba ster/
bzhin mi mdzes pa/ byad btsog meg la mi mdzes/
gdong gi dbyibs/ byad tshugs legs po/
gdong ngam bzhin ras/ dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i byad bzhin/
gdong dang gzugs po/ byad gzugs lha las lhag pa/
pha rol gyi mthu gtad las byung ba'i byad kha'i bzlog pa dang, dus su ldang ba'i sri'i bzlog pa gnyis so/
gdong ris/ mo gsham la bu med bzhin du bu'i byad ris dang gshis lugs legs nyes smra ba ni mi 'os so/
kha zas g.yos sbyor byed mkhan gyi skyes pa/
/ 1) kha zas g.yos sbyor byed mkhan gyi bud med/ 2) chung ma/
(yul) cho dang, bzo, snying po, don/ skad cha byab med/ las ka byab chung/
(tha dad pa) byabs pa, byab pa, byobs,, g.yob pa dang, 'ded pa, sel ba, phyi ba/ dri ma byabs pa/ phyi ras kyis thal rdul byab pa/ nad gdon byabs pa/
lag pas nyug nyug gam 'phur 'phur/ mgo bor lag pas byab byab byed pa/
grib dang mi gtsang ba dag byed kyi cho ga zhig
(yul) par rgyag skabs par shing la snag tsha 'byug byed/
snying nye bas gces par srung ba'i ming/ dge rgan gyis dge phrug la byams skyong gnang ba/
byams pa'i sku brnyan bzhugs yul lha khang/
byams pa mgon po ste ma 'ongs rnam 'drin lnga pa byams pa'i mtshan zhig /
1) snying rje'i rgyu'i byams pa'i sems/ 2) rgyal ba byams pa dang, byang sems byams pa/ 3) byams mgon gyi sku chen po/

shakya ye shes: tsong kha pa'i slob ma zhig ste dge lugs pa dar rgyas byed mkhan gal chen po zhig yin zhing, rab byung drug pa'i chu 'brug lo la 'khrungs, rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lo la t'a ming gi rgyal pos gdan drangs kyang ma phebs pa'i rje btsun tsong kha pa'i tshab byas nas pe cin du phebs, rab byung bdun pa'i shing rta lor pe cin du lan gnyis pa phebs nas gu shr'i chen po'i go sa thob, rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag lo la se ra'i dgon pa phyag btab, rab byung bdun pa'i shing stag lor t'a ming rgyal pos byams chen chos rje zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bstsal, rab byung bdun pa'i shing yos lor pe cin nas bod la phyir phebs skabs lam bar du 'das/
rgyal ba byams pas thogs med la gsungs pa'i chos, mngon rtogs rgyan, mdo sde rgyan, rgyud bla ma, chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed, dbus mtha' rnam 'byed de sde tshan lnga/
bde ba dang ldan 'dod dang sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi bsam pa/
byams pa dang sdang ba'i bsdus ming/ dgra gnyen gyi dbye mtshams phye nas byams sdang gi rnam 'gyur gsal bar ston pa/ kha mngar lkugs pa'i sems la gsal, byams sdang byis pa'i yid la yod/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) gzhan bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa/ byams pa'i ma/ gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang/ lug rdzi lug la byams/ bu la byams drags nas lang du shor ba/ 2) gos lham sogs lus la bde ba/ ko sga rta la byams, phying lham rkang la byams/ 2./ 1) dmangs gzhas nang la dga' grogs sam snying grogs kyi don du go ba/ bu mo chung 'dris byams pa, spyang ki'i rigs rgyud min nam, sha 'dres lpags 'dres byung yang, ri la shor grabs mdzad gi / 2) byam pa dang 'dra, 3) «meetri» rgyal ba ma pham pa dang, byang sems byams pa/ 4) tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i nang gses, sems can gang zhig la dmigs nas de dag bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa ste, gnod sems kyi gnyen po'o/
1) mi ngan dang dgra bo gcan gzan sogs la byams po byas na phyin ci log pa yin pas byams pa go log zer/ 2) (yul) mna' ma dang mag pa go log pa/
bod kyi dgon pa grags can 'ga' zhig gi spyi ming/ lho kha gra nang byams pa gling/ chab mdo byams pa gling/ a mdo sku 'bum byams pa gling/
cho 'phrul smon lam dang drug pa'i smon lam skabs su rje btsun byams pa'i sku gling skor du gdan 'dren zhu ba/
ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga pa/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs la dga' ldan bdag po dang, dga' ldan bzhugs, rgyal tshal, byams chen mgon po, byams pa, ma pham pa, mi pham mgon po, sa bcu'i dbang phyug bcas so,
sems can thams cad skyob pa la mchog tu sbyor ba mi gtong ba/

chos rgyal srong btsan skabs bal bzas gdan drangs pa'i sku ngo mtshar can gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste lha ldan gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi byams sku phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can zhig /

brtse ba'am snying rje/ ming gi rnam grangs la bka' drin can, rjes su 'dzin pa, mnyes gshin, thugs rje che ba, byams ldan, byams brtse can, brtse ldan, brtse bas skyong, brtse bas 'dzin, yid la gcags bcas so,
ba'i chos nyi shu: byams pa'i gsung byams chos sde lnga dang, thogs med kyi gsung sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam gnyis, dbyig gnyen gyi gsung pra ka ra na sde brgyad bcas nyi shu'o/

sngar bod du hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer lnga nyin ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga pa'i bstan pa 'char ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig phyir byams pa'i dngul sku lha sa'i bar skor du gdan 'dren pa'i mdzad sgo zhig /
'phags pa thogs med kyi thugs dam gyi rten byams pa/
tshad med bzhi'i ya gyal, dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan pa bya'o snyom du sems pa'o/
rje btsun byams pas nam zhig sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston par rgyal pa shakya thub pas ma 'ongs lung bstan pa'i mdo zhig /
sbyin pa bzhi'i nang gses, sems can gzhan bde ba dang, dge ba ldan par 'dod pa'i byams pa bsgom pa'o/
rje btsun byams mgon gyis mdzad pa'i phar: phyin drug dang 'brel ba'i smon lam
sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'i sems/
brtse ba dang ldan pa/ byams po gnang ba'i zhor la mgo la snum byul byul/
byams sprin dge rgyas lha khang
srong btsan sgam pos btab pa'i yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
bon po'i chos lugs kyi lha zhig /
byams pa dang snying rje/ byams brtse gnyis ldan/
gzhan phan lhag bsam phul du phyin pa/
gting nas byams shing snying brtse ba/
byams mgon stegs bzhugs ma'i bzhugs stangs/
byams pa'i sems kyi bsdus tshig

rab byung brgyad pa'i nang lho phyogs byar yul du sku 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas rig gnas spyi dang, khyad par du zur lugs kyi bzhed pa gzhir gzung ba'i gso ba rig pa la mkhas par gyur pas kar ma pa chos grags rgya mtshos byar po pan chen zhes mtshan gsol zhing gzengs su bstod, sku tshe hril por gso ba rig pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kho na mdzad de lho rgyud du gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa spel, gsung rtsom yang rig gnas spyi'i skor sna tshogs dang, khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i skor la dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa, sman gyi khog 'bubs legs bshad gser gyi snye ma, bye ba ring srel gyi dkar chag sogs mdzad/
bya ba byed rgyu med pa'am bcos su med pa/
las ka byas pa'i lag rjes sam grub 'bras/ nyes can yin rung byas rjes kyis nyes pa 'dag rgyu yod pa/ las don thog la byas rjes gzengs thon po bzhag byung/
las ka'i lag rjes phul byung yod mkhan/
lag rjes mtshon byed kyi rtags/
las ka'i thog nyes skyon byung ba ste phal cher khrims dang 'gal bar zer/ srid jus lag len legs par ma byas pas las don nang du byas nyes byung/
1) bya ba byas pa'i 'jug / 2) byas rabs kyi lo rgyus/
las ka byas rabs bris pa'i deb yig /
phan btags pa'i rjes drin/ gsar brje'i snga rabs kyi byas drin chud zos su mi gtong/
1. byed pa'i 'das pa, 2./ 1) lag rjes/ byas bzang/ byas ngan/ 2) drin/
1) las ka'i thog las rjes bzang ba'i mi/ 2) drin can te tshur phan thogs byed myong mkhan/ byas pa can la drin lan 'jal/
byas pa chud mi za ba
byas rjes 'phro brlag tu mi 'gro ba'am don med du mi 'gyur ba/ mi rabs snga ma'i byas pa chud mi za ba byed pa/
rang lam gyi bya ba rdzogs par byas par rtogs zin pa'i sa ste nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mngon rtogs 'di dman pa sa brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
drin lan 'jal ba/ pha dang ma la byas pa gzo ba/ ya rabs rnams kyis byas pa drin gzo byed, ma rabs rnams kyis 'khon lan kho na slog /
byas pa drin gzo dang don gcig
drin can yin par shes pa/ pha mas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i byas pa shes dgos par ma zad drin gzo ba byed dgos/
dman pa'i sa brgyad kyi rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i ming/
las ka byas pa'i 'bras bu/ gsar brje'i byas 'bras rlabs chen/
las ka byas pa'i drin yus/ rang gis las la byas yus bshad/
las ka gang dang gang byas kyi lo rgyus/ byas rjes med kyang byas rabs btang rabs mang/
byas la ma bsags pa'i las
bsam sbyor 'bras bu sogs ma tshang bas las byas kyang 'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin smin par ma nges pa/

kun slong drag pos bsam gzhin byed pa, dngos gzhi'i las de rdzogs par byas pa, byas pa la 'gyod pa med pa, rjes su yi rang ba 'khor dang bcas pa, de 'joms byed kyi gnyen po med pa, 'bras bu smin nges kyi nus pa yod pa bcas drug tshang ba'i las/
ba byas pa thams cad:/ thabs shes byas so cog 'dzugs skrun ched du dmigs nas byas pa/
gna' rabs kyi khrims lugs shig ste log g.yem byas pa'i nyes chad/
gna' rabs kyi khrims lugs shig ste gzhan gyi chung mar spad pa'i 'jal/
shing sman gyi rigs sheg ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas srin gsod, me drod skyed/
nyin dgung dang mtshan dgung ste, nyin phyed rta dang mtshan phyed byi ba zer/
1) srog chags gzugs mo lus la khab lta bu'i thur dang ldan pa zhig / 2) gzud mo'i lus kyi thur ma/
gad snyigs 'phyag pa'am gad bdar/ bsam blo'i nang gi skyon cha rnams yang nas yang du byi dor byas nas gtsang ma bzo dgos/
byi ba gsod byed kyi mda'/
1) byi ba 'dzin byed/ 2) byi ba'i sgrung/
gzhan gyi chung mar log g.yem spyod pa po/
1) gnyen sgrig ma byas pa'i bu phrug / 2) byi ba'i phru gu/

1.(tha mi dad pa) skra spu sogs rang bzhin gyis bud pa/ dud 'gro'i spu bal byi ba/ ri mo byi ba/ mgo spu byi ba/ 2. 1) tsi tsi'am tsi gu/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkun po dang, rkun bu, rko byed, khung nyal, pri sha'i mig bu ga byed, 'bigs byed bcas so, 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / chu byi/ byi ba'i lo/ byi ba lo pa/ byi ba lo ma/

dug can gyi byi ba'i mche bas rmugs pa'i dug sngar dgun dus su zhugs pa gsal bar myong ba med kyang phyis dpyid dus su 'brug sgra grags pa'i tshe dug ldang ba na byi bas reg pa dran pa las, dug gis gos pa dran pa'o/
1. 1) 'chal po dang, gzhan gyi chung mar log par g.yem pa'i 'phyon pa/ 2) log g.yem/ 3) skra med spyi ther/ 2.rgyan dang bral ba dang, gog po/ zlos gar ba byi bo/ mchod rten byi bo/ gandi byi bo/
gzhan gyi chung mar spyad pa/

gyi zhal lce: zhal lce bcu drug gi nang gses, gna' rabs kyi khrims srol du gtso bo skyes pas gzhan gyi chung ma la log g.yem gyi byi byas na byi rin zhes pa'i nyes chad 'gel gcod kyi khrims shig / byi brun, tsi tsi'i skyag pa/
/ 1) rang la khyo ga yod bzhin du khyo ga gzhan dang dga' mgur byed mkhan gyi bud med/ 2) mgo'i skra med pa'i bud med/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rims tshad dang, dug nad, mkhal tshad, chu 'gag gi nad bcas la phan/
1) byi ba 'dzin byed rnyi/ 2) rtswa byi 'dzin/
rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la ngag nyan ma dang, bya ze, tshim byed pa bcas so,
(mngon) zhum bu ste byi la'ang zer/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas lgang pa'i rde'u sogs rdo skran bshig rtsa nad sbyong, rims nad ma smin pa smin par byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la byi 'dzin pa dang dam pa yog mgo'o,
gna' rabs kyi khrims lugs gzhan gyi khyo dang chung ma la log g.yem spyad pa'i khrims 'jal/
byi ba la brten nas 'gos pa'i nad rims/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rma gsar gyi 'bu srung ba dang, khrag gcod, srin phol sel, tshod mas bad kan la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la bye reg pa dang, bra ba rgyu lug 'bri rming pa, ru spos pa, li nga bcas so,
byi rug rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog sngo nag 'char ba zhig /
byi rug rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog smug po 'char ba zhig /
byi rug rigs gsum gyi nang tshan me tog ser po 'char ba zhig /
zhum bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrus mkhan dang, byi ba za, byi ba'i zas can, sbed byed, bshang len bcas so,
sa 'og tu sdod mkhan gyi srog chags mig ha cang chung la mdog sngo ba byi ba las cung che ba zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas khong du btang na glo tshad sel, phyi nas 'byar byas na phyi skran bshig /
sems mi gsal ba dang sems mi gnas par 'phro ba/
rig pa mi gsal ba/ mtshan mor gnyid ma byung bas nyin mo bying nyob chen po byung ba/
rig pa grung po med pa/ sems ngal thag chod pas rig pa bying 'thibs byas byung/
rig pa mi gsal ba'am nyob po/
(yul) ngos gcig 'jam po dang ngos gcig la spu yod pa'i ras mthug tsam zhig gi ming/
1.'bying ba'i 'das pa, 2. 1) rig pa mi gsal bar rmugs shing 'thibs pa/ 2) mi mngon pa/ 3) ngo bo dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa gsal ler med pa'i shes pa zhig /
rig pa gsal po med pa/
1) rgya mtshor gnas pa/ byings na gnas pa'i srog chags/ 2) kha thor du gnas pa/

/ 1) ril po dang, tshang ma, gang po, spyi/ lus kyi gyon gos byings po char pas bangs song/ rang gi nus shugs byings po bton nas mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/ mi 'di tsho'i gras la bgres song re gnyis ma gtogs de byings tshang ma dar ma red/ dmangs la blo byings kyis bkal ba/ de nyin gyi nyi zer byings dang mi 'dra ba gsal po 'dug / 2) gtso che ba dang, phal che ba/ sems byings pos dmigs rten dran pa dang de'i cha shas bzhin gyis bya ra byed pa/ mig shes byings pos lam du lta bzhin par mig zur gyis g.yas g.yon gyi gnas tshul la lta ba/ mi byings che ba tshogs khang la 'byor zin pa/
(yul) dpyid rmon brgyab rjes bshal skor drud nas nyin shas song mtshams bskyar du rmon pa rgyag pa/
(yul) rtswa ngan med par bzo phyir rmo slog brgyab ste chu btang nas ser ma langs bar du rmon pa ma brgyab par bzhag pa/
rang bzhin gyis zub pa'i don du go ba'i 'byid pa'i 'das pa,
gzhan gyi bsam pa dang snang ba sogs bsgyur thub pa'i nus pa'am mthu/
rkang pa'i phyi ngos long bu'i thad nas ngar gdong ngos su kyog pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na mkhal nad dang, dreg grum, mngal nad sogs la phan/
rim gyis phra ba/ shing sdong rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar byin gyis phra bar skyes pa/
gzi byin gyis nus ldan du sgyur ba'am, nus pa 'jug par byed pa dang, thon par byed pa/ chu de zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa dngos kyi zhal nas gsung ba ma yin par sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu skus byin gyis brlabs pa dang, ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo lta bu gsung gis byin gyis brlabs pa dang, shes rab snying po lta bu thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' rnams so/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa cho 'phrul bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bsgom pa'i lha de dag rang rang gi rigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/
byin rlabs can gyi bsdus tshig /
'dra chags pa'am nyams dod pa/ skad cha shod tshul byin chags pa/ rnam 'gyur byin chags pa/ tshogs 'du 'tshog khang bag gro la byin chags pa/
rkang pa'i byin snying ngam nywa/
gang ster ba'i lto za rgyu dang, gang bskul ba'i las ka byed rgyu tsam las 'khur sems gang yang mi byed pa'i dpe/
byin rlabs kyi stobs sam nus pa/
1.sbyin pa'i 'das pa, 2.long tshigs nas pus mo bar nywa spyi'i ming/ byin pa'i nywa sha/ byin pa'i ngar gdong/
ya'i 'dra ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, sangs rgyas kyi gsung la gus par byas te byin pas byin pa ri dwags e na ya'i lta bu/
lha spyan drangs nas byin rlabs 'bebs pa/
rkang pa'i byin phug ste sgyid khug /
phar byin pa dang, tshur phrogs pa/ lus srog dang rgyu nor sogs rang 'dod ltar byin 'phrog byas pa/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, dge slong gzhan la yo byad byin pa slar 'phrog pa'o/

rting pa'i dreg pa yod med mtshams nas gyen du mdzub gang gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na mkhal rked na ba dang, gcin pa'i nang khrag 'dres shing tsha ba, khu ba 'dzag pa sogs la phan/
'phags pa'i lam chos kyi don gang yin pa la gnas pa'i nus pa'am mthu/ mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs/ byin rlabs kyi mthu/ bla ma byin rlabs gcig las gcig che ba/
bden pa'i byin rlabs dang, gtong ba'i byin rlabs dang, nye bar zhi ba'i byin rlabs dang, shes rab kyi byin rlabs bcas bzhi'o/
sangs rgyas kyi sku dang, gsung, thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas gsungs pa'i bka' gsum/
lag sor ming med kyi rgyab tu yod pa'i rtsa zhig ..
gang sprad pa de nyid len pa/
par za ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, sman bzhi po gang rung byin len ma byas par za ba'o/
(tha dad pa) g.yogs pa dang 'gebs pa/ sngon gshegs dba' bo'i sku pur la dar dmar gyis byibs pa/

/ 1) bya chung ngam bya phrug / khang byi'u/ sngar bya gnas sar deng sang byi'u mi gnas/ byi'u zhan yang 'bu thub, rdo chung yang rdza gcog / byi'u chung gsung skad snyan yang, sku sha rgya srang do red/ 2) tsi tsi'i phru gu/
skas ril te, shing gdung hril por nyag ka btod pa'i skas/
byi'u mang po/ khra hor pas byi'u khyu gang gtor yin/ byi'u khyu mang yang khra'i lto/
1) 'dab chags byi'u chung ngu'i mgo bo/ 2) rdo sman gyi rigs byi'u'i mgo dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rus chag sbyor, rma gso/
byi'u sa nas 'phag tsam 'phur tsam byed stangs/ sems dga' spro che bas byi'u mchong lding ltar 'gro ba/
bdag skyabs byed mkhan med pa'am skyabs med mgon med ces pa'i dpe/
byi'u yi tshang/ byis pas byi'u tshang sngog /

bu ga'am srubs ka phra mo dang, nags tshal tshang tshing gi gseb tu byi'u thogs med du 'dzul ba ltar shar 'dzul skyod byed pa'i dpe/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pas gang sa gang du byi'u 'dzul du 'gro thabs ji tsam byas pa de tsam gyis zha bo 'dam la tshud pa ltar rang nyid thar mi thub par 'gyur/
'phur skabs sgra 'byin pa'i cha ga pa'i rigs shig
sngo sman gyi rigs la phug gi dri ro ldan pa zhig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas zas ma zhu ba dang, sha dug sogs dug nad la phan/
sngo sman gyi nang tshan zhing skyes sran ma'i rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma gso, khyi smyon gyi so dug la phan/
phyogs gcig nas byul byul byed stangs/ sma ra byil byil btang ba/ mgo skra byil byil byed pa/ sge khung gi ru shing la bkrag rtsi byil byil gyis 'byug pa/
gcer bu'am sgren mo/ 'khyags kyang byil mo dang ltogs kyang zas med du sdod dgos/ gos byil mor ma lus tsam dang zas 'grangs la ma 'grangs tsam/ byis 'gros, phru gu'i 'gro stangs/
byis pa'i sgrung gtam/ byis pa byis sgrung mnyan la dga'/
phru gu'i rnam 'gyur/ rgas 'khogs byis nyams can/

/ 1) lo gcig nas brgyad bar gyi phru gu shed ma bye ba/ byis pa skyong gnyer/ byis pa 'brid pa/ rgyu rkyen chung ngur dangngs skrag byed pa byis pa yer ba lta bu ma byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la nu 'thung dang, phru gu, zho 'thung bcas so, 2) skye 'phags mkhas blun gyi zlas phye ba'i so skye phal pa'am, blun po/
rtog ge : rgya gar gyi slob dpon dgra las rgyal bas brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /

kyi bsam gtan: theg gsum gang gi lam la ma zhugs pa'i byis pas 'dod nyon dang sdug bsngal rags pa tsam gyis skyo nas ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu khams gong ma'i tshor ba de nye bar spyod pa'i bsam gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin/
byis pa shed ma bye ba
phru gu lus sems kyi stobs ma longs pa/
1) phru gu lo chung/ 2) blang dor gyi bya ba mi shes pa'i mi/
1) mi'i phru gu'i bya spyod/ 2) so skye'i brtul zhugs sam tshul/
btsas nas 'gro ba dang rtse mi nus par nu zho 'thung ba'i dus/
don chen sgrub mi shes mkhan gyi gshis ka/ rtsed mor dga' che ba ni byis pa'i rang bzhin red/
blo sgo 'byed pa/ rjes lus thebs pa'i yul du byis blo 'byed pa lta bu'i tshan rig dril bsgrags kyi las don dar spel byed pa/
byis pa'i rtsed mo/ pho tha ma'i gras kyi spyod pa ni, lo nyi shu lon yang byis rtsed byed/
1) byis pa skyes nas yun ring ma song ba/ 2) byis pa'i btung ba/

ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gro mo rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 7128 yod/

(rgya) g.yu byur sogs las byas pa'i hor mo'i dpral khebs sam thod rgyan/
(legs) 'phags pa bhu kam zhes pa bal yul gyi sku rten zhig /
(yul) 1.nyams pa dang, btsog pa/ lto chas la dbags pa shor yong/ 2.(rnying) 'bags pa ste, skyon dang, tshos, tshon, dri ma sogs kyis 'go ba/

/ 1) thob thang dang, nus shugs/ rang dbang/ gzhan dbang/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis nor 'khrul byung ba/ sad ser dbang gis lo nyes byung ba/ 2) (rgya) gna' dus go gnas shig gi ming/ 3) (abhishinytsa) gtor ba'm blugs pa'i don te, sgrib pa gtor nas rgyud dag par 'khrud pa dang, rgyud dag pa'i snod gtsang mar ye shes kyi nus pa blugs pa yin la, cho ga rnam par dag pa la brten te phung khams skye mched la 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sa bon khyad par can gdab pa'i sgo nas rgyud yongs su smin par byed pa'o/

phag gru sde srid khri rabs brgyad pa 'dis rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug lo nas me glang lo'i bar lo dgu srid bskyangs, rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang lor chin hang rgyal po'i bka' 'brel dbang gi go sa thob/

dper na sngar rgya gar du rgyal por dbang bskur bas rgyal po'i bya ba la dbang ba bzhin gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas sngags dang rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa dang sgrub pa la dbang zhing, nyes pa'i dri ma 'khrud cing lam bsgom pa'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog par byed pa/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgom pa cho 'phrul bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, rang rang gi rigs kyi dbang gang yin gyi sku dang ye shes gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par dbang bskur ba'o/
dbang gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga
dbang bskur ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga'i nang gses shig ste, dkyil 'khor gyi las rim dang sgrub mchod dang, bdag 'jug gzhan la dbang bskur ba rnams so/
yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i nus pa/
slob mas dbang thob par bka' drin gtang rag yon du mandal dbul ba dang, dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang ba, sgo gsum bran du dbul ba, dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya ba'o/
mi nor zas sogs dbang du 'du thabs kyi sreg chog /
rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gsum ste sa'i cho ga dang, sta gon gyi cho ga dang, dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/
lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa'i las/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya gang yang rung ba'i don zhig 'gog byed de'i dge mtshan gyi gnas lugs mang du gshad pa'i mthar btsan shugs kyis 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /

dbang du song ba'm shor ba/ btsan rgyal kyi dbang gyur rgyug rnams la rang 'dod ltar gyi khe dbang med pa/ dbang gyur mi dmangs kyis bshu gzhog myangs pa/ rang sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur la brten nas skyon cha byung ba/

mtshan dpal bzang po: phag gru sde srid khei rabs lnga pa 'di rab byung drug pa'i shing stag lor 'khrungs, rab byung bdun pa'i sa 'brug lor t'a ming hung 'u rgyal pos kwa din gu shra'i dang, chu lug lor yung lo rgyal pos gser gyi dam kha, slar yang shel gyi dam kha dbang gi 'ja' sa sogs snga phyir gnang zhing, rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lor rje tsong kha pa'i gsung bzhin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du smon lam gyi dus ston khyad par can 'dzugs rgyu'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs, rab byung bdun pa'i lcags sprel lor 'das/
phag gru sde srid khri rabs drug pa 'dis rab byung bdun pa'i chu byi lo nas shing byi lo'i bar lo bcu gnyis srid bskyangs, t'a ming kreng thung rgyal pos dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang/
chos lugs dbang skur dus kyi tshogs gral/
kha lo sgyur ba/ gdug rtsub can gyi dbang sgyur/ drag shugs kyis dbang sgyur/ drag shugs kyis dbang sgyur byed pa/

dbang po'i mngon gsum gyi bsdus ming,
dbang po'i mngon sum la bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na lnga ste, mig gi dbang mngon dang, rna ba'i dbang mngon dang, sna'i dbang mngon dang, lce'i dbang mngon dang, lus kyi dbang mngon rnams so/

'jig rten dang thun mong ba'i yon tan nam thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad de, gzugs phra ba'i yon tan dang, gzugs rags pa'i yon tan, yang ba'i yon tan, khyab pa'i yon tan, yang dag thob pa'i yon tan, rab tu gsal ba'i yon tan, brtan pa'i yon tan, 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yon tan rnams so/
lha chen dbang phyug / ming gi rnam grangs la mgrin sngon can dang, bde 'byung, drag po, dpal mgrin, phyugs bdag gtsug na zal ba bcas so,
sngar rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig yin pa des dbang phyug kun mkhyen du 'dzin cing, snod bcud thams cad 'dod khams pa'i dbang phyug gis blo sngon du btang nas byas par 'dod/
grub pa'i khyim slebs nyin gyi res gza' dang byed pa'i lo bdag la brten pa'i khyim gza' gnyis mang nyung la dpad nas gnam gshis dang, sa g.yo, bde sdug sod brtag thabs/

thon skyed rgyu chas su la dbang ba'i lam lugs yin zhing, de ni thon skyed kyi 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi yin/
dbang sgyur ba/ bshu gzhog gral rim gyis mi dmangs la dbang byed pa'i dus rabs yal nas 'char rgyu med pa gyur song/
las don dbang sgyur gyi blon po/
chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs lnga'i nang gses, bsam gtan la dbang 'byor ba'i stobs kyis snang ba'i gzugs zad par sngon po la sogs pa lta bu'o/

bum dbang dang, gsang dbang, shes rab ye shes kyi dbang, tshig dbang ngam dbang bzhi pa bcas bzhi'o/
thob thang med bzhin du yod khul gyis brnyas smod dang bed spyod byed pa/ spyi don kha khyer rang 'dod sbug bcug gis don med dbang za ba/
1) dbang cha yod pa/ 2) btsan shed kyi thub tshod/ bud med la dbang yod byed pa/ gzhan la dbang yod kyi skad cha ma shod/ nyam chung bar dbang yod tshad med btang ba/
rang dbang shugs can byed pa/ gzhan la dbang yod shed 'khyer gyis mnar gcod yang yang gtong ba/
dbang zhu skabs 'bul rgyu'i dngos po/
dbang po ril bu'i bsdus ming,

dbang po lag pa'i bsdus ming,

mgo skra/ sku na mtho bas dbu skra skya phyed sngo phyed chags pa/ na gzhon tshang ma'i nang nas khong gi dbu skra gshor ba zhig red/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, blo 'jam pos yongs su shes pa nyid kyis dbu skra 'jam pa/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog bkram pa nyid kyis dbu skra dri zhim pa/
dbu skra sdug pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgad cu'i nang gses shig ste, mthong ba dang sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i bag la nyal spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra sdug pa ste yid du 'ong ba/
ltar gnag pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, yul gyi dga' ba zlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis dbu skra bung ba ltar mdog gnag pa/
ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, thugs 'dod chags la sogs pas ma 'khrugs pa nyid kyis dbu skra ma 'dzing ba/
ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, rtag tu tshig mi tsub pa nyid kyis dbu skra mi gshor ba ste dbu skra mi rtsub pa/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa, dbu skra sdug pa, dbu skra 'jam pa, dbu skra ma 'dzing ba, dbu skra mi gshor ba, dbu skra dri zhim pa bcas drug go/
'phags pa mched bzhi'i ya gyal bal yul gyi lha sku grags can zhig /
dbu med kyi yi ge'i thog mar 'bri rgyu'i mgo ris ? ? 'di dang, dbu can gyi yi ge'i thog mar 'bri rgyu'i mgo ris *. ? 'di'i ming ste dang kyog dang, berga yang zer/
mgo rgyan/ ming gi rnam grangs la cod pan dang, prog zhu, spyi bo'i rgyan, gtsug gi nor bu, gtsug gi rin po che, gtsug rgyan, rtse phran bcas so,
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, smon lam gyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa nyid kyis dbu shin tu rgyas pa ste, dbu gdugs ltar zlum la rgyas pa/
sngar bod kyi mi drag tsho'i mgo skra'i spa lcog /
bzo bo dbu mdzad chung ba/
1) bzo bo dbu mdzad che ba/ 2) 'don pa'i mgo skul mkhan gyi dbu mdzad rgan pa'am gtso bo/
dgon pa'i dbu mdzad dang chos khrims/
1) mgo na ba/ 2) mna'/ rogs ram gnang rgyu'i dbu snyung bzhes song/
'go tshugs pa/ rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa/
mgo dang mgo gtug pa'i zhe sa/
'jim sku bzheng dus dbu'i bzo las tshugs skabs kyi dga' ston/
dpe cha'i dbu shog dum bu/ dkon brtsegs kyi dbu dum de rgyab tu khyer nas phyin/
dbu zhwa pan zhu rna ring/
dgon pa'i dbu mdzad dang spyi so/
mgo 'phang ste mnga' thang dang go gnas sam gzi brjid/ gung khran tang gi dbu 'phang ri ltar mthon por gyur/ rgyal khab dbu 'phang je mthor song,..
lbu ba/ chu rlabs g.yos pas dbu ba thol thol du 'phyur ba/ don dngos dang mi mtshungs pa'i re stong dbu ba ltar yal song/
1) ar las kyi rdo bzo shing bzo sogs kyi lag rtsal dbu mdzad dang, ar po ba dmangs kyi bsdus ming/ 2) dgon pa'i dbu mdzad dang grwa dmangs kyi bsdus ming/
snga dus rgyal po dang dpon po sogs kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma/

/ 1) dkyil ma/ 2) 'jig rten na mtha' dor ba'i dkyil la dbus zhes pa dang 'dra bar yod med la sogs pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs pas dbus nyid dbu ma'o/ 3) srog 'dzin la sogs pa'i rlung rnams kyi rten byed pa'i lus kyi rtsa'i gtso bo zhig ste, skyes pa dang bud med gnyis ka'i g.yas g.yon sogs kyi mtha' la mi gnas par dbus su drang por gnas pas dbu mar bzhag cing, thabs shes dbyer mi phyed pa, ye shes thams cad kyi tsa ba dang, ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba'i gnas kha dog ni sngo skya'o/ 4) gzhung bka' pod lnga'i ya gyal zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i gzhung/

dbu ma la 'jug pa zhes bya ba dbu ma'i gzhung rtsa ba shes rab la 'jug tshul zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du rgya gar gyi slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i mdo sde sa bcu dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed bcu'i rab byed can gyi rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan gyi gzhung zhig
dbu ma stong thun chen mo
mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung, dus rabs bco lnga par mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'o/

thal 'gyur tsam gyis phyi rgol gyi rgyud la bsgrub bya rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skye bar 'dod pa'i dbu ma pa ste, rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa tha snyad tsam du yang mi bzhed pa'i ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'o/
rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba rtsal du 'don mkhan grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
dbu ma rang rgyud pa la mdo sde spyod pa dang, rnal 'byor spyod pa gnyis dang, dbu ma thal 'gyur ba bcas gsum mo/

kun mkhyen dol po ba sogs kyi dgongs pa ste jo nang ba'i bzhed srol du kun rdzob kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul dang, mnyam bzhag tu spros pa'i mtha' thams cad 'gog pa la khyad par med kyang, rjes thob grub mtha' shan 'byed pa'i skabs tha snyad kyi khas len tsam du chos nyid de bzhin nyid yod do zhes pa dang, don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad pa mthar thug pa'i tshe na gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bden par grub par lta ba'o/
rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa tha snyad du khas len pa'i ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'o/
sngar rgya gar gyi slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab dang, rtsod bzlog stong nyid bdun cu, rigs pa drug cu, zhib mo rnam 'thag bcas lnga'o/
dbu ma rigs tshogs lnga'i steng du rin chen phreng ba bsnan pas drug go/
chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug rtogs pa'i blo'o/
dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs pa'i lam/
skra med pa'i mgo dmar rjen/
1) sngon dpa' bo g.yul du chas skabs logs su gyon rgyu'i lcags zhwa/ 2) mgo 'phang/ rgyal khab kyi dbu rmog btsan pa/ 3) (rnying) srid dbang/
pho brang gi rtse thog dang ri rtse sogs/
khang pa'i rtse thog gi rgya phibs/
dbu ma dang tshad ma'i bsdus ming/
1) dbu skra yod med mtshams/ 2) dbu skra rkang so so'i bar/
1) tshogs kyi 'don pa'i dbu skul mkhan/ 2) bzo las lag rtsal gyi jus 'god byed mkhan/ lcags bzo dbu mdzad/ shing bzo dbu mdzad/
1) skra gzhug / 2) mgo mjug / dbu gzhug med pa/ dbu gzhug yod pa/ dbu gzhug ma tshang ba/
gral mgo'am las ka'i mgor sdod pa/ dbu bzhugs sku tshab/ dbu bzhugs blon chen/
snga dus rgya gar gyi dge sbyong rnams kyi cha byad/
(yul) a yu ma ste, gnag phyugs rwa med mkhan/

glang dar ma 'das rjes, btsun mo gnyis so so'i phyogs blon 'bangs tha dad kyis bzung ste yum brtan gyis dbu ru, 'od srungs kyis g.yo ru bzung nas dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas, de'i phyogs bod yul phal cher la khyab ste yul gru re rer yang che srid chung srid, mang tshan nyung tshan, gser pa g.yu pa, sha zan rtsam zan, zhes sde gnyis gnyis su chad de rtsod, rgyal bu gnyis lo nyer gsum lon pa'i sa glang nas bzung ste 'bangs kyi kheng log rnams rim par byung ngo/

bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i nang gses, lte ba lha sa ra mo cher bzhag nas shar 'ol kha'i shug pa spun bdun dang, lho rma la la rgyud, nub gzhu snye mo, byang brags kyi glang ma gur phub bcas so so'i bar du song ba'i sa yul gyi ming rnying/
skyid chu'i stod rgyud 'bri gung sogs kyi sa khul/
bod skyid shod kyi ming rnying/
dbu ma pa dang, sems tsam pa'i bsdus ming/
1) mgo skra 'khrud pa/ 2) skra bzhar ba/ 3) skra bshig pa ste, skra'i spa lo'am lcang lo bshig pa/

/ 1) srog rtsa'i nang gi rlung khams/ kha sna'i dbugs/ srog dbugs rgyu ba/ dbugs mi bde ba/ dbugs 'byung ba/ dbugs bral ba/ dbugs bsdad pa/ dbugs 'tshubs pa/ dbugs 'tshangs pa/ dbugs rngam pa/ dbugs rngub pa/ rlung khrag stod du brgyugs nas dbugs brdzangs pa/ 2) yun dus kyi tshad 'jal byed cig ste, skyes bu nad med stobs dang ldan pa zhig gi dbugs 'byung rngub gnyis gcig tu brtsis nas dbugs khug pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ni nyin zhag gcig gi tshad dang, dbugs drug ni chu srang gcig dang, chu srang drug cu ni chu tshod gcig bcas la yul gyi chu tshod ces pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba'o/ 3) zla ba so sor 'thob rgyu'i dbugs sgang zhes pa'i dbugs/ sgang...4) (mngon) chu srang gcig la dbugs drug yod pas grangs drug mtshon/
lha 'dres dbugs bsdus te blug sa'i rkyal pa/
(mngon) nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig tu byas pa'i zla ba'i ming/
snying stobs med pa'am las shugs mi thon pa/ dka' ngal mthong ba tsam gyis bag 'khum pa'i dbugs skyo po de 'dra byed/
lha 'dres sems can gyi dbugs bsdus te bcug sa'i khang pa ste, bsam yas dbugs khang lta bu'o/
dbugs mgrin par thogs pa/ lud pas ske sbubs bkag pas dbugs 'khar ba/
dbugs rtseg pa/ nad zug drag pos dbugs 'khun pa/
dbugs 'byung rngub kyi khug pa grangs su brtsi ba/ rnam rtog gi gnyen po dbugs bgrang ba/
har sgra dang bcas te gtong ba'i dbugs/ thag ring zhabs 'phen glod pas dbugs rgod pa/
rlung yang po blugs te nam mkha' mtho sar glod rgyu'i lgang bu/

zla ba'i 'go tshugs pa dang dkyil la slebs pa'i dus rtags, phug lugs la, 'dzam gling chen po'i sa dum bu bcu gnyis la khyim slebs 'dra'ang, sa tshigs dbang gis dpyid zla sogs 'go tshugs dus mi 'dra zhing, dus bzhi mi 'gyur ba'i ched du khyim zla bcu gnyis re rer dbugs thob dang sgang tshad re re ste dus tshigs nyer bzhi thob tshul mi 'dra ba 'byung, de yang lho gling dbus mar nyi ma lug khyim du slebs dus dpyid mnyam yin par nges kyang, rang cag sa tshigs 'dir khyim slebs nas khyim zhag brgyad 'das mtshams su rang sgang shar, khyim slebs sngon du khyim zhag bdun gyi mtshams su dbugs thob 'byung la, tshes zla'i dbang du byas na sgang ni rang rang gi tshes gcig nas gnam stong bar gang du 'khel ba nges pa med kyang, tshes gang rung zhig la nges par sgang shar dgos, gal te sgang dang bral na zla ba de zla bshol du 'don/
shed shugs sgrim pa/ lus rtsal sbyong dus dbugs bsgoms te gyad rdo 'degs pa/
dbugs gyen du 'tshangs pa/ dgra la khong khro 'bar nas dbugs brgyangs pa/
dbugs 'byung rngub drag po/ gzhan dang kha 'dzing shor nas dbugs ngar ba/
dbugs lhod 'jags su gtong ba/ gzhas gdangs ring po 'then pa'i skabs su dbugs ngal gso ba byed dgos/ dgra la rdung rdeg gtong dus pha rol po dbugs ngal gso ba'i go skabs mi 'thob pa zhig byed dgos/
dbugs tshur 'then pa dang phar 'bud pa/ dbugs rngub gtong rang babs su bzhag pa/
sngur ba ste gnyid kyi skabs mtshul khung nas gtong ba'i dbugs sgra/
1) dbugs phar gtong tshur rngub re re'i yun nam khug pa gcig gi cha shas/ 2) chu tshod skar ma'i dbugs cha/

rnal 'byor lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rnying ma'i gzhung las mthong lam du 'jigs pa lnga dang bral zhing chos nyid mngon sum mthong bas 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad las 'das pas dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/
dbugs phyir 'byin pa dang, nang du rngub pa/
1) dbugs kyi bar yun/ 2) dbugs kyi nus shugs 'khyongs che chung gi tshad/ bye'u'i dbugs thag thung ba/ rta de dbugs thag ring bas le dbar mang por bang rgyug thub/
(yul) dbugs thengs re ste, dbugs gtong thengs gcig /
1) shi ba'am, brgyal ba las slar sos pa/ 2) skye 'gro dbugs yod pa ste sems can/ 3) zla ba so so'i dbugs 'go thog mar tshugs pa/
dbugs gtong mi thub pa/ khur chen gyis steng nas non pas dbugs 'thums pa/
1) dbugs sam, rlung nang du 'jug pa/ dbugs chad kyi mi'i khog par dbugs 'dren pa/ lgang bu tshon khra'i nang du dbugs 'dren pa/ 2) dbugs kyi grangs 'dren pa/ sems rnal du gnas phyir dbugs 'dren pa/
dbugs had de 'gul ba/ thag ring du bang rtsal brgyugs kyang dbugs mi rdeb pa/
rgyu ba rjes su dran pa: dbugs 'byung rngub kyi lan grangs bgrangs nas sgom pa'i tshul/
1) dbugs chad de shi ba, 2) sdug bsngal zhi ba/ nad pa sdug bsngal las grol te ngal bso'i dbugs phyin pa/
1) dbugs phyir phyung ba/ 2) sdug bsngal las grol bar byas pa/
1) sems gso gtong ba/ mya ngan gyis gzir ba rnams gtam snyan gyis dbugs 'byin pa/ 2) dbugs phar gtong ba/
bad kan gyi dbugs lam bkag nas lud pa 'phel zhing dbugs gtong mi bde bar gyur pa'i ol krong gi nad cig /
dbugs mi bde ba chen po
skad 'dzer zhing mgul pa skam la dbugs rgod cing lud pa mang du 'byung ba'i dbugs mi bde ba'i nad cig /
shed shugs zhan pa/ gsar brje'i spro sems cher med pas las don byed par dbugs med pa lta bur snang ba/
dbugs 'byin rngub brel por gyur pa/ 'chi nad kyis zin te mal du lhungs nas dbugs brtsegs pa/
nam kun dang mi 'dra ba'i dbugs gtong stangs shig / nad zug langs nas dbugs yan gtong ba/
lus sems ngal dub ches pa'i dbugs 'byin stangs shig / nad ro langs nas gcong skad 'byin zhing dbugs ring gtong ba/
blo pham pa sogs kyis dbugs ring por gtong ba/ pham nyes byung nas dbugs ring nar nar du gtong ba/
kha sna nas 'byung ba'i rlangs pa/ dgun dus zhogs par kha'i dbugs rlangs mthong thub/
dbugs dang ngo bo gcig pa'i rlung/
thang chad che bas shugs nus nyams pa/ pham nyes byung ba tsam gyis dbugs shor ba/
dbugs 'thums pa/ du bas khengs pa'i sa dong nang du phyin pas dbugs sub thebs pa/
dbugs 'byung rngub mi bde ba/ brgyugs drags pas dbugs had nas re zhig skad cha yang mi thon pa zhig byung/
dbugs skyon shor ba/ phar tshur rgyug brel ches pas dbugs lhad shor ba/
'chi la nye ba'i dbugs 'byin stangs/ bya byel sa la lhungs nas dbugs lheb lheb byed pa/
dbugs 'chad kha'i nyams/ lus stobs shor nas dbugs lhem me bar bsdad 'dug /
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, dbu rgyas pa dang, dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang, dpral ba dbyes che ba bcas gsum mo/
brdar nas 'jam po bzo thabs/ gsar du bskrun pa'i yo byad la dbur chag rgyag pa/
tshem bzo ba'i lag cha zhig /
(yul) 'jim sku'i 'jam sha 'don byed lha bzo'i yo byad cig /
tshon snag sogs dbur byed kyi rdar rdo/
1) tshem srubs sgang gshong snyom byed mer bsros pa'i lcags sgam mam, lcags leb/ 2) 'jam por dbur byed rdo shing gang rung gi rde'u/
zhib po'am, 'jam por dbur byed kyi rdo/
ras gzhi dbur gdan gyi pang leb/

(tha dad pa) 1) zhib mor 'thag pa/ tshon zhib mor dbur ba/ sna tha dbur ba/ sman phye dbur ba/ 2) 'jam po dang khod snyoms por bzo ba/ shog bu dbur ba/ gyon pa dbur ba/ zhal chen gtong dus dbur legs par rgyag dgos/
pa'i mtshan bzang: gtsug lag khang la sogs pa lhag par byin pas dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/
dbur ti rgyab shul du thon pa'i shul ris/
shog bu dang zhal ba sogs dbur byed kyi shing/
'bur kyong khod snyoms byed kyi shog bu/
'tsho rten gang yang med pa'i dbul po/
rgyu nor med mkhan/ bshu gzhog lam lugs 'og ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams dbul po lag stong du gyur pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la bkren po dang, nor med, phongs po bcas so,
1) rgyu nor med pa/ 2) rgyu nor med pa'i mi/
1. 'bul ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. (tha mi dad pa) bkren pa'am nor gyis phongs pa/ lto gos kyis dbul ba/ nus pas dbul ba/

bgos pa'i g.yo ru'i nang khul sa cha zhig: yin pa 'dir gtso cher dwags po zhes pa'i rigs rus kyi mi tsho gzhis chags yod pas dwags po dang bar skabs rgya tsha dang, glang, lha rgya ri, sku rab rnam rgyal, skyems sdong bcas rdzong khag lngar bsgyur, da lta bod rang skyong ljongs rgya tsha rdzong dang, glang rdzong de gnyis kyi chags yul yin/
bod yul dbus phyogs kyi phal skad/
nang chos rnam dag gang du dar sa'i yul ljongs kyi lte ba lta bu/
rgya gar gyi yul dbus rdo rje gdan/
sems tsam pa'i lta ba gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa ste, byams chos sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
dbus phyogs su gnas pa'i mi/
bod dbus phyogs kyi dpe cha par ma/
1) bar dbus gtsang ru bzhir phye ba'i dbus kyi phyogs/ 2) dkyil gyi phyogs/
dbus phyogs nas thon pa'i snam phrug ste snam bu 'thug po zhig gi ming/
sngar bod rtsis kyi bar khyad rtsi stangs shig ste dper na, gcig skyed phyed gnyis dang, gnyis skyed gsum, lnga skyed phyed brgyad, brgyad skyed bcu gnyis sogs tshang ma dbus 'bun spor gcog la zer/
/ 1) mtha' la ltos pa'i dkyil ma/ gral gyi dbus/ rgya mtsho'i dbus/ yul kyi dbus/ grong khyer gyi dbus/ 2) mtha' gnyis spangs pas dbus nyid dbu ma/
dbus phyogs su gnas pa'i bud med/
bod yul dbus gtsang dang, khams phyogs te gsum/

smad 'dul gyi brgyud pa'i khungs te, klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang, 'bring ye shes yon tan, rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas, rba tshul khrims blo gros, sum pa ye shes blo gros te dbus kyi mi lnga dang, lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tshong btsun shes rab seng ge, bo dong pa u pa de kar te gtsang gi mi gsum dang, mnga' ris pa 'o brgyad spun gnyis bcas mdo smad du phebs te bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal las bsnyen rdzogs zhus, de nas rim bzhin 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun spel te bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas slar gso bar mdzad mkhan rnams so/
dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum
bod yul dbus phyogs dang, gtsang phyogs, stod mnga' ris skor gsum bcas kyi spyi ming/
dbus gtsang khams gsum dang don gcig
dbus pa dang gtsang pa'i khyo ga'i lus chas/
bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi de'o/
dbus pa'i lag rgyun gyi ri mo/
zang zing 'du 'dzi med pa'i khang pa/
ri khrod lta bu khu sim po'i gnas/

1. (tha mi dad pa) med pa'am stong pa/ nor 'khrul gyis dben pa/ bya spyod ngan pas dben pa/ zas gos mthun rkyen gyis mi dben pa/ snying pos dben pa/ 2. bas mtha' dang, 'du 'dzi med pa/ gnas dben pa/ dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim la dam chos sgrub/ ri khrod dben pa/ 3./ 1) 'du 'dzi med pa'i sa cha/ 2) 'phri rtsis/

1) mdo sngags thun mong du lus 'du 'dzis dben pa dang, sems mi dge ba'i rnam rtog gis dben pa, sgo gsum tha mal gyi snang zhen gyis dben pa ste gsum/ 2) gsang sngags rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor zhig ste, 'gro ba'i khams thams cad ni rlung gi gzhan dbang du gyur pa yin pas de dbang du 'dus pa'i thabs rdo rje'i bzlas pa ngag dben dang, sems la dmigs pa sems dben dang, bdag byin gyis brlabs pa sgyu lus bcas so/
khu sim dben pa'i sa phyogs/
dben sa pa blo bzang don grub nas rim bzhin snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag /
1) dben sar sdod mkhan/ 2) gtsang dben sa dgon gyi bla ma/
bzang don grub: pan chen er te ni'i sku phreng gsum pa, rab byung brgyad pa'i shing glang lor 'khrungs, rab byung dgu pa'i me stag lor 'das/
dben pa gsum gyi bsdus ming,
sbo yang zer, rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la khra dang, nyi ma'i lha ldan, phyi mo bcas so,
hor zla gnyis pa ste hor zla dang po'i bcu drug nas gnyis pa'i bco lnga'i bar la dbo zla zer, zla ba nya rgyas dus su dbo dang zla ba gnyis phal cher 'grogs pas na de ltar brjod/
hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i zla ba dang dbo skar mnyam du spyod pa/
sbyin pa'i don du go ba'i 'bogs pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
sngar gdan sa khag gi tshogs chen chos mdzad/

/ 1) pha rgyud bu spun gyi spyi'i ming/ snag gi dbon po/ khu dbon/ 2) ser skya mi drag gi spun chung dang, tsha bo bcas spyi/ 3) rtsis pa/ grwa gzugs dbon po/ 4) sngar bla sprul gyis rang las gnyer ba'i dbang 'dzin pa'i nye gtogs/
bud med yod pa'i grwa gzugs/
1) spun gyi bu'am, tsha bo'i zhe sa/ 2) bon po'i bla ma'i ming/
(yul) phar gtong tshur 'khyer/ dngos zog phar tshur
(yul) skyel 'dren byed pa/ rdo shing dbor ba/ nyer mkho'i dngos chas rnams phar tshur dbor ba/
(rnying) 1) 'pho bar byed pa dang, gsho ba/ 2) gting dpag dka' ba'am, zab pa/
gdangs dang, nga ro/ mgrin dbyangs/ skad kyi sgra dbyangs/ dbyangs 'then nas gsar brje'i glu len pa/ gzhas tshig dbyangs su gyer ba/
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi gnyis pa dbus dang tha mar tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i mdo sde rnams te nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod du gtogs so/
dbyangs nges pa'i bya dka'i rgyan
tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang re re'am, bzhi ga la i sogs dbyangs re re kho na'i sgra'i nges pa sbyar te ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
sgra gdangs snyan po can/ dbyangs can dgyes glu/
snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa dbyangs can dgyes glu zhes bya ba 'di ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me phag lor rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa/
dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rol mtsho
snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rol mtsho 'di ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa bya lor 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos mdzad pa/
dbyangs can bya ka ra na
sngar rgya gar ba a nu bhu tis brtsams pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos da bar bod du dar bzhin pa zhig

shes rab stsol ba'i lha mo zhig sngar gyi gtam rgyud du bskal pa thog ma'i dus shig na lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis g.yos pa las de'i nang du brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad rab tu snyan par grags pas tshangs pa chen pos lo du mar sgra de la mngon par dga' zhing ro myang bas 'dug cing, mthar sgra dbyangs de rnams gcig tu 'dus nas lha mo 'di nyid byung bar grags/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya mtsho'i lha mo dang, sgra dbyangs lha mo, ngag dbang lha mo,..rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma, blo yi gter, dbyangs ldan ma, smra lha mo, tshangs pa'i sras mo, mtsho ldan ma, mtsho byung ma, zla ba'i sring mo, sher lha mo, shes rab lha mo bcas so,
dbyangs can ma dang don gcig
sam kri ta'i dbyangs gcig rkyang las med pa'i tshig / aapeh i...a...iindrapashya...i... uutishtha...u...
legs sbyar skad kyi dbyangs bcu drug / a a'a, i a'i, u a'u, ri r'i, li l'i, e ee, o oo, am a: bcas,
dbyangs yig la brten nas brtag pa'i rtsis kyi ming/

lha dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma gnyis kyis zhu ba zhu lan gyi tshul du gsungs par bshad, bde sdug legs nyes rgyal pham sogs brtag thabs kyi 'khor lo mang por ston pa dang, dbyangs dang gsal byed tshes la 'char tshul ston pa'i cha nas ming de ltar btags pa'o/
dbyangs dang gsal byed la sbyar nas legs nyes brtsi tshul/
1) sgra dbyangs chag pa/ 2) legs sbyar gyi gsal byed yi ge srog med pa/
(mngon) 1) khu byug / 2) dri za/ 3) lha yi glu mkhan/
sgra'i mtho dman phra sbom sogs mtshon pa'i rtags/ dmangs glu mtha' dag la dbyangs rta nges can re yod/
glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun gyi bsdus tshig
1.(yul) glu len pa/ glu gzhas dbyangs pa/ 2.dbu mdzad dam, byang 'dren sogs 'don dbyangs kyi byed po/
sgra'i srog med kyi yi ge /
sgra'i srog med kyi yi ge /
i, u, e, o bzhi ste, de dag so so'i mtshon byed gi gu sogs gug bkyed kyi rnam pa can bzhi yod/
nga ro'i rnam pa can gyi cha nas bzhag pa'i yi ge
mtshungs pa dang 'dra ba ma yin pa'i sam kri ta'i mtshams sbyor yi ge bzhi/ e ee o oo...ee...e...oo...o...
dbyangs yig dang, gsal byed kyi yi ge /
dbyar dus kyi skyid po'i dga' ston/ me tog gi skyed tshal du dbyar skyid btang ba/

nam dus bzhi'i dbyar kha/ dbyar kha'i spang la gang yang skye, gzhon nu'i blo la gang yang 'char/ dbyar kha lcags la bdag po rgyob, dgun kha rdza la bdag po rgyob, nam zhag rgyun du kha la bdag po rgyob/ ming gi rnam grangs la char ldan pa dang, char 'bab dus, chu bo'i gzhung rgyas, sprin 'byung bcas so,
dbyar kha spen ma'i me tog
rum thags kyi ri mo'i bye brag cig
1) dbyar khar sdod khang ste bsil khang/ 2) (rnying) dge slong ma'i sdod khang/
rab byung gis dbyar gnas khas blangs pa/
1) dbyar gyi chas gos/ 2) dge slong gi char khebs/
dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, dpangs su khru gsum sor bco brgyad, dkyus su khru dgu yod pa'i dbyar dus gyon rgyu'i rab byung gi gos shig /
dbyar tsam gyi dus te hor zla drug pa'i bcu drug nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i bar ro/
dbyar gyi gos ras chen dang don gcig
gro zhun zla ba'i tshes gcig ste dbyar tha chung hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nyen dbyar khas len pa'o/
1) dbyar kha'i chu/ 2) dbyar kha'i chu log / dbyar chu rgyas pa
dbyar kha'i mjal kha, sngar rtse slob grwa bas dbyar kha zla ba lnga pa'i nang t'a la'i bla mar dbyar mjal zhu srol yod/
lo gcig ring lo tog ma btab par sa stong du 'jog pa'i zhing ga/
zhing ga 'debs 'jog res mos byed pa'i so nam gyi ming/
dbyar kha'i nyi ma log dus te, hor zla lnga pa'i sgang la nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug yin pas nyi ma byang nas lhor ldog pa'i dus tshigs/
dbyar nyal langs dang don gcig
1) dbyar dus 'char can gyi ston mo/ 2) dbyar kha dang ston kha/
hor zla drug pa ste dbyar tha chung yang zer/
dbyar zla tha ma'i dkyil gyi tshad/
dbyar zla tha ma'i 'go zug pa/
hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug /
snod 'jog sa'i stegs bu'am lhung bzed 'jog sa'i 'og gzhi/
tshal dang lo tog gang rung dbyar dus su 'debs pa/

'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, dbyar snga phyi gang yin rung dbyar zla gsum gyi ring la, dge tshul slong rnams kyis mtshams las 'das te skya rengs 'char bar mi bya ba'i dam bca'i gnas su 'brel ba dang, dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long mi bya ba dang, thos pa sogs la brtson pa dang, gtsug lag khang ral grum bcos pa sogs kyi dam bca' bzung nas dbyar khas len pa'o/

sbyor ba gtsug lag khang byi dor bya zhing, gnas mal sta gon dang, gang zag sta gon sogs byas nas, dngos gzhi bla gab dang bcas pa'i gnas su dge slong gi mdun du sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pas dbyar gnas par khas blangs te, byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu skya rengs 'char bar mi sdod par thos bsam bsgom pa la brtson pa'i mthar dgag dbye bya ba'o/
shing gi bye brag sbyar pa/
shing gi bye brag sbyar pa nag po/
1) shing dbyar pa ste sbyar pa'i pags pa/ 2) lug sogs kyi dbyar kha'i pags pa/
khrums zla'i tshes gcig ste ston ra ba hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug nyin dbyar khas len pa'o/

dbyar gnas skabs su dbyar khas len pa'i gang zag gis gnang ba ma thob par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu zhag gcig gnas kyang dbyar ral ba'i nyes pa 'byung la, 'on kyang chos ldan gyi dgos pa'i dbang gis zhag gcig nas bdun gyi bar byin gyis brlabs nas mtshams las 'da' rung zhing, de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa'o/
dbyar zla 'bring po'i dkyil sgang gi tshad/
dge slong gi dbyar gnas kyi sbyor ba ste sngon 'gro gra sgrig /
lo gcig ring sa bon ma btab par bsnyal ba'i zhing kha/
1) dbyar gzhung gi mar/ 2) sngar 'brog khul du 'bru rigs sogs btsongs te rin 'bab kyi mar dbyar kha sprod len byed pa/
dge slong ma'i gtsug lag khang/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas mkhal rked na ba dang, lus smad du drod mi khug pa, khu ba zad pa, lus stobs nyams pa bcas la phan/
dge slong rnams dbyar gnas kyi dkyil 'khor mtshams su bzhugs pa, dgag dbye bar du'o/
dbyar kha gyon rgyu'i zhwa mo/
ras bse las bzos pa'i zhwa mo zhig /
dbyar gyi dbugs thob pa ste hor zla bzhi pa'i dbugs la dus bzhi'i nang nas dbyar gyi 'go tshugs shing, khu byug grag skabs yin/
hor zla bzhi pa dang, lnga pa, drug pa ste gsum/
dbyar zla ra ba, 'bring, tha chung ste gsum, hor zla bzhi pa, lnga pa, drug pa dang, hor zla gnyis pa, gsum pa, bzhi pa la ngos 'dzin tshul gnyis yod/
dbyar dus ri klung skyed sar spro gseng du 'gro ba/
dbyar zla ra ba'i dkyil sgang gi tshad/
dbyar zla ra ba'i 'go zug pa/
hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar te, zla ba gsum la zhag gcig gis ma tshang ba'o/
1) lam gu dog po'am lam nges pa can/ 2) sgrigs khrims dam po'am bag yod pa'i spyod lam/
1) shad dam lo gsum lon pa'i phyugs kyi ming/ 2) dbyar zla ba gsum/
1) shing bye brag pa zhig / 2) gcan gzan dbyi'am g.yi dkar po/
, dbyu gu'am dbyug pa chung ngu/
1) shing bye brag pa zhig / 2) gcan gzan dbyi'am g.yi nag po/
'dag par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'byid pa'i ma 'ongs pa/

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, dkar po dang, nag po, khra bo bcas gsum mchis, ro tsha la cung mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas drod skyed, skran bshig zas 'ju bar byed, chu ser sogs kyi nad la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la kri shing dang, dkri mo, skra dkar can, sgyi mong, drod skyed byed, me shing, tsa by'a, a za mo, a sa mo bcas so,
1) shing bye brag pa zhig / 2) gcan gzan dbyi dmar ram, g.yi dmar/
/ 1) nor bu'am rin po che ste gter las thon pa'i rin po che'i spyi ming / yid bzhin dbyig / 2) (mngon) nor lha'i ming la brgyad yod pas grangs brgyad mtshon/
1) nor bu mchog gyur ram gong thang shin tu che ba'i rin po che'i rigs/ 2) (mngon) lha tshangs pa/
gser gyi snod ltar sgra mtho zhing zab pa/

'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya gyal, mngon pa'i gzhung 'grel byed po slob dpon dbyig gnyen ni, dus rabs lnga pa tsam na bram ze mo su pra ka sha shi la zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs nas thogs med kyi sku mched du gyur, kha che'i slob dpon sam gha bha dra'i drung nas mngon pa sde bdun sogs gsan, phyis 'phags pa thogs med slob dpon du bsten, mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel dang, pra ka ra na sde brgyad sogs bstan bcos mang du brtsams, tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs glang dang, mngon pa rang las mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa dang, sher phyin rang las mkhas pa rnam grol sde dang, 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa shakya 'od bcas slob ma mkhas pa mang du bskyangs so/
1) rin chen rigs las bzos pa'i dug / 2) rin chen rigs mi'i khog pa'i nang du shor nas phog pa'i dug /
/ 1) gri dang mtshon cha sogs rdar byed rdo zhig / 2) khod snyoms byed shing bu'i yo byad cig /
tshon dang snag tsha sogs dbur 'dul byed dus su 'byung ba'i sgra'i khyad par zhig /
1.tshon rtsi zhib mo/ 2.zhib mo dang, 'jam po/ gos dar dbyig mo/
bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon zhig /

/ 1) klong dang, khams sam nang/ mthong rgya'i dbyings/ nam mkha'i dbyings/ dgongs pa'i dbyings/ 2) rang bzhin nam 'byung gnas/ chos dbyings/ chos dbyings su bsdus pa/ 3) 'gying nyams/ rang nyid dbyings che drags pas rjes lus thebs pa/ 4) tha mag gi dbyings zer ba sogs rgya skad zur chag pa ste don ni ha cang dga' po'am lang shor ba/
dgongs pas dpyad pa/ de don 'grig min dbyings dpyad yod pa zhu/
sngar sde srid dam zhabs pad la 'bod pa'i zhes sa/
ring thung mtho dman sogs dbyibs kyi gzugs su grub pa'o/ dbyibs gsar/ byad dbyibs yid du 'ong ba/ gzugs dbyibs/ kha dog dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba/

zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad kyi nang gses, nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu zil gnon te sems can gyi gzugs mdzes sdug thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba dang, chen po zil gnon te snod kyi gzugs la dbang bsgyur ba dang, nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu zil gnon dang, chen po zil gnon bcas bzhi'o/
gru bzhi'am lham pa dang, zlum po, ring ba, thung ba, phya le ba, phya le ma yin pa, mtho ba, dma' ba ste brgyad/
dbyibs kyi gzugs brgyad kyi bsdus tshig
bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor zhig ste, bskyed pa dbyibs, bzlas pa sngags, 'od gsal 'jug ldang chos kyi rnal 'byor ro/
bzo lta 'don pa'am bzo ba/ dpe gsar 'phrul chas kyi dbyibs 'cho ba/ so nam lag cha'i dbyibs 'cho ba/
bzo dbyibs grub pa'am dod pa/ bris 'bur lag bzo'i dbyibs thon pa/ sbyangs 'bras yig gzugs kyi dbyibs thon pa/

gi mu bzhi: kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis la yin min gyi mu bzhi yod de, rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi ni kha dog yin la dbyibs ma yin pa'i mu dang, ring po dang thung ngu, lham pa dang zlum po bzhi ni dbyibs yin la kha dog ma yin pa'i mu dang, sprin dang du ba, rdul dang khug sna bzhi ni kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis ka yin pa'i mu dang, 'byung ba bzhi ni dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu yin no/
1) bzo mdzes pa/ 2) (yul) phal skad du dbyibs mi legs pa'i ming/
bzo dbyibs 'dra mtshungs/ dpe ris ma bu gnyis po khyad med dbyibs mtshungs su 'bri ba/
mig shes kyis gzung bya gang zhig ring thung phra sbom sogs kyi bzo lta can gyi gzugs/
1) dngos spyad sogs kyi bzo dbyibs/ rlangs 'khor 'di dbyibs bzo 'bring zhig red/ 2) bya spyod kyi cho babs/ thabs jus 'ding stangs 'di'i dbyibs bzo khrig khrig cig 'dug /
(yul) 1) phyis pa'am bsubs pa/ me mda' dbyis pa/ ri mo dbyis pa/ 2) byugs pa'am zhal zhal byas pa/ rtsig ldebs la tshon rtsi dbyis pa/ 'dag zhal dbyis pa/

/ 1) nyin mtshan gcig gi yun tshad chu tshod drug cu tham par phye ba'i chu tshod/ 2) nyi tshod lta byed kyi shing bu/ 3) dbyug pa chung chung/ 4) tha skar te rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / 5) (mngon) gdos pa/
rgyag dbyug ste, g.yul las 'don skabs snye ma rdung byed cig /

dpyad kyi nang tshan nad dmigs steng dbyug pa chung ngus rdeg pa'i bcos thabs shig ste, pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i dbyug bcos dang, grub chen o rgyan pa'i dbyug bcos, de'u dmar dge bshes kyi dbyug bcos lta bu'o/

1.(tha dad pa) dbyugs pa, dbyug pa, dbyugs, 1) 'phen pa dang, rdeg pa, snun pa/ lag 'bom dbyug pa/ dgra'i mgo bor mtshon cha dbyug pa/ ral gri dbyug pa/ 2) 'dor ba dang, skyur ba/ gad snyigs dbyug pa/ dgos med kyi las ka phar dbyugs shig / kha lud dbyug pa/ lo gcig dka' las brgyab, zhogs gcig g.yang la dbyugs/ lham hrul ltar phangs med du dbyug pa/ 2.ber ka ste shing sogs kyi rgyug pa/ khyi ngan par dbyug pas bsdigs pa/ lag tu dbyug pa hril hril thogs pa/ lteb gris dbyug pa gcod pa/

1) (dandi) dus rabs bdun par rgya gar lho phyogs bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon dandi zhes pa sngon gyi snyan ngag gi bstan bcos rnams kyi snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung snyan ngag me long zhes bya ba rtsom mkhan de'o/ 2) slob dpon rta dbyangs/ 3) (mngon) 1.nyi ma'i 'khor/ 2, gshin rje'i rgyal po/
g.yug g.yug / khu tshur g.yas g.yon gnyis dbyug dbyug byed pa/
dbyug gu zla ba zhes pa tha skar zla ba'am hor zla dgu pa ste, ston zla 'bring ba'o/
1.'byed pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.bye brag gam khyad par/ dgra gnyen gyi dbye ba gsal por 'byed pa/ tshig don gyi dbye ba bkrol ba/ pho mo'i dbye ba med pa/

1) zur du 'byed pa/ kho la dbye ba de 'dra gcod dgos pa'i don ci yin nam/ 2) spu ris gcod pa'am khyad par 'byed pa/ bden rdzun gyi dbye ba gcod pa/ yang dag yin min gyi dbye ba bcad nas blang dor ma nor bar 'jug pa/
dbye ba rags rim/ dngos rdzas spus ka yag nyes kyi dbye ba che long tsam zhig 'byed pa/ mi grangs mang nyung gi dbye ba che long tsam bstan pa/
dam bcas pa'i tshig gi nang gses don tshan rnams 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra zhig / dus gsum ste, 'das ma 'ongs, da lta'o/
sha rus rtsa rgyus sogs kyi bar mtshams kyi stong gsang/
1) dbye ba byar med pa/ 2) dbye bsal/
khyad par logs su phye ba'i ming/ dbye 'byed brtag zhib/ dbye 'byed bsdoms rtsis/ legs nyes dbye 'byed byas pa/ dgra dang rang phyogs kyi so mtshams la dbye 'byed gsal por phye ba/
dbye ba phye mtshams/ gral rim dbye mtshams/ dbang ris kyi dbye mtshams gcod pa/
so sor dbye ba phye ba'i zhib 'jug / dngos po bye brag par dbye zhib byed stangs bye brag pa zhig byed dgos/
dbye ba 'byed sa'i gzhi'am rtsa ba/ dbye gzhi gcig las dbye ba mang po phye ba/
dbye ba phye ba/ bshad tshul rigs mi 'dra ba rnams dbye bsal zhib mor byed pa/
so sor 'byed pa'i phra ma/ mthun par dbyen sbyor byas pas, chags sgo rang la 'khor song/
phra ma/ mdza' mthun 'brel lam la dbyen dkrug byed pa/
(rnying) 1) sdang bar byed pa/ 2) co 'dri ba/
(rnying) 'dod pas sems dbang med du g.yos pa/
'khon rtsod mthun 'grigs byung ba/ drang ldan gyi mthun gros byas par brten, sngar yod rtsod gzhir dbyen 'dums byung ba/
dbyen zlum mchod rten dang don gcig
phan tshun mi mthun pa mthun par byas pa/ phan tshun 'khrug rtsod 'phro gcod phyir du dbyen bsdums pa/
(rnying) 'dod pas nyen pa dang, sems dkrugs pa, bzi ba, co 'dri ba, sdang bar byed pa, mtho 'tsham pa rnams la 'jug /

dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, bsgo ba las gyur pa'i lhag ma bzhi'i nang gses, mtshams nang gcig tu bcas ldan dge slong gis rang mi the ba'i dge 'dun du longs pa gnyis chos min gyi lta bas phan tshun dbyen byed pa la, gzhan gyis lan gsum bzlog kyang mi nyan pa'o/
phra ma'am dkrug shing byed pa/ dbyen 'byed yang yang byas nas phan tshun sha len gyi 'khrug rtsod rgyag tu bcug pa/
phra ma'am dkrug shing/ spun zla'i bar la dbyen sbyor byas pa/
phan tshun 'khon rtsod slong ba'i dkrug shing/ phyogs gnyis phan tshun gyi bar du dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab nas mi mthun pa bzo ba/

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, rgyal po'i khab tu lhas byin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa mchog zung gis 'dums pa'i tshe bzhengs pa'i bang rim bzhi pa gru bzhi zur mnyam par bcad pa'i mchod rten/
'khrugs pa slar bsdums pa/ lab gleng gi dbyen bzlums pa/
dbye ba 'byed mi thub pa/ mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril lar rgya zab mo dbyer mi phyed pa/ legs nyes dbyer mi phyed pa blun po'i rang rtags red/
gsung lnga'i ya gyal zhig sgra skad thams cad grag stong gnyis su med pas mtha' gnyis las grol ba ni dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung zhes sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa'o/
tha dad dbye byar med pa/ chu dang 'o ma gcig tu bsres pa lta bu'i dbyer med pa/
go skabs dang, bar mtshams dang, khyon dang, zheng kha/ dpral ba'i dbyes ni zla ba rgyas pa bzhin/ rgyal khab kyi sa khongs dbyes yangs pa/ sa khul dbyes che ba/
bod kyi mi bu rigs drug gi ya gyal zhig /
bar dang, mtshams dang, srubs/ ka ba'i dbrag / brag ri'i dbrag nas chu thon pa/
bar bar/ 'phros mol byed pa'i dbrag dbrag la mtshams 'jog pa/ khang pa phan tshun gyi dbrag dbrag la tshal zhing 'debs pa/
dbrol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
(yul) ril ril/ shel tog dbril dbril/ rdo dbril dbril/ 'ug pa'i mig dbril dbril/
btsog po'am skyug bro po/ spyod pa dbre po/ gyon chas dbre po/
1.mi gtsang ba dang, ngan pa/ mi 'di de 'dra'i dbre ba la ngas bsam ma byung/ 2.(rnying) gyen du rdze ba/
'phrog pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
(tha dad pa) dbral ba, dbral ba, dbrol,, ral bar byed pa/ shog bu dbrol ba/ gyon gos dbral ba/ chings yig dbrol ba/
'jim pa'am ras bse dang, ko bse, shog bse sogs las bzos pa'i gdong gi 'dra gzugs/ khyi mgor mi 'bag g.yogs kyang khyi'i ngo bo 'gyur mi yong/ 'bag phar g.yogs, rdzig tshur skul/
1) 'jim pa'i sku/ 2) 'bag g.yogs pa'i gsob kyi sku/
, tshig cher mi gsal ba'i shab shub tu smra tshul/ lkog lab 'bag ge 'bug ges gzhan yid sun/
1) ngo 'bag gdong la gyon pa/ 2) yin khul du brdzus pa/ 'dre 'bag gyon nas mi la skrag snang skul/
, mgor gyon chog pa'i gdong brnyan/
gdong gi dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i chas/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 'bags pa, 'bag pa,, 1) 'go ba dang, nyams pa/ lus la dri mas 'bags pa/ dug can gyi rlangs pa btang nas sdod khang dang 'gro lam rtswa shing sogs 'bag yong/ ngan goms kyis 'bag pa/ 2) longs su spyad nas zad pa/ 2...1) btsog pa/ phyi bdar byas nas dri ma'i 'bag pa seng ba/ 2) 'bag gyon nas 'cham rgyag mkhan/
gson 'dre ma ste bud med kyi ngan ming zhig /

spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, chos gos gsum gang rung nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi bar du 'bral ba'o/

/ 1) «salu» 'bru rigs shig / mon 'bras/ sha 'bras/ 'bru rigs la mthong chen byas nas 'bras nyag ma gcig kyang 'phro brlag mi gtong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la gra ma med pa dang, dung gi mu tig pa da, 'bru dkar bcas so, 2) 'gram 'khrugs dang kha zas ma smin pa sogs kyis ngan khrag rgyas te rlung gis bsgril nas shing bi da ra yi 'bras bu ltar sra mkhregs ldan par gyur pas na 'bras zhes zer te lhan skyes rma yi nang tshan zhig /
