ya gling gi lho rgyud dang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi lho ldebs su chags pa'i rgyal khab cig yin zhing, rang rgyal gyi bod ljongs dang, 'brug yul, nee p'a la, hin rdu bcas kyi bar du gnas yod, rgyal sa ni sgang thog yin la, rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i rgyal khab yin, 1975 lor hin rdu'i khongs su zla sgril btang ba red/
tshad ma'i 'bras bu ste, rang yul yang dag par rtogs pa'o/

'bras rtogs gsum gyi ya gyal, rang rig gi tshad 'bras te, 'dzin rnam gyi shes pas rang rtogs pa'i cha, gzung rnam gzhal bya, 'dzin rnam tshad ma, rang rig 'bras bur 'jog pa ni sems tsam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag go /

'bras rtogs gsum gyi ya gyal, gzhan rig gi tshad 'bras te, gzung rnam gyi shes pa rnams kyis rang yul rtogs pa'i cha, gzung bya'i yul gzhal bya, 'dzin byed kyi blo, yul de'i rnam par shar nas yul de la gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa tshad ma, rang yul dngos su rtogs pa 'bras bur 'jog pa ste mdo sems thun mong ba'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag go /
tshad ma'i 'bras bu la nang gses su 'bras rtogs dang po dang, 'bras rtogs gnyis pa, 'bras rtogs gsum pa bcas gsum mo/

'bras rtogs gsum gyi ya gyal, mdo sde pa'i thun mong min pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras 'jog tshul zhig ste, phyi don gyi gzugs gzhal bya, gzugs de la rang yul gyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa tshad ma, tshad ma rang nyid gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba'i sgo nas rang gi bdag nyid du ma gyur pa'i gzugs rtogs pa tshad 'bras yin no/

dbus phyogs dge lugs dgon chen gsum gyi ya gyal 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis btab pa zhig ste, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs ri bo dge lugs pa'i chos dang, bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab srid lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bod ljongs yongs la kha lo sgyur ba'i lam lugs de dgon pa 'di'i dga' ldan pho brang du thog mar btsugs, dgon pa de lha sa'i nub rgyud dge 'phel dbu rtser yod/
'bras spungs dgon pa'i dga' ldan pho brang gi ming rnying pa/
1) 'bras spungs dgon pa'i spyi so'i bsdus ming/ 2) sngar dbyin jis rgya gar dbang sgyur skabs 'bras ljongs su btang ba'i gzhung tshab blon chen/

1) rgyus bskyed par bya ba'i dngos po, sa bon las myu gu 'byung ba lta bu'o/ lo 'bras/ shing 'bras/ dge bar 'bras bu bzang po yod la, sdig par 'bras bu ngan pa yod pa/ kham bu btsugs pa'i lo gsum par 'bras bu chags pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la gang bu dang, snye ma, sbubs, mdzod bcas so, 2) gzhag bya'am, dgos pa'i grub 'bras dang byas rjes/ ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu/ lam phyogs nor bas ngal ba che yang 'bras bu med pa/ 3) rlig rdog / phag pa'i 'bras bu phyung ba/ 4) gnyan 'bur lta bu'i phol mig /
can gyi lam: mchog gi 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du brnyes par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi myur lam/
'gal ba'i gtan tshigs gsum gyi ya gyal, rtags dang bsgrub bya gnyis kyi rgyu 'bras 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs ltar snang, dper na dung sgra chos can, rtag ste, rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/

snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags kyi nang gses, 'bras bu rtags su bkod nas de dang 'gal ba'i rgyu'i nus pa thogs med 'gog pa, dper na, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed kyi grang rgyu'i nus pa thogs med med de, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu me 'bras rtags su bkod nas, de dang 'gal ba'i grang rgyu'i nus pa thogs med du 'byung ba 'gog pa'o/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya 'bras bu'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed rgyu mang po nye bar tshogs kyang 'bras bu skyed pa'i nus shugs ma thon pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu dang, bdag po'i 'bras bu dang, skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu dang, rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang, bral ba'i 'bras bu ste lnga'o/
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, rgyu las 'bras bu snga bar ston pa'i rgyu'i rgyan zhig /
'bras bu thogs rgyu yod pa'i rtsi shing spyi/ ming gi rnam grangs la snye ma can dang, nags mchog 'bras ldan, 'bras bu 'dzin, 'bru ldan, me tog 'bras ldan, bza' shing, shing thog can bcas so,
bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris gsum pa ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha rnams ni so skyes bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i 'bras bu gzhan 'og ma rnams las che bas 'bras bu che ba zhes bya/
tshogs gnyis bsags stobs kyis thob pa'i mthar thug gi yon tan/

ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa: 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnod byed kyi khyab bya rtags su bkod nas, gnod bya'i 'bras bu 'gog pa ste, dper na, tsandan gyi mes khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed med de, tsandan gyi mes khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu tsan dan gyi mes grang ba'i 'bras bu med par sgrub pa'o/

'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnod byed kyi 'bras bu rtags su bkod nas, gnod bya'i 'bras bu 'gog pa ste, dper na du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhir chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed med de, du ba drag tu 'phyur bas khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu me 'bras kyis grang ba'i 'bras bu med par sgrub pa'o/

'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa bzhi'i nang gses, gnod byed kyi ngo bo rtags su bkod nas, gnod bya'i 'bras bu 'gog pa ste, dper na, mes khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can, grang 'bras spu long byed med de, mes khyab par non pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu me'i rang bzhin gyis grang ba'i 'bras bu med par sgrub pa'o/

dge sdig gi 'bras bu bde sdug gi rnam par dngos su nyams su myong ba'o/
1) rgyus 'bras bu 'byung bar byed pa/ 2) pho'i rlig 'bras gcod pa/

gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bcu bzhi'i nang gses, 'bras bu rtags su bkod pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog na rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rang rgyud 'phen pa ste, dper na, me med dus kyi rgya mtshor chos can, me yod par thal, du ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, du ba med de, me med pa'i phyir, zhes bzlog pa rang las gzhan pa'i rigs 'phen pa'o/

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung lugs la rig pa'i ye shes nyid sgrib byed kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag pa'i gnas skabs te de nyid sku dang ye shes thams cad kyi 'char gzhi yin pas rdzogs pa dang, de yang ngo bo ye dag yin pas spang ba phun tshogs dang, rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha nas stobs sogs rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pas rtogs pa phun tshogs dang, de gnyis zung du tshogs pa las lhun grub rten 'byung gi snang ba 'gro ba'i dpal du shar ba phrin las phun tshogs te spang rtogs phrin las gsum gyi bdag nyid can yin pas chen po'o/

ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can: srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, grags pa dang ma grags pa'i rgyu gnyis ka bkag nas rgyu med pa tsam las byung ba'i 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
ba 'debs pa: rgyu sdig pa byas pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang, rgyu dge ba byas pas 'bras bu bde ba dang, thar ba dang, thams cad mkhyen pa sogs med do zhes skur ba 'debs pa'o/

a ru ra dang, ba ru ra, skyu ru ra bcas gsum ste, nus pas khrag mkhris sel, bcud len, mig gsal, 'du ba snyom par byed/
nyer len gyi rgyu de nyid glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba las gnas gyur pa'i tshul gyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi skur mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/

rtags yang dag gi nang gses, yod pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang ba ste, dper na du ldan gyi la la chos can, me yod de du ba yod pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu de byung gi 'brel ba la brten nas 'bras bu'i rtags kyis rgyu dpog pa'o/

'bras bu'i rtags yang dag la sbyor ba 'god tshul gyis dbye na lnga ste, rgyu dngos sgrub kyi 'bras rtags dang, rgyu spyi sgrub kyi 'bras rtags dang, rgyu sngon song sgrub kyi 'bras rtags dang, rgyu khyad par sgrub kyi 'bras rtags dang, rgyu chos rjes dpog gi 'bras rtags bcas so/

chu'i dbu ba/ snying med gsob gsob chu yi lbu ba de, phal cher byung ma thag nas yal te 'gro/ brag dang chu bo 'thabs nas lbu ba 'phyur ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu bur dang, chu'i 'dzum dkar, dbu ba bcas so,
1) shing gi bye brag cig / 2) zhal ba 'chag byed kyi sa dkar po zhig /
sba smyug tshon khra'i gzeb slo/
sngar chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan skabs bod kyi sad mi mi bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
sba shing las bzos pa'i lag 'khar/
shing bzo ba'i lag cha zhig /
nyes skyon mi mngon par byed thabs/ skyon dang nor 'khrul sba 'gebs byas pa/
brag ri nas skyes pa'i sba/
sba las bzos pa'i lcag tshan/
sba las bzos pa'i yo byad/
ja mdong dang, zo ba, zom sogs la btang ba'i sba chings/
sba las bzos pa'i thag pa/
1.sbed pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. 1) pho mo'i rtags sam 'doms/ 2) gsang bya'i don/

shug pa spa ma'am shug pa tsher ma can gyi 'bras bu ste, ro kha la tsha ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas snod mkhris lus la gram nas sha pags ser por gyur pa dang, gzhang 'brum, tshigs mig tu chu ser 'phel ba sogs la phan/
1) shing gi bye brag cig / 2) zhal ba 'chag byed kyi sa dmar po zhig /

sba gsal snang gi bzhed par grags pa ste, bsam yas kyi dkar chag chen po zhes kyang zer, de ni spyi lo dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod rje khri srong lde btsan skabs kyi lo rgyus cung zad zhib pa zhig yin zhing, nang don gtso che ba bsam yas gtsug lag khang brgyab nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi chos spel ba'i lo rgyus yin zhing, bod dang thang rgyal rabs kyi 'brel ba dang, bod dang rgya gar bar chos lugs thog nas 'gro 'ong byed tshul, btsan po'i bka' gtsigs bsgrags pa, sgra bsgyur btsugs te chos bsgyur ba sogs skabs de'i chab srid lam lugs dang dpal 'byor rig gnas kyi 'phel rgyas kyang gsal por 'khod 'dug /
sba'i lcug phran bsgrims nas phar tshur btang ba'i zam pa/
sngo sman zhig de'i rtsa bar lus bde ba dang khams dmar snyoms sgrig byed pa'i nus pa yod/
ra bzi ba dang, brgyal nyams/ na tsha byung ste chang gis bzi ba ltar sba ri sbi ri byas byung/
ser snas sba ba/ rang la lag rtsal gyi man ngag ji yod slob ma rnams la sba sri med par bslabs pa/
sba khra'i slo ma'i bsdus tshig
mi mngon pa'am mi tshor bar byed pa'i thabs/ gros bsdur sba gsang byed pa/ bsam 'char sba gsang ma byed/ snying gtam sba gsang byed pa/

rba zhes kyang snang, sngar chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon po sba gsal snang gis rgyal po'i bka' bzhin rgya gar nas mkhan chen bo dhi stwa bod du gdan drangs, mkhan pos gsal snang la ye shes dbang po zhes pa'i ming btags, de rjes bsam yas su mkhan chen dang, slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas mnyam 'dzoms dus bod btsun gyi thog ma sad mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i ya gyal byas rjes che ba zhig yin/
(rgya) rtsed chas shig / sbag dkrug pa/ rgyan bzhag nas sbag rgyag pa/
ja bag khag gi bzhi thig gcig /
1) ja bag khag / 2) rtsed chas shig /
1.(tha dad pa) sbags pa, sbag pa, sbogs,, sgo ba dang, slod pa/ dri mas sbags pa/ ngan goms kyis sbags pa/ skyon gyis sbags pa/ btsog pas sbags pa/ 2.sbag rgyag mkhan/
(yul) drag shul gyi khros pa'i rnam 'gyur/ g.yo ham gyi bsam ngan lam du ma lhongs pas khros te gzugs po sbag sbag gsig gsig byed pa/
btsog par gyur pa/ spus ka legs nyes sbags 'dres su gyur pa/
chang ma btsags gong gi sbang glum/
chang btsags zin pa'i ro ma/ sbang ma btsags kyang chang mi yong/ ming gi rnam grangs la glum ro dang chang snyigs so,
sbang ma za mkhan te mi la smod pa'i tshig cig
chang gi sbang ma'i nang sman sbyar nas na sar lums byed pa'i bcos thabs shig /
sbangs tsha po nad la gtugs te bcos pa'i sman dpyad cig /
(rnying) 1) rgyun ma chad/ 2) shugs che ba/
mang po phyogs gcig bsdebs pa'i chag pa/ kha btags sbab cha gcig / mu zi sbab cha gnyis/
gzhan ngor 'dra chags chags kyi zol ma/
mun khrod lta bur dngos rigs lag nyul gyis 'tshol stangs/ mtshan mo zhu mar med na sbar nyul mi rgyag thabs med red/
1.sbor ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.lag pa'i sbar mo/

/ 1) rkang mthil lam lag mthil sor sen bcas kyi ming/ mi'i sbar mo/ gcan gzan gyi sbar mo bzhi/ zan dron sbar mor btsir ba/ lag g.yas kyi sbar mor me mda' 'dzin pa/ nyi shar sbar mos 'gebs pa/ spre'us bza' bca' sbar mo brgyab ste len pa/ 2) lag mthil gyi nang du shong ba'i tshad/ chu sbar mo gang/ rtsam pa sbar mo gang/ 3) lud 'don byed dang, 'bru dang phub ma gyen du phyar te dbye 'byed byed pa'i zhing las yo byad cig /
lag 'dzing/ g.yul sar dgra dang sbar 'dzing byed pa/
, 1) glo snying rgyu long mkhal ma la sogs par skran skyes pa 'don byed kyi yo byad cig / 2) lus kyi rtsa lam zhig gi ming/ 3) srog chags sbal pa'i mgo /
1) sman du 'gro ba'i rdo zhig / 2) nya'i bye brag gi pags pa zhig /
rdo sman sbal pa'i rgyab kyi 'brum pa ltar yod pa mdog dkar po zhig ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus pa sbyor, chu ser skem, klad skyon gso/
1) sbal pa dang lcong mo/ 2) sbal pa'i phru gu lcong mo/

chu dang skam sa gnyis kar sdod cing, 'phar mchongs brgyab nas 'gro ba'i sgal rus can gyi srog chags shig / khron pa'i sbal pa mthong rgya chung/ sbal pa mthong dus lcong mo sangs rgyas red/ 'phar 'gro sbal pas tshwa thigs mi theg bzhin, thub tshod btsan dbang sus kyang bzod mi 'gyur/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyal can dang, lce med, char las skyes, 'phar 'gro, bshang sbas bcas so,
rdo ba zas su za ba'i sbal pa zhig /
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas gag pa dang, lhog pa, lce 'bam, rlung nad bcas 'joms/
me tog gi thi'u/ ldum ra'i nang gi me tog sbal mig phye nas rgyas pa/
sbal pa'i gnas sa'i tshang/ sbal pa rma can gcig gis sbal tshang 'phung/
sngo chu srin sder mo'i ming gzhan,
rdza sogs las bzos pa'i chang snod leb mo zhig /
mi mngon par byas pa/ mtshon cha sbas bskungs byas pa/
lta ba dang mngon rtogs kyi rim pa khyad par can/

srog rtsa nag po las gyes pa'i lus phyir mi mngon zhing khog pa'i nang du sbas pa lta bu'i don snod dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gnad che ba brgyad de, snying dang 'brel ba gcig glo ba dang 'brel ba gnyis, mchin pa dang 'brel ba gcig mtsher pa dang 'brel ba gcig mkhal ma g.yas g.yon dang 'brel ba gnyis, bsam se dang 'brel ba gcig bcas so/
sngar bod kyi rdzong zhig gi ming yin zhing, deng sang 'dam gzhung rdzong gi snying grong ngo/
1) gsang ba'i yul lung/ 2) lung khug btsan po/
gzhan gyis ha mi go ba byas pa ste,
(yul) bod mda'i me len gyi skud rdzas shig /

(yul) mngon chung gi sgo nas gnas tshul lta rtog byed pa'i 'on gseng ngam rdzi gsang/ rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul 'gyur ldog ji byung rigs la sbi gsang dod po'i sgo nas rtog zhib dbye 'byed kyis ngos 'dzin byed dgos/
(yul) 1) 'chal gtam mam dkrog gtam/ khungs lung med pa'i sbir sgra ma shod/ 2) me mda' sogs kyi sgra cher grag stangs/ me sgyogs kyi sbir sgra che ba/ chu brag 'thab pa'i sbir sgra/
(yul) rang dgar tshod tshod kyis bshad pa'i gtam/ blo brtan po yod pa'i mi rnams kyis sbir gtam ji tsam thos kyang spyod tshul la g.yo 'gul btang mi yong/
, dbyug pa'am, sdong bu smyug ma lta bu'i khog stong/ ngar lcags kyi sbu gu / 'gyig gi sbu gu/ sog ma'i sbu gu / pad ma'i sbu gu / smyug ma'i sbu gu'i nang nas nam mkhar lta ba/
sha gseb na gnas pa'i khrag rtsa rkyang pa gtar byed kyi gtsag bu zhig /
/ 1) sbu gu'i bsdus yig / smyug sbug / sog sbug / 2) mdo sbug gnyis su phye ba'i sbug / khang pa'i sbug / gzims chung sbug / mdzod sbug / 'khyag pa'i sbug / blo sbug dog po
cha lang/ rgya sbug / hor sbug / bal sbug / sbug chal dang sil snyan 'khrol ba/
ngan g.yo lto mthun gyis phar tshur 'bod skyel byed pa/ dgra phyogs dang sbug mthun bsu skyel yin khul gyis dgra phyogs la myang zhib byed pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs t'a la'i bla ma'i tham ga/ sbug dam bka'i rgya/
sba gsang chad lhag / byung song rtsis rgyag rigs sbug 'dren thal lus med pa zhig byung 'dug /
(yul) sngar bod kyi mnga' bdag gi spyi rdzas gtong len gyi stangs 'dzin byed mkhan/
/ 1) mi mngon pa'i gting phug ring po/ 2) kha sbug dog po'i mi/
sbug dam 'byar ma ste, sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs t'a la'i bla ma'i sbug tham phab yod pa'i gzhung yig /
nang gi nang/ khang pa sbug ma/ dngos nor sbug ma/
phug gi don rtsa/ mi'i bsam pa'i sbug rtsa ma lon par gsed bkrol byas kyang mi phan/ las don gyi sbug rtsa lon pa/
lkog tu zos pa/ spyi pa'i rgyu nor sger gyis sbug zos byas pa/
yi ge'i sbo rko byed gzong zhig /
(yul) rtswa'am rtsid mthil can gyi zon pa/
(rnying) 1) stobs shugs/ 2) brtson pa/ 3) dam bca'/
(rnying) 1) stobs bskyed pa/ 2) 'bad rtsol byas pa/ 3) dam bca' brtan pa/

ra lpags sogs las bzos pa'i me sbar byed cig / me 'bud par sbud pa rgyag pa/ sbud pa ldir sgra che yang lag pa'i 'og red/ sbud pa kha 'phang mtho yang, lag chung g.yas pa'i 'og red/ ming gi rnam grangs la khol mo dang, pags pa dbugs 'byin pa, sbud shan bcas so,
don de rang la ched du dmigs pa'i dpe/
(rnying) 1) bud thum gyis 'gro/ 2) mgo 'bur rgyu med par gyur pa/
1) shing gi shun pa/ 2) 'bru'i phub ma/
'bru rigs kyi shun pa dang lhad/
nas 'bru'i phyi lpags mang po phyogs gcig tu spungs pa ltar dgos phan med pa'i dpe/
/ 1) shun pa dang, phyi'i pags pa dang, phub ma/ 'bru med sbun pa 'phyar la snying po med/ 2) bsres pa'am rdzun ma/
(tha dad pa) sbubs pa, sbub pa, sbubs, ,snod kha 'og tu ston pa'am kha sa la ston pa/ dkar yol kha sbubs te bzhag pa/
1.sbub pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) sbubs ma'i bsdus ming, 2) (mngon) 1, sgo nga/ 2, pho mtshan gyi 'bras bu/
nang ngam khog stong/ lcags dong gi sbubs khong nas chu drangs pa/
1) nang nas thar ba/ 2) kha phye ba/ me tog gi sbubs grol te zhal kha phye ba/
sbubs can i khung nang du gzhang 'brum gcur byed kyi yo byad cig /
rus pa la i khung 'bigs byed kyi yo byad cig /
shur sgam med pa'i cog tse/
1) khog pa chung ngu/ 2) sbu gu phra mo/
1) smyug sbug sogs 'gags pa bshangs pa/ 2) sgo nga sogs kha phye ba/ bye'us sgong sbubs brtol nas phyir thon pa/
nang stong pa yin pa'i thur ma/
lus stod kyi rnag gsang dbye ba 'byed byed yo byad cig /
(yul) lcags sogs kong kong bzo byed kyi tho ba/
kong dong/ ri khog sbubs dong/ sa 'og sbubs dong/
phra zhing ring la khog stong yin pa'i dngos po/ khung bu'i sbubs/ rtsa'i sbubs/ sog sbubs/ lcags sbubs/ rlid sbubs/ rna sbubs/ pad sbubs/ me tog sbubs dbyibs can/ rtsa sbubs phra ba/
brag phug sogs sbubs bshangs te che ru btang ba lta bu/
rna ba nas rna bar brgyud pa'i gsang gtam/
srin bu'i bye brag sbur gog nag po/
skogs shun can gyi 'bu'i spyi ming/ bse sbur/ grog sbur/
rtswa snyigs sam, gzan snyigs dang, spu rdul sogs nyal nyil du spungs pa'i rigs/ sgo ra'i nang gi sbur ma phyags nas lud sbyor byed pa/
rtswa'am sog ma sogs kyi me phra mo/
spos shel, thang chu'i rigs kyi 'gyur rdo 'jam po zhig ste, brdar tsam byas na rdul phran nam sbang rdul 'then len byed thub pa, nam rgyun du rgyan char byed/
(yul) gser ram dngul las bzos pa'i khams phyogs kyi rna rgyan zhig /
bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i nang gses, dbu ru'i ming gsar/

bod rang skyong ljongs khongs mtsho sna rdzong 'og mon yul khul gyi sa cha de thog sngar t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i a zhang sde pa zhig gi gzhis ka'i sa khang yod skad/
mi gnyis phan tshun dbyug res rdab res byed pa'i lus rtsal zhig ste rgya gar skad bheka: zer ba las zur chag pa 'dra/ bheka:...
phan tshun 'thams te shed tshad pa/
phan tshun gcig la gcig 'thams nas shed tshad pa/
shed rtsal gyi gras sbe ga dang rdo 'gyogs gnyis/ sbe ga rdo 'gyogs kyi 'gran sdur byed pa/
phan tshun 'dzing tshul gyis shed stobs tshad pa/
(rnying) 1) dngos ngan sha chung ba/ 2) sha skem pa/

(tha dad pa) sbas pa, sba ba, sbos,, mi mngon par byed pa/ sa'i 'og tu 'bar mdel sbas pa/ rang skyon sbed pa/ dpe cha gter du sbas nas mi lo bdun brgya song ba/ dpung tshogs nags tshal du sbas pa/ sa khung brus te kha zas sbed pa/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, tho 'tsham pa'i bsam pas dge slong gi gos dang lhung bzed sogs yo byed sbed pa'o/
«supintra» gnas brtan bcu drug las ri rgyal bi hu lar bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig /
/ 1) lus kyi brang khog dkyil gyi ming/ sbo chu la sbang ma dgos par, rkyal nya 'dra po rgyag 'dod/ 2) dbo dang 'dra,
grod pa dang rgyu ma'i nang du 'ur sgra sgrog pa/
brang khog gi sbo ldir ldir byed tshul/ las 'gan lci po yin par shes nas sbo dgyed dgyed byas te len phod pa/
(yul) rkang pa'i snga rting thad kyi lham gyi rdog pa/
lug gi lto ba'i ngos kyi bal/
mig gi ling thog yos sbo gas pa lta bu/
grod pa'am, rgyu ma'i nang 'ur sgra 'byin pa/
(yul) zhig pa/ dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha sbo lug pa/
ska rags ma bcings par gos lhug por gyon pa/ brel 'tshab chen pos ska rags 'ching long med par sbo lug mar phyir thon dgos byung 'dug /
'ud shob bam kha rbad/ skad cha sbo shob tsha po/

(tha dad pa) sbangs pa, sbang ba, sbongs,, chu nang du sbong bar byed pa/ chu tsha por gos sbangs nas bkru ba/ 'bru son chu'i nang du sbong ba/ 'bras chu la sbangs te bsing ba/ mi chu la dbyug par rang phyed ka sbong dgos/
dar skud las bzos pa'i phod rgyan/ dar cha'i sbod/ mdung ring sbod dmar can/ skra sbod/
lus sbom pa dang lto ba 'bur po/
1.(tha dad pa) sbams pa, sbam pa,
1. phra ba min pa'i rags pa/ shing sdong sbom po/ thag pa sbom po/ gzugs po sbom po/ spro ba'i tshor ba sbom por brtas/ tshig sbom po/ skad cha sbom po ma shod/ 2. sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs shig /

sngags sdom gyi rtsa ba dang rjes su mthun pas yan lag yin zhing, sdom pa gtong byed kyi pham pa min yang dngos grub myur du 'grub pa la gegs byed pa'i phyir nyes pa lci bas sbom po'i ltung ba zhes bya'o/

sngags sdom gyi yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad de, dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i rig ma bsten pa, tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa, mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i rig ma las rang stobs kyis bdud rtsi len pa, don gnyer ldan pa'i slob mar gsang sngags kyi chos mi ston pa, dad ldan chos 'dri ba la chos gzhan ston pa, nyan thos nang du zhag bdun long bar bsdad pa, rnal 'byor ye shes dang mi ldan par sngags par rlom pa, snod min la zab don bshad pa ste brgyad do/
sbom pa dang phra ba/ shing sdong gi mgo gzhug sbom phra mnyam pa/ pho la rgod zhan yod gyur kyang, srog la sbom phra yod mi srid/
, 1) sdom cha byed pa/ 2) sdud pa/ 3) sre ba/ 2. sbom po dang don gcig, 1. sbom pa'i skul tshig 2. mtha' skor gyi ring tshad/
(tha dad pa) sbar ba, sbar ba, sbor,, 'bar bar byed pa/ sgron me sbar ba/ me sbar nas ring brda gtong ba/
(tha dad pa) 1) (yul) g.yo ba/ mar phyur gcig tu sbol ba/ sman phye dang mar khu sbol ba/ 2) phru slog pa/ sa stong sbol ba/ gsar sbol/ zhing kha sngon med gsar du sbol ba/
phyir 'bur du sbos shing skrangs pa/ khog pa sbos skrangs/ rma shu sbos skrangs/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) skrang ba dang, 'bur ba/ mig sbos pa/ rma kha sbos langs su song ba/ grod pa sbos pa/ rkang pa sbos pa/ sran ma sbos pa/ 2) rmongs sam 'thoms pa/ mgo sbos pa/
lus rgud pa'am sha skam pa/ dpyid dgun gyi dus su sgo phyugs sbyag tsher gyur pa rnams la logs su gso skyong byed dgos/
sa 'dru'i yo byad sbyag ma'i yu ba/
lcags kyi sbyag khyem chen pos sa zhing sbol slog / zhing khar sbyag slog gting ring po brgyab pa/ ston thog brngas 'phral du sbyag slog brgyab na phyi lor lo legs yong re yod/
bang ba dang, rjang/ 'bru sbyang nang du til nag blugs/

byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i lnga pa, sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can smin par byed pa'i tshe gzhan gyi log sgrub kyis nyon mi mongs pas sems can gyi zhing dang rang gi sems sbyang dka' ba gnyis po de 'byongs pas sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba'o/
chos lugs pas sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang, rnam shes gnas spor gyi cho ga zhig /
1. sbyong ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. rgyun pa rnams la gshin po'i gos phul te sgrib sbyong gi cho ga 'don pa/
med snang glo bur gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma phra rags dang bcas pa ste, dper na nor bu la sgrib par byed pa'i 'dam rdzab lta bu'o/
sbyang ba'i brtson 'grus/ shes yon sna tshogs sbyang brtson byed pa/ lag rtsal sbyang brtson byas pa/ dmag rtsal sbyang brtson byed pa/
1) skye shi bar do gsum/ 2) bde gshegs snying po sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la gdod ma nas rang la rang chas su yod pa/ 3) ma dag pa'i phung po lnga sogs/
yi ge 'bri sa'i pang leb ste, byang shing yang zer/ sbyang shing gi steng du yi ge'i gzugs ris sbyangs/
byang shing thog yi ge sbyong mkhan slob phrug
bslabs nas lobs pa'am byang chub pa/ 'phrul bzo'i lag rtsal sbyangs goms mthar phyin pa/
lhad bton nas brdungs pa/ lcags rjen pa sbyangs brdungs byas nas ngar lcags su gyur pa/
gser dngul zangs lcags sogs lhad med las bzos pa'i dngos po/ gser sbyangs brdungs ma'i lag gdub/
1) bslabs nas shes pa'i yon tan/ 2) «dhutaguna:» nyan rang sogs kyi kun spyod kyi bye brag cig /
sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis

phyag dar khrod pa dang, chos gos gsum pa dang, phying pa ba dang, stan gcig pa dang, bsod snyoms pa dang, zas phyis mi len pa dang, dgon pa ba dang, shing drung ba dang, bla gab med pa dang, dur khrod pa dang, tsog pu ba dang, gzhi ji bzhin pa bcas bcu gnyis so/
sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa

1) bslabs sbyangs kyi lag rjes sam grub 'bras/ yig rtsis sbyangs 'bras thon pa/ 2) lam gyis dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs pa las, gzhi la ji ltar yod pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa ste, dper na 'dam rdzab las grol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa lta bu'o/
bslabs sbyangs kyi nyams myong ngam rjes 'bras/
sbyangs pa'i nyams 'gyur/ yig gzugs sbyangs sha thon pa/ lag shes kyi bzo bkod sbyangs sha mthar phyin par thon pa/ 'phong skyen rtsal lag gi sbyangs sha thon pa/
phan tshun sgrig ka/ pang leb dang pang leb sbyar ka rgyag pa/ shog bu dang shog bu sbyar ka mthud pa/
(yul) rdza mkhan gyis rdza sa rdung byed kyi lag cha zhig /
1) rdzas sna sbyar te bzos pa'i dug / 2) kha zas gang zhig dang lhan cig tu 'dres par sbyar ba'i dug gi ming/
sman sogs mang po bsres pa'i dri/
shing gi bye brag cig ste shol po'ang zer/
(yul) pus mo gnyis kyi bar du shing leb gnyis kha sbyar te bar du lham mthil sogs 'tshems byed/
sbyor ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,

don gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod dngos po zhig gi gnas lugs bsgrub byar bkod nas de'i sgrub byed rigs mtshungs kyi don gzhan zhig sgra sbyar gyi sgo nas ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sgra gcig gis don gnyis ston pa sbyar ba'i sgo nas gzhi gcig gi khyad chos 'gal bas bya ba 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, rjod byed kyi tshig gam sgra'i gzugs gcig gis, brjod bya sbyar gzhi dngos po gnyis kyi khyad par sbyar chos rnam grangs gnyis la sogs pa gang rung phan tshun sbyar ba'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs dgu ni, tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba, tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba, bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba, bya ba 'gal min gyi sbyar ba, 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba, nges pa can gyi sbyar ba, nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba, 'gal min gyi sbyar ba, 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba bcas so/

ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don gnyis khyad chos gsum gyi sgo nas mtshungs pa sgra sbyar nas thun min khyad chos re re'i sgo nas mtshungs pa las ldog ste so sor 'byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang don gnyis kar yod pa'i don gyi mtshungs chos 'ga' zhig tshig gi rim pa gcig la mnyam por sbyar te ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
stobs phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi khyad gzhi de dpe'i khyad gzhi'i gzugs su bkod cing, khyad chos 'ga' zhig la sgra sbyar, 'ga' zhig la don sbyar ba'i rgyan zhig /

gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, gsal bya dngos po gnyis kyi khyad chos 'dra ba thun mong du sbyar zhing, gsal byed gang rung gcig gis khyad gzhi gnyis kyi gnas lugs gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhig /

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya gtso bo'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig 'gog byed phal pa'i dngos po gtso bo dang mtshungs chos 'dra ba zhig sgra sbyar gyis bkod nas don du gtso bo'i dngos po de nyid 'gog par byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
bstan bcos kyi mjug tu bkod pa'i rtsom pa po'i ming/
rdzas kha shas sbyar ba las byung ba'i dri, dper na, rgya spos dang dbus spos kyi dri lta bu, dbye na zhim mi zhim gnyis yod/
/ 1) mang po kha sbyar nas bzos pa'i dngos chas/ shing sbyar ma/ shog bu sbyar ma/ ras sbyar ma/ gos sbyar ma/ 2) sa rko byed lcags khyem/ 3) (rnying) nyes par spyod pa can/
gyang sogs la sbyar ba'i yi ge/
shing sbyar pa gsar du 'dzugs rgyu'i son/
gsar du skye ba'i shing sbyar pa/

1) (yul) 'dred pa dang, 'byid pa/ skas nas sbyig pa/ 'dam la sbyig pa/ sar sbyig nas yar langs pa/ 2) mo phyugs sdeb sbyor gyi dus la bab pa/ mdzo mo sbyig dus sdeb sbyor byed/ 3) (rnying) gos kyis mnan pa/
sgren mo'am gos med gcer bu/ lus stod sbyig mo/ phru gu sbyig mo ma'i pang du 'khur ba/
ba'i dngos po lnga: dug dang, bud med, mtshon cha, chang, gzhan gnod chen po 'byung ba'i rdzas te lnga'o/
1) «danapati:» «d'ayag» grwa pa sogs la 'tsho chas sbyin pa po/ 2) nang ngam khyim gyi bdag po/ sbyin bdag 'dod dang ma bstun na, bzo pa mkhas kyang don go chung/
sbyin pa gtong yul lam, bsod nams gsog sa'am mchod pa 'bul yul/

1. (tha dad pa) byin pa, sbyin, sbyin,, 1) ster ba dang, sprod pa/ mi gzhan zhig gis rang la bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba sbyin mi yong/ bu mo mna' mar byin/ rgyu dngos sbyin pa/ drang bden gyi bya gzhag la rang gi lus srog sbyin phod pa/ 2) kha snon rgyag pa'am bsre ba/ lnga la gsum byin na brgyad/ 2./ 1) ster ba'i dngos po/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la gtan med mchod sbyin dang, gtong phod, dpal stug sbyin rlabs can, rab ster, ris med ster bcas so, 2) snon rtsis/
zang zing dang, chos dang, mi 'jigs pa dang, byams pa'i sbyin pa ste bzhi/
sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi sbyin pa gsum ste, chos dang, zang zing, mi 'jigs pa bcas kyi sbyin pa'o/
sbyin pa ster rgyu'i dngos rdzas/

sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi khyad chos bzhi ste ser sna sogs mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang, chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa, gang 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa, rigs can gsum smin par byed pa bcas so/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig sbyin pa'i phar phyin rim ldan du sgom pa'o/
«d'anp'armit'a» khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi gtong sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa ste, phar phyin drug gi ya gyal zhig /
yar dkon mchog dang, mar ngan slong sogs so/
ster ba dang len pa/ gzigs gzos sbyin len/ lkog rngan sbyin len/ lto gos sbyin len/
«hom:» yam shing sogs 'bar ba'i me'i mchod sbyin/
dbur zhal rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig / 'dam bag rlon pa sbyil mos dbur/
slob sbyong yang yang byed thabs/ skad yig sbyong brdar gtong ba/ lag rtsal sbyong brdar byed pa/ sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa/
(yul) dka' ngal chen po/ mi gsum gyi shed nga rang gcig pus 'don dgos byung bas sbyong po rang byung rung sngar ltar brtsigs pa de la nga'i gyad rdor grags pa yin/

(tha dad pa) sbyangs pa, sbyang ba, sbyongs,, 1) slob pa/ yi ge sbyong ba/ nang sbyong byed pa/ sbe ga sbyong ba/ dmag rtsal legs par sbyangs pa/ 2) skyon spong ba dang, 'dag par byed pa/ skyon cha sbyong ba/ blo sbyong/ sdig pa sbyong ba/ sgrib pa sbyangs pa/ byas rjes bzhan nas nyes pa sbyong ba/ 3) 'khru bshal byed pa/ grod khog sbyangs nas rgyu ma'i nang gi tshad pa bcos pa/ 4) ster ba'am gtong ba/ sgrub rgyags kyang rang gis sbyangs nas sgom du 'jug pa yin pas dga' bar gyis/ pha ma rgas nas las ka mi 'pher ba'i skabs su lto gos tshang ma phru gus sbyong ba/ 5) 'phri ba'i don/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang ba/ dbugs kyis sbyang/ sbyangs lhag / sbyangs shul/
bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyis bsdus pa'i lam, dpe don gyi 'od zer dang, dag ma dag pa'i sgyu lus, bslab pa'i zung 'jug la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor, dper na 'khrud byed kyi chu dang, 'dag rdzas lta bu/
gzhi rgyud sbyong byed kyi lam ste, 'od gsal dang, sgyu lus, sprul ba bcas so/
bshal dang, skyug sna sman, 'jam rtsi, ni ru ha bcas lnga/
1) rlung nad sbyong byed 'jam rtsi dang, mkhris pa'i nad sbyong byed bshal, bad kan nad sbyong byed skyug gsum mo/ 2) dan rog dang, dong ga ,shri khanda ste gsum/
yi ge'i sngon rjes ming gsum sbyar te klog pa'i ming/
'byar rtsi sogs kyis sbyar ba'i srubs/ sbyor kha med pa'i lcags sbug /
rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i ngag dper na, du ldan gyi la la chos can, me yod de, du ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
las ka'i sbyor ba'am sngon 'gro, dngos gzhi, mjug ste gsum/
spyi la rgyun 'jags su bzhag pa'i nor rdzas/

1. (tha dad pa) sbyar ba, sbyar ba, sbyor,, 1) bsdebs nas bzo ba dang, phan tshun sgrig pa,/ sman chang sbyor ba/ lud sbyor ba/ cha cha byas nas sbyor ba/ thal mo sbyar nas gus 'dud zhu ba/ shing bu gru bzhi mang po sbyar nas pang gcal bting ba/ 2) dngos su'am rnal mar 'byor bar byed pa/ dpe cha'i thog nas sbyangs pa'i shes yon rnams las ka la sbyor ba/ nyes can khrims la sbyor ba/ 3) sgom pa/ 4) 'khrig pa/ 2./ 1) thabs dang, sngon 'gro, bya spyod/ sbyor ba rtsub po/ 'thab 'dzing byed pa'i sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi ma tshugs gong du sbyor ba 'thus tshang byas pa/ 2) rigs pa/ rtsod pa chen po byed dus so so'i sgrub byed kyi sbyor ba yang dag gsal por shod pa/ 3) (mngon) kha sbyor skabs pho mo gnyis dgos pas grangs gnyis mtshon/ 4) lnga bsdus kyi nang gses, res 'grogs zla skar dang nyi dag gnyis bsres pas sbyor ba 'grub pa de ni, tshes rer dbang byed tshul du 'char ba'i sbyor ba nyer bdun po'i longs spyod gnas su gang shar nam langs phan chad 'das zin yin, yang skar rtsis lugs kyi bshad srol gzhan zhig la lha rgyal chen ris bzhi'i bu bdun po de dag gza' bdun dang, bu mo nyer brgyad de dag rgyu skar nyer brgyad yin pa dang, de dag phan tshun thug skabs su 'char ba'i lha la sbyor ba zer/ 5) sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, rtogs pa la rang dbang du bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gsum bsdus te sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/
1) rgya gar gyi slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba sna tshogs yod pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos shig / 2) (mngon) khyab 'jug /

skar rtsis lugs kyi gza' skar sbyor ba nyer bdun te sel ba dang, mdza' bo, tshe dang ldan pa, skal bzang, bzang po, shin tu skrangs pa, las bzang, 'dzin pa, zug rngu, skrangs pa, 'phel ba, nges pa, kun 'joms, dga' ba, rdo rje, dngos grub, shin tu ltung ba, mchog can, yongs 'joms, zhi ba, grub pa, bsgrub bya, dge ba, dkar po, tshangs pa, dbang po, 'khon 'dzin bcas so/
sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi rtsis dag /
sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa

thog mar tshul khrims dag 'bral bar mi byed cing sgo gsum gyi kun spyod dag pa dang, bar du bslab pa la gus pa dang bag yod pa shas cher gnas pas nyes pa rgyun du mi byed pa dang, mtha' mar brgya la byas na'ang sdig pa 'chags par byed pa'o/

sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi nang gses, nyams su len pa'i lam sbyor ba bzhi ste, rnam kun mngon rdzogs sbyor ba dang, rtse mo'i sbyor ba dang, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang, skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams so/
sbyor ba bzhi'i chos so drug

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang tshan, sbyor ba bzhi mtshon byed kyi chos sum cu rtsa drug ste, rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos bcu gcig dang, rtse mo'i sbyor ba'i chos brgyad dang, mthar gyis sbyor ba'i chos bcu gsum dang, skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i chos bzhi bcas so drug go/

bya rgyud kyi sbyor ba'i spyod pa'i yan lag ste, sngags pa sgrub pa po, rang sngags bsgrub par bya ba'i lha, g.yog sgrub pa'i grogs mchog ldong ros la sogs pa'i rdzas, sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus, dbus la sogs pa'i yul phyogs, ri rtse la sogs pa'i gzhi'i gnas, dpyid zla dang snga dro la sogs pa'i dus, ri mo dang gzugs sku la sogs pa'i yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha, 'jigs pa med cing sran che ba'i sems stobs te yan lag bcu'o/
sor sdud, bsam gtan, srog rtsol, 'dzin pa, rjes dran, ting 'dzin te dus 'khor rdzogs rim rlung sbyor gyi dmigs pa'i gnad kyi gras/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, theg chen gyi sbyor ba skye ba dang, sgom pas gnas pa dang, rdzogs pa gang rung la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las/
dam pa bsten zhing chos mnyan bsam sgrub pa las thob pa/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba bsgom pa'i rnam pa gang zhig yul yul can la bden zhen 'gog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/
bdag dam tshig par bskyed pa la ye shes pa dgug gzhug gis gcig tu 'dres pa'o/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, yul lam mkhyen pa'i rnam pa gang zhig sbyor ba'i bsgom byar gyur pa'o/

bya rgyud kyi lam gyi mngon rtogs spyod pa'i sgo bzhi'i nang gses te, sku'i rigs rnam par snang mdzad dang, gsung gi rigs 'od dpag med, thugs kyi rigs mi bskyod pa ste rigs gsum gyi lha bsnyen pa dang dngos gzhi'i de nyid bzhi bsgom pa'o/
tshe 'dir dge ba las bzlog pa'i las la brtson pa/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, sbyor ba'i ngo bo'am nus pa mtshon byed kyi mkhyen pa/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, sbyor ba bsgoms pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi thob bya bdud kyi mthu bcom pa la sogs pa'i phan yon thob pa'o/
nyon mongs pa dang dge ba'i sems gang yang min pas bskyed pa'i spyod lam dang bzo'i gnas so/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
sbyin bdag gis sa zhing sogs mchod rgyun la sbyar nas phul ba/

lam lnga'i nang gses, rnam par grol ba'i 'jug ngogs gang zhig nges 'byed cha mthun gyi dge rtsa rnams thob ste, bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor zhing, sgom byung gi shes rab kyis gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa dang dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga bsgoms pas, spang bya kun btags rnams rnam par gnon pa'i tshul gyis spong zhing, ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang mngon shes sogs kyi yon tan thob par byed pa'i lam mo/
nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi dang don gcig /
'jig rten pa'i dge ba rnams kyi mchog thob pa'i sbyor lam ste sbyor lam bzhi'i nang gses shig /
mthong lam gyi ye shes me lta bu'i lam de skye ba'i snga ltas su drod dang mtshungs pa'i lam dang po skye ba ste sbyor lam bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo ba'i rtse mor son pa'i sbyor lam ste sbyor lam bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
sbyor lam nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi ste, drod dang, rtse mo, bzod pa, chos mchog bcas so/
chos zab mo stong pa nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa gsar du thob pa'i sbyor lam ste sbyor lam bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
/ 1) dbra zhes pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig 2) re lde ste rtsid par btags pa'i snam rigs/ sbra dkar/ sbra nag / 3) sbra gur gyi bsdus ming/ rtswa chu 'dzoms sar sbra phub nas sdod pa/
re lde las bzos pa'i gur/ sbra gur phub pa/
hor sbra chen te rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi byang shar ngos rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud kyi yan lag sog chu rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de star thang du yod/
sbra nag gi nang du sdod mkhan 'brog pa'i sde tsho/
sbra 'dzin ni 'brog pa ste, 'brog pa'i ri phyugs nor lug go/
rtsid snam gyis bzos pa'i yol ba/
sbra gur gyi mtha' skor du bslangs pa'i ra ba/
sbra gur bzo byed kyi re lde/
sbra gur dbub sa'i sa cha/
gtong gi las don te rgya gar skad d'aka: gi zur chag / d'aka...da lam ca lag kha shas sbrag thog la btang yod

1.(tha dad pa) sbrags pa, sbrag pa, sbrogs,, 1) phan tshun sbrel ba/ don gnad de dag sbrags nas gros bsdur gyis thag gcod dgos/ dngos yod gnas tshul dang sbrags nas bsam gzhigs byed pa/ yig rigs sum sbrags/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ glog brnyan gyi par gzhi bod skad rang sbrags/ gzugs rjes grib sbrags/ 2) sprad pa/ ca lag 'di rnams phar sbrag dgos/ 2.yig 'phrin skyel mkhan/
bgod byed grangs gnas gnyis yan chad yod pa'i bgod rtsis/
mnyam sbrags sam, zung 'brel/ rta dang mi sbrags ma/ spags dang spags 'ded sbrags ma/
1) ma btul ba'i sbrang rtsi/ 2) dug can gyi sbrang ma/
sbrang rtsi las bzos pa'i chang/
rtsi shing lo tog sogs gso byed sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gru char/ sbrang char sil bu/
(rnying) mi gtsang ba la 'khor ba'i sbrang ma,..
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul du yod/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung khongs mon: yul gyi sa khul tsho drug ste seng ge rdzong dang smyug ma gdong, phyug rli, nam zhi dang them spang, sang rti, rdi rang ste drug da lta mtsho sna rdzong du yod/
gshog pa srab mo nyis ldan dang bzhi ldan gyi 'bu rigs shig / sha sbrang/ rtsi sbrang/ nags sbrang/ dug sbrang/

sbrang rtsi gsog pa'i bung ba/ me tog dri zhim pas g.yu'i sbrang ma 'khor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang drug dang, 'khor 'gro, 'khor byed, ge sar spyod, ge sar 'dzin, rgyan can, bcud brtul zhugs, bcud sbyin, bcud 'dzin, mchog sbyin, nyam chung dbang po, rdul 'chang, rdul nyal, spos ngad ldan, bung ba, sbrang rtsi skyes, sbrang rtsi skyong, sbrang rtsi 'joms, sbrang rtsi 'thung, sbrang rtsi 'dod, sbrang rtsi spyod byed, sbrang rtsi byed pa, sbrang rtsi myong, sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs, sbrang rtsi'i dri myong, sbrang rtsi'i zas can, mi gnas 'khor 'gro, me tog 'jug me tog 'thung, me tog 'thor ba, me tog myong ba, me tog zas can, me tog la rtse, ra yig gnyis pa, ri skyes, ro myong, gsum sgra can bcas so,

1) bung bas bsags pa'i rtsi mngar mo/ spu gri'i so la sbrang rtsi byug pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mngar ldan dang, spra tshil lo, 2) ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas lus stobs nyams pa gso ba dang, mig nad bar 'grib, rtsa dkar gyi nad, dbang po mi gsal ba, sha 'phel gyi nad bcas la phan, bad kan dang, chu ser la phan pa'i sman gyi nus pa rtsar 'khrid par byed/
(mngon) 1) bung ba/ 2) me tog pad ma/
kha che'i chos lugs skrun mkhan madhru muti yin par bshad/
sbrang rtsi btul ba'i snyigs ma/
sbrang ma skrod byed rnga yab/
1) sbrang rtsi'i ro/ 2) sbrang ma shi ba'i ro/
sbron pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
brling ba, dbyibs che ba/ khog pa sbram po/ sku lus sbram po/
dbyibs gru bzhi'am leb lcug lta bu'i dngos po/ gser sbram bu/ zangs sbram bu/ lcags sbram bu/
(yul) mgo skor gtong ba'i skad cha/

1.(tha mi dad pa) rtsa dkar gyi nad sogs kyis lus sbrid nas tshor ba nyams pa/ rkang pa sbrid nas 'gro mi nus/ grib phog nas gzugs phyed sbrid pa/ 2.sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi ro rkyang gi rtsa sne gnyis la thal rdul phog pa sogs las byung ba'i hab sbrid rgyag pa/ du ba sna khung du 'tshangs nas sbrid pa rgyag pa/ si pan gyi dri ma tshor nas sbrid pa ldang ba/
tshor ba nyams byed kyi sman/ nad par sbrid sman blud nas gshag las byed pa/
(tha dad pa) sbrus pa, sbru ba, sbrus,, g.yo ba'am rdzi ba/ spags sbrus te bzas/ thud sbru ba/ gro zhib sbrus nas rgya thug bzos pa/
phru gu 'khor ba'am mngal chags pa'i bud med/
(tha mi dad pa) mngal chags pa/ ba la be'u sbrum pa/ rang gi mngal du khye'u sbrum pa tshor ba/

/ 1) mngal chags pa'i bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la mngal chags ma dang, mngal ldan ma, phru gu skye, bu che ma, lus lci ma, lus mi bde, sems can zhugs, srog chags ldan bcas so, 2) (mngon) 'dod chags spyod pa'i bud med/

/ 1) sems can sbrul/ grib bsil nang du sbrul 'khyil nas bsdad pa/ sbal pas nga sbom, sbrul gyis nga ring/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun 'gro dang, rkang sbas, khung du nyal, 'khor lo can, 'khyil pa, 'khyog 'gro, gya gur 'gro, ngan pa'i zas can, lce gnyis pa, nyal byed, gnyid mi sad, lto 'gro, lto 'phye, thig le'i sna, dug gi mtshon cha can, dug 'dzin, gdengs ka chen po, 'phel ka can, ba lang sna, brang 'gro, mig gis thos, gzar bu mgo, rlung zas can, lag 'gro, logs ring, sa la 'phye bcas so, 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / me sbrul/ 3) klu chen brgyad du phye ba'i lto 'gro ste sbrul la brgyad yod pas grangs brgyad mtshon/
tsan dan gyi bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la sngo sangs dang tsan dan mchog go,
sbrul mgo gyen gdengs te sbrul gyi dbu rgyan/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas sha bkra dang, glang shu sogs pags nad kyi rigs dang, sha ma ma thon pa sogs la phan/
1) sbrul gyi mgo/ 2) lgang pa'i nang du rde'u chags pa 'don byed kyi yo byad cig /
sbrul mgo gnyis yod pa zhig /
rgyu ba'i dug gi nang tshan sbrul gyi so brgyab pa las byung ba'i dug /
dug gi kha rlangs gtong ba'i dug sbrul/ sbrul gdug pa las thu ba'i skye bo ngan pa/
sbrul las byas pa'i rkang lag gi rgyan/
sbrul mgo gnyis yod pa zhig /
rang gis byas pa'i las don rang gis khungs skyel dgos pa'i dpe/ las rnyog de tsho le thogs so so rang gis sbrul bdud sbrul bshig byed dgos/
sha gseb tu mde'u lus pa yod med yang bskyar brtag byed thur spyad sbrul mig can zhig /
srog chags kyi sman zhig mes 'tshig par phan/
lo skor bcu gnyis gras shig /

1) sngo zhig / 2) srog chags sbrul gyi sha/ sbrul shad, dbu med kyi yi ge 'ga' zhig gi thog mar bri rgyu'i mgo shad 'di dang, dbu can gyi yi ge 'ga' zhig gi thog mar bri rgyu'i mgo shad ` 'di lta bu'i ming/
sbrul lpags/ lo ltar chags kyi dgun gnyid rjes su sbrul shun thengs re brje zer/
rlan nam, snum la phye bsres te brdzi ba/ bsnyal ba'i gro zhib sbrus brdzis byed pa/
gcan gzan gyi rigs shig ste dbre'ang zer, de'i rgyab kyi spu mdog ser zhing lto'i spu mdog dkar ba, nyin mor yib nas sdod pa dang, mtshan mor phyir thon pa/

(tha dad pa) sbrengs pa, sbreng ba, sbrengs,, 1) sgrig pa/ tshang ma gral du sbrengs nas bsdad/ khrom skor du 'gro mi rnams sbrengs sbrengs byas nas mdun du skyod pa/ 2) 'dren pa dang, 'then pa/ pi wang sbrengs nas glu dbyangs len/ gzhu rgyud sbrengs nas mda' 'phen pa/ mgron por chang sbrengs pa/ 3) 'phyar ba/ bum chu sbreng ba/ chu rgyun sbreng ba/ phub ma sbreng ba/ mgo la chu sbrengs te skra bkrus/
1.sbreng ba'i skul tshig 2.phreng star/ ser sbengs/ phyugs sbrengs ma chad pa/ 'grim 'grul sbrengs ma chad pa/
(rnying) 1) rid pa'am, skem pa/ 2) 'khyags pa/ 3) ltogs pa/
phan tshun sbrel byed kyi thag pa/ phyugs kyi sbrel thag / do ya phan tshun sbrel thag /
'go mjug bar mtshams med par rgyun mthud pa/ snam bu sbrel mthud/ skud pa sbrel mthud byed pa/ las ka snga phyi sbrel mthud/
/ 1) cha'am zung/ rdzong sbrel lam rdzong sdod sbrel po/ 2) thun mongs/ las sne sbrel po/

(tha dad pa) chad pa mthud pa dang, 'go mjug phan tshun zung du sbrags pa'm sbyor ba dang sdeb pa/ dpung gshib lag sbrel/ sgo phyugs rwa sbrel/ ske sbrel/ phyag sbrel/ pho mo kha sbrel/ lug sha mgo sbrel/ phyi nang lag sbrel/ nyin mtshan mgo sbrel/ lag gdangs dpung sbrel/
phan tshun mthud ma/ nor sbrel ma/ shog lhe gsum sbrel ma/ bya ba sbrel ma/
'brel ba yod mkhan gnyis/ 'thus mi sbrel zla/ las rogs sbrel zla/

(tha dad pa) sbran pa, sbran pa, sbron,, 'bod pa dang, 'gugs pa/ ra mdar sbron pa/ grogs 'bod par sbron pa/ mgron du sbron pa/ grogs su sbron pa'i ngo mi zlog / mya ngan sbron brda/ ngo chen du sbron pa/ 'phrin yig sbran kyang lan gang yang byung med/

bod yig gsal byed bcu drug pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mchu sna dang bcas pa dang, byed pa mchu, nang gi rtsol ba mchu gnyis phrad pa, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1.1) ming gzhi'i shin tu mo'i yi ge zhig / 2) sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo'i yi ge zhig / 3) rjes 'jug gi mo tsam gyi yi ge zhig / 4) ming mtha'i cha shas shig / bris ma/ par ma/ lag bstar ma/ 'o ma/ nyi ma/ bla ma/ slob ma/ gru bzhi ma/ dar ma/ chu khol ma/ 5) mo rtags mtshon pa'i bdag sgra zhig / btsun ma/ chung ma/ mkha' 'gro ma/ glu ma/ zlos gar ma/ 2.skyed byed a ma/ pha ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba'i lam ster ma dang, skyed byed ma, 'byung byed, yum, rab skrun bcas so, 3.ming gi thog ma dang bar du 'jug pa'i dgag sgra zhig / gang yang ma byung/ nga ma phyin/ bltas kyang ma mthong/ grangs ka ma tshang/ der ma 'gro/ chang ma 'thung/ de 'dra ma byed/ sa ma 'brog / bya ma byi/ ra ma lug / kha ma char/
khri srong lde btsan skabs bod du byon te bod rin po che rba ratna dang bsdebs nas sher phyin 'bum thog mar bod yig tu sgyur mkhan rgya hwa shang zhig /

1) ma rtsa'i gzhi/ sa zhing dang, rmon phyugs, zhing las lag cha che ba sogs thon skyed rgyu chas rnams zhing las mnyam las khang la ma rkang du 'jog pa/ tshong las kyi ma rkang btsugs pa/ 2) gzhi rtsa dang yong rkyen/ las ka'i lag rjes bzang ngan gyi ma rkang shes brtson gnyis kar rag las pa yin/

sngar rgya gar ma ga dha' rgyal khab kyi bhin bo sa la zhes pa'i rgyal po'i gras yin pa de khri bzhugs lo brgyad par shakya mu ne mya ngan las 'das, rgyal po de bka' bsdu dang po'i sbyin bdag tu gyur/
gzhan gyis ma bskul bar rang gis mos nas byed pa/ rang nyid bcings 'grol thob thabs byed mkhan mi dmangs tshor ma bskul dang len gyis rogs ram byed pa/
gzhan gyi bskul lcag la mi ltos par rang bzhin gyis mos pa/ spyi phan gyi bya ba ma bskul rang mos kyis byed pa/
ma bskos pa'i sde tshan bcu

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bcu tshan gsum pa ma bskos pa'i sde tshan la, dge slong ma la chos ston pa'i ltung byed dang, nyi ma nub nas chos ston pa'i ltung byed dang, zas phyir chos ston zer ba'i ltung byed dang, gos byin pa'i ltung byed dang, gos byed pa'i ltung byed dang, lam du 'gro ba'i ltung byed dang, grur 'jug pa'i ltung byed dang, 'dug pa'i ltung byed dang, 'greng ba'i ltung byed dang, zas sbyor du 'jug pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/
1) kha'i ma mgal/ 2) rgyu nor dngos po'i ma rtsa/ mgo bde dran 'phrul gyi bsam sbyor lam du ma lhongs pas tshong las ma kha shi ba/ mi dmangs srid gzhung gis mi dmangs kyi 'tsho tshis ma kha gso ba/
sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis kha che'i chos lugs thog mar 'dzugs sa'i yul du bshad/
1) spyi'am byings kyi khongs/ 2) a ma'i khongs gtogs/
mi dal ba/ las brel gyis ma khom pas 'gro long ma byung/
rang gi yul yang dag par rig pa ste, snang yul la ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa dper na bum 'dzin dbang mngon dang, rnam mkhyen lta bu'o/
yul gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi stod ru thog rdzong khul du yod pa'i chu bo zhig yin zhing chu 'go ru thog rdzong gi nub rgyud nas byung zhing byang ngos su rgyugs te ngang lha ring mtsho'i nang du 'bab/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la bska ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo ba'i nad dang, 'brum nad la phan/
gsham phyogs/ ma gi'i grong khyer/ ma gi'i gnas tshul la rtog zhib byed pa/
(legs) gla rtsi ghiham sogs kyi ming/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge 'dun gyis bsgos pa'i chos ldan gyi bya ba la shad sbyang med par ma gus pa'i tshul gyis 'da' ba'o/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed rang gi mngon 'dod gang yod kyi bsam 'char bstan pa'i sgo nas ma gus pa'i tshig sbyar te 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
med pa/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa/

gtan tshigs ltar snang gsum gyi ya gyal, phyogs chos ma grub pa ste, shes 'dod chos can la rtags 'god pa ltar ma grub pa'am med pa'o, dper na sgr chos can, mi rtag ste, mig shes kyis gzung bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs gsum
gtan tshigs ltar snang las ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs la dbye na, don la ma grub pa dang, blo ngor ma grub pa dang, rgol ba la ltos te ma grub pa ste gsum mo/
ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs so/
ma mgu ba'i bsam pa snying la 'dzin pa/ blo mthun pas rang la skyon brjod byas par ma dga' zhe 'dzin gyis ngan lan slog rtsis byas mi chog /
dgon lag chung ngu 'du sa'i dgon pa che ba/
sngon nas gros sdur gang yang ma byas par bsam pa gcig mthun byung ba/ mi tshang mas blo dang thabs shes 'don pa'i bsam pa de ma bgros rang mthun yin/
kha'i ma kha'am ma le/ seng ge'i ya mgal la khyi'i ma mgal sbyor ba/
ngan zhing sdug pa'i dngos po byung yang ma mgu, bzang zhing legs pa'i dngos po btsal kyang ma rnyed pa/
«aniruddha» shakya thub pa'i nyan thos nye 'khor bcu'i gras lha'i spyan mchog tu gyur pa de'o/
1) a ma rgan mo/ 2) bud med rgan mo/
1) a ma'i rigs rgyud/ 2) stong phyogs shes rab kyi cha gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud/
khang pa'i gzhung sgo che shos/
'bad rtsol med par rang bzhin gyis 'grigs pa/ dus skabs ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs/ sgo pang ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs/
'bad rtsol ma byas par rang shugs kyis grub pa/ ngal rtsol la ma ltos par byas 'bras kyi rten 'brel ma bsgrigs lhun grub yong mi srid/
ngo bo nyon mongs can min zhing rnam smin lung du ma bstan pa, 'jig rten gyi phyi snod dang, rnam smin gyi phung po, sems can gyi dbang shes, rtag pa'i chos rnams so/
1) gcig tu nges gzung med pa/ 'chi bar nges kyang nam 'chi ma nges pa/ 2) ma go ba/ snang la ma nges pa/

dge slong zhig khrims grogs med par dben par sgrib byed kyi skyabs yod pa'i gnas su bud med dang lhan cig tu 'dug pa'i tshe gnas der mi tshangs spyod byar rung mi rung gi kyad par las dge slong de la pham lhag ltung byed gsum gang byung ma nges pa'am dngos po mtha' gang du 'gyur ma nges pa'o/

gtan tshigs ltar snang gsum gyi nang gses, phyogs chos grub kyang khyab pa la the tshom bskyed pa'am khyab pa'i tshul rnal ma dang phyin ci log gang rung du ma nges pa'i rtags, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu gzhal bya ni rtag mi rtag gnyis kar thun mong du 'jug pas gcig tu ma nges pa'o/
ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis
gtan tshigs ltar snang las ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs la dbye na, thun mong ba'i ma nges pa dang, thun mong min pa'i ma nges pa'o/
ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs dang don gcig
'phel skyed yong sa'i rtsa ba'i dngul/ 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du ma dngul gsog 'jog byed pa/
(yul) ma yig la bltas te bu yig bklags nas zhus dag gtong ba/

'di'i 'khrungs 'das kyi lo gang yin la shod tshul mi 'dra ba kha shas yod kyang mang che ba'i lugs la rab byung dang po'i lcags lug la 'khrungs, pha dam pa sangs rgyas bla mar bsten te zhi byed gcod kyi gdams pa'i bdag por gyur, rab byung gnyis pa'i sa bya la gshegs/
dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi nang gses, nyer len gyi phung po dang yo byad sogs la ma chags pa ste chags pas kun nas bslangs pa'i nyes spyod la mi 'jug par byed pa'o/
ma le/ ma mchu sor gsum kha la bcug nas na tsha bsran pa/

byas nyes med bzhin du yod tshul gyi kha 'phang 'gel ba/ btsan rgol dmag 'khrug byed par dmag 'khrug dga' ba yin zhes pa de ni ma nyes khag g.yogs byed pa zhig rang red/ rang sems dkar por lhad skyon med na gnas skabs ma nyes khag g.yogs byung yang gnong dgos med/
1) nyes pa med pa'am skyon ma byung ba/ 2) (rnying) gros mthun pa/ ma gnyis pa, (mngon) ma ma'am bu rdzi/
(legs) gdol pa'i rigs ri khrod pa/
ma the ba'am phud pa'i don/ nga rang ma gtogs med/ der song na ma gtogs thabs shes gzhan med/ kho ma gtogs thams cad ngal rtsol byed du song/ de ma gtogs ci yang mthong ma byung/
sngo zhig sman du spyad na mgo yu 'khor bar phan/
rang yul la nges pa 'dren mi nus pa'i shes pa ste, snang la ma nges pa'i blo rnams so/
rags zhib kyi gnas tshul la lta rtog do snang ma byas pa/ gnas tshul ji yin ma brtags ma dpyad par hol rgyugs kyis bya thabs gtan 'bebs byed mi rung/
ma rtsar bzhag pa'i dngul sogs/
1) yun ma 'gor ba/ las rgyun ring po ma thogs pa/ 2) ma 'khar ba'am ma 'khon pa/ rlangs 'khor gzhung lam du ma thogs par 'gro ba/
chos lugs kyi bshad srol ltar bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad rjes tshe lo bcu pa tha ma nas brtsis pa'i yar tshe lo dpag med bar gyi dus/
dma' mtha'am tha na/ bye ma'i thang la 'thung ja med par ma zad, ma mtha' skom sel gyi chu tsam yang rnyed dka'/
srol rgyun ngan pa mu mthud nas lus pa/ yi ge 'bri srol ma dag rgyun 'byams su phyin pa/

rdzogs rim rim drug gi nang gses shig ste, khams gsum snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i phyi nang gi dngos po 'di thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma dang rmi lam sogs kyi dpes gtan la 'bebs shing bsgom par bya ba'o/
gzhan dbang gi nang gses, bag chags kyi dbang gis khams gsum pa'i sems dang sems byung gnyis med gnyis su snang ba ste ma dag 'khor bas bsdus pa'i snod bcud rnams so/
ma byas byas tshul gyi bden yus shod pa/ gzhan gyi ngal rtsol grub 'bras rang gis btsan bzung byas nas ma dag yus che shod pa ni ngo tsha ba'i gnas red/

byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i bar gyi sa bdun po ste, der gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' la nga rgyal phra ba ma dag par yod pas ma dag sa bdun zhes bya'o/
nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses, yang dag pa'i gnas dang dge chos la mi mos pa gti mug gi char gtogs pa'i le lo'i rten byed pa'o/

1) gtan nyar bya rgyu'i deb ngo ma/ 2) tshong gi ma dngul bkod deb/ 3) snga dus bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas sa zhing sogs kyi khral 'bab sdud deb a ma, 4) (yul) phor pa sogs dkrug byed kyi 'khor lo'i 'og gdan gyi shing/
ma dul ba'am, mi bsrun pa/ kun spyod rtsing po ma drangs pa rnams mi so so rang gis legs bcos gtong dgos/
(rnying) rtsed mos g.yengs shing bag med dang rgod bag can/
dbang phyug gi bu chung ba gdong drug gi ming, ma drug ni u ma: dang, me lha, gangg'a, 'dam bu'i tshal, smin drug sa ga ste drug la zer/
mtsho ma pham gyi ming gzhan,
bod lugs 'byung rtsis nang bu la brten nas ma rtsi ba/
sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de, spyod pas bsdus pa drug dang, rtogs pas bsdus pa drug dang, mdzad pas bsdus pa gsum dang, dus kyis bsdus pa gsum ste bco brgyad do/
pa nyer bzhag gsum: dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang don gcig
rtsa nyon gzhan dang ma 'dres par bden don mi shes pa'i rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'o/

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi khyad gzhi khyad chos 'ga' zhig dpe'i khyad gzhi khyad chos dang ngo bo dbyer med du bkod cing, bar gyi 'brel sgra ma bsdus pa'i rgyan zhig /
(rgya) rta klad de, rin po che'i rigs shig nus pas gza' nad dang dug nad la phan/
gzhi nas sam rtsa ba nas/ da res tsam min par ma nas mi 'di yag po med/
«pandaka» pho min mo min/ ming gi rnam grangs la mtha' gnyis spangs dang, mtshan gnyis, mtshan med, gsum pa'i rang bzhin bcas so,

dres ma rigs gsum gyi nang tshan ri thang mtshams su skye ba zhig ste, ro mngar la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas sha dug sogs dug nad 'joms, smug dug thabs dang, mkhris nad mig ser, glang thabs sogs la phan/
lcam pa rigs shig ste, ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas chu bsags pa dang, skom dad byed pa la phan/
sngo sman zhig ste tshad pa sel bar phan/
byang chub sems rtsa'i ming gi rnam grangs shig

: ngag thog nas rjod skabs sgra gdangs so so'i skye gnas kyi rtsol shugs che chung ran pa'am, grims lhod 'tshams po yin pa'i yi ge rnams/ 1) ming gzhi'i ma ning yi ge / kha cha tha pha tsha lnga, 2) sngon 'jug gi ma ning yi ge / ga/ da. 3) rjes 'jug gi ma ning yi ge / na ra la.

1) sngo zhig / 2) (legs) mi/ 3) skyed byed ma'i nu ma/ 4) (mngon) sngar rgya gar du mi'i rim pa mi 'dra ba bzhir phye ba'i nang nas rgyal rigs la rkang thang dang, rta pa, glang chen, shing rta pa bzhi dang, bram ze'i rigs la nags gnas dang, khyim gnas, dka' thub pa gsum, rje rigs la yig mkhan dang, tshong pa, sman pa gsum, dmangs rigs la sa gzhi rmo ba dang, ba lang skyong ba, 'jim las pa, khyim gnas pa bzhi bcas bsdoms na bcu bzhi yod pas grangs bcu bzhi mtshon/
bse shing dkar po'i 'bras bu ste, nus pas srin nad gsod, pho rims sel/
(legs) yid 'ong 'dab ma can te thang sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar zhing kha la tsha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas khrag rlung gi nad dang, bad kan smug po, lhog pa, bad mkhris bcas la phan/
spos dkar shing gi ming gi rnam grangs shig
shing sman bse shing dkar po/
(legs) 1) nor bu/ 2) om ma ni pad me hum ? zhes pa' yi ge drug /
chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos brtsams pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor dang, bod kyi lo rgyus dang bka' chems sogs pod gnyis yod do/
ma ni yig drug mang po dril ba'i 'khor lo/
chus skor ba'i ma ni 'khor lo/
(yul) kha gdan gyi ri mo zhig gi ming
ma ni 'don thengs dung phyur gcig dpang por btsugs pa ste bod kyi yul srol nang gi mna' tshig cig /
ma ni grangs dung phyur gcig yod pa'i 'khor chen/

1) thags thogs med pa/ kha bde po'i mi des skad cha bshad na chu rgyug rgyug ma ni 'dren 'dren red/ 2) skad cha bskyar skor yang skor kho na shod pa/ mi de sger don kho na ma ni 'dren 'dren byed mkhan zhig red/
1) sil snyan gyi bye brag cig / 2) ma ni'i ri mo yod pa'i gos chen zhig / 3) ma ni dbyangs su 'then mkhan gyi bud med/
rlung gis skor ba'i ma ni 'khor lo/
ma ni sogs kyi yig dril bcug ste lag tu bskor rgyu zhig /
yig drug rdo la brkos te spungs pa'i phung po/
dngos po'i ma rtsa'i rin gong/ bzo skrun ma gnas/
dpe bya sa'i ma phye/ ma dpe ltar 'bri ba/
1) gzhan las ma pham pa/ 2) (mngon) rgyal ba byams mgon/
ma pham g.yu mtsho'i bsdus ming/
mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spu hreng rdzong gi dbus rgyud na yod cing, mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 4588 yod/
1) yig rigs sogs kyi rtsa ba'am phyi mo/ dpe cha bshus te ma phyi phyir bslogs pa/ 2) ma'i ma/
a ma gnyis pa'am ma g.yar/
1) a ma'i phyogs kyi gnyen/ 2) 'og phyogs/
1) ma dang phru gu / 2) nag rtsis kyi 'byung ba ma bu/ 3) ma rtsa dang skyed kha/ 4) ma yig dang 'dra bshus/ 'char gzhi ma bu/ dpe cha ma bu/
ma bu go ldog gi phywa
sngar bod kyi yul srol ltar a ma'i lag rtsa la brten nas bu tsha rnams la gegs rtsub yod med sogs brtag pa'i mo phywa ste ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi nang gses shig

rgya nag lugs la shing dang, me, sa, lcags, chu khams te lnga yod cing, khams lnga'i ma bu dgra grogs brtsi tshul ni, shing ma chu dang chu ma lcags, lcags ma sa dang sa ma me, me ma shing yin shing bu me, me bu sa dang sa bu lcags, lcags bu chu dang chu bu shing, shing dgra lcags yin lcags dgra me, me dgra chu dang chu dgra sa, sa dgra shing yin shing grogs sa, sa grogs chu dang chu grogs me, me grogs lcags dang lcags grogs shing, zhes pa'o/
ma dang bu gnyis ka'i lus bde thang yong ba'i thabs shes/
gzhan gyi nor rku ba dang 'phrog pa dang g.yo thabs kyis len pa/
bar 'tsho ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, rang gis byin zin pa'am rang dang rdzas mi gcig pa'i dge slong gi gos ma byin par longs spyod pa'o/
ma byin par len pa'i bsdus tshig
ma byin len gyi pham pa

pham pa bzhi'i nang gses, gzhi gzhan gyi dngos po rin thang tshang ba, bsam pa rku bar 'dod pa'i sems kyis, sbyor ba rang gis dngos su brkus pa'am gzhan la rkur bcug nas, mthar thug dngos po de bdag po dang phral nas bdag gir byas pa'o, rin thang gi tshad mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang karsha pa ni'i bzhi cha ste, dngul zho gang tsam rin thang gi tshad du grags so/
rkyen ngan ma yong gong nas 'gog thabs byed pa/ mi phyugs la nad rims ma byung sngon 'gog gi thabs shes byed dgos/
ma rtsa'i 'bru ste mchod rgyun du dmigs pa'i 'bru'o/
phru gu la srung skyob 'tsho rdzi byed pa'i ma tshab/ ming gi rnam grangs la nye ba'i ma dang, ma gnyis pa, ma gzhan, 'dzin ma bcas so,
pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma dang, nu ma snun pa'i ma ma, dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma, rtse na grogs byed kyi ma ma ste bzhi/
/ 1) phyi mo/ 2) mo lug / 3) «m'atrika» chos mngon pa/ 4) sha za 'byung po'i rigs shig / 5) lha mo/

ba sbyin pa: 'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, sems ma myos pa'i gnas skabs ltung ba byung ma byung dran du bcug nas, ma byung bar nges na dag pa sbyin, byung bar nges na phyir bcos nas gdams ngag sbyin par byed pa'o/

ba'i gtan tshigs: 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs gsum gyi ya gyal, rtags dang dgag chos gnyis phyin ci log pa, dper na, bum pas dag pa'i sa phyogs chos can snang rung gi bum pa yod de, snang rung gi bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/

rtags yang dag gi nang gses, dgag bya 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba ste, dper na, mdun gyi gzhi 'dir chos can, sha za bskal don du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud la sha za nges pa'i dpyad shes don mthun med de, gang zag de'i rgyud la sha za dmigs byed kyi tshad ma med pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu 'gog byed mi snang ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis dgag bya sha za yod med kyi nges shes don mthun 'jug pa bkag pa'o/
ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na rnam pa gnyis te, mi snang ma dmigs pa'i rtags dang, snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags so/
1) ka 'dzoms te 'bru'i rigs bye brag pa zhig / 2) ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras s'a lu/
1. ma dang bu mo/ 2. khyad du 'phags pa/ yon tan ma smad pa/ nus rtsal ma smad pa/ lam lugs ma smad pa/
tsha ba lus la thog mar phog skabs bad rlung gnyis gang red dang 'doms te tsha ba rkyang pa ma yin pa'i skabs/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnya' nang rdzong gi 'bab chu zhig gnya' nang phu chu'ang zer, lho ngos bal yul du 'bab/

1) ma gzhi/ 2) ma dngul/ tshong zog gi ma rtsa'i rkang longs pa/ zhing las kyi ma rtsa tshugs pa/ ma rtsa'i rkang dngul/ ma rtsa'i rkang bdag / sger sdom ma rtsa shi ba/ dpon ngan ma rtsa'i ring lugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la rtsa nor dang, zong rtsa, yongs sgyur, rin rtsa bcas so, 3) ma bu dgra grogs 'byung ba brtsi ba'i skabs shing ma sa lta bu 'phrad pa de la ma rtsa zhes zer/
ma rtsa bzung zhing bzo pa'i ngal rtsol lhag mar bshu gzhog byed mkhan la zer/
ma rtsa can la thon skyed rgyu chas dbang bar ma zad, gla pa'i ngal rtsol la bshu gzhog dang, rin thang lhag ma btsir len byed pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs la zer/
1) a ma'i khyim mam, zhang po'i khyim/ 2) mi tshang ma zur gnyis su phye ba'i ma tshang ste khyim che ba/
cha tshang ba/ mkho chas ma tshang ba med/ mthun rkyen ma tshang ba med/
ma phyogs kyi gnyen tshan nam nye du/
skyed ma shi ba'i rjes su ba'i a ma'i tshab bam a ma ma g.yar/
ma shes pa'am ma rtogs pa/
ma zhu ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i lus kyi phyi nang gi cha shas la chags pa'i dngos po sra mkhregs ldan pa'i ming ste, nang gses su dbye na skran rigs bcu gcig mchis/
1) ma rkang ngam rtsa ba/ ma gzhi nas kho la 'gan chen po 'khris yod/ 2) 'og gzhi'i gdan/
ma rdzogs sam ma tshad/ snga dus zhing pa dbul phongs la lar sa zhing gtan nas med par ma zad, zhing las yo byad cha lag tshang ba zhig kyang med/
ma nus bgos lhag thig shar tshe rkang sdom stongs pas ma zin ces grags, rkang sngon gyi thad la'ang ltos/
sgra'i skye mched kyi nang gses, ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra ste, sgra'i rgyur gyur pa'i 'byung ba de gang zag gi dbang pos ma zin pa'i sgra, chu dang rlung gi sgra lta bu'o/
rjes su yong rgyu sngon nas dran pa/ gsar brje la 'go 'khrid byed par ma 'ongs sngon mthong thub zhig dgos/

1) dus gsum gyis dbye ba phye ba'i nang gses 'byung 'gyur ram rjes/ 2) rtags 'jug skabs su dus kyi ma 'ongs pa dang bya ba'i yul bya las dang bcas pa la'ang 'jug pa'i bya tshig / chu 'khyil bar 'gyur/ sa cha gzhan du 'khyar bar 'gyur/
ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa
'jug pa ma 'ongs pa'i dus na chos ci dang ci 'byung thams cad ma 'khrul bar mkhyen pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
'byung 'gyur shis min ji yong sngon du bstan pa/
1) yi ge'i ma dpe/ ma yig las bu dpe bshus pa/ 2) pa sde'i bzhi pa, ma...
ma yig bar gyi gsal byed

tshig snga phyi gnyis ka min pa'am med par dgag pa'i tshig phrad ma/ ma...sa ma rdo/ gangs ma char/ ra ma lug / bya ma bye'u/ sha ma tshil/ khrag ma rnag / dkar ma nag / cha ma ya/ ya ma zung/ gsa' ma gzig / 'khyug ma tshugs/ gzhas ma shags/

dgag pa'i nang gses, rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blo'am rang brjod pa'i sgras rang gi dgag bya bkag pa'i shul du chos gzhan 'phen pa, lhas sbyin tshon po nyin par zas mi za, zhes pa lta bu, tshon po yin pas zas za bar bstan cing, nyin par zas za ba bkag pa'i shul du chos gzhan te mtshan mor zas za ba don gyis 'phangs pa'o/
ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel
sel ba'i nang gses, rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du don gzhan 'phen pa'i sgo nas sel ba ste, ma yin dgag dang don gcig /
yin pa'i ldog phyogs te ming gi mthar 'jug pa'i dgag sgra/ chu khol ma ma yin pa/ rta ma yin la bong bu'ang ma yin pa/
ma yin pa ma yin pa
yin pa'i don te, dper na, bum pa ma yin pa ma yin pa ni bum pa yin pa lta bu'o/
dngos gnas ma yin par yin khul/ ngas ma yin yin tshul zhus pa min/ rogs ram ma yin yin tshul gyis mgo skor gtong ba/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brong pa rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
zhing la chu 'dren sa'i yur ba chen mo/ ma yur la chu med na yur phran la ga nas yong/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brong pa rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
bud med kyi mtshan mar gnas pa'i srin 'bu zhig ste, de nad du gyur na mtshan ma g.ya' za byed pa zhig /
blo ma mos pa/ yi ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa/

1) tshul min gyi gtam spyod/ ma rabs spyod ngan/ ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas shes/ 2) ngan pa'i rgyud dam rigs/ ma rabs mtho sar bzhag na spyod ngan je mang du 'phel/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye bo phal pa dang, tha chad, tha shal, dmangs rigs, dman pa'i rigs, mtshon cha ba, g.yung po, rigs ngan, rigs med bcas so,
rgad po rgad mo'i zas za stangs/ so med rgas 'khogs yin pas lto chas ma ri mu rir za dgos byung/

1) rtsa nyon drug gi nang gses, rig pa shes rab kyi mi mthun phyogs rten khams gsum la yod pa'i las 'bras dang bden pa sogs kyi tshul ji lta ba mi shes par kun nyon skyed par byed pa'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la nga yir 'dzin dang, ngar 'dzin, dngos 'dzin, bdag 'dzin, mi shes bcas so, 2) ma mthong ba/ mtshan mo mig gis gzugs ma rig pa/ ma rig rig mdog / 3) (mngon) 1. 'khor ba/ 2. hor zla bcu gnyis pa/
rmongs tsam, the tshom, log par rtogs pa'i rnam pa can bcas gsum/
chu bo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mthong sgom gyi spang bya khams gsum gyi ma rig pa rnams so/
zag pa gsum gyi nang gses, 'dod pa dang srid pa'i zag pa gnyis kyi gnas khams gsum gyi ma rig pa'o/
nyi mas chu srin gyi khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i ming/
lag rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses: bdag tu rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ste, yang dag pa'i don la sgrib par byed pa'i kun rtog srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i ma rig pa'o/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas srin nad gsod, me drod skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la gunydza dang, rakta gunydza, shwa ta gunydza, srin bu dmar leb bcas so,
bsam ngan zhe la bcangs pa:/ kho pa'i bshad tshul khungs lung gtan nas med pa de ma rungs khog bcug gi rang rtags yin par nges/
mi bsrun pa/ gcan gzan ma rungs pa/ mi ma rungs pa/ ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig gis phyin ci log gi bsam sbyor byas pa/
1) ma yin/ dkrog gtam de bden pa ma red/ 2) (rnying) ma grub/
phru gu ma'i mngal du gnas pa'i skabs ma rlung bu la shor ba'i byis pa'i mgo nad cig /
1.kye ma'am kye hud/ ma la blang dor la rmongs pa dag gis bya ba ngan pa ci yang byed do/ 2.lam sang ngam 'phral du/
(legs) dz'a ti/ , (legs) 1) dz'a ti'i me tog / 2) mya ngan, sems mi bde ba dang, sems kyi sdug bsngal/ grong pa'i ba shi yang mya ngan zhag gsum 'khur dgos/

(legs) dri ldan te, sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug gi nub phyogs na yod pa'i brag zhun dang, cong zhi, chu tshan sogs sman rigs skye ba'i ri bo zhig gi ming/ ming gi rnam grangs la tsan dan ri bo dang, lho phyogs sa 'dzin, a'a sha dha bcas so,

'grel 'dod 'jo che chung: rab byung brgyad pa'i nang byang pa mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ri bo ma la ya'i skor gyi sman chu dang, chu tshan, cong zhi, brag zhun bcas kyi dka' gnad rnams gsal bar 'grel ba'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
rigs ldan pho brang ka l'a pa'i mdun du dus 'khor gyi blos bslangs yod pa'i skyed mos tshal/
dang yan lag / rigs lam ma lag dang ldan: pa/ las grwa ma lag cha tshang ba/
(yul) mgyogs po gyis/ las kar brel ba tsha po yod pas ma lag rgyob/
mgyogs rtsal bde po/ skad cha shod stangs ma lag bde po/ 'gro 'dug kun spyod ma lag bde po/ ma lags, ma red dam ma yin/ khyed kyis gsungs pa'i don 'di de ltar ma lags so/
ma nyes sam, nyes skyon med pa/ rang gis ma lan/ ma lan khag 'dzugs byed mi rung/
(legs) rgya gar gyi me tog 'dab ma dkar po yin pa zhig
thams cad dam, yongs rdzongs/ zhogs pa gcig la bya ba bzang po ma lus par sgrub thub dogs med/ mgyod myur 'grub dgos pa'i las don tshang ma de ring ma lus par tshar song/
(yul) ol sko/ mi blo rgyu ring na lkugs mthong, rta ma le ring na rgas mthong/
phyugs kyi bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la khyu mchog dang, chur 'dres, 'jigs pa bcu pa, rta yi dgra, rdul ldan mig mig dmar ral pa can, gshin rje'i bzhon pa, sa nyal bcas so,
srong btsan sgam po'i dus bod du yong ste rgya nag gi chos bod yig tu sgyur mkhan rgya hwa shang zhig
(legs) rgya nag chen po/ , (legs) rgya nag gi ming/

sngags rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu'i ya gyal zhig chen po'i rnam 'byor gyi theg pa zhes bya ste 'jug sgo phyin phan pa'i dbang bcu, nang nus pa'i dbang lnga, gsang pa zab mo'i dbang gsum ste dbang mchog bco brgyad kyis rgyud smin par byas nas, lta ba don dam dkor bdun ngo bo nyid du kun rdzob gdan gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub cing rang bzhin dbyer med pa lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med chos sku mnyam pa chen por gtan la phab nas, bsgom pa bskyed rim gtso bor ston la, de'ang ting 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub, ngo bo dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba, srog sdom gzer bzhis rgyas btab ste sgom pa dang rdzogs rim rlung dang thig le 'od gsal rnams bsgoms la, spyod pa spros bcas, spros med, shin tu spros med gsum gyi nye rgyu la brten nas, 'bras bu rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i bsdus pa'i lam lnga mthar phyin te zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'dod do/
ma ha yo ga'i theg pa
ma ha yo ga dang don gcig
ma snying thig sogs yin zhing

'di'i lta grub ni, 'khor 'das spang blang dang bral zhing re dogs phyogs lhung las brgal nas blo dang yid dpyod las 'das pa'i chos nyid de, gzhi dbyings ka dag khregs chod dang, lam snang lhun grub thod rgal bsgoms pas blo 'das rang byung gi ye shes skad cig la 'char bar byed pa'o/
(legs) mgon po nag po chen po/
sgra chung ba'i gtam gyi shod stangs/ gsal la ma gsal gyi gtam mag gi mug gi lab pa/
(yul) sring mo rgan shos kyi mag pa/
bu mo'i zla bo'am, khyo ga/
mag gi mug gi'i bsdus tshig
sngar rgya gar du thog mar byung ba'i mi kun gyis bkur ba'i rgyal po zhig / mang bkur sde ba, mang pos bkur ba'i sde dang don gcig
nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad kyi nang tshan, mang pos bkur ba'i sde ba la, sa sgrog ri la gnas pa'i sde ba dang, srung ba pa'i sde ba dang, gnas ma mu'i sde ba ste gsum/
dgon khag gi dge 'dun rnams la gtong rgyu'i 'thung ja dang thug pa/
mi mang che bas bshad pa rnams la nyung bas dang len byed pa/ don gnad la gros sdur byed dus mang kha nyung nyan gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa/

ga bur rigs gsum gyi nang tshan shing tshi ging zhes pa las byung bar grags pa'i ga bur mdog ser la sna ring zhing mnyen pa'am dkar 'jam kha ba bsgongs pa 'dra ba bsil shed chung tsam zhig ste, nus pas tsha ba rlung ldan sel/
gang zhig / gang zag che ge mo zhig dang spyod pa mang ge mo zhig /

sngar lo ltar lha sar smon lam chen mo ma 'tshogs gong gi snga lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang rtse 'gag dang, bla brang phyag mdzod, se 'bras dga' gsum sogs 'brel yod las sne rnams 'dzoms nas mang 'gyed gtong mkhan gyi sbyin bdag gi ming tho snga phyi'i go rim ltar bsgrigs pa'i zin tho/
phal che ba'am byings che ba/ las don ci zhig byed kyang mi mang che ba'i khe phan dang bstun pa gal che/ mang ja, dge 'dun pa rnams la 'dren rgyu'i 'thung ja/
mang po dang nyung ngu/ gcig bsgyur ba la mang nyung med/ mi grangs mang nyung 'tsham pa/ gtong yong mang nyung snyoms pa/ mang nyung cher ma shor ba/
1) mang du thos pa ste rnam grangs mang po'am, rgya chen po thos pa/ sngon gyi lo rgyus gtam rgyud mang du thos pa/ 2) mkhas pa/
gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
mang sa nas 'then nas nyung sa la kha snon/ mi grangs mang 'then nyung snon gyis cha snyoms bzo ba/
mang dag ha cang mang po
/ mnga' khongs sa rgya che la mi grangs kyang mang dag 'dug /
dpung mang po'i stobs shugs kyi kha ya/ rgyab dpung med na mang sna nyung gis mi rten pas rgyal kha lon pa dka'/
nyung ngu'i ldog phyogs/ mi mang lag mang/ zas mang gos mang/ mthun rkyen mang po 'dzoms yod pa/ 'bras bu mang po thon pa/
khyon 'bor che la sna kha 'dzoms pa/ gnas lugs mang po sna tshogs/ thabs shes mang po sna tshogs/ mkho chas mang po sna tshogs/
(mngon) chu bo srin dhu/ mngn po sbrel, (mngon) rnga mong/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde ba bzhi'i nang gses, mang pos bkur ba zhes pa skye bo mang pos bkur ste byas pa'i rigs can yin pas de ltar grags la, mdo 'don pa na a ba bhram sha'i skad du 'don, mkhan po 'dreg mkhan gyi rigs nye ba 'khor, snam sbyar gnas brtan pa dang mtshungs shing dge slong gi ming 'bangs dang sde'i mtha' can, grub mtha' brjod du med pa'i bdag yod pa dang, shes bya thams cad brjod du yod med gnyis su sdud pa sogs 'dod pa'o/
nyung ba'i ldog zla/ tshig lo mang bas don 'bras bsgribs pa/ thos grangs mang bas blo skyed chen po byung/ mi grangs mang drags nas nyung du btang ba yin/
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, mtshon byed dpe mang po zhig gis mtshon bya don gcig gi gnas lugs mtshon par byed pa'i rgyan zhig /

po ston byed kyi tshig ste bod yig gi rnam: dbye dang po'i yan lag yin pa rnams zhes pa dang kun dang thams cad mtha' dag sogs ni mang po'i don can gyi ming rkyang tsam rnams so/ rnams...kun thams cad...mtha' dag /
mi dmangs spyi byings la zer/ mang tshogs tshogs chen/ mang tshogs lam phyogs/
krung go gung khran tang gis bya ba byed tshad kyi rtsa ba'i lam phyogs yin, de'i rtsa ba'i nang don ni mang tshogs kyi khrod nas blang te mang tshogs kyi khrod du spel rgyu de yin/
stod mnga' ris spu hreng nas gtsang gi ngam ring dang skyid grong bar bal yul dang thag nye ba'i sa rgyud kyi ming rnying pa/
sa cha zhig da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs kus nan rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/

dpe rnying du mang slon mang rtsan zhes bris, gung ri gung btsan dang 'a zha bza' mang rje khri dkar gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs so lnga pa yin la, yab gung ri de'i yab kyi gong du 'das pas, mes po srong btsan 'das nas dbon 'di khri la 'khod dus sku na chung stabs rgyal srid kyi bya ba blon chen mgar stong btsan gyis khri lo bco lnga'i bar bskyangs, dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun thog 'das/
yang dag pa'am bden pa/ thugs zhe khrel ba mad pa lags/ dge skyon yo bsrang gi zhal slob gnang ba de shin tu mad pa lags/
bden po/ gsung gros mad po/
(legs) g.yas 'khyil te rdo sman gyi rid shig zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag sbyor, rus pa'i tshad pa sel/
1) man ju yang zer, rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs shig / manydzu'i skad/ manydzu'i yi ge/ 2) rang rgyal gyi byang shar sa khul la zer/
ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma/

1. 1) yan gyi ldog zla/ da dung lo sum cu bzhi bcu yan man tsam 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ chu tshod rer le dbar sum stong man tsam zhig slobs thub/ 2) (rgya) gro zhib/ thug pa man chil/ chil man mog mog / 2.(yul) ma yin gyi bsdus ming/ nga man kho yin/ kho man nga yin/
(yul) steng nas thur du skor ba'i gsor chung zhig
(upadesha) thabs kyi snying po'am thabs zab mo/ sman gyi man ngag / lag rtsal gyi man ngag / man ngag gi mthil/

rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grad kyis mdzad pa'i shin tu zab pa'i man ngag sna tshod gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid can lung dang lag len med par spyad mi chog pa'i bka' yi rgyas btab pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos grags chen zhig /
bon gyi lta ba ston pa'i gzhung zhig

dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal dum bu gsum pa spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar gyi nad thams cad lag len dmar khrid kyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa yon tan gyi rgyud de le'u dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i sman gzhung tshad ldan zhig /
gdams ngag gi snying po'am bcud/

rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i nang gses zab pa man ngag gi sde ni, snying thig gi skor rnams te, o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro snying thig dang pan chen bi ma mi tra nas brgyud pa'i bi

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, rjod byed drug tshan du ma'i bdag nyid can gyi sgo nas zhal gdams kyi tshul du ston pa'i gzhung, dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/
dus sam gnas kyi mtshams 'byed pa'i tshig / lte ba man chad chu'i nang du nub pa/ da lta man chad/
(rgya) gro zhib leb mor bzos pa'i thug pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rin spungs rdzong khongs kyi 'bab chu zhig dang, yar klungs gtsang po'i yan lag cig yin/
dus sam gnas kyi mtshams 'byed pa'i tshig / bsam gtam gsum pa man chod/
mi gsal ba'am, thag mi gcod pa/ skad cha man ne mun ne ma shod/
man ne mun ne'i bsdus tshig
(rgya) dar gos srab mo mdog ser la dmar ljang gi thig ris can/
chu shel kha dog dkar ba'i rigs shig /
(rgya) kan khrang ste thug pa 'dril byed kyi rgyug hril/
(legs) yid 'dzin ma ste, slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi gsang yum zhig /
(legs) 1) mchod rdzas kyi bye brag cig / 2) dkyil 'khor/

bod rang skyong ljongs khongs btsho sna rdzong 'og mon yul rta dbang dgon pa chags gsa'i ming rnying zhig ste, sngar yul de'i 'dabs nags khrod cig tu skyes nas byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo gnas pa'i yul grong gi lte ba yin par grags/
phyi dang, nang dang, gsang ba dang, de kho na nyid kyi mandal te bzhi/

1.ming mthar sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi phrad cig / ma...shing sgam mam lcags sgam/ 2.ming mtha' ma'i rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / ma...mtshan mo g.yang sar 'gro dus rig pa rtse gcig tu sgrim mam mi sgrim/

ma'o tse tung dgongs pa ni krung gor mar khe si le nyin ring lugs bed spyod dang 'brel 'phel rgyas btang ba zhig dang, lag len gyi thog nas ra gsal por 'phrod zin pa'i krung go'i gsar brje'i skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yang dag pa'i rtsa don dang nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig krung go gung khran tang gi thun mong blo gros kyi snying bcud cig bcas yin, nga tsho'i tang gi 'go khrid pa phul byung mang pos ma'o tse tung gi tshan rig dang mthun pa'i gsung rtsom ni de'i snying po gcig tu bsdus pa zhig yin/

/ 1) zho'am 'o ma bsrubs pa'i snying po/ chu dkrogs na mar mi thon/ ming gi rnam grangs la rtsi bcud dang, bsrubs skyes so, 2) yar gyi ldog zla/ yar...zlog gong mar bcag pa/ dgun dus chu kha mar 'bri ba/ lang tsho mar rgud pa/ btsan rgyal gyi stobs shugs mar chag pa/
mar gtum byed kyi ko ba/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi snye mo rdzong gi byang rgyud snye mo ma chu'i stod rgyud du yod/
mar thum gyi ko ba/ mar skogs mar gyis mi 'thul, chu rdo chu yis mi 'bong/
mar bzhus pa'i khu ba/ khro kong nang gi mar khu hrangs pa/
po li khri dkar rag snag tsha bcas sbyar ba'i: mdog /

mar khe si dang en ke si rnam gnyis kyis bskrun pa gnang ba'i 'byor med gral rim gyi bsam pa'i ma lag cig yin zhing, de'i rtsa ba'i grub cha ni mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang, chab srid dpal 'byor rig pa, tshan rig spyi tshogs ring lugs gsum gong bu gcig gyur zhig yin, 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi snying po red/

nyin ring lugs: 'dzam gling yongs kyi 'byor med gral rim dang ngal rtsol mi dmangs tshos gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig yin zhing, thog mar mar khe si dang en ke si rnam gnyis kyis gsar bskrun gnang ba dang, phyis su le nyin gyis yar rgyas dang phun sum je tshogs su btang ba zhig red/

rin po che ljang gu zhig / mrgad...padma...pad ma senge...seng gi linga...ling ga...ming gi rnam grangs la khyung skyes dang, mkha' lding gshog pa, rdo'i snying po, nor bu ljang gu bcas so,, margat dang 'dra,
