mar zan sogs mdzes byed dkar rgyan/
smyug ma sogs las bzos pa'i mar 'jug snod sgam/
zla ba'i dkar cha mar 'grib pa'i dus/
nag pa zla ba'i mar ngo la khyim du slebs na mar ngo sngon 'gro byed do/
mar gtub byed kyi lcags khyem/
mar rkyang pas bzos pa'i gtor ma/
ko bas gtums pa'i mar do po/
(yul) mar gzhog byed kyi lcags khyem/
mar gyi dbyibs gru bzhi'am, sgor sgor bzos zin pa'i ming/
1) 'o ma dkrogs nas mar 'don pa/ 2) phyir 'don pa/ ca lag tsag tshig yar bcug nas dgos smtshams mar 'don pa/
ram til mar:/ glog bzhu'i 'gram du mar nag gi sgron me sbor don med/
lung pa'am grong tsho'i mar phyogs/
gsham gyi sne mo'am rtse mo/ skas kyi mar sne/ gos kyi mar sne/ grong gi mar sne/
yig rnying du marda yul yang snang, mar pa lo tsa ba 'khrungs sa'i rigs rus, gnas yul deng sang gzhis ka rtse'i nub rgyud du yin/

chos kyi blo gros: lho brag phu chu khyer du spyi lo 1012 chu byi lor 'khrungs, dang po 'brog mi'i drung du lo tsa bslabs, rjes su rgya gar du lan gsum dang bal yul du lan bzhi byon, pan chen n'a ro pa dang mnga' bdag me tri ba sogs grub thob kyi bla ma mang du bsten, kyee rdor dang, gsang 'dus, phyag rgya chen po sod gsang sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa bslabs, slar bod yul du log nas lho brag gro bo lung du bzhugs, ka chen bzhi sogs slob ma mang du bskrun, bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa'i slol btsugs, rang lo gya drug pa med glang lo la 'das/ (1012-1097)...
mar pa lo tsa dang, mi la ras pa, dwags po lha rje bcas bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa'i srol 'byed rnam gsum mo/
ma ri mu ri'i bsdus tshig
zhun mar las byas pa'i sgron me/ mar khu zad nas mar me grongs/ lhags pa langs nas mar me shi/ rlung nang mar yme/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyim gyi nor bu dnag, sgron me, snang gsal, snum za bcas so,
rang 'gul gyis las 'gan sgrub dgos pa'i dpe/
mar me 'dzin 'khan mchod pa'i lha mo/
mar khu'i nang du gtsos pa/ kha zas mar btsos ma/
zla ba mar ngo'i tshes grangs/ chu stod zla ba'i mar tshes kyi tshes gcig ni hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu drug yin/
(yul) spags za thengs gcig gi mar gyi tshad/
bzhus pa'i mar lhad med/ ming gi rnam grangs la mar bskol ba dang, mar khu, zhun mar bcas so,
mar khu dang, phyur zhib, mngar cha rtsam pa bcas bsres nas brdzis pa'i spags/
rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi kus nan rdzong du yod/
mar pa lo tsa'i bzhed srol/
1) snga dus gzhan la bzhon ma btang ba'i 'bab mar/ 2) (yul) mar do po'am mar ltang/
de ring gi mar ram, da lo'i mar/

sdod sa dang nyal sa/ sdod mal/ gnas mal/ mtshan mo mal du nyal/ zhogs pa mal nas langs/ dgong mal phab pa/ mkhar 'di rtsa ba nas bshig la sa sa mal dang, rdo rdo mal du skyol cig / ming gi rnam grangs la nyal mal dang, nyal sa, mal stan, gzims sa bcas so,
nyal sa'i mtha' nas 'bubs pa'i gur/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer gyi shar ngos skyid chu'i stod rgyud du chags shing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de gung dkar du yod/
nyal gdan gding sa'i mtha' skyor du btang ba'i shing sgrom gru bzhi nar mo/
mal gyi cha rkyen te nyal chas/
1) mal cha dang gdan/ 2) nyal stan/
ltar ltar po ste mnan mi bzod pa/ phru gu skyes ma thag pa'i gzugs po mal mul can/
nyal gzan te bal las btags pa'i snam rigs mthug po'i nyal chas shig /
(legs) dri zhim pa'i shing zhig gam, de'i me tog /
yas kyi ldog zla/ grong pa mas ma/ spang thang mas ma/
khebs kyis mas nas 'gebs pa/ bya'i mig mas 'gebs byas te gnyid khug /
ya mchu thung la ma mchu ring bas yar 'gebs pa'i ming/
(yul) rdog mthil dang lham mgo'i bar gyi srub zan/
1) chu 'khor ram lag skor gyi mas rdo/ 2) mas gtun/
bon lugs las bshad pa'i lha 'dre la klud gtor sbyin stangs shig /
mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi

bla med ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim las bstan pa'i gtum mo'i rtogs pa zhig ste, byang sems brtan pa na nor bu nas lte ba dang snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo bcas 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su yar bzlog pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi'o/
(yul) nya 'dzin byed kyi thag pa zhig /
gsham sne/ gyon pa'i mas mtha'/
rdo gtun dang chu 'khor gyi mas rdo/
yi ge'i sngon 'jug ma yig gis 'phul ba/ ma...
1) (rnying) ma tha dad pa'i spun/ mas dben gyi nu bo/ mas dben sring mo/ 2) a ma shi zin pa/
smad ma'am gsham ma/ grong pa mas ma/ sgo ra mas ma/ 'gro lam mas ma/ rgyal sgo mas ma/
mnyen po'am 'jam po/ lto chas mas mul/
'og nas gong du rim bzhin 'dzegs pa/

1./ 1) smra shes don go nus pa'i shes ldan nam, gang zag / ming gi rnam grangs la rkang gnyis dang, gang zag rta la'i rkang pa, na ra: ma nu'i bu, yid skyes, yid ldan, shed bu, shed las skyes, shes ldan bcas so, 2) mi gzhan pa/ mi'i bsam pa/ rang skyon rang gis mi mthong yang mis mthong thub yong/ mi rang gnyis phan/ 2. dus da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i dgag tshig khyad chos ston pa'i ming bcas kyi thog mar 'jug byed dgag sgra zhig ste dper na, dran pa thor nas gtam shod kyang mi shod la, mig lta yang mi lta, 'bad brtson med pas bsam don mi 'grub, le lo che bas yon tan mi slob, sha mdog mi dkar mi nag rlangs 'khor gyi myur tshad mi che mi chung ba'i ngang nas gtong ba sogs lta bu/
ma nyes khag g.yogs/ nyes skyon mdzub mo 'dzugs rgyu med bzhin du mi dkar zhwa nag g.yog rtsis byed pa/
1) gong du mi bkur ba'am mi brtsi ba/ 2) (rnying) khas mi len pa/
1) mi'i rkang rus/ 2) mi'i rkang gling ste gsang sngags kyi rol mo'i yo byad cig /
mi'i bla rus las bzos pa'i dung ste gsang sngags kyi rol mo'i bye brag cig /
rogs zla med pa'i mi/ mang tshogs la brten nas las don byed dgos pa las rta rkyang mi rkyang gis gang yang mi 'grub/
shes pa bcu'i nang gses, sdug bsngal mi skye ba la mi skye bar shes pa'o/
nyan thos dgra bcom pa drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, nyams pa dang 'pho ba med par rang sar gnas nas mi skyod pa'i gang zag /
1) bal bza' khri btsun srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor yong skabs lhan du gdan drangs pa'i jo bo shakya thub pa dgung grangs brgyad pa'i sku tshad kyi 'dra sku/ 2) rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gras shig /
1) mi g.yo ba/ 2) (mngon) gcin/ 3) rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gras shig /
ngan smras sam gtam ngan/ log spyod par mi kha phog pa/ rang phyogs la bden pa yod pas dgra bos 'phya dmod ji tsam btab kyang mi kha zug mi thub/
mi'i khog par 'dre zhugs pa ste, tshul bzhin spyod pa'i mi zhig gi blo de mi gzhan zhig gis ngan slob kyis bsgyur te log par gyur pa'i dpe/
sngar dpon po gang zhig gi mi ser yin yang dpon po de'i mi khongs yin zer/
dal po med pa/ las med du sdod mi khom pa/
sems can dmyal ba dang, dud 'gro, yi dwags, lha tshe ring po, yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa, dbang po ma tshang ba, log par lta ba, de bzhin gshegs pa ma byon pa ste brgyad/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi snang rdzong khongs su yod/
sdod gnas nges med rang gar myul ba'i mi/
yul gzhan nas gyar 'ongs pa'i mi/
1) mi skyod pa/ sems mi 'khrugs pa/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
dgra bcom pa drug gi nang gses, gang rang bzhin gyis dbang po rnon po 'dod yon gyis myos kyang rung ma myos kyang rung mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa las yongs su mi nyams pa'o/
1) 'dom gang gi tshad/ 2) mi su/ gnas tshul 'di skor dus tshod gang dang yul gang du mi gang gis mig mthong yod sogs tshang ma gsal por bshad rgyu 'dug /
sngar bod la bran g.yog gi khyim dud so so'i mi grangs la gzhigs nas mnga' bdag la sprod dgos pa'i khral zhig /
gla sprad de rogs su bos pa'i mi/

1) ngan pa'am sdug po/ 2) rang 'bras yid mi 'ong 'byin byed yin pa'i cha nas rnam smin lung du bstan par bzhag pa'i chos, dper na, srog gcod kyi gzugs, tshig rtsub kyi ngag gnod sems dang, de'i sa bon lta bu'o/
srog gcod, ma byin len, 'dod log spyod, rdzun du smra ba, phra ma, tshig rtsub, ngag kyal, brnab sems, gnod sems, log lta ste bcu/
lus kyi las gsum, ngag gi las bzhi, yid kyi las gsum ste bcu/
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste, mi dge ba'i sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'byung la sems gzhan la mi 'byung ba/
mi dge ba'i sa mang gnyis
ngo tsha med pa dang, khrel med pa gnyis so/
byung tshad dgos pa/ rang la bde skyid mi dgos dgu dgos byung na dga' ba/
1) mi'i mgo/ 2) mi'i grangs ka/ khyed rang gi nang du mi mgo du tsam yod/
khyod kyi yin pa yod pa ste, so so ba ma yin pa'am gzhi mthun yod pa, dper na, bum pa dang dngos po lta bu'o/
'gyu ba'i rnam rtog ste mi dran dgu dran/
sku lnga'i ya gyal zhig gzugs sku gnyis su snang yang rang rgyud pa med de, chos kyi sku las ma g.yos pa'am, chos sku dang gzugs sku dbyer mi phyed pa ste, sngags rnying ma'i brda chad cig /
1) brtan por gnas pa/ kha dan mi 'gyur ba/ 'grogs sems mi 'gyur ba/ ngo bo mi 'gyur ba/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
tshwa kha zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ru thog rdzong khongs su yod/
don gcod mi 'gro'i 'jon thang tshad gzhi/

ngag rgyun du lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi jo bo bzhugs khri der dang thog sangs rgyas kyi 'jim sku zhig yod cing, phyis jo bo'i sku 'di nyid bzhugs su gsol dgos pas 'jim sku gzhan du spo rtsis byed dus nga mi 'gro zhes gsung byon par brten da lta'i bzhugs khri'i rgyab tu jo bo'i sku dang ltag sprod kyi tshul du bzhugs pa de'i mtshan/
1) na rgas kyi mi/ 2) nyams myong che ba'i mi/
lo na lon zhing bsam blo rnyed pa'i mi/

1) snga dus kyi shod srol ltar, yul mtha' 'khob kyi nags khrod du sdod pa'i mi gdong dang gzugs por spu nag ring po skyes shing, dud 'gro ltar blun rmongs spyod pa gyong po zhig / 2) mi dpa' dang blo khog che ba/ mi rgod dpung pa mnyam gshibs dang, rta rgod bang kha mnyam rgyug byed/
1) mi 'jon po'am grung po/ 2) mi gyong po'am spyod rtsing tshabs che'i mi/
mi rgyu gnyis kas phongs pa/ lung pa de mi rgyu gnyis zhan zhig yin yang thon spel gyi las don byed stangs gang legs 'dug /
gdug rtsub che ba'am, gnod sems can gyi mi/ bkag na mi thub pa khyi ngan, bshad na mi nyan mkhan mi ngan/ mi bzang brgya yod kyang nyung skyon, mi ngan gcig yod kyang mang skyon/
mi dang las don gnyis ka sdug po/
gdug rtsub che ba'i mi nyes can/
1) mi'i nad yams/ 2) 'thab rtsod kyi lhong/
1) khyim bdag / khong tsho'i mi ngo ma rang thug byung/ 2) tshab min pa'i mi rang nyid/ khyed rang mi ngo ma rang tshogs 'dur phebs rogs/
mi dang las don gnyis ka dngos gnas yin pa/
1) mi gsal ba/ tshig mi mngon pa/ 2) mi mthong ba/ gzugs mi mngon pa/
1) mi khom pa/ las mang sdeb gcig tu byed mi lcogs pa/ 2) mi nus pa/ rkang phra pos khur chen po 'khyer mi lcogs pa/ bsam tshod kyi bya ba nus stobs kyis mi lcogs pa/
1) che chung tshad che tsam pa/ lo 'bras thon 'bor mi chung ba/ byas rjes mi chung ba/ 2) mi gzhon pa/ 3) gzugs tshad chung ba'i mi/
mi chung chung gis bsam blo chen po btang ba'am, mi chung chung gis bsam shes chen po byas pa'i dpe/

bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris bzhi pa ste, gnas gtsang ma'i ris su skyes pa'i nang nas 'di gong ma rnams las bsod nams dang lus bongs chung zhing 'dod pa la gdung ba chung bas mi che ba zhes bya ba, gtsang ma'i gnas lnga'i nang gses shig /
1) 'jig rten pa'i bslab bya'am mi'i tshul lugs/ 2) 'jig rten gyi bya ba/
'jig rten pa ste 'jig rten gyi bya ba byed mkhan/
'jig rten pa'i bya ba gang la'ang 'jon po yod pa/

bden par smra ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, rang nyid kyis mi chos bla ma'i yon tan thob pa de dgos pa khyad par can med bzhin du yul bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la smra ba'o/

rdzun gyi pham pa: pham pa bzhi'i nang gses, gzhi smra shes don go ba'i mi la, bsam pa bslu bar 'dod pas, sbyor ba mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs mi'i chos las gong na 'phags pa'i yon tan rang la med kyang yod ces bla ma'i rdzun smras nas, mthar thug gzhan gyis de rdzun du go bar gyur pa'o/
mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug

sngar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims srol don tshan bcu drug ste, lha dkon mchog gsum la mos gus bskyed pa, dam pa'i chos btsal zhing bsgrub pa, pha ma la drin lan 'jal ba, yon tan can la zhe mthong yod pa, rigs mtho ba dang rgan par bkur sti che ba, yul mi khyim mtshes la phan 'dogs pa, bka' drang zhing sems chung ba, nye du mdza' bshes la gzhung ring ba, ya rabs kyi rjes snyeg cing phyi thag ring ba, zas nor la tshod 'dzin pa, sngar drin can gyi mi rtsad gcod pa, bu lon dus su 'jal zhing bre srang la g.yo med pa, kun la phrag dog chung ba, ngan pa'i gros la mi nyan zhing rang tshugs 'dzin pa, ngag 'jam zhing smra ba nyung ba, theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs pa ste bcu drug /
1) rgyal po/ 2) sangs rgyas/ 3) bzang po'i rtser son pa'i mi/
1) gtam mi smra ba/ 2) rgyun mi 'chad pa/
las don sgrub mi shes pa'i mi glen pa/
«saha» mi skrag pa'am zhed snang med pa/
chos sgrub par mi 'jigs pa'am, zhed mi dgos pa'i 'jig rten te lho 'dzam bu gling/
(mngon) 1) shakya thub pa/ 2) lha tshangs pa/
dbus rgya gar rdo rje gdan, shar ri bo rtse lnga, lho po ta la, nub o ti ya na, byang sham bha la/
dgra dang gcan gzan la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las skyob cing phan 'dogs pa'o/
rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa, spangs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa, bar du gcod pa'i chos bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa, nges par 'byung ba'i lam bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa ste bzhi/
mi thub thub mdog / hang shed kyis mi 'jon 'jon tshul byas pa/
1) dpon po chen po/ 2) mi mchog /
sbyangs pa'i yon tan nam yang mi brjed pa'i yon tan nam dngos grub/

1) si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dar rtse mdo'i nub phyogs nas rta'u'i shar phyogs bar gyi sa cha zhig / 2) sung rgyal rabs skabs nying zha zer ba'i sa char rgyal srid btsugs pa'i shis zha zhes pa de'o/
shar zla chu'i shar phyogs sa khul mgar thar man chad dar rtse mdo sogs kyi spyi ming/

rab byung dang po'i sa yos lor tang zhang chang zhes pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyis rma chu'i sked rgyud deng sang nying zha zer ba'i sa char shis zha zhes pa'i rgyal srid btsugs pa de rab byung bzhi pa'i me phag lor hor jing gir rgyal po'i lag tu shor, de'i gdung rgyud lho phyogs su bskyod de mdo khams sgang drug gi nang gses mi nyag ste dar rtse mdo'i nub rgyud du gzhis chags nas bsdad, rgya skad shis zha zhes pa'i sgra gdangs de bod skad du ji bzhin ma thon par zur chag ste si hu'am si'u zhes grags/
dus gtan du med par mi 'gyur ba/ gsar brje'i srol rgyun bzang po mi nyams yun gnas byed dgos/
sman sna sbyor tshul gyis dri shas che ba'o/
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi yan lag can dpe'i yan lag can gyi gzugs can du byas shing, yan lag rnams gzugs su bkod pa dang ma bkod pa ci rigs su byas pa'i rgyan zhig /
'jig pa'i chos te, rang nyid skad cig re re bzhin du 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba'o/ 'dus byas mi rtag chos nyid yin/ tshe mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/
stong pa nyid kyi ye shes ni chos sku mi rtog chen po'i thugs zhes sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa'o/
gang zag la mi rton pa dang, tshig la mi rton pa, rnam shes la mi rton pa, drang don la mi rton pa ste bzhi'o/
mig mi lta ba'am mi rtsi ba/ yul dus kyi gnas tshul la mi lta bar bab col gyi bya spyod gang byung byas na 'thus sgo 'chor rgyu las med/
mi gnod dam mi skyon/ las khungs grol dus tog tsam phyi po byas na yang mi sto/
smra shes, don go, shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa bcas so/
mi rabs gcig pa/ khong dang nga tsho mi thog gcig pa'i grogs po red/

1) mtshungs pa'i ldog phyogs te phan tshun 'gal ba/ skad cha mi mthun par smra ba/ bsam 'char mi mthun pa/ las rigs mi mthun pa/ mi mthun pa'i bslab bya/ 2) 'cham po med pa dang, bsam pa mi gcig pa/ mthun pa'i rgyal khab dbar du mi mthun par byed pa/ grogs po mi mthun pa mthun par byed pa/
bsnyen rdzogs kyi dge 'dun mngon gyur nang gses, mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba ste, las gral du dngos su ma 'dus pa'i mi mthun pa dang, 'dus pa phyir log gi mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba'o/
tshig phrad kyang sogs tshig don snga phyi mi mthun pa'i don la 'jug pa/ kyang yang 'ang...khas blangs kyang lag tu ma blangs pa/ bltas kyang ma mthong/ bslabs kyang ma shes/

1) 'gal ba'i phyogs dang rgyab ngos/ mi ngan gang zhig nga tshor mi mthun pa'i phyogs nas bslab bya byed mkhan yin/ pham nyes byung lugs la phyi mig bltas te mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi nyams myong gsog thabs byed pa/ 2) gnyen po'i phyogs/
gtan tshigs rig pa'i skabs kyi rtags chos gnyis dang mi ldan pa'i dpe/

dpe yang dag gnyis kyi ya gyal, chos mi mthun sbyor gyi dpe ste, bsgrub bya nges pa'i sngon du ldog khyab dngos su nges pa'i gzhir gyur pa, rtag na ma byas pa'i dpe nam mkha' bkod pa lta bu byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i dpe'o/
de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyis stong pa ste, bsgrub bya'i chos dang rgyab 'gal du gyur pa'am ldog pa'i tshul/
mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi shes gang zhig thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang bral ba gzhi'i gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pas bcings pa'i byang sems kyi spang byar gnas pa'o/

khyab byed mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug: pa phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las dngos kyi ma nges pa'i rtad bzhi'i ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mi mthun phyogs la khyab cing mthun phyogs la khyab ma khyab gnyis ka'i cha yod pa, dper na, sgra chos can, rtsol byung min te, mi rtag pa'i phyir, dpe nam mkha' dang glog dang bum pa bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, mi rtag pa de sgra rtsol byung min par sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug cing, mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa ste, rtsol byung la mi rtag pas khyab, rtsol byung min pa la rtag mi rtag gnyis ka yod pa'o/
mi mthun phyogs la gtan med mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa

phyogs chos dgu'i gtan tshigs las rtags yang dag gnyis kyi ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mthun phyogs la khyab cing mi mthun la med pa, dper na, sgra chos can mi rtag ste, byas pa'i phyir, dpe bum pa dang nam mkha' bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, mthun phyogs mi rtag pa la byas pas khyab, mi mthun phyogs rtag pa la byas pa med pas khyab pa'o/
mi mthun phyogs la gtan med mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa

phyogs chos gtan tshigs dgu las rtags yang dag gnyis kyi ya gyal, rtags de gsal ba de'i mi mthun phyogs la med cing mthun phyogs la yin min gnyis kyi cha yod pa, dper na, dung sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir, dpe bum pa dang glog dang nam mkha' bzhin, zhes pa lta bu, rtsol byung de mi mthun phyogs rtag pa la gtan nas med cing, mthun phyogs mi rtag pa la rtsol byung yin min gnyis ka yod pa'o/
mi 'theng po ste rkang 'khyog / rta 'theng mi 'theng khyi 'theng gsum, 'theng gsum hor la bab pa rmis/
mi thub pa/ mi sdar mas dpa' bo la 'gran mi do/
(rnying) 1) mi kha stabs can nam kha bsod can/ 2) mi 'jon thang yod pa/
bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing pa bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang chab srid dpal 'byor gyi dmigs bsal dbang cha longs su spyod mkhan gras/
dran rgyu rgod po/ mi dran dgu dran gyi g.yo 'phrul byas na mi yong dgu yong gi ngan 'bras 'khor yong/
bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas lnga pa ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha ni bsam gtan khyad par can thob pas nyon mongs pas gdung bar mi nus pa'i phyir mi gdung ba zhes gtsang ma'i gnas lnga'i nang gses shig /
1) rgyal po/ 2) 'di rgyal po'i ming gi rnam grangs yin pas grangs bcu drug mtshon/
rdzun tshig lhu sgrig pa/ mi bden rdzun grig byas nas 'chal gtam sna tshogs sgrog pa/
1) mi rgal ba'am mi 'gyur ba/ sngon srol bzang po las mi 'da' ba yon tan mchog yin no/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
blor mi 'bab pa/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gi sdug 'khur su yang mi 'dod pa/ phan med kyi bya ba byed mi 'dod pa/

rnam gcod kyi sgra'i nang gses shig ste, gzhi de la khyad chos de mi ldan pa rnam par bcad nas mtha' gcig tu ldan pa kho nar ston pa'i sgra, dper na nag pa 'phong skyen pa kho na yin zhes dang, sgra mi rtag pa nyid yin zhes pa lta bu, rnam gcod kyi sgra'am tshig phrad de khyad chos kyi 'og de ma thag par sbyar nas rjod par byed pa'o/
slar mi 'ong ba/ nor 'khrul gyi bsam pa gtsang sel byas nas phyir mi ldog pa/
mdzes pa min pa dang, yid du mi 'ong ba/ gzugs mi sdug pa/ rnam 'gyur ches mi sdug pa/
'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal: dgra bo sogs dang thug nas byung ba'i sdug bsngal/

nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, btsog cing dri mnam pa sogs ha cang yi gar mi 'ong ba'i yul mthong ba'i rkyen gyis nang du skyug bro bar byed pa'i rnam 'gyur mi sdug pa'i nyams ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
1) khyim pa'i mnga' bdag gis dbang sgyur ba'i mi ser/ 2) grong sde/
mi nyams yun ring du gnas pa/
srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' dang, zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas par yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o/
spyi tshogs nang du go bab nges can zhig yod mkhan nam 'thus mi/ rgyal gces mi sna/
1) mngon gsal med pa'am, mthong mi thub pa/ 2) yod pa ma yin pa'am med pa/ skyon cha mi snang ba/

zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag de sgrub kyi: mi snang ba'i 'gal zla dmigs pa'i tshul gsum yin pa ste de sgrub kyi mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig ma yin dgag dang sgrub pa gang rung yin pa/
thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gses, bsgrubs pa'i rdzas kyi thig le dpral bar byug pas lus mi snang zhing sus kyang mi mthong ba/

zla rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag lha'i: bar srid bskal don du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi lha'i bar srid nges byed kyi tshad mas ma dmigs pa de mdun gyi gzhi 'dir lha'i bar srid bskal don du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud la lha'i bar srid nges byed kyi dpyad shes don mthun med par sgrub pa'i rtags/
mi snang ba'i 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag de sgrub
kyi mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig rang gi dngos ming gi mthar med pa lta bu'i dgag sgra sbyar ba'i chos
mi snang ma dmigs pa'i rtags

ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi nang gses, dgag gzhi snang du rung zhing, dgag bya'i chos su btags pa'i don snang du mi rung ba'am, rtsod gzhi'i steng du dgag bya'i chos med nges su sgrub mi nus shing, yod nges 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba, dper na, mdun gyi gzhi 'dir chos can, sha za bskal don du song ba'i gang zag gis sha za yod ces dam bca' mi rigs te, de nges byed kyi nges shes don mthun tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/
mi mang dpung bsgril gyis zing cha bslangs pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs grong khyer nang gi mi skya'i khrims bdag /
mi pham skra'i la ba can

sngar shakya mu ne zhal bzhugs skabs kyi rgya gar gyi grub mtha' smra ba zhig gi ston pa des 'byung ba bzhi nas mir gyur pas mi tshe rdzogs mtshams mi dang 'byung ba bzhi 'jigs pas stong par 'gyur bar 'dod/

mkhas pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba, phung po dang, khams dang, skye mched dang, rten 'brel dang, gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang, dbang po dang, dus dang, bden pa dang, theg pa dang, 'dus byas 'dus ma byas te mkhas bya'i gnas bcu ston pa'i gzhung 'di ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu stag lor 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o/ 1902...
1) mi dkyus ma'am dmangs/ 2) so skye'i mi/
1) mi'i rang bzhin nam rgyu dag / 2) mi rgyud kyi khungs/
gzhom gzhig mi thub pa/ rgas 'khogs kyis lto chas mkhregs po mi phed pa/ gshol lcags rtul pos zhing sa tha rgod rmo slog mi phed pa/
skyes pa rgod po/ rta pho'i sga thog mi pho'i las thog /
mi dang nor phyugs gnyis ka 'phel ba/ yul 'brog mang por mi phyugs gnyis 'phel gyi yar rgyas byung ba/
thugs lnga'i ya gyal zhig so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni mi phyed rdo rje'i thud zhes rnying gzhung du gsungs/

1) 'gyur ldog med pa'am, brtan po/ yid ches mi phyed pa/ gral rim gyi lar rgya mi phyed pa/ 2) gnas brtan bcu drug las 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang bcas pa gangs ri'i rgyal por bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig /
sngar dmag dus sogs dza drag che skabs mi su yod skul ba'i khral zhig /
kha zas phan tshun mi 'phrod pa mnyam du sbyar nas zos pa las byung ba'i dug dang 'dra ba'i lus la gnod pa 'byung ba zhig /
mi'i gzugs byad bzang ngan gyi rnam pa,
mi'u gdung drug dang don gcig
se, rmu, ldong, stong ste gna' gtam du bshad pa'i spra nas mched pa'i bod kyi thog ma'i rigs bzhi ste, de la nang gi rigs bzhi'ang zer/
dmu tsha sga dang, a spo ldong, se khyung dbra, a lcags 'bru ste rus chen bzhi dang, dba' dang sda zhes rus chung gnyis bcas drug go/
mi yul byol du song zhing khang pa zhig pa/
mi khral te, sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs zhing pa bran g.yog nas mnga' bdag la las dod dngul 'jal dgos pa'i khral zhig /
bya spyod sna tshogs pa/ mi byed dgu byed byas na rang gzhan gnyis kar gnod yong/
1) mi'i gtso bo'am bdag po/ 2) mi'i tshe srog bla gsum gyi nang gses shig /
mi rnams kyi blo sems gtad sa'i yul/ gnya' gnon 'og tu sdod mkhan gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i mi blo gtad phyogs ni bcings 'grol 'thob tu re ba kho na yin/
phyi mi'i blo kha rang phyogs la sgyur ba/
mi blo thabs can nam, blo gsal can/
mi'i rje bo/ mi dbang rnams kyi spyod pa las, phan gnod 'bras bu rgya cher 'byin/
rgyal po chen po'am dpon po chen po/

dpal mi'i dbang po'i rtogs brjod 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i gtam zhes bya ba 'di mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang lor brtsams, pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal mi tshe ril por mes rgyal gcig gyur la 'bad pa'i rnam thar gzhir byas shing, zur rgyan du hor gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bod du chab srid bzung tshul dang, gong ma hrun kri dang bde skyid rgyal po gnyis kyi skabs su gangs can 'dir rgya bod hor gsum dang man ju bcas phan tshun bar gyi 'brel lam phra rags, dpon 'bangs ser skya'i kha rgyun gtam rgyud thor bu bcas tshar du dngar bar bsgrigs nas rtogs brjod yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig tu gyur, de'i ma dpe da lta lha sa'i yig tshang du mchis, par ma shog grangs sum brgya dgu bcu go lnga pa zhig yod, 1981 lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis deb bton y od/ 1733...395...(1689-1747)/ 1981...
mi'i gdong brnyan nam 'dra 'bag / gdong la mi 'bag gyon nas gdug 'dre'i spyod ngan byed pa/
mi'i gzugs dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i spra/
mi grangs mang la lag pa yang mang ba/ mi mang lag mang mnyam rub hur brtson byed pa/
mi mang blo sems gcig tu mthun pa/ mi mang sems gcig gi sgo nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun hur brtson byed pa/
gzugs med lha 'dre mi ma yin/
mi'i rgyu 'grul med pa'i ri bo/
mi dang mi khyim med pa'i 'brog stong/

ngal rtsol mang tshogs kyis gtso bo byas pa'i spyi tshogs kyi khongs mi ches mang che ba rnams la zer/ mi dmangs yongs rdzogs/ mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab/ mi dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs/ mi dmangs tshogs pa/ mi dmangs mang tshogs/
srid dbang sger 'dzin: bzo pa gral rim (gung khran tang brgyud) gyis 'go khrid byed cing bzo zhing mna' 'brel gyis rmang gzhi byed pa'i mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i srid dbang sger 'dzin la zer/
rang rgyal gyis gtan 'bebs byas te sgor rtsis gzhir byas pa'i shog dngul zhig /
rang rgyal gyi rim pa so so'i rgyal khab srid 'dzin las khungs kyi spyi ming yin/
mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid
phyi nang gi chos rnams 'das pa dang da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus gang du'ang dngos por ma dmigs pa ste, stong nyid bcu drug gi nang gses shig /
mis yid smon byed pa dang rang skyed pa/
ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gso sbyong sogs kyi las gral du 'khod nas 'dun pa ma phul bar gzhan du 'gro ba'o/
1) btsog pa/ mi gtsang 'dam las skyes pa'i pad ma yang, kun gyi bstod yul gyur pa ma lags sam/ 2) dri chen/
sngar bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin bran bdag so sor dbang ba'i mi'i 'byung khungs sam mi rgyud/ rang khongs mi rtsa/ sger gyi mi rtsa/ chos gzhis mi rtsa/ so nam las khungs kyi mi rtsa/
dpon khungs gzhan gyi mi rtsa zhig rang nyid la mgo 'dogs par yong ba de khas len pa la mgo len zer/
snga dus zhing bran bdag po'i dbang sgyur khral mis gnya' gnon bshu gzhog ma bzod par yul gzhan du 'khyar ba'i gras/
sngar mnga' bdag gi khral khongs nas bros te rang gar sdod pa'i mi'i gras/
mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa

pham pa bzhi'i nang gses te, gzhi pho mo ma ning mi dang dud 'gro gang yin rung, lus gson po'am phyed du longs pa'i ro lta bu'i kha dang bshang lam zag byed gsum po gang rung du, bsam pa chags pa'i sems kyis, sbyor ba pho dbang bcug cing, mthar thug reg pa las byung ba'i bde ba rdzogs par nyams su myong ba'o/

1) mi lus che chung gi tshad/ 2) ma zad/ lo mang bar du gsar brje'i las don byas pas mi tshad grub 'bras kyang chen po bzhag yod/ 3) tshad mar 'os pa'i mi/ kho rang yul lung 'di'i mi tshad srang tshad red/
1) mi'i lus tshad dang ring thung mnyam pa/ 'dra sku mi tshad ma/ cha sgam mi tshad ma/ 2) cha 'jog 'pher la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mi/
sngar dgon pa'i grwa pa'i sde tshan khang tshan gyi yan lag /
sngar dgon pa che khag gi grwa pa'i gzhi rims sde tshan gyi 'thus mi/
sngar bod kyi mnga' bdag tshos rang khongs bran g.yog phan tshun mi brjes brgyab pa'i mi tshab/
1) mi gnod pa/ me sogs kyis mi tshugs pa/ 2) tshod mi zin pa/ lus sdod mi tshugs par 'gro 'gro mang/ 3) rang rkya mi 'pher ba/ rang stobs kyis sra mi tshugs pa/

mi'i srog rten bla tshe/ rang gi mi tshe don med stong zad du ma gtong/ mi tshe hril por 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las don du 'thab rtsol byed pa/ khong tshos mi tshe gang por so nam las ka 'ba' zhig hur brtson byed pa/
mi tshe don med du skyel ba/
tshe ring rnam drug gi ya gyal zhig /
mi rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i sde tshom/ lung pa der sdod mkhan mi tshogs 'thug po 'dug / grong khyer gyi mi tshogs 'thug tshad sngar las sum 'gyur du 'phar 'dug /
lto zhim po ma byung na sna khug brdzes nas zhim po mi 'dug mdog mdog gi rnam 'gyur ston pa/
mi yi rkang tshil zhun du byas pa ste, de lus la byugs na snying rlung gi nad 'joms shing, 'bras nad 'dul bar byed do/
mi'i gshis ka'am rgyu dag / mi gzhi nan po/ mi gzhi legs po/ mi gzhi lhing po/
1) rdzogs rgyu med pa/ blo gros mi zad pa/ snying stobs mi zad pa/ sa 'og gi nor mdzod mi zad pa/ 2) (mngon) me pho khyi lo/

tshig sdud kyi bye brag cig ste, shes rig gi yon tan la shes yon zer ba dang, bsam blo'i 'char sgo la bsam 'char zer ba lta bu ming tshig bar gyi rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs yig 'bru nyung ngur bsdus nas brjod pa lta bu'o/
mi grangs/ mi zla sum cu so lnga/
mi'i bzo 'drar bcos pa'i dngos spyad/ 'jim brnyan mi gzugs ma/ shel spyad mi gzugs ma/
1) ma rungs pa dang, khro gtum pa dang, ha cang drag shul che ba/ spyod pa mi bzad pa/ dgra sha len sems mi bzad pa,..mi dmangs dmar gsod kyi las ngan mi bzad pa/ 2) (rnying) bzod dka' ba/
(mngon) 1) dbang phyug chen po/ 2) rgyal chen spyan mi bzang/ 3) gza' spen pa/
khro ba'am ma rung ba'i sems/
cha'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsgrib bya gang yang rung ba zhig sgrib byed dngos po mi 'os pa zhig gis sgrib pa ston pa'i cha'i rgyan zhig /

gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'os pa'i rgyu las mi 'os pa'i 'bras bu skyed pa bsgrub byar bkod nas, sgrub byed skye bo rnams la mi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster ba dngos po'i byed las mi 'os pa zhig bkod pa'i rgyan/

pa'i don gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsgrub bya mi 'os pa dang 'os pa'i dngos po bye brag pa gnyis bkod nas, de'i sgrub byed du spyi la khyab pa'i 'gal zla'i don gzhan zhig bkod pa'i rgyan/

mthong ba don ldan: rab byung bdun pa'i nang bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud bsod nams rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs shing, 'phags yul gyi phan chen nags kyi rin chen dang, lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho, byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang, brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed sogs mkhas grub kyi slob dpon mang du bsten, sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang, khyad par gso ba rig pa la phul du byung ba'i mkhas par gyur, gsung rtsom yang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa bkod pa rnam bzhi, rtsa mdo'i 'grel pa snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs mdzad, gso rig gi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang gi bzhed srol dar rgyas su mdzad/
1) 'gul skyod med pa dang, mi 'khrugs pa/ lugs bzang po nam yang mi g.yo bar byed dgos/ 2) (mngon) 1,khro bcu'i bye brag cig / 2,nam mkha'/ 3,ri bo/ 4,sa gzhi/
dgra bcom pa drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, dbang po rno bas rkyen ngan ji ltar phrad kyang rtogs pa las nyams mi srid pa'i gang zag /
byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i brgyad pa, sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams mtshan bcas dang mtshan med la rtsol ba'i 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo bas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'o/
jo mo glang ma ri'i lha mo tshe ring mched lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
1) gzhan dang rang/ 2) mi hreng/ 3) (yul) kho rang/
mi thog brgyud rim/ mi rabs snga ma'i srol rgyun bzang po mi rabs phyi mas 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs par byed dgos/ mi rabs gsar pa 'tshar logs 'thus tshang du 'gro bzhin yod pa/
sa zhing sogs mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gtan 'jags su sdod pa/
rin gong mi gnas sam, mi 'thob/ ca lag 'di la rin gong de tsam mi ri/

1) lo rgyus thog nas chags pa zhig dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim mi 'dra bar gnas pa'i mi sna tshogs kyi thun mong tshogs pa zhig yin/ 2) bye brag thun mong gi skad yig dang, thun mong gi sa khongs, thun mong gi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba, thun mong gi rig gnas thog nas mtshon pa'i thun mong gi bsam tshul bcas ldan pa'i mi rnams kyi thun mong gi tshod par zer/ mi rigs kyi chas gos/ mi rigs kyi lar rgya/ mi rigs kyi gnya' gnon/
mi 'thad pa'am mi 'os pa/ mis mi la bshu gzhog byed pa ni mi rigs pa zhig red/
mi ser spel yul lam mi ser spel yul phyed tsam gyi rgyal khab dang rang btsan gsar du byung ba'i rgyal khab kha shas nang gi 'byor 'bring gral rim,..
bram ze'i rigs dang, rgyal rigs, rje rigs, dmangs rigs bcas te sngon rgya gar gyi bshad srol zhig /
mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong

mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong byed pa ni krung go gung khran tang gis mar khe si le nyin ring lugs la brten nas rang rgyal gyi mi rigs gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i srid jus dang rgyal khab kyi chab srid lam lugs gal chen zhig dang, rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid 'og grangs nyung mi rigs khag 'dus sdod byed pa'i sa gnas su sa khongs rang skyong dngos su lag bstar byas nas rang skyong las khungs btsugs te rang skyong gi dbang cha spyod rgyu de yin/
mi'i rigs yin pa mtha' dag /
mi rus kyis bzos pa'i mchod rdzas rkang gling/
mi rang rang so so/ bzo pa mi re ngo re/ slob grwa ba mi re ngo re/
snga dus rnal 'byor gyi cha lugs can la smod tshig /
1) bod kyi rigs rus rnying pa zhig rje btsun mi la ras pa rigs de las byung ba yin/ 2) la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul du yod/

thos pa dga' ste, rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug lor la stod gung thang skya rnga rtsa ru 'khrungs, sngar mthu bslabs nas dgra mang po bsad, slad nas sdig pa la 'gyod de chos byas pas sangs rgyas pa zhig ste, khong gis mar pa lo tsa'i snyan grags thos nas lho brag tu byon, bla mas sras mkhar dgu thog brtsigs pa sogs chos phyir dka' chen lo drug zla brgyad tsam spyod du bcug mthar dbang dang gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang, dgung lo zhe lnga pa shing byi lor stod phyogs skyid grong dang gnya' nang khul du phebs te lo dgu'i ring la na bza' ras rkyang dang zas zwa tshod tsam la brten pa sogs dka' spyad dang snying rus drag pos bsgoms pas sku tshe de nyid la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes, de nas sa phyogs gzhan du 'byon bzhud mdzad nas snod du rung ba rnams la gsang sngags kyi gdams pa gnang, nyams mgur mang du brtsams, ras chung pa dang, dwags po lha rje sogs slob ma mang du bskrun, sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srol btsugs, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos lo la 'das/
mi la ras pa'i rnam thar

rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam par thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston mgur 'bum dang bcas pa 'di ni rab byung brgyad pa'i sa sprel lor gtsang smyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can nam mtshan dngos sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas mi la ras pa dang ras chung pa gnyis kyis dri ba dang dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i rnam thar rtogs brjod du brtsams par mdzad pa yin la, de'ang thog mar yab mes brgyud pa'i 'byung khungs dang bcas te sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang, gnyis pa nye ba dgra ru gyur te sdug bsngal bden pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa dang, gnyis pa nye ba dgra ru gyur te sdug bsngal bden pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa dang, gsum par mthu bsgrubs nas dgra bo rnams tshar bcad pa'i mdzad pa ste thun mong 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa gsum dang, mtshan ldan gyi bla ma btsal ba'i mdzad pa dang, dka' spyad kyis sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i mdzad pa dang, smin grol gyi gdams pa thob pa'i mdzad pa dang, nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i mdzad pa dang, chig brgyud kyi gdams ngag thob ste bla ma'i drung nas byon pa'i mdzad pa dang, slar yang sgrub la yid dam bcas pa'i mdzad pa dang, rtse gcig ri la bsgoms pa'i mdzad pa dang, sgrub 'bras mngon du gyur te 'gro don spel ba'i mdzad pa dang, gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i mdzad pa ste, zhi ba myang 'das kyi mdzad pa dgu bcas mdzad chen bcu gnyis kyi rnam par thar pa'i tshul zab cing rgya che ba rnams tshig bcad lhug spel ma'i gtam du byas pa'o/
1) gla mi/ ston sdud brel ba che skabs mi lag sgrig pa/ lam rogs kyi mi lag sgrig pa/ 2) mi gzhan gyi lag pa/ mi lag ma brgyud par rang gis len pa/ rang dbang mi lag tu ma sprod/
mi'i lus rten/ mi lus kyi rang dbang/ mi lus gzhan dbang/
rtsa che'i mi lus/ mi lus rin chen gser las dkon par snying po yod pa zhig byed dgos/
mi'i 'jig rten gyi lo grangs rtsi stangs/
mi bsad pa'i sha lan nam, dgra sha/ mi sha len pa/ sngar 'brog sde phan tshun bar mi sha len res kyi 'khrug gzhi rgyun du langs yong/
dgra sha len mkhan 'phrang 'gag dog por phrad pa/
nyams rgud tshabs chen nam rtsa med du gyur pa/
dus rtag tu mi shigs pa'i thig le shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang, ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mi shigs pa'i thig le snying ga'i khams dkar dmar/
mi rgyu gnyis ka'i stobs shugs/ mi shugs rgyu stobs la gces spras byed dgos/
bya spyod sna tshogs shes pa/
shes zol gyis rdzun smra ba...
kha nas thon tshad shod pa/ khungs lung med pa'i skad cha mi shod dgu shod bshad na mi 'grig /
(rnying) gsha' ma ma yin pa ste yang dag pa min pa/
mi'i rgyu dag gam, rang bzhin/ lam thag ring na bzhon rta legs nyes shes, yun ring gshibs na mi gshis bzang ngan shes/
mi dpe rang la 'gebs tshig / gzhan gyi dka' ngal mthong dus mi sar rang sdod kyis rogs phan byed dgos/
mi'i blo 'dod dang ma mthun pa/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pas kho pa rang gi rgyal khab nang du'ang mi sems ma zin par ya 'gal du phyin pa/
mi dmangs te dpon po'i ldog phyogs/

rgyal khab stobs che bas rang nyid kyis dbang du bsdus zin pa'i sa khul du mi ser spo ba la zer, ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi dus skabs su ma rtsa'i ring lugs rgyal khab kyis rang gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi dbang shugs de dar rgyas ma byung ba'i rgyal khab dang sa khul la rgya bskyed byed pa dang, sa cha de'i mi dmangs kyi sa nas 'phrog bcom dang de dag bran bkol gyi bya ba byed pa la zer/
mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs
ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi rgyal khab stobs che bas rgyal khab bam sa khul stobs chung bar gnya' gnon dang, dbang sgyur bran bkol, bshu gzhog bcas kyi srid jus 'dzin par zer/

sngar rgyal khab cig gis phyi'i rgyal khab kyi sa cha btsan bzung byas rjes rang gi, phyed tsam: rnam pa'i thog rang btsan yin kyang chab srid dang, dpal 'byor, rig gnas sogs gang ci'i thad la btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis tshod 'dzin dang gnya' gnon byed sa'i rgyal khab de tshor zer/

kyis btsan sdod byed pa'i sa khul la zer: da lta ma rtsa'i ring lugs sam btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis gzhan gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi rang btsan dbang cha 'phrogs par ma zad, bdag skyong yang byed sa'i sa khul lam rgyal khab la zer/

rnam gcod kyi sgra'i nang gses, gzhi de la chos de mi srid pa rnam par bcad nas srid pa kho nar ston pa'i sgra, dper na, utpal sngon po srid pa kho na'o zhes pa lta bu, rnam gcod kyi sgra'am tshig phrad de bya ba srid pa'i 'og de ma thag par sbyar nas rjod par byed pa'o/
yod mi srid pa'i bya ba srid pa ltar du byung ba/
mi'i lus sems gnas pa'i rten
1) rang gis shes pa'i yon tan gzhan la mi khrid par sbed pa/ 2) mi slob lam la gnas pa ste, rang 'bras mthar phyin thob pa'i gang zag /

lam lnga'i nang gses, theg gsum rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin pa ste, nyan rang dgra bcom dang sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ mi gsar don gsar, sngar mthong thos ma myong ba'i mi gsar pa dang las don gsar pa/
yul gzhan nas 'ongs ma thag pa'i mi/
khrims 'gal gyi byas nyes tshabs che ba'i tshad/ mi bsad rta khyer lta bu'i ya med rtsing spyod byed mkhan yan por 'jog mi rung/
ma rungs pa'm ma dul ba/ mi bsrun pa rnams ma btul na, de dag 'phel bas rgyal khams 'jig /
ma rungs pa'am chad 'gel 'os pa lnga ste, rgyal po la gnod pa, phan tshun gcig gis gcig la gnod pa, rgyal po'i bka' la mi nyan pa, log pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho ba, log par zhugs par gyur pa bcas lnga/
bden pa dang yang dag pa'o/
mi nus can nam go chod/
mi bzang rta bzang gi dpung/
zla grogs med pa'i mi/ bang chen mi hreng/ mgron po mi hreng/ mi hreng gcig pur gyur pa la rgyal po zhes sus 'dogs/
mi spyod ngan gyi lam du shor ba/

/ 1) lta byed dang 'dren byed dam, snang ba'i dbang po/ sha'i mig rnon po/ blo mig / zur mig / kha bas mig 'phyid pa/ mig g.yas g.yon 'phrig pa/ lta ba mig gis mi bzod pa/ 'grems ston khang nang la slebs dus mig gis lta tshod 'di tshod med pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyab byed dang, mthong byed, snang byed, spyan, tsaksha, gzigs byed, gsal byed, lha'i sgron ma bcas so, 2) i khung dang bu ga/ pang leb la mig 'bugs pa/ 3) (mngon) mig la g.yas g.yon gnyis yod pas grangs gnyis mtshon/
mig 'bras nang du rdib pa'i kong kong/
mig tshum tshum byed stangs shig / rab rib can gyi mig krab krab tu lta/
mig gi dri ma'am mig skyo/
mig 'bras phyi ngos kyi srab cing dwangs pa'i skyi mo/
mig gi dri ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la mig skyag dang, mig gi rngu ma, mig rnag bcas so,
1) bug pa/ 2) mig dbang gi khung bu/ yun ring na nas mig khung gnyis kyang gting du rdib pa/
mig 'bras g.yo ba/ blta yul tshang mar mig 'khyug pa/
mig gis mthong tshul nor ba/ mkhris nad can gyi mig 'khrul nas dung dkar ser por mthong/
(rnying) 1) mig yul du 'thad pa/ 2) yid dga' ba/
mig gi skya sgrib dang don gcig
nang gi skye mched drug gi nang gses, rten gyi cha nas mig gi rnam par skye zhing yul gzugs la mched pa'i sgor gyur pa mig gi dbang po'o/
mig gis lta ba'i tshe phyi rol gyi gzugs 'char bar byed pa'i mig 'bras kyi dkyil du yod pa'i: mthong byed sngo nag sran chung tsam pa de la zer
mig gi lta stangs kyi khyad par/
mig gi rgyal mo'i ming gi rnam grangs shig
dbang mngon lnga'i nang gses, rang gi bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten nas byung zhing rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gzhan rig dper na, dung dkar por snang ba'i mig shes lta bu'o/
dbang po lnga'i nang gses shig ste, rang 'bras mig shes kyi rten nam thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa, dbyibs zar ma'i me tog lta bu de'o/
mig gi dbang po gzugs can
gzhan gyi bya ba'i lad mo'am mi gzhan la byung ba de rang la dgos 'dod byed pa/ bya ba ngan pa la mig 'gran ma byed/ go ming la mig 'gran byed pa/
ling thog dang sha 'dzer lta bu phyi 'grib, mig 'bras dang mig shun bar nas 'grib byed kyi rgyal mo g.yogs pa bar 'grib, mthong byed kyi rtsa nyams pa lta bu nang 'grib bcas so/
(yul) 1) gro nas sogs kyi 'bru rdog thog mar chags pa'i don/ 2) bu ga 'bigs pa/ brag gshag par rdzas mig rgyag pa/
1) phugs bsam/ mig rgyang ring ba/ 2) mthong yul gyi bar thag / rta de gnyis kyi mgyogs khyad mig rgyang gang tsam zhig 'dug /
1) phugs bsam chung ba/ 2) blta yul bar thag thung ba/
1) phugs bsam rgyang ring ba/ 2) blta yul bar thag ring ba/
mig lam du 'bab pa'am mthong snying 'dod pa/ tshong zog 'di nyo mkhan gyi mig sngar mthun pa zhig 'dug /
mig chen po byas te lta ba/ sdang mig ce re bas dgra la lta ba/ mig ce re bas bltas kyang long ba 'dra/
mig chen po byas te lta ba/
sngar spyi tshogs rnying par rdo zhwa g.yogs nas mig bcar ba'i khrims gcod byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/
1) mig lpags te spyan lcibs kyang zer/ 2) mig shel/
mig gi mchi ma/ dga' spro'i mig chu 'khor ba/ mig chu dku ba/ smre sngags 'don bzhin mig chu shor/
mchi ma mang po 'bab pa'i tshul/ sems ha cang sdug po byung skabs mig gnyis nas mig chu nyil nyil du 'bab/
mig chu lhug lhug tu 'bab tshul/
mig la mchi ma mang po 'khor tshul/ skyo snang skyes nas mig gnyis la mig chu long long du 'khor ba/
1) bug pa chen po/ 2) 'dod pa che ba'am ham pa che ba/
mig cer gyis lta ba/ sems gzhan du ma yeng bar ltad mo la mig gtod pa/
gcig la gcig lta'i mig rgyun nam mig 'gran/ mig ltos yar blta byas na rang la phan/
bya spyod ngan pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mig ltos ngan 'gran ma byed/
bya spyod bzang ngan gyi mig dpe ston pa/ lag bstar nus thon gyi nyams myong bzang po rnams mig ltos dpe ston byas nas khyab spel gtong ba/
mig srol lam mig rgyun legs po/
mig srol lam mig rgyun bzang phyogs la 'gran pa/ mi bzang don bzang la mig ltos yar 'gran byed pa/
mig rgyun bzang po 'grib nas ngan pa 'phel rkyen/ tshul min rtsing spyod mig ltos shas rkyen du 'gro rigs rtsa 'gog byed dgos/ mig stong can, (mngon) brgya byin/
dngos thog nyams myong gi sbyong rdar/ dpe deb las rnyed pa'i shes yon rnams bya ba ngo ma'i thog nas mig bltas lag sbyong byas na gzhi nas mngon sum du rtogs thub/
1) mig nad bar 'grib sel byed kyi thur ma zhig / 2) mig nad la sman 'debs byed kyi sman khyem zhig /
dngos su mthong ba/ rna thos brgya las mig mthong gcig dga'/
mig gis mthong zhing rna bar thos pa/
mngon sum gsal mthong gi dpe/ brtson 'grus byas na mkhas par 'gyur ba mig mthong gzugs grub red/
mngon sum tshad grub kyi dpe/ bzo las 'dzugs skrun ha cang mgyogs por yar thon byung ba mig mthong lag zin yin/
mngon sum du mthong zhing gsal por grub pa/ phyogs kun grub 'bras rlabs chen thob pa 'di tshang mas mig mthong gsal grub byung ba red/

nang 'jug gi nang gses te, slob ma rnams ma rig gnyis 'dzin gyis ldongs pa'i mtshon byed mig dar te gdong g.yogs bsal ba dang mnyam du ma rig pa bsal nas, rig pa ye shes lha'i ngo bo ji lta bar gsal bar bya ba'o/
lta stangs shig / chags pa'i mig mda'/ sdang ba'i mig mda'/
sngar mi'i mig 'bras phyir 'don pa'i khrims shig
mthong thos myong goms kyi dpe/ byis pa gzhon nu rnams la lugs srol gsar pa mig 'dris rnar 'jags 'og tu shugs rkyen legs po thebs 'dug /
yang yang mthong ste goms pa/ ltad mo de tsho yang yang mthong bas mig 'dris 'dug / yun ring mig 'dris su gyur nas bltas kyang mi mthong/
1) mig yod pa/ 2) (mngon) 1.mkhas pa/ 2.gza' phur bu/
mig ldan kun gyis shes gsal
mig mthong gzugs grub kyi don/ sngon thon mi sna ni mig ldan kun gyis shes gsal red/
shes bzhin ngan lam 'gro ba'i dpe/
mig 'bur tshugs su lta ba/ mtha' mtshams kyi gnas tshul la mig ldir nas lta ba/ nam mkhar mig ldir ba/
mig 'bras lta stangs 'gyur ba ste srog chags 'chi khar mig 'bras dkar nag log pa lta bu/
mig gi brda thabs/ mig brda gtong ba/
mig na ba lag pas bzos pa ste, rang sdug rang gis bzos pa'i dpe/
mig nag hril le ba lta bu lta stangs shig / dom nag gi phru gu de'i mig nag seng nge ba zhig 'dug /
mig 'bras 'gul stangs shig / byi las byi ba gang nas yong min mig nag hrig hrig byas nas lta ba/
mig nad ling thog dang sha mdzer lta bus mthong byed kyi steng nas g.yogs te mig gis mi mthong bar gyur pa zhig /
rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bcas gang red kyi skyon mthong byed dang mig shun gyi bar du zhugs nas mi mthong bar gyur pa zhig /
mig gis gzugs gsal bar mi mthong ba phyi yul du rab rib dang skra shad kyi rnam par mthong ba'i mig nad/
mig la rdo dbyug phog pa'am ling thog byung ba sogs kyis mig gi steng du 'dzer bu btab pa lta bu'i thor pa zhig /
mig sgor rtsa mi 'gyur ba'i ched mig rtsa gnon byed kyi yo byad cig /
mig gsal po/ kho rang thag ring gi yul yang gsal po mthong ba'i mig rnon po zhig red/
mig yul lam mig lam/ spyod lam ngan pa mi'i mig snang du mi 'gro ba/ dpa' bo'i ming gis dgra srog gcod, ston mo'i zas kyis mig snang rgyags/
'dod yon la ham sems che ba 'ga' zhig la ma rangs pa'i brjod tshul zhig /
mig gi lta stangs mthon po/ mig dpangs mtho la 'jon thang dman/
mig blta sa'i tshad gzhi/ mig dpe ngan pa/ mig dpe bzang po/
(yul) gzong ril gyi 'og gi bu ga tsam gyi lcags kor/
ser sna/ 'gro song gtong dgos nges rigs la mig phra po byed rgyu med/
1) mig gis so srung ba/ 2) zur mig lta ba/
mig 'brid par byed pa'i rtsed mo/ rang 'dod g.yo khram gyi spyod ngan mig 'phrul ltar bstan kyang mang tshogs kyi dbu la sgrib zhwa g.yog mi thub/
long 'khrid mkhan/ dmus long mig bu med gyur na, lam thag ring bgrod ga la thub/
mig thad kar 'bur dod pa/ mdun phyogs la mig 'bur tshugs su lta ba/
mig gis lta yul gyi gzugs/
mig nang gtong byed mig 'byed kyi yo byad cig /
mig nad bar 'grib la i khung 'bigs byed kyi yo byad cig /
1) mig nang du skyes pa'i lha thor/ 2) mig nad kyi bye brag cig /
mig mi gsal ba'am, rab rib tu gyur pa/ ltad mo che drags pas mig sbrid pa/
mig mang gi ri mo lta bu'i re'u mig /
re'u mig la brten nas rtse ba'i rtsed mo'i bye brag cig / mig mangs rtse ba/
1) mig gdangs nas mi zum pa/ rig pa bsgrims nas mig mi 'dzum pa/ 2) (mngon) 1,nya/ 2,spyan ras gzigs/ 3 lha/
(mngon) 1) nub phyogs rgyal chen/ 2) lha dbang phyug /

1) gza' mig dmar/ ming gi rnam grangs la bkra shis dang, chu stod skyes, nam mkha'i steng 'gro ba, rtsibs ldan, gzhon nu, 'od zer dgu pa, rol 'gro, lus dmar can, sa skyes, sa las byung, sa'i bu bcas so, 2) (mngon) shing byi/ 3) ma he/ 4) srin po...
1) mig gi sman/ 2) rdo sman mdung rtse smug po'i ming gzhan zhig / 3) kha dog nag po/
thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gses, bsgrubs pa'i mig sman mig la byug pas 'jig rten gyi gzugs phra rags nye ring med par mthong ba/
mig nang du mig sman 'debs byed kyi thur ma/
dmigs yul de rang la phan pa byed dgos pa'i dpe/
sngo sman zhim thig le'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
1) gzhan gyi 'byor pa la mi bzod pa'i phrag dog / sgog pa rang gis zos na kha tsha, gzhan gyis zos na mig tsha/ 2) nad sogs kyis mig dngos su tsha ba/
gzugs la lta skabs 'od 'tsher ba ltar lta mi nus: par gyur pa'i don te de la nang gses su dbye na bad rlung las gyur pa'i skam tshag dang, khrag mkhris las byung ba'i gsher tshag gnyis mchis so/
mig gi thad mtshams/ skra sil ma mig mtshams su slebs pa/
mig gi nang gi sha mdzer/
mig ya gcig gis mi mthong ba/
mig 'dzum la khad pa/ rgad po zhig mig zim mer bar snang la lta gin bsdad 'dug /
mig ma zum tsam gyi lta tshul/ nyi 'od la mig zim zim byas te lta ba/
rmig lcags la i khung 'bigs byed kyi bye brag cig
yul gang la'ang lta rtog thub pa/
1) dngos po gcig la gnyis su snang ba'i ming/ 2) tho yor/
mig dra ste spu rtsid kyis bzos pa'i mig skyob kyi yo byad cig /
mig / yul gru so so'i gnas tshul la mig ras btsa' ba/
gzhan la 'go bar byed pa'i mig nad/
mig rdog hril hril te mig 'bras/
yid du 'gro ba'am, blo la 'bab pa/ las stangs la legs bcos btang rjes mi tshang ma'i mig la 'khyug po byung song/
lta snang la 'bab pa/ mi tshang ma'i mig la rgyug pa/
1) lta snang la mdzes por mthong ba/ 2) mig ril phug pa/ rlung tshub langs nas gra ma zhig mig la zug pa/
mig gi mthong yul/ khwa ta nag po'i mig lam na, skyag pa gser gyi mchod rten red/
sdang mig / dgra bor mig log lta ba/
mig la gyon rgyu'i shel sgo/

mig gi rnam par shes pa ste, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs kyi skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i shes pa, dper na, dkar po mthong ba'i mig shes lta bu'o/
1) pho mo phan tshun bar du chags pas bslangs pa'i khong khro/ 2) phrag dog / 3) «kamal'a» mig nad cig /
mig 'khrul du 'jug pa/ yin tsam min tsam gyi thabs shes sna mang byas te dgra bo'i mig slu ba/
1) mig gis thag ring por bltas pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i gnas tshul yid du 'ong bar mig bsrings nas lta ba/ 2) phugs don la bsam blo btang ba/
dkar nag ma 'dres par gsal ba'i mig 'bras bkra po/ phru gu'i mig har po/
mig lta stangs shig / las grwa 'dzugs yul kun la mig hur rer lta ba/ khong khro bzas nas mig hur rer lta ba/
mig lta stangs shig / khrom zog gsar par mig hrig ger lta ba/
'bur tshugs su lta stangs shig / nye skor gyi: gnas tshul la mig hrig hrig gis lta ba

/ 1) 'bod byed kyi brda/ rang ming spo ba/ gzhan ming 'bod pa/ chu bo'i ming chags pa/ dpa' bo'i ming sprod pa/ sbyin bdag gi rjes su khyi ltar rgyug pas na rgyug khyi'i ming thob pa/ 2) yi ge gnyis sam, mang po gcig tu 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra, nya', sgug pa, dmar po sogs lta bu 'dod rgyal gyi ming dang, padma'i gnyen, bsil zer can sogs lta bu rjes grub kyi ming ngo/ nya'/ sgug pa/ dmar po/ ming pad ma'i gnyen/ bsil zer can/ ming gi rnam grangs la mngon par brjod pa dang, brjod ming, bla dwags bcas so, 3) go gnas/
don gyi ngo bo ston byed/
1) ming khur du len pa/ 2) gzhan ming g.yar ba/ gzhung don gyi ming khyer nas rang don sgrub/
sdom pa'i cho ga'am kun slong ma dag pa'i dge slong/

don gcig la ming 'dra ba mang nyung sna tshogs yod pa dper na, tsha zer can dang, 'od stong can, nyin byed dbang po, pad ma'i gnyen, mun pa'i dgra, nam mkha'i nor bu rnams nyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs yin, zhes pa lta bu/
don gyi ngo bo tsam ston par byed pa'i brda rnams te, ka ba dang, khang pa dang, ri dang, mi la sogs pa'o/
1) ming gcig pa'i mi/ 2) ming gi cha shas/
don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming gi 'grel bshad/
ming rnying pa gsar du brje ba/
1) grags pa ngan pa/ 2) ming 'dogs ngan pa/
1) skad grags yod pa/ mi ming can/ 2) sngo sman gyi bye brag cig mgo na ba dang so na bar phan/
thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas lhog pa dang gnyan skrangs 'joms, khrag rlung gis lus stod gzer ba la phan, dug tshad sel/
ming can me tog ser po 'char ba zhig ste, nus pa ming can nag po dang mtshungs/
sngar gyi ming de ma yin pa'i ming gsar pa zhig 'dogs pa/
'dod rgyal gyi ming dang, rjes grub kyi ming ngo, de la dngos ming dang, btags ming yang zer/

sngar ser 'bras sogs dgon sde che gras nang gi grwa pa tshor dge bshes zhes mtho rim gyi go ming gsar du btags pa'i dga' ston du dge bshes des khral ltar dge 'dun pa la drang bar bya rgyu'i 'bras thug /
ming dang thel rgya/ chings yig thog ming rtags bkod pa/
don gyi dngos po med pa'i ming rkyang/
1) ming 'dogs kyi ston mo'am mdzad sgo/ 2) mi phyugs dngos po sogs kyi ming brda ston pa/
ming bkod pa'i tho yig / tshogs 'dur bcar nas ming tho 'god pa/ slob grwa'i ming tho nas phud pa/ sman khang du ming tho 'god par 'gro/
go ming gi thob thang/ dmag thog byas rjes bzhag pas dpa' bo'i ming thob byung ba/
1) rjes 'jug / ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa...2) ming gi cha shas kyi yi ge rjes ma, ka ba dang, dmar po'i ba dang po lta bu/ ka ba...ba, dmar po...po...
ming mtha'i rjes 'jug gis rtags mtshungs kyi ming gzhi 'dren tshul dang, sgra mtshungs kyi brjod bde 'dren tshul/
bdag sgra ston byed min pa'i ming gi cha shas kyi pa dang ba/ pa...ba...lag pa/ bum pa/ kha ba/ ring ba/ pa...ba...pa ba...
don gyi ngo bo re re tsam ston pa'i ming rkyang dang, khyad gzhi khyad chos mang po sbrel nas ston pa'i brjod pa/

tha snyad dus kyi ming dang, brda dus kyi don te, gdags gzhi gang la 'dogs byed kyi ming chags pa'am grags shing grub pa'i mi ming dang, 'dogs byed kyi ming gdags par bya ba'i gzhi'o/ ming don gnyis mthun gyi dpa' po/ go gnas dang ming don mi mtshungs pa/
1) tshig don gyi 'grel pa rgyag pa/ 2) lo tsa ba bee ro tsa nas brtsams pa'i rgya bod skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod cig /
khag 'dogs mi 'dra ba mang po/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs mnga' bdag tshos ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis mi dmangs la khral gtser btang yod pa red/
ming gi tha snyad sngar med gsar du 'dogs pa/ lcags zam la ming 'dogs pa/ bu la rnam rgyal dang bu mo la g.yu sgron zer ba'i ming btags pa/
dngos po so so'i ming gi tha snyad/
'phrin bskur gyi rjes su khengs bskyungs kyis rang ming 'god tshul zhig / dge ming pas phul/ sprul ming pas phul/
pha ma gcig pa'i bu rgan gras/
go gnas 'phrog pa/ byas nyes la brten nas kho'i ming 'phrog pa/
1) dpe cha'i kha byang/ 2) ming tho/ ming byang ltar gral sgrigs shig /
yig dan gyi gsham du ming rtags bkod pa/
skad grags che ru 'gro ba/ rang 'dra'i na mnyam khrod du ming 'bur ba/
rtog pa'i nang gses, don dang ming sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dper na gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa la ka ba'o snyam du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o/
ming mang po phrad rnam dbyes sbrel te tshig bzos pa/
1) 'bod byed kyi ming brda med pa/ 2) (mngon) sor mo ming med de srin mdzub/
don dang ma 'brel ba'i ming stong/ khyim tshang gud nas sngar gyi ming tsam las gang yang mi 'dug /
ming dang tshig gnyis, don gyi ngo bo ston pa ming ste, bum pa, ka ba lta bu dang, don gyi khyad par ston pa tshig ste, ri mthon po, ngas bshad, khyod kyis nyan lta bu'o/ ming...tshig /
don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i tha snyad mtha' dag /
ming tshig mang po bkod pa'i deb/
ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi rtsar gyur pa'i yi ge ste, spyir dbyangs gsal dril ba'i yi ge sum cu so bzhi, bye brag gsal byed sum cu, yang sgos ming gzhi rkyang pa nyi shu tham pa bcas so/
sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug sogs med pa'i ming gzhi'i 'bru rkyang pa/ ka kha...
sngon rjes ming gsum gyi zlas dbye ba'i ming gzhi kho na nyi shu/ ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a...
gsal byed kyi yi ge nyis sbrel/ rka gya...

bskyed lta bu sngon 'jug ba dang, rjes 'jug da, dbyangs 'greng bu bcas 'jug sa'i ming gzhi gtso bo ka dang, phal pa sa mgo dang ya btags yin pa bzhin no/ bskyed...ba...da...'greng bu...skya...ka...sa...ya...
rjes 'jug bcu po 'jug rung du gyur pa'i gsal byed sum cu/
ming gzhi sum cu so bzhi
ming tshig rtsom pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i dbyangs gsal sum cu so bzhi/
gsal byed kyi yi ge gsum brtsegs pa/ skra rgya...
ming gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas la byed rtsol gyi shugs che ba'am grims pa rnams la zer/ ka ca ta pa tsa...
ming gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas la byed rtsol gyi shugs che chung ngam grims lhod ran pa rnams la zer/ kha cha tha pha tsha...
ming gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas la byed rtsol gyi shugs cung zad chung ba'am lhod pa rnams la zer/ ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya sha sa...
ming gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas la byed rtsol gyi shugs shin tu lhod cing zhan pa rnams la zer/ ra la ha a...
ming gzhi mo gsham gyi yi ge ra la ha'i rtsol shugs las kyang zhan pa'i a la mtshan med kyang zer/ a...
ming gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas la byed rtsol gyi shugs shin tu chung ba'am lhod pa rnams la zer/ nga nya na ma...
tshor ba, 'du shes, 'du byed, rnam shes bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po yid kyi lus so/
1) ming gi brda chad 'dra ba/ 2) ming yig gi tshig grogs/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, ming bzhi'i phung po dang gzugs kyi phung po gnyis gcig la gcig brten pa'o/

rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, rnam shes kyi dbang gis skye ba phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba na ming bzhi'i phung po dang, mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'i gzugs phung de dag phan tshun brten pa'i tshul gyis lus kun tu 'dzin par byed pa'o/
nyi mas lug khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'm ho zla gsum pa/
ming yod kyang don gyis stongs pa/ kha zhe gnyis mtshungs kyi las ka ma byas na ming yod don med cig las lag 'bras gnad smin mi yong/
kha g.yar ba'am, ming gzhan khyer ba/ spyi ming g.yar nas sger don sgrub pa/
ming po dang sring mo ste pha ma gcig pa'i spun phu bo dang nu mo/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye gnas mtshungs pa dang, tshangs par mtshungs pa'o,
1.(tha dad pa) mgrin sbubs nas pho bar mid pa/ zas skom mid pa/ sman ril khyud por mid pa/ kham du byas te mid pa/ 2.zas 'gro sa'i mid thag / mid pa 'gag pa/ mid pa tsha ba/ mid pa lta bu'i 'gro lam/
sems skyo ba sogs kyis dbugs gtong mi bde bar gyur pa/ sngar myong gi sdug bsngal dran nas mid pa 'chus pa/
(mngon) ba lang dang ra lug sogs/
mi la dang mtshungs te bod kyi rigs rus rnying pa zhig
ma yin gyi bsdus yig ste, ming gi tha mar 'jug pa'i dgag sgra zhig / yang dag pa min pa'i bsam blo/ thag gcod bde min gyis bya dka' byed gtad kyi gnas su gyar ba/ bdag gi min/ yin nam min/
ma yin nam zer ba/ skad cha za ri zi ri 'di dag khos rang gar bshad pa min grang/
yin pa 'dra zer ba/ mi 'di blo stobs chen po zhig min 'gro/
(yul) ma yin nam ma red/ rnyog dra slong mkhan ngo ma kho min da, mi gzhan pa zhig yod/
e yin/ skad cha khungs med 'di shod mkhan khyod rang min nam/
ma yin pa zhes pa'i bsdus tshig / brag ri 'di nas yar 'gro sa'i lam spo bo kho min pa sus kyang mi shes/ nga yud tsam min pa mi sdod/
ma yin pa kho na/ g.yo khram can gyis bshad pa'i skad cha de yid ches rung ba'i bden gtam min pa nyid/
min par dogs pa/ las ka 'di byed mkhan kho rang min pa 'dra/
dgag sgra min dang med ni ming gi tha ma las thog mar mi 'jug / min med...nga lha sa ba min nga la lha sa'i cha rgyus med/
e yin/ kho'i bsam 'char de nor ba zhig min las che/
min pa las log pa zhes pa min pa'i ldog zla ste, yin pa'o, dper na bum pa ma yin pa las log pa bum pa yin pa lta bu'o/
ma yin tshod/ mi 'di'i spyod lam la bltas na gshis rgyud bzang po zhig min shag red/
lha srin sde brgyad mi'i lus por sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi sar chos nyan par yong bas ming de ltar thob/
chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, sog la skya bo nas rma chu'i khug pa'i yan chad ni mdo stod mi'i chol kha/
mi'i lus la phog sla ba'i nad phal pa ste rlung dang, mkhris pa, bad kan, 'dres pa bzhi'o/
byis pa dang, gzhon nu, dar la bab pa, bar ma'am dar yol, rgan po bcas so, yang na, byis, gzhon, lang tsho, rgan, smin lnga/

su skye ba: dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig 'dzam bu'i gling pa lta bu'i rten la rgyun zhugs thob pa de mir lan gnyis skyes nas gling de nyid dam shar nub gang rung du skyes nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'o/
mi'i lus kyi gzugs yul drug
nang gi sa chu me rlung khu khrag bcas/
1) mi gzugs thung gi ming/ ming gi rnam grangs la bongs thung dang, mi thung, lus chung ba bcas so, 2) (mngon) khyab 'jug /
se, rmu, ldong, stong, dbra, 'dru ste spra nas mched pa'i bod kyi rigs drug /
mi'u gdung drug dang don gcig
(sog) brgyal gzer te, klad dkyil gyi srin bu 'khrugs nas glo bur du mgo gzer nas brgyal bar 'gyur ba'i nad cig /
sdod mkhan gyi mi med pa'i khang stong/
mi'i lag rtsal gyis bzos pa/ mis bzos 'khor skar/ mis bzos gtsang po/

/ 1) mtshams dang, mtha'/ 'di nas rgyal mtshams kyi sa mur thug pa/ mnga' khongs rgya mtsho'i mur thug bris pa/ dus rabs snga phyi'i mu/ pang leb kyi bcad kha'i mu khad mnyam pa/ 2) 'phro ma dang, zhor ma'am, ngang/ nor 'khrul byung rigs de mur bzhag na mi 'grig / rgyal kha 'thob mu nas 'bad brtson lhur len byed dgos/ las don byed mu la slob sbyong yang byed pa/
/ 1) za byed kha/ 2) snam bu'am ras kyi snam pa'i mtha'/
lcags ri'am mtha' skor/ sgor dbyibs kyi mu khyud/ 'khor lo'i mu khyud/ grong khyer gyi mu khyud,
gser gyi ri bdun gyi nang gses, ngos su dpag tshad drug brgya dang bcu gnyis yod cing ri thams cad kyi mtha' skor du yod pa'o/

1) gnya' khri btsan po dang gnam mug mug gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs gnyis pa yin la, gnam gyi khri bdun du grags pa'i gnyis pa'ang yin/ 2) khri srong lde btsan gyi sras su gyur pa'i mu khri btsan po ni, mkhas pa'i dga' ston du de'i sras che ba dang, deb dmar du de'i sras gnyis pa yin yang chung dus nas 'das zhes dang, dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs su mu ne btsan po dang 'di gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin par bshad do/
zas kyi 'tsho ba dbul ba'i dus skabs/ than pa 'gog thub par brten yun ring char pa ma bab kyang yul lung la mu ge byung med/ mu ge'i steng la zla lhag gza' ro'i sgang la rkang kyog
bza' btung med pa'i sdug bsngal/
mtha' dang nye 'gram,.. gling phran gyi mu 'gram du chu bya mang po yod/
(rnying) 1) rdzun/ 2) kha gtong ba/ 3) skad cor sgrog pa/
'bri chu'i yan lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rdza stod rdzong du yod/

(legs) rin po che'i bye brag grol ba can te nang gses su dbye na rigs drug mchis, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas klad skyon gso, rtsa dkar gyi nad sel, dug nad la phan/ so mu tig tsam yang med pa/ bya khwa ta'i kha nas mu tig med/
nya phyis kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
(yul) sngar bod kyi lcam gyi mgo rgyan zhig
mu tig star la brgyus pa/
rin chen mu tig gi rdog po/

deb ther dmar po dang mkhas pa'i dga' ston du khri srong lde btsan la sras bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa yin la, blon po zhang gi bu bsad pas byang du spyugs, phyis su mu ne btsan po 'das rjes byang nas gdan drangs te rgyal sar 'jog rtsis byas kyang, btsun mo zhang sna nam bzas chibs dkrogs te rta las lhung nas 'das zhes bshad kyang, dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs su spyugs pa de sras 'bring ba mu rug btsan po yin pa las, mu tig btsan po ni sad na legs mjing yon gyi ming yin par bshad do/
ltag tshugs te tshem bu rgyag stangs kyi bye brag cig /
sngar rgyun ltar/ de ring gi las ka'i mu ltar sang nyin yang byed dgos/
dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su mi 'dzin zhing lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas mi len pa'i chos lugs mkhan/
mu stegs pa'i lta ba ma dor bzhin du bsnyen rdzogs blangs nas phyi nang gnyis ka'i gral du 'tshang ba'o/

shakya thub pa zhal bzhud skabs kyi phyi rol pa'i slob dpon rdzogs byed dang, gnag lhas kyi bu, yang dag rgyal ba can, mi pham skra'i la ba can, ka ta'i bu nog can, gcer bu ba gnyen gyi bu ba gnyen gyi bu ste drug /
kyi mchod rten: cho 'phrul mchod rten/

mngon shes thob pa dang rtog ge la byang ba du mas rang rang gi blos dpyad nas thar pa dang mtho ris thob byed kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag dang, de sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs kyi rigs pa bkod pa'i gzhung sna tshogs brtsams pa la brten nas mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' dar bar byas/
mu tig ste rang rgyal gyi byang shar sa khul chu bo dang mtsho'i nang nas skyes pa'i rin po che'i rigs shig /
mtha'/ nam mkha'i mu mtha'/ zhing ga'i mu mtha'/ grong gi mu mtha'/
rgyun mthud dam 'phro mthud/ rgyal kha'i ngang mu mthud de mdun du skyod pa/
(rnying) mtha' dang kha mtho dman mnyam par gang ba/
rin po che'i rdo khru gang par ma ni yig drug rang byon yod pa bod rgyal lha tho tho ri'i skabs rgya gar nas bod du drangs pa nang pa'i rten rnying gi gras shig
zhing kha'i bar 'gram gyi rdo tsog gam rdo phung/

khri srong lde btsan dang tshe sbong bza' gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs so dgu pa yin la, 'dis kyang rgyal po snga ma bzhin dam pa'i chos la brtsi bkur ches cher byas, bsam yas dang lha sa dang khra 'brug tu sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa chen po bzhi btsugs, deb ther du des 'bangs kyi ltogs phyug lan gsum snyoms par mdzad ces dang, chab srid mdzad nas lo gcig dang zla ba bdun la yum gyis dug btang nas grongs zhes bshad pa 'di gnyis phan tshun 'gal mi 'gal la lo rgyus smra ba dag gi 'dod tshul tha dad pa yod do/
rgyun 'jags/ rims nad kyi mched mu 'byams su ma song ba byed dgos/
mtha' mtshams med pa/ dka' tshegs mu med ma red mu mtha' yod/ rgya mtsho'i chu rdul grangs ni mu med red/
rin po che'i rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad dang, mdze nad, chu ser, pags nad sogs la phan/

dngos po'i mtshan nyid la phyogs mi 'dra ba bzhi nas thag gcod byed lugs shig / skye 'gag rtag chad, yod med, snang stong ste mu bzhi/ mi yin la pho min pa, pho yin la mi min pa, de gnyis ka yin pa, gnyis ka min pa lta bu ste mu bzhi/

gi gtan tshigs: gtan tshigs chen po lnga'i nang gses, rgyu 'bras gnyis ka la dpyod pa mu bzhi skye ba 'gog pa'i gtan tshigs te, dngos po chos can, bden par med de, don dam par rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu gcig dang du ma yang mi bskyed, rgyu du mas 'bras bu gcig dang du ma yang mi bskyed pa'i phyir ro, zhes pa dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa'i rtags so/
1) sa 'og nas thon pa'i gter rdzas shig / 2) me spor byed/
mu zi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gdon 'joms, lhog pa 'dul/
i si lan gyi chos lugs 'dzin mkhan/
sa sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gdon nad 'joms, rnag dang chu ser skem, bse dri zhi ba dang, dngul chu'i dug 'don par byed/
sngo sman zhig pho drod skyed byed dang, so na bar phan/
mtha'/ bum pa'i mu ran/ cog tse'i mu ran/
mu tig btsan po'i mtshan gzhan zhig /

rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen gyi lho nub phyogs dang nyag chu'i yan lag li chu'i smad rgyud kyi byang 'gram na yod, 1952 lor rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing 1953 lo'i zla 4 par smi li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong du bsgyur/
(rnying) g.yo zol/ gzhan gyi mug skyos rang nyid bslu/
(rnying) g.yo sgyu/ mug skyo gyu nam chung bar bya/
1.(tha mi dad pa) 'u thug pa'am thabs zad pa/ yid mug pa/ gti mug / 2.spu rigs za ba'i srin bu sril zer ba/ gos mug / bal mug /
rim gyis ham za byed pa/ mnga' bdag nang khul du phan tshun mug za byed pa/ rgyal khab gzhan gyi mnga' khongs sa char btsan 'dzul mug za'i spyod ngan byed pa/
rtswa shing sogs phan thogs pa'i dngos po gang yang med pa'i ri/
mu ges shi ba/ gangs chen bab ste nor phyugs rnams mug shi thebs pa/
dbyar dus snam phying sogs la srog chags mug ma zhugs pa seng ba/
sangs rgyas mi 'byon pa'i bskal pa/
1) mun pa'i khung bu/ 2) mun nag / 'og khang mun khung gi nang du sgron me zhig spar ba/
1) nyi 'od kyis mi khyab pa'i sa cha/ 2) chos lugs pas bshad pa'i chos mi dar ba'i gling/
1) glo mig bad kan gyis 'gags nas lud pa mang zhing dbugs mi bde ba zhig / 2) sgra gcan gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
mun pas mgo 'thoms pa'am, mi gsal bar gyur pa/ blang dor gyi bya gzhag la blo rmongs mun 'thoms su gyur pa/
mun pa'i nang tshod lta'i ched du 'phangs pa'i rdo/ brag phug la mun rdo gcig 'phangs nas sbubs lam ring thung gi tshod lta ba/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi me tog rdzong khongs su yod/
dmigs yul mi mthong bar bya ba sgrub pa'i dpe/

nag khung du lag pa yul yul byas te dngos po 'tshol ba ltar cha med rgyus med kyi las ka rnams tshod dpag gis byed pa'i dpe/ thon skyed kyi las 'gan gsar pa rnams tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig byed dgos pa las mun nag sbar nyul ltar byed mi rung/

gzugs mi snang bar byed pa'i kha dog nag po, dper na mtshan mo lta bu nang na yod pa'i gzugs mig la snang mi thub pa'o/ mun pa sel bar sgron me dgos/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun khebs dang, khebs pa, mkha'i pags pa, sgrib pa, nyin mthar byed, nyin mo'i sgo nga, 'thibs pa, ldong byed, snang med, mi mngon pa, mi snang ba, mi gsal ba, mun 'khrigs, mun nag smag rum, mtshan mo'i gos, rab rib, she mun bcas so,
dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nang gses/
mun pa shin tu nag pa:/ mun pa mun nag gi dus skabs dang bstun te dgra bor mtshan 'thab byed pa/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
snang ba'i ldog phyogs/ srang lam mun po/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs mun po/
(rnying) blun gtam smra ba'i ngag / bla brdol dang mun sprul bsres nas gang byung du bshad pa/
sa rub pa'am mun pa 'thibs pa/
(rgya) sa zhing che chung gi tshad/
1) kha'i 'gram pa/ 2) ya khung yang zer te mur 'gram gyi gong du yod pa'i gshong bu/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
(tha dad pa) so ma brgyab par bca' ba/ phyur skam mur ba/ rus pa mur ba/ bye ril mur ba/
(yul) 1) rta drel gyi ya mchu'i sha ril mo/ 2) khas ldad rgyag tshul/
(yul) khu tshur ram mdzog mgo/ zla gam nang gi mur mdzog phu thung nang gi lag shed/
dga' ba dang, sgeg nyams kyi gad mo chung chung dgod pa'i rnam pa/ bzhin ras 'dzum mul mul/
rgyun/ las ka byas dang byed bzhin pa'i mus mthud nas byed dgos/
sa cha'i ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ngam ring rdzong gi byang shar rgyud du yod/

/ 1) 'bar byed dam 'byung ba chen po me/ gser sa le sbram me la mi skrag / me 'bar ba'i sgang la shing bshags pa/ mes 'tshig mer gtugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khyog 'bar dang, chu yi skye gnas, dag byed, du ba'i tog ldan, nor las rgyal, bi shwa na ra'i bu, 'bar ba'i lce ldan, 'bar byed, sbyin sreg lag pa, gtsug phud can, gtsang byed, rtse mo can, 'od kyi shing rta, rlung gi grogs po, lam nag zhugs, lus ma bsrung, shing las 'phel bcas so, 2) (mngon) 1. 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi rta gdong me dang, khyim gyi nyi ma dang, bsreg bya za ba'i me ste me gsum yod pas grangs gsum mtshon/ 3. 2. (mngon) me 'brug lo/
shing bu'am lcags rigs las bzos pa'i khyem: bu
1) me stag / 2) me khams kyi skar ma/
bra nye dang, rgyal, smin drug mchu, gre, khrums stod, sa ga rnams so/
me'i gnod 'tshe/ sdod khang la me skyon shor ba/
1) tsha zhing sreg pa'i rang bzhin can/ 2) khams lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
me lcags me rdo spra ba bcas blug snod/
thab dang me phor khog ltir sogs kyi steng du g.yog byed cig /
'bu'i bye brag cig / ming gi rnam grangs la skar skyod dang, mkha' snang ngo,

shing sprel lo ste, spyi lo 624 lor rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khrir 'khod pa dang, kla klo zhugs pa dus mnyam, de nas brtsams te rigs ldan rgyal dka'i lo mtha' spyi lo 1026 ste me stag lo'i bar du lo ngo bzhi brgya dang gsum song ba de la rgyud las me mkha' rgya mtshor grags, de'i phyi lor rab byung dang po'i 'go bzung bas, de dang rab byung lo grangs bsres pa ni kla klo'i gnas tshad kyi lo grangs brtag ched yin/
1) lcags lam thog gtong ba'i 'khor lo/ 2) mchod me'i steng du btsugs pi' ma ni'i 'khor lo rang 'gul can/
dud pa dang thal ba nyung ba'i me/
nag rtsis lugs lcags kyis me gso bas me'i grogs lcags kyis yin pa'i bshad tshul/
nag rtsis ltar chus me gsod pas me'i dgra chu'o/
me shugs la brten nas 'phen pa'i sgyogs/ dgra phyogs kyi mkhar rdzong la gtad nas me sgyogs brgyab pa/
1) sgron me'am mar me/ 2) (yul) me sbar ba/
me'i nus shugs sam me dbal/
me rdo dang spra ba sbyar te me sbor byed kyi yo byad cig /

lhab lhab tu 'bar ba'i me/ khong khro'i me lce/ gsar brje'i me lce/ mi mang 'dus na bkod thabs mang, shing bshags mang na me lce mtho/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khyug byed pa dang, 'bar ba'i ro 'dzin, 'od bkra'i yan lag bcas so,
(yul) lus kyi sha pags la rma dang thor 'brum thon pa'i gnyan nad cig /
me lcags dang me rdo, mu zi bcas so/
ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
bad kan rigs drug gi nang gses shig /
me'i gnod pa sngon tshud nas 'gog thabs/ me ma shor gong nas me nyen sngon 'gog gi thabs shes byed pa/
mnyam gnas kyi rlung dang don gcig
lhen sna'i 'og tu tshon gsum gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i pho ba'i me gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na pho ba'i me drod nyams pa la phan/
1) lcags bsregs te rta sogs la rtags rgyag byed cig / 2) grib rlung dang, mig gi 'grib gsang 'gog byed dang, gnyan rims kyi rtsa rgyus nang la rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig

1) me tog spyi'i ming/ me tog 'dab ma gtor nas sku mgron la phebs bsu zhu ba/ slob sbyong dus su g.yeng ba de, me tog sad kyis khyer dang 'dra/ me tog dri bsung 'thul na, bung ba las kyis 'khor/ ming gi rnam grangs la pashtha? dang, yid dga'o, 2) gcin pa'i wu ba/ 3) (mngon) bud med kyi zla mtshan/ 4) rdzong zhig sngar padma bkod ces zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar lho'i ngos dang yar klungs gtsang po'i smad rgyud du yod/
me tog ka ra bi ra
shog bu bzo rgyu'i sngo re lcag pa'i me tog /
rgyas pas zhus pa: shloo ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, pradzny'a warma dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
1) me tog gcal du bkram pa/ phebs lam du phebs bsu'i me tog bkram pa/ 2) brgyad stong pa'i le'u zhig
sngar lha ldan smon lam gyi dus su mi dmangs kyi khyim du me tog nyar 'thus tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
sngo sman me tog gi rigs ldum rar 'dzugs pa'i me tog dmar po sa bon lo re bzhin 'debs dgos pa de la zer te, nus pas me dbal dang, gnyan nad la phan/
ri mthon por skyes pa'i sngo sman zhig ro skyur la mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas lud pa gog pa dang, ro tsa rgyas pa, khrag gso ba, bu snod la drod 'khor ba bcas la phan/
sngo sman gyi rigs me tog glang chen gyi sna lta bu zhig ste, ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes drod, nus pas dmu chus dri chu 'gags pa dang, dbugs hal ba dang, chu ser gyi nad sogs la phan/
ri bo zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gung ho rdzong du yod cing mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las smi lnga stong lhag tsam yod/
(mngon) 1) bung ba/ 2) bud med zla mtshan can/ 3) sa ga zla ba/ 4) skra/
dka' thub kyi zas te chos pas me tog rnams kyi bcud blangs te ril bu bzos pa dka' thub byed skabs kyi zas shig /
1) char thigs pad ma'i 'dab ma ltar lhung ba me tog gi gzugs su bkod pa/ 2) lha'i me tog dngos su bab pa'i sngon byung gi dpe/

dang mkhas brgya 'gran gleng: sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas dang, tshan rig yar rgyas, spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas dar rgyas bcas yong ba'i ched du 1956 lor krung go'i gung khran tang gis bton pa'i byed phyod shig ste, tang gi gcig gyur 'go khrid 'og spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun la phan thogs dang, gung khran tang gi 'go khrid sra brtan yong bar phan thogs yod na rig rtsal thog rnam pa dang tshul lud mi 'dra ba rnams rang dbang gis 'phel rgyas btang chog cing, tshan rig thog grub mtha' mi 'dra ba rnams rang dbang gi sgo nas rtsod gleng byas chog pa de'o/
nang 'jug gi nang gses te, slob ma rnams kyis rang gi rigs kyi lha las 'brel gang la phog pa de dag la bab pa'i rten 'brel du phyag rten gyi me tog dor ba'o/
1) me tog gi ze'u 'brur chags pa'i thal ba/ 2) bud med kyi zla mtshan...
(mngon) 1) bud med zla mtshan ldan ma/ 2) zla ba gzas bzung ba/
(mngon) 1) dpyid ka/ 2) nyi zla gza' yis bzung ba/
me tog ldan pa'i zla ba
me tog gi chun po'am tshom bu/
me tog ci rigs brgyus pa'i star/
1) me tog 'phreng ba star brgyus kyi rgyan/ 2) 'dul ba'i gzhung zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims tshad kyi 'khru ba gcod, phyir byugs na rma dang, shig nad bcas la phan/

sngo sman gyi me tog cig ste, me tog gi nus pas tshad pa sel, khrag rgyun gcod, gtso bor dmar bshal la phan, son gyi nus pas mchin tshad mig tshad sel, gtso bor mig dmar zhing skrang ba dang mig grib la phan/
me tog gi ze'u 'brur chags pa'i rtsi/
phung por spungs pa'i me tog /
phyi 'jug gi nang gses, rig lnga'i sa bon las skyes pa'i mtshon byed du me tog kha dog lnga pa rigs lnga'i yig 'brus mtshan pa re slob ma rnams kyis gzung ba'o/
sngo sman me tog gi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims tshad dang, dug tshad sel, bcud len par byed/
ldum rar 'dzugs pa'i gur gum ste, nus pas rma gso, rtsa chad pa mthud, khrag shor gcod/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rus chag sbyor, rma gso, rtsa chad pa mthud,..
sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pas na me lta bu'o/

1) me'i tsha tsha/ me stag gis spang ljongs sreg thub/ me stag chung dus ma bsad na, nags ri me la shor nyen yod/ ming gi rnam grangs la mkha' skyes dang, me'i zegs ma, zhugs kyi dum 'phrug rab 'phro bcas so, 2) (mngon) me pho stag lo/
mer bsregs na zhig mi 'gro ba/ me thub so phag
spra ba las byas pa'i me btsa' dang, zangs lcags sogs las bzos pa'i thur ma dang gnyis so/
lcags mer bsregs te rta drel la rtags rgyag byed ri mo gang rung yod pa zhig /
mer bsro ba'i sman dpyad cig ste sman rdzas kyis thum hril bzos pa mer bsros nas sman bcos byed thabs shig /
me mang po yod pa'i dong/
1) mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi stobs las byung ba'i me khams kyi drod gtso bo dang, de'i cha shas lus zungs kun la yod pa'i me drod bcas kyi spyi ming/ 2) tsha drod dam me dbal/
pho ba'i nang du zas skom myag bzhu sbyong ba sogs me dang mthun pa'i drod kyi las byed pa po gsum ste, bad kan myag byed dang, mkhris pa 'ju byed, rlung me mnyam bcas so/
me rdzas kyis 'phen mda' 'am, 'phrul mda'/ lag yod me mda' dam por 'dzin/ gzab gzab ma byas pas me mda' kha shor ba/
(yul) me mda'i kha mtshams su sbrags pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi ru/
ngar lcags dang 'thabs na me mched pa'i rdo/
(legs) lha'i bu mo'am lha'i gar mkhan ma/
mu stegs pa'i bye brag cig me la lhar 'dzin pa dang, sbyin sreg la brtson pa dang, cha lugs ral pa ring po can zhig dang, lta ba ni las rgyu 'bras khas len pa zhig bcas so/
sngar me 'bar ba'i mdog dbyibs kyi rtags sam mtshan ltas la bltas nas shis min ji yong brjod pa'i mo 'debs stangs shig
me chen po 'bar thub pa'i ched du rlung rgyun skul ba lta bu ste bsam nag gis zing cha lang du 'jug pa'i dpe/ mi ngan gyis gzhan la me spar rlung skul gyis zing cha slong ba/
'byung khams lnga po re rer pho mo gnyis gnyis su phye ba'i ya gyal zhig /
me dang ja blug sa'i rdza snod/
'byung ba ma bu dgra grogs brtsi bya'i bye brag cig

1) me tog 'dzugs sa'i bum pa/ 2) rlung khrag 'khrugs nas lus stod gzer ba dang, phyi skran sogs la sbyar ba'i zangs kyi bum pa 'khyud 'khor sor bco brgyad dang, srid du sor bcu gnyis, kha zlum po sor bzhi yod pa'i dpyad kyi cha byad cig
1) me'i drod/ 2) me yi tsha ngar gyis 'tshig pa ltar gyi thor pa 'byung ba'i nad cig ste, lhan skyes rma'i nang tshan gyi me dbal dang, gnyan rigs bco brgyad kyi nang tshan me dbal/
mi zhig khong khro langs pa'i thog la slar yang khong khro slong byed kyi skad cha bshad pa lta bu'i dpe/
1) me gtong ba/ 2) me rlung gis skul ba/ kha yis me 'bud, rkan nang chu gsog /
me min thal min te me phye 'dres pa'i tshan/
1) me mdag yod pa'i dong/ 2) dmyal gnas shig /
nag rtsis las byung ba shing gi me shing las byung bas shing me'i ma ru bshad pa/
me ma mur ram me mdag /
/ 1) 'byung khams lnga po re rer pho mo gnyis gnyis su phye ba'i ya gyal zhig / 2) sgog pa'i bye brag cig / 3) (rnying) sgye snod chung ngu/

me yos lo ste, dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud chen rgya gar skad las bod skad du thog mar 'gyur ba'i lo dus de nyid la rab byung dang po zhes grags shing, de nas bzung lo 'khor drug cu re la rab byung re rtsi ba'i srol dar ba las, de yan chad du rab byung gi lo tshigs rtsi srol med/ rab byung...rab byung...
1) mi'i lus la me btsa' bzhag nas bcos chog pa'i gsang dmigs te, rgyab kyi sgal tshigs nyi shu dang, mtshog gsang, spyi gtsug sdud sgo sogs so/ 2) sngags kyi gtum mo'i dmigs rim/
spra ba ril mor dril nas nad dmigs steng du bzhag ste me sbar ba lta bu dang, tel pa mer bsregs nas nad dmigs steng brdeg pa lta bu'o/ nad la me btsa' bzhag ste bcos pa/
shel dkar me long: dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i me btsa'i skor gsal bar ston pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos le tshan zhig /
me'i rigs la brten pa'i rtsed mo spyi/
1) me stag / btsa' brgyab pa'i lcags mer bsregs te tho bas rdung dus me tshag 'thor ba/ 2) me stag gi tshag sgra/
