lcags sreg sogs lus la gtug pa'i nad bcos/ rkang lag gi tshigs na nas me tshugs rgyag pa/
1) rdza las bzos pa'i me blug snod/ 2) me tog btsugs pa'i rdza ma'i snod/
me phor gyi bye brag cig /
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la rig byed dang, bya ma 'don no,
me'i 'od mdangs/ sbrang bu me 'od du mi chags/
me mang po yod pa'i dong/ me 'obs su mchongs nas gzhan srog skyob pa
thab kyi me dkrug byed kyi shing
rang bzhin gyis me 'bar ba'i ri/
lus kyi 'byung ba me khams shas cher las bskyed pa'i rus pa mdog dmar zhing rtsub pa zhig /

1) me phal cher shi ba'i me ma thal/ thab kyi me ro shing bu bus te gso ba/ 2) sngar lugs rnying pa'i shul/ rtsod gleng gi me ro rtsa ba nas bsad pa/ lam lugs rnying pa'i me ro bskyar du 'bar mi 'jug /
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
(rnying) me la bstan pa'am, sro ba/
me la reg pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dus byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang, na ba'i dbang gis ma yin par rgod bag gis me la reg pa'o/

rma 'bras dang, lhog pa, glo bur skrangs po 'ga' zhig byung ba sogs rma 'bras che ba la i khung bzhi gar rgyag rgyu dang, rma 'bras chung bar gcig gam gnyis sogs rma che chung la dpags te sreg byed kyi yo byad cig /

1) gzugs brnyan gsal byed/ me long la lta ba/ me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan, shel sgo'i nang gi mog mog / ming gi rnam grangs la kun mthong dang, kun gsal, byi dor mel tshe, ma ku ra, gzugs 'char byed, gzugs brnyan skye gnas, bzhin snod bcas so, 2) gyang gi sham bu dang sked ris bar gyi stong cha/ 3) mthongs sam dkyil gzhung/ thang ga'i me long/ stod 'gag gi me long/ cha sgam gyi me long/ sgo'i me long/
mgo bo'i rma'i mtha' skor 'dra byed kyi skra gri zhig /
sngar me shing dbor 'dren gyi 'u lag skul rgyug byed pa'i khral zhig /
me 'byung ba'i shel te 'od 'dus nas me 'bar byed kyi shel zhig /
me rgyun bskyar du gso ba dang ngar che ru gtong ba/ rlung thab kyi me 'chi grabs byed dus 'phral la me sangs rgyag pa/
1) me gtsub byed kyi shing/ 2) tsan dan dkar po/
me phor ram me snod sla nga/
bskal pa'i me dang, khyim gyi me dang, lho yi me bcas so/
1) me med par bzo ba/ 2) me skyon shor bar sel thabs byed pa/
me'i dud pa gtul ba'i bsangs mchod/

1) shar lho'i phyogs skyong/ ming gi rnam grangs la mchod sbyin skyes dang, rta dmar can, nor las skyes, sna tshogs 'od zer, byin za, 'bar ba'i sgra can, sbyin sreg za, tshangs dbang sras po, 'od kyi nor can, 'od bdun pa, ra la zhon, rig byed skyes, sreg za, gser khu ba, gser gyi thig le bcas so, 2) thab la gnas pa'i lha/
'byung bzhi'i khams kyis lhog pa rigs bzhir dbye ba'i nang tshan me khams shas che ba'i lhog pa ste, nad rtags su drod che zhing me lce 'dra ba'i ri mo 'byung ba zhig /
med dgag dgag pa'i nang gses
rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blo'am rang brjod pa'i sgras rang gi dgag bya dngos su bcad tsam gyis rtogs par bya ba ste, gang zag gi bdag med lta bu, bdag bkag pa'i shul du don gzhan mi 'phen pa'o/
sel ba'i nang gses, rang gi dgag bya bcad tsam gyi sgo nas rang gi bsal bya rigs mi mthun bsal ba, dper na ri med ces pas yod pa bsal ba lta bu'o/
med par rtogs pa'i tshad ma ste, med pa la med par nges pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/
ba'i 'brel ba: snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma yong thabs med pa'i dngos po'i 'byung tshul/

/ 1) yod pa ma yin pa ste ming gi tha mar 'jug pa'i dgag sgra zhig / go skabs med pa/ mthun rkyen med du mi rung ba/ skyon cha med bzhin du yod par 'dzin pa/ rgyu med rkyen med/ 2) yod pa'i ldog zla ste, tshad mas ma dmigs pa'am shes bya la mi srid pa ri bong gi rwa dang, nam mkha'i padma lta bu'o/
yul don du med pa'am gzhi ma grub bzhin du 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus bslad pa'i dbang shes la gsal bar snang ba, dper na zla gcig zla gnyis su snang ba lta bu rtog med log shes so/

jo nang pa'i gsung sgros su, nam mkha' la sogs pa dngos med thams cad dang, rnam rtog la shar ba'i gzugs sogs yul gyi snang cha rnams dang, ming la don du zhen pa dang, don la ming du 'khrul ba'i ming don gyi 'brel ba dang, phyi nang mtha' dbus, che chung bzang ngan phyogs dus sogs blos sgro btags kyis gzung bya thams cad ni kun brtags yin pas kun rdzob tu'ang med pa med pa'i stong nyid do/
1) med par bzo ba/ lugs ngan med par byed pa/ rmongs dad med par byed pa/ 2) med par khas len pa/
mar me dang sbyin sreg sogs/
mes 'tshig pa'i 'jigs skrag / me skyon shor ma thag tu gsod thub na me'i 'jigs pa cher mi yong/
me btang ba'i shul du lus pa'i thal ba/
me stag / me'i tsha tsha kun tu 'phro ba/
dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig
so khri btsan po dang dog mer mer gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs lnga pa yin la, gnam gyi khri bdun du grags pa'i lnga pa'ang yin no/

mer gnas kyi de nyid ces bya ba bya rgyud du bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid kyi nang gses shig ste, rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar me 'bar ba'i dbus su zla ba la sngags phreng bkod de srog bsdom pa'i sbyor bas bsgom pa mer gnas te las bzhi 'grub pa'i gzhi'o/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) ltem gyis gang ba/ dbyar dus mtsho mer ba/ snod mer ba/ 2) ldang ba/ skyugs pa mer ba/ sgregs pa mer ba/ zhe mer ba/ 2. sla ba dang mnyen pa'am 'bol ba/ zho mer ba/ 'bras thug mer ba/ mog mog mer ba/ sha tshil mer ba/

1) mig tu snang tshul zhig / thag ring nas chu mer mer rgyugs 'gro ba zhig mthong/ 2) nem nem byed pa'i rigs/ sngas 'bol mer mer zhig la mgo bo rten pa/ 3) 'gul stangs shig / sa yom rgyag dus khang pa mer mer byed pa/
(arbudama) phru gu mngal du chags pa'i gnas skabs dang po'i ming/

1) 'gul 'khyoms kyi rnam 'gyur zhig / rgya: mtsho'i chu rlabs g.yos nas mer mer shig shig byed pa/ 'bar mdel g.yugs dus sa cha mer mer shig shig tu 'gul ba/ 2) srog chags mang po 'dus pa'i 'gul stangs/ sha rul nang du sha 'bu mang po mer mer shig shig byed pa/
sib bu'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
1) mtshan dus so lta/ phru gur mel tshe byed pa/ sa mtshams srung mkhan 'thab 'dzing pas mtshan mor yang mel tshe byed pa/ nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe byed/ 2) mtshan mo'i thun tshod/

mtshan dus kyi bya ra mkhan nam, rtog zhib pa/ sa der lhags pa na phyogs de'i dpung gi mel tshe ba dag gis rtogs pa/ khos mel tshe ba so sor mi rtog par ma nyal zhes zer bzhin du chom po rnams kyis bcom mo/
rang gi rgyal khab/ dogs zon che bskyed kyis mes rgyal srung skyob byed/
mes tshig ste med par 'gyur ba/
bsam gtan gnyis pa, bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad snod kyi 'jig rten de mes 'jig pa'i skabs su rtsa med du 'gro zhing, de yan chad la me'i 'jig pa mi yong bas mes 'jig pa'i rtse mo zer/
dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud dang, bshad rgyud, phyi ma rgyud kyi chu mdo yan gyi 'grel pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos tshad ma zhig /
srong btsan sgam po dang, khri srong lde'u btsan, khri gtsug lde btsan te gsum/
mes bsregs te byung ba'i rma/
sngar mes po'i dus nas brten pa'i lha/
sngar bod rgyal so bdun pa khri lde gtsug brtan gyi ming, sma ra dang bgres nyams che bas de ltar grags so/

1. 1) phywa/ mo rgyag mkhan gyis mo ma btab gong du bden pa bdar khul gyis mi la mgo skor gtong ba/ mo mkhan gyis mo phywa bzang 'tshub sna tshogs bshad pa nas rdzun gtam bzo ba/ 2) mo mtshon par byed pa'i bdag sgra zhig / gnas mo/ bya mo/ 2. ma mthar sbyar rgyu slar bsdu'i phrad cig / ma/ bden pa gnyis ni kun rdzob dang don dam mo/ 3.ming mthar 'jug pa'i ming gi cha shas shig / dus yun ring mo/ slob grwa chen mo/ ltad mo/ nub mo/
1) khyim thab med pa'i mo hreng/ 2) ri dwags rkyang mo/
(yul) zur mang yod pa'i gzer gdan/
mna' ma'i phyogs dang a ma'i phyogs kyi gnyen tshan/
gang zag mo yin pa'i rtags mtshan/
mo phywa'i mngon shes rnon po/
1) bud med kyi dor ma/ 2) (yul) bud med kyi smad g.yogs/
rdo la pho mo'i dbye ba yod cing, mo rdo yis rtsigs pa brtsigs na brtan che zer/
mo ldum sha la yu ring
thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha zhing tsha la mngar ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma gso, rus chag sbyor/

mngal dang, nu ma sogs las byung ba'i bud med kho nar 'byung ba'i nad de nang gses su dbye na, mngal nad lnga dang, rtsa nad bcu drug skran nad dgu , srin bu'i nad rigs gnyis, phal pa'i nad brgyad bcas bzhi bcu tham pa mchis so/
mo nad kyi rigs shig ste, nad rtags su skom dad che zhing, glo lu ba dang, sha pags ser por 'gyur ba zhig
khams dkar 'byams pa dang, mngal gyi srin bu khros pa lta bu mo nad kha thor/
phru gu btsas rjes mkhris tshad skyes pa'i mo nad de, nad rtags su ro stod du gzer phran 'pho zhing lud pa dmar po 'byung ba zhig /

bud med kyi mtshan ma'i nad dang, sha ma ma thon pa, phru gu btsa' ma thub pa, phru gu mgo 'jug log pa, bu snod lug pa, mngal khrag ma chod pa, phru gu btsas rjes kyi nad gzhug lus pa, phru gu btsas rjes dug thabs byed pa bcas so/
bu btsas rjes rtsa 'grams nas skran du gyur te sha rus khol nas na ba'i mo nad cig /
rgyu zhabs gzer zhing zla mtshan 'o kha 'am chu dang 'dra ba 'byung ba'i mo nad kyi rigs shig /

mo nad rnying pa ste, nang gses su dbye na mgo bo'i rlung tshabs, rus pa'i rlung tshabs, snying gi rlung tshabs, pho ba'i rlung tshabs, mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs, rgyu ma'i rlung tshabs bcas rigs drug mchis so/
mo nad srin bu khros pa
mngal gyi srin bu rigs gnyis kyi nang nas a so ka zhes pa'i srin bu khros pa las byung ba'i mo nad kyi rigs shig /
'bri dang, mdzo mo, ba sogs bzhon ma byas chog pa'i sems can gyi rigs/
mo phywa dang, bon lugs kyi gto bcos klog 'don/
dbang po'i bya ba nyams pa'i mo rigs/
rjes 'jug gi mo yig nga ma gnyis la yang 'jug zhugs pa ni sgra zhan pa'i drag par 'gyur bas mo tsam mo/ sa...nga...ma...gangs khams/
mkhris pa'i rang bzhin gyis bskyed pa'i nad med kyi rgyun rtsa'i 'phar tshul zhig ste, 'phar rtsa'i rgyud phra la myur bar 'phar ba zhig /
mo dang rtsis kyi bsdus ming/

mo rigs kyi rtags sam mtshan ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye gnas dang, skye 'dzin, mkha' nang, dga' ba'i bu ga , chu ma, chos 'byung, brjod bya'i phyogs, nyer gnas, gnyis dga'i khyim, dran pa'i khron pa, rdul gyi lam, pad ma, bu gnas grong khyer, byed pa'i yan lag me tog lam, mo rtags, mo'i rang bzhin, myos byed, rmongs par byed, mtshams min rten, lam mi za, srid pa byed, srid pa'i lam, gsang ba'i 'khor lo, i gsang bcas so,
tshwa mtsho gnyis kyi spyi ming, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ngam ring rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
bod kyi bud med kyi lham mthil nyis brtsegs yod pa'i zom pa/
1) bdag med kyi bud med hrang hrang/ 2) (yul) khang pa glas te sdod pa'i dud tshang/

1) ngag thog nas yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas kyi rtsol shugs ma ning yi ge'i rtsol shugs las cung zad chung ba'am lhod pa yin pa'i yi ge rnams/ 1, dbyangs yig bzhi/ i u e o...2, ming gzhi'i mo yig / ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya sha sa...3, sngon 'jug gi mo yig / 'a...2) mo 'debs byed kyi dpe cha/
1) bud med chig rkyang/ 2) (yul) bud med de nyid kho na/
rigs rgyud chad pa'i bud med/
pho mo gnyis su phye ba'i mo rigs/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lhun rtse rdzong gi shar rgyud du yod/
(yul) 1) sgrog lung/ 2) mo phywa dang lung bstan/
lo khams mo la 'khel ba'i lo/ shing mo lug / lcags mo glang/ chu mo sbrul/
yos, sbrul, lug bya, phag rnams so/
shing rigs la pho mo gnyis su dbye ba'i mo shing/
shel rigs pho mo gnyis su dbye ba'i mo shel/
phru gu mi skye ba'i bud med rabs chad ma/
ngag thog nas yi ge rjod skabs so so'i skye gnas kyi rtsol shugs shin tu zhan la lhod pa yin pa'i yi ge rnams/ ra la ha a...
(yul) bud med gcig pu kher rkyang/
1) 'go ba'i lha lnga'i ya gyal zhig / 2) mo phywa ston pa'i lha/ 3) lha mo rigs/

skyong ljongs khongs mtsho sna rdzong gi sa: cha zhig ste sngar mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i gtam rgyud du gnas yul der bdud mos rgyal po'i bu dang bu mo gnyis bzung nas g.yang rong du bskyur sa'i brag ri sogs yod skad/
mog mog rlangs btsos rgyag snod/
(rgya) rlangs btsos byas pa'i kha zas
mdangs bkrag dang 'od nyams pa/ nyi 'od 'khris su zhu mar mog mog por snang ba/ gos gsar dri ma phog na mog mog 'gyur/ me long rdul gyis bsgribs nas mog mog por byed pa/
rta'i spu mdog gi bye brag cig /
1) rta'i spu mdog gi bye brag / 2) (rgya) bza' bya'i mog ro/
chu 'dam dang na ba'i nang nas skyes pa'i mog ro dang cung 'dra ba'i bza' bya zhig /
(yul) khog ltir gyi mchu bzo byed lag cha shing dum zhig /

'di ni srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo, stod lung mong nas zhang blon gyi bu mo mong bza' khri lcam zhes bya ba de yin zhing, 'di la gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs, yum sras gnyis kyi rten skal du dpal gyi yer pa'i lha khang bzhengs so/
sngar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo zhig gi ming/

1. 'phral dang, de ma thag pa'i dus/ kho rang mod du shog zer rogs/ tshogs 'du grol mod du las grwa tshugs yul la phyin pa/ 2. mi mthun pa'i don la 'jug pa'i phrad cig / yin mod/ yod mod/ go skabs byung mod kyi/ khyod kyis bshad pa'i gnas tshul phal cher bden mod kyi da dung brtag dpyad cig byed dgos/ 3. mang po'am 'bel po/
'bel 'bel lhug lhug / 'tsho mkho'i yo byad mod chil le ba/
dngos zog 'bel skabs tshur nyo zhing dkon skabs phar 'tshong ba/ mgo bde glags tshong rgyag mkhan gyis mod nyo dkon 'tshong byas nas bar khe za mkhas po 'dug /
cha snyoms pa'am khod snyoms pa/ sa gnas khag gi 'tsho mkho'i rgyu dngos mod snyoms byed pa/
'bel po/ zas gos mthun rkyen mod po/ nyo cha mod po/
(rnying) 1) dpangs mtho ba/ 2) phra mo ma yin pa/
mon yul nas thon pa'i ras yug /
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la sgrog smad dang, chu'i lha mo, thos mchog nam mthong 'og sha ta bhi sha bcas so,
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la sgrog stod dang, thob ldan ma, dha ni shtha, nam mthong bcas so,

1) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas 'khru ba tsha grang med par gcod/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khru gcod dang, 'gram gcod, bha re ram, mo ra tsa li, shalma li bcas so, 2) mon yul du skyes pa'i shing cha ra/
1) rtsa shun gyi ras/ 2) srin bal gyi gos/
«kosha» rtsa shun dang srin bal gyi gos/
bal sogs do po gcig gi ljid tshad, ha lam rgya ma brgyad cu yod/
sngo sman zhig mchin nad dang mig nad la phan/

rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs shig yin pa gtso che'i rug sdod sa khul mon yul dang, de'i nye 'dabs kyi sa khul bcas yin zhing, zhing las gtso bor byed pa'i zhor du ri dwags rngon pa dang, lag rtsal bzo las phran bu'ang byed kyi yod, mon pa'i skad logs su yod kyang, bod kyi skad yig yongs su dar zhing, bod kyi sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan zhig yin/
pha yul brlags pa'i mon gyi phru gu ste don gang dang gang gi khungs lung mi shes pa'i dpe/
spang ram dang mtshungs te sngo sman zhig /

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho kha sa khul khongs mtsho sna rdzong gi sa cha zhig ste, dus rabs bcu bdun par bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sa khul de dbang sgyur byed 'go tshugs, de khul sngar t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho 'khrungs yul o rgyan gling zhes grags pa de yang yul der yod/

lding sum cu so gnyis: sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs, mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul gyi tsho'am lding ste, legs po tsho bzhi, spang chen lding drug dwags pa tsho brgyad, la 'og yul gsum, sbrang nang tsho drug rong nang tsho bzhi, sha 'ug hro byang dwags bcas so gnyis/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5316 yod/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska la mngar, nus pa bsil, skad 'gags pa dang, glo ba la tsha ba zhugs pa, rgyu tshad kyis bshal ba gcod/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkyal 'gro dang, rkyal byed, 'khyog gar, bcu gang, chu skyes, chu sgra can, chu gnas, chu byung, nya ba'i gla sgang, nyer skyong, 'tsho ming can, yongs 'thor, sa'i gla sgang bcas so,
mon yul nas thon pa'i shog bu
mon yul nas thon pa'i 'bru rigs shig /
mon yul nas thon pa'i 'bru'i bye brag dkar po zhig /
mon yul nas thon pa'i sran ma'i bye brag cig
mon yul nas thon pa'i sran ma'i bye brag cig
mon yul nas thon pa'i sran ma'i bye brag cig
mon yul nas thon pa'i sle'u'am phyar ba/
«moonggaly'ana:» shakya thub pa'i nyan thos nye 'khor bcu'i gras shig dang mchog zung gi ya gyal, rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog go/
las ka byed lugs kyi bkod khyab zhib tu byed pa/ tang gi srid jus mi dmangs la mol khyab zhib nan gyis dril bsgrags byed dgos/
'phros mol/ phan tshun mdza' brtse'i mol mchid zhib lhug gnang ba/
gros gleng/ gang dga' ci legs la mol bsdur byas nas kha 'chams song/
(tha dad pa) gleng ba dang gros bsdur byed pa/ ji ltar byed dgos mol bas gtan khel song/
mos pa dang gus pa/ mi dmangs kyi gtso 'dzin la mos gus drag pos blo gtad lings bcol byed/ mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus tshad med cig byung/
1) mos pas sgom pa/ 2) mos pa sgom lam gyi bsdus ming,
bsam gros rtse mthun pa/ mi mang rdog rtsa gcig tu sgril rgyur mos mthun gtan 'bebs byas pa/

1. (tha mi dad pa) yid ches pa'am yid 'dun pa/ bden don la mos pa/ gsar brje'i dpa' bo'i spyod bzang la mos pa/ tshig bzang la mos pa/ 2. yul nges lnga'i nang gses, nges pa'i dngos po la de kho na yin par 'dzin pa'i shes pa yul gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa'i byed las can no/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig sher phyin la yon tan can du nges par 'dzin pa'o/
mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems la, sangs rgyas dang byang sems gong ma rnams dgyes nas bsngags pa brjod pa'o/

mkhyen pa'i stobs: sems can la la theg pa chen po la mos, la la theg pa chung ngu la mos, la la theg pa 'bring po la mos, la la sbyin pa la, la la tshul khrims la, la la bsam gtan la mos pa bcas mos pa'i bye brag kun mkhyen pa/
snang ba thob pa dang, snang ba mched pa, de kho na'i don gyi phyogs gcig rjes su zhugs pa, bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin te bzhi/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste, 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rab tu gang ba kun tu ston pa'o/
tshogs sbyor gyi skabs su stong nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs pas mos pa tsam mam sgra spyi dang don spyi'i sgo nas chos nyams su len pa'o/
mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed
theg chen tshogs sbyor skabs kyi gzhan don la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed do/
mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed bzhi

sems bskyed nyer gnyis las mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed bzhi ste, sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, gser lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, zla ba tshes pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, me lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams so/
mos pas spyod pa dang, mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/
bza' tshang kha bral byed dus bden pa pho la che na mos bor ram, mos skyur zer/

sems mi bde ba dang, sems kyi sdug bsngal/ mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal/ mya ngan gyi tshogs 'du/ sems la mya ngan med par 'tsho bzhin yod/ grong pa'i ba shi yang, mya ngan zhag gsum 'khur dgos/ ming gi rnam grangs la gdung ba dang, yid gdung, sems ngal, sems sdug bcas so,
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya sgrub 'os kyi don gnad gang dag 'gog byed de dag sgrub ma thub par chud zos te mya ngan 'os pa'i skabs ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

1) 'das por rjes su dran nas mya ngan zhu ba/ gsar brje'i sngon gshegs dpa' bo la ched du dmigs nas mya ngan rjes dran zhu ba/ 2) sngar byung sdug bsngal rjes su dran pa/ rang thog myong ba'i mya ngan rjes dran zhu ba/
1) mdo sde myang 'das chung ba/ 2) srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyung dang bka' chems ka bkol ma'i ming grags dang mtshungs pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus rnying pa zhig /
tshe las 'das song zhes pa'i brda gtong ba'i: yi ge'am brda lan
1) «ashoka:» sdug bsngal med pa/ 2) sangs rgyas shig / 3) rgya gar gyi rgyal po zhig / 4) (mngon) khyim bya/

1) rgya gar du skyes pa'i shing bye brag pa zhig ste bud med kyi rkang pas reg na shing de'i me tog kha phye zer/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang mdzes dang, dga' ba sbyin byed, chu la gar rtse bcas so, 2) shug pa shing/
1) sems nas sdug bsngal byed pa/ 2) mya ngan zlo ba'am sdug bsngal shod pa/
«nirban'a» 1) sdug bsngal las thar ba/ 2) shi ba/
mya ngan las 'das pa la brten pa bzhi

sangs rgyas kyis lan gsung yul du ma gyur pa'i lta log gi dri ba rnams sde tshan bzhir dril ba'i nang gses shig ste, bdag dang 'jig rten shi nas 'byung mi 'byung gnyis ka yin pa dang gnyis ka min par lta ba bcas bzhi'o/
sdug bsngal sel ba'i sems gso/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo dang nang mi la mya ngan sems gso byed pa/
sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa/
chu med dben sa 'jigs su rung ba/
chu med pa'i thang stong lta bu yid skyo ba'i sa/
chu med pa'i sa cha thag ring ngam, chu med pa'i thang/
(tha mi dad pa) myags pa, myag pa,, rul ba dang bam pa/ sha myags nas dri ngan bro ba/ ro myags 'dam par gyur/ khong myags phyi mdzes/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i bad kan lnga'i ya gyal pho ba la gnas pa zhig ste, byed las pho ba'i nang du zas rnams phye ma 'thag pa ltar myag cing zhib mor byed pa/
1) mi gtsang ba dang ljan ljin/ 'dam pa myag myog / 2) mi gsal ba/ rig pa myag myog / khams myag myog /

1) yul ming zhig myang chu'i chu rgyud kyi spyi ming yin zhing deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khang dmar rdzong dang, rgyal rtse rdzong, pa snam rdzong gi khyab khongs mang che ba, gzhis ka rtse rdzong gi phyed tsam bcas 'di'i khongs su gtogs, yul 'di'i 'brong rtse yan la myang stod dang man la myang smad ces dbye srol yod/ 2) sngar bod kyi rigs rus shig /

'bab chu zhig chu 'go hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi byang ngos phag ri jo mo zhes pa'i gangs ri nas byung zhing bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khang dmar dang, rgyal rtse, pa snam, gzhis ka rtse bcas rdzong khag bzhi brgyud nas yar klungs gtsang po'i nang du 'bab/

bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan byis pa'i dus kyi sku rdzi yin zhing, phyis rab tu byung, lo bdun du ting nge 'dzin gcig la mnyam par bzhag mngon shes mnga' bas myang ban sha'i spyan can zhes grags, pan chen bi ma la mi tras snying thig gi man ngag rdzogs par gnang, sad na legs mjing yon dang khri ral pa can gnyis ka'i skabs kyi chos blon mdzad, dbu ru zha'i lha khang bzhengs, yul gru de'ang myang bam la dbang ba rdo ring la bka' gtsigs brkos, phyis su glang dar mas bkrongs so/
gtsang myang chu stod rgyud rgyal rtse yan chad kyi sa cha/
mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsdus tshig

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe rtswa mchog grong du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bang rim med pa gdan khri'i steng du bum gdan yan chad bzhugs pa'o/
1) lta rtog byed tshul zhig / dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul la ske myang myang byas nas lta ba/ 2) zas kyi bro ba'i tshod lta/ lto chas kyi ro bcud yag nyes myang myang byas nas brtag pa/
mgo myug tsam myug tsam 'don tshul/ grogs po yong min sge'u khung nas mgo myang myang myug myug byas te lta ba/ thag ring sa nas gnas tshul la myang myang myug myug gis lta ba/
gtsang rgyal rtse man chad kyi myang chu 'bab rgyud/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas pho long rgyu ma'i nang gi chu cha 'thung, rgyu tshad 'joms, rims tshad dang 'khrugs tshad sel/
lta rtog zhib 'jug / zhing las la myang zhib byed pa/ 'brog khul gyi gnas tshul la myang zhib byed pa/
gtsang phyogs kyi yul gru zhig /
(yul) yul gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i mi gsar gyi mdun du rang gi yon tan ngom mkhan phru gu /
(rnying) mi'u dang mtshungs te gzugs thung gi ming/
, gsar skyes ljang bu/ myu gu gsar pa/ 'bru'i myu gu / rigs kyi myu gu / zhing khar son btab nas myu gu skyes/ ming gi rnam grangs la khye'u kha dang, steng du 'then, zha lu bcas so,
(tha dad pa) myugs pa, myug pa, myugs,, 1) 'tshol ba/ thabs shes myug pa/ 'gro lam myug pa/ 2) mgo don tsam byed pa/ mgo yar myug pa/ 3) 'gul ba dang, g.yo ba/ me tog rlung gis myugs nas 'gul ba/
mgo thon tsam thon tsam dang, khyag khyug gam 'gul ba'i tshul/ sa sbubs nang nas 'phyi ba'i mgo myug myug byed pa/ char sprin gseb nas glog zhags myug myug 'khyug pa/
mgo 'bur tsam mam, mgo 'don tsam/ mgo myug tsam byed 'phral du rdung rdeg gtong ba/
gza' rnams nyi bar las brtsams te rim dang rim min rkang snga phyis nor dang bu lon spyad pa'i rkang longs, myur dag byed kyi gzhi yin pas na de ltar grags/
ha cang myur zhing mgyogs pa/ phar tshur myur mgyogs su phyin pa/
1) mgyogs po'i 'gro stangs/ 2) gza' lnga'i 'gro lugs/ 3) (mngon) rta/
gza' rnams rim pa'i snga rkang thog ma'i sa nas shar du rgyu ba la myur 'gros zhes bya'o/

gza' rang rang gi dal dag la rang rang gi myur rkang gis snon phri byas pa ste, dal ba'i steng nas mgo brtsams te rang 'gros kyis rkang pa'i longs spyod 'phel 'grib rnams kyi nor dang bu lon spyad zin pa dang mnyam du rang rang skyes skar dang nyi ma'i steng du 'dzoms te longs spyod dag par 'gyur ba'o/
mgyogs pa/ myur myur bar 'bad rtsol ma byas na myur
'thob thabs med:/ thog ltar drag la rlung ltar myur ba/ nus pa myur ba nyid du thon pa/
mgyogs myur dran pa'i blo gros/
(mngon) 1) rlung/ 2) rlung lha/ 3) bya rgod/ 4) sbrul/
ha cang mgyogs po/ 'phral mkho'i sman rigs gnam gru'i thog nas myur myur bar btang 'byor byung ba/
mgyogs tsam/ las don phar 'gyangs med par myur tsam byed thub na legs/
mgyogs lam/ bskor nas mi 'gro bar myur lam du phyin pa/

1. (tha dad pa) 'tshol ba dang, rtsad gcod byed pa/ gnas tshul gsal por myul zhib byas nas thag gcod pa/ dngos su lag bstar gyi sgo nas nyams myong myul ba/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) rgyu ba'am 'khyams pa/ don med myul du ma 'gro/ rgyal khams su myul ba/
gsang ba'i gnas tshul 'tshol zhib byed mkhan/
gnas tshul 'tshol zhib/ sa babs kyi gnas tshul myul zhib byas pa/
rang gi nyams myong rnams gzhan la slob khrid byed pa/ las thabs gsar pa'i myong khrid byed pa/
dngos su nyams myong nas byung ba'i gnas tshul/ mthong chos myong grub/ dpyid dus rmo 'debs hur brtson byas na ston dus lo legs yong rgyu mthong chos myong grub red/
myong ba mngon sum gyi shugs sam nus pa/
nyams su myong ba'i steng/ de dag tshang ma rang gi myong thog la cha bzhag nas bshad pa yin/
mngon sum nyams myong gi sgo nas shes shing rtogs pa/ rang gis dngos su mthong thos myong thog shes rtogs kyi gnas tshul gsal bshad byed pa/
goms 'dris/ sbyong rdar yang yang btang na myong 'dris phul phyin 'thon yong/

1.(tha dad pa) myangs pa, myang ba, myongs,, 1) tshod lta ba/ zas kyi bro ba myangs pa/ 2) spyod pa/ bde sdug mang po myangs pa/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) tshor ba/ bde ba nyams su myong ba/ sdug bsngal myong ba/ 3.byed las kyi mthar 'jug pa'i 'das pa ston byed tshig grogs shig / 'gro myong/ mthong ma myong/ 4.nyams myong/ myong ba than thun tsam las med/ rdzas dri tshor ba'i ri dwags myong can/ myong cha med na long ba thang la 'khyams pa dang mtshungs/
las ka'i goms myong gi 'go zin pa tsam/ sbyang brtson byas pas go rtogs kyi myong ba sna zin tsam skyes pa/
myong bar ma nges pa'i las
las bsags kyang so so'i gnyen po sogs kyis bcom nas rnam smin 'byin par ma nges pa/
nyams myong gi zin tho/ nya stob chad pa 'gar gza' 'dzin byung ba'i myong byang mthong/
lus kyi rtsa ba'i bad kan lnga'i ya gyal lce la gnas pa zhig ste, byed las lce'i steng du ro bzang ngan tshor ba byed/
mkhas pa gong mas rtsi myong ba'i zin tho/
nyams su myong ba'i tshor ba/ las don la do snang ma byas na myong tshor ga nas skye/
myong ba'i thog nas byung ba'i sems kyi 'char sgo / brtag dpyad sngon du btang nas rang gi myong tshor bsam 'char shod pa/
tshod lta ba'i don du go ba'i myong ba'i skul tshig
bzi 'thoms/ shing nags mthug po'i nang du phru gu myos 'thoms nas 'gro mi shes pa/ chang btung drags pas myos 'thoms pa/

(tha mi dad pa) bzi ba ste shes pa rnal du mi gnas pa/ chang gis myos te gar phyin gar bsdad kyang bshad rgyu mi 'dug / sems myos pa/ dga' bas myos pa/ dga' ba dang bde bas myos te brgyal 'gro ba lta bu zhig byung/ tsha zer che ba'i 'og tu myos shing 'bogs pa/

(mngon) 1) a rag gam chang/ 2) shing lug lo/ 3) hor zla gsum pa/ 4) sprin/ 5) 'dod lha/ 6) mo mtshan/ 7) glog gi 'od can ma dang, thig le mchog ma, pad dkar ma, lag bzang ma, dga' ba'i shing rta ma, rab tu myos byed ma, me n'a ka, skra 'dres ma, legs rgyan ma, munydza skyes ma, a ma mbu sha, chu shing brla can ma, sked legs ma ste lha'i smad 'tshong ma bcu gsum yod la, de dag 'dod pas myos pa'i rgyu yin pas 'dod pa dang myos byed kyis grangs bcu gsum mtshon/
lang tsho can gyi bud med/
rig pa mi gsal ba/ tsha nad drag pos gdungs pas rig khams myos myos por gyur pa/

/ 1) g.yul sar 'thab 'dzing byed mkhan/ rkang dmag / rta dmag / rang dmag / dgra dmag / dmag mkho'i dngos rdzas/ dmag bsdus pa/ 2) drag po'i 'thab 'dzing gi bya ba/ dmag khas len, mdung sked par gzer/
'go dpon min pa'i dmag mi phal pa/
mi dmangs dmag dpung la brtsi bkur byed pa dang, gsar brje'i dmag mi'i khyim tshang la gzigs skyong byed pa/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs mi ser them dud 'ga' zhig gis dmigs bkar sa zhing la brten dmag mi re gnyis gang 'grub gtong dgos pa'i khral rkang, dmag mi byed ring la me mda' dang mde'u phud, de min bza' gyon sogs so sos sgrub dgos shing, me mda' dang mde'u bor brlag byung tshe so sos skyin tshab sgrig dgos/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs, mi ser khyim dud kyi mi nor sa rten la gzhigs pa'i dmag khral 'gel ba/ dmag bskul, dmag 'gro bsdu bskul/
dmag mi sdud gtong gi khral/
1) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dmag khral 'jal dgos mkhan khral pa/ 2) dmag mir 'gro dgos pa'i 'khri cha ste 'os 'gan/

mi rigs dang mi rigs kyi bar ram, rgyal khab dang rgyal khab kyi bar, gral rim dang gral rim gyi bar, chab srid kyi tshogs pa dang chab srid kyi tshogs pa'i bar bcas su drag po'i 'thab 'dzing byed pa/ dgra 'gog dmag 'khrug / dmag 'khrug rgyag pa/ dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa/ bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug / ming gi rnam grangs la 'khrug 'dzing dang, 'thab rtsod, g.yul 'gyed bcas so,
dmag zing gi rgyu rkyen slong mkhan/
gnas pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dgos pa khyad par can med par dmag gi nang du zhag gcig las 'das par gnas pa'o/
yan lag bzhi: rkang thang dang, rta pa, shing rta, glang chen bcas so/
byed pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dgos pa khyad par can med par rang dgar mtshon la reg pa dang, dmag dpung gi ru bkod byed pa'o/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dmag khral rgyug dgos pa'i sa zhing gi rten/
dmag don la spyod pa'i gru gzings/ dmag gru'i mtsho khug /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dmag bdag so so nas dmag 'gro ngo mar sprod pa'i gla cha/
dmag dus su dpa' gzengs bstod pa'i glu dbyangs/
'thab 'dzing byed pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khrug pa dang, 'khrug long, rgol ba, rdeg gsod, 'thab pa, 'thab rtsod, 'dzing pa, g.yul 'gyed pa, g.yul gshom pa bcas so,
dmag mi sdod gnas gur ram khang pa/
1) dmag gi gra sgrig byed pa/ 2) dmag mi star sgrig pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dmag mi btang ba la brten nas khral rigs byings chag yang gtong srol/
1) dmag gi yo byad/ 2) dmag mi'i cha lugs/
rta dmag gi bzhon pa/ dmag rta rgas po me mdar mi 'drog /
dmag las rgyal kha thob pa/ btsan rgol gyi 'thab 'dzing byas nas dmag thob pa/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag spyi khang ngam, dmag sgar khag gi 'go byed la dmag mi gtong mi dgos pa zhus te dmag mi'i tshab tu dngul sprad par dngul de byung zhes btang ba'i lag 'dzin la zer/
dmag dpung ngam dmag 'khrug dang 'brel ba yod pa'i bya gzhag / dmag don mna' mthun/
dmag mi glas nas gtong mkhan do bdag /
dmag phar tshur log pa/ dgra sde tshar bcad nas dmag ldog pa/
1) dmag 'thab skabs brda gtong byed spyi'i ming/ 2) dmag mi 'bod pa'i brda/
blo gtad thub pa'i dmag dpung/
dmag dpung la 'gro lam ston mkhan/
la zhig si khron zhing chen khongs smi li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong du yod/
dmag mi mang po'i tshogs/ dmag dpung mnyam du 'dzoms pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dpung dang, dpung gi dkyil 'khor, dpung gi tshogs, dmag sgar, dmag tshogs, yan lag bzhi pa bcas so,
mkha' dmag dang, mtsho dmag rkang dmag bcas dmag mi'i rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum/

dmag gi 'go byed/ dmag dpon mang na dmag jus nyes/ ming gi rnam grangs la dpung sde'i gtso bo dang, dpung gi khyu mchog dpung gi mgon po, dmag gi 'go pa, dmag gi 'dren pa, ral gri'i rgyun 'dzin, ral gri'i gnyen bcas so/
rgyal srid sna bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
dmag mi'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs bod sa gnas dmag mi'i 'go khrid pa tsho'i las khungs/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs btsan shed kyis 'ded pa'i dmag khral/
dmag gtam gyi lan nam yig 'phrin/
dmag mi tshur skong ba'am, 'gugs pa/
dmag dpung khag mang tshogs pa/
snga dus dmag bzlog gi mthu gtor/
pha rol gyi dmag phyir skrod pa/
dmag dpung yan lag nang gses phye ba'i dmag mi'i rigs te dper na rkang dmag nang gi me sgyogs dmag dang, las grwa'i dmag sogs lta bu/
dpung sde mang pos dus gcig tu phyogs gcig la kha gtad de dmag rgyag pa/
dmag mi'i rogs byed mkhan dmag /
dmag la lta ba'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, mtshams kyi nye 'khor las 'das te dmag la lta zhing mthong ba'o/
rgol lan slog pa/ btsan 'dzul par dmag lan 'jal ba/
dgra bo'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug phyir zlog pa/
dmag shugs la brten nas srid dbang 'dzin mkhan/
dmag rgyag sa'i sa gnas/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'khrug pa'i sa gzhi dang, 'jigs rung gnas, 'thab mo'i 'dun sa, g.yul gyi sa gzhi, g.yul ngo, g.yul sa bcas so,
dmag 'jon po'am rgod po/ dmag hrag rdza ri nyil nyil 'dra/
/ 1) mi phal pa/ 2) mi spyi byings/
'go dpon rigs phud pa'i spyi byings kyi mi dkyus ma rnams/
mi byings kyi nang ngam, gseb/ dmangs khrod kyi zhabs gzhas/ dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal/
do ha gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
mi dmangs la chab srid kyi thog rang dbang gi sgo nas skad cha shod dbang yod pa dang, rgyal khab kyi srid dbang bdag gnyer byed rgyu sogs la zhugs dbang yod par zer/

kyi lam lugs: dmangs gtso'i rmang gzhi'i thog gi gcig sdud dang, gcig sdud slob ston 'og gi dmangs gtso gnyis zung du sbrel ba'i lam lugs shig yin, dmangs gtso gcig sdud kyi lam lugs ni mar khe si le nyin ring lugs kyi srid tang dang, spyi tshod ring lugs kyi rgyal khab las khungs dang mi dmangs tshogs khag gi rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsa don zhig red/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs med pa bzos nas dmangs gtso'i lam lugs 'dzugs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi bcos bsgyur khag la zer, de'i nang du sa zhing gi lam lugs bcos bsgyur dang, gnyen sgrig gi lam lugs bcos bsgyur, khe las bdag gnyer do dam dmangs gtso can du 'gyur ba byed rgyu, grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul 'ga' zhig gi zhing bran dang bran g.yog bcings 'grol gtong rgyu sod 'dus yod/
rtsam pa zher ba'am, dkyus rtsam ste sngar mnga' bdag gis bran g.yog la ster ba zhig /
ar las kyi lag rtsal mi sna min pa'i las mi 'u lag pa/
«shudra:» sngar rgya gar gyi mi rid bzhi'i nang gses shig / ming gi rnam grangs la kun gtum dang, rkang skyes, chos sbubs, rjes skyes, 'dres ma, phyis skyes, byin pa skyes, rigs kyi tha ma bcas so,
dma' sa bzung ba ste khengs skyung gi rnam 'gyur/

1.(tha mi dad pa) phongs pa dang, med par 'gyur ba/ mthun rkyen gyis dman pa/ 'tsho ba'i rgyu dngos kyis mi dman pa/ blo gros kyis dman pa/ 2.'phri rtsis/ 3. 1) mchog gi ldog zla ste tha shal lam zhan pa/ shes yon dman pa/ nyams myong dman pa/ spus tshad mchog dman bar gsum/ .ming gi rnam grangs la mchog min dang, tha ma, tha shal, phal pa, 'og ma bcas so, 2) mtho ba'i ldog zla/ sa babs dman pa/ ri dman pa/ lta ba dman pa mchog tu 'dzin pa/ byas rjes dman pa dang, khyad du 'phags pa/ lus stobs dman pa/
ba'i le lo: srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi dge ba'i las la brtson pa/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i chad las kyi bslab pa len pa'i gang zag gis dman pa'i spyod pa lnga dang du len dgos pa ste, nangs par dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams las snga bar langs te gtsug lag khang gi sgo dbye ba sogs bya ba dang, chos ston pa'i dus su bsil yab byed pa sogs 'os pa'i las bya ba dang, dge 'dun 'du ba'i dus su gandi brdung ba dang gdan bshams pa, bdug spos bzhag pa sogs bya ba dang, dgong ka'i dus su mthun pa'i chus dge slong rnams kyi rkang pa bkru ba sogs bya ba dang, dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dge ba'i phyogs las mi g.yel zhing dge 'dun gyi gral mthar 'dug pa sogs 'bad par bya ba ste lnga'o/
tha shal gyi don du go ba'i dman pa dang 'dra,
rnying pa'am lhag ro/ me tog dman ma/ kha zas dman ma/
tha shal gyi don du go ba'i dman pa dang 'dra,
sman shar yang zer, bud med dar ma/

dman zhes stobs chen gyi nad la stobs chung gi bcos byed pa lta bu dang, lhag ces tsha ba bcos nas tsha ba zhi yang da dung bsil bcos byed pa lta bu, log ces nad tsha ba la grang ba'i bcos byed pa lta bu'o/

1. 1) mtho ba'i ldog zla/ rin gong dma' ba/ skad gdangs dma' ba/ drod tshad dma' ba/ khang pa dma' ba/ dbus dma' mtha' skor mtho ba'i gzhong dbyibs can gyi sa cha/ 2) mchog gi ldog zla/ nus stobs dma' ba/ spus tshad dma' ba/ 2.dma' ba'i ming/ dma' bar sdang sems ma byed, mtho bar 'gran zla ma byed/

mi mang po'i dkyil du gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa dang, nyam dma' bar gtong ba/ gzhan skyon zur tsam mthong ba'i mod la dma' 'bebs par ma byed/ kha tas 'ug pa dma' phab pa/ chad pa ma bcad kyang dma' 'bebs zin pa/
skyon 'dzugs khyad gsod/ mi la dma' 'bebs brnyas bcos ma byed/
khyad gsod kyi sgo nas dma' sar 'bebs pa/ nor 'khrul byung mkhan gyi blo mthun la'ang dma' 'byin khyad gsod byed mi rung/
1) yul ljongs sogs kyi dma' sa/ dma' sa nas mtho tshod thig phra sa nas sbom tshod thig / 2) go gnas sogs kyi dma' sa/
zhum pa'i sems sam, khengs dregs med pa'i blo/ shes yon yod na de bas kyang dma' sems 'dzin dgos/
1) dmar po dang dkar po 'dres pa'i kha dog / shog bu dmar skya/ gos chen dmar skya/ 2) (mngon) bong dkar/
g.yag lug sogs bshas nas sha tshong rgyag pa/
sngar sha 'tshong ba'i ched du lug sogs bshas nas sha 'tshong mkhan/
gzhi dmar por tshos ris sna tshogs yod pa/ ras dmar khra/ shog bu dmar khra/
gnad don rjen par khrid pa/ sman bcos lag len dmar khrid byed pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shan rtsa rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/
(rnying) dmar chil chil lam dmar thing thing/
1) mtshal mdog dmar po/ 2) ltas ngan/ rmi lam du dmar ngo rmis par cha 'jog rgyu ci yod/ mo la dmar ngo bab 'dug / 3) (yul) nor phyugs la shi rmas 'byung ltas/
1) mdog dmar po'i cha shas/ 2) (mngon) zla ba mar ngo/
dmar po'i rnam pa mtshon stangs shig / nyi 'od kyis khyab pa'i sa gzhi dmar chil le ba/ khros pa'i gdong mdog dmar chil le ba/
dmar mdangs gsal lhang nge ba/ me 'od dmar chem me ba/ sprin gseb nas glog 'od dmar chem me bar 'khyug pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar chem me ba/
dmar mdangs gsal lhang nge ba/ dar cha dmar chems ser bsgrengs pa/ glog zhu dmar chems se ba/
tshon dmar gyis bris pa'i yi ge/ tshig 'chal yig nor la dmar mchan dang bcas te phul/
snga dus sems can bsad pa'i sha khrag gi mchod pa/
sngar bod du phyugs rwa can gyis gzhan gyi nor phyugs brdungs bsad kyi khrims 'jal/
sgrib med kha gsal lam, gcer bur lus pa/ skad cha dmar rjen/ gzugs po dmar rjen/ don gnad dmar rjen/
tshon dmar po dang ljang gu bsres pa'i mdog /
nyi ma nub mtshams kyi dus/ phyi dro nyi ma dmar thag chod dus las mtshams 'jog pa/
thab gzhob ste sngar rmongs dad kyi shod srol ltar me thab kyi nang du sha khrag pags spu sogs shor ba'i ming/
1) kha dog dmar po'i thig tshom/ 2) snam bu dmar thig /
kha dog dmar po'i 'od mdangs/ ngo gdong dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa/ glog zhu dwangs la dmar mdangs 'phro ba/
1) ngan spyod rnams 'dzem zon med par byed pa/ 2) 'bri mar tsag bcad steng skam rtsam dang lug sha'i khu ba sbyar te dmar zas kyi sgo nas rlung nad lus la zhen pa phyir 'don pa'i thabs shig /
thug par gdab rgyu'i sdor sha tshil gyi rigs/
dmar po dang nag po bsres pa'i mdog / me dpung dmar nag / mi khrom chen po dmar nag tu 'khyil ba/ thal rlung dmar nag / ming gi rnam grangs la mchin dmar dang smug po'o,

mtshal mdog / zhogs par lus rtsal sbyangs nas gdong dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ khong khro bzas pas gdong dmar po ston pa/ ngo tsha nas gdong dmar po chags pa/ dar cha dmar po mthon por sgreng ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrag mdog dang, mtshal ka, le brgan mdog bcas so,
lha sa'i rtse pho brang chags sa'i po ta la'i ming rnying, tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs su 'dir pho brang btab cing, srong btsan sgam pos rgyal sa 'di ru spos/
me dang khrag rgyun sogs phyir thon tshul/ thab kyi nang nas me lce dmar phyur phyur du thon pa/ khrag dmar phyur phyur du 'dzag pa/
tshes bcu drug nas gnam stong bar, mar ngo dang phyogs phyi ma'ang zer/
snam bu'i rigs dmar po zhig /
dmar nag bsres pa'i kha dog /
tshos dmar po dang nag po bsres pa'i mdog /

khrag dron dang, tshos dmar sogs kyi 'bab rgyun 'dzag bzhin pa/ 'brong mgo la me mda'i mde'u phog nas khrag rgyun dmar tsa re bar thon pa/ snam bur rgya tshos brgyab nas gcus btsir byed dus tshos khu dmar tsa re bar 'bab 'dug /
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong gi shar lho'i rgyud du yod/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtsa mda' rdzong gi lho rgyud na yod/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum gyi bzhugs gnas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sku gdung bzhugs sa'i gnas/
shing sman btsod kyi ming gzhan, bod snam la rgyag byed kyi tshos shig kyang red/
mtshur gyi bye brag cig ste, tshos mdog dmar po rgyag par mkho ba zhig /
phan tshun khrag 'don res byas nas 'dzing ba/ dmar 'dzing mtha' 'khyol ba byed pa/ dgra bo dang gdong gtugs kyis dmar 'dzing byed pa/
a mdo rma chu nas lhor phyin te shar zla chu'i shar phyogs sa khul stod rgyud, deng skabs mgar thar yan chad kyi spyi ming/
gzhi dmar por mdog ris sna tshogs yod pa/ ba lang dmar zal/ 'bri g.yag dmar zal/
sha rigs kyi zas spyi'i ming/
mer bsregs pa'i lcags dmar po gtub byed kyi gzong/
gtum dpa' ngar can gyi stag / dpa' snying: dmar yag stag dang 'dra
(yul) kha dog dmar po/ dmar ru mgo nag rtswa'i 'bru zhig /
skya rengs tha ma ste, nam langs kha'i skya mda'/
'od dmar po bkra lam me ba/ nam mkhar 'od dmar lam pa zhig mthong byung/
'od dmar po khra lam me ba/ nyi 'od dmar lam me ba/ me lce dmar lam me ba/
'od dmar po khra lam me ba/ sgron me dmar lam lam 'bar ba/ me mdag dmar lam lam pa/
kha dog gam tshos mdog dmar sang sang/ chi bi kha rnams dmar shar shar, li yi kha dog ser shar shar/
ham 'dod/ skad cha dmar shed tsha po/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmar shed btsan 'dzul la sna rgyug gnad 'phrod cig bzhus/
gnyan rims rgyu mar babs te khrag 'dres pa'i be snabs dmar po 'khru ba'i bshal nad cig /
dmar skya las dkar shas chung ba'i mdog / gos dar dmar seng/

li hang ste dmar po dang ser po bsres pa'i mdog / pad kha'i me tog dmar ser/ chos gos dmar ser/ mtshams sprin dmar ser/ ming gi rnam grangs la gi'u wang mdog dang, ngur kha, ser smug gser mdog bcas so,

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses, mi spro ba nan tur gyi phyir bcos byed pa'i gzhi ste, dmar ser can sogs 'thab krol byed pa'i dge slong la sdig pa nan tur sogs byas te, phyis bcos la bkod pas phyir bcos kyi gzhi la dmar ser can gyi ming gis smos pa'o/
bod kyi sangs rgyas chos pa tshos lha 'dre la gtong rgyu'i sha tshil sbyar ba'i rtsam gsur/
dmar rjen du srog gcod pa/ btsan 'dzul mkhan gyis nyes med mi dmangs rnams la dmar gsod 'dzem bag med par gtong ba/
dmar mdangs gsal lhang nge ba/ mtshan mo grong khyer gyi mtha' dkyil bar gsum du glog bzhu mang po dmar lhang nge bar 'bar ba/
me lce sogs kha dog dmar po'i rigs can 'gul tshul/ thab me dmar lhab lhab 'bar ba/ dar cha dmar lhab lhab tu g.yo ba/
(tha mi dad pa) rgud pa dang, 'grib pa dang, nyams pa/ nyams dmas pa/ lang tsho dmas pa/ stobs shugs dmas pa/
bu ga'i don du go ba'i dmig bu dang 'dra,
'bu skya leb kyi don du go ba'i dmig bu dang 'dra,
/ 1) bu ga dang khung bu/ brag la dmig bu bton pa/ 2) 'bu skya leb/
1) lus kyi khong gseng/ 2) bug pa'am bu ga /
na yig gi tshig phrad 'jug tshul zhig / na...mdor bsdus na/ rgyas par bshad na/
nges bzung gis logs su bton pa/ nang don bye brag pa rnams kyi thad la dmigs bkar gyis gsal bshad byas pa/ rgad po dang nad pa rnams la dmigs bkar gyis gzigs skyong gnang ba/
rkyen bzhi'i nang gses, shes pa yul gyi rnam ldan du skyed pa ste, gzugs sgra la sogs pa phyi rol gyi yul la dmigs nas skye ba'o/

, gang la ched du dmigs pa'i mthun rkyen rten so/ sdod khang gsar rgyag gi dmigs sgo la rdo shing gsog pa/ dge rgan byed mkhan gyi dmigs sgor dge 'os slob grwa btsugs pa/ shog bu de dag dpe deb 'di'i gras par 'debs rgyu'i dmigs sgo red/
1) re ba byed sa'am rgyab rten/ 2) dmigs yul/ 'phral gyi dmigs rten/ phugs kyi dmigs rten/ 'tsho ba'i dmigs rten/
yul gzugs sogs la dmigs nas yul can sems la myong ba shar ba'i rnam pa/

1. (tha dad pa) sems gtod pa dang, sems pa'am, sgom pa/ 'gyur ldog myur du 'gro ba'i gnas tshul la rig pa bsgrims nas dmigs pa/ mi dmangs kyi khe phan la dmigs nas dka' ngal la mi 'dzem pa dang rang srog blos gtong ba la yang mi 'dzem pa zhig byed dgos/ 'char gzhi zhig 'ding skabs khyon yongs la dmigs nas 'ding dgos/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) mthong ba dang, 'thob pa/ las don dngos su lag len bstar ba'i dge mtshan dmigs pa/ 'od zer stong ldan gyi mdun lam dmigs pa/ nang gi bsam blo'i dran rtog dmigs su med kyang phyi'i bya spyod la bltas na shes thub/ 3. 1) bsam yul dang, gnad dam, myong ba'i rnam pa/ mig gnyis dmigs par gtod pa/ sems dmigs pa las gzhan du mi g.yeng ba/ 2) logs dang zur/ don gnad 'di'i skor gros bsdur byed rgyur dmigs su bsal ba/ ngal bso'i gung seng dmigs kyis bkar ba/ nang logs kyi gnas tshul sba gsang med par dmigs kyis bstan pa/
slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung zhig /
slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung zhig gi 'grel pa/
rgya gar gyi slob dpon 'dul ba lhas brtsams pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i bshad pa zhig /
dag pa bzhi'i nang gses, dmigs pa'i yul gang 'dod du bsgyur ba la mnga' dbang brnyes pa'o/
zhi gnas kyi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i chos bzhi ste, khyab pa'i dmigs pa dang, spyad pa rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa, mkhas pa'i dmigs pa, nyon mongs rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa bcas bzhi/

khams drug khams bco brgyad kyi nang tshan: zhig ste gzugs, sgra, dri, ro, reg bya, chos te drug / dmigs pa la thogs pa, sems sems byung gis chos gcig la dmigs pa na de la thogs nas chos gzhan dmigs pa la gegs byed pa lta bu'o/

skye ba'i sa: sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor bzhi ba'i skabs su thob pa'i sa bdun pa ste, sgom lam du slob pa'i zung 'jug gi don de la dmigs shing goms pas 'bras bu mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pas, sa bdun a dmigs pa'i 'bras bu skye ba'i sa zhes bya'o/
long 'khrid pa/ dmigs bu med pa'i dmus long thag ring 'gro mi thub/
1) dmigs bkar gyis mdzub mo 'dzugs pa/ mi nges can zhig la las don nges can zhig byed par dmigs 'dzugs byas pa/ 2) bu lon len dus bzhag pa'i gta' ma/

1) bsam blo gtong sa'i gnas/ rgyang ring gi dmigs yul/ las don gyi dmigs yul/ 2) blos ched du dmigs pa gtad pa'am blo kha phyogs pa'i yul te, sgra mi rtag pa'i dmigs yul ni sgra dang, snying rje'i dmigs yul ni sems can rnams yin pa lta bu'o/
byings dang mi 'dra ba/ sngon thon can la dmigs bsal gyi gzengs bstod thob pa/ rgan byis nad pa sogs la dmigs bsal gyi gzigs skyong gnang ba/ dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul/
mang po'i nang nas bkar te gong du bkur ba/ dmigs bsal gyi byas rjes 'jog mkhan rnams la dmigs bsal gong phud kyis bya dga' gzengs bstod gnang ba/
1. 1) sngar bod kyi rus drug tu grags pa'i ya gyal zhig ste rmu yang snang/ 2) gdon rigs shig / 2. (rnying) rtsub po dang, ma rungs pa/

si khron zhing chen zung chu rdzong gi khongs gtogs, rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma snga tshal bzhi'i ya gyal tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas dgon brgya rtsa brgyad btab pa'i nang gses kyi dgon chen zhig dmar dmag rgyang skyod skabs dgon der krung gung krung dbyang gis chab srid cus kyi gros tshogs shig 'tshog myong/
1) gyong po dang, gtum po/ 2) spro thung ba ste chung ngu'i rkyen gyis khro chog chog /
nad bdag gi ming nad la btags pa zhig ste, dmu zhes lha srin sde brgyad kyi nang tshan gdug pa can zhig gi ming yin pas des btang bar grags pa'i lus la chu bsags pa'i nad cig /
chu rigs shig thur sel rlung gis log pa'i las byas de dri chu'i rgyu lam bkag nas dri chu dwangs ma'i rgyu lam la shor nas rtsa kha log pa'i don/
chu rigs shig kha zas ma zhu ba dwangs ma'i rgyu lam du shor nas rtsa la byer ba'i chu nad cig /
chu rigs bco lnga'i nang tshan zas ma zhu ba dwangs ma'i rtsa mig tu shor te be snabs kyis dwangs ma'i rgyu lam bkag nas don snod rang rang gi gnas su chu zags par gyur pa'i don/
bsam pa nag po'am ma rungs pa'i sems/
lus skrangs shing chu bsags nas rdzing bu'i nang chus khengs pa ltar gyur pa'i chu nad cig /
dmu chu dang, 'or nad gnyis kyi bsdus ming zhig /
(tha dad pa) chung zad dgod pa dang 'dzum mdangs 'byin pa/ yid dga' nas 'dzum dmul ba/ kha dmul ba'i sgo nas brda btang ba/
(tha mi dad pa) yid skyo ba dang, mtsher ba dang, yi chad pa/
(rnying) spro ba shi ba dang, tshi chad pa'am yi chad pa'am sun pa/
khog zhar te skye dus nas mig long ba/ dmus long gis dmus long khrid na gar slebs 'dir slebs mi shes/ mig stong ldan pas ma bltas na, dmus long nyid dang khyad par ci/
1) btsog grib/ 2) snga dus kyi shod srol du rigs rus gcig pa'am, gnyen phyogs nang khul phan tshun gsod res byas pa dang pho mo bsdebs pa'i grib/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dpal 'bar rdzong khongs su yod, chu 'go dung la'i byang ngos nas byung zhing rgyal mo rngul chu'i yan lag cig yin/
rme bo'ang zer, rus gcig pa gsod res byed mkhan nam gnyen sdong mkhan skyes pa/
rus gcig pa gsod res byed mkhan nam gnyen sdong mkhan bud med/
gzhan la gnod pa'i drag sngags/
1. (tha dad pa) 1) kha ngan sgrog pa dang, smod pa/ don med gzhan la dmod pa/ 2) smon lam ngan pa 'debs pa dang, bden pa bdar ba/ bden par dmod pa gnod pa ci/ 2. smon log dang, ngan sngags/
1) gzhan la gnod pa'i smon lam ngan pa 'debs pa/ 2) bden pa bdar ba ste, bden tshig brjod nas lha rgyud skul ba/
dmod pa 'dor ba dang don gcig
dmod pa 'dor ba dang don gcig
gzhan gnod kyi smon tshig ngan pa'i mthu/
tsha dmyal brgyad dang, grang dmyal brgyad, nyi tshe ba, nye 'khor ba bcas dmyal ba'i gnas bco brgyad/
dmyal khams bco brgyad kyi gnas/
«narka» ngan song gsum gyi nang tshan zhig / dmyal ba ma mthong na, sangs rgyas yid mi ches/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan 'gro'i mthil dang, bde med, 'dod pa'i 'bras bral, sdug bsngal gter bcas so,

gseg ma dang, bye ma, 'dam chu, du ba, me, mun pa che, ngu 'bod che, rdo rje'i me lce zhes bya ba'i dmyal ba ste brgyad, dmyal ba brgyad po sa dkyil gyi phyed 'og ma nas rlung dkyil gyi phyed 'og ma'i bar gnas par gsungs/

bya'i bye brag cig / rma byas sgro gur phub/ rma byar ngom rgyu sgro mdongs, ne tsor ngom rgyu yig drug spre'ur ngom rgyu rkub/ ming gi rnam grangs la bkra ba'i 'og pag can dang, gar mkhan, mgrin sngon, mgrin pa sngo, sgeg ldan, rgya mtsho skyes, mjug sgro can, brtan pa dregs, mdongs mtha' can, mdongs ldan, 'dab brgya pa, rna rgyan can, sprin gyis sgeg sprin la dga', 'brug sgra'i gar, 'brug sgra'i mngal 'dzin, 'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg gtsug ldan, gtsug phud can, rab g.yo, lag 'gro za, legs bris, shing la rtse, sar 'gro, sen mo'i gar bcas so,

rang skyong khul: mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi shar lho'i rgyud dang rma chu'i 'gram ngogs lho rgyud du yod pas ming de ltar btags, 1953 lo'i zla ba 12 tshes 22 nyin rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing, 1955 lor rang skyong khul du bsgyur, de'i khongs su thung ren dang, gcan tsha, rtse khog bcas rdzong gsum yod, rang skyong khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de thung ren rdzong khongs kyi rong po rgya mkhar du yod/

rtsa ba'am 'og gzhi/ so phag bting ba'i rmang gzhi/ gnam gru 'bab lam gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba/ yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i rmang gzhi/

phyugs kyi lus smad na ba'i 'go nad cig /
smad chen ma dang don gcig
gsham smad kyi phyogs/ gtsang po'i smad rgyud/ lung gzhung gi smad rgyud/ grong khyer gyi smad rgyud/
spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga par rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma shes rab seng ges lha sar phyag btab pa'i sngags kyi grwa tshang zhig /
'og gam gsham gyi phyogs dang, rjes ma'i cha shas/ gtsang po'i smad cha/ dpe cha'i stod cha dang smad cha/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi brag g.yab rdzong khongs su yod cing, zla chu'i yan lag cig yin/
snga dus gzhan gyi chung mar log par spyad pa'i khrims 'jal zhig /

drug bod yul stod smad bar gsum du phye: ba'i smad mdo khams sgang drug ces pa'i sgang drug ni zal mo sgang dang, tsha ba sgang, smar khams sgang, spo 'bor sgang, dmar rdza sgang, mi nyag rab sgang bcas drug ste, de rnams ri chu'i rgyug phyogs la bstun nas zhib tsam bshad na 'bri chu dang nyag chu'i byang rgyud bar gyi sa khul la zal mo sgang dang, rgyal mo rngul chu dang rdza chu'i bar la tsha ba sgang, rdza chu dang 'bri chu'i byang rgyud bar gyi sa khul la smar khams sgang, 'bri chu dang nyag chu'i lho rgyud bar gyi sa khul la spo 'bor sgang, mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs rma chu'i lho nas nyag chu'i stod kyi shar bar la dmar rdza sgang, nyag chu'i chu sked kyi shar rgyud la mi nyag rab sgang bcas zer/

mdo khams smad kyi yul nas dar zhing brgyud pa'i 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun te rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa na, smar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo smad dan tig gi yul grur byon nas, rgya nag gi hwa shang ke wang dang, gyi phan gnyis bcas lnga tshogs kyis bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs, khong gis klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang, lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcu bsnyen par rdzogs, de nas rim bzhin dbus gtsang gi phyogs su 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun spel zhing mched pa'o/
smad du 'dogs rgyu'i yi ge/ ya ra la wa...
zla smad nag po'i bsdus tshig
1. smod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2. smad phyogs pa/
na gnas pa: spyod pa gzhan na gnas pa'i gzhi'i nang gses, nan tur bzhi byed pa'o/
smad pa'i cha las bstod pa
cha'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, g.yo zol gyi tshig gis bstod ra btang ba'i khul byas nas don la smad ra phab pa'i tshul ston pa'i cha'i rgyan zhig /
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi gnas lugs cung zad lhag par ston pa'i phyir, dpe la smad ra btang ba'i tshul gyis don du dpe don mtshungs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod smad yul la nyes skyon gyi smad ra mtshungs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
dngos po dang lung pa sogs kyi smad phyogs/
smad 'tshong ma'i sdod khang/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye bo kun 'jug dang, 'khrig pa'i khyim, rtse dga'i khang pa bcas so,

spyi tshogs rnying par 'tsho ba'i don du gzugs 'tshong ba'i bud med/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan rol ma dang, rtags can ma, thun mong bud med, 'dod pa'i rtsen ma, sbed byed, sbyor byed, tshogs pa'i bud med, tshogs can ma, gzugs 'tshong ma, res ma bcas so,
sha'i smad khog gi phyed ka/
smad g.yogs kyi kha la btang ba'i gong ba/
'phya smod dam sma 'bebs/ rang snang gang shar gyis gzhan la smad ra gtong ba/
gzugs po'i khog smad kyi rus pa/
1) smad g.yogs sam smad gos/ 2) gos chen gyi bye brag cig /

lus la phan zhing nad 'joms par byed pa'i gnyen po'i rdzas te, nang gses su dbye na rin po che'i sman dang, sa'i sman, rdo'i sman, shing gi sman, rtsi'i sman, thang gi sman, sngo'i sman, srog chags kyi sman bcas brgyad mchis so/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkyen sman dang, nad sel, rtsi, rtsi sman, 'tsho byed, gsos sman bcas so,
bod skyes la phug btsos pa'i khu ba ste, nus pas so rnyil skrangs pa dang, sgyid chu 'khums pa sogs rkang 'bam gyi nad 'joms/
1) nad la brtag bcos byed sa'i las khang/ 2) sman 'jog sa'i khang pa/
nad par sman chu 'dzugs pa'i khab sbubs stong zhig /
sman phye 'jal byed kyi yo byad cig /
a bar skyur gsum lta bu sbyor sde ma byas pa'i khrog sman/

lta na sdug gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan: rgyud bzhi 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po'i ming ste de'i ngos 'dzin thad 'og min gnas dang, o rgyan yul, rdo rje gdan, rnam snang gangs can zhing, sman gyi nags, rang lus kyi gnas bcas bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs mchis pas dpyad par bya'o/
a ru ra'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos brtsams pa'i bod kyi rtsa che'i sman gzhung rtsa rgyud dang, bshad rgyud, man ngag rgyud, phyi ma'i rgyud bcas bzhi/

1) ga bur dang, tsan dan dkar po lta bu shin tu bsil ba'i sman gyis nus pa chu dang mthun pa'i las byed pa'i cha nas btags pa zhig / 2) rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus sel bar byed pa'i sman chu rigs lnga/ 3) sman khong du 'phul bar byed pa'i chu ste rlung la gar chang dang, mkhris par gangs chu, bad kan la chu bskol bcas so/
sman gyi gtso bo'i nus shugs te, tsha bas grang nad 'joms pa dang, bsil bas tsha nad 'joms pa lta bu'o/
sman rigs la yod pa'i nus pa brgyad de, lci snum brtul dang rno ba dang, yang rtsub tsha bsil rnam pa brgyad/
sman sbyor byed dus 'debs rgyu'i sman gyi nus pa 'don byed ru rtsi lta bu/

beed'urya 'od kyi rgyal po: nad kyi 'jigs pa las skyob par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas sku mdog sngon po dbu la gtsug tor dang, zhabs la 'khor los mtshan pa, phyag g.yas na nad kyi gnyen po a ru ra dang, g.yon pas lhung bzed bsnams pa zhig gi mtshan/
zag bcas kyi dge ba dang mi dge ba gang rung gi rnam par smin pa'i rgyu las skyes pa ste, zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lta bu/
nad so so'i gnyan po'i sman ro nus zhu rjes sogs mthun par sbyor ba'i sde tshan te, rin chen ril nag chen mo dang, ratna bsam 'phel lta bu la'o/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, bder gnas rkyen gyi gzhi lnga'i nang gses zas mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i sgo nas bde bar gnas pa sman gyi gzhi ste, 'dod khams pa'i lus 'tsho ba'i rten du gyur pa'i dri ro reg bya gsum gyis bsdus pa'i kham zas ni lus gso bar phan zhing nad sel bas sman zhes btags pa'o/
sman gyi yon tan bcu bdun

'jam pa dang, lci ba, dro ba, snum pa, brtan pa bcas rlung sel ba'i yon tan lnga, grang ba dang, rtul ba, bsil ba, mnyen pa, sla ba, skam pa bcas mkhris pa sel ba'i yon tan drug skya ba dang, tsha ba, yang ba, rno ba, rtsub pa, g.yo ba bcas bad kan sel ba'i yon tan drug bcas bsdoms pas bcu bdun no/

rdzas kyi shan gyi nang gses shig ste, thun tshod du rung ba'i sman dang, zhag bdun pa'i sman rnams rang rang gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i thun tshod kyi mtha' las 'das pa na, gsog 'jog gi spang ba bskyed pa'o/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer gyi shar ngos yar klungs gtsang po'i 'gram du yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de dung dor du yod/
sga smug gi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
sle tres, rgya mtsho lbu ba, kanda ka ri, dbang po lag pa, shu dag dkar po/
nad pa'i bshang lam du gtong rgyu'i sbu gu'i sman sbyor zhig gi ming/
nad gzhi rang rang gi gnyen po'i sman btang nas nad 'joms par byed pa'i thabs/
don snod kyi nad gang dang 'phrod pa'i sman dang nas gnyis mnyam du btsos te phabs rtsi sbyar te bsnyal nas langs pa'i tshe btung dgos pa'i rlung nad sel ba'i skom gyi nang tshan zhig /

1) sman gtong byed kyi chu khol/ 2) sman yod pa'i ri'i chu/ 3) lus la phan che ba'i chu/ 4) 'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnya' nang rdzong khul du yod, chu 'go shi sha sbang ma nas byung zhing bum chu'i yan lag cig yin/

rlung nad sel ba'i sman chu mdog sngo la ro mngar ba dang, mkhris nad sel ba'i sman chu mdog ser la ro kha ba, bad kan gyi nad sel ba'i sman chu mdog skya la ro skyur ba, khrag nad sel ba'i sman chu mdog dmar la ro bska ba, chu ser gyi nad sel ba'i sman chu mdog smug la ro tsha ba bcas te lnga'o/
bong nga nag po'i ming ste, nad la sman kyang thabs dang ma ldan na srog la gnod chen 'byung ba'i don/
nus pa che ba'i sman te a ru rnam rgyal lta bu/
1) sman rigs mang po skye ba'i yul/ 2) mchog tu gyur pa'i yul khams/ 3) (mngon) spang ri/
sman gyi do dam byed mkhan/
sman tse rnying ma ste, srin 'bu'i dar skud las bzos pa'i gru'u tse ser po shing lo dang shing tog gi ri mo yod pa zhig /
1) sman phye mar btags pa/ 2) phan 'dogs byas pa/

1) nad rang rang gi gnyen po'i sman rnams rta zhon pa ltar 'phral du nad kyi steng du 'khrid par byed pa'i don te, rlung la bu ram, mkhris par ka ra, bad kan la sbrang rtsi bcas so/ 2) sman khong du 'phul zhing nad kyi mtshan nyid 'joms pa'i rta ste, rlung la gar chang, mkhris par chu bskol grang mo'am chu bsil, bad kan la chu bskol bcas so/

sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, sa drug pa ba'i rgyud kyi sher rab kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang gzung bar rtog pa sogs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pas na sman lta bu'o/
tsha grang gi nad 'joms pa'i sman gyi nus shugs/
sman bskol ba'i khu ba dang, sman dang sbyar ba'i btung ba/
sman gtong thengs re'i spom tshad/
1) sman tshad 'jal byed dang sman blug byed kyi khem bu/ 2) mig 'grib bsal byed dang, glo rnag 'don byed kyi lag cha lta bu dpyad kyi cha byad/
na tsha gang zhig 'chos byed sman gyi ming dang, tshad mang nyung, bkol stangs sogs bkod pa'i yi ge/
spang 'khor mtsho'ang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ru thog rdzong gi nub rgyud na yod/

dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang dpal spungs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi slob ma karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag gi skor gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid pod gnyis te, e ni nad brtag thabs dang, wam ni sman bsdu sbyor gyi skor yin no/
btsan dug dang, thang phrom lta bu dug shas yod pa'i sman/
1) sman rigs sna tshogs/ 2) zas kyi bro ba 'don byed sha sman/

1. (tha mi dad pa) phan pa/ 'dzugs skrun la sman pa/ rgyal jus dmangs 'tshor sman pa/ 2. lha rje'am gso rig pa/ sman pa dor ba'i nad pa der, sman bzang rnyed pa ga la srid/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyon shes dang, mkhyud dpyad, nad 'joms, nad sel, tshe rig 'tsho byed, gso dpyad mkhan, gso rig pa, lha rje bcas so,
rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel dang, cha lag kha skong, mdo byang bcas blor thon cing, de dag lag len du spyod shes pa'i sman pa'i mtshan snyan/
rtsa rgyud dang, bshad rgyud, phyi ma rgyud bcas kyi rtsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa'i don blor tshud cing lag len bya shes pa'i sman pa'i mtshan snyan/

gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len gang la thogs pa med pa'i sman pa mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan zhig ste, rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel dang, cha lag kha skong, mdo byang, phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgus bsgyur pa'i gso dpyad kyi gzhung, bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgus mdzad pa'i gzhung sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po, bdud rtsi bum pa che chung, yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa, drang srong snyan rgyud, tshig don zla zer sogs kyi rtsa 'grel, kha skong, cha lag rnams blo la thon cing, de dag gi don lag len du sgril shes pa la bya'o/

gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len gang la byang chub pa'i sman pa mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan zhig ste, rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel dang, cha lag kha skong, mdo byang, bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgus mdzad pa'i gso dpyad kyi gdams pa, sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po, bdud rtsi bum pa rtsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa blo la thon cing lag shes khong du chub pa la bya'o/
1) sangs rgyas sman bla'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs shig / 2) rgya gar du 'tsho byed gzhon nu dang, bod du rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po gsar rnying gnyis lta bu/
nad pa gso bar byed pa'i thabs shes bzhi ste, sbyor ba sman dang, cha byad dpyad, 'tsho ba zas, bya ba spyod lam bcas so/
sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po

dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su rgya nag gi hwa shang ma ha ya na dang, lo chen bee ro tsa na gnyis kyis bsgyur pa'i rgya nag gi sman gzhung zhig ste, de mdzad pa po 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bzhed pa dang, slob dpon klu sgrub la bzhed pa, rgya nag gi sman pa mkhas pa zhig la bzhed pa, mkhas mang mnyam du bgros nas brtsams par bzhed pa bcas mi 'dra ba mchis so/
sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i spos sbyor zhig /
sman blug snod kyi bye brag cig /
sman gyi ro snyigs 'phyag byed kyi yo byad cig /

bsnyen par rdzogs pas sman bzhi gang rung longs spyod pa na, sman de nyid byin len byas te, sbyor ba len yul de nyid rgan na phyag gsum bya, mdun du tsog pur 'dug gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon par bzhag g.yas pas steng du dgab nas sman byin rlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhus te, dngos gzhi sman bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga lan gsum brjod de thabs legs bya, rjes su phyag byas te, bka' drin che zhu ba dang, yul gyis chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad pa ngo mtshar che zhes brjod pa bcas so/
sman gyi sbyor sdeb kyi bsdus tshig
sman gyi dwangs ma mar la bstims te lus stobs gso ba sogs la phan pa'i sman sbyor zhig /
sman ming sgra sbyor nges pa
kha che pan chen zla ba mngon pa dga' bas mdzad pa'i zla zer gyi sman ming rnams logs su bkod pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
pho ba ris, pi pi ling, sman sga dang gsum/
sman rtsing zhib rim pa 'byed byed kyi yo byad cig /
sman gyi sbyor tshad dam thun tshad/
sman ngo ma ma yin pa/
sman dpyad kyi thabs ston pa'i rig gzhung ste, rgya gar gyi yan lag brgyad pa dang, rgya nag gi zla ba'i rgyal po, bod kyi dpal ldan rgyud bzhi lta bu'o/
sman 'dul sa'i rdo'i gzhong pa lta bu/

bcas ldan dge slong gis bsten du rung ba'i dri ro reg gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i kham gyi zas te, dus rung gi sman dang, thun tshod du rung ba'i sman dang, zhag bdun pa'i sman dang 'tsho bcangs kyi sman bcas bzhi'o/
sman nad la 'phrod pa/ thengs dang po btang ba'i sman zug na da dung bstud nas gtong dgos/
'phral la gnod pa ltar snang yang, phugs su phan che ba'i dpe/ sman bzang ro kha nad la phan/
btsan dug dang, thang phrom lta bu dug yod pa'i sman gyi nus pas kha lce dang rkang lag sogs sbrid de chang gis myos pa ltar gyur pa'i don/
sman dpe ste gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi gzhung lugs dang, lag len rnams ston par byed pa'i yi ge/
1) sman gyi yon tan/ 2) sman gyi rin/
gso ba rig pa'i gzhung don 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i sman pa mkhas pa'i che ming/
yun nan zhing chen gyi 'jol rdzong khongs zla chu'i thog la btsugs pa'i lcags zam zhig /
sman gyi phye ma la brlan phab nas mgo bsdus te gong bur dril ba'i ril bu/
1) khu ba bton pa'i sman snyigs/ 2) sman gyi bro ba'i ro/ sman ro bska rung nad la phan, snying gtam rtsub rung mi la phan/
1) sman lus la 'phrod pa/ 2) sman pa las sman len pa/
sman sna tshogs skye ba'i yul ljongs/
rus par rtsub rdar rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig /
phan sems/ mi dmangs la sman sems kho nas las don hur brtson byed pa/ nad gzhi 'tsho thabs la sman sems kyis sman bcos zhib tshags byed pa/
sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i bdug pa/
gser dngul rkyang pa lta bu'i nor gces pa/ dngul smar rkyang/ 'bru nas smar rkyang/

rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud na yod, de'i shar ngos 'bri chu'i pha rol ni si khron zhing chen yin, rdzong de'i nub rgyud du zla chu 'bab cing lho ngos yun nan zhing chen dang 'brel nas yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de sgar thog tu yod/
chab mdo'i rdzu chu dang, 'bri chu gnyis dbar du chags pa'i sa rgyud, deng skabs chab mdo dang, brag g.yab, smar khams sgar thog sogs kyi yul lung gi spyi ming/

rgyal rong rgyal mo'i rngul chu'i chu lag cig chu 'go mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul nas byung ste lho phyogs su gcig sgril dang pad ma rdzong brgyud nas mthar si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul nas rgyal rong rgyal mo rngul chur 'bab/

sngar bod kyi khrims srol du mi bsad pa'i nyes chad du mi stong zhes 'jal dgos pa de sprod len skabs gser sogs dngos po rtsa chen rigs la smar dang, 'bru nor sogs dngos po go chod rigs la khrag dang, dngos rigs mkho med spus zhan rigs la zong zhes gsum du phye srol yod pa de'o/ smar...khrag / zong...
bod rang skyong ljongs khongs go 'jo rdzong gi nub rgyud nas 'bab cing, rim gyis ri chu, rtse chu sogs dang 'dres rjes go 'jo rdzong gi byang shar mtshams su 'bri chu'i nang du 'bab/
snam ras ko shog sogs phyi 'thum dang, sgam dang, sgye phad sogs blug snod phyi rdzas kyi ljid grib phud pa'i nang dngos smar zog rkyang pa gang yin gyi ljid tshad/
/ 1) gtsang ma dang skyon med spus dag / gser smar po/ dngul smar po/ 'bru smar po/ khe bzang smar po/ 2) phan thogs chen po/ da res khyed kyis las rogs btang ba de smar po byung/
(yul) zog ro min pa'i gces nor smar rkyang/ gzhung gi 'bru mdzod nang du 'bru rigs lhad med smar smar ldig ldig gis yongs su khengs yod pa/
phag gru bka' brgyud kyi nang gses shig /
smar tshang shes rab seng ge
smar tshang bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod po yin, phyis su lugs de khams dpal yul gyi rnying ma pa dang gcig tu dril nas de'i bla ma rnams la karma pa'i yang srid zer/

rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs skabs, mdo smad kyi phyogs su byon nas, bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs mkhan gyi slob dpon gsum ste, smar shakya mu ne, g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas, gtsang pa rab gsal rnams so/
rtsa che'i dngos rigs kyi rin thang/
rul sungs kyi lud snum gsher can/
nyi skar lnga dang chu tshod lnga bcu, spyi zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis skor la smal po zla phyed ces zhag bco lnga brtsi ba'o/
dbyar nyi ldog nas log zhag nyi shu'i mtshams su smal po'i gdong char zhes pa char nges par du 'bab zer/
smal po'i zla ba ste hor zla bcu gcig pa/

(legs) skad rigs chen po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, spyi lo'i sngon dus rabs bzhi pa'i skabs kyi rgya gar gyi skad yig la zer zhing, skad yig de'i bstan bcos shin tu mang, sngon ston pa shak ya thub pa dga' ldan lha yul du phebs skabs skad 'di'i thog nas lha rnams la chos ston par grags pas ming yang lha'i skad dam, legs sbyar skad kyang smra'o/

nyi ma tsha ba'i dus rgyang ring bye thang skya bo nas chu 'gro ba lta bu'i 'khrul snang zhig / smig rgyu 'bab chur 'khrul ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrag khrig snang ba, gya gyu'i ri mo, rgyang ring chu, bar snang chu rlabs, g.yo ba'i 'od, ri dwags 'chir 'jug bcas so,
(rnying) smyig ma'i zur chag ste shing smyug ma/
smin byed kyi dbang dang, grol byed kyi khrid/

bod rang skyong ljongs grwa nang rdzong khongs su t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i bla ma gter bdag gling pas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug lor btab pa'i rnying ma lho brgyud lugs kyi dgon pa'i gtso bo zhig rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi lor sog po jun gar gyis mer bsregs btang yang rjes su zhig gso byas shing, sngar dgon pa 'dir khams dang a mdo'i sa khul khag gi rnying ma pa'i grwa pa chos dang sman rtsis sogs sbyong bar yong mkhan shin tu mang/
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la karti ka dang, ma drug bu, mang po skyes bcas so,
hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bcu drug nas bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar la smin drug zla ba zer/
mig gi smin lpags bsgul nas gtong ba'i brda/
(tha mi dad pa) tshad du son pa'am legs par grub pa/ na tshod smin pa/ lo 'bras legs par smin pa/ ma smin pa'i gzhon nu ma/ lag len byas nas nyams myong yongs su smin pa/
mig gi smin ma gnyis kyi bar/
mig gi smin ma gnyis kyi bar/
mig steng gi spu/ gnag snum gyi smin ma 'jam po/ khong khro bzas nas smin ma gzengs pa/
