'phags yul nas bzo skrun byas pa phyis rgya nag tu gdan drangs te rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su gsol ba'i tsan dan gyi thub pa'i sku brnyan zhig /
tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po

dkon zhing rin che ba'i tsan dan zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la skye can dang, khyab 'jug skyes, sngo sangs, til 'dab can, stong gsum rin gyis gzhal med shing, rna ba nag po, ba glang mgo, beed'urya'i mdog can, rma gso, lag 'gro'i snying po bcas so,

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag la tsha ba zhugs pa dang, khrag ngan 'phel ba, khrag rlung 'thab pa sogs la phan, phyir byugs na yan lag gi skrangs pa 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la ku tsandan, til mar can, 'dab ma'i lus, snum ldan, pa tangga, tsandan dman pa, tshos byed, rakta tsandan, sa'i tsan dan bcas so,
tsan dan dmar po rigs gnyis kyi nang nas mdog dmar smug shas che ba zhig ste, nus pa tsan dan dmar po dang mtshungs/
seng ldeng rigs gsum gyi nang tshan mdog tsan dan ltar dmar ba zhig /
rgya gar pa tsandra go mis brtsams pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos sngar nas bod skad du bsgyur pa 'di'i dpe rgyun da lta'ang dar yod pa/

gtum mo'i rnam grangs gsum ste, rang bzhin tsanda l'i zhes pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid phyi'i gtum mo dang, gtum mo tsanda l'i zhes pa lte ba'i a thung nyid nang gi gtum mo dang, kha sbyor tsanda l'i zhes pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen kha sbyor zung du 'jug pa nyid gsang ba'i gtum mo rnams so/
tsan dra pa'i yi ge'i mdo
slob dpon tsandra go mis mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos shig /
(legs) spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs byung ba'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge bsnyen zla ba zhes pa'o/
blo bag mi phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur/ las ka tsab be tsub be ma byed/ skad cha tsab be tsub be bshad na nyan mkhan gyis gsal por go mi thub/ yi ge tsab be tsub be bris na nor yong/
bzod glags med pa'am, brel tshub chen po byed pa'i rnam 'gyur/ brel ba langs nas tsab tsab byed kyin 'dug /
tsab be tsub be'i bsdus tshig
brel zing gi rnam pa/ las ka tsab tsob byas na nor 'khrul 'byung/
sems tshab pa'am brel tshub langs pa/ las ka byed rgyu mang drags nas tsab langs pa/
brel tshub tshub/ tsab ling nge bar las don sgrub bzhin yod pa/
lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, ro lan tsha la skyur, nus pas pho ba'i drod nyams pa dang, zas mi 'ju ba, khog pa sbos brgyangs byed pa sogs la phan/

/ 1) skor dang, lta bu ste tshad 'dzin pa'i tshig grogs shig / don gnad zur bstan pa tsam gyis rtogs pa/ na tsha cung sdug tsam du song 'dug / kha dog dmar tsam 'dug / sbyong brdar ji tsam mang ba de tsam gyis goms shas che/ tshogs 'dur gzhug mkhan mi brgya tsam byung/ za che ba ri bo tsam, 'thung mang ba rgya mtsho tsam/ 2) kho na ste don gzhan 'gog pa'i tshig grogs shig / ming tsam/ sems tsam/ khang pa tsam las sdod mkhan med/ spyi'i phan bde yid kyi yul tsam du'ang mi 'char ba/
shing sman gyi rigs gang bu nas thon pa'i son gshog pa can me tog dkar po lta bu zhig ste, nus pas tshad pa sel/
dngos min dang, tshad ldan ma yin pa/ gtan tshigs tsam po ba/ rigs pa tsam po ba/
dngos po sogs sa thog tu sdeb gcig min par nar nar zags tshul/ ca lag tsar tsar thebs nas zags 'dug / mi tsho tsar tsar tsar la yong gin 'dug /
'phro can nam lhag lus/ las ka byed 'phro tsar re bzhag pa/
1) kham bu'i tshi gu/ 2) byi ba/
mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi a mdo rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/

(legs) me yi 'khor lo'am blo skyong ste shing sman gyi rigs shig ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas skran 'joms shing, me drod skyed, 'or nad, gzhang 'brum, srin nad, mdze nad bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la sirpanytsa dang, trug trug thang shing ngar pa, me stobs, tsha ba, sreg byed, me 'dra, tsha dbal bcas so,
ka mgo sogs kyi rgyan du brkos pa'i byi la'i mgo lta bu'i srog chags sna leb can gyi gzugs ris shig /
1) 'bru'i rigs khre rgod/ 2) byi ba/ tsi tsi ram pa za bar za lugs dang, a bra thang la rgyug par rgyug lugs/
byi ba'i rigs shig ste, 'phur shes la so yang yod pa'i bya min byi min zhig /
(rnying) lo gnyis par slebs pa'i ra phrug /
(legs) yid bzhin nor bu ste 'jig rten du shin tu 'byung ba dkon pa'i rin po che zhig nus pas lus la 'chang ba tsam gyis nad gdon 'joms shing, bsam don 'grub par grags/
1) mi rkang pa gcig pa'i yul/ tsu ta'i yul du slebs pa na, rkang gnyis pa la mir mi rtsi/ 2) rin po che'i bye brag cig / , a mra'i shing/
sha ro dang, rgyus pa, rus 'dzer sogs 'don byed kyi skam pa 'jab rtse'i dbyibs can zhig /
sman dpyad kyi yo byad cig /
gang/ ci tsug byed/ khyed kyis de skad gsungs pa ci tsug lags/
skabs kha'i rkan nas thon pa'i sgra'i khyad: par zhig /
1) sems mi g.yo bar brtan por 'dug tshul/ 2) (rnying) thams cad/
tser tser zhes pa'i sgra sgrog tshul zhig / shing lo'i gseb tu bya byi'u mang po'i skad tse re sgrog pa/
sgra'i khyad par zhig / na zug che skabs skad ngan tser tser du shor/
slel po ste smyug gshags sogs bslas pa'i sa rdo sogs blug snod/
sdod stangs sam bzo dbyibs krong nge ba'i rnam pa/ mi zhig tsog ge bar bsdad 'dug / ri bo tsog ge ba zhig mthong/ khang pa tsog ge ba zhig brgyab 'dug /

gyen 'greng gi bzo dbyibs shig / mi nyal bar tsog pur sdod pa/ 'bru rigs tsog pur spungs pa/ ri bong tsog pur sdod pa/ ri bo tsog pu/ mchod rten tsog pu/ 'gro zhum bu las mkhas pa dang, sdod ri bong las tsog pa/
1. 1) rdo/ 2) rdung byed kyi rdo gtun bu/ 2.tsog pu dang 'dra,
tsog pur sdod mi thub pa/ skyes ma thag pa'i byis pa tsog mi tshugs pa/ bye phung gyen du spungs kyang tsog mi tshugs pa/
tsog tsog krong krong gi tshul

/ rkub stegs steng du tsog tsog byas nas sdod pa/ ri chung tsog tsog cig la dar lcog btsugs/ khang pa tsog tsog cig la dkar rtsi btang ba/ gdan gyi steng du tsog tsog pur sdod pa/ khang brtsegs tsog tsog pu zhig brtsigs 'dug /
spyir mtsho sngon po'i shar phyogs kyi rma chu'i rgyud kyi sa ming rnying pa gyi thang zer ba de dang, bye brag tu mtsho sngon zhing chen hong krung rdzong khongs sku 'bum dgon pa yod sa'i ming/

bzang grags pa: bod kyi dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' srol gtod pa po yin zhing, rab byung drug pa'i me bya lor mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du 'khrungs, khong gi yab la ta dben rgyal rabs kyi dus su ta ra kha che zhes pa'i go gnas thob, rang lo bdun la rab tu byung ba dang, bcu drug la dbus su phebs, rig gnas dang bka' pod lnga sogs la thos bsam sgom gsum dang, mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la dag ther nan tan mdzad, zhal slob shakya ye shes t'a ming rgyal po'i drung du sku tshab tu btang, de nas shakya ye shes la byams chen chos rje zhes pa'i 'ja' sa byung ste rgya bod dbar gyi 'brel lam dam po tshugs, sa glang lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo btsugs, dga' ldan dang bde chen gsang sngags mkhar phyag btab, ser 'bras dang rgyud grwa stod smad 'dzugs pa'i bkod pa mdzad, lam rim dang sngags rim sogs legs bshad kyi gsung rtsom rgya cher spel, rgyal tshab rje dang, mkhas grub rje, dge 'dun grub sogs slob ma mang du bskrun/
rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig chu 'go mtsho sngon po'i byang 'gram nas byung ste shar phyogs su zi ling grong khyer brgyud de mthar kan su'u zhing chen nas rma chur 'bab/
krong krong/ ri dwags kyis ske tsong tsong byas nas lta/
khrag gtar byed kyi gtsag bu/
lce rtsar gtsag bu rgyag skabs rtsa mi 'gyur ba'i ched du lce gnon byed kyi yo byad cig /
(tha dad pa) gtsags pa, gtsag pa, gtsogs,, gshag pa dang, gtar ba'am, bkas nas 'don pa/ khrag gtsag pa/ gtsag bus lus la gtsags te ngan khrag bton/
nad khrag phyir 'byin par byed pa'i lag cha ste, nang gses su dbye na sta re'i kha 'dra sogs rigs mi 'dra ba drug mchis/ rma 'bras smin par gtsag bu rgyag pa/
mig dmar po chags pa, mgo gzer ba, snying mi bde ba, pho srin glang 'thab, mo nad khrag tshabs na ba bcas la rus steng du rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig /
mchin khrag smug po rgyas pa dang, grang ba bcas na bar chu rgyus gseb tu rgyag byed kyi yo byad cig /

/ 1) sa dmar/ 2) rdo sman zhig tshos la'ang 'jug / mtshal rang la bzhag btsag mi la re/ btsag dang bsdebs na dmar, rams dang bstun na sngo/ ming gi rnam grangs la me lce ba dang, tshon chen, le brgan me tog bcas so,

gtsag pa'i 'das pa, gtsang/ 1) bod dbus gtsang gi zlas phye ba'i nub phyogs nyang ljongs kyi yul/ 2) (rnying) shing bsgrigs kyi ra ba ste, shing phra sbom ran pa 'dom do ba sogs mang po bstar bsgrigs su bskor ba zhig /
dri ma gtsang sel byed pa'i khrus/ zhogs pa re re bzhin gdong dang lag pa gtsang khrus byed pa/
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa gtsang gzhis ka rtse'i sa khul du yod pa'i mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
rtsa chag byung ba:/ khral rgyug mi dgos par gtsang chag byung song/
1) gtsang po'i chu/ 2) gtsang gi sa cha brgyud nas 'bab pa'i chu bo/ 3) chu gtsang ma/
chos grags rgya mtsho: rgya mtsho rnam gsum gyi ya gyal skar rtsis la mkhas par grags shing, de'i slob ma nor bzang rgya mtsho, phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho bcas rgya mtsho rnam gsum mo/
phud mnyams shing btsog pas ma sbags pa'i mchod pa/ lha la gtsang mchod 'bul ba/
gtsang chu rgyug pa'i nang gnas pa'i nya ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes cung bsil, nus pas zas 'ju, yi ga 'byed, bad kan smug po la phan/
dag pa'am lhag ma med pa:/ gad snyigs rnams rtsa med gtsang dag bzo ba/
dus tshod rdzogs pa'i skabs/ gung seng gtsang dus phyir log yong ba/
gtsang phyogs nas btags pa'i snam bu/

ye shes rdo rje: rab byung gsum pa'i lcags mo sbrul gyi lo gtsang myang stod khu le'i yul du 'khrungs, gdung rus rgya bya ba'i rgyud yin, dgung lo nyer gnyis par grub chen gling ras pa bsten pas de'i bu chen du gyur, klong rdol dang ra lung dgon pa btab, slad nas zhe drug lo dbus phyogs gnam gyi phur 'brug dgon pa phyag btab, tsa ri'i gnas sgo phye, slob brgyud bzang po ches mang du 'phel bas mi phyed 'brug pa, 'brug phyed sprang po, sprang phyed grub thob ces grags, rang lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags lug lor 'das/
gtsang pa bstan skyong dbang po

dus rabs bcu bdun pa tsam la bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan zhig yin pa 'dis karma bka' brgyud kyi zhwa dmar ba dang jo nang pa'i grub mtha' la rgyab skyor dang dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' la sdang po byas pas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta lor gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bzung nas bkrongs/

tsong kha pa gshegs rjes dga' ldan khri pa byed mkhan gtsang pa kho na yin pa'i rgyal tshab rje dang, mkhas grub rje, zha lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan, blo gros chos skyong, ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan, blo gros brtan pa, smon lam dpal ba ste bdun/

chu klung chen po/ ming gi rnam grangs la gling ldan ma dang, rgyun ldan, ngogs ldan, chu rgyun, nya lcibs can, 'bab chu, mtshor 'bab, g.yo ldan, rlabs ldan bcas so, gtsang po 'phred bcad, gtsang po'i tshu rol nas pha rol tu thad kar bcad pa/ mi rkyal rtsal can gyis gtsang po 'phred bcad kyis 'gro ba/
1) tshangs par spyod pa'am rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa/ 2) (yul) gsang spyod/
bu lon sogs cha tshang 'jal ba/ g.yar dngul rnams gtsang sprod byas zin/
'bru rlung la phyar te gad gtsang bzo ba/
/ yul lung gtsang 'phrog / khyim nang gi rgyu nor gtsang 'phrog byas pa/
/ 1) dag pa/ bu lon gtsang ba/ dus sgo gtsang song/ 2) gtsang ma dang 'dra,
(mngon) 1) me/ 2) rtswa ku sha/ 3) brgya byin/
1) yi ge'am ri mo gtan 'bebs kyi gtsang bshus/ zin bris zhu dag btang nas gtsang bris byed pa/ 2) gtsang pas 'bri rgyun gyi ri mo'am yi ge'i rus/
1) gtsang ma dang btsog pa/ 2) yi gar 'ong ba dang, yi gar mi 'ong ba/
(rnying) grwa pa'i zas kyi zhal ta ba/
khrus dang byi dor gyi bya ba/ gtsang sbra la dang dod byas pa/ gtsang sbra yag po byas pa/ gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten/

1.dri ma dang nyes pa sogs kyi skyon med pa/ sa cha gtsang ma/ spyod pa gtsang ma/ lto chas gtsang ma/ skyed tshal gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba/ sgrigs lam gtsang ma bzo ba/ bsam pa gtsang ma/ 2.(mngon) hor zla lnga pa/
bsam gtan bzhi pa'i lha ris shig /
'phags pa kho na gnas pa'i lha yul lnga ste, mi che ba dang, mi gdung ba, shin tu mthong ba, gya nom snang ba, 'og min bcas so/
hor zla lnga pa'i mar ngo nas zla ba drug pa'i yar ngo rdzogs pa'i bar gyi ming/
dri ma med pa'am gtsang ma dang, dri ma can nam btsog pa/
gtsang sman ye shes bzang po

lha sa lcags po ri'i gso rig 'gro phan gling gi sman pa mkhas chen zhig ste, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i smad tsam du rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang, pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal gnyis kyis mdo smad du ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi bla sman du btang bas, lo shas ring bla sman pa mdzad de rjes su mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas sman pa grwa tshang btsugs, rdo rje rab 'byams dang, sog po mer gan em chi blo bzang dar rgyas sogs slob ma mang po bskyangs, bka' rtsom yang sman sbyor gces bsdus dang, byang khog yul thig rtsa 'grel sogs mdzad, gso rig rgyud bzhi'i khrid rgyun dang sman ngos 'dzin gyi skor sogs lag len dmar khrid srol gtod pa sogs mdo smad byang rgyud du gso rig la mdzad rjes shin tu che zhing da lta'i bar du phyag len de dag gi srol rgyun ma nyams par gnas so/
yid du 'ong ba dang, skyug bro ba/
rtsis khams dwangs rgyag pa/ lo 'khor gyi byung song tshang ma gtsang rtsis rgyag pa/
gtsang la bzos pa'i zon pa/
1) gtsang pa'i lag rgyun gyi yi ge dang, ri mo 'bri gzugs/ 2) gnas gtsang ma'i lha gnas/
sngar chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan skabs bod kyi sad mi mi bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
1) gtsang nas thon pa'i shog bu/ 2) shog bu gtsang ma/
gad snyigs sogs gtsang mar bshang ba/ chu sbubs 'gags pa gtsang bshang byed pa/
chu gtsang mas dri ma'i lhag ma dag par bkru ba/ skra dang gos bkrus te gtsang bshal btang ba/ dkar yol gtsang bshal byed pa/
yi ge dang ri mo dpe ji ma ji bzhin gtsang mar bris pa/ ma zin gzhir bzung gis gtsang bshus byas pa/ gzugs ris ma dpe'i steng nas gsar pa zhig gtsang bshus byas pa/
mthar thug par bsher ba/ mdzod khang du nyar ba'i dngos rigs gtsang bsher byed pa/
rnyog rdul mi gtsang ba'i rigs med pa/ sa cha gtsang sing nge ba zhig la ngal gso ba/
lhag ma med par bzo ba/ skyon cha tshang ma gtsang sel bzos pa/ dka' tshegs gtsang sel/ lugs ngan gtsang sel/ bu lon gtsang sel/
mtshon gyis btsab sa'i mas gdan/
sha rus rtswa shing sogs dum bur gtub sa'i shing stan lta bu/
(tha dad pa) btsabs pa, btsab pa, gtsobs,, zhib mor gtub pa/ sha gtsab pa/ shing btsabs pa/
rtsis mthong ngam rtsa 'gangs/ gtsigs chen po,
/ lag rtsal bsgyur bkod la gtsigs ha cang chen po byed pa/ skyon dang nor 'khrul phran bu tsam gyi rigs la'ang gtsigs chung ma byed/
rtsis mthong/ bzo las dang zhing las gnyis kar gtsigs snang chen po byed pa/ gtsigs snang chung ba/
(tha mi dad pa) mche ba phyir gnyer ba/ stag mo khros nas kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa/ mche gtsigs sder bgrad/
gces shing phangs pa'am, rtsa ba chen por 'dzin pa'i bsam pa/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi hur sems la gtsigs blo dam por 'dzin pa/
gces gces phangs phangs/ rgyal khab kyi 'dzugs skrun ma dngul gtsigs gtsigs byed pa/
rtsis mthong che ba/ phan tshun dga' zhen gyis gtsigs su che ba/
gtsug mgo'i spyi bo'am rtse mo
1) bya bye'u'i spyi gtsug gi sgro spu/ 2) zhwa mo'i gtsug sgro/
mgo'i spyi bor rang chas su skyes pa'i sha'i gtsug tor ram, skra bcings pa las byung ba'i bcos ma'i gtsug tor/
rig sngags kyi khro rgyal zhig /
«shikhinra» sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa
dbur gtsug tor ldan pa'i mtshan bzang dang don gcig
gdugs dkar mchog grub ma dang de las gsungs pa'i lha mo/
gtsug tor gdugs dkar dang, gtsug tor dri med, gtsug tor rnam rgyal, gtsug tor 'bar ba, gtsug tor phur bu rnams so/
rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs las byung ba'i lha mo/
1) gtsug rgyan gyi nor bu/ 2) mchog tu gyur pa dang, bla na med pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gtsug nor du brtsis pa/
1) skra'i thor cog gi rtse dang ral pa mdud pa'i zur phud/ 2) skra'i lan bu'i sne/ 3) rab byung gis thog mar 'breg rgyu'i skra phud/ 4) (mngon) lha dbang phyug chen po/
skra lan bu'am lcang lo 'khyil mo can/
(mngon) 1) 'jam dbyangs/ 2) seng ge / gtsug phud can, (mngon) 1) skar ma du ba mjug ring/ 2) khron pa/ 3) drang srong bye brag pa zhig / 4) me/ 5) rma bya/
1) bya de'i mgo sha'i ze prog / 2) zhwa yi tog
spyi gtsug tsam khebs pa'i zhwa mo zhig /
hor mo'i spyi gtsug tu 'dogs pa'i g.yu rgyan/
sngar bod kyi lha lcam gyi mgo rgyan bye brag cig /
dam gsung rab:/ sman gyi gtsug lag / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtsug lag / brda sprod pa'i gtsug lag /
dkon mchog gi lha khang/ lha sa gtsug lag khang/
na gnas pa'i sde: sngar rgya gar gyi nyon thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
srid srung dang, nges brjod, mchod sbyin, snyan tshig ste phyi rol pa'i rig byed bzhi/
brda sprod gtsos tha snyad kyi rig gnas tshang ma/
'brad rdar byed sa'i mas gdan gyi shing/
(tha dad pa) gtsubs pa, gtsub pa, gtsubs,, 'brad pa'am rdar ba/ gtsub gtan steng du gtsub shing gtsubs nas me byung ba/ tsan dan bsil ba yin mod kyi, gtsub par gyur na 'bar bar 'gyur/
brdar nas me 'don byed yas mas kyi shing/
me 'byin pa'i shing yas mas gnyis/

(tha dad pa) gtses pa, gtse ba, gtses,, gnod pa'am sun par byed pa/ rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags la gtses pa'i nyes pa/ mi dmangs kyi khe phan la gtse ba'i log spyod pa/ ra lug la spyang kis gtse ba/ tshig rtsub kyis mi'i sems gtse/
sman dpyad kyi yo byad cig /
(tha dad pa) rna ba sun par byed pa/ don med ku co mang pos rna ba gtser bar byed pa/ mi tshogs mang du 'dus nas ca co'i sgras gtser ba/
rna ba gtser zhing sems sun par byed pa'i brdabs gsigs/ rang 'dod khog bcangs kyis gzhan la gtser sun byas pa/ sa bdag gis mi ser rnams la gtser sun tshad med btang ba/
lha dang mi'i gtso bo dang, de'i rjes 'brang/
gtso gnad che ba/ las don gtso gal che rigs/
sngar rdzong gzhis 'og gi yul lung so so'i 'go pa'am 'go byed/
gal che ba'am gnad che ba/ las 'gan gtso che ba/ lcags lam gtso che ba/ zhing btab skyes dngos gtso che ba/
sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung sger chos: gsum gyi gzhis ka khag gi gzhis sdod dang brgya tsho rgan po'i ming
don mang po'i nang nas gcig dmigs su bkar nas 'don pa/ sngon du bsam blo'i skor gyi gnad don gtso 'don byas nas thag gcod pa/ de ring nyams myong phyogs sdom bya rgyu'i thad gtso 'don gyis bshad pa/
drag pa dang, dkyus ma/ las byed pa gtso phal/

/ 1) spyi khyab dang, rje bo/ khong gtso bor byas pa'i 'thus mi tshogs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyad thon dang, mgo ma, sngon ma, mchog gyur, mchog tu byung ba, dang por gyur pa, dam pa, drag shos, phul byung, phyi phyed min pa, bla na med pa, rtser thon, rtser byung, gzhan khyad can, rab, rab rtsom bcas so, 2) gnad dam, snying po/ rgyu rkyen gtso bo khyod la thug 'dug / don gyi gtso bo bstan nas bshad song/ 3) grangs can pas rdul mun snying stobs gsum cha mnyam pa'i gnas skabs kyi rtsa ba'i rang bzhin zer ba 'bras bu thams cad kyi rgyu byed pa shin tu lkog tu gyur pa zhig yod ces sgro btags pa de'o/
rang gi 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung yod pa'i rnam rig rnam shes tshogs drug la sogs pa'o/
ri dwags shig lus chung zhing rwa co ring ba, de'i rwa co me mda' 'degs spyad dang gur 'bubs spyad byas chog cing, sman rigs shig kyang yin/
srog chags las byung ba'i sman zhig ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas 'khru ba gcod, skye rgyun 'gog
ri dwags gtsod phrug gi a ma/
gtsod kyi rwa co las bzos pa'i gzhu/
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro lan tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas zla mtshan mi snyoms pa dang, mngal du khrag skran 'dril ba, bu ro lus pa, khog pa bshal ba sogs la phan/
gcig gtso bor bton te gzhan rnams zhar la go ba'i bsdus tshig gam, khyab byed kyi tshig / nas kyis gtsos pa'i 'bru rigs/ bal gyis gtsos pa'i yul zog /
shing la tshon gdan dang po btsag dang spyin bsres te gtong rgyu'i ming/
tshon dmar po yod sa'i rdo/
dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshag pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
