dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshag pa'i 'das pa,
gtsang mar btsags zin pa'i 'bru rigs/
bar gseb tu 'dzud pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshang ba'i ma 'ongs pa,
bar gseb tu 'dzud pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshang ba'i 'das pa,
'dre'i nang gses shig / ri btsan/ chu btsan/
dbang shed kyis bkol spyod/ 'u lag btsan bskul/ grwa 'phyags btsan bskul/ btsan bskul bkas bcad/
1) khang pa sra zhing mkhregs pas rang bzhin la 'dzul dka' ba/ 2) mi ma yin btsan zhes pa gnas sa'i rten khang/
mi 'dod bzhin khrid pa/ gzhan gyis btsan khrid byas nas gzhan yul du phyin pa/ jag par btsan khrid/
sngar gyi rmongs dad ltar bzos pa'i lha btsan gyi gos/
po'i 'gag mdo:/ btsan 'gag 'di nas cis kyang brgal thub pa byed dgos/
mi ma yin gyi bye brag cig /

deng dus kyi ma rtsa'i ring lugs yin zhing, sger sdom ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyang zer, de ni ma rtsa'i ring lugs 'phel rgyas phyin nas tshad mtho shos dang dus rim mjug shos la slebs pa zhig dang, spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje 'byung nye'i dus yin/
med pa'i skad cha:/ gsham 'og tu btsan ngag phab pa/

sngar bod rgyal nyer bzhi pa to re long btsan dang, nyer lnga pa khri btsan nam, nyer drug pa khri sgra dpung btsan, nyer bdun pa thog rje thog btsan, nyer brgyad pa tho tho ri gnyan btsan te rgyal rabs lnga po spyi'i ming/
btsan thabs kyis thag gcod byed pa/ rtsod gnad byung rigs la bden min gsed bkrol zhib tshags byed dgos pa las btsan gcod byar mi rung/
(rnying) bod rgyal gdung rabs so lnga pa mang srong mang btsan skabs kyi blon chen zhig yin zhing mgar stong btsan gyi bu che ba'o/
bod rang skyong ljongs lho kha rtsed thang gi nye 'dabs su yod pa'i lha khang zhig /

1) dbang shed/ btsan thabs kyis 'phrog pa/ btsan thabs chu brgal byed pa/ dgra bo la btsan thabs kyis phar rgol byas nas mkhar rdzong bzung ba/ 2) glo bur/ mi mang po da nangs btsan thabs su slebs pa/
1) bong nga nag po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig / 2) nad cig /
ri bo zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho byang bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rkang tsha rdzong du yod/
snga dus 'jig rten gyi btsan la bsngo ba'i yas mdos/
dbang shed thub tshod kyi gnod 'tshe/ nyes med btsan gnod byung ba'i mi la rogs ram byed pa/
1.rgyal po/ 2.gnyan po ste bgrod dka' ba dang, 'da' ba'am, sgyur mi nus pa/ mkhar rdzong btsan po/ sa chu btsan po/ khang pa btsan po/ bka' btsan po/ chod yig btsan po/
kha drag shugs gnon/ byed mi 'dod pa'i las btsan po dbang yod kyis bskul ba/
dbang dang rgyu nor gnyis ka tshang ba/
kyis 'phrog pa:/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi ser spel yul nas rgyu dngos thon khungs btsan 'phrog byed pa/
mi 'dod bzhin du dpya khral 'gel ba/
lha dang 'dre zhes pa'i gzugs med kyi dmag dpung/ bar snang btsan dmag stong gis bskor/
mi min gyi 'dre mi dmar rta dmar gyi btsan rigs/
gzhan gyi sa char dbang shed kyis 'dzul ba/ gzhan gyi mnga' khongs la btsan 'dzul byas pa/
nang du thar dka' ba'i mkhar btsan po/
rgyal btsan sogs khog zhugs skabs gyon rgyu'i zhwa mo/
gzhan gyi sa khang mi phyugs sogs dbang shed kyis bzung ba/
kha drag dbang shed/ btsan shugs la brten nas btsan 'dzul byas pa/
btsan shugs/ btsan shed log g.yem/ gzhan la btsan shed kyis las ka bskul ba/
nyer 'tshes mi tshugs pa'i sa'am, gnod pa byed mi thub pa'i sa cha/

rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho ngos dang rgyal rong rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de grong rdal me zhing du yod/
chu chen chu'i chu lag cig si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi btsan lha rdzong du yod/
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tsham pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tsham pa'i 'das pa,

/ 1) lcags rigs la bzha' tshan sogs phog nas chags pa'i g.ya' ser zhig / gri ma brdar bas btsa' brgyab 'dug / 2) rtswa shing rigs la byung ba'i nad skyon zhig / lo tog la btsa' brgyab nas thon 'bor nyung du phyin pa/ 'bras ldan shing la btsa' brgyab nas yal 'dab tshang ma ser por gyur 'dug
lo tog gi gnod skyon btsa' dang than pa/

1.(tha dad pa) 1,gces srung/ thos pa ba rnams kyis dpe cha mig ltar btsa' ba/ 2,btsas pa, btsa' ba,, mig gis ha re lta ba dang bya ra byed pa/ spyan ras btsa'/ spus kar mig btsas pa/ nyin mtshan ltos med sa mtshams kyi gnas tshul la mig btsas pa/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) btsas pa, btsa' ba,, skye ba/ zla grangs tshang nas bu phrug btsa' ba/
lcags rigs sogs btsa' skyon can/ lcags btsa' ma/
skye zug / phru gu skye skabs btsa' zug ha: cang che
pa'i sdug bsngal: 'dod pa'i dngos po btsal kyang ma rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
1) tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tshal ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2) 'tshol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
rtsad gcod dam 'tshol zhib/ phyugs rdzis ra lug gar song btsal 'tshol byed pa/ rang gi skyon dang nor 'khrul 'byung rtsa gar yod btsal 'tshol byed pa/
gla cha/ gru btsas/ la btsas/
lo tog la btsa' yis gnod skyon btang ba/ zhing la sa bon 'debs skor byas nas btab na lo tog btsa' yis mi 'khyer ba'i khyad yod/
btsas ma dngos gzhi rnga ba'i skabs/ btsas chen langs nas mi rnams brel zing gis mi khom pa/
1) phru gu skyes rjes gshom pa'i ston mo/ 2) btsas ma brngas tshar ba'i rjes kyi spro skyid ston mo/
dus brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste btsas nas 'khogs pa'i bar spyi la'o/
smin zin bsdus chog gi lo tog / ston dus lo tog btsas ma brnga rgyu dgos na dgun dpyid dbyar gsum zhing las ma g.yengs hur po gyis/ ston thog btsas ma ma lang ba/
phru gu skyes pa'i zla ba/ btsas zla yol zin kyang da dung phru gu ma skyes pa/
1) pad kha sogs las snum 'don thabs shig / 2) sngar khrims chad gtong lugs ngan pa zhig /
cha bdun thur ma'am skyes bu rkang gcig btsugs pa'i grib ma/
dgun dus kyi mal gzan spu ring can
btsugs phrug gi spu ring shos/ btsugs shing, mis btsugs pa'i shing/
1.sgo gsum gyi kun spyod zhi zhing dul ba'i grwa pa spyi dang, grwa pa'i zhe sa/ 2.sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod spangs pa/
grwa pa sdom pa mi srung mkhan/
sngar rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs mdo sde pa'i slob dpon zhig /
btsun pa bslab pa rgan pa
sdom pa sngon la blangs pa'i grwa pa/
btsun pa bslab pa gzhon pa
sdom pa rjes la blangs pa'i grwa pa/
/ 1) tshul khrims ldan pa'i mi/ 2) rje bo/

rgyal po'i chen ma dang chung ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye rgu'i bdag mo dang, rgyal mo, rgyal rigs chung ma, rgyal rigs ma, jo mo, rje mo, 'dren pa mo, pho brang 'khor ba, 'phags ma, mi bdag mo, sa spyod ma bcas so,
rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gras shig /
byang lugs kyi brag spos dang zur lugs kyis brag skya ha bo la ngos 'dzin mdzad/
zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs kyi bzhugs tshul/
grwa pa'am a ne'i cha lugs/
kha mig zum par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'dzum pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
kha mig zum par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'dzum pa'i 'das pa,
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tshem pa'i ma 'ongs pa,
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tshem pa'i 'das pa,
(yul) phyugs kyi grod pa'i nang du yod pa'i zas kyi snyigs ro/
1.'tshod pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.nad gzhi bcos thabs shig
tshos rgyag mkhan nam tshos pa/
gser dngul sogs 'dul thabs/ gser btso sbyang byas nas lhad bton pa/
/ 1) li khri skyer kha bsres pa'i mdog / 2) yang yang bzhu btul byas nas byung ba'i dngos rigs lhad med kyi zhun ma/ gser btso ma/ zangs btso ma/
sha sogs btso snod kyi rdza ma/
dme btsog las byung ba'i grib kyi rnam grangs shig
btsog snang ngam mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa/ zhing lud gsog 'don gyi las ka byed dus btsog lta grib dogs gang yang mi byed pa/

1.rdeg pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshog pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.mi gtsang bar go ba'i ming rkyang ste skyag pa/ rang dbang med par btsog pa shor ba/ khyis btsog pa btang ba/ btsog pa rang gi am phrag tu nyar, mi la dri ma kha mdog byed/ 3. dbre ba dang, dme ba ste mi gtsang ba/ gyon pa btsog pa/ lto chas btsog pa/ las ka btsog pa/ spyod pa btsog pa/ skad cha btsog pa/
1. 1) (yul) rgod po dang, gyong po/ pho btsog po/ 2) mi gtsang ba/ 2.(mngon) rdo/
'bru rigs rlung la rags tsam 'phyar ba/ nas btsog 'phyar byas nas snyigs rnams 'don pa/
btsog pa/ gyon gos btsog dme'i rigs chu la gtsang mar 'khru ba/
rdeg pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshog pa'i 'das pa,
phar 'tshong rgyu'i ja/ dar mdo nas btsong ja rta drel la bkal te lha sar 'tshong du 'gro ba/
sman la 'jug rgyu'i btsong gi rtsa ba/

/ 1) shing rgyu las byung ba'i tshos dmar po zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la bkra ba'i 'dab can dang, dpag tshad 'dab, sbal pa'i lo ma, le brgan bcas so, 2) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo tshad dang, mkhal tshad, 'grams tshad bcas la phan/
nyes can bkag 'jug byed sa/ bzang btson/ nyes btson/ tshe btson/
btson pa 'jug khang/ ming gi rnam grangs la khri mun dang, 'khrul 'khor khyim, 'ching khyim, til mar ra ba, btson ra bcas so,
rgyal khab nas btson pa yongs rdzogs sam mang che ba gu yangs sam, bab yang gis glod pa/
nyes can btson khang du sdod rgyun ring gyon rgyu'i gos/ sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs btson pas gyon pa'i gos de tshur bshus nas btson chas hrul gyar zhig g.yog srol yod/
btson khang du 'jug pa/ nag can 'dzin bzung gis btson 'jug byed pa/
1) btson du bcug pa/ 2) ang yig la mu khyud kyi re khas bskor ba/
btson la 'jug pa'i dus tshod/ btson dus tshang nas glod 'grol btang ba/
sa 'og tu yod pa'i btson khang/
do dam byed yul gyi mi/ nyes can btson par khrims gcod byed pa/
btson par do dam byed mi/
btsos zin pa'i dngos po/ sha btsos ma/ bza' chas btsos ma/
gtan la phab zin pa 'gyur ldog mi byed pa'i dpe/ kha mchu'i gyod gzhi thag chod zin pas slad btsos sha rjen log gi gleng rnyog bshad mi chog /

1. 1) srog gnas pa'i rtsa ba ltar gyur pas na rtsa zhes zer te, de la nang gses su dbye na, rlung khrag gnyis 'doms kyi 'phar rtsa dang, mi 'phar ba'i sdod rtsa, rtsa dkar ram chu rtsa sogs mchis so/ nad pa'i rtsa la reg pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'dab ldan dang rus 'ching ngo, 2) nye 'gram/ khang pa'i rtsa la shing btsugs/ ri'i rtsa la chu zhig yod/ kho'i rtsa la slebs pa/ 3) dri chen nam phyi sa/ 4) rgyud las gsungs pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i rtsa ni gtso bo dang 'dab ma'i tshul gyis spyi bo nas gsang gnas sogs su 'khor lo'i rnam par gnas pa'o/ 5) (mngon) mi'i gzugs por rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo drug ste rtsa la dgu yod pas grangs dgu mtshon/ 2. grangs ka nyer gcig nas nyer dgu'i bar so so'i mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig grogs shig / nyi shu rtsa bzhi/
klad pa las gyes pa'i nang du khrag mi rgyu ba'i rtsa dkar po ste, nus pas mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga'i yul du gzugs la sogs pa rnams bdag tu 'dzin par byed/
klad pa las gyes pa'i lus kyi rtsa dkar ram dbang rtsa'i cha shas la phog pa'i nad cig /
«ra sa n'a» lus kyi rtsa gsum gyi g.yon ma/
gdang la'i lho rgyud nas byung ba'i 'bab chu zhig yin zhing, bod rang skyong ljongs khongs a mdo rdzong dang dpal mgon rdzong brgyud nas ser gling mtshor 'bab/
phru gu skyes rjes kyi nad cig /
rtsa ba'i khungs/ gtam bshad na rtsa khungs 'khyol ba bya dgos/
rtsa nang nas rgyu ba'i khrag lam 'gog pa/ rtsa kha'i stod cha dam por bsdams nas rtsa khrag sdom pa/
1) rtsa gzhung rkyang pa'i bshad khrid/ 2) nad pa'i rtsa lta tshul gyi khrid/
rgyal khab kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i khrims lugs shig ste, de la khrims lugs kyi nus pa bla na med pa zhig yod pas, bca' khrims gzhan dag gtan 'bebs byed rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa de yin/
lus rtsa rengs pa/ grum bu'i nad kyis rtsa 'khums pa/
rtsa gnas 'khor lo lnga dang don gcig
rtsa gnas 'khor lo bzhi'i steng du gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo dang nor bu'i dbus kyi 'khor lo bsnan pas drug /
rtsa gnas 'khor lo bzhi dang don gcig
spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo, mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo, snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ste gsum/
'phar rtsa stobs chung ba/ lus stobs shor nas rtsa gud pa/
rtsa ba nas dgongs 'khrol/ las byed pa de gzugs khams ha cang zhan pas rtsa dgongs zhu dgos byung ba/
rtsa ba'i ma dgon/ rtsa dgon 'bras spungs su grwa pa bdun stong bdun brgya yod/
(yul) lha mo bas rnam thar gtong dus mgyogs por thong zhes pa dang, mdor bsdus thong zhes pa'i gab tshig /
skyag pa 'gags nas gtong mi thub pa/ nad gzhi'i rkyen gyis rtsa 'gags 'dug /
rtsa ba'i gal gnad/ las don rtsa 'gang che ba/ rgyal kha su la 'thob min gyi 'gag gnad rtsa 'gang che shos shig dang thug pa/ yig rigs rtsa 'gang chung ba/
1) rtsa ba nas 'byin pa/ shing sdong rtsa 'gog btang ba/ 2) rtsa ba nas bkag pa/ khrims lugs dang mi mthun pa'i mgo bde glags tshong rgyag rgyu'i spyod ngan rtsa 'gog byed pa/
dpe cha'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa/ de skor khyod kyis rtsa 'grel la ltos/
1) dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal dum bu dang po gso ba rig pa'i rtsa ba lta bu thugs kyi rgyud de le'u drug yod pa'i sman gzhung tshad ldan zhig / 2) gsang sngags bla med rgyud sde'i rtsa rgyud/
pa rgyud don rab gsal: rab byung bzhi pa'i nang brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa shin tu rgyas shing go sla ba zhig /
rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu bzhi
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu bzhi ste, rdor dbyings dang, khams gsum rnam rgyal dang, ngan song sbyong ba dang, don grub rnams so/
dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal rtsa ba'i rgyud la rtsa ba dang, yal ga , sdong po rnams shing thur dang, lo ma rnams rde'u mdog mi 'dra ba bkod nas 'grel bshad rgyag thabs shig /

dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal rtsa ba'i rgyud la rtsa ba gsum, sdong po dgu, yal ga zhe bdun, lo 'dab nyis brgya dang rtsa bzhi, me tog gnyis, 'bras bu gsum bcas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi tshul du bkod nas 'grel bshad rgyag thabs shig /
bde mchog rtsa rgyud rgyas pa/
lus kyi rtsa dang rgyus pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs stod lung phu'i 'brom ston 'khrungs yul/
rtsa ba'i cho ga nas sgrub pa/ thog mar rtsa sgrub gong bzhin bya/ re'u mig 'di ltar bzung bas rtsa sgrub bzhin 'khrul med shes/
yi dam rang rang gi rtsa ba'i sngags/
rbad de chag pa'am rtsa ba nas chag pa/ khral rigs rtsa chag gtong ba/ bogs ma rtsa chag phyin pa/ skyed ka rtsa chag byas pa/ nyes chad rtsa chag btang ba/
1) bshang gci/ nad kyis rkyen pas rtsa chu 'gags pa/ 2) sman pas nad brtag thabs kyi nang tshan lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i 'phar rtsa dang, chu khams kyi snyigs ma dri chu/
1) rtsa ba chen po'am rtsa 'gang chen po/ dngos po 'di rtsa chen yin pas bdag sprod yag po byed dgos/ 2) lus kyi rtsa che chung nang gi che ba/
don snod nang 'brel gyi sbas pa lta bu'i rtsa chen brgyad dang, yan lag phyi 'brel gyi mngon pa'i rtsa chen bcu drug bcas dril bas nyer bzhi'o/
lus kyi rtsa yo ba'am 'khyogs pa/ gzugs po 'gyel brdabs shor nas rkang rtsa 'chus pa/
gnyen nye 'brel/ rtsa 'jing mang po yod pa'i mi/
sems brtse ba'i gnyen tshan dang grogs po/
gnyen dang nye du sogs mang zhing rgya che ba/ rang mgo rang gis mi 'don par rtsa 'jing sdug pa phun tshogs la re bas ci phan/
dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab dang, dbu ma 'jug pa, dbu ma bzhi brgya pa bcas so/
rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa ste, nyon mongs kyi rten gzhi'am rtsa bar gyur pa/
nyon mongs can gyi lta min lnga dang, lta ba lnga bcas bcu'o/
sems byung nga gcig gi nang gses, ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags dang, khong khro dang, nga rgyal dang, the tshom dang, lta ba ste drug go /
grum bu rigs shig ste, rtsar babs pa'i grum nad cig ste, nad rtags su glo snying mi bde ba dang dpyi yi sta zur gyi sha chad snyam byed pa, rtsa rnams sbos la sra zhing na ba zhig
rbad de med pa bzo ba/ dgra dpung rtsa gtor du btang ba/ bshu gzhog lam lugs rtsa gtor byed pa/
lag pa'i rtsa lta ba/ em chis nad pa'i lag rtsa bltas nas nad gzhi tsha grang gang yin dbye 'byed byed pa/

sngags sdom gyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste, ljon shing gi rtsa ba ltar bsrungs na lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i rtsa ba yin zhing, ma bsrungs na ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i dbang gis phyi ma gnas 'og nas 'og tu ltung bar 'gyur bas rtsa ltung zhes bya'o/

sngags sdom gyi rtsa ba'i spang bya bcu bzhi ste, rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas pa dang, bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa, rdo rje'i spun la 'khu ba, byams pa 'dor ba, byang sems 'dor ba, chos la smod pa, gsang ba sgrog pa, phung po la brnyas pa, rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la the tshom za ba, mngon spyod bya bar 'os pa'i yul la byams pa, ming dang bral ba'i chos la rtog ges blos 'jal ba, dad ldan sems sun 'byin pa, dam rdzas ji bzhin mi bsten pa, shes rab mar smod pa bcas bcu bzhi'o/

byang sems kyi rtsa ltung bco brgyad de, bdag bstod gzhan smod dang, chos nor mi ster ba, shad sbyangs mi len zhing gzhan la 'tshog pa, theg chen spong zhing dam chos 'drar snang ston pa, dkon mchog gi dkor ma byin par len pa, dam pa'i chos spong ba, rab byung la 'tshe ba, mtshams med byed pa, log lta 'dzin pa, gnas 'jig pa, snod min la zab mo bshad pa, theg chen las bzlog pa, so thar spong ba, nyan thos kyi theg pa la skur ba 'debs pa, mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba, dkon mchog gi dkor byin pa len pa, khrims ngan 'cha' ba, byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba bcas bco brgyad/
spyod lam drag po ma bsten gong gi rtsa 'phar stangs/
mi phyugs dang rgyu dngos tshang ma zad pa/ 'di gar chu log ha cang chen po byung nas yul lung rtsa stongs su gyur pa/
rtsa 'phar stangs lta ba/ em chis rtsa brtag pa/
1) thog mar bkod pa'i thig bcad/ 2) rtsa rlung dang thig le'i bsdus ming/
lhag ma med par 'thor zin pa/ dgra bo'i btsan rdzong la me sgyogs phog nas rtsa 'thor du phyin 'dug /

sgra gcan gyi rtsa ba ni go la'i gzhir rang 'gros g.yas skor tshul gyis spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la, gdong ni go la'i gzhir g.yon skor gyi tshul du spyod pa ste nyi zla gza' 'dzin shes pa'i ched nyi zla'i spyod tshul dang bstun pa yin pas rtsa gdong gnyis don la khyad med do, mjug ni gza' dus me la de ltar brjod/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho nub ngos dang glang chen kha 'bab kyi chu rgyud na yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de mtho lding du yod/
mdud pa ltar gyur pa'i rtsa/ rtsa mdud thebs nas na ba/
rtsa mdud med pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa 'grol ba nyid kyis rtsa mdud pa med pa/
1) rtsa rgyu sa'i mdo 'gag / 2) rtsa lta stangs kyi gzhung/
(yul) lha mo bas rnam thar thong zhig ces pa'i gab tshig /
rtsad gcod pa/ bden rdzun gyi rtsa brdar gcod pa/ 'thus shor gyi khag 'gan sur 'khri rtsa brdar gcod pa/

1) nang du khrag rgyu ba'i lus kyi rtsa spyi la zer te, de la nang gses su dbye na snying nas thur du rgyu ba'i 'phar rtsa dang, snying la phyogs nas gyen du rgyu ba'i mi 'phar ba'i sdod rtsa dang gnyis mchis so/ 2) rtsa lam la skyon zhugs nas byung ba'i nad kun/

bud med kyi zla mtshan rgyun ldan ltar thur du ma babs pa rlung dang chu ser lhan du bsdongs nas lus kyi rtsa'i nang byer ba la rtsa nad ces zer te, de yang glo ba dang, snying, mchin pa, mtsher pa, mkhal ma, mkhris pa, rgyu ma, 'o tshabs, nu tshabs, khrag tshabs gor pa bcas khrag tshabs bcu dang, mgo dang, rus pa, snying, mkhal ma, pho ba, rgyu ma bcas kyi rlung tshabs drug bcas bsdoms pas bcu drug go /
gnad chen por thug pa'i don rtsa/ lus kyi rtsa gnad/ las don gyi rtsa gnad/
dbu ma la brten pa'i rtsa 'dab rnams kyi dbyibs 'khor lo ltar yod pa'o/
rtsa gnas 'khor lo bzhi'i steng du gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis can bsnan pa'o/

gsang sngags su gsal ba ltar rtsa'i gtso bo gsum las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab rnams te, spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis dang, mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad, lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi bcas kyi bdag nyid can no/
rtsa ba'i dpon po ste, bran g.yog sogs rang bdag gi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan/
rab byung bdun pa'i nang zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rtsa brtag thabs kyi skor bshad pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
rtsi shing dang sngo tshal gyi son rtsa spos pa/ shing son rtsa spos rgyag pa/ me tog bkog nas gzhan du rtsa spos rgyag pa/

/ 1) rtswa dang shing sogs kyi rkang pa'am sa 'og tu yod pa'i sdong bu/ shing gi rtsa ba spom phra tshang ma sa 'og tu brgyugs nas yod/ dug rtswa'i rtsa ba bkog pa/ sdong po khog nang nas rul na, rtsa ba rang bzhin gyis gog yong/ 2) rten gzhi'am rmang gzhi/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rtsa ba brtan po tshugs zhin pa/ thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs de bshu gzhog dar ba'i rtsa ba red/ 3) gzhi ma'am 'byung gzhi/ chu'i rtsa ba/ dmag 'khrug gi rtsa ba/ nor 'khrul rnams rtsa ba nas legs bcos gtong ba/ nad ro rnying pa rtsa ba nas 'byin pa/ 4) gtso bo dang, lte ba'am, gnad/ bzo las kyi rtsa ba'i 'dzugs skrun/ rgyal pham gyi rtsa ba/ 'char gzhi'i rtsa ba/ 5) bshad bya'i rtsa gzhung/ gzhung rnying gi rtsa ba phal cher go khag po 'dug
gal chen nam 'gangs chen/ las don rtsa ba chen po/ dngos nor rtsa ba chen po/

sor sdom gyi rtsa ba'i bslab bya ste, srog gcod pa dang, ma byin len pa, mi tshangs spyod pa, mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba bcas bzhi ni rab byung gi sdom pa'i rtsa ba yin la, de nyams na sdom pa rtsa ba nas 'jig pas rtsa ba bzhi zhes bya'o/

dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa shes rab ces bya ba, sher phyin dngos bstan gyi stong nyid de, zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rnam dpyod rigs lam gyis ston pa'i gzhung, rgya gar gyi slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'o/
sum cu pa dang don gcig
rtsa ba gsum ste, bla ma dang, yi dam, mkha' 'gro ste gsum/
gzhi lhun grub rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor te, ye shes 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo/
dkar po dang dmar po sogs rtsa bar gyur pa'i mdog go /
sngo, ser, dkar, dma bcas bzhi'o/
mkhris pa lnga dang don gcig

dge slob ma'i bsrung bya drug ste, gcig pur lam du 'gro ba dang, chur rkyal ba dang, skyes pa la reg pa dang, de dang lhan cig 'dug pa dang, pho mo phan tshun smyan byas pa dang, zla mo'i nyes pa 'chab pa spong ba ste drug go/
rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug
rtsa nyon drug dang don gcig

rgyud sde gong 'og thams cad kyi thun mong ba'am rtsa bar gyur pa'i sngags kyi sdom pa bzhi ste, 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang, dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang, byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa dang, dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rnams so/
sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang, 'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal, khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bcas gsum mo/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa ste, 'od srungs nas brgyud pa phal chen sde pa dang, sgra gcan 'dzin nas brgyud pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa, ka ty'a ya na nas brgyud pa gnas brtan pa'i sde pa, nye bar 'khor nas brgyud pa mang bkur ba'i sde pa bcas bzhi/
rlung dang, mkhris pa, bad kan, khrag chu ser, srin bu bcas drug /
rang nyid kyi pha ma dngos/
bad kan lnga dang don gcig
rang la dbang khrid man ngag gnang ba'i thun min gyi bla ma/
legs sbyar skad kyi rtsa ba'i dbyangs a i u ri li e ee o oo bcas dgu/ a i u ri li...e ee o oo...
mngar ba dang, skyur ba dang, kha ba dang, bska ba dang, tsha ba dang, lan tshwa ste drug /
'byung lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi rlung/
mi'i lus la rgyu ba'i 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi rlung ste, srog 'dzin gyi rlung dang, thur sel gyi rlung, gyen rgyu'i rlung, mnyam gnas kyi rlung, khyab byed kyi rlung bcas so/
lus kyi rtsa lam gtso bo yar sne lus kyi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas mar sne gsang gnas bar yod pa'i dkyil gyi rtsa zhig /
1) rtsa'i thog gam nye sar skrangs shing zug 'byung ba'i 'bras kyi nad rigs shig / 2) sman zhig /
1) bshal sman btang ste khog nad rtsa med bzo ba'i sman bcos shig / 2) khrag dang, mkhris pa, dug nad sogs rtsa la zhugs pa'i nad rnams dri chu'i lam nas phyir sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs shig /
rtsa'i tshor ba nyams pa/ rkang pa yun ring bskums nas bsdad pas sgyid pa'i rtsa sbrid pa/ gshags las ma byas gong du sbrid sman btang bas rtsa sbrid pa/
rtsa mi mngon pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, lus la sogs pa'i las dang 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs pa nyid kyis rtsa mi mngon pa/
lus kyi rtsa lam mam rtsa sgo/ gzugs po'i khrag rgyun khog stod khog smad kyi rtsa mig 'grims pa/
rmeg med dam gtan med/ rtsa med gtsang dag bzo ba/ rtsa med shul med gtong ba/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog rtsa med du btang ba/ nang 'dzul byed pa'i dgra bo rtsa med bzos pa/
(yul) rtsa la chags pa'i rmen nad/
(yul) chags pa spyod yul ma rnyed pa'i rkyen gyis smyo ba/
rtsa ba dang rtse mo/ shing gi rtsa rtse rgyas pa/ lo tog gi rtsa rtse smin pa/ gnas lugs yong rkyen gyi rtsa rtse khungs chod pa/
1) kun gyi mthong yul du 'grems yig / sgrigs khrims blang dor gyi rtsa tshig ..dmangs sems bde bar byed pa'i rtsa tshig / 2) rtsa 'grel zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i tshig /
(yul) nyis srub bam nyis tshem ste, sbyor tshem dang gnon tshem gnyis/
tshad dam gzhi 'dzin sa ste mdzub ston gyi nus pa thon pa'i yig cha la zer/
rtsa bar bzung nas dus gtan du rgyun 'khyongs byed pa/ rtsa tshig gi nang don rnams rtsa 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs byed pa/
rtsa bar bzung nas 'gyur ba mi gtong ba/ rtsa ba'i rtsa don rnams rtsa 'dzin g.yo med byed dgos/
rlung nad rigs shig spyi bo 'dzin pa zhes pa'i rtsa la zhugs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su spyi gtsug gi sha mdog nag por 'gyur ba zhig /
sgrig 'dzugs te, dmigs yul dang khongs gtogs nges can zhig gzhir bzung nas btsugs pa'i tshogs pa/
rtsa ba nas zhib 'jug nan tan byed pa/ gnad don rnams la rtsa zhib nan tan byed pa/
si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dkar mdzes rdzong gi la zhig /
gtan nas mi dgos par chags pa/ bu lon rnying pa rtsa yang btang ba/ nyes chad rtsa yang btang ba/
1) sngar mnga' bdag gi bu dang bu mo mna' ma dang mag par gtong dus ster ba'i g.yog po g.yog mo/ 2) snga dus bran g.yog bdag pos rang khongs mi ser gras nas bkug ste nyar ba'i g.yog po/
1) rtsad gcod/ nyes can su yin rtsa ra gcod pa/ bor stor song ba'i dngos po rtsa ra gcod pa/ 2) tsa ra dang 'dra,
lus kyi gtso bo'i rtsa lam gsum gyi g.yas pa/
tshe mi 'gyur zhing srog mi 'gag pa'i rnam par shes pa'i rten te, de yang rtsa khyim lta bu dang, thig le nor lta bu, rlung sems bdag po lta bu dang gsum mo/
1) gzhi 'thor ba dang, med par 'gyur ba/ bshu gzhog lam lugs rtsa brlag gtong ba/ 2) snying don shor ba/ don med tshig lo la yengs nas gtso don rtsa brlag tu song ba/
1) gnyen nye du/ dgra bo rtsa lag dang bcas pa zil gyis mnan pa/ 2) rtsa ba dang yan lag / 3) rtswa shing gi rtsa lag /
1) lus kyi rtsa lam/ 2) bshang lam/
klu sgrub kyis brtsams pa'i rtsa ba shes rab kyi bsdus ming/
1) rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/ 2) rtsa ba dang 'grel pa'i bsdus ming/
rtsa ba nas bshig pa/ dgra mkhar rtsa bshig btang ba/ log spyod pa'i sgrig 'dzugs rtsa bshig btang ba/

1) lus kyi rtsa ro ma dang, rkyang ma, dbu ma gsum/ 2) chos byed pa la rtsa ba gsum yod de, byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma dang, dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha, bar gcod srung ba'i rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas so/
bla ma dang, yi dam, mkha' 'gro gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/
spyod pa 'chol nyog tu gyur pa ste, bag med kyi bya bas bcas khrims las 'das pa'am ral ba'o/
sa cha zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtsa mda' rdzong khongs su yod/
lus kyi rtsa gyong po chags pa/
slog pa ste lug che ba'i pags pas bzos pa'i gos/ dgun grang ba'i sgang tsha ru las rtsag pa drod che/
dngos po chung chung/ las don rtsag rtsig / tshong zog rtsag rtsig /
/ 1) tsher ma/ 2) shing skyer pa phra mor bshags nas gtor ma'i mtha' skor du khra ma lta bur btsugs pa'i thur ma rnams kyi ming/ 3) (rnying) 1, rnyi/ 2, chang/

/ 1) 'bu rmigs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la bkra ba dang, khyim ldan, rgyal ba thu bo, nyin so ba, da byid, mdung can, mig sman rtswa, ral gri can, bshol ldan, sog le can bcas so, 2) lus nang gi yan lag gi rlung lnga'i cha shas shig /
(yul) brag la gnas pa'i srog chags rmigs pa/
/ 1) rtsa ba/ dug gi sdong po rtsad nas gcod/ 2) thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas sha dug dang, sbrul dug sogs dug tshad la phan/
rtsa ba'i phugs/ gnad don de skor rtsad khungs ma chod par da bar lus song/
rtsa ba zhib gcod/ gter kha rtsad gcod/ rgyu rkyen rtsad gcod/ rtsad gcod thig len/
rtsad gcod zhib 'jug / sa dbyibs rtsad zhib byed pa/ rtsad zhib brtag dpyad/
sngo sman zhig de'i rtsa ba'i nus pas zug gzer zhi ba dang, rngul chu 'byin pa, dri chu 'bebs pa sogs la phan/
/ 1) bar srub 'gog byed/ 'gul skyod byed pa'i cog rtse'i 'og tu shing rtsab chug cig / 2) (yul) rtsa ba'i bsdus ming/ rtsa ba/ 'bru dngul tshang ma 'gro song gis rtsab bcad 'dug /
'dul ba las bshad pa'i bcas ldan dge slong gis longs spyad du rung ba 'bras khre sogs btsos nas phab ma btab par mnan pa'i khu ba'o/

1) rang rdol tshabs chen/ gyon pa rtsab hral/ 'doms ras rtsab hral/ sgo yol rtsab hral/ dpe cha rtsab hral/ 2) btsun tshugs nyams te spyod pa gang byung byed mkhan la smod tshig / grwa pa rtsab hral/ btsun ma rtsab hral/ dge slong rtsab hral/
zho'i ru rtsi'am chang gi phabs rtsi/
rtsam pa blug snod khug ma/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsam khral sdud len byed mkhan gyi las khungs dang, de'i las tshan pa'i go ming/
rtsam pa btab nas bskol ba'i thug pa/
nas sogs 'bru rigs la chu brgyab nas brngos te btags pa'i phye ma/ sran rtsam/ dmangs rtsam rtsing po/ bar rtsam/ mchod rtsam/ rtsam pa khag theg bul gyis byed, lhags pas khyer na khyer mnyam yin/
'bru rigs la chu ma brgyab par btags pa'i rtsam pa spus zhan/
1) rtsam pa phyi la gsho ba/ 2) ngo bstod byed pa'i dpe/ mi la ngo bstod kyi rtsam pa gsho ba'i sprel lad byed pa/
snga dus kyi rtsam pa'i phogs/
shing las grub pa'i rtsam snod par bu/
rtsam pa blug sa'i bang ba/
1) thug pa'i kha thal/ 2) rtsam pa cung zad tsam/ gos la rtsam rtsi gos pa/

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig der do dam pa las tshan rim pa lnga pa ser skya gnyis dang, gnyer pa gnyis bcas yod, las 'gan ni, mchod rgyun khag la rtsam pa'i dod dam, rtsam pa ngo gtong byed rgyu, gzhung gi mdzad sgo che khag la dkar spro gtong rgyu, lha ldan smon lam chen mo dang tshogs mchod la dge 'dun rnams kyi nang nas rtsam pa len mkhan la rtsam pa dang rtsam pa mi len mkhan la rtsam dod sprod rgyu bcas yin, las rgyun ni lo gsum re yin/
1) rtsam pa za mkhan/ 2) rtsam pas bzos pa'i zan gyi rigs/
rtsam pa blug sa'i snod zom/
long ga g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du dbye ba'i dbus sam steng du yod pa'i cha shas/
skam brngos kyis btags pa'i rtsam pa spus zhan/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, rtsa mi mngon pa dang, rtsa mdud med pa'o/
nad rkyen gyis mkhrang por gyur pa'i rtsa/
rgyud las lus kyi dbus na rtsa'i gtso bo gsum gnas par gsungs pa de sgal tshigs kyi 'dabs 'byor na yod de, ro ma, rkyang ma, kun 'dar ma'am dbu ma zhes bya'o/
rtsa ra gcod pa ste dri rtsad byed pa/
nus pa'am stobs/ lus rtsal 'gran pa/ ngag rtsal sbyong ba/ rig rtsal phul du byung ba/ gshog rtsal ldan pa/ rang gi nus rtsal bton nas rang 'khri'i las 'gan sgrub pa/
rnal 'byor lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rnying gzhung rnams su, mthar lam du slob pa'i zung 'jug gi yon tan gyi rtsal mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i phyir rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/

1) nan tan nam dmigs su bkar ba/ tha snyad kyi dbye ba rnams rtsal bton gyis bshad pa/ ya rabs kyi bya ba rtsal 'don byed/ 2) nus shugs 'don pa/ mi dmangs kyi bde don du rang nus gang yod rtsal 'don zhu ba/
lus sems kyi nus rtsal dang, stobs shugs/ gzugs stobs che yang rtsal stobs chung/
nus rtsal shin tu che ba/ mi rtsal po che la 'gran mi thub/
lus rtsal gyi bye brag dper na, mthon por mchongs pa, shing rtser 'dzegs pa, mgyogs por rgyug pa lta bu/
lus sems kyi nus shugs/ ri chen 'dzeg cing, chu chen rgal ba'i rtsal shugs che ba/
/ 1) kha dog dang, ro bcud sogs la phan byed kyi rdzas shig / tshon rtsi/ bkrag rtsi/ rgya rtsi/ zhag rtsi/ chang rtsi/ bdud rtsi/ sbrang rtsi/ dmar rtsi/ 2) (mngon) sman/
sa cha zhig da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs zhin ha'e rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/
bzang por rtsi zhing gong du bkur ba/ mi kun gyis rje bor rtsi bkur zhu ba/
(yul) gsar du spar ba'i dpe shog rnams gcig tu bsdams nas khod snyoms brad brdar byas te mtha' rtsi gtong rgyu'i glegs bam/
(yul) glegs bam gyi mthar tshon rtsi gtong dus glegs bam sdom byed kyi pang leb/

1) tshon rtsi dang, bkrag rtsi sogs dngos rigs kyi kha dog sgyur ba dang, sra bar byed pa'i rtsi rigs kyi khu ba/ 2) rdza chu'i yan lag cig ste, mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi skye rgu grong rdal gyi lho nub phyogs su yod/
sman shing kun gyi ming, srin nad sel, kha zus 'ju/
rtsis 'jog ste mthong chen byed pa/ mi gzhan kyi bsam 'char la rtsi 'jog byed pa/
sman zhig ste chu ma rtsi'i ming gzhan zhig /
rtswa dang lo tog sngo ldum sogs kyi 'bras bu'am sa bon/
mthong chen po byed pa/ ngal rtsol grub 'bras la rtsi mthong byed pa/ sger gyi khe phan la'ang rtsi mthong byed dgos/

(yul) gla ba pho'i mjug ma brdar ba, gla ba pho 'khor langs dus rtag tu sa cha nges can zhig gi rdo la rkub brdar bar brten rngon pas tshul de'i gzhir bzung nas dong rnyi btsugs te 'dzin pa'am gsod pa/
tshon dang sra rtsi sogs dngos gzhi ma btang gong du gtong ba'i rtsi zhig /

(tha dad pa) brtsis pa, brtsi ba, rtsis,, 1) grangs ka rgyag pa/ byung song btsi ba/ zhing ga'i rgya khyon zhib tshags su brtsis pa/ 2) cha 'jog pa dang, lta ba/ rang gi skyon cha yon tan du brtsis na mi 'grig pa dang, mi'i yon tan skyon du brtsis na'ang mi 'grig / 3) 'byung 'gyur bya byed kyi bsam blo gtong ba/ grong gseb la 'gro rtsis yod/ ltad mo lta rtsis med/
tshon rtsi btang ba'i lcags dang shing sogs kyi dngos spyad rigs/ phor pa rtsi ma/ rta sga rtsi ma/ cog tse rtsi ma/
rtswa dang sngo ldum sogs rtsi thog gi bcud myangs pa'i phyugs rigs las byung ba'i mar/
1) tshon rtsi dmar po/ 2) byu ru'i ming/
re skon gyi ming gzhan zhig /

nad 'joms shing lus gso ba'i rtsi bcud dang ldan pa'i sman te, de la nang gses su dbye na ga bur lta bu shing las byung ba dang, gla rtsi dang, dom mkhris, dbang ril lta bu srog chags las byung ba, gur gum lta bu sngo las byung ba, brag zhun lta bu rdo las byung ba bcas ma nges so,
1) rtswa dang, shing sogs skye dngos/ 2) 'bras bu can gyi shing/
khang pa'i phyi nang gang rung gi rtsig pa'i zur khug / khyi rtsig khug tu bkar na kha log brgyab yong/
rtsig pa rtsig byed kyi rdo/

1. (tha dad pa) brtsigs pa, brtsig pa, rtsigs,, rtsig pa rgyag pa/ rdo gru bzhi brtsigs nas chu rags rgyag pa/ bya rog tshang rtsig / 2. mkhar khang gi rtsig pa/ rdo rtsig / phag rtsig / gyang rtsig /
khang pa'i nang du bcad rgyag pa'i rtsig pa/
rtsig pa'i phyi logs nas 'bur du btod pa'i rtsig pa/
rtsig pas bskor ba'i ra skyor/
(yul) bska ba/ thug pa rtsig po/
rtsig pa'i ngos kyi zhal ba/ rtsig zhal brgyab nas 'jam po bzo ba/
khang pa'i phyi nang gang rung du 'bur la thon pa'i sne'am gru/
rtsig pa'i ngos kyi yol ba/
yang dag pa'i chos lugs dang mi mthun pa'i lta ba dang spyod pa/
zhib min rags pa dang, rtsub po, gyong po/ gro zhib rtsing po/ rig pa rtsing po/ gshis rgyud rtsing po/
spyod pa gyong po'am ma rabs kyi spyod pa/ rgyun du rtsing spyod kho na byed mkhan phru gu rnams legs par gcun dgos/
zhib zhib min pa'i rtsam pa dang gro phye/
ma thul ma zhi ba'i bya spyod rtsub po'i g.ya' 'am bag / mi 'di rtsing zhad che tsam 'dug /
rtsing po dang zhib mo/ rtsam pa rtsing zhib/ blo gros rtsing zhib/
rags tsam bzos pa'i dngos zog /
rtsid pas bzos pa'i skud pa/ rtsid skud kyis re lde 'tshem pa/ rtsid skud kyis g.yag ro drud/
g.yag sogs kyi rtsid pa 'breg byed kyi gri/
gyong po min pa'i rtsid pa/ rtsid 'jam las bzos pa'i thag pa/
rtsid pa'i nang tshangs can gyi gdan/
phyugs rtsid kyis bzos pa'i thag pa/
'bri g.yag sogs kyi lus zhol spu ring/ 'brong rtsid/ g.yag rtsid/
phyugs kyi rtsid pa'i phyar ba/ phyur ba rlon pa rtsid phyar gyi steng du nyi mar skams pa/
phyugs kyi rtsid pa'i phying pa/
ra phrug lo gnyis lon pa/
lo gnyis lon pa'i mo ra/
lus kyi rtsib ma phra mo/
1) brang 'dabs kyi rtsib ma thung ba'i gras/ 2) lus kyi gsang gnad cig /
glo g.yas g.yon gyi rus thur/
1) rtsib ma dum bur bcag pa/ 2) (yul) lkog rngan sprad de 'dod don 'grub thabs byed pa/
lus kyi stobs shor sha khrag skam ste rtsib ma 'bur du thon pa/ nad kyis mnar te lus stobs shor zhing rtsib ma hrang hrang du phyir mngon pa/
rtsib rus phan tshun gyi bar mtshams/
rtsib ma la zug gzer rgyag pa/
lus kyi rtsib ma'i g.yas g.yon gyi 'gram logs/
'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi lcags ri'am, mtha' skor/
(yul) 1) zur khug dog po'i sgo/ 2) 'khor lo'i rtsibs/
rtsibs ma stong yod pa'i 'khor lo/
'khor lo sogs kyi lto ba rgyong bar byed pa'i nang sgrom/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ nyi gdugs kyi rtsibs ma/ ko gru'i rtsibs/

1. rtsi ba'i skul tshig 2./ 1) grangs rtsi byed kyi thabs sam rig pa/ sngon thon mi sna rtsis las 'das pa zhig byung yod pa/ zhing las thon skor gyi rtsis rgyag pa/ tshod rtsis 'debs mi dgos/ rtsis rtsi ba/ lo rtsis/ 'byung rtsis/ sngon rtsis/ nges rtsis/ 2) grangs su rtsi ba'am gtong ba'i ming/ da yod gnas tshul la rtsis chen yang byed dgos la sngar byung nyams myong la'ang rtsis chung byed mi nyan/
karma rang byung rdo rjes rab byung lnga pa'i sa rta lor brtsams pa'i rtsis gzhung zhig /
rtsis kyi yi ge'i las lnga
anggi, phri, bsnan, bgod, bsgyur bcas/
rtsis kyi gzhung lugs sam rtsis rig ste, bsgyur bgo snon phri bzhi'i sgo nas grangs sna tshogs shes byed kyi thabs sam shes yon/

1) nor rdzas 'gro 'ong rtsis rgyag mkhan las khungs/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sa mi nor phyugs 'bru dngul khral bogs sogs gang ci'i gtong yong rtsis rgyag mkhan las khungs che ba zhig der rtsis dpon rim bzhi bzhi, rtsis pa bzhi, yig tshags gcig rtsis phrug pa brgyad bskos yod/
rtsis brgyab pa'i tho yig / rtsis khra bsher ba/
ji tsam dgos pa'i grangs tshad kha tshang ba/ 'bru rtsis grangs longs pa zhig /
rtsis 'phro dang 'das lo mang ba'i hor khongs mi 'byung ba dang, ri mo thung na stabs bde ba'i ched du yin, rtsis 'phro dang 'das lo'i thad la'ang ltos/

gzhung 'chad thabs shig ste, bstan bcos rnams 'chad skabs, rtsom pa gang gis mdzad pa, khungs gang las btus pa, phyogs gang du gtogs pa, dgos ched gang yin pa, dbu nas zhabs su bsdu ba'i don gang yin bcas lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa'o/
cha 'jog gtsigs su byed pa/ thun mong gi chod don la rtsis 'jog byed pa/ dge rgan la pha ma ltar gyi rtsis 'jog byed pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gzhis 'bangs sogs la 'tsho rgyur rtsis sprad pa'i rta/
grangs ka rtsis rgyag pa'i thabs sam tshul/ sgyur sgril gyi rtsis thabs/ sgyur 'then gyi rtsis thabs/
rtsis rgyag legs par zin pa/ rtsis dag phud pas da ni blo ha cang bde po 'dug /
rtsis legs par brgyab zin pa/ lo gcig khyud khor gyi byung song rtsis dag zhus pa/ gzhung don du 'gro ba'i lam dngul rtsis dag zhus pa/
rtsis sprod len gyi yig deb/
'dor len byed pa/ khe gyong rtsis gdab mi gtong ba/
tshod rtsis byed pa/ khe gyong tshod rtsis 'debs pa/

/ 1) grangs 'bor rtsis rgyag mkhan/ 2) skar rtsis 'byung rtsis rtsi mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la skar dpyad pa dang, bskal pa shes, grangs rig grangs shes, ltas mkhan, ltas shes, dus shes, mtshan ma mkhan, gza' skar mkhan, lo shes bcas so,
gtsigs po che'am mthong chen po/ pha lam dang gser sogs dngos po rtsis po che rnams mdzod du bdag gces byas yod/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rtsis khang gi las ka'i 'go dpon/
rtsis 'khri'i dngos po phar sprod pa/ gzhung gi ca lag rtsis sprod byed pa/ las 'gan rtsis sprod/
phar rtsis sprod pa dang tshur rtsis len pa/ snga phyi 'khor res rtsis sprod rtsis len gyi gra sgrig 'thus tshang byed dgos/ rtsis sprod rtsis len gyi 'gro lugs gtsang dag byed pa/
sngar rtsis khang gi slob grwa ba, dpon rigs skya bo rnams slob grwa 'di nang slob gnyer byas nas slob thon pa byed dgos/

sngar gza' tshes kyi longs spyod stong par zhugs rjes nges pa slar brtsams pa nas da lta'i bar gyi rgyun mi 'chad cing, dus dang yul longs la 'das lo mang ba'i hor khongs mi 'byung ba'i ched du brtsi bya'i zla tshes gang yin de'i thog ma yan gyi 'phro bral dhru wa'i longs spyod ji tsam 'das pa bsdoms te sbyin dgos shing, rgyud las ma 'ongs rab byung re re'i 'gor rtsis 'phro spo dgos par gsungs so, rtsis mgo bstung ba'i thad la ltos/
mthong med dam cha 'jog med pa/ rtsis med rdog rol/ rtsis med snang chung/ 'dra mnyam min pa'i chings yig rtsis med du gtong ba/
1) 'bor grangs brtsi rgyu'i rtsis kyi don gnad/ 2) ji byed kyi bsam blo/ 'byung 'gyur gyi rtsis gzhi cang med/
1) rtsis thabs kyi dpe cha/ 2) rtsis pa'i yig cha dang khra ma/
rtsis gzhung mkhas pa dga' byed
bu ston rin chen grub kyis rab byung lnga pa'i me stag lor brtsams pa zhig /
rtsis gzhung nyin byed snang ba
smin gling lo chen dharma shris rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta'i lor brtsams pa zhig /
sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos lor brtsams pa'i rtsis gzhung zhig /
rtsis rdel sgrig snod kyi gzhong pa'i ming/
rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal zhig de la skar rtsis, bstan rtsis, dbyangs 'char gyi rtsis, 'byung rtsis sogs mang/
rtsis 'khri'i dngos po tshur len pa/ rgyu dngos rtsis len/ las 'gan rtsis len/ rtsis len bdag sprod/

rtsis kyi skor la bdar sha bcad pa'am rtsis zhus btang ba/ mdzod khang du yod pa'i dngos rigs la rtsis bsher gtong ba/ phyir gtong nang 'dren gyi dngos zog la rtsis bsher byed pa/ zla re'i 'gro song la rtsis bsher zhib 'jug byed pa/
grong khyer lta na sdug pa'i lho phyogs su yod pa'i rdzing bu lo ma sogs kyis brgyan pa'i gnas su sleb pa tsam gyis shes pa rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal zhig /

/ 1) 'jam po'i ldog phyogs/ ras rtsub po/ snam bu rtsub po/ rtsam pa rtsub po/ mar kha rtsub po/ pang leb rtsub po/ 2) ngan pa'am mi bde ba/ 'gro lam rtsub po/ snga ltas rtsub po/ 3) gtum po dang yid du mi 'ong ba/ skad cha rtsub po/ bya spyod rtsub po/ gshis rgyud rtsub po/ rtsub po'i tshig gis bsdigs pa/ 4) skya ba dang, 'byar bag med pa/ sman gyi nus pa rtsub pa/ sman gyi yon tan rtsub po/
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed yul la ltos med kyi tshig rtsub brjod pa'i sgo nas 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse drung/
rdzong zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho rgyud na yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de bya dir du yod/
mchog gam rab/ byas rjes rtse gra/ mi rtse gra/ shes rab rtse gra/
rab kyi phyogs/ tshong zog rtse gras/ sa zhing rtse gras/ ras cha rtse gras/
me mda'i rtse la bsgar bya'i gri/
rtsed mo rtse ba'i dga' ston/
sngar hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin rtse rnam grwa pas gar 'cham dang 'brel lo mjug gtor zor 'phen pa'i dus ston/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse 'gag gi mgron gnyer/

sngar rtse po ta la'i gzims chung 'gag nas t'a la'i bla ma'i bka' rnams brgyud bsgrags dang, gsham 'og gi snyan seng zhu 'bul byed mkhan las khungs shig der mkhan chung mi gcig dang rtse mgron las tshan pa mi bcu drug gzims 'gag mi bzhi bcas yod/
1) gad mo dang lhan cig rtsed mo rtse ba'i bag yangs/ na gzhon pho mo rnams rtse rgod la rol ba/ 2) (rnying) lha 'bangs dang g.yog po/
lo gsar skabs rten 'brel mchod rdzas gro so phye mar steng 'dzugs rgyu'i shing byang gi ngos su mar mtshon gyi bkra shis ri mos brgyan pa'i rtse sgro/
blo rtse gnyis med pa/ sems rtse gcig tu bzhag pa/ bsam pa rtse gcig gis bya ba sgrub pa/
sems gnas dgu'i brgyad pa, 'bad med du 'jug pa'i phyir 'bad pa rtse gcig tu byed pa'o/

rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu lag cig chu 'go mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rtse khog rdzong nas byung ste ho nan sog rigs rang skyong rdzong brgyud nas rma chur 'bab/

1) 'jing pa'i ming/ 2) sgrog rus nas gyen du sor bzhi gzhal ba'i gnas su rtsa gsum mthong na dbus ma dang, gnyis mthong na phyi ma rna shal gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na klad srin dang, glo tshad, snying tshad, so na ba, byang khog stod du khrag rgyas pa sogs la phan/
mgo gnon pa dang, rno gcog pa'am nus pa nyams par byed pa/ sta re'i rtse 'jil ba brdegs pa/ khong khro'i rtse 'jil ba/ nga rgyal gyi rtse bcil ba/
rtse po ta la'i mchod gtong 'don gshom byed mkhan gyi las khungs shig dang, de'i las tshan pa'i go ming/
rtse mo'i tog / gdugs kyi rtse tog / zhwa mo'i rtse tog /
khang pa'i yang thog / thog brtsegs can gyi khang pa'i rtse thog la sdod pa/
phyogs mthun pa/ nga gnyis gros bsdur ma byas kyang kha rtsang bshad pa'i bsam 'char rtse mthun red/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs t'a la'i bla ma'i 'khor ser mo ba spyi'i ming/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse drung pha gzhis yod pa'i rigs/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas gzhung zhabs ser skya dang, bla brang khag tshong rigs che khag bcas la dngul bun gtong len byed mkhan las khungs shig /

bod rang skyong ljongs lha sa'i ri bo po ta la'i thog tu yod cing, spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun par chos rgyal srong btsan skabs gnas der rgyal po'i pho brang zhig gsar du bzhengs te pho brang dmar po'i ri zhes su grags, phyis dus 'khrug gi rkyen gyis gyang shul tsam du lus, de nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya lo nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing khyi lo bar ha lam lo lnga bcu ring snga rting du bzhengs pa'i da lta'i pho brang 'di ri ngos nas gyen du brtsegs pa thog rtseg rim pa bcu gsum yod cing, pho brang dkar po dang dmar po khag gnyis su phyes, pho brang de'i nang du mandzu gong ma'i sku rten bzhugs sa'i mchod khang dang, t'a la'i bla ma'i gzims shag bod kyi rgyal po dang, bka' shag yig tshang sogs sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs khag gi gzhung don khang, t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa nas sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i bar gyi sku gdung mchod rten, lha khang, 'du khang sogs mang po yod, sku gdung khang so so'i yang thog tu gser zangs kyi ba gam mngon par mtho ba, lha khang rnams su rtsa che ba'i thang ga dang, mchod rten, dkyil 'khor sogs mdzes par bshams pa, bar khyams dang lha khang rnams kyi rtsig ngos su rgya bod 'brel ba'i skor gyi lo rgyus dang, bod kyi rigs rus 'byung khungs, skyes rabs rtogs brjod la sogs pa'i ldebs ris kyis brgyan pas mi rigs kyi khyad nyams rnam par bkra, pho brang dmar po'i nub sner bla chen rnams bzhugs sa'i gzims shag mang tsam yod do/

1) rtse mo dang rtse mo gtug pa/ rtswa phan tshun rtse sprod du bkram pa/ lcags mdung rtse sprod kyis 'thab 'dzing byed pa/ 2) (yul) kha btags sne brkyangs te sprod res byed pa/ phan tshun thug phrad skabs kha btags rtse sprod byed pa/
rtse po ta la'i pho brang/

'phral bde phyag mdzod de, sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs bla phyag dang rtse phyag zer ba'i mdzod khang chen po gnyis yod pa'i nang gi rtse phyag 'di ni rtse pho brang du btsugs nas t'a la'i bla ma'i nyer mkho 'phral du gtong mkhan dang, bu lon gtong mkhan las khungs shig dang, de'i 'go byed mdzod pa bcas kyi ming/
(tha dad pa) brtses pa, brtse ba, rtses,, rol ba dang, rtsed 'jo byed pa/ mig mangs rtse ba/ sho sbag brtses pa/ chu la brtses pas chu grir shi ba/ me la ma rtse/
rtse dga'i ched du 'khrab pa'i bro/ rtse bro mtha' klas pa brtses pa/ lo legs byung ba'i bkra shis bde legs zhu bar rtse bro 'khrab pa/
rtse mo'i sbyor ba'i bsdus ming,
/ 1) rab bam yag shos/ snam bu rtse ma/ gyon chas rtse ma/ 2) mtho shos su yod pa/ khang pa rtse ma/ gangs ri rtse ma/

/ 1) sne mo dang mtho shos kyi 'go'am zur/ gri'i rtse mo/ khab kyi rtse mo/ rtswa'i rtse mor zil pa chags/ shing gi rtse mor bya sdod pa/ ri'i rtse mor 'dzeg pa/ ri so so'i rtse mo mi gcig rung, de'i ri rgyud bshad na ri gcig yin/ rtse mo dgung sngon gnam la zug rtsa ba rgya mtsho'i gting la chags/ 2) mchog gam rab/ yang rtser son pa/ lag rtsal gyi rtse mor son pa/ 3) (mngon) sngar gyi mtshon cha tri shu zer ba phal cher rtse mo gsum yod pas grangs gsum mtshon/ 4) sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhi'i nang gses, gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i snang ba de nyid gong du mched pa'am 'phel ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste, mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis dge rtsa g.yo ba rnams kyi rab dang mchog tu gyur pas rtse mo'o/
gsang sngags kyi chos kyi che ba 'don pa'i chos skad cig /
mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin: drod snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin de slar yang bsgoms pas sngar gyi sems gsal snang ches cher mched, sngar las yid ches pa'i myong ba gsal po byung ba/

rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba ste, rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la brten nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom pa la rang dbang thob pa'i skabs kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor, sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
rtse mo'i sbyor ba'i chos brgyad

sher phyin don bdun cu las sbyor ba bzhi'i chos so drug gi nang tshan rtse mo'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad ni, drod rtse sbyor dang, rtse mo'i sbyor dang, bzod pa'i rtse sbyor dang, chos mchog rtse sbyor dang, mthong lam rtse sbyor dang, sgom lam rtse sbyor dang, bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang, bsal bya log sgrub bcas brgyad do/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa gong du rnam par 'phel ba'i cha gang zhig sbyor lam rtse mos bsdus pa'o/
bod rang skyong ljongs khongs sne gdong rdzong gi dgon pa zhig rab byung dang po'i dus su bzhengs pa/
1) steng gsham/ khang pa'i rtse zhol/ 2) lha sa'i rtse pho brang dang, zhol lha sa bcas kyi ming/
grwa pa'i tshogs zhwa sgro btsems ma/
(rnying) mgo gnon pa'am nus pa nyams par byed pa/
1) rtse gra ang dang gi 'og ma/ gos chen 'di rtse 'og tsam red/ 2) lus kyi gsang gnad cig /
ming gzhan rtse sgang dang, kong po rtse sgang, rtse la yang zer ste, bod rang skyong ljongs sman gling rdzong gi ming rnying/
1) gong 'og dang, steng gsham/ 2) sngar bod kyi t'a la'i bla ma dang rgyal tshab gnyis/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs drung 'khor grwa pa dang, skya bo/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs yod tshad la zer/
lag sor bzhi bskums pa'i steng mtheb rtse gyen 'greng gi tshigs sbyar ba'i ring tshad/

1. (tha dad pa) brtsegs pa, brtseg pa, rtsegs,, 1) gcig gi steng la gcig 'jog pa/ so phag brtsegs nas rtsig pa bslangs pa/ byas rjes gcig thog nyis brtsegs kyis bzhag pa/ yag thog yag brtsegs/ 2) dam por mthud pa dang, dbugs 'tshang ba lta bu/ ri mthon por 'dzeg dus dbugs rtseg pa/ 3) snon pa dang, spar ba/ rin dngul kha rtseg byed pa/ 'bor grangs brtsegs pa/ 2. khang pa'i thog rim/ khang pa'i thog rtseg / thog rtseg gsum pa/
1) dngos po nyo tshong gi rin thang chung ngu la yang rtsis che che byed pa/ 2) kha snon yang nas yang du dgos pa/ spom tshod kyis nyo cha rgyag dus rtseg rtseg nan tan byas yong/
(rnying) 1) sred zhen che ba/ 2) phran tshegs/
thung thung/ gos rtseng por brdzes te gyon pa/
(tha dad pa) brtsengs pa, brtseng ba, rtsengs,, rdze ba/ gos mthon por brtsengs te chu bo brgal/ phu thung rtseng ba/
rtsed mo rtse dus kyi rgyan/
rtsed mo rtse byed kyi yo byad/
rtsed mo/ rtsed 'jo'i sgyu rtsal sbyong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la gar dang, 'cham pa, bro, zlos gar, rol rtsed bcas so,
rtse mo rtse ba'i ston mo/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sne gdong rdzong gi dbus khul yar klungs gtsang po'i lho na yod, 'di ni lho kha sa khul gyi lte gnas grong khyer yin/
rab byung drug pa'i lcags yos lo la t'a'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa zhig /
bod lho kha rtsed thang nas thon pa'i ther ma/
rtsed mo rtse byed kyi mda' dang me mda'/

/ 1) rol rtsed dang ku re/ byis pa'i rtsed mo/ glu gar rtsed mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bag med rtsed mor rol nas rang 'khri'i las 'gan 'thus shor byung ba/ tsi tsi ku rtsed rkyal pa'i mthil la gzan/ ming gi rnam grangs la kyal ka dang, rtse ba, rtse tshul, rtsed 'jo, bzhad gad, 'dzag pa bcas so, 2) rgyan bzhag nas rgyal pham 'gran pa'i lugs ngan/
1) rol ba'i gnas sam rtse ba'i gnas/ 2) 'khrab sa'i stegs bu/ 3) (mngon)...nam mkha'/

(rnying) 1) rol ba'am rtse ba/ don gnad gal che ba'i rigs byed skabs rtsed mo la rtsen na mi 'grig / 2) gnas pa dang bsti ba/ bsti gnas su rtsen pa/ 3) yar 'phag pa'am lding ba/ rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs mkha' la rtsen/
(rgya) sngar khri srong lde'u btsan dus slob dpon ka ma la shi la dang hwa shang maha ya na rtsod skabs ka shis spel ba'i sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' zhig /
(yul) mjing pa/ rtser 'chus pa/ rtser rgyag pa/ rtser bsgrengs pa/ rtser shor ba/
1) mchog tu gyur pa/ brda sprod rig pa'i shes yon rtser son pa'i slob ma/ 2) rtse mor phyin pa/ tshan rig lag rtsal yang rtser son pa/
rtsod pa'i gnas su gyar ba/ khrims khang la rtsod gyar ba/
1) gyod kha mchu/ da res kyi rtsod gleng 'byung gzhi ni rtswa ra'i don yin/ 2) don gnad skor phan tshun bdar sha gcod pa/ yin min gyi don gnad skor la phan tshun rtsod gleng byed pa/

gtso ring lugs: mar khe si dang en ke si rnam gnyis kyis gsar gtod gnang zhing, rtsod sgrub kyi rig pa spyad de rang byung khams dang, mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs, bsam blo'i 'phel tshul bcas spyir btang gi chos nyid brtag dpyad byed pa'i tshan rig cig /
dngos po rnams kyi 'gal ba'i 'gul skyod dang, 'phel rgyas, 'gyur ldog bcas kyi chos nyid skor gyi mtshan nyid rig pa zhig /

pa'i skabs kyi ngag gi dbye ba la: gang zag gsum la brjod tshul drug yod de, snga rgol la don gyi dngos po 'jog pa dang, skyon spong gi ngag gnyis, phyi rgol la 'dod pa 'dri ba dang, skyon brjod pa'i ngag gnyis, dpang po la rjes su brjod pa dang, rnam par dbye ba'i ngag gnyis bcas drug go /
rtsod ldan dus kyi bsdus ming,

sangs rgyas pa'i bshad srol ltar 'dzam gling mi rnams kyis chos dang, nor, 'dod pa, bde ba bzhi las cha gsum nyams nas cha gcig la longs su spyod cing, 'khrug rtsod dar ba'i dus te de'i yun tshad la lo grangs bzhi 'bum sum khri nyis stong yod par bshad do/
1) rtsod pa'i sa gnas/ 2) rtsod pa'i rtsa ba'am rtsod pa'i 'byung gzhi/

1.(tha dad pa) brtsad pa, brtsad pa, rtsod,, shags 'gyed pa dang, rgol ba/ bden rdzun rtsod pa/ pham rgyal brtsad kyang thag ma chod pa/ 2.phan tshun rgol ba'am, kha shags byed pa'i ming/ gsar rnying gi rtsod pa/ tshad ma'i rtsod pa/ mi snyan pa'i rtsod pa rgyag pa/
gzhan gyis rgol ba'am dgag pa btang ba der lan gyis gnod pa sel ba'o/
rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi
'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun gyi nang gses, rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum gyi ya gyal, dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa phal cher chos phyogs su zhi bar byed pa'i rim pa ste zhi byed kyi chos bdun rnams so/
rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, phyir bcos kyi gzhi bdun gyi nang gses rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum ste, las kyi rtsod pa zhi byed dang, 'khor lo'i rtsod pa zhi byed dang, de las gzhan pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed de gsum mo/
rtsod pa smra ba po gsum
snga rgol dang, phyi rgol dang, dpang po bcas gsum/
rtsod pa mdzes pa'i rgyan bdun

bzhin mdangs gsal ba dang, ngag snyan 'jam pa, pha rol dma' 'bebs kyi tshig mda' mi 'phen pa, lung rigs gsal rno, sgyid lug dang nga rgyal med pa, rigs lam 'dor ba'i g.yo sgyu chags sdang med pa, rang gzhan gyi don dang ldan pa gces par 'dzin pa bcas so/

kyi chos bdun: 'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi bye brag cig ste, mngon sum brgyad kyis zhi ba dang, dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa dang, ma myos pas 'dul ba sbyin pa dang, gang mang gis zhi ba dang, ltung ba'i ngo bo nyid 'tshol ba sbyin pa dang, rtswa bkram pas zhi ba dang, khas blangs pas zhi ba ste bdun no/
'dul ba'i lugs kyi rtsod pa bzhi ste, 'gyed phyir rtsod pa dang, mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa, ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa, bya ba'i phyir rtsod pa bcas so/

rtsod pa rigs pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa, rgol phyir rgol rtsod pa dang, rgyal pham tshar bcad kyi gnas ston pa, slob dpon chos kyi grags pas brtsams pa'i tshad ma sde bdun las 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
rtsod pa dang du len pa/ don la bdar sha mi gcod par tshig 'khri'i rtsod pa kho na lhur len pa la snying po rang med/
don blo sgra skyon nam, ngan g.yo dang, khyad gsod, yid 'khrugs bcas gsum mo/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa'i gzhi'i bye brag cig ste, de bzhin nyid la log par bsgrub pa dang, gdams ngag spong ba dang, ltung ba dang bcas pa dang, las la mi mthun pa ste bzhi'o, rgyu de dag gis 'dus byas rtag mi rtag la sogs pa rtsod pa lta bu 'gyed phyir rtsod pa dang, gdams ngag gso dgag bzhag pa la 'jog pa po dang gzhag bya rtsod pa lta bu mi gdams phyir rtsod pa dang, ltung ba glengs pas khas mi len pa gleng bya gleng byed rtsod pa lta bu ltung phyir rtsod pa dang, rtsod pa de gsum gyi dbang gis gso sbyong sogs kyi las la mthun pa mi sbyin pas rtsod par gyur pa bya phyir gyi rtsod pa bcas 'byung ba'o/
shes rab ldan pa dang, blo sbyangs pa dang, gzhung lugs shes pa bcas gsum mo/
rtsod ldan gyi dus te bskal pa gsum ldan gyi dus/
nyer len bzhi: 'dod pa dang, lta ba, tshul khrims brtul zhugs, bdag smra bcas bzhi'o/
'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun las koo shambhi'i gzhi ste, phan tshun mi mthun par smras pa'i tshig gi rjes su sems gzhol ba'i 'khon 'dzin gyi blo dang, blo des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi rig byed do/
rtsod pa med pa/ drang bden gyi las don la rgyal kha 'thob rgyu rtsod bral red/
bsnyon du med pa/ phan tshun rtsod med yin/
'thab 'dzing/ drag po'i rtsod 'dzing/ 'khrun thag gcod dka' ba'i rtsod 'dzing/

1) rtsod pa yong rkyen/ 2) rtags gsal 'god skabs kyi bsgrub bya'i chos bsgrub pa'i gzhi chos can nam rgol phyi rgol gnyis kyis rtsod pa'i gzhi, dper na, sgra chos can, zhes brjod pa lta bu'o, ming gi rnam grangs la rjes su dpag par bya ba'i gzhi, dpag gzhi, bsgrub gzhi, shes 'dod chos can phyogs chos kyi phyogs rnams so/
rtsod pa mang ba'i zang zing/ mgo rnyog che ba'i rtsod zing thag gcod dka'/
rtsod ya ste, rtsod pa rgyag mkhan kha gtad/
klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rigs tshogs: drug gi ya gyal zhig /
1) phan tshun rtsod pa byas pa'i yi ge/ 2) tshad ma sogs rtsod sgrub kyi yig cha/
pha rol po sun 'byin brjod pa la, rtags ma grub, ma khyab, 'dod sogs kyi lan 'debs pa'o/
kha rtsod kyi shags/ gyod ya phan tshun rtsod shags rgyag res byed pa/
1) rtsom yig gam dpe cha rtsom rgyag mkhan/ 2) gros dang, las ka sogs kyi 'go rtsom pa po/
rtsom tshig legs nyes rtog byed kyi rgyugs/ rtsom rgyugs len pa/
yi ge rtsom pa dang sgyur ba/ rtsom sgyur gnyis kar mkhas pa/
rtsom pa dang sgrig pa:/ tshig mdzod rtsom sgrig byed pa/

1.(tha dad pa) brtsams pa, brtsam pa, rtsoms,, 1) dpe cha sogs kyi tshig sbyor sgrig pa/ gzhung chen rtsom pa/ snyan ngag brtsams pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa/ 2) bya spyod sbyor ba/ las 'go rtsom pa/ dgra bo 'bros par brtsams pa/ 2.tshig rgyan gyi rtsom pa/ gsung rtsom gces bsdus/ go bde'i ched du rtsom gsal po zhig brgyab pa/
1) dpe cha rtsom rgyag mkhan/ 2) las ka sogs kyi 'go rtsom pa po/
dpe cha brtsams pa'i 'phro'am lhag ma/
shes rab dman pa dang, mang du thos pa bral ba dang, le lo sgyid lug bcas gsum mo/

1) dpe cha dang las ka sogs gsar du 'go rtsom pa'i gzhi bcol sa/ bstan bcos rtsom gzhi'i brjod bya'i snying po/ 2) las don bya yul/ bya ba rtsom gzhi'i las grwa/ 3) chags pa'i gzhi rtsa/ rags pa'i rtsom gzhi rdul cha med pa dang, rgyun gyi rtsom gzhi skad cig cha med khas blangs pa/
rtsom yig gi snying po bsdus pa/
rgyag byed kyi shes rig ste: zlos gar dang, snyan ngag sgrung dpe, tshig lhug la sogs pa brtsam bya gang yin pa thams cad la 'jug pa'i rig pa'i gnas/
yi ge'i tshig sbyor sgrig mkhan/
'bad rtsol/ thabs lam 'grig na rtsol sgrub ji tsam byas pa de tsam gyis don 'grub pa yong/
(yul) mgyogs rtsal/ las ka'i 'char gzhi rtsol cag gis mgyogs po tshar thabs byed pa/
las shugs skyed pa/ tshan rig gi shes yon khong du chud rgyu rtsol 'don byed pa/ dmag don rtsol 'don gyis bslab pa/
mgyogs po'i zhe sa/ phyag las rtsol po gnang rogs gnang/ bka' lan rtsol po yod pa zhu/ da res rtsol po phebs byung/

1.(tha dad pa) brtsal ba, brtsal ba, rtsol,, brtson pa dang 'bad pa/ las don la rtsol ba/ byed stangs nor na las la brtsal kyang mi 'grub/ 2. 1) brtson 'grus/ mu mthud rtsol ba chen pos dka' tshegs sel ba/ spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed par rtsol ba skyed pa/ 2) yi ge so sor klog skabs nga ro 'don pa'i 'du byed/
'jug pa'i yid byed: lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i yid byed dang don gcig
rang byung ma yin pa/ rtsol byung dngos rdzas/
skye ldan sngo rigs spyi'i ming/ sngo rtswa/ skya rtswa/ phyugs rtswa/ ri rtswa/ klung rtswa/ rtswa bzang la ri dwags dang, chu bzang la khrung khrung/
sngo sman lo ma ljang skya che la mthug pa, me tog ser po dri zhim pa zhig ste, nus pas pho tshad dang, me dbal, gnyan rims rnams la phan/
kottamba zhes pa'i zur chag ste, kottamba zhes pa'i yul du skyes pa'i rtswa zhig /
(yul) bkag rtswa ste dbyar dang ston gyi rtswa sa rang rang gi bdag thob yin pas mi gzhan gyi phyugs rigs la rtswa za ru mi 'jug par bkag nas srung ba'i rtswa thang
dgag dbye sogs kyi skabs rtswa sa la bkram pa, 'dul bar rtswa phan tshun rtse sprod du nyal ba 'dra bar phyogs gnyis nas phan tshun 'dud par gyur pa'i brda thabs su gnang ba'i phyag len zhig /

'dul ba las bshad pa'i rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, rtswa bkram pa lta bu'i sgo nas zhi bar byed pa zhes pa dge 'dun phan tshun zing zing por phyag byas te ltung ba phyir bcos nas rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'o/
1) gnag phyugs dang ra lug sogs 'tsho yul rtswa thang/ phyugs rigs rnams rtswa kha bzang sar 'tsho ba/ rtswa kha mtho la chu kha dma', mdzo rgan sdod pa'i gnas ma yin/ 2) rtswa'i rtse mo/
1) rtswa las bzos pa'i khang pa/ 2) rtswa 'jog sa'i khang pa/
rtswa rtse'i chu rdul/ rtswa kha'i zil pa phrom phrom du chags pa/
rtsa'i khres po/ rgyab la rtswa khres khur ba/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mkhris par tsha ba rgyas pa dang, mig dang pags mdangs ser por gyur pa bcas la phan/
rtswas dkris pa'i bu ram zhig /
rtswa dang shing los dkris pa'i bu ram sgor sgor/
1) rtswa las bzos pa'i sgye mo/ 2) rtswa blug sa'i sgye mo/
lo thog sogs la gnod pa'i rtswa/ yur ma rgyag dus zhing nang gi rtswa ngan 'gog pa/
rtswa sngon po dang sngo rigs gzhan rnams/
sngar mnga' bdag gi bkag rtswa brnga dgos pa'i khral zhig /
rta sogs kyi gzan pa dang 'bru rigs kyi chag /
rtswa dang chu/ dbyar dus rtswa chu 'dzoms la dgun dus gangs cher med pa/
sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' sa'i grong khyer/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig ste, las 'gan ni gzhung gi rta drel khag la rtswa gzan gtong rgyu sogs yin/
phyugs kyis bzas zin pa'i lhag ro'i rtswa/
bzos pa'i thag pa:/ rta rgod gyong po rtswa thag gis 'dul mi thub/
rtswa skyes yod pa'i thang/ nor phyugs rtswa thang steng du 'tsho/
gis sos ka rtswa gsar mi 'phrod pa zos pa las: byung ba'i dug /
rtswa dang sngo rigs gzhan gyi bsdus ming/
sngo sman zhig de'i rtsa bas khrag tshad sel ba sogs la phan/
rtswa la gnas pa'i gcan gzan g.yi/
rtswa'i khrod du gnas pa'i 'bu srin/
rtswa'i nang tshangs can gyi 'bol gdan/
sngo sman zhig glo gsud 'jags pa dang, lud pa gog pa, dri chu 'bebs pa sogs la phan/
rtswa shing 'thu mkhan te mi dkyus ma la dma' 'bebs byed pa'i tshig cig / rtswa mi shing mi kha shas bsad/
rtswa la 'bar ba'i me/ ri la rtswa me mched pa/
rtswa'i rtse mo/ nor mi rtag rtswa rtse'i zil pa 'dra/
rtswa las bzos pa'i zhwa mo/
rtswa rnga byed kyi zor ba/
1) rtswa dang gzan pa'i bsdus ming/ 2) phyugs rigs kyi bza' chas/
rtswa las bzos pa'i thog g.yab/
1) rtswa 'jog sa'i ra ba/ 2) sngo rtswa skye yul/ rtswa ra'i nang du sems can 'tsho ba/
so ma r'a dza'i skud pa/
a krong rigs kyi nang tshan spang la skye ba zhig ste, nus pa a krong dang mtshungs/
ga : 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rtswa a wa'i las chog sna tshogs bkod pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
rtsod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
yig rtsom brgyab pa'i gla cha/
1.rtsol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.(rnying) 1) skyugs pa/ 2) spyad pa/ 3) gzhol ba/
mthong chen byas nas gong du bkur ba/ snying thag pa nas brtsi bkur zhu ba/
brtsi zhing gong du bkur ba/ mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bka' la brtsi 'khur zhu ba/
brtsi zhing cha 'jog pa/ phan tshun chod yig gan don la brtsi 'jog byed pa/
brtsi 'jog mi byed pa/ mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char la brtsi med byas na mi 'grig /
1) zhib bsher/ ra lug ngo grangs tshang dang ma tshang brtsi bzhag gtong ba/ 2) gzhung dang yig cha rnams blo thog nas 'dzin grwa so sor gnang ba'am blo 'dzin byas nas rgyugs sprod pa/
gal po cher 'dzin cing de las mi 'da' bar byed pa/ brtsi srung nan tan/ mi dmangs srid gzhung gi srid jus dang bka' khrims la brtsi srung byed pa/
snying nas brtse zhing drin gyis skyong ba/ pha mas phru gur brtse skyong byed pa/
sha tsha ba'am ches cher brtse ba/ phan tshun bsam pa gru nang ltar brtse gdung che ba/ spun mched la brtse gdung ha cang che ba/ ma bu'i brtse gdung zab/

1.rtse ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2.(tha mi dad pa) 1) mi bzod pa/ shing 'bras ma smin pa zos na so brtse yong/ lcags drad drad byed pa'i sgra thos dus a mchog brtse ba/ rtsam rtsing gis so brtse ba/ 2) rjes su chags pa'am snying rje ba/ nad par rjes su brtse ba/ phru gu la brtse ba/ rgan rgon rnams la brtse ba/ dbul phongs la brtse ba/ 3.snying rje'i ming/ brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba/ brtse ldan gyi sems/ byams brtse/
snying rje'i ming don du go ba'i brtse ba dang 'dra,
rjes su chags pa'am snying rje ba'i sems/
brtsegs ma yang yin la 'phul yang yod pa'i ming gzhi bska lta bu/ bska
/ 1) ming gzhi mgo can rka sna lta bu/ rka sna/ 2) dngos po gang rung gcig gi steng du gcig brtsegs pa'i ming/
(tha mi dad pa) rta drel sogs kyi rmig pa zad de sha la thug nyer gyur pa sogs kyis reg par mi bzod pa/ rta drel la rmig lcags ma brgyab par thag ring du phyin pas brtsed de 'gro mi thub pa/
(rnying) btsog pa'am gtsang ma min pa/

dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig gi ya gyal zhig ste, dge ba'i gnas la sems mngon par spro bas 'jug pa dang, dge ba'i phyogs yongs su sgrub par byed pa/ las don mthar phyin 'grub par brtson 'grus brtsam dgos/ mi dmangs kyi phugs phan bsgrub par brtson 'grus yun ring la dos drag pa zhig byed dgos pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dga' ba che dang, rtag 'grus, 'dod don 'dun, spro ba che, rtsom pa che bcas so,

brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gyi khyad chos bzhi ste, le lo sogs mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang, chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa, 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa, rigs can gsum smin par byed pa bcas so/
brtson 'grus rgyun ldan gyi rtag sbyor la brten nas byung ba'i ting 'dzin/
le lo sogs kyis mi rdzi ba'i stobs te byang phyogs so bdun gyi stobs lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis sbyor ba gang zhig brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin rim ldan du sgom pa'o/
«b'iryap'armit'a» khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi spro ba'i sems pa dge ba sa bon dang bcas te, phyin drug gi ya gyal zhig /
byang phyogs so bdun las rnam byang gi dbang po lnga'i nang gses shig ste, nyan pa dang sems pa dang bsgom pa la sogs pa'i dge ba rgyun mi gcod pa'o/
'phrul gyi rkang pa: rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus so/
tshul min gyi las kar brtson pa/
yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu brtson 'grus lnga ste, go cha'i brtson 'grus dang, sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus, zhum med kyi brtson 'grus, mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus, chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus bcas so/
mi mnga' ba: sems can gcig 'ba' zhig gi don du yang bskal par bshos mi gsol bar chos ston pa ste, ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
byang chub kyi yan lag byang chub yan lag: bdun gyi ya gyal zhig nges par 'byung ba'i yan lag ste so so'i skye bo'i gnas nas nges par 'byung zhing de las ring du 'da' bar byed pa'i brtson 'grus/
1.(tha dad pa) 'bad pa/ thon skyed la brtson pa/ slob sbyong la brtson pa/ 2.'bad pa'i ming/ las kar brtson pa med na 'grub mi 'gyur/
1) brtson pa chung du btang ba/ 'os pa'i bya ba la brtson pa lhod nas ma sdod/ 2) brtson pa dor ba/ tshul min gyi las la brtson pa lhod pa legs/
bya bar 'bad brtson byed sems/ slob sbyong la brtson sems ha cang che/
(rnying) sogs pa/ la sogs pa...la stsogs pa

(tha dad pa) bstsal ba, bstsal ba, stsol,, 1) sprod pa'i zhe sa ste gnang ba/ bka' slob stsol du gsol/ bka' lan bstsal ba/ 2) las la sbyor ba dang byed du 'jug pa/ slob sbyong byed du stsol ba/ tshur log yong du bstsal ba/ 3) (rnying) sel ba/
stsol ba'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,

bod yig gsal byed bco brgyad pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen sgra med/ c, ?...tsh` ?/ a, ?...ca ?...1.ming gzhi'i ma ning yi ge zhig / 2.rjes grub kyi tshig la tshwa'i tshab byas chog pa/ tshwa...rgya tsha/ byang tsha/ ba tsha/
tsha bas gdungs ches nas rlan thag chad pa/ thug pa der me tsha drags nas tsha skam thebs 'dug /
me mda' sogs 'ben la phog mi phog lag rtsal che chung tshod lta'i tsha kha/ mda' rtsal yun ring sbyangs pas tsha kha lon pa/ me mda'i tsha kha lta ba/
sangs rgyas pa tshos 'jim bzos lha gzugs sogs tsha tsha 'jog yul gyi khang pa/
tsha sob sob/ drod khang la slebs dus lus kun tsha kham kham byas yong/

rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi kho 'phan dpon zhes pa'i bsdus ming ste yul dang dpon ming bsdus nas btags pa'i yul spyi'i ming zhig kho 'phan zer ba ni zhang zhung sbra rgyal gyi rgyal rgyud cig yin pa dang, sbra zer ba ni bod kyi rus bzhi'i ya gyal bse dang gcig pa yin pa des sngar rgyal mo rong gi sa 'gag dog mo gsum po bzung bas rgyal rong gi yul mi rnams kyi rus sbra yin par bshad/
rlung khrag gis rkyen pas lus kyi stod smad sogs la skabs skabs tsha shar rgyag stangs shig / rkang lag la tsha khyug rgyag pa
tshad nad rgyu mar bab pa'i 'khru nad cig /
lhing po med pa'i tshul/ skad cha lab dus tsha gi tshi gi ma byed/ las ka tsha gi tshi gi byas na nor 'khrul 'chor yong/
snga dro'i tsha ba'am kha lag ma zos gong gi dus/ nyin re'i 'char gzhi tsha gong nas bting ba/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsam bzhes las khungs nas smon lam skabs grwa par gshor sprod byed pa'i rtsam pa/

1) dro ba dang bsil ba/ lung pa de gnam gshis tsha grang snyom po 'dug / tsha grang snyoms byed/ tsha grang lta chas/ 2) tsha nad dang grang ba'i nad/ nad rigs kyi tsha grang phye nas sman bcos byed dgos/
1) tsha nad smin ma smin pa'i mtshams/ 2) nad tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis kyi nor 'phrang gal che ba'i mdo don rnams gsal bar ston pa'i man ngag rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum pa la zer/
tsha theg grang theg ste skyid sdug gnyis ka myong thub pa'i dpe/ tsha grang thub pa'i mi zhig /
grum nad tsha grang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i tsha ba shas che ba'i grum bu'i nad cig /
sa ba tshwa can dang zhing ngan/
tsha drod kyi nus shugs/ tsha ngad che ba'i lung pa/
tsha ngad phog stangs shig / me thab kyi 'khris su bsdad pas gzugs gzhi tshang ma tsha ngam ngam byas byung/
tsha ngad kyi nus shugs/ nyi 'od kyi tsha ngar/
sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho lho bod rigs: rang skyong khul gyi ku'e nan rdzong gi rong zhig /
1) thengs gcig na nas bskyar du mi na ba'i nad cig / 2) spu mthug po yod pa'i gdan zhig /
lag pa mi 'tshig par byed pa'i lag lcibs/
(yul) lam rgyags sam lam chas/ lam du ma zhud gong nas tsha chas bsdogs pa/
1) tsha ba'i nad na mkhan gyi gcin pa/ 2) chu tshan/ 3) dmu chu tsha grang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i tsha ba shas che ba'i lus kyi dri chu 'gags pa'i chu nad cig /
chu tshan nam tsha chu yod sa/
1) tsha rting ma'i ja/ 2) tsha phog gi ja/
sgrigs khrims drag pos gcun nas bslab bya nan po rgyag pa/ nyes pa tshabs chen byed mkhan rnams la tsha 'jun drang 'doms kyis kha 'gul lag 'gul gang byung byed du mi 'jug pa/
cha dang mi nor ba'i rtags kyi tsha lag tsha...`` ~ '' ?/ cha...
nyi dros rgyab tsam gyi snga dro'i lto za ba'i dus/ tsha rting rgyag pa/
1) me shugs sam drod ngar che drags pa/ za ma tsha thal shor nas 'tshig pa/ 2) tsha gcun thal drags pa dang, tshad las brgal ba/ skad cha tsha thal shor bas gzhan khong khro langs pa/
thur ma'i cha byad mer bsregs nas nad kyi steng du 'bug pa la zer/
ma yal ba'i dus skabs:/ lcags tsha thog tu rdung ba/
pags nad kyi rigs shig / ngo la tsha thor thon 'dug
(yul) rtsa 'thor du gyur pa'am 'ub ma 'dus pa/ log spyod pa'i rtsa 'dzugs tsha 'thor ba/
me mda'i tsha kha lta ba dang, zhar 'phen glod de 'gran bsdur byed par rgyal kha lon mkhan la thob pa'i kha btags/
tsha drag dza drag chen po
/ las brel ha cang tsha drag che ba/ sngar bun bdag gis ngal rtsol mi dmangs la bu lon 'ded skul tsha drag chen po'i sgo nas bshu gzhog gnya' gnon byed pa/
1) nam dus kyi tsha ngad dang, me shugs kyi drod ngad/ 2) tshad nad 'bar ba'i drod ngad/ nad pa tsha drod rgyas nas rig pa mi gsal ba/
tsha drod mi bzad pa'am ma rungs pa:/ nyi ma tsha gdug che ba/ de ring gnam gshis tsha gdug che ba la ang/
