tshad mar 'jog 'os pa/ mi tshad thub pa/ las ka tshad thub/ dngos po tshad thub/ yig cha tshad thub/
dpe tshad dang mtshungs pa/ gzugs po'i tshad mthun gyi gyon gos shig bdams pa/
tsha drod rgyas te khams mi gsal bar gyur pa/ nam zla'i tsha drod kyis rkyen pas rig pa tshad 'thibs nyog por gyur pa/
tsha drod ha cang ches pas shes pa bzi 'thoms ltar gyur pa/ nad pa'i dbang shes tshang ma tshad 'thums kyis dran pa nyams pa/
tsha ba'i nad kyis lus myos shing shes pa za zir 'gyur ba'i nad dug cig / nad pa 'di tshad dug gis bzi bsdad 'dug /
1) tsha ba'i nad kyi drod ngad/ 2) blo gdeng ngam nyams rtogs/ blo 'dri gros bsdur gyi sgo nas kho pa'i blo phugs ky tshad drod ji 'dug tshod lta ba/
tshad pa skyob pa'i nyi gdugs/
tshad pas mnar ba'i sdug bsngal/ lus tshad gdung drag pos gzir ba/
grangs dang khyon 'bor sogs kyi tshad gzhi las brgal ba/ mi grangs tshad 'das/ khang khyim tshad 'das/ dngos zog tshad 'das,..gzugs bongs tshad 'das/
pa, thig tshad len pa/ lam thag ring la le dbar gyi tshad 'debs pa/
tshad longs pa/ ras khre rtse brgyad kyis phru gu gcig gi stod thung gos thung gi tshad ldang ba/
tshad dang ldan pa'am tshul dang ldan pa/ dpung sde tshad ldan/ 'phrul 'khor tshad ldan/ lag bzo tshad ldan/ skad cha tshad ldan/ mi sna tshad ldan/
'gran sdur ram go sdur/ spus ka yag nyes kyi rim pa tshad sdur gtan 'bebs bzo ba/ dpe bzang tshad sdur 'dems sgrug byed pa/
tshad pa phog pa'am tshad pa rgyas nas byung ba'i na tsha/

1.(tha dad pa) tshad pa, tshad pa, tshod,, sdur ba dang, ring thung sogs 'jal ba/ ring thung 'dom la tshad pa/ lci yang rgya mar tshad/ mi ngan 'de'i nyes spyod des mi tshad/ 2. tsha ba'am tsha drod kyi ngad shugs/ dbyar dus tshad pa phog pa/ rong gi sa char tshad pa che/ tshad pa gsar pa bcos sla/
zhag gnyis na nas drag 'gro ba'i tshad pa zhig /
tshad ji yod shes thabs byed pa/ rgya mtsho'i gting tshad dpog par dka'/
1) tshad 'das dang mtshungs/ 2) thabs med dang ka med/ khyed rang gis bka' mngags gnang ba ltar dam don ma zhus tshad bral red/

tshad ma'i 'bras bu ste, myong stobs dang rgyud mtshan la brten nas rang yul legs par rtogs pa'am mtha' chod par nges pa'i nges shes skye ba sogs rnam 'jog gi rgyu la bltos nas rnam bzhag gi grub 'bras 'byung ba'o/

tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ste, tshad ma ni rnam par 'jog byed kyi rgyu'am mtshan nyid dang, 'bras bu ni rnam par gzhag bya'i 'bras bu'am mtshon bya dang, gzhal bya ni tshad ma de yi yul la byed pa'o/

/ 1) bden pa'am mi bslu ba/ smras pa tshar mar bzungs ba/ 2) (pram'na) 1,rang yu la mi bslu ba'i ses pa pa se ran gyu lgsar du rtogs pa'i blo mngon sum yang dag dang, rjes dpag yang dag rnams so/ 2,rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal, tshad ma rig pa'o/

tshad ma kun las btus pa zhes bya ba, rgya gar gyi slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos brtsams pa'i rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad dang khyad par du yang dag pa'i shes pa don tshan drug tu bsdus nas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa ste, mngon sum gyi le'u dang, rang don gyi le'u dang, sel ba brtag pa dang, gzhan don le'u dnag, dpe brtag pa dang, sun 'byin brtag pa bcas le'u drug gi bdag nyid can gyi tshad ma'i gzhung zhig go /
tshad ma brtag pa chung ba
rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos mchog gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
tshad ma brtag pa che ba
rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos mchog gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /

rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos kyi grags pas brtsams pa'i rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel, 'bring tshad ma rnam nges, bsdus pa tshad ma rigs thigs te rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum, gtan tshigs thigs pa, 'brel ba brtag pa, rgyud gzhan sgrub pa, rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi bcas so/

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba, rang don gyi le'u dang, tshad ma grub pa'i le'u dang, mngon sum gyi le'u dang, gzhan don le'u bcas le'u bcas le'u bzhi'i bdag nyid can, rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpal chos kyi grags pas brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung rgyas pa zhig ste, tshad ma sde bdun las rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum gyi gras shig /
rgya gar gyi slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis brtsam pa/
tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad
rgya gar gyi slob dpon rgyal ba can gyis brtsams pa/
dpal ldan chos grags kyis btsams pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel rang 'grel/

tshad ma rnam par nges pa zhes pa, mngon sum, rang don dang, gzhan don bcas le'u gsum gyi bdag nyid can, slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun gyi ya gyal, rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi nang nas 'bring ba'o/
nges pa'i 'grel bshad: rgya gar gyi slob dpon ye shes dpal bzang pos brtsams pa dang chos mchog gis brtsams pa gnyis yod/
tshad ma tshig don rab gsal
bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
mngon sum tshad ma dang, rjes dpag tshad ma, lung tshad ma, dpe nyer 'jal gyi tshad ma ste bzhi/

gtan tshigs rig pa ste rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal, don gyi gnas la 'khrul ba tshar gcod par byed pa, gzhal bya yul dang, 'jal byed yul can dang, de rtogs byed kyi thabs bcas zhib mor gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i rig pa'o/
rjes dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi spyi don zhig /

tshad ma rig pa'i gter zhes bya ba, tshad ma sde bdun gyi dgongs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te shes bya spyi slog nas gtan la phab pa dang shes byed tshad ma'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba gnyis kyis bstan cing, yul brtags pa, blo brtags pa, spyi dang bye brag brtags pa, snang sel brtags pa, brjod bya dang rjod byed rtags pa, 'brel ba brtags pa, 'gal ba brags pa, mtshan nyid brtags pa, mngon sum brtags pa, rang don rjes dpag gzhan don rjes dpag ste rab byed bcu gcig can gyi gzhung 'di, dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/

tshad ma rigs pa'i thigs pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa, mngon sum dang, rang gi don rjes su dpag pa dang, gzhan don rjes su dpag pa bcas le'u gsum gyi bdag nyid can, slob dpon chos kyi grags pas brtsams pa'i tshad ma sde bdun gyi ya gyal, rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi nang nas bsdus pa'o/
mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma, lung gi tshad ma bcas so/
kun gyis tshad mar gzung ba'i gang zag /
ma rtogs pa dang, log rtog the tshom ste gsum/
'thad pa sgrub pa ste don la mi bslu bar sgrub pa'i rigs pa ste, de la mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang, rjes dpag gi tshad ma dang, lung gi tshad ma bcas gsum yod/

rang dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma des de dang 'gal zlar gyur pa'i blo la gnod pa can gyi 'gal ba, dper na, byas rtag gnyis lta bu gzhi sgra de byas pa yin par rtogs pa'i blos sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo skyed cing, sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blos sgra rtag 'dzin la gnod pa phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi tshad mas gnod 'gal dang, du ba dang grang reg gnyis lta bu, me yod par nges pa'i tshad mas gzhi der grang ba sel bar nges pa'i tshad ma 'dren pas grang reg yod par 'dzin pa la gnod pa lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi tshad mas gnod 'gal yin no/
tshad min gyi shes pa, rang yul gsar du rtogs pa ma yin pa'i blo ste, bcad shes dang, yid dpyod sogs mngon rjes tshad ma gnyis ma gtogs pa'i blo rig gzhan lnga po'o/
tshad min gyi shes pa lnga
bcad shes dang, log shes, the tshom, yid dpyod, snang la ma nges pa'i blo rnams so/
grangs dang rgya khyon sogs gzhal du med pa, dmigs pa sems can tshad med par dmigs shing, 'bras bu phan yon tshad med pa byung ba/ dpal yon tan tshad med brjod kyis mi lang ba
mtha' yas pa/ rgya mtsho'i nang du srog chags che chung tshad med grangs med yod/
bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas ris bar ma ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha'i bde ba 'di tsam mo zhes tshad du gzung du med pas tshad med dge zhes bya'o/

theg chen pas sems can tshad med par dmigs nas bsgoms te bsod nams tshad med pa 'phen par byed pa'i sems bzhi ste, byams pa tshad med dang, snying rje tshad med, dga' ba tshad med, btang snyoms tshad med bcas so/
bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas ris bar ma ste, gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha ni lus kyi 'od 'di tsam mo zhes tshad du gzung du med pas tshad med 'od kyi gnas zhes bya'o/
tshad pa'i nad kyis myos pa'am bzi ba/ nad pa tshad myos kyi kha nas gang byung mang byung bshad yong/
tsha ba'i nad kyis sems 'khrul ba/ tshad smyo thebs nas 'chol ba/
cha tshad kyi gzhi ma/ bya ba gang byas kyang tshad gzhi nges can zhig dgos/ spus ka'i tshad gzhi/
rgya khyon gyi tshad gu yangs pa'am kha rgya che zhing yangs pa/ byang thang 'brog khul gyi sa rgya che zhing tshad yangs pa/
tsha ba dang 'dres pa'i rims nad/
cha tshad thig tshad len pa/ ar po rgyag yul gyi sa rgya che chung tshad len pa/ gyon gos kyi tshad len pa/
1) tshad zin pa/ ras cha 'dis gyon chas cha tshang gcig gi tshad lon pa/ 2) gdeng tshod dpogs pa/ kha nas thon pa'i tshig shugs des kho'i bsam tshul gyi tshad lon pa red/
tshad rgyag byed kyi shing ste thig shing/
/ 1) rlabs sam tshad/ kha tshan chen po/ bzha' tshan/ lto chas za tshan/ a rag 'thung tshan/ shed tshan/ 2) skor ram tsho/ sde tshan/ gnyen tshan/ lnga tshan/
nus pa/ 'phrul 'khor gyi tshan kha shin tu che ba/ rnam dpyod kyi tshan kha chung ba/ thabs shes kyi tshan kha che ba/
sde tshan/ las grwa'i tshan khag / las khungs kyi tshan khag / tshong zog gi tshan khag /
dngos sna mang po'i rnam grangs/ dngos rigs tshan grangs mang po/ tshan rig dpyad gzhi tshan grangs mang ba/
1) sde tshan gcig / grong pa tshan gcig / 2) 'ga' shas/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang 'brog dud tshan gcig la nor phyugs gtan nas mi 'dug /
gtos che ba'am mang po yod pa'i don/ mi tshan che ba/
1.dron mo/ mar khu tshan de/ 2.(mngon) pi pi ling/
sngar mnga' bdag che khag la rten 'bul du 'jal rgyu'i dngos rdzas kyi dod dang, skabs gzhan du ngal rtsol mi dmangs nas nyes chad 'bul dngos tshan grangs kyi dod dngul/
1.dum bu/ le tshan/ mi rnams tshan pa bgos nas las grwar gtong ba/ 2.(rnying) bkru ba/
1) phon 'bor chen po/ skye bo tshan po che/ 2) shed stobs chen po/ gyad tshan po che'i stobs dang ldan pa/ hur sems tshan po che bas las chod kyang chen po yod pa/
sro lo dmar po'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /

tshan pa tshan pa'am, tshan khag tshan khag / thon zog tshan tshan du bcad pa/ tshogs chung tshan tshan du 'tshogs nas gros sdur byed pa/ dpe cha'i le'u tshan tshan du 'thor ba/ me tog chun po tshan tshan du bsdams pa/
rang byung khams dang, spyi tshogs, bsam blo sogs kyi phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid rnams sde tshan so sor dbye zhib byed pa'i shes bya'i ma lag /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rma 'brub, skrangs pa 'joms/
dod/ ngo tshab/ so tshab/ rin skyin tshab gsum/ las tshab/ mnga' tshab/ rdzun gyi tshab tu drang po bzang/
1) skyin pa'am dod sprod pa/ gzhan gyi yo byad brlags pa'i tshab sgrig pa/ 2) ngo tshab 'tshol ba/ kho rang ngo ma 'gro ma thub pas mi tshab sgrig pa/
/ 1) dngos po gang rung gi rin dngul min pa'i tshab/ 2) ngo tshab/ phran rang mi khom pas tshab po zhig btang yong/
g.yar brje'i dod dam rin 'jal ba/ kho'i ca lag gi tshab sprod pa/
mi brtan pa/ lhod lhod min par brel ba tshab tshub de 'dra ma byed/ khyod tshab bi tshub bi de 'dra byed don ci yin nam/
ngo ma'i dod byed thub pa'i mi/ nga'i tshab byed mkhan kho yin/
dngos po gzhan zhig gi tshab byed pa'i dngos rigs/
tshab bi tshub bi'i bsdus tshig
dngangs skrag langs te sems tshab tshub byed tshul/ dngangs skrag skyes nas tshab tshub ngang sdod pa/
nyes skyon gyi stobs sam shugs/ nad tshabs chung ba/ nyes tshabs yang ba/ mi tshabs can/ nor 'khrul tshabs che ba/ gnod tshabs che ba/ skad cha tshabs chen/ rkun ma tshabs chen/
thag ma chod pa'i blo dogs/ las ka byed stangs thag ma chod par tsham me tshom me byed pa/ 'thab 'dzing gi nang du tsham tshom spu tsam med par zhugs pa/
tsham me tshom me'i bsdus tshig
/ 1) 'bru'i sa rdo dang lhad zhib tshags spyad mig mang can zhig / 2) (rnying) tsha bo/
/ 1) thengs sam lan/ yang bskyar tshar gcig bshad pa/ de nyid gnas drug tshar lnga bkod/ tshar drug steng 'og gnyis su bkod/ 2) gral dang phreng ba/
tshar pa'i yal gas bzos pa'i gzhu byed rgyug pa dang, tho ba sogs kyi yu ba byed pa'i rgyug pa/
log rtog rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gam, de'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i 'khrul shes dang brjod pa skyon can/
snga rgol tshar gcad pa'i gnas dang, phyi rgol tshar gcad pa'i gnas te gnyis so/
pham par byed pa'am 'joms par byed pa/ smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod byas pa/ dgra bo tshar gcod byed pa/
tshar ma brtsigs pa'i bam gzugs/ btsas ma brngas rjes zhing ga'i nang du tshar lcog khang pa ltar brtsigs pa/
gral gyi star 'grig po bsgrigs pa/ ru sgrig skabs ru star lugs tshar du dngar ba zhig dgos/ mkho rgu'i yo byad tshar du dngar ba bstabs/
shing gi bye brag pa zhig /
tshar ma'i bam rtsig gru bzhi'i dbyibs can/
ston thog gi tshar ma'i phung po/
tshar ma'i chun po'am tshar ma'i phon po/
mthar phyin pa/ nga tsho'i sngon ma'i las ka tshang ma tshar phyin pa grub song/
(tha mi dad pa) zin pa/ de ring zhogs pa nas lab tshar ba yin/ slob sbyong byas tshar ba/ las don tshar la khad/
ldum sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gre ba dang, ol krong gi tshad pa, glo tshad bcas la phan/
shing sman gyi rigs tshar leb kyi 'bras bu ste, ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas dreg grum sogs yan lag gi chu ser byer ba sdud/
lo tog brngas pa'i tshar ma/
lug phrug gi pags pas bzos pa'i gyon pa rgyab sha can/
lug phrug gi pags pas bzos pa'i gyon pa rgyab sha can/
mtha' sne 'dzar 'dzar gyi rnam pa/ rgyan cha'i phyang phrul tshar tshar mdzes/
lu gu'i tsha rus bzos pa'i zhwa mo/
sngar zhing bdag khag gis zhing steng nas zhing pa'i ston 'bras phyed phyed sogs bgo sdud byed pa'i shas rgyag lugs shig /
lu gu'i tsha ru'i slog pa/
/ 1) ljon shing mang po 'khrigs pa'i sa/ nags tshal/ skyed mos tshal/ 2) (rgya) sngo tshal gyi zas/
gtsug lag khang: rab byung gsum pa'i me lug lor zhang g.yu brag pa dar ma gzhon nus phyag btab pa'i lha khang chen po zhig /
ched du ma btab par skyes pa'i bza' rung ba'i sngo tshal/
(yul) rta drel gyi lag pa ya gcig dang rkang pa ya gcig sgrog byed/
1) sngo tshal/ 2) tshal zhing gi ldum ra/

/ 1) dum bu/ shel sgo tshal par gas pa/ ras tshal par dbral ba/ 2) phyed pa/ tshal bshags/ 3) bod rang skyong ljongs lha sa grong khyer gyi sa cha sngar bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal zhig / 4) tshal gung thang du sdod pa'i mi/
spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i skabs dwags po lha rje'i yang slob bla ma zhang ngam g.yu brag pa brtson 'grus grags pa las brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha'i nang gses shig /

ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa: tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi lugs srol thog mar gtod mkhan de yin, 'di bod kyi rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang lor skyid shod du 'khrungs, mtshan dar ma grags zhes btags, rab byung gsum pa'i sa 'brug lor bsnyen par rdzogs te brtson 'grus grags par btags, chu sprel lor phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po dang lhan du dwags po lha rje dang mjal, de'i dbon po sgom pa tshul khrims snying po las chos mang du gsan te gdan sa mthil du yun ring bzhugs, rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug lor tshal gzhis bdag po mgar rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis yon bdag byas te tshal yang dgon zer ba'i dgon pa dang, rab byung gsum pa'i me lug lor tshal gung thang gi lha khang dgon pa bcas btab, de nas bzung tshal pa bka' brgyud zer ba'i lugs srol thog mar byung, rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang lor 'das/
dum bu/ ras tshal bu/ shog bu tshal bu/
lha sa'i shar phyogs tshal gung thang gi yul du rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug lo la bla ma zhang gis btab pa'i dgon pa zhig /
sgrol ma lha khang: srong btsan sgam po'i skabs btab pa'i ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
sngo tshal sogs rngod sa'i sla nga/
/ 1) 'byar byed dam bag tshi/ 'byar tshi/ spyin tshi dam lhod/ bal tshi/ 2) mi'i sems rgyud dam ngang rgyud/ tshi ring po/ tshi thung ba/
, shing 'bras nang gi rus pa/ kham bu'i tshi gu/ lo gsum kham bu'i tshi gu'i nang snying/
shing 'bras nang rus kyi snying po/ kham bu'i tshi gu'i nang snying/ lo gsum kham bu'i tshi gu'i nang snying/
1) dam tshi zad pa/ 2) sems re thag chad pa'am yi thang chad pa/
1) ring po nar rgyu med pa'i dam tshi/ 2) sems kyi ngang rgyud thung thung/
tshi shugs chen po'am tshi sna ring po/ spyin chu sla drags pas tshi dam po mi 'dug /
shing gi thang chu/ gsom shing gi tshi ba/
1) ring po nar te 'ong ba'i dam tshi/ 2) sems kyi ngang rgyud ring po/
dam por gnon pa'am, rgyun mi 'chad par gnon tshul zhig / rmon mdzo'i gnya' bar gnya' shing gis tshi re gnon pa/

/ 1) don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra sgra mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ tshig rtsub smra ba'i grogs po de, sha tsha snying nas gces pa'i rtags/ tshig gsum shod long med par lce bregs, gom gsum spo long med par nywa bton/ 2) ming gang zhig phrad dang rnam dbye gang rung dang ldan pas don gyi khyad par ston pa tshig yin/ tshig / ka ba zur brgyad/ ri'i rtse/ gzugs la lta/ 3) tshi gu'i bsdus tshig / tshi gu/ kham tshig / kham tshig bcag nas nang snying za ba/
don med kyi tshig gang byung byung/ gal che'i gros mol nan po byed kyi yod pas tshig kyal pa ma smra zhig /

bod yig rtsom lugs la tshig lhug dang, tshigs bcad gnyis yod pa las, tshig lhug la tshig rkang gi tha snyad med cing, tshigs bcad la rkang pa bzhi bzhir sho lo ka re re rtsi dgos pa'i rkang pa'i ya gyal re la tshig rkang zhes zer, de yang shas cher ya tshig gang yin gyi rkang pa re re la yig 'bru bdun dgu sogs ya grangs mang nyung ci rigs tshig rkang du bsgrigs pa yod do/
tshigs bcad gcig gam, sho lo ka gcig / sho lo ka gcig la tshig rkang bzhi yod/
don med pa'i skad cha/ 'bod tshig skam po/ snying po med pa'i tshig skam po/
skad yig gang rung la rjod tshig lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs zhugs pa'i skyon/ rtsom yig 'bri skabs tshig skyon don skyon gnyis ka med pa zhig dgos/
don cha tshang ma bshad pa/ kho'i sems la dogs pa chen po yod pas skad cha shod 'phro bzhag nas tshig bskums song/
bskor ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bskor bya don mi 'dra ba'i gnas lugs 'ga' zhig skor byed tshig gi rnam 'gyur 'dra bas ldab skyor gyi tshul du ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
tshig cha ma tshang ba kha skong ba/ tshig rkang re re'i nang du yig 'bru gnyis re bsnan te tshig kha skong ba/
tshig 'jam po ma yin pa'am go dka' ba/ nang don zab kyang tshig mkhregs po yin pas don ma rtogs pa/
'don tshig bskyar ba'i 'khyor po/ dpe cha'i tshig 'khyor song/
don la mi bsam par tshig rkyang pa la zhen pa/ gros mol byed dus don la mi dpyod par tshig 'khri sha stag byas na mi 'grig /
1) skad cha thag chod pa/ mgyogs po 'gro rgyu'i tshig 'khrun chod pa/ 2) tshig gi dogs pa chod pa/ yin min gyi bdar sha bcad nas don gnad kyi tshig 'khrun chod pa/
tshig gi bro ba'am nus pa/ ma btab gnad du zug pa'i mtshon, ma 'thung khong du song ba'i sman, ma zos yid 'phrog sbrang rtsi'i ro, tshig gi khyad par rnams la yod/

tshur phan 'dogs byas pa'i lan du phar legs so zhu ba'am, thugs rje che zhu ba'am, yag byung zer ba'am, bka' drin che zhes brjod pa lta bu'i tshig / nga tshor rogs ram skyabs 'jug gnang ba la thugs rje che zhes tshig gi gtang rag 'bul ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la dge ba'i gtam dang, mngon bstod, 'jam smra, snyan ngag snying la 'bab, tshig skyes, tshig bzang, zhi smra, ro ldan, legs brjod, legs bshad bcas so,
tshig bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bkod pa ste snyan zhing rna bar 'jebs pa/
chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyi bye brag gi tshig bla dwags te, don gyi khyad par ston pa'o/
gzungs kyi sgo bzhi'i ya gyal, tshig ji tsam thos pa de tsam du 'dzin nus pa'o/
go don gnyis yod pa'i gtam/ kha gdangs glo mthong gi skad cha gsal po mi bshad par tshig go phyogs gnyis ldan gyi thog nas shod pa ci yin/
nyan mkhan gyi sems dang rna bar mi 'gro ba'i tshig / gzhan la tshig gyong po sha stag bshad na rna bar mi 'gro/

tshig la ram 'degs pa'i grogs su byed pa'am don du ming gi cha shas sam yan lag ste, lag pa zhes pa'i pa dang, mthon po zhes pa'i po dang, ka ba zhes pa'i ba dang, skya bo zhes pa'i bo dang, tha ma zhes pa'i ma dang, nya mo zhes pa'i mo lta bu bdag sgra'i don mi ston pa'o/ ga pa mthon po ka ba skya bo tha ma nya mo...pa po ba bo ma mo...
tshig snga phyi 'gal ba/ 'grel bshad kyi snga tshig dang phyi tshig 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur 'dug /
rtsa ba'i tshig rkang gi 'bru re re bzhin rtsal du bton nas 'grel ba'i gzhung/ tshig la tshig 'grel yod na go bde/
1) tshig la dgag pa gtong ba/ gtso bo don la rgol dgos pa las tshig la rgol ba de dgos med yin/ 2) tshig la dgag pa gtong mkhan/
gzhan sems la phog pa'i skor tshig gam zur za'i gtam/ drang gtam thad kar shod pa las tshig rgyag kyog gtam ma shod/ gzhas kyi rnam pa'i thog nas phan tshun tshig rgyag rgyag pa/
1) sum rtags kyi tshig rgyan kyang yang 'ang sogs/ kyang yang 'ang...2) snyan ngag gi don rgyan dang sgra rgyan sogs/ 3) tshig nyams 'don byed kyi tshig rgyan/ rnam par rab tu mngon par...
tshig 'bru mang po'i nang nas mkho che ba'i tshig len pa/ mkho yod kyi tshig sgrug phyogs sdeb byas pa/ gzhan gyis skad cha bshad pa'i nang nas tshig sgrug pa/
tshig mang po'i don gcig pa/ khos skad cha mang po bshad kyang tshig brgya mdo gcig la bsdus na rang 'dod kho na las mi 'dug /
1) skad cha'i tshig lhu bsgrigs pa/ 2) gzhung tshig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/
skad cha rtsub po'am gzhan sems dkrug pa'i skad cha gnag po/ tshig ngan nyung yang mi sems dkrug rgya khab chung yang rtse mo rno/
ngag 'khyal te don med kyi 'chal lab/ don med tshig 'chal kho na bshad nas tshig don snying po brlag pa/
tshig snying rje po'am, tshig rna bar snyan po/ grogs po'i skyon cha brjod par tshig 'jam po smra ba/ tshig 'jam po bshad na mi kun mgu, tshig rtsub po bshad na mi kun sun/
don gyi rjes su tshig 'gro 'jug bde po/ rtsom yig 'di'i tshig 'jug po 'dug /
tshig gi rjes kho na gcod pa ste tshig 'khri/ don la brtag dpyad med par tshig rjes gcod pa tsam la snying po med/
tshig thog don gnas dang don gcig
skad rigs so so'i tshig gi rnam 'gyur/ snyan tshig 'di tshig nyams ha cang dod po 'dug /
1) rjod tshig la skyon zhugs pa/ rjod byed kyi tshig nyams na brjod bya'i don mi rtogs/ 2) (mngon) lkugs pa/
tshig nyog med la don gnad 'dus pa/ yi ge tshig nyung don tshang de sus mthong yang go bde po yong/
'da' bar mi nus pa'i tshig btsan po/
rjod byed kyi tshig snyan la brjod bya'i don bzang ba/ khong gis bshad pa'i gtam de tshig snyan don bzang zhig red/
tshig gi gter zhes bya ba don gcig ming gi rnam grangs rnams tshig le'ur byas pa'i mngon brjod kyi gzhung zhig ste, dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/
pa'i sbyar ba: sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sbyar gzhi dngos po gnyis kyi sbyar chos mang po rnams sgra tshig gcig pa yin zhing, gcod mtshams tha mi dad pas sbyar ba'i rgyan zhig /
skad cha shod nyes/ skad cha tshig thal shor ba/
gang bshad pa thams cad dngos su lag len bstar ba/ khong ni tshig thog don 'khel byed mkhan mi brtan po zhig yin/
gang bshad don gnas/ mi 'dis gang bshad tshig thog don gnas yin pas yid ches byed rigs/
(yul) go dka' ba'i tshig / gzhan gyis rtogs dka' ba'i tshig mthon po/
1) yig 'bru mang nyung cha mi snyoms pa'i tshig / ngag rtsom tshig 'theng po'i rigs rjod mi bde/ 2) skad cha mi gsal ba/ smra rjod tshig 'theng po de shar mar go mi bde/
kha dan nam kha chad/ phan tshun gros sdur byed rgyu'i tshig dan bzos pa/
rtsom mkhregs po/ rtsom yig 'di tshig dam po yin pas go dka'/
1) rjod byed tshig dang, brjod bya'i don/ 2) rjod byed tshig gi nang don/
tshig don gnyis ka bskor ba
bskor ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, skor byed tshig don gnyis kas bskor kyang, bskor bya'i gnas tshul mi 'dra bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
tshig don gsal po/ gzhan la rogs ram byed skabs tshig don dmar rjen du bshad dgos/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gzhi'i gnas lugs la zhugs pa lam du goms pas 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi bar lam 'khyer man ngag gi tshul du bshad pa rdo rje'i gnas bcu gcig pa, dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa/
(mngon) 1) gza' phur bu/ 2) sangs rgyas/ 3) 'jam dbyangs/
bshad pa'i tshig ltar don la gnas pa/
gnad la phog pa'i ngan tshig / gzhan gyi snying la gzan pa'i tshig mda' 'phangs pa/ pha rol por dma' 'bebs kyi tshig mda' mi 'phen pa de ni rtsod pa mdzes pa'i rgyan zhig yin/
tshig nyung don tshang/ tshig 'dum po byung na go bde/
1) tshig zlos skyon can/ 2) yang yang nan tan lab pa/
skad cha mi gsal ba/ bshad pa'i tshig ldab ldib yin na gzhan gyis go dka'/

ming gnyis sam mang po'i bar gy rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas thams cad kyi mtha' mar rnam dbye gcig sbyar ba'i ming ste nang gses la las 'dzin dang, ba gnyis, de'i skyes bu, 'bru mang, zlas dbye, mi zad pa bcas drug yod/
tshig 'doms che la, don ya yo 'khyag 'khyog med pa/ tshig nan don drang byung na gzhan sems rnam par gnon thub/
tshig gi gnad 'gag / gsung bshad kyi tshig gnad bsgrims te mnyan pa/
1) skad cha'i shod stangs la bltas te snyad 'tshol ba/ skad cha nor ba'i tshig gnad sgrug pa/ 2) skad cha'i snying po sgrug pa/ gsung bshad kyi nang don gal che rnams kyi tshig gnad sgrug pa/
(yul) sbyang shing steng du yi ge 'bri byed gro tshig ma dang phyur khus bzos pa'i snag tsha zhig /
1.'tshig pa'i 'das pa, 2.mi dga' ba'i don du go ba'i 'tshig pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
khong khro skye ba/ mi de spro thung thung yin stabs tshig pa za chog chog red/ rna bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha thos dus tshig pa ma za/ rgyu med rkyen med du tshig pa za long long zhig byung/
ming gnyis sam du ma sbrel ba'i tshe bar du mtshams sbyor ba'am, don gsal ba la phan 'dogs pa'i sgra'i rnam pa ste rang dbang can dang gzhan dbang can gnyis su phye yod/

1) mes tshig pa'i bud shing sogs kyi lhag ma/ bud shing gi tshig 'phro/ sol ba'i tshig 'phro/ me skyon shor ba'i khang pa'i tshig 'phro/ 2) skad cha'i lhag ma/ khyed rang tog tsam sgug rogs nga'i skad cha'i tshig 'phro chod ma song/ dza drag gi gnas tshul glo bur du byung nas 'phros mol gyi tshig 'phro bcad pa/ gzhan gyi tshig 'phro phrogs nas bshad pa/
skad cha bsngogs pa/ kho'i kha nas skad cha bzang ngan gang shod tshig brus pa/
ming dngos ma yin par ched du btags pa'i ming/ dkrug shing zhes pa 'di shing gi tshig bla dwags red/
tshig bla dwags kyi reg pa
reg pa'i tshogs drug las yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni tshig bla dwags kyi reg pa zhes bya ste, tshig bla dwags ni ming yin la, yid ni gtso bor ming la dmigs pas yul ming yul can la btags pa'o/

mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la bskur te sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang, 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog byed kyi dbang/

1) rjod byed yi ge mang drags pa/ dgos med tshig 'byams kyi yi ge 'bri rtsom byas na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i dus tshod 'phro brlag gtong rogs red/ 2) skad cha bshad yam che ba/ don gnad kyi thog tu mi 'khel ba'i tshig 'byams nyag nyog
(rnying) 1) tshig bzo ba'am sgrig pa/ 2) lan rgyag mi thub pa/ 3) bod yig gi tsheg shad/ 4) tshig don rtogs pa/
1) rjod byed yi ge'i gong 'og gi 'brel ba/ 2) skad cha shod stangs/ snga phyi'i tshig 'brel/
kha rgyags pa'am kheng dregs kyi skad cha/ rnam rgyun skad cha tshig sbom po bshad na gzhan gyis yid ches dka'/
khe nyen gyi rgyu mtshan gsal por bshad pa/ kho tsho'i lab rnyog dbar la tshig sbyangs gsed bkrol gnang bas le 'grigs byung ba/
ming tshig yi ge'i sbyor ba/ rtsom yig 'di tshig sbyor mi legs pas go brda 'phrod po mi 'dug /
snying rtsom sgros yag po/ rtsom yig 'di tshig sbyor 'dra chags la nang don yang gting zab po 'dug
khro zangs kyi mthil du 'bras sogs mi 'tshig pa'i ched 'debs pa'i mar khu/
go bde ba'i skad cha/ yig rigs rnams tshig dma' po'i thog nas bsgyur ba yin pas go bde po 'dug /
bsgyur bkod gtong mi thub pa'i tshig / bka' rgya tshig btsan po/
tshig brtan po'am, bden pa/ tshig btsun po bshad pas gzhan sems sgul/
gzhan gyi sems la phog thug che ba'i tshig / tshig rtsub kho na bshad pas don mi 'grub/ tshig rtsub tsher ma dang mtshungs pa/
tshig gi rtsod pa/ don med tshig rtsod ma rgyag cig
ming dang tshig mang po'i spros pa/
rjod tshig spyi'i tshig gi bar mtshams/ don tshan re re'i bar la tshig mtshams kyis gcod pa/
tshig gi mtshon cha ste, tshig rtsub/ gzhan la tshig mtshon 'debs pa/
tshig tshogs mdzod khang gi gzugs su bkod pa/ tshig mdzod dang ming mdzod ni nyer bkol gyi dpe deb red/
1) rjod byed tshig gi rnam 'gyur/ 2) sngon rjes ming gsum 'dus pa'i tshig rten te ming/

rang dngos su brjod pa'i sgra tshig gis zin pa'am dmigs kyis bzung nas bstan te don gzhan rnam par gcod pa'i tshig dper na, mngon sum ni rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa yin, zhes pa'i tshig zin gyis rtog bcas dang 'khrul shes rnams bcad pa lta bu'o/
dngos su ma bshad par zur nas mtshang la phog pa'i gtam shod pa/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la tshig zur rgyag pa/
sgra dag pa'am skad cha zhib gsal thon pa/ bka' slob gang gnang sbas bskungs med par tshig zur phyin pa zhig 'dug /
tshig gi spu ris/ bshad khrid tshig ris phyogs 'dra bar, go ba rang rang so sor len/
1) don dag med pa'i tshig / skad cha'i tshig ro rnams bsgyur nas don dag rdog rdog shod dgos/ 2) mes tshig pa'i ro ma/ shog bu tshig ro de rnams phyir skyur cig /
gzhan gyi skyon dang mtshang 'bru ba'i gtum tshig

mi rton pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste 'jig rten pa'i brda dang tha snyad thun mong pa'i rig gnas la sogs pa dang, yang na chos kyi sgo ma brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du'ang sgra tshig dang yi ge tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba ni don chung ngu yin pas de la rton par mi bya ba'o/
1) gtam rtsod kyi gshags 'debs/ phyogs gnyis phan tshun tshig lan tshig rgyag gis thag gcod rgyu dka'/ 2) spyir gyi dri ba dris lan/ tshig lan tshig rgyag gi sgo nas brtag dpyad byed pa/
1) dpe cha sogs kyi tshig blor nges par byed pa/ 2) dpe deb khag nas tshig sgrug pa/
tshig bcad lhug gang rung gi sa bcad sde tshan so so'i ming/ rtsom yig gi tshig le'ur byas pa/ zlos gar 'khrab gzhung gi tshig le'ur bsgrigs pa/
tshig su bcad pa ste, tshigs bcad re re la rgya gar gyi yi ge brgyad bzhi sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bod kyi ni tsheg bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod do/
tshig gi lo ma ste snying po med pa'i tshig / dgos med kyi tshig lo dor nas don gyi 'bras bu gtsor bzung byed pa/
gtam phyin ci log pa/ pha ma la kha log tshig log byed mi nyan/
skad cha'i shod stangs/ khong gi tshig shugs la bltas na nga'i bsam 'char la 'thad pa 'dra'o/
skad cha bden rdzun dag bsher byed pa/ rtsod gzhi'i skor la phan tshun tshig bsher ba/
dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba sgrags pas mdzad pa zhig /
tshig gi sgo nas zhu ba/
1) bstan bya'i tshig 'phro ma/ 2) dgos med kyi tshig thal/
ngag thog gi skad cha'am yig thog gi rjod tshig la rang 'dod kyis gsar snon bcug pa'i tshig skyon/ gnas tshul ngo ma dang mi mthun pa'i tshig lhad/ rang bzos sbyar ba'i tshig lhad/
rjod byed kyi tshig rkang par ma bcad pa'i lhug ma/
bcad mtshams sam bar mtshams/ smyug ma'i tshigs/ rus tshigs/ gtan tshigs/ dus tshigs/
rkang lag gi tshigs bud pa slar sbyor ba/
du song ba: 'dul ba las bshad pa'i mthun rkyen lnga'i nang nas bsam pa'i mthun rkyen zhig ste, dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du song zhing chags pa'o/
«g'tha» tshig rkang bzhi rer bcad pa'i sho lo ka/ tshig lhug 'bri bde yang tshigs bcad 'bri dka'/
mkhrig tshigs gnyis, gru tshigs gnyis, phrag tshigs gnyis bcas lag pa la drug long tshigs gnyis, pus tshigs gnyis, dpyi tshigs gnyis bcas rkang pa la drug ste bcu gnyis so/
lus kyi tshigs chung ba nyis brgya dang nyi shu/
rkang lag sogs kyi rus tshigs kha gyes pa/ tshigs bud pa sman pas slar yang brgyu ba/
yan lag dang nying lag sogs tshid kyi gzhi/
lus kyi tshigs na ba'i zug rngu/

gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi bzhi pa tshigs su bcad pa gnyis la sogs pas don ston pa dper na, tshoms dang mdo sde rgyan gyi tshigs bcad lta bu ste nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod du gtogs pa zhig go /
(tha mi dad pa) tshims pa, tshim pa,, ngoms pa'am mgu ba/ re 'dod ji bzhin 'grub pas blo kha tshim pa/
(mngon) 1) ba ru ra'i shing/ 2) tsan dan/ 3) hor zla bcu gcig pa/
bad kan lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, byed las spyi bor gnas nas dbang po rnams tshim par byed pa/
1) bud shing/ 2) sbyin sreg gi yam shing/
1.'tshir ba'i skul tshig 2.me la chu btab pa'i sgra/
lag pas dam por bzung ba/ zhum bu 'dis bye'u gcig lag pas tshir gyis bzung song/ gal che'i las don dran pas tshir gyis bzung song/ gal che'i las don dran pas tshir gyis bzung ba/
me nang chu bo ba'i sgra'i khyad par/
tshil bzhus nas byung ba'i khu ba/
kha snon tshil bu ste sha khog steng la tshi lu snon pa/ da dung dmag dpung bsdu rgyu de, sha khog steng la tshil snon red/
tshi lu'i nang gi sha rmen/
tshil khu bton pa'i snyigs ma/
/ 1) phan grogs/ mthun rkyen de rigs tshang ma khyod kyi tshis su 'gro nges yin pa/ 2) thabs/ 'tsho tshis/
tshur ngos kyi ngye 'gram mam tshur ngos kyi sne/ chu tshu kha nas phar kha la lta ba/
'di phyogs sam tshur ngos kyi ri/ tshu ri nas pha ri'i bar du glog skud btang/
'di phyogs sam rang nyid yod sa'i ngos/ rgya mtsho'i tshu rol/ lcags lam gyi tshu rol/
mi phyugs sogs kyi rma nad skrangs gcong la gser khab mer bsregs te btsugs pa'i 'chos thabs shig /
/ 1) bzo lta/ lus kyi sha tshugs rgyas pa/ che tshugs/ bris sku'i ri mo tshugs ka med pa/ 2) khang pa gcong can la ka ba'i rogs skyor du btsugs pa'i ka ba phan pa'am nyen ka/
1.'dzugs pa'i skul tshig 2.lam bar gyi 'bab tshugs/ sa tshugs/ rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs/
yi ge dbu med kyi nang gses shig ste, tshugs thung gi phyed tshad tsam yod la 'khyug gi 'brel ba med pa'i yig gzugs/
yi ge dbu med kyi nang gses shig ste, tshugs ring gi phyed tshad tsam yod la 'khyug gi 'brel ba med pa'i yig gzugs/
'gyur ldog med pa/ mi tshugs thub po zhig /
ral gshigs lhod po/ tshab tshub spangs nas tshugs dal gyis zhib 'jug byed pa/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) 'tsho zin pa/ rkang pa lcags skud kyi steng du btsugs nas tshugs thub pa/ phru gu sdod mi tshugs pa/ gsang gtam phyir mi shod pa'i kha tshugs pa/ 2) gnod pa dang 'tshe ba/ rdo bal la mes mi tshugs pa/ 'gyig la chus mi tshugs pa/ gzugs po thang por nad kyis mi tshugs pa/
g.yo ba med pa'am brtan po/ mi tshugs po/ phru gu sdod tshugs po,..rta 'gros tshugs po/
bzo lta'am sha tshugs dang byad gzud/ mi rgan gzhon gyi tshugs byad mi 'dra ba 'dug /
zhag tshugs sdod sa/ tshugs 'bab sar zhag sdod byas pa/
1) sha tshugs byon gtsang ba'am bzo lta legs pa/ 2) spyod bzang/
1) 'grul pa'i nyin lam gyi ring tshad/ 2) thub pa'am nus pa'i tshad/

dus tshigs nyer bzhi'i nang tshan zhig ste, hor zla dang po'i dbugs thob nyin dpy id kyi 'go tshugs pa dang, hor zla bzhi pa'i dbugs thob nyin dbyar tshugs pa, hor zla bdun pa'i dbugs thob nyin ston tshugs pa, hor zla bcu pa'i dbugs thob nyin dgun tshugs pa bcas so/
tshugs ring tshugs thung sogs 'khyug las che ba'i yi ge
yi ge dbu med kyi nang gses shig ste, ka kha yig gzugs las sum gcig gis chung ba'i 'bru chen gyi yi ge /
gur gyi phyi nang du btsugs pa'i kar rgyug / sbra'i tshugs shing khyer nas mang po rdeg tu byung/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) gral lam nang du slebs pa/ mkhas pa'i gras su tshud pa/ las don tshags su tshad pa/ 2) shong ba/ khang pa gcig gi nang du mi grangs brgya lhag tsam tshud thub pa/
tshun chad dam tshu rol/ dgun dus shar tshun/ bcings 'grol thob tshun/ nad pa des sman thang 'thungs tshun nad gzhi rim drag byung 'dug /
dbye mtshams nas rang ngos su phyogs pa/ sa thig 'di tshun chad rang re'i mnga' khongs kyi sa cha bsnyon med yin/ rang btsan byung ba tshun chad/
rtsub mo/ gnam gshis tshub mo/ mi gshis tshub mo/ bya spyod tshub mo/
1.kha mig zum par byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'dzum pa'i skul tshig 2.(rnying) cung zad tsam/
(rgya) lto chas kyi bro ba 'don byed cig /
tshu rol zer ba'i bsdus yig ste, 'di phyogs/ tshu rol...phar sprod tshur len/ pha rol tu phyin nas tshur yong ba/ don med phar 'gro tshur 'gro ma byed/ kho tsho'i ngan khag nga tshor tshur 'bor ba/
lan tshwa'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bsda skyur lan tsha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas kha yi dri ma ngan pa sel, rus pa'i nad dang so rnyil la phan/
1) tshur gnod pa skyel ba/ dgra bos tshur rgol byas pa pham nyes su btang ba/ 2) tshig gis tshur rgol bar byed pa'am snga rgol/
so so skye bo rang ga ba'i rgyud kyi shes pa'o/
tshur phebs par zhu/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/
byung song/ tshur byung phar song gi 'gro gron rnams zhib rtsis rgyag pa,
dngos po dang dbang cha sogs rang phyogs su bsdu len/ dgra bo'i lag tu shor ba'i mnga' khongs sa cha tshur len pa/
rang gnas su phyir yong ba/ lta skor tshogs pa rnams lta skor zin te tshur log byung/
'di phyogs/ gtsang chu'i tshur logs/ ri'i tshur logs/

/ 1) thabs/ 'tsho ba skyel tshul/ las ka byed tshul/ 2) lugs sam stangs/ 'gro tshul/ skad cha bshad tshul/ gnas tshul/ 3) rigs pa/ tshul dang tshul min 'byed mkhas pa/ tshul bzhin byed pa/ 4) khul/ mi shes shes tshul ma byed/
(shil) spong ba'i sems pa ste, tshul 'chal gyi gdung ba sel ba'am, bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba spong ba'i sems pa'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la sdom khrims dang, sdom pa, tshangs par spyod pa bcas so,

tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gyi khyad chos bzhi ste, tshul 'chal sogs mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang, chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa, yongs su srung bar byed pa, rigs can gsuum smin par byed pa bcas so/
tshul khrims kyi mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig tshul khrims kyi phar phyin rim ldan du sgom pa'o/
'phags nor bdun gyi nang gses, sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod sdom pa ste, yon tan gyi rgyan gyis kun yid 'phrog pas btsun mo rin po che dang chos mchungs pa'o/
khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi spong ba'i sems kyis nyes spong 'dod kyi dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa, phar phyin drug gi ya gyal zhig /
zag med kyi phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig /

t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu pa 'di rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me byi lor khams li thang du 'khrungs, chu lug lor gser bum dkrud nas yang srid ngos 'dzin gyis gser khrir bkod, me bya lor 'das/ (1816-1837)...1823...
tshul khrims rjes su dran pa
rjes su dran pa drug gi nang gses, tshul khrims kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'o/
tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, kun rdzob tu tshul khrims kyi yon tan rim ldan du dran pa'o/

tshul 'chal spong ba'i tshul khrims dang, cha byad, tshul, lus ngag bcas kyi 'jug pa nges par byed pa'i brtul zhugs dang, gang la brten nas de dag 'byung ba'i phung por dmigs nas sdig pa 'dag pa dang nyon mongs las grol ba dang 'khor ba las nges par 'byin par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can te lta ba lnga'i nang gses shig /

pha rol las led par yang dag par blangs pa'i yon tan dang, bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i yon tan, nyams na phyir gso ba'i yon tan, mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir gus pa bskyed nas dran pa nye bar gnas pa'i yon tan bzhi'o/

1) byang sems kyi tshul khrims gsum ste, nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang, dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims, sems can don byad kyi tshul khrims rnams so/ 2) 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims dang, legs smon gyi tshul khrims, nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bcas gsum mo/

1) phyi tshul gyi spyod lam 'dra chags po bzo ba/ gzhan rnams rang la dad pa'i phyir tshul 'chos byed pa/ 2) dge slong gi log 'tsho lnga'i nang gses shig ste, rnyed pa don du gnyer nas yon tan dang ldan pa dang, chos dang mthun pa'i phyi tshul bcos ma ston pa'o/
lugs dang mthun pa/ tshad ldan tshul mthun gyi spyod pa/
1) tshad ldan nam tshul dang mthun pa/ mi tshul ldan la kun gyis bstod/ 2) tshul gnas sam khrims ldan/
spyod tshul dan cha byad/ mi'i tshul byad kho na la bltas te ngo bo dpog mi thub/
lugs dang mi mthun pa/ tshul min gyi bya spyod/ skad cha tshul min/ tshul min yid byed/
1) spyod lam legs pa/ 2) tshul khrims gtsang ba/
1) rang tshugs shor ba/ 2) tshul khrims nyams par gyur pa/
rang rang gi lugs srol ltar/ las don tshul bzhin byed pa/ tshul bzhin bshad pa/ tshul bzhin spyod pa/ de lta bu'i gtam smra ba ni tshul bzhin ma yin no/
tshul 'chos te, don du med kyang phyi tshul du yod mdog kha po byed pa/ mi tshul gzob can/
cha byad bzung ba/ drag po'i tshul bzung ba/ zhi dul gyi spyod tshul bzung ba/
lugs srol/ 'jig rten gyi tshul lugs ji bzhin du bya ba byas na led/
dge 'dun gyi las chog byed dus grwa grang 'dren byed 'om bu shing las bzos pa'i thur ma zhig /
gzhal bya lkog gyur ji bzhin rtod byed kyi rtags yang dag 'god pa'i tshul gsum ste, phyogs chos dang, rjes khyab dang, ldog khyab po/
tshul gsum pa'i rtags ston pa
tshul gsum pa'i rtags ston par byed pa'i mtshan nyid gzhan gyi don gyi rjes su dpag pa'i skabs su bab nas bshad pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos mchog gis brtsam pa zhig /
/ 1) srog / tshe gcig lus gcig / 2) dus sam skabs/ tshe ring nad med/

dus tshod dang skabs bab kyi khyad par nye bar ston pa'i tshig phrad cig ste, dper na, chu tshod dang por las grwa tshugs, chu tshod drug par tshogs 'du 'tshogs, nyin dus su ngal rtsol byas, mtshan dgung du glog brnyan bltas, skabs skabs su lus rtsal sbyangs, bar bar du slob sbyong byas, zhes pa lta bu/ la...
sngar hor mo tshos tshe hril po'i ring ma bregs par 'jog pa'i skra/
mi tshe hril po/ tshe gang bsags pa'i nor rdzas/
mi tshe gcig gi gtan grogs te bza' zla/
lha dang drang srong brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas mi la bstims te mi'i tshe bsring bar byed pa'i cho ga zhig /
rang gi skye ba sngon ma'i gnas shes pa/

1) lus stod sbal pa dang lus smad nya'i rnam pa ltar gyur pa'i lcong mo ste, ro mngar la lan tsha, nus pas gnyan nad 'joms/ 2) sgo nga dang 'dab chags kyi lus gnyis dang, sha 'bu dang sha sbrang gi lus gnyis lta bu/
tshe'i zungs/ lus zungs zad na tshe bcud nyams/
gzhan la tshe dbang skur skabs kyi sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi/
slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs kyis 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu mig /
mi tshe je thung du 'gro ba ste, snyigs ma lnga'i nang tshan zhig /
tshe rgyun bsring byed kyi sgrub rdzas rten gtor/
tshe'i stod cha/ kho tshe stod dbul yang tshe smad phyug /
1) tshe srog brtan po/ 2) (mngon) sring bal shing/
gzhan gyis gsod rgyu'i sems can ra lug sogs srog blu gtong srol zhig / bshas lug tshe thar btang ba/
mi thog gcig pa/ nga tsho tshang ma tshe thog gcig pa'i mi yin/
1) mi gson po/ 2) slob dpon gyis slob mar 'bod pa'i tshig /
tshe 'phel thabs kyi mdo sde dang gzungs sngags shig /
tshe dang ldan pa ste ma shi bar 'tsho bzhin pa'i mi/
rgyan me tog sgrol ma: khri srong lde btsan gyi btsun mo che ba, des bsam yas khams gsum zangs khang gling bzhengs par bshad/
tshe 'khyol ba/ mi dmangs kyi ched du las don byas nas mi tshe phyid na don dang ldan pa zhig red/
tshe las 'da' ba/ tshe 'pho ba ldog med chos nyid red/
1) tshe sgrub rten gyi bum pa/ 2) tshe dpag med kyi phyag mtshan bum pa/
tshe ring po yong thabs kyi dbang chog /

o rod tsho pa bzhi'i nang gses kyi jun gar gyi 'go dpon zhig gi ming yin zhing, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya lor khos rang sde'i dmag dpung khrid de lha sar gu shr'i bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi yang tsha lha bzang han bsad cing, t'a la'i bla ma drug pa rjes ma ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho gnas dbyung btang/

sngags rnying ma'i sa lam bgrod tshul rig 'dzin bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mthong ba'i lam bsdus te chos mchog thob pa'i rten de nyid dwangs ma'i lus rdo rje lta bur 'gyur zhing, sems kyang mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes su smin pas skye 'chi med pa tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'o/
nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par 'bar ba'i mar me'i ming/
nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par 'bar ba'i mar me'i kong bu'i ming/
bon gyi spyod pa'i skor gyi gzhung zhig /
sngar bod du byung ba'i bon chos kyi grub mtha' zhig /
tshe mjug / tshe smad la bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel rgyu byung/

lha sa'i nang du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig ste, sngar man ju'i rgyal rabs kyi dus su bod kyi srid 'dzin lan gsum byas pa'i go ming kwan ting shr'i thu no mon han gyis 'dzin bdag byed pa'i dgon pa zhig /
tshe gang btson khang du bcug pa'i btson pa/
tshe ring thung gi gnas tshad/
ra yi ming/ g.yang dkar lug dang tshe tshe ra/
tshe mjug rdzogs pa'am tshar ba/
shi ba/ nad pa myur du tshe yi dus byed pa/
gso ba'i rig pa dang don gcig /
tshe snga phyi'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ tshe rabs brje ba/
tshe snga phyi dang da lta'i skyid sdug lta tshul gyi rtsis 'bras/
1) tshe ring po/ tshe ring nad med/ tshe ring lo brgya/ 2) (mngon) lha/
bod kyi pho mo ris med kyis gyon pa'i zhwa mo zhig /
bu dang bu mo tshe ring ba'i ched du bla ma khag la 'bul rgyu'i skra phud/

sngon gyi ngag rgyun du lha mo bkra shis tshe ring ma dang, mthing gi zhal bzang ma, mi g.yo blo bzang ma, cod pan mgrin bzang ma, gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma bcas rnam lngas rim gyis 'jig rten gyi tshe dpal dang, sngon shes, sa zhing, rin po che, 'brog phyugs sogs dbang du byed zer la, mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i ming gzhan zhig la gangs mthon mthing rgyal mo'ang zer ba de jo mo glang ma rir gnas, lha mo de dag gi gtso bo yin par grags so/
sngar gyi bshad srol ltar brag tshe ring dang, chu tshe ring, shing tshe ring, mi tshe ring, bya tshe ring, ri dwags tshe ring ste drug /
tshe rdzas bsdus bsgrubs kyi ril bu/
mi tshe gcig gi gtan grogs/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste, bskal ba brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par tshe'i tshad byin gyis brlabs pa/
mi rnams kyi tshe thub pa'i tshad/ mi'i tshe lo brgya pa/ tshe lo brgyad khri pa/ tshe lo bcu pa/
mi sogs mi 'chi bar gnas thub pa'i rten/
mar me'i mar khu dang 'dra ba'i tshe, sdong bu dang 'dra ba'i srog me lce dang 'dra ba'i bla ste de gsum sems can rnams kyi rten gyi dbang po 'tsho bar byed pa'i rkyen gsum/
tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyi bsdus ming/ tshe bsod dbang gsum dang ldan pa/
lha tshe dpag med dang, sgrol dkar, rnam rgyal ma ste gsum/
tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan yod pa'i kha btags legs gras shig /
/ 1) dbu med kyi yig 'bru'i bar bar du bri rgyu'i tsheg ris `` ? '' dang dbu can gyi yig 'bru'i bar bar bri rgyu'i tsheg ris `` ? '' 'di lta bu'i ming/ 2) sgra tsam/
snga phyi'i tsheg gi bar yig 'bru gcig nas bzhi bar gang yod kyi sa khongs/ ming gzhi...sgrub...
rgya rim pa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, tshig 'bru mi 'khrug par byed pa'i rtags `` ? '' lta bu/
sgra grag tshul gyi khyad par zhig / byi bas zas dngos brkus te tsheg chom gyi sgra grag pa/
bar bar du mtshams bzhag nas 'then pa'i thig ris/
yi ge'i tsheg gnyis bar gyi sa khongs/ ming gzhi...
yig 'bru'i bar mtshams 'byed byed tsheg dang shad/
kong po sogs nas thon pa'i ljon shing rgya zhes pa me la 'bud skabs tsheg sgra sgrog pa zhig /
/ 1) dka' ngal lam dka' las/ dka' tshegs/ tshegs che don chung/ 2) chung ba dang nyung ba/ phran tshegs/
dka' las med par rang shugs kyis grub pa/ las don gang 'dra zhig yin kyang 'bad rtsol ma byas par rang bzhin gyis tshegs med lhun grub tu 'byung ba med do/
dka' las yang yang brgyab ste bsgrubs pa/ las don rnam grangs mang po tshegs tshegs su bsgrubs nas tshar song/
dka' tshegs rang steng du len pa/
(yul) ston 'bras g.yul 'don gyi yo byad cig /
gos sogs tshem byed kyi skud pa/
dar skud sna tshogs spel nas btsems pa'i gos chen/ gos chen tshem drub ma/
bzo tshem gyi las ka/ tshem bu brgyab nas 'tsho ba skyel ba/ tshem bu'i 'khor lo/
skud pa 'gug nas 'gug tu bkug pa'i tshem bu zhig /
zhib tshags min par bar thag ring por 'tshem pa'i tshem bu/
1. tha dad par 'jug cing 'drub pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshem pa'i skul tshig 2. so'i zhe sa/ tshems dkar dung 'phreng bstar ba 'dra/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, mche ba zlum pa dang, mche ba rno ba dang, mche ba dkar ba dang, mche ba mnyam pa dang, mche ba byin gyis phra ba bcas lnga'o/
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste skye bo thams cad bkur ba la sogs pas tshems dkar ba/
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa nyid kyis tshems mnyam pa/
tshems thags bzang ba'i mtshan bzang
sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, bden pa'i tshig kun tu spyad pas tshems thags bzang ba/
ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, phra ma'i tshig spangs pas tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba/
so'i dreg pa 'don byed kyi shing bu/
tshems dkar ba'i mtshan bzang dang don gcig
tshems grangs bzhi bcu tshang ba
spyan mthon mthing 'dra ba, spyan gyi rdzi ma ba mchog gi rdzi ma 'dra ba ste sum cu rtsa gnyis/
tshe'i kun nas nyon mongs pa
rten 'brel bcu gnyis las, rnam shes dang, ming dang gzugs dang, skye mched drug dang, reg pa dang, tshor ba dang, skye ba dang, rga shi bcas bdun no/
gang zag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i tshe srog ldan min 'du byed kyi gras shig / tshe'i 'du byed yal bar mi mdzad pa/ sku tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba/
kham bu'i me tog bod kyi bzo rtsal thon rdzas nang bed spyod gtong mang ba'i rgyan ris tshe ring po mtshon byed cig /
a byag tsher sngon gyi bsdus tshig
tsher ma tshar du bsgrigs pa'i ra ba/ tsher star gyi ra ba'i nang du me tog btab pa/
tsher mas bskor ba'i ra ba/
shing tsher ma'i phung po/ sgo na tsher phung gis bskor yod/ tsher phung bskor nas, ri bong la 'jab rdo/

/ 1) skya tsher, dmar tsher, sngo tsher sogs reg na 'bigs pa'i shing rigs rtse rno can/ tsher ma rno yang brag ri 'bigs mi thub/ rkang par tsher ma zug dus rdog pa dran/ kha sbrang rtsi las mngar ba, sems tsher ma las rtsub pa/ 2) gzan po/ rna ba'i tsher ma ma byed/
don dag chung chung gzhi chen por sgrog pa'i dpe/
lo gnyis lon pa'i re'u dang lu gu mo/
chos lugs pas gtor zor la 'dzugs rgyu'i tsher ma can gyi shing phra zhing rtse rno ba zhig /
tsu mo ti ste tsher ma 'dzin byed dam rmangs 'jab/
lus kyi gnas gang red du tsher ma zug ste da'i steng gnyan nad dang mnyam du 'doms nas blo bur du skrangs shing zug rngu drag po 'byung ba zhig /

/ 1) tshes grangs/ 2) zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i lo dang zla ba dang zhag bcas kyi yun 'jal byed kyi tshad de, tshes zhag tshes zla, tshes lo, tshes longs lta bu/ 3) (mngon) rags par zla ba'i phyogs rer tshes zhag dang nyin zhag gnyis ka bco lnga re yod pas grangs bco lnga mtshon/
tshes kyi dang po/ zla ba tshes kha stag gam sprel nas 'dzin pa/
nyi skar dag pa la zla skar rtag longs byin zin pa'i ming/
de nyin gyi tshes longs rdzogs par spyod pa'i zla skar rnam dag yin, 'dir 'khyud ces pa ni da lta 'grogs bzhin pa'i don yin/
tshes gcig nas so gcig bar/ tshes grangs rtsi ba/ tshes grangs mthun pa/ tshes grangs mi mthun pa/ tshes grangs gtan 'khel/
tshes grangs kyi gza' skar bzang po/ zla tshes dge bar bris/
zla ba'i phyi rkang lugs ldog dus su zla ba'i 'phel 'grib mgyogs pas na chu tshod nga bzhi'i bar 'byung ba yin/
yar ngo'i tshes pa bcu dang, mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste nyi shu lnga/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la tshogs 'khor gtong ba/
yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs 'cham rgyag stangs kyi zin bris/
tshes grangs/ phyogs su 'gro rgyu'i tshes cha da dung gtan khel ma song/

gza' dag gi gza' gcig lan gnyis bldabs gyur na, chu tshod mang ba'i tshes de chad, mchongs na chu tshod nyung ba lhag don du tshes la chad lhag med, de ltar snang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni, nyin tshes bstun nas brtsi phyir yin, zhes pa ltar ro yin la, de yang tshes zhag la ring thung yod pa'i dbang gis yin, tshes zhag dang snga phyi gsum mthong zhes pa'i thad la'ang ltos/
lo gsar tshes pa gcig gi tho rengs kyi chu/
snga dus bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang, dgon sde khag gis hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig zhogs pa dpal ldan lha mor 'bul rgyu'i mchod gtor/
tshes sum cu tham pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la nyi ma zla ba yang dag 'grogs dang, gnam stong, lhan cig mthong bcas so,
1. (tha mi dad pa) 'char ba/ zla ba tshes pa/ gnam lo gsar tshes/ 2. nyin zhag re re ba/ tshes pa gsum/
zla ba'i snga rkang lugs 'byung dus su zla ba'i 'phel 'grib bul bas chu tshod re bzhi'i bar 'byung ngo/
nag rtsis nas 'byung ba'i tshes grangs rtsi thabs/

1) zla ba'i cha shas 'phel 'grib kyi sgo nas 'jog ste yar ngor 'phel cha bco lnga dang, mar ngor 'grib cha bco lnga'i cha re 'grib pa'am 'phel ba'i yun tshad la brjod, tshes zhag gcig gi dus kyi rtag longs ni, chu tshod nga dgu dang, chu srang gsum, dbugs bzhi, ri mkha' ri'i cha bcu drug dang bcas yin, de yang tshes zhag gcig la nyi ma yul gyi chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang nyer gcig dbugs lnga ri ro'i cha zhe gsum spyod do/ 2) (mngon) zla ba'i phyogs rer tshes zhag bco lnga tsam re yod pas grangs bco lnga mtshon/
khyim lo ste tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig dang, chu tshod gcig tsam gyi dus yun/
tshes zhag re'i yun tshad de chu tshod lnga bcu nga dgu dang, chu srang gsum, dbugs bzhi, cha shas bcu drug tsam yod/

zla ba'i dkar cha dang po nas bco lnga'i bar 'phel ba dang dmar cha'am 'grib cha dang po nas bco lnga'i bar 'grib pa ste 'phel 'grib bsdoms pa'i cha sum cu la tshes zla zhes btags pa'o, de'i dus longs ni, gza'i rang 'khor bzhi song ba'i 'phro na gza' gnas su gcig dang chu tshod so gcig chu srang lnga bcu ri ro'i cha zhe lnga ri mkha ri'i cha sum brgya zhe lnga re yin/
'jig rten pa'i lugs la yar ngo'i tshes gcig la 'dzin pa shas che yang mar ngo'i tshes gcig la 'dzin pa'ang yod do, lo 'go'i thad la'ang ltos/
grub rtsis kyi gza' dag pa'i res gza'/
tshes dge dus bzang/ zla 5 tshes 15 bzang po la phul/ tshes bzang dus bzang/
zla ba'i 'phel 'grib kyi cha sum cu la tshes zla, de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'o/
gza' 'og tu bkod pa'i tshes kyi longs spyod/
zla 'go shar ba/ zla ba rjes ma'i tshes shar la 'gro rgyu gtan khel song/

1./ 1) shog kha dang sde tshan/ 2) rang skya 'pher ba'am rang tshugs thub pa'i rten gzhi dang nus pa/ khyim tsho/ lus tsho/ sems tsho mi zin pas smyon par gyur pa/ 3) mon yul gyi grong dud tsho khag gi ming ste yul 'ga' rer lding yang zer/ 2. gnyis yan chad kyi mang tshig cig / mi tsho/ mtshon cha de tsho/
dang tshan pa:/ 'brog pa rnams tsho khag tsho khag byas nas yod/
(yul) 1) lto chas tshil zhag mang drags pa/ kha zas tsho tshes pa/ 2) 'tshag bzang ba'am, sha rgyags pa/ phag pa tsho ches pa/ gzugs po tshe ches pa/
shog kha/ sde tsho pa re la dpon po re/
sde tsho so so'i dpon po/
sde tsho'am mi khyim brgya re'i dpon po/
sde tsho'am mi khyim stong gi dpon po/
sha khrag rgyas pa dang zhag tshi che ba/ sha tsho po/ thud tsho po/
sde shog gam tsho pa'i dpon po/

1. dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshag pa'i skul tshig, 2./ 1) phung po'am lus po/ ru tshogs/ sde tshogs/ 'das pa'i lo tshogs de gnyis bkod/ thob nor rim par brtsegs pa'i tshogs/ 2) rnal 'byor pa dag gis bza' btung gi rdzas rnams bde stong gi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing tshim pa drug ldan gyi ngang du rol ba'i rdzas/ 3) dge ba'i las/

'dod yon lnga dang, bye brag bza' bca' btung ba'i rdzas rnams zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la mchod pa dang, rang lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i sgo nas tshogs khyad par can gsog pa'i cho ga zhig /

dgag dbye'i nang gses, glo bur du dgag dbye byed pa ste, dmag 'khrug la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis glo bur du 'gyes dgos pa byung na phan tshun gcig gis gcig la tshogs kyi dgag dbye bya ba'o, dge slong gang rung rkyen dbang gis 'gro dgos pa byung na'ang de ltar rung ba'o/
tshogs bsag bya'i zhing gi gtso bo ste bla ma dang dge 'dun lta bu'o/
1) mi mang po 'du sa'i khang pa/ 2) grwa mang 'du khang/
grwa pas tshogs su 'khyer rgyu'i rtsam khug chung ngu zhig /
grwa pa'i mang ja sogs skol snod/
1) tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i gral/ 2) grwa pa 'tshogs pa'i tshogs gral/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, theg chen la zhugs pa mthar phyin byed tshogs kyi sgrub pa ste, theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya ba gang zhig rang 'bras byang chub chen por dngos su 'byin par bya ba'o/
tshogs khag chung ba/ tshogs chung khag bgos kyis gros bsdur byas pa/
tshogs 'du chen po/ tshogs chen thog gros 'cham byas pa/
snga dus bod kyi dgon chen khag gi sgrigs khrims dbang 'dzin las sne/
khrom tshogs yongs la thun mong du 'chad rgyu'i chos/

spyir bod kyi bla sprul che gras kyi sku rim du btsugs pa'i lo 'khor 'das mchod la zer zhing, bye brag tu spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i mjug la sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du btsugs pa'i t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i 'das mchod la phyis t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon 'das rjes 'das mchod nyi ma re bsnan te lo ltar hor zla gnyis pa'i mar ngor tshogs rgyu'i srol rgyun chags pa de'o/
sngar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnam gang nyin lha sa nas rtse pho brang bar du mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i ser mo ba'i phreng ba sbreng tshar du sgrig pa'i dus mchod/

rjod byed kyi sgra gang zhig rang gi dngos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i tshogs spyi yod pa ste, rang gi yan lag du ma tshogs pa'i spyi yin pa dper na, bum pa zhes pa rang gi lto ba dang mchu dang mgrin pa la sogs pa cha shas du ma tshogs pa'i spyi yin pa lta bu'o/
bsod nams kyi tshogs dang, ye shes kyi tshogs/
1) dge 'dun pa'am mi mang tshogs pa'i dbus su spang gi bslab bya 'doms pa'i gtam/ 2) (yul) gshe gshe gtong ba'i bla dwags kyi tshig / mi la don med tshogs gtam btang na mi 'grig /
1) tshogs dang gtor ma'i bsdus ming/ 2) gtor ma'i bye brag cig /
mig rna sna lce lus yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/
tshogs khang du gding rgyu'i gdan ring po/
1) (mngon) seng ge / 2) tshogs bdag ces pa'i lha glang po che'i gdong can zhig /
mi mang po 'dzoms pa'i 'dus pa/ tshogs 'du'i sgo dbye'i mdzad sgo / tshogs 'du grol ba'i mdzad sgo / tshogs 'dur zhugs pa/
grwa tshang so so'i grwa pas grwa pa'i spyi don byed mkhan du bdams nas spyi don gyi tshod 'dur phyin chog pa'i 'thus mi/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 1) zin pa/ rdza khog rdol nas chu mi tshogs pa/ kha ma tshogs par gsang gtam phyir shor ba/ 2) 'dzoms pa/ phun sum tshogs pa/ mthun rkyen tshogs pa/ mi mang po tshogs pa/ 2. 1) sde pa dang 'dus pa/ 'thus mi tshogs pa/ sku tshab tshogs pa/ 2) phung po/ 3) rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rkyen 'dus pa'i gnas skabs, ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig / 4) (mngon) lus/

spyi'i nang gses, rang gi cha shas du ma 'dus pa'i gzugs rags pa ste, dper na bum pa zhes pa, rang nyid kyi lto ba dang, mgrin pa, mchu, zhabs la sogs pa cha shas du ma 'dus shing tshogs pa'i spyi yin pa lta bu'o/
nyan thos kyi sbyor lam tsam sngon du btang nas rang rgyal du gyur pa'o/
dbang rtul srid pa mtha' ma'i sngon slob dpon gzhan la brten dgos pa'i rang rgyal/
1) grwa pas tshogs 'tshog sar 'khyer rgyu'i phor pa'i bye brag cig / 2) (rnying) rdzogs pa'i brda rnying ste gang ba'am, mthar phyin pa'i don/
tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gnyis/
1) dge ba'i las ma bsgrubs pa/ 2) spyod pa rtsing po'i mi la smod tshig /
1) tshogs 'dur 'gro mkhan/ 2) tshogs khag so so'i sgrigs khongs su yod pa'i mi/
tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa/ mi mang tshogs 'dzoms thog tu gtam bshad byas pa/
tshogs 'khor du 'bul rgyu'i bza' btung gi rigs/
sangs rgyas pa tshos phyag mchod gsol 'debs sogs dge tshogs gsog sa'i zhing/

tshogs bsags pa'i zhing gsum ste, yon tan gyi zhing mkhan slob lta bu dang, phan 'dogs pa'i zhing pha ma lta bu dang, sdug bsngal gyi zhing nad pa lta bu ste 'di dag byang sems rab tu byung ma byung gnyis ka'i bsod nams skye ba'i gzhi yin no/
dge 'dun pa'i ja thug skol snod/
1) rlabs chen dge ba'i las bsags pa/ 2) mi grangs mang po gnas gzhi gcig tu bsdus pa/
tshogs mchod rab 'byams pa ste, snga dus lha ldan tshogs mchod kyi tshogs dbus su mtshan nyid dam bca' 'jog mkhan gyi dge bshes/
dgon pa che khag la grwa pa stong tsho 'tshogs pa'i dbus su mi gnyis yar langs te gcig gis snga rgol dang gcig gis phyi rgol byas nas mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa byed srol de'o/

lam lnga'i ya gyal, mya ngan las 'das par bgrod pa'i gzhi gang zhig thar pa cha mthun gyi dge bas bsdus pa'i tshogs rgya chen po gsog par byed cing, bdag med thos bsam gyi sgo nas sgra spyi dang don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa dang, dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang, yang dag spong ba bzhi, rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi bcas bsgoms pas, spang bya shin tu rags pa 'khor bar sdug bsngal skyed byed rnams rnam par sun 'byin pa'i tshul gyis spong zhing, spyan dang, mngon shes, chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thob par byed pa'i lam mo/
tshogs lam gyi nyams len bzhi
tshul khrims la gnas pa dang, lam gyi chos la thos bsam bya ba, lam gyi chos la sgom bya ba, 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pa bcas bzhi'o/
tshogs lam gyi yan lag lnga

so skye'i tshul khrims la brten pa dang, dbang po'i sgo sdom pa, zas kyi tshod rig pa, nam gyi cha stod smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa, dran shes ldan pas dge ba la rtse gcig tu gnas par dga' ba bcas lnga'o/
tshogs lam gsum gyi nang gses, dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi sgom pa sbyor lam la 'jug pa ste skye ba'i dus ma nges pa'o/
tshogs lam gsum gyi nang gses, rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom pa sbyor lam drod tshe 'dir skye bar nges pa'o/
tshogs lam gsum gyi nang gses, yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom pa tshe phyi mar sbyor lam la skye ba'i dus nges pa'o/
tshogs lam la dbye na gsum, tshogs lam chung ngu dang, tshogs lam 'bring po dang, tshogs lam chen po ste gsum mo/
tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas su bshams sha/
1) tshogs mang dbus su bshad pa'i chos gtam/ 2) tshogs 'khor gyi 'grel bshad/
ming gi tshogs dang, tshig gi tshogs dang, yi ge'i tshogs bcas gsum mo/
dag yig tshogs gsum gsal ba zhes pa, ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi tshogs gsal bar bshad pa'i gzhung, dus rabs bcu gsum par dpang lo tsa ba blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung zhig /
tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa

phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag dang, mchod pa'i yan lag bshags pa'i yan lag rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i yan lag bcas bdun no/
khe spogs sgrub pa'i las/ tshong rgyag pa/ gzhung tshong/ sger tshong/ tshong las/ nged tsho tshong la 'ong ba yin/
tshong ba'i skad cha ste tshong rgyag skabs kyi skad cha shod stangs/ tshong skad rgyag pa/
tshong zog gang rung rang nyid ma phyin par gzhan la tshong rogs zhes skur ba/ tshwa bal tshong skur byas pa/
tshong zog khrom rar 'gro rgyug gam brin che ba/ da tshong kha rgyug po'i dus skabs red/
tshong zog khrom rar 'gro rgyug med pa/ pags rigs rnams dbyar dus tshong kha mi rgyug /
tshong zog 'tshong sa'i khang pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la nges 'jug dang, brje gnas tshong lam bcas so,
ma rtsa mnyam bsdus kyis rgyag pa'i tshong/
tshong khe'i steng nas 'jal dgos pa'i khral/ tshong khral 'jal ba/
tshong zog nyo tshong gi don du 'grems ston byed sa/ tshong khrom dar rgyas che ba/
tshong las byed pa/ mi de tshong 'khos 'thab len la mkhas po 'dug /
tshong brgyab nas phog pa'i gyong/ tshong brgyab nas tshong gun byung ba/
tshong zog skyel 'dren byed pa'i gru/
tshong rgyag mkhan gyi rogs pa/
snga dus tshong zog khyer te tshong rgyag tu 'gro ba/ phyogs nas phyogs su tshong 'grim pa/
1) tshong gi don du phar tshur 'gro ba/ tshong 'grul gru kha/ 2) tshong rgyag par 'gro 'ong byed mkhan/
tshong zog brin rgyug / tshong rgyug bde ba/ tshong rgyug skyen pa/ tshong rgyug sla ba/ tshong rgyug mgyogs pa/ tshong rgyug dka' ba/ tshong rgyug mi bde ba/
tshong pa'i sdod sgar/ mi 'du tshogs che sar tshong sgar btab/
'tshong ba/ dngos zog 'or 'dren byas te grong gseb tu tshong sgyur byas/
tshong 'grigs zin rjes 'thung ba'i legs chang/
tshong don du 'jog pa'i chings yig / phan tshun bar tshong chings bzhag pa ji bzhin lag len bstar ba/
tshong la gyong phog pa/ tshong nyes byung ba/ tshong nyes lha sa'i khrom la brgyab, 'gyod pa byang thang sgang la skyes/
tshong zog gi rtags/ dngos por tshong rtags rgyag pa/
nyo tshong gi rin thag gcod pa/ rin gong gtan 'bebs kyi tshong thag gcod pa/
skabs skabs 'tshog pa'i nges pa can gyi tshong dus/ tshong dus gcig la sde thang gnyis mi yong/
phyi rgyal gyi tshong gru yong chog pa'i rgya mtsho'i gru kha dang, gtsang po'i gru kha/
tshong pa dang tshong zog rnams 'du sa/
1) dus tshod nges can la tshong pa mang po gnas gcig tu 'dus pa'i don/ 2) tshong ra/ ming gi rnam grangs la tshong khrom dang, tshong rdal, tshong zong ra ba, zong 'grems gnas bcas so,
1) mang po phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i mthar so sor gyes 'gro ba'i dpe/ 2) tshong gi don du 'gro mkhan 'grul pa/

tshong rgyag mkhan/ skor skyod tshong pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'gron po dang, 'gron lam pa, nges 'gro can, nyo tshong pa, ded dpon, tshong dpon, tshong byed pa, 'tshong mkhan, zong gis 'tsho ba, zong thogs pa, zong dpon, zong ba, zong tshong ba, zong 'tsho, lam 'grul pa, lam pa bcas so,
tshong gi khe bzang/ mod nyo dkon tshong gis tshong spogs sgrub pa/
sngar bod kyi gro mo dang rgyal rtse sa gnas su yod pa'i bod kyi tshong pa khag gi sa nas tshong khral sdud mkhan bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig /
tshong pa'i g.yog po dang, tshong rgyag stangs slob mkhan/
tshong zog 'gro rgyug / deng skabs khrom du tshong brin che shos kyi dngos rigs gang dang gang yang 'dug /
tshong pa gnyis sam kha shas kyis ma rtsa bsdus te mnyam du tshong rgyag pa/ phan tshun tshong sbrel gyis khe gyong mnyam 'khur byed pa/
tshong gi ma rtsa/ tshong rtsa mnyam sdud kyis tshong rgyag pa/
tshong gi khe gun rtsi ba'i rtsis/ khe spogs ji thon tshong rtsis rgyag pa/
sger tshong rgyag mkhan gyi skyid sdug /
btsong bya'i dngos po/ tshong rdzas brin thabs byed pa/
btsong bya'i zog rigs/ tshong zog lkog 'dren/ tshong zog 'khor 'grim/ tshong zog mngags gtam/ tshong zog mngags tho/
tshong gi kha gtad/ gnyen ya ma dma', tshong ya ma mtho/
snga dus sger tshong pa'i g.yog po/
1) tshong rgyag pa'i 'brel lam/ mthun phyogs rgyal khab khag bar tshong lam phye ba/ 2) tshong gi bya ba lam 'gro'i bsdus tshig / tshong lam bde po/ tshong lam gud pa/
tshong zog 'grems spel sgo nas khe sgrub kyi bya ba/ tshong las su gzhol ba/
tshong las jus 'gro/ tshong las lam 'gro legs po/
snga dus nyo tshong mang po byas pa'i grogs po/ sngar nas 'dris 'grogs byas pa'i tshong shag /
1) tshong gi 'jal byed nya ga'am rgya ma/ 2) (rnying) grong khyim/
tshong thag bcad nas kha dan rtsis med du gtong ba/ zog rin sngon 'don byas kyang tshong slog yong shes pa/
snga dus tshong pas mchod pa'i nor lha/
tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tshang ba dang 'tshong ba'i skul tshig

1.tshad pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) ran pa'i skabs mtshams sam rags tsam gyi tshad/ bza' tshod/ 'thung tshod/ gdeng tshod/ gnam gshis bzang ngan gyi tshod thig pa/ pha rol pos tshur rgol zing cha nam slong tshod mi thig pa/ lto chas mang nyung za tshod ran pa/ tshod med po la gros ma 'dri, kha mang po la snying gtam ma shod/ 2) tshod ma'i bsdus tshig
khog tshod dam nyams tshad len pa/ rkyal rtsal ji 'dug tshod bgam pa/
1) dus tshod yol ba/ 2) ma 'os pa/ gzhan sems sreg pa'i skad cha de 'dra bshad pa ni tshod brgal zhig ma red dam/
tshod brtag / kha nas ci 'byung tshod nyul byos/
1) bzang ngan skyon yon che chung sod la rtog pa/ spus ka legs nyes kyi tshod lta ba/ 2) pha rol po'i rgyud tshod len pa/ dpa' gdeng ji 'dug tshod lta ba/
tshod ma'i kha lag bzo sa'i khang pa/
(rgya) sngo tshod blugs snod sder ma/
1) sngo tshod kyis bzos pa'i kha lag la 'debs rgyu'i sha tshil sogs kyi sdor/ 2) thug pa sogs la 'debs rgyu'i sngo tshod kyi sdor/
'ol tshod/ rang gar tshod dpag gi rigs pas gting mi rtod/ rang shed tshod dpag gis thag bcad pa min/
1) 'ol tshod byed pa/ 2) ran pa'am 'tshams po byed pa/ mang nyung tshod byed pa/
/ 1) zas kyi rgyu cha sngo tshod/ 2) ro gsal byed kyi rdzas/ 3) spags ma/ 4) sngo tshal yod pa'i thug pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyo tsha dang, bya na'o,
tshod ma ste sngo tshod sogs kyi lto chas bzo mkhan/ g.yos sbyor khang du tshod ma mkhan ci tsam 'dug /
'ol tshod byas pa'i rtsis gzhi/ ngas tshod rtsis byas na sang nyin char 'bab mi yong ngam snyam pa 'dug /
phyogs tsam gyi 'ol tshod/ de dag tshang ma tshod tshod byas nas bshad pa sha stag yin/
gang la gang 'tsham gyi tshod byed pa'am, tshad ran por stangs 'dzin byed pa/ gtong yong gi tshod 'dzin pa/ mang nyung gi tshod gzung ba/
gang yang 'tshams pa'i thog tu gnas pa/ chang 'thung tshod ma zin pa/ rang tshod rang gis zin pa/
nyams tshod lta ba'am rtog dpyod byed pa/ sems shugs yod med tshod len pa/
lkog gyur gyi don la tshod dpag byas nas rtogs pa/ ngas kho'i tshod longs song/

dus dang las don sogs gang dang gang gi ran 'tshams ji bzhin tshod thig pa/ phar gtong tshur len gyi tshod shes pa/ mi grangs mang nyung gi tshod shes pa/ tshogs 'du tshogs grol gyi dus tshod shes pa/
mthong thos nyams myong med par rang gar tshod byas te smras pa'i gtam/

/ 1) kha dog sgyur byed kyi rtsi zhig / tshon 'dul ba/ tshon brdar ba/ tshon sbyor ba/ 2) (rgya) 1,so so'i mthe bong gi tshigs bar nas sen mo'i rtse bar gyi ring tshad/ khre tse gang dang tshon do/ 2,sman pa'i mdzub mo'i ming/ tshon gyi 'og nas snying gi na tsha lta ba/
(rgya) sman pas nad pa'i rtsa lta skabs mdzub mo la tshon dang, gung mo la kan, srin lag la chag ces rgya nag gi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las byung ba'i brda zhig /
ri mo mkhan gyi yo spyad gras/ dkar yol gyi tshon kong nang du tshon dbur ba/
kha dog sna tshogs yod pa'i tshon mdog / glog brnyan tshon khra/ ri mo tshon khra can/ dar cha tshon khra/
ro gsal byed cig dang sman yang yin pa'i sngo zhig /
(rnying) tshon gyis kha ma bsgyur ba/
tshon mdog sna tshogs gtong ba/ khang pa gsar par tshon 'gyed pa/
1) tshon mdog mi 'gyur ba'i sa tshon dang rdo tshon/ tshon chen btang nas ldebs ris bris pa/ 2) (mngon) rdo tshon bye brag cig /

rab tu byung ba'i gos kyi kha dog mi rung ba'i tshon chen brgyad de, li khri dmar ser dang, mthing shun sngo nag 'od can, rgya skyegs tshos dmar smug mtshal dmar chen, gur gum ser smug btsod gtsang tshos, sman shing dmar nag le brgan rtsi dmar ser 'od can bcas so/
1) tshon mdog ljang khu/ 2) rdo sman zhig /
tshon rtsi gtong yul gang yin la thog mar gtong ba'i rtsi gdan/
tshon gyi kha dog / tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba/
tshon gyi kha dog / tshon mdog sna lnga/ tshon mdog yal ba/
ri mo mkhan gyi lag cha spu smyug /
sha khrag rgyas pa dang zhag tshi che ba/ kha zas tshon po/ ba lang tshon po/
tshon mdog sna tshogs kyis bris pa'i ri mo/
(yul) tshon khra min pa'i gos chen ri mo yod med ci rigs/
tshon ma btang gong du sol pir gyis bris pa'i ri mo/
1) mdog sgyur byed dmar po'i rid/ 2) mtshal/
1) tshon mdog sgyur byed kyi bkrag rtsi/ 2) tshon/ 3) tshon dang bkrag rtsi gnyis kyi bsdus tshig /
tshon zug po'am 'phrod po/ ras gzhi dkar po'i steng du tshon len po yong/
som nyi'am blo rtse gnyis/ byed stangs de nyid yang dag pa yin pas tshom mi 'tshal/
/ 1) spungs pa'i phung po/ sa tshom bu/ rdo tshom bu/ rtswa tshom bu/ 2) chun bu/ me tog tshom bu/ skar ma tshom bu/
1) the tshom pa/ byed tshod ma thig par tshom me bar lus song/ 2) ha go ma go'i bar mtshams/ 'grul pa yong dang mi yong tshom me ba zhig 'dug /
1.tha dad par 'jug pa'i 'tsham pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) khang pa dkyil ma/ tshoms ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ 2) sde tshan dang le'u/
bzhugs gral gsol ston sogs gshom sa'i khang pa/ tshoms chen nang du gsol ston bshams/
grwa pa'i khang tshan gyi dmangs tshogs la gtong rgyu'i ja/
tshor ba'i nus pa/ rna ba'i tshor ngad che ba/ sna'i tshor ngad zhan pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) rtogs pa dang reg ste shes pa/ lus kyi sdug bsngal lus kyis tshor ba/ kho'i skad cha ngas tshor byung/ 2. 1) reg pas yul yongs su spyad pa'i rnam par smin pa sim gdung bar ma gang rung nyams su myong ba'i bdag nyid can gyi shes pa'o/ bde sdug gi tshor ba/ tshor ba btang snyoms/ nyi ma tsha dus grib nag gi sar bsdad na tshor ba bsil po yong/ 2) kun 'gro lnga'i ya gyal/
lus kyi tshor ba bde sdug gnyis, yid kyi tshor ba yid bde dang yid mi bde gnyis, tshor ba btang snyoms dang lnga'o/
bar ma'i tshor ba ste sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba/

nye bar bzhag pa: dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, nang dang phyi dang phyi nang gi lus la dmigs nas byung ba'i tshor ba dang, tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum char yang rang gi mtshan nyid ni sdug bsngal ba'i mtshan nyid de, tshor ba sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab, tshor ba bde ba la ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis khyab, tshor ba btang snyoms la ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab bo zhes brtags shing rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/

mig shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba dang, rna shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba, sna shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba, lce shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba, lus shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba, yid shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba bcas drug go /
tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum/
phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, sim gdung bar ma'i tshor ba lta bu nyams su myong ba'i bdag nyid can gyi sems pa rigs mthun du ma spungs pa'o/
tshor ba lnga dang don gcig
nad kyi zug rngu'i sdug bsngal/
nyi mas karkata'i khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla drug pa'i ming/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses: reg pa la brten nas tshor ba bde sdug bar ma nyams su myong ba ste, de dag la nye bar longs su spyod pa'o/
1.'tshod pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) mdog sgyur byed kyi tshon rtsi/ shing tshos/ rdzas 'gyur gyi tshos/ 2) 'bur du dod cha/ mkhur tshos/ rkub tshos/
tshos chen gyi rigs las byung ba'i khu ba dang, kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshos gsar gyi khu ba/ snam ras dkar gtsang la tshos khu len sla/
tshos mdog snyoms po ma byung ba'i skyon/ snam bu tshos gra ma snyoms pa/ ras cha tshos gra ma snyoms pa/
tshos brgyab pa lam du ma song ba'i skyon/ tshos rgyus med mkhan gyis brgyab na tshos 'grib yong srid/
(yul) tshos dkrug byed kyi dbyug pa
(yul) tshon rtsi'i thog la rgyag pa'i gser ris/
1) tshos mdog gnyis las med pa'i ri mo/ 2) gos chen zhig /
tshos rgyag stangs lam 'gro ma byung ba/ lag rtsal zhan pas tshos nyes byung ba/
1) tshos len bde ba'i ched du tshos dang mnyam du bsre rgyu'i skyur rtsi/ 2) sa mtshur/
dngos rigs mi nor ba'i ched du brgyab pa'i rtags/ lug gi sgal par tshos rtags dmar po brgyab pa/
tshos zug pa/ shog bu dkar por tshos thebs sla/
tshos gzhi mi 'gyur ba'i ched du thog mar gtong ba'i sa mtshur/
tshos dmar ser sogs kyi kha dog /
tshos las byung ba'i snag tsha tshos snag dmar po
(tha mi dad pa) btsos te thul ba/ 'bras btsos kyang ma tshos/
sha sogs legs par btsos pa/ sha tshos po byung 'dug
tshos kyi mdog yal ba/ gyon pa tshos byi ba/
1) tshos rgyag pa/ 2) (mngon) tsan dan dmar po/
/ 1) tshos mkhan/ 2) tshos brgyab pa'i snam ras sogs/
tshos mdog len pa/ snam ras dreg pa can gyis tshos mi 'dzin pa/ ras cha dkar pos tshos 'dzin sla/
tshos mdog / tshos gzhi 'gyur ba/ tshos gzhi gcig pa/ tshos gzhi yal ba/ ras 'di'i tshos gzhi legs po mi 'dug
tshos len pa/ skyur rtsi chung zad bsres na tshos za ba la khyad che/ tshos gdan ma bting bas tshos ma bzas pa/
(yul) tshos khu bsnyal nas lam du song ba/
tshos yal ba/ nyi sreg char rdung byas kyang tshos log med pa/ yang yang bkrus nas tshos log pa/
deng sang gi rgya tshos dmar ser sngo ljang sogs/
tshos brgyab zin pa'i rjes su chu bshal gtong ba/
'gyur byed dam 'gyur rnon po ste ro drug gi nang gses lan tsha ba'i rdzas/ wa zur...rgya tsha/ bod tsha/ kha ru tsha/ tshwa kha ru/ ja la tshwa 'debs pa/
1) tshwa'i 'byung khungs sam tshwa'i thon khungs kyi sa yul spyi ming/ 2) mtsho sngon po'i nub rgyud du yod pa'i tshwa'i 'byung khungs chen po zhig /
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi smar khams rdzong gi lho rgyud dang zla chu'i shar 'gram du yod, de tshwa kha zhig yin/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rdza stod rdzong gi la zhig /
tshwa sla nga'i nang du bsros te ras thum byas nas na sa la sbyor ba'i 'chos thabs shig /
tshwa dang bul tog blug snod/
1) tshwa tshong byed pa/ 2) tshwa'i tshong las byed mkhan/
1) tshwa yod pa'i tshod ma zhig / 2) tshwa mang nyung gi tshod/ tshwa tshod ran po/
/ 1) me stag / 2) sa las bzos pa'i lha'i gzhugs brnyan dang mchod rten chung chung/
1) tshwa yod pa'i mtsho spyi/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sger rtse rdzong gi lho rgyud na yod pa'i mtsho zhig
ri bo zhig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khri 'du rdzong du yod/
(yul) rwa cos bzos pa'i phyugs la tshwa ldud byed kyi ming/
1) tshwa tshong pas 'jal dgos pa'i tshwa'i khral/ 2) tshwa khral sdud mkhan/
rgyags pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshag pa dang 'dra,
nyes skyon nam nongs pa/ skyon mtshang rtol ba/ mi ngan gyi nyes mtshang brtol ba/
skyon 'bru ba/ lkog g.yo ngan gshom gang byas kyi mtshang brtol ba/
skyon sngog pa/ neys mtshang 'bru ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la skyon 'don pa dang, mtshang rgod pa, mtshang slog pa bcas so/
dpyi mgo g.yas g.yon phan chad lus kyi rgyab gzhung smad cha'i phyogs/
mgnon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/
/ 1) ming gi zhe sa/ mtshan 'dogs pa/ 2) mtshan mo'i bsdus tshig 3) mtshan ma'i bsdus tshig 4) sngo sman zhig /
1) nam phyed/ 2) mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor ram sku khams/
dgong mo rgyag pa'i skor ba/ dge skos kyis dgon nang du mtshan skor brgyab ste sgrigs khrims srung min lta ba/
mtshan ltas mkhan po'i bsdus ming,
mtshan mo hril po 'khyol ba,/ so lta mtshan 'khyongs byed pa/ 'phrul 'khor mtshan 'khyongs gtong ba/
ming me tog gi gzugs su bkod pa:/ dpa' bo'i mtshan gyi me tog /
1) ming 'gyur ba/ 2) pho mo'i mtshan ma 'gyur ba/
