phru gu sogs mtshan mo ngu ba/
1) ming 'dra ba/ 2) dri chen dang dri chu gtong sa'i 'og sgo gcig las med pa/
lha'i rnam pa bzhin lag can bsgom pa'o/
bya rgyud du bzlas pa yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas dam ye spun grogs kyi tshul bsgom pa'o/
sngar rgyal rabs dang, srid gzhung, dpon rigs sogs kyi bya ba lam 'gro'i zhe tshig /
1) mtshan mo'i nam smad/ 2) ming gi mjug /
rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba ste, gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa ka ba'i mtshan nyid yin pa lta bu'o/
mdo sde dang, 'dul ba, mngon pa bcas mtshan nyid theg pa'i lam ston pa'i gsung rab/
bka' pod rigs lam slob pa'i dge rgan/
bod kyi dgon sde'i nang gzhung chen rtsod rigs yod pa'i gras/

nyid med pa nyid: ngo bo nyid med pa nyid gsum gyi nang gses, med la yod par 'dzin pa'i kun btags kyi chos rnams thag khra sbrul du 'dzin pa'i kun btags kyi chos rnams thag khra sbrul du 'dzin pa lta bu don la ma grub pa'o/

gyi btung ba: 'dul ba las bshad pa'i thun tshod du rung ba'i sman te, chus btab pa dang, tshags kyis btsags pa, shin tu sla ba, bzhin snang ba, 'dam bu nyag ma'i mdog ltar dwangs pa bcas lnga dang ldan pa'o/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
mtshan nyid chad pa'i kun btags
kun btags kyi nang gses, don la ma grub kyang rtog pas btags pa bdag lta dang rdzas grub lta bu'o/
ngo bo nyid gsum la dgongs nas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa lta bu'o/

rnying ma'i gzhung lugs la nyan thos dang, rang rgyal, byang sems te mtshan nyid sde gsum ni, rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa rnams spong bar byed pa'i sgo nas thar bar 'dren pas kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa zhes bya'o/
1) tshad ldan/ 2) gtan tshigs la brten nas don dpog par byed pa'i rigs lam pa/
skad cig ma'i sbyor ba: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, sbyin sogs chos thams cad bden stong du skad cig ma gcig la mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go/
sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba'i chos 'khor rim pa gsum gyi bar pa ste, chos rnams rang bzhin ma grub par ston pa'i bka'/
mdo phyogs kyi gzhung chen skor gyi dpe cha/
chad pa'i kun btags: bdag gnyis lta bu yul du ma grub kyang rtog pa'i dbang gis yul du bzhag pa rnams so/
1) 'jig rten lta tshul skor gyi gzhung lugs/ 2) gtan tshigs rig pa dang don gcig
shes bya sems tsam pa'i lugs la thams cad mtshan nyid gsum du bsdus pa ste, kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid dang, gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid, yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid bcas so/
pho mtshan dang mo mtshan gnyis ldan/
pho mo gnyis ka'i mtshan ma yod pa'i ma ning/
mtshan gnyis ma ning gi 'jug tshul

rjes 'jug gi ma ning na ra la gsum ming gzhi mo la yang 'jug zhugs pa ste 'dzind, 'byord, rold sogs ming gzhi zhan zhing, yang 'jug drag pas mtshan gnyis ma ning ngo/ da drag / na ra la... da drag / 'dzind 'byord rold...
mtshan dang snyan grags kyi bsdus tshig /
mtshan mo 'jab rgol gyi dpung 'jug ste mtshan 'gebs kyang zer/ dgong mo mtshan gtib gtong ba/
1) rtags mtshan ma/ 2) grwa sa'i dge bshes kyi ming btags/
1) rtags mtshan ma'i ltas/ char pa 'bab pa'i mtshan ltas/ na ba'i mtshan ltas/ 2) rmi ltas kyi zhe sa/ .
snga dus su lus kyi mtshan mar brtag dpyad dang, skar ma brtag dpyad, rmi ltas brtag dpyad sogs kyi sgo nas 'byung 'gyur ci yong lung ston mkhan/
nam gyi cha gsum gang rung/ mtshan thun gsum du bgos pa'i thun tha ma la skya rengs gtong/
mtshan gang thub pa'i mar me/ dkar me mtshan thub/
mtshan gang thub pa'i mar me'i kong bu/ gser gyis bzos pa'i mtshan thub kong bu/

mo hril po'am mtshan gang:/ mtshan thog thag ring la las grwa tshugs pa/ mtshan thog thag dga' ston gyis dus 'das pa'i mthar rgyu skar gyi mdangs nyams pa/ mtshan dod pa'i dus, mngal gnas byis par pho mo'i rtags kyi mtshan ma thog mar thon pa'i dus shig /
1) mtshan gyi don/ dpe cha'i mtshan don/ 2) ming dang don/ mtshan don gnyis mthun/
mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dge rgan mtshan ldan/
(tha dad pa) mtshan pa, mtshan pa, mtshon,, brgyan pa'am spras pa/ bum pa pad mas mtshan pa/ ri bong gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/
skyes bu chen po mtshon par byed pa'i sku'i yon tan mtshan bzang po dang, dpe byad bzang po/
lhan skyes rma rigs kyi nang tshan mtshan ma dang bshang lam bar rdol te rma byung ba'i nad cig /
1) ming byang ste yi ge sogs kyi kha byang/ 2) mi shi ba'i mtshan byang ngam ming byang/

rtags dang ltas/ gzhan dang mi nor ba'i ched du mtshan ma rgyag pa/ dga' ba'i mtshan ma ston pa/ bzang po'i mtshan ma shar ba/ ang yig gzhan dang mi 'dre ba'i ched du dor dang ma dor mtshan ma bkod/ bco lnga ma longs mtshan ma 'debs/ de tshe spyi zhag mtshan mas phye/
mtshan ma ston pa'i bdun pa
mtshon byed gang zhig gis mtshon nas mtshan gzhi de nyid kyis khyad par du byed pa'i chos ston pa'i rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang gses shig dper na dar dmar steng na skar lnga'i ri mo 'dug zer ba lta bu/
spros med dam rang bzhin med pa/
rnam par thar pa'i sgo : rnam par thar ba'i sgo gsum gyi nang gses, yongs grub 'dus ma byas kyi chos la dbyibs dang kha dog gi mtshan mar ma grub pa bsgom pa'o/
rnam g.yeng drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, thar pa 'dod pa'i sems med par khe dang grags pa 'dod pa'o/
pho mtshan dang mo mtshan gyi nang du gnas pa'i srin bu'i nad/
rang lus la sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pas spyod lam kun tu lha'i mtshan ma'am gzugs snang dang mi 'bral bar bsgom pa, bya rgyud kyi lha drug gi nang gses shig /
gnas lugs stong pa nyid bsgom pa'o/
bya rgyud du 'jug gnas ldang gsum gyi khyad par du byas pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o/
1) bshang gci'i lam gcig tu gyur pa'i mi/ 2) pho mo'i mtshan ma gang yang med pa'i ma ning/
mtshan med ma ning gi 'jug tshul

rjes 'jug gi ma ning na ra la gsum ming gzhi ma ning la yang 'jug yod med gang rung ste, phyind, thard, rold sogs ming gzhi drag zhan gnyis ka dang ma phrad pas mtshan med ma ning ngo/ na ra la...da drag / phyind thard rold...

nyi nub nas bzung tho rengs bar/ ming gi rnam grangs la ku mud bzhad dang, rkyang zla, 'khor lo byed, nges nyal, sngo sangs ma, chags dus, nyal dus, thun gsum pa, dal ster, rdul ldan, gnas 'dzin bu mo, snang med, bya bral, sbyor ldan, mig brgya ma, mun bcas, mun pa can, mel tshe can, zhi bar 'jug zla 'od snang ldan ma, ri dwags mig srung byed ma, bsam gtan gnas dus bcas so,

mtshan nyid dang, mtshon bya, mtshan gzhi ste gsum mo, de dper brjod na gdung 'degs don byed nus pa ni ka ba'i mtshan nyid dang, ka ba zhes pa mtshon bya dang, ka ba'i bye brag tsan dan gyi ka ba ni mtshan gzhi yin pa lta bu'o/
phyogs su 'gro dus mtshan mo rta drel ri thang du 'tsho ba'i don/ do dgong mtshan 'tsho 'gro res khyod rang red/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, chos 'dul ba yongs su rdzogs pa nyid kyis mtshan gyi cha shas rnams dag cing gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa'o/

1) snga dus bod kyi bla sprul che khag gi mtshan nyid zhabs phyi/ 2) snga dus bod kyi bla chen khag gi ming gsham 'jug tshig cig ste, dper na dpal bzang po zhes pa lta bu/ dpal bzang po...dpal bzang po...
1) mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon pa'i gzhir gyur pa, dper na, gser bum de bum pa'i mtshan gzhi yin pa lta bu'o/ 2) mtshon bya'i khyad par ram dpe/
1) rtags mtshan bzang po/ 2) skyes bu chen po'i bsod nams kyi mthu las grub cing bsod nams de mtshon par byed pa'i phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis po rnams so/

cu rtsa gnyis: phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa dang, rus sbal zhabs, phyag zhabs sor mo dra bas 'brel ba, phyag zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa, sku'i gnas bdun mtho ba, sor mo ring ba, rting pa yangs pa, sku che zhing drang ba, zhabs long bu mi mngon pa, ba spu gyen du phyogs pa, byin pa e na ya'i 'dra ba, phyag ring zhing mdzes pa, 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa, pags pa gser mdog 'dra ba, pags pa srab cing 'jam pa, ba spu re re nas g.yas su 'khyil ba, zhal mdzos spus brgyan pa, ro stod seng ge 'dra ba, dpung pa'i mgo zlum pa, thal gong rgyas pa, ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang ba, sku na-ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa, gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa, ljags ring zhing srab pa, gsung tshangs dbyangs lta bu, 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra ba, tshems shin tu kar ba, tshems mnyam pa, tshems thags bzang ba,
mtshan mo sgang tshang/ mdang mtshan rangs po gnyid khug ma song/
ming dang la rgya mthon por bkyag pa/ dpa' bo byas rjes can gyi mtshan la dgung 'degs zhu ba/
ming don la gnod pa'i smad ra/
mtshan mor skor g.yeng rgyag pa/ chu rags la mtshan so byed pa/
1) ming 'dogs pa/ khong la phul byung gi dpa' bo'i mtshan gsol ba red/ 2) (rnying) dgongs dag thugs bden zhu ba/

1. 1) tshigs dang, bar gseng/ sa mtshams 'byed pa/ dus mtshams/ chu mtshams/ slob sbyong byed mtshams bzhag pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ dkar nag mtshams 'byed/ 2) zur dang grwa/ shar lho'i mtshams/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad/ 2.(mngon) lo rer dpyid dang, so ga, dbayr, ston, dgun stod, dgun smad de mtshams la drug yod pas grangs drug mtshon/
1) kha mchu sdum mkhan/ 2) (mngon) rkun ma'am jag pa/
rgyu 'grul gyi mtshams bcad de sgruub pa nyams su len mkhan sdod sa'i khang pa/
yul dus khrims sogs kyi mtshams las 'das pa/
1) re zhig bar mtshams 'jog pa dang, 'phro rbad kyis gcod pa/ 'gro rgyun gyi mtshams gcod pa/ 2) bsnyen mtshams gcod pa/ 3) (rnying) khrims gcod pa/
bar mtshams chad pa/ 'grim 'grul gyi mtshams chad pa/
1) phan tshun 'brel mtshams rbad de gcod pa/ 2) chos lugs pa tsho mtshams dam po sdod pa/
1) sa mtshams kyi rtags tho/ 2) bsnyen mtshams kyi tho bo/
snga dro dang dgong dro'i nyi zer phog pa'i sprin dmar ser/ mtshams sprin dmar po'i 'od mdangs rnam pa bkra/
sgra rig pa'i ming gi mtshams sbyor, dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor, rang bzhin gyi mtshams sbyor, gsal byed kyi mtshams sbyor, rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor bcas lnga'o/
1) mi'am yul dang, dngos po gsar du ngo sprod byed pa/ 2) bar mtshams mthud pa/ snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor ba/ 3) tshig snga phyi gnyis sbrel ba'i thabs tshul/

rgya gar gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug las ring ba'i yi ge bzhi ste, e ee o oo rnams so, de yang a dang i sbyar ba ni e yin no, a dang e sbyar ba ni ee yin no, a dang u sbyar ba ni o yin no, a dang o sbyar ba ni oo yin pas de dag phan tshun sbyar ba las byung bas na mtshams sbyar ba'i yi ge zhes bya'o/ e ee o oo...e...a...i/ ee... a...e... o...a...u...oo...a...o...
mtshams sbyor lhag bcas kyi sgra

las tshig snga phyi gnyis ka rim gyis 'jug pa'am, tshig tsam brjod zin pa'am, cig car du 'jug skabs las tshig phyi ma 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra zhig / tsheg sgra dang bcas te me 'bar ba/ yar langs te ngar skad chen po zhig rgyag pa/ mi tsho'i bsam 'char bsdus nas sdom tshig 'god pa/ spyod lam zhi zhing 'jam la dul ba/ te nas zhing la...
1) bar gyi dbye ba med pa/ dus skabs mtshams med/ sa yul mtshams med/ 2) shi ma thag dmyal bar skye bas bar do sogs kyi mtshams ma chod pa/
pha gsod pa dang, ma gsod pa, dgra bcom gsod pa, dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa, de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa ste lnga'o/
nye ba'i mtshams med pa'i las/
khang byin gyis ma brlabs par btsos pa'i: zas
mtshams kyi bar tshigs/ bya ba mtshams tshigs yod pa'i sgo nas sgrub bzhin 'dug / rtas rtswa mtshams tshigs med par za/
bar bar/ mtshams mtshams la ngal rtsol dang, mtshams mtshams la slob sbyong byas/ sems shugs mtshams mtshams che la, mtshams mtshams chung bar 'gyur ba/
shar lho'i mtshams, lho nub kyi mtshams, nub byang gi mtshams, byang shar gyi mtshams bcas bzhi'o/
bar mtshams med pa/ yul dus go skabs mtshams yas la ya rabs kyi spyod pa spel ba/
1) sa mtshams srung mkhan/ 2) sa mtshams srung ba/ 3) bsnyen mtshams pa la zhabs tog byed mkhan/
1) khyim bya de pho dmar po/ 2) (rnying) rting pa dkar po/ rta drel mtsha' lu/
1) ngo mtshar te dga' ba/ 'khrab ston la mtshar dga' byed pa/ 2) (mngon) 1, gla'am yon/ 2, bya dga'/
1) ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/ 2) kyal ka'i mtshar gtam/
mtshar sdug ha cang mdzes pa
/ 'ja' tshon mtshar sdug can/ mtshar sdug lang tsho/ mi yi bu mo lha yi mtshar sdug can/ bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa/
mdzes pa dang, rmad du byung ba, ya mtshan/ khyad mtshar/ ngo mtshar/ zab cing mtshar ba/

/ 1) rgya mtshal te rdo sman gyi rigs shig ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma 'brub, rus chag sbyor, rtsa nad sel, glo ba dang, mchan pa'i tsha ba, mig nad bar 'grib bcas la phan/ 2) khrag gi zhe sa/ shangs mtshal/ sku mtshal/
1) dre'u spu mdog dmar la dkar shas 'dres pa/ 2) sman du 'gro ba'i mtshal dkar/
mtshal gyi mdog can nam dmar po/ stod gos mtshal kha zhig gyon 'dug /
rdo sman zhig ste 'dul sbyong ma byas pa'i mtshal/
mtshal las dngul chu bton pa'i shul gyi thal ba ste, nus pas rma 'bras dang, sha ro 'joms/
mtshal gyis btab pa'i yig ris/
mtshal byugs te par btab pa'i dpe cha/
khrag gam mtshal dmar pos bris pa'i yi ge dang ri mo/
mo drel spu mdog dmar po/
1) rgya mtshal lcog la/ 2) dre'u spu mdog dmar shas che ba/
1) dre'u spu mdog dmar nag 'dres pa/ 2) mtshal dang snag tsha bsres pa'i mdog /
lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, ro lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas skran bshig pa dang, rma gso, 'khru bar byed/
mtshal gyi ri mo'am thig dmar po/
rting pa dkar po'i don du go ba'i mtsha' lu dang 'dra,
(yul) bod lham zon pa'i yu bar btang ba'i 'ja' dmar po'i ming/

gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can: ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi phan tshun mtshungs chos dang, 'byed byed gnyis ka tshig zin la dngos su bstan pa'i sgo nas so sor ldog pa'i rgyan zhig

'byed byed sgras zin gyi ldog pa can: ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe don gnyis phan tshun 'dra ba'i khyad chos shugs la bstan cing, so sor dbye ba 'byed byed kyi tshig dngos su ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
phan tshun 'dra bar ston pa'i mtshan ma/
1) mtshungs par ldan pa ste rigs 'dra po yod pa/ 2) sems byung rnams ni sems gang dang gang la mtshungs par ldan pa/
rgyu drug gi nang gses shig mtshungs par ldan pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs pa'i rigs su gnas pa ste, sems dang sems byung rnams phan tshun grogs byas nas mgo mnyam du 'byung ba'o/
'du byed kyi bye brag sems dang sems byung gnyis phan tshun mi 'bral bar don rnam pa lngas lhan cig mtshungs par ldan pa ste, tshor 'du gnyis ma gtogs pa'i sems byung thams cad do/
mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa
nyon mongs thams cad dang mtshungs par ldan pa 'dres pa'i ma rig pa'o/
mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs
sems byung gang zhig sems dang mtshungs pa lnga ldan gyis 'khor du 'gro ba'am skye ba ste, rten dang, dmigs pa dang, rnam pa dang, dus dang, rdzas bcas lnga mtshungs pa'o/
ma rig pa: nyon mongs gzhan dang mtshungs par mi ldan pa'i ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa'o/

'dra ba'am mnyam pa/ sa babs mtho dman mtshungs pa/ mi grangs mang nyung mi mtshungs pa/ che chung mtshungs pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la cha mthun dang, mnyam, de lta bu, de 'dra, de mtshungs, 'dra bcas so,
mtshungs pa mgo snyoms kyi lan

thal 'gyur gyi lan gang zhig rnal lan min par gzhan gyi rtags bkod pa de nyid la brten nas pha rol po sun 'byin pa'am rtsod pa bzlog pa ste, dper na, khyod rkun ma yin te, skyes bu yin pa'i phyir zhes zer ba'i lan du, 'o na khyod kyang ngo zhes pa lta bu'o/
mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra

dpe dpe can phan tshun 'dra mtshungs su dngos su gsal ba'i ched sbyor ba'i tshig / bzhin, ltar, lta bu, ji ltar, mthun, mtshungs, yang dag mtshungs, mnyam, yang dag gsal, nges par gsal, rab gsal, gzugs kyi zla, gnyen po, dgra zla, so sor rtog 'gal, 'dra, blta, bcas, bsla, rigs mthun, rjes su smra, gzugs brnyan, so sor sdeb, gzugs mtshungs, gzugs mnyam, yang dag 'jal, mtshan nyid mthun, mtshan nyid 'dra, mtshan nyid mtshungs, mthun phyogs, dper byas, dpe, rtog dman, cung zad dman, rab tu smra, so sor bzlog rigs su mthun, mnyam par byas, 'gran, rgyal, sdang, 'khu, mi mthun sgrogs, 'thab, 'phya, dma' 'bebs, smod, co 'dri, 'gog dgod, phrag dog mi bzod, skal bzang 'phrog byed, mdzes pa zum byed, tshar gcod, rjes su rkang pa 'jog rjes 'gro, rjes su 'ching, ngang tshul, ngang tshul 'gog pa, rjes su byed, rigs, chos mthun pa, grib ma mtshungs pa, rjes su snyeg dbyer mi phyed, gnyis su med, ro gcig gyur sogs lta bu mang ngo,

legs sbyar gyi dbyangs yig a i u ri bzhi po re re la thung ngu ring po shin tu ring po gsum gsum yod pas bcu gnyis dang, li yig la thung ngu dang shin tu ring po gnyis yod pas bsdoms na bcu bzhi yod do/ a i u ri li...li...
legs sbyar skad kyi dbyangs yig a i u ri li/ a i u ri li...
sems dang sems las byung ba rnams yul la 'jug cing gcod pa na gcig pus 'jug cing gcod mi nus kyi, sems dang sems las byung ba du ma zhig phan tshun du grogs byas nas mgo mnyam du 'byung ba'o/
spyod pa mtshungs pa'am skal ba mnyam pa/ bdag gis sde snod gsum po bsdus pa na, tshangs pa mtshungs spyod sus kyang ldog mi nus/
'gran zla bral ba/ bka' drin mtshungs bral/ byas rjes mtshungs bral/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod dpe dang dpe can gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas mi mtshungs kyang, ming ngam, rnam grangs kyi sgo nas phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses gnyis ni, bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor dang, smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor ro/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe yon tan lhag pa zhig dang, dpe can yon tan dman pa gnyis phan tshun bya ba byed lugs kyi gnas tshul 'dra ba'i sgo nas ris gcig tu mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig /
mnyam med/ snying stobs mtshungs med/ blo gros mtshungs med/ stobs ldan mtshungs med/
'gran zla/ mtshungs zla ma mchis pa/
/ 1) pha mes/ 2) bon lugs ltar pha mes kyi bla'am srog gi bcud/ 3) pha mes dus kyi lha/ 4) gshin po/
1) pha mes kyis bsten pa'i 'jig rten gyi lha gnas yul/ 2) gshin po'i bang so/
bon lugs ltar pha mes kyi dur sar gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi lhar sha khrag gtor ba'i mchod pa/
bon lugs ltar pha mes dus kyi lhar bstar ba'i gtor ma/
pha mes dus kyi lhar sha khrag gi mchod pa byas pa/
pha mes dus kyi dur khrod du gnas pa'i lhar sha khrag gtor ba'i gsol mchod/
1) pha mes kyis bsten pa'i lha/ 2) gshin rje'i rgyal po/
mtshur dkar nag sngo dmar ser sogs kyi spyi ming/
tshos gdan du byed pa'i sa dkar zhig /
tshos gdan du byed pa'i sa sngon zhig /
mar pa lo tsa'i slob ma grags can zhig
tshos gdan du byed pa'i sa nag cig /
mtshur phu dgon pa'i bsdus ming,
rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya lo la karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas btab pa'i karma bka' brgyud kyi dgon chen zhig ste, lha sa grong khyer gyi nub byang gi phyogs su yod/
tshos gdan du byed pa'i sa dmar zhig /
mtshur phu don grub 'od zer gyis karma rang byung rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rtsis kyi lugs/
tshos gdan du byed pa'i sa ser zhig /
/ 1) mchu dang sna/ mtshul nyag nyag / mtshul 'gags pa/ kha mtshul/ sna mtshul/ 2) srog chags kyi sna mdo dang ya mchu/ 3) sna'i bya gshog g.yas g.yon gyi 'gram na 'phar ba'i gnyan pa'i rtsa zhig /
sna bug gi mtshul khung nas shu 'debs pa'i sgra/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dpal mgon rdzong khongs su yod/
ldum bu'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mcher pa'i tshad pa dang, tsha ba gsar rnying sel, khrag gcod, lus stobs skyed/
/ 1) mnyam skyes phru gu/ 2) khyim bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / 3) (mngon) dus gcig tu phru gu gnyis mnyam du skyes pas grangs gnyis mtshon/
mtshe'i rdzas la brten pa'i zor/
1.dur gnas/ dur mtshed/ 2.(rnying) dur du 'jug pa'am dur du mtshed pa/
mtsho chung ba'am rdzing bu/ tshwa sgo can gyi mtshe'u/ sa mtho'i steng du mtsho dang mtshe'u skar tshogs ltar chags pa/
gnas skabs sdod sa/ 'brog mtsher/ mgron mtsher/ mtsher shag /
nor phyugs la sa nad phog tshe shing thur gyis mtsher pa 'bigs pa'i 'chos thabs shig /
'brog pa sdod sa rnying pa dang, phyugs kyi lhas ra rnying pa/
'brog pa'i ru ba ma spos gong spo yul legs pa zhig la sa rdo sogs brtsegs nas brgyab pa'i rtags/
ngo tsha ba'i snang ba dang, zhum pa'i mtsher snang/ mdza' grogs nang khul la mtsher snang mi dgos/ mi mang gi dkyil du 'gro ba la mtsher snang mi byed/
ngo tsha po/ de ring gi las ka yag po ma byung bas ha cang mtsher po byung/
(tha mi dad pa) 1) sun pa dang, byed snying mi 'dod pa/ dka' ba'i las don la ma mtsher cig / sems mtsher ba/ 2) ngo gnong ba dang, ngo tsha ba, zhed pa/ 'gro mtsher/ shod mtsher/
mtsho sngon po'i nang du yod pa'i ri zhig de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las smi sum stong lhag tsam yod/
zhed pa'i nyams/ rang skyon dang gzhan skyon brjod rgyur mtsher bag mi byed pa/
'brog pa'i ru ba spos pa'i shul/
grogs sam zla bo/ khyim mtshes/ shag mtshes/ sdum mtshes/ gral mtshes/ khang mtshes/

1. 1) chu gter/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun nas brkos dang, skyes bus ma byas pa, lha min brkos, lha rdzing, lhas bkang, lhas brkos bcas so, 2) lag sor bcu'i rtse'i sha ris sgor sgor gyi ming/ 2.(mngon) ri rab kyi mdangs phog lugs kyis rgya mtsho chen po la kha dog gis dbye na dkar sngon dmar ser bzhi yod pas grangs bzhi mtshon/
1) rgya mtsho'i steng du skor g.yeng rgyag pa/ 2) chos lugs pa tshos bla mtsho sogs la gnas skor du 'gro ba/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs su yod pa'i mtsho zhig /
(mngon) 1) me tog pad ma/ 2) zla ba/
gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
chu bskams zin pa'i mtsho shul/

da lta'i mtsho sngon po'i ming yin, sngon gyi gtam rgyud las chu mig chung ngu zhig glo bur du 'phyur te, mtsho chen por gyur pas mi khyim khri bsnubs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mtsho khri shor rgyal mo zer zhes su grags, dpe rnying pa la lar mtsho khri bshos sam mtsho khri bshor zhes 'dod rgyal gyi ming yin zhes kyang gsungs/ mtsho khri bshos...mtsho khri bshor...
gting zab chu'i rlabs 'khor ba/ ko gru mtsho 'khor du thim nyer yod pa/

rgya mtsho'i nang du sdod pa'i srog chags shig ste, lus che zhing spu skyes med pa, mdog skya bo, mig phra la rna gshog med pa, so ha cang ring po gnyis yod, so de ba so'i tshab byed dngos rdzas byas chog /
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rgya tsha rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
rgya mtsho'i thog gru gzings btang nas skyod pa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong nas thon pa'i rgun 'brum/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs su yod pa'i mtsho zhig /
1) mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sa rgyud kyi spyi ming/ 2) bod rang skyong ljongs kyi nag chu rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod pa'i mtsho zhig /
thog thu chen po rnam pa brgyad: lcang skya, a kya, gser khri, stong skor, ra kho, smin grol, chu bzang, thu'u bkwan te brgyad/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi mtsho che shos shig /

1) rgya mtsho chen po/ 2) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi nub rgyud du yod cing de khul du bkra ri gnam mtsho yod pa'i rkyen gyis ming de ltar thogs pa red, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de sman stong du yod/
sngar bod kyi bshad srol du mtsho'i ngos nas shar ba'i gnas tshul la bltas te 'byung 'gyur lung bstan byed thabs shig
rgya mtshor gnas pa'i nya ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba'i drod skyod, bad kan gyi nad sel, lus zungs gso/
1) mtsho mthil gting ring gi bug gsang/ 2) mtsho sngon po'i dkyil du yod pa'i ri zhig de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 3266 yod/
rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i nya rigs shig de'i gdong rta dang 'dra bas ming de ltar btags, che gras rnams sman rtsa chen zhig go/
mtsho nang nas ston pa'i ltas/
sbrang rtsi dang, mar dang, zho dang, 'o ma dang, chu dang, chang bcas kyi mtsho drug go/
1) ljon shing dz'a ba ka/ 2) (mngon) lha mo dbyangs can ma/
1) tshwa mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dge rgyas rdzong khongs su yod/ 2) mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi a mdo rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/

bod rigs ha sag rigs rang skyong khul: mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi mtsho sngon po'i nub phyogs su yod pas ming de ltar btags, 1954 lo'i zla 1 tshes 25 nyin rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing, 1955 lor mtsho nub sog rigs bod rigs ha sag rigs rang skyong khul du bsgyur, de'i khongs su wu'u lan dang, then cun, tu'u lan, ker mo bcas rdzong bzhi yod, rang skyong khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de te lin kha ru yod/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de zhol shar du yod/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs nas 'bab cing, de'i smad rgyud la rta dbang chu zer/
rab bzang po: bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs su 'khrungs pa dang, 'dul ba mtsho t'ika ste 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba rtsom mkhan/
ma ra mgo: mtshe'ur skyes shing zur gsum can gyi sngo zhig sman la'ang 'gro ba/
sngar bod du mtsho'i ngos su 'char ba'i mthong tshul sna tshogs la brten nas ma 'ongs ji yong tshod bshad byed thabs shig
mtsho ngos kyi snang tshul lta rtog byed thabs/
mtsho chung ngu/ mtsho chen gcig la mtsho phran mang pos bskor ba/
mtsho la gnas pa'i bya rigs/

rang skyong khul: mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi mtsho sngon po'i byang phyogs su yod pas ming de ltar btags, 1953 lo'i zla ba 12 tshes 31 nyin rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing, 1955 lor rang skyong khul du bsgyur, de'i khongs su ha'e yan dang, rkang tsha, chi len, mong yon hu'e rigs rang skyong rdzong bcas rdzong bzhi yod, rang skyong khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de mong yon hu'e rigs rang skyong rdzong khongs kyi ha'o mon kren du yod/

(anabatasta ?) bod rang skyong ljongs khongs spu hreng rdzong gi mtsho ma pham g.yu mtsho zhes pa, bod kyi deb ther du mtsho 'di ni rgya'i lo rgyus nang du gsal ba'i ya'o khri ste g.yang ti'i mtsho zer ba de yin zhing, de ltar na lo sum stong gi sngon la kro'u rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po mu dbang zhes pa nub phyogs gnas skor du phebs pa'i mtsho de yin zhes dang, mngon pa'i gzhung du mtsho 'di dbyibs gru bzhi chu zheng gnyis la dpag tshad lnga bcu re yod pa mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya yod pa, yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ba ste spos ngad ldang ba'i ri nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol na yod ces gsungs/
mtsho ma dros pa dang don gcig
mtsho zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gting skyes rdzong gi shar rgyud du yod/
mtsho mo ngang lha ring po
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ru thog rdzong gi nub rgyud na yod pa'i mtsho ring zhig /
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de gtam zhol du yod/

mtshan gzhan ska ba shakya dbang phyug ste, rab byung brgyad pa'i nang stod lung glang grong du 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i slob ma phrag dpon bsod nams bkra shis sogs dam pa du ma bsten nas rig gnas spyi dang khyad par gso rig la shin tu mkhas par gyur te mtsho smad lha khang gi mkhan po mdzad pas mtsho smad mkhan chen zhes grags, gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa spyi dang zur mkhar ba'i bstan pa spel, gsung rtsom yang gso rig khog 'bubs legs bshad dngul dkar me long dang, phyi ma rgyud kyi dka' gnad gsal sgron, lag len dmar khrid du sdebs pa snying po bsdus pa sogs mdzad/
rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i sems can zhig spu mdog ser nag lto ba dkar ba, de'i tshi lu snum btso sbyang byed thub pa/
si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi mdzod dge rdzong gi mtsho zhig /
rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/ gru gzings kyis mtsho rlabs gshags te gtong ba/
mtsho chen dang chu lam 'brel ba'i mtsho chung ngu/
mtsho thog tu rgyu ba'i lam/
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho nub sog rigs bod rigs ha sag rigs rang skyong khul gyi tu'u lan rdzong gi mtsho zhig /
mtsho kha bsubs te mi mngon par byas pa/

rang skyong khul: mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi mtsho sngon po'i lho phyogs su yod pas ming de ltar btags, 1953 lo'i zla ba 12 tshes 15 nyin rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing, 1955 lor rang skyong khul tu bsgyur, de'i khongs su ku'e te dang, shin ha'i, thung te, ku'e nan, kung ho bcas rdzong lnga yod, rang skyong khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de kung ho rdzong khongs kyi chab cha ru yod/
spyi gtsug ka li'i srubs sgo/
skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi song ba'i thad/ phru gu'i mtshog ma lhem lhem du 'gul gyi 'dug /
skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na mtshog ma dang dpral ba gzer ba, me nyis dros pa dang chang btungs pa'i rjes mgo bo na ba sogs la phan/
mtshon gyi bskal pa'i bsdus ming,
mtshon cha khyer te gdong thug tu 'thab pa/
gri dang me mda' sogs lus la phog ste thon pa'i khrag /

tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su, mtshon bskal zhag bdun la gcig gis gcig mthong na ri dwags la rngon pa ltar gsod 'dod skyes pas lag tu bong ba sogs sleb pas mtshon cha rnon por gyur nas phan tshun gsod par byed pa'o/
gcod pa'i nus pa che ba'i mtshon cha/ mtshon ngar ma dgra bo'i steng du phyar/
gri mdung la sogs pa'i mtshon cha/ mtshon cha bzung nas g.yul 'gyed byed pa/ lag na mdung ring dang ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzung ba/
dpes mtshon par bya ba'i don gyi dngos po/ sa bkra'i nang gi thig dmar po'i mtshon don de lcags lam yin/
mtshon char brten nas byung ba'i rmas skyon sogs/
(tha dad pa) rtogs byed dang ston byed dang gsal byed/ mtshon byed dpe/ mtshon bya don,/ lto gos kyis mtshon pa'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen tshang ma yag po 'dug /
btags yod chos gsum tshang ba'am tha snyad chos gsum ste shes brjod 'jug gsum gyi yul du gyur pa, dper na, shes bya dang, dngos po, bum pa lta bu'o/
dpe/ yul ljongs mtshon byed kyi ri mo 'bri ba/
cung zad tsam mam mngon tsam, sne sel tsam/ dngos rdzas mtshon tsam phul ba/ gnas lugs mtshon tsam zhus pa/
gri sogs kyis rmas pa'i rma/ mtshon lam du shi ba/
dgra lha ste, dmag 'khrug skabs mtshon cha 'gog srung byed nus pa'i lha mthu ldan zhig /
lus kyi sha rgyags pa'am nyams rgyas pa/ phru gu rnams 'tshag rgyas lus mdangs bzang/

1.(tha dad pa) 1,'tshags pa, 'tshag pa, 'tshogs,, gsog pa dang gnyer ba/ ma dngul 'tshag pa/ yig rigs rnams sgam gyi nang du 'tshags pa/ 2,btsags pa, btsag pa, tshogs,, dwangs snyigs 'byed pa/ ja btsags pa/ rdza ma'i thim bu brtol nas chang btsags pa/ sman khu btsag pa/ chu dar la 'tshag pa/ 2.rgyags pa/ lug sha 'tshag pa/ gzugs stobs 'tshag pa/ 3.(rnying) 'dzom pa/
lus kyi nyams brjid pa'am sha rgyags pa/ lus 'tshag bzang po/
gsog pa'i don du go ba'i 'tshag pa'i 'das pa,
gos sogs kyi bar srub tu gzhug bya/ dgun chas nang du srin bal bar 'tshang bcug pa/
, mi mang gzhi gcig tu sdeb 'tshang gi tshul/ 'tshang ga brgyab nas ma 'gro/ mi tshang mas 'tshang ga shig shig gis gzhung 'bru skyel ba/
sangs rgyas pa'i ma 'ongs da lta gnyis/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ 'di ru 'dug nas 'tshang rgya bar bya'o dgongs so/

1.(tha dad pa) btsangs pa, btsang ba, tshongs,, bar gseb tu dbang shed kyis 'jug pa'am, shugs kyis 'dzud pa/ rtsig pa'i gseb tu sa rdo btsangs nas lhags pa bkag pa/ mi mang po'i dkyil du 'tshang ba/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) 1,'tshangs pa, 'tshang ba, 'tshongs,, nyul ba dang, 'dzul ba/ go skabs byung 'phral du dgra bo 'tshangs yong/ go sar 'tshangs pa/ 2,'tshangs pa, 'tshang ba,, dbugs sogs gyen du rgyong ba/ cham pa phog pas sna khung 'tshang ba/ ri bo mthon por 'dzeg skabs dbugs 'tshang yong ngam mi yong/
tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'tshang ba'i 'das pa,

(tha dad pa) 'tshabs pa, 'tshab pa, 'tshobs,, 1) 'jal ba dang, gsob pa/ dngul skyin lhag med 'tshabs pa/ 2) brel ba'am rtab pa/ sems 'tshabs nas yig rigs bris nor byung ba/ 3) snon pa/ phan tshun brje tshong gi snon pa 'tshab pa/
sems brel rtab byung ba'i rnam pa/ sngon tshud nas gra sgrig byas yod na skabs 'phral du 'tshab 'tshab byed mi dgos/
brel zing/ 'tshab 'tshub ngang dmag lan slog pa/
lhing lhing min pa/ kho brel zhing 'tshabs por rang khyim du log song/
lus kyi 'byung khams sam yul gyi bde dog sogs 'tsham po yin min 'dri ba/ thag ring nas phebs pa'i mgron por 'tsham 'dri zhu ba/

1.(tha dad pa) btsams pa, btsam pa, tshoms,, co 'dri ba'am brnyas bcos byed pa/ gnod byed dgra la mtho 'tsham pa/ 2.(tha dad pa) 'tshams pa, 'tsham pa,, ran pa'am mthun pa/ blo dang 'tsham pa/ gang la de 'tshams/ che chung 'tsham pa/
/ 1) 'os po/ blo dang 'tsham po/ 2) bde po/ gzugs khams 'tsham po/ yul lung 'tsham po/
ran 'tsham/ gtong yong tshang ma'i 'tsham tshod 'dzin pa/
tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'tsham pa'i 'das pa,
'tshams 'dri zhu skabs 'bul ba'i dngos po/ khong la dar dkar srid du ring ba zhig 'tshams zhu'i 'bul mtshon du phul/
'tshams 'dri zhus pa'i lan/ 'thus mi rnams kyis tshur 'tshams lan gnang ba/
(tha mi dad pa) cher skye ba dang, 'phel ba, skyed thon pa/ phru gu 'di'i gzugs po myur du 'tshar ba/
cher longs pa'am cher 'gro ba/ lo phyugs kyi thon skyed 'tshar longs legs po byung 'dug / 'tshar longs stobs 'phel/ phru gu rnams skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i ngang nas 'tshar longs byung 'dug /
