me la ma bsregs pa'i rdza ma/
rdza snod so gtong sa'i ra skor/
rdza las bzos pa'i sla nga/
dngos zog btang ba'i tho/ dngos rigs rnams brdzangs tho nang gsal ltar rtsil len dgos rgyu/
/ 1) 'dam chu ljan ljin/ 'dam rdzab tu tshud pa/ 2) shing rigs kyi sdong po dang rtsa ba gang rung la skye ba'i wa ba phor pa dkrug byed legs shos shig /
1) 'dam rdzab che ba/ 2) (yul) ya med tsha po'am nyes pa'i las kar mi 'jigs pa/
(yul) ya med tsha po'am nyes pa'i las la mi 'jigs pa/ mkhas rlom rdzab chen/ rkun ma rdzab chen/
rdzab ya zhes pa mchin pa'i ri mo lta bu yod pa'i shing gi wa ba zhig /
rdzab ya zhes pa phag pa'i spu ris lta bu yod pa'i shing gi wa ba zhig /
rdzab ya'i phor pa/ rdzab phor dngul shan ma/
nges pa med pa'am g.yo sgyu zol zog gi tshul/ g.yo zol rdzab rdzub/ las stangs rdzab bi rdzub bi/
1) rdzun gyi rang bzhin/ gtam rdzab be rdzob be ma shod/ 2) mi gtsang ljan ljin gyi tshul/ lud snyigs rdzab be rdzob be zhing gar skyel/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha ldan mi dmangs kyi grong khyim phyi nang du rdzab chu rdzab lud gsog nyar chog pa tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
rdzab bi rdzub bi'i bsdus ming,
rdzab be rdzob be'i bsdus ming,
shing rigs rdzab las bzos pa'i phor pa/
rdzab ya ri mo 'ug pa'i sgro ris lta bu yod pa zhig /
phor pa dkrug byed shing gi wa ba zhig /
phor pa dkrug byed shing gi wa ba yag shos rdzab ya la mtshan mo me 'od 'phro skad/
shing rdzab ya las bzos pa'i btung snod/
drel la sga rgyag skabs brla sha'i 'phred du gtong rgyu'i shing hril/

/ 1) ka ca/ nor rdzas/ dngos rdzas/ 2) sgra dang rtog pas btags pa tsam min par don dam par don byed nus pa'am skyes bu'i dgos don sgrub nus pa, gzugs sgra lta bu'o/ 3) 'bar byed kyi rdzas/ me mda'i rdzas/

dgag dbye dngos kyi cho ga'i gras shig ste, dbyar nang gi rnyed pa bgo ba'i ched du, bskos pa'i dge slong gis khab la sogs pa'i rdzas phran tshegs kyis rdzas kyi dgag dbye'i sgo phye nas sbyin bdag gzhan gyis rnyed pa dang bkur sti rgya chen pos mchod pa byed pa'o/
rgyud las gsungs pa'i khams dkar dmar de 'ching byed kyi thabs dang bcas pa/
(rnying) khang skyong ngam mkho ba'i yo byad srung mkhan/
rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa
rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses bdag po dang 'brel ba'i rdzas gang rung gi gnas lugs drang por brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /

gsang sngags kyi spyod 'bras thun mong ba zhig ste, ral gri dang ril bu sogs rdzas la brten nas dngos grub bsgrubs pas lha dang mi'i gnas rnams su thogs med du rgyu zhing, rig sngags kyis sems can la phan 'dogs shing tshar gcod par nus pa'o/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i shan gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, yo byad snga ma la bdag tu 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i nus pas yo byad phyi ma la yang gos par byas pa'i stobs kyis ltung ba gzhan skyed par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'o, de la nang gses su gos kyi shan dang, sman gyi shan dang, lhung bzed kyi shan bcas gsum yod/
1) dngos rdzas blug snod khug ma/ 2) bod mda'i 'bar rdzas blug snod/
1) brag rdo gshag skabs rdzas blug sa'i mig khung/ 2) bod mda'i sna rdzas blug sa'i lcags lheb i khung can/
me mda'i rdzas dbur dus dgos pa'i shing gi gri chung zhig /
rdzas kyi rgyun te, dngos po rang nyid kyi skad cig du ma'i yun, dper na, nas kyi sa bon las nas kyi myu gu skye ba'i bar gyi rang nyid kyi rgyun la nas kyi rdzas rgyun zhes pa lta bu'o/
rdzas dri ngan pa'am dug yod pa'i rdzas cha/ rdzas ngan sbyor ba/ rdzas ngan gtong ba/
rdzas kyi sgo nas so so ba ma yin par skyes pa'i chos, bum pa dang bum pa'i mchu lta bu'o/ me dang me'i mtshan nyid tsha ba gnyis rdzas gcig pa red/
1) don dam par don byed nus pa'i dngos gzugs lta bu'o/ 2) rdzas kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i gzugs kyi yon tan, dper na, gzugs kyi mi rtag pa lta bu'o/
ma'i gsal byed: gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi nang gses thog mar bkod pa'i rdzas kyi gsal byed des phyi ma kun gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhig /
rdzas kyi sgo nas so so bar skyes pa'i chos gzugs shes gnyis lta bu'o/
me mda' 'phen thengs gcig re'i rdzas 'bor gyi tshad gzhi/
1) sman dang mngar cha sogs blug snod cig / 2) me mda'i rdzas blug snod dam be/
sha mig gis mthong mi thub pa'i rdzas gzugs phra ba/
sman rdzas sna tshogs sbyor ba lta bu/

khyad par brjod pa: khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod dngos po gang zhig gi rdzas sam, yo byad kyi cha lag ma tshang yang, tshang ba dang 'dra ba'i rdzas kyi byed las khyad 'phags ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gzugs can gyi rgyu'am dngos po min pa/ sems dang nam mkha' gzugs can gyi rdzas ma yin pa/
rgyu cha 'dra ba/ chang dang a rag gnyis kyi rdzas mtshungs pa/ mar dang zho gnyis rdzas mtshungs pa/
me mda'i rdzas la mu zi sogs mang nyung sre lugs kyi skor thang/
1) rdzas su grub pa ste dngos por yod pa, bum pa lta bu'o/ 2) rang nyid ngos gzung rgyu de chos gzhan ngos gzung ba la bltos mi dgos pa'i dngos po zhig /
dngos smra bas don byed nus pa'i dngos po thams cad rdzas yod du 'dod do/
mtshan nyid yin pa'i rdzas su yod pa'i chos gsum ste, mtshan nyid yin pa, rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa, rang gi mtshon bya las gzhan pa'i mtshan nyid mi byed pa bcas gsum mo/
rdzas yod la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na, rigs pas grub pa'i rdzas yod dang, brtan pa mi 'gyur ba'i rdzas yod dang, don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod dang, rang rkya 'dzin thub pa'i rdzas yod de bzhi'o/
sha mig gis mthong thub pa'i rdzas gzugs che ba/

rigs gcig pa'i nang gses, rang gi nyer len gcig las skyes pa'i tha dad pa'i dngos po, dper na 'jim pa gcig las grub pa'i rdza bum dkar nag gnyis dang, rang rgyu snga ma'i blo gcig las skyes pa'i sems sems byung lta bu'o/
1) me mda'i rdzas 'dul byed rdo ril/ 2) rdzas kyi ril bu/
rdzas rwa ste rwa co las bzos pa'i rdzas snod/
bod sog gi me mda'i rna rdzas blug byed rwa co las bzos pa zhig /
rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i gzugs med dngos po sems lta bu/ rdzas las min pa'i dngos por rjes dpag gi rigs pas dpyad dgos/

kyi dngos grub: dngos grub bsgrub pa'i spyod pa zhig ste, rdzas ral gri dang mig sman sogs la brten nas mkha' spyod du 'gro ba dang, lus phung po rags pa sbyangs nas phra ba dang yang ba sogs kyi dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad mngon du byas te mkha' spyod du 'gro ba dang, longs spyod mi'i 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bu nas mkha' spyod du 'gro ba'o/
dngos smra bas don byed nus pa'i chos thams cad rdzas su grub par 'dod do/
dngos su med pa'am gzugs su med pa/
dngos su yod pa ste rang gi 'bras bu skyed pa'i nus pa yod pa'i dngos po'o/
1./ 1) rig shes/ khyi de rdzi yag po 'dug / lus stobs nyams nas rdzi'ang rdib song/ 2) (rnying) rlung/ 2. grangs gnas shig /
(yul) 1) phyugs rdzi sdod sa'i ra skor/ 2) khyi dang gcan gzan gyis rdzi snom bzhin du gang sar skor ba rgyag tshul/
rlung char/ rdzi char zim bu/
rlung gi ming yin pas: sbyar dug gi nang tshan du ba rlung gi rdzi la rta byas nas bskur ba'i dug /
dri tshor skyen po dang gsal po/ sgo khyi rdzi rnon po/
lhags pa gang nas yong ba'i phyogs/ rngon pas rdzi phyogs la bltas te ri dwags gsod par 'jab pa/
(tha mi dad pa) brdzis pa, brdzi ba, rdzis,, 1) sno ba dang sbru ba'am g.yos sbyor byed pa/ zan brdzis pa/ 2) gnon pa/ rkang pas brdzis pa/ mgo rdog pas brdzis pa/ 3) gnod pa/ gzhan gyis mi brdzi/
do dam pa'am lta rtog byed mkhan/ bu rdzi/ lug rdzi/ rgyab rdzi/
rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed
sngon du sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod de rjes su rang nyid 'tshang rgya bar bya snyam pa'i sems bskyed de dpe med pa'i sems bskyed ces kyang bya/
mig lpags kyi mtha' na yod pa'i spu/ mig gi rdzi ma/ rdzi ma 'khrab pa/ rdzi ma stug po/ rdzi ma nang du zug pa/
rdzi ma stug pa'i dpe byad
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, sems can gyi tshogs drangs pa nyid kyis rdzi ma stug pa/
1) dri tshor rgyu med pa/ 2) spyang grung med pa/ 3) srung mkhan med pa/ 4) mig gi rdzi ma med pa/
rdzi gsang po/ khyi rdzi yag pos gcan gzan yong ba shes yong/
sna'i rdzi yis shes pa ste, don gnad kyi zur tsam ha go ba/
rlung ngam lhags pa/ rdzi rlung 'jam po/ rdzi rlung drag pa/
bshang lam nas rgyu ma phyir lug pa/
1) sna'i rdzi/ nor srung rdzi gsang can/ 2) spyang grung/
grung sha dod po/ mi de rdzi gsang dod po zhig 'dug /
'dra chags mdog kha po/ khog la dpa' med phyi la rdzig nyams ston/
gzhan la sdigs mo byed pa'i skad cha/
nyams kyis 'then pa/ khyis rdzig 'then thag pa chad na med/
/ 1) 'dra chags po/ gzugs stobs che ba'i mi rdzig po/ phyi rdzig nang stong/ 2) phyug po/ mi tshang rdzig po/
1) bshad bshad gtong ba'am tshig rtsub brjod pa/ phru gur rdzig rdzig gtong ba/ 2) 'jigs snang skul ba/ nga khyod kyi rdzig rdzig 'khur mi min/
rdzing gi kha'i mtha' skyor/ rdo dang ar 'dam mnyam bsres kyis bzos pa'i rdzing skyor brtan po 'dug /
chu bskyil ba'i lteng ka/ rdzing chen/ rdzing ring/ ming gi rnam grangs la nya sbal can dang, lteng ka, shang shong chu bcas so,

shing s'a la rab brtan de'i shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu 'das pa na rdzing bu dal 'bab ces bya ba rgya khyon ma dros pa ji lta ba bzhin du yod pa la 'khor du rdzing bu brgya stong yod pa de la udpal la sogs pa'i me tog sdong bu gshol mda' tsam dang, me tog shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam, lo ma ba lang gi ko ba tsam, rtsa ba skyes bu chen po'i brla tsam sogs yod pa zhig /
myang rtsis las rdzing bur 'jug gi ri mo: ste gcig shar na than pa 'byung
(rnying) rdzing bu dbral ba'am rdzing chu phyir 'don pa/
shing gdung ma bsgrigs pa'i gzings/
/ 1) rdzi bo chung ba/ 2) rdze'u dang 'dra,
khyad gzhi sems kyi 'phen pa'i lus chos ni rdzu ba dang, khyad chos lus kyi spyod pa sems chos ni 'phrul ba/ rdzu 'phrul ston pa/ rdzu 'phrul du snang ba/
me dpung mtsho ru bsgyur ba dang, bsad pa gso nus pa la sogs pa'i sprul bsgyur gyi bkod pa/
rdzu 'phrul ni mngon shes lnga dang, rkang pa ni thob par byed pa'i rgyu la bya ste dkyus kyi ting nge 'dzin no/

byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang gses, tshogs lam chen po nas thob pa'i chos shig ste, 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang, sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang, brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang, dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bcas bzhi'o/
'bar ba dang, 'phur ba dang, mang nyung dang, bzang ngan dang, chu la 'gro zhing sa la bying ba dag shes pa ste mngon shes drug gi ya gyal zhig /
sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang don gcig
ba shes pa'i mngon shes: rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang don gcig
sku stod la me 'bar ba dang sku smad la chu 'byin pa lta bu'i cho 'phrul lo/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro ba sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs ston pa la dbang ba'o/
(tha dad pa) brdzus pa, brdzu ba, rdzus,, sgyur ba dang, ma yin pa yin pa ltar byed pa/ ri bong rdor brdzus/
/ mkhas pa'i rdzu bag byed pa/
ma yin yin khul byed pa/ nad rdzu byed pa/ spam rdzu byed pa/ zog rdzu byed pa/ bzang rdzu byed pa/ bzang rdzu byed pa/
g.yo thabs bzang po/ ngan g.yo rdzu bzang gi gdong 'bag yongs su bshus pa/
mi bden pa'i gtam/ ming gi rnam grangs la de nyid bral dang, bden min, sbyar rdzun, log par mngon, slu tshig bcas so,
rdzun gyi phug / rdzun rkub brtol ba/ rdzun rkub rdol ba/
rtag tu rdzun sha stag shod mkhan gyi ngan ming/ mi de rdzun rkyal zhig yin pa go byung bas khos bshad pa la yid ches ma byung/
rdzun gyi char gtogs bcu gnyis

dge tshul gyi bslab bya blangs 'das so gsum gyi nang gses, rdzun gyi char gtogs gzhi med dang, bag tsam gyis skur 'debs, dge 'dun dbyen, de rjes phyogs pa, khyim sun 'byin pa, shes bzhin rdzun smra, bshes ngor 'phya ba, zhal ta bar 'phya ba, zas cung zad kyi phyir chos ston zhes skur ba 'debs pa, lhag ma'i skur 'debs, bslab pa khyad gsod, lhag po len phyir 'bras chan 'gebs pa ste bcu gnyis so/
rdzun pa'i rgyab langs rdzun pas byas pa/
mi bden pa'i skad cha mang po lhu bsgrigs nas bden mdog kha po ltar bcos pa/ mi bden rdzun bsgrigs kyi lo rgyus/
skyag rdzun gyi bsngags brjod/ ngo bstod kyi rdzun bsngags/
gyon chas brdzus ma/ rdzun chas spras pa/
skyag rdzun gyi skad cha/ mig gis mthong bzhin du rdzun gtam bshad pa/ rdzun gtam ther 'don/
mi bden pa'i skad cha rang gar bzos pa/
mi bden pa/ skyag rdzun/ rdzun du smra ba/ gtam rdzun pa/
yin bzo byed pa'i rnam 'gyur:/ gdong la rdzun 'bag gyon pa/
drang min g.yo sgyu'i tshig ste, mi dge ba bcu'i nang gses shig /
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, pham pa bzhi'i nang tshan gyi rdzun ma yin pa shes bzhin du rdzun smra ba'o/
rdzun ma bzos pa/ rdzun bzos dngos po/ rdzun bzos skad cha/
bcos mar bzos pa'i gtam dang dngos po bcos min bden par 'gyur ba/ gnas skabs rdzun bzos bden 'gyur du 'gro srid kyang mthar mtha' gsal bar nges/
ma yin yin khul/ drang min rdzun gsob/
(rnying) g.yo zol lam zog rdzu byed pa/ srin po mir rdzub/
skye gnas bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mtho ris kyi lha rnams dang 'dre srin yi dwags dmyal ba la sogs pa'o/
(tha dad pa) brdzes pa, brdze ba, rdzes,, gyen du sdog pa/ gos brdzes te chu brgal/ phu thung brdze ba/ skra brdzes pa/
(yul) chu 'khor gyi srog shing gi shing shubs ming/
pho ba'i nang ldebs su yod pa'i zas skom myag byed kyi sul lam gnyer ma lta bu zhig /
(yul) gos kyi gsham thung thung du rdze ba/ chu chen rgal dus gos gsham rdze lo byed pa/
rdze'u tshos kha zas kyi bsdus ming,
rdza snod chung ngu'i nang du btsos pa'i kha zas bro ba zhim po/
(yul) rtsig pa'i thod nas phyir rdzog rdo 'phen pa'i i khung/
(yul) zhib mor rdung ba/ sa rdo rdzog rdung gtong ba/
(yul) gtun kong ngam rdung snod/ rdo'i rdzog snod/ lcags kyi rdzog snod/
(yul) 1) rdung ba/ rus pa rdzog pa/ 2) sgyel ba/ shing sdong sa la rdzog song/
rdzogs pa chen po'i bsdus ming,

khams rdzogs chen dgon pa o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling zhes rnying ma'i dgon pa skad grags can de khams sde dge'i sa char rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing mo glang gi lor grub dbang padma rig 'dzin gyis phyag btab, rdzogs chen shr'i sengha zhes par gzhung chen bcu gsum rgya gzhung thog nas 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i bshad grwa'i rgyun btsugs te mdo sngags rig gnas bcas shin tu dar, 'ju mi pham dang, dpal sprul sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang du byon/
sems sde dang, klong sde, man ngag gi sde ste gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po'i theg pa'i nang gses sde gsum mo/
zad pa'i mtshams sam mtha'/ rnyog gra rdzogs mtha' med pa/ dus skabs rdzogs mthar thug pa/
'dzam gling mi rnams kyi chos dang, nor, 'dod pa, bde ba bzhi yongs su tshang bar longs spyod pa'i dus te, de'i yun tshad la lo grangs sa ya gcig dang, bdun 'bum nyi khri brgyad stong yod par grags/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) gang ba dang tshang ba/ mthun rkyen gang dgos tshang ma rdzogs pa/ zla ba'i cha thams cad rdzogs par shar ba/ 2) tshar ba dang zad pa/ las don thag gcod bya rgyu tshang ma rdzogs song/ yo byad yod dgu bed bcad pas rdzogs song/ skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pa/ 2. yar ngo'i rdzogs pa dang po tshes lnga, gnyis pa tshes bcu, gsum pa tshes bco lnga, mar ngo'i rdzogs pa dang po tshes nyi shu, gnyis pa tshes nyer lnga, gsum pa gnam stong/

sngags rnying ma'i chos skad de, sems kyi rang bzhin la ngo bo stong pa chos sku, rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku, thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku ste sku gsum gyi yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub par rdzogs pa ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pas chen po'o/
rdzogs pa spyi chibs kyi sa

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnal 'byor lnga pa'i skabs su thob pa'i sa bcu pa ste, mthar lam du rtsal snang gzugs sku'i bkod pa thams cad skye ba med pa'i dbyings su 'ub chub par yongs su rdzogs shing mthar phyin pas, sa bcu pa la rdzogs pa spyi chibs kyi sa zhes bya'o/
gser gyi phreng ba: bon gyi lta ba ston pa'i gzhung zhig /
sngar rgya gar mu stegs kyi ston pa zhig /
skye ba de la bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi myong ba ci tsam yod pa skyed cing rdzogs par byed pa/
yul dus dngos po ming tshig bya byed sogs gang dang gang gi mtha' zad mtshams/
sangs rgyas pa/ slad nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'o/

rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun te rtsa thig rlung gsum las su rung ba la brten nas stong bzhis drangs pa'i 'od gsal dang, dga' bzhis drangs pa'i lhan skyes ye shes mngon du byed pa'i shes rab khyad par can/
yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi ste, sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang, dam tshig gi rnal 'byor, dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor, ye shes kyi rnal 'byor bcas bzhi'o/
/ 1) mkhar/ brag rdzong/ btsan rdzong/ 2) bar gseng gi tshags/ ko rdzong/ gru rdzong/ do rdzong/ dpe rdzong/ 3) srid 'dzin sa khul zhig / rdzong khag so so/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khongs su 'du dgos pa'i khral rkang/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rdzong nas rdzong du 'u lag thog dos dang yi ge sogs skyel ba/
sa rdo brtsigs pa'i mkhar rdzong/ nyin mang po'i ring rdzong mkhar btsan po'i nang dgra dmag dang 'thabs pa/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi skyid rong rdzong gi mi dmangs srid gzhung gnas yul yin/

t'a la'i sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i skabs btab pa rtse pho brang rgyab klu chen gtso 'khor gnas pa'i khang pa, hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin klu khang mjal mchod kyi dga' ston byed srol yod/
sngar hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer drug nyin smon lam gtor mjug dga' ston rdzong rgyab rta rgyug gi dus ston/
(yul) lcags sam shing las bzos pa'i bod mda'i mde'u rdzong byed dang, 'phrul mda'i mdel khog 'don byed kyi gsor 'bigs/
'gro dgos pa'i bka' phab ste gtong ba/ kho tsho rdzong bda' byas pa yin/ rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor rnams kyis rdzong bda' byas pa yin/
1) bang chen gtong ba/ 2) mtha' 'bud gtong ba/
rdzong dang, rdzong de'i 'du khongs te khral pa'am mi ser bcas kyi 'dus ming/
rdzong dpon nam de'i ngo tshab/
rdzong du 'gan khur nas sdod mkhan dpon po/
(tha dad pa) brdzangs pa, brdzang ba, rdzongs,, 1) 'bud pa/ nag can sa mthar rdzong ba/ 2) mngags pa dang gtong ba/ thag ring phyogs su mi gcig brdzang dgos/ 3) 'jug pa/ sgam gyi nang du brdzangs pa/
1) snga dus rdzong khag gnyis zung du sbrel ba/ 2) snga dus rdzong dpon ser skya gnyis zung du sprel ba/
rdzong dpon dang 'du khongs kyi gtso drag gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
gzhom gzhig dka' ba'i mkhar rdzong btsan po/
dngos po snod du 'jug stangs dam lhod kyi tshags/ sgam du gyon chas rdzong tshags 'grig po byung ba/ dpe snod du dpe cha rdzong tshags dam por bcug pa/
sngar gyi yul gru so so'i rdzong dang gzhis ka/
rdzong dang gzhis ka'i las kyi sne mor sdod mkhan/

rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i dgon pa ni khams sde dge'i shar phyogs sman shod ces pa'i sa char rab byung bzhi pa'i chu glang lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas phyag btab, 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos gdan sa mdzad pa'i sa skya'i dgon pa skad grags can zhig /
skyes bskur ba/ thag ring grogs po la yul mkho'i rdzongs bskur ba/
lam du 'gro ba'i rgyags phye'am 'grul pa 'gro khar sprod pa'i dngos rigs/
skyes rdzongs kyi dngos po ched bskur/ phyogs su phebs skabs rdzongs sta gya nom pa zhig phul ba/
skyes/ skal rdzongs/ thon rdzongs sam 'gro rdzongs/
(tha dad pa) brdzad pa, brdzad pa, rdzod,, skyon lhad gtong ba/ mi ngan gyis brdzad pa/ mar khus gyon chas ma rdzod cig /
blun rtags/ spang blang nor na rdzob rtags yin/

(tha dad pa) brdzabs pa, brdzab pa, rdzobs,, 1) snon pa/ rtsam pa rdzob pa/ ja mar rdzob pa/ dngul gyis ma 'dangs na de'i khar rdzob chog / 2) sgrib pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sbar mos rdzob mi thub pa/ bden pa'i gnas lugs rdzob pa/ kun tu rdzob pa/
rdzod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
ngo ma ma yin pa/ mi brdzus ma/ yi ge brdzus ma/ dngos rdzas brdzus ma/ skad cha brdzus ma/

bod yig gsal byed nyi shu pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mchu dang, byed pa mchu, nang gi rtsol ba mchu gnyis cung zad 'phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1. ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2. 1) gcan gzan zhig / wa 'dzum gson la ngom pa las, stag shi rnga ma ngom pa dga'/ 2) khang thog gi chu 'gro'i shur/ 3) (yul) rta shed rgyas pa'i skabs kyi drug mdo'i sgang gi shur/
wa lpags sbubs bshus las bzos pa'i zhwa mo/
gcan gzan wa/ wa skyes gsod pa pags pa'i slad, don mthun bcom pa nor gyi don/ ming gi rnam grangs la wa mo dang sa myos so,
blo khog med pa'i mi'i dpe/ wa skyes dar mas seng ge la 'gran pa/
khang thog gi chu 'gro sa'i shur bu/
1) chu 'gro'i dbor khung/ 2) wa mo 'dzul sa'i khung bu/
khur mong la rgya khur dang, wa khur gnyis dbye ba'i rigs gcig ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas tsha ba sel, dang ga 'gags pa 'byed, bad kan smug po 'joms, glang thabs la phan/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag skya bo rim bzhi yan chad kyis gyon rgyu'i wa lpags nag pos bzos pa'i dgun zhwa tog can zhig /
wa mo 'khyug ste 'gro ba/ lus zor yang ba wa 'khyug 'dra bar 'gro/
wa mo spu mdog ngang skya/
srog chags sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo rnag skem, glo rdol gso/
wa mos chu btungs nas skad rgyag pa/ skad ngan wa brgyal ba bzhin du shor ba/
1) khang thog gi wa kha'i chu/ 2) chu'i rka'am yur ba nas 'bab pa'i chu/
1) chu 'gro sa'i wa kha'i sne/ 2) sems can wa mo'i mchu to/
gcan gzan wa yi snying ste, ro mngar, nus pas dmu chu'i nad thur du sbyong bar byed/
1) ras dkar po zhig / 2) thang phrom dkar po ste, nus pas srin gsod, gag lhog dang glang thabs 'joms, lus stobs bskyed/
(legs) mang yul skyid grong gi rten gtso 'phags pa mched bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
smad 'dogs kyi yi ge bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, kwa khwa gwa nywa dwa tshwa zhwa zwa rwa lva shwa hwa bcas wa btags can bcu gnyis so/ wa...kwa khwa...
1) gcan gzan wa mo'i gdong rus/ 2) wa mo'i gdong rus kyi dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i mjug rus kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
wa mo nag po/ wa nag gi pags pa rin thang che/
wa mo'i pags pa/ wa mo rgyug 'dur mang na wa lpags gdang la 'gel/
zhed nas 'bros 'gro ba'i dpe/ dgra dmag pham nas wa 'bros byed/

wa skyes/ snying stobs med pa wa mo 'dra/ wa mo stag brdzus/ dgra lan po med na wa mo yin, grogs lan po med na khram pa yin/ wa mo g.yo sgyu mkhas kyang rngon pa'i mig lam nas mi thar/ 'gro wa mo las mkhas kyang mjug ma ring ba'i skyon, sdod ri bong las tsog kyang am cog ring ba'i skyon/
nyi skar bdun dang chu tshod zhe gsum ste, spyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i skor nas wa zhag bco lnga 'dren, ston sad yod med brtag pa'o/
wa lpags las bzos pa'i zhwa mo/ gos chen gyi rgyab sha btang ba'i wa zhwa/
dma' ba dag 'bod pa'i sgra zhig /
(legs) 1) klu bye brag pa zhig / 2) chu lha'i shing/
(yul) bya 'ol ba'i mdog / rta wa la/
sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong khongs su yod/
gsal le'am lhang nge/ yid la wa ler shar/ sems la wa ler dran pa/
sems la lam lam du shar tshul/ tshig don thams cad yid la wal wal shar/ bsgom pa bla ma'i zhal ras, yid la 'char rgyu mi 'dug ma bsgoms byams pa'i zhal ras, yid la wa le wal le/
bod rigs kyi rus ming zhig ste, mdo smad 'brog khul gyi shul chen bco brgyad nang gi gcig /
khang ba'i chu 'bab kyi wa zhabs 'dom gang brkos pa'i 'og gi sa chur bgrungs pa'i dwangs mas sman rta byas na rma 'bras dang sha ro gcod par byed/
wa mo'i pags pa'i gyon pa

rgya gar gyi chu bo r'a dang na s'i gnyis bar gyi grong khyer zhig ste, sngar ston pa shakya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rjes su 'khor lnga sde bzang por bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i yul/
(rgya) sngar rgya nag gong ma'i dus kyi go gnas shig /
(rgya) sngar rgya nag gong ma'i dus kyi go gnas khag gnyis kyi bsdus ming/

(rgya) tung han rgyal rabs su byung ba'i rgya nag gi mkhas pa zhig ste, khong gis gtso bo byas pa'i nang chos don gnyer gyi mi bcu phrag lhag tsam gyis nub phyogs su phyin pa na, chos dpe zhig khyer yong ba'i rgya gar gyi pandi ta gnyis phrad nas de gnyis rgya nag tu gdan drangs te rgya gar gyi chos rnams rgya yig tu bsgyur nas rgya yul du nang chos thog mar dar spel mdzad pa po de yin par bshad do/
(rgya) sngar bod kyi sku drag byes su 'gro mkhan sogs kyi zhwa mo'i bye brag cig /
(rgya) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod bzhugs am ban la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu'i ming/
(legs) thu mi sambho tas bod yig thog mar rtsom skabs dbu med kyi ma phyi mdzad pa'i rgya gar gyi yi ge zhig /
lam gyis/ tshig don blo la wal gyis shar ba/
wa le wal le'i bsdus ming,
(rgya) a rag 'bebs byed kyi yo byad cig /

rgya rje thang the tsung gi sras mo, bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo yin la, lcags glang lor btsan po'i bka' ltar blon po mgar stong btsan sogs kyis thang gi rgyal sa nas gdan drangs, der brten rgya'i bzo rig dang, gso rig rtsis rig sogs rig pa'i gnas dang dpal 'byor spel ba'i thabs tshul sna tshogs pa rim gyis bod du spel, bod mi chen gyi bu du ma rgya nag tu yon tan slob tu btang, sgos su rang gi rdzongs skal sangs rgyas thub pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad kyi sku brnyan jo bo shakya mu ne bzhugs su gsol ba'i lha sa'i ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs, rab byung sngon gyi drug cu'i skor drug pa'i lcags 'brug lor 'das, khong bod du lo sum cu lhag bzhugs pa'i ring la mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res bcas la phyag rjes shin tu che'o/

(rgya) sngar thang zan bla ma'i slob ma khra'o zhan gyi slob dpon zhig yin, khong gis 'phags pa dgongs pa zab mo nges par 'grel ba'i mdo rgya cher 'grel pa rgya yig tu brtsams, slar 'gos lo chos 'grub kyis bod yig tu bsgyur/
/ 1) dgra lha'am mtshon lha/ 2) 'go ba'i lha/

bod yig gsal byed nyer gcig pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen dro zhing sgra med pa, ming gzhi'i mo yig cig /
yan lag zha nas kyog por gyur pa/ rkang pa zha kyog / lag pa ya gcig zha kyog tu gyur pa/
zha nye las bzos pa'i skud pa/
, 1) ra ba rtsig pa sogs zhig grabs yod pa/ ca lag zha gi zhi gi / khang pa rnying pa zha gi zhi gi / 2) mdud pa sogs dam po med pa zhig chog chog / sked rags zha gi zhi gi chags pa/
1) nyams chag / 2) chad lus/ zha chag 'theng 'khum med pa/
lcags rigs shig ste, sman sbyor gyi nus pas dngul chu'i dug 'joms, sha ro gcod/ zha nye dkar po/ zha nye nag po/ zha nye'i gting rdo/
rkang kyog gi 'gro stangs/ zha 'theng 'theng byas nas thag ring 'gro dka'/
rdza chas sogs la rtsi gtong byed kyi rdo rigs shig de zhu na zha nye 'byung/
bod yig gsal byed kyi sde pa drug pa ste, zha za 'a ya/ zha za 'a ya
(tha mi dad pa) rkang lag sogs la skyon shor ba/ rkang 'theng lag zha/
rkang lag gang rung la skyon zhugs te nyams shing 'khums pa'i ming/
sgur sgur ram gug gug / kha 'phred 'phred sgyid zha zha/
(yul) phru gu chung chung/ zha zhi ngu ba/
yan lag 'khum skyon shor ba/ zha ril 'khums pa/ grum bu'i nad kyis rkang lag bzhi ga zha ril du gyur pa/
(yul) gyang ldebs sogs la gtong rgyu'i zhal ba/ rtsig pa la zha la brgyab pa/
1) gzhis ka rtse rdzong gi sa cha zhig ste, sngar 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal zhig / 2) (rnying) pad kha sogs rtsi shing gi myu gu gsar pa/
pad kha sogs kyi lo ma gsar du kha 'bus pa/

sngar dus rabs bcu gcig par gzhis rtse'i sa khul du btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing, der dus rabs bcu bzhi par bu ston rin chen grub yun ring bzhugs te rgyud sde mang po'i 'chad rgyun btsugs pa de nas bzung zha lu ba'i grub mtha' dar rgyas byung zhing, sngar dgon pa 'dir sam skri ta'i skad kyi chos dpe mang po yod zer/
dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i mjug dang, dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i 'gor bu ston rin chen grub kyis gsar gtod byas pa'i chos lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan/

mtshan la chos skyong bzang po zer, rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi lor gzhis rtse'i sa khul zha lur 'khrungs, rab byung dgu pa'i shing byi lor dag yig za ma tog thengs dang po brtsams shing, sa glang lor bskyar du legs bcos dang zhu dag byas, de min sum rtags kyi 'grel pa yang brtsams yod, de nas mi ring bar 'das/

/ 1) mar dang snum sogs kyi tshil lam rtsi/ 2) bod ja bsrubs ma'i kha la chags pa'i mar tshi/ 3) nyi ma snang ba'i cha nas nyin dang, nub pa'i cha nas mtshan zhes nyin mtshan bsdoms pa'i cha la btags pa'i ming/
nyin zhag gi 'tshub cha'am bar chad/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i shan gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, zhag snga ma la rnyed pa'i yo byad la bdag 'dzin zhugs pa'i nus pas zhag phyi ma la rnyed pa'i yo byad gsar pa la gos par byed pa'o, nang gses su gos la brten pa'i zhag shan dang, lhung bzed la brten pa'i zhag shan dang, sman la brten pa'i zhag shan dang gsum yod do/
lam bar zhag por sdod ring ldeng ba'i za chas/ lam bar du zhag grangs mang po 'gor bas zhag rgyags rdzogs pa/
1) mi'i rus pa'am tshil bu bskol ba'i zhag / 2) tshi lu/
'dul ba las bshad pa'i gso sbyong bco lnga pa rnams ni tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod thub pa'i dus su byas pa'i gso sbyong yin pas zhag thub pa zhes bya'o/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i sman bzhi'i nang gses rlung nad sel ba la gtso bor gnang ba'i sman te, bcas ldan dge slong gis zhag bdun pa'i mtha'i bar byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad du rung ba mar dang, zhun mar dang, 'bru mar, phye hwag li khar, bdud rtsi zhag la sogs pa de dag ni zhag bdun gyi bar du byin gyis brlab tu rung bas na zhag bdun pa zhes bya ba'o/
chos lugs kyi bshad srol ltar mi shi nas zhag bdun phra bdun ring du rtsi rgyu'i bdun tshigs te, bzhi bcu zhe dgu'ang zer/
'grul pa mtshan mor sdod pa/ 'grul pa rnams rtswa chu 'dzoms sar zhag sdod byas pa/
(yul) ral ba/ gos rnying pa dum bur zhag pa/ rdo zhag pa/ pang leb zhag pa/
/ 1) nyin mtshan phrugs gcig / nyin zhag / tshes zhag / khyim zhag / zhag gcig po de lo gsum tsam gyi snang ba byung/ 2) mtshan mo gcig / zhag po gnyis/ bzhugs zhag /
ja zhag sogs gsog sa'i phor pa/
nyi ma skyel ba/ gtam stong gis zhag 'phul/ don med nyin 'phul zhag 'phul gyis dus tshod stong zad du gtong ba/
/ 1) nyin mtshan phrugs gcig / 2) mtshan mo gcig /
zhag sdod byed sa/ rta drel 'gro ma thub pas lam bar du zhag mal byed dgos byung ba/

'dul ba las bshad pa'i gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa rnams ni, tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod ma thub pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i gso sbyong yin pas zhag mi thub ces bya ste, tshes zhag de nyin zhag las chu tshod gcig gis dman pa dang, nyin zhag ni tshes zhag las chu tshod gcig gis lhag pa yin la, de 'byung ba'i dus ni, dgun stod smad, dpyid stod smad, dbyar stod smad de dus tshigs drug la zla ba gnyis yod pa'i phyed dang gnyis 'das phyed lus pa'i tshe na zhag mi thub re re 'byung ba yin no/
mar tshil snum sogs kyi tshi/ sha khu'i kha la zhag tshi 'khrigs pa/ kha lag zhag tshi can/ zhag tshi 'thug po/ mchin nad na dus zhag tshi ngam la brgyab yong/
zha gi zhi gi'i bsdus tshig
ja bsrubs ma dang sha khu sogs kyi kha nas zhag zur du 'don pa/
1) zhag po gcig 'das pa/ 2) btsos nas zhag po 'das pa'i zas/
zhag por sdod sa/ grong 'dabs su zhag sa byed pa/

khyim zhag dang, nyin zhag tshes zhag ste lo la khyim lo gtso bor byas pa dang, zla ba la tshes zla dang, zhag la nyin zhag dbang btsan pa ste gtso che ba yin zhes grags, zhag gsum nang gses mnyam tshad ni, khyim zhag re lnga dang tshes zhag re bdun gnyis mnyam pa yin, khyim zhag dus mda' mkha' ri yid 147056 dang nyin zhag bug mkha' mig bug yid 149209 gnyis mnyam pa yin, tshes zhag nyi 'dod zla 11312 dang nyin zhag mda' 'dod drag 11135 gnyis, yul longs dang dus longs gang gi dbang du byas na'ang mnyam pa yin, de dag gi dus longs dang yul longs ni so so'i thad la ltos/
khyim zhag nyin zhag tshes zhag ste zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba/
thag pa'i zhags pa/ rta rgod kyi ske la zhags thag bskon te 'then pa/

'gugs byed kyi thag pa'am, 'ching byed/ zhags pa'i a long/ g.yag la zhags pa brgyab nas 'dzin pa/ zhags pa 'phangs pa/ rta la zhags pa brgyab pa/ steng gi nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra drag po 'u ru ru bsgrags shing, glog dmar gyi zhags pa bar snang la tshub tshub 'khyugs shing byung ba/ ske khyer nas zhags pa 'dzed pa/ rlung bser bu zhags pas mi zin, chu gtsang po rdo yis mi non/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgrim ba dang, sgril ma, bcings thag thag pa, 'phen thag bzung thag bcas so,
sgo ma bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
sngar bod kyi rus shig gi ming/
, (yul) bla rgan phal par 'bod pa'i zhe ming/
sngar lha sa'i smon lam las byed shing gnyer ba'i 'go pa zhig /

po g.yu brag pa brtson 'grus grags pa: tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi lugs srol thog mar gsar gtod byed mkhan 'di rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos lor lha sar 'khrungs, rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug lor tshal yang dgon zer ba'i dgon pa dang, rab byung gsum pa'i me lug lor tshal gung thang gi lha khang dgon pa bcas brgyab pa de nas bzung tshal pa bka' brgyud zer ba'i grub mtha' byung, rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang lor 'das/
zhang po dang de'i bza' zla/
a ma'i rigs dang 'brel ba'i mi/
a ma'i spun pho/ ming gi rnam grangs la ma yi skra nye dang, ma yi spun zla, ma yi tshang mtshungs, a zhang bcas so,
1) zhang po'i rigs las byung ba'i blon po/ 2) srung ma bye brag pa zhig / zhang blon gyis shes/
a ma'i phyogs kyi gnyen tshan/

yul zhig sngar yul de'i rje bo ni chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud las mched pas btsan po'i gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyal phran zhig yin yang, mthar btsan pos mnga' 'bangs su bcug g.yung drung bon lugs thog mar dar ba'i yul du grags, deb sngon du gu ge'i yul 'di nyid yin gsungs, da lta stod mnga' ris rtsa mda' rdzong gi khongs su yod/
zhang zhung gi khongs gtogs g.yung drung bon po thog mar dar ba'i yul/
'di ni srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo yin zhing, zhang zhung gi rgyal po li mig skya'i bu mo zhang zhung bza' li thig dman zhes bya ba de yin la, 'dis thim bu lkog gi lha khang gbzhengs/

rgyal po khri srong lde btsan skabs byung ba'i lo tsa ba ska cog zhang gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal zhig yin zhing, khong gis lta ba'i khyad par, bzang spyod kyi 'grel pa bzhi'i don bsdus, 'jig rten pha rol sgrub pa, dgongs ldem dgongs bzhi'i brjed byang sogs bsgyur/
srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su 'bro dang mchims dang sna nam gsum ni zhang gsum zer ba dang, sbas ni blon gcig zer, de dag gis dbus kyi 'dun sa 'dzin pa ni bod kyi khod drug gi gras yin/
bag dang dri ma'am g.ya'/ ngan goms kyi zhad/ sngar gyi zhad/ glen zhad/
skyon cha'am ngan pa'i cha/ ca lag 'di la legs cha dang zhan cha gnyis ka 'dug /
dman pa'am ngan pa/ spus tshad zhan pa/ lus stobs zhan pa/ spobs pa zhan pa/ gyon rgyu zhan par khyi kha sdang/
sngon 'jug gi mo yig 'a dang, rjes mjug gi mo yig nga ma 'a bcas rang rang 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi dag la sgra dang rtsol ba zhan par 'jug pa/ 'a/ nga ma 'a...
/ 1) rkang pa'i zhe sa/ zhabs sor/ zhabs mthil/ tshogs 'dur zhabs bcags pa/ 2) ming 'ga' zhig gi sngon du 'jug pa'i zhe sa/ zhabs phyi/ zhabs bro/ zhabs lham/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, zhabs long bu mi mngon pa dang, zhabs mnyam pa dang, zhabs gom pa che snyoms pa ste gsum mo/
phebs pa/ lha gcig chu'i pad mas byin gyis brlabs shing, brtul zhugs pad ma rgyal po'i zhabs kyis bcags pa/
u yig mtshon byed kyi brda/ u...
brjed bskul lam dran bskul/ mi bsnyel ba'i ched du zhabs bskul zhu ba/ myur du phebs dgos pa'i zhabs bskul zhu ba/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, thams cad la thugs snyoms pa'i phyir gom pa che chung med par snyoms pa'o/
rdzong dpon la g.yog po gtong dgos pa'i khral/
rkang pa 'gred pa/ dkan gzar por zhabs 'gred shor ba/
phor pa'i zhabs ra sogs gtub byed phyogs gnyis kar so can gyi lag cha/
rkang rjen ma/ zhabs rjen par gshegs pa/
sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, bgrod dka' ba'i gnas thams cad las skye bo sgrol bar mdzad pa nyid kyis zhabs ring thung med par mnyam pa/
(rnying) rkang pa 'khums pa'am rid pa/ zhabs rnyongs pa med pa/
1) bsnyen bkur/ zhabs tog zhus pa/ 2) 'bul mtshon gyi skyes/
rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyes par byed pa'i zhabs tog zhu tshul gsum ste, rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa, 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog tha ma zang zing gi 'bul ba bcas gsum mo/
rkub stegs sogs rkang pa 'jog sa'i rten/
sku rim mam rim gro'i zhe sa'i ming/ zhabs brtan sgrub pa/ zhabs brtan zhu ba/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi skabs t'a la'i bla ma'i zhabs brtan sgrub mkhan rnams la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i las khungs shig /
rkang thang/ khong dgung lo bgres pas zhabs thang la phebs mi thub/
rdog tho'i zhe sa/ khyod rang la nor yod na khyer shog de min nga'i dbang gral du ma sdod gsung gin bzhengs nas bka' bkyon mang po gsungs shing, zhabs thos brdungs nas bton/
1) lus kyi mdun nam rkang pa'i 'khris/ 2) bla chen gyi drung du 'khod myong ba'i ser mo ba/ 3) bla chen gyi zhabs 'brang ser mo ba'i skye srid/
zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa
phag gru sde srid khri rabs tha ma 'di'i skabs phag gru'i srid dbang nyams pa'i 'go tshugs/
rkang pa'i gdu bu'i zhe sa/
gzhan gyi don du byed pa'i bkur ste/ zhabs 'degs las rigs/ mtshan mor zhabs 'degs zhu ba/
rang gzhan gyi rkang pa nas mar 'then pa lta bu'i ming grags gnod skyon/ zhabs 'dren zhu ba/
rang gi snyan grags rang nyid kyis med pa bzo mkhan nam grags pa ngan pa bzo mkhan/ mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren pa/ spyod pa ngan pa'i bu rgyud ni pha ma'i zhabs 'dren pa red/
rkang pa'am snod kyi mthil la i khung rdol ba/ thag ring du phyin pas zhabs rdol ba/ snag bum zhabs rdol ba/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs rim pa dma' shos kyi gras su sdod mkhan/
1) zhabs kyi padma ste rkang pa pad ma'i gzugs su bkod pa/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon gyi che ming/
bla ma'i zhabs rang gi mgo thog tu blangs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs pa rnams kyis rang gi bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor blangs te bla mas bka' ci bstsal ltar khas len/
rkang pa dang lag pa'i zhe sa/
lham/ zhabs phyags phud nas gzims pa/
1) phan rogs byed pa'i las ka/ zhabs phyi zhu ba/ 2) g.yog po/ 'go gtso'i zhabs phyir 'brang ba/
phyi'i las don byed mkhan g.yog po/
blos 'khel ba'am nang gi las don byed mkhan g.yog po gtso bo/
rkang bro ste rkang pa'i stangs stabs/ zhabs bro rgyag pa/
pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pas zhabs long bu mi mngon pa/
gang gi phyi rjes su 'gro ba/
gsham ma'am 'og ma/ rim pa zhabs ma/ khang pa steng ma dang zhabs ma/
phru gu'i rkang pa sa la thog mar 'dzugs pa'i ston mo/
sngar gyi gzhung zhabs zur pa/
snod chas kyi mthil skyor/ dkar yol gyi zhabs ra/ rdza bum gyi zhabs ra/ mi 'di la zhabs ra mi 'dug / 'ju ba la lung med, 'jog pa la zhabs ra med/
1) rkang par mgo bos gtugs pa/ 2) bsten pa/ dge rgan gyi zhabs la gtugs pa/
rkang par phyag 'tshal ba'am gus pas bkur ba/
mngon pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste shin tu sbas pa'i chos kyi blo gros can nyid kyis long bu mi mngon pa/
dpe cha'i gsham shog / dpe cha 'di'i zhabs shog tshang mi 'dug /
1) rkang pa bkrus pa'am 'khrud pa,/ 2) rkang pa 'khrud chu/
rtse pho brang nang gi khang gnyer zhig
1) gzar sa nas dal bur mar 'bab pa'i chu/ 2) lus tsha bas rngul ba las byung ba'i chu/
1) sa khod mi snyoms pa'i 'bar 'bur/ 2) snod sod rdib zhom gyi tshul/
rngul nag gi chu sogs khrum khrum du 'bab tshul zhig / lus po yongs rdzogs nas rngul nag zham zham du thon pa/
zham me zhom me'i bsdus tshig
1) mig long ba'i lta tshul/ 2) mig gi rgyal mo 'khyog por lta ba/ mig zhar lta byas nas skad cha cang mi shod pa/
zur dang, gtso che ba dang chabs cig / las ka'i zhar dang zhor la slob sbyong byed pa/ phar phyin pa'i zhar dang zhor du brda lan gtong ba/
(yul) rgyug shar te mgyogs myur gyi 'gro stabs/ zhar 'phen glod pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) mig long ba dang, mig ya gcig shor ba'am skyon zhugs pa/ mig g.yon pa zhar ba/ 2. 1) mig gnyis ka'am ya gcig la skyon shor ba'i mi/ mi zhar ba/ khyi zhar ba/ 2) rtsa 'phar stangs te g.yas g.yon nam yan na stod smad gang rung nas mnan na mi gsal ba dang, rab rib tsam las mi gsal ba/

1) zhor dang zur du byung ba/ dpung gi tshogs chen po nye bar bteg nas shul lam du zhugs pa'i zhar byung tsam du rtsa brang bkra shis sgang ngar shugs kyis dbang du bsgyur/ tshad ma'i gzhung don 'chad pa'i zhar byung du dbu ma'i spyi don tsam yang bshad songs/ 2) dpe deb sogs kyi zur ram 'phros la bkod pa/

ched du ma yin pa'am dmigs bkar min par zhar du byung ba/ sger don zhar zhor du byed pa/ zhar zhor du lta tsam byas pa/ khyed kyis brtsams pa'i dpe cha der ngas zhar zhor la cha tshang zhig lta rtsis yin/
zhor du byung ba/ skad cha de tsho ni ched du bshad pa zhig min par zhar la byung ba zhig red/
/ 1) kha'i zhe sa/ zhal nas gsungs pa/ zhal gyis bzhes pa/ 2) gdong gi zhe sa/
/ 3) ming 'ga' zhig gi sngon du 'jug pa'i zhe tshig / zhal dkar/ zhal slob/
kha rtsed/ zhal kyal gnang ba min/
dkar yol/ zhal dkar rnying ma/
blo sems mthun pa'i mi rnams phyogs gcig tu gnas pa/
zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsdus tshig
kha nas bkod pa btang ba/ zhal bkod zhib gsal/
kha skom pa/ zhal skom pa la tshad med pa me 'bar ba lta bu byung ngo/
1) tshab kyi zhe sa/ 2) lha'i 'dra sku/
ja chang sogs btung ba'i rigs/ zhal skyems mnyes dag / zhal skyems bzhes pa/
1) kha khebs sam kha leb/ phyag sgam gyi zhal khebs/ 2) thang ga sogs la g.yog bya'i dar ras/
bzhin ras sam gdong/ zhal khyim mdzes pa lha yi bu mo 'dra/
dpe cha'i don ngag nas bshad pa'i zhe sa/
zhal ba mkhan dang don gcig
gdong pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal byung/ dngos su zhal dkyil ma mjal skyo/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, zhal ha cang mi ring ba dang, mchu shing thog bim pa ltar dmar ba/
khas blangs pa/ re zhig 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/
kha so sor bral ba/ zhal gyes gsol ston/
kha grangs kyi zhe sa/ mi'i zhal grangs ma tshang ba/ dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs ci tsam 'dug /
kha 'phred 'phred byed pa/ zhal bgrad nas bzhad mo bzhad pa/
gdong gi rnam pa 'gyur ba/ dgongs pa 'khrugs nas zhal 'gyur ba/
ngag rgyun/ 'di ni sngar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal rgyun dri ma med pa yin/
rtsed mo'i gtam/ zhal brgya byin chags po zhig gnang ba/
1) kha ngo/ 2) dge 'dun spyi'i dge skos/ tshogs chen zhal ngo/ 3) dmag mi'i zhal ngo ste dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'go pa/
gdong dngos sam sku ngo ma/ zhal dngos mjal ba/
spyan snga ste, sku dngos kyi drung/ zhal snga nas phebs pa/ zhal snga nas gsungs pa/
kha gcod dam kha leb/ dngul gyi zhal gcod/
bkod jus/ 'o na mkhar gyi zhal bcos mdzad par zhu/
khrims/ zhal lce gcod pa/ zhal lce gcod mkhan/

sngar t'a la'i bla ma lnga pa nas bod la dbang sgyur byed skabs zhal lce bcu gsum nang gi sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce dor nas zhal lce bcu gnyis su gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs don tshan bcu gnyis/

sngar gtsang sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang pos bod la dbang sgyur byed skabs spel ser ba sgrig tu bcug pa'i khrims yig nang gsal khrims kyi don tshan bcu drug ste, dang po dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce, gnyis pa sdar ma wa'i zhal lce, gsum pa sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce, bzhi pa zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal lce, lnga pa bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce, drug pa nag chen khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce, bdun pa dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce, brgyad pa hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce, dgu pa bsad pa stong gi zhal lce, bcu pa rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce, bcu gcig pa bsnyon ham mna' dag gi zhal lce, bcu gnyis pa brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce, bcu gsum pa nye 'brel 'bral 'dum gyi zhal lce, bcu bzhi pa byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce, bco lnga pa nam phar tshur gyi zhal lce, bcu drug pa kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce rnams so/

gtsang sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang pos bod la dbang sgyur byed skabs, zhal lce bco lnga nas dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce dang, sdar ma wa'i zhal lce gnyis dor nas zhal lce bcu gsum du gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs don tshan bcu gsum/

sde srid phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod la dbang sgyur byed skabs, zhal lce bcu drug nas kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce dor nas zhal lce bco lngar gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs don tshan bco lnga/
gzu dpang byed mkhan nam khrims gcod mkhan/
kha dan nam kha chad/ phebs rgyu'i zhal chad mdzad pa/ zhal chad gsal por mdzad pa/
mi shi khar mngags pa'i skad cha/ 'da' khar zhal chems bzhag pa/
gdong thug pa/ zhal mjal gnang ba/ zhal mjal zhu ba/
skad cha 'jam po/ thugs drang zhal 'jam gyi sgo nas bka' slob gnang ba/
slob ston/ dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la zhal ta gnang ba/
1) g.yog po/ 2) dbyar gnas skabs dge 'dun pa spyi la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan/
g.yog mo/ btsun mo'i zhal ta ma/
zhim zas sna 'dzoms kyi kha zas/
thang ga ste lha sku ri mor bris pa zhig /
kha gcig mthun/ bod kyi lo tsa zhal mthun du bsgyur pa'i gzhung ni khungs dag yin pas cis kyang gang byung du bcos mi chog /
bkra shis pa'am kha dro ba/
1) kha gdangs pa/ 2) gzhan gyi nor rdzas la ham sems byed pa/
gdams ngag gam slob ston/ zhal gdams bslab bya/ khyed kyis gsungs pa'i zhal gdams rnams sems la bcangs yod/
dgon sde khag gi mdzod sogos la bdag sprod dam 'dzin byed mkhan/
gzhan gyis gtong ba'i 'gro song lte ba'i thog la brgyab pa'i kha snon/ lam bzo ba'i 'gro song la zhal 'debs rgyag pa/
kha 'don/ zhal brda, kha brda/ dge rgan nas dpe cha khrid tshar rjes rang gar zhal brda mdzad de bzhugs pa/
sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, mdo sdud pa lta bu ston pa dngos kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'o/
khang pa'i nang zhal ba gtong mkhan gyi las dpon/

1) gzhan du yod ces pa ste de ni si tu'i 'grel chen la ltos zer ba lta bu/ 2) khag dkri ba'am gzhan la khag btang ba/ zhal 'phangs mdzad snying 'dod pa/ rang byas las ka'i 'gan 'khri de, gzhan la kha 'phangs ga la 'os/
skyang nul te khang pa'i skya dang mthil gyi ngos 'jam po/ zhal ba gog pa/ mthil zhal/ rtsub zhal/ ar zhal/

rtsig pa dang gyang sogs la zhal ba gtong mkhan/ gyang ldebs su zhal ba mkhan mkhas pas zhal ba gtong ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la rdo thal nyal dang, bra rngas 'tsho, zhal ba mkhan po, zhal zhal mkhan bcas so,
dpe cha klog 'chad sogs khar goms pa'am bde ba/ dpe cha klog pa la zhal byang ba/
skad cha bshad pa'am kha grag pa/ khong la zhal 'bug rgyu med pa/
1) ku re'am rtsed mo rtse ba'i skad cha/ 2) kha shob tsha po/
kha mi gsal ba/ rtsom 'di zhal mi gsal ba zhig red/
kha dang ngo gdong 'dzum mer mer/ grogs po su dang thug kyang zhal 'tsher 'tsher gnang gi 'dug /
pa'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, mkhan slob pha ma sogs gong ma thams cad la bsnyen bkur zhing rim gro bsgrubs pas zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa'o/
gad mo cung zad dgod pa/ mnyes nas zhal 'dzum pa/
1) rdzun dang ham bshad/ 2) ku re byed pa'am rtsed mo rtse ba'i don/
zhal ba mkhan dang don gcig
zhal le zhol le'i bsdus tshig
mi ma shi bar gson por bsdad pa'i zhe sa/ khong zhal bzhugs skabs/
khas len pa'i zhe sa/ zhal bzhes gtsang ma gnang ba/
yi dam lha sogs kyi zhal gzigs byung ba ste, zhal dngos su bstan pa/
rtsed mo'am ku re/ khong gis gsungs pa de zhal yab tsam las ngo ma ma red/

ngo gdong/ zhal ras mjal ba/ zhal ras mtshar ba/ zhal ras nag thing nge ba/ zhal ras dmar mdangs bkra ba/ shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas, dkar gsal zla ba shar byung, ma skyes a ma'i zhal ras, yid la 'khor 'khor byas byung/
rub brgyab nas kha rdung btang ba/
1) kha btsums nas skad cha gang yang mi shod pa/ 2) gdong nag rog ge ba/
kha lag gam gsol tshigs/ zhal lag gtong ba/ zhal lag phul ba/
skol snod dam phor pa/ thug pa zhal lu gang bskol nas lha gcig kong jo la 'dren pa/
zhal nas gsungs pa'i man ngag gam gsung rgyun/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung/
'bri g.yag gi spu rtsid sogs thur du 'phyang ba'am nyal nyil du yod pa'i rnam pa/ dug log zhal le zhol le gyon pa/
bla ma sogs kyi zhal gsung la brten nas shes dgos pa'i man ngag snying por dril ba'i gzhung/ sman gyi gces bsdus phan bde'i snying po'i zhal shes/
ku re'i rdzun nam rtsed mo'i gtam/ khong gis zhal shob gnang ba red/
yi ge'i ngo bshus/ rdo rje gcod pa'i dpe cha zhig zhal bshus byas pa yin/
dngos slob/ mi la ras pa ni mar pa lo tsa'i zhal slob gtso bo'i gras red/
skad cha ma sbas par lab pa dang bsam blo drang po yin pa/
skad cha ma sbas par bshad pa/
kha gsal po 'khod yod pa/ de ring chu tshod gsum par tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu zhal gsal 'khod pa'i brda tho 'byor byung/
lha'i bzhin ras la gtong rgyu'i grang gser/ lha sa'i jo bo la zhal gser bsgron pa/
nyams pa gso ba dang nyung ba la snon pa brgyab ste gso ba/ spyi rdzas la zhal gso mang tsam phul ba/
1) gdong 'khrud byed kyi chu/ 2) kha bshal byed kyi chu/
1) spyan dbye ste rab gnas/ 2) rmang gzhi btsugs pa'am gzhi btsugs pa/
ring ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, bslab pa rab tu mang po kun ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis zhal ha cang mi ring bar che chung 'tshams pa/
/ ming gi rnam grangs la drag po'i phyogs dang, nag phyogs, phyod phyi ma, dbang phyogs, mar ngo, dmar cha bcas so,
zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin dang, drag gsum dal ba gnyis kyi bsdus tshig de dag gi thad la ltos/
rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'jam dpal sbrags nas sgrub pa lta bu'o/
zhi ba rdor dbyings dang khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha rnams so/
zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po'i las rnam bzhi'o/
'jam po'i byed thabs/ phol mig bsregs dang bcad pas gdon, zhi chos de yi dug tu 'gyur/
zhi bde lhing 'jags/ 'jags su btang ba/ phan tshun zhi 'jags su gnas pa/
zhi gza' gnyis te, gza' lhag pa dang pa sangs gnyis/
de la dal dag gis sbyangs na myur rkang re'u mig 'dzin byed yin pas na de ltar grags/
zhi gza' gnyis kyi dal bar te nyi bar dang don gcig /
rgyud bzang zhing spyod lam 'jam po/
zhi ba dang drag po/ zhi drag gnyis ldan/ zhi drag gi bya gzhag /
zhi ba dang drag po'i las don gnyis 'pher/
zhi ba dang drag po'i 'go byed mi sna/

spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs mi 'dra ba'i rgyal khab bar zhi ba'i thabs shes la brten nas phan tshun bar gyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod dang, 'dra mnyam gnyis phan gyi gzhi rtsa'i thog phan tshun bar gyi dpal 'byor dang, rig gnas kyi 'brel ba 'phel rgyas gtong ba la zer/
«sha ma tha» ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyi chings sam rgyu zhig ste, phyi rol gyi yul la sems g.yeng ba zhi bar byas nas bsam gtan gang sgom pa de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'o/
thos pa'i stobs dang, bsam pa'i stobs, dran pa'i stobs, shes bzhin gyi stobs, brtson 'grus kyi stobs, 'dris pa'i stobs rnams so/
zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa bzhi
khyab pa'i dmigs pa dang, spyad pa rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa, mkhas pa'i dmigs pa, nyon mongs rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa rnams so/
mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa dang, 'dod pa chung ba, chog shes pa, bya ba mang po yongs su spangs pa, tshul khrims rnam par dag pa, 'dod pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa yongs su spangs pa ste drug go/
zhi gnas kyi yid byed bzhi
bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed dang, chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed, chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed, rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed bcas bzhi'o/

gso sbyong gi nang gses, sngon bsags kyi las sgrib sbyong phyir gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la brten, lam nang rig pa'i sde snod la thos bsam tshul bzhin du byas nas de'i don bsgom pas nyams su len pa ste, sems gnas pa'i thabs dgus zhi gnas bsgrub cing, dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi sogs kyis lhag mthong gi shes rab bskyed la lam lnga byang phyogs so bdun gyis bgrod nas 'bras bu bzhi 'thob par byed pa'o/
nyes pa lnga: le lo dang, brjed ngas, bying rgod, 'du mi byed pa, 'du byed pa bcas lnga'o/
shin sbyangs kyi bde bas zin pa'i sems gnas dgu pa zhi gnas cha 'dra ba'o/
bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyis bsdus pa'i zhi gnas dngos so/
zhi ba'i las don byed mkhan rnams kyi 'go khrid/

1.(tha mi dad pa) yal ba/ rlung 'tshub zhi ba/ tsha ba zhi ba/ grang ba zhi ba/ khong khro zhi ba/ 2. 1) (mngon) sa mo bya lo/ 2) 'gog bden gyi rnam pa'i gras shig ste, ma zhi bar byed pa 'du byed sdug bsngal nyer len gyi phung po rnams dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid can te, bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig go / 3) las bzhi'i ya gyal, nad gdon sod 'jigs pa nye bar zhi ba/ 4) thar pa dang myang 'das/ 3. drag po'i zlog zla/ sems rgyud zhi ba/ rang bzhin zhi ba/ zhi ba dang drag po'i las kun la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad bral ba/ , (mngon) 1) lha mo u ma/ 2) rje btsun sgrol ma/
«shintamgarbha» chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus su bod du gdan drangs pa'i rgya gar gyi pandi ta zhig 'dis bsam yas kyi rab gnas mkhan byas par bu ston bzhed/

«shantarkshita» sngar bhangga la'i yul du za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs, dpal na lendrara slob dpon ye shes snying po las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs, rgya gar gyi dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i slob dpon zhig dang, dbu ma shar pa gsum gyi ya gyal zhig yin, dbu ma rgyan la sod pa'i bstan bcos brtsams, chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du phebs, bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i bkod pa mdzad, sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas dge 'dun gyi sde bod du thog mar btsugs, 'dul ba dang dbu ma spel, mtshan mkhan bo dhi satwa zhes grags, mkhan chen 'di dang, slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas, chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gsum la mkhan slob chos gsum du grags, snga phyir bod du lo bcu lhag tsam bzhugs te gshegs/

spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'am brgyad pa tsam la rgya gar gyi rgyal po dge ba'i go cha'i sras su 'khrungs shing, chung ming zhi ba'i go cha zer, na lendrar rab tu byung nas spyod 'jug dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab btus sogs brtsams/
1) (mngon) ri khrod dgon gnas dben sa/ 2) thar pa'i go 'phang/
1) dal ba'i 'gro stangs/ 2) (mngon) chu bya ngang pa/
lha'i phyag mtshan gyi bye brag cig /
(mngon) zla ba'i yar ngo'am dkar phyogs/
nad gdon sogs 'jugs pa brgyad zhi ba'i sreg chog /
nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byed pa'i las/
sems gnas dgu'i drug pa, rnam g.yeng la skyon du bltas nas ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba zhi bar byed pa'o/
1) thar pa thob pa/ 2) sku mya ngan las 'das pa/

1) spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i 'gor pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis srol gtod pa'i sher phyin nyams len gyis srid zhi'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i cha nas ming btags pa'i grub mtha' zhig / 2) (mngon) 1,skyu ru ra'i shing/ 2,gshin rje/ 3,a ru ra'i shing/
na tsha med par bzo ba'i sman te, nang gses thang dang, phye ma, ril bu, khanda, sman mar rnams yod/

phyi ma rgyud kyi mdo bzhi'i nang tshan sman khong du btang nas nang gi nad zhi bar byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i mdo ste, thang dang, phye ma, ril bu, lde gu, sman mar, thal sman, khanda, sman chang, rin po che'i sbyor ba, sngo sbyor bcas so/
sman khong du btang nas nad rang bzhin du zhi bar byed pa la zhi byed ces dang, lus kyi gyen thur gyi gnas nas sbyong bar byed pa la sbyong byed ces te gnyis so/
gza' lnga'i nang gi lhag pa dang pa sangs gnyis/
zla ba dang, lhag pa, pa sangs, mjug ring ste bzhi ni nyi ma'i g.yon nas 'char nub byed cing, g.yon gyi yan lag tu 'gyur bas na zhi gza' zhes bya'o/
zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis kyi bsdus tshig /
sems rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas dang, so sor rtog pa'i lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'o/

1.nga na ma 'a ra la dang mtha' med bcas kyi rjes su sbyor rgyu'i phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / nga na ma 'a ra la...mi zhig / gang zhig / sman thun zhig / bya ba zhig / yul zhig / 2.skul tshig ston byed kyi tshig grogs shig / 'dir ma yong zhig /
zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sngar yod zhig nas med pa'i dngos med kyi rgyu des 'bras bu'i dngos po gzhan zhig bskyed pa ston pa'i rgyu'i rgyan/
1.tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'jig pa'i 'das pa, 2.(mngon) 'chi ba/
1.chag dum/ rkub stegs zhig po/ dpe sgrom zhig po/ ko sgam zhig po/ 2. 1) bden 'dzin dang gces 'dzin thul ba'i gang zag / 2) sdom pa lhod pa'i ngan spyod can/
chag grum gog hrul/ khang rnying zhig ral/ spyod lam mi btsun pa'i zhig ral/
nyams gso/ gzhung lam zhig gso/ 'jag spyil zhig gso/ 'phrul 'khor zhig gso/

1.yul lung dang rgyal khams/ zhing chung/ zhing chen/ dag pa'i zhing/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing/ 'dul zhing/ bsod nams kyi zhing/ snying rje'i zhing/ tshogs zhing / zhing la phebs pa/ zhing la gshegs pa/ 2.nga na ma 'a ra la mtha' med rnams kyi mthar sbyor rgyu mtshams sbyor tshig phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / nga na ma 'a ra la...zhing...'on zhing blun/ bde zhing skyid/ nor zhing 'khrul/ ja dkar ja dwangs kyis bkang zhing sar bzhag pa/
yul nyer bzhir skyes pa'i pho nya mo'am so skye'i rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ma/
yul khams sam gnas ri skyong mkhan gyi srung ma/

lo tog 'debs sa'i sa zhing/ ri zhing/ thang zhing/ nas zhing/ tshal zhing/ 'ong zhing/ chu zhing/ sa zhing/ zhing khang nor gsum/ zhing rmo ba/ zhing la lud bkram pa/ zhing ga 'debs pa/ zhing ga bogs mar gtong ba/ blo gtad gangs rir bcol nas, zhing chung than pas 'tshigs song/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'bru skye sa dang, 'bru yi skye gnas, 'bru yi zhing, 'bru sa, mu tshigs can, rmo sa, zhing sa, sa zhing bcas so,
chu gtong rgyu yod pa'i zhing kha/
'bru rigs ma btab par bzhag pa'i zhing kha/ mi tshang de nyams gud du gyur te zhing kha rnams tha gog tu lus pa/
sa zhing rmo slog brgyab ste zhing chu btang rjes sa bon 'debs ran pa/
1) yul spyi'i ming/ 2) sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gnas yul dag zhing bde ba can lta bu'o/
bde ba can sogs zhing gi chags tshul dang dbyibs bkod/
1) zhing gi rgya khyon/ 2) zhing khams kyi rgya khyon/
1) ston thog gi phud nas sprod pa zhing khral/ 2) (rnying) sa zhing gi 'bru skal/
zhing kha'i son 'gror dpags nas sa zhing rgya che chung rtsi srol te mnga' bdag khri ral gyi skabs nas gsar gtod byas pa'i lo rgyus 'dug /
zhing bdag la sprod pa'i zhing bogs/
sad ser btsa' than sogs lo tog la gnod byed/
zhing sa gyong po'am ma dul ba/ phan med kyi zhing rgod rnams zhing sa gshin por sgyur ba/
sa rgyu sdug pa'am ston thog skye dka' ba'i zhing/
zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra

rgyud las gsungs pa'i bsgral byar gyur pa'i bstan pa'i dgra bo la rkyen bcu tshang dgos pa, bstan pa bshig pa dang, dkon mchog la smad pa, dge 'dun gyi dkor 'phrog pa, theg chen la smod pa, bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba, rdo rje spun grogs sun 'byin pa, sgrub la bar gcod byed pa, brtse ba snying rje gtan nas med pa, dam tshig sdom pa dang bral ba, las 'bras la log lta ste bcu'o/
zhing khar gtong rgyu'i chu/ zhing chu 'dren pa/ yur bu bzos nas zhing chu 'grems gtong byed pa/
zhing la chu 'dren sa yod pa/ zhing chu ma'i nang nas sa lu skye/
zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra'i mi lpags yan lag lnga tshang ba/
zhing kha lta mkhan 'go byed pa/
lo tog yag po mi skye ba'i zhing sa/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, zhing dag pa bla na med pa'i sbyor ba ste rang gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi snod kyi zhing dang bcud kyi sems can khyad par can 'grub pa'i smon lam la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i dag pa'i rnal 'byor de'o/
so nam pa'i grong khyim/ sa cha 'dir zhing dud ci tsam 'dug /
sa zhing bdag tu bzung zhing, rang nyid kyis ngal rtsol mi byed par sa zhing bogs mar btang nas zhing par bshu gzhog byed pa de 'tsho ba'i yong khungs gtso bor byed mkhan la zer/

sa zhing bzung zhing, rang nyid kyis ngal rtsol mi byed par zhing par bshu gzhog byed par brten te 'tsho ba skyel mkhan gral rim de la zer, zhing bdag gral rim gyis zhing par bshu gzhog byed stangs gtso bo ni sa bogs bsdu ba de red/
zhing khar sa bon 'debs/ zhing 'debs snga ma/ zhing 'debs phyi ma/ zhing 'debs bar ma/
so nam pa'i sde tsho'am grong tsho/
so nam byed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la zhing las pa dang, shas pa, so nam pa bcas so,
zhing chen pags pa'i bsdus tshig
(rnying) zhing kha rmo slog rgyag pa/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nang bran bdag gam bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin bdag po'i mnga' 'og tu yod pa'i zhing las thon skyed byed mkhan dpal 'byor thog bshu gzhog myong zhing, rang dbang dang chab srid kyi dbang cha gang yang med pa zhig
ston thog la gnod skyon byed pa'i 'bu rigs/
zhing kha'i ngo grangs/ mi tshang 'di la zhing mig che chung bsdoms bdun 'dug /
zhing ga'i gnod 'bu gsod byed sman rigs/
zhing kha'i mtshams sam mu tshigs/
lo tog yag po skye ba'i zhing sa/ zhing bzang la son bzang 'debs pa/
bed med du stong par lus pa'i sa zhing/ bdag med zhing yan gyi nang du rtswa ngan gyis khengs pa/
zhing kha'i nang gi chu 'khrid lam gyi rka/
'phrul 'khor bed spyod kyis zhing las thon skyed rgya chen byed pa'i khe las sde tshan la zer/
zhing kha tha rgod dam tha gog /
zhing la snga chu gtong ba
zhing la chu snga ma gtong ba'i dus la slebs pa/
so nam gyi las ka/ zhing las thon skyed/ zhing las thon dngos/

rin spungs pa'i sde pa zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rjes rab byung dgu pa'i shing glang lor 'bangs gyen log gi skabs dang bstun nas mnga' thang bzung, de'i tsha bo phun tshogs rdo rjes rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta lor lha sar 'dzul ba'i sog dmag gtor te, gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che sogs rten gnas zhig gso byas, dbus gtsang mtha' dag rim gyis chab 'og tu bcug gtsang stod rgyal por grags, de'i bu karma bstan skyong dbang po ste rgya'i deb ther du gtsang pa han zhes grags pa dang jo nang pa t'a ra na tha mchod yon du 'brel, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags rta lor gtsang la 'dzul ba'i la dwags kyi dmag gtor, chu rta lor gu shr'i bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bkrongs,.. .1565...1618...1630...1630...
sa rgyu bzang po yod pa'i zhing kha/
dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa ste 'das po/
so nam gyi bya ba'i yul gyi sa gzhi/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig ste, las 'gan ni las khungs khag gis lo re'i byung song rtsis khra phul ba rnams 'grig dang ma 'grig zhib gcod byed rgyu de yin/
tshig don zhib tshags su bkrol pa'i 'grel bshad/
zhib la cha lag tshang ba/ phyag bris zhib rgyas/ 'grel pa zhib rgyas/ gnas lugs rgyu rkyen zhib rgyas su zhu ba/
1) yin min gyi mtha' zhib tu gcod pa/ yang dag yin min zhib gcod byas pa/ 2) brtag dpyad zhib mor byas nas thag gcod pa/ gnas lugs zhib gcod/
zhib tu phye ba'i cha'am phra zhing zhib pa/ don tshan zhib cha rnams gzhan du gsal ba/ zhib cha'i gnas tshul/ bsam blo zhib cha gtong ba/ zhib cha'i lam srol/
rtog dpyod dam brtag dpyad/ zhib 'jug nan tan byed pa/ lam yig zhib 'jug /

zhib rtsad gcod pa/ gnad don byung rkyen gang yin pa zhib 'jug rtsad gcod byed pa/ gter kha'i gzhi rgya che chung la zhib 'jug rtsad gcod byed pa/ gter kha'i gzhi rgya che chung la zhib 'jug rtsad gcod legs par byed pa/
zhib 'jug byas te rtsis len pa/ thon rdzas zhib 'jug rtsis len byed pa/
zhib 'jug byas nas thig tshad len pa/ lam gzhi 'khel phyogs la zhib 'jug tshad len byed pa/
'phrul 'khor ram khang pa sogs lta zhib byas nas skyon cha bcos pa/
ram khang pa sogs lta zhib byas nas skyon cha bcos pa/
phra zhing zhib pa/ las stangs zhib tig /
gzab nan gyis lta ba/ 'go mjug bar gsum du zhib lta byas pa/
thug par rgyag rgyu'i phye'am rtsam pa/
phye mar zhib tu 'thag pa/ sman phye zhib 'thag
zhib cing cha tshang ba/ dri ba zhib 'thems/ zin bris zhib 'thems su 'god pa/
zhib pa dang drang po/ gnas tshul rnams rgyu mtshan zhib 'drong byung mtshams thag gcod byas chog /
phye mar rdzog pa/ rdo gtun gyi nang du sman rnams zhib rdung byas pa/
gros bsdur zhib mor byed pa/
rags pa'i ldog zla/ phye ma zhib pa/ rtsam pa zhib pa/ rtsing zhib ran pa/ zhib zhib tu dbur ba/ zhib mor gtub pa/ bsam blo zhib pa/ zhib tu dpyad pa/
1) don rtsa rtsad gcod dang brtag dpyad byed pa/ 2) rtog dpyod/
las don bzang ngan dbye 'byed mkhan/
rtsam pa blug snod par bu/
zhib cing phra ba/ bkod pa zhib phra/ lta rtog zhib phra/
smyug ma sogs las bslas pa'i 'bru rigs bkrab byed dam 'phyar byed kyi snod chas shig /
'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rigs tshogs drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, bden dngos sgrub pa'i rigs pa 'gog byed kyi bstan bcos shig /
zhib rtsad 'tshol myul/ dgra bo'i gnas tshul la zhib myul byas pa/
zhib mo dang rtsing po/ rtsam pa zhib rtsing gnyis las zhib pa zhim/
zhib phra'i rtsis/ zhib rtsis rgyag pa/
dogs gnad yod rigs la phan tshun 'dri zhib zab gsal byed pa/
rags tsam min pa gtan gtan du byed pa/ brda don zhib tshags su bkrol ba/ las don zhib tshags/ brtag dpyad zhib tshags/
re re bzhin blta ba/ 'char gzhi zhib gzigs mdzad/ phyi'i snang tshul la zhib gzigs gnang ba/
re re bzhin zhib tu brtsi ba/ spus tshad longs min zhib bsher gtong ba/ 'grul pa zhib bsher/
zhib tu rtsis bsher gyis thag gcod/ gyod gzhir zhib bsher 'khrun gcod byed pa/
dngos po zhib tu bsher nas rtsis len pa/ 'dzugs skrun zin mtshams zhib bsher rtsis len byed pa/
zhib cha che zhing brtan pa/ bya spyod zhib lhing/ blang dor zhib lhing/ las don rnams zhib lhing gi sgo nas sgrub pa/
phra zhib sbas gsang med pa/ 'phros mol zhib lhug byed pa/ 'grel bshad zhib lhug / gros bsdur zhib lhug /
sngo sman zhim thig le'i rigs me tog dkar po 'char ba zhig /
sngo sman zhim thig le me tog nag po 'char ba zhig /
zhim thig dmar po dman pa
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su dbye na rigs drug tsam mchis, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas mig la ling thog skyes pa dang dmar tshag sogs la phan/
ro legs shing dri bzang ba/ bro ba zhim po/ dri ma zhim po/ zas zhim po/ chang zhim po/ gtam snyan na nyan mi mang, zas zhim na za mi mang/ zhim po'i chang de mang na dug
zhim mngar gyi zas ci rigs pa de rnams/
zhwa mo/ thang zhu/ wa zhu/ pad zhu/
kha mchu'i skor yar phul zhu ba dang, mar gnang khra ma'i bsdus ming/

1) don gnad gang rung yar zhu mkhan nam lab mkhan/ zhu mkhan gyis zhu ma shes kyang, gsan mkhan gyis gsan shes pa dgos/ 2) shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas glo tshad dang, mkhal tshad, 'grams tshad bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la dmar po len pa'o, zhu gleng, ngag thog nas zhu tshig 'bul ba/
re don mgron gnyer brgyud nas zhu ba/
don dag zhu ba la ngo chen gyi grogs byed pa/
zhu ba 'then rgyu dang chag gtong rgyu/ do bdag gnyis ka kha 'chams nas zhing khang nor gsum sho'i rgyal du gtsugs, zhu chag med par 'ba' yi ges bsdams/
zhu dag gtong mkhan gtso bo/ zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/

kha zas zhu ba'i rjes su nad ldang ba'i rlung gi nad kyi rtags shig /
/ khrims khang la zhu gtug byed pa:/ zhu gtug byed mkhan/
yi ge'i tshig don ma dag pa rnams dag par byed pa'i las don/ yi ger nor 'khrul yod med zhu dag gnang ba/ rtsom yig ma phyi la zhu dag zhib tshags btang ba/
brjod bya'i don snying/ re ba zhu don/ dri ba zhu don/ snyan seng zhu don/ zhu don gsol ba/ zhu don ltar bka' 'khrol/
yi ge dang nyam du bskur ba'i rten/ zhu 'degs lha reg bcas zla tshe bzang por phul/
zhu yig dngos gzhi min pa'i zhur shog /
1) don dag zhu ba'i mgo 'dren pa'am sne 'khrid mkhan/ 2) zhu yig sogs la ming thog mar 'god mkhan nam, don gnad zhu mkhan gyi gtso bo/
rang 'dod zhu bar spobs pa che ba'am ham shugs che ba/

1.(tha dad pa) zhus pa, zhu ba, zhus,, 1) re 'dun rjod pa/ zhu bde ma byung ba/ re ba zhu ba/ gnas tshul zhu ba/ 'tshams 'dri zhu ba/ 2) blug pa dang, len pa, byed pa sogs kyi zhe sa/ gsol ja zhus/ mchod chang zhus pa/ zhabs 'degs zhu ba/ ngas rogs ram zhus chog / bstod bsngags zhu ba po/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) 1) mar sogs gong bu rang bzhin du khu ba'i rnam par gyur pa/ tshwa rnams chu'i nang du zhu rgyu las snum gyi nang du zhu dogs med/ nyi ma shar ba dang ba mo zhu ba/ mar zhu ba/ 'od du zhu ba/ 2) tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'ju ba'i 'das pa, 3.snyan zhu/ zhu ba 'bul ba/ zhu ba gsol ba/
gyod don bar 'dum pas kha mchu rgyag mkhan phyogs gnyis kyi sngar phul snyan zhu mar gnang rogs zhu ba/
1) zhu ba'i khu ba/ 2) lus kyi khams kar po'am thig le/
1) snyan seng 'bul ba/ 2) zhu ba 'then pa/
zhu yul gyi mtshan bos nas bde sdug zhu ba/ zhu 'bod mdzes mtshon 'bor ba/

zhu yig don gnad che ba,

1) yig lan dang, gtam lan/ 2) gyod yas gyod ya la smras pa'i lan/

yi ger bkod pa'i zhu ba/

1) ham pa che ba'i zhu ba/ 2) rdzun zhu/

1.tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i 'jug pa'i skul tshig 2.me'i zhe sa/ sku gdung zhugs la bzhus pa/ 3.me dang 'brel gnas yod pa'i dngos po'i ming gi sngon du sbyar nas zhe tshig sgrub pa'i tshig grogs shig / zhugs me/ zhugs nyi/ zhugs shing/ zhugs slang/
