gzhan dag kha shas/ mi gzhan 'ga' zhig / dus gzhan 'ga' zhig / yul gzhan 'ga' zhig /

sems byung nga gcig gi nang tshan, gnyid dang, 'gyod pa dang, rtog pa dang, dpyod pa bcas bzhi ste, de rnams kun slong dang, bsam pa'i khyad par gyis dge mi dge lung ma bstan ci rigs par 'gyur bas gzhan 'gyur bzhi zhes bya'o/
gzhan la 'gran sems skye ba nad langs pa'i gzugs su bkod pa/
mi gzhan gyi sems rgyud/ gzhan rgyud la yid ches bskyed pa/ gzhan rgyud la yod pa'i rna ba'i dbang po/
nad gzhan gyis rgyud bslad pa 'dres pa'i nad de dper na, bad mkhris dang, bad rlung, mkhris rlung lta bu'o/
mi pha rol po'i ngo la rtsis mthong byed pa/ gzhan ngor lta ba/

jo nang pas 'dod pa'i lta ba ste, yul gzung ba dang yul can 'dzin pa gnyis su med pa rtogs pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes de yongs grub yin la, de gzhan dbang dang kun btags sogs kun rdzob pa'i chos gzhan gyis stongs pas na gzhan stong zhes zer/
gzhan la bshu gzhog byas pa kho nar brten nas rang gi 'tsho ba skyel ba/
pha rol po'i nyis tshig gam mang tshig / gnas lugs gzhan dag dang thun mong ma yin pa/ mi gzhan dag gis do zlar mi spobs pa/
de ma yin na/ me tog la chu rgyag dgos kyi, gzhan du na skam 'gro/ gzhan du na ni nges pa med/
1) gzhan dag la phan pa'i don/ gzhan don la rtsol ba/ gzhan don ma pher ba/ sngon la gzhan don dang, rjes la rang don/ 2) gzhan gyi don dag / gzhan don lhur len/
rtags yang dag gang zhig snga rgol gyis phyir rgol gyi don du bkod pa, dper na, rgol bas phyir rgol la byas pas sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshe byas pa lta bu'o/

rang nyid kyis mthong ba'i don de rtags yang dag gi sgo nas gzhan la ston pa'i ngag ste sgrub ngag yang dag sgrub ngag des phyir rgol gyi rgyud la 'bras bu rjes dpag bskyed phyir, 'bras ming rgyu la btags nas gzhan don rjes dpag ces bya'o/
gzhan don rtogs pa'i shes rab
phyi'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i sman dpyad la mkhas pa dang, nang gi nad 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i gnyen po byams pa dang snying rje la sogs pa ston pa'i blo/
gzhan gyi stobs sam drin shugs/ gzhan dring la ltos pa/ gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ spobs pa gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ skad gnyis smra ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i byang chub pa/
rang gzhan gnyis ka bde zhing skyid pa/ gzhan bde rang skyid yong rgyu ni mi tshang ma'i 'dod blo red/
tshig don lhag ma yod tsam ston pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra zhig / shar gyi phyogs su rgya mtsho ste, de bzhin nub phyogs ri chen no/ de ni mi ste, 'di ni khyi/

rnam gcod kyi sgra'i nang gses, chos de gzhi gzhan la ldan pa rnam par bcad nas gzhi de kho na la ldan par ston pa'i sgra dper na, sgra kho na mnyan bya yin zhes pa lta bu, rnam gcod kyi sgra'am tshig phrad de khyad gzhi'i 'og de ma thag par sbyar nas rjod par byed pa'o/
gzhan la sdug bsngal byung na dga' tshor byed pa/
gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba

so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo ste, gzhan la gnod pa ni lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun dang, gzhi ni 'dir rgyu'i don te yid kyi mi dge ba gsum bcas pa spong ba'o, de'ang legs smon dang 'jigs skyob tsam min par 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pas rtsis zin pa ni sor sdom mtshan nyid pa'o/

1. logs su'am tha dad pa/ mi gzhan pa/ go skabs gzhan pa/ ming gzhan pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la cig shos dang, tha dad, dbye ba, gzhan, gzhan dag la la bcas so, 2. bdag min pa'i pha rol pa thams cad/ gzhan la 'khang ba/ gzhan la bsngo ba/ gzhan pas 'phya ba dang smod pa la mi 'dzem pa/ gzhan gyi bslab byar ma nyan na, de las 'on pa su zhig yod/
gzhan la phan pa/ gzhan phan lhag bsam dkar po'i bsam pa rtse gcig tu khyer nas blo mthun rnams la rogs ram byed pa/
sems can rnams thabs kyis bsdus te dge ba la 'god pa/
1) pha rol pa'i grub mtha'/ 2) rang phyogs kyi ldog zla/
gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang don gcig
'dod lha ris drug gi nang gses, gzhan gyis sprul pa'i longs spyod la ci dgar dbang byed pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ces bya/

1) rang dbang min pa dang, rang dbang med pa/ gzhan dbang du gyur pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la gzhan rgyud dang, gzhan ltos, gzhan la rag las pa, rang dbang min pa, rang dbang med pa, dbang med bcas so, 2) gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid kyi bsdus ming,
gzhan dbang gi ngo bo nyid
gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dang don gcig
'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba zhig sgrub par rtsom pa la, 'gog byed gzhan dbang la khag bzhag nas zur gyis 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
ma dag gzhan dbang dang, dag pa gzhan dbang ste gnyis so/

'byor pa bcu'i nang gses, cha rkyen gzhan la ltos nas tshang dgos pa lnga ste, sangs rgyas byon pa dang, des chos gsungs pa, bstan pa gnas pa, bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa, chos kyi mthun rkyen tshang ba bcas lnga/
mi gzhan la rtsod pa brgyab ste rang 'dod phyogs zhen byed pa/ gnad don dngos la ma bltas par rang 'dod kho nas gzhan rtsod 'then 'khyer byed pa/
gzhan gyi zhor la rang yang tshud pa/
1) de min pa gzhan dag kyang/ las don gzhan yang mang po sgrub dgos/ yon tan gzhan yang shes/ 2) da dung yang/
gzhan gyi zhor/ rang nyid kyis rtog dpyod mi byed par gzhan g.yam du 'brangs te skad cha gang rung bshad pa/
yul can rang las gzhan pa'i phyi rol gyi gzugs la sogs rnams la 'jug par byed pa'i shes pa, dbang shes lta bu'o/

sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur gang zhig bzlog pa rang dang rigs tha dad pa gzhan 'phen pa ste, dper na, du ldan gyi la la chos can, du ba med par thal, me med pa'i phyir, zhes rgyu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis, de chos can, me yod de, du ba yod pa'i phyir, zhes 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa'o/
gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bcu bzhi

bzlog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur la dbye na, rgyu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dgu dang, phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dang, khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang, rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur bcas bcu bzhi'o/
gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma

tshad ma gang zhig rang nyid tshad ma yin par gzhan stobs kyis nges pa 'dren pa, dper na, utpal ngo mi shes pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi utpal 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon dang, tshad ma'i brda la ma byang ba'i skyes bu'i rgyud kyi tshad ma lta bu'o/

gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma la nges pa 'dren tshul gyis dbye na don la utpal yin kyang rgyang ring po nas kha dog tsam las gang yin the tshom za dus kyi mig shes lta bu snang ba rang las nges shing bden pa gzhan las nges pa dang, don la shug pa yin pa la rgyang ring po nas yal 'dab can du nges kyang gang yin the tshom za dus kyi mig shes lta bu spyi rang las nges shing khyad par gzhan las nges pa dang, rgyang ring po nas 'od dmar tsam nges kyang mar me dang nor bu sogs gang gi 'od yin the tshom za dus kyi mig shes lta bu yod pa rang las nges shing bdag nyid kyi spyi dang khyad par gzhan las nges pa ste gsum mo/
rang gi 'dod lugs la ltos pa'i gzhan gyi lugs te grub mtha' gzhan/
mi pha rol po'i 'dod pa/ gzhan sems srung ba/
gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes
sems can gzhan gyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal shas che chung kun shes pa ste, mngon shes drug gi nang gses shig /
rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos rang gi dgag bya dngos su bsal ba'i sgo nas rtogs par bya ba, dper na bum pa'i don spyi lta bu ste, 'di dang sel ba dang, dgag pa dang don gcig go/
tshig le'u byas pa: rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge srung gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
ba'i rab tu byed pa: rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos mchog gis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /
(rnying) 1) thabs kyis brtags pa/ 2) bzhags pa dang 'dra,
(rnying) 1) skung ba'am yibs pa/ 2) mgu ba/ 3) gab pa/
(rnying) 1) 'phrin las/ 2) g.yung drung/ 3) phyi nang gnyis/
1. (tha dad pa) bzhar ba, gzhar ba, gzhor,, 1) skra sogs breg pa/ skra gzhar khang/ 2) 'bred pa/ rtsig ngos kyi dreg pa gzhar ba/ 2. (rnying) nye ba'am mthun pa/
tshad mas rtogs par bya ba ste, ka bum la sogs pa'i shes bya'i chos thams cad ni tshad mas dngos su rtogs par bya ba'am, shugs la rtogs par bya ba'o/
rang mtshan dang spyi mtshan gnyis so/
mngon gyur dang, lkog gyur dang, shin tu lkog gyur te gsum mo/

mngon pa mdzod du gzugs phra rags 'jal byed kyi tshad cig ste, rdul phra rab, rdul phran, lcags rdul, chu rdul, ri bong gi rdul, lug rdul, glang gi rdul, nyi zer gyi rdul, sro ma, shig nas, sor mo, zheng bcas rim bzhin bdun 'gyur dang, sor tshigs nyer bzhir khru gang, khru bzhi la 'dom gang, 'dom lnga brgya la rgyang grags, de brgyad la dpag tshad gcig bcas so/

dus 'khor lugs kyi gzugs phra rags 'jal byed kyi tshad cig ste, rdul phra rab, rdul phra mo, skra rtse, ske tshe, shig nas, sor mo rnams rim bzhin brgyad 'gyur dang, sor nyi shu la khru, khru bzhi la 'dom, 'dom nyis stong la rgyang grags, 'di bzhi la dpag tshad gcig bcas so/
mngon sum dang, rjes dpag yid ches tshad ma bcas gsum mo/
1) 'jal du med pa/ pha ma'i bka' drin gzhal du med/ 2) grangs gnas shig /
gzhal yas khang dang don gcig
ring thung dang, che chung sogs gzhal ba'i tshad/
1) tshad las 'das pa/ 2) grangs gnas shig /
1) rgyu dang rgya khyon sogs kyi tshad dang yon tan 'jal mi nus pa'i lha'i khang bzang/ 2) ri'i dbang po ri rab/
glu/ dmangs gzhas/ bod gzhas/ gzhas gtong ba
gzhas kyi 'gor ngag gi gdangs ring por gtong ba zhig /

sngar bod yul gyi mi chen sku drag dag gis chang sa rgyag skabs skyes pa phos rten 'brel mtshon byed du sgra gdangs dma' zhing ring bar glu blangs nas gzhas gzhug la rkang 'gros mgyogs myur gyis zhabs bro rgyag pa zhig /
glu gzhas kyi tshig dang gdangs rnying pa/
glu sogs kyi dbyangs sam gdangs/ gzhas gdangs rtsom mkhan/
gzhas gtong ba'i 'go gleng mkhan nam dge rgan/
gzhas gtong mkhan gyi bud med/
gdangs ring gdangs thung gi gzhas dang, 'gyur khug spel ma'i rnam thar/ gzhas ma rnam thar btang nas dga' dga' skyid skyid byed pa/
gzhas kyi mjug bsdu sa ni gzhas gzhug ste 'khyug gzhas/
gzhas gtong ba'i sa cha/ chos rar chos dang, gzhas rar gzhas/
gdong thug rtsed 'gran gyis gzhas gtong ba/ phar tshur gzhas shags rgyag pa/

/ 1) sa cha dang, gnas yul/ khyim gzhi/ sa gzhi/ yul gzhi/ gnas gzhi/ 2) rtsa ba dang, ngo ma/ rmang gzhi/ rten gzhi/ ma gzhi/ tshos gzhi/ dngos gzhi/ gzhi gcig du mar spro ba/ gzhi 'cha' ba/ 3) dngos po dang, chos/ khyad gzhi/ mtshan gzhi/ bslab gzhi/ rtsod gzhi/ gyod gzhi/ 4) rgyu dang, sa bon/ nad gzhi/ yong gzhi/ 'byung gzhi/ gzhi ci las gyur pa/ gzhi med par 'bras bu mi yong/
tshos gzhi nag po'i zla, ras gzhi dkar po/ gzhi dkar po'i steng me tog dmar ljang gi ri mo yod pa/
rtsa ba'am, ma mo, ma gzhi/ gzhi rkang thog nas grub pa/
tshad mas grub pa ste, ka bum la sogs pa'i chos gang dang gang yin kyang de yod med dang yin min sogs blo tshad mas brtags nas de ltar grub pa'o/
tha gru'i khyon yongs/ gzhi rgya che chung/ las gzhi rgya che ba/

bye brag smra bas shes bya'i chos thams cad gzhi lnga'i nang du 'dus par 'dod la, de ni snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi dang, gtso bo sems kyi gzhi, 'khor sems byung gi gzhi, ldan min 'du byed kyi gzhi, 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhi ste lnga'o/
chos du ma 'gal ba: 'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gzhi gcig gi khyad chos mang po 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
gzhi gcig gi rdzas dang las 'gal ba
'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gzhi gcig la khyad chos kyi rdzas mi 'dra ba mang po tshogs pa dang, de'i byed las kyang phan tshun 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
tan 'gal ba: 'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, byed po'i dngos po gzhi gcig gi yon tan gyi khyad par phan tshun 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, byed po'i dngos po gzhi gcig gi byed las 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

rab byung gi bsgrub pa'i bslab bya la, sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa rab byung gi gzhi gcig dang, thob pa mi nyams par bslab pa bsrung ba'i gzhi dgu dang, nyams pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi bdun te bcu bdun no/
ldog pa gcig pas ma grub pa gsum gyi ya gyal, gzhi chos tha dad med nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, sgra yin te, byas pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, mal stan la chags pa'i gnyen po dben sar gnas gar bab bab tu 'dug cing bde ba mi 'dam par 'dug pa/
rtsa ba'i bsnyen tshad kyi grangs/

ba ma grub pa: don la ma grub pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, gzhi rtags kyi 'brel ba mi srid nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, mig gis gzung bya yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sgrub byed dang bsgrub gzhi gnyis kyi 'brel ba med pas rtags ma grub pa'o/
gzhi rtags kyi 'brel ba la the tshom za nas ma grub pa

blo ngor ma grub pa'i rtags gsum gyi ya gyal, chos can dang rtags gnyis kyi bar la khyab 'brel yod med ma nges pa'i rkyen gyis ma grub pa ste, dper na, rma bya'i sgra ri sul gsum po gang nas grag par ma nges pa'i ngor, ri sul gsum gyi dbus na chos can, rma bya yod de, rma bya'i sgra grag pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/
ldog pa gcig pas ma grub pa gsum gyi gras, gzhi rtags tha dad med nas ma grub pa ste, dper na, sgra chos can, mi rtag ste, sgra yin pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/
bya ba 'gal ba: 'gal ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, byed po'i dngos po gzhi mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi bya ba mi mthun pa 'gal ba ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

par smra ba bdun: theg dman sde pa bco brgyad kyi gras shig gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba dang, 'od srung ba, sa ston pa, chos srung ba, mang thos pa, gos dmar ba, rnam par phye ste smra ba ste sde bdun/
gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde
yod par smra ba'i sde dang don gcig
tha dad pa'i chos gnyis ka gzhi gcig tu mthun pa'am, gnyis ka yin pa, dper na, gser bum de gser yang yin la bum pa'ang yin pa lta bu'o/
rnam dbye drug pa'i nang gses rdzas su grub pa gnyis med kyi dngos po gcig gi steng du gzhi mthun par sbyor ba/ zla ba'i dkar mdangs/ nyi ma'i tsha zer/ gser gyi rgyan/ dpal gyi be'u/
'gal med gcig tu 'du ba/ sgra de, shes bya dang, dngos po gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yin pa/
srid pa bar do ste bar do dngos/
sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas rnam par dag pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid can te, gzhi rgyud bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/
gzhi dus kyi ye shes lnga

nyon mongs pa lnga po ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur ba ste, zhe sdang rang grol me long dang, nga rgyal rang grol mnyam pa nyid, 'dod chags rang grol so sor rtogs, phrag dog rang grol bya ba grub, gti mug rang grol chos kyi dbyings zhes bshad do/
yul lha gzhi bdag ste sa bdag lta bu/
gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa
yul gang der rtag tu gnas shing skyob pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha/
chos rnams kyi rang rang gi mtshan nyid mtshon pa'i gzhi ste, bum pa'i gzhi ldog gser bum yin pa lta bu'o/
slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rjod byed kyi gzhung rnams sde snod gsum du bsdu bar bstan pa'o/
tshos gzhi dkar po'i ldog zla/ gzhi nag po la yig 'bru dkar po'i ri mo shin tu gsal/
rtsa ba nas/ las don gzhi nas rkang yag po tshugs pa/
(rnying) sa gzhi khod snyoms po bzos pa/
1) gzhi rtsa chung chung/ 2) 'dul gzhung gi bye brag cig /
1) tshad mas ma grub pa/ 2) med pa/ 3) gshis ka yag po min pa/
1) stong pa nyid/ 2) rtsa ba med pa/ gzhi med skur 'debs/ gzhi med sgro 'dogs/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, gnod pa las gyur pa gnyis kyi ya gyal, dge slong gzhan la brjod pa'i gzhi mthong thos dogs gsum med bzhin pham bzhi gang gi sgo nas skur ba 'debs pa'o/
don gyi gzhi'am rtsa ba/ gzhi rtsa btsugs pa/

sngags rnying ma'i chos skad de, gzhi gnas rang byung gi ye shes so, de yang rig pa'i ngo bo la, 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rdzogs pa ste, 'khor ba'i chos thams cad rmi lam ltar med snang nyag gcig yin kyang rig rtsal bdag tu bzung ba las gzhan med pa dang, mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni nyi ma dang zer bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du rdzogs pa de nyid srid zhi kun khyab kyi ye shes yin pas chen po'o/
gzhol ba gsum gyi bzlas pa'i ya gyal te, bdag mdun lhar gsal ba'o/
theg pa thams cad kyi lta sgom 'bras gsum la sbyar ba ste, gzhi lta ba gtan la phab pa dang, lam sgom pas nyams su blangs pa, 'bras bu byang chub thob pa bcas gsum/

gzhi phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa, sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

sher phyin don bdun cu las mkhyen pa gsum gyi chos sum cu'i nang tshan, gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu ni, shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang, snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang, ring ba'i gzhi shes dang, nye ba'i gzhi shes dang, mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang, gnyen po'i phyod kyi gzhi shes dang, gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba dang, byang sems kyi sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid dang, gzhi shes kyi mthong lam bcas dgu'o/

sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam gang zhig theg dman gyi mthong lam shugs la 'phen byed gzhi shes kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs so/
nyan rang gis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, gzhi gzugs sogs la zhen pa bkag nas bsgoms pas nyan rang gi sbyor ba shugs la 'phen byed kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/

, gso sbyong dang, dbyar gnas, dgag dbye gsum gyi lag len dngos su byed pa'i skor gyi gzhung, de yang zla ba re re bzhin tshes bco lnga dang, gnam gang gnyis la gso sbyong re dang, dbyar kha zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i bar dbyar khrims khas blangs pas dbyar gnas dang, de zla'i sum cu nyin dbyar gnas grol skabs dgag dbye bcas yin/
dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong dgag dbye ste gzhi gsum byed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung zhig dus rabs bco brgyad par dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/

(tha dad pa) gzhigs pa, gzhig pa, gzhigs,, dpyod pa dang rtog pa/ rnga rdung stangs la gzhigs pa'i 'cham/ 'di'i don ni gzhig dka' ba'o/ legs nyes kyi bya bar rang blo gzhigs shig / gnas tshul de la gzhigs nas shes thub pa/
'o ma sogs 'jib byed kyi sbu gu lta bu/ 'o ma gzhib sbubs/
(rnying) 1) sgrig pa/ mi mang po gral gzhibs te bsdad pa/ 2) gzhib pa dang sdeb pa/ khang pa gu dog po yin stabs tshang ma gzhibs nas bzhugs dgos/
tha mal ba'i skye ba gzhi'i sprul sku dang, tha mal gyi 'chi ba gzhi'i chos sku, tha mal gyi bar do gzhi'i longs sku bcas gsum/

gzhi'am thabs kyi rgyud ni, sgra yangs par na rigs sad nas byang chub kyi bar du bgrod par byed pa'i lam gyi rnam pa srid do 'tshal thams cad dang dog par na smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam yan lag dang bcas pa la gzhi zhes bya'o/
'khor ba'i bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams so/

gnyen po bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bar chad med pa'i lam gyis spangs pa'i bral thob 'dzin pa ste, bar chad med pa'i lam dang po ma gtogs pa sdug bsngal la chos shes pa la sogs pa rnam par grol ba'i lam mo/
skyes nas ma shi bar du rlung 'byung 'jug byed pa/

bon gyi bshad tshul ltar, 'od gsal stong pa bon sku'i ngo bo rang bzhin rnam dag rtsol med lhun grub sems can thams can la rang chas su yod pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs te nang pa'i bde gshegs snying po dang 'dra ba zhig /
bar do'i sems dang de'i lus tshogs pa gnyis/

grangs ka bzhi/ gsum la gcig bsnan na bzhi/ nam dus bzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya mtsho dang, chu bo, chu gter, bdud, sde ba, rig byed bcas so,
zhing son khal gcig 'gro bar thon 'bab khal bzhi thon pa/
bzhi ling yang zer, tsho bzhir bgos pa'i gling gcig / tshags sha bzhi gling gcig /
dngos bstan stong nyid gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung, sngar rgya gar gyi slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'o/
sngar bod kyi skyed ka'i tshad gzhi zhig ste, dpyid ka 'bru khal bzhi bu lon blangs pa'i tshab ston kha 'bru khal lnga sprod pa/
dum bu bzhi ru bgos pa'i cha gcig / bzhi cha gsum/
hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nyin se ra dgon pa phyag 'debs mkhan byams chen chos rje zhi bar gshegs pa'i dus mchod/
(rnying) bshang ba smin pa'am mi gtsang ba/

sngar mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi skabs, lha sar btab pa'i dgon pa zhig ste, dgon bdag rwa sgreng ho thog thu'am, a chi thu no mon han sku phreng snga phyi rim pa gnyis kyis bod kyi rgyal tshab byas yod/
1.grangs rim zhig / 2.(yul) chu 'khor nang gro thengs bzhi pa btags pa'i ming/
'phags pa bzhi pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu pa, 'gyur byang med pa/
bzhi rang/ kho tsho mi bzhi po/
dum bu bzhi ru bgos pa'i cha shas/
yi ge'i shad``,, ,,'''di lta bu'i ming ste, tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gang rung gi don tshan chen po rdzogs mtha' dang le'u'i mtshams su bri rgyu'i shad cig /
lo skor bcu gnyis po'i rang rang gi yas mas kyi bzhi pa gang yin pa de ni bzhi gshed ces bya ba ste, de yang dper na, byi ba'i mas kyi bzhi gshed yos dang yas kyi bzhi gshed bya yin pa bzhin no/

1.ngo'am ngo gdong/ bzhin skya thal/ bzhin rgyas pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i bzhin/ bzhin 'dzum ston pa/ bzhin gyi gzi brjid 'bar ba/ 2.byed mus su yod pa'i bya ba ston rogs kyi tshig grogs shig / skad cha shod bzhin du gad mo bgad pa/ mi shes bzhin du shes khul byed pa/ thugs mnyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas zhal bzhes gnang ba/ re re bzhin/ 3.dpe don mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi phrad rang dbang can zhig / ngo ma bzhin/ yid bzhin/ gzugs dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa/ snga ma nang bzhin/ skam sar thon pa'i nya bzhin/ de bzhin nyid/ 'di bzhin/ ji ltar gong du bshad pa nang bzhin/ ka ba bzhin du drang dgos, ka gdan bzhin du brtan dgos
bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dang don gcig
bzhin sgra can gyi rab rtog
rab rtog gi rgyan gyi nang gses ting 'dzin rab rtog /
zhal ras kyi nyams 'gyur ram, gdong gi rnam pa/
gdong gi mdangs/ bzhin mdangs 'dzum pa'i dgra zla yis, rang la rtag tu gnod nyen che/
gdong 'gyur ba/ bzhin mdangs dkar por ldog pa/ bzhin mdangs nag por ldog pa/
1) sems sdug gi rnam pa ston pa/ 2) khong khro za ba'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur/
1) gdong mdog nag pa/ 2) mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ngo nag / yab kyi drung du bzhin nag ste 'dug pa/
ngo tsha nas gdong thur du gug pa/
ngo'am gdong/ gzigs pa gzhan du mi g.yo bar mi de'i bzhin ras la mngon par gtad pa/
1) gdong mdzes pa/ 2) klu'i rgyal po zhig /
gzhis ni gnas mal dang, byes ni phyogs/
me la bzhus nas 'dul ba/ gser bzhu 'dul lan mang byas pa/
(tha dad pa) bzhus pa, bzhu ba, bzhus,, me la bsregs nas khu ba ltar sgyur ba'am skol ba/ mar khu bzhus pa/ zangs bzhu ba/ ba mo nyi mas bzhus dang 'dra/
(yul) zhugs mar te 'od gsal byed kyi sgron me/
shing dang rin po che las bskrun cing bla dpon bzhugs sa'i stegs bu'i khri stan mthon po/ bzhugs khri'i rgyab yol/
bza' zla'am mnyam du sdod rogs pho mo gang rung/
gling ga / bzhugs gling gtong ba/
1) 'grul pas lam du brgyab pa'i sgar/ 2) sngar dmag spyi rnams phyogs la 'gro skabs sdod gnas khang pa'am gur sogs/
sdod sa'i gdan/ bzhugs gdan sgron pa/ bzhugs gdan 'jags/

1.(tha mi dad pa) sdod pa dang, 'dug pa dang, gnas pa'i zhe sa/ gdan la bzhugs te bka' mol gnang/ bstan bcos de dang de zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 2.ming gi sngon du sbyar nas zhe tshig bzo ba'i tshig grogs shig / bzhugs khang/ bzhugs gur/ bzhugs stan/ bzhugs stegs/
mar bzhugs te gtam mol ba/ bzhugs mol tshogs 'du/

(tha mi dad pa) 'byon pa dang, phebs pa ste, 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i zhe sa/ rang rang gi gnas su bzhud de bde bar gnas so/ nyi ma lar bzhud tshar 'dug / lam du bzhud pa/ g.yul sar bzhud pa/ phar bzhud tshur 'byon/
mar phyur brdzis pa'i thud dkar po/
mgar bas gser sogs btso sbyang byed tshul te, las don la zhib tshags byas pa'i dpe/

(tha dad pa) 1) bzhar ba dang, bzhod pa/ skra bzhur ba/ shing gi pags pa bzhur ba/ yal ga bzhur ba/ 2) dwangs snyigs 'byed pa/ 'o ma bzhur ba/ 3) bzhu ba'i 'das pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig 'bri tshul 'di si tu'i sum rtad 'grel chen kho nar gsal,
gzhu ba dang bzhu ba'i 'das pa,
tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i bzhengs pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
'grengs te sdod tshul lam langs stangs/ spyan ras gzigs bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

1.(tha dad pa) 1) gsar du bzo ba dang, skrun pa'i zhe sa/ thog rtseg can gyi khang chen bzhengs pa/ 'jim sku bzheng ba/ rdo sku bzhengs pa/ 2) slong ba dang, 'dzugs pa'i zhe sa/ ka ba bzhengs pa/ rdo ring bzhengs pa/ dar po che bzhengs pa/ 3) glu len pa'i zhe sa/ dbyangs su gyer nas mgur dbyangs bzhengs/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) yar lang ba'i zhe sa/ sku bzheng gnang a/ zhogs par sku bzheng gnang mi 'dug / ma bzheng ma bzheng/ tshang ma yar bzhengs shig / bzhugs gral las bzhengs pa/
1) bsam blo gtong yul te khas blangs pa'i don snying/ 2) 'dod don dang re don/ bzhed don lhun gyis grub song/

1.(tha dad pa) 1) khas len pa'i zhe sa/ rtag gcig rang dbang can du bzhed pa/ gang zhus de bzhed/ 2) 'dod pa'i zhe sa/ 'byon par bzhed pa/ gzigs bzhed pa/ rang bde bzhed pa/ gtam don bzhed par mi mdzad pa/ 2.dgongs pa/ gzhan gyi bzhed pa/ rang gi bzhed pa dang 'gal ba/ bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po/
'dod tshul/ mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul mi mthun pa/
(rnying) bsregs pa/ sku gdung zhugs la bzhen/

bza' btung sogs longs su spyad bya'i rgyu chas rigs kyi ming 'ga'i sngon du sbyar nas zhe tshig bzo byed tshig grogs shig / bzhes kham/ bzhes sgong/ bzhes bag / bzhes lum/ bzhes can/ bzhes thur/ bzhes tha bzhes pa ma gnang/ bzhes rag mnyes dag /
chang gi thug pa ste, bskol ldan/

1.(tha dad pa) 1) gsol ba ste longs su spyod pa'i zhe sa/ gsol tshigs bzhes pa/ na bza' bzhes pa/ dbu zhwa bzhes pa/ gsol sman bzhes pa/ snyung gzhi yun ring bzhes pa/ dgung lo mthon po bzhes pa/ 2) 'khyer ba dang len pa'i zhe sa/ phyag 'khar bzhes pa/ zhal gyis bzhes pa/ snyan gsan bzhes pa/ phyag bzhes bstar ba/ 3) bsam blo gtong ba'i zhe sa/ dgongs pa bzhes pa/ bzod sgom bzhes su gsol/ 2.zas/ bzhes pa 'dren pa/
mar khu dang snum la btsos pa'i kha zas/
'o ma 'jo skabs bzho zog gam bzhon ma'i lag pa gnyis sdom byed kyi thag pa,..
char pa'i nang 'o ma 'jo skabs gyon rgyu'i phying pa sogs las bzos pa'i char gos/
'o ma 'jo snod shing gi zo ba/
bzhog rgyag byed kyi yo byad/
bzhur ba dang gsheg pa'i don du go ba'i 'jog pa'i 'das pa,
dkar chu/ da lo 'brog khul du char chu legs pas bzhon yag po byung 'dug /
1.zhon pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.rta drel sogs bzhon bya/ bzhon pa zhon pa/ bzhon pa bzang po la brten nas lam du zhugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'gyogs byed dang, rgyu byed, lam 'degs bcas so,
bzhon pa lta bu'i sems bskyed

sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi snying rje lhag mthong dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gang du yang mi ltung bas mi gnas pa'i sar bde blag tu 'gro bas na bzhon pa bzang po lta bu'o/
/ 1) 'o ma bzho rgyu yod pa'i mdzo mo dang, ba mo, ra lug sogs/ 2) 'o ma 'jo mkhan gyi bud med/
1.'jo ba'i 'das pa, 2.(rnying) sems gso byas pa/ snying bzhos pa/

bod yig gsal byed nyer gnyis pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen dro zhing sgra med pa, ming gzhi'i mo yig cig /
sngar dpon khungs kyi ngo tshab mi sna la khral ltar sprod pa'i gla lto/
ba spu byi zhing g.ya' za byed pa dang, sha mdog sngon por 'gyur zhing gzhan la 'go bar 'gyur ba'i pags nad cig
lto chas kyis kha phyid pa/ za kha bud min/ za kha bud tsam byung ba/
za ma za sa'i khang pa/
kha zas kyi dwangs ma lus zungs su ma gyur nas dri chu dang lhan du phyir bab pa'i gcin snyi'i nad kyi nang tshan zhig
gron chung gi thog nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhas pa/
sha gtub byed kyi gri chung/ za gri rang la ma yod na, zhim sha mi nas chod le min/
bza' btung byed mkhan gyi rogs pa/
lugs dang mi mthun zhing gang byung gis 'tsho ba skyel stangs/
ltogs rngam/ lto la za rngam ma byed/
1) za yun ring thung gi ldang shed/ za bcud che ba/ za bcud chung ba/ 2) zas kyi ro nus/
lto chas bzas drags pa/ zas za che na pho ba na yong/

1) bza' btung 'tshol thabs tsam gyi bya ba'am cho ga / 'dis za chog 'thung chog tsam las gzhan gang yang mi shes/ 2) g.yo bskol byas zin pa'i bza' btung gi rdzas/ nga'i khyim du mgron nam yong yang za chog 'thung chog byas nas bsdad yod/
lto za ba dang gnyid nyal ba/ za nyal 'gro 'dug spyod lam rnam pa bzhi/

1) tshod ma bzung bar gang byung za ba'am za mi rung ba za ba/ mthong tshad za nyes kyis grod khog na ba/ 2) 'tsho ba skyel stangs mi shes pa/ mi 'dis za nyes 'thung nyes kho na byas te sprang por gyur pa red/
lto chas za stangs yag po ma byung ba'am za nor ba/
lkog rngan za 'dod kyis snyad 'tshol ba/ gzhan la za snyad byed pa/ sngar dpon ngan gyis mi ser la za snyad byed rgyu kho na las gzhan gang yang mi shes/
lto chas thob skal gyi lam 'gro/ dmangs kyi za thang/
(yul) za spyad thur ma'am khem bu/
i sho legs dang rmu lcam smad legs gnyis kyi sras, sngar bod rgyal bcu drug pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
zas za nus pa/ mi'i nang du 'byor pa che chung gcig pa yin yang za phod pa dang mi phod pa sna tshogs yod/
g.yan pa/ mgo la skogs skyi chags te za phrug langs pa/ gzugs por tsha thor skyes nas za phrug langs pa/
1) lto chas bzas pa'i lhag ma/ za 'phro 'thung 'phro/ lto chas za 'phro yun ring du 'jog mi rung/ 2) zas za bzhin pa'i mtshams bzhag pa/ kho tsho lto chas za 'phro bzhag nas phyi la phyin song/

1.(tha dad pa) bzas pa, bza' ba, zo,/ za ma za ba/ mngar cha za ba, ..za za 'thung 'thung/ kha la mar zhig bzas nas, rkan la rus pa zug byung/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) 1,za phrug langs pa/ gzugs po za ba/ rma kha za ba/ 2,bzas pa, za ba, ,skye ba dang, 'byung ba/ khong khro za ba/ g.yang za ba/ the tshom za ba/ rnam rtog za ba/ dogs pa za mi dgos/ tshig pa bzas pa/ ltogs tshig za ba/ 3.'dza' ba'i da lta ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig 4. 1) lto chas/ za ba'i kham/ 2) za phrug / za ba phrugs pa/
'bras bu la longs spyod pa'i za ba po zhes gang zag gi bdag gi rnam grangs su grangs can pas 'dod/
gos chen bye brag pa zhig / gos chen za babs kyi phyu pa 'tshem pa/
(yul) nan tan med pa/ las don za be zo be byed pa/
mi ser gyi sa nas ham za byed pa/
za phrug langs pa/ gdong la dug sbrang gis so btab pas za ber ba byas byung/
(mngon) 1) kha/ 2) brgya byin gyi rdo rje/ 3) gdong/ 4) me/ 5) me lha/ 6) srin po/
gtong yong mgo gtug pa/ lo gcig khyud 'khor gyi za 'bor kha 'thab sdom rtsis rgyag pa/
/ 1) lto chas/ 2) bud med/ 3) lto yun te, lto thengs gcig za ba'i dus yun/ zhag dang za ma tsam yang ma 'gyangs pa/ 4) ma ning/
1) yo byad 'jug snod/ 2) mdo sde zhig /
spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo sde zhig bam po phyed dang lnga le'u gnyis pa, pandi ta dzi na mi tra sogs dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/
pho mo gang rung 'dod pa tshul bzhin du spyod mi nus pa zhig /
lto chas mang nyung za thub pa'i 'bor tshad/ za tshan shin tu chen po/
zas za 'bor mang nyung gi tshod/ lto chas za tshod ran pa/

'du long ste las dang skad cha mang po'i brel zing/ mi mang 'du 'dzoms za zi'i khrod du'ang mno bsam gtong thub pa/ smig rgyu za zis mgo rmongs te shar dang nub la sogs pa'i phyogs kyang mtshon par mi nus/
dar skud sna lnga dang gser skud sogs bsres nas btags pa'i gos chen zhig /
1) khyim bdag a pha/ 2) gzhan gyi las rogs byas pa'i gla/ 3) snga dus bod srol chos klog pa'i yon/

1) mi gsal ba'i tshul/ nam za ri zi ri'i dus/ dran pa za ri zi ri/ chang gis bzi na sems rnal du mi gnas par za ri zi ri byed yong/ 2) don med du g.yeng ba'i tshul/ don med za ri zi ri'i las kyis brel/ 3) sgra mtshon pa'i tshig / me tog gi khrod nas bung ba'i sgra za ri zi ri sgrog pa/
shing skyogs/ dka' las za rus spyad na, 'bras bu za rur 'khor yong/ khog ma la med na, za ru la gang nas yong/
gtsang stod bon po'i gnas shig /
zas za shugs sam zas za 'bor mang nyung gi tshod/ za shed che ba/ za shed chung ba/
lto chas za ba'i skal ba'am lam 'gro/ 'byor pa che yang za bsod med pa/
ltogs rngam/ za ham 'thung ham byed pa/
rgya gar skad za ho ra'i zur chag ste, de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus thog rgya gar bhangga la zer ba'i yul gyi ming ste, deng sang meng ca lar zer/
(yul) chu ma brgyab pa'i chang gi snying khu/
, (yul) kha la du ba 'then byed kyi yo spyad cig /
nyon mongs can te, dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas zag pa'am nyon mongs rgyas 'gyur gyi chos, nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu'o/
nyon mongs pa'i zag dang bcas pa'i chos rnams/
zag bcas kyi phung po lnga
rang rgyu las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i gzugs dang, tshor ba, 'du shes, 'du byed, rnam par shes pa bcas kyi phung po lnga'o/
zag bcas kyi bde ba ste nyon mongs pa'i bde ba/ yun ring zag bde spyad pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 1) zags pa, zag pa,, lhung ba/ g.yang sar zags pa/ khang pa'i nang la thigs pa zag gi 'dug / khang thog nas zags song/ mchi ma zags pa/ 2) 'dzag pa'i 'das pa, 2. 1) nyon mongs/ 2) bshang gci mchi ma snabs sogs lus las byung ba'i mi gtsang ba'i rdzas/ zag pa 'dor ba/
zag pa dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i sems byung dang bdag rkyen mig dbang sogs te, zag pa'i sgo drug gi nang tshan zhig /
'dod pa'i zag pa dang, srid pa'i zag pa, ma rig pa'i zag pa, lta ba'i zag pa ste srid pa'i chu bo bzhi la zag pa bzhi zhes pa'o/
zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs
de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i nang gses shig ste, sems can 'di dag ni nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i zag pa zad do zhes bya ba'i bye brag la mkhas pa/
zag pa zad pa la mi 'jigs pa
spangs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa dang don gcig
zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes
mngon par shes pa drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, mthong ba dang bsgoms pas spangs pa'i nyon mongs pa gang spangs ma spangs pa'i rim pa shes nas zad pa dang mi skye ba'i ye shes thob pa shes pa'o/
zag pa zad pa'i rig pa
rang rgyud ldan gyi nyon mongs zad pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi shes pa ste rig pa gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
'dod pa'i zag pa dang, srid pa'i zag pa, ma rig pa'i zag pa ste gsum/
gzhan la zhe sun skyed pa'am khong khro slong ba/ don med skad cha rtsub pos mi gzhan la zag pa gsog pa/
zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba
zag pa'i 'bras bu rnams te, zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po/

kun nyon rgyas pa'am 'phel bar rung ba'i sgo drug ste, zag pa'i bdag nyid, zag pa dang 'brel ba, zag pas bcings pa, zag pa'i rjes su 'brel ba, zag pa'i rjes su mthun pa, zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba bcas so/
zag pa'i rjes su mthun pa
zag pa'i yul gzugs la sogs pa ci rigs pa ste, zag pa'i sgo drug gi nang tshan zhig /
zag pa'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pa ste, lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos rnams so, zag pa'i sgo drug gi nang tshan zhig /
zag pa'i sgo drug gi nang tshan te, rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams so/
lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol du mi rung ba'i gnas ngan len/
khams gsum gyi dge ba zag bcas rnams des srid pa'i rgyur kun nas bcings pa ste, zag pa'i sgo drug gi nang tshan zhig /
dmigs pa'am mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas kyang zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i chos lam bden dang 'gog pa lta bu'o/
lam bden dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams so/
khams gsum las 'das shing 'phags pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sdom pa'o/
zag med kyi phung po lnga
tshul khrims kyi phung po dang, ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po, shes rab kyi phung po, rnam par grol ba'i phung po, rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po bcas lnga'o/
zag med kyi dbang po gsum
'phags lam gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i zag pa dang bral ba'i dbang po ste, kun shes byed pa'i dbang po dang, kun shes pa'i dbang po dang, kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po ste gsum mo/
bsod nams dang, tshul khrims dang, ye shes kyi tshogs te gsum mo/

tshul khrims kyi zag med lam dang, ting nge 'dzin gyi zag med lam, shes rab kyi zag med lam, rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi zag med lam, rnam par grol ba'i mthong ba'i phung po'i zag med lam ste lnga/

sde tshan nyer gcig: ye shes chos sku'i yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig ni, byang phyogs so bdun, tshad med bzhi, rnam thar brgyad, mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu , zad par bcu, zil gnon brgyad, nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin, smon gnas mkhyen pa, mngon shes drug so so yang dag rig pa bzhi, dag pa bzhi, dbang bcu, stobs bcu, mi 'jigs pa bzhi, bsrung ba med pa gsum, dran pa nyer gzhag gsum, bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid, bag chags yang dag bcom pa, thugs rje chen po, sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad, rnam mkhyen bcas sde tshan nyer gcig /
bshang gci mchil snabs sogs/ zag rdzas btsog pa/
zag pa zad pa'i bsdus tshig
mthong ba dang bsgom pas spangs pa'i nyon mongs pa ci spangs ci ma spangs pa'i rim pa shes bzhin zad pa dang mi skye ba'i ye shes thob pa shes pa'o/

1) kha khu sim po min pa'am lhing mi 'jags pa dang brel ba tshab tshub/ sems zang ngi zing ngi byed pa/ zang zing gis sun pa/ 2) go rim 'khrugs pa/ mi nor mang po zang ngi zing ngir 'tshogs pa/ las don zang ngi zing ngi/ lung par zang ngi zing ngi byung ba/

bar mtshams med pa'am, thogs rdugs med pa/ yar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba/ mar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba/ nus pa ha cang che bas brag dang rtsig pa la zang thal du 'gro ba/ sgyogs chen 'phangs pa'i mde'u dgra mkhar la zang thal du 'gro ba/
rjen pa'am, thad ka dang mngon sum/ zer rgyus phongs pa'i rtags zang mar ston pa/ chang gis ha cang myos pa'i rang rtags zang mar thon pa/
1) zang ngi zing ngi'i bsdus tshig 2) rgyu nor dang longs spyod dam dngos rdzas/ zang zing gi rogs ram/ zang zing gis 'byor pa/
sbyin pa bzhi'i nang tshan, gnas lus longs spyod kyi sbyin pa/
1) nor rdzas med pa/ 2) 'du 'dzi med pa/
grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs khag gcig nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming zhig /

/ 1) rin po che'i rigs shig ste, rang byung dang rdo las byung ba gnyis bcas mchis, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo rnag dang, chu ser, tsha chu sogs skem, dngul chu'i nus pa srung/ lcags rdung sar lcags dang, zangs rdung sar zangs/ ming gi rnam grangs la kla klo kha dang, lcags dmar, zangs ma, zangs dmar bcas so, 2) zangs las bzos pa'i chu snod dam thab chas/ dkyil zangs/ khams zangs/ chu zangs/ stod zangs la lnga rdig dang drug rdig sogs yod/ ,/ 2) (mngon) gser/
1) zangs las bzos pa'i me tog / 2) me tog gi rigs kyi bye brag pa zhig /
stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi nang tshan zhig ste rab byung dang po'i dkyil la zangs dkar lo tsa ba 'phags pa shes rab yul lung der 'khrungs/
zangs las bzos pa'i ja chang thug pa sogs btung ba 'dren byed kyi snod cig /
zangs las bzos pa'i skud pa/
zangs las bzos pa'i skyogs/ rag skyogs las zangs skyogs zhan/
1) zangs las bzos pa'i khog ma/ 2) skra byi ba'i mgo dmar po'i ming ngan/
zangs zhu ba'i khu ba/ zangs khol lugs su blug pa/
zangs kyis bzos pa'i go khrab/
1) zangs rag lugs su blug pa'i khro/ 2) lugs su ma blugs pa'i zangs rag mnyam bsres kyi lcags rigs shig /
zangs rdung mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la zangs mgar dang, zangs rdung ba, zangs bzo ba bcas so,
1) zangs 'dra byed/ 2) zangs las bzos pa'i gri/
'dzam gling gi gling phran zhig 'ga' zhig gis da lta'i gling phran tsa'o wa yin zer, 'ga' zhig gis da lta'i si li lan kha yin zer/
zangs las bzos pa'i ja skol snod/
1) sa 'og nas thon pa'i rang byung
tig ta rigs me tog dmar po 'char ba zhig ste, nus pas mkhris nad dang, rlung 'dres pa'i tsha ba rnying pa sel/
zangs las bzos pa'i tel pa ste, 'bras dang lhog pa sogs kyi nad dmigs sreg byed kyi lag cha zhig /
zangs gyong po'am ma thul ba/

1) zangs 'phrul mer bsregs pa'i thal ba ste, nus pas dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i nus pa skyed cing lus la dngul chu'i nus pa yun ring du srung, dmu chu dang, glo rnag chu ser bcas skem/ 2) zang thal dang 'dra,
zangs las bzos pa'i dung chen/ zangs dung 'bud pa/
1) zangs la chags pa'i dreg pa/ 2) zangs mgar bas mer bsregs te brdungs pa'i dreg pa ste, nus pas 'or nad dang, dmu chu, glo rnag chu ser bcas la phan/
slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams shig /
1) zangs spyad bzo mkhan/ 2) zangs tho bas rdeg pa/
sman pas zangs kyi phor pa tsha po bzos nas nad gar yod la rgyag pa'i sman bcos byed stangs shig /
zangs kyi chu snod dang chang snod/
/ 1) rang byung zangs/ 2) zangs dkyus ma/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, nus pa snyoms, zangs rtsi dkar pos khrag gcod, khu ba 'dzag pa la phan, zangs rtsi nag pos mkhris nad mig ser la phan/
zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan
dpal chen 'od po'i bu sa skya pan chen gyi gcung po chos rgyal 'phags pa'i yab rab byung gsum pa'i shing pho 'brug lo la 'khrungs, nga drug pa sa mo phag lo la 'das/

zangs rlan gyis zos pa'i g.ya' ljang gu / zangs g.ya' dug lcags g.ya' sman/

lho kha zangs ri'i gnas dgon gyi bye brag cig ste rab byung gnyis pa'i sa lug lor ma gcig lab kyi sgrol mas btab pa'o/
zangs lung bzhi ma'ang zer, zangs snod kyi bye brag cig /
zangs ru bzhi ma dang don gcig
zangs chas bzo byed kyi rgyu cha srab po zhig /
kha dog ser po yin pa'i zangs/
stongs pa la thug pa/ stobs shugs zad gtugs la gyar ba/
zad zin stong pa ste lhag med du song ba/ khyim nor zad stongs su gyur pa/ sa 'gul gyi gnod 'tshes grong khyer zad stongs su phyin pa/
rdzogs mtshams kyi mtha'/ nam mkha'i khams la zad mtha' med pa/
1) rgyu dngos bed spyod kyis zad pa'i gun gsab dngos skyin/ gyon chas zad 'thud/ 'phrul 'khor zad 'thud/ 2) gron tshab bsgrig rgyu'i cha shas/

1.'dzad pa'i 'das pa, 2. 1) rdzogs rgyu dang, tshar rgyu/ shes bya'i rnam grangs la zad pa med pa/ dpal 'byor longs spyod zad mi shes pa/ bya ba zad par mtha' 'khyol ba/ rkyen zad pa dang nus shugs nyams pa dus gnyis yin/ bya rgas sgro zad/ 2) (mngon) me pho stag /
shes pa bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste rang nyid spang bya thams cad spangs zin pa'i gden 'thob par byed pa'i shes pa'o/
bsgyur bgod kyi gnas rnams zad de thig le stong par gyur pa, dper na, bsgyur bya stongs par bsgyur rgyu med, sgyur byed stongs na bsgyur gzhi dbyi, bsgyur bgod bar stongs thig les 'dzin/

bsam gtan la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'byung ba bzhi sogs gang la dmigs pa de ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bsgyur ba ste, zad par zhes pa rgya khyon tshad med pa'i don no/
zad par gyi skye mched bcu

sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi dang, sngo ser dkar dmar kha dog bzhi dang, nam mkha' mtha' yas dang, rnam shes mtha' yas bcas bcu'o, de la zad par sa'i skye mched ces pa ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs las sa la dmigs pa na phyogs thams cad sa'i phung por bsgyur nus pa'o, de bzhin du 'byung ba gzhan dang kha dog sogs la rigs 'gre'o/
zad par gyi skye mched bcu dang don gcig
ma zad bar du/ mda' rgod nyag ma zad zad 'phangs/
snga ma zad pa dang phyi ma len pa/ dgos mkho zad len/
'gro song/ zad song gi sdom rtsis rgyag pa/
/ 1) rtsam pa brdzis pa'i gong bu ste dbus gtsang du spag zer/ phor pa'i nang du zan brdzis/ 2) bza' bca'/
kha la shong tsam gyi spag /
spag rdog rdog / skyugs nad can gyis zan gong mthong ba dang mtshungs/

brtag pa byed thabs shig ste zan ril 'dra ba gnyis kyi nang brtag bya'i ming mi 'dra ba gnyis bcug ste rten rtsa che'i mdun du bden pa bdar te dkrug dkrug btang nas gcig phyir zag pa der brtag dpyad byed pa'i srol la zan sgril zhu ba zer/
zan brdzis te gong bu bzos pa/
pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, gnod sems kyi sgo nas grogs dge slong la khyim bdag gis dus rung gi zas 'dren pa bkag pa'o/
1) chang ltar bsnyal te langs pa'i spag / 2) sbar mor bcangs pa'i zan gyi chang bu/
rtsam pa brdzis pa'i zan tsha po/
(rnying) zas zhim la gya nom pa/
1) spag btsos ma dang zan dron mo/ 2) rlung nad 'chos thabs zan btsos/
(rgya) bsam yas zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi ming ste, zan yang ni, rgya skad la lugs gsum zer te rgya gar rgya nag bod rnams kyi mkhar rtsig lugs gsum mo/
dar zab bam gos chen gyi skud pa/
zab pa'i khyad chos gsal por thon pa/
gos chen dar zab mer bsregs pa'i thal ba/
gtsang khul shangs kyi phur yod pa'i slob dpon padma'i sbas lung zhig /
1) blo mi sgrim pa'i tshul/ zab be zob ber nyan na ha go 'di go mi yong/ rig pa zab be zob be/ 2) tshags lhod pa/ thag pa zab be zob be byas nas bsdams pa/ ske rags zab zob tu lhod pa/
nang don gting zab pa'i sgra dbyangs/

/ 1) gting ring po/ dong zab mo/ chu zab mo/ brtse dung zab mo/ rgya che gting zab kyi rgya mtsho chen mo/ 2) rtogs dka' ba/ don zab mo/ dgongs pa zab mo/ blo rig zab mo/ 3) phra zhib/ zab mo'i stong pa nyid/ thabs lam zab mo/ rgya che zhing gting zab pa/ 4) spus legs pa'am, dag cing gtsang ba/ dar zab/ gos zab/
rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nas mgon po klu sgrub yab sras sogs la rim gyis brgyud pa'o/
chos thams cad bden grub kyis stong pa/
gi brgyud pa: lhag pa'i lhas zhal bstan nas dngos su gsungs pa'i gdams pa'o/
slob dpon klu sgrub kyis srol phye ba'i mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi lta ba 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' zhig /
zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba
thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi lta ba'o/
gting dpag dka' ba'i don te zab mo stong pa nyid/
mi skrag pa'i bzod pa: chos la nges shes kyi bzod pa dang don gcig
1) sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'od gsal chos sku/ 2) zab pa ni gting rtogs dka' ba dang, zhi ba ni 'gog pa mya ngan las 'das pa/
spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i zab mo stong pa nyid/
zab be zob be'i bsdus tshig
gting ring zhing 'gyur ba med pa/ gtam zab brling/
1) chu rtswa/ 2) chu rtswa'i rtsa ba/
gsang sngags kyi rim pa lnga ste, ngag dben dang, sems dben, sgyu lus, 'od gsal, zung 'jug lnga'o/
kyi rnal 'byor: stong dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor/
zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes
nges ngor stong nyid la dmigs pa dang, snang ngor lha'i rten brten pa'i snang ba 'ja' tshon ltar gsal bar 'char ba'i ye shes/
gting dpag dka' bas zab pa, tshab tshub med pas lhing ba, 'gyur ldog med pas brtan pa ste gsum/ las don zab lhing brtan gsum gyi sgo nas sgrub pa/
gting ngam, dong gi dpangs/ grog rong zabs su ring ba/ chu yur zabs su thung ba/
rgyud dam, rgyun/ las ka zam ma chad pa/ rlangs 'khor zam mi 'chad par 'gro ba/ chu klung nyin mtshan zam mi 'chad par 'bab pa/
zam pa'i 'og la yod pa'i chu/ btung chu len dus zam chu len mi rung/
zam pa 'degs pa'i sa rdo sogs kyi 'og stegs/
1) zam pa kyog po/ 2) zam pa'i sked pa ldem ldem du g.yo ba/ zam ldem gyi steng du 'gro dus lhod yangs ma byed/

chu steng bgrod lam/ rdo zam/ shing zam/ lcags zam/ lcug zam/ 'breng zam/ dpyang zam/ rkang zam/ zam pa'i ka ba/ zam pa'i rkang pa/ chu brgya zam 'og tu 'dus pa/ chu thon song zam pa ga ler bzhugs, la thon song la rtse ga ler bzhugs/
1) mig gdang 'dzum myur por byed tshul/ mig zam mi zim mir lta ba/ 2) char pa 'bab tshul zhig / char pa zam zim babs/
zam pa'i chu 'gro'i khung bu/ zam mig dgu ldan gyi zam chen/
las ka zhib tshags med pa'i tshul/ las ka zam me zom me byas na mi 'grig /
1) zam mi zim mi'i bsdus tshig 2) grangs gnas shig /
zam me zom me'i bsdus tshig
snum rgyu dang, sngo sman zhig /
zhing skyes lo thog gi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rlung sel/
za ri zi ri'i bsdus tshig
zar ma'i sdong bu'i shun pas btags pa'i ras/
gzengs thon pa'am ngo so thon pa/ byas rjes zal thon pa zhig bzhag pa/

/ 1) khra bo/ gzhi dkar por nag thig yod pa la dkar zal dang, gzhi nag por dkar thig yod pa la nag zal zer/ 2) mdzo g.yag zal po, dbus gtsang du g.yag dang glang ze dang sgal gzhung dkar po la zal pho dang, 'bri dang ba phyugs ze dang sgal gzhung dkar por zal mo zer/ zal pho...zal mo...
spu mdog khra bo yin pa'i mo phyugs/
'bri chu dang, shar zla chu gnyis dbar du chags pa'i sa cha'i stod rgyud, deng skabs dpal yul dang, sde dge, ldan ma, ser shul sogs kyi yul lung gi spyi ming/

bza' bca' sogs lus zungs gso bar phan byed kyi rgyu/ 'khyag dus gos dang ltogs dus zas/ mid pa zas kyis brnangs/ sgo phyugs zas kyis gso ba/ zas la bcag bcag byas na zhim po, gtam la nyan 'jog byas na snyan po/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha zas dang, lto chas, gdugs tshod, 'tshal ma, bzhes pa, za ma, zan, bza' ba, rab dang byed, gsol dgongs bcas so,
1) kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rig par spyod pa/ 2) nang sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyod pa/
1) dkar sdor can gyi zas/ 2) shakya'i rgyal po zas gtsang gi mched bzhi'i ya gyal gcig /
zho 'o ma mar te dkar gsum sbyar ba'i zas/
bza' btung ste, za rgyu dang 'thung rgyu gnyis bsdoms pa'i bsdus ming/ zas skom lhag ma/ zas skom yo byad/ zas skom gyis ngoms pa/
bza' bca' mang nyung gi 'bor tshad/ grod khog na bas zas kha phri ba/ dang ga nyams nas zas kha bri ba/
lto gos bzang zhing mang ba/ mi tshang mar zas gos bzang 'bol yod pa/
lto chas sam za ma'i 'gro song/ zas gron che drags song/
1) dug dang 'dres pa'i zas/ 2) zas dman pa/
1) gzugs por gnod pa'i zas spong ba/ 'ju dka'i zas gcod pa/ 2) lto mi za ba/
zas kyi snying po'am nus pa/ zas bcud ro bda' ba/
bzas na zas kyi bcud mi tshor, nyal na gnyid mi khug pa/ sdug bsngal che drags pa'i rkyen gyis zas bcud gnyid bral lta bu'i dka' gnas su gyar ba/
ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i zas/
zas khong du zhu ba/ gang zos kyi zas 'ju ba/ chang phabs dang skyu ru ra sogs kyis zas 'ju bar byed/
zas kha nas khar 'jug pa'am ldug pa/ byis pa chung ngu la nom bu'i zas snyod pa/
1) zas sgrug pa'am len pa/ 2) zas bsdu cha rgyag pa/
mi 'phrod pa'i zas bzas nas gyur pa'i dug / kha zas za nyes kyis zas dug byung ba/
zas blug pa'am sprod pa/ bos pa'i mgron la zas 'dren pa/
zas bcad pa'am zas mi za ba/ dmar zas bsdams pa/
zas dang nor rdzas/ zas nor gos kyi longs spyod 'dzoms/
(rnying) zas zhim la gya nom pa/
1) lto chas kyi rnam grangs/ ston gral la zas sna sgrig pa/ 2) za ma sna tshogs/
1) kha zas dang spyod lam/ zas spyod mthun pa/ 2) lto chas za ba/ ltogs dus su zas spyod pa/
zer ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, phrag dog gi sgo nas dge slong ma'i ston par bskos pa'i dge slong la kha zas cung zad kyi phyir chos ston no zhes skur ba 'debs pa'o/
sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan te, phyi dro'i kha zas mi za ba'o/
1) gral rim bzhin du zas ston 'gyed pa/ 2) lto chas dngos su bshams pa/
bla ma dang mchod gnas la zas sam bza' ba phul ba/ dge 'dun gyi sde la zas 'brel cung zad 'jog thub byung/
pa'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma brgyud nas khyim bdag la rang gi bza' btung sbyor du bcug pa'o/
zas gos 'bol lhag / mi tshang mar zas mang gos mang gang la ci dgos byung ba/
1) za ma dngos gtsang ba/ 2) sngar rgya gar gyi rgyal po zas gtsang ma ste shakya thub pa'i yab kyi mtshan/ 3) (mngon) yungs dkar/
rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras ston pa shakya thub pa/
zas mang nyung gi tshod/ rnam kun zas tshod mang nyung ran par za ba/

kham gyi zas dang, reg pa'i zas dang, sems pa'i zas dang, rnam shes kyi zas te bzhi ste, tshe 'di la gnas dbang po rgyas pa'i don du kham zas dang, brten pa rnam shes rgyas pa'i don du reg pa'i zas te gnyis dang, phyi mar srid pa gzhan 'phen pa'i don du sems pa'i zas dang, srid pa gzhan 'grub pa'i don du rnam shes kyi zas dang gnyis te bsdoms na bzhi'o/
za ma za stangs ma legs pa/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye min khyim pa mu stegs pa 'dug pa'i sar zhag gcig las lhag par bsdad de zas za ba'o/

nyes byas kyi sde tshan bzhi pa, zas len pa'i sde la, zas lhung bzed kyi kha las mtho bar len pa dang, 'bras chan dang tshod ma mnyam par len pa, gral rim mthar chags su mi len pa, lhung bzed la zur mig bltas te len pa, zas ma byung gong nas lhung bzed bzed snga ba, tshod ma 'dod nas 'bras chan gyis tshod ma 'gebs pa, 'bras chan 'dod nas tshod mas 'bras chan 'gebs pa, bza' bca'i steng du snod gzhan bzed pa ste brgyad do/
ba'i ltung byed: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa las kha zas bzang po ci bder ma bstabs kyang, chog mi shes par bslangs te zos pa'o/
bzas pa'i 'phro ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la sder zhabs dang, pha la, za 'phro, lhag ma bcas so,
/ dzeheshakim...1) rang byung zangs/ 2) rin po che du ma phyogs gcig tu bzhus pa/
(yul) sbrang bu'i rigs chen po zhig /
nges med kyi sgra zar zir mang po/ khrims rnga sogs kyi sgra dang zi ber mang du byung ngo/
1) me stag / lcags dmar la tho ba rgyag dus zi ra 'tshub pa/ 2) sngo sman zi ra dkar po dang zi ra nag po'i spyi ming/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha la cung skyur, zhu rjes drod, nus pas glo tshad kyi nad dang, kha zas mi 'ju ba, dang ga 'gag pa bcas la phan/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la cung tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas mchin nad grang ba dang pho ba'i drod nyams nas zas mi 'ju ba la phan, yi ga 'byed par byed/
sngo sman zhig tshad pa sel bar phan/
lus sems mi brtan pa'i bzi khyom khyom/ chang gis bzi nas zi ri bi ri byas song/
sgra skad sgrog tshul zhig / sbrang ma mang pos sgra zi ri rir bsgrags te 'phur lding byed pa/ rlung zi ri rir rgyag pa/
(yul) lcug mas bslas pa'i sa sogs 'khur snod kyi phyogs bzhi'i ru shing/
gser dngul bsres nas bzhus pa'i gsha' dkar ram ti tsha ltar gyi lcags shig /

mtsho sngon po'i byang shar phyogs tsong chu'i chu sked kyi lho 'gram na chags pa'i grong khyer zhig ste, tung han rgyal rabs skabs zhi tu'u rdzong btsugs pa nas bzung, sung rgyal rabs kyi skabs bar zi ling kro'u dang, ming rgyal rabs skabs zi ling we, ching rgyal rabs skabs zi ling rdzong bcas rim bzhin du 'gyur nas 1944 lor gzhi nas zi ling grong khyer du bsgyur, da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gnas yul yin zhing, zhing chen yongs kyi chab srid dang, dpal 'byor, 'grim 'grul, rig gnas sogs kyi lte gnas yin/
sga rigs mdog dmar shas che ba zhig ste, nus pas drod skyed cing, bad rlung sel bar byed/
bod mda' bye brag pa zhig gi ming/
ser gling mtsho'i ming gzhan zhig
kha dog dmar la dkar shas che ba, ..ras zing dkar/
kha dog dmar skya/ gos dar zing skya/
dmag 'khrug / zing 'khrug lhing chags/ nang khul gyi zing 'khrug /
1) krong nger langs tshul/ ri rtse mang po zing nge bar gyen du bstan pa/ skra zing nge bar 'dzings pa/ 2) lhing 'jags med pa'am zang zing/ las don zing nge ba/ yul lung gi sgrig lam zing nge ba/
'khrug zing/ zing cha langs pa/ zing cha slong ba/ lung par zing cha med pa/ nges med zing cha langs pa shar na de ma thag tu zhod 'jags gtong ba/
1. (tha mi dad pa) lang ba/ spu zing ba/ ba spu zing ba/ 2. lhing mi 'jags pa/ dus zing/ sems zing ba/
zing skya dmar shas che ba/
mdog zing skya cung zad smug pa
skra dang kha spu sogs zing ba/ 'bu srin zing zing byed pa/ mgo skra zing zing/
zang zing tshub tshub kyi rnam pa/ las ka brel ba zing long long/ dmag 'khrug zing long long/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro zing long long/
nyi ma 'khyol sla ba'am mgo 'khor po/ slob gnyer byas pas dpe cha legs po ma shes kyang sems la shin tu phan pa dang zid thung ba zhig byung/
/ 1) (rgya) 'byung rtsis kyi spar kha brgyad kyi gras shig / 2) gnyen/ dgra zin gyi dbye mtshams 'byed pa/

1) nad bcos thabs rnams gsal bar 'khod pa'i sman gzhung gces btus shig / 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gnyan nad dang, gza' nad, srin nad bcas la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar mo mkhar thabs so,
reg zig gam zin bris/ brjed byang zin thun/ bya rim zin thun du bris pa/
tshig don blo la zin thub pa'i ched du bris pa'i yi ge/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) nges pa/ dpe cha zin pa/ gsungs pa rnams blor zin pa/ tshig don bzung yang ma zin pa/ 2) thebs pa/ rkun ma lag par zin pa/ bya ba byed skabs tshang ma gzhan phan gyi bsam pa'i rtsis zin dgos/ phabs kyi rtsis zin pa/ 2. tshar ba'i don ston rogs byed pa'i tshig grogs shig / las ka byas zin pa/ tshogs 'du grol zin pa/ skyes zin ma 'gag pa/

sgra'i skye mched kyi nang gses, zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra ste, sgra'i rgyur gyur pa'i 'byung ba de gang zag gi dbang pos zin pa skyes bu'i ngag gi sgra dang, thal mo brdab pa'i sgra lta bu'o/
gang zag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sa khams sogs/
sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs/
1) tshig don blo la zin rim bzhin du bris pa'i yi ge/ zin bris bkod deb/ 2) thog ma'i ma yig /
tshar rgyu med pa'i las kyi 'khor lo/
yi ge pa'am brjed tho 'bri mkhan/
(rgya) 'byung rtsis spar kha brgyad kyi bye brag cig /
zin bris rgyag pa'i shog bu/ thig brgyab zin shog /
1. thags mkhan gyi yo byad cig / 2. tshad chung tsam zhig / char zim bur 'bab pa/ mig zim bur byas te nyi mar lta ba/
mig 'byed 'dzum ran pa'i lta stangs/ spyan zim mer gzigs pa/
1) mig 'byed ma 'dzum gyi lta stangs/ 2) char pa chung ngu'am 'jam char/ 'jam char zim zim 'bab/ gangs zim zim du 'bab/
bung ba'i gshog sgra lta bu/
bung ba'i gshog sgra lta bu/ bung ba'i gshog sgra zir zir du sgrog pa/
gzi brjid dam nus pa/ rngam zil/ zil che ba/ snyan zil srid rtse'i bar du khyab pa/
gzhan sde zhum par byed pa/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ pha rol po zil gyis mi gnon pa/ smra ba ngan pa rnams zil gyis mnan pa/ so so'i sger sems zil gyis ma mnan pa/
zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched
ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bsgrubs pas dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar dmigs pa ltar snang bas gzhan zil gyis mnan nas rang yid mi 'phrog par gyed pa'o/
zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad

dbyibs kyi zil gnon bzhi dang, kha dog gi zil gnon bzhi bcas brgyad de, ting nge 'dzin la brten nas dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar dmid pa ltar sprul bsgyur la dbang bas gzhan zil gyis mnan nas rang gi yid mi 'phrog par byed pa'o/
zil gyis gnon pa'i gad mo
yi dam lha'i bzhad pa brgyad kyi bye brag cig /
(rnying) sbrang rtsis sbrus pa'am sbags pa/
rngam zil can/ 'dra sku zil chags po/ byas rjes zil chags po/
1) zil gyis gnon pa'i bsdus tshig 2) (mngon) me pho rta/
zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad dang don gcig
rtswa shing me tog sogs kyi rtser chags pa'i chu thigs/ zil pa'i 'od 'tsher ba/ rtswa rtser zil pa skya phrom me bar chags 'dug / me tog gi 'dab lo'i zil pa/ nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra/
1) zla tho nas bshad pa'i dus tshigs ston byed cig / 2) rtswa dang me tog sogs kyi rtser chags pa'i zil pa'am chu thigs dkar hril le ba/
rngam zil gyi shugs sam nus pa/
(yul) lcug mas bslas pa'i slel po/
na tsha/ grang rlung gis gnod rkyen byas nas lus zug langs pa/ rus tshigs la zug brgyab na spru dkar dang bong nga sogs kyi 'joms sman gtong ba/
1) na tsha mngon gsal thon pa'i nyams/ lus na zug ge ba zhig 'dug / gzugs gzhi tsha zug ge bar bdog / 2) blo la bab pa'i tshul/ mig lam du zug ge ba zhig mchis/ yul bzang po sems la zug ge ba/

1) na tsha'i zug gzer/ mya ngan gyi zug rngu zug pa/ glo bur glo bur du lus la zug rngu rgyag pa/ rlung stabs kyis zug rngu langs pa/ nyin mtshan med par zug rngus mnar ba/ sman khab brgyab ste zug rngu 'byin pa/ 2) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig / 3) ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal/
rdel 'gags nad kyi nang tshan rde'u lgang pa'i kha la zug nas chu thigs thigs tsam las mi thon pa rgyun du sdom zhing gting du zug na na zhing gzer la dri chu gtan 'gags ma yin pa thon dka' ba zhig /
phar 'bigs pa'am zug pa'i nus pa/ zug nus med pa'i mda' 'phen de, dman bu mos mthong yang ngo re tsha/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) 'bigs pa'am 'dzul ba/ rtsa ba gting ring du zug pa/ rkang pa gcig la tsher ma brgya zug / mgo la skyes pa'i rwa co mig la zug / ngo mtshar gyi rnam pa mig la zug pa/ bu lon mang po zug pa/ 2) khyis 'cha' ba/ mtshan mor khyis zug / khyi mang pos zug pa/ sha khyis ri dwags 'ded skabs zug pa/
nad kyi zug rngu'i gzer/ nga yi lus la zug gzer shin tu che/
lus la zug gzer rgyag pa/ glo bur du mgo la na zug langs te sman khang la phyin pa/

1.'dzin pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) gnyis/ dge slob zung gis brtag dpyad byas pa/ phru gu mtshe ma zung gcig / mi zung gis 'degs pa/ zung du bgrang ba/ zung du byung ba/ zung du ma mchis pa/ 2) (mngon) zung du 'brel ba la ya gnyis dgos pas grangs gnyis mtshon/
1) cha 'grig pa/ sgo glegs zung nga/ 2) sgo'i dkri lcags bkan sa'i mdzo sna/ 3) (rnying) 1,phur pa/ 2,gos sogs 'gel sa'i thag pa'i gdang bu/

1) rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi shar khul du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de cin an kren du yod/ 2) chu bo zhig rmin cang gtsang po'i yan lag cig /

1) mi 'dra ba gnyis gcig tu 'byor ba'am mthun par 'byor ba/ zhi lhag zung 'jug / bde stong zung 'jug / 2) rdzogs rim lnga'i nang gses shig ste, shes rab stong pa nyid dang thabs snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'am, thabs lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po dang shes rab 'od gsal gyi stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa dang, yul rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang yul can mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'o/
sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang/
snang stong zung 'jug dang, rig stong zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug gsal stong zung 'jug bcas bzhi'o/
grangs gnyis dang ldan pa'am yod pa/ pha ma zung ldan gyi phru gu /

yig gzugs 'dra ba tshig rkang gi thog mtha' bar gsum du bkod pa'i sgo nas mtha' thog sbyar ba dang, bar du chod pa dang ma chod pa sogs zung ldan gyi rnam pa sna tshogs sgra kho nas ston pa'i rgyan zhig /

gnyis mnyam du yod pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la cha dang, gnyis gnyis, gnyis sdeb, dor, zung bcas so, zung 'brel, gnyis mnyam du gshibs pa/ rgya bod zung 'brel/ chos srid zung 'brel/ zhi drag zung 'brel/
gzungs rgyag kyang zer, tshem skud kyis zungs rgyag pa'am len rgyag pa/
khab tshugs ring len byas pa'i tshem bu'am len rgyag pa/
lus stobs zhan pa'am skyo ba/

mur gong gi sha sogs skam pa phyi sha yi zungs shor ba dang, kha zas mi 'ju ba sogs nang gi me drod kyi zungs shor ba, 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba nyams pa sogs gsang ba'i rlung khrag gi zungs shor ba gsum mo/
(rnying) gnyen/ dgra zun gnyis kyi dbye ba 'byed shes pa/
(tha mi dad pa) 'gags pa dang mi mngon par gyur pa/ khab mig zub nas skud sne thar mi thub pa/ srubs ka zub pa/ mi 'dzad rgya mtsho'i gnyer ma, mi zub rdo yi ri mo,
kha btags kyi bye brag cig /
(tha mi dad pa) kha rub pa/ mig zum pa/ rma kha zum pa/ me tog zum pa/

1.'dzur ba'i skul tshig 2. 1) logs dang gzhogs/ lam zur/ mtsho zur/ g.yas zur du sdod pa/ gyon zur du langs pa/ zur du bzur ba/ zur gsal/ 2) mtha' gnyis 'brel sa'i grwa'am sne/ zur gsum/ zur lnga/ ri zur/ kha zur/ mig zur/ rtsig zur/ 3) cha shas/ sum zur gcig / lnga zur gnyis/ zur gtod/ 4) dngos su ma yin pa'i zhor/ zur gyis brjod pa/ zur gyis smod pa/ zur gyis ston pa/ tshig ngan zur mda' 'phen pa/
zur du bkar ba ste logs su bton pa/ 'go nad can zur bkar gyis sman khang du bskyal ba/
zur du bkod pa ste, logs su bris pa/ brjed tho zur bkod/
zur du bkol pa ste, logs su phye ba'am bton pa/ kha tsha dgos gtud rigs zur bkol byas nas bzhag pa/
zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje

mtshan gzhan dharma sva ste, rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug lor shar dwags po'i sa cha la thog zur mkhar du sku 'khrungs, thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas spyi dang gso ba rig pa rtsal du thon par sbyangs, gsung rtsom dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen pod shal khra mo, rgyud kyi dka' gnad rnams la dri tshig dngul dkar me long sogs mang du mdzad, shar phyogs mngon dga' zhes byar gnyal lor byar gsum, e nyang kong gsum bcas kyi sman pa thams cad bsdus te rin chen 'khrungs dpe'am sman ngo gsal byed, ro skor lcags kyi phreng ba, bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod sogs sman gyi ro dang, nus pa, zhu rjes, ngo bo, nges tshig byed las bcas gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos brtsams, dgung lo sum cu so bdun shing lug lor 'das/
zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po

zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje dang gdung rgyud gcig ste, rang byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul lor sku 'khrungs, chung ngu'i dus nas thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas rnams gsan, khyad par du gso ba rig par 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med par gyur te, zur mkhar gong ma'i bzhed pa gtso bor bstan nas rtsa rgyud dang, bshad rgyud, phyi ma rgyud kyi chu mdo yan gyi 'grel pa mes po'i zhal lung zhes pa mdzad, gzhan yang rje mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam thar dang, rgyud bzhi bka' bstan gyi 'gal spongs la phyi ltar na sangs rgyas kyi bka', nang ltar na pandi ta'i bstan bcos, gsang ba ltar na bod kyi bstan bcos su bzhed pa sogs gso dpyad skor la gsung rtsom shin tu mang zhing, snyan ngag me long ma'i me long zhes pa sogs rig gnas gzhan skor la'ang sna tshogs mchis, g.yu thog phyag bris ma'i rgyud bzhi gser mchan sogs gna' rabs kyi tshad ldan yig cha rnams la khungs bcol te rgyud bzhi la zhus dag mdzad cing nang so yar rgyab pa sbyin bdag tu bskul nas par du brkos pa'i gra thang par ma zhes rgyud bzhi'i par snga shos su gyur pa de'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa sogs sku tshe hril por gso ba'i bstan don kho na mdzad, dgung lo bdun cu lhag tsam bzhugs par grags/
khang pa'i thog ka'i zur gyi g.yab phibs/
phra mo'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsam blo sngon btang gi sgo nas go bya'i nang don brda thabs zur gyis ston pa'i phra mo'i rgyan zhig /
(mngon) bud med sgeg pa'i nyams can/
zur du 'bul ba/ snyan zhu zur sgron/ mjal dar zur sgron zhu ba/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dge rgyas rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
cha shas gcig / sgor mo'i zur gcig la mo'o tse gcig red/
1) gzhal yas khang gi zur lcam phra'u zer ba/ 2) khang pa'i thog zur du 'khel ba'i lcam/
khang pa'i thog zur la yod pa'i khang chung/
skad yig zur chag pa ste zur nyams pa/
1) «ababhramsha»...2) yig gzugs sam sgra zur nyams pa'i skad/
1) dmigs bsal can la sprod rgyu'i dngos skyes/ 2) logs su yod pa'i dngos chas/
zur chung shes rab grags pa

gsang sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zur mes dbon rnam gsum gyi ya gyal, rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo bcu bzhi pa shing stag la 'khrungs, zur po ches gsos pa'i bu dod yin la, brag rgya bo dgu 'dus kyi rtser sgrub pa mdzad de rdzogs chen mngon par grub cing, spobs pa mtha' yas par gyur pas bde gshegs rgya bo par grags, rab byung dang po'i shing stag lor 'das/
yi ge'i rtsa ba'i zur la btags pa'i 'grel mchan/
1) sne mo chag pa'am zad pa/ so phag gi zur nyams pa/ 2) sgra zur nyams pa/ skad dang yi ge'i zur nyams na go brda mi 'phrod/
brda tsam bstan pas yongs rdzogs shes pa'i dpe/
zur mang gi dbyibs kyi nang nas zur nas zur du 'debs pa'i thig /
khang pa'i zur gyi thog ka/
zur sne/ rtsig pa'i zur gdong/ ri'i zur gdong/
1) zur snon rgyag pa/ dran gso'i zur 'debs/ 2) kha skong/ tshig don gyi zur 'debs/ nor rdzas kyi zur 'debs/ 'tsho chas kyi zur 'debs/
logs su 'don pa/ mkho che'i dngos rdzas tshong khrom zur 'don byed pa/
1) rtsig pa'i zur gyi rdo/ 2) khang pa'i rtsa ba'i zur gdong du bslangs pa'i rdo nar mo/
kha snon/ mi grangs zur snon rgyag pa/
/ 1) las 'gan 'phos tshar ba'i zur pa/ mkhan zur/ bka' zur/ 2) lte ba ma yin pa logs su sdod mkhan/ hor zur/

kya 'byung gnas: sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zur mes dbon rnam gsum du grags pa'i zur po che shakya 'byung gnas, rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo nyer lnga pa chu stag lor 'khrungs, tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen du bzhugs, 'ug pa lung gi lha khang bzhengs pas 'ug pa lung pa zhes grags, rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud 'grel pa sgrub thabs so sor phye ste bshad, slob ma rtse mo bzhi dang sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad sogs mang, mthar sgro phug gi lha khang brtsigs, drug cu rtsa gcig la gshegs/
1) skra'i rtse mo nang du bkug ste bcongs pa'i zur phud/ 2) gral nas phyung ba/ nad pa rnams zur phud/ legs par bsgrubs pa'i gras zur phud/
(mngon) zur phud lnga pa'am 'jam dpal dbyangs/
/ bya ba zur phyin par byed pa/
khang pa'i zur du bstan pa'i dkar gsal/
logs su 'phrad pa'am sger la gtug pa/
lag rtags gla rngan sogs sger du ster ba/
shing gi zur la rgyag byed kyi 'bur len zhig /
chags pa'i nyams sam sgeg chos kyis lta tshul zhig /
1) zur cha med pa/ 2) (mngon) sgor sgor ram zlum po/

gsang sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zur mes dbon rnam gsum ni, dang po zur po che shakya 'byung gnas te, khong gis bstan pa phyi dar la snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs, gnyis pa zur chung shes rab grad pa'am bde gshegs rgya bo pas yal ga bskyangs, gsum pa rje sgro phug pa chen po shakya seng ges lo 'bras rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/
phyogs tsam dang cha tsam/ mang po shod mi dgos par zur tsam gyis go ba/ zur tsam rtogs pa/ don snying zur tsam sdud pa/
logs su 'dzoms pa/ tshogs chung zur 'tshogs kyis gros sdur byed pa/
don dag logs su smra ba/ dgongs skor snyan seng zur zhu byed pa/
logs su 'dzul ba/ 'brel yod kyi mi sna gzhan rnams tshogs 'dur zur zhugs byed pa/
tshig zur gyis kha gtong ba'am, go rgyu can bshad pa/ khrel dgod zur za/ zur za'i gtam/ zur za ngan smras/ zur za'i ri mo/
ma yig gi logs su bkod pa'i kha skong yi ge /
zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud kyi bshad sgros dang, sman gyi ngos 'dzin sogs srol rgyun ma nyams pa 'dzin mkhan gyi brgyud 'dzin spyi la'o/
zur mkhar ba'i lugs kyi lus kyi dri chu 'gags pa phyir 'dren pa'i sngo sman zhig /
zur mkhar ba'i lugs kyi sman chu rtsi/
zur mkhar ba'i lugs kyi sman snyi ba'i rigs shig /
zur mkhar ba'i lud kyi bong nga dkar po'i rigs shig /
1) sger ram logs su bshad pa/ 2) zhor gyi 'grel bshad/
zur du btang ba'i dngos po de rtsis len dgos zer ba'i don/
1) dbyibs zur gsum ldan gyi gzong/ 2) gru gsum/ mgo rus pa'i dkyil 'khor ma zhig na, kha zur gsum gyi gtam la 'dzad pa med/
logs su sprod pa'i gsol ras/
/ 1) sne'am mtha'/ ri'i ze/ brag g.yang gi ze nas rta'i kha bskyogs pa/ 2) rkyen/ kha mchu'i ze/ 3) rngog ma/
ri'i sgang zur/ ri bo mthon po'i ze kha nas bltas na mthong rgya che/
snga dus bod kyi bla chen mi chen sogs kyi rta'i ze ba g.yog byed kyi rgyan/
1) ze ba dang sgro/ 2) rtse zhwa'i ze sgro/
rta drel gyi ske'i ze ba'am rngog ma/
sde dge 'bri chu'i shar rgyud khams rdzogs chen dgon gyi nye 'dabs kyi rnying ma'i dgon chen zhig /
rngog ma dang rnga ma'i bsdus ming/ rta drel gyi ze mjug gzhur/
1) bya de'i mgo'i sha 'phru/ 2) sgo lcags kyi nang rtsib/ sgo lcags kyi ze prog btsan po/ 3) (rnying) 1,bdar ba/ 2,g.yer po/
/ 1) rngog ma/ rta'i ze/ phag ze/ de pho'i ze ba/ 2) me tog gi ge sar/ pad ma'i ze ba/
ze tsha'i kha sgyur gyi skyur rtsi/
lan tshwa'i rigs shig ste, ro lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rdo skran dang, lgang pa'i rde'u, ma zhu ba'i nad rnams bzhu bar byed/
rta drel sogs kyi rngog ma dang rnga ma/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon yul du yod/
1) rta drel gyi ze ba'i spu langs pa/ 2) kha mchu sogs kyi rkyen langs pa/
spu mdog dmar po zhig / rta 'ol ba dang zeg pa/
1.(yul) lhung ba/ yig rigs bor zegs su ma song ba/ 2.rnying pa/ gos hrul zegs pa/

gzegs ma'ang zer, chu'i thigs pa'am chu rdul/ chu thigs kyi zegs ma/ char pa'i zed ma/ chu gtor rlangs 'khor gyis zegs ma mang du 'thor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu thigs dang, chu'i zegs ma, thigs pa bcas so,
(mngon) zas kyi ro 'gugs byed spod sman gyi bye brag cig /
(yul) sen rtsa logs pa'am sen skyi logs pa/ sen zed langs pa/
me tog 'dab ma'i dbus kyi ge sar ram sgang bu/

1.'od kyi zer mdangs/ 'od zer/ nyi zer/ chu zer/ tsha zer/ 2.mi 'dod pa dang, ma rangs pa'i tshig shugs ston byed phrad cig / chos thams cad rang ngos nas bden par grub zer/ de skad zer/ skabs der 'jig rten pa rnams zhing la so nam byed pa'i srol dar zhing, bsod nams kyi mthu las dngul zangs lcags gsum yang thon zer/

1) nges gtan med pa'i don/ 'byung khungs klu yin 'dul byed khung, gnyen po rlung yin zlog thabs mang, 'phral du 'tshubs kyang phugs mi skyon, zer skad/ 2) gzhan gyi skad cha la cung zad zur za ba'i tshig /
shod srol lam zer rgyun/ de lta bu'i zer sgros gtan nas med/ sbir gtam tshang ma rang gar gyi zer sgros las mi bden/ sgrung gtam zer sgros/ zer sgros nyan par cha bzhag pa/ zer sgros tsam las med/
shod ci dgos te mi dgos zer ba'i don/
sbyar dug gi nang tshan nyi ma'i zer la rta byas nas bskur ba'i dug cig /

1.(tha dad pa) rjod pa/ skad cha de 'dra zer ba'i don gang yin/ ci zer ba la nyan/ zer tshad bden min, btso tshad sha min/ lug ma gsod bla mas zer, sha khyer shog bla mas zer/ zer sa bu mo la zer, phog sa mna' ma la phog / 2.nges gzung gi sgra/ kham bu zer ba ha cang mngar mo zhig yod/
/ 1) zegs ma/ chu'i zer ma/ 2) rlung/ zer ma rlung dang mnyam 'gro yin/
/ 1) sems can gzugs mo'am sgang/ 2) bya pu shud/
shod srol lam zer rgyun/ gzhan gyi zer rigs bden min sna tshogs 'dug /

1) ma rangs pa'i tshig ste, gzhan gyi 'dod pa'am zer tshul la zur za'i tshig / phyi rol pas 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad lha tshangs pas bskrun pa'o zhes zer lo/ de 'dra zer lo tsam thos pa las khungs btsan pa zhig ma rnyed/ 2) bshad pa tsam/ kha nas zer lo tsam min par lag len bstar dgos/
bshad sgros/ sngar gyi zer srol la de ltar 'dug
1.tha dad par 'jug pa'i za ba'i skul tshig 2.(rnying) khams dang rang bzhin/
sa mtho sar chu rgyun 'dren pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi ming/
chu gyen la 'dren byed kyi 'khor lo/
yul 'khor skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag gi gtso bo'am grags che shos/
lus kyi gzi mdangs/ lus kyi zo mdog rgyas pa/ zo mdog bde ba/
1) khams bde zhing las su rung ba/ 2) bzhin mdangs gsal ba/ 3) brtson 'grus can/
/ 1) 'jal byed shing snod/ mda' zo/ 2) 'o zho thug pa sogs kyi snod cig / 'o zo/ thug zo/
zo ba'i snod dkri byed lcug thag /
zo ba'i nang du chags pa'i spris ma/
yun ring spyad pa'i 'o zho blug snod shing zo'i nang la chags pa'i mar dang 'o spris/
1) byug rdzas khyad par ba zhig / 2) mkhur tshos sogs la bskus pa'i ri mo/
zangs rag shing sogs las bzos pa'i 'o zho thag pa sogs kyi snod cig /
zo ba'i nang lcug ma sil bu bskor te bzhag par 'o ma blugs te chags pa'i bcud ldan gyi rtsi zhig /

/ 1) btsong bya'i rdzas/ tshong zog / dngos zog / zog gong/ zog sgam/ zog mngags gna rgya/ zog gong chung na rgyu spus zher po'i rtags/ zog legs gong khe/ 2) sgo phyugs/ zog gi tshos gzhi phyi nas mthong, dgra bo'i lkog jus khog na yod/ 3) g.yo sgyu/ zog chen gyis rgyu za ba/
1) tshong zhog la 'gel ba'i khral/ 2) phyugs rigs la 'gel ba'i khral/
ma brin pa'am phan mi thogs pa'i zog ro/
dngos zog gi rin thang/ zog thang brtan gnas/
1) tshong zog gi bdag po/ 2) phyugs zog gi bdag po/ 3) (yul) bal po'i tshong pa/
g.yo khram mkhan nam zol ma/ dam pa mi brin zog po brin pa'i dus, zog po phal cher mkhas pa'i gral du bzhag /
g.yo sgyus mi gzhan la zing 'drog slong ba po'i dpe/
dngos po'i rgyu dag bzang ngan/ zog spus zhib dpyod/
/ 1) g.yo sgyu rdzun can gyi bud med/ 2) rdzun nam g.yo sgyu'i ming/
g.yo khram can gyi mi mo/
ma yin yin khul byed pa'am tshul 'chos/ zog rdzun mkhas par 'khrul ba de, ra gan gser du 'khrul ba yin/
ma brin pa'am mkho med kyi dngos zog /
dngos po'am tshong zog / smar min zong thog nas rtsis rgyag pa/ zong du byed pa/ zong du mi byed pa/ zong khral, tshong zog gi khral/
(rgya) gna' rabs kyi sa ming, deng sang si khron zhing chen gyi zung 'phan sa khul/

/ 1) skar khyim du rgyu ba'i gza' zla ba'i go la ste nam mkha'i ri bong can/ ming gi rnam grangs la ku mud gnyen dang, ga bur dbang, rgya mtsho skyes, rgya mtsho dga', rgya mtsho'i mar gsar, rgyu skar bdag po, rgyu skar gtso, bcu drug cha, cha gter, chags skyed, chu las skyes, gnyis skyes rgyal po, steng 'phur, thos ldan dbang, bdud rtsi spro, bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas, bdud rtsi'i 'od can, bdud rtsi'i 'od, bdud rtsis mtshan, bde 'byung gtsug rgyan, nam mkha'i rna ba, pad ma'i dgra, mun 'joms, dbang phyug gtsug rgyan, tshes bdag mtshan mo'i bdag po, mtshan mo'i nor bu, mtshan mor byed, 'od dkar can, ri dwags mtshan ma, ri bong can, ri bong 'dzin, shar gyi thig le, bsil byed, bsil sbyin mkhan, bsil zer can bcas so, 2) dus kyi zla ba, spyir zla ba'i dkar cha dang dmar cha 'phel 'grib bco lnga re ste zhag sum cur longs tshe zla ba'i tha snyad btags pa de tshes zla yin la, gzhan yang nyin zla dang khyim zla zhes pa'ang yod/ zla ba ngo re bzhin/ zla thog lo bzhag lo khar zla mthud/ 3) res gza' bdun gyi gnyis pa/ 4) (mngon) 1,zla ba gcig las med pas grangs gcig mtshon/ khu ba/
