byas rjes 'jog mkhan la bdag rkyen gnang ba'i bka' gtan tshigs/
(tha mi dad pa) gzings pa, gzing pa,, zang zing du langs pa/ spu gzings pa/ sma ra dang smin ma gyen du gzing ba/

/ 1) chu thog tu shing gdung ma'am smyug ma bsgrigs te brtsigs nas 'dren pa/ shing rnams chu thog gzings bcas te drangs pa yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la chu gter lam dang, gzings chen no, 2) gru gzings sam gru rdzings/
la'i dang pan chen sogs bla ma go gnas: mthon po yod pa tsho'i sdod sa'i khang pa'i sgo 'gram du lta srung byed mkhan phal che ba mi byings las gzugs stobs che ba sha stag yod/
sdod sa'i khang mig chung gras/
sngar bod sa gnas kyi rgyal po'i sku srung dmag mi yin zhing, nye dus smon lam chen po'i skabs ru sgrig tu yong ba'i dmag mi'i gras bod snga rabs pa'i chas gos can gyi dmag mi khag cig /
gzims pa'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
sngar sku drag sogs kyi mdun g.yog byed mkhan/
ba ste sngar sa rten la 'khri ba'i bod: snga rabs pa'i chas gos can gyi dmag mi
drag gi mdun la rgyun du g.yog rgyug: mkhan
nyal ba'i skabs 'ding rgyu'i rkyong gdan/ gzims khang, mal sa'i khang pa'am sdod sa'i khang pa/
nyal sa'am sdod sa'i ras gur/
khang pa'i sgo ming byang can/

1. (tha mi dad pa) nyal ba'i zhe sa/ mtshan mor gzims pa/ mal du gzims pa/ 2. nyal 'dug dang 'brel ba'i ming 'ga'i sngon du sbyar nas zhe sa'i ming bzo ba'i tshig grogs shig / gzims sgo/ gzims khang/ gzims chas/
1) mal chas blug snod 'bog 'jol/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dbang sgyur gras sku drag mi chen gyi g.yog pos rgyab tu 'khyer rgyu'i 'bog sgril/
sngar bod rgyal po'i nyal khang rang la g.yog byed mkhan te phyis kyi gzim dpon dang 'dra ba zhig / gzim dpon
rmi lam gyi zhe sa/ gzims lam brtag pa/
sdigs stangs kyis bltas pa'am khros pa'i lta stangs/

(tha dad pa) 1) mnar ba dang gdung ba/ gdung ba/ gdung bas gzir ba/ nad kyis gzir ba/ sdug bsngal mang pos gzir ba/ 2) gzas pa dang kha gtod pa'am snun pa/ 'ben la gzir nas me sgyogs rgyag pa/ dgra bo'i snying khar mtshon chas gzir ba/
shan 'byed dam bar gyi dpang po/
1. rtsod gleng bar 'dum byed mkhan/ 2. drang po/ blo gzu bor gnas pa/ gzu bo'i tshig la brtsi bkur byed pa/ gzu bo'i bya ba byed pa/ gzu log khrims log /
sems drang po/ bdag bstod gzhan smod mi byed par, gzu blo'i gtam gyis thams cad dga'/
bden rdzun dbye ba'i blon po drang po/
gsham 'og nas thag gcod pa/ lugs dang 'gal ba'i gzu mas bkod byas mi chog /
rgya gar gyi rgyal po zhig gi ming/
1) tshul 'chos/ 2) rang bzo/ gzu lum smra ba/ sum rtags don gyi brda sprod dang, 'brel med gzu lum nor ba red/ 3) ma brtags pa'i spyod pa/
1) brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byas par skad cha shod mkhan dang las ka byed mkhan/ 2) rang bzo can/
cha bzhir bgos pa'i cha gcig / sha khog: gcig la stod gzug gnyis dang smad gzug gnyis yod

/ 1) gzugs su rung ba'i dngos po ste, reg pas gzugs su yod pa dang, yul spyad pas gzugs su yod pa'i chos, gzugs phung dang don gcig go/ dbyibs gzugs/ kha dog gi gzugs/ rnam par rig par byed pa'i gzugs/ rnam par rig par byed pa ma yin pa'i gzugs/ gzugs dang grib ma 'bral med 'grogs pa bzhin/ gzugs med na grib nag yong don med/ 2) lus po/ gzugs po che/ gzud mdzes shing spyod lam khyad du 'phags pa/ 3) (mngon) gzugs kyi phung po gcig tu nges pas grangs gcig mtshon/
phyi'i skye mched drug gi nang gses shig ste, mig shes kyi yul du gyur pa dbyibs dang kha dog gis bsdus pa'i gzugs rnams so/
khams bco brgyad las gzugs kyi phung po'i char gtogs pa bcu ste, mig gi khams nas lus kyi khams bar gyi yul can dbang po lnga dang, gzugs kyi khams nas reg bya'i khams bar gyi yul don lnga ste bcu'o/
nad pa'i srog tshab tu glud du gtong ba'i 'dra gzugs/

sngar gyi gtam rgyud du drang srong zhig gi bu mo gzugs kyi nyi ma zer ba de rgyal pos btsan shed byas nas btsun mor khrid skabs pha rgan gyi bslab bya brjed cing, mi ngan dang 'grogs te dogs zon ma byas pas mgo skor thebs rkyen rgyal pos rgyang 'bud btang ba dang phyis su mi ngan de rnams 'gyod sems skyes te sngar byas g.yo sgyu'i sdig pa mthol bshags kyis bu mo la bzod gsol zhus pa ltar yang bskyar pho brang du log pa'i sgrung gi lo rgyus gzhir bzhag gis bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi zlos gar lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung zhig /
gzugs can rnams kyi rtsom gzhi'i phra rdul/
phung po lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rgyu gzugs dang 'bras gzugs sogs gzud su rung ba'i dngos po du ma spungs pa'am 'dus pa'o/
mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

zla dkyil sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs te zla ba sngas dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las spyan la sogs pas phye ba'i zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi lha de dang de'i gzugs su bsgom pa, bya rgyud lha drug gi nang gses shig /
dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pas gdul bya dag dang ma dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor gzhan don du longs sku chags can dang, sprul sku chags bral gyi gzugs snang ston pa'i sku'o/

1) lus khams/ 2) ri rab kyi steng gi bar snang la gnas bcas pa'i bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar gyi gnas ris rnams te, dwangs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od lus dang ldan pa dang, 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral zhing gzugs la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'o/
spang brgya brgyad cu: gzugs khams kyi sgom spang lnga po de bsam gtan bzhi po re re nas chen po'i chen po sogs sgom spang skor dgus phye bas brgya dang brgyad cu/
gzugs khams kyi sgom spang lnga
gzugs kyi khams su sgom lam gyis spang bar bya ba ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, nga rgyal, 'jig lta, mthar lta bcas so/
gzugs khams kyi sgom spang gsum
gzugs kyi khams su sgom lam gyi spang bya ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, nga rgyal bcas gsum/
spang nyer brgyad: gzugs khams su khong khro med pas, 'dod khams kyi mthong spang so gnyis las bden bzhi'i spang bya khong khro bzhi dor ba'i lhag ma nyer brgyad/
gzugs khams kyi lha rnams kyi gnas bzhi ste, bsam gtan dang po'i gnas dang, bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas dang, bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas dang, bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas te bzhi'o/
gzugs khams kyi gnas bzhi dang don gcig

dus 'khor gyi lugs su: ri rab kyi dpral ba'i cha bzhi la, 'og min dang, shin tu mthong, mi gdung ba, mi che ba bcas bzhi gnas, sna yi cha bzhir, 'bras bu che, bsod nams skyes, sprin med, dge rgyas bcas bzhi gnas, kos ko'i cha bzhi la, tshad med dge, dge chung, 'od gsal, tshad med 'od bcas bzhi gnas, mgrin pa'i sum cha yan la, 'od chung, tshangs chen, mdun na 'don, tshangs ris bcas bzhi gnas/
gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun
bsam gtan dang po'i gnas ris gsum dang, bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas ris gsum dang, bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas ris gsum dang, bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris brgyad de bcu bdun no/
bsam gtan dang po dang, gnyis pa, gsum pa, bzhi pa bcas kyi gnas bzhi/
mdog dbyibs can gyi rnam 'gyur ram yongs mthong gi rtags mtshan/
gzugs dang ldan pa thams cad/

dpe dang don gyi dngos po gnyis phan tshun tha dad ma yin par gzugs gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med du sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs nyi shu tham pa ni, bsdus pa'i gzugs can, ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can, bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can, mtha' dag gzugs can, cha shas gzugs can, cha shas can gyi gzugs can, yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can, ldan pa'i gzugs can, ldan min gzugs can, mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can, khyad par can gyi gzugs can, 'gal ba'i gzugs can, rgyu'i gzugs can, sbyar ba'i gzugs can, dpe'i gzugs can, ldog pa can gyi gzugs can, 'gog pa'i gzugs can, mnyam 'jog gi gzugs can, gzugs can gyi gzugs can, bsnyon dor gyi gzugs can rnams so/
reg rgyu dang mthong rgyu yod pa mtha' dag /
gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi dngos po zhig dpe'i gzugs su bkod cing, de nyid kyang dpe gzhan gyi gzugs can du sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig /
«bimbis'ara» sangs rgyas dang dus mnyam pa'i rgyal po zhig /
dbyibs dang kha dog gi rnam pa can ma yin pa ste mig gis mthong rgyu med pa'i gras/
gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po
tshor ba dang, 'du byed, 'du shes, rnam shes te bzhi/
gzugs can ma yin pa'i sems can
lta ba'i rnam thar: rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, bdag rang gi gzugs sngar ma bshig par phyi rol gyi gzugs stong par 'jig cing sun 'byin pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/
1) lha sku sogs bzos pa/ 2) dngos gnas ma yin pa'i gzugs/
1) gzugs bzang po mchog tu gyur pa/ 2) (mngon) longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
phan tshun mi 'bral ba'i dpe/ go ming dang las 'gan gzugs rjes grib 'brang lta bu red/
mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

1) sku 'dra/ gzugs brnyan gson nyams ldan pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la sku brnyan dang, sku 'dra, 'dra sku, 'dra dbyibs, lder bzo, snang brnyan, gzugs dbyibs bcas so, 2) me long nang gi 'char gzugs/ khron pa shin tu gting ring ba zhig gi khar seng ge song ba na chu nang du rang gi gzugs brnyan mthong ba dgra bor bsam/ 3) mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

gsang sngags sgrub pa'i bya ba'am rgyud kyi dngos po zhig ste, rten gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs khang brtsegs tog dang bcas pa dang, brten pa lha'i sa bon dang, phyag mtshan, zhal phyag sogs rdul tshon dang, ras bris, tshom bu'i rnam par bkod pa'i gzugs so/
dga' ba'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dga' ba skye ba'i rgyu dngos gzugs mthong ba ma yin par gzugs brnyan tsam mthong ba las dga' ba skyes par ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
lus kyi stobs/ kho'i gzugs stobs nga las che/ gzugs stobs che ba/
rnam par shes pa'i rten can gyi dbang po/
lus sam phung po/ gzugs po thang po/ gzugs po skyo po/ gzugs po 'or lhung/ gzugs khog rgas pa/ gzugs po la bdag gces legs po byed pa/
(yul) ma'i mngal du phru gu chags pa/
1) mi'i ro/ 2) gzugs kyi phung po'i bsdus ming,
1) lus po phra mo'am chung chung,/ 2) rdul phran lta bu'i gzugs/ 3) bar do'i yid lus/ 4) 'od kyi lus/
gzugs po dang gdong/ gzugs byad mdzes pa/ gzugs byad ngan pa/
1) thogs reg byar rung ba'i dbyibs gzugs te, gru bzhi dang zlum po, leb leb, ril ril sogs/ 2) lus po'i bzo lta ste, lus ring po dang thung thung, mdzes pa dang mi mdzes pa sogs/
(mngon) 1) khyab 'jug / 2) nyi ma/ 3) 'dod lha/ 4) spyan ras gzigs/ 5) dbang phyug chen po/
lus mi mdzes pa/ nang la yon tan yod na phyi'i gzugs mi sdug kyang skyon med/
gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi

gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa, gzugs khams dang rang sa 'og ma'i zag bcas kyi chags pa las thar bar byed pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi ste, nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar dang, rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar dang, ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi rnam thar dang, 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi rnam thar rnams so/
gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi
nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang, rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched, ci yang med pa'i skye mched, 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched de bzhi/

nam mkha' mtha' yas nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi skye mched mu bzhi ste, de dag la yid gzugs dwangs pa tsam las rags gzugs med cing, 'dod gzugs las 'dod chags dang bral zhing gzugs med la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'o/
sgom spang brgya brgyad cu: gzugs med kyi sgom spang lnga po de gzugs med kyi sa bzhi po re re nas chen po'i chen po sogs sgom spang skor dgus phye bas brgyad dang brgyad cu/
gzugs med khams kyi sgom spang lnga
gzugs med khams kyi sgom lam gyis spang bar bya ba ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, nga rgyal, 'jig lta, mthar lta bcas lnga/
gzugs med khams kyi sgom spang gsum
gzugs med khams su sgom lam gyi spang bya ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, nga rgyal bcas gsum/
gzugs med khams kyi mthong spang nyer brgyad
gzugs med khams su khong khro med pas, 'dod khams kyi mthong spang so gnyis las bden bzhi'i spang bya khong khro bzhi dor ba'i lhag ma nyer brgyad do/
gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi dang don gcig
skyon med pa la yod par mngon pa'i dpe/
skyon med skyon 'dogs/ rang gis mngon sum mthong thos med par gzugs med grib bzo ma byed/
dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'og sa las 'das pa'i: rigs su gnas pa'i dge sems rtse gcig pa'o
nam mkha' mtha' yas, rnam shes mtha' yas, ci yang med pa'i skye mched, srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug ste gzugs med khams kyi snyoms 'jug bzhi'o/
gzugs med du nye bar 'gro ba
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi nang gses, gzugs khams su mi 'jug par gzugs med du skyes nas 'da' ba'o/
kun dkris mngon gyur pa bral bar mthun par gnas pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin la gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi'o/
gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi dang don gcig
nam mkha' mtha' yas, rnam shes mtha' yas, ci yang med pa, yod min med min bcas bzhi/

lta ba'i rnam thar: rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi nang gses, bdag rang gi gzugs cha shas kyis stong par bshig pa ni nang gzugs med par 'du shes pa dang, phyi rol gyi gzugs snam bu dang bum pa la sogs pa stong par sun 'byin pa'o/
nam mkha' mtha' yas dang, rnam shes mtha' yas, ci yang med, srid rtse bcas bzhi'o/
byi thur can te sgang gzugs sam ze mo/
spu khab ltar rno ba'i srog chags ze mo sgang thur/
mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs/ ming gi rnam grangs la snying du sdug pa dang, snying du 'bab pa, snying po ldan, blta bas chog mi shes pa, blta bas mi ngoms, thun mong min pa, mthong na dga', sdug gu, mig tu 'thad, mig la mngar, mtshar ba, mtshar sdug mdzes sdug gzugs bzang ba, yan lag mchog ldan, yid gar 'ong, yid dga', yid 'phrog yid 'ong, lus mchog ldan, lus mdzes pa, legs pa, shin tu sdug shin tu mdzes bcas so,
mdzes mi mdzes che chung sogs gzugs kyi khyad par mig shes kyis lta ba/
gzugs 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i mngon sum ste, rang gi bdag rkyen mig gi dbang po las dngos su skyes pa'i gzhan rig shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/

gzugs 'dzin pa'i yid kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste, rang gi bdag rkyen gzugs 'dzin yid kyi dbang po las dngos su skyes pa'i gzhan rig gi shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba, gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig phyi ma lta bu ste, rang gi gzugs don grogs su yod pa'i dbang mngon gcig gis de ma thag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i gzhan rig gi shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'o/
mi sogs kyi lus po'm phung po/ bdag cag gzugs gzhi bde po yin/
grangs gnas shig ste grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs gzhan zhig gi nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming/
1) sha khrag yod pa'i gzugs phung/ 2) sa rdo sogs mig gis mthong thub pa'i dngos po/
gzugs thang lod kyi tshad dam gshis ka/
snyan ngag gzugs can gyi rgyan sbyar ba/ brtan pa ri'i gzugs su bkod pa/ zab pa rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod pa/ rgya che ba nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod pa/
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi nang gses shig ste, 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang gzugs khams su nges par skye ba blangs nas myang 'das thob pa'o/
gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba gsum
phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can las gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba gsum ste, bar dor 'da' ba dang, skyes nas 'da' ba dang, gong du 'pho ba rnams so/
gzugs can du gyur pa/ gos chen gyi ri mo sprin 'brug gi gzugs su dod pa/
mthong thos sogs dbang shes kyi yul du gyur pa/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lta bu'o/
sngags chog bum sgrub sogs la dgos pa'i yo byad cig ste, tshon sna lnga ldan gyi thig skud rdo rjer dkris pa zhig /
kha phyir phyogs te gzung ba yul gyi rnam par skye ba ste, mig shes sogs gzhan rig gi shes pa rnams so/
1.'dzin pa'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. 1) yul te gzugs, sgra, dri, ro, reg bya, chos bcas drug la zer/ 2) (mngon) bu lon/
yul rang ngos nas bden par ma grub pa/
gzung ba rdul phran cha med
yul gyi dngos po'i chung mtha' phyogs mtshams kyi cha dbye mi thub pa zhig ste, bye brag smra bas 'dod pa'i phyi don rtsom byed do/
phyi rol yul du yod pa'i dngos po/
lus kyi rtsa'i bye brag cig /
yul dang yul can gnyis bsdus pa'i ming/
chos dang gang zag gnyis kyi bdag 'dzin nam yul dang yul can gnyis su bden par zhen pa'i rnam rtog /
'dzin byed kyi blos gzung bar bya ba'i yul te, blo ngor snang ba'i chos bum pa dang, bum pa'i don spyi lta bu'o/

«dharani» chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i don te, ngo bo dran pa dang shes rab khyad par can gyis byed las dge ba'i chos rnams 'dzin cing mi dge ba'i chos rnams sel ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'o/
bzod pa'i gzungs dang, sngags kyi gzungs, tshig gi gzungs, don gyi gzungs bcas bzhi'o/
chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa'o/
dang rgyud sde sogs nas phyung ba'i gzung: sngags
gzungs sngags kyi shog dril la g.yog rgyu'i dar gos/
thog la lhan pa rgyag skabs sngon la lhan: pa'i steng du rob rgyag pa
zung 'jug 'bul rgyu'i gzungs lnga ste, gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang, gtsug tor dri med, gsang ba ring bsrel, bya ba rgyan 'bum, rten 'brel rnying po rnams so/
lha'i sku dang gsung rdo rje gtso bor sgrub byed bde stong yi ger shar ba'i sngags/
stong chen rab 'joms ma dang, rma bya chen mo, gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma, bsil ba'i tshal chen mo, so sor 'brang ma bcas kyi gzungs sngags/
sku 'dra'i gzungs sngags sogs kyi nang rten/
gzung thag rdo rje dang don gcig
mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'am dbang thob pa/
jo nang t'a ra na thas mdo rgyud khag nas bton pa'i gzungs sngags dang chos tshan gyi glegs bam zhig /
1) sngags phreng gi skud pas rgyas btab ste byin gyis rlob pa/ 2) gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i phus 'debs pa/
gzugs sngags kyi grangs mtha' yas pa/
sngar thos pa'i tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa ni gzungs dang, chos kyi tshig don bshad pa la thogs pa med pa ni spobs pa'o/
1) grangs gnas chen po zhig / 2) gzungs kyi lung 'bog pa/
phyag rgya ma ste shes rab ma/
dang sku 'dra'i nang la 'jug rgyu'i ring: bsrel dang gzungs sngags sogs rten gyi snying po
1) mchod rten nam sku 'dra'i nang du ring bsrel sogs 'jug pa/ 2) mgo bskor btang nas khog pa brgyangs pa/
gzungs sngags ring ba'i gras te rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring lta bu'o/
tshig don ma brjed par byas pa/ bslab bya tshang ma gzungs su bzung ba/
rnam smin gyis thob pa'i gzungs, thos bsam goms pas thob pa'i gzungs, sgom byung ting nge 'dzin gyis thob pa'i gzungs bcas gsum mo/
phyogs su ma lhung bar drang por gnas pa'am gzu bor gnas pa/ blo gzur gnas kyi sgo nas las don byed pa/ gzur gnas skyes bu nyin gyi skar ma ltar dkon/
rno med/ snyung bu gze chung/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas mkhal nad dang, gcin 'gag pa, grum bu bcas la phan, lus stobs skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dang, ngu byed ma, chu med skyes, mtha' rnyed dka', reg pa dka', reg bya ngan bcas so,
tsher ma gze ma ra mgo'i 'bras bu/
sngar rgya gar gyi drang srong zhig ste, de gzhan gyis bor ba'i gzegs ma za zhing brtul zhugs la spyod mkhan zhig yin pas ming de ltar grags/
dpangs/ dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing shangs kyi gzengs mtho ba/
bsngags brjod dang, gzigs bzos/ gzengs bstod 'phar ma/ 'os babs kyi gzengs bstod/ gzengs bstod lag 'khyer/
gzhan las lhag pa'am legs pa/ byas rjes gzengs mtho ba/ bzhugs khri gzengs mtho ba/ 'bul ba gzengs mtho ba/
1.(tha dad pa) gyen du'am yar 'degs pa'am rkyong ba/ sbrul mgo gyen du gzengs pa/ ral gri gnam du gzengs pa/ bang med kyang thu ba gzengs gzengs/ 2.(rnying) gzi byin/
/ 1) dpangs mtho po/ ri bo'i rtse mo gzengs po gnam la snyeg / 2) phul byung dang khyad 'phags/ byas rjes gzengs po/ yon tan gzengs po/
zhwa rtse mo ring po zhig /
'greng 'greng ngam yar zing zing/ smin ma gyen du gzengs gzengs byas nas lta ba/

/ 1) gur/ 2) lcug ma las bslas pa'i sgrom kha sbyar zhig
smyug ma sogs las bzos pa'i gzeb snod/

/ 1) smyug mas bzos pa'i snod dbyibs gru bzhi zhig / ne tso smra bas gzeb mar tshud/ 2) gzeb snod dang 'dra,
'dzem pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
/ 1) nad kyi zug rngu che ba/ mgo gzer/ zug gzer/ grum nad kyi gzer/ 2) 'od gzer/ 3) lcags kyis bzos pa'i 'dzugs byed rnon po zhig / lcags gzer/ gcus gzer/ smyug gzer/ gzer gyis 'debs pa/
na zug / rtsib nad kyi gzer kha rgyag pa/
1) yun thung nad kyi gzer/ 2) stod gzer glo tshad ces pa gnyan rigs bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig / 3) lcags gzer thung thung/
gzer bu btab nas zug pa/ las don mi 'gyur ba'i gnad gzer thebs pa/
gzer dang 'og gzhi'i bar gyi gdan/
1) gzer kha rgyag pa/ shing la lcags kyi gzer 'debs pa/ 2) na ba'am nad gos pa/ lus la nad kyi gzer 'debs pa/
gzer gyis mnyam du sdom pa/ shog lhe mang po brtsegs pa'i mtha' sner gzer sdom brgyab pa/
gzer zug rgyag pa'i na tsha/ glo bur gzer nad byung ba/
(yul) skon pa dang, 'gel ba, 'dzugs pa/ sked par gri gzer/ gong bar khab gzer/ rna bar smyu gu gzer/
lcags kyis bzos pa'i 'dzugs spyad dam 'debs spyad rnon po zhig / gzer ma rgyag pa/
1) na zug gi gnad/ 2) gzer bu rgyag yul i khung/
na tsha yod sa'i gnad gsang/
1) nad kyi zug rngu/ 2) gzer bu zug pa/ rkang par gzer zug pa/
(tha dad pa) drin 'jal ba'am gso ba/ byas pa gzo ba/ bka' drin gzo ba/ gzo zhing byas pa shes pa/ drin can la drin gzo ba'i blo med pa/
/ 1) shing dang rdo sogs la i khung 'bigs byed kyi lag cha zhig / 2) lcags gtub byed kyi lag cha zhig /
i khung 'bigs byed lag cha'i so/
gzong la kha gnyis yod mi rung ba ltar gcig sgril dgos pa'i dpe/
shing bzo ba'i gzong gi bye brag cig /
shing bzo bas shing 'bigs byed kyi gzong chung chung/
lcags rigs la i khung 'bigs byed kyi gzong/
gdod ma'am thog ma/ nam mkha' gzod ma nas stong pa red/ gzod ma'i dus nas mi skye ba/
1.(tha dad pa) gzan pa, gzan pa, gzon,, chud zos pa/ rgyu dngos rnams chud gzon par ngo rgol byed pa/ 2.(rnying) mi nyan pa dang nyan 'dod med pa/ bsgo ba rnar gzon pa/
(tha dad pa) gzabs pa, gzab pa, gzobs,, blo bsgrims nas bag zon byed pa/ brtags te gzab pa/ las stabs gzob par byed pa/ rig pa gzob gzob pa/ blon por mnga' gsol ba la shin tu gzabs pa/
gzab pa dang gzob pa'i skul tshig
lus bongs che zhing skad sbom pa'i 'dogs khyi/
stobs ldan gyi mi phyugs kyi zungs khrag:/ bzang khrag blug pa
1) chas gos bzang po/ 2) gos chen spus dag /

bzang po dang ngan pa/ bsam pa bzang ngan/ rnam 'gyur bzang ngan/ byas rjes bzang ngan/ sbyangs 'bras bzang ngan 'bring gsum du khyad 'byed byed pa/ dug sbrul ngo ma yin pas na, phra sbom gang yin bzang ngan med/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong gi byang rgyud nas 'bab cing, dngul chu dang 'dres rjes rdza yul chu zhes zer/
1) bzang po'i tshul lam bzang mdog kha po/ rang bzhin bzang po med kyang bzang nyams ston pa/ 2) legs pa'i rtags mtshan/
bzang po drug dang don gcig

1. 1) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig / 2) gnas brtan bcu drug las chu bo ya mu na'i gling na bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig / 2.(mngon) 1) dbang phyug chen po/ 2) sman bzang la ka ko la dang, cu gang, sug smel, dza ti, li shi, gur gum bcas sna drug yod pas grangs drug mtshon/ 3) yar ngo'i bzang po dang po tshes gnyis, gnyis pa tshes bdun, gsum pa tshes bcu gnyis, mar ngo'i bzang po dang po tshes bcu bdun, gnyis pa tshes nyer gnyis, gsum pa tshes nyer bdun/ 3.legs pa dang mdzes pa/ khang bzang/ gos bzang/ dri bzang/ zas bzang po/ kun bzang/ spyod
/ sems bzang/ tshes bzang po/ je bzang je legs/ skal ba bzang po/ mi bzang don bzang/
bod kyi yul srol la hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug gi nyin phyed nas bdun gyi nyin phyed bar ngan pa dgu 'dzoms kyi phyi nyin 'char ba'i dus tshod bzang po zhig /
dza ti snying gi bzang po, cu gang glo ba'i bzang po, gur gum mchin pa'i bzang po, li shi srog rtsa'i bzang po, sug smel mkhal ma'i bzang po, ka ko la mtsher pa'i bzang po bcas drug /
bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam

'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes pa mdo phal po che'i sder gtogs pa'i smon lam zhig ste, gzhon nu nor bzang la 'phags pa kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa'i smon lam ltar, rang gzhan gyi spyad dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba rnams kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa phyir bsngo ba dang smon pa'i thabs khyad par can ston pa'i mdo zhig /
rgyal ba byams pa'i bzhugs stangs/
hor zla gnyis pa la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs nas bzang po'i zla ba zer/
1) spyod tshul bzang po/ ya rabs bzang spyod ldan la bkur bsti byed/ 2) 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po ste mdo sde zhig / a ni'i khog par bzang spyod mi tshud/
bzang spyod smon lam gyi mdo tshar brgya rtsa dang mchod pa brgya rtsa la brten nas 'chi blu'i cho ga zhig /
yag po'i 'brel ba/ bzang 'brel tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa/
bod kyi lha mo 'khrab skabs mo skad thog nas gtong ba'i rnam thar/
gu yangs kyi btson bcug pa ste, phyi rol tu gang 'dod 'gro mi chog kyang btson khang nang gu dog po med par bde bar bsdad chog pa/

'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, gnyags khri bzang yang ston yang zer, srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi blon po zhig yin zhing, bod kyi lo rgyus thog bod kyi mi rnams de sngon ri khul la bsdad nas khang pa sogs med pa la blon po 'dis mi tshang ma klung la babs nas khang pa bzo ba dang zhing kha 'debs las byed du bcug pa red ces shod srol yod/
tshur bzang po byas pa'i drin lan/ bzang lan bzang ldon/ bzang lan ngan 'jal/ bzang lan glan pa/

1) dul ba dang, bsrun pa/ kun spyod bzad pa/ rnam 'gyur bzad pa/ mi bzad pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ 2) (rnying) zhi ba dang, thul ba/ gshis rtsub bzad pa/ gcan gzan bzad pa/ spyod ngan tshang ma bzad par gyur pa/ sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/
gzab pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
bud med/ rgya bza'/ bal bza'/
khyo shug gam bza' mi gnyis ka/
zas spyi/ bza' bca'i bzo las/ bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga/
bza' rgyu'i mkho chas/ bza' chas gtso bo/
za ma bzo byed kyi snum/
bza' ba dang btung ba/ nyin ltar bza' btung mang nyung ran po bsten pa/
nang mi bza' tshang gi gtso bo'am khyim bdag /
khyim 'dzin khyo ga'am nang gi pha/
1.za ba'i ma 'ongs pa, 2. 1) za ma'am lto/ bza' las rjes 'brangs/ 2) bza' tshang/ bza' skyon bza' bas shes, nad skyon sman pas shes/
'dul ba las gsungs pa'i dus rung gi sman gyi char gtogs pa zhig ste, sna tshogs 'bras chan dang, zan dang, sha dang, phye dang, snum khur bcas lnga'o/
sngags bla med kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sha: lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bsten pa'am gtsang dme'i rnam rtog spangs pa'o
khyo shug / bza' mi khyo shug / bza' mi bye bral/ bza' mi byed pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyim thabs dang, khyo shug bza' tsho bcas so,
khyo shug / bza' tshang kha bral/ bza' tshang rgan rgon/
ster slong sogs chang sa'i cho ga ma byas pa'i bza' tshang/ 'dod dang 'dod mthun gyis bza' tshang lam 'phrad byung ba/
1) khyo shug / 2) khyim gcig gi mi rnams/
khyim thabs sam bza' rogs/ bza' zla mo/
'bras bu can gyi shing sna btab pa'i ra skor/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun dga' ra ba dang, skyo sangs gnas, ngal gso'i 'dun sa, 'bras ldan nags bcas so,
rang tshod mi zin pa'i 'dar yom yom/ mgo yu 'khor te bzi khyom khyom byed pa/
lus sems khams dwangs po med pa'i za ri zi ri/ mgo bo bzi 'thom 'thom byed pa/ khrag kha mtho bas mgo bo bzi 'thom 'thom byed pa/
chang a rag gis bzi ba las sangs pa/
(tha mi dad pa) ra ro ba'am myos pa/ chang rag gis bzi ba/ sman gyi nus pas bzi ba/ mtshan mo'i thun mtshams su gnyid kyi bzi ba/
cung zad bzi ba/ chang mang rab btungs pas bzi ber tsam byung/
lus kyi rang tsho shor ba'i 'dar tshul/ nad pa bzi yom yom du 'gro ba/
'dzin bzung dang bsdams bkyigs/ nyes can bzung bkyigs byas pa/
bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce
zhal lce bcu drug gi nang tshan, snga dus khrims 'gal nag nyes che rigs 'dzin bzung dang, bsdams bkyigs, rdeg rdung sogs gang 'os babs bltas kyis byed pa'i khrims/
jag rkun sogs kyis nor phrogs mi gsod kyi sdig nyes byas pa/
dmag rgyag skabs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i dgra dmag
bzod bsran chung ba'am, sdug rus phra mo yang bzod mi thub pa/ bze re che ba/ bze re chung ba/ lus po bze re can/ dka' tshegs dngos su byung na bze re che chung ha go yong/
zhag sogs blug snod/ ming gi rnam grangs la chol zangs dang, mchil ma'i snod, lud phor bcas so,
dbyibs gzugs sgrig stangs/ dngos rdzas bzo bkod thon po/ khang khyim bzo bkod legs po/
dngos rigs gsar bzo/ nyer mkho'i yo byad sna tshogs bzo skrun byed pa/
1) lag shes bzo las byed sa/ 2) sngar gzhung las byed mkhan tshem bu ba'i tshogs pa/
bzo rigs kyi las grwa khang ste bzo las thon skyed kyi bya gzhag thad kar byed mkhan sde tshan/
sngar yod gsar du bcos pa/ khang rnying la bzo bcos rgyag pa/ yi ge'i tshig don la bzo bcos rgyag pa/
rgyal spyi'i gung khran ring lugs kyi las 'gul nang du mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi phyi gos gyon te mar khe si'i ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun zhig
sngar bod kyi lha bris pa'i skyid sdug tshogs chung zhig /
thal che ba'i dpe/ las don bzo nyes dras thal du ma song ba byed dgos/

1) dbyibs gzugs kyi rnam pa'am dbyibs tshugs/ khang pa'i bzo lta/ dngos rdzas kyi bzo lta/ yi ge'i bzo lta/ ri mo'i bzo lta/ bzo lta bzo ba/ 2) rnam 'gyur/ dga' ba'i bzo lta/ khros pa'i bzo lta/ zhed pa'i bzo lta/ mi'i bzo lta/ bzo lta ngan pa/
dbyibs dod pa/ ri mo bzo lta thon pa/ 'bur brkos kyi bzo lta thon pa/ las don 'grub pa'i bzo lta thon pa/
(yul) ha cang khag po'i gnas su gyar bcug pa/ gzhan la bzo lta sprad nas 'gro sdod mi shes pa bzos pa/
nyams nyes pa'am bzo dbyibs skyo po chags pa/ rdung rdeg gzed nas dgra bo bzo lta shor ba/
dbyibs tshugs yag po dod pa/
dbyibs gzugs phan tshun 'dra ba/ cha lugs bzo 'dra po 'dug /
1) bzo las byed pa'i ra ba/ 2) bzo las lag rtsal/
gla char brten nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan ngal rtsol pa, gtso bo lus kyi ngal rtsol par zer/ shing bzo/ rdo bzo/ lcags bzo/ bzo pa bud med/ bzo par gla med skud pa 'phar 'don/
(yul) gzan gron chung ba'am skyon ma shor ba byed pa/ bed spyod gtong thabs bzo po byed pa/
1) bzo rig la mkhas pa/ 2) las ka'i 'go byed mkhan/

1.(tha dad pa) bzos pa, bzo ba, bzos,, 1) dbyibs 'don pa/ khang pa bzo ba/ dngos spyad bzo ba/ 'gro sa bzo ba/ 'gal rkyen bzo ba/ 2) gron chung ba'am skyon ma 'byung ba/ za 'bru la bzo ba/ gzugs po la bzo ba/ snga ru rta la bzo ba, phyi ru sga la bzo ba/ 2.zhi zhing dul ba/ 'gro tshul bzo ba/

sprul sku gsum gyi nang tshan zhig ste, sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du bzo bo rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul pa dper na dri za rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir dri za'i pi wang gtong bar sprul pa lta bu'o/
dbyibs gzugs kyi rnam pa/ gru bzhi'i bzo dbyibs grub pa/ bya 'brug gi bzo dbyibs dod pa/ ri mo'i bzo dbyibs/
1) ma bcos rgyu cha'am phyed bzos dngos rdzas rnams grub rdzas su bsgyur ba'i las ka dang, thabs shes, lag rtsal sogs la zer,/ 2) lag shes kyi rtsal/
bzo pa'i gral rim gyi mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig /
dngos su bzo rgyu yong mi yong ba'i tshod lta ba/ 'phrul 'khor bzo tshod bltas pa/

bzo pa'i gral rim gyi srid tang gi 'go khrid 'og bzo pa'i gral rim dang ngal rtsol zhing pa'i gsar brje'i mnyam 'brel la zer, rang rgyal la cha mtshon na bzo zhing mna' 'brel ni 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brjer rgyal kha 'thob rgyu'i 'gan len med du mi rung ba zhig yin la, 'byor med gral rim gyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed rgyu'i gral rim gyi rmang gzhi zhig kyang yin/

rtsal sum cu: sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi'i nang gses rigs shig ste, yi ge , lag rtsal, grangs, rtsis chen, thor tshugs, gom stabs, lcags kyus sgyur thabs, ral gri'i thabs, zhags pa gdab pa, mda' bo che 'phen pa, mdun du bsnur ba, phyir bsnur ba, bcad pa, dral ba, dbug pa, rgyang nas 'phog pa, sgra grag par 'phog pa, gnad du 'phog pa, mi 'chor bar 'phog pa, tshabs che bar 'phog pa, mchongs pa, gyad kyi 'dzin stangs, bang, rkyal, brgal ba, glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa, rta la zhon pa, shing rta'i bzo thabs, mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs, gyad stobs dang sum cu'o/
bzo dang 'phong rtsal la sogs pa mkhas par bya ba'i gnas so/
bzo rigs kyi las don/ lcags bzhu'i bzo las/ bzo las can du 'gyur ba/
bzo rig pa'i gnas shes pa/
lus bzo dang, ngag bzo, yid bzo bcas gsum mo/
bsran thabs med pa/ sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa/
bzod pa sgom pa'i bsdus tshig
(mngon) 1) mgo zla ba'am hor zla bcu gcig pa/ 2) sa gzhi/

1.(tha mi dad pa) bsran pa dang, theg pa, nus pa, phod pa/ ma nyes khag g.yogs kyi gtam ngan bzod par dka'/ zug rngu ji tsam che'ang bzod thub pa/ 2.sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhi'i nang gses, gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gsal snang chen po thob cing 'dzin pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gsal snang chung ngu thob pas bden pa'i phyogs gcig la zhugs shing rjes su song ba'i ting 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste, bden pa mthong ba'i lam dang rjes su mthun par stong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa'o/
bsran thub thabs byed pa/ de la bzod pa sgom thub na, bzod sgom mi thub gzhan ci yod/ dka' ngal ji tsam byung yang bzod sgom byed pa/ dbu phog zhabs phog gi tshig thal ji shor bzod pa sgom du gsol/
sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa dang, gnod byed la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa, chos la nges shes kyi bzod pa bcas gsum mo/
1) bsran thub pa'i nus pa/ 2) bzod pa'i pha rol son pa'i mthu/
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig bzod pa'i phar phyin rim ldan du sgom pa'o/
«kshantap'aramit'a» khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi mi 'khrug pa'i sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa ste, phyin drug gi ya gyal zhig /
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa ci rigs pa dang sems can gyi don mi gtong ba la brtan pa thob pa'i rtse mo gang zhig sbyor lam bzod pas bsdus pa'o/

yi ge a mngon du bsgom zhing de la cha shas su bshig ste stong pa nyid du rtogs nas yi ge gzhan la yang de bzhin du gyur pas na chos thams cad la yang de bzhin du gyur pas na chos thams cad la yang bsgres te, stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sgo nas dga' ba ni bzod pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa'o/
(rnying) sdug khur dang du len pa/
grangs gnas shig grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs bzhan zhig nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming/
bzod par mdzod ces pa'i zhu 'bul/ tshig thal dgongs 'gal byung na bzod gsol zhu ba/
dka' sdug 'khur thub pa/ dka' ngal la bzod bsran che ba/
sdug bsngal lam dka' ngal theg pa'i nus shugs skyed pa/
gzengs bstod pa'i gzigs bzos/ byas rjes can la bzos sgo thob pa/
lkog tu bzos pa'am brkus pa'am phrogs pa'i dngul/
byas rjes gzigs bzos kyi lam srol/
sngags bzla ba'am ngag nas 'don pa/
kho na nyid: bya rgyud kyi sgom pa de nyid bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, gzhol ba gsum gyi sgo nas srog rtsol bsdams te bzlas pa bya ba'o/
spyod rgyud kyi bzlas pa dngos kyi yan lag bzhi ste, bdag gi gzhi, gzhan gyi gzhi, sems la gzhol ba'i yan lag sgra la gzhol ba'i yan lag go /
1.zlog pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa, 2.(rnying) gshin pa/
bzlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu
rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, rgyu dngos med las 'bras bu dngos med bskyed pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, mtshon bya don gyis mtshon byed dpe'i khyad chos phar 'jal ba 'jig rten grags pa dang go bzlog gi rgyan zhig /

bod yig gsal byed nyer gsum pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mgrin pa dang, byed pa mgrin pa, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1) ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2) sngon 'jug mo yig cig / 3) rjes 'jug gi shin tu mo yig cig / 4) dbyangs yig gi ring cha ston byed brda zhig /
(yul) thang chad nas thabs zad pa/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs 'a chad 'u thug gi sdug bsngal mang po myong ba/
a chung yang snang ste, dbyangs kyi ring cha ston byed 'a yig gi ming/ 'a...'a...
bon po'i stong nyid kyi ming/
las ka'i khyon nam gzhi rgya/ 'a 'ub ma 'dus pa/
zhib tshags med pa'i las ka byed stangs/ las ka 'a ri 'u ri byas pa/

ming mtha' 'a dang, mtha' med gnyis su sbyor ba'i rgyan sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / 'a...rig pa myur po'ang yin la, zab po'ang yin/ ri bo mtho'ang shing nags mi 'dug / me mda'ang ma rgyag gri'ang ma rgyag / khyed ni skye dgu kun la mnyen gshin pa'i bsam pa dge ba can yin na'ang, de lta bur kun gyis kyang dang ba mi ston no/
(rgya) rgya thug man chi'i dril pang ngam, gsol tshigs bzo pang/
rna ba gsang po med pa'am bskul ba la dang du mi len pa'i tshul/ 'an ne 'on ne'i mi la las ka bskul ba dka'/
ma gus pa'i skad sgra rtsub po/ skad cha 'ab sgra tsha po/ mi 'ab sgra che ba/
(yul) hang rgyag gi las ka byed stangs/ las ka 'ab be 'ob be byas na gra 'grig po mi yong/
gcig chod min pa/ 'ab 'ub ma bsdus pa/
(yul) las ka'i khyon nam gzhi rgya/ mi gcig gis phyi nang gi las don sne mang 'ab su 'dus pa dka'/

1. ming mtha' 'a dang, mtha' med kyi rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud sgra'i rkyen zhig / 'a...dga'am, mgu'am, yi rang ba'am/ 'chad pa'am, rtsod pa'am, rtsom pa/ 2. ming mtha' 'a dang mtha' med kyi rjes su sbyor ba'i the tshom ston byed kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / 'a...mdzad brel che'am/ khyod la gsar du bkums pa'i sha rlon pa sbyin na za'am/
(yul) khral dang bu lon sogs tsha 'ded byed pa'i btsan shed/

1.(tha mi dad pa) sgra thos mi thub pa/ me sgyogs kyi sgras rna ba 'on pa/ 2.rna ba mi gsang ba/ 3.(rnying) ston pa dang len pa/ bum pa 'on gyis/
rna ba ma 'on kyang 'on khul byed pa/ skad cha nyan 'dod med pas 'on rdzu byed pa/
rna ba 'on pa dang mig long ba gnyis bsdus pa'i ming/
rna ba 'on nas bskyar du gsos pa/

1.dong ngam sa shur/ 'obs su lan gcig lhung na shes rab lan gcig 'phel/ chu 'gro'i 'obs/ ming gi rnams grangs la mtha'i mu khyud dang, 'obs tshal, 'obs ring, yongs brkos bcas so, 2.rags pa'am ha lam/ 'char gzhi 'obs tsam bkod pa/
zhing ga dang lcang gling sogs kyi mtha' la yod pa'i 'obs dang lcags ri/
(yul) robs tsam brgyab pa'i ra ba/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad bsdu, tshad pa sel, chu ser skem/

sngar bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs rgyal po'i pho brang lho kha'i yar klungs su thog mar btab pa de 'om bu dang gla sgang mang po skyes pa'i sa cha zhig gi dkyil du yod pas ming de ltar thob/
chu'i nad skrang 'bur thon pa zhig /
chu 'gro sa'i bu ga / 'or khung brtol bas 'khyil chu sha ra rar rgyug pa/
bka' drin che zer ba'am legs so zer yong snyam pa'i re ba mi byed pa/
dbor 'dren yang zer, ca lag sogs phar tshur skyel 'dren/

kha zas ma zhu ba dwangs snyigs 'dres pa dwangs ma'i lam du shor bas des khrag ngan rgyas te sha lpags la byer bas chu ser 'phel bar gyur pa dang, chu ser de nyid thur du babs nas lus g.yo bar 'gyur ba'i chu nad cig /
1.(tha dad pa) skyel 'dren byed pa'am dbor ba/ dngos zog 'or ba/ ca lag 'or mkhan/ 2.(rnying) 1) bor ba/ 2) skyob pa/
(yul) thengs sam lan/ 'or cig / 'or log rgyag pa/ nga lung pa der 'or ma gcig las 'gro ma myong/
1) 'or nad rgyu ma'i nang du bab pa/ 2) gso dka' ba'am nyam thag pa/
/ 1) bya 'ol ba'i kha dog gam kham nag / 2) dbus kyi lho kha'i sa gnas shig /
rags rim dang ha lam/ 'ol spyi tsam du dus mnyam yin/ slob sbyong yang yang byas pas nang don 'ol spyi tsam go ba/
brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byas par byas pa'i las ka dang bya spyod/ rang mtshams 'ol spyod/
grangs gnas shig grangs gnas drug cu'i gras la med/
/ 1) bya ne le'am ping kyur ma/ 2) bya 'ol ba'i mdog can gyi rta/
spyod yul du ma gyur pa/
/ 1) 'ol mo lung ring gi bsdus ming, 2) sngo sman zhig de'i rtsa bas dri chu 'bab pa dang rtsa khams rgyu ba la phan/
bon gyi ston pa gshen rab 'khrungs yul/
sngo sman 'bras bu'i rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas khrag nad kyi mngal skyon sbyong, bu dang sha ma 'gags pa 'don, byugs na rgya rngo pags nad sogs la phan/
rags rtsis sam spom tshod/ khungs lung 'dzin sa med par 'ol tshod kyis thag gcod mi byed/ lci yang gang yin 'degs rgyar bteg med par 'ol tshod kyis byas pa yin/
1) 'os babs kyi las ka'i 'gan/ 2) phogs thob mi dgos par rang mos kyis dang du blang ba/ 'os 'gan gyi ngal rtsol/
las tshan bsko rgyu sogs kyi 'os ming gi 'char gzhi/
'os pa'i rin tshad/ ca lag de'i rin gong rgyal khab kyis gtan la phab pa ltar 'os thang zhig red/
1) babs 'os yod pa'i mi'i ming tho/ 2) 'os khongs 'khod pa'i ming tho/
bsko gzhag byed rgyu'i ming tho'i dang po/

1.rung ba dang 'thad pa/ za 'os pa/ byed 'os pa/ 'os shing 'tshams pa/ 'os tshod byas/ de ltar 'os min bka' gsal yod pa zhu/ skyabs su 'os pa/ chad pa phog pa las 'os med/ gces par 'os pa/ skye bo mi bsrun pa dag la, 'jam po bya ba 'os ma yin/ ri la 'os pa rdzong dang, thang la 'os pa zhing/ 2.phyi rol gcer bu ba/
cha'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsgrib bya gang yang rung ba zhig sgrib byed 'os pas sgrib par ston pa'i cha'i rgyan zhig /
don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'os pa'i rgyus 'bras bu mi 'os pa skyed pa bsgrub byar bkod nas de'i sgrub byed du 'os pa'i byed las dang ldan pa'i don gzhan zhig bkod pa'i rgyan/
'byung mi srid pa'i don, tshig phrad kyi na'i 'jug tshul zhig / na...chu ci tsam bskol na'ang me ru 'bar ba ni dka' ba'o/ mi rgan pa yang ngu na phru gu lta ci smos/
'os 'tshams/ khong 'thus mir 'dam rgyu'i 'os bab yod nges red/
'os tho 'bul ba ste, las byed pa bsko gzhag byed skabs gong la 'os mi'i ming tho 'bul ba/
mi dang dngos po gang rung 'os khongs su ngo sprod byed pa/
phal cher 'grig yong bsam pa'i tshod dpag byed pa/

log spyod dbang sgyur la rgol ba'i ched du drag chas kyi gsar brje slong ba, skabs rer log spyod tshogs khag gi drag po'i stobs shugs kyis rang nyid kyi tshogs khag de la ngo log byas nas gsar brje'i phyogs su langs par yang zer/

pa'i don gzhan bkod pa: don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, bsgrub bya 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i dngos po bye brag pa gnyis bkod nas, de'i sgrub byed du 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i don spyi khyab pa gzhan zhig bkod pa'i rgyan/
gam 'dems shog / tshogs chen thog 'os shog: 'phangs te 'thus mi bdams pa
1) 'os babs chen po yod pa/ 2) nges par du byed dgos pa/

bod yig gsal byed nyer bzhi pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba rkan lce cung zad phrad pa dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chung sgra ldan/ 1.1) ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2) ming gzhi 'ga' shas kyi mas nas gdags bya'i smad 'dogs bzhi'i ya gyal zhig / 2. 1) gong dang steng/ ya so/ ya mchu/ ya rkan/ ya mgal/ ya gi gangs ri dkar po/ 2) cha min pa/ lham ya gcig / do po ya gcig / 3) zla/ dgra ya/ 'thab ya/ 'gran ya/ gnyen ya/ ya med pa/ 3. 1) 'gyod nyams kyi tshig / ya, de 'dra ma byas na chog pa la/ ya, de 'dra'i phangs pa la/ ya, don dag gcod rgyu gcig brjed bzhag / 2) go rtogs shar ba'i tshig / ya, tshig de'i don 'di 'dra yin pa red ang/
yun nan zhing chen gyi 'ba' lung rdzong khongs su zla chu'i thog la btsugs pa'i lcags zam zhig /
(legs) 'gyur byed thal ba ste sa sman gyi rigs shig ro lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas skran nad bshig ma zhu ba 'ju, drod skyed/
cha min pa/ dkar yol sngon po ya rkyang gcig /
1) ya rkan yod phyogs/ 2) yas phyogs/ 'gram pa'i ya kha/ mchig gi ya kha/
mig dang rna ba'i bar gyi srin tshang sha kong kong yod sa/

mi dang phyugs sogs kyi khong pa'i stod kyi cha ste glo ba dang snying yod sa/ ya khog nang la glo ba med, brla rus nang la rkang mar med/ ya thod nang gi mig 'dra 'dra, ya khog nang gi snying 'dra 'dra/
1) 'phya lad/ ya ga sgrog pa/ ya ga ngan pa/ 2) ngan smras sam tshig rtsub po/ mi ya ga can/
yas kyi stod phyogs sam steng ma/ ri 'go ya gir rdzong gcig 'dug / ya gi'i steng phyogs lha la, skyid po rang dang e yod/
nang tshan nam nang gses dang bye brag cig dper na rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ya gyal zhes pa ni rig pa'i gnas lnga'i gras kyi gcig la zer/ karka da ni khyim bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal/
cha min pa'i grangs ka/ gcig gsum lnga bdun sogs cha min gyi grangs ka gang yin ya grangs rang red/ ya grangs kyi tshes pa nam shar/

1. 1) 'jigs skrag / gdong thug dgra bo'i mdun du sems la ya nga rtsa ba nas med/ ya nga ba ma spangs pa/ ya nga ba spyod pa/ 2) snying rje/ ya nga snying rje med pa/ ya nga med pa'i nyes rdung gtong ba/ dgra bor ya nga snying rje byed mi dgos/ 2. 1) 'jigs su rung ba/ sdug bsngal ya nga ba/ lam 'phrang ya nga ba/ 2) nyam thag pa/ bshu gzhog myong mkhan rnams kyi 'tsho ba shin tu ya nga ba/ nad kyis mnar bas ha cang ya nga ba/ 3) sha tsha ba'am, snying rje skyes nas sems mi bzod pa'i snang tshul/ snang ba ya nga ba/ nad pa mthong nas sman pa ya nga ba/
1) mtho sa dma' ru nyag pa/ 2) phyug po dbul por gyur pa/
lo bzhi lon pa'i rta drel/

yi ge smad 'dogs bzhi'i ya gyal zhig kya khya gya pya phya bya mya bdun no, ya btags can gyi yi ge'ang zer/ ya...kya khya gya pya phya bya mya...ka li'i nang nas sde tshan dang po'i yi ge snga ma gsum dang, sde tshan bzhi pa'i yi ge hril po bcas gsal byed bdun po kho nar ya btags sbyar chog / ya...
bon po'i mdos glud dam gto mdos kyi rdzas/
1) bskal pa thog ma'i dus/ 2) ches snga ba'i dus/ bskal pa ya thog /
gnas bskal gyi ya thog gam bar bskal dang po tshe lo dpag med nas tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du bri ba'i bar bskal/
1) mgo'i thod pa/ 2) sgo'i ya thod/
thog ma'i mtha', ma mtha'i zlog phyogs/ drod tshad kyi ya mtha'/
legs sbyar gsal byed ya nas pa bar gyi yi ge ste, dro ba bzhi spangs pa'i sde pa dang, mthar gnas kyi yi ge ya ra la wa rnams so, ya pa...ha sa...sha sha sa ha...
padma ya log ste, 'dab rtse gyen lta'i pad dbyibs/
/ 1) 'gran zla/ mi dmangs la ya po gtan nas byed mi nyan/ kho rang gi ya po ma yin pa/ 2) ri dwags sogs bsad nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan/ 3) 'khyams po/
1) khang thog g.yog byed kyi 'dam rtswa sogs/ 2) (mngon) khang pa'i yang thog /
srung ma chos rgyal gyi 'khor zhig /
(yul) do do tan tan med pa/ las ka la sems shugs hur skyed med pa'i ya be yo be byed mi rung/ lag rtsal slob sbyong ya be yo be byas na dus yun ring po song yang shes mi yong/
lan byed pa/ ya mi byed/ ya ma byed/ gtam bzang shod pa'i ya byed gtam snyan shod, gtam ngan shod pa'i lan du rtsod ya byed/
kha bral ba, tha dad du 'gyur ba/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang don dngos kyi gnas lugs gnyis ya bral du song ba/ so sor ya ma bral ba'i mthun sgril dam po gyis shig / ma bu phan tshun ya ma bral/
yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i ming gzhan zhig

/ 1) mig dang rna ba'i bar gyi srin tshang/ 2) khrag rtsa'i nang du gnas te lus kyi cha shas kun tu rgyu bar byed pa'i srin bu phra mo zhig gi ming/ 3) ha sa zer ba'i sdud yig nang ya nas ma bar gyi yi ge zer ba'i sdud tshig ste legs sbyar gyi gsal byed nas mthar gnas kyi yi ge ya ra la wa bzhi dang, sde ba so so'i lnga pa nya na na nga ma lnga bcas yi ge dgu, ya ma...ha sa...ya wa ra la...nya na na nga ma...
rlung dang bad kan gyi sdong zla ldan pa'i srin nad zug rngu cung chung zhing grang ba shas che ba zhig /
khrag dang mkhris pa'i sdong zla ldan pa'i srin nad zug rngu shin tu che ba 'byung zhing tsha ba shas che ba zhig /
lha mo 'khrab dus gyon rgyu'i bud med kyi 'bag phyed dkar phyed nag cig /
'gran pa'am rgol ba'i ya byas kyang ma thub pa/ mda' mdung mtshon gyis rgol yang ya ma zin/
cha min ya min/ tshos gzhi ya ma zung/ gyon chas ya ma zung/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung/
cha lugs rigs mi mthun pa'am bzo lta thun mong dang mi 'dra ba/ 'phel rgyas ya ma gzugs/ ya ma gzugs su 'gyur ba/
(rnying) snying po med pa'am mi bden pa/
lus kyi srin bu 'khrugs pa las byung ba'i nad mgo dang, mur 'gram, so, rna ba sogs kyi gnas su na zug drag po 'byung zhing ldang dub byed pa zhig /
(legs) rgya gar gyi chu bo zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la nyi ma'i bu mo dang, gdung byed ma, rtsod can, zhi ba'i sring mo bcas so,
grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs gzhan zhig nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming zhig /
1) do zla'am 'gran zla med pa/ dpa' mdzangs ya med/ dpa' ya med dmag dpon g.yul las rgyal/ 2) khrel med dam rtsi med/ ya med tsha po/ sgrigs khrims la ya med btsongs pa/
'gran zla dang bral ba/ 'dzam gling yongs la ya med do med yin/ stobs shugs ya med do med/
skyi g.ya' ba'am, 'jigs rung gi rnam pa/ mthong nas ya tsha ba/ seng ge mthong bas glang chen ya re tsha/

1) ya phyogs kyi thag nye'i sa/ lung pa ya tshad tsam la grong pa kha shas yod/ 2) che mtho'i tshad/ khong dgung lo ya tshad la slebs tshar ba red/ chab srid kyi go rtogs ya tshad thob pa/ 3) 'gran sdur ram ya lan sprod pa/ dgra la phar rgol gyis ya lan tshad pa/ phan tshun rtsed mo rtse res kyis ya tshad pa/
ngo mtshar/ ya mtshan che/ skad cha ya mtshan po/ don dag ya mtshan can/ ha cang ya mtshan po/

1) spyir btang dang mi mthun pa'i khyad mtshar can nam phul byung gi dngos po/ lta ba ya mtshan can/ ya mtshan can gyi spyod pa/ thabs 'phrul ya mtshan can/ 2) (rnying) mu stegs pa'i rab byung spyi'i ming/
ngo mtshar ba dang khyad mtshar ba/ snang tshul ya mtshan pa/ thabs 'phrul ya mtshan che ba/
yar thag ring tsam/ ya zad cig na mtshe'u zhig 'dug /
bod sgrung du bshad pa'i hor gyi grong khyer zhig /
dgra yar lta ba'am kha gtad du 'dzin pa/ tshur rgol la ya bzung byed pa/
1) khas blangs pa'i tshig / ya ya lags so/ 2) 'khon 'dzin ston pa'i brda tshig / ya ya, a 'u tsi sgugs shig sgugs shig mgyogs po mjal yong/
1) sems dbang med du g.yos nas brtan mi tshugs pa/ pham nyes mu mthud byung nas sems ya ya bor gyur pa/ 2) cha min, tha dad/ grogs med ya ya bor gyur pa/
1) gya tshom dang, bab col/ 2) som nyi bral ba, spobs pa che/
thal cha'am gnad 'gag / tan tan ma byas na ya yud hang zom chen po yong/ skad cha de 'dra bshad pa ni ya yud chen po red/ mi dmangs kyi don du rang srog 'dor dgos byung yang ya yud med/

1) bya spyod rgyab mdun mi mtshungs pa'i drang min g.yo sgyu/ gtam ya yo ba/ las ka ya yo byas pas khungs thub par dka'/ lus sems kyi spyod tshul ya yo kho na yin pa/ 2) thad ka min pa dang, kyag kyog / ka ba ya yo med pa/ rtsig rmang ya yo ba'i thog la rtsig pa brtan po brtsig mi thub/ rgyug pa ya yo snyoms shig / sbrul ya yor 'gro ba/
(rnying) thags 'thag pa'i tshe bar bar du spun ma bcug pa'i dbang gis hral hral chags pa/

1) sngar rigs rus mtho ba'i mi la zer/ rigs rgyud ya rabs/ ya rabs rigs bzang/ ya rabs kyi 'tsho ba/ 2) rang bzhin nam spyod pa bzang ba/ snga dus kyi ya rabs gong ma/ ya rabs spyod bzang/ ya rabs tshul mthun/ ya rabs gshis bzang/ ya rabs srol bzang/ pho ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas shes, yul sa phyogs gang yin skad kyis shes/
(yul) g.yas g.yon du yo zhing brtan po med pa'i tshul/

(yul) nyes skyon nam nag nyes/ gzugs med grib bzo'i ya la bsnyon 'dzugs byas pa/ dkrog gtam ched bzos kyis ya la mtshan shas bzo ba/ don med du ya la bzed pa/ mi la ya la dkris pa/ bong bu bslangs pa la dga' tshor med par mjug ma bkog pa'i ya la 'dzugs pa/
go cha dang rmog / ya lad btsan po lus la gyon/

1) rgol lan nam dgra lan/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas dgra nag la ya lan sprod pa/ btsan 'dzul pa la ya lan mi sprod ka med byung ba/ 'gram lcag brdegs pa'i ya lan klad 'gems thub thabs/ 2) dri lan nam gtam lan/ skad cha ji tsam 'dri bar ya lan de tsam sprod pa/ 3) gtam lan gnad du phog pa/
(yul) stod smad so sor kha bral ba ste, gdong gi ya rkan yod phyogs dang ol sko yod phyogs gnyis so sor kha bral ba lta bu'i dpe,/ ya le ma le bral ba/
1) nyi ma gang 'khyol/ 2) khur med snang chung gi tshul/ las don ya le yo le byas par lag rjes thon pa dka'/
gos chen ri mo med pa zhig /
(yul) khe gyong gang yong la bsam blo ma btang bar thal drags pa'i las ka byed stangs/
'tsham tshod mi zin pa/ bya ba ha cang tshod med ya se yo se ma byed/
sngar lha ldan smon lam gtor rgyag gi dmag ru'i spyi khyab pa'i go gnas kyi ming/
ya ma'i nad 'byung rkyen 'bu phra mo zhig /
'bri chu'i yan lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'bri stod rdzong du yod/
bzang ngan dang, legs nyes/ yag nyes kyi dbye ba 'byed pa/ mig yod kyang yag nyes ngo mi chod/
bzang po'i steng du bzang po snon pa/
legs po'am bzang po/ spus ka yag po/ 'tsho ba yag po/ gnam gshis yag po/ tshong zog yag po/ rtsis yag po rgyag pa/ spyod pa yag por brtsis pa/
(yul) 1) sga'i 'og tu 'jug rgyu'i gdan mthug po/ 2) gsar pa/ 3) yag po'i gras/
1) bzang bzang/ gang yag yag byas 'dug / 2) grangs gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs gzhan zhig nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming zhig /
(rnying) rab rub tsam mam phar 'gro tshur 'gro tsam/
mang po'i nang nas yag shos/

1. ming mtha' nga na ma ra la'i rjes su sbyor ba'i rgyan sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / nga na ma ra la...rin gong chung la dngos po yang legs/ phyugs rigs yar rgyas rjes su 'tsho ba yang legs su phyin pa/ dgra ngan gdong gtug byas kyang dpa' zhum gyi rnam pa spu tsam yang ston mi rung/ 2. bsnan pa'i phrad rang dbang can zhig / yang gcig / yang khong gis bshad don/ yang dang yang du/ yang na/ yang min na/ yang nas yang du/
lan grangs mang po/ sbang glum la chu yang skor bskyar skor rgyag pa/
slar yang ngam bskyar ma/ yang bskyar gsal por bshad pa/ yang bskyar yang bskyar/
nying khu ste khu ba'i snying po/ 'o ma'i yang khu/ a rag yang khu/
'grel pa bskyar bzlos/ mkhas pa'i myong khrid gdams ngag dang, rjes zlos yang nas yang 'grel gnyis, 'dra dang 'dra ste nor dogs yod/
ha cang rgod po/ pho rgod po'i nang nas yang rgod red/
yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod de rkang longs brtsi ba'i skabs mda' yon zlas thob pa'i chu tshod rjes 'brang dang bcas/
khyad par dang, lhag par te, spyi'i zlas dbye/ spyir ja 'thung ba dang, yang sgos bod ja 'thung bar dga' ba/
1) sems bag med du g.yeng ba/ 2) nyin 'gyangs zhag 'phul/ yang nge yeng nges nyi ma stong zad du gtong ba/ 3) sems yengs pa/
yang ba dang lci ba gnyis bsdus pa'i ming/ yang lci bkyag pa/ yang lci med pa/ yang lci shor ba/ mang nyung bre la 'jal, yang lci srang la 'degs/
gu yangs dang khur chung ba/ khral rigs yang cha byed pa/ yang cha dang khrol cha ster ba/
yang ba'i yo byad/ yang chas spras nas phyogs la 'gro ba/
(rgya) sgra snyan gyi bye brag cig /

rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi mthar 'thob pa'i da drag dang, rjes 'jug ga nga ba ma'i mthar 'thob pa'i sa yig gnyis la zer, rab byung dang po'i 'go ma btsugs pa'i gong gi lo nyis brgya bcu med gcig brtsis pa'i me sprel lor rgyal po khri ral pa can gyis yig zor yang po bzo ched da drag 'bri mi dgos par gtan 'bebs byas pa/ na ra la...da...ga nga ba ma...sa... da...sa...
1) snying po'i snying po'am lte ba'i lte ba/ 2) don snying ngo ma/ g.yul 'gyed byas pa'i mtha' ma la, yang snying su yis rgyal kha lon/

1) snying po'i snying po/ 2) nges gtan nam tan tan/ rin gong yang tig / yang tig yod dam/ yang tig bsgrig rgyu phran bu yod/ yang tig phar tshur bsgrig pa/ 3) mtsho sngon hwa lung rdzong na yod pa'i grub pa'i gnas chen zhig ste, dan tig dang khad nye ba'i sa na slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang t'a la'i sku phreng gsum pa rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho phebs myong ba zhig / 4) zab pa'i zab pa ste rnying ma'i chos skor zhig /
don dag yang snying/ skad cha mang po bshad kyang yang tig snying po 'di las med/
gter chos kun gyi nang nas zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i yang gsang snying po'i gter kha/
1) khang pa'i thog brtsegs steng ma/ 2) khang pa thog brtsegs du ma can/
kun rdzob gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, phyi nang gi rten 'brel la yang dag par brtags te dge ba bcu la sogs pas bskyed pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu rnams so/
1) (mngon) dus/ 2) phar phyin pa/ 3) gzhung lam/
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, bar chad kyi chos bzhi sogs dang mi ldan zhing de bzhin dge 'dun gyis kyang khong du chud pa'o/
1) legs par thos/ 2) (mngon) 1, grub mtha'/ 2, khas len/
khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings de nyid dam stong nyid/

1) dag pa'i dag pa ste, bden thog drang bzhag dang, dam pa mthar phyin pa/ rgyu mtshan yang dag pa/ bsam tshul yang dag pa/ 'gro lam yang dag pa/ yang dag pa'i re 'dod/ yang dag pa'i gnas tshul/ yang dag par smra ba/ yang dag par lta ba/ lta stangs yang dag pa 'dzin pa/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhus pa/ 2) mchog dang rab/ yang dag par 'gog pa/ yang dag rgyas pa/ yang dag par mgu ba/ yang dag pa chags pa/
yin pa'i kun rdzob: phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos la phyin ci log tu brtags shing bsgrubs te bskyed pa rnams so/
yang dag kun rdzob dang don gcig
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong ngo/
rgol ba dang the tshom 'dri ba'i lan ma nor bar 'brel ba'i gtam smra bas na 'di ni shes rab rnam par dag pa yin no zhes yid ches par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
mngon shes sogs yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por sgom par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
mdo sde la sogs pa gsung rab kyi don la 'jug par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /

'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang gses sa gnyis pa yan chad kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rjes las thob pa dag pa'i 'jig rten pa'i ye shes te, de chos kyi dbyings la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis 'di ltar mthong ngo snyam du dmigs shing gcod pas na yongs su gcod pa'i yan lag go/

zhi gnas dang rab tu 'dzin pa dang btang snyoms kyi rgyu mtshan rnams ma brjod pas na zhi lhag gi lam mngon du bya ba'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
yun ring por mi skyo bar shes sgrib bam sgom spang gi gnyen por sgom par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
tshul 'chos la sogs pa lus ngag gnyis ka'i las rnam par dag par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'
srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi dge ba'i las rnams cung zad mi byed par spangs pas 'di tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin no zhes yid ches par byed pa ste, 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig /
dge ba'i chos rnams gnyen por bsten nas mi dge ba rnams spong ba'o/
pa las byung ba'i gzugs: chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs lnga'i gras, rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs so/
yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub
yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang don gcig
yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas

«samyakamsabuddha:» sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan zhig ste, tshul ji lta ba bzhin phyin ci ma log pa dang, mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chen po thob pa, sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa sangs shing, mkhyen pa'i pad mo rnam par rgyas pa'o/
yang dag par bslab pa'i gzhi
chos 'dul ba'i spang blang gi khrims/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang gses sde tshan zhig ste, mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba dang, mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa, dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa, dge ba skyes pa spel ba ste bzhi/
1) legs par mthong ba/ 2) stong nyid rtogs pa/ 3) sangs rgyas/

lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i rtags gang zhig gang la rtags su song ba'i rgol bas mthun phyogs la mthong, mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong yang med par ma nges pa, dper na skyes bu 'di chos can, kun mkhyen ma yin te, ngag smra ba'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu'o/

bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod chags yul gyi sa dgra srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba lta bu'i gru mo g.yas g.yon dang, pus mo g.yas g.yon gyi kha gnon du bzhengs pa kong po bu chu, lho brag mkho mthing, byams sprin dge rgyas, byang pra dum rtse ste lha khang bzhi/
lci ba'i ldog phyogs kyi don du go ba'i yang ba dang 'dra,
a ma'i a ma'i rabs dang, mes po'i rabs gnyis bsdus pa'i ming/

1. legs sbyar skad kyi rab sbyor dang rnam bcad dang nga ro med pa'i yi ge thung ngu/ 2. lci ba'i ldog phyogs/ khur po yang ba/ khur po yang du gtong ba/ gzugs po yang ba/ sman nus yang ba/ sman gyi yon tan yang ba/ yang mo phrag la mi lon, 'jam po gri yis mi chod/
sngar 'bad par ma zad da dung bskyar skor yang skor du 'bad pa/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gting skyes rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5182 yod/
lus yang zhing bde ba'i rtsal/ 'phong skyen la lus kyi yang rtsal che/
rtse mo'i rtse mo/ ri'i yang rtse/ mkhas pa'i yang rtser son pa/ yang rtse lhur len/
1) rang gi bu brgyud kyi mi rabs bzhi pa/ 2) rang gi spun brgyud kyi mi rabs gsum pa/ 3) slob ma'i slob ma de'i slob ma/
zab mo las kyang zab mo ste shin tu zab mo/
yang rtsal can/ skyes bu yang zor can/
nyes chad yang du gtong ba/
thengs mang ngam, rgyun du/ brtag dpyad yang yang byed pa/ skul lcag yang yang gtong ba/ yang yang bsam blo gtong ba/ bsam blo yang yang ma btang na, gtam bshad chu kha'i lbu bar 'gyur/
yang yang gi sde tshan bcu

ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu las, bcu tshan bzhi pa la, yang yang za ba'i ltung byed dang, zas za ba'i ltung byed dang, lhag pa len pa'i ltung byed dang, spangs pa za ba'i ltung byed dang, spangs pa stob pa'i ltung byed dang, 'dus shing za ba'i ltung byed dang, dus ma yin par za ba'i ltung byed dang, gsog 'jog byas pa za ba'i ltung byed dang, byin len ma byas par za ba'i ltung byed dang, zas bsod pa slong ba'i ltung byed de bcu'o/
sbyor ba'i sdug bsngal: srid par yang dang yang du skye ba len pa'i sdug sngal te sdug bsngal drug gi nang tshan zhig /
du 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal: srid par mtho dman res mos su 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal drug gi nang tshan zhig /
yang yang za ba'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la dus rung gi kha zas kyi bsod snyoms nyin gcig la gnyis gsum bslangs te za ba'o/
yang nge yeng nge'i bsdus tshig
(rgya) tshil sogs las bzos pa'i zhugs sgron/
po med pa chags tshul zhig / bsam don 'grub: nas snang ba yang shig shig byung ba

tsha dmyal brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste, lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng la mdag me 'bar ba'i klong du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med du 'dus nas phan tshun khong khro'i sems kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs pas gcig la gcig brdegs nas shi ba dang, nam mkha' las yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra grag ma thag yang sos te sngar bzhin 'thab pa sogs shi sos res mos byed pas sdug bsngal ba'o/
1) skye srid dam skye ba/ 2) bla ma'i sprul sku/
skye ba phyi ma/ yang srid med, (mngon) thar pa/
1) gsang ba'i gsang ba/ 2) rdzogs pa chen po/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho yul sa khul gyi 'bab chu zhig /
1) gu yangs po dang dog po/ 2) rgya khyon gyi tshad/ khang pa'i yangs dog / khog pa yangs dog /
1) dga' ldan dgon pa'i lha khang zhig / 2) «beeshali» rgya gar gyi grong khyer zhig / 3) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'dam gzhung rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/

ma med pa ldan pa: yangs pa dang dri ma med pa ldan pa zhes bya tshad ma kun las btus pa'i 'grel bshad ces pa'i bsdus ming, rgya gar gyi rgyal ba'i dbang po blo gros kyis brtsams pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung zhig /

rgya che ba/ sa cha gu yangs po/ blo rgya yangs po/ khog yangs/ spyan yangs po/ sku kho lag yangs shing bzang ba/ yangs pa'i bsam pa/ bag yangs po/ blo yangs khog gsal/ mi sems bde na bzang, me khog yangs na bzang/ sde don shod na khog pa yangs dgos, rta rgod khrid na mthur mda' ring dgos/

1) gsal po med pa/ sngar gyi gnas lugs yad de yud de dran pa/ bsam blo yad yud tsam las ma btang ba/ 2) khe nyen la mi lta ba'i gtam dang bya ba rngam chen/ khe nyen ji byung mi brtsi bar yad yud bya rgyu/
yad de yud de'i bsdus tshig
yas mtshams 'byed pa'i tshig / ri sked yan du song ba/ rang lo bco brgyad yan la/
zur du kha 'thor ba'am, thor bu ba'am, yan gar ba/ dkar yol yan khyar ba/
logs su thon pa'am zur pa/
ya tshad dam yas mtshams 'dzin pa'i tshig / bsam 'char 'dir yid mthun pa brgya cha dgu bcu yan chad zin 'dug /

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) 'khyam pa/ gang sa gang la yan du ma 'jug / gzhan yul du yan nas phyin pa/ 2) brlag pa/ dngos po 'di ma yan pa zhig gnang dgos/ 3) snang med/ yan par bzhag pa/ yan par gtong ba/ bdag med rgya yan du 'jog pa/ 2. gzhan pa/ 'di min yan pa ci zhig yod/ 3. bdag tu ma bzung ba dang bdag po med pa/ khyi yan/ sa zhing yan pa/
bye brag pa'am logs gar ba/ lag cha yan pa ba/ mi rigs yan pa ba/
yan chad dang man chad de, ha lam mam rags tsam/ rgya ma lnga bcu yan man tsam/ lo nyi shu yan man/

1) lus las yan par gyes pa'i lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis, mgo bcas lnga'i spyi'i ming/ lus kyi yan lag / yan lag nyams pa/ 2) cha shas sam, le lag / tshul khrims kyi yan lag / lus dang yan lag / rtsa ba dang yan lag / gtso bo dang yan lag / yan lag dang nying lag / yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag / yan lag dngul khang/ yan lag tshong khang/ yan lag ma tshang ba/
sprin dang du ba sogs yan lag tu gyur pa'i mdog go /
yan lag gi kha dog brgyad
sprin dang, du ba, rdul, khug rna, grib ma, nyi 'od, snang ba, mun pa bcas so/
'byung 'gyur gyi chos lnga bskyed pa las gyur pa/
lus la gnas pa'i 'byung gyur gyi rlung ste, klu'i rlung sa khams, rus sbal gyi rlung rlung khams, rtsangs pa'i rlung me khams, lhas byin gyi rlung chu khams, nor rgyal gyi rlung sa khams rnams so/

dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i lus can nad gso ba'i skabs la yan lag mi 'dra ba brgyad mchis te lus spyi'i nad kyi yan lag byis nad kyi yan lag mo nad kyi yan lag gdon gyi yan lag mtshon gyi yan lag dug gi yan lag rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag ro tsa'i nad gso bar bya ba'i yan lag bcas brgyad do/
yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu
mngar ba dang, bsil ba, 'jam pa, yang ba, dwangs pa, gtsang ba, mgrin pa la mi gnod pa, lto ba la phan pa ste brgyad/
yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bsnyen gnas

bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa ste, srog gcod pa dang, ma byin par len pa, 'dod pas log par g.yem pa, rdzun du smra ba, chang 'thung ba, dus ma yin pa'i kha zas za ba, phreng sogs gar sogs gcig tu byas pa, mal stan che mtho bcas spong ba'o/
yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bsnyen gnas dang don gcig
yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa
'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos tshad ma zhig /
'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po dpa' bo rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa la, slar rang nyid kyis 'grel pa mdzad pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos tshad ma zhig /
1) rkang lag bzhi dang mgo/ yan lag lnga sa la gtugs nas phyag bya ba/ 2) skar rtsis skabs kyi lnga bsdus/

gyi sbyor ba: 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyi phyag chen khrid pa'i sngon 'gro'i sbyor ba yan lag lnga ste, byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang, rang lus lhar bsgom pa, bla ma la mos gus bsgom pa, mi rtog pa'i lta ba bsgom pa, bsngo sman gyis rgyas 'debs pa bcas so/
la phab pa'i phyag dpral ba: lag mthil gnyis pus mo'i lha nga gnyis bcas sa la gtugs nas phyag 'tshal ba/
1) cha shas 'dus pa'i tshogs pa/ 2) (mngon) zla ba/
yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can

gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe can don gyi yan lag gcig kho na dpe'i yan lag gcig gi gzugs can du byas shing, yan lag lhag ma dang, yan lag can gzugs su ma bkod pa'i rgyan zhig ste 'dis yan lag gnyis gzugs sogs kyang mtshon/

bya rgyud kyi bsnyen sbyor yan lag bcu'i cho ga: ste gang du sgrub pa'i gnas dang, de nyid gsum, bsam gtan gsum, sngags sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga, sbyin sreg gi cho ga , dbang bskur gyi cho ga ste bcu'o/
myang rtsis su yan lag 'jug gi ri mo ste gnyis: shar na yul gru la lar char 'bab cing la lar mi 'bab, 'bru tshogs nyams/
lag can gyi 'brel pa: rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra'i nang gses/ shing gi yal ga/ lag pa'i sor mo/ me tog gi 'dab ma/
chos bsgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i sbyor ba'i chos bdun te tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa dang, rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa dang, sngags phyogs kyi yan lag bdun pa lta bu'o/
gnas brtan bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, ston pa'i bka' bsgos ltar ri bo gangs can na gnas nas bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa/
rta dmag dang, glang po che'i dmag shing rta'i dmag rkang thang gi dmag bcas bzhi yod pa'i dmag dpung/

rnam par 'byes pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shin tu rnam par phye ba ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byes pa/
/ 1) pha'i zhe sa/ 2) skyibs/ bsil yab/ mda' yab/ 3) pho rgyud kyi lha/
drug dbu rgyan dang: rna rgyan, mgul rgyan, gdu bu, mchod phyir thogs, thal chen gyi tshom bu drug go/
yab kyang yin la rgyal po'ang yin pa/ yab gcig rang gi pha'i zhe sa'am brtsi bkur che ba'i ming/
snga dus mi drag sku drag gi phru gu'i pha yi che ming ngam zhe sa/
rang gi bu sogs nye 'khor gyis rgyal po la 'bod pa'i zhe sa/ sa skyong yab rje rgyal po/
sngar bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan pos bod la: dbang sgyur skabs rgyal rigs su gtogs pa'i rus te lho, gnyags, khyung, snubs, se, spo bcas drug /
1) pha dang mes po/ 2) mes po snga rabs/
bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs t'a la'i dang, pan chen sogs bla chen khag 'khrungs sa'i khyim tshang/
sems rang sar gnas mi thub pa/
1) pha ma gnyis/ 2) khyo shug gnyis/
ya be yo be'i bsdus tshig
1) pha dang bu/ 2) slob dpon dang slob ma/

yab sras mjal ba de kho na nges par bstan pa'i bam po bco lnga pa le'u nyer drug dang, sho lo ka bzhi stong lnga brgya yod pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lendra bo dhi dang, dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na shi la dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/
nee p'a la'i rgyal sa ka te ma gru/
ha lam mam rags tsam/ slob sbyong yam me ba zhig las byed rgyu ma byung/

1) 'gul stangs sam g.yo tshul zhig / shing 'go rlung gis bskyod de yam me yom me byed/ zam pa yam yom byed pa/ 2) tshig don rags rim tsam/ yam yom la lus pa/ gsal po med pa'i 'grel bshad yam me yom me zhig gis go rtogs la phan mi thogs/
yam me yom me'i bsdus tshig

sngags kyi sbyin sreg gi rdzas 'om bu/ ming gi rnam grangs la phra mo'i shing dang, bud shing, byin za'i shing, sbyin sreg shing, tshim byed shing, zhugs kyi shing, shing bu, sreg shing, hom shing bcas so,
/ 1) rims nad/ dal yams/ 2) rgyu mtshan tan tan bshad rgyu med pa'i tshod bshad/ mkhas rlom bshad yams/ na yams su bshad pa/ bshad yams 'byams pa/
'go ba'i rims nad/ yams nad kyis lus can gyi srog phrogs pa/
/ 1) yas mas gnyis kyi yas/ yar 'khyam mar myul/ yar bshad mar bshad/ yar rlangs shor dang, mar thigs shor med pa/ 2) 'phar ba'am 'thor ba/ khong gi mgo la yar rdo phog nas rma bzos 'dug /
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sne gdong rdzong khongs yar lha sham po'i chu rgyud kyi spyi ming/
yar klungs bkra shis zhol pa
sngar 'phyongs rgyas bkra shis zhol pa'i rjes su btsugs pa'i bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa zhig gi ming/
yul yar klungs nas bzos pa'i lham zon pa'i mthil zhig /

bod du yod pa'i gtsang po che shos shig gi ming, gtsang po de mnga' ris sa khul khongs spu hring rdzong gi mtsho ma pham shar rgyud nas 'bab cing, gtsang po de'i stod rgyud la rta mchog kha 'bab zer, de nas gtsang gi sa cha brgyud lho kha sa khul khongs sne gdong rdzong gi yar klungs yul du 'bab skabs yar klungs gtsang po zer, de nas mu mthud kyis shar phyogs su bab ste, kong po nying khri sa khul khongs me tog rdzong gi nye 'dabs nas kha lho phyogs la gtad nas hin rdu dang, bhang ga la brgyud hin rdu rgya mtshor 'bab gyin yod, gtsang po 'di'i rgyud kyi bod yul sa khul khag la thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing gnam gshis yag po yod pas, bod kyi mi rigs thog mar sa khul de nas 'phel rgyas byung ba dang, gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar gyi srid don lte gnas shig red/ (rta mchog kha 'bab)/ (gtsang po)/ (yar klungs)...

zla ba'i dkar cha yar 'phel ba dang, dkar phyogs kyi dus tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar/ yar ngo'i tshes brgyad/ yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar phyogs dang, gang phyogs, rgyas phyogs, phyogs snga ma, 'phel phyogs, zhi phyogs bcas so,
nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo la khyim du slebs na yar ngo sngon 'gro zhes bya/
gong du phud pa ste dmigs bsal btang ba/ lo na rgan po dang byis pa nad pa nyam chung ba bcas yar bcad nas tshang ma las kar zhugs pa/
yar klungs gtsang po ste 'phyongs rgyas rdzong dang sne gdong rdzong brgyud skabs kyi ming/

yar dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba dang, mar ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba ste, dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron dang mgon po yon tan mgron te, yar mgron gnyis dang, rigs drug snying rje'i mgron dang gdon bgegs lan chags mgron te, mar mgron gnyis bcas mgron tshan bzhi la mchod 'bul sbyin gtong/
legs pa'am bzang bar mig dpe lta ba/
dmigs sar ma phog par gzhan du 'khyogs pa'i rdo/ dmigs pa'i gnad la ma thebs par yar rdo gzhan la phog nas bsnad skyon bzos pa/
nyal sa sogs nas yar lang ba/
steng du 'phyo ba'am 'phur ba/ lgang bu tshon khra rnams mkha' la yar lding ba/
gyen ldog / bka' la yar ldog /
lung pa'am grong tsho'i yar phyogs/ ri chen po de'i yar nang na grong tsho mang po yod cing mar nang na nags tshal stug po yod/
1) steng du thon pa'am mthon por gyur pa/ 2) khyad par du 'phags pa/
1) mang du song ba/ mtsho chu yar 'phar ba/ khrom gong yar 'phar/ 2) gyen du 'phar ba/ sa nas yar 'phar ba/ spre'u shing gi yal ga la yar 'phar ba/
(tha mi dad pa) 'khyar ba, kha 'thor ba/ khyu nas yar ba/ rdo bcag pa'i dum bu rnams ring du yar ba/ me stag yar ba/
lo gcig lon pa'i be'u ste yul skad la lar ya ru zer/
sa khul khongs sna dkar rtse rdzong gi sa: cha zhig /
sna dkar rtse rdzong gi sa cha sngar bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud dang gtsang po'i lho ngos, sna dkar rtse rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod, de'i 'khor rgya spyi le gru bzhi 678 dang mtsho'i ngos mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las smi 4441 yin pa, gting zab shos kyi sar smi 59 yod pa, mtsho'i nang du nya rigs 'bel ba, mtsho 'gram du rtswa sna chu sna 'dzoms pas 'brog sa yag po zhig red, mtsho de'i nub byang gi mtsho sner mtsho chu yar klungs gtsang por rgyug sa'i lam zhig yod kyang, da lta bye 'dam gyis bkag nas chu rgyug sa med pa'i skam sa'i nang khul gyi mtsho zhig tu gyur/
be'u skyes nas lo gcig khog stong du bsdad de 'o ma phyed tsam bzho rgyu yod pa'i 'bri sogs,

1) yar ma'i 'o ma las bton pa'i mar/ 2) steng 'og gam phar tshur/ yar mar 'gro ba/ yar rgyu mar rgyu/ yar rgyug mar rgyug / yar mchong mar mchong/ yar bskums mar brkyangs/ yar skyug mar bshal/ rgan gzhon rnams yar bud mar bud byas pa/ yar rlangs mar thigs med/ yar zhu mar gnang/ yar bzhag mar bzhag / yar bbshad mar bshad/ yar bstod mar smad/ rin gong yar spar mar bcag nges gtan med pa/ tshong la khe gyong mi 'dug yar lang mar bsdad khyad par med/
zla ba yar ngo'i tshes grangs/ chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga/
'bri sogs yar ma'i 'o mas bzos pa'i zho/
zas ma zhu bar thur du 'byung ba...
(yul) 1) yas sgron dang don gcig 2) snod kyi kha gyen du yar bzed pa/
1) gong nas gong du 'gro ba/ nga tsho yar yar 'gro dus, kha ba mar mar bab byung/ 2) chad pa'am 'phar ba/ mdung khra ring skar mda' yar yar red/
khyar khyor/ gom pa yar re yor re spos pa/ gom pa yar re yor re spos te 'gro ba/
1) nyal ba dang bsdad pa las ldang ba/ yar langs nas bya rmyang byed/ 2) log spyod dbang sgyur gyi 'og nas thar grol thob pa/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams yar lang zin/
bod kyi rgyal rabs deb ther 'di yar klungs rje rgyud shak ya rin chen sdes rab byung drug pa'i me 'brug lor brtsams, mjug tu rngog lo dang sa skya'i gdan rabs 'khod yod/
1) gyen log byed pa/ 2) kha yar phyogs pa/ me tog gi 'dab ma yar log pa/ 3) thur nas gyen du yong ba/ lung pa'i mda' nas phu la yar log pa/
grwa pa skya sar babs nas slar yang grwa pa byas pa/
yar dkrug mar dkrug gam gong 'og brje ba/
yar klungs phur yod pa'i gangs re zhig /

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sne gdong rdzong khongs yar klungs nas 'bab pa'i 'bab chu zhig ste chu 'go mtsho smad rdzong khongs kha grod kyi phu nas byung zhing yar klungs gtsang po'i yan lag cig yin, mi kha shas kyis yar klungs chu'am sham po chu'ang zer/

sdong po nas skyes pa'i lcug phran/ lcang ma skye lugs legs kyang, yal ga med na mi mdzes/ kham bu za 'dod ma red, yal ga gcod 'dod red/ yal ga gyes pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mgo ling dang, lcug ma, sdong po'i sor mo, shing gi brtul zhugs bcas so,
grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i rtsi stangs gzhan zhig gi nang yod pa'i grangs ka'i ming/

(tha mi dad pa) mthong rgyu med par gyur pa/ tshon mdog yal ba/ drod yal ba/ sprin nag yal nas gnam gshis dwangs por gyur pa/ lhags pa brgyab nas na bun yal ba/ du ba yal ba ltar med par gyur ba/ kha gtam g.yu 'brug skad las che lag len nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal/
gces spras mi byed pa'am dang len mi byed pa/ nyam chung yal bar 'dor ba mi rigs so/
