ya le yo le dang yal le yol le'i bsdus tshig

dus dang, bya ba, dngos po sogs don med du 'da' ba'am snying po med par 'dzad pa/ yal yol dor ba/ yal le yol le'i ngang nas nyi ma gang 'khyol byed pa/ khag 'dogs ci rigs kyis yal yol phar 'gyangs byed/ nad kyi yong rkyen thams cad yal yol cha med du thal/ sngar gyi grags pa cal col thams cad yal yol cha med du thal/
/ 1) stod dang yan/ mig btsum skabs pags pas steng nas yas 'gebs byed pa/ 2) bon po'i glud rdzas mdos gtor sogs/
1) rang 'thag gi yas rdo/ 2) yas gtun/
ya khas ma kha 'joms pa'am gnon pa/
bod lugs rten 'brel byed skabs chang snod sogs kyi khar mar rtsam gyi mdzes rgyan sbyar ba'i ming/ yang rtse'i sgang la yas sgron/
1) rang 'thag gi yas rdo/ 2) yas gtun/
lo bzhi lon pa'i rta drel/
1) rang 'thag gi yas rdo/ 2) sgog gtun gyi yas rgyag
bon lugs las bshad pa'i lha 'dre la brngan pa'i glud gtor cha zhig /
(yul) nya 'dzin byed kyi thag pa zhig /
sgo'i ru bzhi'i thod kyi 'phred shing/
chu 'khor gyi yas rdo/ chu 'khor yas rdo 'khor yong, mas rdo brel ba ma byed/
mar me kong bu'i bye brag cig /
klas pa dang 'das pa dang med pa/ mtha' yas pa/ bgrang yas pa/ dpag yas pa/ gzhal yas pa/
1) chu sogs steng nas mar babs pa/ 2) nyams pa/

bla med ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim las bshad pa'i rlung gnad du tshud pa'i gtum mo'i rtogs pa zhig ste, byang sems spyi bo las bab pas dga' ba dang, mgrin par bab pas mchog dga' dang, snying gar dga' bral dang, lte bar lhan cig skyes dga' sogs 'khor lo bzhir bab pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi'o/
byang sems spyi bo nas gsang gnas su yas nas mar bab pa la yas babs dang, nor bu nas lte ba sogs gnas bzhir yar bzlog pa la mas brtan zhes bya'o/
sngon ma dang gong ma/ ka kha sde pa dang po'i yi ge yas ma gnyis so, ka kha...
yas mar zhung gis byung ba
(rnying) steng nas mar shar te byung ba/
stod smad dam gong 'og / grong yas mas/ mi grangs sum cu yas mas tsam/ tshes pa lnga'i yas mas/
yas kyi mtshams sam ltag ma'i bar mtshams/
mang nyung, bzang ngan, legs nyes, mtho dman sogs mgo snyoms pa'am cha mnyam par byed pa/ ring thung yas bsu mas skyel gyis gcig pa bzo ba/ mi grangs mang nyung yas bsu mas skyel byed pa/
yas bsu mas skyel dang don gcig
1.yid/ yi rang ba/ yi gu dog / yi brel ba/ 2.rnam dbye drug pa'i rkyen te 'a dang mtha' med la 'thob pa'i 'brel sgra/ 'a...
1) sems/ 2) zas kyi dang ga/ yi ga gyen du 'phyur ba/ yi ga 'chus pa/ yi ga 'gags pa/ yi ga 'byed pa/
1) dang ga dang 'phrod pa/ nad pas yi gar 'phrod pa'i lto chas bza' dgos/ tshwa mang bas yi gar mi 'phrod pa/ 2) yid la 'ong ba'am, sems la bab pa/ bsam 'char de nga'i yi gar 'phrod byung/
1) zas la dang ga yod pa/ 2) yid du 'ong ba/ 3) (mngon) chu dwangs ma/

1) ming dang, tshig dang, rjod pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa zhig ste, skad kyi sgra gdangs kyi gzhi rtsa mtshon byed kyi brda/ dbyangs kyi yi ge/ gsal byed kyi yi ge/ rkyen gyi yi ge/ ming gzhi'i yi ge/ sngon 'jug gi yi ge/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge/ yi ge a'a li ka li gnyis/ yi ge sum cu tham pa/ yi ge'i khongs nas ming 'byung ba/ 2) tsheg bar gyi dbar du yod pa'i ming dang phrad dang rnam dbye so sor ston byed kyi yig 'bru/ yi ge sbyor klog / yi ge'i dag cha/ yi ge dag pa/ yi ge ma dag pa/ yi ge'i rig pa/ 3) rjod pa ste, yig 'bru du ma sbyar nas grub pa'i yig tshogs/ rgya'i yi ge/ bod kyi yi ge/ yi ge rtsom pa/ yi ge 'bri ba/ yi ge klog pa/ yi ger bkod pa/ 4) yig cha'am, yig rigs spyi/ gzhung sa'i yi ge/ khungs skyel yi ge/ dpang rgya'i yi ge/ kha dan yi ge/ lag 'dzin yi ge/ gros chod yi ge/ go bsdur yi ge/ 5) gtong yig / yi ge bskur ba/ yi ge bsrings pa/ yi ge'i 'bul rten/ yi ge skyel ba/ yi ge'i lan/
legs sbyar gyi yi ge 'greng bu dang rna ru nyis brtsegs can/ 'greng bu...rna ru...
1) yig 'bru re re ba/ 2) mgo can gsum dang 'phul med kyi yi ge/
yi ge pa dang don gcig
yig 'bru brgya tham pa yod pa'i gzungs sngags/ rdor sems kyi yi ge brgya pa/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'grel pa/
go dka' ba bkral ba'i yig chung bkod pa/
sgra, skad, ming, mtshan ma, brda, tha snyad, tshig don bcas brgyad/
the'u brgyab pa'am phab yod pa'i yi ge/
1) ommanipadmeh'um, zhes pa'i gzungs/ 2) spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan gyi bye brag cig /
yi ge drug ma'i rig sngags
spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs kyi snying po/
snga ma'i gsal byed phyi mar spos la phyi ma'i gsal byed snga mar spos pa/ hidra + ? sa/ hridra + ? sra/ sridra + ? hra/ sidha/ sidhe/ sengge
1) yig mkhan/ 2) (mngon) shing gi srin bu zhig /
yig tshig gzhan la dpod bzhin du rtsom pa/
yig nag gam gshar ma 'di'i khongs su yig gzugs ka kha dang, zlos hral, tshugs ring, tshugs thung, tshugs chung ngam 'khyug ma tshugs, 'khyug yig bcas che chung mi 'dra ba khag drug yod/
ming gzhir rjes sngon dbyangs sogs sgrig pa/
za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad snying po: gzungs kyi sde tshan zhig /
yig rus yag po'am, yig gzugs sbom shas che ba/
sgra rig pa las gsal ba'i sgra'i gzhi yi ge'i rgyu lnga ste brjod 'dod dang, rlung, gnas, byed pa, rtsol ba bcas so/
pho dang, mo, ma ning gi rtags so/
spyir btang yi ge re re ba'i sgra 'byin pa'i yun tshad mig 'dzum gyi tshad du bshad/
1) spyir btang yi ge la a'a li dang ka li gnyis kyi dbye ba dang ka li'i nang gses kyi dbye ba mtha' dag / 2) yi ge sbyor tshul sogs bshad pa'i gzhung/
1) yi ge'i rtsa ba'am, ka sogs sum cu/ ka...2) yi ge 'bri klog gang byed kyi ma dpe/
ming tshig yi ge sogs kyi sdeb sbyor gyi bya ba/
1) ma gzhi'i zin bris/ 2) ka deb bam yi ge gzab gshar gyi ma yig yag po dper lta sa/
sngon rjes ming gsum 'dus pa'i ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge thams cad kyi phyi mo a dang ka la sogs pa mang po 'dus pa ldan min 'du byed kyi nang gses shig / a ka...
1) dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yig gzugs dang sgra/ 2) shog bu dang shing byang sogs/
stong nyid de kun rdzob zla dkyil gyi rnam par bsgyur nas sngags kyi yig 'bru sa bon bsgom pa, bya rgyud lha drug gi nang gses shig /
sems skyo ru 'jug pa'am sems pham du 'jug pa/
sems skyo ba dang zhum pa/ lan brgyar pham yang yid thang mi 'chad pa/ bzang bstod ngan smad med pa dang, go ldog byas tshe bzang po rnams kyang yi chad par 'gyur/
yi chad pa dang don gcig
1) rgyud sde las bshad pa'i thun mong min pa'i bsten bya'i lha sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ yi dam gyi lha/ 2) dam bca' dang, khas len/ yi dam bca' ba/ yi dam brtan pa/
rgyud sde rang rang gi lha'i rtsa sngags dang nye snying sogs/

(pret'a) ngan 'gro gsum gyi nang tshan zhig ste, zas skom yid la btags pas na yi dwags/ yi dwags kyi 'jig rten/ yi dwags nang sgrib can/ yi dwags phyi sgrib can/ yi dwags wa ba can/ ming gi rnam grangs la ngan khyab dang, chu bo rab med, dpal min, phun tshogs min bcas so,
yi dwags kyi 'jig rten nam skye gnas/
sgrib pa can: yi dwags kha dang mid pa ha cang phra zhing lto ba che ba'i rigs shig /
yi dwags phyi'i sgrib pa can
yi dwags zas skom mi rnyed pa'am, rnyed kyang longs spyod mi nus pa'i rigs shig /
byings na gnas pa dang, kha 'thor ba gnyis so/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rdzong khongs rgyal mo rngul chu'i 'gram du yod/
phyi'i sgrib pa can dang, nang gi sgrib pa can, gnyis ka'i sgrib pa can te gsum/
(rnying) dogs pa'am rnam rtog za ba/
sems sdug pa'am sems pham pa/
sems dga' ba dang mos pa/ gzhan gyi bde ba la yi rang ba/ gzhan gyi gsungs pa la yi rang ba/ yi mi rang ba/ las 'gan khur du len par yi rang ba/ dga' mgu yi rang/ yi rang gong bkur/
yi mug pa dang don gcig
yi chad pa ste sro shi ba'ang zer, yul dge mi dge lung ma bstan ci rigs la dmigs nas ngas mi nus so snyam ste sems kyi sro shi ba'am chag nas sems shugs nyams pa/ dka' las byung yang yi mi shi ba/
yi ge'i bsdus ming, yi ge/ ka yig ka...ga yig gis 'phul, ga...rtsom yig / chad yig / chings yig / bskur yig / btang yig / lam yig / 'khyug yig / drung yig / yig khag / yig bstar/
1) yig phreng gi dkyus tshad/ 2) rtsa ba dang mchan bu gnyis kyi rtsa ba/ 3) yig gzugs phal pa/
1) sngon 'jug rjes 'jug mgo can gang yang med pa'i yig 'bru rkyang pa/ 2) 'bul rten dngos po sogs med pa'i bskur yig /
yi ge 'bri srol ltar gyi skad cha'am yig thog gi skad cha/
1) yi ge ma dag pa/ 2) yig gzugs ma legs pa/ 3) tshig dang don la skyon yod pa'i yi ge/
yi ge'i par brkos rgyag mkhan/
bskur yig / yig bskur gtong ba/ yig bskur thog gi slob khrid,
phrin yig 'bri ba'i thabs lam dang bskur: lugs kyi bshad pa
(yul) 'bri mkhan rang ming 'god mi nus pa'i gtam 'chal yi ge/
rtsod pa thag bcad kyi dpyad mtshams yi ge/
1) yi ge pa'am drung yig / ming gi rnam grangs la drung yig dang, 'bri mkhan, smyig can, smyu gu can, yi ge pa, yi ge'i mkhan po bcas so, 2) (mngon) shing gi srin 'bu zhig
dbu med kyi yi ge'i thog mar bri rgyu'i mgo ris * 'di dang, dbu can gyi yi ge'i thog mar bri rgyu'i mgo ris * 'di lta bu'i ming/
1) yi ge 'jug sa'i phyi'i rgya/ 2) sgo thel lta bu'i bkag yig / 3) yig skogs la brgyab pa'i thel/
yi ge bris gzugs legs nyes kyi tshad gzhi/ yig rgyugs len pa/
1) yig rigs mi 'dra ba phar tshur du sgyur ba/ 2) yig rigs gcig nas gcig tu sgyur mkhan/
yi ge brgya pa'i bsdus tshig
ras dang shog bu sogs kyi khud du bsgril ba'i yi ge/
1) dpe cha dang yig rigs sna tshogs/ tshad ldan yig cha/ krung gung krung dbyang gi yig cha/ mi rigs srid jus kyi yig cha/ 2) mtshan nyid yig cha/

1) tshugs thung las cung zad chung ba gi gu gyen du bslangs pa'i yig gzugs/ gi gu...2) srid gzhung rnying pa'i skabs brda gtong gi yig chung/ 3) dpe cha'i yig chen mtshams kyi mchan bu yi ge chung ba/ 4) glu gzhas kyi nang du 'phrin yig la go rgyu/
1) rtsa ba'i yig 'bru/ 2) yig gzugs chen po/
phan mi thogs pa'i yi ge/
yig cha do dam byed mkhan/
snga rabs kyi dpe cha dang, yig rigs rnying pa/
yi ge dang mnyam du 'bul rgyu'i dngos rigs/
yig ger bkod pa/ yig thog 'khyol po/ yig thog rgyugs sprod/ yig thog gtam bshad/ yig thog bsam 'char/
1) gnyis mos kyis bzhag pa'i yi ge/ 2) tshags yig
(yul) mi mngon par tshig don la skyon gtong ba'i yig dug /
yi ge drug ma'i bsdus tshig

la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ri bo che rdzong gi lho rgyud dang, lho rdzong gi byang shar mtshams, dpal shod rdzong gi byang ngos bcas kyi bar du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 4998 yod/
yi ge dbu med/ yig nag zin bris/
gnyis mos kyis bzhag pa'i yig rigs rtsi med rdog rol du btang ba'i dpe/
shing sogs la yi ge brkos pa'i par gzhi/
mi gcig gis bklags te mi gzhan zhig gis 'bri ba'i ming/ khyod kyis yig dpod gnang dang, ngas bris chog /

sngar thu mi sam bho tas bod yig gsar du brtsams rjes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas yig phud phul ba'i tshig rkang dang po bzhir gug kyed kyi dbyangs bzhi ma 'brel ba'i a nges rkyang pa dang, tshig rkang lnga par 'greng bu, tisg rkang drug par gi gu, tshig rkang bdun par na ro, tshig rkang brgyad par zhabs kyu'i nges pa bcas snyan ngag gi gzhung bzhin sbyar te phul ba'i sgra rgyan ngo mtshar can zhig / 'greng bu...gi gu...na ro...zhabs kyu...
yig thog tu bkod nas btang ba'i gnas tshul/
1) yig 'bru dang yig 'bru bar gyi stong cha/ 2) yig phreng dang yig phreng bar gyi stong cha/ yig bar hral po/
dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge so so ste, gzugs zhes par yig 'bru bzhi yod pa ltar ro/ gzugs...yig 'bru
1) yi ge dang rtsis/ yig rtsis la mkhas pa/ 2) yig thog nas brgyab pa'i rtsis/
1) yig tshang las khungs kyi bsdus ming, 2) yig rigs nyar tshags byed sa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs yig tshang las khungs kyi drung yig chen mo bzhi'i 'og gi las byed gtso che ba zhig /

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs shig ste, de'i las 'gan ni dgon pa khag gi chos khrims gnon rgyu dang, dgon pa'i 'go byed bsko 'then, rtse drung gi go gnas spor gcog sogs yin zhing, de'i nang snyan zhu 'bul mi rnams kyi gnad don rnams yar zhu mar lan byed mkhan yig tshang gnyer pa gcig las byed pa rtse drung dkyus ma bcu gnyis, ri mo ba gcig yig tshang slob phrug ces pa yig tshang 'tshogs skabs drung yig chen mo bzhi la gsol ja 'bul mi bzhi, e pa yon bdag zer ba gcig bcas yod/
sngar chos rgyal srong btsan gyis blon po rnams la bya dga' gnang ba'i yig lam/

blon po rab la gser g.yu gnyis kyi yi ge dang, blon po 'bring bar dngul dang phra men gnyis kyi yi ge, blon po tha mar zangs dang lcags gnyis kyi yi ge sprad pa ste srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod du lag len bstar ba'i bya gzhag rigs gcig /
1) yig gzugs sbyangs 'bras chu tshad/ 2) yig rgyugs/ yig tshad rdzus ma/ yig tshad len pa/
yi ge'i tshogs pa'i bsdus tshig
yig rigs mang po 'jog sa'i khang pa/
nor sprod len sogs bris te thel tse btab pa'i yi ge / yig 'dzin bzhag pa/
yig tshogs mang nyung gi 'bor grangs/ yig zor yang ba/ yig zor rdzob dogs kyis re zhig bzhag pa/
yi ge'i bzo dbyibs/ yig gzugs mdzes kyang dag cha med na phan thogs chung/
rjod pa sna tshogs bkod pa'i yi ge rnams/ yig rigs nyar skogs/ yig rigs 'dra gnyis/
yi ge 'bri tshul lag rgyun gyi rigs/ yig rus la dbus rus, gtsang rus, khams rus, gzhung rus, e rus sogs yod/
yig thog nas btang ba'i 'phrin lan/ yig lan slog / yig lan 'byor ba/
1) bya dga'i yi ge/ 2) yi ge lam gyi gzugs su bkod pa ste don du yig thog dang 'dra/ khong la yig lam nas lan btang ba yin/
1) yi ge mi shes mkhan/ 2) dkar cha zub pa'i yi ge /
'phrin yig bskur bar phyir g.yog byed shog bu'i khug ma/
1) phan mi thogs pa'i yi ge hrul hrul/ 2) shog bu ral ba'i yi ge rnying hrul/
1) yig nor ram yig skyon/ 2) yi ge'i tshig don gyi lhad/

/ 1) yul shes pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rnam shes te, sems rnams so/ yid 'thad pa/ yid la bab pa/ yid kyi dogs pa/ yid 'phyo ba/ yid 'khrul ba/ yid 'khrugs pa/ yid dpa' zhum pa/ yid kyi zug rngu/ yid kyis grangs bsher byed pa/ yid la skor ba/ yid la song ba/ yid la lhag ger snang ba/ yid la 'tsher snang yod pa/ 2) (mngon) yid can nam sems can gyi srid pa bcu bzhi yod pas grangs bcu bzhi mtshon/ yid...
rang rang gi yul 'dzin byed kyi rnam par shes pa ste, rnam shes khams bdun po'o/
yid kyi gting ngam yid kyi kun slong/

1) mngon sum bzhi'i nang gses, rang 'dren byed kyi dbang mngon las byung zhing de'i gzung don skad cig gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gzhan rig dper na, bum 'dzin mig shes 'gag ma thag tu de'i rgyu las byung ba'i yid mngon dus mtha'i skad cig ma'i yun tshad skye ba lta bu, dbang mngon skad cig phyi ma'o/ 2) rang gi bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gzhan rig dper na gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes lta bu'o/
yid kyi nye bar rgyu ba
tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms kyi dbang gis yid gzugs sgra sogs la yang dang yang du rgyu bar byed pa'o/
brnab sems, gnod sems, log lta bcas yid kyi nyes par spyod pa gsum/
sems kyi las sam bya ba
yid kyi mi dge ba nye bar spong ba'i sems pa/
yid kyi yul te skye mched bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/
pho rtsal sna dgu'i nang gses, mdzangs la blo 'gyu ba dang, dpa' la bsran tshugs pa, kha gsal zhing gting mi dpog pa ste gsum/
1) snying gi dkyil/ 2) mthun pa'i snying grogs sam mdza' grogs/
yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las te, brnab sems sogs yid kyi las mi dge ba dang, brnab sems spangs pa sogs yid kyi las dge ba lta bu'o/

cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi: rjes su 'brang ba thugs kyi phrin las te, rnam par rtog pa dang spros pa thams cad ye shes kyi sngon du spangs nas don dam pa'i rjes su zhugs shing chos kyi dbyings la yid 'jug pa ste ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /

sbyang gzhi bar do'i lus gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, shi nas skye ba ma blangs bar gyi srid pa bar do ni zas su dri za zhing sems sgyu ma lta bu dbang po tshang zhing thogs pa med pas yid kyi lus zhes bya'o/
1) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 2) (mngon) 'dod chags/
thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang las byung ba'i rig pa/
sems sdug pa'am blo pham pa/ yid skyo ba'i lam la ma song na, sems dga' ba'i grogs dang mi 'phrad do/
mig gi rnam shes la sogs pa drug po de dag nyid 'das ma thag pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam shes gzhan gyis bar du ma chod pa'i rnam par shes pa skyed pa'i dbang po ste yid kyi dbang po'o/
1) 'dod pa tshims pa/ 2) nga rgyal skyes pa/
sems rgyud 'byongs pa'am thul ba, sems 'khul thebs pa/
yid tshims pa'am yi rangs pa/ mi rnams kyi yid mgu thub pa/
(mngon) nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren pa'i rta bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
sems la sna tshogs dran nus pa'am blo g.yer po/
sems kyi nang ngam blo yul/ yid ngor gang snang/ yid ngor gsal ler dran pa/
blo tshims pa'am 'dod pa gang ba/ phyogs gnyis ka yid ngoms pa byung ba/
yid kyi mngon sum gyi bsdus ming,
yid kyi mngon sum la rten gyi sgo nas dbye na, gzugs 'dzin yid mngon dang, sgra 'dzin yid mngon dang, dri 'dzin yid mngon dang, ro 'dzin yid mngon dang, reg 'dzin yid mngon te lnga'o/

tshad ma gsum gyi nang gses, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa, dper na, mngon shes skad cig dang po lta bu'o/
mdza' ba'am yid mthun pa, sems mthun pa/ chog tu yid gcugs pa/ yid gcugs grogs po lhan cig 'dus te phan tshun snying la 'bab pa'i gtam gleng byas/
yid chad par byed pa'am blo zhum par byed pa/ dgra ma thub gong la tshig ngan gyis yid bcad pa der dgos pa ci yod/
yul yid 'ong la sems chags pa/ 'tsho ba skyid por yid chags pa/ gzhan gyi 'byor pa la yid chags pa/
blos 'khel/ yid ches brtan po/ yid ches blo smon/ yid ches rnyed pa/ yid ches blo 'gel/ yid ches la ma ches/ mang tshogs la yid ches/

rtags yang dag gsum gyi nang gses, dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung sgrub byed du bkod nas bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa ste, dper na, sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde zhes pa'i lung chos can, rang gi bstan don la mi bslu ba yin te, dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir, zhes pa lta bu sa 'og gi gter dang, zhing khams las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag sogs gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur 'jal byed kyi rtags so/
dad pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang dkon mchog la yid ches pa'o/
yid ches rjes dpag dang don gcig

rjes dpag gsum gyi nang gses, rang gi rten yid ches kyi rtags yang dag la brten nas gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur la mi bslu ba'i shes pa ste, dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung la brten nas rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu'o/
blo 'khel ba'am yid brtan thob pa/
gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur dpog par byed pa'i gzhi dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung/
sems gzhan du 'khyogs pa'am blo kha 'gyur ba/ sems gcig tu brtan pas yid mi 'chus pa/
yid la nges pa/ de don yid 'jags yod pa 'tshal/
blo'am sems la 'jog pa/ las ka byed stangs yid 'jog byed/
the tshom mam som nyi/ yang dag yin min la yid gnyis byed pa/
1) mi gzhan la blos bkal ba/ 2) dmigs yul la bsam blo gtad pa/
cha 'jog / thabs lam yid rton rung ba/ gang bshad tshang mar yid rton thub pa/ g.yo can ngag 'jam smra ba la, mkhas pas yid rton ci la byed/ drang zhing yid rton rung ba/ 'dra sku la yid rton pa/
yid ches dang, blos bkal ba/ yid brtan 'khel ba/ yid brtan 'pher ba/ yid brtan byed pa/ yid brtan pa la ma 'khu ba/ yid brtan du mi rung ba/ mchog tu yid brtan par gyur pa'i grogs po/
gzhan blo dang mthun par byed pa,/ phan tshun yid bstun mi byed pa/ nor 'khrul gyi shod stangs la yid bstun thabs med pa/
1) phan tshun blo mthun pa/ 2) blo dang mthun pa'i gnyen nye/ yid mthun rogs ram/
brtse gdung rtse gcig tu'am rtsol med shugs 'byung/ skom pas gzir ba rnams chu 'dod kyis yid dung nge bar sdod/
sems sdug pa'am sems skyo ba/ yid dung dung ngang nas ngus pa/
1) snying brtse ba/ 2) 'dod yon la zhen pa/
sems sdug pa/ rang gi 'dod don ma 'grub nas yid gdungs pa/
1) sems sim pa/ yid mi bde ba/ 2) bag phebs pa/
dbang po nyer gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, sems kyi tshor ba bde ba'o/
sems kyi mos pa/ bden don 'thob par yid 'dun byed/
yid la brjed med du 'jags pa/ gong gsal bka' dgongs rnams yid 'doms gyis/
sems log pa'am 'gyur ba/ bsam sbyor rtsub pas gzhan yid ldog /
1) sems skyo ba/ sdug bsngal byung nas yid nang du chud pa/ 2) (mngon) sdug bsngal/

blo rig bdun gyi nang gses, myong stobs dang gtan tshigs gang rung la brten nas dngos su sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i nges pa dang bral zhing rang yul bden pa la mtha' gcig tu gsar du zhen pa'i rtog pa ste, dper na, sgra spyi tsam gyis nges pa rnyed pa'i thos byung gi blo lta bu rgyu mtshan mi shes bzhin du rang yul don mthun du 'dzin pa'i yid kyis rnam par dpyod pa'i rtog pa thams cad do/
gces spras byed pa/ spyi nor la yid phangs byed pa/
yi chad pa'am yi mug pa/
yid ches su rung ba dang, blo dang 'tsham pa/ gzhan la gtam yid phebs par smras te blo 'gugs pa/
sems chags pa'am dung sems kyis 'dor mi bra ba/ pha yul la yid 'phreng ba/ yum sras gnyis la yid 'phreng ste srog gi thag pas sbrel ba ltar gyur te gom re'i mtshams nas phyi mig re lta/
sems 'gugs par byed pa/ yid 'phrog pa'i skyed mos tshal/ yon tan gyis yid 'phrog pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa/
bud med mdzes ma/ yid 'phrog lha mo/
sems kyi tshugs ka lhod por gnas pa/
dmigs par bya ba'i yul la sems gtod cing mngon du phyogs par byed pa'i shes pa'o/
ting nge 'dzin sgom skabs sems dmigs par 'jug pa'i yid la byed pa bzhi ste, bsgrims te 'jug pa dang, chad cing 'jug pa, chad pa med par 'jug pa dang, lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i yid byed de bzhi/
1) blo rig mi gsal ba/ 2) sems mi bde zhing brtan por mi gnas pa/ 3) sems ci bya gtol med du gyur pa/

1) yid shes kyi bdag rkyen nam, sems kyi rtsol ba nus ldan/ brtse ba chen pos yid dbang 'phrog pa/ ltad mo ngo mtshar can gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa/ 2) yid kyi dbang po ste, rnam shes tshogs drug gang yang rung ba 'gag ma thag pa yid shes skye ba'i rten du gyur pa, dper na bum 'dzin mig shes sogs gang yang rung ba 'gag ma thag pa ni bum 'dzin yid shes skad cig dang po'i yid dbang yin zhing, yid shes skad cig dang po 'gag ma thag pa ni skad cig gnyis pa'i yid dbang yin pa lta bu'o/

1) lus dang longs spyod de dag la spyod cing gnas pa'i mtha' skye ba dang, rga ba dang, na ba dang, 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'phel bar rig nas spong zhing de la mi 'jug pa'o/ 2) sems skyo ba/
(rnying) yid ma mug pa'am yi ma chad pa/
1) sems la sdug bsngal yod pa/ 2) sems smyos pa/
yid mi bde ba'i dbang po
dbang po nyer gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, sems kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/
sems myos pa/ dga' bas yid myos pa/ nga rgyal gyis yid myos pa/ sems sdug pas yid myos pa/
sems mi gsal ba/ chang gis bzi nas yid rmugs par gyur/
yid sun pa'am sems skyo ba/ yid rmus te mchi ma shor ba/
dga' zhing gus bkur ram re 'dun yod pa/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo rnams la yid smon pa/
blo ngoms pa'am 'dod pa gang ba/ yid tshim blo dga'/ yid tshim blo bab/ gnas skabs yid tshim pa/ dga' mgu yid tshim/
tshod dpag / don gsal po ma rtogs par yid tshod ma byed/ dka' ngal la yid tshod byed rgyu mang drags pa/
1) sems dpa' 'khums pa/ yid zhum nas mdun skyod mi thub pa/ 2) sems sdug / bka' bkyon 'khel bas yid zhum pa/
1) blo gsal ba'am mkhas pa/ yid mi gzhungs pa/ 2) dran skyen pa/
bsam pa nang bzhin/ don kun yid bzhin 'grub pa/

lha klu sogs kyi khyad nor te sems la gang 'dod pa ltar 'byung ba'i rin po che zhig / mi lus rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ rgya mtsho'i gling du ma phyin pas, yid bzhin nor bu ga nas rnyed/
yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i sems bskyed

sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses, sa brgyad pa ba'i rgyud kyi smon lam gyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni gnas kyi dbang du byas pa'i yid la ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o/
yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po
nor bu'i mchog tu grags pa zhig
yid bzhin stsol ba'i nor bu
nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po/

klong chen mdzod bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, rgyu 'bras theg pa'i gnas rnams gsal bar ston pa le'u nyer gnyis kyi bdag nyid can rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan gyi gzhung, dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/
(rnying) snying gtam ma lus par smra ba/
(mngon) 1) lha/ 2) me tog / 3) ze'u 'bru/ 4) me lha/ 5) gro/
1) bsam pa bzang ba'i bud med/ 2) bdag 'dzin sogs sems kyi dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa thams cad kyi rten lta bu byed pa'i snying gi rtsa zhig /

1) sems la bab pa/ yul lung yid 'ong/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ yid 'ong ljon shing 'dab ma'i rtse la, snyan snyan sgrog pa'i g.yu bya khu byug char sprin 'bod pa'i skad gtong yin skad, 'di la brngan na gsung ngag bsdam 'gro/ 2) sa ming zhig spo bo yid 'ong ste, bod rang skyong ljongs spo bo rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/ 3) (mngon) gser/
1) bud med mdzes ma/ 2) lha mo'i rigs/
'bab chu zhig chu 'go shar gangs la dang nub gangs la nas 'bab cing, stod rgyud la shar chu zer, phar lung gtsang po dang 'dres rjes lho ngos yar klungs gtsang po'i nang du 'bab/
yid kyi re ba/ yid re skong ba/
sems la 'jog pa/ bka' shog lag tu 'chang, bka' mngags yid la 'chang/
yid la 'gro ba'am yid la 'bab pa/
yid la bzod pa'am bsam pa/
1) sems la dran par byed pa/ 2) bsam gzhigs/

g.yeng ba: rnam g.yeng drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, theg pa chen po'i rigs can dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis skyo zhing mi bzod cing, nyan thos kyi theg pa yid la byed na theg pa chen po las nyams par 'gyur te, de'i phyir sems rnam par 'phro ba zhig /
(mngon) 1) mi/ 2) bdud dga' rab dbang phyug
1) bar srid kyi ming ste 'byung ba la mi ltos par yid tsam nas byung ba/ 2) yid las skyes dang don gcig
yi thang chad pa dang, khong khro zhi ba/

yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i chos kyi skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa, dper na bum 'dzin yid kyi rnam shes lta bu'o/
rtog med log shes kyi nang gses, yid shes su gyur pa'i log shes, dper na rmi lam gyi rta de rta yin par snang ba'i rmi lam gyi yid kyi shes pa lta bu'o/
(mngon) 1) bdud/ 2) 'dod lha/ 3) hor zla gsum pa/
sems skyo ru 'jug pa'am, pham du 'jug pa/ mi'i yid gsod pa/

1) gtan 'khel ba'i tshig / sang nyin 'gro res nga rang yin/ khyod su yin/ pad ma dkar po ni 'dam rdzab las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pas pad ma'i mchog yin/ 2) 'a dang mtha' med kyi rjes su sbyar rgyu dang bzhin zhes pa dang gcig pa'i da lta ba'i las ston byed phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / 'a...bzhin...kha shas dga' yin 'dug / gnas 'cha' yin 'dug / sdod sa bzo yin 'dug /
yin zer/ gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus la de ltar yin skad// mtsher skad sgrog pa'i 'ol ba smug chung, mkha' lding rgyal po'i pho nya yin skad/
ma yin yang yin pa ltar byas pa'i zol nyams/ dpa' bo yin khul gyis g.yul sar phyin pa/ rang nyid ni mchog tu gyur pa'i mi zhig yin khul byed pa/

phan tshun gcig yin na, cig shos kyang yin dgos pa'i don de, dper na, byas pa dang dngos po gnyis yin khyab mnyam yin pas, byas pa yin na dngos po yin pas khyab, dngos po yin na byas pa yin pas khyab pa lta bu'o/
(yul) phal cher yin te 'ong/ yi ge de tsho khos bris pa yin gyi red/
yin rung/ lo rgyus bden pa yin grang, e bden mi shes/
yin na ni/ de ltar yin grang na nga tsho'i bar bsam 'char mi mthun pa mi 'dug /

1) yin shag gam yin bden red/ mkhas pa yin dgos byung, yon tan tshang ma shes pas so/ bden pa yin dgos byung, rdzun pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ 2) ngo ma min yang, thabs med kyis yin zer dgos byung ba/ kho de'i bu min yang rgyal pos de'i bu yin pa gzhir bzhag gis bka' babs stabs, de'i bu yin dgos byung ba red/
(yul) phal cher yin te 'ong/ yi ge 'di phal cher khos bris pa yin 'gro/

(yul) yin pa dag gam yin pa ste don ngo ma ni/ yin rgyu dag tshong pa red de deng sang zhing las byed kyi yod pa red/ mi de yin rgyu dag yag po zhig ma red, 'on kyang nye char khos bya ba ngan pa gang yang byas med/
yin pa brgya dang min pa stong zhes skad cha bden mi bden sna tshogs bshad pa/
ci nas kyang ngam nges par/ nga gnyis yin gcig min gcig mnyam du 'gro dgos/
yin par the tshom med pa/ khyed kyis gsungs pa de yin thag chod red/
yin 'os pa'am yin mdog kha po/ kho'i byas rjes dga' mo yin thang snyam/
yin khul du cha zhog / khos de ltar bshad pa ltar yin du chug kyang, bden pa rang e yin mi shes/ khos bshad pa ltar bden min mi shes kyang, da res yin du chug /
yin tshod red dam, yin mdog kha po red/ khyed rang sku khams bde po yin du gsha' ba la rab tu spro/
1) min yang yin khul/ mkhas pa yin mdog kha po byas pa/ 2) phal cher yin gyi red/ mi 'di mkhas pa yin mdog kha po red/
yin min 'dri ba'am the tshom gyi tshig / deng sang gzugs po bde thang yin nam min nam/
'on te/ rgad po yin na'ang gzugs po thang po 'dug
yin pa thams cad/ skyes pa yin no cog / gzhung don yin no cog /
yin mdog kha po'am phal cher yin pa/ mdang dgong gnyid yag po ma khug pa yin pa 'dra/ de ring char 'bab rgyu yin pa 'dra/
pa'i shes bya: yin pa mi srid pa'i blo'i yul du bya rung, ka bum gnyis ka yin pa lta bu'o/
(yul) phal cher yin/ khyed rang zhal lag mchod rgyu yin pa yod/
(yul) yin par go ba'i tshig / de ga rang yin pa red/
yin pa srid pa'i shes bya
yin pa srid pa'i blo'i yul du bya rung, ka ba lta bu'o/
yin pa'i khungs skyel ba'am rgyu mtshan rjod pa/
yin pa dang ma yin pa/ yin min go ldog / yin min mnyam bsre/ yin min gsal 'byed/

yin na'ang ngam yin rung/ kho 'phrad par phyin pa yin mod thug ma song/ lta bar phyin pa yin mod kyang gsal po mthong ma byung/ khyod kyis mngon sum du mthong zhing thos na de nyid kho na tshad ma yin mod kyi, 'on kyang da dung cung zad brtag dpyad bya'o/
thams cad/ mi yin tshad spyang po yin pa'i nges pa med/
ma yin yang yin pa ltar byas pa'i zol nyams/
ma yin yin khul byed pa/
'on te/ tshig la de ltar yin yang don la nges pa med/
de ltar min zhes dam bca' ba'am mna' skyel ba/ bya ba ngan pa byed mkhan de nga yin re skan/
yin min the tshom gyi gzhi/
1) rgyu mtshan/ yin lugs min lugs/ 2) stong pa'i gshis lugs/
rang bzhin nam gnas tshul dngos gnas/
yin khul/ yin lo min lo byas kyang yid mi ches/
yin pa las log pa zhes pa yin pa'i ldog zla ste, ma yin pa'o, dper na, ka ba yin pa las log pa ka ba ma yin pa lta bu'o/
yin par nges/ khong gis zer ba de ga yin shag red/ las don legs grub yin shag /
yin las che'am yin 'gro snyam/ khyed rang gis bshad pa ltar yin shas che/
bden rdzun gnyis kyi rgyu mtshan mtha' skyel/
(tha mi dad pa) yibs pa, yib pa, yibs,, gab pa/ gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i sa khung du yibs nas bsdad pa/ sa cha kyong por nyal nas yib pa/
mgo nas gzugs por mar bskon rgyu'i kong yul dang spo yul gyi pho mo'i gos chas phu med cig ste mgo shubs kyang zer/
sgrib shing ste, 'ug pa'am skya ga'i tshang gi shing sogs lus la btags na pha rol pos mi mthong bar sgrib nus pa zhig
1.yib pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) skyibs/ char yibs/ 2) (rnying) dbyibs/
rnam dbye gsum pa'i rkyen zhig ste 'a dang mtha' med la 'thob pa'i byed sgra/ 'a...
gtsub shing ste phan tshun brdar nas me 'bar ba'i shing zhig /
rtswa'i ljang pa 'bru ldan zhig ste yug po'ang zer/ zhing nang gi yu gu 'dra 'dra, lug nang gi spyang ki 'dra 'dra/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma sbyor, pags nad 'joms, dug tshad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang gtso dang, glos ma, bcad 'byor rgyal po, bcad 'byor gtso bo, chu rta mo, chu 'thung, tre tre shing, tre re shing, nam mkha' so le, phag gdong bcad 'byor, phag ldang ba, bya se ba, dbyu gu shing, myu gu shing, rtsa rkang pa, 'ug pa bcad 'byor, yib shing, gsang ba'i sman gcig bcas so,

1) bod dang, zhin cang, a mdo'i sa 'brel yul lung gi ming rnying/ 2) rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs shig mang che ba zhin cang yu gur rang skyong ljongs su gnas yod, 1982 lo'i sdom rtsis ltar mi grangs khri phrag 594 lhag tsam yod/

/ 1) lung dang rkang pa ste 'chang zungs/ gri'i yu ba/ lham gyi yu ba/ gdugs yu/ rgyal mtshan gyi srog shing la rgyal mtshan gyi yu ba zer/ sta yu byas na sta yu mi lo, 'jor yu byas na 'jor yu mi lo/ 2) rtswa'i chu ba/ pad ma'i yu ba/ lo tog gi rkang yu/
1) yu ba can gyi dngos po spyi/ 2) (mngon) brgya byin rdo rje/
rwa co med pa'i gnag phyugs pho dang ra lug pho/ g.yag yu bo/
gnag phyugs rwa co med pa a yu ma'i bsdus ming/
rtsa med/ sdang dgra yu med bzos pa/ 'bu gnod yu med gtong ba/
/ 1) rwa co med pa'i gnag phyugs mo dang ra lug mo/ 2) sha ba mo/ 3) kha sha mo/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas bu dang sha ma ma thon pa dang, khong pa'i nang logs su mde'u sogs zug rngu lus pa phyir 'byin par byed/
yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje

rab byung dang po'i dus su byon, dang po rnal 'byor pa, phyis rab tu byung nas mtshan dad pa rgyal por btags, kha che pan chen zla ba mgon po nas dus 'khor rgyud 'grel zhib tu gsan te bsgoms pas rtogs pa brnyes, gzhan stong gi lta ba'i srol phye, yig cha 'ga' zhig mdzad pas lugs de'i bla ma gong mar bkur, dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis par 'das, de'i slob brgyud thugs rje brtson 'grus dang dol bu bas jo nang dgon pa btab ste grub mtha' rgya cher spel, de nas bzung brgyud 'dzin rnams la jo nang pa zhes grags/
ru rta pho mo rigs gnyis su dbye ba'i nang tshan mo rigs la'o/
'chang zungs ring po/ lham yu ring/ dkar yol yu ring/
(yul) rwa co med pa'i gnag phyugs dang ra lug / rwa can brgya thar sar yu lu ma gcig mi thar ba med/
1) dar gos ras sogs ma bcad pa'i kha tshar tshang ba'i bubs gcig / ras yug gcig / 2) khyon nam mu khyud/ grong khyer gyi khor yug / ra ba'i khor yug / yug gcig tu 'brel ba/
(yul) lham mthil khebs pa'i rdog pa/
1) snam bu bubs tshang/ 2) (rnying) btsag rdo/
(rnying) 1) zhen pa'am chags pa/ 2) rkang pa/
rang gi bza' zla bud med shi ba'i khyo ga /
yug chung ngam lteb hril chung ba/
gos chen dang, dar kha, ras, ther snam sogs yug tshang kha tshar can/
rang gi bza' zla shi ba'i mo hreng/ khyo ga shi ste yug zar gyur pa/
khyo ga shi ba'i bud med/
khyo ga shi rjes skyes pa'i bu/
phar tshur g.yo bar byed tshul zhig / lag pa yug yug byas nas phyin song/
chu stod zla ba ste hor zla drug pa, rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs nas yug sa ma'i zla ba zhes brjod/
rdo sman gyi rigs btsag dang cha 'dra ba'i mdog smug po zhig ste, nus pas chu ser skem par byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la rde'u khrag ldag dang smug rdo'o,
yung ba ste sga ser gyi mdog /
(rnying) 'phan po yung ba dang rma zer ba'i lung pa khag gnyis/
nyungs ma/ dgra mgo yung ma spung spung byed/
'bru'i rigs shig / ming gi rnam grangs la don grub dang, 'byung po 'jigs byed, zas gtsang bcas so,
yungs kar la sngags brgyab ste 'brab byed kyi thun rdzas/
snum nag 'byung ba'i 'bru rigs pad kha/ ming gi rnam grangs la pad khang dang, tsha ba'i snum can, tshogs ma can bcas so,
yungs dkar nag gi 'bru/ yungs 'bru tsam/
yungs dkar gyi gang bu btsugs pa'i gtor zor/
dbugs thengs gcig gi yun tshad/ kho tshur slebs nas yud kyis phar song/

1) sngar rgya gar gyi dus yun brtsi lud su nyin zhag gcig gi cha sum cu'i zur gcig / 2) 'khyug tsam ste, dus yun ha cang thung ngu zhig / glog 'od yud tsam gyis gsal ba/ sprin gseb nas zla dkar yud tsam 'char ba/ nar 'gyangs yud tsam yang med pa/
(yul) bstod bsngags byed pa/ bzo pa dang zhing pa dmag mi rnams la yud yud byed pa/
dus tshod kyi ring thung/ yun ring/ yun thung/ yun gtan/ yun 'gor ba/ yun nas yun du/ yun ci srid bar du gnas pa/ yun nas yun ring po/ yun du thogs mi dgos pa/ 'chi med yun gnas/
dus rim gyis/ phru gu'i lus stobs yun gyis rgyas pa/ yun gyis dmigs yul bzang por 'jug pa/
dar cig gam yud tsam/ lam khar yun cig 'gor ba/
dus yun ring po'i bar du brtan pa/ rgyal srid yun brtan/

dus yun ring po/ lam thag ring na rta shugs shes, yun ring gshibs na mi rgyus lon/
na nas dus ring song ba'i nad pa/ thag ring gi mgron po dang, yun ring gi nad pa/
/ 1) ma'i zhe sa/ 2) yi dam gyi shes rab mtshon pa'i cha/ 3) bud med kyi zhe sa/ gsang yum/ yum khab tu bzhes pa/ 4) shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo/ yum 'bum pa/

1) lo tog gi lhad 'don yur ma brgyab pa'i rtswa ngan/ 2) yur chu'i 'gram gyi rtswa sogs/

/ 1) sa cha'am lung pa/ skye yul/ sdod yul/ las yul/ pha yul/ yul ga shed/ yul gyi yas mas/ yul khyad par can/ yul gyi mthil/ yul gyi lte ba/ yul gyi gshed ma/ yul rgyang ring ba/ yul gyis bskal ba/ yul 'khyams/ yul gyar/ yul byol/ yul thon pa/ yul bud pa/ gnas med yul 'khyar du 'gyur ba/ yul phyung ba/ yul 'bud gtong ba/ yul gzhan du mthar skrod gtong ba/ rang yul na rta brgya yod kyang, mi yul la 'gro dus rkang thang red/ 2) rgya khyon/ mthong yul/ bsam yul las 'das pa/ yul las 'gong ba/ 3) zhing las sa khul/ rong yul/ yul 'brog / yul ma 'brog / yul rta/ yul bal/ 4) blos rig par bya ba ste, blos mthong bar bya ba'am rtogs par bya ba, dper na, bem shes ldan min gyi dngos po dang, nam mkha' la sogs pa'i dngos med kyi chos rnams te, shes bya dang don gcig pa'o// dmigs yul/ bya ba'i yul/ skye bo stong gis sdigs pa'i yul, nad med rang bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur/ 5) dbang po dang shes pa'i gzung bya, dper na, gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos lta bu yul can rnams las gzhan pa'i chos te, yul yul can gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i yul lo/ phyi rol gyi yul/ gzung yul/ rna ba'i yul sgra/ sna'i yul dri/ mngon gyur gyi yul/ lkog gyur gyi yul/ yul lkog tu gyur pa/ 6) (mngon) phyi nang gi yul so sor nyer bzhi re yod pas grangs nyer bzhi mtshon/

1) grong 'bum phrag yod pa'i sa gnas/ shes rab med na byams pa tsam gyis yul 'khor skyong mi nus/ 2) sa cha'am lung pa/ yul 'khor gzhan gyi skye bo yang, gang 'tsham thabs kyis bskyang bar bya/
1) rgyal po/ 2) sangs rgyas bzhugs dus kyi 'phags pa zhig /

bod kyi yul/ yul gangs can pa'i brda/
sa gnas so sor yod pa'i dngos zog gi rin thang/
yul lung so sor sngar nas dar zhing chags pa'i lugs srol/
bskal don gsum gyi nang gses, yul thag ring pos bar du chod pas rtod mi thub pa, dper na, byang sgra mi snyan gyi 'bras sa lu lta bu'o/
khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge , 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge , gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge , khang shing 'bud shing shing gi dge , khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge /

rgyu skar nyer bdun re re'i sa khyon cha mnyam drug cur byas pa'i cha gcig la yul gyi chu tshod gcig ces btags, rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi skar khyon re la yul gyi chu tshod chig stong drug brgya nyi shu tham pa/ 1620...
gza' so sos rgyu skar gyi yul la spyod sa'i yun tshad/

srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi sa mi dang bcas pa blon po che khag rnams la bgo bsha' brgyab ste sprad pa'i mnga' khongs dbye mtshams, dbu ru shod chen, pho brangs sne che, yar klungs, 'ching nga, bya 'ug brad dang zhong pa, brag rum stod smad, gtsang stod smad, klung shod nam po, 'phan yul, nyang ro gram pa, shangs dang gle phyi, yung ba che chung, zha ga sde gsum, nam ra, chag gong, 'dam shod dkar mo, mdo khams bcas bco brgyad/
sho gam pa'am sgo khral sdud mkhan/
phan tshun rgyang thag ring por gnas pa,..
lung pa/ yul gru so so'i skad mi 'dra ba/
lung par grags pa'i glu dbyangs te, dmangs khrod kyi glu gzhas/
sngar mi rtsa gzhan 'khyar rang yul du bkug ste khral khungs su 'jug pa/
1) yul lung dbul phongs/ 2) nyin mor thal char sogs kyis mun 'thibs pa'i gnam gshis/ de ring yul ngan bstan pas phyi rol tu 'gro thub ma song/ 3) mu ge/ yul ngan chen po byung bas bza' 'bru chad pa/
sems byung nga gcig gi nang gses, yul nges byed kyi shes pa lnga ste, 'dun pa dang, mos pa dang, dran pa dang, ting 'dzin dang, shes rab rnams so/
gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste lnga/
stong hang hang ngam skyo lhang lhang/ mi nor gang yang med sar yul cang cang zhig yong gi 'dug /
rang yul la 'jug pa'i chos te, rang yul ci rigs dang ldan pa'i dngos po, rjod byed kyi sgra dang, blo dang, dbang po, gang zag rnams so/
bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi sku/
yul lnga 'dzin par byed pa'am, yul lngar 'jug par byed pa'i rten gyi dbang po lnga ste, mig dang, rna ba, sna, lce, lus kyi dbang po'o/
yul mi bslu ba de blos yid dpyod tsam min par tshad mas nges pa'i shes pa dang, de ltar rtogs pa'i gang zag dang, ma 'khrul ba'i dbang po rnams so/

rjod byed kyi sgra dang dbang po gzugs can pa lta bu gzugs su gyur pa'i yul can dang, sems dang sems byung lta bu shes par gyur pa'i yul can dang, gang zag lta bu ldan min 'du byed du gyur pa'i yul can te gsum mo/
1) sa cha'am lung pa mi grong mang po yod sa/ 2) yul gyi bkod pa/ yul ljongs kyi bkod pa/ yul ljongs mdzes sdug can/
lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa ming mi 'dra ba/

yul lung so so'i dngos zog gi rin thang/
1) 'khor bzhi ma tshang ba'i sa cha/ 2) srol bzang ngam chos lugs ma dar ba'i lung pa/
yul 'ga' zhig la lo nyes byung ba'i dus/

ma 'dres pa: gzhi gcig la gnas dang dus ngo bo bcas ldog pa'i khyad par so sor yod pa, dper na yul bum pa lta bu shar nub gnyis ka na yod kyang shar la yod pa'i cha de ni nub la yod pa min la nub la yod pa'i cha de shar la yod pa ma yin pa ni yul ma 'dres pa'i don dang, bum pa de snga dro phyi dro gnyis ka na yod kyang bum pa snga dro yod pa'i cha de nyid phyi dro yod pa ma yin pa ni dus ma 'dres pa'i don dang, bum pa de gser bum zangs bum gnyis ka la rjes su song ba yin kyang gser bum la rjes su song ba'i cha de nyid zangs bum la rjes su song ba ma yin pa dang zangs bum la rjes su song ba'i cha de nyid gser bum la rjes su song ba ma yin pa ni rang bzhin ma 'dres pa'i don yin/
gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos te drug /
yul lha ste, khyim tshang dang, sde ba sogs kyis srung mar bsten pa'i gzhi bdag /
rnam dbye lnga pa'i nang gses/ lha sa nas be cin bar/
1) lung pa'i mi grong/ 2) lung pa so so'i sde ba'am tsho ba/ yul sde 'khyoms pa/
1) btsan 'dzul gyis gzhan yul la dbang sgyur ba/ 2) sdod gnas skyas spos kyis yul gzhis 'dzin pa/
/ 1) zhing las byar rung ba'i sa char gzhis chags pa'i mi/ 2) byes pa dang yul pa gnyis su phye ba'i yul pa/

grong nang du sdod pa'i phag pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la grong pa'i phag pa dang, bshang ba za'o,
1) rang rang sdod gnas sam lho byang shar nub kyi yul phyogs/ 2) pha yul/ yul phyogs gcig pa/

1) yul gang rung gi mtha' min dbus/ 2) bod kyi lha sa'i phyogs sam dbus chu'i rgyud kyi sa gnas/ 3) rgya gar rdo rje gdan/
(mngon) 1) pi pi ling/ 2) sngar rgya gar ma ga dhar skyes pa'i mi/
1) lung pa der skyes pa'i mi/ yul mi'i skad/ 2) lung pa der gzhis chags pa'i mi/ yul mi las pa/ yul dmag /

1) shul med dang, gtan nas med pa/ 2) gnas sam go skabs med pa/
sa gshis zhan pa sogs kyi yul skyo po/ phu dbrag yul mo ngan rnams zhing las thon tshad dma'/
1) yul can gyis yul 'dzin/ 2) yul 'khor srung ba/ 3) ngang pa'am ngang pa'i rgyal po/
rang yul nas thon pa'i dngos rdzas/
lung pa der yod pa'i khyim gzhis/

1) ngo tsha ba'am mtsher mtsher po'am zhum zhum po/ rtsod lan ma thebs pas yul yul por gyur/ 2) gang la gces pa de dang bral bas sems 'phreng 'phreng por gyur pa/ mkho gnad che ba'i yo byad de brlag song bas sems yul yul po byed pa/
bsnyon dor gyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dbang yul so so'i rang gi byed las dngos la bsnyon nas de min byed las gzhan zhig ston pa'i rgyan/

byas drin nam bden pa/ lto yus 'dren pa/ byas yus ham che bshad pa/ ham yus shod pa/ sdug yus shod pa/ yus kyis brnangs pa/ gzhan la phan ma btags par yus byed pa/ nga bden nga yus/ bden yus shod pa/ chos 'dod na yus ma che bar mkhar las kyi 'phro gyis/ sdig po che yin pa'i yus nga la mi 'gro/ bla ma la gzigs phul rung bkyon pa las mi 'ong, yum la gzigs phul rung las yus su 'gro bar 'dug / ji ltar gsungs pa de de bzhin du thugs yus lags/ byas rjes yus pa/ byas yus rang khengs/ drin gyis bskyangs zhes yus bshad pa/ gnam la yus shod pa dang mi la kha gtong ba/ las la byas yus che na ngo so chung/
1) rang bden tshul brjod pa/ 2) ngo so btang ba/

rang skyong khul: mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi lho nub rgyud du yod, 1952 lo'i zla 2 tshes 12 nyin rang skyong sa khongs btsugs shing, 1955 lor rang skyong khul du bsgyur, de'i khongs su nang chen dang, chu dmar leb, yus hru'u, khri 'du, rdza stod, 'bri stod bcas rdzong drug yod, rang skyong khul mi dmangs srid gzhung de yus hru'u rdzong khongs kyi skye rgur yod/
1) thog ma dang, gdod ma, rtsa ba/ ye nas bzang po/ ye nas med pa/ ye nas dag pa/ ye nas yod pa'i yon tan/
ye nas lhun gyis grub pa
/ 2) gtan dang, nam rgyun/ ye mi byed pa/ ye mig mi yengs pa/ 3) nges par dang, mtha' gcig / yongs ye/ yod ye/ ye mi yong ba/
1) thog ma nas shes pa/ 2) bon gyi lha zhig / 3) (mngon) skar rtsis mkhan/
grol lugs chen po bzhi'i nang gses, rang byung gi rig pa de nyid thog ma med pa nas rang ngo la 'khor ba'i chos gang gis kyang ma gos pas srid pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu zad pas ye grol zhes bya'o/
ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste, zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sbra chen rdzong khongs ye tha khul du 'bab pa'i chu bo zhig dang sog chu'i yan lag cig /
ye nas sam gdod ma nas stong pa/

dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la btegs pa'i ye shes kyi thig ste, thig skud kyi rgyu dang grangs dang kha dog dang byin rlabs dang sdod pa dang rkang stabs dang skor phyogs la sogs pa'i khyad par cho ga'i tshul bzhin gdab pa'o/
legs lam la bar du gcod cing mi 'dod pa la sbyor bar byed pa'i mi ma yin zhig /
thog ma nas/ ye nas ma bcos mdzes sdug lha mo'i gzugs/
sngar bod kyi rigs rgyud cig gi ming/
thog ma nas 'bad rtsol la ltos ma dgos par tshang ba/
'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyi mtshan gzhan zhig /
bal yul lam ne pa la'i grong khyer rnying pa zhig /
thengs gcig gam tshar gcig / lung pa der ye re las 'gro ma myong/
mang po'i nang na lhang nger mngon tshul lam gsal tshul zhig / dpa' bo mi brgya'i nang nas ye re bud/
mngon gsal che zhing brel ba med pa'i rnam 'gyur/ chibs gral bstar la bsgrigs te ye re lhod de bag phebs brjid chags par bzhud do/
1) ye nas gnas pa'i shes pa ste sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i stong gsal gyi rig pa/ 2) 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/
ye shes mkha' 'gro dang don gcig
snying dbus mi shig pa'i thig le/
nang gi thabs shes sam bde stong dang, de mtshon byed kyi rdo rje rwa dgu dang dril bu/
sku dang zhing khams sogs dag pa'i snang ba'o/
ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon du phyogs par byang chub pa ste rtogs pa'i ye shes/
rol tu phyin pa: phar phyin bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid stong par thugs su chud pa'o/
tshogs gnyis kyi ya gyal, dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs te stong nyid byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin pa'i 'bras bu ye shes chos sku thob par byed pa'i zag med kyi dge ba'i tshogs/

dbus nas mnyam du rgyu ba'i rlung drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga ni sgra gcan ltar stobs dang ldan pas sgra gcan gyi khams dang, nam mkha' ltar go 'byed pas nam mkha'i rlung ste, thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid do/
chud pa'i le'u gsum: dgra bcom pa'i le'u dang phyir mi 'ong ba'i le'u, rgyun zhugs kyi le'u bcas so/
ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ste, 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'am, 'phags ma'am rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/
sgyu lus kyi nang gses shig ste, de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams ni ye shes kyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma'o/
me long lta bu dang, mnyam nyid, sor rtog bya grub, chos dbyibs te lnga'o/

sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bye brag cig ste sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnas yongs su gyur pa'i mthar thug pa'i ye shes gang zhig zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi rten du gyur pa ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad pa 'dres par mkhyen pa'i ye shes/
mnyam bzhag gi ye shes dang rjes thob kyi ye shes gnyis/
spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun nam brgyad tsam la 'khrungs pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig yin pa des dbu ma bden gnyis mdzad cing dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs 'dzin mkhan zhig yin/
dag pa bzhi'i nang gses, shes bya'i chos kun la chags thogs mi mnga' bar mkhyen pa'o/
snying ga'i mi 'jig pa'i thig le/
1) mdun du bskyed cing bsgom pa'i lha ste, ye shes sems dpa'/ 2) gdod nas grub pa'i lha spyan drangs nas bstims pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha/
ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor/

nang 'jug gi bye brag cig ste, slob ma'i rgyud las rung du dngos su smin phyir ma dag pa'i snod bcud rnams mi dmigs par sbyangs nas dag pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te rang la bstims pas dam ye dbyer med du rgyas 'debs pa'o/
ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i sngags/
bon ston pa gshen rabs kyi slob ma zhig /
'dus pa lugs gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, blob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs nas brgyud pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa,..
ye shes lnga'i nang chos dbyings ye shes las gzhan pa'i ye shes bzhi'o/

glang dar ma nas brtsis pa'i rgyal brgyud kyi mi rabs lnga pa ste jo bo rje bod du gdan 'dren gyi grabs gshom byas pa'i rkyen la brten nas gar log gis bkrong pa'i stod mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma'i ming/
bstan bcos shig mngon pa sde bdun gyi nang gses, 'phags pa ka ta ya nas mdzad pa'i mngon pa'i gzhung/

rton pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs don dam par skye 'gag la sogs pa'i spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes pa dang, bdag med pa gnyis ji bzhin mkhyen pa ni ye shes te, de la yid rton par bya ba'o/

byang chung ? sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste, de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang, mi 'jigs pa dang, sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang, mtshan dang, dpe byad bzang po dang, mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa kun tu ston pa'o/

bskyed rim sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi nang gses shig ste, dam tshig pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la sogs pa'i gdan la dam tshig pa dang 'dra ba'i lha bsgom pa dang, dam tshig pa dang sku mdog zhal phyag mi 'dra ba bsgom pa dang, sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshan bsgom pa sogs so/
sangs rgyas te bon lugs kyi tha snyad cig /
don gyi 'bum: bon gyi spyod pa'i skor gyi gzhung lugs shig /
1) bod kyi gna' rabs pa'i rus rgyud cig / 2) bon po'i lha zhig /
zing pa, seng seng po/ skra yegs pa/
sems yang nge yeng nge ba/ blo yeng nge ba byas na stobs shugs gcig tu sgril mi thub/
(tha mi dad pa) yengs pa, yeng ba,, rig pa sor mi gnas par gzhan du 'phro ba/ rig pa mi yeng ba/ blo gzhan du yengs nas bltas kyang mi mthong ba/ kha yengs mig yengs/
sems gzhi gcig tu mi gnas par dbang med du g.yo tshul/ don med yeng yeng ngang nas nyi ma 'phul/
(rnying) sems g.yeng g.yeng dang brtab brel che ba/
rnam g.yeng gi ngang tshul/ yengs ma lam du mi tshe stong par zad/
g.yeng ba/ glu skad yen zhing lam du 'gro ba/
mgyogs pos sam, mngon gsal chen pos/ glog zhu yer gyis gsal ba/ dar dmar yer gyis bteg pa/ ri rtse nas yer gyis byon pa/

lha sa'i byang shar mtshams su yer pa lha ri snying por yod pa'i ri khrod cig ste, sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo mong bza' khri lcam gyis btab pa zhig de skabs kyi rdo ring dang cong chen da lta'i bar bzhugs, brag yer pa'am zer/

1. (tha dad pa) 'degs pa/ lag pas phor pa bkyag ste gyen du yer ba/ 2. (tha mi dad pa) 1) dwangs pa dang sad pa/ rmi lam 'tshub po btang nas gnyid yer ba/ 2) skrag pa/ 3./ 1) myur ba/ gnyid yer te sad pa/ yer te log pa/ 2) g.yer ba dang 'dra,
rlung rims shig ste, nad rtags su gnyid yer zhing lus sngangs pa sogs 'byung ba zhig /
gyen du g.yo ba'i rnam pa zhig / me sgyogs sgras sa gzhi yer yer du bsgul song/
1) rig pa gsal zhing dwangs pa/ gnyid sad de blo yer re seng nge bar gyur song/ 2) yang ba/
bka' brgyud pa'i nang gses shig yel pa grub thob ye shes brtsegs pas yel phug dang, bya rta rna sogs chag btab, phyis su rta rna kam tshang gi chos brgyud ces su grags/
(rnying) 1) zung 'jug / 2) sems pa gnam la bkyag pa lta bu/
1. kyog kyog / 2. (rnying) tshang ma'am thams cad/
'khyog po/ rgyug chu yo kyog / lam ka yo kyog / bsam blo yo kyog /

yo kyog ste 'khyog por gyur pa/ don dngos yo 'khyog byas pa/ shel sbubs yo 'khyog tu gyur pa/ yo 'khyog 'dug na drang por bsrang, sgang gshong 'dug na khod la snyoms, ring thung 'dug na rtsa rtse bsgrig /
'khrugs pa'am gnod rkyen/ mi ngan de tshos spyod ngan byas te mang tshogs khrod du yo 'khyoms chen po bzos song/
nang gi sgom pa gtso bor ston pa ste rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/
(rnying) thams cad blos btang ba'am ster ba/
1. (tha mi dad pa) phyogs su lhung ba/ gtam ci bshad kyang rang gi nye phyogs su mi yo ba/ 2. yon po/ ka ba yo ba/ gtam yo ba/ 'gro lam yo ba/ mgo yo ba/
mkho chas kyi nor rdzas/ yo byad kyis mi dbul ba/ yo byad bsar ba/ yo byad lhag pa/ thon skyed yo byad/ zas skom yo byad/ yo byad gya nom pa bstabs pa/

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal, skra dang kha spu bregs shing khrus byas pa lus kyi byi byad kyi rtags khyad par 'phags pa dang, chos gos rnam gsum mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs nas gnang ba de nyid rgyun chags su 'chang zhing, gding ba mkhan pos gnang ba ltar du 'chang ba gos kyi rtags khyad par 'phags pa dang, rung ba tshad ldan gyi lhung bzed dang chu tshags mkhan pos gnang ba 'chang ba snod spyad kyi rtags khyad par 'phags pa ste khyim pa dang mu stegs pa las khyad par 'phags pa'i rtags gsum dang ldan pa'o/

dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum ste snam sbyar dang, bla gos dang, mthang gos dang, sham thabs dang, sham thabs kyi gzan dang, rngul gzan dang, rngul gzan gyi gzan dang, gdong phyis dang, rnag gzan dang, g.yan dgab dang, skra gzed dang, gding ba dang, dbyar gyi gos ras chen rnams so/
dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad drug ste, chos gos rnam gsum dang, lhung bzed, chu tshags, gding ba ste drug /

'dul ba las bshad pa'i 'tsho mkho lhag gsum gyi yo byad rnams 'chang 'jog gi ltung ba sel phyir byin gyis brlab par bya ba ste, yo byad rnams lag tu thogs te, dge slong zhig gi spyan sngar yo byad gsum po'i byin rlabs kyi sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa dang, dge slong gis thabs legs bya ba'o/
pa'i lhag ma gnyis: dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum gyi nang gses, khang pa'i lhag ma dang, khang chen gyi lhag ma gnyis ni yo byad la chags pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma'o/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang gses shig ste, 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyan bkod pa du mas rab tu brgyan pa'i byin gyis brlabs nas kun tu ston pa'o/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rnying tshad dang, rma tshad la phan/
gzugs dbyibs khyad par ston byed kyi tshig grogs shig / mgo skya yo re ba/ mi nag yo re ba/ lci yo re ba/ mtho yo re ba/

1) zang zing ngam lang long/ 'grim 'grul yo lang che ba/ yo byad dang bya byed mang po'i spros pa'i yo lang mtha' yas pa 'dug / 2) mang po'am rnam pa sna tshogs/ tshong ra dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yod pa dang, dngos rdzas mi 'dra ba yo lang 'dug / rgyu nor gtong yong yo lang che ba/ 3) (rnying) gshom che ba/
1) kyog po'am zol zog gi spyod pa/ gzhan la 'khyog spyod yo le phyod de byas pa/ 2) 'gro thabs 'dug thabs/
(rnying) thams cad phan thogs sam go chod pa/
mi dga' ba/ bod 'bangs rnams yo log nas a'a tsarya bal por btang/
'khyog po 'drong po bzo ba/ yod na yo bsrang dang med na dogs zon byed dgos/ skyon dang nor 'khrul yo bsrang byed pa/ yo bsrang thal che ba/ yo bsrang legs bcos/
,(yul) skud pa sgrim byed kyi shing thur/
(yul) 1) rgyu spun skud pa sogs sgrim byed yog shing gi mgo/ 2) mgo yang po/ 3) phan tshun dkrug shing byed pa'i mi'i ming 'dogs/ mi de yog mgo tsha po 'dug /
sngo sman zhig ste tshad pa sel ba dang dri chu 'bab par phan/
yos rngod byed kyi yog pa/
1. (tha dad pa) yogs pa, yog pa, yogs,, 'khal ba'am sgrim pa/ skud pa yogs nas thag pa bzo/ 2./ 1) dbyug pa/ 2) (yul) rtswa'i 'bras bu ste nor phyugs kyis za chas shig /

rtswa 'bru can gyi yog pa de gzan pa 'bru med kyi nang du zla bsgril btang na gzan pa dang chag gnyis kyi go chod pa ltar don tshan khag gnyis khag gcig tu bsgril ba'i don/ gla dang lto dod yog pa gzan bsgril gyis sprad pa/
/ 1) me dkrug byed shing rgyug / 2) 'phang lo'i srog shing dang skud pa dkri sa'i shing rgyug /
ldum bu'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rma 'bras 'dul, rnag chu skem/
(yul) mang zhing mthug pa'i khyab tshul/ shing la 'bras bu yog yog btags pa/ nang la rtsam pa med kyang sge'u khung rtsam ral yog yog /
lag pa skor g.yug gis srad bu sgrim byed kyi shing/
1. yog pa'i 'das pa, 2. (rnying) khyab pa dang khebs pa/
'byung gzhi/ na tsha'i yong rkyen/ gyod gzhi'i yong rkyen/
'byung khungs/ rtsa ba yo bsrang byed cing yong khungs gtsang ma bzo ba/ yong khungs gsar gtod/ dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi yong khungs phun sum tshogs pa/
tshur yong ba'i rgyu dngos sam tshur 'bab pa'i rgyu dngos/ yong sgo sdud pa/
'bab sgo/ lo legs byung ste 'bru rigs kyi yong thang 'phar ba/
1) sleb rgyu'i bzo thon po/ 2) phan thogs pa'i gnas yod pa/ khang pa de yong mdog kha po 'dug /
tshur yong rgyu'i dngos po'i sdud tshags/
snga dus bkar rgya'i yong 'bab len mkhan/

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) tshur 'ong ba/ yong ran pa/ yong nye ba/ yong 'dod med pa/ yong khul byed pa/ kho rang yong dang mi yong/ gzhas la yong rgyu zho gang, gzhas gos g.yar gla srang gang/ 2) 'byung ba dang, 'gyur ba/ brtson 'grus ma byas par grub 'bras bzang po yong mi srid/ lag pa gcin pas bkrus pa'i gtsang ma yong mi shes/ gnas tshul yag po yong bzo 'dug / 2.dus skabs ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig phrad cig / de ltar byas na 'grig mi yong/ rjes ma mjal yong/ char pa 'bab yong/ 'dred brdab shor yong/
tshur yong sgo'i 'bab/ yong 'bab kher gtsang/
1) tshur yong sgo'i rtsis/ 2) tshur 'ong rgyu'i grabs sam 'dun pa/
yong rkyen dang 'byung khungs/ 'khrug rkyen yong gzhi/
(rnying) 1) nges par/ 2) rnam pa kun tu/ 3) rtsa ba nas sam gtan nas/
'byor shas che'am 'thob shas che ba/ slob ma mang shos 'dir yong las che/

1.kun nam thams cad/ dmangs yongs/ rgyal yongs/ 'dzam gling yongs/ mi dmangs yongs la dbang ba'i lam lud/ 2.yi ge 'di'i mthar su sbyar na thams cad du'am tshang mar zhes pa dang mtshungs pa'i don ston pa'i tshig rgyan zhig / su...yongs su bskor ba/ yongs su khyab pa/ yongs su gyur pa/ yongs su grags pa/ yongs su grub pa/ yongs su mthun pa/ yongs su smin pa/ yongs su bdag bzung ma byas pa/ yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa/ ming yongs su grags pa/ ming ngan yongs su grags pa/ sa chen po nor dang skye bos yongs su gang ba/ yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams/
tshang ma'am rgya khyab/ yongs khyab bden don/ yongs khyab 'dems bsko/ yongs khyab brda yig /
1) thun mong du zer ba'i rigs/ 2) kun gyis shes pa'am thams cad kyis shes pa/
1) phun sum tshogs par grub pa/ 2) yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bsdus ming,
yongs grub kyi ngo bo nyid
yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid dang don gcig
'gyur med yongs grub dang, phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub ste gnyis so/
dge ba yongs su bsngo ba/

blos rtogs tshul gyi khyad par zhig ste, gzhi de chos de yin par yongs su gcod pa ste tshur sgrub pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa'am dgag bya bkag pa'i shul du chos gzhan sgrub pa, dper na, gzhi bum pa lta bu de blos rtag pa yin pa phar rnam par bcad pa'am rtag pa ma yin par nges pa'i stobs kyis, de mi rtag pa yin pa tshur yongs su gcod pa'am grub pa lta bu, yang dper na, thag khra sbrul 'dzin la mtshon na, thag khra sbrul yin pa bkag pa rnam bcad, thag khrag thag khrar sgrub pa yongs gcod do/ rnam bcad...rnam bcad...yongs gcod.
(mngon) bzhon ma'am 'o ma bzho rgyu yod pa'i mo phyugs/
don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang rung gi yon tan dang bya ba la sogs pa phar tshur bsnol te go brjes byas pa'i rgyan zhig /
don yongs rdzogs shes pa/ dam pa'i don gnad yongs rtogs byed pa/

gso sbyong sogs kyi las gral der dngos su zhugs ma thub kyang bdag nyid kyis gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya ba'i phyir ram, bdag nyid yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir, yul las byed pa'i dge 'dun dang, dge 'dun gyis yongs su dag pa len pa la bskos pa'i dge slong la, las gral der 'du ba'i rkyen ma tshang zhing ltung bas rgyud yongs su dag pa'i gang zag gis gso sbyong dang dgag dbye'i las kho nar yongs dag 'bul ba'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa'o/
dag pa bzhi dang don gcig
1) thams cad 'du ba'am 'dzoms pa/ 2) (mngon) dpag bsam shing/ 3) lha'i rtsed sa/

grong khyer lta na sdug de'i phyi rol gyi byang shar mtshams na dpag bsam gyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba, rtsa ba dpag tshad lnga bcu thur du zug pa, steng du dpag tshad brgya 'phags pa, yal ga dang lo 'dab kyis dpag tshad lnga bcur khyab pas chu zheng du dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu ste mtha' skor du dpag tshad bzhi brgya lnga bcu yod pa, de'i me tog dang 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dri dpag tshad lnga bcur ldang ba/
(mngon) 1) rgyan 'jog gi rtsed mo/ 2) sangs rgyas/ 3) brgya byin/
gab tshig gi rgyan gyi sa bcad dang po nas bco lnga bar gyi mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dres pa'i gab tshig /
1) longs yongs su spyod pa/ 2) (mngon) bran g.yog /
gang du tshig sbyor mang po'i phreng ba snga ma snga ma'i don phyi ma phyi mas phrogs pa ltar du gab pa'i bdag nyid tsam de ni yongs su phrogs pa zhes bya ba'i gab tshig /
1) srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis las yongs su skyob pa'am 'dzin pa'i slob dpon te, bla sprul che khag gi dge rgan/ 2) yongs su 'dzin pa'i dngos po/ 3) (mngon) chu byi lo/
tshang ma'am cha tshang/ skra rkang gcig 'then na gzud po yongs rdzogs 'gul ba/ bya ba phra mo dag kyang yongs rdzogs grub/
rtsa ba bzhi dang chang bcas lnga gang srung ba'i dge bsnyen/
yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha khang

sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus rgya phyogs su sgo mig bstan te lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad phyag btab pa'i mtha' ma mdo smad mi nyag sa khul du yod pa'i lha khang zhig ste, da lta mi nyag lha sgang dgon pa zhes su 'bod pa dar mdo rdzong khongs su yod/
1) thams cad shes pa/ 2) mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes/
yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid

mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang gses, gnas lugs su gyur pa'i chos nyid, don dam par yod pa ste, btags yod kyi dgag bya kun btags kyis stong pa'i 'dus ma byas dang, gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi shes pa rnam par mi rtog pa rnam par dag pa'i dmigs pa de las gzhan du med par yongs su grub pa'o/
'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, li'i dge slong shila dhar ma dang, bod kyi ban de rnam par mi rtog pas bod yig tu bsgyur pa rnams so/
yongs su nyams pa'i chos can
dgra bcom pa drug gi nang gses, gang dbang po rtul po 'dod yon gyis myos kyang rung ma myos kyang rung mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa las yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba'i skal ba can no/
dge ba'i rtsa ba dang smon lam dang lta ba ste gsum po dag pa/
yongs spyod pa dang don gcig
pa shes pa'i dbang po: kun shes byed pa'i dbang po dang don gcig
las 'da' ba: srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' las yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'o/
yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo
mdo sde zhig bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug dang le'u bco lnga pa rgya nag gi mkhan po wang phan zhun dang, dhar ma'i gzhi 'dzin dge ba'i blo gros, lo tsa ba rgya mtsho'i sde bcas kyis bsgyur pa'o/
bsod nams bya ba'i dngos pos mtho ris dang byang grol skyed pa/
yongs su 'dzin pa'i mi dge ba
sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod kyi 'bras bu mi 'dod pa 'byin pa'o/
yongs su 'dzin pa'i lung ma bstan
bzo gnas goms pas slad ma'i tshe de la goms pa myur du rdzogs pa lta bu'o/
rtogs pa'i dbang po: kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang don gcig
yongs su shes pa'i dbang po
kun shes pa'i dbang po dang don gcig
yod pa red zer/ lung pa 'dir gter kha mang po yod skad 'dug

nus pa'am longs spyod sogs yod tshad 'don pa/ las don la thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprug gis 'bad pa/ nus shugs yod dgu rtsal sprug gis las rtsol byas pa/ stobs shugs yod dgu rtsal sprug gis, nam 'tsho'i bar du zhabs zhur brtson/
, yod pa'i bzo/ kho la las ka'i bsam 'char yod 'gro/
sems tsam pa'i lud kyi yod pa yin pa'i kun btags te gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du sgro 'dogs pa'o/
yod par rtogs pa'i tshad ma ste, med par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad de, yod pa la yod par nges pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/

1) yod las che, yod dgos sam yod chog / kho la bsam 'char yod thang/ 2) yod stangs sam yod pa'i 'khos ka/ nga rang gi yod thang ni da lta'i dpal 'byor 'di rang yin/ bdag gnyer do dam legs bcos byas rkyen thon skyed kyi 'khos ka yar rgyas yod thang 'dug /
don dam pa'am rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod par 'dzin pa'o/
1) med bzhin du yod khul byed pa/ 2) phal cher yod 'gro/
med pa'i ldog phyogs/ da lo lhag par du lo thog yag po yod 'dug /
rtsa ba che shos/ rgyu mtshan yod na med na 'di red/ mkhas pa yod na med na kho rang yin/

1) mchis pa ste med pa'i ldog phyogs/ yod par nges pa/ yod pa'i dngos po/ dngos su yod pa/ nam mkhar nyi zla skar gsum yod/ 2) 'das tshig gi rjes su sbyar nas byung zin pa'am, byung nas gnas bzhin pa'i don ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / lcog rtse 'di ngas 'od thing thing du phyis yod/ ngas kham bu nyos yod/ kho la lan bzhag yod/ 3) tshad mas dmigs pa ste, ka bum la sogs pa'i chos rnams blo tshad mas yod par dmigs pa'o/
rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags so/
la log lta: dgra bcom pa sogs med par lta ba lta bu'i skur 'debs so/

jo nang pa'i gsung sgros su, gzung 'dzin gyi dngos por snang ba'i rnam par shes pa tsam ste, ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i snang ba rnams kun rdzob tu yod pas gzhan dbang ni yod pa'i stong pa nyid do/

nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i nang gses, gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba zhes bya ba ni sde pa thams cad kyi gzhi yin pa dang shes bya'i gzhi lnga rdzas yod du smra bas de ltar grags la, mdo 'don pa'i tshe sam skri ta'i skad du 'don, mkhan po rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin las brgyud, snam sbyar snam phran dgu yan nyer lnga man la rtags 'khor lo dang pad ma, dge slong gi ming dpal dang bzang po dang snying po'i mtha' can, grub mtha' dus gsum rdzas su yod pa dang, 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma dang, gang zag gi bdag med pa dang grangs med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i sde pa'o/
gzugs med bzhi'i nang gses, 'du shes med 'du shes med min te srid pa'i rtse mo'o/
yod min med min skye mched

ci yang med pa'i skye mched las langs nas 'du shes 'di ni nad dang shu ba dang zug rngu lta bu'o zhes brtags te 'du shes bkag nas je phra je phrar gyur pa dang, 'du shes shin tu phra ba la snyoms par zhugs pa ste, 'du shes rags pa yod pa yang ma yin la gtan nas med pa'ang ma yin pa zhig /
yod pa dang med pa'i bsdus ming/

gi gtan tshigs: gtan tshigs chen po lnga'i nang gses, 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa ston pa'i gtan tshigs te, myu gu lta bu'i dngos po chos can, bden par med do, rang rgyu'i dus na yod pa dang med pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min las mi skye ba'i phyir, zhes mi snang ba'i 'brel zla rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags so/
yod kyang ngam yod na'ang/ sngar lo rgyus mang po yod mod kyi, da lta grags chung/ phyi rol rdzig po yod mod kyi nang don stong pa red/
thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/

nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses, yod par smra ba'i sde pa la gzhi kun pa'i sde pa dang, 'od srung gi sde pa dang, sa srung gi sde pa dang, chos srung gi sde pa dang, mang thos kyi sde pa dang, gos dmar ba'i sde pa dang, rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde pa dang bdun no/
gang yod thams cad/ sems shugs yod tshad 'don pa/ mi shugs yod tshad mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu 'dzoms/ ltad mo yod tshad tshang ma bstan song/
yod pa 'dra/ snang tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' shas yod zhan 'dra/
yod pa'i re ba med de med nges yin zer ba'i mna' tshig /
mna' tshig ste med nges yin zer ba/
(yul) yod pa gzhir bcas/ rang bzhin du skyes pa'i rtsi shing gi rigs la skye stobs chen po zhig yod shag red/

/ 1) rin nam gla cha'i zhe sa/ yon 'bul ba/ sman yon/ blu yon/ ming gi rnam grangs la gla rngan dang bya dga'o, 2) sbyin ba'am gtong sgo/ yon stob pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mchod pa dang me tog go , 3) yon tan zhes pa'i bsdus ming,
yon po'am kyog po/ ka ba yon kyog / gdung ma yon kyog / ming gi rnam grangs la kyog kyog dang, kyog po, 'khyog po, sgur po, sgye sgur can, gcu po, 'chus po, mi drang ba, yon po bcas so,
nor sprad pa'i don du bsngo smon byed pa/
chu'i mchod pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mchod yon dang 'thor 'thung ngo,

1) rig gnas shes pa'i khyad chos/ yon tan khyad par can/ yon tan gyi nus pa/ yon tan slob pa/ yon tan sbyong ba/ yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa/ dran rgya che yang yon tan chung ba/ yon tan yod kyang med mdog byed pa/ yon tan yod pas ma spyad na, zhing la so nam ma byas 'dra/ 2) (mngon) rdul dang, mun pa, snying stobs kyi yon tan gsum yod pas grangs gsum mtshon/
bzhin brjod pa: rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dngos po gang rung gi yon tan gyi khyad chos kyis gzhan rgyud la nus pa skyed tshul drang por brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /

t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa 'di rab byung bcu pa'i sa glang lor nang sog tu 'khrungs, lo bco lnga par bod du phebs, pan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas bsnyen par rdzogs, se 'bras kyi khri pa mdzad, rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug lor 'das/ (1589-1616)...
yon tan rgyas pa'i dri chu
byis pa lo brgyad lon pa'i skabs yon tan sbyong ba'i rig pa'i rtsal rgyas pa'i dus yin pas de'i skabs kyi dri chu la'o/
yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis

mthong lam gyi skabs su thob pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis te, dus skad cig ma gcig la sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mthong ba dang, sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlab par shes pa dang, sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa dang, dus skad cig ma gcig la bskal pa brgyar ston pa dang, sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' brgya la ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug pa dang, ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba dang, sems can brgya smin par byed pa dang, zhing khams brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang, zhing khams brgya 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa dang, chos kyi sgo mo brgya 'gyed pa dang, rang gi lus brgyar ston pa dang, lus re re la yang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa brgyas bskor bar ston pa'o,/
bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan: dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad thob par byed pa/

sangs rgyas kyi 'bras chos nyer lnga'i nang gses shig rnying ma'i gzhung du, rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams, rgya tshad bral ba'i gzhal yas khang, gsal zhing dag pa'i 'od zer, khyad du 'phags pa'i gdan khri, dgyes rgur spyod pa'i longs spyod de sangs rgyas nyid la rdzogs pa'i yon tan lnga'o/
1) rig gnas mkhas pa'i gang zag / 2) skyes bu dam pa/
thog ma'i gsal byed: gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, thog mar bkod pa'i yon tan gyi gsal byed des, phyi ma'i yon tan kun la phan zhing gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhig /

gnyer mkhar phug sogs bod kyi mkhas pa rnams dang rtsod du bcug pas kun las rnam par rgyal te bod sman mkhas pa mi dgu'i gtso bor gyur, rgya gar gyi sman pa shanti garbha dang, rgya nag gi sman pa pa yongs kyi gtsug tu bkur nas mi yul du byon pa'i sangs rgyas sman bla zhes grags, chos rgyal mes ag tshom dang, khri srong lde btsan gnyis kyi bla sman pa mdzad, dgung lo nyer lnga thog rgya gar du thengs dang po phebs pa dang rim bzhin thengs gsum phebs te pan chen tsandra bh'i dang, mkhas pa me dbang sogs slob dpon du ma bsten nas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i kha skong mu tig phreng ba dang, thur dpyad gnad kyi lde mig sogs gdams ngag mang po gsan, rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar thengs gcig phebs te 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mdun nas sbyor ba'i phreng ba dang, byang khog don 'grems sogs gdams ngag du ma zhus nas bod du phebs te gangs can bod yul gyi sman gyi rig pas gzhi byas, de'i steng rgya gar nag gyi slob dpon rnams kyi gdams ngag dang, be ro tsa nas bsgyur pa'i phyogs gzhan gyi gso ba rig pa'i 'gyur dag gi dgongs bcud rnams blangs nas kha snon mdzad de dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhes pa'i ma phyi bskrun, bal po'i rgyal po ha rda ru grang ba thur 'babs kyi nad bcos pa sogs sku tshe gang por «sumeru:» gser gyi sa gzhi de la lhun po'i ri chags te, brjid che bas na lhun po dang, ri'i rgyal po yin pas na ri rab bo, de yang shar dngul dang lho beed'urya dang nub shel dmar po dang byang gser te rin chen gzhi'i rang bzhin can, ri rab kyi ngos rin po che gang gi rang bzhin yin pa de'i 'od kyi nam mkha' yang de'i kha dog tu snang la, de'i 'od kyi rgya mtsho'ang de'i kha dog tu snang zhing, tshad ni chu'i nang du dpag tshad brgyad khrir nub cing, chu'i steng du'ang dpag tshad brgyad khrir nub cing, chu'i steng du'ang dpag tshad brgyad khri 'phags pa'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la ri rgyal lhun po dang, ri bo'i dbang phyug ri yi mchog rin chen brtsegs pa, ri'i rgyal po, sa 'dzin dbang po, lha'i ri bo bcas so,

1.rkyang pa dang sde tshan gcig mtshon byed cig / nang re dgong re/ gcig re gnyis re/ mi re ngo re/ 2. 1) bya byed kyi las dang, skan nam shi gnyis gang rung zhig gi bar du sbyor ba'i dgag sgra dang mtshungs pa'i rnam gcod kyi phrad cig / skan...shi...byed re skan/ byed re shi/ yod re skan/ yod re shi/ yin re skan/ yin re shi/ 'gro re skan/ 'gro re shi/ 2) ming tshig 'ga' zhig gi bar du sbyar nas ha cang ngam shin tu'i don nyams ston pa'i sgra zhig / rgod re bro/ brjid re che/ 'dra re chags/ rgya re che/ ri'i dpangs re mtho/ stobs re che/ lag re yangs/ thugs re bzang/ dpa' re che/ phan re thogs/ gnod re 'khyol/ 'u re thug / 'o re brgyal/ nyams re dga'/ bag re dro/ sha re tsha/ ngo re tsha/ ya re nga/ ngo re gnong/ 3) bya byed kyi las dang ran zhes pa'i bar du sbyar nas ran zhes pa'i don mtshon byed cig / ran...byed re ran/ za re ran/ skam re ran/ 4) ang grangs drug cu dang, de'i gcig gnas bar la sbyar ba'i phrad cig / drug cu re dgu/

bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na drug yod de, mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang, de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang, sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang, lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang, lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang, yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang drug go/
nyi mas 'khrig khyim spyod pa'i zla ba ste hor zla lnga pa/

1) rig pa'i reg pa ste zag pa med pa'i reg pa dang, ma rig pa'i reg pa zhes pa nyon mongs pa can gyi reg pa dang, rig pa dang ma rig pa gnyis ka ma yin pa'i reg pa zhes pa dge ba zag bcas dang ma bsgribs lung ma bstan dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i reg pa rnams so/ 2) 'bras bu'i sgo nas dbye ba'i reg pa gsum ste, bde ba myong 'gyur gyi reg pa dang, sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi reg pa, btang snyoms myong 'gyur gyi reg pa bcas gsum mo/
zas bzhi'i gras shig ste, chos kyi bshad srol du yid 'ong gi yul la reg nas lus sems 'tsho bar byed thub pa dper na ltad mo la mgo 'khor bas ltogs snang mi tshor ba lta bu'o/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, yul dbang shes gsum 'dus nas mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drug 'byung ba yul yongs su gcod par byed pa'o/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum gyi nang gses, sems can la chags pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma lnga'i ya gyal, chags pa'i sems kyis bud med kyi sha rjen pa la reg pa'am lus kyi cha shas 'dzin pa'o/
lus kyis reg nas shes thub pa'i dngos po/ reg bya 'jam po/ reg bya rtsub po/ ltogs skom gyi reg bya/ reg bya mi tshor ba/

'jam pa dang, rtsub pa, lci ba, yang ba, grang ba, bkres skom bcas drug go/
lus shes kyis gzungs bya, tsha ba dang, grang ba'i reg bya lta bu'o/

reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i mngon sum ste, rang gi bdag rkyen lus kyi dbang po las dngos su skyes pa'i gzhan rig shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/

reg bya 'dzin pa'i yid kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste, rang gi bdag rkyen reg bya 'dzin pa'i yid kyi dbang po las dngos su skyes pa'i gzhan rig gi shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba de, reg 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig phyi ma lta bu, rang gi gzung don grogs su yod pa'i dbang mngon gcig gis de ma thag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i gzhan rig gi shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i phyir/

dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang kong rong sman bla don grub kyis mdzad pa'i kha 'thor sna tshogs dang, khyad par du phyi ma rgyud kyi lhan thabs tshul du bkod pa'i zin bris shig /

1) ro 'ching byed kyi thag pa/ 2) thag pa'i dmod tshig

/ 1) snyigs ma/ khu ba bton nas ro ma lus pa/ 'tshags ro/ shog ro/ sa ro rdo ro/ ja ro/ skud ro/ gyang ro/ tshig ro/ 2) srog rtsa nag po sogs khrag rtsa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i ls kyi rtsa'i gtso bo bo zhig ste skyes pa'i g.yon dang bud med kyi g.ytas su yod cing, dwangs ma dmar po 'gyu bar byed la shes rab kyi rang bzhin can rtsa'i kha dog dmar po'o/
ro mchog snang ba'i mtshan bzang: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi nang gses shig ste, skye bo nad pa'i g.yog byas pas ro bro ba'i mchog snang ba/

rab byung bdun pa'i nang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lus stobs skyed pa dang, khu ba gso ba, 'dod pa 'phel ba sogs kyi thabs ston pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos shig /
rigs rgyud mi 'byung ba dang, 'khrig pa spyad mi nus pa, khu stobs nyams pa rnams gso bar bya ba'i don/

ro 'dzin pa'i yid kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste, rang gi bdag rkyen ro 'dzin yid kyi dbang po las dngos su skyes pa'i gzhan rig gi shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba ste, ro 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig phyi ma lta bu, rang gi gzung don grogs su yod pa'i dbang mngon gcig gis de ma thag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i gzhan rig gi shes pa'o/

1) phung po'i nang du rkyen zhugs nas bskyar du langs pa/ 2) lam lugs rnying pa sogs rtsa med bzos nas slar gso ba/

su sku 'khrungs: dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas thugs brtson chen pos mdo rgyud sogs thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas rnams gsan, khyad par du dbus su byon nas grwa pa mngon shes can gyi slob ma dge bshes khu ston dbus pa dar grags kyi zhabs la gtugs te gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi rdzogs par zhus, 'phags yul du thengs gcig phebs nas thams cad mkhyen pa shanti pa phyi ma las gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa gsan, gzhung gi sa bcad bsdud don rin po che'i dra ba zhes brtsams pa bcas rang gi slob ma'i thu bo gangs ri'i khrod kyi sman pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po la bka' babs so/
dud 'gro spu mdog nag po/ g.yag rog po/ bya rog / pho rog / kha rog / glang rgan rog po/

gtsang gi khungs rong du 'khrungs, zur po che dang ha lam dus mnyam, pandi ta smri ti dang mnyam du bod du 'ongs pa'i pandi ta phra la ring bas grong 'jug byas pas rong pas chos mang po rdol shes su byung skad, gang ltar mdo rgyud dang, tshad ma, rig byed, rig gnas phyi nang kun la mkhas pa chen po zhig yin la, rgyud sde rtsa 'grel mang po bsgyur, rang nyid kyis kyang gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos dang smra sgo mtshon cha'i 'grel pa sogs brtsams, mdo sgyu sems gsum ka'i gsan pa dang nyams bzhes gzhan la legs 'doms kyi phrin las spel to/

/ 1) sgra dbyangs snyan po 'don byed kyi yo byad spyi/ rol mo dkrol ba/ rol mo sil sil/ 2) sbub chal dang sil snyan/

sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi'i nang gses kyi rigs shig ste, gar dang, bro, rnga bo che, rdza rnga, rnga phran, rnga chen po, 'khar rnga, pi wang rgyud gcig pa, rdza rnga gcig pa, lcags kyi sil khrol, 'khar ba'i sil khrol, pi wang rgyud gsum pa, rnga mu kunda, sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa, pheg rdob, rol mo'i sgra, pi wang, gling bu dang bco brgyad do/
rol cha sna tshogs dkrol mkhan gyi tshogs pa/
glu gar rol mo'i bya ba byed sa/
1) zlos gar 'khrab mkhan bu mo/ 2) smad 'tshong ma/
yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang bas klu'i rgyal po rnams rtse zhing rol ba'am spyod pa'i mtsho ste, ri rab kyi mtha' skor gyi gser gyi ri bdun dang spel nas yod par grags pa'i mtsho drug go/
tshwa'i mtsho dang, chang gi mtsho, chu'i mtsho, 'o ma'i mtsho, zho'i mtsho, mar gyi mtsho, sbrang rtsi'i mtsho ste, dus 'khor lugs nas bshad pa ltar ri rab kyi 'khor yug tu bskor ba'i mtsho bdun no/
zhing ga rmos pa'i rol shul/
rmon pa brgyab pa'i rol shul du sa bon 'debs pa/
rwa co ste, nor lug sha ba sogs kyi mgo la skyes pa'i lus kyi cha shas sra zhing mkhregs pa de'o/ rwa rtser rdo brgyab na, nu ma nas khrag 'bab/
rwa co ker zhing mjug ma rtsub pa ste, don ni mi byings dang spyod tshul mi mthun pa'i dpe/ mi rwa ker mjug rtsub de tshor kha ya mi byed/
ba phyugs dang mdzo g.yag gi na so che chung rtsis rgyag thub pa'i rwa co'i ris kyi ming/ rwa dkri gcig rwa dkri gnyis/ rwa dkri gsum/
chu 'khor gyi steng yos blug snod kyi rkyal pa'am lding gi kha nas yos sogs thon sa/

rwa cos ngan khrag 'jibs pa'i sman bcos byed thabs/

bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lhun grub rdzong gi byang shar rgyud na yod pa'i 'bab chu zhig yin zhing 'phan yul ngan chu'i nang du 'bab, skyid chu'i yan lag cig yin/
1) mdzo g.yag dang sha ba sogs rwa co yod pa'i sgo phyugs sam ri dwags spyi/ rwa can thar sa la, dbu yu ci mi thar/ 2) (mngon) bong dkar/
1) rus sbal/ 2) me tog lug ru/ 3) ba mo/
ra g.yag sogs kyi mgo bor skyes pa'i rus cha 'bur du thon pa/ rta'i mgo la mdzo'i rwa co/
mthun sgril med pa dang sgrigs khrims med pa'i: dpe
rwa lo tsa ba rdo rje grags kyi tsha bo ste, rgya gar gyi pandi ta sa manta shri spyan drangs te, dus 'khor dang, phag mo mngon 'byung dang, mgon po mngon 'byung sogs bsgyur mkhan/
ri dwags 'dzin byed phyugs rwa las bzos pa'i yo byad cig yin pa 'di'i cha shas su kha zungs dang, go leb, go yu, rnyi mdel, rnyi thig sga ru bcas yod/
rwa co nas gnya' shing bar la 'then pa'i: thag pa
sgo phyugs kyi rwa co la lcags bsregs btab pa'i thel tse/

1) sgo phyugs gsar pa gzhan du mi 'bros pa'i ched du rnying pa dang rwa 'brel byas nas 'dogs pa/ 2) rmon mdzo dang rmon glang dor gyi gnya' sbrel ba/
sems can gyi rwa co'i rtse/
sems can gyi rwa yi rtsed mo/
sems can gyi rwa las bcos pa'i til pa shing la brdar te reg mi bzod par gyur pa'i tshe nad dmigs steng brdeg dgos pa zhig /
phyugs kyi rwa sna tshogs las bzos pa'i tshwa rigs te, ro lan tshwa la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba dang, long ga sogs snod kyi grang ba sel/
rwa co las bzos pa'i gzhu/

rwa zhes pa'i yul nas byung ba'i rwa lo tsa ba rdo rje grags pa/
/ 1) dri chen rnyang ma/ 2) (rnying) nyon mongs/
bod kyi rus rgyud cig gi ming/

bsam yas rab gnas mdzad skabs mkhan slob dang, rgyal blon rnams gdan 'dzoms te bka' bgros gnang ba'i tshig rnams thor bsdus byas pa zhig /

nang 'bar 'phrul 'khor la brten nas gzhung lam thog tu gtong ba'i 'grim 'grul yo byad cig /
rlangs pa'i zil pa bsags nas byung ba'i chu, gtsang zhing dri ma med pas sman dang sgyur rdzas la mkho ba mang/
1) kha rlangs kyi dug / 2) dug chu'i rlangs pa'i dug / 3) sbyar dug gi nang tshan gom pa rgyag skabs sa yi rlangs pa la rta byas nas bskur ba'i dug /

/ 1) tsha drod las thon pa'i rlangs pa/ drod rlangs/ sa rlangs/ kha rlangs/ rlangs pa thul le ba/ me du ba med pa gtong mi shes, chu rlangs pa med pa skol mi shes/ 2) (bashya:) 'khor lnga sde'i ya gyal/
drod kyi rlangs pa mang po 'thul stangs/ tsha po khyer shog zer dus rlangs pa 'phyur 'phyur dang grang mo khyer shog zer dus 'khyags pa sil sil dgos/
rlangs pa'i nang du btsos pa/
gsher ba las byung ba'i dug /
