chu'i rlan/ me shing rlan gsher che ba/

/ 1) chu sogs 'gul skabs byung ba'i gnyer ma/ chu rlabs/ rba rlabs/ rlabs mthon por 'phyur ba/ rlabs ris med pa/ 2) nus pa dang, mthu stobs kyi tshad/ nus rlabs dang ldan pa/ phan rlabs chung ba/ 'phrin las rlabs chen/ gom pa rlabs can/ las chod rlabs che ba/

1) chu'i rba rlabs che ba/ 2) nus stobs che ba/ 3) las chod che ba/

/ 1) ham pa'am snod sogs la chags pa'i spu sngon lta bu'i dreg pa/ 2) (rnying) ba thag /
pho rtags kyi 'bras bu/ rlig pa 'byin pa/ rlig med de pho/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgro ba dang 'bras bu'o,
1) rlig 'bras bton zin pa'i mi/ 2) rlig ril bton pa/
rlig 'bras/ nad pa'i rlig ril bton pa/
lhan skyes rma rigs kyi nang tshan, gsang sgro'i 'bras bu skrangs pa'i nad/

gcer bshus sam sbubs bshus brgyab nas byung ba'i pags pa cha tshang/
sbubs bshus brgyab pa'i pags pa/

1.(tha dad pa) brlugs pa, brlug pa, rlugs,, 1) blo gtod pa/ dmangs la yid brlug pa/ grogs por blo brlugs nas bcol ba/ 2) bshig pa/ rang lus rang gis ma rlug / khang pa brlugs/ mngal brlug pa/ 3) skyon mtshang gtol ba/ nag nyes mthar phyin brlugs pa/ nor 'khrul brlugs nas yo bsrang byed pa/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) rlugs pa, rlug pa,, 1) 'byang ba dang, bshal ba/ zas ma zhu bar rlug pa/ grod khog rlug pa/ rlugs nad ngan pa na ba/ 2) 'dzag pa/ rags rtsa nas chu rlug pa/ khu ba rlugs pa/
tha dad par 'jug pa'i rlug pa'i skul tshig
1.tha mi dad par 'jug pa'i rlug pa'i 'das pa, 2.(rnying) lugs pa ste zas ma zhu ba phyir 'byang ba'i nad/

/ 1) 'byung ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, yang zhing g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid can/ drod rlung/ char rlung/ shar rlung/ lho rlung/ 'jam rlung gdong par reg pa/ re ba rlung 'phyar/ drag rlung tshan tshan du langs pa/ dar dmar rlung 'phyo/ shing sdong chen po rlung gis sprugs pa/ dar lcog rlung bskyod/ bya sgro rlung khyer/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun 'du rnga dang, 'gro ba'i ngang tshul, 'gro ba'i srog rtag 'gro, dri bzhon, dri len, dri'i shing rta, rdul gyi kha lo pa, nam mkha'i stobs, nam mkha'i dbugs, nam mkha'i srog gnas med, ma mos 'phel, g.yo byed, reg ldan, bsil byed bcas so, 2) 'byung ba rlung dang nam mkha'i khams las byung ba'i lus kyi cha shas yongs la zer zhing khams kyi rang bzhin dang chos mtshungs pa'i mtshan nyid drug dang ldan pa, yul lus smad kyi dpyi sked la gnas shing rnam par ma gyur na dbugs 'byin rngubs dang, las la bskyod pa, shugs 'byin pa, khrag la sogs pa'i dwangs ma rnams rang rang gi gnas su skyel ba, mig la sogs pa'i dbang po gsal ba, sems kyi bya ba rjes su 'dzin pa sogs kyi bya ba byed cing gzhan du rnam par gyur na srog rtsa dkar nag gi char gtogs pa'i nad kun kyang 'di las byung ba yin no/ pho rlung/ snying rlung/ 'og rlung/ khrag rlung/ 3) rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i rlung ste, lus kyi rtsa thams cad du khyab pa'i 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin can, mi shigs pa, cha shas kun tshang ba, de nyid g.yo ba'i cha nas rlung zhes bya'o/ rlung bsgoms nas nad gzhir gso bcos byed pa/ 4) 'tshig pa dang, khro ba/ rlung langs po/
mgo dang, me bzhi, nag pa, nabs so, dbo, sa ri, tha skar rnams so/
ngo bo mi brtan pa 'phyo lding 'phel 'bri sogs byed pa'i rlung las gyur pa'i skran nad cig /
lus yongs su khyab pa'i rlung ste, rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i nang gses shig /
1) rlung 'tshub sgor mo/ 2) rlung gis skor ba'i ma ni 'khor lo sogs/ 3) rlung g.yob byed kyi 'khor lo/
1) rlung 'khyir mor 'khor ba/ 2) 'tshig pa za ba/
1) rlung drag po langs pa/ 2) lus kyi rlung khams 'khrugs pa,

mngon pa mdzod las bshad pa ltar 'jig rten 'di'i 'og gzhi, rlung gi dkyil 'khor yin pa de'i ming 'jam po zhes bya la, dbyibs zlum po dang, kha dog sna tshogs pa'am, kha cig sngo skyar 'dod la, rgyar grangs med cing, rngams su dpag tshad sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yod pa'o/
yang zhing g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can/

lam nor/ blon po kha cig shing rta bde ba la zhon nas lam gol bar 'dong ba la sogs pa rmis so/
'od gsal chos sku, sgyu ma longs sku, sna tshogs sprul sku'o/

bden pa bzhi'i nang gses, rang 'bras 'gog pa thob par byed pa'i lam ste, kun 'byung spong byed kyi gnyen por zag med kyi lam sgom pa ni sman lta bu bsten par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bslu bas lam gyi 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/

rnam pa bzhi: bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi nang tshan zhig ste, so so skye bo'i sa nas 'phags pa'i gnas su 'gro bas lam dang, mi rigs pa nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen por gyur pas rigs pa dang, sems phyin ci ma log par yang dag par sbyor bas sgrub pa dang, 'khor ba dang bral nas myang 'das kyi gnas su phyin par byed pas nges 'byin bcas bzhi'o/
bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas gzhan rkyen la ma ltos par rang nyid kyis dbang bzhi len pa/
theg gsum rang rang gi lam la brten nas thob pa'i byang chub/
lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum
nges 'byung dang, byang sems, yang dag pa'i lta ba ste gsum/
phyogs su 'gro dus 'khyer rgyu'i bza' chas/
lam du 'gyangs pa/ don dag cung zad yod rkyen lam 'gor byung song/
lam du 'gro ba ste, stabs legs kyis 'grub pa'i las jus rgyug po/ lam 'gro chen po/ lam 'gro chung ba/ lam 'gro yod med/ bya ba lam du 'gro ba/
lam 'phrang sogs su phyin mi chog pa'i khrims/
'grul pa'i za chas/ byes su 'gro dus lam rgyags ldang ba zhig 'khyer dgos/
'khor bar 'gro ba'i lam dang skye ba'i rgyud kyis dbye na lnga ste dmyal ba dang, yi dwags, dud 'gro, lha, mi bcas lnga'o/
1) 'gro lam ston mkhan/ 2) lam shes pa/ de nas 'gro ba'i lam rgyus nga la med/
1) 'gro lam ngan pa'am, ma dag srol ngan/ lam ngan mu 'byams/ 2) lta ba ngan pa'i lam/
don dam pa'i mngon pa thob byed kyi thos bsam sgom gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag bcas kyi mngon pa/
tshogs lam dang, sbyor lam, mthong lam, sgom lam, mi slob pa'i lam ste lnga/
theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na, nyan thos dang, rang sangs rgyas, theg chen bcas lam lnga so sor dbye bas bco lnga'o/
me 'khor 'gro lam steng du gding rgyu'i lam lcags/ lam lcags 'ding ba/
«mh'apanthaka:» gnas brtan bcu drug las sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas na bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig /
lam la chos shes pa'i bzod pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig 'dod khams kyi lam bden la dmigs nas bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/

lam la chos shes pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig lam chos bzod de ma thag tu 'dod khams kyi lam bden la dmigs nas bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/
«uttarmandrina:» gling phran brgyad kyi nang gses, nub ba lang spyod kyi lho na yod pa'i gling g.yog cig

lam la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa'i bzod pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig lam chos shes de ma thag tu khams gong ma'i lam bden la dmigs nas sngar bzhin bdag med du rtogs pa'i mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ye shes/

lam la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa ste mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig lam rjes bzod de ma thag tu khams gong ma'i lam bden de nyid la dmigs nas sngar bzhin bdag med du rtogs pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam gyi ye shes/
tshul dang mi mthun pa'i lugs srol/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dang, theg pa gnyis kyi lam dang, skye 'phags gnyis kyi lam dang, mdo sngags gnyis kyi lam dang, thabs shes rab kyi lam gnyis dang, smin byed kyi lam dang, grol byed kyi lam sogs so/
1) 'gro lam la rtog dpyod byed pa/ 2) 'gro lam la rtog dpyod byed mkhan/
lta ba ngan pa'i lam bzang por bcos pa/
1) nyi ma/ 2) mtsho lam ston byed kyi bzhu mar/
1) lam rgyus ston pa/ 2) lam rgyus ston pa po/ 3) thabs shes ston pa/ 4) lam lugs gsar pa gtod pa/
lam chen bstan dang don gcig
bar thag / lam thag ring po la dka' gsum: 'tsher gsum/ lam thag le dbar khri phrag gi dka' ngal la mi 'dzems pa/
'grul pas 'gro lam gyi gnas tshul bkod pa'i zin bris/
lam 'grul gyi mi dang khal ma/
1) 'gro sa'i lam ga mthun pa/ 2) bya ba mthun pa/
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, dge slong ma dang lhan cig rgyang grags las 'da' bar byed pa'o/
1) lam du phyin pa/ 2) bya ba lam 'gro yod pa/
1) 'gro lam nor ba'am 'gro mi 'os pa'i lam du phyin pa/ 2) lta ba yang dag min pa'i lam du zhugs pa/
pa'i spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, chags sems kyis kun nas bslangs te bal la sogs pa'i khur chen po khur nas nyi ma gcig gi nang du rgyang grags las 'das par phyin pa'o/

rten rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad bcings nas yid mig rlung gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag pa na lus sems rten 'brel khyad par can gyis ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gags pas rnam pa dang bcas pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen mo mngon du byed pa'o/
lam gyi bden pa'i bsdus tshig
lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi
lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi'i bsdus tshig
lam bden gyi spang bya brgyad
'dod pa'i khams 'dir lam bden mthong bas spang bar bya ba, ma rig pa dang, 'dod chags, khong khro, nga rgyal, the tshom, log lta, lta ba mchog 'dzin, tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te brgyad/
'gro lam khag mang 'dzoms sa/ lam mdo kha/ lam sum mdo/ lam bzhi mdo/
1) lam du 'jug pa'am phyogs su 'gro ba/ 2) (mngon) bzhon pa/
lam sgug byas te gzhan nor 'phrog pa dang nyes rdung byed pa/ lam nag (mngon) 1) me/ 2) me lha/ 3) sgra gcan/
lam nor zin par ngos 'dzin byas nas lam legs par tshur ldog shes pa ste, nor 'khrul ngos zin nas legs bcos byed shes pa/
lam gyi 'go'am lam sne/ lam sna pa/ dpung sde'i lam sna 'dren pa/ lam sna ldog pa/ sna rgyug phog nas lam sna ldog pa/
/ 1) 'grul pa/ 2) sprang po/ 3) ba lang dang ra lug gi khyu mchog / 4) lam srung ba/ 5) lam 'khrid mkhan/ 6) (mngon) tshong pa/

bu'i sems bskyed: sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi nang gses dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi byang phyogs kyi chos so bdun dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni 'phags pa thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs pas na lam po che lta bu'o/
1) sa phyogs gcig nas sa phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro sa'i lam ka/ 2) bsam blo'i thog dang, cha srid kyi thog las ka'i thog bcas la brtsi srung byed rgyu'i rtsa ba'i 'gro lam/
bgrod pa'i myur tshad dam sa phyod/ rta las rlangs 'khor lam phyod shun tu che/
«tsa'utpanthaka:» gnas brtan bcu drug las bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan zhig /
lam dog pa'i sa/ lam 'phrang dog po/ lam 'phrang chu yi 'jigs pa bsam las 'das/
1) lam gnyis kyi bar/ 2) thon yul nas slebs yul bar gyi lam thag / lam bar du brang btab nas ngal gso ba/
1) sems bskyed dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos zin pa'i theg chen tshogs lam sogs lam lnga/ 2) dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang, dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lam mo/

sa skya pa'i zab chos gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste, thog mar grub chen birwa pas kyee rdo rje'i rgyud la brten nas lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang, rgyud kyi bshad bka' bsdus pa dang, lam 'bras bu dang, bcas pa'i gdams ngag rnams nag po pa dang tom bhi pa la gnang, de las rim par brgyud de bod du 'brog mi lo tsa ba dang, des sa chen kun dga' snying po la gnang, khyad par du grub chen birwa pa chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du sa skyar byon te sa chen kun dga' snying po la lam 'bras nye brgyud sbas bshad bstsal, des bsod nams rtse mo dang grags pa rgyal mtshan, de nas sa pan dang, 'gro mgon chos 'phags sogs las rim bzhin dar ba'o/

lam 'bras kyi chos skor rnams sa skya gong ma rnam lnga las rim gyis brgyud de grub chen buddha shri las ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos gsan, de nas rim par brgyud pa la ngor lugs tshogs bshad ces su grags/

lam 'bras kyi chos skor rnams rdo ring kun spangs pa las tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos gsan, des 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho gnyis la bstsal ba nas rim par brgyud pa la tshar lugs slob bshad ces grags/
sha sogs tshos ldur gyi tshul/
'od kyi snang ba gsal le ba'am mngon par bkra ba/ me'i 'od dmar lam me ba/ dkar ba'i 'od kyis lam mer gsal/
phyogs 'dra tsam mam ha lam tsam/ tshig don lam tsam rtogs byung/ lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul lam tsam bshad/
lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi bsdus ming,
lam thag ring thung/ lam tshad rdo phur/

sngags rnying ma'i gzhung las, sems dang sems byung dbyings su zhi ba'i spros bral rang byung gi ye shes blo 'das chen por rtsal snang glo bur gyi dri ma rang dwangs la 'gro ba'i thabs te, de la 'bras bu'i chos thams cad lhan gyis grub par rdzogs pa dang, de nyid theg pa dang lam thams cad kyi mthar thug yin pas chen po'o/
1) lam lugs bzang po/ 2) 'gro sa'i lam bde po/

1) 'gro chog pa'i lam yig / 2) sngar 'gro myong ba'i sa ming bkod pa'i lam yig dang 'gro lam mi nor ba'i lam yig / 3) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs su rta khal khral 'ul skul 'ded chog pa'i lam son
1) lam bgrod tshul gyi snga phyi'i rim pa/ 2) rje tsong kha pas brtsams pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa che 'bring chung gsum gyi bsdus ming/
rdzogs rim gyi rim pa lnga ste ngag dben dang, sems dben, 'od gsal, sgyu lus, zung 'jug bcas lnga'o/
mkhas grub rje'i gcung ba so chos rje'i sku phreng lnga pa ba so lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis lam rim chen mor mchan btab pa la zer/
/ 1) gsal po/ tshig don lam lam rtogs pa/ phyi nang tshang ma lam lam du mthong ba/ 2) 'od snang 'tsher ba/ gser 'od lam lam du 'phro ba/
lam mi lum mi'i bsdus tshig
1) lta ba yang dag pa min pa/ 2) nor ba'i 'gro lam/ 3) lam ga 'gyel ba'am zhig pa/
gzhan dag phyin pa'i rjes kyi lam shul/
rang gi 'thob byar gyur pa'i 'bras bu sher phyin thob byed kyi thabs su gyur pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/
rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi sgo nas yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed pa'i slob lam pa'i mkhyen pa sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

bcu gcig sher phyin don bdun cu las mkhyen: pa gsum gyi chos sum cu'i nang tshan lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig ste, lam shes kyi yan lag dang, slob ma nyan thos kyi lam dang, bse ru rang rgyal gyi lam dang, theg chen mthong lam dang, sgom lam byed pa dang, mos pa sgom lam dang, mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon dang, bsngo ba sgom lam dang, rjes su yi rang sgom lam dang, sgrub pa sgom lam dang, rnam dag sgom lam bcas bcu gcig go /
lag sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses lam: shes rdzogs byed kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi yon tan khyad par can
shes pa bcu'i nang gses, las nyon spong byed zag med kyi lam shes pa'o/
lam bar la ston rgyu'i bka' shog /
'gro lam gyi gnod byed sel thabs byed pa/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs rta khal sogs kyi khral 'ul skul 'ded chog pa'i lam yig /
1) sa gu yangs pa'i rgya lam chen po dang, rtsig pa sogs kyi bar sa gu dog pa'i lam chung chung/ 2) khrom lam che chung/ lam srang mdo/
(mngon) chu bo gangga, mtho ris dang, mi'i yul, sa 'og gi lam gsum du 'gro ba'am 'bab pa/
lam du lhung ba ste, bsam pa don thog tu khel ba/

1) gzhi'am rtsa ba/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byas na lar nas gsal por go shes mi thub/ 2) spyir/ lar na las don gal che'i rigs la shin tu sgrim dgos/ mi de da res tsam min par lar nas yag po mi 'dug /

1. 1) «karma» bya ba'i rang bzhin te rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems yul la g.yo zhing skul bar byed pa'i sems pa/ bskos pa'i las/ sngon gyi las/ tshe rabs las rtsis/ las dang rgyu 'bras/ las 'bras/ las kyi bskos thang/ las can/ las zad pa/ las bsags pa/ las kyis ded na g.yol thabs med/ ming gi rnam grangs la skal ba dang, bgo skal, sngon byas, sngon las, lhas bskos, lhas bstan bcas so, 2) rtags 'jug las bshad pa'i bya byed las gsum gyi ya gyal zhig / 2.rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs dang, de'i nang gses mi mthun dgar ba la 'jug pa'i sgra zhig / rgyun gangs ri las bab/ sa phag las brtsigs pa'i lcags ri/ spyod 'jug las gsal ba/ de la gsum las dang po ni/ gcig las gcig che ba/ me las kyang tsha ba/ kha bu ram las mngar ba, gting tsher ma las rtsub pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa/ 'di las gzhan pa med/ thob pa las shor ba mang/ sgo nga mkha' la 'phangs gyur na, chag pa nyid las gzhan ci 'byung/

«karma» bya ba'am spyod pa/ bzo las/ zhing las/ 'brog las/ ar las/ lus ngag yid kyi las/ dge ba'i las/ mi dge ba'i las/ nyis las/ gsum las/ las chung phan che/ las med lhod sdod/ las mtshams bzhag pa/ mi mang las nyung/ las su che ba/ las ka 'byon po/ las ka khungs 'khyol/ las ka mi lcogs pa/ las ka rtsing po/
las su bya ba'i sgra dang 'dra,
mtshams med pa lnga'i las rnams so/
las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa

'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo, sho lo ka nyis brgya sum cu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na shi la dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/
las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa

'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i mdo, bam po gcig dang sho lo ka bzhi bcu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, prdzanya warma dang, lo tsa ba bnde ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur pa'o/
1) las ka'i mjug / 2) mtshams med kyi las/
las su bya ba'i sgra dang 'dra,
mkhyen pa'i stobs: las dge ba dang mi dge ba dkar nag 'dres ma'i las rnams dang, de rnams kyi 'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'o/
1) dgon sde khag gi las ka byed mkhan/ 2) las ka'i sne mo/ 3) las ka'i cha shas/
1) rig ma/ 2) phrin las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor ro/
las ka'i rgyab rdzi byed mkhan/
kha dang, lag pa, rkang pa, bshang lam, gci ba'i lam, khu ba 'bab pa'i dbang po bcas drug /
bya ba drug: smra ba dang, len pa, 'gro ba, bshang ba, gci ba, khu ba 'pho ba ste drug /
las kyi rtsod pa zhi byed

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum gyi nang gses shig ste, mi mthun pa'i nyes dmigs dang mthun pa'i phan yon shes par byas te, dge sbyong gi chos bzhi la brten nas rang lta mchog 'dzin dang gzhan lta khyad gsod byed pa spong ba nang gi gnyen po dang, las bye ba'i rtsod pa byung na dge 'dun la bzod pa gsol te dge 'dun gyis gsol bzhi'i las kyis bzod pa byin, de nas dge 'dun la mthun pa sbyin par gsol ba btab nas gsol bzhi'i las kyis mthun pa sbyin, de nas mthun pa'i gso sbyong byas te dge 'dun rnams thugs dbyer med du byed pa'o/

'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun las, bslab pa bsrung ba'i gzhi dgu'i nang gses thams cad la khyab pa las kyi gzhi ste, dge slong gi bya ba'i las rnams rgyas par dbye na brgya rtsa gcig yod cing, de thams cad bsdus na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las dang, gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las dang, gsol ba dang bzhi'i las te gsum du 'du'o/
gzhi dang, kun slong, sbyor ba, mthar thug bcas bzhi, yang las so sor nges pa dang, 'phel ba, ma byas pa mi 'phrad pa, byas pa chud mi za ba bcas bzhi'o/
bar do'i skabs kyi 'jit skrag gi snang ba zhig /
'chi bdag gi sde dpon te gshin rje'i rgyal po/ las ngan sdig pa ma bsags na, las kyi gshin rjer zhed don med/
las bsags stobs che zhing rnam smin yang de 'dra myong ba'i gnas/
'dul ba las bshad pa'i slob dpon lnga'i nang gses, dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsgrub bya la gsol bzhi'i cho ga brda sprod par byed pa'i dge slong ngo/
1) las bgos brgyab pa'i skal ba/ 'gan lci ba'i las skal/ 2) sngar las kyis bskos thang/ las skal che ba/ las skal ci bab/
las don byed mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs/ las khungs 'dzugs gnas/ las khungs gsar btsugs/ las khungs 'tshogs pa/ las khungs grol ba/ las khungs khu bsdu/
las 'gan/ las khur bkal ba/ las khur 'phar ma/ las khri, 1) shing cha'i gras gzhog dus dgos pa'i stegs bu/ 2) khang pa chen po'i ldebs zhal sogs kyi skas zam/
1) las ka byed pa po/ 2) gshin rje'i pho nya/
1) las ka byed sa'i gnas sam ra ba/ 2) thon skyed 'dzugs skrun gyi las don gzhi rgya che ba/
las ka byas pa'i gla thob/
'gan 'khur/ rang 'khri'i las 'gan/ las 'gan dkri ba/ las 'gan sgrub pa/ las 'gan gcig lcogs/ las 'gan 'phos len/ las 'gan 'khyur ba/ las 'gan 'thus shor/ las 'gan g.yol ba/ skabs babs las 'gan/

chab srid dang, rig gnas, thon skyed sogs kyi thad rtsa 'dzugs yod la, dmigs yul yang yod cing, mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bya gzhag rgya khyon che tsam zhig / lnga bzhi'i las 'gul/ lag rtsal gsar brje'i las 'gul/
, las ka'i thog ma/ las 'go btsugs pa/
(yul) las ka legs nyes lta rtog byed pa/
1) las ka'i rgya khyon/ 2) gsang yum/
mchod bstod phrin las la sogs pa ni las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/

ting nge 'dzin: bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed rjes lha rnams kyis zhing sbyong ba sogs kyi mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang mthun pas las rgyal mchog go ,
1) 'bru sogs kyi sa bon dang lo tog / 2) dge sdig gi las bsat pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu ste, dge ba'i las bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang, sdig pa'i las bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lta bu'o/
1) las skal/ 2) sde khag / tshong las kyi las sgor zhugs nas bya ba sgrub pa/ 3) las ka byed dus 'gro bde ba'i sgo/ 4) thon khungs/ las sgo rang gi ca lag /
las su bya ba'i sgra dang 'dra,
las kyi sgrib pa'i bsdus ming,
las dbang ngan pa/ las ngan bsags pa/ las ngan byi'u yar yong dang, la kha'i rdo leb mar ril phrad/

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal, gang la bya ba'i yul bsgrub bya, byed pa las kyi cho ga , byed pa po mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa la, de yin pa la de yin gyi 'du shes ma 'khrul ba, kun slong zhe thag pa nas byed par 'dod pa, rgyud de dag nyid la ci nas kyang phan par 'dod pa'i snying rje ste thugs dgongs rnam pa gsum gsal ba'i sgo nas gsol bzhi'i cho ga ma 'khrul bar brda sprod par byed pa'o/ las rnga, las kar 'dzom brda gtong ba'i rnga/
1) las zhwa las gos sogs/ 2) las ka byed pa'i yo byad/
1) skal ba chung ba'am bsod nams chung ba/ 2) las chod chung ba/ 3) las ka stabs bde ba/
1) skal ba che ba'am bsod nams che ba/ 2) las chod che ba/ 3) las ka rnyog 'dzing che ba/
so thar sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga/
las ka'i gzhug gu/ las mjug bsdus pa/ las mjug ring snar/
byed stangs nor ba/ las nyes khag 'gel/

rnam smin myong nges ma nges las dang, 'phen byed dang rdzogs byed las dang, sbyin pa dang tshul khrims las dang, sems pa dang bsam pa'i las lam gnyis re, lus ngag gi las la rnam pa rig byed yin min gnyis re bcas so/
dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gdab pa'i dam tshig gi thig ste, thig skud kyi rgyu dang tshad, kha dog sogs cho ga'i tshul bzhin gdab pa'o/
las 'gan 'khur bzhin yod pa/ las thog 'khyur ba/ las thog yol ba/ las thog pa/ las thog las byed pa/
las don gra 'grig po ma byung ba/ las mtha' ma log pa, rang 'byor lnga'i nang tshan zhig mtshams med pa'i las byas pa'am byed du bcug pa ma yin pa'o/
log pa'i lam du zhugs te mtshams med lnga'i las byas pas chos sgrub pa'i skal ba med pa/
1) thog mar slob sbyong byed mkhan/ 2) lam la thog mar zhugs pa'i so skye'i gang zag /
las khungs kyi dam ga / las dam gnang ba/
las ka'am bya ba dang de'i bsgrub gzhi'am dmigs yul/ gal che'i las don/ las don go 'pher/ las don nang ma/ spyi phan las don/ spyi spyod las don/
bya ba gang byas kyi mjug bsdoms/
las 'gan gtso bo 'khur mkhan/ las sner bskos pa/
1) las ka sna tshogs/ 2) (mngon) nyi ma/ 3) las bzang ngan nam las dkar nag /
1) las sna tshogs byed mkhan/ 2) (mngon) 1,lha'i bzo ba/ 2,nyi ma/
las dbang gis bskyed pa'i ma dag 'khor ba'i snang tshul/
1) dge 'dun pa spyi'i las byed mkhan/ 2) las don gyi sne 'khrid mkhan nam sne mdzad mkhan/ las sne sbrel po/
dgon khag gi grwa pa'i mgo khrid byed mkhan dbu mdzad dang dge bskos kyi bsdus ming/

1.(tha dad pa) las pa, las pa, los, byed pa/ 'dod mos ltar las chog / don las nus pa/ ci las pa/ las los byed pho lo bco lnga yin, rta los rgyug thor mo rngog bcad red/ lto khyi'i lto la las bong las/ 2.yul gru khag gi 'ong skor sogs dga' ston gyi gtong sgo'i do dam pa/
1) las ka skul 'ded byed mi/ 2) sngar 'u lag bskul nas so nam gyi las ka'i 'go byed mkhan/
las ka byas pa'i phogs thob/
1) las ka chung ngu/ 2) las 'gan chung ngu/
1) las ka byas ma tshar bar lus pa/ las 'phro lus pa/ las 'phro brtul ba/ 2) las skal/ dge ba'i las 'phro med pa/
tshe sngon mar yod pa'i las bzang po'i 'phro tshe 'dir smin pa'i nus pa yod pa/
chos lugs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang, mchod rdzas dang, bdag dang, gnas dang, slob ma la bsang gtor gtong byed chu snod cig /
bya ba byed pa'i cho ga, las chog kyang zer/
'dul ba'i brda chad cig ste, dge 'dun pa rnams las la mi mthun par rtsod pa byung ba'o/

1) rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang, dmag dpung, mi dmangs tshogs pa bcas kyi nang gi gzhung zhabs mi sna, dmag dkyus dang las ka rtsag rtsig byed mkhan der 'dus med/ 2) 'go khrid kyi las ka'i 'gan khur ram bdag gnyer gyi las ka nges can zhig byed mkhan/ bzo tshogs kyi las byed pa/ kung hre'i las byed pa/ 3) las mi dang 'dra, las brel, las ka brel ba yod pa/ las brel lhing chags/
las ka tshang ma do dam byed mkhan blon po/
las kyi bskos thang/ las dbang gang phrad/ las dbang smra ba/
rgyu 'bras/ dkar nag las 'bras lus dang grib ma 'dra/
tshe snga mar bsagsg pa'i las kyi 'brel ba/ mar pa lo tsa ba dang khyod rang tshe snga ma nas las 'brel yod pas de'i drung du song zhig /
las ka byed mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la gla pa dang, gla zan, gla yis 'tsho, zho shas 'tsho, las mkhan, las pa ba bcas so,
1) skye ba snga phyi'i las bzang ngan rtsi ba po/ 2) las bzang ngan la rtsi mthong chen po byed mkhan/
tshe rabs las rtsis kyi bsdus tshig
las ka'i sde tshan/ las tshan rkang 'dzin/ las tshan drag rim/ las tshan gsar 'phar/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las byed go gnas rim pa lnga pa'i ming/
yi dam rang rang gi zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sgrub skor phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/
las ka byed 'dod med pa/ thub bzhin nus bzhin du las 'tsher byed pa/
khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gzhi mthun par bsdu ba ste utpala yang yin la sngon po yang yin pa utpala sngon po zer ba lta bu/
las ka byed pa'i zhor ram bar gseng/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs las khungs la 'gro skabs gyon rgyu'i zhwa gos/
1) las ka la mkhas pa/ 2) las ka la blo dkar ba/
zhi ba'i las dang, rgyas pa'i las, dbang gi las, drag po'i las so/

las bzhi ni zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi po yin, zhi ste srid kyi las don byed mkhan, rgyas te dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun byed mkhan, dbang ste khral sdud mkhan, drag ste dmag gi las ka byed mkhan bcas dang, sne 'dzin ni gong gsal bzhi po'i 'go khrid byed mkhan rnams yin,/ zhi...rgyas...dbang...drag / sne 'dzin...
ar las byed skabs kyi rkang zam mam las khri/
1) las ka bzang ba/ 2) sbyor ba nyer bdun gyi nang gses shig /
las don sgrub mkhan dang bzo pa/
las ka gang yang byed thub mdog kha po/
las ka mi 'dra ba'i rigs mtha' dag / las rigs khag / las rigs gcig pa/ bzo tshong las rigs/
las su rung ba ste don byed nus pa'am bya bar bkol bzod pa/
las kar hur brtson che ba/
las ka'i lhag ro'am 'phro ma/ las ror ma song ba/
las ka byed mkhan gyi rogs byed mkhan/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang phyug bcu'i nang gses shig ste, las kyi rnam par smin pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa/
las de'i lam zhes pa ste dngos kyis bsdus pa'am sems pa'i 'jug gzhi/
1) las ka byed stangs/ 2) lam srol/
las ka bskyar du byed pa/
1) las ka byed pa la nus shugs dang ldan pa/ 2) nus pa che ba'i las/
gzhung las byed skabs kyi 'bri shog /
1) bya ba byed pa/ 2) byed pa pos bya ba gang la byed pa'i las kyi don can du 'gyur ba rnam dbye gnyis pa/ las...bya ba...su...

bya ba'i yul gang zhig la byed pa po rang gi don du byed pa nye bar ston pa'i rkyen ni la don rnam pa bdun te, 'di la rnam dbye gnyis pa'am zer, dper na, nam mkhar 'phyar ba zhes pa'i nam mkha'i mthar sbyar ba'i ra des nam mkha' ni bya ba'i yul yin par ston pa dang, chu la zam pa btsugs zhes pa'i chu'i mthar sbyar ba'i la des chu ni bya ba'i yul yin par ston pa lta bu dang, de nyid kyi sgra yang 'di'i bye brag cig yin/ nam mkha'...ra...chu...la...
byed bde ba'am khag po med pa/

1) dus kyi sgo nas phye ba'i las gsum ste, mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi las dang, skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las, lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las so/ 2) ngo bo'i sgo nas phye ba'i las gsum ste, bsod nams kyi las dang, bsod nams ma yin pa'i las, mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum mo/ 3) dge mi dge bar ma'i las/ 4) lus ngag yid kyi las/ 5) sdom pa sdom min bar ma'i las/

/ 1) lcags sna tshogs bsres nas bzhu ba'i li zhes sbub chal dang sil snyan sogs rol cha'i rgyur dgos pa zhig / li ma/ li dkar/ li ser/ li dmar/ li khra/ li sku/ li ting/ li sder/ li thur/ li yi gdung rten/ li g.yer/ 2) spar kha brgyad kyi dang po/ 3) (rgya) shing tog cig / 4) rin po che'i sman gyi rigs shig ste, nus pas mig nad skam tshag dang, 'bras nad la phan, phyugs kyi rngo 'joms/
1) ka ra'i shing/ 2) rgya gar gyi yul zhig /
phye hwag rdog por byas pa, 'dul ba las bshad pa'i zhag bdun pa'i sman gyi bye brag cig /

1) kha dog dmar ser 'dres pa'i tshon nam mdog sindhu ra yang zer/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri 'dzin skyes dang, rdul dmar, phye ma dmar po, bye ma dmar, dmar ser tshon, zha nye skyes bcas so, 2) sa sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma rul gso, sha'i tshad pa dang rtsa'i tshad pa sel/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha la mngar ba, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo tshad dang, rims tshad la phan/

nyag chu'i chu lag cig si khron zhing chen gyi nub rgyud du yod, chu 'go dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul nas byung ste lho'i li thang rdzong khul brgyud nas mthar mu li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong nas nyag chur 'bab/
rdzong zhig si khron zhing chen khongs dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dbus khul dang li chu'i stod rgyud du yod/
sga dmar gyi ming gzhan zhig /
lcags rigs li las bzos pa'i sder ma/
lcags rigs li nag shas che ba/
/ 1) skra su lu'am thur du 'phyang ba/ skra li ba/ skra g.yas su li ba/ skra 'khyil zhing li ba/ 2) mig skyon can/
li yis bzos pa'i dngos rigs/ rgya gar shar li ma/
'bri chu'i stod rgyud kyi yan lag cig mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi chu dmar leb rdzong du yod/
(rgya) spar kha brgyad kyi gras shig /
lcags rigs li dmar shas che ba/
1) li khri mtshal snag tsha bcas bsres pa'i mdog / 2) li kha dog smug shas che ba
(legs) 1) rgya gar yangs pa can gyi yul dang de'i mi/ 2) ya rabs dang, mkhas pa dang, mdzangs pa/
sngar rgya gar gyi mi rigs shig /
1) tshon dmar ser 'dres pa'i mdog / 2) li khri/

shin cang lho rgyud ri bo khu nu'i byang phyogs dang, thag la ma gan zhes pa'i bye thang chen po'i lho phyogs bar mtshams kyi ho then dang, che mo, rmin hpheng nas ru'o chang gtugs pa'i bar bcas kyi sa cha spyi dang, sgos su de'i nang gses kyi ho then dang yus then yul gru gnyis kyi ming rnying, sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya cher dar myong ba'i yul 'khor zhig /

rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas drod skyed, zas 'ju, yi ga 'byed, srog rtsa'i nad dang grang rlung sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la dpal gyi ming can, spos kyi rgyal po, lha'i me tog bcas so,
mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs mtsho nub sog rigs bod rigs ha sag rigs rang skyong khul gor mo rdzong gi mtsho zhig /

bod kyi skad las gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par ston pa legs par bshad pa li shi'i gur khang zhes pa dus rabs bco lnga par skyogs ston smon grub lo tsa bas mdzad pa, 'dir brda gsar rnying gi tha snyad chig stong lhag tsam yod pa tshang ma skad gsar bcad gong gi gsung rab kha gcig las bsdus/
1) lcags rigs li kha dog ser shas che ba/ 2) tshos li hang ser shas che ba/
rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nus pas mig nad rab rib sogs la phan/
rngon pa 'khrab dus thig ral gyi 'og tu bcing rgyu'i dar gyi ska rags shig /
rdog khres sogs ga ler min par ling nger glod pa/ thang chad nas khres po ling bskyur du phab pa/
(legs) 1) rtags sam mtshan ma/ pu lingga/ stri ling ga/ 2) gdon bgegs kyi gzugs/
ling ga bsgral ba ste gdon bgegs la drag gnon byed pa/
ling ling du g.yo stangs shig / yol ba dkar po zhig ling nger btang 'dug /
mig 'grams pa sogs kyi rkyen las byung ba'i mig gi steng du thor pa ling ling tog gi rnam pa ltar 'byung ba zhig / ma rig ling tog stug po yis, shes rab mig ni bsgribs par gyur/
rnam pa thams cad dam yongs rdzogs/ blo ling ste gtad pa/ lus srog ling ste bor ba/ 'dam rdzab nang du ling ste 'gyel ba/
dum bu dum bu'am re'u mig /
sbo ma ste mig nad kyi rigs shig /
g.yo 'gul gyi rnam pa zhig / sa yom rgyag dus khang pa ling ling du g.yo/ 'jigs skrag gis snying ling ling du 'dar/ rtsa ling ling du 'phar ba/ sprin dkar ling ling du rgyug /
(rgya) lcags sam li gyer kha shas dang rnga dmar gyi tshom bus brgyan pa rta drel dang bong bu'i ske rgyan zhig
rgya'am rnyi/ lings btsugs pa/ lings su chud pa/ lings su tshud pa/ lings las/ lings 'debs pa/ lings gtong ba/ lings bkye/ lings thob/
rngon rgyag dus gtong ba'i dung ngam gling bu/
rngon pa'am khyi ra ba/ lings pa khyi khrid can gyis gnod ma thebs/
cha tshang ba/ las grwa lings po grub pa/ bag leb lings po zhig / las 'gan lings po khur du blangs/
lug phrug rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud du ske la thag pas sbrel nas lug rdang du 'dogs stangs shig /
sngo sman gyi rigs g.yar mo thang gi ming gi rnam grangs shig /
rang sa nas thon pa'i yon tan can sogs kyi dpe/ rang dgon gyi lu gu lag skyes kyi dge bshes/
(tha mi dad pa) lud pa 'don pa/ glo lu ba/ lud pa lu ba/
/ 1) chu 'khyil ba'i spang ljongs kong kong/ 2) chu mig
tshogs gtso mtsho'ang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi ru thog rdzong gi shar rgyud na yod/
1) glo rgyun mi 'chad par ldang tshul/ glo lu lu nyid kyis brang khog ha cang tsha byung/ 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig / shib shi lu lu/ tsher ltar lu lu/
sngon rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig /

/ 1) sgo phyugs .yang dkar lug / ra lug / pho lug / mo lug / glen pa lug 'dra ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la lto 'phyang dang, bal ldan, g.yang dkar, g.yang mo bcas so, 2) lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig / 3) nyi khyim bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig /
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas klad 'khyom gso, bad rlung gis mgo yu 'khor ba 'joms/
lug sha cha tshang/ lug khog mgo 'byar/

khyim gyi thog ma lug khyim la byed de, gza' rnams stongs par zhugs nas thog mar lug khyim nas mgo brtsams pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin, khyim zhag nyi bar tha skar steng du slebs ma thag pa de la nyi ma lug khyim la slebs, lho gling dbus ma'i tshangs thig steng dpyid mnyam/
lug mang po'i tshogs/ lug khyu'i sna 'khrid mkhan/
, lu gu yang zer, lug phrug /
, 1) lug gi mgo bo/ 2) bod kyi yul srol du lo gsar skabs rten 'brel sgrig chas shig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug nad sel, yan lag tsha skrangs 'joms/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rims nad dang, dug tshad, smug po bcas la phan/
lo gsum lon pa'i pho lug /
ri bong gi rdul bdun gyi tshad/
skam rlon gang rung gi bcud lug sa'i snod spyad/

1.(tha dad pa) lugs pa, lug pa, lugs,, 1) par blug pa/ zangs bzhus te gzugs brnyan lug pa/ 2) nang du 'jug pa/ dkar yol nang la ja lug pa/ 2.(tha mi dad pa) nyil ba'am thur du bsnar ba/ khang rnying gi rtsig pa lug pa/ ri lug pa thag pas mi 'dum, thang gas pa skud pas 'tshem mi thub/ 3.lug rdzi/

1) srog chags lug gi mig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas so rtsi dang, so brtan par byed/ 2) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug tshad dang rims tshad sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la go slad dang, rgyal ba'i spyan can, sgrol sngon stong 'khor, 'dab sngon stong ldan, ni la utpala, blon po dngul mdog ral gri'i 'khor lo, lug skyes ma'i mig a phyag sngon po, utpala ral gri ma bcas so,
thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas gre ba'i nad dang, glo nad, 'khrugs rims, 'bras nad bcas la phan/
lug 'jug sa'i khang pa'am, lhas ra/
1) rtswa khar lug 'tsho skyong byed mkhan/ glu snyan po la kha'i lug rdzis len/ 2) byi'u zhig /
1) lug gi mjug ma/ 2) mchan khung/
1) sems can lug gi rwa co/ 2) sngo sman lug ru dkar po dang, ser po, smug po bcas la zer/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas thos pa 'dzin, byang sems dkar po sdom/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas tsha 'khru gcod, bad kan smug po sel, rma'i sha'u skye/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mchin mkhris kyi nad dang rlung tshad sel, chang nad dang, thig le 'dzag pa bcas la phan/
thur du 'phyang ba/ grod pa lug lug /
lo skor bcu gnyis kyi nang gses shig / lug lo pa/ shing lug lo/
gser bzhus pa sogs blugs te nar mo bzo spyad/
lug 'jug sa khang pa'am ra ba sogs/
(yul) am cog chung la rwa co 'khyil ba'i lug /

1.tha dad par 'jug pa'i lug pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) tshul dang, srol dang, khrims/ khrims lugs/ tshul lugs/ rang lugs/ ring lugs/ goms lugs/ lam lugs/ yul lugs/ las lugs/ byed lugs/ 'gro lugs/ gnas lugs/ ngo bo'i gnas lugs/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs/ rtsom lugs/ mi rigs kyi cha lugs/ chos lugs/ lugs rnying dam zhen/ lugs gsar 'dzugs pa/ lugs ngan dong sprugs/ lugs zlog pa/ 2) blugs pa'i dngos rigs/ lugs dpar/ lugs rgyag pa/ lugs su blug pa/
zangs sogs bzhus te blug pa'i sku 'dra/
lugs mkhan dang mgar ba'i bsdus ming/
chos lugs dang 'jig rten gyi lugs gnyis/
lugs srol dang mthun pa/ lugs mthun spyod lam/ lugs mthun khe dbang/ lugs mthun gros gzhi/ lugs mthun byed stangs/ lugs dang mi mthun pa/ lugs mthun drang gzhag /

mjug nas mgo la yar bgrang ba dang, rgyu 'gags pas 'bras bu 'gag pa'i rim pa/ lugs ldog gi rtsi thabs/ mar ngo lugs ldog 'char ba/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs ldog gis 'gag pa/ rtsa ba bkag na yan lag lugs ldog tu shugs kyis 'gag pa/ lugs ldog skabs su rtogs pa'i bde gshegs gsum bzhag pa/ lugs ldog gi go rim/
phru gu rkang pa sngon la thon nas skyes pa lta bu/
1.tha dad par 'jug pa'i lug pa'i 'das pa, 2.lugs rgyag mkhan/
lugs spyad bzo byed kyi par/
lcags rigs bzhus te lugs rgyag pa/

snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba'am, rgyu las 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa/ lugs 'byung gis brjod pa/ lugs su 'byung ba ma yin pa/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs su 'byung bar brtag pa/ lugs 'byung ldog tu bstan pa/
mgo rting ngam, rgyu 'bras go rim ma log pa'i skye ba ste, phru gu mgo sngon la thon nas skyes pa lta bu/

steng 'og dang, gyen thur, g.yas g.yon sogs rim pa ltar na lugs 'byung dang, rim min la lugs ldog / re'u mig rer cha shas bzhis lugs 'byung lugs ldog tshul gyis 'khor/ bra nye nas bzung g.yon skor gyis lugs 'byung ba'i rgyu skar nyer bzhi pa khrums stod yin la, nam gru nas g.yas skor gyis lugs ldog tu bgrangs pa'i gsum pa'ang khrums stod yin/
lcags rigs sogs me la bzhus nas blugs pa'i dngos rigs/
lugs srol ltar/ yang dag pa'i lugs bzhin du byed pa/ khrims lugs bzhin lag tu bstar ba/
chos lugs dang 'jig rten gyi lugs gnyis/
sngar gyi srol rgyun/ lugs srol rnying pa/ lugs srol gsar pa/ lugs srol dang 'gal ba/

/ 1) yu ba'am a lung/ bum pa'i lung/ khog ma'i lung/ lung mig / lung thag / lung thag ske la brgyus pa/ 2) gzhung dang gsung/ 'dul ba'i lung/ bka' lung/ lung tshig / lung gi yon tan/ lung dang rigs pa/ lung dang rtogs pa/ lung klog pa/ lung 'don pa/ lung gtong ba/ lung phog pa/ lung rgyun 'bogs pa/ lung thob pa/ lung 'dren pa/ lung gis sgrub pa/ lung dang 'gal ba/ lung gi tshad ma/ 3) lung bstan gyi bsdus tshig / lung zhu ba/ lung 'bebs/
dben pa'i lung pa'am, lung pa khug kyog / ri khug lung khug gi grong gseb/ lung khug grog rong/ la kha la kha ba dang, lung khug la char pa/
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/
mdo las ji ltar 'byung ba'i sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa'i grub mtha' smra ba 'di'i nang lung gi rjes 'brang mdo sde pa dang, lung gi rjes 'brang sems tsam pa gnyis yod/
dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung ste, yid ches rjes dpag go/
gzhung lugs mang po thos pa'i yon tan/

lung gi dus lnga brgya phrag gsum ste ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad lo lnga brgya phrag bcu'i bdun pa nas dgu pa'i bar rim bzhin mngon pa'i le'u dang, mdo sde'i le'u dang, 'dul ba'i le'u ste gsum/
bar ma chad pa'i chos kyi lung rgyun/
mdo sde lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig
yul gru chung chung/ lung chung nang gi dpon chung/
rnal 'byor lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, rnying gzhung rnams su, sgom lam du dus dang gnas sogs nges pa can gyi sgo nas lung bstan chen po thob pas lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro bska, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas bsam se'i nad sel, sa bon las su rung bar byed, grang bas chu kha snyi ba dang za khu 'dzag pa la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la na ga ban de dang ri bong mig go,
lha la lung zhus pa'i rtags mtshan/
lung rtogs gnyis kyi bsdus ming,
t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng dgu pa, 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing glang lor khams 'dan khog tu 'khrungs, rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing phag rang lo bcu gcig par 'das/
lung gi chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang, rtogs pa'i chos bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mo/
mi dang mi khyim med pa'i lung pa/ lam ring zhugs nas mi med lung stong 'grim/
1) sgra'i mtshan nyid ston par byed pa/ 2) 'byung 'gyur gyi don shod pa/

1) de bzhin gshegs pas sems can che ge mo zhig 'byung 'gyur 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas lugs rnams sngon tshud nas dngos su'am lkog gyur gyis gsungs pa'i don bzhi ste, rigs la lung ston pa dang, gnas la lung ston pa, sems ma bskyed par lung ston pa, sems bskyed ma thag pa lung ston pa bcas so/ 2) gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan nges par sbyin pa bzhi ste, mgo gcig tu lung bstan pa dang, rnam par phye ste lung bstan pa dang, dris nas lung bstan pa dang, gzhag pa'i lung bstan pa bcas so/

1) ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi don rnams sngon tshud nas gsal ston byed pa'i gtam/ 2) mo brtag sogs/ 3) dge dang mi dge ba'i chos kyis rnam smin yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong ba gsal bar ston pas na lung bstan zer/ lung bstan min pa/ lung bstan du rung ba/ lung du ma bstan pa'i chos/
1) 'dzin lung khug pa can nam, khug pa med pa'i 'ju thag / 2) lung pa'i bar thag gi tshad/ lung thag ring yang nyin phyed na sleb thub pa bya/
lung thag ske la brgyus pa
'dogs thag ske la bskon pa'i dpe bzhin du don gnad kyi rgyu mtshan 'di dang, 'di zhes gsal por ngo sprod pa/
1) klung la chags pa'i sa thang/ 2) lung tong mig gi ming gzhan zhig / 3) bgrang phreng gi rgyur rung ba'i shing gi 'bras snying zhig /
1) gsung rab kyi lung thob pa/ 2) gong rim gyi bka'i gnang ba thob pa/
mdo sde lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
sems can la brjod bya'i don lung ston pa'am brda sprod par byed pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra, skyes bu'i ngag gis gtam bshad pa lta bu'o/
gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi gsum pa, mdo sde rnams las gdul bya de dang de'i skye ba lung du ston pa nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod du gtogs/

pa'i lta ba bcu bzhi: sngon gyi mtha' la brten pa bzhi dang, phyi ma'i mtha' la brten pa bzhi, mya ngan las 'das pa la brten pa bzhi, lus srog gcig dang tha dad du lta ba ste, gdags gzhi med par btags chos gang yang dmigs su byar med pas sangs rgyas kyis lung du ma bstan pa bcu bzhi'o/
lung du mi ston pa'i sgra
sems can la brjod bya'i don mi ston pa, gling bu'i sgra lta bu rjod byed kyi sgra ma yin pa rnams so/
gzhung gi dgongs pa/ lung don 'jog pa/
lung pa'i 'dus mdo/ lung mdor dmag 'gas bsrungs yod/

1) 'dul ba lung sde bzhi ni, lung rnam 'byed dang, lung gzhi, lung zhu ba, lung phran tshegs te bzhi/ 2) mdo sde lung sde bzhi ni, lung bar ma, lung ring po, lung dag ldan, lung gcig las 'phros pa ste bzhi/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong khongs su yod/
chos sam bka' lung thob pa po/
'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, 'di la pha'i rnam 'byed sho lo ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya ste, bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum yod pa lo tsa ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/

/ 1) yul/ rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i lung pa skyid po/ the'u rang la dbang byung na, lung pa thal 'tshub kyis brgyangs/ 2) ri gnyis bar gyi klungs/ lung mjug / lung pa'i mda'/ lung mdo/ lung pa'i phu/ lung pa lung kyog / lung phu mdo bar gsum/ lung pa zho ltar chags pa de khrag ltar dkrugs/
yul gang ba ste ha cang mang ba'i dpe/ mgo rnyog lung pa gang bzos pa/ ming ngan lung pa gang lus pa/ rdzun lung pa gang bshad de mi la mgo skor ba/
yul so so'i skad lugs/ lung pa re la skad lugs re/
lung pa'i stod cha/ khyi gso sa lung pa'i phu la gso, bu gso sa lung pa'i mda' la gso/
'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi 'di la bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu yod pa lo tsa ba dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur/
mdo sde lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
lha dang bla mas ma 'ongs pa'i lung ston pa/

rnam smin la ltos nas dge mi dge gang rung du ma grub pa'i cha nas blang dor btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i chos, dper na, rtag pa'i chos rnams dang, snod kyi 'jig rten dang, sems can gyi dbang shes lnga lta bu'o/
'dul ba'i sde snod kyi gras shig /
dpung tshigs nas gyen du chag gang sar gnas pa'i glo bu rta'i mig dang 'brel ba'i rtsa zhig /

rang shed ring lugs kyi ngo bo mtshon tshul zhig ste, rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang don dngos kha bral ba dang, gnas tshul dngos kyi 'gyur ba dang 'phel rgyas la dbye zhib mi byed pa, 'gal ba'i dmgis bsal gyi rang bzhin la dbye zhib mi byed pa, gzugs 'das rig pa'i lta tshul bzung nas mar khe si le nyin ring lugs de rengs por gyur pa'i lugs shig tu mthong nas ga sa gar zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byed pa bcas shig yin/
1) 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig / 2) bka' lung zhu ba/ 3) ma 'ongs lung bstan 'dri ba/
'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig 'di la sho lo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya ste, bam po brgya rtsa dgu tshang ba de lo tsa ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/
lung pa'i gzhung/ srib lung gzhung nang gi shug pa de, ri chen po'i rgyan du rnam par mdzes/
lung gzhung bla ma zhu ba
'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum tshang ba, lo tsa ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/
dpe cha'i lung dang rtog dpyod kyi rigs pa/ lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas sgrub pa/
mdo sde lung sde bzhi'i ya gyal zhig /
lung phran tshegs dang don gcig
zhing sa 'dul byed kyi rdzas/ kha lud/ smar lud/ skya lud/ 'og lud/ sa lud/ lud gsog pa/ lud rgyag pa/ lud gsos rgyag pa/ lud bsres rgyag pa/ chu lud 'dzims po/
lud pa bsal ba'i sgra'am glo sangs rgyag pa'i sgra/
sngar zhing bran gyi gla phogs med par mnga' bdag gi zhing khar lud skyel 'dren byed dgos pa'i khral zhig

1.(tha mi dad pa) 'phyur ba/ 'o ma khol te phyir lud pa/ mtsho lud pa/ gtsang chu rgyas nas lud pa/ 2.glo ba'i rtsa sbug las byung ba'i chu khams kyi snyigs ma kha sna'i lam nas phyir lud pa'i be snabs/ lud pa g.yugs pa/ lud pa 'phen pa/
kha lud g.yug sa'i snod spyad/
1) smar lud dang skya lud mnyam du bsre ba/ 2) zhing la lud sbyor ba/ 3) zhing lud gsar du bzo ba/
sngar smon lam tshugs dus lha sa'i mi dmangs kyi khyim phyi nang du mi phyugs kyi btsog lud sngar rgyun ltar gsog 'jog byas 'thus tshogs chen zhal ngor dgongs pa zhus pa'i 'khrol 'dzin/
sangs rgyas shak ya thub pa 'khrungs sa'i gnas te da lta bal yul gyi khongs su gtogs yod/
lum bi'i tshal dang don gcig
gyen du 'phyur stangs shig / chu lum lum du 'khol/ chu mig nas chu rgyun lum lum du rdol/ mig chu lum lum du gtong ba/ du ba nag po lum lum du 'phyur/

rtsa dkar dang rengs 'khums kyi nad sogs ldan 'dus mkhris pa shas cher sel ba'i phyir sman dang 'bru gnyis mnyam du btsos nas phabs rtsi sbyar te langs pa'i khu ba drod 'jam bsros pa'i nang nyal bas ba spu'i tsha ba 'byin pa dang, rtsa rgyus brlan cing mnyen par byed pa'i thabs shig /

/ 1) gzugs po/ mi'i lus/ dud 'gro'i lus/ lus sim pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ lus gso/ lus bskyangs pa/ lus dang yan lag / lus kyi lhu lag / lus kyi dwangs ma/ lus kyi rtsa lam/ lus kyi bongs tshad/ lus snyoms pa/ lus brtas pa/ lus rgyags pa/ lus lci ba/ lus nyams chung/ lus kyi nyams chung ba/ lus rgud pa/ lus rid pa/ lus nyams pa/ lus 'jam pa/ lus drang po/ lus sgren mo/ lus gcer bu/ lus dmar hreng/ lus kyi ngal dub/ lus thang chad pa/ lus brgyan pa/ lus g.ya'/ lus sbrid/ lus mnye ba/ lus 'dzur ba/ lus sgur ba/ lus gsig pa/ lus bkan pa/ sbrul gyi lus bskyil ba/ lus 'khums pa/ lus skum pa/ lus ril 'dar ba/ lus brel sems brel/ lus spang ba/ lus bor/ lus 'pho ba/ lus ma bral ba/ lus kyi nyes chad/ lus dros pho rgyags/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa/ lus dang longs spyod/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa/ lus phyi ma/ lus rjes ma/ lus ston pa/ lus kyis mngon sum du byas pa/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la sku dang, khog nyer len, thob byed, 'dus pa, rnam 'dzin, phung po, dbang po'i skye mched, tshogs pa, zag phung, gzugs bcas so, 2) nag rtsis pas brtag bya'i srog lus dbang thang gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, shing me sa lcags chu lnga'o/ 3) «deha:» gling phran brgyad kyi nang gses shar lus 'phags gling gi gling phran lho ma/
lus kun skam pa'i rlung nad
rlung nad rtsa dang rgyus pa'i nang zhugs pa zhig ste, nad rtags su lus kyi reg bya nyams shing sha skam por 'gyur ba zhig /
nang gi skye mched drug gi nang gses, rten gyi cha nas lus kyi rnam par shes pa skye zhing yul reg bya la mched pa'i sgor gyur pa lus kyi dbang po'o/
lus kyi rus gzhi'am lus po sgrom gyi gzugs su bkod pa/
gtso bo rang gi lus shugs la brten nas thon skyed ngal rtsol byed pa/
gzugs po'i dbyibs/ lus kyi nyams stobs che zhing brjid pa/
dpral ba, lag mthil gnyis, pus mo gnyis te lnga/
lus kyi rnam par rig byed
sems kyi dbang gis lus de dang de ltar gnas pa ste, 'gro ba dang srog gcod pa lta bu'o/
lus dbang la brten pa'i rnam par shes pa/
dbang mngon lnga'i nang gses, rang gi bdag rkyen lus kyi dbang po las byung zhing rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gzhan rig dper na, grang ba'i reg bya myong ba'i shes pa lta bu'o/
dbang po lnga'i nang gses, rang 'bras lus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rten nam bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i gzugs can dwangs pa, dbyibs bya reg na 'jam pa'i spu lta bu'o/
mig rna ba, sna, lce, lus te lnga'o/
lus kyi dbang po gzugs can

nang don bem po gang zhig lus kyi dbang shes kyi bdag rkyen du rung ba ste, lus kyis yul la 'jug dus kyi lus dbang lta bu rten bcas kyi dbang po gzugs can dang, lus kyis yul la mi 'jug dus kyi lus dbang lta bu de mtshungs kyi dbang po gzugs can rnams yin no/
lus kyi sa chu me rlung gi khams bzhi/
dpral ba dang, pus mo gnyis, lag mthil gnyis te lnga/ lus kyi mal lnga sa la phab ste bskums phyag phul/
lus kyi khrag rgyu ba'i rtsa che chung rnams/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'bab ldan dang, rtsa, rus pa 'ching byed bcas so,
mkhris pa rigs lnga: mkhris pa lnga dang don gcig
mtheb kyis sha non pa dang, rkyal gyis chu chen chod pa, yang rtsal bya lta bu ste pho rtsal sna dgu'i nang tshan/

gsang sngags kyi spyod 'bras thun mong ba zhig ste, lus phra yang sogs yon tan brgyad dang ldan par gyur te, de'i lus dngos 'dod khams su mi 'byung yang sprul pa sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/
lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las te, ma byin len sogs lus kyi las mi dge ba dang, ma byin len spangs pa sogs lus kyi las dge ba lta bu/

cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi: rjes su 'brang ba sangs rgyas kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa' mdzad pa'i dus na phrin las mdzad do 'tshal thams cad la dgongs pa snga nas bzhag ste phrin las lhun gyis grub pas sangs rgyas pa'i dus na ci mdzad do cog ye shes kyis snga nas mkhyen bzhin du phrin las mdzad pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
sha stobs zad pa'i lus rid po/
ba spu gyen du langs pa/
1) lus kyi sa bon nam khu ba/ lus khams 'dzag pa/ 2) lus kyi 'byung bzhi'i khams te gzugs po/ lus khams bde bar gnas la bgyi sgo brtson par mchis/
lus nas thon pa'i khrag / mtshon bsnun te lus khrag 'don pa/
che nyams can gyi gzugs po'i rnam 'gyur/
1) sprul pa bstan pa/ 2) lo keg zla keg sogs tshe 'phrang gi bar chad zhi phyir lus kyi cha lugs sgyur ba'i gto bcos shig / 3) lus bsgyur ma dang don gcig
1) lus mdog stobs dman po/ 2) (mngon) rnam sras/
bstan bcos kyi gzhung dngos gzhi/
dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa ste, phyir mi 'ong rnam thar brgyad la snyoms par 'jug par nus pa, 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi gras shig /
lus nas thon pa'i rngul chu/ ming gi rnam grangs la rngul chu dang, rngul nag tshad skyes, lus kyi rlan, lus chu, lus bab, lus 'bab, lus rlon bcas so,
1) sems can spyi'i ming/ 2) rnga mong/
lus kyi khu ba'am dwangs ma/
gos sogs lus kyi yo chas/
chos lugs pas rang gi gyon chas la chags zhen spangs te mchod sbyin gyi rgyur gtong srol zhig /
lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang rnam pa la bzo bcos byed pa/
(rnying) gzhan gyis rang la ster dgos pa'i rdzas tshang bar ma byin pa'i tshe de'i mdun du khro bas lus bsgyel zhing bsnyal ba/
phung po lnga tshogs pa'i gang zag gi gzugs gzhi/ bud med kyi lus rten/ dud 'gro'i lus rten/
lus kyi cha shas lte ba yan chad/
1) lus kyi nus shugs/ lus stobs zhan pa/ mya ngan gyis mnan nas lus stobs kyang shor ba/ 2) lus kyi bongs tshad/ lus stobs chen po/ lus stobs 'tshar longs/ lus stobs bzang ba/
dag pa bzhi'i nang gses, sku lus kyi khyad par gang 'dod du bsgyur ba la mnga' dbang brnyes pa'o/
(rnying) lus dang 'khyil le ste sbrel ba ltar mi 'bral ba'i don/
las ka'i brel ba med pa/ kha dal lus dal/

bar bzhag pa: dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste phyi dang nang dang sems can gzhan gyi lus dag la rang gi mtshan nyid ni rdul phra mo 'dus pa yin la gzhig cing gzhom du rung ba dang spyi'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba sogs shes rab kyis gtan la phab nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/
gus zhabs/ lus kyi 'dud pa dang, ngag gi 'dud pa dang, yid kyi 'dud pa ste sgo gsum gyi 'dud pa/
1) rang srog blos gtong ba/ 2) tshe las 'das pa/ lus 'dor ba'i sdug bsngal/
lus kyi gtos sam bongs tshad/ lus rdos che ba/
1) lhag bsdad yod pa/ las ka bya rgyu lus bsdad yod pa/ dngos chas 'khyer rgyu lus bsdad pa/ 2) rjes la lus pa/ rjes ma zin par lus bsdad pa/
lus kyi cha gang rung la skyon shor ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgur 'khyog dang, sgur po, ltag sned, sne po, sned po bcas so,

(tha mi dad pa) ma tshang ba'am chad pa/ las ka med par lus pa/ ltogs par lus pa/ grogs med du lus pa/ ca lag 'or 'dren bya rgyu'i khongs nas re zung rjes su lus pa/ ngas skad cha bshad rgyu gal che ba zhig lus song/ skyabs med mgon med gcig pur lus/
gzugs po/ lus po che/ dud 'gro'i lus po/ mi'i lus po/
«bideha:» shar lus 'phags po'i lho na yod pa'i gling g.yog ste gling phran brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

gling bzhi'i nang gses shig ste ri rab shar ngos kyi rgya mtshor yod pa'i gling chen, gling de gzhan bas shing t'a la bdun srid kyis 'phags pa'am der skye ba'i mi rnams lus che bas ming de ltar btags pa yin zhes bshad/
1) lus kyi dbyibs/ 2) lus dang gdong gnyis/
lus mi dal ba/ lus brel sems brel byas nas las don sgrub pa/
lus kyi dbang po ste, rang 'bras lus kyi rnam shes skyed byed kyi dbang po/
1) lus po 'du 'dzi'i spros pa dang bral ba/ 2) dben gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, 'og sgor phra mo bsgoms nas rlung dh'u tir 'dzud cing thim pas zhu bde lhan skyes bskyed pa'o/
lus kyi bzo lta/ rte'u de'i lus dbyibs la bltas na rta rigs bzang po zhig yin par shes/
(mngon) lus nas thon pa'i rngul chu/
lus la gyon yod pa'i chas gos/ gyon chas lus 'byar tsam las med/
gcod lugs kyi lus mchod sbyin byed pa'i cho ga zhig
(rnying) lus zungs ma nyams pa'am mdangs ma shor ba/
1) bud med kyis khyo mang bsten pa/ 2) (mngon) me/
1) lus po mi bde ba/ cham pa na nas lus mi bde ba/ 2) (mngon) bud med sbrum ma/
1) gzugs mi mdzes pa/ 2) (mngon) sdig pa rwa can/

(mngon) 1) nam mkha'/ 2) bdud/ 3) 'di bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gi ming gi rnam grangs yin la des myos byed ma dang, glog gi 'od can ma, thig le mchog ma, pad dkar ma, lag bzang ma, dga' ba'i shing rta ma, me na ka, skra 'dres ma, legs rgyan ma, munydza skyes ma, a la mbu sha, chu shing bral can ma, sked legs ma bcas lha'i smad 'tshong ma bcu gsum sprul pas na grangs bcu gsum mtshon/
lus kyi gzhung rtsa dbu ma, rkyang ma, ro ma gsum/
gzugs po'i shed rtsal sbyong ba'i spyi ming/ lus rtsal 'gul skyod 'phel rgyas btang nas, mi dmangs kyi gzugs gzhi thang po yong ba byed pa/

tshor ba'i bye brag dbang shes lnga dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems pa ste, mig gis 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nas lus kyis 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i bar gyi dbang shes lnga'i tshor ba'o/
lus kyi sha nyams/ lus 'tshag rgyas pa/ lus 'tshag bzang ba/
lus kyi stobs shugs sam, 'tshar longs tshad du phyin pa/
lus kyi stobs shugs/ ngal rtsol la zhugs rjes lus zungs je bzang du gyur pa/ lus zungs zad pa/
lus 'dzin par byed pa'i rten rnam pa bdun te, kha zas bza' btung gi dwangs ma dang, khrag sha, tshil, rus pa, rkang mar, khu ba bcas bdun no/
ba'i sdug bsngal: sdug bsngal drug gi ya gyal zhig, skye ba brgyud mar 'khor ba'i gnas su lus yang yang blangs te yang yang 'dor dgos pa'i sdug bsngal/
rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'dod pa'i lugs la kun gzhi dang, rnam shes tshogs drug 'dod pa'i lugs yid kyi rnam shes yin par 'dod/
gzugs po'i stobs shugs/ lus shugs kyi ngal rtsol pa/
lus kyi stobs shugs/ lus shed 'gran pa/

lus kyi rnam par shes pa ste, rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lus dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul gyur pa'i reg bya'i skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa, dper na, bkres pa dang, grang ba'i reg pa nyams su myong ba'i shes pa'o/ sus bsher lus chas nang du lkog nyar gang yod lta bsher byed pa/
gzugs po dang, yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ lus sems gnyis bde/ lus sems gnyis kar phan pa/ lus sems gnyis gnod/ lus sems gnyis ngal/ lus sems bde thang/ lus sems dga' bdes khyab pa/
gzugs po dang, de'i gnas lugs bab tshul/ lus so thang chad pa/
1) lus skyob go khrab sogs/ 2) rang gi lus la gnod pa'i rigs srung ba/
1) rang gi lus gnod pa'i rigs las skyob pa/ 2) bud med kyis rang gi bza' zla min pa'i skyes pa gzhan dang 'gab mthun mi byed pa/
gces pa'i rang lus dang tshe srog / lus srog la lta ba/ lus srog 'tsho ba/ lus srog 'ben 'dzugs/ lus srog thed bor/ lus srog blos btang/ dpa' bo'i lus srog mes rgyal gyi don du btang/

tha dad du lta ba: sangs rgyas kyis lan gsung yul du ma gyur pa'i lta log gi dri ba rnams sde tshan bzhir dbye ba'i nang gses shig ste, lus gang yin pa de srog gam, lus kyang gzhan la srog kyang gzhan no zhes lus srog gcig tu lta ba dang de gnyis re re bzhin tha dad du lta ba'o/
rnam smin gyi lus dang, bag chags kyi lus, yid kyi lus dang gsum ni sbyang gzhi bar do'i lus gsum/

bar do sbyong ba'i gdams pa la lus gsum gyi gdams pa zhes bya ste, rnam smin gyi lus lha sku phyag rgya chen pos sbyang, bag chags kyi lus rmi lam sprul sgyur la sogs pas sbyang, yid kyi lus 'od gsal gyis sbyang ba'o/
ming sngon gyi cha shas shig / le tshan/ le lag /
1) le tshan/ 2) le thogs sam khag ngan/

1) nyes khag 'khri ba/ le 'khon dus 'gyangs/ nag nyes kyi le 'khon byed gte kho rang la babs/ 2) gra ma 'grig gi skyon/ las 'gan 'phral 'phral sgrub pa las le 'khon dus 'gyangs kyi rkyen dbang du btang na mi 'grig /
gyod gzhi'i do bdag ma yin par gnad don de dang 'brel ba yod cing khrims sar gtug dgos pa'i mi/
1) mdog dmar po/ 2) btsod/ 3) dar dmar po/ le brgan dar/ 4) mchin pa/ 5) sman le brgan rtsi/ 6) mkhris pa shas che ba'i rims nad cig /
rtsib thung g.yas g.yon thad skrangs shing ro stod gzer ba'i mchin nad cig /
le brgan te, gur gum phal pa'i ming/

btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus skabs dang 'byor med gral rim gyis gsar brje byed pa'i dus skabs su le nyin gyis yar rgyas dang 'thus tshang du btang ba'i mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs/
zla ba so so'i tshe grangs dang, gza' skar ma, gnam gshis, thon skyed dus tshigs bcas re'u mig la bkod pa'i dpe deb/
1) las ka'i thog nor 'khrul byung ba/ 2) nor 'khrul sod kyi rtsa ba thug sa/
lam ka thag ring thung gi tshad cig le dbar re la smi lnga brgya re yod/ gom re gom re ma spos na, le dbar stong phrag chod mi srid/ le dbar nyis khri lnga stong gi rgyang skyod/
1) gnod lan nam 'khon lan/ 2) skyon nam nyes pa/ le lan bshad pa/

1) sgyid lug gam las don la mi spro ba'i sems, dbye na, dman pa la sbyor ba dang, snyoms las so/ le lo can/ le lo'i sems/ le lo byas na legs tshogs 'chor zhing 'grib/ le lo spangs nas rtse gcig slob sbyong byed/ 2) nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses, 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan pa la zhen nas dge ba'i phyogs la mi spro zhing 'jug pa lhod par byed pa brtson 'grus kyi mi mthun phyogs so/
bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo dang, sgyid lug gi le lo, rang la brnyas pa'i le lo bcas gsum mo/
le lo byas te 'thus shor byung ba ste, las don tshags tshud po ma byungs ba/ le shor can/ le shor med pa/
1) gsol ras/ legs skyes gnang ba/ 2) lag rtags/ legs skyes bskur ba/ legs skyes 'bul ba/ bkra shis legs skyes/
bram ze'i bu mo legs 'tsho ma zhes pa ste, shak ya mu ne rdo rje'i gdan du gshegs pa'i lam du ba men lnga brgya'i 'o ma nying khur bsings pas bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan/
go rim sogs yag po sgrig pa/ legs sgrig dag ther/
don gnad mang po thabs shes gcig thog nas sgrub pa'i dpe/
skyon bsal te yag tu btang ba/ 'gyod sgyes legs bcos/
1) legs par bshad pa/ 2) bkra shis pa'i tshig /
bzang ngan/ legs nyes 'byed pa/ legs nyes 'dems pa/
dang 'bras bu bstan pa: 'phags pa legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i dmdo, lo tsa ba bande chos grub kyis rgya nag gi dpe las bsgyur pa'o/
bya ba bzang ngan bltas te yin min thag gcod pa/
«sudarshana:» nyan thos dgra bcom pa zhig ste, bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun pa/
(yul) legs pa'i rten 'brel mtshon byed kyi kha btags/

sngon rgya gar du byung ba'i dbu ma pa'i slob dpon zhig yin zhing, shes rab sgron me'i phreng ba mdzad de rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs 'god dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsal du bton te dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du gyur/

bzang ba'am spus dag pa/ lo legs/ spyod legs/ lo phyugs legs pa/ bkra shis bde legs/ dge legs phun sum tshogs pa/ legs par brda sprad pa/ legs par brtag pa/ legs par rtogs pa/ legs su gtong ba/ legs par bcos pa/ legs thog legs 'tshol/ gtam legs par bsgo ba/
sangs rgyas shak ya thub pa la log lta byed mkhan gyi dge slong zhig /
legs pa'i blo gros kyi sa
byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i dgu pa, sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i blo gros bzang po thob pas sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya'o/

dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang, gzugs phun sum tshogs pa, dpal phun sum tshogs pa, grags pa phun sum tshogs pa, ye shes phun sum tshogs pa, brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams te bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba'i yon tan drug go /
lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su byung ba'i bod kyi lo tsa ba zhig /
phye ba'i chos 'khor: bka' tha ma legs par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang don gcig
bshad stangs yag po'am yang dag par bshad pa/
dge mtshan rgya cher spel zhing, nyes skyon rtsa ba nas 'gog pa/
grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i nang gses shig /
legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gyi bsdus ming,

1) bya ba legs par byas pa/ 2) dge ba'i bya ba/ 3) (mngon) 1,skal pa/ 2,skal pa'i phul/ 3,kha rje/ 4,dge legs/ 5,bgo skal/ 6,sngon bsags mthu/ 7,bsngags 'os/ 8,mtho ris gnas/ 9,bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ 10,bde legs/ 11,gnam bskos/ 12,phun tshogs/ 13,mya ngan 'das/ 14,zhi ba/ 15,yid bzhin 'grub/ 16,rab bsngags/ 17,rab zhi/ 18,legs ldan/ 19,re skong/ 20,bsod nams/
legs so zhu ba'i 'bul tshan/ thugs rje legs 'bul/ bkra shis bde legs kyi dar dkar legs 'bul zhus/
1) ming tshig yi ge phan tshun legs par sbrel ba/ 2) gtam bshad kyi zhe sa/
samskrita'i skad de rgya gar gyi skad rigs bzhi'i gras shig /
legs sbyar skad kyi gsal byed
gsal byed so bzhi la ltos,
rlung 'dren pa'i sman gyi rtsa ba dang sdong bu dang lo ma dang 'bras bu dag bskol nas 'khrud pa'i khrus/
yag po yong bar smon 'dun byed pa/
lha mi'i bde ba don du gnyer phyir chos sgor zhugs pa/
mngon mtho thob phyir mi dge bcu spong gi sdom pa/
phan pa dang bde ba ji snyed pa rnams/
dag las kyang: mkhas pa rnams ni yongs su len/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rgya cher bshad pa'i legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba, rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'o/
(mngon) 1) sangs rgyas/ 2) sangs rgyas kyi bka'/
yang bskyar bzo bcos byed pa/
1) gong rim du snyan zhu legs par zhus pa/ 2) bka' drin legs par gsol ba/
yag pa bslabs shing sdug pa bcos pa/

1.(tha dad pa) blangs pa, blang ba, longs,, 1) tshur sdud pa'am 'dren pa/ sne len/ lag len/ 'phrod len/ mna' ma len pa/ dgra sha len pa/ ma byin par len pa/ dngos po len du gtong ba/ dang du len pa/ go ba log len/ khas len/ drod len pa/ mgo btags len pa/ gdong len pa/ ngan skyur bzang len/ snying bcud len pa/ ngal rtsol mi byed par thob cha len pa/ snying bcud tshur len pa dang snyigs ro phar dbyug pa/ blangs na rdzogs rgyu med pa dang, spyad na zad mtha' med pa/ dge sdig blang dor/ 2) glu gzhas gtong ba/ glu len zhing gar 'khrab pa/ la glu la kha'i lug rdzis len/ mdzo rgan ri la shi na'ang, mdzo ko yul la len dgos/ 2.rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang gses len pa'i yan lag go / len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa/ nyer len gyi rgyu/

'dod pa len pa dang, lta ba len pa dang, tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs snyems pa len pa dang, bdag tu smra ba len pa ste phyi nang gi chos thams cad nye bar len pa'i nyon mongs pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa rnams len pa bzhir bsdus pa'o/
nyi mas bu mo'i khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla brgyad pa/

rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, sred pa'i dbang gis yul sdug pa dang tshor ba bde ba la yang yang 'phrad par 'dod cing, de dang du len pa ste nyer len bzhi sogs rnam shes skye ba la dngos su sbyor bar byed pa'o/ len po/ 1) 'dra chags po/ gzhan gyi mthong lam la len po mi 'dug / gos chas len po 'dug / 2) zug po dang 'phrod po/ snam bu 'di tshos len po 'dug / shog bu 'di yi ge len po 'dug /
dngul dngos sogs tshur len rgyu'i 'dzin yig /
yug gcig tu/ leb rtsis/ leb 'dur/
rtsa stongs/ zhing bran leb stongs su phyin song/ sa zhing rnams leb stongs su lus 'dug /
su la'ang dmigs bsal med pa/ bya ba tshang ma rgyug pa leb 'dur gyis sgrub pa/
(yul) lham gyi snga rting rgyong byed shing dbyibs leb leb cig /
nyal dbyibs sam ldebs logs khod snyoms po'i don du go ba'i leb mo dang 'dra,

/ 1) nyal dbyibs sam ldebs logs khod snyoms po/ mon sran leb mo/ bag leb/ rdo leb/ pang leb/ mgo leb mo/ sna leb mo/ lcags leb/ sa 'bur leb mor glebs pa/ sha leb mor gtub pa/ 2) yongs rdzogs sam yug cig /
yongs rdzogs sam yug cig tu rtsi ba'i rtsis/ gnag phyugs leb rtsis rgyag pa/ sa zhing leb rtsis/
nyal dbyibs/ bzo dbyibs leb leb/

/ 1) dum bu/ chos gos kyi le'u/ 2) brtag pa dang rab byed/ le'u'i grangs/ le'ur byas pa/ le'u dang po/ le'u bar ma/ tshig le'ur byas pa/ le'ur bcad pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la skabs dang, cho ga, cho ga zhib mo, rtog pa, brtag pa, dum bu, 'dus pa, rab tu brtag pa, rab phyed, rab byed, sarga bcas so, 3) mngal gyi byis pa/ le'u'i lha/
1) gzhung tshig la le'u gsar du sbyor ba/ 2) (rnying) lan ldon pa'i brda rnying/
ling tshe'am re'u mig / ras khra le'u tshe can/

1. 1) spyir nyi mas khyim zla bcu gnyis po bgrod yun dus bzhi rdzogs pa la lo gcig zer/ da lo/ phyi lo/ snga lo/ lo gcig khyud 'khor/ lo nas lo bsdud/ lo du ma song ba/ gnam lo gsar tshes/ lo 'pho ba/ nyi ma lo las ring ba/ zla thog lo brtsegs/ yos lo'i 'bru stag lor za ba/ shing gso bar lo bcu, mi gso bar lo brgya/ ming gi rnam grangs la bgrang bya dang, bgrang gzhi, 'gro 'ong, 'dor byed, dus tshigs, dus kyi cha shas, zla ba'i phreng bcas so, 2) na tshod dam skyes lo lon tshod/ mi lo/ rang lo/ tshe lo/ spyi lo/ 'das lo/ khri lo/ skyes nas lo ma lon pa/ lo rgan drug cu/ 2. 1) rung ngam chog / za e lo mi lo/ gon e lo mi lo/ khyod rang la lo'am mi lo/ 2) tshul lam zol/ slob lo sbyong lo tsam byas pas yar skyed mi thon/ shes lo tsam gyis don snying la mi phan/ nyan lo thos lo kho nas rtogs par dka'/ 3. 1) lo grag zer gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste ma rangs pa'i tshig / 'di skad lo/ mkhas pa mgo rmongs so lo/ mnga' thang che lo skad/ dpa' snying yod do lo/ rgyal kha thob lo zer/ shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis, blun po yon tan mi slob lo, brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis, blun pos 'bad pa lhag par dgos/ 2) la mthar sbyar rgyu slar bsdu'i phrad cig la...phyag 'tshal lo/
nag rtsis las bshad pa'i rang gi lo rtags shar skabs kyi lo'i bar chad cig /
nyi ma lug khyim du slebs nyin khyim zhag phur bu'i myur dag skar ma gang shar ba de lo skar yin/
byi ba dang, glang, stag yos, 'brug sbrul, rta, lug sprel, bya, khyi, phag lo ste lo rtags bcu gnyis so/
ston thog gam, lo ltar thon pa'i za 'bru spyi'i 'bras bu/ lo skya rgyas pa/
lo skor bcu gnyis dang shing me sa lcags chu lnga'i khams/
lo tog srung ba'i khrims/ yul du rgan dran ma myong ba'i lo legs byung ba la gang dgar brnga rgyu med pa'i lo khrims byas/
1) lo hril po/ lo 'khor tshogs 'du/ 2) lo re/ lo 'khor 'char gzhi/ lo 'khor mo'i phyogs sdom/ lo 'khor mo'i char pa 'bab tshad/ 3) shing sdong gi lo ris/
nag rtsis kyi bshad srol du lo skor bcu gnyis so so rang nas yar brtsis pa'i bzhi pa dang, mar brtsis pa'i bzhi pa gang thug pa de lo dgrar brtsi/

, lo re'i zla ba bcu gnyis las gang dang gang la lo yi 'go 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod de, hor zla'i sgo nas bshad na, 1,hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig ste nag zla yar ngo'i tshes gcig la 'dzin pa ni dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas skar rtsis pa rnams kyi lugs, 2,hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig la 'dzin pa ni, mdo sde gser 'od dang sman gyi rgyud bzhi ltar rgya nag hor rgyal po, bod kha ba can pa, nag rtsis pa 'ga' zhig bcas thams cad mthun pas da lta yongs grags ltar ro, 3,hor zla bcu gnyis pa'am dgun zla 'bring po rgyal zla ba nas 'dzin pa ni gdan bzhi dang rdo rje mkha' 'khro'i lugs, 4,hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig gam dgun nyi ldog nas 'dzin pa ni nag rtsis pa rnams kyi lugs yin, rags rtsis byas na tshes gcig dang, zhib rtsis byas na dgun nyi ldog nas 'dzin, 5,hor zla bcu pa'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin pa ni 'dul ba dang, mngon pa mdzod kyi rjes su 'brangs nas sa pan dang rje tsong kha pa sogs kyi lugs yin, 6,hor zla dgu pa'i mar ngo'i gcig nas 'dzin pa ni mdo nyi ma'i snying po'i rjes su 'brangs nas, kha che pan chen dang, snar thang ba, mchims 'jam dbyangs sogs kyi lugs yin, 7,hor zla brgyad pa'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin pa ni rten 'brel mdo 'grel gyi rjes su 'brangs nas skyor mo lung gi sba ti dgra bcom pa sogs kyi lugs yin/

1) rgya nag lugs la lo bcu gnyis, shing me sa lcags chu lnga yi, dbang thang khams rer pho dang mor, sbyar bas lo rgan drug cu 'byung, zhes pa ltar rab byung ril po gcig la zer/ 2) lo drug cur slebs pa'i mi/ mi ro skam po chu la sbangs nas lo rgan drug cu'i rtsis rgyag /
na so lon pa/ lo rgas rdzi rdib/
lo ltar ram lo re bzhin/ lo rgyun chags su lo gsar gyi dus chen gtong ba/
gnas tshul byung rabs/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ lo rgyus thor bu/ lo rgyus shul rnying/ khyim gyi lo rgyus/ na ba'i lo rgyus/ lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba/ mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus/
gtso'i ring lugs: mar khe si dang en ke si rnam gnyis kyis gsar skrun gnang ba'i mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chos nyid ches spyir btang pa'i skor gyi tshan rig cig /
sba bzhed kyi ming ste bsam yas dkar chag chen mo yang zer/
(rgya) gro zhib 'tshag byed kyi dar tshags/
byis pa lo brgyad lon pa'i dri chu ste, nus pas gnyan rims dang dug tshad sel/

snga dus bod rje gri gum btsan po'i skabs kyi tsho dpon zhig 'dis gri gum btsan po bkrongs te rgyal sa phrogs, rgyal bu gsum yul gzhan du spyugs, rje'i sras mo btsun mor byas, mthar gri gum btsan po'i btsun mo yug sar lus pa las skyes pa'i byi phrug ru las skyes kyis bsad pa red/
lo bcu la ston thog lnga ste lo gnangs 'char du 'debs rgyu'i zhing kha/
lo tog dang char chu/ lo chu legs pa/
char chu dus thog tu bab nas ston thog yag po byung ba/
1) lo chung ngu/ 2) lo tsa ba chung ba/ lo chen rin bzang dang lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis/
1) lo na chen po/ 2) lo tsa ba chen po/

chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gcung, rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing rta lor 'khrungs, mdo sngags gsar rnying, tha snyad rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas shing, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta lor rtsis gzhung nyin byed snang ba brtsams, gsung rtsom gzhan dag kyang shin tu mang, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi lor jun gar gyi dmag gis bkrongs/
lo snga mar mi shi ba'i zla dus tshes grangs bzung ste byed pa'i phyag mchod/
zla ba bcu gcig pa'am, bcu gnyis pa/ lo mjug gnam stong/
ston thog legs po ma byung ba/
'bru rigs spyi'i 'bras bu/ lo tog gi sdong bu/ lo tog nyal ba/
lo tog mchog tu bde ba
mgon khang nang du lo 'khor mor bshams nas 'jog pa'i gtor ma/
1) 'byung rtsis skabs lo khams so so mtshon byed kyi dud 'gro bcu gnyis/ 2) rang skyes pa'i lo rtags/
lo rtags gsol ras zhu ba
(yul) bag ma sogs slong skabs slong yul gyi pha mar bu bu mo gang yin gyi lo rtags 'dri ba/
1) lo dus kyi rten mjal/ 2) lo ltar gyi 'bru'i khral 'bab/ 3) lo gcig gi yong 'bab/
sngo tshal gyi lo ma'i thug pa/
lo nyi shu sum cu tsam du slebs pa'i dar babs/
lo tshad dus bkag / lo dus rgyas bcad/ lo dus thim pa/ lo dus gtsang ba/ lo dus tshang ba/ lo dus rdzogs pa/
dngul bun sogs lo dus rgyas dpyad kyis kha grangs thag bcad pa/
bstan bcos shig ste slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi lo dri ba zhes bya'o/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, lo drug gi bar du rang la longs spyad rgyu'i stan yod bzhin du stan gsar pa ched du byas pa'o/
1) nyi ma lug khyim la slebs pa'i nyin gyi res gza' ni lo ril po de'i bdag po'o/ 2) lo'i bdag po ste lo re re la dbang ba'i lo lha/
lo ma dang 'dab ma'i bsdus ming/ lo 'dab thur du 'phyang ba/ lo 'dab seng seng/ shing sdong lo 'dab rgyas pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la sgrib byed dang ltung byed do/
skad grags don gnyer/ lo 'dod can gyis gnas lugs kyi don mi rtogs/
lo ma dang, sdong po, me tog 'bras bu bzhi'i bsdus tshig /

lo grangs na tshod/ lo na mtho ba/ lo na ma son pa/ lo na ran pa/ lo na phra ba/ lo na son pa/ lo na rgan pa/ lo na rgad po/ lo na gzhon pa/ lo na mtho la lus stobs zhan pa/ lo na rgas kyang rgan pa min, shes bya rgyas na rgan pa yin/
lo sme gnyis nag la 'khel ba'i gnam lo/
nad kyis mnar te rgyun ring nyal sar lus pa/ rgas 'khogs nad mnar gyis lo nad stan 'byar du gyur pa/
lo gcig res bar du chod pa'i lo re/ sa mtho'i sa zhing zhan pa kha shas lo gnangs 'char la ma gtogs 'debs mi nyan/
lo gang la skyes pa'i pho/ byi ba lo pa/
lo tsa ba dang pandi ta'i bsdus ming/
bod kyi goms gshis su lo gsar gong nas snod chung nang la ched du btab nas lo gsar skabs mchod rdzas tshul du rten drung du bsgrig bya'i lo tog gsar pa'i phud/
lo re'i nang thengs re 'bul ba phul te phyag 'tshal ba/
1) zhing las dang 'brog las/ char chu dus su phab cing rtag tu lo phyugs 'phel bas yul der bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyis khyab pa/ 2) lo tog dang phyugs zog /
lo snga ma rdzogs pa dang phyi ma gsar du shar ba'i dus mtshams/
rtsis 'phro spos mtshams nas brtsi bya'i gnam lo'i dgun nyi ldog yan chad la nyin zhag ci tsam song ba'i grangs yin/
dgun nyi ldog pa'i phyi nyin gyi gza' dang skar ma la lo phyi ma gsar du shar ba'i skabs yin pas na de ltar brjod/
'grig pa'am go chod pa/ tshod ma 'di za lo ba tsam 'dug /
'bru rigs spyi/ lo 'bras legs shing ro bcud ldan/

/ 1) rtswa shing gi lo ma/ shing lo/ lcang lo/ sngo lo/ lo ma kha 'bus pa/ lo ma phre'u/ lo ma lhags pa/ lo ma'i spyil bu/ lo ma dang 'dab ma/ lo ma'i srin 'bu/ me tog padma mdzes kyang lo ma sngon pos brgyan dgos/ lo ma skam po/ g.yu shug zil pa mtha' yas pa'i lo ma'i drung nas 'phur lding byed cing skyo shas kyi glu blangs pa/ 2) snying po med pa/ tshig gi lo ma/
(mngon) 1) tshos gzhi ljang khu/ 2) chu lha'i shing/
dri zhim po'i bsang shing gi lo ma brdar ba'i thum bu/
'bri la sogs pa'i phyugs kyi mar rnying pa lo gcig lon pa zhig /
rjod byed kyi tshig mang drags te brjod bya'i don ston mi thub pa'am mi gsal ba/
ti mu sa ri skyes dang klung skyes gnyis kyi nang tshan klung skyes kyi ming zhig /
(legs) 'jig rten mig gam, skad gnyis smra ba po ste, skad yig sgyur mkhan/
brtson 'grus seng ge: byang chub 'od kyis a ti sha gdan 'dren du btang ba'i mi lnga'i ya gyal yin la, a ti sha gdan drangs te bod du phyir log pa'i lam du 'das/

khri srong lde btsan skabs kyi lo tsa ba ba gor bee ro tsa na, ldan ma rtse mang, kha che a'a nanta ste rgan gsum, gnyags dznya na ku ma ra, 'khon klu'i dbang po, rma rin chen mchog ste bar pa gsum, ska ba dpal brtsegs, cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan, zhang ye shes sde ste gzhon gsum bcas lo tsa ba rab dgu'o/
chen bzang po: rin chen bzang po la ltos,
1) lo tog legs nyes kyi gnas tshul/ 2) sngo sman zhig lo tsan yang zer/
sngon rabs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i lo zla'i dus tshigs/
na tshod mtho dma'i tshod/ khyed rang da lo lo tshod ga tshad red/
lo gnyis res bar du chod pa'i lo gsum pa/ phru gu gzhes 'char la skyes par gsum tshigs zer/
1) lo dang zla ba'i bsdus ming/ 2) lo na mnyam pa'i mi'am skyes lo gcig pa'i mi/
lo zla zhag dus kyi khams

gnam lo ma la zla ba bu, zla ba ma la zhag ni bu, zhag ni ma la dus tshod bu, dper na, gnam lo'i khams me yin na zla ba dang po sa stag yin, zla ba dang po sa stag yin na de'i tshes gcig lcags stag yin pa dang, zla ba de'i tshes gcig lcags yin na nam langs chu yos, nyi shar shing 'brug nyi dros me sbrul, nyin phyed sa stag sogs lhag ma kun la rigs 'gre'o/
grub rtsis la nyi ma lug khyim du slebs pa'i nyin gyi res gza' ni lo de'i gza' yin no/
1) lo 'go gang nas 'dzin pa'i thog ma/ 2) byi ba'i lo/
(mngon) 1) nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig brtsis pa'i zla ba/ 2) bskal pa/
lo gang la 'char ba'i sme ba/
1) lo rgyus kyi dus rabs dum bu gcig / 2) lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul/ 3) deng skabs lo brgya tham pa la dus rabs gcig brtsis pa'i lo bcu phrag gcig /
dus skabs snga phyi bsgrigs pa'i rim pa/ lo rim 'phar ba/
dgun dang, dpyid, dbyar, ston bcas bzhi/
lo thog legs pa'am bzang ba/ lo legs byung na mu ge med/ lo ltar lo legs byung ba/
lo gcig lon pa'i sha rnying pa ma rul ba ste, nus pas rlung nad 'joms/
lo skor bcu gnyis so sor rang nyid nas brtsis pa'i yar gyi bzhi pa dang, mar gyi bzhi pa de lo gshed du rtsi/
lo so so'i nang zla tshes gza' skar char chu gnam gshis sogs bzang ngan gyi khyad par bshad pa'i lo tho/
lo 'go gsar du 'char ba/ lo gsar nya gang/ lo ma gsar gong la/ lo gsar tshes gcig / lo gsar du tshes pa/ lo gsar pa shar ba/ lo gsar legs skyes/ lo gsar gtong ba/
1) bod lugs lo gsar skabs gro so phye mar gyi steng du 'dzugs rgyu'i me tog / 2) sngo zhig /
btab nas lo gsum song mtshams 'bras bu yong ba'i kham bu/
lo gsum dang zla ba gsum mtshams bcad de sgom sgrub byed pa/
lo 'khor/ lo hril gsum la slob grwar bsdad/
1) lo tog gi lha/ 2) lo khams kyi lha/
legs) 'jig rten dbang phyug ste spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan/
bzo lta'am stangs ka zhig / the tshom log ge ba/ lus gzugs zur log ge ba/ bden nam rdzun snyam pa'i the tshom log ge ba la nang du phyin/
zhing gar rmon pa rgyag pa/ ston ka lo thog brngas ma thag tu zhing gar log rgyag dgos/
go ba phyin ci log tu rgyag pa/ gzhung don la go ba log sgrub byed pa/
dge ba'i rtsa ba phyin ci log par bsngo ba/
drin lan log 'jal/ spyang ki sgo khyir gsos na drin lan log 'jal byas yong/
tshad ma'i 'gal zla gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste phyin ci log gi rtog dpyod/ log rtog gi gtam mang du gleng ba/

rgyu 'bras bya byed tshe snga phyi sogs yod pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas, rnam pa med par 'dzin cing byed las dge ba la mi 'jug cing dge rtsa gcod pa dang, mi dge ba la 'jug cing sdig sems dam 'cha' ba sogs blang dor log par sgrub par byed pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can no/
ngos 'dzin phyin ci log tu byed mkhan/
log pa'i bsam sbyor mar gnon pa/ bsam pa legs spel log gnon byas pa/
ming gzhan bsam yas dkar chag chen mo'ang zer, rab byung dang po spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang, khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis brtsams pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus shig /

1. (tha mi dad pa) 1) tshur yong ba/ log tu 'jug pa/ lam nor nas phyir log pa/ chu bo gyen du log mi srid/ zhen pa log pa/ rta dkar po kha dog log rung, gser ser po kha dog mi log / 2) 'gyel ba'am nyil ba/ rtsig pa log pa/ 2. nor 'khrul/ phyin ci log pa/ log par sems pa/ log par rtogs pa/ log pa'i lta ba, lta ba log pa/ log pa'i blo gros/ log par sdang ba/ smon tshig log pa/ go ba log sgrub/ drin lan log 'jal/ log pa rtsom pa/ log srid bskyar langs/ log pa'i lam/ log rtsis kyi bshu gzhog /
nga rgyal bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, yon tan ma yin pa la yon tan du rloms nas khengs pa'o/
zhe sdang dang gti mug las skyes pa'i ngag /
1) don med du khong khro skyes pa/ 2) sems kyi gting nas 'khon 'dzin byed pa/
log par lhung ba dang don gcig
'khor ba 'jig gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
1) 'dod log spyod pa/ 2) bya ba phyin ci log byed pa/
1) log pa'i phyogs su lhung ba/ 2) ngan 'gro/
(rnying) 1) 'dam pa po/ 2) ldab 'phar/ ldab grangs log por btang ba/ mi grangs log por 'phar ba/

tshul las log par spyod pa ste, bsam blo'i thog gam bya spyod thog nas lam lugs rnying pa srung skyong dang lam lugs gsar pa gtor bshig gsar brjer ngo rgol bcas byed pa/ log spyod gral rim/ log spyod pa/ log spyod dbang sgyur/

1) gzhung dang 'gal ba'i sbyor tshul log pa, dper na byed pa po ston skabs mkhan la gis sbyor ba dang bdag la gyis sbyor ba lta bu/ 2) tsha ba'i nad la drod bcos dang grang ba'i nad la bsil bcos byed pa lta bu ngo bo mi mthun pa'i sbyor ba byas par zer/
1) log par smra ba/ 2) log par shod pa po/
lus dang ngag gi las chags pa las skyes pa/

tshul 'chos te ma yin yin khul byas nas byung ba dang, kha gsag ste sprel lad bshad nas byung ba, gzhogs slong ste go rgyu btang nas yong thabs byed pa, thob kyis 'jal ba ste dbang yod btang nas 'phrog pa, rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba ste chung chung phar sprad nas chen po tshur yong thabs byed pa bcas lnga'o/

dgun nyi ldog nas zhag nyer bzhi'i ring la log zhag zer, de'i ring la kha rlung dang grang ngar che na dbyar zhod zer, dbyar nyi ldog nas zhag nyer gcig ring la log zhag brtsi, de'ang nyi ldog nyin dang, bdun dang po, gnyis pa, gsum pa bcas dus char bzhi po de la char bab na gnam dma' ba zhes zer bas dbyar dus than pa med zer, dus char bzhi po de la char ma bab na gnam mtho ba zhes grags pas nyin nyer gcig tsam la than/
log par g.yem pa yang zer, gzhan gyi chung mar byi byed pa dang, rang gi chung ma sbrum mar 'khrig pa lta bu/
bgrod bya min pa dang, yan lag min pa, dus min pa, gnas min pa rnams la chags pa spyod pa/
1) nor ba'i lam ga / 2) lta ba ngan pa'am lam lugs ngan pa/
zlum po'am ril mo/ grod pa'i nang du btums pa'i mar log log de la rgya ma ci tsam 'dug /
