blo rig bdun gyi nang gses, rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i shes pa, dper na sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang, dung ser snang gi dbang shes lta bu ste, chos kyi tshul ji bzhin mi shes pa'i rmongs pa la sogs pa phugs kyi 'khrul rgyu dang, mkhris nad la sogs pa 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu'i dbang gis rang yul ji ltar gzung ba de ltar ma grub pas log pa'i shes pa'o/

1. ngos/ mdun logs/ rgyab logs/ g.yon logs/ khang pa'i nang logs/ sgam gyi logs gcig / logs shig na bris/ 2. yi ge 'di'i mthar su sbyar na gzhan du'am zur du zhes pa'i don du go/ su...logs su bsal ba/ logs su dgar ba/ logs su bton pa/ logs su bkar ba/ logs logs su skyod pa/ logs su med pa/ logs su phye ba/ logs su bzhag pa/ logs su bskyur ba/
lung pa gcig gam las rigs gcig nang logs kyi mis ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi go bar logs su bshad pa'i skad cha/
dkyil khang gi logs su'am, zur du yod pa'i khang pa/
1) zur du phrad pa'am thug pa/ 2) 'khris la song ba/
/ 1) khom pa dang lcogs pa'i dus/ za long mi 'dug / sdod long byung ma song/ long skabs/ long ye med pa/ 2) rta drel gyi rgyu smad/
1) mig long ba 'khrid mkhan/ 2) long ba'i lag rten/

,mi lus kyi byang khog smad kyi char yar sne rgyu ma dang mar sne gzhang du 'brel ba'i snod drug gi ya gyal zhig ste, de'i byed las ni lus kyi rlung khams kyi snyigs ma dang, zas ro rnams bsags shing thur du gtong ba sogs byed pa yin no/
mun 'thom gyi thal skyod/ gnas tshul la ma brtags ma dpyad par long mchongs byas na pham nyes yong rgyu las med/
1) rgyu mtshan zhib tu ma rtogs par bshad pa'i gtam/ 2) rgyu mtshan dang don med kyi gtam/ las med long gtam du tshogs pa/
lte ba'i g.yas g.yon du tshon gang re gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i long ga'i ther dang 'brel ba'i me gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na long skran dang, lbu ba, be snabs can 'khru ba'i nad la phan/

long gi na tsha ste, nang gses su dbye na grang sbos dang, grang 'gyings, tsha rnyongs, 'ju skems, rlangs pa can bcas lnga mchis, nad rtags su lte ba'i g.yas g.yon du na zhing sbo 'khrog byed pa dang, skabs 'gar dri chen mi 'byung bar 'gags pa zhig /
lte ba'i g.yas g.yon du na zhing sbo 'khrog byed pa dang, lbu ba'am be snabs can 'khru ba'i nad cig /
mig la skyon shor ba'i pho/
lte ba'i g.yas g.yon nas phyi la tshon do re gzhal ba'i gnas su long ga dang 'brel ba'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na long skran dang sbo 'khrog byed pa 'khru ba 'byams pa sogs la phan/
glo phreng yang zer, bud med kyi ska rags 'og tu dpyang ba'i dngul thag /

1. (tha mi dad pa) longs pa, long ba,, 1) mig ldong ba'am, mig dbang shor nas mthong mi thub pa/ g.yas long ba/ mig longs kyang ha rer lta ba/ mig med longs mchongs/ 2) 'dang ba/ rtsis grangs longs pa/ tshad longs pa/ lo grangs longs pa/ ring tshad ma longs pa/ gzugs stobs ches cher long dus/ rgya ma gang longs ma longs tsam/ 2. gzugs mi mthong mkhan/ dmus long/ long bar long 'khrid med pa/ khyi long ba/ long bar lam 'dri ba/ long bas long ba khrid, long ba rbab tu 'gril/ long bas bltas kyang khams gsum/ rgan mo long bas gser khur nas 'gro ba/ the tshom gar 'dzugs med pa'i long ba'i 'khar rgyug 'dra/
/ 1) rkang pa'i long bu/ long tshigs/ 2) (rnying) shing 'bras/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste shin tu sbas pa'i chos kyi blo gros can nyid kyis long bu mi mngon pa/
mig la skyon shor ba'i bud med/

nang long gi tshigs 'bur po'i steng nas gso bya rang nyid kyi tshon gang gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na glang thabs dang, mngal skran, zla mtshan 'gags pa'am 'byams pa, pus mo'i tshigs na ba sogs lus smad kyi nad la phan/
long gar tsha ba zhugs pa'i nad de, nad rtags su kha skam la skom dad che ba dang, khog pa sbo zhing dri chen 'gag pa sogs 'byung ba zhig /
'bur du thon pa'i rnam 'gyur/ chu long long du 'khol/ rba rlabs long long du 'phyur/ tshig pa za long long byas byung/ mig chu long long zhig 'khor/ rdul long long du ldang ba/
rgyab kyi sgal tshigs bcu drug pa long ga dang 'brel ba'i me btsa'i gsang dmigs shig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na long gar grang rlung zhugs nas sbo 'khrog byed pa dang, long skran sogs la phan/
1) len pa'i skul tshig 2) ldang ba'i don du go ba'i lang ba'i skul tshig
longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bsdus ming,

gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa kho nar bzhugs pa, dus 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs pa, sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa, 'khor theg chen 'phags pa sha stag gis bskor ba, de la chos theg chen gyi chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa/

gyi khyad par lnga: sku ston pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang, gsung brjod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa, thugs mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa, 'bad rtsol gyi mngon par 'du byed med pa, sna tshogs su snang yang bden par ma grub pa bcas lnga'o/
1) mig dbang shor ba dang 'dang ba'i don du go ba'i long ba'i 'das pa, 2) (rnying) rgyags pa/
longs su spyad pa'am, bed spyad pa/

1) nor rdzas/ longs spyod che ba/ longs spyod gra rgyas/ longs spyod ngan ngon/ 2) bed spyod/ dka' las gzhan pas brgyab nas longs spyod rang gis byas pa/ bag med longs spyod/ dga' ba'i dpal la longs spyod pa/ 3) nyi zla gza' lnga sogs skar khyim gyi go lar rgyu ba'i dus sam yul khyon/
gsang sngags kyi spyod 'bras thun mong ba zhig ste, rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa longs su spyod pa'i dngos grub thob pa/
bza' btung gi ro la longs su spyod pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo ste, mgrin pa la gnas shing 'khor rtsa phran lnga brgyas bskor ba zhig /

sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bye brag cig ste, chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par gdul bya byang sems 'phags pa kho na la snang ba'i sku gang zhig sprul sku'i 'char gzhir gyur pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa, sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses shig kyang ngo/
longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan bcu gsum

longs skur spras pa'i rgyan gos sna kha bcu gsum ste, dar gyi cod pan dang, stod g.yogs, dar dpyangs, sku rags, smad dkris bcas dar gyi chas gos lnga dang, rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang, snyan rgyan, mgul rgyan, dpung rgyan, do shal lam se mo do, phyag gdub, sor gdub, zhabs gdub bcas rin chen rgyan brgyad do/
(yul) tshad kyi dri tshig gi phrad cig / che lod 'dug / mang lod 'dug / kha par gtong lod mi 'dug len mkhan mi 'dug /
sdug po'am ngan po/ nad gzhi ha cang lod po/ gshis rgyud lod du 'gro ba/ bya spyod lod po/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) son pa'am rnyed pa dang grub pa/ bsam don lag tu lon pa/ lo brgya lon pa'i mi med kyang, bskal pa stong gi gtam rgyud yod/ 2) grangs long ba'am tshang ba/ grangs tshad lon pa/ 3) shes pa'am rtogs pa/ sa rgyus lam rgyus lon pa/ tshod lon pa/ go ba mi lon pa/ rang rgyus rang gis lon pa ni mi'i spyod bzang rtsa chen yin/
(tha mi dad pa) shes pa'am goms pa/ bslabs te lobs pa/ lobs skyen pa/ lto chas 'di kha la ma lobs/ yon tan legs par lobs bzhin 'dug / za gin za gin kha lobs, bzo gin bzo gin lag lobs/

1. las pa'i skul tshig 2. nges par/ tshong pas khe bzang los za/ de ka los drag / rgyun du bgo ba'i gyon pa ngo los shes/ 'di ni rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin, rmi lam yin na snang ba skyo, mngon sum yin na los kyang dga'/
(rnying) dar zab kyi bye brag cig /
/ 1) chags su ma bcags pa'i snam bu spu can zhig / lwa gos/ lwa dkar/ 2) kam pa li/ 3) gos sam gyon pa/ dmag lwa/ char lwa/
sngar rgya gar gyi dbu ma rnam rdzun pa'i slob dpon rgyun du lwa ba'i gos gyon mkhan zhig /

bod yig gsal byed nyer bdun pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas rkan dang, byed pa lce dbus, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba dang, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen dro zhing sgra med pa/ 1. ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2. khrag gi dwangs ma/ g.yag sha/ lug sha/ sku sha/ nyva sha/ sha tshon po/ sha snag / sha rgyags pa/ sha yi phung po che/ sha sbyags pa/ snying rtsa 'dar zhing sha tshan 'phrig pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrag skyes dang, khrag las gyur pa, mam sa, lus zungs gsum pa bcas so,
1) shing sha ka ra ste bu ram shing/ 2) bu ram gyi dwangs ma/ 3) shel ka ra/ 4) chu srin zhig /
na bya ka ra na: (legs) sgra rig gi bstan bcos/
sha ba'i rwa co las bzos pa'i krad kor/
mi'i klad pa sha dang 'dra ba zhig /
srin dang chu ser gnyis 'doms pa'i pags nad sha khra bor 'gyur ba zhig /
pho rog dang skya ka'i sha za 'dod kyi skad/
1) skam thag bcad pa'i sha/ 2) lus kyi sha rid po/ sha skam pags skam/
1) lus kyi sha stobs zhan po/ 2) bza' chas kyi sha spus sdug pa/
spang ri dang shing nags nyung sar gnas pa'i ri dwags sha ba spu mdog skya shas che ba, de'i khrag rwa gong che/
lus kyi sha dang shun pa'am skyi mo/
lus kyi sha zhan pa'am skam po/
1) khog pa'i skran nad/ 2) lus kyi pags par chags pa'i sha skran/
rwa cos bzos pa'i me mda'i rna rdzas blug byed cig /
1) bu ram shing/ 2) bu ram gyi dwangs ma/
1) sha 'jog sa'i khang pa/ sha khang mun pa nag kyang, sha la sha grangs brgyab yod/ 2) sha 'tshong sa/
gang nas byung ba de de rang du gtong dgos pa'i dpe/ rgyal khab kyis 'gro song gtong rgyur gnang ba de dag sha khu sha thim du gtong dgos pa las, gang byung 'thor gyar du gyur na mi 'grig /
gdong gi pags steng la chags pa'i skyi mdog nag khra/
nor phyugs kyi sha nang khrol dang pags pa med pa'i sgrom che chung/ gzugs gzhi tshang ba'i sha khog gcig nyos yod/ sha khog gar song med par, tig gzhog la rtsod pa/
rngon pas ri dwags gsod byed kyi khyi/ jo lags sku thang mnyel rogs dang, sha khyi lag pa tsha rogs red/
sha dang khrag / sha khrag gi phung po/ sha khrag gi 'brel ba/ sha khrag rgyas pa/ sha khrag gcig pa/
1) gri gung btsan po'i bu rgan pa sa skal du kong po thob pa de'o/ 2) sha rigs 'jog sa'i stegs khri/
sngar char pa mi 'bab pa'i dus dang sa ga zla ba'i nang bshas btang mi chog pa'i bkag rgya/
lus kyi pags steng du chags pa'i sha ro/
gzhan srog bcad pa'i snying nad dam 'khon 'dzin/
sha la sbyor ba'i nang gos/
1) sha gtub byed kyi gri/ 2) ko ba'i sha gcod byed kyi gri/
1) stod gos phu med/ 2) (rnying) phu thung/
sha btsos pa 'don byed lcags kyu yu ba can zhig /
stobs shugs nyams pa'am lus thang chad pa/
1) lus sha tshan che ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la stobs bcas dang, stobs ldan, 'tshag ldan, bzod ldan, yan lag rgyas, lus sbom, sha rgyas bcas so, 2) tshil shas che ba'i sha/
lus stobs rgyas pa ste rgyags pa/
don tshan khag gnyis thag mnyam du chod pa'i dpe/
1) rnga mong gi sgal par yod pa'i sha 'bur nyag ka can/ 2) (yul) rnga mong rgyab kyi sha lcog /
ri la skyes pa'i sgog pa zhig ste bod zla dang por gangs ri'i thog tu skye zhing, zla gsum par rul 'gro ba, bro ba zhim pa zhig /
1) sha blug snod ko ba'i sgro ba/ 2) ri dwags sha ba'i pags pas bzos pa'i snod/
sha bongs/ sha rngams che ba/
glang po che'i sha, mi sha, rta sha, khyi sha, ba glang ngam rma bya'i sha bcas/
1) a ma gcig pa'i spun mched/ 2) (rnying) blo gcig pa/
mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis lus kyi sha lpags gcu ril rgyag pa/
rta glang g.yag lug sogs kyi rlig 'bras 'breg pa/
ri mo'i gzugs la bcad ris rgyag pa/
rnga mong dang ba glang sogs kyi sgal pa'i sgang la yod pa'i sha rdog gam nog /
(rnying) 1) blo la yod pa'am blo la chags pa/ 2) mthug pa'am brling ba/
sha dang chang ste, bza' rgyags longs spyod kyi spyi ming la'ang/
srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan mi'i sha'i gab ming zhig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas gnyan nad dang, rlung nad 'joms, 'dril ba'i skran bshig mig la phan/
spang ri dang nags ri sogs la skyes pa'i sha mong zhan gras/
1) sha btso sreg ma byas pa'i rlon pa/ sha rjen za ba/ 2) gos med pa'i sha gcer bu/
1) lus kyi sha bri ba/ 2) lus kyi sha'i bzo dbyibs/ sha nyams rgyas pa/
chag nyil/ mi rta brgya tsho mang po sha nyog rus nyog tu btang/
grum bu rigs drug gi nang tshan sha la babs shing bad mkhris shas che ba'i grum nad cig ste, nad rtags su sha sbos la yan lag sbrid pa sogs 'byung ba zhig /
(legs) lto chas blug snod zhabs ring zhig /
pags steng gi sme ba'am smug thig /
'ba' zhig gam kho na/ ri mo sha stag / chu sha stag / skyid pa sha stag la mi tshe mi 'gro/
rta sga'i sha thag rgyun bu/
ngal thag chod pa'am a thang chad pa/ phyugs rigs la sha thang chad chad bar du bkol spyod ma byed/
dka' ngal che ba dang sha zad pa/ sha thang chad pa/
sha shas che ba btab pa'i thug pa/
sha dang thud kyi bsdus ming/ sha thud kyi zas ri bo ltar spungs pa/

sha bza' rgyu yod thog mar yang bza' rgyu: yod pa ste legs po yin thog slar yang legs po byung ba'i dpe/ da lo zhing las lo legs yin khar 'brog las kyang yag po byung ba ni sha thog mar rtseg rang red/
1) sha rgyags pa/ 2) smyug ma sha 'thug po lta bu/
sha zos nas byung ba'i gyur dug /
ngal rtsol byas drags pas lag par chags pa'i sha mkhregs po/

lus kyi bkrag mdangs te, pags pa phyi nang rim pa bdun du dbye ba'i pags pa phyi ma gnyis kyi bar na rgyu ba'i khams kyi dwangs ma chu ser gyi rang bzhin lus la dkar dmar sogs kyi bkrag mdangs 'byung ba'i rten byed pa zhig /
sha'i kha dog / sha mdog can gyi ras/ mi rigs sha mdog mi 'dra ba/
sha dum bur gtubs pa'i rdog po/ sha rdog sgang la mar rdog gos chen sgang la phar phyin/
1) lus kyi sha rgyags pa lhug lhug / 2) sha snag rdog rdog /

ri dwags sha ba khyis ded pa'i sdug bsngal: dang sha khyi'ang dka' ltogs kyis sdug bsngal ba ste, phan tshun gnyis kar dka' sdug byung ba'i dpe/ sha sdug khyi sdug rngon pa sdug rdza khra yag dkyil na gsum sdug red/
sha rul 'gro ba dang der zhugs pa'i 'bu yang 'chi 'gro ba ste, brten pa dang rten mkhan gnyis sdug gam, sdug gi steng du sdug byung ba'i dpe/
1) nags chen la gnas pa'i sha ba nag po zhig de'i khrag rwa thung zhing gong chung/ 2) sha tshil nang gi sha smug /
(legs) so ma'i gos can te, sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi ya gyal dgra bcom pa zhig /
«shankam» so ma ra dza las bzos pa'i ras/
sgal tshigs kyi 'og la yod pa'i sha zhig /
mi'i lus la yod pa'i sha'i gnad kyi gtso bo/
rgyus pa dang tshil dang rus pa sogs med pa'i sha 'bol po/
/ 1) shing sha pa ste a ka ru/ 2) dgra sha len mkhan/ 3) shan pa/
/ ri dwags sha ba pho, shwa ba pho'ang snang/
ru rta'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
rdza mkhan gyis rdza gsar par 'jam sha 'don byed sha ba'i pags pa lhe pa zhig /
ri dwags sha ba'i phru gu/
shwa ba'ang snang, ri dwags rtswa gzan skyugs ldad pa zhig / sha ba gsod pa'i mi dang, sha mjug non pa'i khyi/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas srin bu gsod, zla mtshan gcod/
rngon pas sha ba 'dzin pa'i yo byad cig /

srog chags kyi sman gyi nang tshan sha ba'i khrag rwa ste, ro mngar la lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas byang khog gi rnag khrag dang chu ser skem, rlung 'joms, mkhal ma'i drod nyams pa dang, khu ba zad pa sogs la phan/
'cham chas sam lha mo ba'i chas kyi gras shig
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas srin thor dang, pags nad za 'phrug sogs la phan/
srog chags kyi sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro lan tshwa, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rnag khrag chu ser dang, khyad par dmu chu skem/
1) sa thog la chags pa'i sa zhag sngon po/ 2) sa dreg ste sa gzhi ba tshwa can la chags pa'i dkar sha lta bu/
gzugs po/ sha bem skrangs pa/
dwangs ma dang gtso bo/ dgra sha bo/
rdog khres khur nas dka' las byung skabs gsig tsam byas pas ngal sangs pa/
gzugs po'i sha phyi la 'bur ba/
1) a 'bras dang 'dra, 2) sha dang 'bras btsos nas bsres pa'i zas/

/ 1) phru gu mngal du gnas pa'i skabs bu'i lte ba dang 'brel nas ma'i kha zas kyi bcud rnams sha ma brgyud bu'i lus la skyel zhing gso bar byed pa dang, lus srung bar byed cing phru gu'i lus la g.yogs par byed pa'i shun pags shig ste, de yang phru gu btsa' ba'i rjes su rim bzhin mngal nas 'byin te phyir dor ba zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la mngal gnas dang, phru ma, bu rogs bcas so, 2) skad snyan po'i bya zhig / 3) lha yi gos/
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su dbye na rigs brgyad mches, ro mngar la lan tshwa, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas sha dug dang rma la phan/
phyi nas g.yogs pa'i shun pa srab mo/
1) ri dwags sha ba mo/ 2) spang dang nags su skye ba'i sha mo sul can dkar ser sogs/ bya ba sna tshogs sha mo'i sul bzhin mang/ 3) lug gi tshang ra/
ma btsos pa'i sha rjen pa/ sha dmar za ba/
1) sha tshil nang gi sha smug / 2) rma shul gyi rmen/ 3) lkog rmen/
sha'i bro ba 'don byed spod sman/
sngar rang gi rigs rgyud gzhan dang bsre slad med pa'i don/
rgo ba'i spu lta bu'i bal/

'gog pa'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dgag bya mi 'dod pa'i bya ba'i dngos po zhig 'gog byed bkra shis dge legs kyi smon tshig brjod pa'i sgo nas rang la 'byung 'gyur gnas tshul ngan pa yong rgyu shugs kyis bstan te 'gog pa'i rgyan zhig /
kyi lce'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
legs pa dang dge ba, bzang ba/ bkra shis pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ shis pa can/ shis pa brjod pa/ shis pa'i ltas/ yul khams dge zhing shis pa'i rnam pas khyab/
shu sgras gtong ba'i glu/ rdzi bos shu glu len bzhin lug 'tsho bar 'gro /
so rkan gyi bar nas byung ba'i tshig med brda gtong gi sgra/ shu sgra 'debs bzhin ra lug 'ded/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, skye tshul 'u su dang mtshungs shing, 'bras bu spru 'bru dang 'dra ba zhig mchis, ro tsha la mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas bad kan smug po dang, pho tshad, skom tshad sogs sel/
gnyan nad shu ba'i rang bzhin gyi thor pa zhig /
thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha zhing mngar ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas bcud len, lus stobs skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar po dang, rgyal ba, dza ya, shukla, a pa ra dzi ta bcas so,

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba'i drod skyed, zas 'ju, rims nad srung, gdon 'joms, gag lhog sogs gnyan nad gsod/ ming gi rnam grangs la gang ldan dang, dri ngar ldan pa, nag po khro gnyer, tshigs pa can, yongs su mdud pa can, sam grantha, he ma wa ti, he ru ka bcas so,
shu sgra/ phan tshun shu brda gtong res byed pa/
/ 1) pags pa g.ya' zhing rtsub la mes 'tshig pa ltar gyi thor pa byung nas rim bzhin rma ru 'gyur ba'i pags nad cig / 2) rma rnying pa'i skogs/ 3) za phrug can gyi rma chung/
mdze rigs shig sha ro shu ba dang 'dra zhing ser ga mang du 'byung ba'i bad mkhris ldan pa'i mdze nad cig
(yul) khang rnying gi thog rnying pa bshus nas gsar pa 'bubs pa/
shu ba dang, 'bras nad gnyis 'doms pa'i pags nad dam rma ngan zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo ba'i rnag khrag skem, 'khru ba gcod/
shing shug pa mer bsregs pa'i dud pa/

1.(tha dad pa) bshugs pa, bshug pa, shugs,, nang khul phan tshun khe bzang mi za bar rang yod dngos po 'tshong ba/ rang la mang po med kyang gzhan la bshugs/ khyod kyi dkar yol 'di nga la nang bshug gnang rogs/ lcags sgam 'di nga la 'don bshug gnang rogs/ khang pa spo bshug byed pa/ 2.bsangs shing gi rigs shig / lha shug / rgya shug / 'bri shug / g.yag shug / ming gi rnam grangs la brgya byin rkang 'thung dang, bdug spos shing, mda' 'dzin, 'od zer 'dab can, yongs bzang can bcas so,

shing sman gyi rigs shug pa tsher ma yod pa can te, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mkhal mar tsha ba zhugs pa dang, chu ser dang lhog pa sogs la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya shug pa dang, spa ma, ba da ra, 'brog rtsi sngon po, g.yu 'brug ze ba bcas so,
gos dar gyi rigs ling srab mo/ shug gtsang sngon po'i ska rags/
shug pas bzos pa'i phur pa chung ngu/
shug pa'i lo ma dbyibs ril po can/
shug pa'i lo ma leb dbyibs can/
(yul) gzhan gyis mi tshor ba/ kho shug shug tu phyin song/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chu shur rdzong khongs kyi dgon sde zhig /
gyer sgom tshul khrims seng ges snye phur shug gseb dgon pa btab ste, de las brgyud pa'i phag gru'i bka' brgyud chung brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /

1.shug pa'i skul tshig 2. 1) nus pa dang stobs/ nus shugs/ chu shugs/ rlung shugs/ rlabs shugs/ btsan shugs/ ngar shugs/ rtsal shugs 'gran pa/ shugs sbyong ba/ shugs brgyab pa/ shugs 'don pa/ shugs 'byin pa/ shugs snon pa/ shugs sgril mnyam sgrub/ 2) ngang ngam rang bzhin/ rang shugs kyis grub pa/ dngos shugs gang rung/ shugs bstan/ shugs rtogs/ go rgyu'i gsang gtam shugs la 'phen pa/ shugs kyis go thub pa/ sman ma btungs par rang shugs kyis drag pa/ mi rtag pa ma yin pa las log pa ni shugs kyi bsgrub bya'i chos yin no/ shugs kyi zhen pa'i brjod bya/
nus shugs las byung ba'i byed rkyen/ shugs rkyen thebs pa/ shugs rkyen bzang ngan sna tshogs yong ba/
shugs chen po'i skad sgra/ shugs skad brgyab pa/
stobs nyams pa'am stobs zad pa/ lus shugs chad kyang sems shugs mi 'chad/

rang 'dzin gyi blo ngos yul de'i rnam pa ma shar yang yul gzhan gyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas yul de la'ang nges pa 'dren nus pa, dper na, shar phyogs su mthong ba'i bum 'dzin mig shes kyis lho phyogs kyi bum pa shugs la rtogs pa dang, sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag gis sgra rtag stong shugs la rtogs pa lta bu rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos chos gzhan shugs la rtogs pa'o/
don dngos su bstan pa'i zhor nas don gzhan bstan pa, dper na, lhas sbyin tshon pos nyin par zas mi za, zhes pas nyin mor zas mi za ba dngos su bstan nas, mtshan mor zas za ba shugs bstan pa lta bu'o/
shugs chen po/ lus rtsal shugs drag byed mi nyan/ shugs drag dbang btsan/ shugs drag gang gis kyang 'gog tu med pa/
shu sgra dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bton pa'i dbugs ring/ kho rgyugs drags pas thang chad de shugs nar 'byin pa/
nus shugs kyi kha snon/ 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon rgyag pa/ mthun sgril la shugs snon byed pa/
mi gsal bar brda gtong gi skad sgrog pa ste, shu sgra rgyag pa/
stobs shugs dal ba'am nus shugs zhan pa/ rdo rong gi lam du 'gro shugs bul/
dbang med dam, thabs med/ khong khro shugs ma thub kyis za ba/ chang shugs ma thub kyis 'thung dgos byung/
skyo ba'am mya ngan gyi dbugs ring/ thang chad nas shugs ring sgrog pa/ 'gyod sems skyes pas shugs ring nar nar 'byin pa/ spyan chab 'don zhing shugs ring nar nar pho brang du log phebs/
smod pa'am lkog kha gtong ba/
1.bshud pa'i da lta ba'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig 2. (yul) 'byil ba'am nyil ba/ ri rtse nas sa rdo shud pa/
1) pags pa rnying pa bud de gsar pa skyes pa/ 2) (mngon) sbrul gyi ming/
pags pa dang skogs pa/ shing gi shun lpags/ 'bru'i phyi shun/ shun pa 'bud pa/ shun pa gog pa/ shun pa bshu ba/ shun gsar/
sgra chung ngur smra ba'i skad/
skad sgra chung ngu/ skad cha shub bur smra ba/ lkog tu shub bus smod pa/
sgra gdangs chung ngur smra ba'i tshul/ gtam shub shub tu smra ba/
dngos po rang rang dang che chung 'tshams pa'i phyi thum/ gri shubs/ sgam shubs/ lag shubs/ shubs skon pa/
'dar ba'i tshul zhig / grang shum byed/ 'dar shum shum byed/ 'jigs shum shum byed/
1.bshur ba'i skul tshig 2.nyag ka'am, khung bu/ sa shur/ nyag shur bton/ khung shur brdol/ bar shur dog po/
sgra sgrog stangs kyi khyad par zhig / rta phos la mo rgal dus sna las shur sgra sgrog pa/ bya khra shur sgra sgrog bzhin 'phur ba/ rlung shur sgra can brgyab byung/
nang du shur sgam yod pa'i cog tse/
ska rags/ sked par shur bu bcings pa/
skud pa khra bo las btags pa'i ska rags thung ngu dra mig can zhig /
shur 'don byed kyi lag cha 'bur len zhig /
ras kyi bye brag cig spu ring po btsugs pa'i ras la dgu lung dgu lta bu/
(rgya) ko bzos pho lham gyi bye brag cig /
chung chung/ bu ga shur shur zhig bton/ rma shur shur zhig bzos 'dug / 'gro lam shur shur zhig 'dug /

/ 1) rjes/ rjes shul/ sngon shul/ rnying shul/ khang shul/ phyin shul/ nyal shul/ bsdad shul/ shul med du btang ba/ chu rgyugs shul dang, gdung ma drud shul/ 'gro ba'i grogs ni grib ma dang, shul du lus rgyu rkang rjes yin/ 2) ring ngam sgang/ mi med pa'i shul la/ gzhan du thon shul la/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs shul la/ khab shul skud pas ma khengs na'ang khab mig stong par ma lus tsam/ 3) tshab tu'am mal du/ bu ngan nas pha shul ma zin, rta ngan nas byang lam ma chod/
khang pa sogs sngar gyi shul rjes rnying ma/
sngar gyi rjes shul stong pa/
shul du lus pa'i dngos po/
1) las ka'i rjes shul 'dzin mkhan/ 2) pha ma sogs shi rjes kyi khyim 'dzin mkhan/
'gro sa'i lam bu/ bgrod bde'i shul lam yud kyis bcad/
gzhan la brda gtong ched kha nas shu rgyag pa/
/ 1) sngar 'brog bdag gis 'brog pa tshor bogs ma lta bur btang ba'i 'bri dang mdzo mo/ nag she/ dkar she/ 2) (rnying) shed/
sngar gnag phyugs she la btang ba'i ru khag /
sngar she la btang ba'i gnag phyugs kyi mar khral/
sngar gnag phyugs she la btang ba'i mar phyur sogs kyi yong 'bab/

sa mthar sbyar rgyu zer na dang don gcig pa'i phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / sa...de don sus shes she na kho bo'i slob dpon no/ 'o na bod kyi snyan ngag 'di bod kyi rig gzhung gi khyab khongs gang 'dra zhig tu gtogs she na, spyir bod kyi rig gnas bcu'i khongs su gtogs pa'o/
mig dkar po'am dkar long/ rta she ba la khyi mi ri, khyi she ba la rta ri/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sbug dam mam srid tham brgyab pa'i sgrub chag 'jags gsum skor gyi gzhung yig spyi'am gtso bo'i gras/
'brog khul gyi dud 'gror 'khri ba'i mar dang phyur ba sogs dkar gyi yong 'bab/
'khrig spyod ma ste, chags pa spyod par dga' ba'i bud med/
dkar chu'i las ka byed mkhan 'brog pa/
sngar she la btang ba'i gnag phyugs kyi mar 'bab/
/ 1) dpal 'byor mnga' thang/ 2) rtsis gzhung gi dus tshigs shig gi ming ste, bya 'ol ba slebs pa'i dus/ 3) shed mo dang 'dra,

nyi skar nyer lnga dang chu tshod nyer gnyis spyi zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis skor nas she mo zhag bdun brtsi, de'i ring la kha char babs na dgung than yong bar bshad, she pho she mo zhes pa rtsangs pas sdig pa za ba'i dus yin zhes dang, yang 'ol ba pho mo slebs pa'i dus skabs red ces bshad srol yod/
stobs shed kyis gzhan la snyad 'tshol ba/
sngar bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dus she la btang ba'i gnag phyugs kyi rigs/
she la blangs pa'i phyugs zog gnyer nas sdod mkhan dud tshang/

/ 1) stobs shugs/ stobs shed/ khur shed/ za shed/ btsan shed/ dbang shed/ shed sbyong ba/ shed rgyag pa/ shed mi 'byin pa/ shed sdeb/ shed shor ba/ shed tshad pa/ dpung shed ngom 'khyer/ shed ngoms nas rtags mtshan thon pa dgos, de min na stong gtam 'chal bshad red/ 2) phyugs zog gi shed mo'am sha shed/ shed sos pa/ sha shed len pa/ sha shed zhan pa/ shed sbyag pa/ rta nor sha shed rgyas pa/ gzan chag yag po ster bas sha shed myur du sos pa/ rta la ci dgos shed dgos, bu la ci dgos dpa' dgos/ 3) (rnying) yid/
1) nus stobs dar du 'jug pa/ 2) shugs rtsal 'don pa/
1) sems can/ 2) shugs can/ 3) (rnying) nan tan/
cha shas shed ma mnyam na snyoms par byed pa/ cha shas shed snyoms bya ba'i phyir cha shas ri ros bsgyur te ri mkha' ri thob/
1) grogs po/ 2) sku zhabs lta bu'i zhe tshig / 3) shugs mthun pa/
1) gang zag ste mi/ 2) mi bdag ste rgyal po/
/ 1) «manaba:» «manu» mi'i gang zag spyi dang, gtso bo bskal pa dang po'i mi'i ming/ 2) (mngon) ma nu'i ming gi rnam grangs yin pas grangs bcu bzhi mtshon/ ma nu...
1) rgya gar gyi gna' bo'i rigs rgyud cig / 2) sngar rgya gar du chu srin mgo bco brgyad pa zhig byung ba'i skye ba snga ma'i dge slong zhig /
(rnying) blo byang bar som mam brda don byang bar som/
lus sems kyi stobs skye bzhin pa/ byis pa rnams rim bzhin tha snyad blang dor shes pa'i shed 'bye yong ba/ lus sems kyi shed ma 'bye ba/
/ 1) lus shugs/ 2) sha shed/ shed mo yag po/ shed mo rgyas pa/ shed mo shor ba/ 3) dbang thang/
(rnying) 1) snyigs ma/ 2) nyam chung ba'am mthu chung ba/ 3) chud za ba/
1) srog gcod mkhan shan pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig 2) (rnying) myur ba/
ri dwags sha ba'i phru gu/
sa mthar sbyar rgyu zer ro dang don gcig pa'i tshig mtshams ston byed phrad gzhan dbang can zhig / sa...kho rang gis rig gnas sna tshogs shes she'o/
1.sher ba'i skul tshig 2.shes rab kyi bsdus tshig / shes rab...sher snying ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i snying po/
shes rab snying po'i mdo chog bden bdar dang 'brel bar phyi nang gi bdud bgegs bar chad phyir zlog gi cho ga zhig /
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsdus ming/
sher phyin gyi sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rnams dngos po brgyad du bstan pa ste, mkhyen pa gsum dang, sbyor ba bzhi dang, chos kyi sku ste brgyad do/
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/
sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi brjod bya rnams don bdun cu'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa ste, mkhyen pa gsum gyi chos sum cu dang, sbyor ba bzhi'i chos so drug chos kyi sku'i chos bzhi bcas bdun cu'o/
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/

(tha dad pa) bsher ba, bsher ba, sher,, 1) bden rdzun lab res byed pa/ bden rdzun bsher ba/ gtugs bsher/ rtsod bsher/ 2) zhib 'jug byed pa/ zhib bsher byed pa/ 'dri bsher/ lus bsher/ sngog bsher/ gtam bsher/ 3) phan tshun sdur ba/
shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi bsdus ming,
dus rabs bco lnga par stod shes rab bzang pos mnga' ris phyogs su rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs spel, smad shes rab bzang pos mdo khams phyogs su rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs spel/
«pphatikam:» rang byung dang, bcos ma'i shel rigs/ me shel/ chu shel/ rdo shel/ mig shel/ ngo shel/ che shel/ rgyang shel/
shel 'dra ba'i mngar cha ka ra dkar po/
1) lho shel dkar zer ba'i yul, deng skabs ding ri rdzong khongs su yod/ 2) lung nag shel dkar zer ba gtsang shab kyi nub 'gram du yod/
shel sgo yod pa'i khra ma/
ga bur rigs gsum gyi nang tshan shing bhi ma zhes pa las byung bar grags pa'i ga bur mdog dkar sngo 'khyag pa'i dum bu 'dra ba shin tu bsil ba zhig /

bdud nad gzhom pa'i gnyen po rtsi sman gyi nus pa rkyang bshad gsal ston dri med shel gong dang, bdud rtsi sman gyi rnam dbye nus ming rgyas par bshad pa dri med shel phreng dang gnyis te, de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang mdzad, shel gong nang sman sna dgu brgya dang bco lnga yi nus pa rkyang sel bshad de rtsa ba lta bu tshigs bcad du mdzad pa dang, shel phreng nang sman de dag gi nang gses dbye ba nyis stong nyis brgya go bzhi'i ngo bo, nus pa, ming gi rnam grangs bcas rgyas par tshig lhug tu 'grel ba'i sman gzhung tshad ma zhig /

bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi zlos gar zhig yin zhing, mi gnyis kyis 'brong lpags gyon, rnga dang 'khar rnga'i sgra dang bstun nas 'khrab pa zhig ste chu shur rdzong khongs shel grong zhes pa'i yul mi tshos 'khrab pa'i 'brong rtsed cig /
, 1) shel spyi/ 2) gdong dbyibs lta sa'i shel chas/
1) thang ma sgron shing gi thang chu ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rus chag gso, rma yi chu ser skem/ 2) rin po che zhig / 3) na gi'i ming/
kyi lce'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
kyi lce dkar po dang nag po'i ming gzhan zhig /
1) shel gyi snod spyad dam bi/ 2) shel gyi tham ga /
shel gyi nyer spyad dam yo byad/
shel phreng bya rgod sug pa
de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi shel phreng nang 'khod pa'i bya rgod sug pa/
tshig pa dang ma tshig pa gnyis 'dres pa'i yos/
1) shel gyi rigs su gtogs pa/ 2) (mngon) rdo rje pha lam/
shel grong 'brong rtsed dang don gcig
shing bzo ba'i lag cha shur 'don 'bur len/
(rnying) chos kyi zhar la don du gnyer ba'i 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs/
shes rab bkra zhing gzugs gzhi mdzes pa/
yon tan yod la rgyu yang yod pa/
blo gros sam yon tan gyi tshad,..shes rgya chen po,..shes rgya chung ba/
1) sems kyi rgyun/ 2) sems kyi gshis ka'am rgyu dag /
, yon tan gyi rgya tshad/ shes sgo yangs pa/ shes sgo zhan pa/
shes bya'i sgrib pa ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par gegs byed pa'i 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa/
: bden 'dzin chen po'i che 'bring chung gsum, 'bring po'i che 'bring chung gsum, chung ngu'i che 'bring chung gsum/
log pa'am yang dag ma yin pa'i shes rab/

tha snyad 'jug par byed pa'i chos gsum ste 'di ka ba yin no snyam pa'i shes pa ni btags pa'i shes pa dang, ka ba zhes pa'i sgrar brjod pa ni brjod pa dang, ka ba yin pas khang khyim byed par rtsom pa ni 'jug pa yin pa lta bu'o/
ha go ba'am don rtogs pa/
shes dang shes bya'i bdag nyid mchog
1) blo ldan nam mkhas pa/ 2) (mngon) 1,mi/ 2,sems can spyi/
blo gros can gyi bud med/

1.(tha mi dad pa) go ba'am rtogs pa dang, khong du chud pa/ chog shes pa/ legs nyes shes pa/ mngon par shes pa/ 'gro sdod mi shes pa/ gang shes de bshad/ kun shes gcig rdut/ mi shes dgu shes/ mi shes shes mdog byed pa/ shes bzhin du dri ba/ 2. 1) gsal zhing rig pa'am blo/ shes pa yongs su smin pa/ shes pa gsal ba/ dbang shes/ dpyad shes/ rtog shes/ mig gi rnam par shes pa/ yid shes/ shes pa rang bzhin du mi gnas pa/ shes pa kha nas ma lab na, blo gros khog pa'i nang du rul/ 2) grangs can pa'i lus kyi shes bya nyer lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
1) bsam blo gtong thub mkhan/ 2) mu stegs pa/ 3) sems can spyi/

sangs rgyas kyi sa'i shes pa bcu ste, chos shes pa dang, rjes su shes pa, sdug bsngal shes pa, kun 'byung shes pa, 'gog pa shes pa, lam shes pa, zad pa shes pa, mi skye ba shes pa, kun rdzob shes pa, pha rol gyi sems shes pa rnams so/
1) dbang shes yid shes/ 2) sems sems byung/ 3) rtog pa rtog med kyi shes pa/ 4) tshad ma tshad min gyi shes pa/ 5) 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi shes pa/ 6) mngon gyur bag la nyal gyi shes pa/
rtog pa dang bral ba'i shes pa ste brgyal ba'i yid shes dang, dbang po lnga'i shes pa lta bu/
sems rnam rtog gi gyeng ba med pa/
shes pa yer re sing nge
(rnying) rig pa dwangs shing gsal sing nge/
sems stobs sam shes rab kyi stobs/

mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses gzhi don dam la ltos te stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis srid mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/

blo'i yul du bya rung ba ste, ka ba dang bum pa la sogs pa'i chos gang dang gang yin kyang, sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi blo spyi'i yul du bya rung ba'o/ shes bya bye thang chu dang 'dra, gting du brkos na dwangs shing gsal/
shes par bya ba'i gnas thams cad/
shes bya'i rang bzhin nam gnas lugs ngo ma/

gtso bo rtsa ba'i rang bzhin dang, chen po dang, nga rgyal dang, de tsam lnga dang, 'byung ba lnga dang, dbang po bcu gcig dang, bdag shes rig gi skyes bu ste, mu stegs grangs can pa'i shes bya nyer lnga'o/

dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang zur mkhar ba blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa'i shes bya rig pa'i gnas spyi dang, khyad par 'phags yul dang bod du gso ba rig pa dar tshul, rgyud bzhi bka' bstan gyi rnam gzhag thad phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad thabs bcas gsal bar gsungs pa'i chos 'byung zhig /

theg pa'i sgo kun las btus pa gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod bslab pa gsum legs par ston pa'i bstan bcos shes bya kun khyab ces bya ba, gdul zhing snod bcud 'jig rten rgyu bcas dang, 'dul byed ston pa ji ltar byon tshul dang, bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi rnam gzhag dang, mdo sngags rig gnas dar tshul chos 'byung dang, lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom gsum rnam dbye dang, rig gnas theg pa la sogs thos pa dang, bsam pas lhag pa'i shes rab skyed tshul dang, sgom pas lhag pa'i ting 'dzin sgrub tshul dang, nyams su blangs pas sa lam bgrod tshul dang, mthar thug rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu ste, gnas bcu dang skabs bzhi bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan glegs bam gsum yod pa 'di kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing byi lor brtsams pa'o/
thams cad mkhyen pa: (mngon) sangs rgyas kyi mtshan/
ha go ba/ de sngon shes tshor gtan nas ma byung/
1) shes shes pa/ shes bzhin du 'dri ba/ shes bzhin rgyab 'gal/ shes bzhin min pa/ 2) lus sems la yang yang brtag pa/
nye nyon nyi shu'i nang gses nyon mongs pa dang, mtshungs par ldan pa'i shes rab ste, de lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa la mi shes bzhin du 'jug pa/

sde tshan bcu: ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, bcu tshan dang po shes bzhin gyi sde tshan la rdzun smra ba'i ltung byed dang, skyon brjod pa'i ltung byed, phra ma byed pa'i ltung byed, skyon sngogs byed pa'i ltung byed, bud med la chos ston pa'i ltung byed, bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig 'don pa'i ltung byed, gnas ngan len brjod pa'i ltung byed, mi chos bla ma bden par smra ba'i ltung byed, bshes ngor 'phyas pa'i ltung byed, bslab gzhi, khyad gsod kyi ltung byed de bcu'o/
yon tan/ shes yon ci yod/ shes yon yang dag pa de lag len thog nas 'thob/
rig gnas kyi chu tshad mtho tsam dang bsam pa'i ngal rtsol byed mkhan gyi mi rnams/

«pradznya:» yul nges lnga'i nang gses, rang yul gyi brtag bya'i dngos po la dmigs nas de'i ngo bo dang khyad par dang rang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang blang dor legs par 'byed pa'i shes pa rab kyi mthar son pa the tshom zlog pa'i byed las can no/ dge skyon dang yin min sogs dbye 'byed thub pa'i shes rab/ shes rab myur ba/ shes rab rno ba/ shes rab zab pa/ shes rab dwangs gsal can/ shes rab rdzogs rgyu med pa/ shes rab zhan pa/ shes rab go log / shes rab ral gris bcad na rma mi 'byung, mang po'i blo yis dpyad na don mi 'phyug / ming gi rnam grangs la kun tu rig kun tu chub, nyal slong, rnam dpyod, rnam rig byed, spobs pa, blo gros, blo yi byed po, legs rtogs bcas so,
shes 'chal sogs mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang, chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa, 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa, rigs can gsum smin par byed pa ste bzhi/
byang phyogs so bdun gyi stobs lnga'i nang gses shig ste, shes 'chal sogs kyis rdzi ba med pa'i shes rab/
shes rab kyi mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig shes rab kyi phar phyin rim ldan du sgom pa'o/
'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi nang gses, chos rab rnam 'byed kyi rig pa ste, rang gzhan gyi re ba skong bas nor bu rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'o/
'dus byas ma byas kyi chos thams cad la cir yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/

rdo rje gcod pa dang don gcig
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma

«pradznyap'aramit'a» chos bzhi ldan gyi chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i ye shes, phyin drug gi ya gyal zhig /
chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma nor bar gsal bar gtan la 'bebs pa/

slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis brtams pa'i bstan bcos shig /

'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa zhig ste, de yang 'jig rten gyi lugs srol bzang po dang yang mthun la dam pa'i chos dang yang mi 'gal bar mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bor mngon mtho sgrub byed kyi thabs ston pa'o/

blo gros dang ldan pa'i mi/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha byang ba dang, go ba can, goms pa can, grags ldan, grags pa can, dge ba can, rgyu mtshan rig nges ldan, nges par shes, mngon par mkhyen pa, bstan bcos rig pa, rnam mkhyen, rnam par thos pa, rnam par shes, blo gtsang, yid gzhungs pa, yongs su rtogs pa, legs par sbyangs pa, shes can, shes ldan, bshes gnyen can, bslabs shes can bcas so,

mi mnga' ba: sems can gyi spyod pa dang, chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dag mkhyen zhing, sems can gyi don ma zad par so so yang dag par rig pa mi zad pa ste, sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
lta ba lnga shes rab kyi rdzas yin kyang, nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis shes 'chal du song bas na de ltar brjod do/
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po, rgya gar gyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang, lo tsa ba rin chen sdes bsgyur cing, lo tswa ba dge blo dang nam mkha' gnyis kyis zhus dag mdzad/
mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos shig ste, gtso bor blon po la gdams pa dang, 'jig rten tshul lugs dang mthun par ston pa'o/

mtshan dngos rdo rje rgyal mtshan, chos rgyal 'gro mgon 'phags pas bdag rkyen gnang nas bal yul du lo tsa slob tu byon, rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga gtso bor sbyangs, khyad par sgra rig la phul du phyin, sa skyar byon te dus 'khor 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i 'gyur mdzad, dpag bsam 'khri shing bsgyur, gzhan yang snyan ngag me long dang, klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang, bstod pa brga pa la sogs pa bsgyur, snyan ngag dang ming gi mngon brjod rnams kyi srol legs par btsugs/

bod yig gsal byed nyer brgyad pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas so dang, byed pa lce rtse, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen dro zhing sgra med pa/ 1.1) ming gzhi'i mo yig cig / 2) rjes 'jug yi ge ga nga ba ma'i rjes su 'jug pa'i yang 'jug / ga nga ba ma...3) rjes 'jug pho yig gi skyes bu tha ma zhig / 4) ming gzhi 'ga' zhig gi yas nas 'dogs rgyu'i yi ge zhig / 2. 1) 'byung ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste ngo bo sra zhing 'thas pa dang, byed las rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten thams cad skye zhing gnas pa'i rten byed pa/ sa 'bol po/ me tog gi sil mas sa bkang ba/ sa brlag gi a bra, sde brlag gi rkun ma/ 2) rten gnas sam gnas gzhi/ sa btsan po/ sdod sa/ 'gro sa/ yod sa/ gros 'dri sa/ mthong sa/ 3) go gnas/ che sa/ mtho sa/ 4) phyugs nad cig / 5) grangs kyi gnas/ zhag sa bcus bsgyur/ zhag sar bsgril/ 6) sa lam gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i sa ste, rang gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i yon tan du ma'i gzhi rten byed pa'i lam zhugs kyi mngon rtogs te, dman pa sa brgyad dang, theg chen sa bcu lta bu'o/
1) dkar rag / gyang ldebs la sa dkar byug pa/ 2) sa rtsi dkar po ste rdo sman zhig /

1) sa cha'i dpe ris/ sa bkra 'debs pa/ sa bkra'i ris bshad/ krung go'i sa bkra/ 'dzam gling gi sa bkra/ 2) sa bzang ngan gyi rtags mtshan/

sa skya bdag chen bzang po dpal
'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gcung po ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras, rab byung lnga pa'i shing 'brug lor sa skya gdan sa'i khrir phebs, chu byi lo la gu shri'i 'ja' sa bzung, chu khyi lor 'das/

rab byung dang po'i dus su 'khon dkon cog rgyal po zhes pas srol gtod, sa chen kun dga' snying po sogs gong ma rnam lngas dar rgyas su btang zhing, gsung ngag lam 'bras chos kyi snying por byed pa'i ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa, de la chos rgyud dang gdung rgyud gnyis yod, rab byung bzhi par sa pan khu dbon hor gyi rgyal po dang mchod yon du 'brel ba la brten nas sa skya pas lo grangs brgya tsam gyi bar du bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur te t'a dben gong ma rgyal po'i lung bzhin bla mas chos kyi bya ba mdzad cing, chos dang mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi bka' gnang, dpon chen rnams kyis srid kyi bya ba mdzad, rab byung drug pa'i nang srid dbang phag mo gru par shor/
nams rgyal mtshan: rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long rtsom pa po, rab byung lnga pa'i chu byi lor 'khrungs, rab byung drug pa'i shing yos lor 'das/

sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan, 'di nyid sa chen gyi sras bzhi pa 'khon dpal chen 'od po'i sras su rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag lor gtsang du sku 'khrungs, rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan las sa skya gong ma'i gsung bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus pa gsan, dgung lo nyer gsum nas bzung kha che pan chen mkhan slob las rig gnas che chung bcu la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas pandi ta'i mtshan snyan thob pa 'di bod ljongs kyi pandi ta dang po de yin, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug lor hor rgyal o go ta'i sras go dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin khong rang dang, sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang phyag na gnyis bcas lyang cu sde bzhi ste deng sang kan su'u zhing chen gyi wu'u we sa char phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal, yon mchod kyi 'brel ba chags, bod du dpon rigs bsko lugs dang, khral 'ul bskul tshul sogs la zhal 'chams te, bod kyi bka' gros la dbang ba'i bla dpon ser skya rnams la yi ge snga phyi lan gnyis btang nas dbus gtsang gi sa phyogs rnams hor rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su bcug sdom gsum rab dbye dang, tshad ma rig gter, mkhas 'jug legs bshad rin po che'i gter sogs mang du brtsams, rang lo bdun cu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag lor 'das/

t'a dben rgyal rabs skabs su chos rgyal 'phags pas ming byang bton pa bzhin se chen rgyal po go be las sa skya dpon chen la son thin si'i 'ja' sa gnang ste dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum la khrims kyi byed por bsko ba'i lam de gtan 'jags su gyur, de'i dpon rabs dang po shak ya bzang po, gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po, gsum pa zhang btsun, bzhi pa phyug po ban dkar ba, lnga pa byang rin, drug pa kun gzhon, bdun pa gzhon dbang, brgyad pa byang rdor, dgu pa ang len, bcu pa legs pa dpal, bcu gcig pa seng ge dpal, bcu gnyis pa 'od zer seng ge , bcu gsum pa kun rin, bcu bzhi pa don yod dpal, bco lnga pa yon btsun, bcu drug pa 'od zer seng ge , bcu bdun pa rgyal ba bzang po, bco brgyad pa dbang phyug dpal, bcu dgu pa bsod nams dpal, nyi shu pa yang rgyal ba bzang po, nyer gcig pa dbang brtson, nyer gnyis pa nam mkha' dam pa bcas kyis rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags sprel lo nas rab byung drug pa'i sa glang bar lo dgu bcu tsam gyi ring dbang sgyur byas mthar srid dbang phag mo gru pa ta'i si tu'i lag tu shor ba red/
sa skya pa'i dam la btags pa'i 'dre mo/
sa skya dmar po rnam gnyis
sa skya 'khon rigs kyi bla dpon lnga las kun dga' rgyal mtshan, 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis rab byung ngur smrig can yin pas dmar po rnam gnyis so/

sa skya'i legs bshad rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba, mkhas pa brtags pa, ya rabs brtags pa, blun po brtags pa, spel ma brtags pa, ngan spyod brtags pa, rang bzhin gyi tshul brtags pa, mi rigs pa'i tshul brtags pa, bya ba brtags pa, chos brtags pa ste ra byed dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos de dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pandi tas mdzad pa'o/

'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos rab byung dang po'i chu glang lor sa skya dgon pa btab ste gdan sa bzung, rab byung gnyis pa'i chu rta lor gshegs, ba ri lo tsa ba rin chen grags kyis gdan tshab mdzad, de nas lcags yos lo nas sa chen kun dga' snying po lo zhe bdun, rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag lo nas bsod nams rtse mo, chu 'brug lo nas grags pa rgyal mtshan, rab byung bzhi pa'i me byi lo nas sa pan kun dga' rgyal mtshan, lcags phag lo nas 'gro mgon 'phags pas gdan sa mdzad kyang rgyal sar byon pa'i shul du gcung po phyag nas sku tshab mdzad, rab byung lnga pa'i sa 'brug nas dhar ma p'a las lo bdun, me phag nas shar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pas lo bco brgyad, shing 'brug nas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyis lo bcu dgu, chu phag nas bar stong lo gsum, shing glang nas mkhas btsun chen pos lo bcu dgu, rab byung drug pa'i shing sbrul nas bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lo gsum, me phag nas t'a dben blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gdan sa mdzad pa'i lo gsum pa la sa skya pa'i srid dbang nyams, lo ngo nyis brgya don drug gi ring la gdan rabs bcu gsum byung zhing, de rjes gdung rgyud rim byon gyis rang gi mnga' ris tsam skyong bar gyur/ 10 73...1102...1111...1111... 1158...115 8-1172...1 172-1216.. .1216-1251/ 1251-1280...1280-1286/ 1287-13 04...1304- 1322...132 3-1325...1 325-1343...1344-1346...1347/ 1349...

rin chen bang mdzod: 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rin po che ji ltar byon pa'i tshul gyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba gong dkar bsod nams grags pas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sbrul lor bsgrigs, sa skya pa 'khon rigs kyi gdung rgyud dang chos srid kyi mnga' thang ji ltar byung tshul dang, yar dar tshul, mar rgud tshul, de skabs kyi 'ja' sa bka' shog springs yig dang bcas pa rgyas par bkod pa'i rnam thar gnad che ba 'di'i dpe rgyun khyab che ba sde dge'i par la shog lhe sum brgya so bzhi yod cing, snar thang par ma dang sa skya pa'i dpe mdzod du bris ma'ang yod par snang/ 1629...
(mngon) 1) gza' mig dmar/ 2) ljon shing/ 3) lha yi glu mkhan/

phyugs la nad de thog mar phog skabs glo bur 'khun sgra sgrog cing, rnga ma g.yug nang du mcher pa la nad phog ste chu tshod kha shas nang 'chi, shi rjes sa nad thar ma'i mis ma gtogs reg rgyu med, bshas tshe khrag la khrag sha chags rgyu med pa'i phyugs kyi 'go nad tshabs chen zhig /

bar thag / las don sgrub yul sa khad rgyang stabs phan tshun ngo thug dka' ba/

chu dang sa 'dres pa'i khu ba/ sa khu byugs pa/
bug pa yod pa'i sa'am, sa phug /
sa gnas so so'i khul/ 'dus sdod sa khul/ mi rigs 'dres sdod sa khul/ gsar brje gnas gzhi'i sa khul/ bkag sdom sa khul/
1) sa cha'i khongs gtogs/ 2) sa khul gyi rgya khyon che chung/

yul gru'i sa chu ri klung sogs chags tshul bkod pa'i ri mo/
kha dog sna tshogs yod pa'i sa cha/
1) lam rgyus ston mkhan/ 2) sa ltas bzang ngan dpyad mkhan/

rgyu skar sa ga 'char ba'i hor zla bzhi pa 'di'i tshes pa bco lnga la sangs rgyas shak ya thub pa sku bltams pa dang, sangs rgyas pa, mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen gsum 'dzoms yin par 'dod la, zla ba 'di'i nang chos spyod kyi bya ba'ang shin tu mang/
1) gro nas sogs kyi thal rdul bsal ba/ 2) sa char gad snyigs byi dor byed pa/
hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga/
bong ba'am sa rdog rdog / sa gong brdungs nas sa zhing bde khod snyoms pa/
1) sa gzhi rtsub po/ sa gyong rko na 'jor rtse rnon po dgos/ 2) rlan med pa'i sa/ chu rka bzos nas chu khrid na, sa gyong yin yang skam mi nus/
grags pa shin tu che ba/ mtshan snyan sa grags gnam grags/
'byung rtsis las 'byung ba'i dgra grogs rtsi tshul gyi ya gyal/
sa cha g.yar skabs sprod len byed pa'i gla cha/

1) hor zla dang po'i dbugs thob nyin sa glang gi kha dog sogs la brten nas lo tog legs nyes sogs brtag thabs ma h'a tsi na'i yul nas byung ba'i rtsis shig rgya nag glang rtsis kyang zer/ 2) lo rgan drug cu'i bye brag sa mo glang gi lo/
1) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho nub rgyud dang yar klungs gtsang po'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de skya skya ru yod/ 2) (mngon) me tog ku mu da/
1) grong khyim sogs la gnod pa byed zer ba'i sa dpyad ngan pa/ 2) 'byung khams dgra grogs kyi nang tshan sa dgra shing/
'byung rtsis las 'byung ba'i dgra grogs rtsi tshul gyi ya gyal/

gnon byed kyi lha khang: bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod chags yul gyi sa dgra srin mo gan rgyal du 'gyel ba lta bu de'i dpung mgo dang dpyi mgo gnon par byed pa la, g.yon ru khra 'brug g.yas ru gtsang 'gram, sbus ru bka' tshal, ru lag grum pa rgyang gi lha khang ste, mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi, de'i gru mo dang pus mo gnon par byed pa la kong po bu chu, lho brag mkho mthing, byams sprin dge rgyas, byang pra dum rtse ste yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi, lag mthil rkang mthil gnon par byed pa la, khams klong thang sgrol ma, spa gro skye chu, tshal rigs shes rab sgrol ma, tshangs pa rlung gnon te, ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi rnams brtsigs par grags/

sa gzhi chen po yom yom du g.yo ba/

ma btul ba'i sa cha/ sa rgod slog pa/ sngon dus bed med sa rgod rnams, deng sang 'bru yi mdzod du gyur/
sa khyon gyi tshad gzhi/ sa rgya che chung/ sa rgya che zhing mi grangs nyung ba/ sa rgya che la thon khungs phun sum tshogs/ sa rgya dpangs gru bzhi/

gnas pa'i sde: mang bkur ba gsum gyi ya gyal zhig
1) sa cha gyong po'am rtsub po/ 2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi go 'jo rdzong khongs su yod/
sa skya pandi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang, rngog legs pa'i shes rab, bu ston rin chen grub gsum gyi mtshan mdor bsdus su bkod pa/
sngags brgyab pa'i sa hril mo'am sngags btab pa'i sa hril mo/

chings lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, gzhung don gyi le'u gong 'og rnam par 'byed pa'i sa bcad/

1) byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu ste, dang po rab tu dga' ba dang, gnyis pa dri ma med pa, gsum pa 'od byed pa, bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba, lnga pa sbyang dka' ba, drug pa mngon du gyur pa, bdun pa ring du song ba, brgyad pa mi g.yo ba, dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros, bcu pa chos kyi sprin rnams so/ 2) a nu yo ga'i thun min gyi bshad srol ltar tshogs lam skabs kyi sa bcu ste dang po 'gyur ba ma nges pa'i sa dang, gnyis pa brten pa gzhi'i sa, gsum pa gal chen sbyong ba'i sa, bzhi pa bslab pa rgyun gyi sa, lnga pa bsod nams rten gyi sa, drug pa brtan pa khyad par du 'gro ba'i sa, bdun pa dmigs 'bras skye ba'i sa, brgyad pa gnas pa mi 'gyur ba'i sa, dgu pa gdal ba chos nyid kyi sa, bcu pa rdzogs pa spyi chibs kyi sa ste bcu'o/

sa zhing dbang ba'i dbang char brten nas thob pa'i yong sgo /

/ bsdus nas son du 'bri, 1) myu gu skye ba'i rgyu/ gro'i sa bon/ rtswa'i sa bon/ shing son/ sa bon gsho 'debs/ son btsugs pa/ sa bon grung po/ son bzang/ sa bon nam dus dpyid la 'debs, ma thebs ston gyi dus na 'gyod/ 2) khu ba'am thig le/ sa bon 'dzag pa/ 3) zin bris sam, 'char gzhi/ snyan zhu'i sa bon/ thug brtag gi sa bon/ sa bon la mchan rgyag pa/
skyes pa'i sa bon bu ma chags kyang phyir ma 'dzags par mngal du 'dril nas skran du gyur pa'i mo nad cig

rtsa ba'i sa bon te ku shu dang li sogs dang, sdong po'i sa bon te lcang ma dang sbyar pa sogs, thog gu'i sa bon te, kham bu sogs, 'gas pa'i sa bon te zho khog sogs, sa bon gyi sa bon te 'bru dang gro sogs/

sa cha rdog rdog de'u lta bu/
1) sa kha 'bye ba/ pha ba dgo dgo skye bar nye skabs sa 'bur 'bur byas nas 'bus pa/ dpyid drod kyi dbang gis sa 'bus pa/ 2) (rnying) 1,sbrang ma'i tshang/ 2,tshwa sgo can/

rab byung lnga pa'i lcags stag lor sa 'bri nang 'khrug pas sa skya dpon chen aga ? len gyis se chen rgyal po la 'bri gung gi mgo gnon pa'i dmag gtong dgos tshul zhus nas bod khri skor du ma'i dmag 'bri gung du drangs te 'bri gung mthil gyi lha khang me la bsregs pa sogs 'bri gung gling log tu grags pa de byung/
sa shur khog stong/ chu 'gro sa'i sa sbubs/
1) rdo rtsig sgang la 'grems rgyu'i sa rlon pa/ 2) sa stong slog pa/ sa sbol rgyag pa/

sa chog gi nang gses shig ste, lto 'phye brtags shing brkos te sel phyung nas mtshan nyid can gyi stegs bu byas la, rdzas dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang bla na med pa dag pas sbyang ba rnams so/
(yul) sa nad dang 'gag nad 'dres pa'i phyugs kyi nad tshabs chen zhig /
1) sa rdo 'dres pa/ sa ma rdo yi zhing las rdo hrug sel ba/ 2) mkhregs po min pa'i rdo yi rigs shig / sa ma rdo la ri mo sna tshogs rko ba,

'byung rtsis las 'byung ba'i dgra grogs rtsi tshul zhig
sems byung skabs kyi sa mang ste, sems byung rnams gang dang gang gi rjes su 'gro ba'am 'khor du gtogs pa'i sde tshan/
sems kyi sa mang dang, dge ba'i sa mang, nyon mongs pa'i sa mang, mi dge ba'i sa mang, nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa mang rnams/
sa brkos pa'i shul/ sa sa mal dang, rdo rdo mal du skyel dgos/
sa lam mi bgrod pa/ zha bos bshul thag ring po'i sa mi chod/

gyang sogs lo mang song nas rang bzhin du dul: 'gro ba
'byung khams lnga po re rer pho mo gnyis gnyis su phye ba'i ya gyal zhig /
lo rgan drug cu'i ya gyal zhig /
(mngon) me tog ku mu da, zla ba shar ba dang kha phye zhing, nyi ma shar ba dang kha zum pa'i pad ma chung ba zhig

1) sa sman gyi rigs brag gseng sogs su chags pa'i sa zhag kha rtsi chags pa zhig ste, ro mngar, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas tsha ba las gyur pa'i skrangs pa 'joms, byis pa'i rgyu rtsi srung, dmar bshal gcod/ 2) dbyar dus chu 'khyil shul du chags pa'i 'dam tshi/
1) sa'i 'gag mdo'am sa gnad/ sa dmigs 'ga'i mdo la so khang btsugs/ 2) sa dpyad kyi dmigs/

'byung ba sa'i khams las byung ba'i sman te, nang gses su dbye na sin dhu ra dang, btsag lta bu las snon bya ma dgos pa rang bzhin sman du sbyar chog pa'i rigs shig dang, mu zi dkar ser lta bu bcos pa las kyis gtsang bar bya dgos pa'i rigs shig dang gnyis mchis so/
sa mdog dmar smug dang rgya smug sogs/
sa las bzos pa'i smyu gu ste, sa dkar gyi 'dam bag hril mo bskams te nag pang la yi ge 'bri byed/
lhad med bsres med kyi dpe/
sa dkar sa dmar sogs kyi khu ba/
sa'i mthug tshad/ sa tshan che chung la gzhigs te rmo las rgyag pa/
(yul) than pa/ sad dang sa tshig ma byung bas ston thog bzang po byung ba/
1) sngar gyi khral rgyug rta khal sogs brje mtshams/ 2) 'gro lam dum bur bgos pa'i skyel mtshams/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs phyi khral gyi khongs nas sa tshigs la mi dang ca lag skyel ba'i khral/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sa tshigs la 'khri ba'i khral/
sngar sa rgyus byed mkhan sa tshigs so sos btang ba'i mi hreng/
sa rim gyi bab tshugs/ 'grul lam sa tshugs/
sa nas langs pa'i thal ba dang rlung tshab tshub/ sa tshub phyur re ba/
1) sa cha'i mtha' mtshams/ sa mtshams 'gog srung/ sa mtshams brgal ba/ sa mtshams bya ra byed pa/ sa mtshams dbye 'byed/ sa mtshams 'brel ba/ 2) sa lam gyi thob mtshams/
tshos dang tshos gdan byed rgyu'i sa/
(mngon) 1) dgang gzar shing/ 2) rgyal po/ 3) rgyal rigs/

1) sngar rgyang phud du btang ste khral rten sa cha 'dzin du bcug pa/ sa 'dzin du btang ba/ 2) glu dbyangs nges pa bdun gyi ya gyal zhig / 3) (mngon) 1,rgyal po/ 2,da byid/ 3,nub kyi ri/ 4,me tog cig / 5,ri spyi'i ming/ 6,ri rab kyi mtha' skor du gnya' shing 'dzin dang, gshol mda' 'dzin, seng ldeng can, lta na sdug rta rna, rnam 'dud, mu khyud 'dzin te gser gyi sa 'dzin bdun yod pas grangs bdun mtshon/
1) zlos gar mkhan gyi rnam grangs gcig / 2) mchor sgeg can/ 3) sa gnas gcig gi khral sdud mkhan/ 4) sa gnas pgzhan la rgyang phud btang ba'i mi/

(legs) ma bsregs thal ba ste, sngo sman gyi nang tshan zhing skyes snye ma nag po, ro kha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas drod skyed, zas 'ju, dang ga 'byed/ ming gi rnam grangs la snye nag pa dang, dud dkar snye ma, spos kyi snye ma, ben khong pa, ma bsregs sol ba, me med dud pa bcas so,
1) sa 'jam po zhig / 2) bskal pa thog ma'i skabs kyi zas shig / 3) chu 'khyil shul gyi 'dam tshi/

sa sbol ba'i zhing kha/ sa zhing sger la dbang ba/ sa zhing tha rgod/ sa zhing tha ba skya chags su lus pa/ sa zhing spyi la dbang ba/ sa zhing bogs mar gtong ba/ sa zhing bogs len/ sa zhing dbyar re mos nyal langs byed pa/ sa zhing gshin po/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa zhing dbang ba'i lam lugs bcos bsgyur byed pa'i las 'gul la zer, rang rgyal gyi sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul ni krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og zhing pa mang tshogs skul slong byas nas sa bdag gi sa zhing dang thon skyed rgyu chas gzhung bzhes btang ste sa zhing med pa'am nyung ngu las med pa'i zhing par bgo 'grems byed pa de yin/
1) sa rgyu zhib mo/ 2) sa cha la zhib 'jug byed pa/
sa skya'i bla chen gyi dbu zhwa'i bye brag cig /

sa cha'i rten gzhi/ sa gzhi skam po/ sa gzhi g.yo 'gul/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ sa gzhi chen po'i sa dbyibs tshad len/ sa gzhi'i bang rim/ sa gzhi rdul dag / sa gzhi thams cad lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pa/ blo rgya sa gzhi las che yang, bya ba rdul ltar zhib dgos/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun bzod dang, skrun byed, khur la mi 'jigs, gling ldan, gling 'dzin, rgya chen ma, rgya mtsho'i gos can, bcud ldan, chu skyob, chu gter ska rags can, rten byed, brtan pa, mtha' yas, dog ma, nor gyi blo gros ma, nor ldan, nor 'dzin, gnas, sna tshogs 'gengs, sna tshogs 'dzin, dbyig gi blo gros ma, dbyig 'dzin, 'byung po 'dzin byed, 'byung po'i yum, mi yi 'jig rten, mi g.yo ba, 'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan can, 'dzin ma, zhag ldan ma, 'od srung byin, yangs ldan, yangs ma, yongs ldan ma, ri yi rna ba can, ri'i phur bu, sa steng, gser gyi snying po, gser ldan ma bcas so,
1) thang ga'i smad cha'i spang gi mdog / 2) yul lung gi kha dog /

sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la zer zhing de'i nyin shak ya mu ne lhums su zhugs pa dang, sangs rgyas pa, mya ngan las 'das pa bcas kyi dus chen gsum 'dzoms yin/

sa chog gi nang gses shig ste, sa'i thog tu dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa byas te dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas lha la snyan gsan 'bul ba dang, slob mas gsol ba btab ste slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor 'degs pa dang, bdud 'dul ba'i phyir bgegs la bka' bsgo zhing rdo rje'i gar dang stangs stabs kyis bgegs bskrad pa rnams so/
1) sa cha yag po/ 2) rgyal rigs/ 3) lo tsa ba ma ti pan chen sdod sa'i yul/
sa g.yo drug gi ya gyal zhig /
1) sa gzhi'i 'og / sa 'og la gter kha phun sum tshogs pa yod/ 2) sa gsum ste klu'i 'jig rten/
thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gses, sa 'og gi gter ram bum pa bzang po bton nas sems can rnams la ci 'dod ster nus pa/
lkog g.yo ngan gshom mam dran 'phrul/ mi ngan dpung bsdebs kyis sa 'og dar 'thag byed pa/
sa 'og gi 'dam rdzab sa steng du thon pa ste lkog tu yod pa'i skyon mngon gsal du thon pa'i dpe/
sa 'og la sbas pa'i me rdzas 'bar ba'i mde'u/
sa lha brtan ma, bla mgon, stong gsum rgyal ba, sa srin dmar po, rje khra bo, 'gog chen drug 'bum, snang sel mched drug be snabs rgyal ba, khril khri 'bum gyi gnas rnams yin zhes zer/
'bum bcu tham pa/ sa ya'i zur gcig /
1) (mngon) 1,gser/ 2,rdo rje gdan/ 2) byang chub sems dpa' zhig /

1) rgyal po dang blon po/ 2) mgo zla ba ste hor zla bcu gcig pa/
1) bram ze/ 2) sa la gnas pa'i mi min/
sa la gnas pa'i lha mo zhig ste bstan ma/
sa cha dang yul lung zer ba'i bsdus tshig / sa yul mtshams med/
sa 'gul gyis sa gzhi g.yo tshul/
1) sa bcud/ 2) sa cha gang zhig la yod pa'i bsod nams/ sa g.yang 'gugs pa/ sa g.yang shor ba/ sa g.yang 'phel ba/
1) sa gzhi'i nang rim gyi 'byung khams 'khrug pa'i rkyen gyis 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ sa g.yo ri 'gul/ 2) sa g.yo drug gi ya gyal zhig /

'gul dang, rab tu 'gul, kun tu rab tu 'gul, g.yo ba, rab tu g.yo, kun tu rab tu g.yo, ldeg rab tu ldeg kun tu rab tu ldeg 'khrug rab tu 'khrug kun tu rab tu 'khrug 'ur 'ur, rab tu 'ur 'ur, kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur, chem chem, rab tu chem chem, kun tu rab tu chem chem ste sa g.yo ba'i rnam pa bco brgyad/

1) 'gul dang, g.yo, ldeg 'khrug 'ur 'ur, chem chem ste sa g.yo ba'i rnam pa drug / 2) shar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho ba dang, nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho ba, lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho ba, byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho ba, mtha' dma' na dbus mtho ba, dbus dma' na mtha' mtho ba ste sa g.yo ba'i rnam pa drug /
sangs rgyas pa'i bshad srol ltar na shak ya thub pa lhums su zhugs pa dang, sku bltams pa, rab tu 'byung ba, 'tshang rgya ba, chos 'khor skor ba, mya ngan las 'da' ba ste drug /
(legs) rgya mtsho'i skad dod/ mkhas dbang sa ra'i bzhed pa/ , (legs) 1) rlung/ 2) khra bo// 3) rgya mtsho/

sa gzhi cha mi snyoms pa'i sgang gshong can/
zhing sa ha cang gshin po'am yag po/
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la rlung gi dbang phyug dang, rlung gi lha mo, swa sti bcas so,
1) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs drung 'khor gyis gzhung sa'i zhi drag zhabs 'degs sgrub rten pha gzhis kyi sa cha/ 2) zhing las bya yul/ sa rigs 'debs 'khos/
sa tshugs rim pa khag / sa rim khang/ sa rim skyel gyi khral/ yi ge 'di rnams sa rim brgyud nas 'phral 'phral skyel ba/
1) rtsis gzhong gi sa thal la bris pa'i ang ki dang yi ge/ 2) sa la bris pa'i ri mo/ 3) sa bkra/ 4) sa cha/ sa ris bdag thob/

1) rje rigs te 'byor ldan gyi ming/ 2) sa la reg pa/

mi mkho ba'i sa dang gad snyigs/ sa ro rdo ro gtsang mar bsal ba/
khang rnying bshig shul sogs su yod pa'i sa rdo phan med rigs/
'gro lam mi bde ba'i sa rtsub/ sa thag ring zhing sa rong shin tu rtsub/
sa la drod dang brlan gsher 'dzoms pa'i rlangs pa/
sa gzhi sdom byed 'khyag mdangs cung zad slebs pa/
1) (mngon) rtswa ku sha/ 2) sa thob pa/
brgya byin gyi bzhon pa glang chen/
1) sa cha dang 'gro lam/ 2) mdo rgyud kyi sa lam ste, sa bcu dang lam lnga'i bsdus ming/
spos dkar shing ste de'i thang chu ni spos dkar ro/ , spos dkar gyi shing sdong/
sa dang rdo 'dag pa sogs kyi las ka/
sa rdo'i las ka'am, ar po'i las ka/
(legs) zas rgyu 'bras mchog / sa lu ljang pa/ sa lu'i zhing/ nang par sa lu skam po las, myu gu sngon po skye gyur cig / , shing 'bras tsha lu ma/
