'phags pa sa lu'i ljang pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, sho lo ka nyis brgya nyer drug pa 'gyur byang med pa'o/
'khon dkon cog rgyal po dang, sa skya gong ma rnam lnga sogs nas brgyud pa'i man ngag la zer/
po tho dang 'dam sogs las byung ba'i lud/

gser dang zangs kyi spus tshad dag pa/ gser sa le sbram/ zangs sa le sbram/ sa le sbram ni bsregs bcad kyang, de yi kha dog nyams mi 'gyur/ rin thang bral ba'i rin po che sa le sbram gyi dngos por lta ba/
stong gsal rjen par 'char tshul/ rig pa'i gshis lugs sa le hrig ge bar gnas pa/
sa las dang shing las kyi las grwa,
dgos med kyi gtam gang byung du bshad pa'i dpe/
'bu ta la, mdog skya bo, rkang lag mang ba, khang pa'i nang la yod pa zhig /
1) sa rub mtshams kyi dus ming/ 2) sa rub pa/
1) sa mtshams srung mkhan/ 2) (mngon) 1,sa skyong ste rgyal po/ 2,rgya mtsho/
brgya byin bzhon pa glang chen/
mi ngan gyis glags 'tshol ba'i dpe/
sa rub rjes nam phyed ma zin gong gi dus tshod/
dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal zhig ste khyi dus/
1) sa rko ba/ 2) (mngon) phag pa'am phag rgod/
1) sa bla dang, sa steng, sa 'og ste gsum/ 2) sa dang po dang, gnyis pa, gsum pa ste gsum/

sa chog gi nang gses shig ste, rdo rje phur bu bskyed la bka' bsgo mi nyan par ged byed pa'i bgegs rnams bkug ste de dag la phur bus gdab pa dang phyis bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir srung 'khor bsgoms te byin gyis brlabs pa rnams so/
sa chog gi nang gses shig ste, sa de mngon pa yul grong gi bdag po rgyal po la sod pa dang mi mngon pa zhing skyong ngam sa'i lha la bslang bar bya ba'o/

(legs) lhan cig byed pa ste, a mra sdong po la 'o ma'i chu drangs nas skyed bsrings pa las byung ba'i a mra'i 'bras bu dri zhim la khyad par du 'phags pa zhig / g.yang sa mthon por skyes pa yi, sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu bzhin, rang gzhan gang la'ang mi phan pa'i, longs spyod che de lba ba yin/
(legs) rgya gar shar phyogs bhangga la'i yul te za hor dang mtshungs shing, deng sang gi meng ca la/
sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi'i khams kyis skyed pa'i lhog rigs bzhi'i nang tshan sa yi khams kyis skyed pa'i lhog pa zhig ste, nad rtags su skrangs pa sra zhing mkhregs par 'byung ba zhig /
spos dkar gyi ljon shing ste sa la'i ljon pa dang don gcig
(legs) tsha tsha ste dam pa'i sku dang mchod rten gyi gzugs brnyan/ tsha tsha...
/ 1) shar rgyag / sag gis 'gro ba/ khos brda tho khyer nas sag gis 'gro ba/ sag ste 'gro ba/ 2) glo bur/ sag ste phyin pa/ gzhan gyis ma mthong bar sag ste phyin pa/
bse thebs dang mtshungs te zhwa mo'i bye brag cig
seg rdar yang zer, lcags rdar byed kyi lag cha zhig / sag rdar zur gsum ma/
(yul) bod du bzos pa'i ko sngon zhig /
1) drel gyi dpyi mgo'i pags pa mnyes nas ri mo 'bur dod yod pa'i ko ba zhig / 2) lus kyi dreg pa mkhregs po/
(yul) rgyu ma skam po sil ma'i ming/
1) sag sa dang 'dra, 2) ras sogs tshags zhib po med pa/
sag sgra sig sgra zhes sgra'i bye brag / rlung gis shing lo sag sig tu g.yo ba/
pags pa sag ri'i lham gog /
bya ba la blo sgrim po med pa/ las don sgrub skabs snang chung lhod yangs byas na nor 'khrul yong/

/ 1) de ring gi phyi nyin dang, ma 'ongs pa'i dus tshe/ sang zhod/ sang gi gdugs/ sang gi 'tsho tshis/ sang snga po/ sang nas sang du bshol ba/ sang bcar gnangs bcar zer nas 'gor ba/ sang las ma 'gyangs par yong nges yin/ sang 'chi gnangs 'chi/ 2) ras srab mo zhig / sang khebs/
(legs) dge 'dun zhes par la don gyi rnam dbye ster ba/
bar snang ngam, sgo bar sogs nas snang ba dkar po mthong tshul// sgo dang sge khung gi bar seng nas 'od snang dkar po sang nge seng nge mthong/
de ring gi phyi nyin/ sang nyin gyi sha las de ring gi rus pa zhim/
1) sang nyin dang gnangs nyin/ sang gnangs las ma 'gyangs pa/ 2) dus yun ring po ma 'gor ba'i ma 'ongs pa/ sang gnangs las grwa'i mjug sgril zin mtshams/
sang nyin snga mo'am sang nyin zhogs pa/
ras srab po sang zer ba/

mes ag tshom dus su rgya nag nas bod du btang ba'i pho nya zhig gi bu yin la, khri srong lde btsan chung dus su sgrom bu bskur nas sang shi dang mi bzhi rgya'i gtsug lag len du btang, ri bo rtse lnga mjal, rgya rjes chos bam po stong gnang, pho nya'i las grub nas slar bod du mchis pa dang, blon chen gyi thob bstsal, ming yang rgya phrug mdzangs pa por btags, khri srong lde btsan gyis chos spel ba'i skabs zhabs tog mi dman pa zhus so/
bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus kyi btsun pa zhig /
snang ba gsal po/ tho rengs shar phyogs kyi 'od snang sang sang po/
sang nge seng nge'i bsdus tshig

«buddha:» sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa sangs shing, mkhyen gnyis kyi snang ba rgyas pa/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs la kun mkhyen dang, kun tu bzang po, rkang gnyis gtso bo, sku gsum pa, khyab bdag mkha' mnyam pa, mkhyen lnga pa, 'gro ba'i bla ma, rgyal ba, mngon shes drug ldan, bcom ldan 'das, chags 'joms, chags bral, chos kyi rgyal, chos kyi dbang phyug 'jig rten 'dul, gnyis med gsung ba, ston pa, stobs bcu ba, thams cad mkhyen, thams cad sgrol, thams cad rtogs, thams cad gzigs, thub pa'i dbang po, dus gsum mkhyen, de bzhin gshegs pa, dran pa'i dgra, bdag nyid chen po, bdud 'dul, bde gshegs, rnam par 'dren pa, mi mnyam pa, lus med thul, legs gsung bcas so,
sangs rgyas kyi bka' rnam pa gsum
sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsum dang don gcig
bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na gsum ste, zhal nas gsungs pa dang, byin gyis brlabs pa dang, rjes su gnang ba bcas gsum mo/

ma 'dres pa bco brgyad: de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba dang, ca co mi mnga' ba, bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba, mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba, tha dad pa'i 'du she mi mnga' ba, ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba, 'dun pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba, brtson 'grus nyams pa mi mnya' ba, dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba, shes rab nyams pa mi mnga' ba, ting nge 'dzin nyams pa mi mnga' ba, rnam par grol ba nyams pa mi mnga' ba, lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba, ngag gi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba, yid kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba, 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa, ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa, da lta'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa ste bco brgyad/
byad bzang po brgyad cu: dpe byad brgyad cu la ltos,
ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon du phyogs par byang chub pa ste rtogs pa'i ye shes/

de bzhin gshegs pa dang, dgra bcom pa, yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas, rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa, bde bar gshegs pa, 'jig rten mkhyen pa, skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa, lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa, sangs rgyas, bcom ldan 'das te mtshan bcu/

pa bcu gnyis: dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba dang, lhums su zhugs pa dang, sku bltams pa dang, btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang, bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang, khyim nas mngon par byang ba dang, dka' ba spyad pa dang, byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang, bdud sde bcom pa dang, mngon par byang chub pa dang, chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang, mya ngan las 'das pa ste mdzad pa bcu gnyis/
sku'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin, gsung gi sras nyan thos rang rgyal, thugs kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/
ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs shing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pas padma kha bye ba bzhin bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas pa, de ni yon tan gyi phul che la 'jig rten na nyung ba/
gos chen skyin khebs kyi bye brag cig bal po dang rgya gar nas thon/

rgya gar du byung ba'i dbu ma pa'i slob dpon zhig yin zhing, rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa budha pa li mdzad, rtsa shes las bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs su bkral bas, dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i slob dpon chen po'o/

t'a la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs kyi sde srid cig rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug lor bod kyi sde srid byas, t'a la'i bla ma lnga pa 'das kyang gsang rgya bsdams nas rang nyid kyis chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha bzung, phyis bde skyid rgyal pos bka' bkyon gnang bas tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gser khrir gdan 'dren zhus, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya lor bod rgyal lha bzang han gyis bkrongs, sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la'ang ltos/ (1653-1705)... 1679...1682...1705...
phag gru sde srid khri rabs bdun pa 'dis rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi lo nas rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug lo'i bar lo bzhi srid bskyangs/ 1444-1448... 1469...
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, rgyal ba'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can bshams pa'o/
sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa

rjes su dran pa drug gi nang gses, de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'o/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan don dam par ma dmigs shing, kun rdzob tu sangs rgyas la ston pa'i 'du shes rim ldan du dran pa'o/
1) sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob zin pa/ 2) sangs rgyas pa'i ring lud 'dzin mkhan/
bden bzhi khas len pa'i ring lugs te sngar rgya gar la sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' la bye brag smra ba dang, mdo sde pa, sems tsam pa, dbu ma pa bcas mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/
rnam par gzid dang, gtsug tor can, thams cad skyob, 'khor ba 'jig gser thub, 'od srung, shak ya thub pa ste bdun/
sangs rgyas kyis srid pa ji srid du phyogs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams la phan bde sna tshogs pa dag ston par mdzad pa/

gter ston thams cad kyi thog ma sangs rgyas bla ma ni, dus rabs bcu gcig pa rab byung dang por la stod mtsho bar du sku 'khrungs, rtsa gsum dril sgrub dang, rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon sogs gter chos mang du bton, dgung grangs brgyad cu lhag bzhugs te gshegs so/
rang sangs rgyas te rang rgyal/
sems can nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas shig /
sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun dang 'dra,
mkhas pa'i mdun du rang gi yon tan ngom pa/
rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tsam la khri srong lde btsan gyis bod du gdan drangs te, bod la gsang sngags kyi chos spel mdzad/
«buddha:deb:» sngar rgya gar gyi bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon zhig /

(tha mi dad pa) 1) 'dag pa/ chu'i nang la bkrus pas dri ma thams cad sangs pa/ btsog grib sangs pa/ 2) gsal ba/ gnyid las sangs pa/ ngal gso phran bu brgyab na ngal dub tshang ma sangs pa/ nam langs pa dang mun pa sangs pa/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i 'og las sangs pa/ yid kyi rmugs gnyid tshang ma sangs kyis sangs pa/
dwangs po/ nam mkha' sangs po/ lus khams sangs po/ dran pa sangs po/

rtsi shing lo tog rigs la grang ngad phog pas rnyid cing ro bcud dang, 'bras bu mi grung bar 'gyur ba'i 'khyags skyon/ sad skyon/ sad rgyag pa/ sad nyen che/ gro zhib de la sad dri bro ba/ me tog tshang ma sad kyis khyer ba/
nyung ngu'am cha shas/ lto sad de sud de/ byas rjes sad sud tsam/
bya ba gang zhig 'jug ldog gi don ma rtogs pa the tshom du gyur pa'i skabs don de gsal bar shes pa'i phyir sngon du tshod lta byed pa/

khri srong lde btsan gyi sras chung ba ste, deb dmar du sras bzhi pa yin par bshad cing, deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs su mu tig btsan po yin par bshad, gcen po mu ne btsan po 'das dus, blon po rnams kyis dang por btsan po tha chung 'dis rgyal po 'ong mi 'ong nyams sad na legs ces bgros pa dang, mgul yon por byas te bzhugs pa zhig yod pas sad na legs mjing yon zhes mtshan du grags, snga gong yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa phul, shul na bzhugs pa'i lo pan ka ma la shi la sogs la phul du byung ba'i zhabs tog bsnyen bkur byas, slar yang rgya bal nas slob dpon bi ma la mi tra sogs spyan drangs te, sngar ma 'gyur ba'i mdo dang sgra du ma bsgyur, skyi shod du rgyal sde dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs, blon 'bangs rnams la nam yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi gzhig par bro bor ba'i bka' gtsid yang yang bstsal/
1.(tha dad pa) brtag dpyad dang tshod len pa/ nyams sad pa/ btub bam sad cig / 2.(tha mi dad pa) sang ba/ gnyid sad pa/ sngon gyi bag chags sad pa/ go rtogs ma sad pa/ rmi lam sad pa/

chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan skabs mkhan chen bo dhi satwas bod mis rab byung gi bslab sdom srung nus mi nus tshod blta'i phyir du thams cad yod smra'i lugs bzhin thog mar rab tu byung ba'i mi sba gsal snang dang, sba khri bzher, bee ro tsa na, rgyal ba mchog dbyangs, 'khon klu'i dbang po, rma rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub ste bdun, bod kyi chos 'byung gi deb ther khag las sad mi mi bdun gyi ming 'dren stangs mi mthun pa mang/
sad de sud de'i bsdus tshig
lo tog gi dgra sad dang ser ba dang, btsa', than pa'i bsdus tshig /
zla ba dgu pa'i sgang nas 'brug sgra chag pa dang lo tog bzhag kyang sad kyis 'jig pas sad lhung gi dus tshigs zer/
mkhregs min dang mnan mi bzod pa'i 'bol po'am btags ma'i thags rkang mi led pa'i rnam pa/ chu'i lbu ba sab be sob be/ snam bu sab sob/ kha ba'i gong bu sab sob/
/ 1) shing gi lcug ma sbom phra mtheb sor tsam phan tshun bsnol te gyang gi tshul du bskor ba'i ra ba lta bu/ tshal zhing sab mas bskor ba/ .2) smyug gdan nam rtswa gdan/
sba 'gebs/ byas nyes dngos rjen rnams sab sub byed pa/
sab be sob be'i bsdus tshig

1.ming mtha' sa'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / sa...stobs shugs sam lag rtsal/ rlung ngam, mkhris sam, bad kan/ 2.ming mtha' sa'i rjes su sbyor ba'i 'byed sdud kyi sgra'i rkyen zhig / sa...khyed rang sku rkyang phebs nus sam mi nus/ pha mes bu mo ma mjal yun ring song, bu mo snang sa sku khams bde lags sam/
smas kri ta'i 'bri srol gzhan zhig
yi ge 'bri gzhi'i shing byang rtsi ldan zhig / sam ta'i sked chings/
(legs) bod bzang po'am legs pa ste sngar rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tshos thu mi a nu'i bu la 'bod pa'i che ming/
bsam gtan gyi skyon brgyad dang don gcig
sa bon brten pa'i bya ba byed pa/
1) sa gzhi ril mo/ 2) sa gzhi ril mo rgyu sa'i mkha' lam/
'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'am rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa'i nang gses shig /

bdag pos bzung ba'i gzhi la dbang mi za ba'i phyir sa'i cho ga bya ba ste gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i gnas, sa brtag pa, sa bslang ba, sa sbyang ba, sa bzung ba, sa bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa bcas kyi cho ga'o/
1) (mngon) 1,gser/ 2,rdo rje gdan/ 2) byang chub sems dpa' zhig /
lo bcu pa: bam po bcu dang le'u brgyad pa, rgya'i mkhan po hwa shang zab mo la sogs pa dang, lo tsa ba bande rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/
rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten thams cad skye zhing gnas pa'i rten byed pa/
sa'i dbang phyug gi zla ba
mgo zla ba ste hor zla ba bcu gcig pa, rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang, gdan bzhi las de ltar zer/

sa thob pa la rang rang gi ngos skal du gyur pa'i spang bya rnams spong ba dang, bsgrub bya'i chos la 'jug pa dang, sa gong ma'i spyod yul la 'jug par rung ba nyid du sgrub pa'i phyir sa rang skabs kyi yongs su bsgrub pa'i chos so/

sngar bod rgyal bcu pa e sho legs dang, bcu gcig pa de sho legs, bcu gnyis pa thi sho legs, bcu gsum pa gung ru legs, bcu bzhi pa 'brong zher legs, bco lnga pa i sho legs bcas rgyal rabs drug po sbyi'i ming/

dbang gi sta gon las, sa yi lha mo sta gon gyi cho ga ni, dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sa'i lha bskyed nas ye shes pa bstims la, mchod gtor phul zhing gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin nas sa'i ngo bor gnas par bsgom pa'o/
sa gzhi skyong ba'i lha mo bstan ma/
1) sa la nyal ba/ 2) (mngon) ma he'i ming/
sa the 'dzugs pa yang zer, dam bca' byas nas sa gcig tu sdod pa'i don/
1) gsar du slebs pa'i mi/ 2) (rnying) bang chen/
sbub sil g.yer kha sogs kyi skad sgrog stangs shig
1) ngam grog / sang gshong mang po'i sal sul dod pa/ 2) gos sogs kyi sul/
tshig mi gsal bar rkan sbubs nas 'don pa'i sgra zhig / si sgra brgyab ste brda gtong ba/ g.yag pas khal ma 'ded skabs si si'i sgra sgrog pa/
lce dang so'i bar nas 'don pa'i sgra zhig /
si skad kyi glu len pa/
lce dang so'i bar nas 'don pa'i skad sgra zhig /
(rgya) sngar gyi go gnas kyi ming zhig /
si tu chos kyi nyin byed
si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas so/

mtshan gzhan karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba ste, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug lor mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal 'bri zla zal mo'i bar du sku 'khrungs, sku nar son pa dang karma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje dang, zhwa dmar brgyad pa chos kyi don 'grub, de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs, zur mkhar ba'i slob rgyud 'dzin pa ye shes shogs slob dpon du ma bsten nas rgyud sde bzhi dang, sde snod gsum, sgra dang, bzo, gso ba sogs dpyis phyin par sbyangs te bod tsam du ma tshad rgya bal hor sog gi yul du ta'i si tu ma h'a pandi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes mtshan snyan gyis khyab par gyur, bod kyi yul gru kun dang, rgya gar, rgya nag bal yul bcas su phebs nas yul de dag gi mkhas pa rnams dang rig gnas kyi bgro gleng gnang, gsung rtsom yang nang rig pa'i skor dang, gtan tshigs rig pa, sgra rig pa, gso ba rig pa, skar rtsis rig pa sogs dang, khyad par du bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs kyi sku dus su ji bzhin ma 'gyur ba'i rgya rtsis gsar 'gyur dang, 'brum bcos sogs gsar 'gyur sman gyi skor sna tshogs, sgra p'a ni pa dang dbyangs can sgra mdo, mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod bcas gsar du bsgyur ba'am 'gyur bcos mdzad pa sogs mdzad rjes shin tu che/
chos kyi snang ba: si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas so/

'grel chen mu tig phreng mdzes: si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis rang lo sum cu tham pa'i skabs thog mar brtsams, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug lo rang lo sum cu so bdun par slar yang brtsams mgo tshud nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing byi lo rang lo zhe lnga par brtsams tshar, bod kyi sum rtags 'grel ba'i nang nas skad grags che shos kyi gras shig red/

(legs) 1) bod kyi gnas yig rnying pa'i nang nas gsal ba ltar mtsho ma dros pa'i byang phyogs su rdo rje'i brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas chu si t'a zhes bya ba rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren zhing chu bran lnga brgya dang bcas mtsho ma dros pa la g.yas bskor lan bdun byas nas byang gi rgya mtshor 'bab pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khrag 'bab dang, brgyar gyes, rtag tu 'bab, dpung pas byin, dbyig gi dpung pa, lag pa'i chu bo, srid sgrub ma bcas so, 2) (mngon) 1,kha dog dkar po/ 2, me tog ku mud/
(rgya) rgyal nang nas thon pa'i smyug ma spus legs: kyi smyu gu
(yul) lcug mas btags pa'i slel po'am smyug bshags kyis bzos pa'i snod/ si ra bslas pa/
rlung sogs kyi sgra chung ngu/ bug pa nas rlung phra mo grang si ri rir 'ong ba/
(yul) sil li ma yang zer, dgun dus chus khyer te rgyug pa'i 'khyag dum/ dpyid ka shar dus chu klung gi gzhung du si li ma mang po rgyug yong/
sgra grag stangs shig / char zim si li lir 'bab/ khu 'phang si li lir 'bab/ me tog gi char si li lir 'bab/ rin po che'i rgyan gyi sgra si li lir 'khrol ba/
mi nyag si'u rgyal po dang don gcig
(legs) spos sbyor la 'gro ba'i dri zhim gyi shing zhig
/ 1) 'khyags pa dang 'jigs skrag gis lus 'dar stangs shig / skrag ste 'dar sig sig byed pa/ 2) khur po ro stod du yar 'degs tshul/ khres po stod du sig sig byed pa/
tshigs ma'am snyigs ma/ mar khu'i sigs ma/
chang gi khu ba yang yang btsags nas sla po chags pa'i btung stong zer ba de yin/
khams dwangs pa'i snang tshul zhig / sgra sing nge ba/ thugs bag phebs spro sing nge ba/ sdod gnas gtsang sing nge ba/
ha cang gsal po/ chu sing nge ye re bar gzugs brnyan 'char/
chang gi khu ba sla po/
/ 1) la dwags dang thag nye ba'i yul zhig / 2) yul de'i mi/
chang bcud dang po gnyis pa bsings zin pa'i lhag ma ro zhan pa de'i ming/
chang dang a rag zer ba'i bsdus tshig /
dril bu dang g.yer kha sogs kyi sgra'i khyad par zhig /
(legs) ya gling lho rgyud hin rdu rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du yod pa'i gling phran rgyal khab cig /
so'i gseb nas sgra gtong tshul zhig /
1) seng ge'i sgra khyad par sid sgrog / 2) so gseb nas sid kyi glu chung sgrog pa/

(legs) sngar bod kyi gnas yig rnying pa'i nang nas gsal ba ltar mtsho ma dros pa'i lho phyod su gser gyi brag khyung mchog gi kha 'dra ba nas chu bo sindhu zhes bya bas gser gyi bye ma 'dren zhing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas mtsho ma dros pa la lan bdun g.yas skor byas nas lho yi rgya mtshor 'bab pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la sngon gyi gangga, rtse 'jo'i chu bo, zla ba skyes bcas so,
(legs) rgya mtsho'i khrag ste sa sman gyi rigs shig ro mngar, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rtsa tshad sel, mes 'tshigs pa'i rma dang, mtshon rma gso, byang khog nang gi rnag khrag skem/
'brum bu sib sib 'byung ba'i thor rims shig ste, nad rtags su lus kun na zhing tsha ba rgyas pa dang, mig dang lce'i steng du thor pa 'byung ba, mgo dang gre ba tsha ba sogs 'byung ba zhig /
nyung nyung du thim stangs shig / bye ma la char thigs sib sib tu thim pa/

1.(tha mi dad pa) sims pa, sim pa,, thim pa'am nub pa/ sman lus la sims te bde bar gnyid yur/ bye ma la chu sim/ zhing la chu sim/ 2.bde ba'am skyid pa/ 'du 'dzi med pas kha khu sim po 'dug / tshor ba sim pa/ sim pa ster ba/ kha khu sim po/
bde ba'am skyid pa'i don du go ba'i sim pa dang 'dra,
bde ba'i rnam pa can/ lus bde sim me bar gnas pa/
sib sib bam zim zim/ char pa sim sim babs te rnyid pa'i me tog rnams sos song/ char pa sim sim zhig gis 'dal chog chog dang, nyi ma lhang lhang zhig gis dros chog chog med/
rdo skas kyi them pa/ steng 'gro'i rdo skas la si'u bdun yod/
sbrang ma 'phur lding gi sgra lta bu/
1) rgyan gyi 'phyang 'phrul sner btags pa'i dril chung ngam, g.yer kha'i sil khrol/ 2) rol mo'i ming/
dkrol bya sbubs chal/ sil snyan dkrol ba/
sil snyan dkrol mkhan gyi bud med/
me tog sogs sil ma'am thor bu/ zhal tog sna tshogs sil thor zhig bsgrigs pa/
sil ma'ang zer, thar thor ram lhug ma dang dam dum/ me tog sil ma/ dngul sil ma/ ja mar sil ma/ rlung sil bu ldang ba tsam yang ma mchis pa/
dngos rdzas sil ma byas nas nyo mkhan la 'tshong ba'i tshong/
thor bur gsil te 'tshong ba'i tshong pa/
dum bur gtubs pa'am sil bur byas pa'i shing/
g.yer kha dang, sil snyan, dril bu sogs kyi sgra/ sgra sil sil/

1.spyi sgra'i nang gses shig yin la gang zag gi spyi sgra kho na la 'jug par bshad srol yod kyang gtso che ba tsam las mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ su...gtam de sus gleng ba/ kho su yin pa/ ji snyed su dag / pho su ma yin gyis thub le min/ rgyal khab su 'dra zhig / 2.la don zhig / la...logs su langs pa/ phyogs su ma lhungs pa/
mi gang yin pa thams cad/
(yul) su dang su zhig gam ci byung gang byung/
ka ra na: sgra mdo chen po brgyad dam bcu'i ya gyal zhig /
su 'dra zhig ste gang zag gi spyi sgra/ mi su zhig gis yid ches byed/ 'di ni byed po su zhig gis khyod lag tu byin/
(yul) si pan te spod ro tsha ba/
1) lham bzo byed kyi ko ba'i bye brag cig / 2) (sog) khyu'am phyugs kyi tshogs pa/

(legs) lha'i dbang po byang chub dus rabs dgu pa tsam la bod rgyal khri gtsug lde'u btsan nam khri ral pa can gyis bod du gdan drangs pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig yin pa des bka' dang bstan bcos mang po bsgyur yod/

/ 1) bod du me kha gso byed kyi shing bongs thung la yal 'dab 'dzings te skye ba zhig / 2) lug phrug gi spu ltar sgor sgor 'khyil bzhin skye ba'i mi'i skra dbyibs shig / su lu mgo / 3) ba lu/ 4) phyugs kyi nang khrol sul mang/ su lu ka, (rnying) 'bru'i chang/
su dang su zhes pa'i bsdus tshig / mi su su slebs 'dug su su slebs mi 'dug / 'thus mi su su phebs 'dug /
rta g.yag sogs rkang lag dkar po can/
rkang lag bzhi thag pas bsdams pa/ gnag phyugs sug bkyigs btang nas spu rtsid 'breg pa/
mi'i lag mthil dang, dud 'gro'i rkang lag bzhi'i rmig mthil/
1) sro lo smug po zer ba'i sngo sman/ 2) lcags rigs shig /

/ 1) rkang lag / sug bzhi/ sug par son pa/ sug bzhi bcad pa'i lug khog kha tshang/ sug rting skam po'i thug pa bskol, dge rgan lags la ljags gang zhus/ chung ngu ra lug gsod stangs mi shes par, chen po g.yag gi sug bzhi 'breg rgyu zhog / 2) gzhan la yan lag gis gtong ba'i gsang brda/ rkang sug / lag sug brgyab/ mgo sug / rgyug sug gtong ba/ 3) sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas rna ba 'on pa la phan, gos sogs kyi dri ma 'dag par byed/
rkang lag gi don du go ba'i sug pa dang 'dra,

(legs) e la phra mo ste, rtsi sman gyi rigs shig ro tsha la kha ba, zhu rjes drod, nus pas mkhal ma'i drod dang nus pa nyams pa gso, pho ba'i me drod skyed/ ming gi rnam grangs la nye ba'i lde mig dang, tri bi tri, thum gsum pa, lus ngan ma, seg brdar ris, e la rtsi bcas so,
sngar byol song la brten nas 'khri ba'i khral/
rul ba'i ming/ sha'i sungs dri ngan pa/ ro'i sungs dri/ dngos zog rul nas sungs dri bro ba/

nyung nyung dang thung thung/ ja sud pa zhig drangs/ chang sud tsam zhig 'thung/ lto sud/ spro sud pa/ glo sud rgyag pa/ nges 'byung sna thung spu sud/ 'bru sud tsam nyos/ rtsam pa sud tsam ster/ dngul sud tsam bsags/
sems mi dga' ba'i snang ba/ yid la sun snang skyes pa/ slob sbyong byed dus khengs sems med pa dang, slob khrid byed dus sun snang med pa/
(tha mi dad pa) skyo ba'i don/ yid sun pa/ 'ur zing gis sun pa/ rna ba sun pa/
bsun po'ang zer, mi dga' ba dang yid 'tsher ba'i rnam pa/ sna sun phog pa/ mi gzhan la sun po bzos pa/
skyon la skyon du mi brjod pa'am, skyon min skyon du brjod pa/ sun 'byin nus, pha rol po'i 'dod tshul la sbyor ba bkod nas dam bca' 'dor bar byed nus pa/
1) dgag pa rgyag pa/ gzhan lugs la sun 'byin byed pa/ phyin ci log pa'i bshad srol la sun 'byin pa/ 2) dma' 'bebs byed pa/ rang mthong che drags pas gzhan gyi yon tan la sun 'byin byas pa/
skyon la skyon du brjod pas skyon can du go nus pa'am log rtog sel nus pa'i ngag /
bsu ba'am bsu ma/ mgron po la sun ma zhu ba/
zhe sun med pa'i gshis bzang/ sun med ngang ring gis gzhan la bslabs nas rogs ram byed pa/
yid sun zhing rna ba gtser ba ste, zos mi bde ba'am bag mi phebs pa/
(rnying) cung zad re/ zas sun re tsam
nyer bsdogs sam gra sgrig / nyal chas sub bkyigs byas nas phyin pa/

(tha dad pa) bsubs pa, bsub pa, subs,, 1) 'phyi ba/ rkang rjes lag bsub/ ri mo bsub pa/ byas rjes rnams mi mngon par bsubs song/ 2) 'gog pa dang, rdo sogs kyis brgyangs nas med par bzo ba/ 'gro lam bsubs pa/ la lam kha bas bsub pa/ sa rdo shing gsum gyis chu yur bsub pa/ mtsho sub pa/ dbugs sub gtong ba/
grangs 'bor gyi sngon du 'jug pa'i gsum/ sum sgril/ sum cu/ sum stong/ sum ldab/ sum 'bum/ dkar sum sder bzhi'i gsol tshigs bsgrigs pa/
sum ldab tu 'gyur ba/ bcu sum 'gyur la sum cu tham pa thob/
slob dpon shak ya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya yin zhing, sho lo ka sum brgya yod pas sum brgya pa zhes btags so/
sum ldab tu bsgyur ba/ brgya sum bsgyur la sum brgya tham pa thob/
khag gsum sdeb gcig tu bsgrid pa/ rgya yig dang bod yig sog yig sum bsgrigs kyi dpe cha/
thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas mchin tshad dang mkhris tshad sel/

thon mi sam bho tas brtsams pa le'u phyi ma rnams kyi rten gzhir gyur pas rtsa ba dang, mchod brjod dang brtsam par dam bca' ba dor ba'i lhag ma sho lo ka sum cu yod pas sum cu pa zhes sam, mkhas pa la las ka li sum cu'i brjod bya gtso bor ston pas de skad ces btags par bshad/
1) bod kyi brda sprod rig pa sum cu pa'i gzhung 'grel/ 2) mdo sde sum cu pa zhes pa'i gzhung 'grel/

1) grangs ka zhig / 2) «triyastrisha» lha'i gnas te ri rab kyi steng du nor lha brgyad dang, drag po bcu, nyi ma bcu gnyis, tha skar gyi bu gnyis te nye dbang so gnyis dang lha dbang brgya byin dang bcas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams rtse zhing rol ba'i gnas/
gsum gnyis dang 'dra, sum rtags, sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming/

dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang ru mtshams snye mo'i mdar sum pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas kun la dpyis phyin par sbyangs, khyad par du rje btsun g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i sku'i drung du lo bcu gnyis bar du bcar nas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i gzhung don dang gdams pa'i zab bcud bka' lung phyag len lhag ma med par zhus, bka' rtsom yang g.yu thog pa'i rnam thar sku lnga lhun grub ma dang, gsang ba'i rnam thar, bshad rgyud kyi 'grel pa 'bum chung gsal sgron, rkang 'bam gso ba'i snyan rgyud zin bris sogs bstan bcos sna tshogs mdzad, sku tshe hril po'i ring gtso bor dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel, gzhon nu ye shes sogs slob ma shin tu mang ba bskrun/
thog brtsegs gsum yod pa'i khang pa/
lung pa'i mda' gsum mam, lam gsum, chu bo gsum sogs 'dzoms pa'i 'dus mdo/
rdzogs ldan skabs kyi dge ba bcu'i nang nas sum cha tsam zhig lus pa'i skabs te dus tshad la lo grangs sa ya gcig dang, 'bum ther gnyis, khri phrag dgu, stong phrag drug yod par bshad do/
1.(tha dad pa) bsums pa, bsum pa, sums,, rub rub bzo ba/ khug ma'i kha bsum pa/ gos kyi am phrag dang sgab gsham bsums pa/ 2.sum pa'i ru'i bsdus ming,

ye shes dpal 'byor: rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing sprel lor sku 'khrungs, dgung lo dgu'i thog a mdo dgon lung du phebs te chos kyi rgya mtsho las rab tu byung, pan chen blo bzang ye shes dang, sku 'bum 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs bsten nas thun min dang thun mong gi rig gnas kun la thos bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad, khyad par du rgyal dbang lnga pa'i bla sman ra ba phug po che'i slob ma, sman rams pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan slob dpon du bsten nas gso rig rgyud bzhi'i lung gsan zhing, lag len zhib khrid mdzad, gzhan yang rtsis dkar nag dang, sum rtags, snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig lam gang la'ang thogs pa med par sbyangs pas sum pa pandi ta zhes mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul lor pe cin du phebs te lo gsum tsam mtsho bdun dgon pa'i mkhan po mdzad, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug lor rgya gar dang, rgya nag sog yul, bod bcas kyi lo rgyus 'khod pa'i chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang dang, mtsho sngon gyi lo rgyus dang, 'dzam gling spyi bshad, gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dang sman ngos 'dzin, sman gyi ming gi rnam grangs sogs mang du mdzad, rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa sprel lor dgung lo brgyad cu gya lngar gshegs/
mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs gcan tsha rdzong gi rong zhig /

chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang zhes bya ba 'di sum pa mkhan chen ye shes dpal 'byor gyis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug lor brtsams, brjod bya ni stod char rgya gar du rgyal rabs dang dam pa'i chos byung tshul dang, smad char rgya nag chen po dang, bod sog yul bcas su dam pa'i chos byung tshul rnams gsal/
bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i gong nas bod du dar ba'i bon po'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i bye brag cig /

srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod yul dbus gtsang gis thog drangs pa'i yan lag gsum pa'i ru'am, dbus gtsang ru bzhir phye ba'i thog tu btsugs pa'i ru chen lnga pa ste byang phyogs 'phan yul mtsho sngon dang sa 'brel ba'i yul 'di'i lte ba rgya shod stag pa tshal la bzhag nas shar gnye yul bum nag lho smri ti chu nag nub yel zhabs sdings po che, byang nags shod gzi 'phrang bcas so so'i bar du song ba'i sa khul gyi ming rnying/
samkrita'i sgra zur chag pa ste bstan bcos kyi mgo rgyan lanytsha, wartu, bod yig dang yi ge gsum sgrig /
phan tshun gsum sbyar ram gsum sbrel/ sum sbyar pang leb/ shog lheb sum sbyar/
gsum phyogs gcig tu sdeb pa/
brgya byin, drag po, nye dbang ste lha'i gtso bo gsum rtse ba'i gnas la sum rtsen zhes bya ste, sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul yin no/
lha'i 'dun sa ste, lha'i grong khyer gyi ming/
rim pa gsum brtsegs/ deb sum brtsegs/ khang pa sum brtsegs/
dbyibs sum tshugs/ thab rdo sum tshugs shig btsugs te tsha phogs brgyab/
1) sum cha'i zur/ sum zur gnyis tsam/ 2) grwa'am zur gsum/
1) gsum yan chad/ 2) sum cha gcig yan chad/
rim pa sum brtsegs sam rim pa gsum bskor/ lcags ri sum rim pa/ sum log ldab gsum
shing sman gyi nang tshan ba lu'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
me'i nang du chu gtor ba'i sgra lta bu/
re'u yis ba lu zos pa las byung ba'i pho bar dug zhugs nas bshal ba'i nad/

(legs) 'od 'gyed de, lhan skyes rma rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan glo mchin pho mkhal gyi gnas su khrag ngan chu ser 'dus nas rdol te rma yi mdog dbyibs nyi ma ltar dmar zhing sgor ba dang, mtha' ru lhog shu nyi zer ltar 'byung ba zhig
shur can/ gos sul ma/ sham thabs kyi sul ma/ sha mo'i sul/ ri bo'i sul/
nang khrol lam nang cha grod pa/
grog shur sgang gshong mang po yod pa'i bgrod dka'i lam/
sgang gshong mang po gshib pa/ gyon pa'i sgab gsham sul sul byas pa phar g.yug tshur g.yug gis 'gro ba/

1. 1) bod kyi lo rgyus thog spra nas mir gyur pa'i thog ma'i dus skabs kyi rus rgyud bzhi'i gras shig / 2) bya zhig / 3) (yul) rdza snod bzo byed kyi sa dkar zhig / 2.sa mtha'i ming gi rjes su bcug nas tshig gzhan dang mnyam du ming de'i don gyi ngo bo gzugs su bkod pa'i tshig grogs shig / sa...chems se chem/ shigs se shig / thoms se thom/ lhabs se lhab/
lag sor mtheb gung gnyis rtse sbyar te rdeb pa'i sgra/ se gol gyi sgra/ se gol gyi brda/ se gol gtogs pa/ se gol gtogs tsam/
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas dug sdud, chu ser sel/
1) gna' rabs bod kyi rus rgyud nang gi gcig / 2) lung pa zhig /

ming gzhan la hu bi li yang zer, sngar 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang dus thog gcig pa'i yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dang po'i ming, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing phag lor 'khrungs, rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags sprel lo nas rab byung lnga pa'i shing rta lo'i bar lo sum cu so lnga ring srid bzung, rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi lor rgyal sa pe cin du spos, rab byung lnga pa'i lcags lug lor rgyal khab kyi ming yon zer bar bsgyur, de'i phyi lo 'gro mgon 'phags pa ti shri gong ma'i dbu blar bkur, bod sa gnas su dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi zhon wu'i hri si tu'u yon hra'o hphu zer ba'i srid 'dzin do dam sa khul btsugs, rab byung lnga pa'i me byi lor bod sa gnas yongs la shing sgo can gyi dud tshang zhib bsher byas nas khri skor bcu gsum thob pa rnams khag bgos kyis khri dpon bsko ba'i lam lugs thog mar btsugs, rab byung lnga pa'i shing rta lor 'das/
(rnying) lcags bdar nas ngo mnyam par byed pa'i sag bdar gyi ming/ se bdar gyis 'tshal ba/
lde 'phrul gnam gzhung gi bu bod rgyal bco brgyad pa ste rgyal po lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
se snol gnam lde'i bu, sngar bod rgyal bcu dgu pa ste lde brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
/ 1) shing sman zhig / 2) gser gyi ljid tshad 'jal ba'i tshad gzhi zhig gi ming ste, gser zho gang cha brgya la bgos pa'i cha gcig gi ljid tshad yin/
rje mi la'i slob ma'i gras shig
shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar skyur kha ba, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas mkhris pa sel, rlung gi nad gnon par byed/
dkar skya/ dge sbyong se bo/ khyi se bo/
sngar bod du dar ba'i bon gyi chos lugs shig /
se go bo'am se go ding zer ba'i bya chen po mgo se bo zhig /
1) se shing gi 'bras bu/ 2) se ra dgon pa dang 'bras spungs dgon pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming/
se ra, 'bras spungs, dga' ldan te gsum/

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro skyur, zhu rjes drod, nus pas pho ba'i me drod skyed, bad kan gyi nad sel, dang ga 'byed, grang ba'i nad 'joms/ ming gi rnam grangs la rked ma dang, mchin nad dgra, spre'u shing, pha la ta ka, pho ba'i gnyen, ma hu ra, mdzod ldan, lo thog gshed, se la shartu bcas so,
1) shing se ba'i 'bras bu gsar pa/ 2) shing gi bye brag cig /
shing tsher ma can se ba'i 'bras bu/
'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi bla ma zhig
1) gser dngul 'degs pa'i srang grangs kyi rtsis gzhi zhig / 2) bdud rtsi se dkar zer ba'i shing sman gyi ming/
mgo'i skra skya yo re ba/ dgung lo bgres te dbu skra se yo re bar gyur 'dug /
1) ser ba/ 2) (yul) khal 'gel rgyu'i do po/ 3) se ra dgon pa/

dbus phogs dge lugs dgon chen gsum gyi ya gyal byams chen chos rje shak ya ye shes kyis phyag btab pa zhig ste, khong gis rje tsong kha pa'i sku tshab tu t'a ming rgyal po'i dbu blar phebs nas phyir log skabs rten skal du bsnams phebs pa'i gser chos bka' 'gyur dang tsan dan gyi gnas brtan bcu drug bcas yod pa'i gdan sa zhig /
se ra dgon pa'i rgyab kyi ri rked du yod pa'i tsong kha pa'i sgrub gnas chung chung zhig /
dbus phyogs gdan sa chen po gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, se ra dgon pa'i ming gzhan zhig /
sngar lo re bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin se ra dgon pa'i byes grwa tshang du yi dam rta mgrin gyi phur pa mjal ston dus chen zhig /
skud pas phrag pa dang mchan khung 'og g.yas g.yon du bsnol te btags pa'i phreng ba zhig /
phrag gong dang mchan 'og g.yas g.yon du dkri ba'i rgyan cha/
(rnying) ser po/ byang du mchod rten se ru bzhengs pa/
1) rnying pa hrul po/ 2) sa sman gyi rigs gyang rnying sogs la chags pa'i sa dreg ser skya ro kha nyams can zhig ste, nus pas 'khrugs tshad dang, gyur dug sbyar dug sel/
mdog kham skya/ be'u se shar re ba/ skra se shar re ba/ sma ra se shar re ba/
(tha mi dad pa) so brtse ba/ rdo phye'i lhad 'dres pa'i rtsam pas so seg pa/
/ 1) gzeb ma zer ba'i slo ma ste smyug lhas kyi snod gru bzhi khebs can/ 2) rdo phye/
seng ge dkar po'am gangs rir gnas pa'i seng ge / seng dkar g.yu ral can/
khyi spu mdog dkar zhing sna dmar ba can gyi pho rtags te, ro mngar, zhu rjes drod, nus pas ro tsa, chags pa 'phel/
ri mo'am 'jim pas bzos pa'i seng ges bteg pa'i khri/

, 1) ri dwags rgyal po/ seng ge'i g.yu ral la spre'us lag rtsed/ seng ge'i 'o ma bzho 'dod na, de la 'thab pa'i snying stobs dgos/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha lnga pa dang, glang po 'joms, nga ro can, cha shas 'jigs, gdong lnga pa, sder chags rgyal po, nags kyi dbang po, nam mkha' gnon, rnam par gnon, 'phrog byed, gtsug phud lnga pa, tshogs kyi bdag po, ral pa can, ri dwags dbang po, ri dwags zas can bcas so, 2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong khongs lho brag nub chu'i 'gram du yod/
gcan gzan ngo mtshar can zhig ste, khyung gi gshog pa gnyis dang sder mo gnyis, seng ge'i rkang lag bzhi bcas pa zhig /
bod rang skyong ljongs mnga' ris sa khul khongs spu hreng dang sgar rdzong gnyis kyi chu zhig ste chu bo si t'a'o/
kha 'bab kyi chu bo bzhi 'byung sa'i gangs ri te se/
seng ge'i khyim dang don gcig
seng ge'i ri mo yod pa'i gos chen zhig /
gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig /
seng ges lus 'gyings tshul bstan pa/
lha sgrung nang bshad pa'i seng ge rdzu 'phrul can zhig /
sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas rma gso, rus chag sbyor/
skar rtsis las 'byung ba'i ri mo'i 'khor lo zhig /
1) seng ges lus rtsal ngoms te 'khrab cing rtse ba/ 2) byang sems shig gi mtshan/
stod gos kyi dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi bzo dbyibs/
sngo ga bur tis lo'i ming gi rnam grangs shig
sngar rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig ste, sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal dang, brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs mdzad mkhan sher phyin smra ba'i slob dpon no/
khyim lnga pa, khyim zhag nyi bar skar gnas dgu la slebs skabs nyi ma seng khyim la spyod/
rgyal thabs kyi khri la mnga' gsol ba'am, rang rang yul dgon gyi bdag por khri 'don byed pa/
1) rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i yab rgyal po seng ge 'gram/ 2) seng ge'i 'gram pa 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
1) seng ge sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i skad/ 2) rnying ma'i chos lugs nas bshad pa'i slob dpon gu ru mtshan brgyad nang gi gcig / 3) bdud kyi bu/
1) seng ge'i ngar skad/ 2) sangs rgyas shig
glo g.yas pa phab ste rkang pa g.yon pa g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag nas nyal ba'i tshul/
gshegs pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, mi zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa/
chu tshan zhig ste, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rnam gling rdzong khongs su yod/
nad yongs su drag pa/ nad seng drag byung song/
dbyangs 'char las gsungs pa'i legs nyes brtag thabs shig /
ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgom bzlas la brten nas bar chad phyir sgyur gyi cho ga zhig /

«khadiraka:» shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro mngar la bska, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas khrag ngan dang, chu ser skem/ ming gi rnam grangs la kha di ra dang, khu ba mdze 'joms, glu len ma, chu ser khrag 'thung, byis pa'i nu ma, 'tsho ba'i shing, zla ba'i yal ga bcas so,
gser ri bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste, ri'i rtse mo na seng ldeng gi nags mdzes pa yod pas seng ldeng can zhes zer, ngos rer dpag tshad lnga 'bum dang mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis yod pa/
seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma
lha sgrol ma ljang gu'i rigs shig
mdog gi dbye ba'i sgo nas ming btags pa'i seng ldeng dmar skya ser gsum gyi ming ste, dmar ba tsan dan seng ldeng, ser ba skyer pa seng ldeng, skya bo gsom seng ldeng ngo/
tshags hrob po/ srub dbar seng po/ ljon shing seng po/
1) seng ge'i phru gu / 2) seng ge dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i khyi/
zhu mkhan lo ma'i ming gzhan zhig /
(tha mi dad pa) sengs pa, seng ba,, 'dag pa dang sang ba/ skyo ba seng ba/ ngal dub seng ba/ dri ma sengs pa/ skyon sengs pa/
'brug dang seng ge'i ming gi bsdus tshig /
seng 'brug stag gsum gyi ri mos mtshan pa'i ge sar rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong/
/ 1) srub ma'am bar gseng can/ ras seng ma/ seng ma med pa'i mdza' gcugs dam zab/ 2) (rnying) lan kan/
ras srab srab kyi chu tshags lta bu/
shing seng ldeng gi tsher ma/
phyi gsal nang gsal ras srab kyi yol ba/
khang pa'i dkyil gyi dkar gsal mthongs g.yab/
bar srub hral hral/ gral tshags zhib po med pa'i srub dbar seng seng po/
1.seng ba'i 'das pa, 2.(rnying) ras srab mo shin tu tshags lhod cing sha rjen ji bzhin sgrib mi thub pa zhig /
lag pa'i sen mo'i rtsa ba'i pags pa/ sen skyi gas pa/
sen mos sha lpags 'jus te 'then pa/ phru gu'i 'phongs la sen 'thog rgyag pa/

rkang lag gi sen mo/ sen mos 'thog pa/ sen mo 'debs pa/ sen mos dbral ba/ ming gi rnam grangs la gcad bya dang, bcad skye, 'dod myos lcags kyu, sder mo, yang srid can, lag skyes, lag 'khru, lag pa'i tsher ma, slar skyes bcas so,
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, sems can thams cad la phan pa'i lhag bsam nyid kyis sen mo mdog snum pa/
ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, rigs kyi mchog las skyes pas sen mo mtho ba ste, gshong bu dang leb mo min par dbus mtho ba/
lta bu'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, 'du byed thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral ba nyid kyis sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu/
grangs shin tu nyung ba'i dpe/
dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, sen mo zangs mdog lta bu dang, sen mo mdog snum pa dang, sen mo dbus mtho ba bcas gsum/
sen mo skye sa'i rtsa ba/
rkang lag gi sen mo'i zur gyi sha'am skyi lpags/
dam po med pa dang, mkhregs po med pa'i sob sob/ rtsam pa seb seb byas nas bshar ba/

/ 1) rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i shes pa, dper na mig shes su gyur pa'i sems la sogs pa lta bu'o/ sems kyi ngal rtsol/ sems kyis mi bzod pa/ gzhan sems dkrug pa/ sems 'khyams pa/ sems 'khrugs pa/ sems gu yangs po/ sems 'gul thebs pa/ sems bsgyur ba/ sems gnyis phrad pa med pa/ sems gting nas khro ba/ rang sems dang mthun pa/ sems 'dogs par byed pa/ sems phyin ci log pa/ sems zil gyis non pa/ sems yeng yeng ba/ sems la 'khums pa/ sems la 'phreng ba/ sems la bab pa/ sems la gzir ba/ sems la shar ba/ pha ma'i sems chu, bu phrug gi sems rdo/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun gzhi dang, dran pa, nang gi byed pa, rnam shes, blo, yid, rig pa, shes pa bcas so, 2) gtso sems kyi bsdus ming,
sngon ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i sems kyi sa bon rgyas pa las byung ba de'o/
yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ste, yid tsam la brten pa'i tshor ba yin pas de'o/
sa mang lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste, sems kyi skad cig thams cad dang khams gsum dang sa thams cad la 'byung ba/
kun 'gro lnga dang, yul nges lnga bcas so/
sems klong man ngag gi sde
rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i theg pa'i dbye ba ste, gnas pa sems kyi sde, bya bral klong gi sde, zab pa man ngag gi sde'o/

sems bzang ba'am blo nye ba/ tang dang mi dmangs la blo sems dkar ba/ sems dkar zas de mang mi dgos, yid smon gtam de nyung mi rung/ sems dkar po'i lta ba ma log na, la lung pa brgal kyang mgo sbrel red/
yid mi bde ba'am yid pham pa/ gzhon dus yon tan ma sbyangs na, rgas par gyur tshe sems skyo yong/

rang rgyu gzhan phan don gnyer gyi 'dun pas drangs shing, grogs byang chub 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgor gyur pa'i lam gyi rigs su gnas pas rab tu phye ba'i theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can no/

sems bskyed la sa mtshams dang dpe don gyi sgo nas dbye na nyi shu rtsa gnyis te mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed bzhi dang, lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed bdun dang, rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed dgu dang, sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed gnyis rnams so/
ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na rnam pa gnyis te, don dam sems bskyed dang, kun rdzob sems bskyed do/

rgyal sras kyi sems bskyed dam bca' bzhi ste, sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral ba dang, sems can thams cad 'khor ba las dgrol ba dang, sems can thams cad mngon par byang chub par byed pa dang, sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar dgod pa ste bzhi/
sa mtshams kyi dbye bas rnam pa bzhi ste, mos pa spyod pa'i sems bskyed dang, lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed, rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed, sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed do/
byang chub kyi sems thog mar bskyed tshul gyi khyad par gsum ste, rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams so/
sems gting nas do gal byed pa/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar sems khur byed pa/ mi dmangs kyi bde sdug la sems khur byed pa/
sems nang gi rdog khres/ 'di skor sems khral byed mi dgos/ mi la nyes chad gcod 'dod na, nyes ming mi rnyed sems khral ci/
sems yag po rang med pa/ mi de sems khrig khrig cig yod pas yag po rang byas mi yong/
1) sems kyi ngo bo ra sprod pa/ 2) sems 'gyur thabs byed pa/
1) bsam blo gtong shes mkhan/ 2) sems can,..
1) klad pa mkhregs po/ 2) snying rje med pa/
dga' ba'am spro ba/ spro sems 'khol ba/
dga' zhen/ mes rgyal la sems 'khri che ba/
1) yin pa la min par sems pa/ 2) ra bzi ba'am tshad nad kyis smyo ba/
ngan g.yo dran 'phrul gyi sems 'khyog po/
1) sems dran med du song ba/ 2) gnyis snang gi shes pa yongs su nub pa'o/
bstan 'gyur khrod na bzhugs pa'i gzhung gsum ste phyag rdor stod 'grel dang, rdo rje'i snying 'grel, rigs ldan pad dkar gyi 'grel chen dri med 'od de gsum/
1) sems kyi rang bzhin/ sems rgyud 'jam po/ sems rgyud rgod pa/ sems rgyud des pa/ sems rgyud zhi ba/ sems rgyud bzang po/ sems rgyud gshin po/ 2) sems kyi rgyun/
1) sems 'tshab med pa'am ngang rgyud ring po/ 2) gshis ka bzang po/
1) bsam pa/ sems rgyun thung ba/ 2) shes pa skad cig snga phyi 'phro mthud pa'am bar ma chad pa'i cha/

sems ni chos can, sems snga ma la brten pa yin te, de nyer len du med na mi 'byung ba de'i phyir, nyer len lus la brten pa ma yin te, nges par sems snga ma gang yang rung ba nyid kyi goms pa'i 'du byed kyi rjes su 'jug pa de'i phyir/

1) «satwa» sems dang ldan pa'i gang zag gam, sangs rgyas ma tshar ba'i skye 'gro spyi'i ming/ ming gi rnam grangs la skye 'gro dang, skye rgu, skye ldan, skye bo, skyes bu, 'gro ba, lus can, shes ldan, sems ldan pa, sems pa can, srog chags bcas so, 2) (yul) mi min pa'i srog chags dang sgo nor spyi'i ming/
sems can gyi gnas pa dgu
rnam shes kyi gnas pa bdun dang, srid rtse dang, 'du shes med pa'i sems can dang dgu'o/
snyigs ma lnga'i ya gyal zhig /
sems can du ston pa'i sgra
ston pa'i sgra: lung du mi ston pa'i sgra'o/

kyi tshul khrims: byang chub sems dpas sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i tshul te, grogs bya dgos pa dang, thabs la rmongs pa, phan 'dogs pa, 'jigs pas nyen pa, mya ngan gyis gzer ba, yo byad kyis phongs pa, gnas 'cha' bar 'dod pa, blo mthun par 'dod pa, yang dag par zhugs pa, log par zhugs pa, rdzu 'phrul gyis gdul bar bya ba rnams kyi don ji ltar rigs par sgrub pa'o/
sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan

bsam gtan bsgrub pa'i sgo nas mngon par shes pa drug po dag thob ste lus kyi rdzu 'phrul byas pa'i rgyus sems dga' bar byas shing gzhan gyi sems shes pas sems dang mthun par chos bshad nas mi dge ba las bzlog cing dge ba la 'god pa/
dmigs pa'i snying rje: mi rtag pa dang bdag med gang gi yang khyad par ma phye bar sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/

pa'i lhag ma lnga: dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las, sems can la chags pa las gyur pa'i lhag ma lnga ste, khu ba 'byin pa'i lhag ma dang, reg pa'i lhag ma dang, 'khrig tshig smra ba'i lhag ma, bsnyen bkur bsngags pa'i lhag ma, smyan byed pa'i lhag ma rnams so/
sems can la ston pa'i sgra
rjod byed kyi sgra de la skyes bus glu len pa lta bu snyan pa'i sgra dang, tshig rtsub smra ba lta bu mi snyan pa'i sgra gnyis yod/
sems can la ster ba'am sbyin pa'i don/
ston pa'i sgra: rjod byed kyi sgra ma yin pa'i sgra, de la skyes bus gling bu 'bud pa'i sgra lta bu snyan pa'i sgra dang, skyes bus khu tshur brgyab pa'i sgra lta bu mi snyan pa'i sgra gnyis yod/
sems sdug gam sems nad/ bsams shing bsams na bu nga sems pa gcong/
1) sems srab pa/ 2) blo gros chung ba/ 3) gzhan la gus pa chen po/
1) snying stobs chen po'am blo khog chen po/ 2) rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po/
ji lta ji snyed rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen/
yid kyi spyod pa nyams pa/ chang gis sems 'chal bag med skye bas blang dor nyams par byed/
sems gnas dgu'i dang po phyi rol gyi dmigs pa las sems bsdus nas nang du dmigs pa la gtod pa'o/
1) sems kho na/ 2) sems kyi chos nyid/

mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor thams cad bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi tshul du bshad pa gzhung le'u bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi rtsa 'grel gnyis ldan gyi gzhung zhig 'di ni dus rabs bcu bzhi par rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/
btang snyoms kyi thog mar zhum rgod med pa rnyed ma thag pa/

bzhag pa mi mnga' ba: nyan thos dag 'phral la mnyam par 'jog cing ldang gi , sangs rgyas ni 'byung 'jug mi mnga' bar spyod lam bzhi'i dus thams cad du sems mnyam par 'jog pa, ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi nang gses shig /
1) blo bkal ba/ 2) rig pa bsgrims pa/
1) mi brjed pa'i dran gso'i rten/ 2) sems gnas pa'i rten te klad pa dang snying yin par grags/

ting 'dzin sgom pa'i snod rung gi sems kyi rten 'di la ngo bo tha dad pa'i sems rten dang, ngo bo gcig pa'i sems rten gnyis las dang po ni sems phyi ma de skyed par byed pa la med du mi rung ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i shes pa zhig dang, gnyis pa ni sems snga ma gang yin pa'i shugs de bzhin du sems phyi ma yang de'i ngo bor bskyed nus pa'i shes pa/
1) snying brlag pa// 2) dran shes sam rig pa nyams pa/
blo rgyun nam, ngang rgyud/ sems thag bcad pa/ mi de las ka la sems thag chod po yod/ sems thag thung thung/ sems thag rbad bcad/ sems thag gtsang bcad/ sems phu thag ma thung/
1) yi mug pa'am re thag chad pa/ 2) sems ngal ba/
dag pa bzhi'i nang gses, ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa'o/
yid la 'bab pa'am mos pa che ba/

bar bzhag pa: dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, nang gi lus la dmigs pa'i sgo nas byung ba'i sems nyi shu dang, de bzhin du phyi'i lus dang, phyi nang gi lus la dmigs pa'i sems rnam pa gsum po thams cad kyang mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med pa'o zhes rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/
mig dang, rna ba, sna, lce, lus, yid bcas kyi rnam shes drug /
yid la gdeng tshod yod mkhan/
1) yid sim pa/ 2) blo bde bag phebs/

rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde'i skor la, rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud rig pa rang shar, nyi ma lta bu'i rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long, seng ge lta bu'i rgyud seng ge rtsal rdzogs, ri rgyal lta bu'i rgyud yi ge med pa, 'khor lo lta bu'i rgyud bkra shis mdzes ldan, lde mig lta bu'i rgyud sgra thal 'gyur, ral gri lta bu'i rgyud kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long, gsal shing lta bu'i rgyud sgron me 'bar ba, gser zhun lta bu'i rgyud nor bu phra bkod, ma bu 'brel ba lta bu'i rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor, me long lta bu'i rgyud ngo sprod spras pa, mu tig star la brgyus lta bu'i rgyud mu tig phreng ba, sbrul mdud lta bu'i rgyud rig pa rang grol, khyung chen lta bu'i rgyud klong drug pa, chu bo lta bu'i rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung, spu gri lta bu'i rgyud nag mo khros ma, rgyal po lta bu'i rgyud sku gdung 'bar ba, bang mdzod lta bu'i rgyud rin po che spungs pa ste bco brgyad do, de dag ni bee ro tsa na dang, bi ma la, ku ma ra, g.yu sgra snying po sogs kyis bsgyur pa'o/
rab rtog gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sems ldan gyi dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi bya ba'i gnas lugs shig la bsam blo'i 'du shes gang zhig med bzhin du yod par sgro btags te brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /

rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i nang gses gnas pa sems kyi sde ste, slob dpon shri sengha dang lo chen bee ro tsa na las rim par brgyud pa yin la, 'di'i lta ba'am grub mtha' ni, sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes kyis 'khor 'das kun la khyab kyang, snang ba dngos por rgya ma chad, stong pa dngos med du rgya ma chad, gnyis ka ma yin pa zung 'jug gi phyogs su'ang ma lhung la, ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol zhing, rang rtsal ma 'gag pas chad pa'i mtha' las grol bas bya bral bde sdug las 'das pa'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'o/
1) yid la sdug bsngal byung ba/ 2) rang gi mtshang la phog nas yid mi dga' ba byung ba/
1) sems khur ram sems sdug / 2) snying gi na tsha'i rigs/

zhi gnas sgom skabs kyi sems gnas dgu ste, sems 'jog pa ni phyi rol gyi dmigs pa las sems bsdus nas nang du dmid pa la gtod pa dang, rgyun du 'jog pa ni dang por gtad pa'i sems de nyid gzhan du mi g.yeng bar dmigs pa dang, bslan te 'jog pa ni sems phyi rol tu yengs na shes par byas nas slar yang dmigs pa de nyid la 'jog pa dang, nye bar 'jog pa ni sems yang yang bsdus te phra bar byas nas 'jog pa dang, 'dul bar byed pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan bsags nas de la dga' ba dang, zhi bar byed pa rnam g.yeng la skyon du bltas nas ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba zhi bar byed pa dang, rnam par zhi bar byed pa chags sems dang yid mi bde sogs zhi bar byed pa dang rtse gcig tu byed pa 'bad med du 'jug pa'i phyir 'bad pa dang, mnyam par 'jog pa ni sems mnyam par gyur pa na btang snyoms su byed pa'o/
sems rnam par ma zhi ba
1) sems bag mi phebs pa dang dal ba med pa// 2) rang snang gang dran byed mkhan/
bar du zhum rgod de phyir 'byung du dogs bzhin du gnas pa/
1) bden pa bden thub/ 2) sems smyos pa min pa/

1.(tha dad pa) bsams pa, bsam pa, soms,, rtog dpyod byed pa dang yid la skor ba/ ji ltar bsams pa ltar kha nas shod/ gang brtsams lam du 'gro ba zhig byung na sems/ bde skyid 'thob par sems pa/ 2.kun 'gro lnga'i ya gyal, rang yul la g.yo zhing 'jug pa'i sgo nas yul de yid la 'jags par byed pa'i shes pa'o/ sems pa rgya che ba/ sems pa bzang po/ de 'dra'i sems pa gnag pa la/ sems phra ba/

sems gnas pa dang 'phen pa sems pas byed pa ste, dper na, sngon mu ge'i tshe thal ba'i rkyal pa rtsam pa'i rkyal par sems pas bu gnyis ma shi ba dang, gcig gis kha phye bas thal bar shes pas de ma thag shi ba dang, rgya mtshor thang du shes nas song ba chur shes pa dang shi ba lta bu'o/
yid shes dang mtshungs ldan lus ngag gi las mngon par 'du byed pa'i sems byung/
nga rgyal lam spobs pa che ba/
1) snying stobs che ba/ 2) gzhan don la snying stobs mi zhum pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ sems dpa'i skyil krung/
lha bskyed pa'i tshul zhig ste, dam tshig sems dpa' dang, ye shes sems dpa' dang, ting 'dzin sems dpa' bcas cig car du bskyed pa'o/
byang chub sems dpa' dang, byang chub sems ma'o/
sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan
bsam mi khyab sogs kyis khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes/
sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i byed mtshan
phan bde skyob sogs kyi byed las khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes/

sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum: sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor bas sems can thams cad thar ba'i bde ba la 'god pas phan pa dang, sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde zhi ba sogs tshe 'di'i bde ba dang, 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las bskyabs pa'i skyob pa de dang gsum mo/
1) blo'i stobs gong nas gong du je 'phel du song ba/ 2) snying ldem ldem du g.yugs pa/
1) sems 'phang mthon por 'phro ba'am g.yo ba/ 2) blo mi bde ba'am sems skyo ba/
sems chags pa'am zhen pa/ ma yis bu gcig po la sems 'phreng ba/
yul la sems dbang med du shor nas 'bral mi phod pa byung ba/
1) sems 'tshab pa'am zhum pa/ 2) yid la mtsher snang yod pa/
(mngon) lkugs pa smra mi shes pa/
rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi khyad par rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa sems las byung ba ste, tshor ba la sogs pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /
rtsa gcig kun 'gro lnga dang: yul nges lnga dang, rtsa nyon drug dang, nye nyon nyi shu dang, dge ba bcu gcig dang, gzhan 'gyur bzhi bcas so/
sems lhod po med pa/ sems brel ba tshab tshub langs pa/
1) yid mi bde lhang lhang byed pa/ 2) (rnying) rig pa mi gsal ba/

1) rnam rtog ngan pa'i rgyun bcad pa/ 2) dben pa gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, phyi nang gi mtha' la brten nas snying gar rlung thim pas khyad par gyi stong pa bzhi bskyed pa'o/ 3) 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba sems kun rtog rlung dang bcas pa las dben par byas te bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bor shar ba'i rdzogs rim pa'i rnal 'byor/
1) sdug bsngal gyis sems skyo ba/ 2) sems kyi skyon sel thabs byed pa/
gnas skabs sems med du gyur pa'i tshul lnga ste, 'gog snyoms, 'du shes med, 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyid mthug brgyal ba'i skabs/
rab rtog gi rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, sems med kyi dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs la rnam rtog gi bsam blo med bzhin du yod par sgro btags te brjod pa'i rgyan zhig /
nga rgyal spangs nas sems chung byed pa/
sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i nang gses shig ste, dbang shes la rags par snang ba snang ba ltar du grub par 'dod pa/
sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i nang gses shig ste, dbang shes la rags par snang ba snang ba ltar du grub par mi 'dod pa/
'phags pa thogs med kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i grub mtha' smra ba, des phyi don rigs pas 'gog cing rnam shes bden par 'dod pa'o, de la dbye na rnam bden pa dang, rnam rdzun pa gnyis yod/
las don la khur brtson che ba/
bya ba 'di ci yin zhes btsal nas 'di ni ka ba'o 'di ni bum pa'o zhes rags rim spyi tsam zhig shes pa/
rig pa gzhan du mi g.yeng bar gcig tu sgrim pa/
bsgoms pa'i yul la sems gzhan du mi g.yeng bar gtod pa/
bsam blo tshab be tshub be/
tshor ba'i bye brag yid shes dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems pa ste, yid kyis 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/
1) sems sun pa/ 2) khrel dang ngo tsha/ 3) yid skyo ba/
gzugs sgra sogs yul lnga la 'jug pa'i sems/
sems la dran par byed pa/
1) skyon mtshang la phog pa/ 2) sems mi skyid pa byung ba/
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i nang tshan zhig ste ting nge 'dzin nges par sems pa la dpag tu med pa'i ye shes kyis 'jug pa/
gzhol ba gsum gyi bzlas pa'i gras shig ste, lha'i thugs kar zla dkyil bsgom pa'o/
sems la gzhol ba'i yan lag
spyod rgyud kyi bzlas pa yan lag bzhi'i nang gses te, yi ge dang po, don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid dang de'i snang cha kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zla dkyil bsgom pa'o/
sems khral lam, sems khur gyi sdug bsngal/
sems rgyud zhi zhing dul ba/ sems las su rung ba nyid du bya ba'i phyir thos pa la sogs pa dag la brtson 'grus bya'o/
khong khro zhi ba'am, yal ba/
blo'i nus shugs/ sems shugs skul ba/ sems shugs skyed pa/ sems shugs chig sgril/
1) bsam blo gtong shes mkhan/ 2) (mngon) mkhas pa/
1) legs nyes kyi rnam dbye shes pa/ 2) bsam blo gtong shes pa/
1) sems tshul ldan du gnas su 'jug pa/ 2) gzhan gyi mtshang la mi phog par byed pa/
mya ngan can gyi sems sdug gso thabs/ sems gso 'tshams 'dri/
(yul) mi shi ba'i nang mi rnams la 'bul rgyu'i kha btags/
mthar yun ring du bsgoms te goms nas zhum rgod mi 'byung zhing dogs pa med par gnas pa/
sems dal dal/ brel zing med pa'i sems bag lhod lhod byung/
/ 1) dmar zhing chung la ro skyur ba'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i shing tog cig / 2) gsar du skyes ma thag pa'i so/ 3) (rgya) gos chen gyi rigs shig gi ming/
gzhan gyi zer sgros kyi rjes su 'brang ba/
dngos rdzas kyi phyi ngos gas pa'i srubs ka/ sgo'i ser ka/ lag par ser kha gas 'dug / dkar yol ser ka gas pa/
1) lci ba ser skam ma/ 2) ser gas can/
ser ba shar shar du 'bab pa'i gzud/
ser kha ma yang zer, ston dus kyi ri kha'i lci ba 'bud shing legs shos shig /
dbyar dus kyi lci ba rlon pa'i khar 'bab pa'i 'bu ser po gshog pa can zhig /

1) ser po dang dkar rag bsres pa'i mdog / 2) btsun pa dang khyim pa gnyis kyi bsdus ming/ ser skya mi dmangs/ ser skya dpon rigs/ 3) (mngon) 1,nyi ma/ 2,khyab 'jug / 4) phyi rol pa'i drang srong zhig /
phyi rol pa'i drang srong ser skya'i grub mtha' mkhan/
ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer
rgya gar gyi grong khyer bye brag pa zhig /
sngar ser srung sngags 'chang sdod khang/
ser chas can gyi khyim pa ste dbon ser gzugs/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kong po dang spo yul bar gyi la zhig /
kha dog ser po'i mdangs mngon stangs shig / sma ra dang smin ma ser khyug ge yod/
gzhi ser por ri mo tshon khra yod pa/ ras ser khra/ shog bu ser khra/
1) sngar ser srung ba'i yon khral/ 2) grwa pa'i khral, sngar khyim nang du bu gsum yod na 'bring ba de grwa pa byed 'jug pa dang gnyis yod na chung ba de grwa pa byed 'jug pa de'o/
ser mdangs chags tshul/ zhing gar gro ser 'khyil 'khyil du smin pa/

1) ser ka dang 'dra, 2) (yul) sbud pa'i shan mchu 'jug sa sa dmar las bzos pa'i khog stong/ 3) lhags rlung sogs grang ngad kyis gdung nas rkang lag gi pags pa gas pa'i don/ 4) mdze nad kyi sha ro ser ga mang po gas pa ltar gyur pa'i dpe don sbyar ba zhig /
1) grwa pa'i gyon pa/ 2) mdog ser po'i gos/ 3) dar gos ser po'i rigs/
sngar ser srung sngags 'chang la sprod pa'i gla cha/

/ 1) sog po'i bud med/ 2) ra lug gi sog pa la brten pa'i mo phyva/ sog mo 'debs pa/

/ 1) mdzub mo ste, rkang lag gi nying lag / rkang sor/ lag sor/ dkyil sor/ mtha' sor/ sor mo mtha' ltag / sor chung/ sor mo 'jar ma/ sor mo drug pa/ sor 'jas/ sor mo 'byar ba/ sor mo bcu nas ga bcad tsha/ ming gi rnam grangs la lag pa'i yal ga'o, 2) ring thung 'jal byed kyi tshad cig ste nas 'bru bdun bsgrigs pa'i tshad/ rtse sor/ dkyil sor/ 3) rkang lag gnyis so sor sor mo bcu re yod pas grangs bcu mtshon/
lag pa'i sor mo lnga ste, mthe bong, mdzub mo, gung mo, srin lag, mthe'u chung ngo/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams rgyas pa/
gyis phra ba'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste yang dag par mthar gyis so sor zhugs pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba/
pa'i dpe byad: sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i nang gses shig ste, tshul kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams zlum pa/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gras shig ste, sor mo rnams zlum pa dang, sor mo rnams rgyas pa dang, sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba bcas gsum mo/

sngar rgya gar gyi rgyal po gdug rtsub can zhig yin pa des mi grangs go dgu bsad de mi re'i sor mo re blangs te ske phreng bzo skabs brgya la gcig gis ma tshang bas shak ya mu ne bkrong rtsis byed skabs bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs te kho'i rgyud btul, rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa/

dge slong gi spang bya ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses, smre sngags 'don pa'i rnam pas so sor bshags par bya ba'i sde zhes bya ste, rab byung dang khrim pa'i gzhi las gyur pa gnyis yod do/

dge slong gi spang bya ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses, so sor bshags pa'i sde la bzhi ste, yul dge slong ma la, dge slong ma rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i bsod snyoms de dge slong gis bslangs nas longs spyod pa dang, sbyin bdag gi gnas su dge slong ma gzhan rang la dmigs bsal du zas 'brim du bcug ste zas len pa dang, khyim gyi bslab sdom byin pa'i sbyin bdag gi nang nas zas bslangs te longs spyod pa dang, 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i gnas su chom rkun sogs yod med ma myul bar zas la longs spyod pa ste bzhi'o/
dbugs kyi lhag ma mgrin sbug nas 'byin stangs shig /

sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs 'brog khul mi ser gyi sa nas bsdu ba'i sol ba'i khral/

brag srubs sogs nas thon pa'i rdo rigs mdog nag po sol ba dang 'dra ba zhig ste, nus pas rma 'brub, chu ser skem/
shing mer bsregs pa'i sol ba/

/ 1) dpyid ka/ 2) 'dul ba'i lugs ltar na hor zla gsum pa dang bzhi pa, skar rtsis kyi lugs ltar na hor zla bzhi pa'i bcu drug nas drug pa'i bco lnga'i bar ste zla ba gnyis/ ming gi rnam grangs la nges par sreg dang, tsha gdung can, tsha zla, tshad chen, tshad dus bcas so,

dge slong gi chos gos ma zhig pa sgam snod lta bu'i nang du brkyangs te 'jug pa la sra brkyang zhes grags/ sra brkyang 'ding ba/

«kathani» gos kyi gzhi gsum gyi ya gyal, bag yangs dang 'brel ba sra brkyang gi gzhi ste, chos gos dras drub byed pa'i gzhi spang leb ni sra brkyang gi dngos po mtshan nyid pa dang, 'dir dge 'dun spyi la dbang ba'i chos gos rnams gsum la 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa ste, spang leb kyis chos gos la khyab pa dang, 'khum pa brkyang ba dang, chos gos kyi tshad gcig tu 'gyur ba ltar, 'dis kyang 'ding ba pos thams cad la khyab cing, gnang ba dang 'brel bas ltung ba bcu'i bag yangs pa dang, 'ding ba po rnams blo gcig tu mthun pas sra brkyang zhes su grags/

ltung ba bcu bag yangs su byas pas rang don bde ba la gnas pa dang, gzhan don sbyin pa po'i bsod nams 'phel ba'i ched du, dbyar rnyed kyi rgyu las byung ba'i chos gos gsum phrug yan chad la, dbyar gnas grol ba'i phyi nyin nas zla ba lnga'i bar du sra brkyang 'ding ba'i cho ga bzhin gding ba'o/

dbyar rnyed kyi rgyu las byung ba'i chos gos gsum phrug yan chod la sra brkyang 'ding ba'i nyin par dge slong rnams kyi chos gos kyi byin rlabs phyung nas gsol gnyis las kyis thugs bstun pa dang, 'ding ba po bsko ba sogs sbyor ba dang, dbyar khas len pa'i dge slong rnams kyis dbyar gnas byed pa'i gnas der dbyar gnas grol ba'i dgag dbye'i phyi nyin tshes bcu drug gi nangs par lhan cig 'dus pa la las bsko bas sngags lan gsum brjod nas go bar bya ba dngos gzhi dang dge 'dun gyis yi rang brjod nas las bsko bas tshags skong byed pa las mtshams kyi phyi rol tu mi 'khyer ba dang, dus dus su rlung seng dang rdul sprugs sogs rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig bsrung ba bcas so/

sra brkyang gding ba 'di phyis dbyung bar bya ba ste, sra brkyang de mtshams gzhan du phyin pa dang, las bsko ba mtshams gzhan du skya rengs shar ba dang, der gtogs kyi dge 'dun dag mtshams khongs su mi gtogs par sra brkyang gi rnyed pa mi slong zhing mtshams 'dir 'ong ba'i bsam pa rgyun chad pa sogs rang 'jug bral dang, dbo zla ste dpyid ra ba'i nya'am rkyen dbang gis de'i snga rol tu dbyung ba bcos ma'i dbyung ba rnams so/
