sku drag gi bu'i zhe sa/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong khongs su yod pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa sngar mi la ras pas phyag btab pa zhig de'i nang la rtsa chen gyi dpe cha dang ldebs ris sogs yod/
bu'i zhe sa/ slob dpon gyi sras pos 'di rnams sgrub rgyags mdzod cig ces phye sgye gang dang chu sdor bzang po rnams byin byung/
sku drag gi bu mo'i zhe sa/
sku drag gi bu bu mo'i zhe sa'i bsdus ming/
/ 1) gdon 'dre'i rigs shig / sri langs pa/ 2) ser sna/ 3) dus tshod nges can zhig gi rkyen ngan nam bar chad/
gnod byed gdon gzugs kyi rnam pa 'brub khung gru gsum gyi nang du sba gnon gyi cho ga/

(tha dad pa) bsris pa, bsri ba, sris,, 1) 'gro song spyod mkhas byed pa/ dus tshod sri ba/ mi shugs bsri tshad/ mang myur legs sri/ don med chud zos su mi gtong bar bsri ba/ 2) skyil ba/ gcin sri ba/ mchin par chu bsris pa/
bkur sti dang zhabs 'degs/ sri zhu legs par zhus pa/ rang bzhin gyis yid gzhungs shing sri zhur brtson pa/
rgyun du nor rdzas chud zos su mi gtong ba'i thabs byed pa/
ras bal las bzos pa'i skud pa/
sring skud dkri byed kyi 'khor lo/
sring skud kyis btags pa'i ras cha sogs/

(tha dad pa) bsrings pa, bsring ba, srings,, 1) ring du gtong ba/ ko thag ring du bsrings pa/ tshe sring ba/ dus yun ring du sring ba/ 2) spel ba/ pha mas phru gu skyed sring ba/ 3) skur ba dang spring ba/ yi ge bsrings kyang 'byor lan ma byung/ 4) 'phen pa/ thag ring du bsrings pa/
spun bu mo gzhon pa/ ming sring/ ming gi rnam grangs la lcam mo dang che zhe'o,
pha ma gcig pa'i bu'i spun bu mo rgan pa/

/ 1) 'jig rten nam spyi tshogs kyi bya gzhag / rgyal srid/ chos srid/ nang srid/ dmangs srid/ nor srid/ 2) dkyus/ srid ring ba/ srid thung ba/ bdag gis dang por shing 'di'i srid nga nyid kyi lus tshad tsam du mthong ngo/
sngar bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan gtso bo'i ming/
1) brgya byin gyi bu/ 2) dkar po/ 3) shak ya mu ne dang dus thog gcig la byung ba'i skad grags can gyi rtsis rig pa zhig /
rgyal khab bam srid tang zhig gis lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can zhig gi lam phyogs mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bya spyod kyi tshad gzhir zer/
gral rim zhig gam, rim gras shig gam, tshogs pa zhig mtshon byed yin par ma zad, de'i khe phan sgrub ched du 'thab rtsod byed pa'i chab srid kyi rtsa 'dzugs shig kyang yin/
1) shin tu 'byung dka' ba'i don/ 'jig rten thog lo brgya lhag brtan mkhan gyi mi srid mtha' ma bkag pa tsam yin/ 2) 'khor ba'i mtha' 'am mjug /
gnas pa'i gzhi shes: thabs snying rje chen pos zin cing mi rtag sogs bcu drug gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/
yod do cog ste yod tshad/
chab srid kyi bya ba byed mkhan/

1.rung ba dang btub pa/ bde sdug legs nyes ci yang 'byung srid pa/ snga ma'i lo rgyus dang gtam dpe tshang mar mi srid pa yin/ nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig tu mthong thub pa ni srid pa tsam yin/ yon tan slob pa'i dus na sdug bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ rdo gor mor me tog skye mi srid/ 2. 1) 'khor ba/ 'chi srid/ bar srid/ skye srid/ srid pa'i 'khor lo/ 2) rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags brtas nas tshe phyi mar khams gsum du skye ba/ 3) yod pa'i don te rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan bcu pa/ 4) (mngon) 1,sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i sa gsum yod pas grangs gsum mtshon/ 2,'dod gzud kyis phye ba'i lha la brgyad dang, skye gnas kyis phye ba'i dud 'gro la bzhi, mi dang dmyal ba ste srid pa la bcu bzhi yod pas grangs bcu bzhi mtshon/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, 'jig rten na yongs grags kyi rgyu bzlog nas, ma grags pa'i phyi nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad tsam gyi 'bras bu ston pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam grangs gsum ni, phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can, nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can, nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can, 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can rnams so/

lha dgu : 'o de gung rgyal la bu brgyad byung ste, yar lha sham po, gnyan chen thang lha, rma chen sbom ra, sgyogs chen ldong ra, sgam po lha rje, zhogs lha rgyug po, jo bo g.yul rgyal, she'u kha rag rnams so, 'di dag stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang, bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi, smad mdo khams sgang gsum ste bod kyi stod smad bar gsum la gnas so/
srid pa'i gnas 'dir las kyi dbang gis slar skye ba len mi dgos pa'i phyir na srid pa tha ma pa ste, nyan rang dgra bcom 'thob ka ma'i gang zag dang, sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams/
lha, mi, dud 'gro , yi dwad, dmyal ba, bar do, las kyi srid pa bcas bdun/
sho lo ka bdun cu pa, rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang, d'a na shi la dang, lo tsa ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'o/
bar srid kyi ming ste 'chi srid dang skye srid kyi bar du grub pas na srid pa bar ma zer/
bar srid kyi ming ste skye srid 'tshol ba'i ngang tshul can/
sngon dus kyi srid pa dang, 'chi srid, bar srid, skye srid de bzhi/
bul kyang srid par lan bdun du 'khor rjes dgra bcom pa thob pa'o/
srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig
gzugs med khams bzhi dang, gzugs khams bcu drug 'dod khams bcu gcig bcas so/

1) sa 'og dang, sa steng, sa bla bcas gsum/ 2) skye srid dang, 'chi srid, bar srid bcas gsum/ 3) sngags rnying ma'i lugs ltar na lus snang ba 'dod pa'i srid pa, ngag phyed snang gzugs kyi srid pa, yid mi snang gzugs med pa'i srid pa ste gsum mo/ 4) lha'i srid pa dang, klu'i srid pa, mi'i srid pa'o/
spar kha brgyad dang, sme ba dgu sogs bris pa'i thang ga / ho...

dgon pa dang lha khang khag gi sgo 'phyor 'og bris pa'i ri mo zhig gi ming ste zlum skor phyi nang bzhi yod pa'i dkyil du, 'dod chags, zhe sdang, gti mug gsum mtshon byed du, phug ron, sbrul, phag pa gsum gyi gzud brnyan dang, de'i phyi la bde 'gro dang, ngan 'gro'i 'gro lam mtshon byed lam dkar nag gnyis, de'i phyi la cha lnga bgos pa'i steng gi cha gnyis, lha dang mi'i 'jig rten, 'og gi cha gsum gyi dkyil du dmyal ba, g.yas su dud 'gro , g.yon du yi dwags, de'i phyi la rten 'brel bcu gnyis mtshon byed, long ba, rdza mkhan, spre'u, gru rdzing, khang stong, mi gnyis 'o byed pa, mig la mda' phog pa, chang 'thung ba, shing tog len pa, sbrum ma, phru gu skye ba, mi rgad po dang shi ba'i ro bcas bris yod/
chu bo bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, khams gong ma'i ma rig pa dang lta ba ma gtogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/
khams gong ma gnyis kyi 'dod chags te de dag 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral zhing yang srid par 'phen pa'i 'dod chags yin no/
(yul) 1) lugs par bzo byed kyi bye ma/ 2) dus snga rabs nas yod pa'i bye ma'i phung po/
lus kyi dbang po dang, rnam shes, phung po, pho mo'i dbang po bcas kyi rten gnas su gyur pa'i rtsa/
phra rgyas sam nyon mongs pa/

che rnam bzhi: klad pa la gnas pa'i dbang po yul la 'char ba byed pa'i rtsa dang, snying la gnas pa'i dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa, lte ba la gnas pa'i lus kyi phung po chags par byed pa'i rtsa, mtshan ma la gnas pa'i bu tsha rigs rgyud 'phel bar byed pa'i rtsa bcas so/
srid pa gsum gyi yang rtse/
zag pa bzhi'i ya gyal, khams gong ma'i ma rig pa dang lta ba las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/
nyi mas srang khyim spyod pa'i zla ba'am hor zla dgu pa/
rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang gses, len pa'i rkyen gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas yang srid mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i las stobs dang ldan pa mngon du byed pa'o/
srid pa'i yan lag gi bag chags
las dge ba dang mi dge ba'i bag chags te, srid pa'am 'khor bar skye 'chi sna tshogs sgrub par byed pa'i nus pa'o/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs kyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i blon po che shos/
chab srid kyi dbang cha/ srid dbang sger gcod/ srid dbang sger 'dzin/ srid dbang 'dzin pa/ srid dbang 'dzugs lugs/ srid dbang rdzus ma/

dpe'i rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, dpe'i dngos po las rang gi gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i dngos po 'byung mi srid pa bzhin du dpe can gyi dngos po las kyang rang gi gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i dngos po 'byung mi srid pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig /
srid pa'i rtse mo'i bsdus ming,
gzugs med snyoms 'jug bzhi'i ya gyal, 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/

par 'gro ba: gong du 'pho ba gang tshangs ris nas tshangs chen ma gtod pa 'bras bu che ba'i bar thams cad brgyud cing, de nas gzugs med bzhi rim gyis song nas mthar srid rtse'i rten la 'da' ba'i rigs can no/
1) rgyal po'am blon po chen po/ 2) srid don gyi 'go 'dzin pa/ 3) bu chung gso ba'am srung ba/
srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin pa/ srid 'dzin tang/ srid 'dzin las khungs/ srid 'dzin sa khul/
srid pa 'khor ba dang, zhi ba myang 'das zer ba'i bsdus ming/
kyi sbyor ba: sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das gnyis rang bzhin med par rtogs nas sgom pa'i sbyor ba'o/
1) srid pa 'khor ba dang, zhi ba myang 'das gnyis kyi bde ba dang skyid pa/ 2) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung bka' shag gi las tham lte ba'i kha ris kyi tshig gzhi/ 3) kha btags led gras shig /
rgyal khab kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyi lag bstar las khungs te rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin las khungs la zer/ mi dmangs srid gzhung/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gong ma'i srid gzhung/
sngar rgyal po rnams kyis srid skyong ba'i lo ming/
«atharbabed:» sngar rgya gar bram ze'i chos lugs kyi gzhung bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste bgegs dbang zhi byed kyi drag las ston pa'i rig byed/
srid pa gsum gyi bsdus ming,
srin bu las byung ba'i skud pa ste dar skud/
pho ba dang long ga'i gnas su srin bu dang be snabs lhan du dru bur 'dril ba'i skran gyi ming/
1) mig dang rna ba'i bar gyi srin tshang ngam ya khung zer ba/ 2) srin bu'i tshang/
1) sdom dang 'dra ba'i gdug 'bu zhig ste mi la so btab na 'chi bar 'gyur ba/ 2) srin bu me khyer/
glang 'thab rigs bzhi'i nang tshan pho long sogs su srin khros pa'i glang 'thab shig /
srin nad la phan pa'i sman nam, srin bu gsod pa'i sman/
pags nad kyi rigs thor pa rtse dkar zhing nag po 'byung ba zhig /
khong srin dang, mgo srin, pags srin sogs lus kyi srin bu nad du gyur pa'i ming/

«rakshasa:»...1) gdug 'dre spyi'i ming/ srin po lang ka mgrin bcu/ bu 'di ni srin po lta bur bzhin dang skra dmar zhing mche ba dang ldan pa'i mtshan ltas ngan pa zhig go / ming gi rnam grangs la kun gsod dang, mkha' 'gro skyes, mgrin dmar can, sgra sgrog thun mtshams stobs, 'bod sgrog mi la 'tshe, mig dmar, mtshan rgyu, mtshan spyod, sha rjen za, sha za khrag 'thung, ro zan, bsod nams skye bo bcas so, 2) (mngon) gter dgu la srung ba po srin po dgu yod pas grangs dgu mtshon, bshad srol gzhan zhig la langka'i grong khyer dgu'i bdag po srin po dgu yod pas grangs dgu mtshon/ 3) shing yos lo/

srin po'i rgyal po, srin po ni mi sha za mkhan rnga yab gling sogs su yod pa mi'i bye brag cig yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la dga' byed dgra bo dang, mgrin bcu pa, sgra sgrog rgyal po, dal 'dzin rgyal, gdong bcu pa, bden bral gtso bo, nor sbyin gcung po, gnas bzhi pa, 'od yangs bu, ra ba na, langka'i bdag po, gsod bdag skyes, bsod nams skye bo'i dbang phyug lho nub phyogs skyong bcas so,
mi ngan mi bzang du brdzus pa'i dpe/
srin bu yod pa'i phol mig gi rma/
srin bu las byung ba'i bal/
srin bal stan gyi spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rin thang can gyi dngos po srin bal lta bu las grub pa'i 'khor gsum khebs pa'i mtha'i tshad du longs pa'i stan byed pa'o/
'bu srin te srog chags phra mo/ rgyu srin/ khong srin/ srin bu me khyer/ dar srin/
pho srin glang 'thab zer ba'i nad/
dus tshigs shig ste hor zla gnyis pa'i dbugs thob nas 'bu srin dbugs rgyu, dpyid kyi rlung chen ldang, rtsi shing kha 'bus pa'i dus tshigs yin/
(rnying) 'bu'i bye brag cig ste me khyer/
klad pa'i nang du gnas pa'i srin bu phru mo zhig ste, 'di nad du gyur na brgyal gzer du 'gyur/

mtshan mo grod pa nas me 'od 'tsher ba'i sbrang bu zhig / srin 'bu me khyer gyis nyi ma la 'gran pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dkar 'od dang, mkha' snang, nyin mi gsal, nam mkha'i mu khyud, nam mkha'i 'od, 'od kyi sa bon, 'od can, lam 'od bcas so,
ma ru rtse'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
(mngon) srog chags sdig pa rwa can/
srin bu langs pa'i mo nad

mngal gyi srin bu ma ra ka dang, a so ka khros pa'i nad de, nad rtags su mtshan ma g.ya' zhing, nu ma dang rked pa sogs na ba dang, sha 'phral du skem zhing, skyes pa dang 'phrad snying 'dod pa bcas so/
rgyu ba'i dug rigs kyi nang tshan srin bu a lang ka sogs las byung ba'i dug /
dar 'bu sogs kyis bzos pa'i tshang/
(mngon) grog ma'i tshang ngam grog mkhar/

mtshan mor 'phur skyod byed pa'i bya rigs shig / ming gi rnam grangs la gad mo'i dbyangs ldan dang, 'gal 'du'i rdzun can, nyin mo yib, nyin mor dga' bral, 'byung po'i bya, mig ser can, ser skya'i lta byed bcas so,
sha za mi'i bye brag srin mo/
sngar gyi bshad srol du bod yongs kyi sa dpyad de srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel 'dra'i dbyibs lta bur yod ces gsal/
lho kha sa khul khongs mtsho sna rdzong 'og mon yul khul gyi dgon pa zhig srong btsan sgam pos btab pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang gses shig tu bshad/
1) mig dang rna ba'i bar gyi ya khung sha kong kong yod sa/ 2) srin bu yod pa'i tshang/
lag pa'i mthe bo nas mar brtsis pa'i mdzub mo bzhi pa ste ming med kyang zer/
khang pa phan tshun bar thog steng nas 'gro sa'i zam pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang gnyis dngul gyi srin zam gyis sbrel ba/

lus la lhan skyes su mchis pa'i srin bu'i rigs bcu gcig ste, phyi srin la shig sro dang, nang gnas la pho ba'i bad srin, mkhris srin la so srin mig srin, pags srin, gzhang srin, rgyu srin, mtshan ma'i srin, khrag srin, klad srin ya ma dkar nag gnyis, rlung srin long la gnas pa bcas so/
mthe bong nas mar brtsis pa'i sor mo bzhi pa/
srin lag gi rtsa ba'i tshigs nas mkhrig ma'i phyogs su tshon gang gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i gtar rtsa zhig ste, de gtar na pho tshad dang, rgyu gzer sogs la phan/
snod drug gi ya gyal long ga'i g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyi gnas stangs la brten nas khrag long dang rtsam long, srin long zhes dbye bas 'dir lus kyi g.yon ngos kyi long ga'i cha shas la'o/
stong skud kyi rgyu cha bzo mkhan dar 'bus za ba'i shing/

shing sman gyi rigs shig ste, yul skad du stag bu chung dang ko blangs pa yang zer bas lo sdong khanda byas na srin nad sel, 'bras bus khong srin la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la ko blangs pa dang, stag chung pa, stag bu chung, dza ya dkar po bcas so,
mun rub dang mun 'thibs/ mun srib/ ri'i nyin srib/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtsa mda' rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
gdags khri btsan po dang srib lha sngon mo gnyis kyi sras, sngar gyi bod rgyal bdun pa ste gnam gyi khri bdun gyi ya gyal zhig /
1) grib ma nag yo re ba/ 2) srib kyi ri nag chag ger yod pa/
srib rir skyes pa'i nags tshal lam, nyi 'od mi phog pa'i sar skye ba'i nags tshal/
(tha mi dad pa) rub pa dang 'thib pa'am sgrib pa/ sa srib pa/ na bun srib pa/
nyi 'od mi phog pa'i nags tshal/
nyi 'od mi phog pa'i lung pa/
'bu mug pa'am, 'bu mug ma, snam phying sogs bal gyis bzos pa'i dngos po rnams za ba'i srog chags shig /
(yul) ri mo'i me tog la dmar mdangs 'don byed kyi tshos shig /
a ma'i spun bud med kyi rigs/
srung bar byed pa'i skud pa/
lam bar gnod pa srung ba'i phyir 'gro rogs byed pa/
srung zhing skyong ba/ mi phyugs srung skyong/ phru gu srung skyong byed pa/
srung zhing skyob pa/ spyang ki la srung skyob, rkun ma la dpa' dar/
rdzas sngags dmigs rim sogs kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo/
dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang dbang bskur ba sogs kyi sngon du steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur khang gis mtshams bcad pa'o/
rang sa srung zhing pha rol po 'gog pa/ ang gsar 'bad len gyis srung 'gog byed pa/
mtshon sogs kyi gnod pa srung phyir sngags btab pa'i skud pa sogs mdud pa can dad mos byed mkhan gyi ske la 'dogs rgyu zhig /
nyes skyon mi yong phyir srung ba dang 'doms par byed pa/
khas blangs pa'i don las mi 'gal bar srung zhing sdom par byed pa/

1. (tha dad pa) bsrungs pa, bsrung ba, srungs,, 1) skyob pa dang skyong ba/ 'gog srung/ gsang srung/ lus srung/ tshe srung/ bde thang srung ba/ bde 'jags srung ba/ sgo srung/ khyim srung rgyal skyob/ rgyal mtshams srung ba/ 2) gnod 'tshe 'gog pa'am zlog par byed pa/ bar chad las srung ba/ gnod 'tshe las srung ba/ srog gi 'jigs pa las srung ba/ 3) brtsi 'khur byed pa/ tshul khrims srung ba/ khas len dam bca' srung ba/ sgrigs lam srung ba/ rnying srol srung ba/ bka' don brtsi srung/ 2. skyob byed/ srung ba btags pa/ srung ba byed pa/
mang bkur sde ba gsum gyi ya gyal zhig /
1) dgra bo sogs srung mkhan/ 2) (mngon) srin po/
1) dgra bo sogs srung byed/ 2) (mngon) 1, nyi ma/ 2, zla ba/ 3, lcags ri/ 4, go mtshon sogs/
rang sa srung mkhan dmag mi/
khrims lugs srung zhing bka' la brtsi 'jog / srid jus la srung brtsi byed pa/ srung brtsi zhu ba/
gegs bar dang mtshon sogs srung ba'i rdzas cha/
1) dam du 'dzin pa'i bsam pa/ 2) 'tsho ba'am bya ra byed pa'i sems/
bsrun po yang zer, zhi zhing dul ba dang g.yung ba/ rta mchog srun po/ zhum bu srun po/ blo mi srun pa/

sngo sman gyi rigs shig ste, ro tsha, zhu rjes drod, nus pas rma rul ba gcod, skran nad bshig me drod gso, chu ser 'dren/ ming gi rnam grangs la rtsa ta ra dang, rtsa srub ma, srum ma, ra srus bcas so,
'o ma sogs srub byed kyi srub shing 'then thag /
ja mdong dang 'o ma srub snod/
(tha dad pa) bsrubs pa, bsrub pa, srubs,, 1) dkrogs pa/ 'o ma bsrubs nas mar bton pa/ ja bsrubs ma srubs shig / yid srub/ 2) rdar ba/ gtsub shing bsrubs nas me byung/
1) 'o ma dang ja sogs dkrog byed/ 2) (mngon) 1, nyi ma/ 2, gru'i skya ba/
/ 1) mdong mo'i rgya lo/ 2) bar srub/
srub byed dam, dkrog byed kyi shing/

1. srub pa'i skul tshig 2. bar mtshams sam gseng/ tshem srubs/ gyang gi ser ga'i srubs dbar/ rma kha'i srubs/ phyag las srubs dbar byung dus/ srubs bsgrigs/ srubs 'gog pa/ srubs dod/ srubs sdom/ srubs phye/
ser ga / srubs ka zub pa/
dbur rdel lam, dbur ti ste tshem bu ba'i yo byad cig
sgo sogs kyi bar srubs sam, gseng dbar/ srubs dbrag seng po/
tshem srubs mi mngon pa'i gos bzang khyad par ba zhig /
tshem bu'i srubs bar du gtong ba'i tshangs/ srubs zan gtong ba/
gas srubs bar du 'jug rgyu'i shing/
bar srubs 'gog byed kyi lhan pa/
smin la khad pa'i gro nas kyi 'bru rdog gsar pa/ snye ma'i 'bru ma smin pa'i srus lcag gi lcig gi/ ming gi rnam grangs la byis pa'i bza' bya dang, rma med, so ma ma nyams pa bcas so,
snye ma'i 'bru ma smin pa'i srus kyis bskol ba'i thug pa/
lo tog gi snye tshad longs pa'i 'bras bu med pa kha dog nag po can/
thab snod kyi mthil du chags pa'i nag dreg /
(tha dad pa) bsres pa, bsre ba, sres,, spel ba'am 'dre bar byed pa/ nya nyung mnyam bsre/ 'o ma'i nang chu bsres pa/ cha gnyis sre ba/ skad cha'i nang la rdzun bsres, bzang po'i nang la ngan bsres/

(tha dad pa) bslang pa, bslang ba, slongs,, 1) sgreng ba dang ldang du 'jug pa/ dar chen slong ba/ mal nas bslangs pa/ ryal mtshan gyen du bslng ba/ nad ro rnying pa slong ba/ khang pa'i rtsig rmang slong ba/ kha slong ba/ 'ben slong ba/ 'khrug rkyen slong ba/ gcig ngar gcig slong/ chags sgo slong ba/ dmag 'khrug slong ba/ 2) don du gnyer ba dang gzhan la re nas zhug ba/ lto gos bslangs pa/ bsod snyosm slong ba/ bag ma slong ba/ chang bslangs pa/ slong skad 'don pa/ slong ba po/ slonbg bas 'tsho ba/
dad sogs dge ba'i sems gyis kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi las rnams/
long ba dang sprang po lta bu mi gzhan gyi sa nas 'tsho ba slong ba la dge ba slong ba zhes pa'i ming btags pa'o/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rang la chos gos rnam gsum yod bzhin du 'khor gsum khebs pa'i tshad du longs pa'i gos sam rgyu nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa las slong ba'o/
rtsa nyon dang nye nyon sogs kyis kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi las thams cad/
(mngon) 1) bye'u khug rta/ 2) khang bye'u/ 3) rtsangs pa kha ral/
kha mchu bar 'dum byas chog pa zhes sngar phul snyan zhu phyir 'then zhu ba/
/ 1) bsod snyoms dang ldom bu/ slong mo ba/ slong mo slong ba/ 2) bud med sprang po/

(tha dad pa) bslad pa, bslad pa, slod,, lhad 'jug pa dang skyon sre ba/ nam mkha'i rang mdangs sprin gyis bslad/ mi gshis bzang po ngan pas bslad/ kha zas zhim po ham dris bslad/ gzugs po bde thang nad kyis slod/

1.(tha dad pa) bslan pa, bslan pa, slon,, 1) sdud pa dang sbyor ba'am zla sgril gtong ba/ tshu rol gyi mi rnam pha rol gyi mi tsho'i zla bor bslan pa/ zhum bu dd 'gro'i phyogs su bslan/ lcags rag zangs gsum lcags rigs su bslan chog / 2) tshem bu rgyag pa/ lhan pa legs par slon/ 3) yul 'grim pa'am bskor ba/ dgun lho bal bslan, dbyar byang 'grog bslan nas nyo tshong byas/ 2.(rnying) skyugs pa/
shes yon slob pa dang, 'tsho bas skyong ba/
slong sbyong byed sa'i khang pa/
yon tan slob tshul gyi khad par ram go
slob sbyong gi nang don ngo sprod byed pa/
slob sbyong byed sa'i gnas khang/ slob grwa grol ba/ slob grwa sgo dbye'i mdzad sgo/ slob grwa chags yul/ slob grwa nas thon pa/ slob grwa'i sgrigs lam/ slob grwa'i slob gso/ slob grwa ba/
byis pa rnams la thog ma'i shes yon slob gso byed sa'i slob grwa yin zhing, der byis pa rnams la sgo kun nas gzhi rtsa'i slob gso gtong sa/
rigs lam mtho gras slob gso byed sa'i slob grwa ste, slob grwa che mo'am, slob grwa chen po'ang zer/
slob grwa'i nang slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i mi ste slob ma'am slob phrug kyang zer/
lo chung byis pa shes yon 'bring gras slob gso byed sa'i slob grwa/
mnyam du slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi grogs mched/

slob ma gcig nas de'i slob ma sogs mtha' ma'i slob ma'i bar du mar 'ded pa'i brgyud rim la slob brgyud zer ba dang, bla ma gcig nas de'i bla ma sogs thog ma'i bla ma'i bar du yar 'ded pa'i brgyud rim la bla brgyud zer/
yon tan sbyong brdar don gnyer/ slob gnyer skab shor/ slob gnyer ba/ slob gnyer ba yag po/
shes yon slob par don gnyer byed mkhan te slob grwa ba'ang zer/
bslab bya brgyab nas mdzub ston byed pa/
slob sbyong byed pa'i dus tshod/
slob sbyong byed rgyu'i dpe deb/

1.(tha dad pa) bslabs pa, bslab pa, slobs,, gzhan las yon tan slob pa'am gzhan la yon tan slob pa/ nga la slob/ ngas bslab/ lus rtsal bslabs/ legs par bslobs shig / ma bslabs pas mi shes/ shes yon slob 'dod pa/ 2. 1) bslab bya/ bka' slob/ 2) mthong lam dang thos lam la gnas pa/ nyan thos slob pa/ rang rgyal slob pa/ byang sems slob pa/ 3) (rnying) 'bul ba/
slob pa phyir mi ldog pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, srid zhi gang du yang mi ltung bar nges pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa rnams so/
1) yon tan slob mkhan dge rgan/ 2) shing bzo ba'i thig shing/ 3) «a'atsrya» rang gi slob ma la chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas phan 'dogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/
dge rgan gyis yon tan sbas nas mi slob pa/
rnal 'byor gyi 'jug sgo'i dbang bcu gcig las, slob dpon gyi dbang drug ste phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang, gsang ba'i dbang, rjes gnang, lung bstan, dbugs dbyung, gzengs bstod de drug go /
bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i ya gyal zhig ste, las kyi slob dpon dang, gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gnyis dngos su zhugs pa'o/
'dul ba nas bshad pa'i slob dpon lnga ste, dge tshul gyi slob dpon dang, gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon, las kyi slob dpon, gnas sbyin pa'i slob dpon, klog gi slob dpon/

dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa'i slob dpon dang, bzlas lung sbyin pa'i slob dpon, rgyud bshad pa'i slob dpon, man ngag ston pa'i slob dpon, dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon, las byed pa'i slob dpon bcas drug /
slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi dge phrug /
slob ma'am, dge phrug gam slob phrug /
chos zhu myong ba'i slob ma/
shes yon gyi gnas la don gnyer byed pa/ nyin mtshan kun tu slob sbyong la brtson 'grus byed pa/ dka' spyad kyis slob sbyong byed pa/
bslab bya tshul bzhin du len mkhan dge phrug / bla slob/ dpon slob/ dge slob/ dngos slob/ zhal slob/ yang slob/ slob ma skya bo/ slob ma rab tu byung ba/

du 'jug pa: slob ma la dngos su dbang bskur ba'i nye ba'i sngon 'gro ste, gdong g.yogs dang bcas te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa phyi 'jug dang, nang 'jug dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du gzhug pa'o,
slob ma nyan thos kyi lam
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, lam shes gang zhig gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i nyi tshe ba'i mkhyen pa ste, nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes so/

dbang gi sta gon gyi cho ga ste, kun slong bcos shing nang dbang bskur ba, gsol ba gdab cing 'dzin du gzhug pa, sdom pa gzung zhing byin gyis brlab pa, dngos grub brtag phyir so shing dor ba, ngag nyes sbyang phyir khyor chu blud pa, rmi ngan bzlog phyir ku sha gtad pa, bar chad zhi phyir dpung skud gdags pa, spro ba bskyed phyir chos bshad pa, mtshan ltas brtag phyir rmi lam brtag pa rnams so/
slob ma byar 'os pa'i khyad chos sam mtshan nyid bzhi ste mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang, mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus, gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gsung rab, bshes gnyen la dad gus/

bshes gnyen 'tshol ba la skyo ba med pa dang, sku lta bas chog mi shes par bya ba, des bstan pa dang rjes su mthun par 'dzin pa, de'i thabs mkhas spyod pa la mi khro ba, de las rtogs pa thebs par bgyi ba bcas so/
rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'jug sgo dbang bcu gcig las slob ma'i dbang lnga ste rig pa'i dbang lnga'o/
blo gzu bor gnas pa dang, blo gros ldan pa, don gnyer che ba, gus pa, yid gtod pa/
blo gsal ba dang, shes 'dod, bla mar gus pa/
thar pa cha mthun dang, nges 'byed cha mthun, don mngon rtogs, rjes la mngon rtogs/
dge rgan gyis slob rgyu dang, dge phrug gis shes pa'i 'gan len/
1) mi la bslab bya byas pa/ 2) slob sbyong gi don gnad bshad pa/ 3) lam 'bras slob bshad kyi bsdus ming,
slob sbyong byed pa'i dus tshod kyi bar seng/
slob sbyong la zhugs ma thag pa'am, slob sbyong byas ma thag pa'i mi/
shes rig gong du spel thabs sam, go rtogs mtho ru gtong ba'i bslab bya/
(yul) brjod pa'am bshad pa/ kha brdar slos pa/
(rnying) 1) ma tshor ba/ 2) myur ba/ gsag gis 'gro ba/
par rko ba'i yig ris dngos gzhi rko spyad cig /
(rnying) bang brgyugs te mchong ba/ gsag gsir sgra/
lus sogs kyi bar seng, sems can rnams kyi lus khog nang du bar seng du ma yod pa de dag don snod dang 'brel med pas bu ga brtol kyang srog nyen mi yong/
gsang ba'i sgo nas brda gtong ngam, glod 'then byed pa'i skud pa/ gsang skud 'then pa/
1) gsang ba'i khang pa/ 2) gsang spyod dam, phyi sa khang/
1) bshang lam/ 2) gsang spyod kyi bshang gci 'dor sa'i bug pa/
gal che zhing gsang ba dam po/ gsang rgya 'grol ba/ gsang rgya bsdams pa/
gsang gnas kyi gsham du 'phyang ba'i sgro ba ste, skyes pa'i rlig pa'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /

shes rab stong pa nyid dang thabs snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes te, gsang zhing sbas pas 'grub la, snod min rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pas gsang sngags zhes bya'o/
gsang sngags kyi khyad chos bzhi

rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa khyad du 'phags pa'i chos bzhi ste, mthar 'bras sangs rgyas don du gnyer bar gcig pa yin kyang, lam gyi 'jug sgo dbang skur ba sngon du song nas lha sgom zhing sngags bzla ba sogs thabs kyi cha la ma rmongs pa dang, gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun par bya spyod rnal 'byor sogs rgyud sde'i dbye sgo mtha' yas pa'i phyir thabs mang ba dang, dka' thub sogs tshegs chen po la ma stos par thabs kyi spyod pas dka' ba med par sa lam bgrod pa dang, dbang rnon theg pa chen po'i rigs can gyi yul du gyur pa rnams/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'chang gis ji ltar gsungs pa'i bcas pa las mi 'da' bar nyams su len pa'i khas len dam bca'/
gsang sngags kyi gdul bya bzhi
gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyis gdul bar bya ba'i yul ni rigs bzhi ste, lta ba dang, dgod pa, lag bcangs, gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa ste 'dod yon la chags pa lam du byed tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi'o/

rdo rje 'chang gis 'di dang 'di bya dgos so zhes gsungs pa ltar mi byed pa dang, 'di dang 'di mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa las ldog nas byed pa'i nyes spyod rnams bsrung zhing sdom par byed pa'i tshul khrims/
gsangs sngags kyi chos nyams su len mkhan/

gsang sngags kyi chos bstan bya'i yul lam gdul bya'i gang zag ste, 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa'i lam la 'jug pas dbang po rno ba dang, dbang gis rgyud smin par byas pa dang, rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung ba ste, mtshan nyid de gsum dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni gsang sngags kyi snod du rung ba'o/
gsang sngags kyi babs so gsum

gangs ri'i khrod du snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang po gnyags dznya na ku ma ra la babs, bar du gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la babs, mtha' mar zur shak ya 'byung gnas la babs, de las gnyags dang gnubs rnam gnyis ni dus rabs brgyad pa dang, zur ni dus rabs bcu par byung/
sa ming zhig ste bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rdza yul rdzong gi ming rnying/
gzungs chen grwa lnga'i nang tshan zhig /

spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor, rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra sogs gdan drangs nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur, de rjes dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs rgya gar nas slob dpon pad ma sam bha ba dang, pan chen bi ma la mi tra sogs rgya gar gyi slob dpon mang po bod du gdan drangs nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur, de nas dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug pandi ta smri ti bod du slebs pa'i bar bsgyur pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams la gsang sngags rnying ma zer/
dus rabs bcu gcig par lo tsa ba rin chen bzang po phyin chad du bsgyur pa'i rgyud rnams/
lo chen rin bzang gi dus tshun du bsgyur pa'i gsang sngags kyi grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan spyi/
1) sba gsang/ gsang cha byed pa/ 2) lkog nas btang ba'i yig cha'am 'phrin/
gcin pa/ gsang chab gsil ba/
gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed
gsang ba'i sgo nas gzhan gyi bya spyod la so lta tshod nyul byed mkhan/
gsang ba'i skad cha'am, snying gtam/ gsang gtam 'grol ba/
gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon

kha skong gi chos dang ldan zhing, 'gro ba bzhi dang bral ba lkog tu bar chad dri ba la mkhas pa dge 'dun gyis gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyi gsang ston du bskos nas bsgrub bya la lkog tu bar chad dris te dge 'dun la go bar byed pa'i dge slong ngo/
gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gyi bsdus ming,
mi mngon par glod 'then byed pa'i thag: pa
gsang ba'i don gnad/ gsang don nang ma/
1) gsang ba'i bdag po/ 2) (mngon) rnam thos sras/
lkog nas gtong ba'i brda/ gsang brda gtong ba/ gsang brda sprad pa/
1) pho mo'i mtshan ma/ 2) gsang ba'i sa gnas/
gi 'khor lo: gsang gnas thad kyi dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar kha mar phyogs pa/
yangs po'am 'khrol po/ skad gsang po/ kha gsang po/
1) bshang gci 'dor sa'i khang pa/ g.yang gral sgrig skabs phyi ma, gsang spyod 'don dus nang ma/ 2) 'khrig pa/
skyid shod smad kyi gsang phu zhes pa'i yul dang dgon pa/
gsang phu ne'u thog dang don gcig
rab byung dang po'i chu glang lor a ti: sha'i dge phrug rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis btab cing rjes su a ti sha'i dge phrug blo ldan shes rab kyis bskyar 'debs byas pa'i dgon pa zhig /
gsang phu ne'u thog dgon par dbyar dus 'tshogs pa'i chos ra/

1.(tha dad pa) gsangs pa, gsang ba, gsongs,, sbed pa dang, gzhan la mi mngon par byed pa/ snying gtam gsang ba/ skyon cha gsang ba/ rgyu nor gsang ba/ brag phug gi nang du gsangs nas yib pa/ dngos po rnyed kyang mi gsang ba/ gsang bar rang mkhas kyang, shod par mi mkhas/ 2.mi mngon pa'i dngos po/ gsang ba sbas pa/ gsang ba khrom bsgrags/ gsang ba phyir grags/ gsang ba'i gtam/ gsang ba'i man ngag / gsang ba'i myul ma/ gsang ba'i zhu sbyor/ gsang lam/ gsang shor/ phyi nang gsang gsum/
1) ha cang gsang ba/ 2) gzhan la mi ston pa'i dngos po'am nang don/
bla med pha rgyud kyi lam dang 'bras bu'i gsang ba'i gnad thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud dang, de'i yi dam zhig
thabs kyi theg pa: ma h'a, a nu, a ti gsum ste rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu'i nang gses shig /
gsang ba zab mo'i dbang gsum

ma h'a yo ga'i 'jug sgo ste, spyod pa'i brtul zhugs can la gsang dbang, rig pa'i brtul zhugs can la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang, mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs can la dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang bcas gsum/
sku'i gsang ba dang, gsung gi gsang ba, thugs kyi gsang ba'o/
1) gang byung la mi ston pa'i gnad 'gag / 2) gsang ba'i gzungs sngags/
gsang sngags ni nyan thos sogs snod min la sba ba'i phyir gsang ba'i theg pa zhes bya'o/
(mngon) 1) rnam thos sras/ 2) phyag na rdo rje/
skyes pa dang bud med kyi mtshan ma'i nad/
lkog tu gdams pa'i bka' dang nang don gyi bslab bya/
gegs sam bar chad de khro ba dang yid mug pa lta bu/

1) mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, bla ma yab yum gyi kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas slob ma'i ngag la bskur zhing ngag gi dri ma dag lam rtsa rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba la dbang, 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog byed kyi dbang/ 2) (mngon) phyag na rdo rje/
mi mngon par sbed pa/ rang gi bsam blo gsang sbed mi byed/
1) gsang ba'i skad cha/ 2) sngags kyi brda skad/
gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur skabs btags pa'i ming/
thugs dgongs su yod pa'i gsang ba'i bang mdzod/ man ngag slob dpon thugs la gnas, dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod lon thabs 'tshal/
sngags lugs kyi bla sprul gyis bsten pa'i bdag mo/
1) sa gnad kyi 'dus mdo/ 2) sba gsang bya sa'i yul/
dge slong gi sdom pa gnang mkhan zhig gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/
gsangs sngags rdo rje theg pa
bya rgyud, spyod rgyud, rnal 'byor gyi rgyud, rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud bcas kyi bstan don 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa/

(tha dad pa) 1) gsan pa, gsan pa, gson,, nyan pa'i zhe sa/ snyan seng gsan pa/ snyan gsan/ nga la tshur gson...a khu spyi dpon rgyal po lags, gson dang zhu rgyu 'di 'dra yod/ 2) tha dad par 'jug pa'i gson pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa,
nyan 'jog / bsam 'char gsan bzhes gnang ba/
kha gsab byed dngos rigs/ 'tsho ba'i gsab cha/ gun gsab/
gsob pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
kha skong gi tshul du bris pa'i tshig kha: shas
g.yi dang 'dra ba la de las cung zad chung ba'i gcan gzan zhig /

/ gang zhig dug gi ri la gnas bcas na, de yi 'dab chags thams cad dug tu 'gyur, gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas na, de yi 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ 2) sdod sa'i khyim tshang sogs bzos pa/ mtha' mtshams su gnas bcas pa/
thon ma thag pa'i dngos po/ gyon gos gsar pa gsar rkyang/ bzo dbyibs gsar rkyang/
1) mi phyugs sogs kyi phru gu/ 2) thol skyes/ dran blo gsar skyes/ yong rkyen gsar skyes/ gsar skyes stobs shugs/ 3) (mngon) lo tog dang me tog sogs kyi myu gu /
gsar du bzo ba/ chu bed gsar skrun byas pa/ 'phrul 'khor gsar skrun byas pa/
gnas tshul gsar pa bkod pa/ gsar 'gyur khang/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan/ gsar 'gyur mdor bsdus/ gsar 'gyur phyogs bsdus/
dri ngad gsar pa/ gyon pa'i gsar ngad/ gsar ngad nyams pa/

1) gnya' gnon myong mkhan gral rim gyis drag po'i bya spyod la brten te srid dbang 'phrog rgyu dang, rul sungs su gyur pa'i spyi tshigs kyi lam lugs rnying pa gtor rgyu, gsar zhing yar thon gyi spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs 'dzugs rgyu bcas so/ gsar brje'i sgul shugs/ gsar brje'i sngon gshegs dpa' bo/ gsar brje'i rten gzhi/ gsar brje'i 'dun pa/ gsar brje'i dmag mi/ gsar brje'i gtso 'dzin/ gsar brje'i las 'gul/ gsar brje'i lo rgyus/ 2) gsar brje'i don snying ldan pa/ bzo pa'i gral rim ni gsar brje'i bsam blo che shos kyi gral rim zhig yin/ 3) rtsa ba nas bcos bsgyur byed pa/ lag rtsal gsar brje/
gsar pa dang rnying pa zer ba'i bsdus tshig /
sngar med kyi thabs tshul gsar du 'don pa/ gsar gtod pa/ lam lugs gsar gtod byas pa/ yig srol gsar gtod/ mtsho lam gsar gtod/
1) ston thog gsar pa/ 2) gsar pa'i sgang ngam gsar dus/
sngar grwa pa gsar zhugs mkhan la smad pa'i tshig
so ma dang dang po/ mi gsar pa/ gyon pa gsar pa/ lo gsar/ mi rnying pa dga', gos gsar pa dga'/ dmag dpung gi bkod pa gsar pa zhig bsgrigs pa/
thon ma thag la gsar ngad ma yal ba/ rlangs 'khor gsar pa gsar rkyang/ gyon pa 'di bzos ma thag pa'i gsar pa gsar rkyang yin/
dang thog med bzhin du gsar skyed byas pa/ khral lugs gsar spros/ dpe dbyibs gsar spros/ sngar med gsar spros/
/ 1) bslab pa gzhon pa/ 2) goms 'dris med pa'i mi/ 3) gzhon nu/
sa zhing tshal zhing sogs gsar du phru slog rgyag pa/ sa stong 'bor chen gsar sbol byas pa/ gsar sbol sa zhing/
/ 1) las don gsar ma/ 2) dus phyis su dar ba'i nang pa'i chos lugs/
lo tsa ba chen po rin chen bzang po man chad gsang sngags kyi rgyud bod du bsgyur pa'i srol 'dzin pa po rnams la gsar ma ba zer/
lo zla zhag dus sogs kyi 'go gsar du shar ba/ gnam lo gsar tshes/ dus rabs gsar tshes/ gsar bzo, gsar du bzo ba/ la lam med la lam bu gsar du bzos, chu zam med la zam pa gsar du btsugs/
gsar du bskrun pa'i dngos po/
'grel bshad zhib gsal brgyab pa/ dpe cha'i nang don gsal bkrol byas pa/
mngon gsal che chung gi tshad/ snang ba'i gsal kha/ don gyi gsal kha/ lan gyi gsal kha/
shes zin pa'i las don gang zhig slar yang bshad nas gsal 'debs byed pa'am gsal por ston pa/
bug pa'am bu ga'i ming/ gyang la gsal khung brtol ba/ shar ngos la gsal khung gcig 'dug /
thun mong du gsal ba'am yongs su thos pa'i skad grags/ mkhas pa'i gsal grags/
rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bsdus tshig
mngon gsal dod pos khyab bsgrags byas pa/
mngon gsal che chung gi tshad/ khang pa'i gsal cha/ gsal cha chung ba/ gsal cha che ba/ gsal cha med pa/
thog mar de yin de min gsal po ma byung ba gang zhig gsal por byung ba/
snang gsal ba'i mchog tu gyur pa...
sgrib med mngon sum/ rang gi bsam tshul gsal rjen du ston pa/
dran gso byas pa'am dran par byas pa/
zhib gsal shes pa/ sa cha'i gnas tshul gsal rtogs byung ba/
ngo bo stong pa dang, rang bzhin gsal ba/
dbyibs dang ye shes dbyer med kyi rig pa/

mched zla ba dang, sgrub byed, be sha kha, bha dra, dbyar zla ra ba, sbrang rtsi skyed, me tog ldan, sa ga zla ba bcas so, hor zla lnga pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la nges sreg dang, 'dod 'phel, snron zla, dbyar zla 'bring po bcas so, hor zla drug pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la kurma dang, chu stod zla ba, bre'i zla ba, dbyar zla tha chung, gtsang ma'i zla ba, tshor ba'i zla ba bcas so, hor zla bdun pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la mkha' sprin can dang, gro bzhin zla ba, ston zla ra ba, nam mkha'i thod ldan, ma ka ra, myos zla, shra ba na, sred pa'i zla ba bcas so, hor zla brgyad pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la rkang pa dang, khyu mchog can, khrums zla, ston zla 'bring po, nor ldan, sprin bzang, ba glang rkang, bha dra ba, bzang po'i zla ba bcas so, hor zla dgu pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la glu dbyangs zla ba dang, rgod ma can, ltad sbyor, ltad mo'i zla ba, ston zla tha chung, tha skar zla ba, dbyug gu gcig pa, mi ki ri, rtsi thog zla ba, srid pa'i zla ba, gsal ba'i bu mo, a shwa ni bcas so, hor zla bcu pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la skye ba'i zla ba dang, karti ka, glu dbyangs can, dgun zla ra ba, mgo las skyes, mang po 'dzin, smin drug zla ba, sa ga skyes bcas so, hor zla bcu gcig pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la rga shi'i zla ba dang, dgun zla 'bring po, mgo zla, smal po'i zla ba, smrag shirsha, tshim byed zla ba, bzod ldan ma, ri dwags mgo, lo'i thog ma bcas so, hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la rgyal zla dang, dgun zla tha chung, nus zla, poo sha, ma rig zla ba, me tog ldan, tshim byed zla bcas so,

rab byung bzhi pa'i me phag lor hor jing gir rgyal pos mi nyag gi lag nas rgyal sa thob pa'i zla bar bkra shis pa'i dga' ston byas pa mchu zla lo gsar du bzung ba dkyus su shor bas, ming la'ang hor gyi zla ba dang por grags zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rtsis dkar nag dris lan las gsungs shing, dus 'khor rang lugs la nag zla sogs nya skar brtsi ba las, dang po gnyis pa sogs ang grangs kyi sgo nas brtsi srol med do, spyir dgun nyi ldog rjes kyi zla ba gnyis pa de lo gsar gyi zla ba dang po dang, de nas gnyis pa gsum pa sogs brtsi ba ni rgya nag zha rgyal rabs kyi rjes 'brangs yin kyang, sog po la brgyud nas bod du dar ba'i rkyen gyis hor zla zhes grags, de yang zla shol 'don tshul lugs gnyis mi 'dra bas skabs 'gar zla ba gcig gi snga phyi yod do/

bod kyi rab byung lnga pa'i sa sbrul lor yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma se chen han gyis re 'dun bton pa ltar 'gro mgon 'phags pas bod yig dper blangs nas bzos pa'i sog yig gsar pa, yig srol 'di bton pa nas bzung rgyal tham gyi kha yig dang, bka' shog tshang ma yig ris 'di'i thog nas 'bri dgos zhes rgyal pos rgyal yongs la gtan 'bebs byas kyang slad yig ris 'di bzhin dar rgyun cher ma byung, sog yig dang tham yig gsar pa bzos pa'i yig phud dang tham phud gcig bod sa gnas kyi gsang phu dgon par yod zer/
rags pa'i 'gro tshul lam ma brtags ma dpyad par gang byung gis 'gro stangs/
ha le ho le/ bya ba hol rgyug kho na byas pa/
/ 1) gos kyi mtha' dang gong ba/ pad ma hwa gor/ 2) (rgya) ri mo/
(rgya) sngar rgya gar gyi skad rigs chen po bzhi'i nang gses rang bzhin gyi skad du kho sha dang, legs sbyar gyi skad du u p'a dhya ya zhes pa ste mkhan po'i skad dod zur chag

rgya nag gi btsun pa'i ming bye brag pa zhig bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sngon tsam la rgya nag kre cang du byung ba'i btsun pa zhig rgyun du ras khug khyer nas su thug la bslangs te 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten thog gnas nges med du sdod cing gtam cha med du smra ba smyon pa'i brtul zhugs can rang nyid rje btsun byams pa'i sprul par smra ba zhig yin, rgya nag gi nang pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo mchor phal che bar hwa shang grod 'phyang ba'i sku 'dra zhig 'bri srol yod pa de btsun pa 'di'i 'dra brnyan yin par grags/
hwa shang ma ha ya na

chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su rgya nag nas bod du yong ste ston mun zhes cig car pa'i lugs spel ba la, dge mi dge'i rnam rtog gang yin yang 'khor bar 'ching byed yin pa dang, ci yang yid la mi byed pa kho nas thar pa thob pa 'dod mkhan zhig yin, 'bro bzas gtsos pa'i bod phal mo che de'i rjes su zhugs, phyis su slob dpon ka ma la shi la dang rtsod pas pham ste, btsan pos hwa shang gi lugs mi byed pa'i bkas bcad pas rgya nag tu log /
bu ram gyi dwangs ma'am bye ma ka ra/
bu ram dang sbrang rtsi sogs mngar cha bsres pa'i kha zas ro ldan/
(yul) sra ba'am tan tig / gzugs po bde thang hra tag tag / las don hra tag tag sgrub pa/
1) las ka 'jon po/ las don go 'pher hra thang thang 'dug / 2) gzugs po thang po/ gzugs po hra thang thang 'dug /

1) hril mo yin la min la te, bzo dbyibs gcig tu ma nges pa'i dngos po chang chung sna tshogs kyi ming/ de ring 'di gar dngos po sgril kha hra le hri le mang po zhig bskyal byung/ 2) (yul) zan ril sla mo phan tshun 'byar stangs shig
nus can dang go 'pher po/ dpung hrag po/ go hrag / rta hrag dmag hrag /

1) mnyen po min pa'i gyong po/ ko ba hrag hrag / ras hrag hrag / gyon pa hrag hrag cig gyon pa/ 2) hrug hrug min pa/ bud shing hrag hrag / mi 'di rnams hrag hrag zhe gcig red/ rin dngul hrag hrag sprad chog / 3) sgra zhig
hrag ge hrug ge ste, rdog chen po med pa'i chung rtsag / rdo hrag hrug / sha hrag hrug /
rtsing zhing rtsub pa/ rtsub cing hrags la mi brtan 'gyur ba yi, yal ga gdan du re ba'i dus shig byung/
gal che phyogs bsdus/ tshig don gal che hrags bsdus zur du bkod/
ha cang gyong po/ ko ba hrang gong/ lag pa hrang gong/ go med hrang gong gi mi la bslab bya byas kyang phan thogs dka'/
rjen ne ba/ gos med dmar hrang nge ba/
mkhregs po/ gnya' hrang tor gyur pa/ lus dang yan lag 'khyags nas hrang tor gyur pa/ mi de gang bshad mi nyan pa hrang to zhig chags 'dug /
(yul) 1) dred po dang rtsing po/ mi hrang po/ bsam pa hrang po/ 2) hreng po dang 'dra,
(yul) 1) ngan lang shor ba/ spyod ngan lang la shor nas hrang ba/ 2) rengs por gyur pa/ ko ba hrang ba/
(rgya) sngar bod kyi sku drag phyogs 'grul skabs gyon rgyu'i zhwa mo zhig /
(yul) 1) ya med pa'i chig rkyang/ kho hrang hrang byas nas phyin pa/ 2) sha skam nas rus pa phyir don pa'i rnam pa/ rtsib ma hrang hrang du don pa/
(yul) lag pa'i sor mos 'brad stangs/ gdong la sbar hrad ma rgyag / sder hrad rgyag pa/
lag pas brad brad byed pa/ bla mas sgo la hrad hrad 'ga' mdzad pa/
rab rib bam gsal po rang min pa/ gzugs hrab hrib cig mthong/
(yul) thang chad pa'i nyams,/ lam thag ring por rkang thang du phyin nas gzugs po hram me hrom mer gyur song/
nas chag gam gro chag gi thug pa/

1./ 1) bar tshags dam po med pa dang zhib po min pa/ yig dbar hral po/ snam bu'i thags hral hral zhig las med/ tshem bu hral po/ so phreng hral ba/ bzhugs gral hral po/ 2) ral po/ gos rtsab hral/ 3) mi srun pa'am ma dul ba dang rtsing po/ sems hral po/ rang gshis hral po/ 2. (rnying) 'chal ba'am 'dod zhen can/
ral pa ral rkyang/ gos hral le hrul le zhig las gyon rgyu med pa/
1) bar gseng che ba/ 2) rtsing po/ rtsam pa hral hral/
1) rnying shing ral ba/ chas gos hral hrul/ 2) ngan ngon nam thabs chag / lto chas hral hrul/ yo byad hral hrul/
gsal sing nge ba/ mig hrig ge bar lta ba/
