rig rig lta ba dang, cer gyis lta ba dang, 'bur tshugs su lta ba dang, grung grung lta ba/ mig hrig hrig gis lta ba/

(tha mi dad pa) 1) ngan lang shor ba/ phru gu la byams drags nas gnya' ba hrings pa/ 2) mnyen po mkhrang du song ba/ dgun dus lag pa hrings pa/ 3) sla ba sra ru song ba/ mar khu hrings pa/ zhag tshil hrings pa/
dus yun thung ngu/ sprin gyis nyi ma hrib tsam zhig la bsgribs song/ tshur hrib tsam phebs rogs/

/ 1) gzugs dbyibs zlum po dang ril po/ dbyibs bod sran ltar hril po zhig red/ hril mor 'dril ba/ 2) thams cad dang, gang po dang, yongs rdzogs dang, cha tshang/ lo hril po/ mi tshe hril po/ rgyu nor hril po/ hril gyis gtum pa/ mi tshe hril po'i gtan grogs/
dbyibs zlum zlum/ ril bu hril le ba chung ngu zhig
dbyibs zlum zlum/ mig hril hril/ zan ril hril hril/
ngam ngam shugs kyis 'gro ba ste, rang gis ngang gis 'gro ba/
1) ril gyis bzlums pa/ 2) mdor bsdus pa/ yi ge thams cad dbyangs gsal gyi nang du hril hril dril ba/
1) dngos po sra ba'i rigs 'cha' ba'am gcog pa'i sgra zhig / rgyus pa hrug ger bldad/ 2) dum bur 'gro tshul zhig / mi rta mang po hrug ger btang ste rgyal kha blangs/
dum bur bcag pa/ rta yis 'phra tho brgyab nas rkang pa hrug chag tu btang ba/
rtsag rtsig gam dum bu chung chung/ lcags hrug / zangs hrug / dras hrug / shing hrug hrug /
1) dkar yol sogs chag pa'i dum bu chung chung/ 2) so yis zas ldad pa lta bu'i sgra/
(yul) mi gsar pa yong skabs rgod mdog byed pa'i krog krog mkhan/ myi hrud dam, myi hrud hrud/
1) rtsub pa/ sag rdar gyi leb ngos hrud hrud po yod pa/ 2) bro ba med pa/ lce'i nus pa nyams na zas hrud hrud por 'gyur ba/
hrob pa'i ldog pa/ sha hrub pa 'tshod bde, rdo hrub pa 'grems bde/
(yul) zhib mor gtub stangs/ tshal hrub hrub yag po zhig gtubs song/
(yul) 'bol 'bol du gtub stangs/ rgya thug hrum hrum du gtub bzhin yod pa/
(rgya) tshwa khu'i nang du bsnyal ba'i sngo tshal zhig gi ming/
nyams gog gi skyon/ gyon pa hrul skyon/ lham gog hrul skyon/
ral po/ rtsab hrul/ ral hrul/ rnying hrul/ gos su ras hrul po gyon/ gos hrul po gyon zhing lag tu 'khar ba thogs pa/
1) rjen ne/ gzugs po dmar hreng nge ba/ 2) ker re/ mi gcig pha gir hreng nger langs 'dug /
/ 1) grogs med kher rkyang/ pho hreng/ mo hreng,/ 2) gos med gcer bu/ gzugs po dmar hreng/ sha mdog sngo hreng/ mi hreng grogs med/
mi sogs rogs zla med pa kher rkyang/
sra mkhregs/ khrag skran hrem po/ skrangs pa hrem me ba/
sa gdan dang kha gdan 'thag byed shing sgrom gyi yas mas gnyis la yod pa'i shing/
zhib pa'i ldog phyogs/ sman hrog pa/ phyur ba hrog pa/ rdo shing hrog hrog /
rtsing ba'am zhib zhib min pa/ snga ma bas rjes ma 'di hrob pa 'dug / phyur ba hrob hrob/ sman hrob hrob rnams zhib mor rdzog pa/ rtsam pa hrob hrob/

/ 1) mi'i rgyal po/ mi'i lha dbang/ yab lha/ lha sras/ 2) sangs rgyas te sngags lam gyi bsgom bya'i yi dam/ lha sgom pa/ lha 'gugs pa/ lha khro bo/ lha zhi ba/ 3) 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang gses shig / lha tshe ring po/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha/ lha dang mi'i 'jig rten/ lha mi'i phun tshogs/ mi 'u thug nas lhar dris, lha 'u thug gis rdzun bshad/ dma' nye bas bcag lha dkon gnyer gyis brdungs/ ming gi rnam grangs la skabs gsum pa dang, mkhar nyal, dge skyes, rgas med, ngag gi mtshon cha, 'chi med, bdud rtsi'i zas can, bde 'gro, 'dod gzugs can, rnam sad, mig mi 'dzum, me sbyin skyes, me zhal, rmi lam med, tshigs mda' can, tshigs bzang, ri yig skyes, legs bris, lha min dgra bo bcas so, 4) (mngon) lha chen la tshangs pa dang, bhringgi ri dhi, drag po, dbang phyug smin drug tshogs bdag legs ldan nag po, bi tri pa tra ste brgyad yod pas grangs brgyad mtshon/

rgya skad la chan lung zhes pa don 'gyur byas na lha skyong ste, ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing yos bar lo drug cu tham pa'i ring khrir bzhugs/

1) lha 'jog sa'i khang pa'am sku gsung thugs rten 'jog sa'i khang pa/ lha khang rnying pa la logs ris gsar pa/ lha khang rnying pa la, gnas bshad gsar pa/ lha khang nang gi mda' mo, bkang sa yod kyang rgyag sa med/ ming gi rnam grangs la kun dga' ra ba dang, dkon mchog pho brang, mchod khang, mchod 'os gnas, dri gtsang khang, 'du khang, gandho la, gtsug lag khang bcas so, 2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod/
la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khang dmar rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
1) lha khang la bdag srung byed pa/ 2) (mngon) dkon gnyer ram lha gnyer/
bzang po'i khog pa ngan pas brlams pa'i dpe/

nyes grib thams cad sel bar mdzad pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa phyag g.yas rgya gram snying khar 'dzin zhing, g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa, zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bgrad pa, khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pa zhig /
dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mkhar rdzong/
lha mi dga' bar khros nas gnod 'tshe skyel ba/
1) gtso 'khor dgu re yod pa'i lha tshogs/ mi 'khrugs lha dgu/ rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ 2) srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i bsdus tshig

rab byung gsum pa'i me rta lor chos rgyal gdung rgyud yar klungs jo bo'i sras su 'khrungs pas lha zhes pa'i ming thob, bka' gdams gzhung pa'i dgon pa 'chad kha dang spyil pu gnyis kyi gdan sa lo ngo nyi shu rtsa bdun bskyangs, kong po dang dwags po sogs kyi dgon pa bcu phrag du ma'i dgon gnyer dang mi dpon bskos par gsol bas bka' gdams pa'i gtsug lag khang phal cher rtsa lag gcig tu dril, 'gro mgon 'phags pas de nyid la bkur sti chen po mdzad, rab byung bzhi pa'i sa lug lor 'das/
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha rtse rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 6457 yod/
sa ming zhig e lha rgya ri'ang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chu gsum rdzong gi ming rnying/
bswo bswo lha rgyal lo ste mgon grogs byed pa'i lha'i dbu 'phang mtho bar gyur cig ces pa'i smon tshig /
lha gsol mchod bya sa'i khang pa/

si khron zhing chen khongs hong yon rdzong gi sa khul zhig sngon rgyal rong so mang rgyal po'i tshogs 'du 'tshog sa dang rta rgyug byed sa yin la, der rgyal po'i par khang yod stabs sa cha de la chos par khang zer, 1958 lo'i gong du rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lte ba de gar btsugs/

lha sgang dgon mthong grol bsam 'grub gling chos sde chen mo zhes pa si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dar mdo mi nyag rab sgang gi char gtogs shar stod bzhag bra dkar po'i mdun zhol du, rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sgo mig rgya nag tu bstan pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i tha mar mi nyag rab sgang du yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha sgang 'di nyid bzhengs par grags la, bshad srol du, rgya bza' kong jo bod du byon skabs yul 'dir bzhugs te jo bo shak ya mu ne'i zhal skyin du lha sgang jo bo 'di bzhengs par grags, chos brgyud thog mar bka' brgyud pa yin zhing, phyis su sa skya pa chags/
bon gzhung du gson po rnams la lha chos sgrub pa'i sgo ste gegs bar chad sel byed kyi cho ga /
lha 'dre sogs kyi gtam rgyud yod pa'i gna' sgrung/
rkang pa'i pus mo'i lha nga'am rus pa 'bur po/ pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs/
lha yul gyi rnga bo che/
1) rgyal po'i bu mo'i zhe ming/ 2) chos lugs kyi mgon skyabs chen por 'bo pa'i zhe ming/
rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs dza tha'i yan gyi mi drag tsho'i bza' zla bud med/
sngar bod kyi lha lcam gyi gzab mchor lus chas/
1) sku rten la g.yogs pa'i gos/ 2) lha spyan 'dren skabs gyon pa'i chas/
1) byin can gyi chu mig / 2) (mngon) chu bo gangga'i ming/
dbang phyug chen po dang, brgya byin, tshangs pa, khyab 'jug 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs bdag bhringgi ri dhi, gzhon nu gdong drug bcas so, 'di'i 'dren tshul gzhan yang yod/
1) lha'i gzugs brnyan chen po/ 2) sangs rgyas shig / 3) tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug sogs/
lha dbang phyug chen po dang don gcig...
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gam pa: rdzong gi byang shar mtshams su yod de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 6155 yod/
1) sangs rgyas kyi chos/ 2) 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge chos/ dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub par blo rtse sgrim/
snga dus bod rje srong btsan sgam pos dge ba bcu gzhir bzung nas bod 'bangs la khrims su bcas pa'i chos lugs kyi rnam grangs shig /
bka' gdams pa'i lha thub pa dang, spyan ras gzigs, sgrol ma, mi g.yo ba bcas bzhi dang, chos sde snod gsum ste mngon 'dul mdo sde gsum mo/
dge bcu'i chos la spyod mkhan/
mchod mchod bstod bstod mang ba'i don/
sngon bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis sman pa rnams la gnang ba'i go thob kyi mtshan snyan zhig /
rjes su dran pa drug gi nang gses, 'dod gzugs kyi lha dang, 'phags pa rnams kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'o/
lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa
sher phyin don bdun cu'i nang gses, kun rdzob tu 'dod gzugs su skyes pa'i 'phags pa'i lha rnams kyi yon tan rim ldan du dran pa'o/
1) lha de nyid dam, lha rang nyid/ 2) rgyal po khyod nyid/
rnal 'byor pas dmigs pa'i sgo nas lha la lha stim pa dang lha rang gzhan la stim pa/
si khron zhing chen gyi chu chen rdzong gi khongs su yod cing, sngar bon dgon yin la, chan lung skabs dge lugs par bsgyur pa'i rgyal rong gi dgon chen zhig /
lha gnas sa'i lcog chung ngam khang chung tsog tsog
lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan

'di'i mtshan tho tho ri snyan btsan dang, tho tho ri snyan shal yang zer, khri rje thog btsan dang ru bza' stong rgyal na mo tsho gnyis kyi sras, bod rgyal gdung rabs nyer brgyad pa yin la, btsan lngar grags pa'i lnga pa'ang yin, rgyal po 'di dgung lo drug cu'i dus mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa dang gser gyi mchod rten khru gang ba sogs 'byor, ngo mtshar che bar ni dgongs, gang yin ni ma mkhyen te, ming gnyan po gsang bar btags nas pho brang gi dkor khang du mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol, bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du bshad do/
zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chab mdo rdzong: khongs zla chu'i yan lag ri chu'i 'gram du yod
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi pa snam rdzong khongs 'dus byung gi shar ngos su yod, de'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas smi 5487 yod/
cha 'jog dka' zhing mthong tshul sna tshogs pa'i dpe/
sgra rig pa sogs la mkhas pa'i bod kyi lo tsa ba zhig ste, dbyangs can sgra mdo bod skad du thog mar sgyur ba po, 'di'i ming ngo ma la bshes gnyen rnam rgyal zer/
kyi ston pa: «shastridebamanushya» sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bcu'i nang gses shig /
1) dbang phyug chen po/ 2) lha khro bo'am gtum po/
pa'i lha dang: sgra'i lha, mtshan ma'i lha, gzugs kyi lha, bsgom pa'i lha, rnam par dag pa'i lha ste drug

bya rgyud kyi lha drug ste, bya ba'i rgyud du lha de kho na nyid rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor nyams su len pa na lha drug gi mtshan nyid du bsdu ste, stong pa'i lha, yi ge'i lha, sgra'i lha, gzugs kyi lha, phyag rgya'i lha, mtshan ma'i lha rnams so/
lha sa'i shar phyogs gtsang po'i g.yas g.yon gyi lha gdong shan kha/
snga dus lha sa'i rgya ma/
snga dus pho mo chang sa'i skabs bzhugs gral grol rjes khang thog tu phyin te bag mar rang khyim nas bskur ba'i khams mthun gyi dar lcog btsugs te lha gsol ba'i don/
phan 'dogs mkhan gyi rigs shig la lha dang, gnod skyel mkhan gyi rigs shig la 'dre zhes su btags pa'o/
kyi rten khog sku rten nam: chos rje/
'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre khog zhugs kyi rten skye dman/
bad kan khams kyis skyed pa'i lgang pa'i rde'u 'gags kyi nad na zug chung ba zhig /

bod rang skyong ljongs khongs lha sa'i grong khyer gyi lte bar yod pa'i lha khang zhig ste dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus rgya bza' kong jos rgya rtsis la brten nas sa dpyad btab pa ltar bal bza' khri btsun gyis bskul nas chos rgyal gyis bkod jus btang thog sgo 'phar nub phyogs su bstan nas btab pa'i 'khor sa phyi nang steng shod khyon la lha khang che chung bdun cu lhag tsam yod, dbus kyi rten gtsor rgya bza'i rten skal du drangs pa shak ya thub pa lo grangs bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dang mthun pa'i jo bo shak ya mu ne dang, thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan, byams pa chos 'khor ma bcas kyis mtshon grub mtha' ris med kyis mchod pa'i lha sku mang po dang sgo 'phyor gyi mdun phyogs su rgya bod shan sbyar gyi yi ge 'khod pa'i rdo ring dang, jo bo'i dbu skrar grags pa'i rgya lcang gi ljon shing chen po zhig kyang yod cing, snga dus lo ltar hor zla dang po'i nang dbus kyi gdan sa gsum gyi dge 'dun khri phrag lhag tsam 'tshogs nas cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus mchod chen mo tshugs yul yang 'di nyid yin/ 823...
lha ldan gtsug lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring

bod rgyal khri ral pa can dang, rgya rje thang rgyal mu'u tsung dbon zhang gnyis kyi mna' dan gan rgya'i yi ge rdo thog brkos te lha sa'i gtsug lhag khang mdun jo bo'i dbu skra'i 'khris su bslangs pa'i rdo ring/ 822...823...
sngar dgon pa khag gi khongs su gtogs pa'i sde 'bangs/
1) sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sger pa'i mi ser dang dgon pa'i bla brang gi mi ser/ 2) dgon pa grwa tshang dang, khyim pa'i grong sde gnyis kyi ming/
lha sar gtan du sdod mi/ lha sdod las khungs/ lha sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag /
lha 'dre 'khon te bskyed pa'i nad rigs/
rnam thos sras te, nor lha shig / lha rnam sras kyi bang mdzod la, 'dre yi dwags kyi dkor gnyer/
dkyil 'khor gyi nang du lha bzhugs sa'i gdan/
snga dus lha 'dre khog zhugs kyi rten khog / lha pa mo pa sgyu ma gsum, 'jig rten khams na rdzun chen gsum/
mi la lha dang 'dre zhugs pa/
1) gus phyag gi che bstod/ 2) lha'i phyag gi bsdus tshig /
rkang rus kyi mgo dang, rtsib ma'i rus mgo sogs la yod pa'i rus pa sob sob khrag rtsi chags pa de'i ming/
1) sangs rgyas lha yul nas mi yul du byon pa/ 2) mi la lha dang 'dre zhugs pa/

mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal lha las bab pa'i mchod rten zhes pa ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sum rtsen du dbyar gnas mdzad de snga dro dgag dbye mdzad, phyi dro 'dzam bu'i gling du bab pa'i tshe yul yangs pa can gsal ldan du bzhengs pa bang rim bzhi'am brgyad pa ngos rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa, glo 'bur gyi dbus na them skas yod pa'i mchod rten zhig go/
/ 1) lha'i bu/ 2) shangs lha bu ste sa cha zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rnam gling rdzong gi byang rgyud du yod/

bod kyi rgyal po rabs bcu pa e sho legs skabs kyi blon po zhig lo rgyus thog gi bshad srol la blon po 'dis chu yur por drangs pa dang, spang zhing du rmod, nyi ma gcig la ga tshod btab thub pa'i zhing kha dum bur bgos, chu la zam pa btsugs, rdo bzhus nas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton pas, bod kyi 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi nang gses shig /
ri la gnas pa'i bya rigs shig / la kha'i kha ba che chung de, lha bya gong mo'i skad la ltos/
rgyal po rab tu byung ba'i ming ste, rgyal po la lha dang rab byung gi rten yin pas bla ma zhes brjod/

'jig rten gyi bdag po phyi nang thun mong gi lha zhal gcig spyan gsum pa, phyag na thod pa dang, khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa, mgrin pa sngo ba, dbu gtsug na zla ba'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa zhig go/ ming gi rnam grangs la khyu mchog rgyal mtshan dang, gangga 'dzin, grong gsum mthar byed, dgra sta'i dum bu, mgul nag mgrin sngon, mgrin pa khra bo, rgyal mtshan 'chang, 'chi las rgyal, steng 'phur dbang po, drag po, dran pa'i dgra, mdung thogs, bde 'byung, nam mkha'i skra can, sna tshogs mig can, pags pa'i gos can, dpal mgrin, phyugs bdag phyogs gos can, dbyig ldan, 'byung po'i mgon, 'byung po'i dbang po, mi bzad mig mi yi khu ba, mig gsum pa, gtsug na zla ba, gtsug phud, rtse gsum can, g.yon gyi lha, ri nyal, srid pa 'jig srid srung 'dzin, gsang ba'i bla ma, lha chen bcas so,
1) rgyal po'i mnga' 'bangs/ 2) sngar bod kyi dgon pa'i mi ser/
mi la lha dang 'dre gzhug tu 'jug pa/
gang sa gang du skyabs sam rogs mgon 'tshol ba'i dpe/
gnyan rims 'brum pa dkar nag rigs gnyis kyi nang nas nad gzhi yang zhing srog nyen chung ba'i 'brum nad dkar po/
lha 'dre khog zhugs kyi rten khog bud med/
lha'i dgra 'thab rtsod la dga' ba thags bzang ris sogs/

lha ma yin gyi bsdus tshig / ming gi rnam grangs la khu ba'i slob ma dang, sngon gyi lha, bcud mi ldan, mchod sbyin dgra bo, da nu'i bu, pa sangs slob ma, dbang po'i dgra, sbyin skyes, sbyin byung, sbyin ma'i bu, gzhu rgyal, gzhu las skyes, sa 'og gnas, gser can bu, lha la sdang, lha las rgan, lhar smod bcas so,
lha ma yin gyi rgyal po/

mngon mtho'i theg pa zhig ste, ngan song la 'jigs nas mtho ris kyi bde 'bras don du gnyer bas mngon par mtho ba'i rten sgrub par byed cing, 'jigs skyob dang legs smon tsam la skyes bu chung ngu'i lam ste, lta ba rnam par dag pa 'jig rten pha rol dang las 'bras la yid ches pa dang, spyod pa mi dge ba bcu spong zhing dge ba bcu'i lam sgrub pa dang goms par byas te, 'bras bu gling bzhi'i mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug gi bde ba'i mthar thug pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po'i bar du bgrod pa'o/
lha dang mi'i 'gro ba rnams thar pa'i gnas su rnam par 'dren pa ste skyes bu dam pa rnams la gsol ba'i mtshan gyi che ba zhig /
/ 1) 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi lha mo/ lha mo ma mnyes khar mgon po khros/ 2) bod kyi zlos gar/
1) sgrol ma drag mo zhig / 2) lha mo khro nyams yod pa thams cad/
lha dbang phyug gi btsun mo u ma/
sangs rgyas shak ya thub pa'i yum/
dpal ldan lha mo'i ming gzhan zhig /
bod kyi lha mo 'khrab mkhan gyi chas/
rgyal ba yum lnga'i ya gyal zhig dang mi bskyod pa'i yum/
lha mo tshe ring mched lnga
tshe ring mched lnga la ltos,
dbang phyug chen po'i btsun mo/
1) lha mo 'khrab dus bud med kyi chas/ 2) lha mo ba'i chas kyi bsdus ming,
rgyal po sogs mi drag rigs kyi sman pa/
1) btsun pa'i che ming/ 2) rab byung gi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i rgyal po/
1) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gtsang gzhis ka rtse'i nub ngos kyi yar klungs gtsang po'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de chu shar du yod/ 2) (mngon) nam mkha'/
'du shes med pa ba dang gzugs med pa gnyis/
rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig / ming gi rnam grangs la lag sor, a nu ra dha, mdza' bo'i lha bcas so,
lha btsugs zhes pa'i 'bri srol yang 'dug khang pa'i thog zur so sor yod pa'i dar shing 'dzugs sa rdo rtsig gru bzhi can/
1) kha btags/ 2) lha'i rin po che/ 3) lha'i dar gos dang rgyan cha yo byad/
snga dus lha sa'i 'degs srang gi gser dngul gyi ljid tshad cig /
1) lha sa dang zhol zer ba'i bsdus tshig / 2) tshe thar du btang ba'i lha g.yag gam khyu pa/

lha bzang han yang snang, gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi yang tsha ming ngo ma lha bzang klu dpal zer, 'dis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug nas de'i me bya (spyi lo 1703-1717) bar lo bcu bzhi'i ring bod sa gnas kyi rgyal po byas nas lo gnyis la slebs skabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang ma mthun par 1705 lor dmag drangs nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bkrongs, t'a la'i bla ma drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri las phab ste mtsho sngon du rgyang 'bud btang, ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho po ta la'i khrir bkod, rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya 1717 lor jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyis btang ba'i dmag dpung bod du 'byor nas lha bzang han bsad/ 1703...1705...1717...
1) lha bzo mkhan/ 2) lha bzo bar byed pa/
lha yis gtong ba'i gdon nad de, nad rtags su sam skri ta'i skad smra zhing bzhin legs la gtsang sbra che bar byed pa zhig /
(mngon) 1) brgya byin:/ 2) shak ya thub pa/

lha gnas sa'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ dgra 'khrugs pa lha yi yul la'ang yod, gnyen 'grig pa srin po'i yul la'ang yod/ ming gi rnam grangs la skabs gsum gnas dang, mtho ris, dal 'dzin, bde ldan, gnas bzang, sa bla, gsum rtsen bcas so,
tshe thar du btang ba'i g.yag khyu pa...
rab byung na'am yag shos la/ lha rab byung na khyed rang ngo ma phebs dang/
lha ldan rab 'byams pa ste, sngar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbus su mtshan nyid dam bca' bzhag nas ang grangs su tshud pa'i dge bshes/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs lha sa grong khyer gyi byang shar ngos su yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de stag ma ru yod/
bod rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po thog mar 'byor sa deng skabs sne gdong rdzong khongs yar klungs kyi ri grags can bon po'i gnas chen zhig /
ge : thu mi'i slob dpon rgya gar gyi pandi ta zhig /
1) rgyal rigs/ 2) lha'i ri mo/ lha ris pa/ 3) lha'i rigs sam phyogs/ 4) rab tu byung ba/
lha ba can gyi rus pa'i rtse mo ste, rtsib ma'i rus pa dang, brang rus gnyis kyi bar du 'brel byed phrum rus la zer/
1) lha la smad ra gtong mkhan/ 2) (mngon) lha ma yin/
ston pa shak ya thub pa la bstod pa rgya gar gyi slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa'o/
lha las bab pa'i mchod rten
lha bab mchod rten dang don gcig
lha las bab pa'i dus chen

khyad par can gyi dus chen bzhi'i nang gses, hor zla dgu pa, tha skar zla ba'am dbyug zla'i yar tshes bco lnga la, ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa lha sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas 'dzam bu'i gling du byon pa'i dus chen yin pa dang, dbyug zla'i mar ngo tshes bco lnga yin zer sgros kyang 'dug /

1) gtsang khul gyi yul zhig / 2) bod rgyal glang dar gsod mkhan lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i bsdus ming/ lha lung dpal rdor ri la phyin kyang, rta pho'i zhabs rjes thang la bzhag / 3) lha yi yul lam gnas/ lha lung du 'dre lag brkyangs pa/ 4) lha'i lung bstan/
lha yi lus sam rten/ lha lus thob kyang g.yar ba'i rgyan dang 'dra/
1) lha la 'bul rgyu'i bsang shing gi rigs/ 2) lha gnas sa'i shug pa/ brag la skyes pa'i lha shing gi shug pa ma red, chu la skyes pa'i 'dre shing lcang nag red/
cha 'jog dang nges gtan med pa'i gtam/
lha'i zhal zas sam bshos bu/

dbus skyid chu'i rked rgyud kyi gzhung du chags pa'i grong khyer zhig ste, sngar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su dmar po ri'i rtser sku mkhar pho brang dmar po brtsigs, 'o thang du rgya bal nas spyan drangs pa'i sku rten jo shak ya rnam gnyis bzhugs su gsol ba'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs te chos dang rgyal srid kyi gzhi btsugs, rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang, 'bangs kyi bde skyid, chos kyi 'byor bas mngon par mtho ba lha yul sa la 'phos pa lta bu yod pas lha sa zhes su grags, de nas bzung mthar rgyal po glang dar ma'i bar gyi bod rgyal rabs rim byung gi rgyal sa dang, phyis su rgyal dbang lnga pa chos srid zung gi bdag por mnga' gsol ba nas bzung rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon gyis chos dang srid kyi phrin las kyi snang bas khyab pa'i gdan sa'i mthil dang, bod kyi chab srid, dpal 'byor, rig gnas bcas kyi lte bar gyur, deng skabs bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gnas yul yin no/
lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs
t'a la'i bla ma lha sar phebs skabs mchod 'bul dang 'tsho ba'i skor gyi las don sgrub mkhan las khungs shig /
sum cu rtsa gsum la ltos,
snga dus lha sa grong khyer kho na'i 'jal byed kyi nya ga /
1) snga dus bod kyi mtho rim mi drag che shos rnams kyi bu'i che ming/ 2) lha yul gyi bu/

gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud las, gshin rje dang, ma mo, srin po, gnod sbyin, mi'am ci, sa bdag btsan, bdud bcas bshad pa dang, yang bshad srol gcig la lha dang, mi'am ci, lto 'phye chen po bcas bshad pa, yang bshad lugs gzhan zhig la gshin rje dang, ma mo, bdud, btsan, rgyal po, klu, gnod sbyin, gza' bcas lugs mi 'dra ba mang po yod/
ram 'degs gnang rogs zer lha la 'bod bskul byed pa/
'dod khams kyi lha dang, gzugs khams kyi lha, gzugs med khams kyi lha bcas gsum mo/
1) ri lha dang chu lha khyim lha rnams la gsol mchod byed pa/ 2) sa ming zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rgya tsha rdzong gi nub rgyud du yod/
gong la bzang bstod dang, 'og la ngan smra byed pa'i dpe/
1) yul lha gsol ba'am lha bsangs btang ba/ 2) lha mnol ba bsangs pa'am mnol ba bsal ba/
1) lha'i lham gog / 2) rgyal po'i bang mdzod nas blangs pa'i nyer mkho'i yo byad/
, (yul) dam po med pa/ thag pa'i mdud pa lhag gi lhug gi zhig brgyab 'dug / sked chings lhag lhug kho nar snang ba/
gsal por mngon du gyur pa/ mi 'di ngo shes lhag ge ba zhig red/ 'ja' tshon kha dog lhag ge bar 'tsher ba/ yid la lhag ger gsal/ nyi ma ser lhag ger shar/
, (yul) lus la skrangs 'bur mang po thon tshul zhig / lus po tshang ma lhag ge lhog ger skrangs pa/
ldang tshad kyi lhag ma dang bcas pa/

mtshams sbyor dang, dam bca', gzhan 'dren gsum gyi sgo nas bstan bya'i lhag ma 'dren pa'am ston pa'i phrad gzhan dbang can zhig ste, te, de gsum dang, phrad rang dbang can gyi rkyen nas, la gnyis bcas lnga yod/ ste te de...nas la...mda' 'phangs te phog / nga tshos rgyal kha len thub thag chod yin te, nga tsho'i las don drang bden can yin pa'i phyir/ g.yas su ri yod de, g.yon du chu yod/ kho rang yin par bsams nas yid ches pa/ rlabs chen yin la yang dag pa'ang yin pa/
skyes pa tsam las mi 'chi bar nyon mongs ma lus pa spangs te, phung po lhag ma dang bcas par mya ngan las 'da' ba ste, skyes nas 'da' ba'o/
chad lhag / dus tshod lhag chad med pa/
1) 'phel skyed lhag por thon pa/ bza' 'bru lhag thon pa/ 2) gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa/ dmag mi'i nang nas dpa' bo de nyid lhag tu thon pa/
«bisheshapashya» ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyi chings sam rgyu zhig ste, dngos po'i rang bzhin lhag pa'i khyad par shes rab kyi mig gis mthong ba'o/
gnas lugs kyi don cha 'dra tsam mthong ba/
gnas lugs kyi don yang dag pa mthong ba/
the tshom gyi lhag ma dang ldan pa ste, lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i rtags so/

nges pa'i rtags: thun mong gi ma nges pa'i rtags gang zhig gang la rtags su song ba'i rgol bas mthun phyogs mi mthun phyod gang rung la mthong zhing, cig shes ma mthong bas the tshom gyi lhag ma dang ldan pa'i rtags so/
lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i rtags gnyis
thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i rtags drug gi nang gses, lhag ldan la dbye na yang dag lhag ldan dang, 'gal ba'i lhag ldan no/

1.(tha mi dad pa) 1) lus pa/ gcig kyang ma lhag pa/ yi ge bri rgyu mang po lhag 'dug / 2) tshad nges can zhig las brgal ba/ gzhan las lhag pa/ sngar las lhag pa/ kun las lhag pa/ 2.gza' lhag pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la mkhas pa dang, rgyal po'i bu, sngo sangs lus, thos ldan skyes, snar ma skyes, sngo sangs lus, thos ldan skyes, snar ma skyes, mdza' lha'i grogs po, zla ba'i bu, rab dga', lus gcig pa, gsal ldan, gser ldan bcas so,
'dzin gyi bslab pa: theg pa chen po ni dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang, nyan thos dag gi mi sdug pa sgom pa dang, bsam gtan bzhi dang, gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bcas/
kyi bslab pa: so thar ris bdun gyi sdom khrims dang, byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gsum bcas/
lhag pa len pa'i ltung byed
ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i nang gses, nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la dus gcig la lhung bzed gsum las lhag pa len pa'o/
kyi bslab pa: theg pa chen po ni chos dang gang zag gnyis kyi bdag med rtod pa dang, nyan thos dag ni gang zag gi bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab/
nga rgyal bdun gyi nang gses shig ste, rang dang mnyam pa las lhag par khengs pa'o/
1) gzhan las lhag pa'i dpal 'byor snyan grags/ 2) (mngon) 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/

rab byung gi gos kyi gzhi'i nang gses, yo byad gsum gyi ya gyal zhig ste, rab byung la med du mi rung ba min kyang dgos pa'i dbang gis bcang bar bya ba ste, gzhan kho na'i ming gis byin gyis brlabs pa'am yid gtad de bcang rung gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang mkho ba'i yo byad kyi lhag po dag go/
lhag pa'i sems kyi bslab pa
mu stegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin las lhag pa/
rang nyid yal bar dor nas gzhan phan sgrub pa'i bsam pa/

skye bo phal pa dang, mu stegs pa las khyad par 'phags pa'i lam lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum ste, lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang, lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang, lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rnams so/
rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsten bya'i yi dam/

khyad par du'am, yang sgos/ spyir yig rigs mang po dang lhag par rgya yig la mkhas pa/ gung khran tang la lhag par brten pa/ lhag par mi dmangs kyi las don la 'gan khur byed pa/ spus tshad lhag par legs pa/
1) rab tu mdzes/ 2) mtshungs gsal gyi sgra zhig ste 'dra ba/

1. 1) 'phro ma/ 'tsho chas kyi lhag po/ 2) snon ma/ nyung ngu'i steng du lhag po bsnan pa/ 3) bskyar bzlos kyi yi ge ste, sam skri ta'i sbyor klog skabs yi ge'i gzugs 'gyur nas bskyar bzlos su byung ba'i yi ge / 2.khyad par ba/ yon tan lhag po/ stobs shugs lhag po/
, dge slong gi nyin re'i lto chas kyi lhag ma lus na nyin rjes ma bar nyar thabs kyi cho ga /
lto chas lhag ma bzhag pa/
lhag por len pa'i spang ba
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, chos gos rnam gsum med pa'i dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la stod g.yod smad g.yogs zung gcig gi tshad las lhag pa bslangs te len pa'o/
bed spyad pa'i lhag ma/ za btung lhag 'phro/ yo byad lhag 'phro/ las don lhag 'phro/

/ 1) bed bcad pa'i 'phro ma/ zas lhag / btung lhag / gyon lhag / kha lhag 'khrol 'khyil/ zla lhag / chad lhag / las don lhag ma med par bsgrubs pa/ sngon gyi rgyal po'i stobs dang grags pa rnams kyang da lta ming tsam gyi lhag mar gyur/ 2) «samghabashi shta» ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses shig /
(mngon) 1) mtha' yas pa/ 2) klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas/ 3) dgun smad/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum gyi bsdus ming,
'phro lus pa/ lto chas kyi lhag ma las ma song/
lhag 'phro bsdad pa/ dus yun thung ba'i rkyen gyis gros bsdur bya rgyu'i skad cha'i lhag ma lus pa red/
dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum ste, ltung ba sde lnga'i nang gses gnyis pa gso ba dge 'dun la rag las shing sdom pa rnam dag gi lhag ma tsam lus pa'o/
shul ma lus pa/ phyis mi lus len mi dgos par phung po lhag med du sangs rgya ba yod pa yin/
nyon mongs ma lus pa spangs ma thag tu tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba phung po lhag med par mya ngan las 'da' ba ste, bar dor 'da' ba'o/
longs spyad pa'i lhag ma'am ro ma/
lhag ma lus pa'i bsdus tshig
sger sems med pa'am, sems bzang po/ zhabs 'degs lhag bsam dkar pos zhu ba/ yun ring rgyun du 'khyong bar lhag bsam 'gyur med byed pa/ las ka lhag bsam rnam dag gis byed pa/ lhag bsam zol med/
lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed
sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar te ma dag sa bdun skabs kyi byang chub sems bskyed/
lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed bdun

sems bskyed nyer gnyis las lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed bdun te gter lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, rgya mtsho lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, ri rgyal lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, sman lta bu'i sems bskyed dang, bshes gnyen lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams so/
g.yo zol med pa'i bsam pa/
lhag bsam rnam dag dang don gcig
'phro lus ngan hrul/ zas gos lhag hrul mang po phyogs gcig spungs/
lhag gi lhug gi'i bsdus tshig
lhag ge lhog ge'i bsdus tshig

1.(tha mi dad pa) 'byor ba'am slebs pa/ sku mdun du lhags pa/ rang yul du lhags pa/ 2.rgyug 'gro ba'i rlung rgyun/ zhogs pa nam mkhar sprin pa yod stabs phyi dro lhags pa lang yong/ lhags bsil/ lhags 'phyar/ 3.(rnying) gtad pa'i brda/
skor 'tshub kyis rgyag pa'i lhags rlung/
lhags pa/ lhags rlung tsha po/
/ 1) dri ma'am g.ya' bag dang nus shugs/ 2) zur/ khong la lhang tsam zhus pa/ ngas lhang tsam zhig go byung/ snyan lam du lhang tsam gsol ba/
gsal le/ lhang nger dran pa/
gsal por go tshul zhig / gsung lhang nge bar sgrog pa/ rna bar sgra lhang nge ba zhig thos pa/ gsung lhang nge ba/ snyan pa lhang nger grags pa/

rdo sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su dbye na rigs dkar nag dmar ser bzhi mchis, nus pas rma gso ba dang, dngul chu 'ching bar byed, klad pa rmas skyon byung ba gso/ ming gi rnam grangs la dri med dang, sprin gzugs, ri skyes bcas so,
pus mo'i lha nga'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su yod pa'i rus pa kong kong yod pa'i gsang dmigs shig /

1) skad sgrog stangs sam thos tshul/ ring nas 'bod skad lhang lhang thos/ dpe cha lhang lhang klog pa/ tho rangs bya skad lhang lhang sgrog / 2) mngon gsal du thon pa'am lkog tu ma gyur pa'i tshul/ dga' lhang lhang byed pa/ na zug lhang lhang gzer ba/ grang lhang lhang/ 'khyag lhang lhang/

skyon dang dri ma'am g.ya' dang bag / bsam pa lhad can/ tshig lhad/ gser lhad med pa/ lhad 'don pa/ gser la ra gan gyi lhad 'jug pa/ rang sems dkar por lhad skyon med gyur na, yi dam lha yi bka' chad yong don med/
dam po med pa'i don/ rked rags lhad de lhod de zhig bcings pa/ phad gog lhad de lhod de zhig brgyangs pa/
dngos por bsres lhad med pa/
gad snyigs kyi rigs rtsa ba nas med pa'i gtsang ma gtsang rkyang, gtso bo 'bru rigs la zer/
dngos po gang zhig rang dang lhan cig tu thog ma nas byung ba'am ngang ngam shugs la gnas pa/
rang gi phung po lnga la dmigs nas rang tshugs thub pa'i nga yod snyam du bsam pa/
lhan skyes kyi nyon mongs pa
grub mthas blos ma bsgyur bar sems can gyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/
rdzas kyi sbyor ba la ma ltos par dngos po rang nyid dang lhan cig skyes pa'am rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i dri, tsandan dang, shing kun gyi dri lta bu'o/
rang byung du yod pa'i dri bzang ldan pa'i spos/
lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa
sems can gyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i bdag tu rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'o/
lus kyi rma sgo gsum sogs/
skye thob kyi yon tan te rang stobs kyis shes pa'i yon tan/
kha sna sogs lus kyi bu ga nas rgyu ba'i dbugs rlung/
rang lus dang mnyam du skyes pa dang, shi ma thag tu kha bral ba'i lha 'dre zhig ste rang gi dkar nag las grangs 'dren pa'i mi min zhig /
dben gsum dang 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa thob pa'i pho nya mo/
nad rang nyid dang lhan cig skyes pa'i rma ste, 'bras dang, gzhang 'brum, me dbal, surya, rmen bu, rlig rlug rkang 'bam, mtshan bar brdol ba bcas brgyad mchis so/
mi'i lhan skyes kyi lha lnga ste, 'tsho ba'i lha dang, srung ba'i lha, skyob pa'i lha, 'grod pa'i lha, 'go ba'i lha bcas so/
gos la lhan pa brgyab pa/
1) thun mong/ lhan rgyas thog nas bka' bsdur zhib lhing mdzad/ 2) tshogs 'du/ bzhugs gral gcig tu lhan rgyas 'tshogs/

thabs cig dang, stabs cig dang, chabs cig dang, mnyam pa/ tsha grang gnyis lhan cig tu mi gnas/ bya rog dang 'ug pa lhan cig tu mi gnas pa/ dpyid dus su drod dang gsher gnyis lhan cig tu byung ba/ kha ba dang bu yug lhan cig 'byung ba/ gcen gcung 'bral du ma phod par lhan cig tu nags la 'khyams so/
1) thog ma nas mnyam por byung ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i shes rab/ 2) (mngon) mtshe ma/
(rnying) 1) lhan cig kha gshags 'debs pa/ 2) ngag 'khyal smra ba/

don rgyan gyi nang gses shig ste, brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba'i yon tan dang bya ba rnams dus mnyam du brjod pa'i rgyan zhig ste, nang gses rnam rangs gsum ni, yon tan lhan cig brjod pa, bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa, bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa bcas so/
(mngon) gnam gang ste bod zla so so'i tshes pa sum cu'i nyin mor nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig tu mthong thub zer/
(rnying) mnyam du tshogs pa'am lag sbrel sogs byed pa/
mnyam pa/ lhan cig par gyur pa/ lus dang grib ma lhan cig par gyur pa/ chu dang 'o ma lhan cig par gyur pa/

nyer len gyi rgyu rang dang lhan cig tu 'bras bu skyed byed du gyur cing rdzas rgyun ma yin pa gtso bor skyed byed, dper na, myu gu skye ba la chu lud drod gsher 'dzoms pa lta bu dang, rdza bum gyi rgyur gyur pa'i skyes bu'i byed rtsol lta bu dang, shes pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang po lta bu'o/

rgyu drug gi nang gses shig ste, lhan cig 'byung ba'am chos de dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i sgo nas phan tshun gcig la gcig brten te mgo mnyam du 'byung zhing, ring po brten nas thung ngu bzhag pa ltar med na mi 'byung ba'i tshul gyis gcig grogs gcig gis byas pa'o/
lhan cig byed rkyen dang don gcig
lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang don gcig
gnod bya gnod byed du gyur pa'i sgo nas phan tshun rgyun nus mtshungs su 'grogs su mi rung ba'i dngos po, snang ba dang mun pa, spang bya dang gnyen po lta bu'o/
lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags spyor

'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten nas rang gi khyab 'brel nges dgos pa ste, me dmigs pa'i rtags kyis grang reg rgyun chags su gnas pa 'gog pa lta bu spang gnyen gyi sgo nas 'gal zlar gyur pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags rnams so/
lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rtags sbyor bcu gnyis

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa'i snang rung gi 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags de la sbyor tshul gyi dbye bas bcu gnyis te, 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa bzhi dang, 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa bzhi dang, 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa bzhi rnams so/
lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur dgu

gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur bcu bzhi las, lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi thal 'gyur la dbye na dgu ste, 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmid pa'i thal 'gyur gsum dang, 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum dang, 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum bcas dgu'o/
lhan rgyas thog ste 'dzoms dgos pa rnams tshang ma 'dzoms pa'i thog dang, lhan rgyas ni 'dzoms pa'i zhe sa'o/ las don che ba rnams bka' blon lhan thog nas thag gcod gnang dgos/
lhang nge'am lham mer te mngon par gsal ba/
thugs gsal lam me ba/ yid ma yengs na lhan ne bar gnas thub/ thugs la lhan ne bar 'char ba/ lhan ne bar sdod pa/
gos sogs kyi bug ral 'gog byed/ lham la lhan pa glan pa/ gos la lhan pa rgyag pa/ nyes pa can la chad pa, bug pa can la lhan pa/ lhan thog lhan brtsegs/
gos la lhan pa brgyab pa/
mnyam du yong ba/ sku mgron tshang ma gzigs skor la lhan phebs gnang ba/
mnyam du 'dus pa/ lhan 'dzoms gros mol/ 'thus mi lhan 'dzoms/
lhab lhub gi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
lhab be lhub be'i bsdus tshig phar tshur rgyun mi 'chad par g.yo tshul/ lhags pas dar cha lhab lhub skyod pa/ me lhab lhub tu 'bar/ gos kyi phu thung lhab lhub tu g.yug pa/
lhe ba chung ngu/ kha ba lhab lheb tu 'bab/
g.yo tshul lam bskyod stangs shig / rlung gis g.yos pa'i dar lce lhabs se lhab/ me lce lhabs se lhab/ me lce lhabs se lhab 'bar ba/

ko ba dang ras sogs kyis bzos pa'i rkang pa skyob byed kyi gyon chas/ ko lham yu thung/ lham gog po/ lham bzo/ lham rul nang nas dri ngan, mi ngan kha nas gtam ngan/ lham ngan yang nyva dro/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkang skyob dang, rkang pa'i shing rta, bcag lham, mchil lham, tsher ma srung, zhabs phyags, srog phan bcas so,
lham bzo byed kyi ko ba/
(yul) lham gyi ming/ lham gog a krad la ma ltos, zhabs bro 'byung khungs la ltos/
, 1) lham gyi steng man gyi mgo'i cha/ 2) (yul) lham spyi/
lham yu ring sgro gu can lta bu/
lham yu nyar sgrog byed/ ring ba sked rags dang, thung ba lham sgrog yan chad go bsdur byas/
lham mthil zad skyob kyi lcags gzer/
sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gung bka' blon gyis rgya lu chas spros skabs gyon pa'i gzab lham/
lham nye ba'i rin po che
'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i lham zhig /
sngar bod kyi lha lcam gyi gzab gyon lham zhig
lham gyi mthil lam rdog pa/
lham gyi sne mo bsgyur ba ste 'gro ba/ rang yul nas lham sna bsgyur te sa cha gzhan la phyin pa/
gru bzhi kha gang/ gru bzhi lham pa/ gru bzhi lham pa sho lta bu/
(yul) lham gyi yu ba bzo byed snam bu/
ras spu mas bzos pa'i lham/
lham bu chu gsher gyi bsdus tshig
sku gsal lam me ba/ sku lham me ba/ lham me lhang nge/
lham me lhan ne lhang nge
brjid pa dang gsal ba dang bag phebs gpa sogs kyi nyams khyad par can/
brjid pa'i mngon tshul zhig / 'od stong lham mer 'phro ba/
skud btsems zom mthil dang de la yu ba bsgar ba'i lham/
rkang par gyon rgyu'i lham bzo mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la ko lpags mkhan dang lham bzo mkhan no,
'od 'bar tshul lam 'phro tshul zhig / me lham lham bar/ 'od zer lham lham 'phro/
«samskrita» skad rigs chen po bzhi'i nang gses shig ste, legs sbyar gyi skad de sangs rgyas kyis lha yul du chos gsung ba'i skad/
lha yul gyi gar pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la dran pa'i snye ma'o,

1) dbyangs can ma/ 2) lha yul gyi bu mo glu dbyangs mkhan/ ming gi rnam grangs la skabs gsum pa'i glu dbyangs mkhan dang, sgra ngan spangs, dri za, dri za skyes, dbyangs sgrog pa, dbyangs ldem mo bcas so 3) lha yul gyi pi wang mkhan/
1) tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ 2) rgyal chen sde bzhi/ 3) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
1) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 2) tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ 3) rgyal chen sde bzhi/
bdag bskyed skabs kyi rang nyid lha'i skur gyur par gsal ba'o/
1) 'jig rten gsum gyi nang gses shig ste sa bla/ 2) (mngon) mtho ris/
1) dpag bsam gyi shing/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya mtsho skyes dang, dpag bsam shing, man d'a ra, yongs 'du, yid mos, legs khyab, ha ri tsan dan bcas so, 2) lha yul gyi shing spyi/
lha rnams btung bya'i chu/ ming gi rnam grangs la bdud rtsi dang bde 'thung ngo,
lha sku'i dpangs zheng che chung gi thig tshad/
mi min gnas sa'i rten mkhar/

bya rgyud kyi sgom pa de nyid bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, bya rgyud lha drug gi sgo nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i mdun du ye shes pa spyan drangs shing rje khal gyi tshul du bltas nas dngos grub sgrub pa'o/
lha'i sngags 'chang ngam sgom chen pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgyas pa dang, mchu las skyes, me sbyin bu bcas so,
1) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 2) (mngon) tshangs pa/
lung phran tshegs kyi le'u chig stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go dgu pa/
1) nam mkha'/ 2) ri rab lhun po/ 3) lha'i yul/
dpag tshad brgya la sogs pa'i sgra phra rags mngon sum du thos pa/
1) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/ 2) lha'i stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa/
nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi gzugs thams cad mthong ba/
bdud bzhi'i nang gses, 'dod khams kyi lha'i bu rnams phrag dog gi dbang gis dge ba'i bar chad byed pa/
bdud dang po gsum po gang rung las mi 'da' bar byed pa'i rnam g.yeng lta bu/
gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po dga' rab dbang phyug /
'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad kyi: shes pa
mngon shes drug gi nang gses, da ltar gyi gzugs thag ring thung ji snyed pa dang, shi nas gar skyes pa'i gzugs la sogs pa yul dang dus kyis bskal ba'i lkog gyur rnams mthong zhing shes pa'o/
1) lha yul gyi me tog / 2) (mngon) li shi
dbang phyug gi bu chung gdong drug /
lha rnams kyi sman bcos pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgod ma skyes dang, tha skar skyes, mtho ris sman pa, rnam 'byed bu bcas so,
tshangs pa dng, dbang phyug dang, khyab 'jug bcas so/
shing rta sna tshogs can dang, rtsub 'gyur tshal dang, 'dres pa'i tshal dang, dga' ba'i tshal rnams so/
1) sangs rgyas spyi'i mtshan/ 2) (mngon) shak ya thub pa/
lha'i 'jig rten kho na brgyud de skye ba/
lha'i rigs nas rigs su skye ba

dge 'dun nyi shu'i nang gses, rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig 'dod lha drug po gang rung gi rten la rgyun zhugs thob pa de ltar lan gnyis skyes nas dang po'i lha'i rigs de'am gzhan lnga po gang rung la mya ngan las 'da' ba'o/
1) lha yul gyi dpag bsam shing sogs/ 2) (mngon) shug pa/
bskyed rim sgom skabs yi dam lha'i zhal phyag dang rgyan cha lugs sogs ma 'dres par bkra lam gyis gsal ba'i snang ba/
1) sangs rgyas kyi mtshan/ 2) (mngon) shak ya thub pa/
yag sa nas g.yar, sdug sa nas bskyis te thabs 'tshol ba'i gtam/
'brog pa'i phyugs ra/ 'brog pa'i phyugs lhas/
(mngon) 1) las skal/ 2) mnga' thang ngam dbang thang/
«debadarta:» bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po log lta can zhig /
lhas byin gyi brtul zhugs lnga
sha mi za ba dang, 'o ma mi 'thung ba, lan tshwa mi za ba, gos dras shing drub pa mi gyon pa, dgon par mi gnas pa ste lnga/
lhas byin gyi bslab tshig lnga
sha mi za, 'o ma mi 'thung, lan tshwa mi za, gos dras drub can mi gyon, dgon par mi gnas pa ste lnga/
chun po bslas ma/ skra lhas ma/ sked rags lhas ma/ spa thag lhas ma/
phyugs kyi gnas ra ba/ ra ri la btang yang don lhas rar tshang dgos,
lhas ra nas byung ba'i lud/
rlung gis skyed pa'i skran nad lhing 'jags po med pa zhig ste, pho long sogs kyi gnas su brtan po med par 'phyo lding 'phel 'bri byed pa zhig /
lhod pa'am brtan por gyur pa/ las brel lhing chags nas lhod dal la gnas/ zing 'khrug lhing chags nas zhi bde'i go skabs thob/
dus zang zing dang bya ba zang zing bral ba/ ngo log zing 'khrug lhing 'jags su gtong ba/ spyi tshogs nyin bzhin lhing 'jags su gyur pa/
lhing po dang nan po'i bsdus tshig / mi gzhi lhing pos bya ba do nan byas pas las don lhing nan byung/

zhi zhing dul ba dang 'drog 'tshub med pa'am tshab tshub med pa/ rta lhing po/ mi lhing ba/ spyod lam lhing ba/ zab lhing brtan gsum/ brel brel 'tshab 'tshab med pa'i skad cha lhing po byas na go brda legs par 'phrod yong/
khrag rtsa'i bye brag sdod rtsa/
yan lag dang dum bu/ lhu che ba/ lhu chung ba/ ma lag gi lhu mi 'phrod pa/ rtsa 'dzugs lhu 'thor/ bar mtshams kyi lhu thebs pa/ dus tshod snga phyi'i lhu ma thebs pa/ sha khog lhu ru gsil ba/
1) dngos po dang las don sogs khungs 'grig pa/ 'phrul 'khor gyi yan lag tshang ma lhu 'grig pa/ 2) stabs 'grig pa/ las don mang po lhu 'grig pa/ dus skabs snga phyi lhu 'grig pa/
yan lag dang dum bu phan tshun sgrig pa/ pang leb phan tshun kha sbyor lhu sgrig byed pa/ 'phrul 'khor lhu sgrig pa/
lhu'i dum bu chung gras/ nying lag gi lhu chung/ 'phrul 'khor gyi lhu chung/
lhu'i dum bu che gras/ rkang lag bzhi'i lhu chen/ 'phrul 'khor gyi lhu chen/ lhu chung mang po lhu chen du bsgrigs/
yan lag gi dum bu'i cha/ rkang pa'i lhu tshigs bral ba/
yan lag gi dum bu'i bar mtshams/
rus tshigs kyi lhu'i dum bu/ sgal pa'i lhu rus/ rked kyi lhu rus/
yan lag gam cha shas/ 'phrul 'khor gyi lhu lag sgrig pa/ lus kyi lhu lag / lhu lag che rigs/ sug bzhi g.yang la lhungs na, lhu lag tshang ba khag po red/
kha phral ba:/ shing sgrom rnying pa'i lhu bshig pa/ lhu bshig bskyar bsgrig /
thur du 'phyang ba'i rnam pa zhig / gos lhug ge ba/ grod khog lhug ge ba/
1.tshigs bcad min pa'i yi ge/ 2.dam po ma yin pa/ ska rags lhug pa zhig bcings te phyin pa/
1) tshigs bcad min pa'i dpe cha/ 'bol rtsom go bde lhug par bshad pa/ 2) skad cha zhib cing rgyas par bshad pa/ snga phyi'i yong rkyen gnas tshul lhug par bshad pa/

/ 1) 'bol po/ 'tsho ba lhug po/ 'bol lhug / 2) shogs po dang lhod po/ 'gro song lhug por gtong ba/ lag pa lhug po/ gos lhug por gyon pa/ dgos cha lhug por gtong ba/ lhug por bshad pa/ 3) tshod 'dzin med pa/ spyod lam lhug por gnas pa/ nyam thag pas mchi ma'i rgyun lhug por 'bab pa/
tshigs bcad min pa'i ye ge'i don du go ba'i lhug pa dang 'dra,
phyag bris lhug stsol zhes sogs thogs pa med par gnang ba'am sprod pa/
rkang par ma bcad pa'i tshig lhug pa/
sgrigs khrims sogs dam po med pa/
dog po'am dam po min pa'i lhod de ba/ mdud pa lhug shig ge ba de grol ba sla/

'bol po dang yangs po'i rnam pa zhig / 'tsho ba 'bol 'bol lhug lhug byung ba/ phan tshun zhal mol zhib zhib lhug lhug gnang ba/ go bsdur lhug lhug shig shig legs po zhig byed rgyu byung/ gad mo lhug lhug rgod pa/
ldug pa'i skul tshig gi 'bri srol gzhan zhig
1) tshigs bcad min pa'i yi ge'i don du go ba'i lhug pa dang 'dra, 2) lhug po dang don gcig

(tha mi dad pa) lhungs pa, lhung ba,, zag pa/ skar mda' lhung ba/ g.yang sar lhungs nas srog dbang chad/ rta las lhungs nas mgo bo bkas/ thang gi rdo blangs nas rum gyi gro lhung ba/ 'obs su thengs gcig lhung na, shes rab thengs gcig 'phel yong/
glo bur gri mtshon sogs las byung ba'i rma rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan sha rus gnyis ka bcad nas lhu tshigs bral nas lhung ba'i rma/

rgyu rdo lcags gang rung, kha dog bya rog mig bzhin, dbyibs sgo nga phyed bkas pa lta bu, che tshad 'bras ya khyor re gsum, chung tshad ya khyor so gnyis, de'i bar 'bring tshad, chung tshad 'di dge slong ma rnams kyi lhung bzed che tshad do/ lhung bzed mi 'byog / lhung bzed mi skyom/ lhung bzed kha g.yogs/ lhung bzed kyi snod/ lhung bzed bkru ba/ lhung bzed 'chang ba/
rdzas kyi shan gyi nang gses shig ste, lhung bzed zung byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag bcu 'das pa na zhag bcu 'chang spang gi lhung ba 'byung ba'o/
spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i lhung bzed zhag bcu 'chang ba'o/
lhung bzed mang po'i bdams snyigs/
lhung bzed spyod tshul bcu bzhi

nyes byas kyi sde tshan drug pa la, dge slong gzhan gyi lhung bzed la 'phya ba dang, lag pa zas kyis sbags pas chu snod la reg pa dang, gzhan la zas kyis sbags pa'i chu gtor ba dang, khyim bdag la ma dris par zas dang 'bag pa'i chu khyim du 'bo ba dang, zas lhag lhung bzed nang blugs pa dang, lhung bzed 'og stegs med par sa rjen steng bzhag pa dang, lhung bzed gad khar bzhag pa dang, g.yang sar bzhag pa dang, dkan gzar du bzhag pa dang, gad kha dang, g.yang sa dang, dkan gzar du lhung bzed 'khru ba dang, langs te 'khru ba dang, 'bab chu drag po'i rgyun las ldog ste lhung bzed kyis chu bcu ba ste bcu bzhi'o/
lhung bzed 'jog sa sgor stegs te, lhung bzed zhabs stegs kyang zer/
'chang ba'i spang ba: spang ltung sum cu'i nang gses, rang la lhung bzed tshad ldan yod bzhin du khyim pa nye du ma yin pa las lhung bzed btsal nas thob pa'o/
chu phran 'bab stangs dang 'bab sgra/ 'bab chu lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i sgra dang 'dra ba smra ba/ gtsang bsil chu rgyun lhung lhung 'bab/

/ 1) ngang ngam shugs sam rang bzhin/ ma bcos lhun grub/ las don 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa/ 2) bongs tshod dang gtos tshad/ gzugs byad lhun che ba/ khang pa'i rgya khyon lhun che ba/ 3) gzi brjid/ nyi zla'i 'od mdangs lhun che ba/
'jug pa'i yid byed: yid byed bzhi'i nang tshan, sems gnas dgu pa'i skabs su bar yang mi 'chad cing rtsol ba yang rgyun par bsten mi dgos par 'bad med du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin/

1) lhun gyis grub pa ste 'bad med rang bzhin gyis grub pa/ 2) rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lha sa'i byang ngos 'phan yul ngan chu'i chu rgyud na yod cing, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de phod mdo na yod/
bod la snga dus nas dar ba'i zlos gar tshogs pa zhig /

gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gyi gnad, brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas su grol ba'i gdams pa ste, sngon 'gro sna khrid gsum la bslab, dngos gzhi gnad gsum dang sgron ma bzhi la goms pa bsten, snang ba bzhi rim gyis mthar phyin te chos can snang ba'i ngos nas lhun grub kyis gdos bcas 'od gsal du dwangs par byed pa'o/
sngags rnying ma'i lam bgrod tshul rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig ste, mi slob pa'i lam bsdus te mthar 'bras sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob pa'o/
mtho zhing brjid chags pa/ gangs ri lhun chags can/ khang bzang mtho zhing lhun chags pa/
1) gzi brjid che ba/ 2) gtos che ba'am bongs che ba/
mtho zhing gtos che ba'am mkhregs pa:/ mnga' thang lhun stug gser ri 'dra/ ri bo brtan zhing lhun stug pa/

rab byung bcu pa'i nang gtsang lhun sdings su sku 'khrungs, dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas rig gnas spyi dang gso ba rig pa la dpyis phyin par sbyangs, jo nang sprul pa'i sku kun dga' snying po'i bla sman pa dang, rgyud bzhi rtag brtan par ma par du brko ba'i do dam dang zhus chen mdzad, gsung rdzom yang byang pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa gtsor ston pa gso ba rig pa'i lag len kun gyi snying po dgos 'dod kun 'byung sogs mdzad/
lhun sdug brjid cing mdzes pa
/ sku gzugs lhun sdug ldan pa/ skyed tshal nyams dga' lhun sdug pa/
ri rab kyi ming ste ri gzhan las lhun cing brjid chags pas na lhun po zhes bya'o/ lhun po chu yis nub dogs med, lung chen rlung gis khyer dogs med/
1) shin tu mtho zhing brjod chags pa'i ri/ 2) sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan/
ri rab lhun po'i rtsa ba'i mthar 'gram stegs dpag tshad stong phrag gcig gis bskor ba/

ri rab lhun por bcings pa'i rwa lnga po sder ma kha 'phyang lta bu chung rim nas gyen du btegs pa ltar rwa steng mas 'og ma bkab pa'i tshul du yod cing, de'i lnga pa ni kha khyer gyi thad kar dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu yod pa des khyab khongs kyi 'og mtha' nas rtsa ba'i 'gram stegs la thug pa'i bar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug yod pa de'i thur 'phyang bsil ri dang phrad nas yod/
rdzong zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de skyid thang du yod/

'bab chu zhig chu 'go bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong khul nas byung zhing, lhun rtse rdzong khul du bya yul chu dang 'dzoms nas snang rdzong khul du 'bab, shi pa sha chu'i yan lag cig yin/
phru gu chags sa'i snod mngal gyi zhe sa,/ yum gyi lhums su chags pa/
brtson pa chen po'am do khur che ba'i don du go ba'i hur po dang 'dra,
dang du len pa/ las 'gan lhur len/ spyi don lhur len/ rang don lhur len pa ma yin pa/
dang ba'am nan tan gyis sgrub pa/
tshod thig pa/ las don 'di da dung lhus ma things pa/ nyams myong ji ltar che ba de tsam gyis lhus things pa yong/
/ 1) brang 'dabs dkyil gyi a phrum srab mo/ 2) brang dkyil nang du brdibs sa/ lhen na ba/
ma zhu be snabs 'phel ba de rlung gis gong bur bsgril ba'i skran gyi ming/
bad kan rigs drug gi nang gses shig /
brang rus kyi mjug ma phrum rus 'bur po/
lhen sna'i rtse nas tshon gang gzhal ba'i gnas su yod pa'i me btsa'i gsang zhig ste, der me btsa' bzhag na ma zhu be snabs 'phel ba sogs me drod nyams pa la phan/
/ 1) tshal pa dang dum bu/ ras lheb/ shog lheb/ 2) rta drel glo bur du 'chi ba'i nad rigs shig /
leb mo'i rnam pa zhig / mal du lheb be nyal ba/

1) snam ras shog bu sogs kyi tshal bu chung chung/ shog bu lheb lheb cig bkog pa/ snam ras lheb tsam/ 2) gshog rtsal med pa'i 'phur stangs/ bye'u phrug cig gshog pa lheb lheb byed kyin 'dug / 3) (yul) dbugs gtong len skabs kyi 'gul tshul/
'gul bskyod kyi bye brag cig / me lce dmar lhem mer 'bar/ dbugs lhem mer bsdad 'dug /
lhem me ba dang don gcig
/ 1) phyogs bzhi'i gras shig ste shar du kha gtod skabs kyi g.yas phyogs/ 2) sngar bod kyi yab 'bangs rus drug nang gses kyi rus shig /
mchu dang, gre, dbo, me bzhi, nag pa, sa ri, sa ga rnams so/

sa khul zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud na yod cing sa khul 'di'i byang rgyud na yar klungs gtsang po gzhung du 'bab cing, lho rgyud na hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yod, 'di'i khongs su sne gdong dang, zangs ri, gra nang, gong dkar, rgya tsha, snang, 'phyongs rgyas, chu gsum, lho brag mtsho sna, lhun rtse, mtsho smad, sna dkar rtse bcas rdzong khag bcu gsum yod cing, sa khul gyi las khungs de rtsed thang du yod/
nyi ma la mtshon na dbyar nyi ldog nas 'khrig pa sogs khyim zla drug la nyi ma lho bgrod de, nyin je thung dang mtshan je ring 'gro ba'i skabs so/
dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug gi skabs...
1) khang pa sogs la sgo mang po yod pa'i lho phyogs kyi sgo/ 2) gson gshin gyi sbyang chog bya yul rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo/
lho la cha gnyis phye ba'i cha gcig /
lho dang nub kyi mtshams phyogs/
sa gzhi ril mo'i lho phyogs kyi zur sne/
phyogs bzhi'i lho phyogs te zhogs par kha nyi mar gtad de lag pa g.yas kyi phyogs/
(mngon) 1) skar ma ri byi/ 2) gshin rje/
rta gdong gi me'am rgod ma kha'i me/
sngar do ba rdzong zer: bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho rgyud yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i lho ngos su yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de dkar por yod/

mkhas pa'i dga' ston: dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba shog lhe bdun brgya dgu bcu go gcig yod pa 'di bod kyi deb ther shin tu rgyas pa zhig yin, 'di'i par shing lho brag do ba rdzong gi lha lung dgon du yod pas lho brag chos 'byung zhes grags, mdzad po dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas karma pa zhwa nag gi yang srid brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje bsten nas rig gnas kun la mkhas par sbyangs pas mkhyen sgo shin tu yangs par gyur, gzhung 'di'i le'u bcu bdun spyi dang, khyad par du bod kyi rgyal rabs skabs su lo rgyus kyi ban mdzod mtha' yas pa la dpyad de yig cha dkon po'i rigs las lung legs par drangs yod pas lo rgyus don du gnyer ba po rnams kyi dga' ston du gyur, lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu de la dgag bzhag zur za byas pa'i gtam yang snang ngo/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lho brag rdzong khul du yod cing sdur zhes pa'i grong sde'i 'gram du lho brag shar chu dang 'dres rjes lho ngos 'brug yul du 'bab/
mar pa lo tsa chos kyi blo gros kyi bsdus ming/
'bab chu zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtsho smad rdzong gi lho rgyud nas 'bab cing, lho brag rdzong khul du lho brag nub chu dang 'dres rjes lho ngos kyi 'brug yul du 'bab/
lho phyogs la cha gnyis phye ba'i cha gcig /
snga dus lho kha'i phyogs su rgyag pa'i tshong/
snga dus lung pa lho byang nas thon pa'i dngos zog brje res byed pa'i tshong/

«dzambudabipa:» ri rab kyi lho ngos rgya mtshor chags pa'i gling chen 'dir skyes pa'i shing 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu mtsho'i nang du lhung ba las, 'dzam bu zhes pa'i sgra 'byung bas na 'dzam bu dang 'dzam bu shing des mtshon pa'i gling yin pas na 'dzam bu'i gling dang, dbyibs shing rta lta bu dang, ri rab kyi phyogs ngos dang g.yas g.yon gnyis dang gsum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis dang, ngos gcig ste khor yug la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod do/
bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shar rgyud dang rgyal mo rngul chu'i stod rgyud du yod, rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung de rdzi tho ru yod/
khug rna'o/ ming gi rnam grangs la mtshan mo'i na tshod skyes so,
klo la'ang zer, bod rang skyong ljongs kyi smin gling rdzong dang klo yul gyi mtshams su yod/
lhog pa'i nad rigs drug gi ya gyal, glo bur du lus skrangs pa sogs nad rgyas sla ba zhig /
nad dngos lhog pa ma yin kyang nad rtags sha sna 'gul ba sogs lhog pa ltar na ba zhig /
1) sngo sman stag sha'i ming gzhan zhig / 2) gnyan nad cig /

gnyan rims sha la bab pa'i nad cig ste, nad rtags sha sna 'gul zhing 'phyo 'dar byed pa dang, thor pa thon pa sogs 'byung, nang gses su 'byung bas dbye na bzhi dang, nad gzhis dbye na gsum, rigs kyis dbye na bzhi bcas mchis so/
lhog pa'i rigs kyi dbye ba bzhi'i nang tshan thor pa khong du 'chor skyen pa dang, gzhan la 'go myur ba zhig
lhog ba'i rigs kyi dbye ba bzhi'i nang tshan, skrangs pa 'bar 'bur 'byung ba dang, yams thabs kyis gzhan la 'go ba zhig /
zang zing ngam 'ba' 'bur gyi rnam pa/ sprin nag lhog lhog tu 'khrug pa/
(yul) phar shor ba'i dngos po tshur lon pa'am khug pa/ brlags pa'i ca lag bdag po'i lag tu tshur lhogs pa/ rgyan shor gyi dngos po tshur lhogs byung/
/ 1) rtags sam mtshan ma/ 'tshub lhong/ bar chad kyi lhong tshar chod gsum/ 2) gegs sam bar chad/ phyi'i lhong/ nang gi lhong/ gsang ba'i lhong/ glo bur lhong shor gyi nyen dogs/

(tha mi dad pa) lhongs pa, lhong ba,, 1) son pa dang 'jug pa/ bslab bya rna bar lhongs nges byed dgos/ ngan jus lam du lhongs su ma bcug pa/ 2) rang tshugs thub pa/ dar dmar gyen du bslangs te lhongs/ mi 'gyel ba de yar lhongs song/
1) las ka zing long long ba/ 'grul pa lhong lhong du slebs pa/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro brel zing lhong lhong 'dug / 2) ri mo 'bur du thon tshul/ rdo la stag ris shig lhong lhong du brkos pa/
zhar ram zhor/ bka' mol gyi lhongs la/
dal lhod kyi ngang nas phan tshun mjal tshul/ grogs po dang lhod mjal byed pa/
brel 'tshab med pa/ ngal gso lhod dal rgyag pa/
dal zhing bde ba/ rgad po rnams lhod bder sdod pa/

1.(tha dad pa) glod pa/ thag pas bkyigs pa rnams lhod pa/ dogs zon ma lhod/ 2. rtsa shed gcig tu ma 'gril bar rnam pa 'bol po/ 3. 1) grims pa min pa/ khrims lhod pa/ las ka lhod pa/ 2) dal ba dang bag phebs pa/ sems lhod lhod byas nas sdod pa/ blo rang mal du lhod phab pa/ dal dal lhod lhod/
grims pa min pa'i don du go ba'i lhod pa dang 'dra,
lhod yangs med pa/ hur brtson lhod med byed pa/ rgyun 'khyongs lhod med/
1) dam med gu yangs/ bzung dmag la lhod yangs byed pa/ do dam lhod yangs su gtong ba/ 2) do snang med pa/ las don sgrub skabs lhod yangs mi byed pa/ lhod yangs snang chung/
blo mi sgrim pa/ las kar lhod yengs byas pas 'thus shor byung ba/ dus nam yang lhod yengs med pa/ mi sems lhod yengs su gtong ba/
/ lus sems lhod shig shig / blo lhod shig shig /
/ 1) brel ba med pa/ ngal gso lhod lhod cig byed pa/ lhod lhod byas nas lta ba/ 2) mdud pa sogs dam por ma byas pa/ sked rags lhod lhod bcings na grol yong/
(tha mi dad pa) rna bar son pa dang lhong ba/ rna bar lhon par smras pa/
khug rna/ ming gi rnam grangs la mtshan mo'i na tshod skyes so,

bod yig gsal byed sum cu pa'am, la las dbyangs gsal gnyis chod kyi yi ger 'dod pa 'di'i nga ro 'don tshul la skye gnas mgrin pa dang, byed pa mgrin pa lce rtsa dang sbyar ba, nang gi rtsol ba mgrin pa btsum pa, phyi'i rtsol ba srog chen sgra ldan/ 1) gang zag gi ming 'ga'i sngon du bcug nas snying nye ba'i don ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / a pha/ a ma/ a khu/ a zhang/ a rogs/ 2) ming 'ga'i sngon du bcug na sems kyi tshor ba drag po zhig phyir mngon thub byed kyi tshig grogs shig / a kha kha/ a tsha tsha/ a mtshar/ a pham pa la/ a ya mtshan/ 3) (yul) 1,ang sgra zur chag pa zhig ste, tshig 'ga'i mjug tu bcug nas skul tshig ston rogs byed pa'i tshig grogs shig / de 'dras ma byed a/ mgyogs po phebs a/ dpe cha ltos a/ 2,yin nam, yod dam, yong bcas kyi sngon du bcug nas the tshom mam dri ba ston pa'i tshig grogs shig / yin yod yong...khong rgya rigs a yin/ rgan lags slebs a yod/ sang nyin kha ba 'bab a yong/
ston rgyab kyi ri kha'i lci ba skam thag chod pa ser ga ma'i ming/
bud med kyi rna rgyan/ gser gyi a kor btags pa/
(yul) sngar bshad kyi gtam de rtsed mo yin par ston pa'i tshig /
ma 'tshoms sku rtsed zhus pa yin:
(yul) rgyu sgrim byed kyi 'phang lo'i rtse'i lcags kyu/
(yul) drang po min pa/ las ka byed stangs a kyog pa kyog / skad cha a kyog pa kyog / 'gro lam a kyog pa kyog /
lham rdog la glan pa'i ko krad rnying pa'am, rdog pa rnying pa/

thang sman gyi rigs shig ste, nang gses su mkhan pa a krong dang, rtswa a krong, shing a krong bcas rigs gsum mchis, ro mngar la skyur zhing kha, zhu rjes bsil, nus pas glo tshad dang, gre tshad, ol krong gi tshad pa bcas la phan/
yid pham pa dang hang sang ba ston pa'i sgra zhig / a kha, ga 'dra 'dug / a kha, de ga rang yin pa red/ a kha, byis pa rta thog nas lhung la khad cig byas/ a kha, khyed yin nam/
1) sems pham pa'i tshig / a kha kha phangs pa la/ 2) 'gyod pa skyes pa'i tshig / nor 'khrul de 'dra byung ba a kha kha 'grig ma song/
(legs) gshis ngan nam rang bzhin ngan pa/
yag po med pa'am phan thogs med pa'i mi dang dngos por btags pa'i ngan ming zhig /
pha'i spun zla/ a khu rgan pa/ a khu gzhon pa/ ming gi rnam grangs la khu bo dang, pha yi spun zla'o,
a khu lha shing shug pa
lha mo 'khrab sa'i dkyil du 'dzugs pa'i shing zhig /
a kha ma dang 'dra,, (legs) 'grogs byed pa/

(legs) lci med dam snying sel te nang gses su dbye na ar skya dang, ar nag ar dmar bcas rigs gsum mchis/ ming gi rnam grangs la thal ba'i snying po dang, dri zhim ljon pa, 'dab zung can, nags kyi tsan dan, mi bdag dga', mdzes sbyin byed bcas so,
a ga ru'i rigs mdog nag shas che ba zhig ste, ro kha la tsha, zhu rjes snyoms, nus pas snying dang, srog rtsa'i nad la mchog tu bsngags/

a ga ru'i rigs mdog dmar shas can go snyod kyi dri ma mnam pa zhig ste, nus pas snying dang srog rtsa'i tsha ba dang khyad par du tshad rlung sel/ ming gi rnam grangs la go snyod ma dang, go snyod a gar, t'a gha ra, ar dmar bcas so,
ri bo zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dpa' shod rdzong gi lho ngos dang rdza yul rdzong gi byang ngos su yod/
gro rdog che zhing spus legs pa zhig /
thabs zad pa/ mi khyod la skrag na a dgos chung/
gnam/ kha pho dgung a sngon gyi 'brug sgra las che ba/ dgung a sngon dbyings nas nyi zla 'grim, smag nag po'i mun pa'i pha yul shor/
si khron zhing chen rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs mdzod dge rdzong gi la zhig /
(yul) 1) bud med/ 2) spun zla bu mo rgan pa/ a cag lags, khyed rang ga dus phebs pa/

shod mi dgos zhes pa'am, los bden zer ba'i don/ phru gus kyang sgrub thub na, mi rgan pas a cang cang/ rlangs 'khor yang shin tu mgyogs na, gnam gru ni a cang cang/ dgun yang dro na, dbyar kha ni a cang cang/
bshad mi dgos sam smos ci dgos/ 'jigs drags nas zhing khang gi phyogs la 'gro ba dag a cang che ste mig kyang blta mi phod pa tsam yod/
(yul) ra lug sogs kyi pus tshigs rus chung, khams sogs bod kyi sa khul gyi byis pa tshos rus chung gru bzhi de shar nub rta drel sogs kyi dbye ba byas nas rtsed mo brtses te rta drel rtse bar zer/
1) (yul) bud med/ a ce'i phyu pa/ 2) mo spun rgan pa/

bod rje srong btsan sgam pos blon po mgar thang tha'i tsung gi sras mo btsun mor zhu bar btang lugs dang, kong jo bod du yong lugs sogs kyi lo rgyus rnams dmangs kyi ngag rgyun gzhir bzhag ste bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi zlos gar lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung zhig /
bye brag gi ming spyi la btags pa zhig ste lha mo'i chas kyis spras pa'i bod kyi zlos gar zhig / a ce lha mo 'khrab pa/
(sog) sog skad ar chol gyi zur chag ste, gdong 'phyid ras/ a cor spu ma/
(yul) rna ba, am cog la'ang snang/
'a chad 'u thug ste thang chad nas thabs zad pa/
(sog) drin can te hor gyi go sa'i ming zur/ rwa sgreng a chi thu no mon han/
'khyags nas skad 'don pa'i sgra/ grang bas 'khyags nas a chu chu zer ba/
«huhuba:» grang dmyal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig ste, grang ba'i zug rngu bsran mi bzod par smre ngag rgyun mi 'chad par 'don pa/
(yul) rang las rgan pa'i spun mo/
ri bo zhig ste, a mye rma chen yin zhing mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi shar lho'i rgyud du yod/
rna ba/ a mchog rgyab kyi lhags pa/ a mchog bkog nas rkub kyi lhan pa/ ri mgo thams cad mig dang, rtsig khug thams cad a mchog red/
(yul) re ba zad pa'i dpe/ 'grub thabs med pas a mchog lteb tshigs brgyab ste sdod pa las 'os med/
grong pa'i rim gro byed mkhan grwa btsun dkyus ma/ a mchod yon tan phad gog gang, phad gog lus na yon tan lus/
gcen po'am, jo jo/ ri dang nags gseb thams cad du nyul yang a jo ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal gyis mnan zhing bzhugs so/
(yul) 1) phag nyan/ gzhan gyi skad cha a nyan ma byed/ 2) re ba/ don dag legs 'grub yong rgyu'i a nyan byas pa/
(yul) phru gu'am byis pa/ a nyog ngu sdigs mi rgan shi sdigs/
rte'u chung gsum: las byas pa med de kun gyis byams/

, sngags rnying ma'i gzhung rnams su, rdzogs chen a ti yo ga ni spros bral rang byung gi ye shes la rgya chad dang phyogs lhung bral bas theg pa mtha' dag gi don yongs su rdzogs pas rtse mor gyur pa yin la, snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang byung ye shes kyi rol bar shar ba las gzhan du med cing, gzhi gnas rang byung gi ye shes de lam ka dag khregs chod dang lhun grub thod rgal gyi nyams len gyis snang bzhi mthar phyin nas 'bras bu gzhi thog tu grol ba ste gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin pa'o/
a ti yo ga'i theg pa

sngags rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu'i ya gal zhig, shin tu rnal 'byor rdzogs pa chen po'i theg pa ste, 'jug sgon rig pa'i rtsal bzhis smin par byas te, lta ba sems las 'das pa'i rig pa ngo bo stong pa chos sku, rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku, thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku ste sku gsum gyi rang zhal la lta ba dang, sgom pa ka dag khregs chod dang, lhun grub thod rgal gyi nyams len dang sbyar nas, spyod pa cir snang thams cad chos nyid kyi rol par shar bas spang blang re dogs med par bzhag pas, 'bras bu snang bzhi mthar phyin te 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku mchog brnyes te ye shes bla ma'i sa'am dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin par 'dod pa'o/

phul du byung ba ste, rgya gar shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras su chu rta lor 'khrungs, mtshan dpal mar me mdzad ye shes te, ma ga dha'i gtsug lag gnas chen 'ga'i tshogs kyi bdag po mdzad, lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang byang chub 'od kyis 'bad pas gdan drangs nas bod du byon te mdo sngags thams cad bsdus nas lam nyams su len pa'i rim par dril ba byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba gtso bor byas pa'i gzhung nyi shu lhag tsam mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstan pa rgyas par spel bas bstan pa phyi dar dang bka' gdams pa'i srol btod, gzhan yang gso rig gi gzhung yan lag brgyad pa btsams, mnga' ris su lo gsum dang, dbus gtsung du lo dgu bzhugs, dung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa shing rta lo la 'das, sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rig gnas spel ba la bod du bka' drin che bas gangs can pas jo bo rje zhes zhe sar brjod/
(yul) gtan gtan/ rim gong sgrig rgyu med pa'i a tig yang tig yin/
phal cher ram, ha lam/ mno ba bzhin du a to grub/

1) brtan brtan yin pa/ 2) skar ma brtan pa/

rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs rnga ba rdzong gi la zhig /

la zhig bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sgar rdzong gi nub rgyud na yod/

gnag phyugs dang ra lug la rwa co med pa'i yu bo yu mo spyi'i ming/
rwa co med pa'i gnag phyugs dang ra lug /
ngal ba'am blo mi bde ba'i tshig /

bod kyi zlos gar 'khrab mkhan gyi bye brag cig /
nad mi bzod pa'i sgra/ a ra u ru'i skad de sems kyi gcong/
myos byed kyi btung ba'i bye brag /

dngos gnas dang, ngo ma'am, ngo thog / dbyar a rang da rang gi nyi ma tsha po/ rgan rgon a rang da rang gi na tshod slebs dus/
1) 'brong gi rwa las bzos pa'i ra lug gi 'o ma 'jo snod hor byang lugs/ 2) sman gyi bye brag cig / a ru chung yang bzang drug me tog chung yang mchod rdzas/
a ru skem po sul mang
a ru rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhig ste, ro bska la kha, nus pas byis pa'i nad dang, byis gdon bya 'dre la phan/ ming gi rnam grangs la mchu snyung dang mchu ring ngo,

a ru sha chen gyi ming gi rnam grangs shig /

a ru rnam rgyal dang, a ru 'jigs med, a ru sha chen, u ru 'phel byed, a ru skem po sul mang lnga'o/

1) ya mtshan pa'am, re ba byed pa/ gzugs po bde thang byung na a re skyid/ bu pha ma dang phrad na a re dga'/ sa cha de a re mdzes po zhig 'dug / de ring grogs po dang phrad pas a re dga' ba zhig byung/ 2) blos gtong mi bra ba'am, gces pa'i tshig / dngos spyad 'di a re phangs dgos pa'i gces nor yin/ 3) ha cang 'gyod pa'i tshig / nor 'khrul byung ba a re phangs/

1) 'ju sa'am 'chang sa'i sgor sgor/ sgo'i a long/ zangs kyi a long/ gri'i a long/ zhags pa'i a long/ 2) rna rgyan/ gser gyi a long/ 3) (yul) gser dngul gyi sor rgyan rin chen gyi phra can/

bde zhing snyom la mtha' yangs pa/ rtswa thang a long me long/

1) gad sgra/ a ha khyod kyi spyod pa mthong na dgod re shor/ 2) ha las pa'i tshig / a ha de 'dra'i mgyogs pa la/
i si la mu'am kha che'i chos lugs kyi 'go 'dzin/
ya mtshan byed pam, ngo mtshar ba'i tshig / a ho ngo mtshar rmad du byung/ a ho de 'dra'i snying rje ba la/
gnam grang zug che shos/ dgun a hrang da hrang/
legs shos sam, bzang shos gang yin pa/ tshong zog a hrug ca hrug /
(legs) a phreng ka phreng ngam dbyangs gsal/
gi gu'i ming dang, de bzhin du a li gnyis pa dang, gsum pa, bzhi pa bcas kyang rigs 'gre chog / i...gi gu...
bod yig dbyangs bzhi ste i u e o/
bod yig ltar na dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal bar byed pa'i i u e o bzhi ga'i sgra dang yig gzugs/ i u e o...gi gu...

1) snga dus lha sa smon lam chen mo'i ja 'dren mkhan/ 2) (yul) byis pa spyi'i ming/ o lo gso skyong pha ma'i las 'gan red/
byis pa chung ngu gnyid thabs kyi tshig / o lo lo, o lo lo, gnyid skyid po nyol, o lo lo/
(yul) sku mkhyen/ rgan lags, o shes, dpe cha 'di nga la g.yar rogs gnang/ o shes sku mkhyen zer na snying rje dgos/
gcan gzan rigs zhum bu las che tsam pa 'bras ljongs dang bal po'i shar rgyud nas thon pa zhig /
ma le'i ag tshom dang 'gram pa'i rgya'i spu/
1) srab mthur gyi 'og sgrog / 2) zhwa mo'i 'og sgrog /
rta'i rke dang lkog ma ru skrangs pa dang rnag 'byung ba'i nad cig /
sgom shing ste, sgom rgyag skabs kyi og ma'i stegs/
bzhon rta'i og ma'i 'og tu 'dogs rgyu rnga dmar gyi dom dom ste, sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi drung rigs ser skya'i go gnas che chung mtshon rtags shig /
(yul) mgrin pa'i mdun phyogs/ og wags/ snying nas mi dga' na og ma yan gyi skad cha snyan po ci phan/
og dkar dang byi la 'dres pa'i phru gu /
ma le la skyes pa'i spu/ skra dang og tshom dung ltar dkar ba/ ngo gdong skya seng nge og tshom 'byil bzhin smras pa/ og tshom byug byug byas nas gtam shod na gdeng dang spobs pa yod pa'i rtags red/
og tshar can dang don gcig
mchu 'gul ba'i tshe og ma'i steng du gnyer ma shig ge ba'i 'dzum zhig 'byung bas de'o/
1) rkub kyi rgyab ngos/ 2) me shing lci bam rta sbangs/
rkub bam 'phongs/ ong sha/ ming gi rnam grangs la rkubb tshos dang 'phongs tshos so,
1) smad gos/ 2) sgron me'i sdong ras/
rta sbangs/ ong ril me yis lcags mi bzhu, nus med gtam gyis don mi 'grub/ mi ngan phyi 'jam nang rtsub bong bu'i ong ril 'dra/
oo di ya na'i 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
skyor shing ngam, mgo gtso/ , 1) sku rdo rje sogs mtshon don mang po/ 2) sngags kyi mgo 'dren byed/
mkhar rgyug la lag pa dang brang gi ljid bkal te ngal bso ba/
om ma ni pad me hum
(legs) spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma'o/
sgrol ma'i ming gi rnam grangs/
(legs) u rgyan yul, u rgyan la ltos/
wa kham, or pa 'jug sa'i khung bu/ chu 'gro'i or khung/
rang shed/ mi or 'thom tsha po la ngang ring gis bslab bya brgyab na gzhi nas yar thon du 'gro thub pa/ rang la bden pa med na or 'thom bshad pas khungs mi 'khyol/
(yul) chu rgyug sa'i wa mchu/ thog ka rgya che yang 'gro sa or pa'i nang red/
glo ba nas gre ba'i bar du zug pa'i dbugs rgyu ba'i lam glo yu yang zer ba de'i ming gi rnam grangs shig /
ma mchu'i 'og gi sha rus 'bur po'i ming/
chu 'gro sa'i bu ga / ol khung brtol bas 'khyil chu shar rar rgyug pa/
yu mo ol gong ngam srol gong yang zer, 'di'i lo ma dang sdong po rnams khu mang dang 'dra ba'i me tog ser po kha zum pa/
rta drel ol cham gyi nad phog tshe glo rgyag mi thub par yun ring na nas sha skem pa dang, gtso bor og ma'i 'og ma'i 'og gam gzhan du'ang rdol te rnag khrag thon pa'i rta drel gyi 'go nad cig /
mgrin pa'i mdun ngos kyi 'bur mdud/
ma mchu'i 'og tu kha 'gul dus gnyer ma zhig 'byung bas de'i ming/
au rgyan gyi 'bri tshul gzhan zhig
